en: 17108 geolocated postcards from Europeana. Data retrieved from Europeana. Geolocation process done at EPFL.

The image shows a historical black-and-white photograph of a brick industrial building located beside a small river or stream, surrounded by trees and forested hills. There are two people visible near the building, and the architecture suggests early 20th-century construction. The text on the image identifies the building as an electricity works and provides a date and photographer's name.

The image shows a hand-colored photograph of a dam (with a curved structure) and a few buildings on a hillside above it surrounded by trees. The largest building on the hill appears to be a hospice or guesthouse, and there is another distinctly visible house with a red roof. The scene is tranquil and natural, with a body of water to the right. At the top of the image, there is printed text in German: 'Talsperre Marklissa mit Hospiz.'

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a picturesque alpine village nestled in a valley, with a prominent church featuring a tall spire, traditional buildings, and dramatic mountain peaks in the background. The text at the top reads 'Fiera di Primiero m. 717 s. m.'

The image depicts a black-and-white photograph of a ceremonial event or procession. A group of young women dressed in white dresses, some with floral headbands, stand at the front holding a ribbon. Behind them, men, women, and children are gathered, many holding flags and banners. A wooden house with a thatched roof is visible in the background, along with leafy trees. The scene appears to be a festive or official event in a rural village. There is white handwritten or printed text across the bottom of the image, though it is partially obscured and difficult to read.

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a grand city square with a monumental triumphal arch and an equestrian statue. The square is surrounded by classical buildings. The arch is richly decorated with sculptural elements, and the statue depicts a man on horseback atop an ornate pedestal. There is text printed at the top of the postcard.

A sepia-toned image showing a large, orderly dormitory with rows of neatly made single beds. The room has high ceilings and large windows on one side, letting in natural light. There is a crucifix on the wall, indicating a religious affiliation. The text at the bottom identifies the location as a dormitory in a school.

A black-and-white aerial photograph showing a planned housing development or residential neighborhood. The image features several modernist, mid-century apartment blocks arranged around open green spaces, parking areas, and roads. Suburban detached homes and grid-like streets can be seen in the background.

The postcard features a black and white photograph of a building partially obscured by large trees, with a garden or park-like area in the foreground. There is French text printed below the photograph identifying the location. The design and print style suggest early 20th-century European origin.

The image shows a sepia-toned view of a waterfront area with a large chimney emitting smoke, an industrial-looking building, and a pier crowded with people. There are several seaplanes visible on the water, and many boats. The scene appears to capture a historical event or gathering, likely related to aviation or industry. The setting is likely from the early 20th century, given the presence of seaplanes and the architectural style of the buildings.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a quiet street lined with early 20th-century houses. The buildings feature wooden and stucco facades, steeply pitched roofs, and decorative elements typical of northern or eastern European small towns. The street is unpaved and appears rather empty, suggesting a rural or small-town setting. There is a sign on the building to the right, but it is mostly illegible due to the image quality.

This is a sepia-toned postcard showing a rugged coastal landscape with rocky cliffs leading to a bay. The image has vintage characteristics, and there is printed text in red at the top of the postcard.

A black and white photograph showing a small settlement by a lake surrounded by rugged, mountainous terrain with patches of snow. The buildings look like a mix of wooden and stone structures, possibly a hotel or station, with a prominent lake and barren mountain landscape in the background. There is handwriting at the bottom left of the image, and a signature or name at the bottom right.

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of striking vertical basalt columns forming a cliff, with scattered rocks at the base. The text at the bottom provides information about the site, identifying it as 'Les Orgues de Montrodeix'—a natural geological formation known for its columnar basalt structures. The scene is natural, without human-made structures, and some trees are visible at the top of the cliffs.

The image shows a sepia-toned historical street scene viewed through a large stone archway with a decorative crest above it. People in early 20th-century attire are seen walking and standing along the cobblestone street. The architecture is distinctly Northern European, with gabled rooftops and stone facades. The text 'REVAL. GROSSE STRANDPFORTE.' is printed on the lower part of the image, and there is also vertical text on the right-hand side.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a large, brick building with a steeply pitched roof and small tower or spire in the center. The architecture features arched windows and decorative elements, with a symmetrical facade. The building is set amidst a forested area, with tall, thin trees lining a road that leads directly to the entrance. There are no people visible, and the overall scene is tranquil and orderly.

A black and white photograph showing a rocky hill with a large stone formation in the foreground. A path leads up the hill to a building at the top, which appears to be a mountain hut or inn. The landscape is rugged, with scattered rocks and some vegetation. At the bottom of the image, there is German text.

The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a quaint railway station building marked with the name 'STANGE.' The architecture is wooden and typical of early 20th-century northern European stations. There are railway tracks in the foreground and some luggage carts near the entrance. Another building is visible in the background, and there is a sign that also reads 'STANGE.'

A black and white group photograph showing a formal gathering of men and women, most in suits or formal attire, seated and standing on a stage or in a hall. Some individuals are numbered for identification. There is handwriting in Cyrillic script at the bottom, describing the event and listing names and titles. The photograph has an archival or commemorative feel.

The image shows a vintage postcard with a colorized photograph or illustration. The scene depicts a peaceful street lined with tall cypress trees and a white stone fence. On the right, there is a building with simple architectural features, and a person is visible near the wall. In the background, there are hills and clear skies. The top of the postcard contains the text '110. - Dubrovnik - Lapad'.

A black and white postcard featuring a forested mountainous landscape with a building complex perched on a ridge. The complex includes what appears to be a station and possibly a hotel or guesthouse. There is a prominent road leading to the building, and a railway or funicular track is visible among the trees. The caption at the top reads: 'MENDEL. Station Mendel mit Mendelbahn, Mendelstrasse und Monte Roen.'

The postcard features a black-and-white photographic portrait of a young person with long, curly hair adorned with a bow and a visible beard. The person is wearing a necklace with a heart-shaped pendant and a dark, decorated dress. There is printed text at the bottom of the image.

The image depicts a vintage exhibition booth with the number 65, displaying a variety of metal products, documents, and boxes. The booth is decorated with a large black banner featuring the word 'ЛОРМЪ' (LORM) and the years '1922-1932', with a winged wheel design made of metallic parts. Above the booth, there is a sign in Bulgarian Cyrillic advertising an industrial company from Varna, Bulgaria, specializing in metal products. The booth appears to be part of a trade fair or industrial exhibition.

The image shows a historic postcard featuring an ornate building with large domes and elaborate architectural details. The structure is grand, with a central dome and several smaller domes, likely in a neoclassical or Beaux-Arts style. At the bottom of the postcard, there is red text, partially visible, that reads 'Bucuresti' and 'Casa de Depuneri.'

A black and white postcard showing a large, stately institutional building with a central dome and symmetrical wings. The architecture is early 20th century European. In front of the building, a group of boys or young men, some in uniform, are standing and posing. The building has large windows and a notable entrance with steps. The text on the postcard includes 'Zagreb', 'Konvikt, na šalati', and a handwritten date '29/IX 1915.'

A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a two-story wooden building identified as 'Hotel Alexander.' There are signs in both Russian (Гостиница Александров) and German/English (HOTEL ALEXANDER) above the entrance. The building is situated on a corner, with horse-drawn carriages and several people visible outside. The postcard also includes printed text 'Werro.' at the top left, and 'Verlag von F. Karlson’s Buchhandlung, Werro.' at the bottom.

The image depicts a pastoral scene with a woman in traditional Eastern European attire standing near an ox-drawn cart. In the background is a panoramic view of a historic city sprawling across low hills, with several prominent church spires and domes visible on the skyline. The scene is set at sunset, and the cityscape has a distinctly old European architectural style. There are grapevines and other agricultural activity in the foreground.

This is a vintage postcard depicting a street scene in an old European city. The image shows a gently sloping street with grand multi-story buildings on either side, people walking along the sidewalks, and a set of stairs leading up to an elevated area with trees. The image is sepia-toned, typical of early 20th-century photography. There is a round purple stamp with the text 'BIBLIOTECA PUBLICA PONTEVEDRA' at the top, and printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'Vigo. - Calle de Carral.'

A vintage, black-and-white postcard showing a winding mountain road bordered by forest. The road is clearly marked with bollards and curves dramatically up a hill. There are a few buildings visible near the top of the forested slope. At the bottom of the image, the caption reads 'Strada della Mendola (m. 1360)' in Italian.

A sepia-toned image showing a historical street parade. Women dressed in ceremonial or period costumes walk down a cobblestone street lined with crowds of onlookers. Two women in flowing robes stand at the front, and a group behind them carries a banner with German text. The street is flanked by tall buildings with flags and signs, one of which reads 'KURHAUS.'

A sepia-toned, vintage street scene showing a row of ornate, late 19th or early 20th-century European buildings. There are lines of trees and people walking along the wide street. The architecture features decorative façades, suggesting a prosperous urban area. The image has an old-fashioned aesthetic typical of early postcards.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing a lively beach scene with people swimming, sunbathing, and walking along a long pier extending into the water. Several small sailboats and rowboats are visible on the water. The shoreline is lined with trees and large buildings, likely hotels or beach facilities, and a slightly hilly terrain appears in the background. The edges of the photo are scalloped, typical of early-to-mid 20th-century postcards. No visible text is present on the image side.

The image shows a large dam with a reservoir surrounded by high mountains, some of which are snow-capped. In the foreground, there is a small wooden building labeled 'BAR', a few cars (notably, classic European models from the 1970s or 1980s), and some outdoor seating. The setting suggests a popular tourist spot, possibly in a mountainous European region.

The image shows a black-and-white photo of a busy street scene, featuring people in early 20th-century attire walking through an elaborate temporary archway structure adorned with vertical banners or flags. The street is lined with brick and stone buildings, with shop signs visible. The architecture and clothing suggest a European city, and the overall composition is consistent with historical postcards.

The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate Gothic Revival building with pointed arches, tall windows, and intricate stonework. There are a few people and a horse-drawn carriage in the square in front of the building, giving it a historical atmosphere. The text at the top reads 'Brugge. – Gouvernementspaleis en Post.'

A black-and-white postcard showing a well-maintained park or square with trees and bushes in the foreground. In the background, there are several multi-story buildings with classic early 20th-century European architectural features. The lower left corner contains the text 'Zemun, Jugoslovenski trg.'

A sepia-toned, old photograph of a man with curly hair and a mustache, showing signs of age such as creases and worn edges. The man is wearing a collared shirt and appears to be deep in thought or somber. The image is cropped closely around the face and shoulders. There is a small, faint printed mark at the bottom that reads '© Biblioteca Regional de Madrid.'

This is a color illustrated postcard divided into four comic-like panels. The top left panel depicts a large white castle on a hill under a starry night sky, with three people in yellow clothing hunched over or examining something. The top right panel shows an interior room with cobwebs, spiders, and red stains resembling blood on the walls. The bottom left panel shows two people, a man in a red checked suit and a woman in a yellow coat and hat, walking towards the castle with luggage. The bottom right panel shows the same man and woman, now holding up bars of soap and bottles labeled in German, standing on a yellow floor. There is handwritten German text under each panel and at the top.

The image is a vintage postcard showing a quiet, tree-lined road with tram tracks running through it. There are small white buildings with tiled roofs along the road, one of which has a person (possibly a toll collector or guard) standing outside. The area appears to be semi-rural, with dense woods in the background. The text 'Tol Ubbergen' is printed in red at the bottom left, along with a small windmill logo and some numbers.

A black and white vintage postcard depicting a city square with old European buildings, a canal, and a prominent statue on a pedestal. People in early 20th-century attire are seen walking near the statue. The text on the postcard reads 'BRUGES. — Place et Statue Van Eyck.'

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a busy waterfront with boats, large ships, and multi-story colonial-style buildings lining the quay. There is a lighthouse or tower visible in the distance. The waterfront is bustling with people and small boats. The overall style and print suggest an early 20th-century setting.

A black-and-white photograph showing a rural landscape with open fields, a body of water, and a small settlement. The settlement features a prominent church with a tall spire at the center, surrounded by a few houses. Farmland and gently rolling hills can be seen in the background. There is visible text in white at the bottom of the image.

This is a sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a European town square bordered by ornate buildings with distinctive architectural features, such as domed towers and detailed facades. The square is paved with cobblestones, and a few people are visible walking or standing. The photograph captures a quiet, historic atmosphere. The postcard has printed text at the top, which appears to be in German.

The image shows an ornate fountain surrounded by highly decorative wrought-iron gates set in a public square. The centerpiece is a sculptural group with classical figures and flowing water, framed by elaborate gilded gates with intricate designs and crests. The scene is surrounded by trees, suggesting it is outdoors. The postcard has a sepia tone, indicating it is likely vintage.

A black and white historical photograph depicting a small town scene with several two-story wooden buildings, picket fences, and unpaved streets. There are mountains visible in the background. The word 'Tønset' appears in the top left, and 'MINØ.43827' in the top right.

This is a vintage postcard written in Hungarian. The left side contains a handwritten message, while the right side is formatted for the recipient's address. There is a pink postage stamp labeled 'MAGYARORSZÁG' (Hungary) with a value of 8 fillér, depicting the Holy Crown of Hungary. The address is written to 'Molnár Sarika' in Budapest. The bottom margin credits the publisher: 'Barasits János Budapest.'

A black-and-white image showing a street parade with a large crowd gathered on both sides. The focal point is an ox-drawn float carrying people in costume depicting the Nativity of Christ, with a sign reading 'Gloria in Excelsis Deo.' The buildings in the background have European architectural features, and the crowd is dressed in early 20th-century European fashion. The caption at the bottom is in French and Dutch.

This sepia-toned postcard shows a large group of children and a few adults (likely priests and teachers) gathered in front of an ornate iron fence and stone gate. Behind the fence, there is a building that resembles a church or a school, and a visible cross at the top of the gate suggests a religious context. The children are dressed in formal attire, possibly for a religious ceremony such as First Communion. The scene is shaded by large trees.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a well-maintained garden or park with large agave plants, decorative hedges, and a classical statue in the background. The bottom section includes printed and handwritten text. The printed text at the bottom left says 'Park.' and at the right 'Gruss aus Semlin I.' There is also a publisher's note: 'Verlag von A. Stepper Semlin.'

The postcard features a color illustration of a scenic alpine lake surrounded by mountains, with a prominent church featuring a tall bell tower near the water's edge. There is a bridge visible in the background and a historic building on a hill. The back of the postcard contains handwritten text, postage stamps, and several postal markings. The printed text on the front reads 'Wocheinersee in Krain.'

The image shows a historic European town square with prominent old buildings. The main building is labeled 'HOTEL goldne Sonne', and nearby are other businesses with German signage. The street is cobbled, and a few people can be seen walking. The image is monochrome, giving it an antique feel, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The caption at the top reads 'Lommatzsch. Am Markt.' and at the bottom '7037. Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'

The image is an old black-and-white photograph showing a rural landscape with a winding dirt road, traditional wooden fences, scattered farm buildings, and a forested hill in the background. The scene is tranquil and pastoral. At the top of the image, there is printed text that reads 'Jyväskylä. Roninmäki.'

A black and white vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with several buildings, including a prominent two-story house in the foreground and more houses or farm buildings in the background. There are scattered trees, fenced areas, and rolling hills or low mountains in the distance. The overall setting is open countryside. The text 'Dalholen, Foldalen' is printed at the top center, and a reference number 'MINØ.24322' appears in the bottom right corner.

The image is a black-and-white photograph of a grand building with classical architecture, featuring symmetrical windows, a mansard roof, and a formal garden with potted trees and outdoor chairs in the foreground. The top of the postcard has printed text identifying the location as 'Montluel (Ain) - Château Heer.' There is a handwritten signature or note along the right side of the postcard.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a stone plaque embedded in a rough stone wall. The plaque has a decorative scroll-like border and contains a Latin inscription. The text begins with 'URBANUS EPISCOPUS SERVUS SERVORUM DEI' and references a decree dated 1367 in Viterbo, Italy, under the papacy of Urban V. The content and style suggest it is a commemorative plaque about the establishment or recognition of a Studium Generale (a medieval university or center of learning).

A vintage black-and-white postcard image depicting a grand neoclassical theater building, titled 'Le Grand Théâtre' in Bruges. The structure has prominent columns, arched windows, and elaborate architectural detailing. There is text printed in red in the upper left corner and lower left, as well as a handwritten name 'Jeanne' at the bottom.

The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a town with rows of historic-looking buildings with steep roofs, a central street, and a church with a steeple. In the background, there is a distinctive conical hill and a range of mountains, suggesting a Central or Eastern European setting. The overall style is old-fashioned, implying an early 20th-century period.

The postcard depicts a picturesque town nestled at the base of a steep, rocky hill. Atop the hill is a prominent castle or fortress, surrounded by trees. The town below features a number of buildings with red roofs and a notable church with a bell tower. The setting is mountainous and lush, suggesting a location in southern Europe. The image is colorized in a vintage style, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The word 'Arco' is printed on the top right, and there is a publisher's mark along the left edge.

The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a fortified building with multiple levels of wooden walkways and staircases attached to whitewashed stone walls. The roof is steep and covered with wooden shingles. The photo has a handwritten caption at the bottom left: 'Prejmer-Tartlau'.

The image is a black-and-white photograph of a smiling woman standing outdoors in a rural setting. She is dressed in traditional folk costume, featuring intricate embroidery, and is carrying two large containers balanced on a wooden yoke across her shoulders. In the background, there are haystacks, a wooden cart wheel, and a rustic thatched structure, suggesting a village or farming environment. The text at the bottom is in Bulgarian and German, indicating the subject relates to folk costumes from Sofia.

A black and white photograph showing a historical street parade or religious procession. The participants are dressed in period costumes, some resembling Roman soldiers and others in robes, reenacting a biblical scene (likely the Passion of Christ, with a central figure carrying a cross). Crowds line both sides of a bustling city street, and there are many flags hanging from the buildings. In the background, a tall, recognizable medieval bell tower rises above the rooftops.

A black-and-white postcard showing the entrance to an old building complex with an archway and stone walls. Two soldiers are standing at the entrance, and a sign reads 'U.S. ARMY Camp Hospital No. 52.' The background shows a church-like structure with pointed roofs and arched windows. The caption at the bottom provides historical context about the building's use during and after World War I.

The image depicts a vintage postcard featuring an embroidered or woven textile scene. The scene shows several figures in 18th-century European aristocratic dress, likely participating in an indoor fencing or theatrical performance. The figures include both men and women, posed dramatically in an ornate room with patterned wallpaper and draped curtains. The border of the postcard is decorated with a subtle embossed design. There is handwritten French text at the top and bottom of the postcard.

A vintage black-and-white postcard image showing a central town square surrounded by ornate buildings with distinctly European architecture. There is a small monument or fountain in the foreground, horse-drawn carriages, and a few people walking around. One building has a dome with a weather vane. The text at the top of the image reads 'Naumburg a. Saale. Kaiser Wilhelmplatz.'

This is a colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a prominent hill topped by a fortress or castle. The foreground includes green fields and a winding river flowing through the city. There is a bridge crossing the river, and the city is densely built around the hill. At the top, the text reads 'Graz von der Kanzel.'

The image shows a grand neoclassical building with a large dome and several smaller domes, adorned with statues and columns. The area in front is a landscaped public square with people walking and flowerbeds. The surrounding architecture is also historic, with another prominent building and a church spire visible to the left.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a tree-lined street with tram tracks and a pedestrian promenade. On the right, there is a statue on a pedestal surrounded by a small plaza. The surrounding buildings appear to be from the late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Hirschberg.' and 'Promenade.' is printed at the top.

A black-and-white postcard featuring a close-up photo of two people: a woman with dark hair (left, in profile) and a man (right, facing forward) with a bandaged head, both in period attire. The bottom of the card contains text in Finnish and the names of the actors and their roles.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a street scene with several people, including a smiling girl in the foreground making a playful gesture, and a group of men and boys dressed in early 20th-century attire in the background. The architecture suggests an old European city. There is bilingual text in English and French at the bottom, referencing the Vardar district.

The postcard is a black-and-white image depicting a coastal village with a hillside in the background. There are several small houses clustered near the shore and scattered further up the hill. A small sailboat is visible on the water in the foreground. The card is labeled 'Ferrol — La Graña' at the top, and 'FOT. P. REY.' appears at the bottom left, indicating the photographer.

The image shows an old, domed building with arched windows, likely a church, situated on a slightly elevated, rough terrain. The architecture appears Byzantine or Ottoman-influenced, with a rounded dome and simple, sturdy construction. There are a few smaller buildings and trees around it. The postcard is in black and white, giving it a vintage feel. Printed text in French and English at the bottom identifies the location and subject as an old Greek church in Salonica (modern Thessaloniki).

A black-and-white illustrated postcard depicting an ancient stone gate and surrounding buildings, with people gathered and walking in a lively square. The architecture is Romanesque, and the scene features a central arched gateway, known as 'Porta ferrea,' with several smaller structures and a columned kiosk in the foreground. The text at the bottom is in both Italian and Croatian, indicating the name of the city and the monument.

The postcard shows an old black-and-white or sepia-toned illustration of a city or town on fire, with large plumes of smoke rising from burning buildings. In the foreground, people are gathered, possibly fleeing or observing the destruction. The postcard has printed text in German in the upper left and upper center.

The image shows a vintage black-and-white postcard with a domed building labeled 'Centralno blatno kupalište' (Central Mud Bathhouse) set in a landscaped park with trees, likely from the early 20th century. The reverse side features handwritten text, a postage stamp, and a printed address section, with the recipient's name and city, Zagreb, prominently displayed.

A sepia-toned, vintage postcard depicting the Brandenburg Gate, a neoclassical monument in Berlin. The image shows the gate with its iconic columns and the Quadriga statue on top. There are people and horse-drawn carriages visible in the foreground, and an old-style street lamp on the left. The postcard has text in the upper left corner.

A black-and-white aerial photograph of a small town or village with scattered houses, a few larger buildings, and a body of water (lake or river) in the background. The landscape is lush and green, with a mix of open fields, trees, and a grid of roads. The structures are mainly single-family homes with pitched roofs, and there appears to be a rectangular building with a flagpole in the center, possibly a school.

The image depicts a black-and-white group portrait of around eighteen people, most of whom are wearing costumes that suggest a theatrical or festive occasion. Some individuals are dressed in traditional Eastern European folk attire, while others wear suits, ties, or theatrical makeup (including fake mustaches and expressive facial paint). The background appears to be an indoor setting with curtains, possibly a parlor or stage. The overall presentation resembles an early 20th-century posed photograph, possibly for a theater troupe or cultural event.

The image shows a historic, ornate building with steep gabled roofs, brick walls, and multiple windows. There is a prominent exterior staircase leading up to an elevated entrance. The photo has a vintage, colorized appearance typical of early 20th-century postcards. At the bottom, 'Waaggebouw Nijmegen' is printed, identifying the location.

A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a picturesque canal scene in Bruges, Belgium. On the right is a large, ornate Gothic-style building with pointed towers and elaborate decorations, likely the Palais du Franc. The left side of the image shows a tree-lined street with two children standing near the water’s edge. Two swans are swimming in the canal. In the background, a small stone bridge crosses the water. The postcard includes French text at the top and along the left margin.

A black-and-white postcard showing a seaside promenade with several people walking along the waterfront. There are boats on the water, and buildings and hills can be seen in the distance. Trees line the promenade on the right-hand side, and the setting gives a peaceful, historical vibe. Greek text and a watermark are visible at the bottom of the image.

This image depicts a vintage postage stamp with blue and brown colors. The central image features human figures, possibly soldiers or allegorical characters, with a large overprinted '2 Mk.' (mark) in the center. The border contains various denominations ('70 PEN', '15 PEN') and text in Estonian, including 'EESTI POST' and 'VIGASTATUD SÕDURITELE'.

A vintage, colorized view over a European city with a prominent church tower with an onion dome in the foreground. The city is surrounded by mountains in the background and has red-roofed buildings and lush greenery. The style and quality of the image suggest an early 20th-century printing technique. There is text at the top in German.

A vintage black-and-white postcard shows a panoramic view of a town surrounded by fields and hills. Prominently visible are clusters of old buildings and a notable church structure. The top of the postcard contains printed French text describing the view and location. The title 'YSSINGEAUX' is bolded, and the postcard is marked as part of a series called 'Le Velay Illustré.'

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a public square with a prominent neoclassical building in the center. Behind the building, a large hill with a castle or fortress (Ljubljana Castle) rises in the background. The square is labeled 'Kongresni-trg.' The reverse side contains handwritten text, a postage stamp, and postal marks, indicating it was mailed.

This is an old postcard featuring multilingual text, including French, German, Hungarian, Polish, Russian, and English, indicating its use in international correspondence. The card is addressed and stamped, with a red postage stamp bearing a crown and Cyrillic script. The address includes 'Alexandri ul. 76.' and 'Turjet'. There are several postal marks and a handwritten address.

The image shows a picturesque, forested mountain village with a small lake at its center. The surrounding area is densely wooded, with a scattering of chalet-style buildings, hotels, and what appears to be a church. The architecture features steep, reddish roofs typical of Alpine or Central European mountain resorts. The lake is bordered by a road and more buildings, and the scene is viewed from an elevated rocky vantage point.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a public square in Bruges, Belgium. The foreground shows people in early 20th-century attire walking and socializing. On the left, there is a building with a sign reading 'MERCERIES'. In the background, a prominent medieval tower (the Belfry of Bruges) is visible. On the right, there is a grand, ornate building, labeled as the 'Hôtel du Gouvernement'. The postcard is captioned in French at the bottom.

A black-and-white photograph showing a large statue on a pedestal, surrounded by snow-covered trees and landscape. The statue appears to depict a robed figure holding a cross, possibly a saint or religious leader, and is situated in a park-like setting. The scene is wintry, with heavy snow on all visible surfaces.

A sepia-toned image showing a large, multi-story wooden building with a fire escape staircase on the left side. The building is surrounded by hedges and a paved road. The text 'MT. ALTO SAN. INFIRMARY' is visible in white letters at the bottom left of the image, suggesting the building's function as a sanatorium infirmary.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a park with tall trees framing a view of a stone fortress wall and tower in the background. There is a circular feature (possibly a fountain or a garden bed) in the foreground. The postcard has text written in a white script at the bottom: 'Dubrovnik - Park Gradac.' and 'FOTO-BERNER 46.'

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large, brick, institutional-style building with an orderly facade, gabled roofs, and many windows. The building is set behind a metal fence and is located on a tree-lined street. The text at the bottom provides location and building details.

People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and in the street, and trees line the right side next to a street lamp. The printed caption at the top reads "Finsterwalde, N.-L. — Berliner Straße". Shop signs are visible on the left façades.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Kamenz from the south. A curving railway line runs along the left foreground, while fields and a dirt path occupy the right. In the distance, the town's skyline is visible with a prominent large church dominating the center-right, surrounded by houses, industrial chimneys, and other buildings. The lower part of the card is blank for writing, with the caption and publisher information printed near the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a baroque entrance façade with a grand semicircular staircase leading up to three arches. In the central arch is an ornate niche with a statue. Decorative railings flank the steps, and the building features a tiled roof and sculpted pediment. Trees frame the view. Printed caption text runs vertically along the right side; the right half of the card is blank for writing and address.

Sepia-toned historic photograph of a Middle Eastern street scene dominated by an ornate mosque with a large patterned dome and a highly decorated minaret. The building shows alternating light and dark stone courses and arched windows. In the background there is another slender striped minaret. People in traditional long garments walk along an unpaved street lined with older buildings. At the bottom center, a small printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears, likely added by the archive and not original to the postcard.

A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a hilltop castle complex rising above a town with pitched-roof houses and trees in the foreground. The large Gothic and Renaissance-style building complex is prominently featured on the ridge, with towers and spires visible. The lower margin has printed red script text identifying the site and city, and there is a small vertical printer's credit on the left side.

Sepia-toned view of a landscaped public park with a flowerbed in the foreground, open lawn and paths, and rows of trees in the background under a cloudy sky. No visible buildings, monuments, or printed text appear in the image.

Black-and-white postcard view of a railway station complex with freight wagons on curved tracks in the foreground and several station buildings behind them, bordered by a forested hillside. The printed red caption at the top reads "Klingenberg i. Sa. Bahnhof", and a red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.

A colored vintage postcard-style illustration showing a group portrait of Tibetan people in traditional clothing, labeled as inhabitants of Lhasa. They are arranged in two rows against a painted background. Beneath the image is printed text in Dutch referring to Lhasa as the holy city of Lamaism and promoting Liebig products, with a facsimile Liebig signature on the right.

Colorized vintage view of a harbor with large steamships docked at a pier, crowds of people along the waterfront promenade, and a town stretching along the bay and hillside in the background. The printed title at the top reads in Spanish about Santander and a general view of the port. There is also handwritten text along the right margin.

Colorized vintage postcard view framed by evergreen trees, looking down onto a wide inlet or channel. A large white ocean liner with multiple masts and smokestacks sails through the water. In the distance are low hills and coastline. At the top is printed caption text indicating the ship and location.

The image shows a postcard reproduction of a large mural or altarpiece framed by a pointed Gothic arch with pinkish ribs and ornate golden borders. The painting depicts a medieval or early‑Christian royal figure in rich robes and crown, holding a processional banner topped with a cross and laurel, surrounded by warriors. One kneels before him with outstretched hands, while another stands with a round shield and sword; discarded armor and weapons lie on the ground. In the background are additional soldiers and a landscape. A Latin inscription runs along the bottom in a decorative golden frame.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large, rectangular early-20th-century school building with many tall windows and a steep, tiled mansard-style roof. The school stands on a small rise with bushes and trees in the foreground. Another wooden house is partially visible on the right. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, along with a small printer's mark.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a lakeside promenade in a landscaped park. A curving path runs along the water's edge, bordered by young trees and shrubs. Across the lake, densely wooded banks rise toward ornate late‑19th‑century villa or hotel buildings with turrets and steep roofs, set against a forested hillside. On the right foreground, a well‑dressed man in a long coat and hat and a small girl in a patterned dress and wide‑brimmed hat stroll along the path, suggesting an upper‑class leisure scene from the turn of the 20th century. A tiny boathouse or pavilion sits at the shoreline of a small wooded island in the lake.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a lakeside or pond scene with small rowboats carrying people in the foreground. Behind the water is a tree‑lined shore with tall birch trees partially obscuring a large traditional inn or guesthouse building. The caption at the bottom reads in German "Moritzburg bei Dresden — Adams Gasthof." The overall style suggests an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

Black‑and‑white image of a forested outdoor café in front of an elegant pavilion-style building with a steep tiled roof, dormers and a small clock on the façade. The structure has many tall windows and stands on a raised stone base. In the foreground among tall pine trees are metal café tables and folding chairs covered with patterned cloths. A well‑dressed man and woman in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century attire sit on chairs, with a child standing nearby. The scene suggests a resort or spa restaurant in a wooded, hilly landscape.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a riverside view of a large church with a tall clock tower and adjoining episcopal residence on a hill above the Elbe River. Below the buildings are terraced gardens, trees, small houses and people near the riverbank. Printed captions in German identify the location as Leitmeritz on the Elbe and describe the cathedral and bishop's residence.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a historic European town nestled in a valley, with dense trees in the foreground. Prominently on a hill stand a church with a tall tower and an adjacent castle-like complex with towers and fortified buildings. The background shows rolling hills or low mountains. At the top left of the image is printed German text identifying the place.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an early airfield with two biplanes flying overhead. On the ground are simple wooden buildings and a tall signal mast with flags and a spherical object. In the foreground a fenced area and several people are visible. Text at the bottom reads "SOUVENIR VLIEGKAMP – SOESTERBERG".

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural lakeside scene. A dirt path lined with tall trees runs along the edge of a pond or small lake. Reeds grow at the water's edge, and open fields and scattered houses or farm buildings are visible in the background. In the lower left corner, there is German text printed in a decorative script.

Colored postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city. The tower has a steep tiled roof, timbered upper structure, and a massive clock face with Roman numerals on a stone base. Trees frame the left side, and at the bottom right a person in early-20th-century clothing stands by a path and railing, looking out over the rooftops and distant hills. Printed text at the top identifies the location in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large group of uniformed boys or young sailors posing in rows in front of a wooden building with a pitched metal roof and chimneys. Several trestle tables and a lectern or display stand are set up in front of them. The image is framed by a white border with printed captions, and the lower margin is densely covered with handwritten text.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a stream or river flowing through a rocky canyon with hills in the background. On the right side, several people sit on large rock outcrops above the water, surrounded by natural vegetation. The card has printed captions in red ink, including the site name at the bottom and publisher/printing details along the sides, plus a red handwritten or printed number in the lower-right margin.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a large cargo ship named ORION navigating through sea ice. The vessel has multiple cargo masts and booms along its deck and a rounded superstructure amidships. Low, snowy or icy land is visible in the distant background under an overcast sky, giving a cold, northern maritime impression.

Color image of a river with rapids in the foreground and calmer water upstream, crossed by a distinctive wooden truss bridge on concrete piers. A person in a striped shirt sits on rocks at the riverbank with a small dog, looking toward the water. The far bank is densely forested with coniferous and deciduous trees under a partly cloudy sky. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view over the rooftops of a historic European town. Dominating the scene is a large church with two baroque-style towers (the cathedral), and beside it a fortified complex with round towers and a large building (a castle and courthouse). The foreground is filled with smaller townhouses and industrial chimneys. At the top in red Gothic-style script are printed captions identifying the location and buildings.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a fast‑flowing river with rapids and small waterfalls running between rocky banks and wooded islets. Industrial buildings and mills line the right bank, while a few larger houses stand further upstream on the left. The scene is bordered by a light frame, and at the bottom in green print is a caption reading "Toppö- och Gullöfallet."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a steamship named S/S RHEA sailing close to a breakwater or harbor entrance. The ship has two masts, a single funnel, lifeboats on deck and several passengers visible along the railings. The sea is calm and a low lighthouse or beacon stands on a small islet to the left. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the ship and the publisher.

A sepia-toned postcard-style image mounted on a page, showing a large monument with a dramatic statue in the foreground and people walking around a wide square. Behind it rises a neo‑Gothic church with twin spires and an attached large building complex. The caption beneath the photograph appears in three languages and identifies the scene as the Monument of Palacký.

Stylized Art-Nouveau/early Modernist illustration of a pavilion-like building with a steep, multi-peaked green roof, three front bays with statues in niches, vertical decorative panels, and flower arrangements flanking the entrance. In the foreground is a patterned plaza and red-railed walkway. To the right, a flagpole flies a checkered red, white, yellow and black flag. Decorative text in a geometric type appears on the left side of the building.

Black‑and‑white street view labeled "Elsterwerda — Hauptstraße" showing a cobblestone main street lined with early‑20th‑century buildings and shopfronts. A church tower with a clock and tall spire rises prominently in the center background. Horse‑drawn carriages and a few pedestrians are visible further down the street. The image has margins and typography typical of an old photographic postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large, continuous block of multi‑storey residential buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. The block forms a gentle curve along a street, with several arched entrances and shopfronts on the ground floor. In the foreground is an empty, ploughed field or open ground. On the far right edge stands a round corner tower with a conical roof attached to the last building. At the top of the card, printed captions read "Riesa a. Elbe" on the left and "Sedanstraße" on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a small European town in a wooded valley. A curving main street runs through tightly packed multi‑story houses with steep roofs; hills and dense forest rise on both sides. On a hill in the distance stands a ruin or castle complex. Printed German captions in red at the top left identify the view as from the ruins in Tharandt, and a publisher's imprint appears on the right.

Black‑and‑white view over a cobbled main street in a European town, likely early 20th century. People walk along the street and a horse‑drawn carriage stands in the foreground. Dense rows of two‑ and three‑story houses with steep slate roofs line the street. In the background rises a large church with a tall tower and spire, and a patterned roof on the nave. On the left facade of a building there is German text advertising a business.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a seaside view of old stone fortification walls and towers along the shore, with rough water in the foreground and a sailing ship at left. The text below the image, in French and English, identifies the scene as the old walls of Constantinople seen from the Sea of Marmara.

Vintage monochrome postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a village street (Dorfstrasse) with traditional houses and a prominent church with a tall spire and clock tower in the center background. A person walks along the unpaved road, and wooden fences line the street. The lower image shows a large two‑storey school building (Schule) with many windows and a hipped roof, surrounded by a metal fence and small trees. The captions are printed in red German script.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a vaulted restaurant or dining room with modernist patterned ceiling decoration, long tables with white tablecloths and chairs arranged in rows. Wall lamps, framed pictures, and coat racks line the walls. Printed text at the lower right reads "Burgkeller Meißen. Gastzimmer".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned street lined with multi‑story buildings featuring shops and awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. On the right is a building with a sign reading "CAFÉ D'EUROPA / CAFÉ DE L'EUROPE." The caption at the bottom reads "Trento. Via Lunga." There is handwritten cursive text across the bottom and along the right edge and top margin. The left margin has the photographer's imprint.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long wooden building with a gabled roof, identified as a museum. In front or alongside the building is a large whale skeleton or similar large marine skeleton structure arranged in an arching display. The ground around the building is bare earth. Printed red captions in Russian and German appear at the top, and there is a publisher line in Russian at the bottom right, plus a handwritten inscription along the bottom edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white view of a small alpine town square. In the foreground on the right stands a stone fountain in front of a traditional building with shutters and a religious image on its facade. On the left are fenced houses with balconies and a roadside water trough with a pump. In the center background a three‑story building carries the sign 'PANIFICIO COMUNALE'. Rolling hills or low mountains rise beyond the town. Along the bottom margin, printed in red, is the caption 'Romeno - Alta Anaunia - m. 962'.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm river flowing between rocky banks with large boulders and scattered trees along the shore. The water reflects the rocks and vegetation, and the sky is lightly clouded. Printed text at the top reads "Ambriz." on the left and "Aspectos do Rio Loge, No. 1." on the right.

Color printed postcard showing a hilltop baroque pilgrimage church complex surrounded by green fields and scattered houses, with distant low mountains under a blue sky. At the bottom is the printed German caption "Gruss aus Maria Trost b. Graz," and there is cursive handwriting across the borders and sky area. Along the left edge is the printer's imprint mentioning Karl Braun & Co., München.

Sepia-toned portrait of a woman in elaborate 18th‑century style stage costume: a voluminous striped gown with ruffles and floral decorations, and a large feathered wig-like headdress. She holds a fan in front of her. The background is dark and indistinct, typical of a studio or theatrical setting. White text at the top right identifies her and the role, and small text at the bottom right credits the photographer and city with a date.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town built along a river with a small arched bridge. Dominating the scene are a massive round stone tower with crenellations and a large church or fortified building with a tall, pointed spire. Traditional pitched‑roof houses cluster on the riverbank and up the hillside, with open farmland stretching into the distance. The style suggests an early 20th‑century photograph used as a postcard. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a park landscape with a waterway curving through the foreground, dense trees, and on the left a prominent medieval round brick tower with crenellations. Behind the trees a large historic building with a steep roof is visible. The caption beneath the image identifies the scene as Kronenburgerpark in Nijmegen. At the bottom left there is a small publisher's line and a card number.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing steep rock cliffs covered with pines rising above a calm river. A rowing boat with several people is on the water in the foreground. At the top in red Gothic-style type is the caption "Hans Heiling bei Karlsbad und Elbogen." The scene depicts a rugged forested gorge in a natural landscape.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European urban square with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The central façade is long and baroque‑style, with a tiled roof, dormer windows and detailed window frames. On the right side stands a corner building with two onion-domed towers and cupolas. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians are visible in the square in front. The lower part of the image and right side margin are heavily covered with handwritten cursive text. Printed caption text is faint but runs vertically along the right edge and horizontally near the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, crenellated medieval brick tower standing in an open square with a few people in early 20th‑century clothing. Mountains rise in the background, and surrounding the tower are several multi‑story buildings. Printed red text in the upper right names the location, and publisher information appears in small red type at the lower right border.

A colorized panoramic view of a mountain town with many villas and hotels scattered across rolling green hills and forests. In the foreground stands a large multi‑story building with red roofs, while more houses and lodgings extend into the valley and up the slopes. Soft, rounded mountains rise in the background. At the top of the image, German text identifies the place as Ober‑Krummhübel in the Riesengebirge, with an additional label pointing to a specific peak.

Black-and-white postcard showing a tranquil reservoir bordered by trees and gentle hills. Two rowing boats with people are on the lake, while two children and an adult sit on a bench at the right foreground looking over the water. In the distance are forested hills and scattered buildings. The caption at the bottom left reads "Sohland/Spree – Stausee," and a small code "K3160B" appears in the bottom right corner.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a central market square with landscaped greenery in the foreground and a row of historic townhouses and hotels in the background. Visible signs on the buildings include "Hotel zum Hirsch," "Hotel goldner Löwe," "APOTHEKE," and other shop names. A fountain or monument with a lamppost stands on the square, with a few people and horse-drawn carriages. Printed captions at the bottom read "Stolpen." on the left and "Markt." in red on the right, with the publisher credit "Brück & Sohn Meissen." along the lower margin. Handwritten signatures are present across the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Italian square. On the right stands a large Romanesque cathedral with an octagonal dome, rose window, arched colonnade, and side portico. To the left are old palazzi and a crenellated civic tower. In the foreground is an ornate fountain topped by a Neptune statue. A few people are seen walking in the square with mountains in the distant background. Caption text is printed along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a large two‑story inn or community building labeled "Schützenhaus" in the center, with a smaller building on the left and trees on the right. Two people stand in front of the main entrance. Rolling fields, scattered trees, and low hills form the background landscape. The overall look is of an early‑20th‑century central European countryside.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large baroque-style castle on a rocky hill above a river. In the foreground a side‑wheel steamship travels along the water. Trees and a stone bridge or gate are visible to the right of the castle. Printed red text at the top identifies the site, and a small vertical imprint at the left edge names the publisher.

Colorized historic postcard showing the façade of a rectangular museum building with arched windows and a central arched wooden door, flanked by classical statues and flowerbeds in the foreground. A small tower-like structure rises from the roof. Printed multilingual captions at the top identify it as the imperial museum of Brussa/Brousse (Bursa).

A vintage greeting postcard with scalloped edges featuring a hand-painted botanical illustration of pale purple-white flowers with green leaves on the right side. On the left, there is cursive text in a Scandinavian language. The background is light cream with a subtle wash behind the flowers.

Sepia-toned postcard showing ancient stone ruins with four arched niches in a wall, partially preserved columns in front, and several men in early 20th‑century clothing posing among the remains. The setting appears to be an archaeological site. Printed captions and handwritten notes are visible at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white street scene in a small town, showing an unpaved road lined with trees and a few pedestrians in the distance. On the right stands a two‑story functionalist building with the large sign "SVENSKA HANDELSBANKEN" on the facade, indicating a bank branch. Further down the street are additional modest multi‑story buildings and detached houses surrounded by trees, under a clear sky.

Black‑and‑white historical photograph showing a formal procession in front of a monumental colonnaded building. In the foreground is an open horse‑drawn or motorized carriage with uniformed officers in long capes and peaked caps; one elderly man sits wrapped in a cloak. To the left a uniformed rider or motor officer passes close to the camera. Behind them, dense crowds of civilians and officials in early‑20th‑century dress stand on steps between tall classical columns; a period streetlamp rises at the right.

A black-and-white historical postcard showing a wide cobblestone street lined with low colonial-style buildings. People, including adults and children, walk or stand along the street. Low hills or mountains rise in the background. On the right is a long, walled military-type building with an arched entrance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center of the image.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad town square with young trees planted in orderly rows, a circular fountain or monument in the center, and a bandstand or pavilion. Behind the square stands a row of colonial-style buildings with tiled roofs and arched windows. The caption in red at the top reads: "Cabo Verde – S. Thiago – Praça do Albuquerque."

A colorized vintage postcard view of a hospital complex with several low, whitewashed buildings with red-tiled roofs arranged along an open courtyard. Wooden shutters cover the windows, and there is a central path lined with a few trees. A nurse or staff member in white clothing stands at the steps of the building on the right. The caption at the bottom is in Portuguese and identifies the place as the secretariat and wards of the hospital in São Tomé.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a riverside cityscape with three bridges crossing a river. On the right, a steep hill with fortifications and a prominent clock tower rises above the town. Church towers and dense historic buildings line both banks. At the bottom margin, there is printed German text and a handwritten date.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic town hall building with a steep tiled roof, ornate gables, clock and tower with a weather vane. The facade has arched entrances at street level and several windows; a sign reading "Stadtkeller" is visible on the right side, above an awning. Small figures and a bicycle stand in the square in front of the building. Printed text at the top left reads "Lommatzsch i. Sa. Rathaus."

Black‑and‑white photograph of a concrete bridge over a calm river or canal. A group of about a dozen people in formal or semi‑formal clothing stand along the parapet, leaning over the balustrade and looking toward the camera. The bridge has simple rectangular openings in the railing and multiple supporting piers, reflected in the water below. Trees and foliage line the riverbanks in the background. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Gothic cathedral with a tall central spire and multiple smaller spires, surrounded by bare trees. In the foreground, a long procession of boys in choir robes with crosses on the chest walks toward the camera. Printed Norwegian text appears in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand vaulted hall in a historic building. The room has high, ribbed Gothic ceilings and pointed arch doorways. Large wall murals depict dramatic battle and historical scenes with soldiers, horses, and crowds. The lower walls are paneled in dark wood. There is an ornate wooden cabinet on the left, a circular table with carved chairs on the right, and a wall shelf above a doorway holding a large globe and books. The photograph has a narrow black border, and on the far left edge there are faint handwritten numbers or notes.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of the Elbe riverfront in Dresden, showing a busy steamboat landing with docks, small boats and people working along the quay. In the background rise prominent historic buildings and church towers of Dresden's old town, with a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing the river. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German, along with a publisher credit and number.

A colorized panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. There are multiple villas, sanatorium‑style buildings, and a church tower in the foreground, with more scattered houses on the wooded slopes behind. At the top, printed text in German identifies the place as Schreiberhau and mentions a health resort area with sanatoriums.

Color-tinted, aerial-style view of a European town square dominated by a large, two‑storey neoclassical public building with a central pediment and red-tiled roof. Tree-lined streets encircle a rectangular plaza in front of the building. To the right stands a tall, cylindrical brick water-tower-like structure; behind are low industrial buildings with a smoking chimney and a river or large body of water in the distance. Rows of modest townhouses with pitched roofs line both sides of the square.

Vertical postcard with a minimalist light-grey background. At the top is the text 'EESTI ÜHISPANK' with a yellow horseshoe logo inside a square between the words. Below, numerous glowing yellow horseshoe symbols are arranged in a triangular, Christmas-tree-like shape, creating a festive, stylized design.

Black‑and‑white image showing an old suspension bridge with massive stone pylons spanning a wide river. A tram runs along the embankment in the foreground, and ornate lampposts and railings line the riverside. On the bridge towers there is a coat of arms, and on both the bridge and the riverbank there are signs reading "VÁMHÁZ." Historic multi‑storey buildings with towers are visible on the far bank.

A black‑and‑white street scene lined with birch trees and wooden buildings. Vintage cars and several cyclists travel along a quiet avenue. There are shopfronts on the right, one with a sign reading "FRISÖR". Printed caption text at the lower left reads "Umeå. Skolgatan." and at the lower right is publishing information and a number. The overall style resembles a mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic town hall on a cobbled square. The building has several stories, a steep tiled roof, and a tall central clock tower with an ornate baroque spire and weather vane. Two large clock faces are visible on the tower. The façade includes many rectangular windows, decorative gables, and an elaborate main portal at ground level. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the open square; small carts stand at the left edge. The sky is blank and white, emphasizing the architecture.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural landscape with fields in the foreground and a small village in the distance. A dirt road runs along the right side toward the village. There are scattered houses, trees, and what appears to be a church or mill with a tower. The lower part of the card is mostly blank with printed red Gothic-style text. A red number "131" is written or printed in the top right corner, and small vertical publisher text appears along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view overlooking a coastal town with flat-roofed white buildings beside the sea. On the right foreground stands a traditional round stone windmill with a thatched conical roof and radiating spars, characteristic of the Cyclades. The sea and distant land are visible in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the scene as Mykonos and describe it as a partial view.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside village with low stone or brick houses scattered across the slope. In the foreground there is a large gathering or procession of villagers, many wearing traditional dress and head coverings, some with animals, moving along a path. Mountains and rolling hills form the background. Printed French captions appear below the image, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible over the lower right of the photograph.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with historic multi‑story buildings bearing German signage. In the center-right stands an ornate stone fountain or monument with statues. Shop signs advertise goods such as colonial wares, cigars, wine, spirits, delicacies, and confectionery. A few children and a horse‑drawn carriage are visible, suggesting an early 20th‑century European scene.

A monochrome, illustrated riverside scene showing a paddle-wheel steamship with two smoking funnels towing barges along a broad river. On the opposite bank, a town with clustered houses rises on a hill, dominated by a large church or cathedral with a tall nave and tower as well as several other steeples. Sailing vessels are moored near the nearer bank, and trees frame the foreground. The style resembles a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century engraved or lithographed postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European city corner. On the left is an ornate multi‑story brick building with decorative stonework; its ground floor hosts a shop with signage reading "Drogerie." On the right is another multi‑story building with balconies and a ground‑floor dairy shop, with signs for milk, butter, eggs, and cheese. A relatively quiet street with a few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart extends into the distance between rows of similar residential buildings. At the top in red script is the caption "Limbach i. Sa. Königstrasse." The overall layout and typography strongly resemble an early 20th‑century postcard.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a deep-winter landscape in a mountainous coniferous forest. Heavy snow covers tall fir trees, the ground, and a simple wooden fence in the foreground. On the right side a lone skier stands on skis in the snow. Handwritten red numbers appear at the top margin, and a German caption is printed along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white night photograph of a large Baroque/Baroque‑Revival church with an ornate tower and statues along the roofline, dramatically illuminated by streetlights. Light trails from passing vehicles curve along a cobblestone street or bridge in the foreground, emphasizing long‑exposure photography. The scene has no visible printed caption or writing on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, neoclassical military barracks complex standing on open sandy ground with low vegetation in the foreground and a cloudy sky above. The large, multi‑story buildings have a central portico with columns and symmetrical wings. Handwritten text along the bottom edge identifies the location, and a photographer's credit appears on the right.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a hilly spa town with many large villas and sanatorium-like buildings on the slope, dense forest around, and a railway line with station buildings and train carriages in the foreground. The words "Bad Gottleuba" appear in the upper left.

A monochrome panoramic view of a European town set in rolling countryside. In the middle distance are dense rows of houses and larger public buildings, with a prominent church featuring a tall central tower and spire. Smokestacks and factory buildings dot the right side, suggesting early industrialization. In the foreground are fenced fields, trees lining a road, piles of stone, and a small wooden shed. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the town as Warnsdorf i. B. and the publisher information with a date.

A hand-colored historic postcard showing a long, light-colored barracks-style building with a central pavilion, mansard roof, and dormer windows, set behind a large field of greenery. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Printed red and black German text appears on the lower margin, including the town name "Oschatz" and the name of the barracks "Franz Joseph Kaserne." Publisher information and a note indicating it is a hand-colored artist card are also printed at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, classical-style educational building and surrounding grounds in winter, with bare trees in the foreground and additional school buildings in the background. Handwritten and printed Swedish text labels the scene and publisher, including the place name Uppsala.

A black‑and‑white interior view of a museum room filled with wooden display cases holding specimens such as shells, fossils, and taxidermy. Glass cabinets line the walls and stand in rows, with hanging light bulbs from the ceiling. The caption printed at the bottom reads: "St. Canisius College, Nijmegen Museum".

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Gothic-style Protestant church with pointed arches and tall corner towers. A large crowd of people, including many children, is gathered in front of the entrance. The image is framed by a beige border, and a caption is printed below the picture.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a coastal town and harbor area with scattered houses, low buildings, and fields descending towards the sea. Hills rise on the left, and the shoreline curves into the distance. At the top left is a printed caption in French identifying the scene as the port of Karlovassi on the island of Samos. At the bottom right is a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a spa pavilion set in front of a dense forest. The low, modernist building has large glass doors and a central round glazed tower topped with a statue. Trees and potted topiary line the front colonnade. Caption text in German appears at the bottom.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a hilly rural landscape with fields, orchards, and patches of forest. In the foreground and mid-ground stand several ornate late‑19th‑century mansion-like villas and larger industrial buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, suggesting a factory complex. On a wooded hill in the background sits a prominent manor or small castle with a tower. The scene appears European and early‑industrial, with no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image itself.

An old sepia-toned street scene showing a town road lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings on both sides. At the far end stands a larger, more ornate building with a tower-like roof. A horse-drawn cart is on the right side of the street and a child stands on the sidewalk. The title printed at the top in red reads "Geithain, Chemnitzer Strasse." Additional German shop signs are visible on the building fronts.

A monochrome postcard showing a heavily bomb-damaged urban area centered on a ruined church with two surviving towers and a gaping hole in the main structure. Surrounding buildings are roofless shells and rubble. At the bottom border there is a printed caption identifying the location as the surroundings of the Franciscan church in Nijmegen.

Illustrated postcard combining a lively fairground scene with a small colored inset view of a European town square. The main illustration, mostly in monochrome, shows people at a fair with a puppet booth labeled "Kasperl-Theater," children and adults walking, and people sitting at tables. The inset image is a colored view of a central square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with red roofs, a fountain or monument in the middle, market stalls with umbrellas, and a hill in the background topped by a clock tower and fortification. German text at the top and on the inset identifies the scene as Graz and mentions the autumn fair.

Black-and-white image of a grand, empty ballroom or reception hall in ornate late Baroque/rococo style. The long room has a polished parquet floor, high decorated ceilings with elaborate stucco and gilded moldings, multiple large crystal chandeliers hanging in a row, and wall sconces with candelabra. Along the walls stand many upholstered chairs in a uniform style. There is an ornate fireplace with a mantel and bust, tall double doors with carved panels, and heavy curtains. The image is framed by a wide white border that is scuffed and worn, suggesting an old printed postcard or photographic card.

Sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a hilly, semi-rural landscape with scattered villas, vineyards, and a small castle-like building on a hilltop. The foreground contains trees and a grassy slope, while the middle ground shows a village spread through a valley. Printed German text in red appears at the top of the card.

A colorized aerial view of a European city with a river running through the center, lined by dense rows of red‑roofed buildings and several bridges. The vantage point is from an elevated hill covered with trees, looking across the old town toward flat countryside and low hills in the distance. Printed text at the top reads in German, identifying the scene as a view from the Schlossberg hill looking south over Graz.

Sepia-toned portrait of an opera singer in costume, standing with arms slightly outstretched against a dark studio background. She wears a long flowing classical-style dress with a decorated sash and a floral wreath on her head. Text at the top identifies her and her role, and small text at the bottom right credits the photographer and gives a date.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of nine small photographs of city scenes. Captions in German label various locations: a grand outdoor staircase and landscaped garden in the Stadtpark, a river scene on the Elbe with a steamboat and industrial riverside buildings, a remaining section of an old city wall in the park, large multi‑storey former military barracks (Ehem. 32er‑Kaserne), a circular landscaped square labeled Adolf Hitler‑Platz surrounded by buildings, a tree‑lined path in the city park called Brandenburger Weg, a large arched steel bridge over the Elbe (Elbbrücke), and additional views of the Stadtpark. A red number "26367" is handwritten in the upper right margin.

Black-and-white postcard view of a neo-Gothic Catholic church with a tall, slender spire topped by a cross. The church has pointed-arch windows, a steep roof with small dormers, and is surrounded by trees and adjacent town buildings. The background shows a slightly hilly landscape. Printed German text identifying the location and church appears in the upper left corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural road leading toward a church tower partly hidden by large trees. A small horse‑drawn cart travels along the dirt road while a person walks on the left side near fields. On the right is a farmhouse or outbuilding with a tiled roof and wooden fences. Printed captions at the top identify the place and the Lutheran church in multiple languages (Cyrillic and German).

Black-and-white postcard showing a large historicist university building with ornate facades, statues along the roofline, arched entrances, and manicured grounds in the foreground. The caption at the bottom right reads "GRAZ-UNIVERSITÄT," and the publisher credit at the bottom left reads "ERIKA-VERLAG-GRAZ. 84".

A black‑and‑white photograph of two substantial late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century buildings in a landscaped setting. The nearer building is a two‑storey, stuccoed structure with a steep tiled roof, symmetrical façade, tall rectangular windows, and a central entrance reached by steps. Modest classical detailing decorates the gable above the doorway. In front is a sloped lawn with paths crossing a small park‑like area. Several children and a few adults stand or sit along the paths and near the steps. In the background to the left stands a larger three‑storey institutional building with arched windows on the top floor. Trees and simple fencing border the grounds. The image has blank margins and slight damage at the edges, consistent with an old postcard or glass‑plate reproduction.

Black‑and‑white view of a small spa or resort town in a forested mountain valley. In the foreground stands a large wooden or partly masonry villa with ornate balconies, arched veranda, and a tall central turreted roof. A picket fence and a narrow bridge over a small stream lead to a road on the right, where several people in early‑20th‑century clothing are walking. In the background are more multi‑storey villas or hotels and dense conifer-covered hills. The overall style suggests a central European alpine or Black Forest resort.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small mountain resort village surrounded by dense coniferous forest and rolling hills. Traditional steep‑roofed houses sit in a valley, framed by tall fir trees in the foreground. At the bottom margin there is a printed German caption describing the spa town and its elevation in the Ore Mountains.

Sepia-toned old postcard showing a dense cluster of wooden and brick houses with pitched roofs in a small town. In the foreground there is a fenced yard and several men gathered near a low wooden building. Further back are more modest houses and chimneys, with leafless trees forming a wooded ridge in the distance. On the skyline two church-like structures are visible: one with a tall, thin spire and another with a squarer tower and dome-like top. The overall scene suggests an early 20th‑century Central or Eastern European town. No printed caption or writing is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European spa or small town nestled in forested hills.
