In the lower left stands a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance style building with arched windows and a flat, balustraded roof; behind and above the town on the right is a hilltop church with a tall tower and onion‑shaped spire. Smaller houses with pitched roofs sit among dense trees in the valley. The image has the framing and composition of an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white image showing a group of early‑20th‑century soldiers in dark uniforms and peaked caps standing in formation outdoors on a sandy training ground bordered by trees and grassy embankments. On the left, an officer sits at a small wooden booth or desk while another soldier stands beside him holding a notebook. At the center, an officer appears to be inspecting or adjusting the equipment of a soldier wearing a backpack and rifle; another soldier stands at a small folding table with papers. In the background is a low earthen berm or shooting range wall. The scene looks like a formal military inspection or training exercise. No printed caption or text is visible on the image itself.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic railway station complex with a tall clock tower and arched train hall. Horse‑drawn carriages and people stand in front on a cobbled square. On the right is a smaller building marked 'TELEGRAAF-TELEGRAPHE'. Printed caption text in French at the bottom identifies the scene as the station of Bruges.

Colorized postcard-style image showing a boy in traditional Alpine clothing holding a chalkboard with cursive German text, standing in front of a picturesque river city. Across the river are grand historic buildings and a bridge, with a steep, wooded hill rising behind them crowned by a fortified complex and a clock/bell tower, under a clear sky.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard view across a river toward a large hilltop castle complex with towers and steep roofs, above a row of townhouses along the waterfront. At the top left in red lettering it reads "Meissen. Kgl. Albrechtsburg." At the bottom left in smaller red text it credits a publisher and date. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a two‑storey fire station building with large arched doors for fire engines and a tall lookout tower on the right side. Trees line the street in front of the structure. At the bottom of the image is a caption in Latvian identifying the location.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley, with rows of gabled houses, farm buildings, and trees in the foreground and forested hills in the background. At the bottom right, there is a printed caption identifying the place as Wilthen and specifying the district Oberdorf with a panorama toward Dietrich.

Color postcard showing a solitary round stone tower with a conical red‑tile roof. Around the upper part of the tower there is a wooden overhanging gallery with windows. The tower stands beside a dirt road lined with leafless or early‑spring trees; a single person is walking in the distance. The scene is rural and calm under a clear blue sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

A vintage colored postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple green onion domes and ornate façades. The sky has a gradient from light tan near the horizon to blue at the top. In the upper left corner, German text reads "Libau. Kathedrale." The lower right corner has small text identifying the source. The style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

A color postcard showing a small rural town in a wide green valley surrounded by steep, rocky, forested mountains. In the foreground there are orchards and cultivated fields laid out in rows. The middle ground has scattered light‑colored houses with red or brown tiled roofs, a low industrial building, and electric poles. Further back, a clustered village with a church tower stands at the base of a hillside. The sky is bright blue with wispy clouds. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large church with a tall clock tower and spire on a cobblestone square. The building has steep tiled roofs, arched windows, and smaller turrets. Printed red text at the top reads "Radeberg i. Sa. Kirche." with ample blank space on the right, typical of early picture postcards.

Black‑and‑white view from a gently winding hillside road with a wooden railing, where a boy in old-fashioned clothing is standing and facing the camera. To the left is a steep, tree‑covered hill with a villa or small manor house visible among the trees. In the valley and plain beyond, there is a town with church spires and scattered houses, and low hills on the distant horizon. A stone wall and a single utility pole stand on the right side of the road. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image itself.

Colorized vintage street scene showing ornate late‑19th‑century brick buildings around a square. The architecture is Dutch with steep roofs, dormer windows, and decorative brickwork. In the foreground three children in coats and long skirts stand on a broad paved area bordered by low metal fencing and trees. The caption at the top reads "NIJMEGEN. KEIZER KARELS PLEIN."

A monochrome historic street scene showing several multi‑story stone buildings with steep tiled roofs, likely in an old European town. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stand and walk along a cobblestone street between the buildings. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Reval and specifically the cathedral school (Domschule). Publisher information is printed in small text along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside covered with the ruins and remaining buildings of the medieval town of Mystras. The structures climb up the slope beneath a fortress at the summit, with some trees and branches framing the scene. A white margin at the bottom contains printed captions in Greek and French and a publisher credit.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural riverside village with clustered houses and trees along a broad river. The foreground shows wooded riverbanks, and flat agricultural fields extend into the distance. At the top left, printed text in German reads "Niederlommatzsch a. d. Elbe" indicating the location on the Elbe River.

Black-and-white view over a rocky seaside harbor with small boats and a ferry docked at a pier. The scene shows low barren islands in the distance, simple wooden buildings near the pier, and canoes or small boats pulled up onto the rocks and grass in the foreground. The word "BRÄNNÖ." appears at the bottom left, and a triangular publisher's logo with the number 5234 is printed at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a historic European town street with a church tower in the foreground and a large castle-like complex rising behind the townhouses. In the lower part of the image there are gardens and trees along a wall, and a narrow street with a few people walking. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European street scene. Multi‑story townhouses and civic-style buildings line a broad cobblestone street bordered by bare trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the street, and a small cart is visible in the center. At the top of the image in red printed script is the caption indicating the location: 'Pirna a. Elbe' and 'Obere Burgstrasse'.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a small wooden church with shingled exterior walls and a steep gabled roof, seen from the front entrance. A hedge-lined path leads to the doorway. Leafy trees surround the church and a cemetery is partly visible to the left. In the lower left corner is the printed caption "Näshults kyrka." In the lower right corner is a photographer/publisher imprint inside an oval cartouche and some Swedish text.

Colorized panoramic view of a small alpine village nestled on a green hillside, surrounded by forests and high mountains. At the center stands a church with a tall steeple among clustered houses with red and light-colored roofs. In the foreground is a stone wall and sloping meadow; in the background are rugged peaks. Along the bottom edge there is a handwritten-style caption in Italian.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a park scene with a tennis court fenced in wood, set against a wooded hillside. In the foreground a young man in early 20th‑century attire sits on a wooden bench with a straw hat beside him. A winding path leads into the trees on the left. Printed captions at the top read "Piatra N." on the left and "Parcul Cozla, Tenis" on the right, with a handwritten number over the sky area.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view framed by a stone archway, showing a cobbled square with horse‑drawn carts and people in early 20th‑century dress in front of a church wall with a large round clock. The church has a steep tiled roof and Gothic arched doorway. In the background are old town buildings with German signage. At the bottom margin is German caption text identifying the scene.

Colorized vintage view of a grand neo‑Renaissance town hall building dominating a central square. In front of it is a market scene with stalls, umbrellas, people walking, and a tram on tracks running through the cobbled square. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Printed text at the top identifies the location.

A monochrome, likely early‑20th‑century street scene showing multi‑storey stone apartment buildings with steep, snow‑dusted roofs and small bay windows along a broad avenue. Leafless trees line the street, and several pedestrians walk along the snowy sidewalks. In the top right corner appears the printed caption "Tammerfors - Tampere."

Black‑and‑white landscape view of open fields leading to a lake, with a forested shoreline in the distance. In the right foreground stands a small dark wooden farmhouse beside a tree and a traditional split‑rail fence running across the scene. There are a few grazing animals in the fields and several telephone poles. White printed captions appear at the bottom with the location name and photographer's credit.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small European town bordered by open, gently rolling farmland. In the foreground are tiled‑roof houses and a few larger masonry buildings, one of them an ornate multi‑storey structure with dormer windows and decorative gables. A narrow river or canal with stone embankments runs through the town, crossed by a modest bridge. Industrial elements are visible, including tall brick chimneys and a rectangular factory‑like building. Beyond the clustered houses, a straight tree‑lined road leads out into patterned agricultural fields stretching to the horizon. The overall scene is semi‑rural with a mix of residential and light industrial architecture. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village in gently rolling hills, with scattered traditional houses, meadows in the foreground filled with wildflowers, and dense forest in the background. The architecture is typical of Central European mountain villages, with steep roofs and timber elements. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white view of a European old town with a narrow canal or millrace running between cobbled walkways. Wooden railings and small weirs or sluice gates line the water. On the left are half‑timbered houses; on the right a tree‑lined promenade with iron railings. In the distance, behind more historic buildings, rise two church towers with steep spires. The scene is quiet with only a few small, indistinct figures; there is no visible printed caption on the image.

A black-and-white postcard view of a calm river or harbor with several moored sailing boats and small rowboats along a tree-lined quay. Smoke stacks and low buildings are visible in the distant background on the right bank. The water reflects the boats and tall masts, and fluffy clouds fill the sky. Handwritten text appears at the bottom of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad promenade in a landscaped park lined with trees, shrubs, palms, and scattered benches along the path. At the top, in red letters, it is labeled with the city and a caption. At the lower left there is an ornate printer's or publisher's mark, and at the bottom the country and a number are printed.

Black‑and‑white image showing a forest path running along a rocky outcrop on the left, with rustic wooden benches and railings on both sides of the trail. A wooden shelter or pavilion is partly visible against the rock. Tall coniferous and deciduous trees fill the background. A woman in long, late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century dress and hat stands by the railing, looking toward the view. There is no visible printed text on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooden church on a low hill, surrounded by fields and trees with a simple fence in the foreground. The church has a tall, pointed central tower and a smaller tower behind it, in a Nordic stave‑church style. In the sky area, printed text reads "Rupert.-E. Vang".

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate stone fountain or commemorative structure with columns and decorative reliefs in a tree‑lined park. A wide path and lampposts run through the park, with benches visible in the background. Along the bottom border there is a printed caption in multiple languages.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered stone bridge leading toward a historic castle complex behind bare trees. Heavy snow blankets the ground, bridge, and rooftops. At the bottom left, printed caption text reads "SCHLOSS GRILLENBURG im Winter."

A multi‑view vintage postcard showing several colored photographs of dramatic waterfalls, rapids, forested cliffs, a bridge over a river gorge, and a riverside hotel. Captions on each small image label specific viewpoints and features of the falls area. At the bottom, large stylized white letters spell out the destination name 'TROLLHÄTTAN'. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist postcard highlighting the waterfalls and river scenery around Trollhättan.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist exhibition hall building with large vertical windows and a flat roof. The facade bears the inscription "GRAZER MESSE" with a coat of arms in the center. In the foreground is an empty street, a sidewalk, lampposts and some trees. At the bottom margin the caption reads "GRAZ. MESSEHALLE." with a small photographer's credit "W. KRAMER" in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a quiet residential street with multi‑storey houses on both sides, fenced front gardens, telegraph poles, and a single overhead streetlamp suspended on wires. A small child stands with a dog in the foreground on the left. Trees line the street and low hills are visible in the distance. The caption at the bottom reads "Coswig i. Sa. Spitzgrundstraße".

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a corner building on a sloping street. The multi‑storey structure houses a liquor factory and wine shop owned by Karl Kohn, with large German signs along the facade. Early utility poles and surrounding town buildings are visible. The right half of the card is mostly blank for writing, with printed captions in red indicating it is from Karlsbad and refers to the Bahnhof (railway station) area.

A black-and-white postcard view of a small European town taken from an elevated, tree-framed vantage point. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire rising above a cluster of gabled houses and rooftops. Trees and gardens fill the foreground, and the town extends into the background under a cloudy sky. In the lower left corner, the caption 'Dahlen i. Sa.' is printed.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the façade and bell tower of a large church integrated into a row of urban buildings. People stand and walk in front of the entrance on a city street. The lower margin of the image bears printed caption text identifying the scene as the cathedral of Grenoble.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfall in a wooded, hilly landscape in winter or early spring (leafless trees). In the foreground there is a wooden or metal conduit or aqueduct supported by posts, with a small bridge structure. The waterfall drops from a rocky height amid trees. Printed French captions at the top identify the location as a cascade near Granges, in the environs of Saint-Nectaire, and a small credit line to the publisher appears at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a large Renaissance-style castle or manor complex situated by a wide, curving river in open countryside. The ensemble includes tall rectangular towers with stepped gables and small cupolas, long residential wings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, and farm or garden buildings in the foreground. Trees and formal gardens surround the buildings, with expansive agricultural fields and a tree line along the distant riverbank.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural European town surrounded by fields and forest. In the foreground there is dense woodland; beyond it lie clustered houses and farm buildings, a church with a tall spire in the center, and gently rolling agricultural land stretching to the horizon. At the top left in red gothic-style lettering is the caption 'Klingenberg i. Sa.'.

Color-tinted historic postcard showing a Byzantine church converted into a mosque, with a prominent dome and smaller domes, arched windows, and an added Ottoman minaret. A long, low tiled-roof building stands in front, with a person visible near the entrance. Printed captions in French and another script (Ottoman Turkish/Arabic) identify the site and indicate it is a souvenir from Salonika.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a very large winter crowd filling a broad city street and adjacent tree-lined promenade. People wear long coats, fur hats, shawls and headscarves, suggesting a cold climate in the early 20th century. A brick public building with decorative masonry lines the left side, and tram or trolley wires run above the street. In the center distance some people hold a flag or banner, indicating a march, rally, or demonstration. Bare trees and snow on the ground frame the right side; the image has the appearance of a historic postcard view of a northern European city during a mass gathering.

Colorized vintage riverside view showing the town of Riesa on the Elbe River. In the foreground is a grassy and pebbled riverbank with an anchor lying on the ground. Across the water sits a long paddle steamer named "PILLNITZ" with smoke stacks and cabins. Behind the ship is a row of multi‑story town buildings with red and gray roofs, small warehouses, and a church spire rising in the distance. The caption in German is printed at the top left.

Vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a riverside cityscape with a bridge in the foreground and a church tower with an onion dome on the right. A hill with fortifications rises behind the town. Pedestrians walk along the embankment, and the river runs through the scene. On the bottom left is printed the caption "GRAZ von der Albrechtsbrücke." There is vertical publisher text on the left margin and handwritten cursive text on the right side, plus a circular postal cancellation mark overlapping the image.

Sepia-toned harbor scene showing several steamships and boats moored along a calm waterfront lined with multi‑story buildings. The reflections of the vessels and houses are visible in the water. The image has printed captions identifying the place.

A monochrome (black‑and‑white) industrial scene showing a large sawmill complex by the water with timber logs laid out in long rows in the foreground. In the middle stands a long, light-colored factory building with many windows and a tall chimney emitting little or no smoke. Surrounding it are smaller wooden houses and industrial structures, with forested hills in the background. Printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom margin of the image.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a broad cobblestone street lined with grand late‑19th‑century buildings. On the left is a stately two‑story villa with a balcony and fenced garden; on the right stands a larger ornate brick building with elaborate roof decorations and small towers. In the foreground a horse pulls a simple wooden cart, and a few pedestrians walk near the gated entrance. The title print at the top reads "Wurzen. Bahnhofstrasse." and there is a faint red publisher/date line along the bottom edge.

A vintage, surreal black‑and‑white illustration of a distorted city square. Tall townhouses and a central clocktower lean and twist as if melting or swaying. A park with a fountain or geyser sends ribbon‑like streams of water into the air on the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll, dance, and gesture animatedly in the square. The word "GRAZ" is printed in bold letters in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a wide, mostly empty plaza or square bordered by multi‑story European‑style buildings with balconies. On the left side are several horse‑drawn covered wagons and carts lined along the street. In the foreground to the right is a low, arcaded structure with several large round arches; people are sitting or resting in the shade beneath the arches. Above the arcade stands a modest two‑story building with a palm tree behind it. The setting looks historical, likely late 19th or early 20th century.

A black‑and‑white street view of a historic European town with cobblestone pavement and multi‑story townhouses lining the right side. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street, and a small vendor cart stands in the foreground. Shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including an inn or guesthouse. The street curves gently into a small square bordered by more traditional gabled buildings.

Black-and-white photograph of a historic hilltop complex overlooking a river, showing a large castle-like structure with multiple steep roofs and towers alongside a Gothic cathedral with tall spires. Below, a town with densely packed houses and trees spreads down to the waterfront. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage cityscape showing a busy European urban square with tram tracks and an electric streetcar in the foreground, pedestrians crossing the cobblestone streets, horse‑drawn carts, ornate multi‑story buildings with elaborate façades, and domed and towered structures in the background. The scene is labeled at the top with printed captions indicating the city and the specific square.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small European town in a hilly, rural landscape. In the middle ground are compact, gabled houses and larger masonry buildings along a narrow street, with trees and gardens around them. A church with a tall spire rises in the left background. The foreground is an open, grassy or crop-covered slope. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing, with the printed caption "Stadt Bärenstein." in red at the bottom center.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an ornate Ottoman-style public fountain set into a wall with carved and patterned stonework. A man in traditional dress bends to take water from the spout into a shallow basin, while a child in similar dress stands nearby. The fountain niche is arched and richly decorated. French caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a central square or park with a bust monument in the foreground, surrounded by flower beds and curved paths. Behind it stand two large neoclassical public buildings. The left one is an ornate, older structure with a clock tower and the inscription in Cyrillic on its façade. The larger right-hand building is a symmetrical three‑storey block with many windows and a sign over the entrance in Cyrillic that appears to be the name of a gymnasium or municipal institution. People, horse-drawn carts, and workers are visible in the square. Low hills rise in the background.

Vintage monochrome panoramic view of a town seen from a field with a curving path in the foreground. In the distance are rows of houses, church towers and chimneys, forming the skyline of a small European town. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, with the town name printed in red script at the center bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central town square with a prominent historic town hall building topped by an ornate tower. In front of the town hall is a small monument or fountain, a horse‑drawn carriage, and a few pedestrians including a child in period clothing. Surrounding the square are multi‑story houses with steep roofs and dormer windows. The title "Waldenburg i. Sa. Rathaus." is printed at the top in red, and there are publisher details and signage such as "Rathskeller" visible on the town hall façade.

Black‑and‑white image of a European city street with ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses. In the foreground is a large, pale, three‑storey corner building with Baroque/Neoclassical detailing, high gabled roof and a broad exterior stairway leading up from a cobbled street. Trees and a fenced garden are on the left; a long row of similar buildings continues along the street to the right. Pedestrians and children with bicycles stand on an unpaved or lightly paved roadway; a taller tower‑like building appears in the distant background along the same street. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a small Neo‑Gothic chapel or mausoleum in a forest. The central structure has a steep gabled roof topped with a cross, pointed‑arch doorway with decorative tracery windows, and small circular windows above. It is flanked on both sides by pergola-like arcades covered with climbing plants and vines, with long benches beneath. A path leads up a few steps to the entrance. Two seated figures in early 20th‑century clothing are visible on the benches to the left and right of the central structure. Tall coniferous trees surround the site, giving it a secluded, park‑like atmosphere. No legible printed title or caption is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from an elevated, wooded foreground looking down onto a European town in a broad valley with mountains in the distance. The town is dense with traditional gabled houses and several prominent church towers; at the right stands a large cathedral‑like church with a tall tower, while at least one more slender church spire rises near the center. The photograph shows fields and orchards around the town and low mountain ranges at the horizon. The image edges are worn and scratched, giving it an old‑photo / early‑postcard appearance. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story townhouses. People walk along the left sidewalk and horse‑drawn carts are visible further down the street. Trees and a small square or garden appear on the right. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Altenburger Strasse in Geithain, and the publisher line notes Brück & Sohn, Meissen, with the year 1905.

Color postcard-style landscape view of a green, hilly valley framed by tall conifer trees in the foreground. In the middle distance there is a small town with clustered houses and a prominent church with a bell tower, set against a sloping mountain. The sky shows a gradient from pinkish near the horizon to blue above. The caption "Folgaria." appears in red text at the top right.

A sepia-toned vintage street scene titled "Riga Theaterboulevard." It shows a broad cobblestone boulevard with early electric trams, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Multi‑story classical buildings line both sides of the street, including a domed structure on the right. Trees and a large building appear in the background, suggesting a central urban avenue near a theater district.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad town square or parade ground bordered by trees and long, classical buildings. In the distance are low mountains or hills. Benches and a few people are visible in the shaded central area. German captions in red label the view as Theresienstadt, with specific buildings identified as the town hall (Rathaus) and the commandant's house (Kommandantenhaus). Printer information is at the bottom.

A monochrome historic postcard showing an elegant European city street with multi‑storey stone or brick buildings featuring arched windows and awnings. In the foreground is a landscaped park with paths, trees, and a person walking; a horse‑drawn cart appears on the street. Printed captions in Swedish are at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white view of an elegant European spa town or resort. In the foreground is a landscaped park with manicured lawns, shrubs, conifers, a small pond and a low waterfall. On a small rise stands a pavilion or colonnade covered in greenery. Behind the trees are large ornate late‑19th‑century hotel buildings with elaborate facades, balconies and turrets; one has a domed corner tower. A sign on the distant roof appears to contain the word "KURHAUS" or similar, suggesting a grand spa hotel. The overall look is that of a historic postcard photograph.

Black‑and‑white/sepia street view showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and in the distance church spires rise above the rooftops. At the top in red Gothic-style script is the caption 'Oschatz. Lutherstraße.'

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large historic church with a tall central tower and steep gabled roofs, set on a slight hill surrounded by trees and fields. A path or country road leads toward the church. At the bottom of the front image is a caption in German script.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a lakeside residential suburb bordered by dense coniferous forest. Small detached houses with gabled roofs are spread out along curving streets, each with gardens or small plots of land. A shoreline with trees and dark water appears in the lower left, while forest stretches along the top edge of the image. No visible text appears on the front.

A colorized historical street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue with tram tracks, several trams, horse-drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Multi‑story brick and plaster buildings with shops line both sides of the street, and a church or town-hall style tower with a clock rises in the background on the right. Printed greetings and captions appear in German, Russian, and another script at the top of the card.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over gently rolling farmland and fields divided into irregular plots, with a few scattered houses or farm buildings nestled among trees. The scene is viewed from an elevated vantage point, with distant wooded hills fading into the horizon. Printed caption text appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a hilltop with a tall cylindrical stone tower capped by a lantern-like lookout and pointed roof. The tower stands beside a small building partly hidden by dense trees. Winding footpaths and a narrow road climb the hillside, with a few telegraph poles and scattered houses lower down. In the distance are rolling hills or low mountains; the overall scene suggests a Central European hill town and an old watchtower or lookout tower.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooden church with a central tower topped by a cross and star finial. The building has a metal roof, tall arched windows, classical details on the tower cornice, and is partly obscured by trees and a small fenced area with a monument. The sky is mostly clear with scattered clouds. Printed captions on the image identify the church and the publisher/photographer.

Black-and-white aerial photograph depicting a dense waterfront city with many islands and inlets. At the top center, white text reads "Stockholm från aeroplan". At the bottom left are small publisher credits, and at the bottom right a round photographer's mark. The overall layout and typography strongly resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a large rectangular Renaissance‑style castle or manor with steep gabled roofs and a central tower with a spire, seen from a wooded hillside. A dirt path with a simple wooden railing leads through dense trees and bushes in the foreground, while open countryside stretches into the distance behind the building. No visible text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white view of a European small‑town square with cobblestone pavement. At the center stands a fenced obelisk‑style monument bearing round medallions and plaques. Surrounding it are 3–4 story houses with tiled roofs and shuttered windows. Commercial signs in German advertise businesses such as a steam laundry, a hotel or inn, and a textile shop. One man walks across the foreground while another stands by the monument.

A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a straight, slightly rising street lined with 2–3 story townhouses on both sides. The buildings have shuttered windows and ornate façades, with a few pedestrians visible on the sidewalks and a lone figure walking in the middle of the street. At the end of the street there is a wooded hill filling the background. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location as Graz and the street name Laimburggasse.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad urban square with a central circular fountain and surrounding streets. Early automobiles, carriages, and a tram or bus travel around the square. Multi‑story European‑style buildings frame the scene, including a prominent classical building in the center background. The card bears postal cancellation lines and stamps over the image, and printed caption text at the bottom reads that it shows Cairo's Opera Square.

A sepia-toned photograph of a narrow cobblestone street lined with long colonial buildings. On the right, a projecting wooden balcony with a tiled roof juts out from the corner of a stone wall, characteristic of Spanish colonial architecture. Overhead, utility wires and a single hanging streetlight are visible against a misty sky. At the bottom, a caption in Spanish identifies the scene as a colonial corner and the 'camarín' (chapel or dressing room) of the old church of the Monastery of El Carmen in Bogotá, Colombia. A small printed number appears in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a calm river or pond in the foreground, bushes and reeds along the bank, and reflections of trees in the water. On the left stands a large, simple multi‑storey house or manor with a sloped roof, smaller outbuildings beside it, and cultivated land. In the middle distance are several small houses and tall trees, while in the background a rocky, wooded hill or low cliff line rises across the scene. At the bottom right, there is a white area used for a caption written in German cursive, with some words struck through and additional handwritten notes or numbers.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large two‑storey building with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows and a central pediment above the main entrance. A flagpole with a flag rises from the roof. The house is fronted by a fence and gate opening to a street with trees and adjacent smaller buildings. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A black‑and‑white image shows a stone suspension bridge crossing a deep, wooded valley. Massive masonry pylons support the bridge, whose deck is carried by a lattice of vertical hangers and cables. Behind and above the bridge on a hill stands a large medieval stone castle complex with multiple towers and steep roofs. To the right of the castle is a baroque‑style church with a tall spire and cross, and several multi‑storey town buildings. Forested hills form the distant background.

Tinted early-20th‑century postcard showing several people sitting on rocks in the rapids of a forested river. Dense tropical vegetation surrounds the fast‑flowing water. At the bottom is printed caption text and an editor credit, with additional handwritten notes and a date.

Black-and-white vintage view of a harbor with sailing boats and a steamship moored along a quay. On the left, low waterfront buildings with awnings line the promenade; people walk along the pier and work around the moored boats. Hills rise in the background. Greek text is printed at the top left, and a circular seal plus the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appear on the lower right.

A black‑and‑white image showing a young woman in traditional folk costume knocking on a heavy wooden door in a timber interior. She wears a long striped skirt, a patterned apron, a white blouse with puffed sleeves, a vest, and a kerchief or headscarf. The wooden door and wall feature carved decorative details typical of old rural architecture.

A colorized historic postcard view of a busy riverside wharf with paddle steamers and barges docked along a wide river. On the sandy bank are horse‑drawn carts, stacked wooden crates, sacks, and people loading or unloading goods. Trees line both sides of the river. Printed caption at the bottom reads: "The Wharf, River Murray, Mildura."

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a rural lakeside scene. In the foreground is a fenced dirt field leading up to a traditional wooden house with two chimneys and shuttered windows. A smaller outbuilding stands nearer to the water behind the main house. Hills or low mountains rise on the far side of the lake. Printed text appears at the top, identifying the location as a country store.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a long, ornate brick barracks building along a cobblestone street lined with young trees and iron fencing. A guard post stands at the entrance gate, and another domed building is visible in the background to the left. Handwritten-style captions in German appear at the upper left and right of the image.

A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a wide river winding through a steep, forested valley or canyon. Pine‑covered hills rise on both sides, and a narrow railway or road follows the river along the left bank. The sky is filled with layered clouds. At the very top edge there is faint, mirrored handwriting or numbering from the original negative.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial Central European town in a river valley. In the foreground is a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a river with a rocky shore. On the left stands a factory complex with tall chimneys and the name "S. WOLLE" on the facade. Across the river are several multi‑story townhouses and commercial buildings; one bears a sign "Max Weichhold". In the distance a church with a tall spire rises above the rooftops, with hills and scattered buildings in the background. The caption at the top left reads "Aue i. Erzgeb." indicating the location in the Ore Mountains.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, simple Baroque-style manor or small castle with a long, steeply pitched tiled roof and regularly spaced windows. The building is partly obscured by large trees in front, with a central entrance approached through a landscaped garden and two white lion statues flanking the path. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the title identifying the place.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a decorative fountain in a circular basin surrounded by lush trees, flowerbeds, and park paths in a landscaped city park. Sunlight filters through the foliage, illuminating the spray of water from the fountain. At the bottom margin there is multilingual printed text identifying the location, along with a small publisher's logo on the left.

Black‑and‑white view along a calm river or wide stream bordered by forest. On the right bank stands a partly ruined masonry building attached to a more intact house with a pitched roof and simple windows. A dirt path runs beside the house. In the mid‑distance on the left bank, partly hidden by trees, is a romantic villa or small castle‑like house with a pointed turret and timber‑frame details, built directly above the water. The scene is rural and tranquil, with no people or text visible on the image itself.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated stone entrance gate with an arched doorway and heavy wooden doors, adorned with carved floral and martial motifs. Above the arch is a triangular pediment with sculpted cannons and a central coat of arms. Through the gate a small courtyard and part of another building façade are visible. At the bottom edge of the image there is printed caption text indicating the location.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a wide tree-lined open square with paths and lawns (the Esplanade), bordered by multi‑storey arcaded buildings on the left and further buildings in the distance. There are printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom and a postal cancellation stamp at the top right.

Old postal card with Russian imperial coat of arms on the left, a printed red heading in Russian, handwritten Latin‑script address in pencil or ink, and a brownish-red Russian stamp on the upper right with circular date cancellations. The card is creased vertically and horizontally, showing wear from mailing.

Colorized vintage view over a lakeside village surrounded by high mountains. In the foreground are tightly packed red‑tiled houses and a small church with a red roof and bell tower. The lake dominates the middle of the image, with steep mountains and a small peninsula or island in the distance. At the top center the word "Molveno" is printed, and on a building or sign in the lower left appears the text "EL MOLVENO".

Black-and-white postcard view of a small coastal town with a curved waterfront and pier extending into a calm bay, backed by steep, barren hills. Low, mostly white buildings line the shore. There are a few small boats moored near the pier. Greek text appears along the bottom left and center, with French text on the right, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river scene on the Elbe at Mühlberg. In the foreground a long paddle steamer is moored or moving along the river, with smoke coming from its funnel and people visible on deck. On the opposite bank stand a cluster of buildings surrounded by trees, including a prominent manor‑ or castle‑like structure on a slight rise. The printed caption at the top in German identifies the location and mentions the harbor scene with the castle.

A vintage illustration of a young boy in a checked suit and red bow tie pouring a large bottle of champagne into an overflowing coupe glass. On the left lie a black top hat, a wrapped gift with a bow, greenery, and a cork on the ground. The background is a plain dark blue with a light border, and there is no visible text.

Black‑and‑white view of a large, plain Baroque‑style manor house or small palace with a steep tiled roof featuring multiple small "eye" dormer windows. In front is a formal vegetable and flower garden bordered by low stone walls and hedges. A dirt lane runs alongside the garden, where several children in early 20th‑century clothing stand, one pushing a baby carriage, while a horse‑drawn carriage with two horses approaches from the distance. On the left edge another building with similar plastered walls and multi‑pane windows is visible, with a person looking out. The overall scene is rural, calm, and somewhat staged, typical of early photographic postcards.

A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over a European city with dense tiled rooftops along a river with several bridges. In the left foreground there is a wooded hillside with a path and a pavilion-like structure. The bottom margin contains handwritten cursive text, and in printed red type the word "Graz" appears. The publisher credit "L. Strohschnedler, Graz" is printed in small red type at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large fortified complex on a hill above trees. The ensemble includes a long, steep‑roofed Gothic‑style building with many small gabled dormers and pointed arch windows, a tall church spire, a richly ornamented central roof with pinnacles, and curtain walls with battlements and a prominent square gate tower on the right. The foreground is a rough, cultivated field and dense trees; the sky is blank and overexposed. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the image side.

A colorized portrait postcard showing a uniformed officer in elaborate dress with a tall white plumed helmet and many decorations. He stands in the center framed by a decorative border. At the top there is Greek text and a red star. At the bottom, flanked by olive branches, are two Greek flags crossed beneath a royal crown, with the years 1821 and 1912 on either side and Greek words along the lower edge.

A printed postcard with a central black‑and‑white illustration framed like a stamp. The image shows a large, aggressive male face with exaggerated features behind a sleeping infant, with flames on both sides and the word "Ruhr!" at the bottom. Above are denominations "50 Mark + 1 CcO" and the year "1923". Below the illustration on the card are German captions crediting the etching to Ludwig Hesshaimer, titled "Die schwarze Schmach", described as a design for a Ruhr relief stamp, along with the publisher information and the number 53.

Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city with many red-tiled roofs, tree‑lined streets and a few larger light‑colored buildings in the foreground. In the distance are green hills with scattered structures on the ridgelines. The caption in the upper left reads in German "Graz von der Roseggerwarte." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a rural dirt road leading toward a large metal bridge in the background. On the left are a few traditional Dutch houses with tiled roofs surrounded by hedges, while on the right is a fenced field. Telegraph or power lines run above the road. The image is bordered by a white margin with printed captions in Dutch at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate church interior wall and vaulted ceiling. The wall features a framed triptych painting depicting Christ, the Virgin Mary, and surrounding figures. Above the painting is a sculpted cherub with outspread wings, and the vaulted ceiling is richly decorated with stucco reliefs of angels, drapery, foliage patterns, and classical mouldings. Light enters from a multi‑pane window on the right, partly overexposing that side. A handwritten marking, likely an archival number, appears at the lower left edge.

Vintage multi-view postcard with three sepia photographs of a German village. The upper left view, labeled "Total", shows an elevated panorama of the village with clustered gabled houses and surrounding fields. The lower left view, labeled "Dorfstraße", depicts a village street lined with simple residential houses, fences, and trees. On the right, a view labeled "Kirche" shows a church with a tower at the end of a tree-lined path. In the lower right corner, printed caption text identifies the place as Gröden, Kreis Liebenwerda.

Black-and-white postcard showing a cargo ship named FLORIA on calm water, viewed in profile. The sky is cloudy, and low shoreline with buildings or trees appears in the background. The lower margin includes printed captions identifying the vessel and the shipping company.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a canal-side scene with a traditional Dutch windmill in the background, trees lining the water, and houses along a quiet street. The image is vignetted, and printed text identifies the scene as "Weesp." Additional publisher information is printed along the left edge.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a crowd gathered around stone arches and a spring emerging from a rocky hillside. Above the arches stands a long, low building with a tiled roof. The terrain is mountainous and rocky. There is printed bilingual titling in Greek and French at the bottom, plus handwritten Greek text across the lower margin. A circular postal cancellation mark is visible in the upper right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modern mid‑20th‑century hotel building in a snowy landscape. The hotel has four to five stories, a flat roof, and a simple façade with rows of square windows. The word "HOTELL" appears vertically on the left side of the taller block, and on the right block a sign reading "Restaurant" is visible above the ground‑floor level. Deep snow covers the foreground, suggesting a cold northern climate.

A colorful postcard with a yellow-to-orange gradient background. Large block letters spell 'DUKENBURG', filled with images of a canal, greenery, modern buildings, and a red structural element, likely a local landmark. At the top left, smaller text reads 'GROETEN UIT'. At the bottom right is a red logo with the letters 'SP.' and a small tomato symbol.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a photograph of an ancient round Greek mirror with a relief of a woman's face with curly hair. The object is centered on a plain background. Beneath the image, printed in small capital letters, are the title and the institution: on the left, the label of the artifact and approximate date, and on the right, the name of the museum. The lower half of the postcard is blank for writing.

Black‑and‑white view taken through tall conifer trees over a small town in a forested mountain valley. In the middle distance stands a church with a square tower and bulbous dome roof, surrounded by dense evergreen woods. Closer to the foreground are several multi‑storey buildings with steep, hipped roofs and large windows, typical of early‑20th‑century Central European alpine or spa architecture. Forested hills rise in the background, giving a secluded mountain‑resort atmosphere. No visible printed caption or border text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white military postcard showing a temporary pontoon bridge over a river. Soldiers in early‑20th‑century uniforms are marching across the bridge, while several officers stand at the near end. Small boats are lashed together supporting the wooden roadway. On the opposite bank there is open countryside with a few tall trees and low buildings. Red printed German text appears along the top margin.

Black‑and‑white night view of a snowy European square with a large baroque fountain in the foreground. The multi‑tiered fountain is topped by a trident‑holding figure and surrounded by statues at its base, all covered with snow. Behind it stand several multi‑story historic buildings with shuttered windows and arcades at street level. Leafless tree branches frame the upper edge of the image, and shopfronts with illuminated signs are visible along the ground floor.

Black‑and‑white photograph of the interior of a traditional wooden log house with exposed beams and plank floor. A large white masonry hearth or oven sits in the middle against a log wall, with wooden benches and tools around it. On the left stands a spinning wheel and a simple wooden chair; on the right are long poles or ladders leaning against the wall. Through an open doorway another room with a table and a large window can be seen. Captions in a Scandinavian language are printed at the bottom of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a steamship entering a harbor with small lighthouses on breakwaters and several sailing boats in the background. The image is printed in a sepia tone with Swedish captioning at the bottom and handwritten text over part of the lower margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a tree‑lined avenue with wooden and brick buildings on both sides. In the distance a horse‑drawn vehicle and a few pedestrians can be seen. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Östergatan in Vänersborg. A sign on the left reads "Elia Kapellet" on a wooden building, and at the lower right the publisher credit appears.

A multi-view color postcard with a bright blue border, showing modern seaside resort buildings and beaches along a forested coastline. The top-right image shows a tall hotel tower labeled "International" on a busy beach by the sea. The lower-right and left images show terraced hotel complexes nestled in green hills and a marina or sailing club with small sailboats on the water. Large white Cyrillic text in the center reads "ЗЛАТНИ ПЯСЪЦИ".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a canal or watercourse lined with stone walls running between tall, old town buildings. Several women and children stand or kneel along the edge of the water, washing clothes or working, some under umbrellas for shade. In the background are multi‑story houses with shutters and balconies, and a few pedestrians walking along the path beside the canal. The image has printed text at the top left indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a painting or mural framed by a steep Gothic arch. The scene depicts several men in an alchemical laboratory with glass vessels, furnaces and equipment; one central figure sits wearily while others work around him. At the bottom, white printed German text identifies the scene and location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a blonde woman in a floral dress, reclining and smiling toward the camera in an interior setting. Behind her is a blurred background with figurines and a framed photograph. The right margin of the postcard bears vertically printed text identifying her and the film she appears in.

Sepia-toned aerial photograph of a large mosque complex with an inner courtyard and a tall square minaret rising above surrounding low-rise traditional buildings. The view shows the dense urban fabric of the old city around the mosque. Captions in French, English, and Arabic are printed beneath the image, identifying it as a view of the great mosque of Marrakech taken from an airplane.

A black‑and‑white night view of an illuminated grand theater building beside a river, with its lights reflecting in the water. The building is prominently lit along the roofline and façade, and there are street lamps and another large building visible in the background. A white border surrounds the image and a caption is printed at the bottom left.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a harbor quay with cobblestone pavement in the foreground, people in early 20th‑century clothing, large steamships moored at the pier, and a smaller steamboat on the right. Across the water stands a long row of grand waterfront buildings. Printed caption text appears at the top left.

A multi-image postcard showing three landscape scenes. The upper-left image depicts a river with lush green vegetation in the foreground and a city skyline behind it, including a tall church tower and an arched bridge crossing the river. The upper-right image shows a wintery riverside meadow with patches of snow, leafless trees, and a herd of grazing horses. The bottom image captures a rural dike road at dusk with a cyclist riding along it, silhouettes of people cut-out figures near the roadside, and wide flat fields under a dramatic dark-blue sky. At the bottom right, partially visible text reads "NIJMEGEN EN OOIJPOLDER".

A color postcard showing a small town square with a two‑story neoclassical public building at the center, featuring a symmetrical façade, central portico with four columns, and a tiled gable roof. In front of it is an open paved area with a few trees and people walking. A vintage bus is parked on the left and a blue truck stands closer to the middle. Low hills and green countryside are visible in the background under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town with dense, steep‑roofed houses in the foreground, a river or embankment partly visible through trees, and larger civic-looking buildings and villas on a hill behind. On the right side rises a prominent baroque or rococo church tower with an onion-shaped spire and clock, dominating the skyline. The surrounding landscape is gently hilly and partly wooded. The image has wide white margins typical of early photographic postcards. No visible printed caption or handwriting can be seen.

Sepia-toned image showing a small village church surrounded by trees and enclosed by a low plastered wall with a wooden picket fence and gate in the foreground. The church has a clock tower with an onion-shaped dome and a slender spire topped by a weather vane. At the bottom of the image, printed in red, is a short German caption.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a waterfront area with trees, small pavilions and boats, and a few prominent towers in the distance. In the foreground there is a villa among trees; across the water appear exhibition buildings and flagpoles. The caption in white script at the bottom names the scene as being in Stockholm and related to an industrial arts exhibition.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph of a rocky grotto and pond within a landscaped park. Trees and shrubs surround jagged rock formations; steps lead up through the rocks and there is a small waterfall or dark opening at the water's edge. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the location, with handwritten cursive text filling the bottom and running along the side and top borders.

A sepia-toned postcard showing an inner courtyard and arcaded corridor of a Renaissance-style building. On the left is a small domed tower and ornate facades with gabled roofs and windows; in the background are multi-story arcades with staircases. On the right, a long vaulted colonnade casts strong shadows along the walkway. The card has printed captions at the bottom edge.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway station building beside multiple train tracks. The large, rectangular two‑storey masonry structure has many tall windows and a hipped roof. A sign on the corner of the building reads "GULBENE". In the foreground are railway tracks, a water crane or signal installation, and lampposts. Trees line the background, and there is a low wooden fence along the side of the station. The handwritten word "Gulbene" appears at the top left of the postcard, and a small printed number and text appear in the bottom right corner.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a large European square with cobblestone pavement. On the left stands an ornate neoclassical building with arched entrances, heavy stonework and sculptural decoration, resembling a theater or court. In the center and right background are several multi‑story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. A prominent commercial sign on the corner house reads "Möbel‑Magazin". People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the square and a few carriages or early automobiles are visible.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple domes topped by crosses, set on a raised terrace with broad stairs in the foreground. The church dominates the right side of the image, with smaller houses and buildings around it and tree‑covered hills in the background. Overhead power lines cut across the scene. At the bottom left, white printed text identifies the location, and a small logo appears at the lower right edge.

Illustrated satirical postcard printed in German, depicting a caricature of a worried, big‑headed man (identified as Mr. Chamberlain) sitting on a chair, holding and reading several telegrams labeled "TELEGRAMM" with a distressed expression and his hand on his forehead. The title at the top mentions the Boer War and Chamberlain receiving telegrams from the theater of war. A humorous rhyming caption is printed beneath the figure. Decorative corner mounts are visible around the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden railway station building with a long platform canopy and several chimneys, viewed from across multiple train tracks. A few people stand on the platform near the entrance. There is a clock on the facade and trees in the background. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom and in the lower right corner of the image.

Sepia-toned postcard with scalloped edges showing a view across a river toward a small town dominated by a church with a tall white tower and dark roof. In the foreground are trees and the riverbank with logs or wooden platforms in the water; behind the river are several houses and the prominent church. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in Latvian.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet village street lined with trees and traditional houses. On the right stands a two‑storey inn with several people and a dog in front of it. The building bears painted signage identifying it as a railway‑station tavern. Hand‑written style red text at the top right gives the place name and the establishment's name.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a winding mountain road bordered with small stone bollards in a steep valley. Two people in early 20th‑century clothing stand/sit beside the road under a tall tree, with dramatic rocky peaks and cliffs rising in the background. A caption is printed along the bottom margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) postcard showing a panoramic view over a dense townscape with many multi‑story houses, factory chimneys and an arched iron bridge in the foreground. The image looks across rooftops toward an industrial horizon. Printed German text in red at the top identifies the view, and red vertical text is printed along the left border with a publisher's line and a number.

Black-and-white postcard view of a historic hill with densely packed old houses in the foreground and a large Gothic church with two tall spires dominating the skyline. A narrow lane and stone walls lead up toward the hill. At the bottom border of the image there is a caption in German.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a tall square minaret attached to a mosque in a traditional North African medina. The tower has small windows, decorative crenellations near the top, and Arabic calligraphy around one level. Below, arched doorways and flat-roofed buildings surround a narrow street where several robed figures walk. The caption at the bottom reads in French: "KAIROUAN. – MOSQUÉE DE LA PORTE DE TUNIS LL" along with the number 8.

A grey postcard with a dark, stylized artwork on the front showing an abstract night scene: a crescent moon, a large arc, three vertical pillars, and a rectangular field with many small vertical elements, possibly representing a memorial or grave markers. Behind it lies a grey envelope with blue printed sender information and white handwritten recipient information in Estonian, plus a circular postmark and postage imprint from Tallinn.

A colored vintage postcard showing a general view of a busy harbour with several steamships and sailing vessels anchored near long quays. On the left is a low shoreline with buildings and a tall minaret-like tower in the distance. Calm blue water fills most of the image, with mooring posts and small boats visible. The title at the top reads 'PORT-SAID — General view of the Harbour', and there is a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers conducting field maneuvers in a forested landscape with sparse trees and underbrush. The soldiers wear light-colored tunics and caps, many kneeling with rifles, while officers stand or walk among them. The printed caption "Manöver." appears in red at the lower left, and "Manööveri." at the lower right. Along the left edge in red, a vertical imprint reads "G. Cederberg & Co., Wiborg, Wipuri." A small red number "6" appears at the bottom left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow European street with tall, closely packed buildings on both sides. At the end of the street stands a large medieval-looking building with pointed-arch windows and a tall, slender tower or spire rising into a cloudy sky. Early 20th‑century automobiles and a few pedestrians are visible in the street, suggesting an interwar period scene.

Black-and-white view of a European town square with a tall clocktower in the center background. In the left foreground stands a two‑storey building with a tiled roof and shopfront awnings; signage on the façade reads "Möbel-Magazin" and additional German text. Behind the tower, partially hidden by trees, is a large castle-like complex with round corner towers and steep roofs. The street in front is mostly empty, with an old streetlamp and a small monument or obelisk visible near the base of the hill leading up to the castle.

Colorized panoramic view of a historic coastal city with medieval stone walls, towers, church spires and a harbor with ships in the background. A large round tower with a green spire rises on the left, and another tall church with a pointed spire stands to the right. Trees and park-like areas surround the old city walls. The image has printed captions in Latin and Cyrillic scripts at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to a gated entrance of a historic building complex. Behind the wrought‑iron gate and stone wall rises a multi‑storey structure with steep tiled roofs and a prominent central tower topped by a lantern and dome. The scene is framed by large trees on both sides, and handwritten-style text is printed at the bottom right of the image.

Sepia-toned colonial-era hunting scene showing a dead hippopotamus lying in shallow water in the foreground. Behind it stands a group of local African men with paddles and spears, and several European men in light clothing on a wooden boat. The printed image occupies the upper part of the card, with ample blank space below for writing. Text is printed in red beneath the image and vertically along the left side.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard-style photograph showing a column of uniformed cavalry soldiers riding horses down a street lined with European-style houses. The soldiers carry long lances with pennant flags. In the background are stucco buildings with tiled roofs and a walled property with a small pavilion. A hanging sign on the right side of the image reads "Wagenbach" and some smaller text below. Civilians stand by the wall watching the procession.

Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a narrow, curving street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings, shops and hotels. A church tower with an onion dome rises in the background. Text in German advertises a hotel with central heating, electric light, an elevator and baths. At the bottom in red print it identifies the scene as Karlsbad and the hotel "W. Gärtner's Hôtel Nürnberger Hof" on Kirchengasse, opposite the Sprudel (hot spring). Handwritten red numbers appear along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a striking modernist church set on a gently sloping, grassy hill scattered with rocks and bordered by evergreen trees. The building has a sharply angled, A‑frame style roof and a tall, triangular bell tower with several openings and a cross on top. Large glass windows and white railings emphasize the contemporary design, likely from the mid‑20th century. The sky is partly cloudy and there are no people visible.

A black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped city park with a pond in the foreground. On the central lawn stands an ornate bandstand or pavilion surrounded by tall trees. In the distant background a tall church spire rises above the treeline. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as a park in Bruges and credit the photo collection.

Black‑and‑white landscape view showing a calm river in the foreground with reflections of trees, a path running along the riverbank, a small house nestled among trees in the mid‑ground, and on the wooded hilltop above, a large rectangular multi‑storey building that looks like a historic castle or manor house. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European market square with cobblestone streets and historic townhouses. In the center foreground, the year "1902" and a coat of arms are drawn on the pavement. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand near gas‑style street lamps. On the right, a large building carries the sign "HOTEL GOLDENER LÖWE," and next to it another building reads "Hotel Deutsches Haus." The caption at the top in red letters says "Waldenburg. Markt." indicating the town's market square.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a view from a village street with small half-timbered houses in the foreground and the large Gothic-style Albrechtsburg castle complex rising above a wooded hillside in the background. German caption text is printed at the top, with a red handwritten number along the right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a massive stone city gate with a pointed arch, part of old fortifications. Cobblestone street passes under the arch; beyond it are historic buildings and a fence. Leafless trees frame the scene. German caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard-style image showing a rural landscape with cultivated fields in the foreground, a dirt road with a cart, and trees framing the scene. In the distance lies a small town with multiple houses and a prominent church with a tall steeple. At the top center, printed in red German text, it reads "Grimma. Blick vom Tempelberg nach Hohnstädt."

A colorized panoramic view over a European city surrounded by green hills and fields. In the foreground are dense trees; in the middle distance a compact old town with multi‑story buildings and church spires stretches along a river. A prominent, steep, wooded hill with a fortification or structure on its top rises near the center of the image. At the top of the card, printed in red German text, it reads: "Graz vom Rainerkogel." The overall style and tinting suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet residential street with several wooden houses featuring steep gabled roofs and decorative trim. Tall, thin pine trees stand near a path or road in the foreground, with more houses visible in the background. The layout suggests a small town or village scene. Printed text appears at the bottom of the image, including a caption and a small printer's or publisher's mark in an oval on the lower right.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a multi‑storey modernist commercial building with large windows and the word "STRÖMS" on the facade and on a rooftop flag. People in long coats walk along the cobbled street, and a tram is visible on the right. Leafless trees and street lamps line the street. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as Göteborg and the building as Strömska Huset.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing people (likely children) playing or working beside a rocky cliff with a small water source or cave-like recess. The foreground has handwritten cursive text across the bottom. Printed Greek text appears in the lower left, partially obscured by handwriting.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a Dutch polder landscape with a waterway in the foreground, reed-covered banks, and at least three traditional windmills spaced along the horizon. In the distance there is a church tower or spire rising above a village. Handwritten and printed captions appear along the bottom margin, and the word "Zaandamstek" (likely Zaandam/Zaandstreek) is visible at the right.

A monochrome vintage postcard view of a European street with early 20th‑century houses on the left and a very tall cylindrical tower with a multi‑tiered domed top on the right. Trees and a grassy area line the street. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene as a street in Finsterwalde.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate covered promenade or colonnade set among rows of trees. The iron or metal structure has decorative columns, arches, and finials on top, with a hanging lamp in the center. Several figures in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand or walk inside the hall. Red printed script at the bottom identifies the scene, and a red handwritten number '123' appears at the top right.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European street lined with old multi‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. On the right are several shopfronts with hanging signs and posters; on the left a row of large leafy trees and a traditional street lamp. Further along the street stands a larger institutional or religious building with a high gabled roof and an elegant tower topped by a cross. A few pedestrians, including children, walk along the cobbled and dirt roadway. Handwritten markings appear vertically on the left margin of the image.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large church with a tall central spire and two smaller flanking spires, each with clocks, rising above a small town. In front of the church are early 20th‑century detached houses and civic buildings on a gentle slope, with a field or reeds in the foreground. The style suggests a northern European townscape. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Hand‑tinted studio portrait of a young woman in traditional Japanese clothing. She wears a light purple kimono with a floral obi, her hair styled in a classic updo adorned with a pink flower. She holds a decorative folding fan and gazes over her shoulder against a plain neutral background. A small white artist or studio mark appears near the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal town built among bare rocky hills, facing a calm sea with several small islands in the distance. In the foreground are smooth granite outcrops and wooden houses with steep roofs, typical of Scandinavian architecture. A wooden lookout structure or signal mast with a pointed roof stands on a rocky knoll to the right. In the harbor below are piers, a few sailing vessels and a larger steamboat. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century photograph of a Nordic fishing and shipping town, likely used as a scenic postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a suspension bridge with stone towers spanning a river, with a large medieval hilltop castle complex and a church rising above a wooded slope and small town buildings. The caption "Elbogen." appears in red at the lower left, and the publisher credit is printed in small red text along the bottom edge.

Illustrated postcard showing a panoramic view of a Middle Eastern / North African town with flat-roofed buildings, wooden mashrabiya balconies, a dusty unpaved main street and a tall clock- or bell-tower in the distance. The caption at the bottom left reads "Ville de Suez." and there is a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" over the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an equestrian statue of King Karl IX on a tall pedestal in a city square. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the monument. In the background are multi‑storey European buildings with shop signs, one reading "C. LINDEMA…". Red printed caption text appears below the image, with a short line of publisher information beneath.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) street scene showing a row of traditional gabled townhouses lining a market square. Signs on the ground-floor shops read "Rudolph Wöhler" and "Gertrud Zschaler, Milch‑Kohl‑Meergem." A cyclist rides across the cobbled square and several women and children stand or sit in front of the shops. At the top left of the postcard, printed text reads "Grimma. Markt."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic riverbank landscape: a tall pine tree grows at the very edge of a rocky cliff above a wide river, with forested banks visible in the background. The lower margin contains printed Latvian text describing the location, along with a small publisher's logo.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town with mid‑century apartment blocks, wooden houses, tree‑lined streets, and open countryside and a lake in the background. A large church-like building with a steep roof stands near the center. At the bottom edge, white caption text identifies the place as Lohja/Lojo and includes a serial number.

Night view of an illuminated Moorish-style building with multiple domes and minarets, reflected in a pond with colorful fountain jets in the foreground. A small arched bridge crosses the water. The scene is lit with many small lights outlining the architecture. Text is printed near the bottom edge.

Historic black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a European town market square. Several multi‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and ornate façades line the square. Shop signs and a hotel sign are visible on the ground floors. A horse‑drawn wagon stands near a decorative fountain or well in the open square, and a lone woman in a long dress walks across the empty space. The caption at the top reads "Wurzen. Markt." and a printer credit with date appears at the bottom.

Vintage postcard showing the façade of an Italian café named "Caffè Bertolasi" on a town square. The building has multiple shuttered windows, a tiled roof, hanging street lamps, and a large awning sheltering tables and people gathered outside. Signs on the building read "CAFFÈ BERTOLASI" and "VINO E BIRRA". The right side of the card contains printed text describing the café and handwritten cursive correspondence.

Colorized vintage view over rooftops toward a busy harbor with sailing ships and steamers. In the foreground stands a church with a tall pointed steeple among dense urban buildings. Across the water is a tree‑covered promontory with large monumental buildings. The lower front margin contains printed French text identifying the scene, a series number, publisher information, and handwritten inscriptions and date.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a river or lake with small rowing boats and a covered wooden pier or boathouse with flagpoles. On the far bank stands a lush tree line, behind which are several late‑19th‑century villas and townhouses. On a hill to the right rises a large Gothic‑revival church with a tall spire. The scene is framed like a classic tourist view of a small European town by the water.

A black-and-white postcard view of a rural mountain village on a sloping meadow, with scattered farmhouses and traditional buildings in the foreground and densely forested hills or low mountains in the background. The landscape is open and pastoral, with fences and trees visible. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Schellerhau - Osterzgebirge."

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town by a lake or river. In the foreground are reeds and grassy banks; across the water stands a cluster of low houses and farm buildings, with a church steeple rising above trees on a hill to the right. The sky is filled with scattered clouds. The caption "Talsi." appears in the lower left corner and "Talsen." in the lower center; in the lower right corner there is a small imprint resembling a publisher mark or logo.
