In the hazy background are scattered trees and faint outlines of larger buildings or towers beyond the park.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street in a historic European town, lined with two‑ and three‑story stucco or stone houses with steep tiled roofs. People in early 20th‑century clothing (men in suits, women in long dresses and aprons, children in caps and coats) stand and walk along the street. In the distance a tall church or town‑hall tower with a spire dominates the skyline. Hanging signs identify a restaurant and café on the right side.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with paths, a small bridge and dense vegetation. In the foreground stands a stone monument or memorial with pillars and a central block bearing a circular medallion or relief. A boy or young man in dark clothing and cap stands on the path to the right. In the background are several substantial houses or villas on a hillside, one with a tower and ornate roof. Printed red text at the top identifies the place and the park installations.

Black‑and‑white view down a wide main street in a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century town. Multi‑story brick commercial buildings line both sides, with striped awnings over storefronts. Horse‑drawn wagons and carriages are on the unpaved street, and people walk along the sidewalks. Tall wooden utility poles with crossarms run down both sides. Visible storefront signs advertise farm machinery, agricultural implements, and paints.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard-style image showing a large, four‑storey corner building with mansard roof and dormer windows, likely a late-19th‑century hotel or residential block. The structure stands at the junction of two gently sloping streets; one curves up past a small park or landscaped garden, the other descends between older gabled houses. A few pedestrians in long dresses and period clothing walk along the pavements, and ornate streetlamps line the roads.

Colorized panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by steep green mountains and distant snowy peaks. The settlement has many white buildings with red roofs and a prominent church with a tall bell tower in the center. In the foreground are patchwork agricultural fields. Handwritten-style captions on the sky area read the town name on the left and the mountain name and height on the right. A small date is written near the town name.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a neoclassical manor complex set in a landscaped garden. Several interconnected buildings with columned porticos, pediments and arched windows stand amid trees and pathways. At the bottom, printed captions identify the place as 'Wiurila' and the publisher information from Hamburg.

Black-and-white photograph of a lush city park with tall weeping trees and open grassy areas. A path runs through the park in the background, and benches or small features are faintly visible. The lower left corner is printed with the caption 'Graz Stadtpark', and the lower right corner has the publisher credit 'Erika-Verlag Graz 288'.

Vintage sepia postcard showing an ornate interior with intricate geometric tilework, arches, and columns in an Arab-Moorish style. A large circular mosaic fountain dominates the left side, with a person in traditional robe standing beside it. Another figure sits on the tiled floor in the foreground. The architectural setting appears to be a historic interior in the medina of Fez. Printed caption text in French and a photographer/editor credit appear at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town on a hill, with open fields in the foreground and a winding path leading toward the settlement. The town features clustered houses with pitched roofs and a prominent church with a tall tower and spire dominating the skyline. Trees and hillside vegetation surround the built-up area. The town name "Dohna." is printed in red at the bottom, and a publisher's line appears along the lower edge. A red handwritten number "2281" is written in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a monumental architectural gateway with a very large central arch flanked by engaged columns and blind arcades. The façade is heavily stylized, with multiple rectangular window-like recesses above, decorative friezes, and smaller arched niches below. The scene appears to be indoors, possibly a museum gallery, with stone slabs or sculptures visible through the dark opening behind the arch. There is a wide, empty floor area in the foreground and no visible people or text on the image.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a valley spa town set on wooded hillsides. Numerous early 20th‑century villas and sanatorium-style buildings are scattered across terraced slopes above a small town and railway line in the foreground. At the upper left is printed the caption "Bad Gottleuba." The overall style and layout resemble a historic European health resort postcard.

A vintage multi-view postcard with five illustrated scenes framed separately. The central image shows a tall brick lookout tower on a hill labeled "Rochlitzer Berg. Friedrich-August-Turm." The upper left image depicts a hilltop castle above a forested slope titled "Schloss Rochsburg." The lower left image shows a riverside scene with a large church or castle complex with two towers, labeled "Schloss Rochlitz." The upper right image shows a large brick railway viaduct over a valley, labeled "Göhrener Brücke." The lower right image depicts a complex with a castle-like building and a church tower among trees, labeled "Schloß u. Kirche Wechselburg." The style and coloring resemble early 20th‑century German postcards.

Sepia-toned street scene showing a gently curving cobblestone street lined with two- and three-storey townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and a horse-drawn cart stands in the middle distance. Shop signs are visible on the right, including one reading "Hermann Seifert." At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location as a street in Geithain in Saxony, Germany.

A sepia-toned postcard reproducing a historical painting of a group of children gathered under a tree, some holding musical instruments and toys, with decorative scrolls of text floating above them. Below the image, printed on the postcard, is the attribution "Mathias Blumenthal Barnegruppe, ca. 1760" and in the lower left corner the institution credit "Bergens Museum".

A sepia-toned portrait of a smiling young woman in staged studio lighting, wearing a folk-style dress with embroidered bodice and apron, braided hair, and a floral wreath on her head. She holds a thin branch or staff. The background is a neutral cloudy studio backdrop. White printed captions appear in the lower left and right corners, identifying the photographer/publisher in Dresden and the woman as Erika Wedekind in a role from 'Die Schönen von Fogaras.'

A colorized historic postcard view of Cairo's Citadel complex. In the foreground are stone fortification towers, people walking, horse-drawn carriages, and soldiers or guards in red uniforms. In the background, a large mosque with a central dome and two tall minarets dominates the skyline, likely the Mosque of Muhammad Ali within the Cairo Citadel. The style is early 20th‑century chromolithograph.

A black-and-white postcard view of historic brick houses along a canal, with gabled roofs and a small arched bridge reflected in the water. A rowboat with a person is visible on the left. Large trees frame the canal, and church spires rise in the distant background. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as old houses on the Rosary Quay in Bruges.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small baroque or early‑modern pavilion or manor house on a hill, with a high tiled roof, roof terrace with railing and flagpole, and a stone terrace/balustrade. The building stands above a wooded slope with bare trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. The image is framed by a light border, and in the bottom margin there is a handwritten German caption.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic multi‑storey palace-like building with ornate gables and towers, partly obscured by tall trees and landscaped park grounds. A path curves through the grass in the foreground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage sepia postcard showing a column monument topped with a winged victory figure (Sieges­säule) behind a low stone wall and iron fence, framed by trees on both sides. A woman stands in front of the railing. The lower margin bears printed captions in German identifying the place and monument, and the publisher information, with a red handwritten number on the right.

A colorized, early 20th‑century bird's‑eye view over a town nestled between green hills. The town has a prominent red church with a tall spire, dense blocks of stone buildings, rail lines or roads, and open green fields in the foreground. Trees frame the lower right corner. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text identifying the view, as well as a publisher credit. Across the bottom, there is cursive handwritten correspondence in ink.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded lakeside scene. On the left stands an open wooden gazebo or pavilion with a person inside; on the right another person stands among trees near stacked logs by the shore. The bottom margin contains printed captions and cursive handwritten text.

A vintage, blue-tinted postcard view over a harbor area with several passenger boats and smaller vessels docked along the quay. In the background are tree-lined streets, a busy square with horse‑drawn carriages and early automobiles, and large ornate stone buildings. A prominent building with a grand façade and columned entrance is visible to the right; this is the Dramaten (Royal Dramatic Theatre). The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Stockholm's Nybroplan with the Dramatiska Teatern.

Black‑and‑white image of a European old town street dominated by a tall church tower with a very slender, steep spire. The tower has a square base with arched windows and belfry openings, and it is flanked by narrow historic townhouses with steep, tiled roofs lining a cobbled street. Trees are visible on the left side and a few early‑20th‑century cars are parked along the street. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.

Sepia-toned photograph of a cloister-like garden courtyard enclosed by tall, ivy-covered brick buildings. Large multi-pane windows line the inner facades, and a gravel path forms a cross-shaped layout through dense shrubs, flowers, and small trees. A single figure in dark, long clothing, possibly a nun or monk, stands near the center-right of the courtyard. The image has the aged look and border wear typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.

A colorized vintage coastal view showing a fortified historic town by the sea, with high stone walls, red-tiled roofs, tall cypress trees in the foreground, and an offshore island in the background. Two boats are visible in the calm bay. The printed caption at the top reads "Dubrovnik — Ragusa."

A monochrome blue-toned image showing a small historic watermill house beside a calm river or canal. The building has whitewashed or light-colored masonry walls and a steep, tiled gabled roof. A wooden water wheel is attached to the side, next to a simple timber sluice or weir structure over the water. Dense trees form a backdrop, and the mill and foliage are reflected clearly in the water. The image is bordered by a white margin, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No printed text is visible on the front.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a straight European city street lined with tall late‑19th‑century brick townhouses featuring ornate stone window frames, shutters, and small balconies. The buildings are tightly packed and uniform in height. A few pedestrians in long dark clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a small horse‑drawn or hand‑pulled cart with several people stands in the middle of the cobbled street. Gas‑style street lamps appear along the right side. The sky is overcast and there is no visible printed caption on the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rural scene with a rectangular two‑story masonry house beside a pond or millrace. A wooden footbridge with railings crosses the water in front of the building, and a woman in an apron stands on the bridge looking toward the camera. Ducks and geese swim in the pond in the foreground. Trees, shrubs, and a simple wooden fence surround the property. The architecture is plain, with symmetrical sash windows and a steep tiled roof typical of Central European farm or inn buildings. There appears to be a small sign above the main door, but it is too small and blurred to read.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a severely iced shoreline or lakeside scene. Thick layers of ice and frozen spray cover railings, rocks, and other structures along the water's edge. Utility poles and a large telephone/telegraph line support frame run into the distance on the right, also encased in ice. The water body to the left appears rough and wintry, with bare trees in the background. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Black-and-white postcard view of a crowded outdoor dance pavilion and surrounding promenade. People in early 20th‑century clothing gather around a low, wide-roofed building and small kiosks, with trees and benches in the foreground. Printed captions and a publisher's mark appear along the bottom edge.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a mountain landscape with a lake in the foreground and forested slopes rising toward rocky peaks. At the top in red German text it reads "Umgebung Rottenmann: Scheibelsee mit Bösenstein (2449 Meter)". Along the right edge in small vertical print is the publisher information. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist postcard.

Black-and-white image of a large cargo ship moored at an industrial dock. The vessel has multiple cranes and loading booms along its deck and a large funnel. Warehouses and harbor cranes line the quay behind it. The ship's bow bears the name "TYSON LYKES," and the side of the hull prominently displays the company name "LYKES LINES." The sea is calm in the foreground and the sky is overcast.

Black‑and‑white image showing a richly decorated historicist building with a tall clock tower topped by an ornate spire, situated beside or at the end of a multi‑arched stone bridge over a river. People in early 20th‑century clothing and a horse‑drawn carriage are crossing the bridge. The top edges of the card are damaged or irregular, suggesting age and wear.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing part of a Gothic-style building façade. Three tall pointed arches dominate the view; the central arch is filled with several rows of small, light-colored bells forming a carillon or glockenspiel, while the two side arches contain decorative stone tracery. The masonry has contrasting lighter mortar lines that emphasize the gothic arch shapes. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a newly built suburban housing estate surrounded by fields and forest. The development consists of multiple mid‑rise apartment blocks arranged in curved and zigzag patterns around open courtyards, with a few taller towers and scattered low buildings that may be schools or community facilities. At the bottom of the image there is an older area of detached houses with gardens, and a wide road intersection leads toward the estate. The setting looks like a planned mid‑20th‑century residential district on the edge of a European city.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a stone railway viaduct crossing a valley in a hilly, forested landscape, identified as the railway viaduct with the Löbauer Berg. Inset at lower left is a separate view of a tall, ornate iron observation tower rising above trees, labeled as the Friedrich‑August‑Turm. German captions are printed at the top and beside the inset image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a full-length studio portrait of a veiled woman in traditional dress. She wears a dark head covering and shawl, a face veil, and loose patterned trousers, standing against a painted backdrop with flowers. There is printed text below the image and a photographer's or publisher's mark on the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an old European town with stone fortifications, towers and church buildings in the background, and a narrow lane with trees and small houses in the foreground. Two people in historical dress walk along the street. At the top in red print is a caption in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet cobblestoned town square with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. At right is a two‑storey house with shopfront signage and a balcony with flower boxes; behind it rises a church tower with clocks and a spire. On the left are several ornate townhouses with shops at street level. In the distance a larger civic-looking building stands at a bend in the street. The scene is devoid of cars and only a couple of pedestrians are visible.

A black‑and‑white image showing a grand neo‑Baroque parliamentary or governmental building with a long façade of tall Corinthian columns, elaborate sculptural groups along the roofline, and two corner towers. A central portico with a pediment and statues is approached by several arched entrances. In front is an open square or broad street with a few pedestrians and a small landscaped garden area. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century architectural photograph commonly used on postcards.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a church with a tall spire set behind a landscaped park or garden with paths, lawns, trees and flowerbeds. Several people walk or stand on the paths. At the top in red lettering is the caption identifying the location and church.

Hand-colored historic postcard showing a town square with the town hall (Rathaus) building on the right, bearing signs for "Hotel" and "Rathskeller" and topped with a small clock tower. On the left is a row of two‑story houses and shops, including one with the sign "Gustav Bierkamp." Numerous townspeople, including children, are standing and walking in the open square in front of the buildings. The lower margin contains printed captions identifying the view as the town hall and Lindenauerstraße in Ortrand and credits the local publisher.

A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of many small photographs arranged in a collage. The images show notable sights of Budapest, including monumental buildings, bridges over a river, statues, a parliament‑like building, and park scenes. At the bottom, bilingual greetings in Hungarian and German identify Budapest, along with the publisher's credit.

Vintage sepia-toned street view titled "Graz – Annenstrasse." The image shows a broad urban avenue with tram tracks running down the center, lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings that have shuttered windows and ground‑floor shops. Pedestrians, a few carriages or early trams, and streetlamps are visible along the street. The perspective looks straight down Annenstrasse toward the city center.

Vintage sepia-toned street scene showing early 20th‑century downtown Los Angeles. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians move along Third Street between multistory commercial buildings. In the distance, the funicular railway known as Angel's Flight is visible climbing the hillside. Red printed captions frame the image, including information about the location and publisher.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large statue of the painter Jan (Jean) van Eyck on a high pedestal in a city square beside a canal with moored boats and historic Flemish houses. The caption at the top is in French and there is a small publisher's line and number at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a stone arch bridge spanning a rocky gorge with a powerful waterfall or canal outflow beneath it. A group of people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the bridge, with a horse and cart visible on the left side. Printed caption text appears at the top.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a street corner with a two‑storey plastered house, shuttered windows, and a hanging gas lamp. A signboard on the left advertises a workshop, and a small street sign on the corner reads "Svartbäcksgatan." Printed vertically on the right margin is the caption "UPSALA. LINNÉSKA HUSET." accompanied by handwritten notes and a number.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a river valley with fields, orchards, and a village in the foreground, and a rocky hill crowned by several prominent buildings and a church in the background. The image has a vintage photographic style and printed caption text at the top.

Colorized street-view postcard showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story wooden and masonry buildings with balconies and arcades. People walk and a few vehicles move along the street. The caption at the top and bottom identifies this as Calle Bolívar (Bolivar Street) looking south in Colón, Republic of Panama.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a wide waterfront street with tram tracks running along the center. On the right side are numerous sailing ships moored at the quay, their masts forming a dense forest of lines. On the left side stand multi‑story buildings with shops and pedestrians. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and the quay. Printed captions in French and English identify the scene as the quays/the wharfs of Salonique.

Illustrated vintage postcard showing a scene from the Schlossberg hill in Graz. On the left stands a round tower with a domed roof surrounded by trees. To the right are multi‑arched fortification walls with greenery on top. A curved pathway runs through the middle with a few people in old-fashioned clothing walking toward an arched gateway in the background. The title text is printed in red at the top.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town nestled in a forested valley, seen from a field in the foreground. The town has several large multi‑story spa or hotel buildings, scattered villas, and a tall church with a pointed spire on the right side. The printed title "Bad Elster." appears in red at the top left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large timber building with steep gabled roofs on a wooded hillside beside a reservoir or river. In front of the building is a terrace with many parasol-covered tables crowded with people. Below the slope, excursion boats full of passengers travel along the water. The scene is framed like a typical vintage tourist postcard. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Zschopau-Talsperre Kriebstein.

Vintage black‑and‑white (with light sepia tone) postcard view of a hillside street lined with ornate early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left stands a large multi‑storey school building with towers and steep roofs, connected to the street by a stairway and railing. On the right are substantial bourgeois villas with balconies and decorative façades. Printed red text along the top identifies the location and the school.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a Romanesque cloister with an inner garden. The view looks along a covered arcade with thick twisted and paired columns, ornate carved capitals, and round arches framing another set of similar arches across the courtyard. The masonry appears medieval with decorative brick and stone patterns. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate, rectangular school building with classical architectural details, multiple chimneys, and tall windows. In front of the building stands a group of schoolchildren and adults, some gathered around a wooden gymnastic frame; another person is on a long ladder leaning against the building. The scene appears to be in an open yard or school grounds. Printed caption text is in the upper left corner.

Colorized historic postcard view of a grand neoclassical concert hall with columns and sculptures, fronted by a statue of composer Felix Mendelssohn and formal flowerbeds in a park-like setting. Another ornate institutional building is visible in the background to the right. The sky is clear blue and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Illustrated postcard showing a stylized view of a church with a tall Gothic tower and steep red roofs, fronted by a row of shops and houses. One shop sign reads "ANTON HÄUSLER." The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Michaelerkirche in Vienna (Wien).

A colorized panoramic view of a European city with a steep, forested hill dominating the center. On top of the hill stands a fortress-like complex or castle. The city, with red-tiled roofs and several large institutional buildings, spreads around the base of the hill and along a river visible to the right, with bridges and embankments. The style is that of an early 20th‑century printed postcard, with a white border and no visible caption on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a slightly uphill road lined with simple two- and three-story houses. A church steeple rises in the background. People walk along the street and a horse-drawn wagon moves up the road. Trees and fences border the left side. Printed caption text appears at the top center of the image.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a close-up of a sculpted head and upper torso of Jesus Christ wearing a crown of thorns, likely part of a crucifix. The image focuses on the sorrowful expression, beard, and hair of the statue, with a dark, undefined background and a white border around the photo with scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central square bordered by classical multi‑storey buildings. In the middle stands a large statue on a pedestal surrounded by trees and a fenced area. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the open square, and there is a streetlamp in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads "Graz, Freiheitsplatz."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside rural settlement. In the foreground, pine trees and a rocky slope descend to the water, where a small rowboat floats. A person in light clothing sits on the slope looking toward the lake. Across the water are several wooden farm and village buildings. Printed place names appear at the top, and a Finnish caption strip is visible at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large cobblestoned market square surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings. Small groups of people and carts stand in the open square, and there is a central trellised structure or pavilion with trees. On the right side rises a church or town‑hall tower with a spire topped by a cross. The lower margin of the card bears printed red text identifying the place and publisher.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a cobbled town square with several children and adults standing in the foreground. Surrounding the square are historic multi‑story buildings, and prominently in the background rises a large church with two tall Gothic towers. The left side of the card has open blank space, while the right side contains the town view. Red German text appears at the upper left and along the left margin.

Color-printed historic postcard showing a large, ornate multi-story building in a wooded setting. The structure has steep red roofs, decorative half‑timbering, and multiple small towers, resembling a grand hotel or restaurant. In front, a couple with a child and dog walk along a wide pathway; to the right is an outdoor café terrace with tables and chairs under trees. A horse-drawn carriage stands beside the building. The sky is a gradient blue, and the image has a hand‑tinted lithographic style. The words "Karlsbad." appear at the top left and "Etablissement Jägerhaus." at the top right. Additional small signs near the entrance advertise the Jägerhaus and a café.

Black-and-white postcard view over a small town nestled in a hilly rural landscape, with patchwork fields in the background. A prominent neo-Gothic church with twin spires dominates the center of the town. Scattered houses and trees fill the foreground, while hills rise in the distance. German text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view of a cobblestone market square bordered by multi‑story historic townhouses with shops on the ground floor. A few people stand along the facades. In the background, a large wind turbine or windmill structure rises above the rooftops against a forested hillside. The caption in red Gothic-style type at the top reads "Thum i. Erzgeb. Marktplatz." Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the gable wall of a stone ruin surrounded by trees. The building appears to be part of an old monastery complex. Red printed German text in the upper left identifies the site, and a handwritten red date is visible on the right side.

Black‑and‑white view of a long, slightly rising street lined with two‑ to three‑storey townhouses and small shops. On the left corner is a rough‑plastered house with dormer windows and a steep tiled roof. Farther along the left side are shopfronts with German lettering on their façades. Several women and children stand and walk in the middle of the unpaved street, one pushing a baby carriage. On the right are more ornate houses with gabled façades and a line of trees and street lamps. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century European town.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town nestled in rolling agricultural hills. In the mid‑ground stands a multi‑story industrial building with a tall smokestack, surrounded by detached houses and small villas. A patchwork of fields and tree lines spreads across the hills behind the town. On a distant hilltop a church with a tall spire dominates a compact village skyline. In the foreground a narrow dirt path runs along cultivated land bordered by low vegetation and a simple fence. No visible printed text appears on the front.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a canal with a stone bridge in the foreground and a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire and crosses on a rocky hill in the background. Sparse trees and utility poles line the hill. At the top in red print is a short caption in Swedish mentioning the power canal and church in Trollhättan.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town set in rolling hills. In the center background on a low hill stands a prominent large church with two tall, slender spires and a steep gabled roof, surrounded by monastic or institutional buildings. Below it are clustered village houses with pitched roofs, gardens, and orchards. At the right background is an industrial facility with a tall smokestack. The foreground shows open grassy fields and fenced yards leading toward the town. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a villa-like building labeled "Grundschänke" in a lush, tree-filled foreground with wooden fencing. Behind it rise terraced vineyard hills. On the upper right hillside stands a prominent historic building identified as "Spitzhaus." The captions "Oberlößnitz." and "Grundschänke." are printed in red at the bottom, with a printer's line indicating "Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

A color religious postcard-style image depicting Santiago Apóstol (Saint James the Apostle) as a mounted warrior saint. He rides a rearing white horse, sword raised in his right hand and a white flag with a cross in his left. Below the horse lie several defeated, armed figures in turbans and medieval-style clothing, suggesting a battle scene. In the top right corner, red Spanish text reads: "Santiago Apostol. - Patrón de España y de las Indias" against a pale sky and mountainous landscape.

A colorized vintage view of a small alpine village nestled in green rolling hills and mountains. In the foreground are clustered stone and plaster houses with red-tiled roofs, and in the center rises a white church with a tall, slender steeple. Larger villa-like buildings stand to the right. The sky is pale blue with a pinkish horizon. At the top left, printed text reads "Malosco, Val di Non, Trentino."

Sepia-toned photograph showing a tall stone monument built from rough boulders and dressed masonry. At the top stands a winged female figure (an angel or allegorical Victory) holding up a long cross with a double crossbar. Midway up the plinth there is a niche with a carved cross. Heavy chains hang between stone posts around the base, and trees are visible in the background. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the front.

Black-and-white winter street scene in a European city. Snow covers the ground and roofs. On the left is a large ornate stone building with arched windows at street level and a gabled central section, likely a public or municipal building facing a small square or open area. On the right, a row of multi‑storey 19th‑century style townhouses with shops at street level lines a slightly descending street. Several pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and a few 1950s–1960s style cars drive along the snow-covered road. No visible caption or printed text is present in the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a tall brick church tower with a steep spire topped by a cross. The tower stands behind a low brick wall and iron fence along a curved street with tram tracks. Mature trees surround the church grounds. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Hees" and "Oude Kerk," indicating the old church of Hees.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑storey plastered school building with a gabled roof, many rectangular windows, and a small clock on the upper façade. The building stands beside trees and an open yard or playground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal town with a curving seafront road and promenade, low-rise buildings along the shoreline, small boats in a calm bay, and hills in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the place as Loutraki and describe it as a general view. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right.

A vintage monochrome panoramic view of the city and port of La Coruña, showing low houses, fields, industrial buildings, rail lines and ships in the harbor. The scene is printed in a blue-tinted tone, with captions and publisher information in Spanish beneath the image.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a landscaped park with paths, dense shrubbery, and large trees. On the right stands a prominent statue or monument (Julius-Otto-Denkmal). Two women in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the paths. Residential-style buildings are visible in the background. Red printed German text runs along the bottom, including the place name and publisher information.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a harbor with a large passenger steamship in the foreground moving through calm water, leaving ripples behind. Smoke rises from its funnel. Along the left shoreline are smaller boats and masts, with warehouses, houses, and industrial buildings of a town in the background. The scene is labeled at the bottom in Swedish, and publisher information appears in the lower right corner.

Colorized panoramic view over a coastal town with red-tiled roofs, fortification walls and bastions projecting into a calm blue bay filled with numerous ships and boats. Hills line the far horizon. In the upper left corner the word "Korfu." is printed, and at the bottom right the web address "www.elia.org.gr" appears.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship in a harbor in front of a waterfront lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings. Low hills are visible in the background. Printed text on the front reads "Souvenir de Salonique," with an additional handwritten inscription in another script at the top and a modern archive watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town seen from the south side, with a foreground of fields and trees. The skyline shows multiple church towers, a large church with a high roof, and fortified towers and walls. Printed text at the bottom identifies the town and viewpoint and credits a publisher from Meissen.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a coastal city with low buildings and open fields in the foreground. A large rectangular multi-storey building complex is prominent in the lower center, with more scattered structures leading toward the distant shoreline and hills. Greek and French captions appear at the top, along with the phrase "Souvenir de Crète" on the right. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed at the bottom.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a wooden church complex in a rural lakeside landscape. The main church has a steep, hipped roof with a small belfry on top and scaffolding or ladders leaning against the roof, suggesting maintenance work. To the right stands a separate bell tower. In the foreground are fields with haystacks and a wooden fence. Finnish text is printed below the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a newly built housing estate with simple three‑storey apartment blocks arranged around an open, still‑undeveloped grassy area where many children are playing. The buildings have steep tiled roofs with multiple chimneys and regularly spaced rectangular windows. In the distance a church with a tall, pointed spire rises above the roofs, and there is a curved paved street with very little traffic. A small white number, apparently a catalog or negative number, is handwritten in the lower left corner.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a church with multiple spires and a separate wooden bell tower. People in early 20th‑century clothing are gathered outside the church and along the path. Trees frame the scene. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Lerum. Kyrkan." and the publisher's imprint "Jac. Hægerströms förlag." appears at the lower right. There is handwritten vertical text in cursive along the right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard‑style photograph showing a small cargo ship named "ROLAND KRUSE" sailing along a river or canal. The vessel has two masts and a low, elongated hull. On the left bank stands a modernist industrial or harbor building with large windows and a small group of people gathered on the quay. Behind the quay and along the horizon are trees, industrial chimneys, and light smoke, indicating an industrial waterfront landscape.

An old panoramic black‑and‑white view of a densely built city with many domes and minarets at the foot of a large mountain. The image has a red postage stamp and cancellation mark in the upper right corner, and French captions printed at the bottom. The overall style is that of an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

A black‑and‑white image of an older bearded man dressed as a traditional rural postman, carrying a large mailbag over his shoulder and holding a suitcase. He stands on the front step of a small wooden house with a dark door and climbing plants covering the facade. A tall stone stands in the foreground to the left, and there is a window with ivy on the right. The whole scene has an early‑20th‑century, Northern European village atmosphere.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate historic building with a tower and mansard roof, likely a college or religious institution, surrounded by trees. A group of people poses in front of the entrance. In the lower left corner, white printed text reads "Salvatorianerkolleg Graz."

A black‑and‑white aerial view of a European town with dense, tiled rooftops, several church towers, and a large central building. In the foreground and midground are multi‑storey 19th‑century style townhouses and civic buildings. A church with large Gothic-style windows and another tall tower dominate the skyline. There are visible commercial signs on some buildings. The scene looks out toward open countryside in the far distance. The lower-left corner bears a printed caption and a building sign near the bottom right advertises a local newspaper.

A black-and-white photograph showing a dramatic mountainous landscape, likely in the Alps. Sheer rock faces and wide, terraced slopes dominate the center, with scattered snow patches on the highest peaks. In the foreground are dense forests, rocky outcrops, and a few isolated farmhouses or alpine buildings set in open meadows. A valley with a road or rail line runs along the base of the cliffs on the left. The image is bordered by a white margin, typical of vintage postcards, and there is no visible caption or printed text on the front.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large neoclassical government building with two stories, a central entrance, many windows, and a flag above the main doorway. The building stands in an open square with several trees protected by wooden crates. Printed captions in Portuguese and French at the bottom identify the scene as the Government Palace in the city of Praia, Cabo Verde (Cape Verde).

Colorized postcard view of a tree‑lined lake with small rowboats on the water and a path with benches along the shore. In the background stands a building with two pointed towers and flags. The lower margin contains printed German text identifying the scene, plus a publisher credit and faint handwritten notes.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a highly ornate triumphal arch standing alone in a snowy landscape. The wooden arch has two tall towers with spires, rich decorative details, and the imperial Russian double-headed eagle crest on top. Below the image there is Russian pre‑revolutionary text identifying the location as Khabarovsk and explaining that the arch commemorates a journey of Emperor Nicholas II when he was still heir to the throne.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a vaulted stone interior, likely a crypt or basement of a large historic building. Massive barrel and cross vaults rest on thick piers with a heavy masonry base. Light enters through a large round-arched window with a grid of small panes on the right. On the left, a staircase leads upward. Near the center is a small shrine or arrangement with plants, beside which a person sits or kneels, emphasizing the religious or contemplative character of the space.

A tinted winter photograph of a snow-covered village in hilly terrain, with scattered houses and chalets among fields and forested slopes. Leafless trees frame the foreground, and a lone skier stands on a snowy path. In the upper right corner, there is printed text in German that reads "Winter in Bärenfels." The overall image has a blue-toned monochrome style typical of early 20th‑century winter postcards.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an extremely ornate stone or wood church pulpit in a Gothic-style interior. The pulpit base is surrounded by swirling vegetal forms, cherubs and seated figures, with a spiral staircase winding up to a large, cup-shaped preaching platform decorated with bishops and saints in high relief. In the background are pointed-arch windows, tracery railings, statues, and other ecclesiastical furnishings. The image has the look of an old printed postcard, but no visible caption or writing appears on the front.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with small, gabled houses. People stand and walk along the street, and a small cart is visible in the foreground. The architecture is characteristic of an old Northern European town. At the top of the image there is printed text indicating the place name and the street name.

Black‑and‑white view of a central European town square at the foot of a steep wooded hill. In the foreground is a small landscaped square with trees, paths, and a few people walking. Surrounding it are richly ornamented 4‑ to 5‑storey historicist buildings with shops at street level and awnings over the windows. Signs on the façades are in German, including one large sign reading "NEUDORFER" on the right and another building labeled "BÖRSE". The scene appears to be from the late 19th or early 20th century.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene in a small town or village. A wide unpaved road lined with leafless trees and wooden picket fences stretches into the distance. On the right are large wooden houses with steep roofs, window awnings, and balconies; one has a tower or spire-like structure behind it. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the street. In the background low hills or mountains are visible on the left side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rustic stone building built into a hillside, with a man standing in the doorway and another seated on a bench outside. The structure appears to be a spring house along a forested mountain path, surrounded by dense conifer trees. On the right side, there is a blank light area for writing, printed with red text identifying the place and the publisher, plus a handwritten date.

Vintage multiview postcard featuring a central illustration of a large circular fountain in a busy urban square with carriages, pedestrians, and trees, labeled as 'Place des Consuls' in Alexandria. Two smaller inset images show a statue labeled 'STATUE DE BOIS CHEIK-…' and a scene with several men in traditional dress outside a building. Decorative grapevine motifs and handwritten script in Greek appear on the lower part. A green stamp with postmark is affixed in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a wooded hill with buildings and terraces. In the foreground are rooftops and a large bare tree; further up the slope are glasshouse-like structures and pathways. On top of the hill stand fortification-style buildings, and in the background a church tower with a dome and spire rises above the trees. At the top left, printed text reads "Graz. Partie am Schlossberg."

Black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing rolling fields, scattered farmhouses and barns, tree‑lined roads, and low forested hills. In the foreground are fields, bushes, and telephone poles; in the distance are clustered farm buildings on gentle slopes. Text is printed along the bottom margin with a serial number and a Norwegian caption identifying the location, plus a handwritten photographer/publisher signature at the lower right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a long neoclassical building with arcades along a street corner. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand in the foreground. The printed caption in French and Greek at the top right identifies the scene as Rue Nikis (Victory Street) in Salonique (Thessaloniki). A watermark with a website address appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, rocky valley densely filled with palm trees, surrounded by low hills or mountains. A small group of people is visible walking through the landscape. At the bottom is a handwritten Greek caption, and a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears on the right.

Sepia-toned vertical postcard showing an ornate, Hindu-temple-style palace with a tall tower and intricate carvings, surrounded by a low fence and sandy ground. At the bottom margin, French text reads "HELIOPOLIS - Palais du Baron." There is also a faint round seal and a small website watermark.

Colorized view of a hill covered in greenery with historic buildings. Dominating the right side is a square stone clock tower with large clock faces and a steep, dark roof, known as the Uhrturm. To the left are additional buildings with red-tiled roofs. At the top left of the image, red printed text reads 'Graz. Uhrturm.' The style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century tourism postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a tree-lined area with a road or path in the foreground and a town with scattered buildings in the background. At the top, printed text identifies the view as from Vänersborg and specifically Dalbobron.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a ceremonial entrance of royals and dignitaries into a large marble stadium packed with spectators. People in formal military uniforms and elegant early‑20th‑century dress walk along the track toward the infield. The architecture suggests a horseshoe‑shaped classical stadium with stone seating rising on both sides and a colonnade at the far end. Printed captions in Greek, French, and English appear along the bottom margin, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible over the image.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural valley with forested hills in the background. In the foreground stands a two‑storey half‑timbered house with shutters, likely an inn or guesthouse, beside a curved unpaved road. Nearby are several traditional farmhouses and barns scattered on gentle grassy slopes. The scene is quiet and pastoral, with dense coniferous forest covering the hillside behind the buildings. There is a signboard on the main house but the text is too small and blurred to read.

Vintage black-and-white postcard with decorative scrollwork, showing two different exterior views of a large institutional building complex. The upper right image depicts a long, two‑story frame building with porches and staircases; the lower left image shows another large multi‑story structure with a central tower topped by a cross, suggesting a religiously affiliated hospital. Printed caption text appears in the lower right, with handwritten numbers in ink over part of the design.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with decorative frames showing two street scenes of a colonial town with single‑story houses, trees and pedestrians. The title text reads "Recordação d'Inhambane" with illustrated banana leaves and scrollwork. Each inset photograph is captioned with a street name: one is "RUA MOUSINHO D'ALBUQUERQUE" and the other "RUA VICTOR DE PORTUGAL". There is cursive handwritten text filling the lower part of the card.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a coiled rattlesnake against a plain background. The lower margin has the caption 'Rattlesnale.' in red type. Along the left margin in red text it credits the publisher in Los Angeles, California, and along the right margin in red text it notes that it was printed in Germany and is hand-colored work.

A colorized postcard view of a historic hilltop complex featuring the Albrechtsburg Castle and cathedral towers rising above the town of Meissen on the banks of the Elbe River. In the foreground is the river with a small sailboat; below the castle are clustered houses and riverside buildings with red-tiled roofs. The sky is light blue and the scene has a vintage, hand-tinted look. German captions are printed at the top: on the left identifying the town on the Elbe, and on the right naming the castle and cathedral.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal promenade lined with trees and classical buildings. A man walks along the path in the left foreground, while the right side shows a row of waterfront houses and a prominent larger building facing the water. The scene is calm and urban, with the canal curving into the distance. Printed at the top are the words indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a monumental statue in a landscaped park. A standing male figure in 19th‑century dress is on a tall plinth, surrounded by sculpted children and a seated woman at the base. The pedestal is set on tiered steps, with flowerbeds and palm‑like trees and dense foliage in the background. The visible inscription on the pedestal reads "SEMMELWEIS."

A black-and-white postcard photograph of a cargo ship named ULLA sailing close to the coast. The vessel is decorated with signal flags running from bow to stern. In the background are low wooded shores and small coastal buildings. Printed caption text appears in the lower right corner, identifying the ship and its Swedish shipping company in Helsingborg.

Black‑and‑white image of a broad town square with historic gabled houses and small businesses around the perimeter. In the center foreground is an unpaved square with a horse‑drawn carriage and wagon. The central building has an ornate Baroque façade with many windows; surrounding houses have steep tiled roofs with dormers. Signs on the buildings advertise a hotel, clothing shop, and restaurant in German.

Colorized postcard view of a large, white multi‑story institutional building with many uniform windows, set in front of a wooded hillside. A landscaped park or garden with lawns, trees, and winding footpaths occupies the foreground. To the right is an attached industrial‑looking section with a tall brick smokestack, suggesting a sanatorium, hospital, or factory complex in a semi‑rural setting. There is no visible caption or printed text on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped public park with formal flowerbeds and walking paths. At the center stands an octagonal pavilion or garden café with decorative wooden trim and a small finial on the roof. To the left is a large marble statue group on a pedestal with a low basin around it. Several people in late‑19th‑century or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths or stand under the trees lining the background.

Black-and-white street scene showing a corner apartment building with balconies, with an apotek (pharmacy) on the ground floor. The view captures intersecting roads, a few pedestrians, older cars, street lamps, and utility poles, with a water tower visible in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, along with a small code in the lower right corner.

A vintage, lightly colorized postcard showing a rural sandy road lined with wooden fences and simple wooden buildings. Large boulders are scattered along the left side of the road, and there are trees in the background. A tower-like structure rises above the low buildings near the center of the image. Printed captions in Russian and German (or older Estonian usage) at the top identify the place, and a handwritten word in blue ink appears in the upper right corner.

Colorized vintage image showing a lakeside or riverside pavilion with two round corner towers and red-tiled roofs, likely a grand café or lakeside casino. Numerous white outdoor tables and chairs line a terrace along the water. Several small rowboats and canoes are on the calm water in the foreground, with people boating. Behind the building are trees and, further back, more villa-style buildings with towers and domes in a wooded, hilly setting. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with a river in the foreground and dense trees along its banks. A tall round medieval tower with a domed roof stands near a stone gate on a hill, surrounded by historic buildings and sloping streets. Large institutional-looking buildings with mansard roofs dominate the skyline. On the left front, a multi‑storey house bears the sign "Alt‑Heidelberg". The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century cityscape.

Black-and-white portrait of a wide‑eyed woman with long dark hair, dramatically lit against a dark background, in an intense, theatrical pose. At the bottom center, white text identifies her as Annie Krull in the role of Elektra. In the lower right, small print credits a Dresden-based producer with the year 1909.

Tinted vintage postcard view of a round brick chapel with a tall pointed roof, partially framed by trees in a park-like setting. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or sit on benches along a gravel path in the foreground. Printed captions in Dutch appear below the image, along with a publisher line and some handwritten notes.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy market square filled with horse‑drawn wagons, stalls and people. On the left stands a large, ornate stone building with classical detailing; behind the square are multi‑storey brick buildings and, in the distance, tall factory chimneys emitting smoke. The image is bordered by handwritten text in a cursive script along the right edge and bottom, with a vertically written note on the left margin.

Black-and-white historical street view showing a cobblestone road with tram tracks running down the center in a European city. Several pedestrians in long coats and hats walk along the street, and a tram or horse-drawn streetcar is visible in the distance. Multi‑story brick and stucco buildings line the right side, with lower wooden houses and bare trees on the left. Printed text at the top identifies the location as a street in Malmö and credits the photographer and date.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a wooded sandstone mountain with rock formations and sparse ruins on top, labeled 'Berg Oybin'. At the base of the mountain lies a small settlement with several buildings, including what appears to be a church and other village houses, surrounded by trees and open grassy foreground with a large tree framing the right side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large neoclassical two‑storey government building with ornate window pediments, a central entrance with steps, and landscaped gardens in front. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location and publisher.

A small, vintage-style card featuring a painted portrait of a man in 18th‑century dress with a white powdered wig and a red and gold coat, set against a dark background. Below the portrait, on a gray band, is the printed name "HÄNDEL" in blue capital letters.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of riverside buildings at the foot of a steep, wooded hill with rocky outcrops. On the slope a funicular or electric railway ascends toward fortification structures on the hilltop. The lower margin contains printed German text in red, including the title referencing an electric railway to the Schlossberg and the city name Graz.

The image shows the back side of a mailed postcard. It features handwritten blue ink text on the left and center, a red postage stamp in the upper right corner with a circular postmark, and a machine cancel marking across the top center. There is no visible photograph or illustration side in this view.

An old monochrome postcard showing a large neoclassical building with arcades on the ground floor, three main stories, and two side towers. In front is a landscaped garden with paths, trees, and people walking. The right margin of the card has printed vertical text in French and Greek, and there is handwritten cursive text over part of the image. The building is identified as the central post and telegraph office.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside complex of buildings with a small dam or weir in the foreground. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century German, with a multi‑storey villa‑like structure and adjoining industrial or farm buildings, set beside a calm river and surrounded by fields and low wooded hills. The caption "Klosterbuch b. Leisnig" is printed in red at the top.

Vintage monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley between steep mountains. In the foreground are tightly packed houses and a church tower; in the background a wide, flat valley floor with fields and a winding road or river. A caption is printed in Italian along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large Gothic-style church with a tall tower rising above a wooded hillside and rooftops. The church dominates the skyline, and in the upper left portion of the card there is printed German text identifying the location and the church, including a note that it was built around the year 1225.

A monochrome postcard showing a full‑length studio photograph of a woman dressed in ancient Greek-style drapery and sandals, posed in profile with one arm raised to her forehead as if gazing into the distance and the other arm extended in front of her. The card has a light border and printed captions in French and Greek at the bottom, along with a faint seal on the lower left and a website credit at the very bottom.

A colorized vintage postcard view over a calm river or canal from a shaded riverside spot with a wooden jetty in the foreground. A man in dark clothing and a cap sits on a bench under large overhanging trees on the left. Across the water are moored boats and steamships, quays, and a townscape with low buildings and church spires in the distance. The caption in Swedish is printed along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square or street corner. On the right stands a large church or town‑hall‑like building with a tall clock tower featuring an onion‑shaped spire and multiple stacked stages. In the foreground is an open paved area with trees, a decorative streetlamp, and several pedestrians, including children and adults in early 20th‑century clothing. On the left and right sides are rows of two‑ to three‑story townhouses with steep roofs and many windows. The architecture looks Central European, likely German‑speaking. A faint shop sign is visible on one of the buildings, but the resolution makes the text unreadable.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a lively European city street or square lined with multi‑story buildings and trees. A fountain or circular flowerbed is in the foreground, and a baroque church tower rises prominently in the background along the main street. Well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and gather in the square. Large printed German text and handwritten notes appear at the bottom, including the red word "Graz."

Color postcard showing a panoramic view over a densely built city with many low-rise buildings and a prominent hilltop complex with ancient ruins in the distance. Tall cypress trees frame the foreground. In the upper left corner, red text in Greek and French reads "Άποψις Αθηνών." and "Vue d'Athènes." A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.

A colorized panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley, bordered by forested hills and fields. The image shows dense clusters of multi‑story townhouses with red and gray roofs, a few larger institutional-looking buildings, a rail or road corridor in the foreground with station‑like structures, and church spires rising above the rooftops. At the bottom margin, a caption in cursive script identifies the place.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an old European street scene with children playing in an open square in front of narrow, multi‑story houses with steep gabled roofs. In the background rises a large church with a steep roof, a clock on its facade, and a small spire. The caption at the bottom reads "Freiberg i. Sa.  Am Mühlgraben."

A black-and-white postcard view across a river toward the baroque skyline of Dresden. The foreground shows a riverside promenade with a balustrade and trees framing the scene. Across the river stand large historic buildings and church towers. The caption at the bottom reads in German: "Dresden  Blick vom Königsufer".

Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a broad tree-lined street bordered by two- and three‑story townhouses. The scene shows people walking and standing along the sidewalks and in the street. Large trees in the foreground frame the view. Printed text in red identifies the place as 'Innere Kamenzer-Strasse' in 'Königsbrück' and includes a publisher's line 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen' with a number '8951' and handwritten number '13085'.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large statue of a robed clergyman (Mgr. Hamer) on a tall stone pedestal in a landscaped park or square. The base is decorated with numerous wreaths and flowers, and two men in dark clothing and hats stand at the left. Trees and a building appear in the background. At the bottom margin in red print is the caption indicating the city and the statue.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town built on a hillside along a wide river. The foreground shows the riverbank and water, while the middle ground is filled with dense traditional European houses and small church towers. On the ridge above the town stands a large building complex that looks like a villa or small palace, and to the far left a tall cylindrical tower rises above the wooded hill. At the bottom margin of the image, a caption in white script reads "Radebeul‑West, Friedensburg." The overall style and printing look like an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy, narrow, sloping street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. People in early 20th‑century dress walk up and down the steep street. At the bottom left is a corner building with an awning and a sign on the wall. A domed structure rises in the background. The caption at the bottom reads 'CONSTANTINOPLE. Kûksek Kaldirim.' and there is a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' over the image.

Vintage monochrome (blue-toned) postcard showing a tall medieval tower beside a tree-lined waterway and park, with bridges crossing the water. The printed caption and publisher information appear beneath the image, and there is a handwritten message in cursive on the right side of the card.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a canal or river flowing between old multi‑story buildings, with balconies and arcades along the right bank and trees and houses on the left. A low stone bridge crosses the water in the middle distance, and a church tower with a pointed roof rises behind the buildings. At the bottom center margin, printed in red and black, is the caption 'Borgo - Lungo il Brenta'.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modernist four‑storey public building seen through trees in the foreground. The façade is symmetrical, with large vertical windows and a recessed entrance with columns. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street and across a forecourt, suggesting an institutional or cultural facility, likely a library or university building.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with cobblestone streets, large leafy trees, a church tower on the left, historic multi‑story buildings, and a prominent ornate war memorial monument with a statue on the right. Printed caption text in red identifies the scene as Wilhelmsplatz with a war memorial in Naumburg. The printer's credit appears in small type at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly townscape. In the foreground are residential houses with steep roofs surrounded by many trees. On the hillside above the town are terraced slopes and a prominent building resembling a small palace or villa with a tower and flag, known as Friedensburg. Further along the ridge are smaller buildings or pavilions. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Kötzschenbroda – Friedensburg, and a small number appears in the lower right corner.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a town square bordered by multi‑storey buildings and, in the background, a large fortified complex with high stone walls and a prominent cylindrical tower. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the square, and an old car is visible. Mountains rise behind the castle. Caption text is printed along the lower border.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large, steep‑roofed building with dormer windows and a tiled roof, set in a forested mountain valley. Conifer trees line a curving driveway in the foreground, and a rocky, cliff-like hillside rises behind dense mixed forest in the background. The composition resembles a rural inn or institutional building in an alpine or central European landscape.

Black‑and‑white view through an old city gate with a large rounded arch opening onto a cobbled street lined with multi‑storey townhouses. Above and to the right of the arch is a baroque‑style niche containing a seated crowned figure in relief, flanked by two standing figures with spears. Several German signs are attached to the wall by the arch. The overall scene suggests a historic European city street photographed in an early 20th‑century style.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a forest path along a river. On the left, tall coniferous trees line a dirt road where a few people walk with umbrellas or hats. On the right, the river bends away, with rocks and a low wooden structure or dam visible in the water and forested banks in the distance. Along the entire lower margin there is a handwritten message in cursive script. In the bottom-right corner, faint printed text appears.

Nighttime winter scene of a tall, multi-tiered monument covered in deep snow. A robed figure stands on top of the column-like base, with multiple sculpted figures around the pedestal, all blanketed in snow. Leafless trees and park lights surround the monument, and in the background a warm-lit brick tower with arched windows and a crenellated roof rises above the trees. The sky has a reddish glow typical of city lights on a snowy night. A thin white frame surrounds the image, as is common in printed postcards.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a street procession or parade in a European city. Men in suits and hats march in front while a mixed group of men and women follow behind. Some participants carry large placards with Cyrillic text and a large flag. The street is lined with multi‑story buildings with shops and awnings, and crowds stand on the sidewalks watching the march.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tree-lined road leading over a small bridge to a gated entrance with two stone pillars and wooden gates. Beyond the gate stands a large manor or small palace with a steep roof and dormer windows. At the top center of the image, printed text reads 'Gross-Schweidnitz.'

Colorized vintage view over a river running through a European city, with three bridges crossing the water, lined by multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. A church tower with an onion-shaped dome stands prominently on the right, and a fortified structure sits on a wooded hill in the background. At the top left, German text reads "Graz mit den 3 Brücken."

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing an old European street scene with steep‑roofed medieval houses and a tall church tower in the background. The drawing is done in pen-and-ink style. At the bottom margin there is a caption in German that reads "REVAL AN DER OLAIKIRCHE."

Black‑and‑white image of a large multi‑storey wooden hotel with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, standing beside a dirt road lined with trees. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the road. A long sign on the hotel façade reads in German, identifying it as a mountain hotel named "Berg hotel" in Oberbärenburg. Additional German signage is visible on boards near the road.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the circular stone ruin known as El Caracol at the Maya archaeological site of Chichén Itzá. The structure rises in tiers of weathered masonry with a partially collapsed upper section under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text in Spanish appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large, ornate stone institutional building in late 19th‑century historicist style. The façade has three main stories with rusticated ground floor, arched windows, and a richly decorated central section with pediment, statues, and balustrades. A wrought‑iron fence and low stone wall line the street in front, with trees and shrubs along the sidewalk. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century architectural postcard.

A black‑and‑white image of a two‑storey wooden house in a rural setting, likely serving as a small village shop or inn. The building has vertical wooden siding painted dark with light trim, a steep tiled or shingled roof, and a decorative front balcony or porch with ornate woodwork. Several people, including children and adults in early 20th‑century rural clothing, stand in front of the house along a dirt road, with trees and open land surrounding the scene.

A black-and-white landscape view of a valley with two hilltop fortifications on opposite sides. On the left stands a ruined medieval castle with one mostly intact round tower and another partially collapsed tower, both sitting atop a rocky ridge. On the right, across the valley, is a more preserved castle complex with a tall, pointed-roof tower and surrounding walls, also on a steep hill. The valley between is cultivated farmland with a light-colored strip of crop curving through the fields, bordered by trees and shrubs in the foreground. The sky area appears overexposed or cut out in the print. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small river or canal with a waterfall and an early hydro‑electric facility in a hilly town. Buildings stand along the water's edge, including a mill‑like structure and several wooden houses on the hillside. A small boat with people is on the water in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, with handwritten correspondence in Swedish over the lower margin.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large gabled town hall building fronting a cobbled square. The building has a steep red roof, a stepped or curved gable with a clock, and a small tower or cupola on top. A fountain or statue stands in front of the facade, and a sign reading "Ratskeller" is visible at street level. People are walking in the square in front of the town hall. The sky is lightly clouded and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene with a large two‑storey inn or guesthouse on a corner, bearing the sign "Gasthof zur goldenen Taube" and smaller text with the proprietor's name. A few people stand in front of the building. Other traditional houses with steep tiled roofs line the street. Printed in red at the bottom is the greeting "Gruss aus Ostrau i. S." and along the left margin publishing information.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European city on a wide river. In the foreground are tree‑lined paths and a curving elevated ramp or road leading down the hillside into a dense cluster of 19th‑century buildings with ornate roofs and church towers. On the hill to the left stands a large palace‑like complex. The broad river runs through the center of the image; a prominent suspension bridge with stone towers crosses it, with several steamships and boats on the water. On the far right riverbank a very large, domed neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance parliament‑style building stands prominently. Distant hills form the background. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

An old monochrome postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic monastery complex with a church and adjoining convent buildings behind a line of trees and a wall. The church has pointed arches, a tall central spire and decorative gables; crosses are visible on the roofs. Printed text at the bottom identifies the site, and there is cursive handwritten correspondence over the lower part of the image.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy street or small square in an old urban quarter, with two‑storey Balkan/Neoclassical houses with balconies in the background and a crowd of people, some in military uniforms, filling the scene. Market stalls line the right side. The caption at the bottom is in French and the card bears a printed website watermark.

A monochrome postcard showing a striped façade church with alternating dark and light horizontal bands, a central arched doorway with a small porch, circular window above, and small spires on the roofline. The church stands before a mountainous backdrop, with trees and a courtyard in the foreground. Printed caption text appears in the lower margin.

A black-and-white vintage view over a calm body of water toward a tree-lined shore with several large villa-style houses partly hidden among the trees. Overhanging branches frame the top of the image. At the bottom of the picture are printed captions: on the left, the bilingual place name "Helsingfors - Helsinki" and on the right the more specific location "Turholm." The overall design and typography resemble an early 20th-century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formation of uniformed soldiers standing in ranks in front of a multi‑storey neoclassical building with tall windows and a few trees in the courtyard. The men wear early 20th‑century style military uniforms and caps. Printed captions in red appear below the image in both Swedish and Finnish.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide urban street scene with several- to many-story buildings in early 20th‑century European style. People walk along the street and sidewalks; there are shopfronts at ground level. On the right is a rounded corner building with balconies and a large socialist‑style mural or poster of a worker holding a hammer. In the upper right corner of the card is Cyrillic text.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a small town in a wide alpine valley, surrounded by tall mountains with some snow on the peaks. The foreground shows clusters of red‑roofed houses and a church with a white bell tower. Fields and roads stretch across the flat valley floor toward dark green mountains in the background. The word "Caldonazzo." is printed in the lower left corner, and a small number "04912" appears in the upper right.

Vintage sepia stereoscopic image showing two nearly identical photographs side by side of the Parthenon temple ruins on the Acropolis, with rocky foreground and several columns standing. The style is that of an old photographic postcard or stereoview card, with Greek text beneath the image and a modern website watermark overprinted at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a staged opera or theatre scene in an ornate 18th‑century interior. A woman in a long dress stands near the center while a man in a military-style uniform kneels before her, reaching out. The backdrop features tall doors and decorative moldings. Handwritten Cyrillic text appears across the bottom identifying the work and performers.

Black‑and‑white view over a European town square or park, with a broad unpaved street in the foreground. On the left stands an ornate multi‑storey corner building with a mansard roof, dormer windows and a small cupola; in front of it is a decorative metal streetlight and a sign on the lamppost. In the center of the image, within a landscaped park filled with trees and shrubs, is a large equestrian statue on a pedestal. To the right are several richly decorated late‑19th‑century apartment houses with gabled roofs. In the distant background, on a hill, are more town buildings and a church with a tall baroque tower and onion‑shaped dome. The overall style and clothing of a few pedestrians suggest an early‑20th‑century Central European city.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a wide river with several boats and barges moored along the embankment. On the left side stands a long row of ornate multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with mansard roofs and a central domed structure, forming a classic European riverside boulevard. In the distance on the right is a slender suspension bridge crossing the river. The image is framed by an irregular white vignette border typical of old postcards.
