Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large fortified castle complex surrounded by wooded hills. The main building has steep roofs with many dormer windows and a central tower with turrets. Nearby are ancillary stone and half-timbered buildings, walls, and a pathway leading up from a valley. Printed German text appears at the top left of the image.

Color postcard view of a large medieval clock tower with a steep shingled roof and wooden balcony, standing on a hill overlooking a city. A man in period clothing and hat stands on a path by the tower, looking over the city. Trees and a winding walkway frame the foreground. The printed caption at the top right reads in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy seaside scene with a curving sandy beach lined with umbrellas and bathers. Behind the beach is a long arc of low seafront buildings and higher modernist apartment blocks, with a church-like structure and trees in the background. The image is captioned at the bottom left with the location, and a website watermark appears at the lower right.

Colorized historic postcard showing the ornate entrance of a brick Renaissance-style building with stone portal, statues, iron lattice window grilles, green shutters, and steps with railings leading up from a cobbled street. At the bottom edge, a caption in Dutch is printed.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a wide urban avenue lined with multi‑story buildings featuring balconies and awnings. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and several mid‑20th‑century cars are parked or driving along the street. The photo is taken from an elevated vantage point looking down the avenue under a partly cloudy sky. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Alexandria, Fouad I Avenue, along with a reference number and a website.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade and harbor basin bordered by stone quays and multi‑story neoclassical buildings. People walk along the promenade beside the calm water. The printed captions in Greek and English identify the location as Piraeus Harbor (Kanaris Bay). A logo and website appear at the lower edge, indicating an archival collection.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an elevated view of a mosque complex surrounded by trees and low buildings. A prominent square minaret with geometric decoration and a finial stands above tiled roofs. In the foreground, two robed figures stand on a path overlooking the scene. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the location as the Mosque of Sidi Haloui in Tlemcen.

A vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a townscape with a central church featuring a tall nave, pitched roof, and a small tower with a spire. Around it are clustered houses and larger multi‑story buildings, with trees interspersed and low hills in the distant background. The bottom margin contains red printed greeting text in Czech, and a publisher line in smaller type. A red handwritten number "1342" appears in the upper right margin.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European riverside town. In the foreground is a wide river with a stone embankment and riverside path. Behind it stand detached villas and multi‑storey townhouses with steep, gabled roofs and ornate façades, typical of late‑19th‑century Central European architecture. Terraced slopes planted with vines rise up the hillside, dotted with more houses and a large institutional‑looking building with corner towers. In the distance, rolling hills and an elevated church with a tall spire dominate the skyline. The overall scene shows an affluent residential district with vineyards along a river. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Gothic ensemble on a hill above a river, showing a castle-like complex with tall spires and towers (Albrechtsburg Castle and the cathedral) rising above smaller riverside houses. The scene is reflected in the calm water in the foreground. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a busy interior hall, likely a conference or transport terminal. Many people in mid‑20th‑century clothing stand in queues and groups, while others sit on benches in the foreground reading or writing. A brick pillar divides the space, and in the back right there is a counter area marked with a hanging sign reading "POST" where several people are being served.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rocky hillside topped by a large wooden cross. At the base of the rocks is a tree-lined path or road running into the distance on the right. The printed caption in German at the top left reads "Neissethal bei Kloster Marienthal."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Baroque-style palace with a central tower and mansard roof, seen from a formal garden with stairs and trimmed hedges in the foreground. Printed red text at the top identifies the site, and there are red pen marks crossing out a number. The publisher's imprint is printed vertically along the right edge.

A color winter street scene in a small town: snow-covered road, pedestrians in winter clothing, several 1960s–1970s cars, and low-rise brick and stone buildings. On the left is a red-brick building with a large circular ESSO gas-station sign and a sign for a Taverna. On the right is a substantial stone building with a vertical neon sign reading "BANK". Farther along the street are more commercial buildings, one with a light tower-like structure. The image has the look of a printed tourist postcard.

Colorized historical view taken from the deck of a ship looking toward a coastal city with low hills behind it. Several men in early 20th‑century naval or official uniforms stand and converse on the deck. The sea is dotted with small boats and the distant shoreline shows dense, light‑colored buildings along the waterfront. A lifebuoy, rigging, and ship structures frame the scene. At the bottom right there is a printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.

Black-and-white postcard view of a church largely hidden behind tall leafy trees and a wooden picket fence. The church has a tall, slender spire rising from a white gabled tower with a circular window. The scene appears tranquil, with a road in the foreground. In the lower-left corner, white text printed on the image identifies the place.

Black‑and‑white view of a busy European city street with tram tracks, pedestrians, shops with awnings, and historic buildings. A large baroque church tower dominates the right side background. Text along the bottom margin identifies the scene as Herrengasse with the city parish church in Graz and notes the publisher and date.

A vintage-style Easter greeting postcard showing a red squirrel sitting on a budding branch, holding a large yellow Easter egg. Behind it is a bright yellow sun or moon against a blue background. At the bottom, in a decorative script, is a short greeting in a Scandinavian language.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small European town surrounded by gently rolling hills and fields. Dense clusters of pitched-roof houses fill the foreground, with several factory chimneys visible. Dominating the town center is a large church with a tall steeple and clock tower. Conifer trees frame the lower edge of the image. At the top left, printed text reads "Roßwein i. Sa.", indicating the town name and region.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large rectangular manor or small castle with a steep gabled roof and dormer windows, photographed from the southeast across a lawn with bare trees in the foreground. Printed red German captions identify the place and viewpoint, and a small printer's credit appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European spa town, showing densely packed multi‑story buildings along a valley with a prominent colonnade crowded with people. On the hillside are large villas and grand hotels. The caption at the bottom reads in German: "Weltbad Karlsbad. Blick vom Panorama."

The image shows the written/back side of an old postcard. It has brown handwritten text in Estonian on the left and address information on the right. There is a red postage stamp in the upper right corner with a denomination of 15 (likely Estonian senti) and several black circular postmarks. The most legible postmarks read "POLTSAMAA EESTI 14 X 26" and "TALLINN EESTI 15 X 26," indicating dates in October 1926. The address is written to a person in Kopli, a district of Tallinn.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a coastal town with dense white cubic houses clustered around a curved bay, set on rocky terrain with low surrounding hills. The sea is calm and there are no tall modern buildings, giving it an old-fashioned appearance. Printed captions in Latin and Greek scripts appear at the bottom, and a website watermark is overlaid across the image.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a tall, narrow waterfall cascading down a rocky, wooded hillside. Leafless trees and a simple bridge or aqueduct structure occupy the foreground. Printed French captions at the top identify the location near Saint-Nectaire, and there is a small publisher credit at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a tree-lined street in a spa town with several elegant late-19th/early-20th-century houses. The central building bears the name 'MOZART' above a balcony, while another building is labeled 'GERDA'. The caption at the top reads 'Bad Elster. Haus Weiße Rose u. Mozart'. Power poles and a sloping road with a few pedestrians are visible, giving a small-town Central European atmosphere.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a man in a suit and cap posting or collecting mail from a street mailbox beside a wide, busy road. Several 1960s-era cars are parked or driving past; one car in the foreground has a crown-and-horn postal emblem on its door. In the background are waterfront buildings and a bridge-like roadway lined with streetlights and overhead wires. The image has the look of a documentary or tourist postcard from a Northern European city.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a baroque church-like building with a richly decorated façade, statues, and a large dome behind it. Narrow streets and adjacent buildings frame the view. At the top in red print it reads "Graz (346 m)" on the left and "Mausoleum Kaiser Ferdinand II." on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large open square with gardens, walking paths, and people strolling. On the left is a long row of multi‑story buildings with arcades and a towered structure in the middle distance. Behind the town rise steep, rocky mountains. The caption at the bottom margin reads "TRENTO - Piazza Venezia," identifying the scene as a city square in Trento, Italy.

Black-and-white postcard showing a canal with a passenger ship named 'JUNO' moored in front of a large Renaissance-style castle with round corner towers and a church-like tower. Trees line both sides of the waterway. The printed caption at the bottom left reads 'Vadstena Slott.' Additional small text with photo credits and numbering appears in the lower right corner.

A sepia-toned postcard showing an elegant neoclassical interior with a colonnaded gallery surrounding an open atrium. Massive stone columns with ornate Corinthian capitals support arches and a coffered glass roof. Balustrades run along the edges of the gallery, and a large painting is visible on the far wall. On the right side is a printed caption in multiple languages identifying the location and publisher.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a riverside town with a large historic building complex on a wooded hill to the left and a church with a tall tower near the center. Small houses line the riverbank. A paddle steamer crowded with people sails along the river, with another smaller vessel behind it. Trees frame the foreground. In the lower left corner, text reads 'Pirna a.d. Elbe'.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm lakeshore bordered by dense trees and reeds. A small rowboat with people inside is on the still water. In the distance, forested hills line the opposite shore. Faded printed text appears in the upper right area of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town set on gentle hills with fields and rows of trees in the foreground. A dense cluster of traditional multi‑storey buildings with steep roofs fills the middle, dominated by a large church or town hall tower rising above the skyline. At the bottom of the image, printed in red, is the town name, and in smaller red type below is the name of the publisher and city.

Sepia-toned historic street scene labeled "EISLEBEN Plan" showing a central square with a small pavilion and pond in the foreground, surrounded by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with shopfronts. People walk across the open square; tram tracks run through it. In the distant background are church towers rising above the town's rooftops. A red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.

Illustrated seascape of an early 20th‑century warship under steam in rough green water. The ship is painted white with yellow funnels and superstructure, and flies two Japanese naval flags: a white flag with a red disc at the stern and the Rising Sun naval ensign with rays at the main mast. Dark smoke pours from the funnels into a cloudy sky. There is a small artist's signature at the lower left, but no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow canal with wooden lock gates winding between steep rocky cliffs and forested banks. A footpath with railings runs along the rock wall. In the distance the canal curves through a wooded landscape under a sky partly rendered with drawn clouds. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text.

Color image showing a dramatic, steep green mountain valley under a partly cloudy sky. At the bottom of the valley there is a small settlement with scattered houses, fields, and a winding road. In the foreground is a rustic wooden viewing platform or balcony made of intertwined branches, suggesting a popular lookout point over the landscape.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a cargo motor ship named 'BARDALAND' at sea. The vessel, with multiple masts and cargo booms, is viewed from the side. Maritime signal flags fly from a mast, and a small flag at the stern appears to be the Swedish flag. The lower left corner has printed technical details about the ship, and the lower right corner identifies the shipping line and city.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal fortification with round stone walls on a bluff above the sea. A lone figure in traditional dress walks along a grassy path in the foreground. Below the cliff is a shoreline with rocks and small boats or structures in the water, and a town faintly visible in the background. French captions are printed beneath the image.

Black-and-white photograph showing a group of well‑dressed men and women, many wearing suits, hats, and summer dresses, standing on the deck of a boat. They look toward a lakeshore town in the distance. On the far shore, slightly left of center, rises a prominent church or monastery complex with a tall tower and dome above clustered buildings, surrounded by trees. The lake is calm and stretches across the foreground under a clear sky. There is a small handwritten mark or number in the upper left corner, but no printed caption is visible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing ancient stone ruins on a hillside, with a retaining wall to the left and scattered blocks and columns in the foreground and background. Mountains and a hazy valley are visible in the distance. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the site as the gymnasium of Delphi.

A colorized postcard view of sailboats racing on the water in the foreground. Two large sailing yachts dominate the left and right sides, with smaller boats and a red marker buoy between them. In the background stands a large seaside resort complex with red roofs and a prominent conical-roofed tower, identified as the Coronado Hotel. The sky is lightly clouded, and printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a walled military complex with multi‑storey stucco and brick buildings with tiled roofs. A uniformed sentry with a rifle stands at the main gate, which is framed by pillars and a metal fence. The caption in German at the top identifies the place as a royal garrison hospital (military hospital) in Leisnig in Saxony.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand historic opera house in a large open square. The building has richly ornamented Neo-Renaissance architecture with arched windows, heavy rusticated stone on the lower level, statues along the roofline, and a prominent portal crowned by a quadriga sculpture. Several people are walking or standing in the foreground and a few cars are visible in the distance. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a small seaside town with wooden boats moored along a narrow wooden pier or boardwalk that curves along the water. In the background are wooden houses and villas and, further back, a church with a tower rising above the trees. The word "STENUNGSUND" is printed in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 458 appears in the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large metal truss bridge spanning a river with steep rocky mountains in the background. Small buildings cling to the slopes and a road runs along the riverbank. There is an Austrian post stamp with a circular postmark in the upper left. Printed captions at the top identify the surrounding mountains and route, and at the bottom the location and publisher. Handwritten text appears in the lower right corner.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped garden in a city park. A sandy path splits into three directions, bordered by manicured lawns, low flowerbeds, and rows of rose-covered trellises or standard rose bushes. Dense green trees form a wooded backdrop under a blue sky. Red printed German text appears at the top.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tranquil park scene with a pond in the foreground reflecting trees and sky. Behind the pond are gently sloping lawns and tall coniferous trees, with a building partially obscured by the trees. Printed German text appears across the top, with a handwritten name added above part of the text.

Black‑and‑white view down a broad cobblestone street or square lined with multi‑story historic townhouses. Market stalls are arranged in long rows in the center, with people in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing walking and trading, and a few horse‑drawn carts. On the right side, shop signs and a hotel sign are visible on the façades. In the background stands a large medieval building with many dormer windows and scaffolding on its façade, and behind it a tall church tower whose spire is under scaffolding.

Colorized vintage postcard showing dramatic rocky sandstone formations rising above a rough, stony ground, surrounded by coniferous forest under a clear sky. Red German text is printed at the top of the image describing the location and elevation.

Black‑and‑white coastal view showing a calm bay with a low hill in the background, a small boat on the water, and a pebbly shoreline lined with trees on the right. The bottom margin contains printed Greek text identifying the location and publisher, and a faint circular seal plus a website watermark are visible.

A colored historical postcard showing an allegorical female figure in a purple dress and laurel wreath holding a large Greek flag. She stands on a red map-like shape that appears to depict territory with Ottoman symbols. In the background is a lake or wide river with small steamships and low hills, suggesting a town on the far bank. Greek text appears at the bottom left and a numerical code at the bottom right, with a watermark-like logo and the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' overprinted.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street view with a large, ornate late‑19th‑century civic building on the left, identified as the royal district court. The street extends into the distance with several historic buildings featuring steep roofs, dormers, and tower-like structures with spires. People walk along the sidewalk and a horse-drawn vehicle is visible. The bottom of the card bears red printed German text and a publisher's line in smaller type.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a gently curving street lined with multi‑story townhouses and inns, leading towards a prominent church tower with a clock and spire. The caption at the top in red Gothic-style text reads "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb. Bahnhofstrasse," indicating a view of Bahnhofstrasse in Frauenstein in the Erzgebirge region. German signage on the left façade includes "Gasthaus zum Lindenhof." The printer's imprint and date appear along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned image of a grand historicist university building with ornate facades, arched ground floor, statues in niches, and a balustraded roofline with decorative railings. In the foreground, two men stand by a low wall and hedge along a street. At the bottom of the image, a caption identifies the location.

Colorized postcard view of a large sanatorium building with steep red-tiled roofs and white walls, surrounded by lawns, flowerbeds, and trees. A long, low gallery-like wing extends in front of the main building. The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and a small airship or dirigible appears above the roof. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the place as "Bad Elster" and the facility as "Dr. Köhlers Sanatorium."

Colorized panoramic view over a European town with red‑roofed houses, factory chimneys and a large hilltop castle complex in the background. The scene is printed in an old chromolithographic style and the top of the image bears the caption 'Nossen, Blick vom Seminar.'

Sepia-toned photograph of an inner cloister or courtyard with arcaded walkways. The image shows a series of stone columns supporting rounded arches, with potted plants lined along the balustrade in the foreground. Across the courtyard, another arcade with smaller arches and a decorative balustrade is visible, along with weathered plaster walls, arched windows, and traces of frescoes. The architectural style is reminiscent of a Renaissance or late-medieval cloister in Southern Europe.

Vintage illustrated postcard framed by a stylized stone arch and crenellated wall. At the top are two circular crests: one with a silver lion on a green background, the other with red, black, and yellow fields, a rising sun, and plants, encircled by German text. Below, in the arch opening, is a monochrome view of a grand historicist building with a central dome and two corner towers, labeled 'Rathaus'. A square with market stalls, umbrellas, pedestrians, and a tram is in front of the building. At the bottom, the word 'GRAZ' is printed.

A black‑and‑white historical photograph of a wooden pier and harbor. Steamships with smokestacks are docked to the left, small boats to the right, and cranes and masts rise above the ships. People and cargo are scattered along the long wooden quay. The text at the top reads in Swedish and Finnish, indicating the harbor of Yxpila/Ykspihlaja.

Tinted vintage postcard showing an outdoor garden café set along a path bordered by dense greenery and trees. Several simple wooden tables and chairs are arranged beside the path, with a small white pavilion or kiosk on the left. Tall trees rise on a hill in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Café Valk, Ubbergen." with a date handwritten in ink near the lower left. Along the left margin there is vertical printed text.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑storey barracks building in a wooded camp area. Numerous uniformed men stand and walk in the yard under large trees in front of the long, simple building with many windows. Printed German text at the top right identifies the scene as a barracks camp in Dresden and specifies it as a soldiers' barrack, rear side.

A black‑and‑white view through a large stone archway toward a historic European building complex. In the distance stands a church or chapel with a tall, slender spire and bulbous baroque-style roof. To its left are long steep‑roofed buildings with rows of Gothic-style windows and dormers. The foreground shows a rough stone wall and ground framed by the darker interior of the arch. At the very bottom, faint, mirrored handwriting appears on the negative.

A black‑and‑white night view of an illuminated grand historic building with a dome, behind an equestrian statue and several standing figures on a pedestal. The photograph is vertically oriented with a white border, and printed caption text appears at the bottom in Czech, identifying the scene as Prague's National Museum with the statue of St. Wenceslas.

Colorized postcard view of a large historic building with a red-tiled roof, small towers and timber-framed gables, seen behind trees and a garden wall. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. In the upper right corner there is printed German text identifying the location as Großenhain and the König-Friedrich-August-Stift.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing an old stone doorway with a rounded Romanesque/Gothic arch and worn steps leading up to a heavy wooden door. Above the entrance is a carved coat of arms. To the right is a metal fence and climbing vegetation on the wall. The lower front margin bears a printed caption in red identifying the location as Meissen and specifying it as an entrance to the castle area.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside or canal in a small town. On the right bank stand large wooden houses with steep roofs and many windows, with smaller houses and buildings scattered up the hill behind them. Trees frame the scene, and calm water fills the foreground with a curved stone embankment and benches on the left. Printed text at the top reads in Swedish that the motif is from Uddevalla.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural church complex with a tall square tower and adjoining nave, surrounded by trees and fields. A winding country road leads toward the church. Printed text at the top left reads "Svärta kyrka, Södermanland."

Colorized historic postcard showing a formation of soldiers in dark green tunics, white trousers, and spiked helmets (Pickelhauben) standing with rifles in front of a neoclassical building with white columns and steps. The scene is outdoors, with trees and a brick building in the background. Red German text is printed at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white view over a rocky coastal landscape with scattered low islands and the sea in the background. In the foreground and mid‑ground, people walk among rocks and vegetation down towards a bathing area with rows of small beach huts or cabanas along a path. The scene is framed by granite cliffs typical of a Scandinavian west coast. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with a number is in the lower right.

A black‑and‑white beach scene showing many children playing in the sand and shallow water. In the background is the sea with a low rocky breakwater. On the right stands an ornate wooden bathhouse structure on piles over the water, with domed roofs and decorative details and a covered walkway with curtains hanging down. The lower left corner bears the caption "Varbergs Havsbad." In the lower right corner there is an oval stamp-like mark reading "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI."

Sepia-toned postcard view of a riverside or canal-side promenade labeled in German. It shows an elegant historic building complex with ornate roofs and a tall tower with a spire, reflected in the calm water in the foreground. A small bridge crosses the water on the left, and a walled walkway with trees lines the bank on the right. The printed caption at the top left reads "Bilin. Am Bielaquai."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a historic European city. On the left is the corner of a building with a bay window and iron balcony. A curved street runs downhill along a wall, leading toward a dense cluster of old rooftops. In the distance a large medieval church with a very tall, slender spire dominates the skyline. There is a printed caption at the bottom and a red postage stamp with a circular postmark at the upper right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town. A narrow river or canal runs through the foreground, lined by trees and a path on the left. On the right are multi‑story houses and industrial-looking buildings with simple facades and gabled roofs, plus a tall chimney in the distance. A bridge crosses the waterway toward the center-right. In the upper right corner, red printed text identifies the scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large brick school building in historicist style with towers, gables, and arched windows, surrounded by a wrought‑iron fence and trees. A few people walk along the unpaved street in front. In the upper left corner printed text reads "Wittenberg a. d. Elbe. Neue Bürgerschule." in German.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Gothic-Renaissance castle complex on a hill above trees. One of the central towers is surrounded by extensive scaffolding, indicating construction or restoration work. The caption at the top left reads "Meissen.  Kgl. Albrechtsburg." and a small vertical imprint with publisher information appears on the right edge.

A colorized historic postcard view of a busy bridge over a river leading into a city square. The ornate iron bridge is crowded with pedestrians and an early electric tram. On the far side stand multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs, one bearing the sign 'CAFÉ MERAN'. There are lampposts and statues on the bridge and in the square, with trees and more buildings behind. A church tower with a clock rises in the background. The caption at the top reads 'Graz. Franz Karl-Brücke.'

Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square in front of 3–4 story historicist buildings with shops on the ground floor. A tall Marian or plague column with a statue stands on a stepped base surrounded by trees in the middle of the square. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand around, and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. A church with a tower and cross is in the background on the right. The architecture and signage suggest a Central European city.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a mid-20th-century cargo ship at sea in profile. The vessel is painted light in color with darker hull below the waterline. Several cargo masts and booms are visible along the deck. On the side of the ship, large lettering reads "SWEDISH CHICAGO LINE." Near the bow, smaller text identifies the ship as "FREDSBORG" with the home port or registry written below. The sea is relatively calm and the sky is lightly clouded, giving the image a classic maritime publicity-photo look.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a flat, modern industrial factory building in a snowy landscape bordered by pine trees. In the foreground are tall, thin conifer trunks and snow‑covered ground. Printed Finnish text appears on the bottom left, and the company name "Oy Tampella Ab" with a phone number appears on the bottom right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a uniformed cavalryman on horseback holding a lance with a small flag. The rider wears a traditional military dress uniform with a plume on his hat, and the horse is fully tacked. They stand in front of a simple wall with a low stone base. The image is bordered by a wide blank margin; at the bottom in red script is the word 'Grossenhain.' There is also small vertical printer information along the left side and a handwritten red number at the lower right.

A winter-themed biathlon World Cup '97 souvenir postcard with purple snowflake border and Japanese text at the top, including event dates and location. The right side has an illustration of a cartoon beaver on skis with a rifle on its back inside a frame labeled "Biathlon World Cup'97 NOZAWAONSEN CROSS COUNTRY SHOOTING 3/6·8·9". The left side bears several Japanese postage stamps (including Olympic-themed and bird stamps) with commemorative postmarks. The center contains handwritten address and message in Estonian, as well as multiple signatures at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard with three photographs of stone ruins on a hillside. The images show crumbling walls, arches, and fortifications surrounded by rocky terrain and sparse vegetation. On the right side, printed text in French reads "GRÈCE – Péloponèse – MISTRA" and each photo is captioned with a small number and the word "Mistra." A faint circular stamp and a printed URL watermark (elia.org.gr) also appear.

Color postcard view of a large historic market square. On the left stands an ornate Renaissance-style town hall with a steep greenish copper roof and richly decorated façade with arcades at ground level. On the right is a large twin-towered Gothic cathedral with tall green spires and a prominent rose window above three arched entrances. The square in front is busy with 1950s–1960s era cars and many pedestrians under a clear blue sky. There is no visible printed caption on the front.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large late‑19th‑century red‑brick institutional building with several long wings and three to four stories, set behind a fence and young trees. The architecture is sober and functional, with regularly spaced tall windows, simple cornices and a tiled, moderately pitched roof with many lightning rods. In the foreground is an open square or parade ground where groups of men in dark jackets and light trousers stand and converse; one man on horseback passes along the front of the building. The overall scene suggests a military barracks, academy, or other government complex. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a sandy forest path on a hill, with several children standing on the path in the foreground and a group of people silhouetted on the hilltop in the distance. Dense trees line both sides of the path. Printed Dutch text appears at the top, and handwritten cursive text is written across the bottom. A small imprint with publisher information and number is in the lower left corner.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal town with many low, tile-roofed houses on a hillside leading down to the sea. The foreground shows orderly streets and single- to two-story buildings; the background includes more densely packed houses and a small peninsula. Printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom identify the town as Agios Nikolaos in Crete, and a website watermark appears in the lower right.

Illustrated World War I–era military postcard showing a uniformed soldier standing beside two pack ponies loaded with gear in a wintry landscape. The border is decorated with alternating red, black, and white squares. Text in Swedish and Finnish captions the scene, and there is a small signature with the place and date "HAGA 12/4 1918."

A black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered road lined with bare trees leading toward a large church building with a tall tower. A lone person walks along the path. Small wooden buildings and fences are visible on either side. In the lower left corner, text reads "Bodens Kyrka."

Urban skyline view of a dense city with many mid- and high‑rise apartment and office buildings in hazy light. A curving river or canal runs through the foreground with embankments on both sides. The architecture is mostly modern concrete towers, with one distinctive white mid‑rise building featuring rounded corners and a small tower on its roof. The scene looks somewhat smoggy, suggesting a large industrial or commercial Asian metropolis. No visible text appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a long row of solid brick institutional buildings with three to four stories, built in a late‑19th‑century style with gabled roofs, chimneys, and light stone banding around the windows and corners. The complex is enclosed by a brick wall topped with metal railings, bordering a wide unpaved or lightly paved road lined with a few young trees. No people or vehicles are visible. There is no printed caption or legible signage on the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a pavilion at an international fair. The building has classical-style columns and a tiled roof with Greek signage on the frieze and above the entrance. People in 1920s clothing are walking and standing around the structure. At the bottom, bilingual Greek and French captions identify the event as the 1927 International Fair in Thessaloniki. In the upper-right corner there is a printed Greek postage stamp.

An old Italian postal card with pre-printed Italian text at the top and a red printed stamp on the upper right, postmarked "MILANO". The card bears the coat of arms of the Kingdom of Italy in the center. There is a blue circular arrival postmark in Russian and purple handwritten address text in Russian and Latin script, including "St. Petersburg". The card side shown is the address/message side only, without any photograph or illustration.

Illustrated advertising postcard for a steam brewery. It shows a bearded king-like figure in a red robe sitting on a beer barrel and holding up a foaming mug, scenes of brewery workers operating large vats and machinery, and a horse-drawn wagon loaded with beer barrels. Decorative hop vines frame the industrial scenery. The lower part contains printed German and Russian text naming the brewery and city.

Vintage monochrome postcard view over dense trees toward a historic European townscape. Church towers and a large castle-like complex dominate the skyline on the right. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the view as Torgau from the south, with additional printed publisher information and red handwritten script across the lower margin.

Black-and-white vintage postcard view taken from under a large brick viaduct arch, looking onto a broad tree‑lined street with people walking. In the background rises a tall church tower above the surrounding buildings. Printed captions identify the scene as a viaduct in Nijmegen. Marginal text at the left names the editor/publisher from Amsterdam, and there is a handwritten-style signature at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white view of a lakeside or pond with trees framing the scene and the water reflecting the buildings opposite. In the background stands a substantial late‑19th‑century building with a mansard‑like roof, gabled ends, and arched ground‑floor windows. A group of people is lined up in front of the entrance. On the façade, German text advertising a concert or ball hall is visible. To the left is a timber‑framed house partly obscured by trees and a fence.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate, high‑ceilinged interior hall with large arched and round windows, elaborate stucco wall decorations, chandeliers, framed medallion reliefs, a tall cabinet with a clock, small tables and chairs, and potted plants. The right margin bears German text printed vertically with a date and publisher information.

A colorized historical postcard depicting a bustling market square surrounded by ornate Dutch-style buildings with stepped and ornate gables. A tall tower with a decorative spire rises behind the square. Numerous stalls, carts, and people fill the foreground, suggesting an open-air market day. The caption on the upper left reads 'NIJMEGEN. Markt'. Additional commercial signage is visible on one of the buildings.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a riverside landscape with several wooden houses and buildings along the shore, backed by a forested hill. Tele poles and a small riverside settlement appear in the foreground. On the upper right, there is overprinted Swedish text describing the scene.

Colorized postcard view of a neo‑Romanesque bastion with round towers and conical spires overlooking a city and the Danube. In the foreground are terraced gardens and a path; in the distance a church with twin towers is visible. Red printed text at the top left identifies the scene in Hungarian and German.

Monochrome vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with a row of birch trees beside a narrow dirt path leading toward a town in the distance. A church tower rises above the town's rooftops and there is a tall power line pole visible on the right. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border.

Color postcard showing a bright spring or summer rural landscape: a wide meadow full of yellow flowers, paths crossing the grass, a small pale-colored house with a red tiled roof on a gentle hill, dense green trees behind it, and a light-colored coach or bus parked near the house. In the foreground two people walk along a path toward the bus. The sky is blue with light clouds. A small printed caption appears in the bottom‑right corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with a central statue of a man on a pedestal surrounded by a cast‑iron fence, a fountain to the left, and rows of multi‑story gabled buildings with shops at street level. In the background stands a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped spire and clock. Shop signs on the facades are in German, indicating various businesses around the square.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a serene garden scene with a narrow river or canal lined by dense trees on both banks. In the center background there is a small wooden arched bridge crossing the water, with a person standing on it. At the top, printed text in German reads "Mitau" and "Partie aus dem Schloßgarten. II".

Black-and-white postcard photograph of an ivy-covered church surrounded by trees and a churchyard with gravestones. The church has a tiled roof and a distinctive tower with a bulbous spire topped by a cross. At the bottom of the image, white caption text identifies the location as Radebeul-Zitzschewig Kirche.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded park set in a hilly, forested landscape. Numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along winding paths, sit on the grass, and gather around small pavilions and tables. Coniferous trees rise in the background. At the bottom left there is a printed caption identifying the place.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town. In the background stands a large historic castle-like building with a central tower and red roofs on a hill above the riverbank. Boats and small wooden barges lie along the shore and on the water in the foreground, with people sitting in one of the boats. Trees line the left side, and a bridge over the river is visible in the distance to the right. The sky is softly colored from yellow to blue. Red printed text at the top reads "Torgau." on the left and "Blick von der Elbe." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a church complex with a central baroque-style tower and arched entrance, flanked by tall trees and adjacent buildings. In the background to the left, three crosses stand on a hill, reinforcing the Calvary theme. There are a few people in period clothing in front of the gate. The lower margin of the image is printed with the caption identifying the church and the city, and the left margin lists the publisher. Handwritten notes appear along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small village in a wide valley surrounded by steep, rocky mountains. In the right foreground stands a prominent church with a bell tower and dome-like roof, facing a small square and clustered houses. The landscape is filled with fields, orchards, and scattered farm buildings extending to the base of dramatic limestone cliffs and higher peaks in the background. The print has a decorative scalloped border typical of vintage postcards. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad, almost empty square flanked by early 20th‑century multi‑storey townhouses on the right and older, low plastered buildings with steep tiled roofs and chimneys on the left, possibly part of an industrial complex or brewery. Ornate cast‑iron street lamps line the square. In the distance a freestanding building with commercial signage on its facade faces the open space. The overall style is central European and pre‑war.

Black-and-white postcard showing the bow and port side of the motor ship m/s Birkaland moored at a quay. The ship's name "BIRKALAND" is clearly visible on the hull, with masts, rigging, and flags above. At the bottom of the image, printed text provides technical data about the vessel and the shipping line, including its deadweight, speed, and that it belongs to Svenska Orient Linien of Gothenburg.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional rustic inn or tavern with carved wooden chairs, tables, a large tiled ceramic stove, hanging pots and pans, a guitar on the wall, decorative plates on a shelf, framed pictures, and patterned doors. The space has exposed wooden beams and cozy, folk-style decor. Above an archway in the back, the word "Hölle" is written.

A yellow postcard from the Museum of Physical Education and Sports in Budapest. The left side shows a circular image of a sports medal labeled with the number 6. At the top left are bilingual headings in Hungarian and English. At the bottom left is information about an exposition of sports medals held in 1987. On the upper right is a purple Hungarian postage stamp depicting a historic building, with a circular cancellation mark featuring a running athlete and the text of the museum and Budapest around it. Address lines are printed on the right-hand side.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a cobblestoned town square with a large stone church or chapel on the left, an adjacent civic-looking building with a small tower in the center, and lower townhouses on either side. In front of the church stands an elaborate Baroque Marian or plague column with statues around a tall obelisk-like shaft. People in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square; a horse‑drawn cart is at the left edge. German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

Vintage sepia postcard with multiple photographic views of Degerloch. The upper strip shows villas on a hillside and a railway track, labeled as the villa colony Degerloch and the electric rack railway, including an observation tower. The lower strip has two street views: on the left a building by a tram or rail stop among trees, on the right a traditional inn with people standing in front. Decorative floral motifs appear at the sides and all captions are printed in German.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a river with a cart and person in the shallow water in the foreground, ducks on the river, and a town along the riverbanks. On the left there is a bridge and riverside buildings; in the middle distance a crowd of people stands along the right bank. On the hill in the background stands a prominent fortress or castle. Handwritten text in Greek runs around the margins. At the bottom, the place name appears in Latin characters.

Black‑and‑white image of an old-fashioned kiosk or newsstand filled with books, magazines, and racks of postcards. The stand has large glass windows, decorative metal brackets, hanging lamps, and a striped awning on the left. The surrounding area appears to be a wooden platform, possibly near a station or port. The visible printed items show small images and lettering but are not legible in detail.

A black‑and‑white interior scene showing a woman standing behind a tall wooden reception or office desk. She wears an early‑20th‑century style blouse with a ruffled front and looks toward the camera. On the counter and behind her are office items such as books, papers, a desk lamp, and an early box‑style telephone. The room has dark wood paneling and frosted glass partitions, suggesting a bank, hotel, or administrative office.

A black‑and‑white image showing a multi‑arched stone railway viaduct crossing a deep, wooded valley in a rural, hilly landscape. Train tracks run along the top of the viaduct with a signal mast visible near one end. Beyond the bridge are open fields and dense forested hills. The photograph has irregularly cut borders, as if mounted or cropped, consistent with early 20th‑century postcard prints.

Color postcard-style panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, green landscape near a lake or wide river. The foreground shows orchards or cultivated fields with neat rows of trees. In the midground is a compact town with red-tiled roofs and a prominent church with a tall bell tower. Beyond the town lies blue water curving along the base of extensive green hills, with scattered farmhouses and small settlements on the slopes. A mountain ridge runs across the background under a bright blue sky with large cumulus clouds. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

A sepia-toned studio portrait of a young couple, likely from the early 20th century. The woman, in a light-colored, lace-trimmed dress, holds a basket of large flowers. The man, in a striped suit and tie, stands closely beside her with his arm around her, both smiling slightly. They pose in front of a painted backdrop featuring a small tree or plant. The photograph is printed in an oval vignette and surrounded by a faux-wood printed border, resembling a framed picture. No visible writing or postal markings appear on the image side.

A monochrome postcard showing a large, early‑20th‑century residential building complex behind a wooden picket fence. The houses have steep tiled roofs, chimneys, balconies, and a rounded corner veranda. Trees and shrubs partially obscure the lower part of the building. Printed text at the top reads "Nya Prästgården. Trollhättan."

Sepia-toned vintage aerial view of a European town dominated by a tall central tower with a clock and spire, surrounded by dense rows of tiled-roof houses. In the background are industrial buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, and in the foreground a large classical-style multi-story building. The upper left corner bears the printed title 'Wurzen'.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an old stone and brick chapel with arched doorway and small leaded-glass window, topped by a steep, gray, pyramid-shaped roof. The structure appears medieval and somewhat ruinous. Surrounding trees are visible in the background. At the bottom, in decorative red script, is a caption identifying the site.

Old sepia photograph mounted in a decorated card frame showing a cluster of modest, weathered houses with tiled roofs and wooden sheds or fences in a dense urban neighborhood. The architecture appears Balkan/Ottoman-influenced, with upper stories slightly overhanging and clay roof tiles. The mount has floral ornaments and handwritten text in a Cyrillic script at the top and bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic masonry bridge with large arches leading to a complex of old buildings with steep tiled roofs and a small tower. Trees and foliage surround the scene. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Colorized historic postcard view of a European city square with a tall brick clock tower (town hall) on the left and a row of gabled houses lining a broad street or market square with trees and a fountain. In the background stands a massive brick Gothic church with a large central tower and multiple slender spires. The caption at the bottom reads "Danzig. Langenmarkt und Rathhaus." and printing information appears vertically along the left edge. The number 365 is handwritten in red in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a half‑timbered German tavern or inn on a sloped cobblestone street. The building has a steep tiled roof, shuttered windows, and painted shields on the facade. A large sign identifies it as a beer and wine tavern, and three women in aprons and dresses stand in the doorway while a man poses on the steps. Another man is visible along the street. The lower edge of the image shows damage typical of old photographic postcards.

A hand‑colored panoramic view of a small European town set amid rolling fields and farmland. The town has dense red‑roofed houses, a prominent church with a tower at the center, and another large churchlike building with a tall spire on the right. The foreground shows cultivated fields; the background consists of gently rising hills and scattered trees. Printed German text appears in red along the bottom margin, with publisher information in smaller type.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey historic school building with many regularly spaced windows, a mansard roof with small towers, and decorative façades. In front of the building is a tree‑lined street with a few pedestrians and a small park or green area in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the location and the institution depicted.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a carved Gothic altarpiece in three panels. The central scene is the Crucifixion of Christ with mourners and figures in relief; the side panels depict additional biblical scenes with many finely detailed figures under ornate tracery. A light border surrounds the image, and German captions are printed along the bottom margin.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large rectangular military barracks building fronting an open parade ground. The multi‑storey structure has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance, with young trees lining the street in front. Printed German titles in red identify the location as Dresden and specify that it is the barracks of the 3rd and 4th companies of the 12th Infantry Regiment No. 177. Publisher information is printed along the sides.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a broad curved road in the foreground leading toward a large, two‑storey classical-style building with many windows and chimneys. Behind it are wooded hills with rocky outcrops and scattered houses. The scene looks semi‑rural with telegraph poles along the road. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and a small serial number in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing four men in straw boater hats rowing a wooden boat on a calm pond or small lake. Behind the water is a line of leafy trees, beyond which stand historic masonry buildings, including a prominent church with a tall, slender tower topped by a bulbous spire and cross. Another large, simple gabled building with small windows stands to the right. The scene has a tranquil, park-like atmosphere. No printed caption or text is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a landscaped circular park in the foreground, benches, gas lamps, and several people sitting or standing. At the center stands a cylindrical monument or fountain with reliefs and a large statue of a figure on top, encircled by an iron fence. Behind it is a row of 3‑story gabled houses with shopfronts at street level, and in the background rises a church tower with a tall, narrow spire. Some German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

Black-and-white street view showing a historic town gate tower with a clock at the center of a busy street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. In the foreground there is a fountain with a basin and a column topped by a statue of a man working with or pushing a wheel (Radmacherbrunnen). Vintage cars and pedestrians are visible. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as Rietstraße with Radmacherbrunnen in Villingen in the Black Forest.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels, each showing a small European town square with cobblestone streets, 3–4 story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs, and 1950s–1960s cars parked along the streets. The upper left panel features a town hall–like building with a clock tower and cupola. The upper right panel shows a market square with a sculptural fountain in the foreground and a church or gate tower with a pointed roof in the background. The lower panels depict rows of shops and businesses; visible signs include a pharmacy labeled "STADT-APOTHEKE" and other German shop names.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, clipped shrubs and flowerbeds along paths, and a large historic complex with church-like buildings, towers and spires in the background. On the right is a manor-style building. Printed German captions appear at the bottom, and the number 382 is written in red at the top right.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a small European town. In the foreground are fenced fields and modest houses with pitched roofs. In the middle stands an ornate Orthodox-style church with onion domes. Behind it, on a wooded hill, are the ruins of a medieval castle with a round keep or tower. On the far right is a tall Lutheran-style church with a slender spire. The image is bordered like an old photographic postcard; no clear caption is visible within the picture area.

Colorized historic postcard view of a grand spa building with ornate towers and arcaded wings, labeled as the Kurhaus in Bad Elster. The foreground shows a formal garden with circular flowerbeds, trimmed lawns, paths, benches, and trees framing the scene. The sky is lightly clouded, giving a serene resort atmosphere.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a mass grave. A man in heavy winter clothing and a fur hat stands in a deep earthen pit filled with numerous naked or partially clothed corpses, many extremely emaciated. He is lifting one of the bodies by the legs. The setting appears muddy and cold; the walls of the pit are rough earth. There is no visible border design or caption on the image side, only the stark documentary photograph.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, low, colonnaded building in a landscaped park with large trees and lawns. The modernist pavilion has many tall windows and stands on a raised platform with steps leading up. Curved paths run through the foreground. Handwritten captions at the bottom read the location and the name of the building.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large wooden pavilion-style building in a park-like setting, surrounded by tall trees. The architecture features verandas, ornate wooden railings, and a prominent steeply pitched roof with a curved peak. In the foreground is an open grassy area; in the background, dense forest. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene, and there is handwritten text along the left border.

A monochrome vintage image showing a calm river curving through a rural landscape. On the left bank stand several two‑storey houses with steep roofs and simple facades, followed further back by more small buildings partly obscured by dense trees. A forested hill rises behind the settlement, and a flagpole with a faint flag can be seen near the central building complex. On the right side of the river a small boat with a few people is visible. The overall style and tonality suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard of a small European riverside town.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing four aerial photographs of an industrial waterfront complex surrounded by forested landscape and a river or bay. The images depict a large sawmill or timber-processing facility with stacks of logs floating in the water, factory buildings, chimneys, docks, and nearby rural settlements. Below the photos, bold printed text identifies the company and location: Ankarsviks Ångsågs Aktiebolag in Sundsvall, Sweden.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a statue of Martin Luther in front of a Gothic church facade with large pointed-arch stained‑glass windows. The statue stands on a pedestal enclosed by a low decorative fence and surrounded by plants. Text identifying the place is printed at the top right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance and minaret of a historic mosque. The tall square minaret with decorative arches rises above a large arched doorway framed by intricate ornamentation. In the foreground, several robed figures stand and converse near a donkey on an unpaved street in front of the mosque. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a mosque in Meknes.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rocky coastal bay with wooden bathhouse buildings on the shoreline. A large building with many windows stands on the rocks, with people gathered around in light summer clothing. A tall flagpole flies a Scandinavian-style cross flag with a line of small pennants. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large early-20th‑century battleship at sea, viewed from the side. The ship has multiple gun turrets, two funnels, and tall masts with rigging. Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a World War I memorial ceremony. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a waterfront scene dominated by a large round stone tower with crenellations at the top. A vintage monochrome postcard showing an inner courtyard surrounded by Renaissance-style arcaded galleries with multiple arched loggias and a steep tiled roof with dormer windows. Vintage monochrome postcard showing an outdoor gymnastics or athletic display. Greek text is printed beneath the image and there is a faint circular emblem on the left plus the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right.

Sepia-toned early 20th‑century postcard showing a panoramic view of a spa town with grand multi‑story hotels and villas along a park or promenade in the foreground, backed by wooded hills. A sepia-toned historical postcard showing an ornate stone staircase leading up to the entrance of a richly decorated Renaissance-style building. The architecture suggests a town hall or civic building. At the bottom of the image, printed text identifies the location.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large stone-and-plaster institutional building with a metal roof, multiple chimneys, and many rectangular windows. The architecture appears early 20th century. Colorized landscape view of a river curving through green fields with low hills and farm buildings. In the middle distance there is a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing the river. Old monochrome postcard showing a rural landscape with fields, trees, and a village of scattered farmhouses and small buildings labeled as Höckendorf. Black-and-white postcard showing a calm river or reservoir bordered by forested hills. In the foreground are trees and the shoreline; on the water are small boats and a sailboat. In the distance, partly obscured by trees, stands a hilltop castle. German text is printed along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the medieval rooftops of Sibiu with a tall clock tower capped by an onion dome rising above the old town. The reverse side has Romanian text and postcard layout with price and publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval cobbled lane with a stepped ramp and multiple brick arches between old walls. Several people walk up the passage. The reverse is printed in Romanian and identifies the view as from Sibiu's Lower Town.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a street view of Sibiu with pedestrians and a bicyclist framed by an arch. ROMÎNĂ stamps, and the printed heading REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stepped alley with brick arches and old houses, bustling with pedestrians. Multiview color postcard labeled SIBIU, showing the city's coat of arms and several views of Sibiu's historic center: the ornate cast‑iron Bridge of Lies over a curved brick rampart, the tall spire and clock of the Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral rising above red‑tiled roofs, a narrow old street with a hanging barrel sign, and a grand boulevard with an early‑20th‑century building and parked cars. The reverse has Romanian text, stamps, and a handwritten message dated 1982.

Color view of medieval brick fortifications with a deep outer wall and a round defensive tower with a red tiled conical roof along a tree‑lined lane. Reverse shows blue‑ink handwriting, a Romanian 40 Bani stamp (oil derrick), Bucharest postmarks dated 1971, and the credit line indicating Sibiu.

Color postcard showing Sibiu's medieval brick city walls with an arched gate at the base and a round defensive tower with a steep red-tile roof. Color photo view of a historic central square with formal gardens, people walking, 1960s–70s cars and buses, and baroque and medieval buildings. Color postcard showing Sibiu's historic brick Stairway Passage with the Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral of St. Mary rising above it, featuring a tall spire with four corner turrets and clock faces. Printed caption identifies the scene as the Stairway Passage in Sibiu; publisher Editura Meridiane and price are shown.

Color postcard showing a winter evening view of Sibiu's medieval fortifications: a massive octagonal stone tower with machicolations and a covered wooden walkway along the brick wall, flanked by a snowy street with car light trails and historic houses. Color postcard showing a medieval European old town with red-tile roofs and a prominent Gothic church featuring a tall central spire flanked by four smaller spires and clock faces. Color postcard showing a lively pedestrian street in Sibiu with crowds walking along a wet, sunlit roadway lined with historic buildings. A large storefront sign reads "Magazin universal." Romînă (bobsleigh motif), a circular postmark, and a handwritten message and address to Bucharest.

Color postcard showing a brick-and-stone Orthodox church with a tall octagonal tower and fir trees in the foreground. Black‑and‑white view framed by spruce trees of ornate spa villas and a hotel complex in a mountain resort; turrets and wooden verandas are visible. The reverse side is printed in Romanian and postmarked, with a handwritten message and address.

Color postcard showing a grand neoclassical spa building with a red roof, set in a landscaped garden with benches and people strolling. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp (40 bani, POSTA ROMANA), and a cancellation. Printed caption indicates the view is from Borsec.

Winter scene of a spa/resort complex in snow, with tall evergreen trees and a long one-story building with a red roof and dormer windows; gazebo-like pavilion at right. The back has Romanian address fields and identifies the view as BORSEC.

Color photo postcard showing a landscaped central park with lawns, flowerbeds, curved paths, benches and a circular fountain, surrounded by dense conifer forest. Multiview color postcard highlighting folk pottery from the Horezu area: craftsmen and children at a workbench, decorative plates displayed on grass, a modern street scene with a hotel, a traditional house, and a small wooden shop covered with ceramic plates where people browse. Color postcard showing a dramatic mountain reservoir and the curved face of a large concrete arch dam. Color view of a landscaped neighborhood park with flower beds, paths, benches and people in summer clothing, set in front of mid‑century apartment blocks with red roofs and balconies. The reverse is a Romanian postcard layout with a printed 40 BANI Poșta Română indicium.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic rocky gorge in the mountains with a lone hiker standing on a ridge. The reverse is printed in Romanian and identifies the scene as 'Munții Bucegi — Valea Jepilor.' It bears a Romanian 40‑bani stamp and a cancellation from București dated 29.4.58.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing tourists on a hillside viewpoint looking at a circular volcanic lake surrounded by forested mountains. Color postcard showing a person water‑skiing on a large lake with wake in the foreground. On the opposite shore are rows of trees and two large modernist resort hotels/apartment blocks. Black‑and‑white aerial view of a mountain spa town nestled in dense conifer forests, with a small round lake with boats and a cluster of resort buildings; reverse shows a Romanian postal card with a blue imprinted stamp and a TUȘNAD postmark and a handwritten Romanian message and address.

A vintage black‑and‑white view of a mountain spa town set in dense forests with a small lake and buildings around it. Caption at front bottom reads "TUȘNAD – Vedere generală." Color view of a small spa town nestled in densely forested mountains with autumn foliage. Color postcard showing a forested mountain landscape with a lake where people row small boats. Color postcard showing a wooded mountain landscape with a green lake and small boats. On the shore there is a resort building with two turret-like roofs, part of the Băile Tușnad spa area. Multiview color postcard titled "Băile Tușnad," showing the Romanian spa resort in the forested Eastern Carpathians: an aerial view of the town around a small lake, a crater lake surrounded by woods, modern resort buildings and a lakeside pavilion. Color postcard showing a landscaped central square with flowerbeds, paths and benches, a central fountain and a white column/monument. Multiview color postcard showing forested mountains, lakes, and modern resort buildings. Large yellow captions read "BĂILE" and "TUȘNAD." The reverse bears Romanian text, publisher info, a 40 Bani "POSTA ROMANA" stamp, and address lines.

Color postcard showing a tranquil mountain lake with dense conifer forests and hills. In the foreground a woman and three children sit on rocks fishing. The back has multi‑language caption identifying the lake, Romanian postal markings, stamp and a handwritten message and address.

Color postcard showing a serene mountain lake surrounded by dense conifer forest. In the foreground, four children sit on a rock fishing. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40 Bani stamp, and the printed caption identifying the location.

A multiview color postcard with a black border and a shield reading "PIATRA NEAMT." Multiview night postcard with a blue patterned frame and five photos of Bucharest. The center has yellow script reading "Bucuresti". Color postcard showing a modernist hotel complex labeled as Hotel București in Baia Mare, with a low-rise block of balconies and a separate taller tower full of TV antennas; mountains in the background and 1960s-era cars on a wide avenue. Color postcard showing a socialist‑modernist spa complex with low and mid‑rise concrete buildings, benches and people outside. A red Dacia 1300 car is parked in front, and a small kiosk marked "PRESA" is at left. The reverse has Romanian postal marks and handwriting.

Color postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance castle with multiple pointed towers and timbered galleries on a forested hillside in the mountains. Color postcard showing a stone historic inn with arched ground floor, wooden balcony and a steep hip roof, set among lawns and birch trees, with modern apartment blocks in the background. Color postcard showing a crowded sandy beach with families and swimmers on a calm seaside, terraced green slopes, a concrete promenade and modernist buildings in the background. Color postcard showing a wide central boulevard with landscaped flower beds and modernist apartment blocks, leading toward a steep conical hill topped by a ruined fortress (Deva Citadel). A multiview color postcard showing scenes from Romania's Black Sea coast: a port with cranes and ships, modern seaside hotels and resort buildings, landscaped gardens with a pond, and city views. Multiview color postcard of Bucharest showing four sights: the Arcul de Triumf on a broad boulevard with cars and a trolleybus; Mogoșoaia Palace beside a lake with people rowing; the façade and gardens of the Bucharest National Opera; and the Carol Park Mausoleum with an arched bridge and boats on the lake. Color postcard view across a lakeside path in a leafy park, with two people walking in the foreground and a large Stalinist high‑rise crowned by a tall spire across the water. Color postcard showing a busy intersection with pedestrians, 1960s–70s buses and cars in front of a grand Baroque/Rococo Roman Catholic church with a domed bell tower topped by a cross, giant columns at the portal, and angel statues. A vintage Romanian postcard. The front shows a black‑and‑white photograph of Peleș Castle with tall spires, labeled "SINAIA - Muzeul Peleș." The reverse has Romanian printed headings, a handwritten message, and an airmail stamp (40 BANI, airplane) canceled in 1962, addressed to Satu Mare.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent dining room with a very long polished table, rows of high‑back chairs, richly carved wood paneling and ceiling, and a large chandelier. Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent historic dining room with a very long wooden table flanked by high‑backed chairs, crystal centerpieces, ornate carved paneling, a richly coffered ceiling, and large chandeliers. Color postcard showing a wooden spa pavilion with steep conical roofs and timber‑frame walls set among trees on a sunny day. Color postcard showing a grand Neo‑Renaissance castle with multiple spires and timbered sections on a wooded hillside, with mountains in the background. The reverse side is in Romanian, bearing a preprinted Posta Romana stamp and the caption identifying the site as the Peles Museum in Sinaia.
Color postcard showing Peleș Castle in winter, with snow-covered slopes and the Carpathian Mountains behind. The reverse has Romanian address fields and publisher details, priced in lei.

Color postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance castle with tall spires set against snowy alpine scenery and evergreen forests. The reverse has printed addressing fields in Romanian and a caption identifying the site as Peleș Castle in Sinaia, with multilingual titles.

Color postcard showing a richly ornamented Neo‑Renaissance castle with tall spires on a forested mountainside, photographed from a grassy slope under a bright blue sky. The reverse has Romanian text and postmarks, indicating the subject as Muzeul Peleș in Sinaia.

Color postcard with scalloped edges showing a cave-like exhibit filled with stalactites and stalagmites, metal supports and lighting visible. The reverse side has Romanian text, publisher line 'EDITURA MERIDIANE', price, and standard address lines.

Color souvenir postcard with a golden border showing the Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle surrounded by autumn foliage with the Bucegi Mountains and blue sky in the background. Multi-view color postcard showing exterior and richly decorated interior rooms of Peleș Castle with a vertical yellow strip reading MUZEUL PELEȘ. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, address to București, Romanian postage and cancellations from Sinaia and București.

Color multi-view postcard showing Peleș Castle in Sinaia with towers, façades, statues and terrace gardens. The word "PELES" appears vertically on the left and "Muzeul" at top. Color postcard showing Peleș Castle with tall spires and timbered facades set against the Carpathian Mountains, framed by autumn trees. The reverse has Romanian text, a 40‑bani airmail stamp and cancellations, with address lines filled in blue ink.

Color view of a modernist high‑rise hotel and a large arched-window theater under a blue sky, with a few cars and pedestrians in front. The hotel bears the rooftop sign "HOTEL BUCURESTI." These are the InterContinental Bucharest hotel beside the National Theatre in central Bucharest.

A minimalist postcard front with a large blank white area. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption listing the site in multiple languages, indicating the subject is the Peleș Museum/Castle in Sinaia, Romania. The caption is numbered.

Color postcard showing the richly carved wooden Dining Room of Peleș Castle, with a long table set with candelabra, high-backed chairs on both sides, elaborate coffered ceiling and chandeliers. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cultural palace with a tower and arched loggia, seen across a round fountain in a leafy park. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small Transylvanian town nestled in a valley with the Carpathian hills in the background. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand historic administrative building with mansard roofs, iron cresting and arched ground‑floor openings, set behind a fence and trees. The back bears Romanian text and postage, including a 40‑bani airmail stamp and Bucharest postmarks dated 2 Oct 1965.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Transylvanian village framed by tree leaves. At center is a church with a steep shingled spire and a clock on the tower, surrounded by traditional houses and rolling hills/orchards. The reverse reads in Romanian and lists the location and publisher.

Color postcard showing the Danube riverside promenade in Sulina with trees, low buildings, street lamps, and boats moored along the quay. Multiview color postcard showing four views of Gura Humorului, Suceava County: a large socialist-era administrative building with a rooftop slogan, a modern building with a fountain, the chalet-style Motelul Ariniș amid trees, and a street scene of the town center. Multiview color postcard labeled CAREI – JUDEȚUL SATU MARE, showing three scenes: left, the neo‑Gothic Károlyi Castle with its crenellated tower; center, a modernist obelisk and sculpted soldier heads of the Monumentul Ostașului Român set among flowerbeds; right, a communist‑era apartment block with landscaped flowers. Color postcard showing a formal botanical garden with trimmed hedges, flowerbeds, a small round fountain, tall conifer and deciduous trees, paths, and small garden buildings. Color postcard showing a wide modern avenue lined with socialist‑era apartment blocks. On the left stands a long green multi‑storey hospital building (Slatina Hospital). Sepia panoramic view of the mountain resort of Sinaia with grand buildings and gardens beneath rocky peaks. The scene shows the Sinaia Casino and the large Palace Hotel in Dimitrie Ghica Park. Black‑and‑white winter view of a mountain resort town with snow‑covered streets, birch trees, and chalet‑style buildings. Color postcard showing a rustic stone building with a steep red-tile roof inside a hilltop ruin. Two visitors stand on rocky ground in the foreground. The scene is part of a fortified complex under a bright blue sky.

Color postcard showing the exterior of the painted Voroneț church with vivid frescoes on the walls, steep wooden roof and a tall bell tower with a cross, set among trees and hills under a blue sky. The reverse side has multilingual caption and Romanian postcard layout.

Color collage postcard with a red cross-shaped band and yellow lettering reading "MĂNĂSTIREA COZIA." Color postcard showing a white Eastern Orthodox monastery church with two domed towers topped by cross finials, arcaded porches with carved stone columns, and a cloistered courtyard set against forested hills. The back carries Romanian text identifying the site.

Color postcard showing the west façade and gatehouse of Tismana Monastery, a long two‑storey building with a central tower and flanking octagonal turrets. Color art-reproduction postcard showing Gheorghe Petrascu's painting of a bouquet of flowers in a bowl ("Flori"). The reverse has Romanian address fields, price, and a vertical credit line to the County Museum of History and Art in Bacau.

Color postcard showing a sunset over a large lake with silhouettes of small rowing boats on the water and dark shoreline in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian address fields and publishing details.
