Reverse side has Romanian handwriting, the printed heading 'CARTE POȘTALĂ', a Romanian airmail stamp (40 bani, R.P. ROMÎNĂ) canceled 'BUCURESTI II 15.6.52', and an address in Bucharest.

A Romanian postcard. The front shows a dense cover of green water‑lily leaves with a few pink blossoms on a lake, photographed at Băile Felix near Oradea. The reverse has a Romanian stamp and postmark, a printed multilingual caption about water‑lilies, publisher credit, and a handwritten message and address in Romanian.

Color postcard showing the ornate Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle with tall spires, timbered and stone facades, ivy on the walls, terraces and statues, formal gardens with visitors, and forested mountains in the background. The reverse has Romanian layout text "CARTE POȘTALĂ," publisher credit Editura Meridiane, multilingual captions naming the castle, a price in lei, and photo credit.

Color photograph of a striped brick-and-stone Orthodox church with a central dome and crosses on top, seen in a courtyard with paths, lawn, a bench, and several people walking under a bright blue sky. The back has multilingual captioning and publisher/price details.

Multiview color postcard showing landmarks of Brașov, Romania: at left the Saint Nicholas Church; top-right the Council House on Piața Sfatului; bottom-right the Black Church with the wooded mountain backdrop. The city coat of arms appears on the front. The back has Romanian postal layout, a Poșta Română 40 bani stamp, a circular postmark reading PREDEAL with a 1974 date, and a bilingual caption listing the three sights.

Color view of a richly decorated Baroque gate in a brick fortification, with statues atop the gate and people walking by. The reverse has Romanian layout with lines for address, a Romanian stamp marked POSTA ROMANA, and multilingual caption identifying the subject.

Color postcard showing a modernist high‑rise hotel with a crenelated roofline and a grid of small square windows. The white concrete building stands by a landscaped boulevard under a bright blue sky. The back identifies it as the Continental Hotel in Timișoara, Romania.

Color postcard showing a river winding through a tree-filled valley with the snow‑tipped Făgăraș Mountains beyond. Reverse side bears a 40‑bani Romanian stamp marked "R.P. ROMINA," postmarks from Călimănești (Reg. Argeș) dated 25.8.67 and from București dated 26.8.67, a vertical imprint of the national tourism office, a multilingual caption naming the Olt Valley and Făgăraș Massif, and a handwritten Romanian message and address to Bucharest.

Colorized postcard showing a grand corner hotel building with a domed turret and ornate Neo‑Romanian/Secession facades, small balconies, and shops at street level. A large rooftop sign reads "ECONOMISITI LA CEC." People stroll in a central square in front of the building. The reverse has Romanian text, a 40 Bani Posta Romana stamp, and a printed caption naming Craiova and the hotel.

Color postcard showing a large medieval hilltop fortress with red-tiled roofs and multiple towers rising above dense evergreen forest, viewed through pine branches against a bright blue sky. The reverse side has multilingual captions identifying the site, a vertical imprint of the Romanian National Tourism Office, a publisher mark, and a postage stamp (40 BANI) with a raspberry illustration.

Color postcard showing a mountain resort town with red‑roofed villas and hotels scattered on green slopes under a high, snowy ridge. A tall fir tree stands in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian airmail stamp depicting cosmonaut Andrian (A.) Nicolaev, a PREDEAL postmark, and a multilingual caption mentioning Valea Prahovei (Prahova Valley) – Predeal.

Color postcard showing the ornate Curtea de Argeș Cathedral within the monastery grounds, with twisted domes topped by Orthodox crosses and surrounding gardens. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40 bani flower stamp (POSTA ROMANA), and postmarks. Printed caption at bottom identifies the site in multiple languages.

Color postcard showing a mountain lodge beside a clear stream with a small weir, grassy banks, and dense conifer forest on a rocky hillside. The lodge has modernist wooden upper floors and stone lower walls, with cars and small buildings nearby. No text on the front; printing is on the back.

Color postcard showing a large Belle Époque grand hotel with mansard roofs and balconies, set in landscaped gardens with mountains in the background. The reverse bears a Romanian 40 bani stamp marked POSTA ROMANA, a handwritten Romanian message and address, and a printed caption identifying the scene.

Color postcard showing a line of young folk dancers in North Moldavian costumes performing on the beach at the Black Sea resort of Mamaia. Behind them are modernist beachfront hotels and many beachgoers; a tall tower bears the sign "PARC HOTEL."

Color postcard showing a modernist motel with red tile roofs and stone facades set on rolling green hills and trees under a blue sky. The reverse has a Romanian stamp (POSTA ROMANA, 40 bani, "Babele", 1971) with postmarks, printed caption mentioning Motel Bucium, and a handwritten Romanian message and address.

Back side of a museum souvenir postcard. It is mostly white with Romanian text crediting painter Nicolae Grigorescu and noting an exhibition at the Muzeul Național de Artă al României in Bucharest (Oct 2007–Mar 2008). The postcard likely features on the front a reproduction/detail of the painting 'Țărancă franceză în vie'.
Front shows two fluffy ginger kittens sitting in a woven wicker basket against a green textured fabric background. The reverse is largely blank with printer information and a price at the bottom.

Color postcard showing the interior of a church niche with a carved stone sarcophagus (tomb) beneath a rounded arch. Above it is a narrow stained-glass window with a silhouetted cross and a hanging silver lamp. Floral arrangements flank the tomb. This is the tomb of Stephen the Great inside Putna Monastery.

A richly gilded Orthodox iconostasis with intricate Baroque woodcarving, a central set of Royal Doors with a cross, and flanking painted icons (including the Virgin and Child and a bishop saint). Numerous small oval saint medallions run along the upper frieze; the color palette is heavy in gold with green panels.

Color postcard showing a large, old linden tree in a city park in early spring. Behind it stands an obelisk flanked by lion sculptures, and a pavilion-like building; a child with a red-and-white hat holds yellow flowers in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian publisher and caption text identifying the scene.

A Romanian-language religious postcard with a Christmas/New Year thank‑you message and a Bible verse (2 Corinthians 13:13). It mentions the Patriarch of the Romanian Orthodox Church and bears a blue-ink handwritten signature. Small text at the bottom reads "Nașterea Domnului".

Front: a color reproduction of a 16th‑century fresco detail showing a procession of richly dressed, crowned figures in blue and brown robes, from the painted church at Arbore, Romania. Back: Romanian postcard layout with publisher imprint, price, and a multilingual caption identifying the work as a fresco detail from the Church at Arbore.

Color postcard showing a detail of the medieval fresco known as the Ladder of Virtues: a monk on a ladder is pulled down by a horned demon with flaming hair against a blue background. The reverse has printed Romanian caption and price.

Front shows a reproduction of a medieval fresco depicting Stephen the Great (Ștefan cel Mare) offering a book, with the title "Manastirea Putna." The reverse has a multilingual caption identifying the portrait and dates, with the rest blank for address/message.

Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard titled "Bușteni" showing the mountain resort of Bușteni with views of the Bucegi Mountains and a snowy chalet. The reverse has a Romanian 40 bani stamp ("ANIVERSARI CULTURALE" – Aron Pumnul, 1966), Romanian-language handwriting, and postal cancellations from Bușteni and București dated 1967. Publisher credit "Editura Meridiane" and price "Lei 1" appear on the back.

A saturated, orange-tinted close-up portrait of a woman with light hair, resting her head on her arms. The reverse has Romanian text, a diamond logo reading InterCONTEMPress, the word PUBLITURISM, and a standard divided-back layout for address and stamp.

Color postcard showing an oval-framed painted portrait of a young man in a suit and tie against a yellow background. The reverse side is a standard divided back with Romanian and French texts indicating a museum reproduction.

Color postcard showing a reproduction of a painted portrait of Prince Alexandru Ioan Cuza in a decorated military uniform with medals and a red sash, set against a warm red drapery background. The reverse has Romanian postal layout and multilingual caption identifying the artwork from the Union Museum in Iași, with publisher and price.

Color postcard reproducing a painting of a young mother breastfeeding her child (Orazio Gentileschi). The back reads in Romanian and English that it is from the Art Museum of the Socialist Republic of Romania, with a printed price of 1,50 lei.

A white-bordered postcard with an oval reproduction of a classical oil portrait: a young woman crowned with flowers, partially draped, holding a small dog. The back is laid out in Romanian with museum credit lines and publisher/printer details, and standard address lines and stamp box.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand eclectic/neo‑Romanian palace with a tall clock tower and steep roofs, fronting a busy square with pedestrians and modern street lamps. Reverse side bears Romanian handwriting, a purple 50 Bani stamp of R.P. ROMINA, and postal cancellations.

Museum art postcard reproducing a 17th‑century-style painting of a man with long hair and a buttoned coat, hands folded; the reverse credits the work to Gonzales Coques with the title "Pipăitul / Le toucher". The back carries Romanian 'CARTE POSTALĂ', notes "SIBIU, MUZEUL BRUCKENTHAL", and a price in lei.

A color postcard reproducing a portrait painting of a young Romanian peasant woman wearing a white headscarf and red blouse, adorned with blue and red bead necklaces. The back side has Romanian address lines and publisher details, including Editura Meridiane and price in lei.

Color reproduction postcard of a painting by Hans Memling showing a man in dark clothing reading a book, with a young boy behind him against a landscape. The reverse lists the issuing museum in Romanian and English with a printed price.

Front: a color reproduction of a painting showing an elderly man with a beard resting his head in his hand, painted in thick, expressive brushstrokes; the lower right bears the signature "Luchian." Back: multilingual caption identifying the work, Romanian postcard layout with "CARTE POȘTALĂ," stamp box, and a vertical line with a lei price and printer code.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded seaside resort with waves, a sandy beach, and a terraced promenade with stairs and lawns. People walk along the promenade and sunbathe on the beach. The reverse bears a Romanian stamp and handwriting. The printed caption identifies the scene as Eforie-Sud and describes the beach and promenade in multiple languages.

Vintage Romanian postcard. Front: a monochrome illustration of a pavilion-like building beside a pond with its reflection, surrounded by forest—identified on the card as 'Foișorul' in Sinaia. Back: handwritten Romanian message and address, Romanian 40 bani 'POSTA ROMANA' stamp (DENSUS), Bucharest postmarks, and printed caption 'SINAIA — Foișorul'.

Art postcard reproducing a still-life painting of bright red and yellow flowers in a green jug against a dark background. The artist's red signature "Sirato" appears at the lower right. The back has Romanian postcard layout with the caption crediting Fr. Sirato, the publisher Editura Meridiane, a price in lei, and a serial number.

Art postcard reproducing a textured impressionist portrait of a young girl with dark hair titled "Jeanne, fiica artistului." The reverse is in Romanian, marked CARTE POSTALĂ, priced in lei, and references the Zambaccian Museum in Bucharest with a circular cancel of the National Philatelic Exhibition (București '77).

Sepia-toned art postcard showing an impressionistic painting of a busy harbor with several wooden sailing boats beached or moored, tall masts and rigging dominating the scene. Low buildings line the waterfront in the background. No visible printed caption on the front; wide white margin on the right.

A museum art postcard reproducing a Renaissance-style painting in warm golden tones showing a mythological scene: a seated smith (Vulcan) forging, a nude child (Cupid) beside him, and a standing woman; riders and a pastoral landscape with hills and trees in the background. The reverse carries Romanian museum and postal markings from the Socialist Republic era and the painting's title/attribution.

Sepia aerial view of a Carpathian mountain spa town with multiple grand hotels and sanatoria nestled among dense forested hills. In the foreground stands a large U-shaped multi‑story building with courtyards; other villas and lodgings spread along the valley. The reverse side is a divided-back postcard with Romanian text indicating the location and publisher.

Color postcard reproducing the painting 'Hora de la Aninoasa' by Romanian artist Theodor Aman, showing villagers in traditional dress dancing a hora in a rural scene. The reverse has a Romanian address template and publisher credits, with handwritten holiday greetings dated 1983.

Front shows a reproduction of a painting of an opulent 19th‑century artist's studio packed with framed artworks, ornate woodwork and furniture; an artist works at an easel while elegantly dressed figures sit and a child plays on the floor. The reverse has Romanian text naming the Theodor Aman Museum in Bucharest and address fields.

Color-printed landscape view over a forested valley with scattered houses with red roofs. In the foreground are large rock formations and dense trees; in the distance rolling wooded hills stretch to the horizon under a pale sky. A printed caption at the bottom margin reads "ZWIESEL-BAD BERGGIESSHÜBEL". The style and coloring suggest an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Sepia-toned street view showing a tree-lined avenue leading toward an arched gateway in a historic building. Horse-drawn carts and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing move along the cobbled street. Multi-story buildings with arcaded windows and colonnades frame the scene. The top of the card is printed with the caption "Graz. Partie beim Burgtor".

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic general view of the coastal city and naval shipyards of El Ferrol. The foreground includes a long breakwater and harbor waters with several small boats; behind it stand walled arsenals, industrial buildings, and the built-up city backed by hills. Printed Spanish captions describe the scene, and the lower half and margins contain dense handwritten correspondence in ink.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone paving. A large Baroque‑style church with a tall onion‑domed tower dominates the background. Around the square stand three‑ and four‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level. Painted signs in German are visible on the facades. Horse‑drawn carts and several pedestrians in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing move across the square. The overall composition and border suggest an old photographic postcard.

A colorized historic postcard view of a Central European spa or resort town set in a forested valley. In the foreground are several ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas and hotels with mansard roofs and decorative façades. Behind them, scattered on the green hillside, stand more villas and a large, castle‑like white building at the top of the slope. Dense coniferous forest covers the surrounding hills under a blue sky. One prominent white building in the lower right bears the name 'VILLA GRENZ' on its façade.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a forest road bordered by tall coniferous trees on both sides. A man in early‑20th‑century attire stands at the right edge of the road. At the top, in red German text, it identifies the location as Oelsnitz in the Erzgebirge and notes the route toward the Rödlitz valley.

Black‑and‑white view over a small European town in a hilly landscape. Dominating the right side is a large multi‑winged castle or palace on a rise, with towers and steep tiled roofs. In the middle distance stands a tall church with a slender spire and a large adjoining nave. At the left is a multi‑storey industrial building with many identical windows and a tall smokestack. The foreground shows grassy fields and the roofs of smaller houses; one roof in the lower right bears faint painted lettering. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century picture postcard of a historic town with a castle and church.

Vintage monochrome view over the alpine village of Fulpmes in a broad valley surrounded by steep forested mountains and snow‑covered peaks. The town's church with a tall onion‑domed tower stands in the center. Printed German captions at the top label the scene as a view of Fulpmes towards the glaciers and name surrounding mountain peaks with their elevations.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden villa or manor house with a two‑story columned veranda and decorative railings. A flagpole on the roof flies a Scandinavian-style Nordic cross flag that appears to be the Swedish flag. Leafless trees stand in the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter. Printed text in the upper right corner reads "Prästgården i Sköldinge".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural European village. In the foreground is a sizeable two‑storey building with a sign indicating it is a restaurant and hotel dedicated to St. Romanus. A dirt road curves past the building toward the background where scattered houses, fields, and a church with a tall spire are visible. Handwritten red numbers and printed captions appear on the front.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a riverside Dutch landscape with several traditional windmills along the water, low farm buildings with gabled roofs, and a sailing boat on the river in the foreground. Handwritten blue text appears below the image, and small printed numbers/letters are at the bottom edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small alpine town in a valley surrounded by high mountains with some snow on the peaks. The town features a prominent church with a tall bell tower rising above clustered houses and a few larger buildings in the foreground. At the bottom left the caption reads "Pinzolo", and along the lower margin there is a printer/photographer credit line in Italian.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing two Indigenous men wearing patterned ponchos and traditional sandals, posed in a studio setting. One man is standing beside a large decorated clay vessel; the other is squatting. The background is a painted backdrop depicting a European-style villa or small palace with turrets, balconies, stairs, and a landscaped garden. The image has wide margins consistent with early 20th‑century postcards.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the overgrown stone ruins of a large building, likely a castle, with crumbling walls, arched openings and a tower-like section. Trees and vegetation grow around the structure. The lower margin contains printed red text indicating the location and publisher, along with handwritten cursive text in a Scandinavian language.

Black-and-white postcard showing a formal park with paths, benches, flowerbeds, and a central fountain in the foreground. Behind the trees stands a large three-story brick building with a gabled central section and a metal roof. Text at the bottom left reads "Uddevalla, Margaretaparken." and there is a small oval photographer/printer logo at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a wooded valley with scattered villas and farmhouses along a winding road. In the foreground stands an ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villa with a turret and steep roof, surrounded by a garden and fence. Further back, more detached houses lie among trees, with forested hills and terraced fields rising in the background. The style evokes a Central European spa or resort village in a mountainous region. Along the bottom border there are some hand‑written or printed alphanumeric marks, but no clear title or caption.

A black-and-white image showing the entrance of a post and telegraph office. A man is captured mid-step as he enters through a glass door. On the doors are bilingual inscriptions for postal and telegraph services, and stone steps lead up to the entrance. Above the doors is a single letter 'A'. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century European public building.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a grand historic city square. On the left stands an ornate neo-Renaissance city hall with domes and towers. In front of it is a busy market scene with many stalls and umbrellas, people walking, and a central monument with steps. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey traditional European buildings with shopfronts. Printed captions at the top identify the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a stepped pyramid in a desert landscape, with two riders on camels or donkeys in the foreground. The structure is a large stone step pyramid rising in several tiers. At the lower right is a website watermark and handwritten-style caption; a small number appears in the lower left corner.

Black-and-white winter landscape showing a snow-covered valley with sparse low trees and bushes in the foreground, a small settlement with wooden buildings and a rail/power line in the mid-distance, and a large snow-clad mountain range and lake in the background. Printed caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom left, and a photographer credit is on the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a mid‑20th‑century modernist multi‑storey corner building at a street intersection, viewed from across a landscaped garden with flowerbeds and steps in the foreground. There are pedestrians, a cyclist, and a vintage car on the street, plus lampposts and a traffic light. In the upper left corner the printed caption reads "Vedere din Cluj".

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑wing hospital complex on a gentle hill, seen from across a river or pond whose calm surface reflects the building. The foreground shows tall reeds at the water's edge and a grassy bank with small trees lining a path. The main building is several stories high with a hipped roof, dormers, many windows, and balconies; additional wings extend to the right. Printed caption text in German appears along the lower margin, with a small serial number at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European town square or open space with unpaved ground. In the foreground stands a two‑storey plastered house with a steep, tiled hip roof and dormer windows, surrounded by a low wooden fence. To its right are larger, older houses with steep gabled roofs and dormers, partly covered with vegetation, and behind them rises a tall building with a high, patterned roof and small spires, possibly a church or town hall. On the left edge of the scene is a row of simpler houses; a young girl in a dress stands on the sidewalk near an old streetlamp. The scene has an early‑20th‑century atmosphere. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a railway station building with a central pavilion and metal roof, seen from the railway tracks. The station sign reads "FLEN" and other Swedish words are visible on platform signs. Bicycles are parked along the platform, and a few people sit or stand near the station entrance. Overhead electric wires run above the tracks. Text printed at the bottom-left identifies the place as "Flen. Järnvägsstationen." Additional publisher and photographer information is printed at the lower right.

Old black‑and‑white winter street scene with snow and long icicles hanging from the right‑hand building. Several people stand in the middle of the street, with houses lining both sides and a church tower visible in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a large, ornate country hotel or inn beside a wide dirt road, with low hills and woods in the background. The multi‑storey building has steep gabled roofs, balconies with wooden railings, and decorative trim typical of Central European architecture. Small blossoming trees line the front. On the road in the foreground a woman pushes a pram and another woman stands nearby in long early‑20th‑century dress. Faint signage is visible on the façade of the building.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Gothic/Renaissance-style tomb with rich reliefs and a recumbent armored effigy on top. The scene is indoors, in a church interior. French captions identify the subject as the tomb of Charles the Bold in the Church of Our Lady in Bruges. There is also printed branding with a star and the word "Bruges" on the wall at left and a vertical credit line at the right edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, two‑storey historic brick building along a wide tree‑lined street. A tramcar runs on tracks in front of the building and horse‑drawn carriages travel on the road. The facade has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance. Trees and lampposts line the sidewalk, with a park or wooded area on the right. Red printed text at the top identifies Budapest and the building as an imperial and royal military food supply depot in Hungarian and German; a small red number is printed at the bottom left.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a riverside town with a prominent hilltop complex consisting of a large Gothic-style cathedral with tall spires and an attached castle-like palace and tower. Below the hill are rows of old town houses along the riverbank, with a paddle steamer or riverboat on the water in the foreground. Printed German captions identify the location.

Black-and-white image showing a long wooden building with many identical multi-pane windows facing a cobblestone street. The structure has a steep tiled roof, a small central entrance with steps, and a stone foundation. Tree branches with leaves frame the top of the scene. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image side.

Colorized view of a long row of red-brick military barracks along a wide dirt road lined with trees. The multi‑storey buildings have white stone window accents, iron fencing, and a formal, institutional look. At the top of the image, German text identifies the location and military unit.

A black-and-white rural scene showing several traditional wooden farmhouses and outbuildings with pitched roofs, set at the edge of fields and bordered by trees and forest in the background. At the top center of the image is the printed place name "Elverum", suggesting the view is of a farm or settlement near Elverum. The overall style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white image of a modernist fountain featuring two nude, elongated bronze figures—likely a man and a woman—posed dynamically as though gliding or swimming while grasping each other's hands. Water jets spray upward around them in a shallow circular basin. In the background are a paved path, grass, shrubs, and some trees, suggesting a city park setting. No printed title or caption is visible on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a small Alpine town set in a valley surrounded by high mountains. The town features dense traditional European houses with red and gray roofs, a prominent church with a tall pointed steeple on the right, and another church-like building with a tower closer to the center. A chapel or small church stands on a hill to the left. The sky is overcast, and the whole scene has a hand‑tinted appearance. The word "Imst." is printed in the upper right margin, and a vertical credit line with German text runs along the left edge.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide valley landscape with a river running through a small town, surrounded by forested hills and terraced fields. In the lower right corner, there is a light-colored panel with red German text printed in an old-style script and publisher information at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped cemetery or park cemetery with monumental tombs and sculptures. In the foreground are stone grave monuments and a central fountain-like structure with a seated figure sculpture. In the background stands a large mausoleum-style building with columns and statues. Trees and paths surround the funerary monuments. German text is printed at the top of the card.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with decorative lilies-of-the-valley framing three photographic views of medieval monastery ruins. The left view shows an arched stone gate labeled "TOR". The central view shows a gabled ruin behind a long stone wall labeled "GIEBEL". The right view depicts a small ruined chapel with tall arched windows labeled "KAPELLE D. HEIL. 3. KÖNIGE." Beneath the central image a banner reads "RUINEN DES KLOSTERS ALT-ZELLA BEI NOSSEN." On the lower right margin, printed vertically in red, is "Handkolorirte Künstlerkarte."

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a castle complex with two prominent square towers featuring ornate gabled tops and small lantern structures. The castle buildings with steep tiled roofs rise behind a tree-filled park and a decorative wall, with a wooden fence in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as a castle in Strehla on the Elbe River.

Black-and-white postcard view of a mountain lake surrounded by steep rocky slopes and a village on the right shore. A bridge crosses a narrow part of the water in the foreground, with scattered buildings and cultivated fields along the shoreline. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Molveno and its lake in Trentino at 860 meters altitude.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a gently curving ramp and stairways with stone balustrades descending through a landscaped terrace. People with hats and parasols walk along the paths. Decorative street lamps line the upper terraces, and to the right a promenade with buildings and gardens stretches along what appears to be a seaside bathing area. Printed captions in Bulgarian (using old orthography) and German appear at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal city with mountains in the background. In the foreground, a small rowboat is on calm water, while several larger ships are moored along the waterfront lined with low-rise buildings. Printed captions in French and Greek identify the location, and there is a circular postal or institutional stamp on the left and a website watermark at the bottom.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing the richly decorated Renaissance façade of a large castle courtyard building with numerous statues in niches, surrounded by garden greenery. The caption at the top left identifies the site as part of Heidelberg Castle, specifically the Otto-Heinrich wing (Otto Heinrichsbau).

Black‑and‑white divided postcard with two rural views. The upper image shows a farming landscape with a field of stacked sheaves in the foreground, a small village behind, and a church with a tower rising above the trees. The lower image depicts a village street bordered by houses and trees, with a church tower and spire visible in the background; a cart and a signpost are seen near the road. Between the two images is a decorative script title reading "Lampertswalde b. Großenhain".

Black-and-white photographic postcard showing an industrial harbor scene with cranes, ships, warehouses and rocky hills in the background. The view is across the water toward shipyards and port facilities. Printed captions appear along the bottom border, and a museum inventory number is visible.

Vintage sepia postcard with two inset photographs framed by floral decorations. The left image shows a long formal dining room (Speisesaal) with a very long table covered in a white cloth, lined with many wooden chairs, an ornate tiled stove, and a large cabinet at the far end. The right image depicts the exterior of a substantial institutional building behind an iron fence and gate, along a dirt road with trees lining the property. Printed captions in German identify the dining hall, an agricultural household school, and the town name Dahlen. Publisher information is printed vertically along the left margin.

A sepia-toned, ornate postcard featuring an oval-framed black‑and‑white photograph of a baby with closed eyes, dressed in a white garment. The frame and border are richly decorated with embossed gold-colored scrollwork, bows, and a fabric-like edge. In the upper left corner there is an embossed crest with a crown, and at the bottom there is decorative ribbon and printed/embossed text.

A vintage colorized postcard depicting a narrow street in an old quarter of Cairo with people in traditional dress walking along the road. At the end of the street rises a large domed mosque with an ornate dome and a tall minaret. The image is framed by a beige border. At the top center is the caption 'Le Caire', and at the bottom appears a partially legible caption referring to a mosque.

Black‑and‑white portrait of an elderly woman wearing traditional clothing and a headwrap with hair tied in a topknot. The background is dark and plain, focusing attention on her face. At the top of the image, there is a short printed caption in a Scandinavian language.

Black-and-white historical postcard showing a busy industrial harbor with multiple large sailing ships and steamships moored along the quayside. In the foreground are several railway tracks, freight cars, and piles of ore or coal. Small industrial buildings and cranes are visible, with water and ships in the background. The layout and printing style are typical of an early 20th‑century postcard.

A monochrome image showing a bust of a bearded man on a tall stone pedestal inscribed with the name "ALBERT." The monument is set in a lush, tree‑filled park or garden, surrounded by dense shrubs. In the foreground there is a decorative metal fence with stout posts linked by chains. Along the left edge of the image there are hand‑written numbers or notes, typical of early photographic postcard negatives.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped city park with large trees, manicured lawns, flower beds, a pond and a tall water fountain. People can be faintly seen walking or sitting in the background. At the bottom border, a caption in cursive handwriting identifies the location as Nijmegen, Keizer Karelpark.

Black-and-white postcard showing a street lined with heavily damaged and burned buildings after a major fire. Ruined arches and walls stand on the left, while more intact multi‑story buildings are on the right. A few people walk along the cobbled street. Printed captions in French and English at the bottom describe the scene as related to the great fire of Salonica (Thessaloniki) in August 1917.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a town square with a church-like building and a tall bell tower or clock tower on the right. Several people, including children and a person with a horse or donkey, are gathered in the square. Traditional multi‑storey houses line the left side of the street. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the place as Pantocratoros Square in Lixouri, on the island of Cephalonia (Kefalonia) in Greece. There is handwritten text across the top and a printed website watermark at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white historical photograph showing a ceremonial laying of a foundation stone. Clergy in white vestments, suited dignitaries, and onlookers in early 20th‑century dress stand around a pit while a large stone block is lowered by chains. Handwritten Dutch text is visible on the right side of the image.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a broad, curved street lined with trees and a park-like area. There are ornate streetlamps, cobblestone pavement, several pedestrians, and a horse-drawn carriage. Elegant townhouses or villas are partly visible behind the trees. The caption at the bottom reads "Kronenburgersingel — Nijmegen." indicating the scene is from a boulevard or ring road in Nijmegen.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large brick institutional complex with multiple connected buildings and steep, hipped roofs, partly hidden behind a line of trees and hedges. The lower part of the card is blank for writing. Printed red captions identify the scene as the garrison hospital in Borna, and small printer's details appear at the bottom left. A handwritten red number appears in the upper right corner.

A vintage illustrated postcard featuring a black‑ink portrait drawing of a bald man with a thick beard and mustache on a beige background. At the top there is Bulgarian text in Cyrillic, and below the portrait there is the person's name in a decorative script along with additional printed text giving a date (1809) and a note about his role in the enlightenment/education of the town of Stara Zagora.

A sepia-toned historical photograph showing an enormous crowd gathered in a city square or open area for a demonstration or rally. Many people wear winter coats and hats and hold flags and banners. In the background stands a cityscape with a prominent church or town-hall–like spire. Purple Cyrillic text printed at the top left reads a place name and the date 10 March 1917.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large church with tall round and pointed towers and Gothic-style arched windows. The building fills most of the frame, viewed from an angle, with a small garden or grassy area in the foreground. Printed captions in German at the top read "Freiberg i. Sa." and "St. Petrikirche." A vertical imprint along the left edge notes the publisher and the year 1905.

Colorized historical postcard depicting a busy harbor-side fish market with moored wooden boats and canopies along a waterfront lined with tall gabled townhouses. People in late‑19th to early‑20th‑century clothing crowd the quay. Text in German appears on the right and bottom margins.

Vintage sepia multi‑view postcard with a patterned border. It shows three photographs: at the top, a large three‑storey school building behind a fence labeled in Bulgarian as a girls' gymnasium; in the middle, a park or open field with trees, a pavilion and a distant church tower, labeled Ayazmoto; at the bottom, a large Orthodox church with multiple domes, labeled as the Church of St. Nicholas. Along the bottom edge there is a greeting text indicating it is from Stara Zagora.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a narrow forested ridge and several islands extending between large lakes, with a causeway or road crossing the water in the distance. The landscape is dominated by water and pine-covered landforms. The handwritten caption at the bottom left reads "Punkaharju."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy harbor with several docked ships and sailors on the pier in the foreground. Warehouses, piers, and smaller boats line the waterfront, while a town with many buildings and church domes spreads across the hillside in the background. At the bottom of the image there is a caption in Cyrillic and German identifying the view as Varna.

Sepia-toned landscape view over a forested valley with scattered farmhouses and village buildings, seen from an elevated vantage point. Evergreen trees fill the foreground, while fields and small houses dot the gently rolling hills in the middle and background. At the top left, in red serif type, is a printed caption indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a curving coastal road built along a steep, rocky, forested hillside beside a body of water. The image has printed caption text at the top right that identifies the location as Uddevalla and describes the road leading to Gustafsberg.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central statue of a man in a long coat standing on a tall pedestal in a landscaped square or park. On the left is an ornate multi‑storey civic building with arched windows; in the background to the right stands a church or bell tower partly hidden by trees. Flowerbeds and paths surround the monument. Along the bottom border of the image, printed text identifies the place as the statue of Dr. Ioan Rațiu in Turda.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a river scene with a paddle steamer pushing barges loaded with material along a wide, calm river. On the far bank stands a small town with a prominent church tower and clustered houses set on gently rising terrain, with trees and fields around. The image has an old photographic style and printed caption text at the top left.

Colored vintage postcard showing a town at the foot of a forested hill or mountain. In the foreground there are several light‑colored, two‑story buildings with classical facades and sloped roofs, surrounded by trees and smaller houses. In the background rises a steep, green hillside with a path or road cut across it and a rounded white structure or terrace near the top. Printed red text appears in the upper right corner of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large fortified complex with a high round tower, crenellated medieval walls, and an attached palatial wing with many rectangular windows and classical details. The structure stands on heavy stone ramparts above trees, with mountains rising in the background. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young woman facing the camera against a dark background. She wears a light-colored, delicate blouse with lace details and small buttons, a long necklace, and small earrings. The style of clothing and photographic treatment suggest an early 20th‑century portrait. At the bottom edge there is a small printed credit line.

A sepia-toned image showing a colonial-style two‑storey building with an arched arcade on the ground floor and a balcony corridor above, set in front of a landscaped town square or garden with curving paths, flowerbeds, trees, and a statue on a pedestal. Hills or mountains rise steeply behind the town, with a small church complex visible on a slope to the right. Utility poles and wires run across the scene, and a few people can be seen walking near the building and in the square.

A multiview tourist postcard with a blue border showing various color photographs of a mountain resort town surrounded by dramatic rocky peaks. The images include village streets with alpine-style hotels, ski lifts or cable cars, hikers among steep rock faces and snow patches, and panoramic views of a valley town and surrounding mountains. The title text at the top reads "S. MARTINO DI CASTROZZA."

Black‑and‑white image showing a rural hotel building labeled "Bahnh‑Hôtel Bärenstein." The three‑story house with a balcony stands beside a dirt road, with trees, a wooden fence, and forested hills in the background. In front of the hotel are several people posed for the photograph: men in period suits or uniforms, women in long dresses and aprons, a bicycle, and a horse‑drawn cart. The scene appears staged as a formal view of the establishment, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad city street lined with multi‑story stone buildings in a late 19th/early 20th‑century style. A tram runs along tracks in the center of the street, with people walking on sidewalks and horse‑drawn carriages visible near the buildings. Trees line the right side of the avenue. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Birger Jarlsgatan in Stockholm, and Swedish text signage can be seen on the central corner building.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large stepped pyramid rising from a flat plain, framed by cactus and yucca-like trees in the foreground. A person wearing a broad-brimmed hat sits in the shade on the left, looking toward the pyramid. The landscape is semi‑arid with scattered shrubs and agave plants under a partly cloudy sky.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall stone obelisk-like war memorial in a cemetery, surrounded by a circular flowerbed and crosses marking graves. The monument bears carved symbols on its shaft. Trees frame the scene in the background. The lower margin of the postcard contains printed text indicating the place depicted.

Old sepia-toned postcard showing a display of carved stone coats of arms and reliefs arranged on shelves or steps, likely fragments from historical buildings. The stones bear heraldic shields, crests, and Latin inscriptions. The photograph is bordered by a wide cream margin with handwritten cursive notes on the right side.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a full-length studio portrait of a man in traditional Ottoman/Turkish attire. He wears a wrapped headscarf, a dark shirt with several medals pinned to his chest, a wide sash around his waist, and loose trousers. He rests one hand on a decorative prop resembling a small tree or plant. In the upper-left corner there is a green postage stamp with Arabic/Ottoman script, partially canceled with a round postmark. Handwritten text and a printed caption appear at the bottom.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a broad river, with people standing along the banks. On the far side are trees, houses on a hillside and a large building or fortress above the town. French and Ottoman Turkish text are printed at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a coastal town with low, tile‑roofed houses, straight streets leading toward a harbor filled with masts of sailing ships, and a large mountainous island or headland across the bay. The image is surrounded by handwritten cursive text in the margins and across the bottom, with a short caption in printed letters just above the lower edge of the photograph.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large rectangular manor or small castle set in open countryside. The building has three visible stories, a steep hipped roof with chimneys, many evenly spaced windows, and is surrounded by trees and fields. In the foreground there is a pasture and a simple wooden fence with tall trees framing the view. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, along with the photographer's credit and a serial number.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large hilltop castle complex above dense trees. The building features several massive round towers, one with an onion-shaped dome, steep gabled roofs with dormer windows, and two tall, slender church-like towers with cupolas in the background. The architecture is late-medieval/early Renaissance Central European. No text or caption is visible on the image.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a coastal city with a long stone pier or jetty leading into a harbor. People walk along the pier, with mooring posts and lampposts on each side. Sailing ships are docked to the right, and a dense cluster of low-rise buildings stretches along the waterfront at the base of surrounding hills and mountains. A fortress or castle is visible on a hill overlooking the town. Red printed captions in Greek and French appear at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white image showing a group of uniformed soldiers manning a field artillery gun in a muddy field. The men wear pickelhaube-style spiked helmets and late‑19th/early‑20th‑century uniforms, suggesting a European (likely German) army. Several soldiers kneel by ammunition baskets near the gun carriage while others stand behind, one officer pointing into the distance. In the right background stands a traditional wooden windmill with large sails.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a studio photograph of a triangular carved stone relief. The relief depicts a stylized running or leaping bull or ox, framed by a border of simple geometric and foliate motifs. The stone looks weathered and broken along two sides, suggesting it is a fragment of a larger medieval or Romanesque sculpture. There is a wide blank margin around the photo and no visible caption or text on the image side.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a young woman in three-quarter profile, looking over her shoulder toward the camera. She has carefully waved hair in a 1920s–1930s style and wears an ornate dress or shawl decorated with circular, spiral-like patterns. The background is a plain studio backdrop. In the lower right corner there is an embossed photographer's stamp indicating the studio and city.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a medieval brick complex with crenellated walls and tall towers. The central structure has arched windows with grills and battlements along the roofline. In the foreground stands a narrow bell tower, and in the background a larger clock tower. At the bottom margin is a printed caption identifying the view.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an industrial waterfront scene with a brick steam pumping station building in the center, a tall smoking chimney, and arched water outlets at its base. Traditional Dutch windmills stand on both sides in a flat polder landscape. Printed captions in Dutch appear at the bottom margin, identifying the location and publisher.

A vintage panoramic view over the tiled rooftops of a historic town beside a wide river with a long bridge or pontoon crossing. Boats are visible on the water and the skyline is low, with a small church tower in the distance. The bottom margin contains printed captions and there is vertical publisher information along the left side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a steep rocky hill or cliff with a path or terrace cut into the rock. At the foot of the slope there is a house with a steep gabled roof partially hidden by trees. The image caption at the top is in German and there is a small vertical printer's credit along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white image of a cobblestone street in a small European town. On the right side stand one‑ and two‑story brick houses with steep gabled tile roofs and small-paned windows; some have half‑timbered details. Trees line the street, and several people, including children, are visible walking or standing. In the background rises a square church tower with a simple façade and two circular windows near the top. The image is framed by a broad white border with worn and stained corners, suggesting an old printed postcard.

A vintage black-and-white street view showing a curved corner building with a dome-like roof and several adjoining multi‑storey buildings lining a broad avenue. A few pedestrians are visible on the street and sidewalk. Leafless young trees are planted along the pavement. At the bottom, there is Cyrillic text printed as a caption and publisher credit.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with multi‑story historic buildings and dormer windows surrounding an open cobbled plaza. A horse‑drawn carriage, several pedestrians, and a child with a bicycle appear in the foreground. Large church roofs and multiple tall spires rise behind the row of houses. The town name "Lommatzsch." is printed at the top in red, and publisher information appears at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor seawater swimming stadium with terraced concrete stands around a rectangular pool, sandy beach area in the foreground with bathers, and a tall diving platform. In the background are fortification walls and buildings, and to the far right industrial buildings with smoke from chimneys. Printed captions in Swedish appear in the lower left and right corners.

Black-and-white postcard showing the grand interior patio of a museum with arched colonnades and classical statues displayed around the courtyard. The tiled floor has decorative patterns, and rope barriers separate visitors from the sculptures. Printed caption at the bottom reads in French that this is the Grand Patio of the Bardo Museum.

A sepia-toned photograph framed by large stone arches and parapets, looking out over a harbor area with fortification walls and a tall column or lighthouse in the distance. The image appears printed on a postcard with a light border. The URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible in the lower right corner, likely added by the archive, not part of the original print.

A colored vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a monastery complex in a river valley surrounded by steep rock cliffs and forested hills. Fields stretch across the valley floor, and a river meanders along the right side. In the foreground is the large monastery with a church tower and multiple buildings arranged around courtyards. Decorative handwritten script covers the lower portion. Printed text in German appears on the image margins and at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a beach scene with several small sailing boats near the shore, one with a large triangular sail raised. People are working around the boats in the shallow water and on the sandy beach. In the background there is a wooden pier extending into the sea, crowded with people. Hills or dunes rise in the distance. Printed red text appears in the upper left and along the right edge, and a red handwritten number is at the top right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, elegant neoclassical building on a corner square. The structure has four stories, pilasters, many rectangular windows, and a central entrance with a small balcony above it. A few people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the open square in front of the building. The printed caption below the image reads "PALAZZO BANCA D'ITALIA - TRENTO."

A black‑and‑white image of an elegant landscaped park or garden. In the foreground is a curved stone balustrade terrace with ornamental posts and classic gas street lamps. The terrace overlooks a path leading into a wooded area with tall deciduous trees and manicured shrubbery. The scene feels like a formal city park from the late 19th or early 20th century.

A vintage colorized postcard showing the entrance to a large stone and brick building behind a gate and pillars. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk near the gate, including men in coats and hats and two children. Leafless trees frame the scene. Decorative handwritten text appears along the right and left margins. Printed captions at the bottom identify the place and publisher.

A monochrome postcard showing the richly decorated interior courtyard of a historic Islamic school, with carved stucco arches, columns with intricate geometric and floral motifs, and a long rectangular reflecting pool or basin in the foreground. The architecture is highly ornamented in the Moroccan style. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene and the photographer.

Colorized panoramic view over a coastal city and its bay, seen from elevated fortifications. Buildings and streets spread out toward the shoreline where many ships are in the water. Printed captions at the bottom read in French and English, identifying the scene as a panorama of Salonique/Salonica taken from the ramparts or fortifications, with a reference number at the start.

A black‑and‑white, vintage postcard photograph showing a large Gothic church with tall pointed-arch windows, heavy stone buttresses and a decorative entrance porch. A baroque-style tower with clock faces and an onion-shaped dome rises above the roof. The foreground shows a cobbled area along the church wall. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed caption text identifying the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide river with many small sailboats on the water. On the right bank stands a traditional Dutch windmill, and the distant shoreline is low and flat. The image has a white border, and printed caption text appears at the lower left.

A monochrome/sepia postcard view of a dramatic granite valley landscape with domed rock formations and forested slopes. A meadow with trees is in the foreground, steep rock walls and domes rise in the background, and clouds fill the sky. Red and black handwritten catalog numbers appear near the top, and printed red text in the upper right identifies the location as Yosemite in California.

Black‑and‑white image of a grand villa along a gently rising road with tram tracks. The ornate mansion has a tower, mansard roof, balconies, and is surrounded by a wrought‑iron fence and trees. Another house stands further up the road. Printed text at the upper right identifies the location and villa name.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a dense religious procession moving along a narrow street or ravine lined with multi‑story houses. In the foreground are Orthodox clergy in vestments carrying icons and crosses, followed by a large crowd. Above the scene, partly visible buildings and a slender minaret suggest an urban setting with both Christian and Muslim architecture. At the top there is a decorative cartouche with Greek text, and at the bottom appears a small website watermark and a printed number.

Black‑and‑white image of an ornate vaulted interior hall with a highly decorated neo‑Gothic ribbed ceiling and patterned walls. The ribs are covered with floral ornament and converge in pointed arches. Oval portrait medallions of historical or religious figures run along the upper walls, framed by elaborate foliage. The lower walls are filled with repeated geometric and floral motifs, and there are pointed arched doors on both sides with intricate paneling. The floor is wooden parquet and the room is empty except for a single hanging light fitting in the center.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rocky river or stream flowing through a forest. Sunlight reflects on the water surface, and trees line both banks. A person is sitting on a rock near mid‑stream, facing upstream. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in a Scandinavian language.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic city square with a richly decorated Renaissance/Baroque palace-like building and a tall clock tower with a spire. In the foreground stands an equestrian statue on a pedestal in the center of a round plaza with early 20th‑century buses and a streetlamp around it. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Dresden – Ehemaliger Schloßplatz."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large lattice-arched steel bridge spanning a wide river, with trains and freight wagons in the foreground and moored river barges along the bank. A small turreted building stands to the left by the bridge. The caption and publisher information are printed in German at the bottom.

Colorized historic postcard view of a park with a pond in the foreground and tree-lined lawns leading to several multi‑story buildings and a towered structure in the background. The sky is lightly clouded, and the scene is tranquil and pastoral. Red printed text at the top identifies the location as Bischofswerda in Saxony and specifies the view as being at König-Friedrich-August Park.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a steep hillside with a funicular railway climbing up to a fortified hilltop complex. The scene shows the wooded Schlossberg hill with stone fortification walls, buildings with red-tiled roofs, and a prominent round tower on the right. The funicular cars ascend between rocky cliffs and greenery. Printed German text appears along the top edge.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town featuring unpaved streets and rows of modest wooden and clapboard houses with porches. In the foreground is a dark rectangular utility building on a corner lot. Behind it stand multiple single‑story homes and, farther back, several larger multi‑story Victorian‑style buildings with gabled roofs and turrets. The area appears flat with open land beyond the town. A visible sign on one building reads "OXNARD LIGHT & WATER CO.", indicating a local utility company. The image is bordered like a printed card, consistent with an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white studio photograph of a young man standing in profile, wearing traditional academic attire: a dark cape and formal suit, holding a book. The image is bordered by a white margin with printed Portuguese text at the bottom indicating that this is number 4 in a series and that it depicts academic dress associated with Coimbra.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a rustic stone watermill by a small stream in a wooded area. The mill has a tiled roof and small windows, and water flows beneath or alongside the building. On the right side stands a small white roadside shrine or chapel next to a rocky path. The scene is bordered by a light-colored frame with handwritten-style Greek captions at the bottom.

A black-and-white postcard view taken from within a pine forest, looking out toward a long wooden pier stretching into a calm body of water. Low islands or opposite shores are visible on the horizon. The foreground is shaded by tall tree trunks, while the background shows the open sky and water. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Colorized view of a riverside town beneath wooded hills, with a large ruined Renaissance castle complex on the slope above the town. Traditional European houses with red-tiled roofs line the riverbank in the foreground. At the bottom margin in ornate script is the caption "Gruss aus Heidelberg" and the number 339 is written in red in the upper right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings. On the right is an ornate Renaissance/Baroque-style palace façade with a richly decorated portal and balcony; further along is another grand building. A few pedestrians walk along the street and distant mountains rise in the background. The caption at the bottom edge reads in German: "TRIENT, PALAST SARDAGNA MIT POSTGEBÄUDE."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverfront cityscape with several tall church spires and a large domed-tower building on the skyline. In the foreground is a wooden pier with small boats and a side‑wheel river steamer carrying passengers. The opposite bank is lined with substantial masonry buildings and greenery. There is a small, faint text block in the lower right corner but it is not clearly legible.

Colorized vintage view of a formal stone staircase in a city park, flanked by manicured hedges and trees. Two broad stairways rise symmetrically on each side with a central decorative stone wall and balustrade above. In the foreground there is a circular flower bed enclosed by a low wrought‑iron fence. At the top center of the image, red printed text identifies the location in German.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rocky cliff formation with a wooden log hut built against or on stilts beside the rocks, surrounded by trees. A person stands on the veranda of the hut. There is printed Russian text beneath the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide panoramic view of an archaeological excavation on a rocky mountainside. The foreground and middle ground are filled with stone ruins, terraces, and foundations, with steep hills rising behind. Printed captions in French and Greek appear beneath the image, and there is a circular stamp-like mark on the left plus a website watermark at the bottom.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a mountainous alpine landscape with dramatic rocky peaks partly covered in snow, labeled with peak names at the top. At the bottom of the valley sits a small settlement with hotels and a church-like building surrounded by trees and fields. There is printed Italian captioning at the bottom and handwritten Italian text across the lower margin and upper right corner.

Sepia-toned historic postcard depicting the courtyard and portico of a large church or mosque-like building with arched colonnades. A crowd of people, many in traditional robes and hats, gathers in front of the arches. In the foreground there is a rectangular stone fountain or sarcophagus, and a large tree at the right edge. The architecture includes a tall vertical element resembling a bell tower or minaret. The style and clothing suggest an early 20th‑century scene in southeastern Europe or the eastern Mediterranean. A web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a stone coastal fortress with a lighthouse rising from one corner. The structure has thick Venetian-style fortification walls, an arched entrance, and a relief with a lion emblem. Printed captions in Greek and French appear below the photograph, and a web address watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is visible across the lower right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined park road with a central wooded area. A child stands in the open foreground while further along the road a person walks toward a horse‑drawn wagon. Lamp posts and simple railings line the path. The printed captions identify the scene as Hunnenpark in Nijmegen. At the bottom, there is publisher information and some handwriting.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wooded stream with rocks along the bank, trees without leaves, and a stone structure with a small bridge or walkway near what appears to be a castle or manor grounds. The printed caption runs vertically along the left edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, fortress‑like military barracks complex on a cobblestone street corner. The multi‑storey brick buildings have crenellated rooflines and corner turrets. Several soldiers and civilians stand near the entrance, and an early motorcar is parked by the sidewalk. A woman in a long skirt and wide‑brimmed hat stands in the foreground under a tree. At the top in red Gothic-style script is a German caption identifying the place.

Colorized view from a hillside clock tower overlooking a European city with dense historic buildings and a river. The prominent structure on the left is a tall white tower with a steep shingled roof and a large round clock face with Roman numerals and ornate hands. Below the tower is a path and greenery, while the right side shows the sprawling old town, bridges, and the river in the distance. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

A sepia-toned portrait postcard featuring a formally dressed man in a suit, shirt, and tie, with short hair and a small mustache. The background is plain, and the lower part of the image bears the printed name "MERIKANTO." in capital letters.

A colored vintage postcard showing a tranquil river scene with small wooden rowing boats and people on the water. Lush green trees line both banks, with low hills in the background and a small bridge crossing the river in the middle distance. Barrels and rural structures are visible along the shore. At the top is a French caption identifying the place as the Sweet Waters of Europe near the Bosphorus.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a 19th‑century European spa town nestled in a steep, wooded valley. Dense rows of multi‑storey historicist townhouses and grand hotels line the hillside. In the foreground is a long, ornate colonnade with arches and a pavilion roof, crowded with people, suggesting a promenade over thermal springs. A forested hill rises directly behind the town, with more villas and hotels scattered higher up the slope.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a tranquil river or moat with rocky banks and leafless trees, with low buildings and earth ramparts in the background. Printed captions in Finnish appear at the bottom along with a handwritten message across the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a riverside industrial town in a hilly rural landscape. In the middle ground stands a large multi‑storey factory complex with many tall windows and a single high chimney. Smaller residential buildings and farm plots surround the factory, with a river running along the right side of the image and cultivated fields in the foreground. Tree‑lined hills and scattered houses extend into the distance. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.

A colorized vintage view over a small town at the foot of a forested hill. In the foreground are several low, pale buildings with red roofs and simple classical detailing, lining a light-colored street or square. Behind them, more houses and a few larger structures sit among dense trees, all overlooked by a steep, wooded hillside. Printed text in the upper left corner reads in Romanian, identifying the scene and indicating it is a general view toward a park.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside town with reflections in the water. A large fortress‑like complex dominates the hill in the background, with church towers and town roofs around it. Smoke rises from an industrial chimney on the left. At the top in red Gothic script is the caption identifying the scene, and at the bottom in smaller red print is the publisher's information and date.

A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small Alpine town set in a wide valley at the foot of a large mountain. The settlement consists of clustered traditional buildings, with a prominent church and steeple on the right side. Open fields and scattered trees occupy the foreground, while rugged, forested slopes rise steeply behind the town. Text printed at the top reads the location and altitude.

A black-and-white postcard showing a forested mountain landscape with tall conifer trees in the foreground and several people standing on a narrow path. In the background, a village with scattered houses and a church lies on a gently sloping hillside. At the top, German text identifies the location and viewpoint.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a sturdy stone building beside a metal bridge over fast‑moving water, surrounded by forested cliffs. At the near end of the bridge there is a sculpted figure rising from the river. The scene has a misty, industrial‑yet‑natural atmosphere. White printed text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

A monochrome vintage postcard view of a harbor scene with several sailing boats moored along a curved embankment. In the background stand a few large industrial‑looking buildings, one with a tall chimney, on slightly elevated ground. People are walking along the embankment. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the abattoir and harbor of Nijmegen.

Tinted historic street scene showing horse‑drawn carriages and carts on a cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings with red roofs. The view looks along an urban street; people in dark clothing sit on or walk beside the carriages. The image has a caption at the bottom left and right in German, suggesting it is an old printed postcard.

Colorized historic postcard view of a harbor with numerous sailing ships and small boats along both quays. Traditional houses and warehouses line the waterfront, and a church tower or similar structure is visible in the distant background. The scene is tranquil with one person rowing a small boat in the foreground. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing, with printed red text giving the place name and publisher information.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large laboratory classroom with checkered tile floors and tall windows. Several people in early 20th‑century attire work at long laboratory benches filled with glassware and equipment. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center of the image.

Colorized scenic postcard showing a lake with small rowboats and people boating in the foreground, a tree-lined shore and ornate building with red pointed towers behind it, and a panoramic view of a city and surrounding green hills in the background. At the top, printed in German, it identifies the view as being of Graz and the Hilmteich with a view of the city.

Colored vintage postcard showing a grand neo-baroque / eclectic concert and events hall. The facade has ornate sculptures, columns, round windows, and a mansard roof with statues on top. In front there is a small street and railing, with some greenery and adjacent buildings. Red printed caption at the top reads "Budapest" with further text identifying the building as Budai vigadó / Ofner Redoute. Additional small printed text appears at the bottom with a publisher credit and a building-level sign over the ground floor.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad street lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees, dominated by a large church with a tall, narrow steeple rising above the surrounding roofs. The scene looks down Schönaugasse in an urban setting with distant hills in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the place as Graz and mentions Schönaugasse with the St. Josef Church.

A sepia-toned panoramic view of a town with low, tile-roofed buildings lined along a wide street in the foreground. A few pedestrians walk on the street. In the background are rolling hills dotted with houses, and on the right side, a prominent neoclassical-style building with a flag on its roof stands on a small rise. Handwritten text in Greek appears at the bottom, and a web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible.

An illustrated postcard showing an elegant classical statue of a woman on a decorated pedestal in a lush garden setting. The statue stands amid dense green foliage, trees, and manicured pathways, with flowers at the base of the plinth. The style is graphic and decorative, reminiscent of early 20th‑century art. At the bottom margin, the words "WIEN" and "Schwarzenberggarten" are printed, and the artist's signature appears on the right side of the image.

Black‑and‑white aerial view over a broad river with rapids in the foreground, a bridge crossing the water, and a town and farmland along the banks. Forested hills extend into the distance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and a publisher logo at the bottom right.

Vintage multi-view postcard showing three black‑and‑white scenes of a rural inn and its surroundings. The upper left image depicts an outdoor garden restaurant with many tables and chairs under trees, filled with guests and children. The upper right image shows the facade of a country guesthouse with a sign on the building and numerous people in traditional clothing seated and standing in front. The bottom image is a wide landscape view of a valley with fields, scattered houses, and wooded hills. Printed German text below the images identifies the guesthouse and its location near Graz.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly rural village landscape with scattered houses, fields, and forested hills in the background. In the foreground are trees and a few larger buildings and a walled area, likely part of the village. The lower left corner bears a printed caption with the place name, and a small serial number appears at the bottom right.

Color-tinted historic postcard showing a lively town square with people standing and walking in the open space. Surrounding the square are ornate gabled buildings and a prominent church tower in the background. The scene is framed by a decorative border, and printed captions at the top read the city name and the name of the square.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large, elegant villa with a symmetrical façade, multiple windows with shutters, and a central entrance. In front of the villa is a formal Italian garden with geometric beds, paths, a central fountain, and stairs leading down to a gate in the foreground. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the location and building, and a small printed credit appears beneath the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a compact town in a narrow Alpine valley. Dense clusters of mid‑rise buildings with pitched roofs fill the valley floor, surrounded by terraced fields and meadows. Steep, forested mountains rise sharply on both sides, with higher snow‑covered peaks visible in the background. A river or torrent runs along the valley bottom, paralleled by a road, and a few larger, possibly hotel‑like buildings stand at the edge of town. The image has the classic framing and style of a mid‑20th‑century landscape postcard.

Color image of a ski resort scene in the mountains. In the foreground many children and some adults are skiing and learning on a gentle snowy slope with a rope tow. Most wear bright 1960s–1970s style ski clothing. In the mid‑ground there are long, low chalet-style lodge buildings with dark red/brown wood and white-trim windows, plus another small lift building on the right. Evergreen trees surround the runs, and high, snowy mountains rise in the background under a clear blue sky. A faint circular violet postal cancel mark is visible near the center top of the card.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the Königin Carola memorial stone (Königin Carola-Gedenkstein) in a landscaped park. In the foreground is a circular terrace and a stone monument with a portrait medallion and wreath garlands. Behind it rise ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas on a wooded hillside. The caption at the top is printed in red German text.

A black-and-white postcard showing a small car ferry or workboat at the edge of a calm lake, with low hills and a town visible across the water. At the bottom of the image there is Norwegian text identifying the view toward Gjøvik with the car ferry, and a credit line to the publisher Carl Normann in Hamar along with a card number.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an ornate, two‑story waterside pavilion with elaborate neoclassical and Ottoman architectural details, situated directly on the Bosphorus shore behind an intricate wrought‑iron fence. The building is labeled as a kiosk of the Sultan on the Asian side of the Bosphorus. In the background are additional waterfront structures and greenery along the shoreline.

Black‑and‑white view of a largely empty town square bordered by 2–3‑storey plastered buildings with steep gabled roofs. On the left are commercial houses with signage at street level; in the distance a baroque church tower with an onion dome rises above the roofs. At the right stands a large leafy tree near additional houses and small shops. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photograph printed as a postcard.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large, ornate late‑Victorian/Queen Anne style house with multiple gables, bay windows, and a wrap‑around porch. The house is surrounded by a lush garden filled with dense flowering shrubs, palms, and other subtropical plants. A set of concrete steps leads up from the sidewalk to the front garden, with manicured hedges of flowers lining both sides. A broad sidewalk and neatly cut lawn run along the street in the foreground. The overall scene suggests an affluent residential neighborhood in a warm climate. Along the bottom border, some handwritten or printed numerals and letters appear, partly cut off.

Colorized street scene showing an early 20th‑century town. A broad unpaved road is lined with trees and multi‑story houses.
