On the right is a red building with a sign for an apothecary, and several pedestrians, including a man walking with a small child, are visible. An early motorcar drives along the street. At the top, printed text identifies the view as 'Neumark i. S. Werdauerstrasse.'

Vintage sepia postcard showing a two‑storey late‑19th/early‑20th‑century building with a gabled roof and decorative wooden details, set behind a grassy foreground with a few young trees. In front of the building stand several people and a horse‑drawn cart. The image is framed by a light vignette. Printed red text appears at the bottom center and along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cobblestone street in a European town. Tall narrow townhouses line both sides, with simple stucco facades and shutterless windows. In the background stands a prominent church tower with a clock face and a slender spire topped by a weather vane. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children and a woman pushing a handcart, walk along the street. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.

A black‑and‑white historical photograph showing a small canal lined with a stone embankment and simple metal railing. A two‑story plastered house with a steep tiled roof stands directly on the canal, with wooden annexes extending over the water. A few leafless trees grow along the wide street on the opposite side. People in early 20th‑century European clothing—men in long coats and hats, uniformed officers, and children—stroll or pose along the canal and the street. In the background are modest town buildings and a tree‑lined square.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a round stone tower with small windows and a steep conical roof, standing on a grassy hill lined with trees. A paved path curves in the foreground where people in mid‑20th‑century clothing are walking. In the background, partly hidden by trees, are onion-domed church towers characteristic of Eastern Orthodox architecture. The sky is filled with long, streaked clouds. There is a narrow white margin around the image and some catalog-style writing along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white portrait of a seated crowned woman in elaborate medieval-style royal regalia. She wears an ornate metal crown with jewels, long veil, heavy chain necklaces, and a richly decorated gown with large round shoulder ornaments. Her hands rest on her lap, holding a small patterned purse or book. The background shows part of a carved throne. There is no visible caption or handwriting on the front.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with low buildings and a large, prominent complex in the foreground, enclosed by a fence and trees. Rolling hills or mountains appear in the distant background. Russian pre‑revolutionary text in the upper margin identifies the location and the view.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a coastal town with a harbor in the foreground and low mountains in the background. Small boats lie in the bay, with quays, piers, and a few waterfront buildings visible. The town climbs the hillside with whitewashed houses and several prominent church domes and bell towers. There is a green postage stamp with a flying bird in the upper-left corner. Printed captions run along the right and bottom edges, and there is cursive handwriting on the right side. A faint watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears over the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with a dirt path and birch trees on the left, an open grassy field on the right, and a steel viaduct crossing the middle distance. A steam locomotive with passenger carriages is traveling across the viaduct. Printed German text appears in the top right corner.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet cobblestone street ending at a small, simple two‑story house with a steep tiled roof and two chimneys. The house stands alone at the end of the lane, with older stone buildings and a high wall to the left and a large dark façade on the right, partly in shadow. Tree branches overhang the street from the upper left, casting shadows on the pavement. The image is framed with a light border typical of vintage photographic postcards. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large hydroelectric dam and spillway in a forested landscape. Water rushes through multiple sluice gates beneath tall concrete towers, then cascades down a rocky channel. Two narrow pedestrian bridges span the turbulent water below the dam, with several small human figures standing on them. Coniferous and leafless deciduous trees frame the river gorge, while open fields and low hills stretch into the distance. The image is bordered by a white margin, in the style of a vintage postcard. No visible text appears on the front.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a river toward a European town with many gabled houses and several prominent church towers. In the foreground are boats and a pontoon-style bridge or jetty extending across the water. The lower margin contains printed Dutch text and the place name, with a handwritten signature at the bottom right.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a coastal town with many low, whitewashed buildings and tiled roofs. In the background is a bay filled with numerous small boats and ships, framed by rugged mountains. The caption at the bottom reads in Portuguese, identifying the scene as a partial view of São Vicente in Cabo Verde.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small guesthouse set among trees and rocky hills. In front of the building is a fenced garden area and what appear to be sunbathing beds or platforms on the rock. A flagpole on the roof flies the Swedish flag. The house has a sign reading "PENSIONAT" above the entrance. At the bottom left of the image the caption identifies the location as "Heestrand. Pensionatet" and there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 9184 in the bottom right.

Sepia-toned image showing a calm lake framed by tall trees and reeds in the foreground, with a large building or estate visible on the opposite shore. The style and print resemble an early 20th‑century postcard. At the bottom there is a printed caption identifying the location.

Color postcard showing a large statue of the crowned Virgin Mary holding the Child Jesus, with golden stars encircling her head, floating above an image of a church complex with a tall central bell tower and surrounding buildings and greenery. The sky is blue with clouds fading into a pink-tinted horizon. There is Croatian text at the top and beneath the statue.

Color view of a small hillside town with red-tiled roofs, a tall narrow church tower with a pointed spire, and scattered houses rising up a green slope. Behind the town is a densely forested mountain under a clear blue sky. The scene suggests an Alpine or pre‑Alpine village landscape.

A sepia-toned interior view of an ornate council chamber with carved wooden paneling, a long U‑shaped table surrounded by high-backed chairs, large framed paintings on the walls, a clock above an elaborate door, and tall windows on the right letting in light. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style captions read a place name and the word 'Raadszaal'.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a hilly forest landscape with a winding footpath cutting across grassy slopes and dense trees in the foreground. At the top left, red printed text identifies the location as St. Andreasberg in the Oberharz region and names the specific path as the John F. Rothe-Weg.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a row of multi‑story townhouses and shops. On the left is a distinctive corner building with curved balconies, flower boxes, and a tower‑like upper section. On the right side of the street are several shopfronts with awnings and signage, tram tracks in the road, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. At the top, printed in orange, is the caption "Freiberg i. Sa." indicating the location.

A black-and-white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a river, showing the large Albrechtsburg castle and the cathedral with tall spires rising behind it. Below the hill are rows of old town houses along the riverbank, and in the foreground a paddle steamer or small ferry moves along the Elbe River. The printed captions at the top identify the place as Meissen on the Elbe and name the Albrechtsburg and the cathedral (Dom).

A sepia-toned historic street view showing a broad, tree-lined avenue flanked by multi-story residential and civic buildings with ornate facades and steep roofs. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk along the sidewalks. The printed caption at the top reads "Flöha — König-Albert-Straße," indicating the name of the town and street.

Black-and-white postcard view of a rural town in a valley surrounded by forested hills and a large mountain in the background. In the foreground are fields with cut hay drying on racks and a wooden structure of poles. A small town with smoking chimneys lies in the middle ground. White printed caption text at the bottom left reads "5-26-2 Tynset - mot Tronfjell." At the bottom right is a cursive publisher's mark and a number.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad boulevard with ornate late-19th‑century buildings and a circular square. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move along a wide avenue lined with trees and tall streetlamps. The scene depicts the Andrássy út körönd (a roundabout) in Budapest, framed by grand residential and civic buildings.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox-style cathedral with a dominant central dome and several smaller domes, all topped with crosses. The building has tall arched windows, heavy masonry, and a broad stairway leading up to the main entrance. It is surrounded by a landscaped square with paths, small trees, and shrubs. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced on cardstock, with a wide blank margin typical for vintage postcards.

A vintage, graphic postcard dominated by a bright red background on the left, overlaid with black barbed wire and bold white-and-black lettering that reads "MOSTRA dell'ALDILA' ". The right side is a cream-colored panel listing several Italian cities and dates under the headings ITINERARIO 1, ITINERARIO 2, and ITINERARIO 3, ending with "ROMA STAZIONE TERMINI" at the bottom. The design resembles a promotional card for a traveling exhibition, likely with a somber or memorial theme suggested by the barbed wire.

Black-and-white photograph showing a street parade with people in traditional folk costumes walking down a broad, busy street lined with multi‑story buildings and shop awnings. A large crowd watches from the sidewalks and balconies. At the front of the group, a man carries a sign in Cyrillic, followed by others holding a large flag. The atmosphere suggests a public celebration or festival in an urban setting, likely in the early–mid 20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic building with a tall central tower topped by an onion dome and cross, likely a former manor or small castle set among trees and lawn. At the bottom edge there is German text identifying the place as a children's home in Lindenau near Ortrand, in the district of Senftenberg.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with a paved road leading into a small village or farmstead. Wooden fences line the road and fields; scattered houses and farm buildings sit in gently rolling countryside bordered by forest. In the foreground a person or small vehicle is on the road. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small printer/photographer credit is at the bottom right.

A stylized winter cityscape framed by white snowflakes, showing a mix of medieval towers and church spires alongside modern industrial buildings, a bridge over water, and a construction crane. Snow-covered trees dot the scene. At the bottom, in red cursive script, is a New Year greeting in Estonian.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a forested valley with two railway bridges: a tall metal trestle bridge in the foreground above houses and trees, and a large multi-arch stone viaduct in the background with a train crossing it. German caption text is printed along the top edge.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a quiet street with early 20th‑century villas and garden fences in a leafless winter setting. A prominent corner wall and trellis-covered garden stand in the foreground; larger residential buildings with ornate roofs and antennas rise behind. The caption at the top in red print reads 'Oberlößnitz. Nizzastrasse.' and a vertical red imprint on the left margin gives the publisher information.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a harbor surrounded by hills. Several ships are anchored close to the shore, and in the foreground a seaplane (hydroplane) is about to land on the water. Greek and French captions are printed at the top describing the scene. A web address is faintly visible at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a side view of a steam-powered ferry with two smokestacks sailing on the sea. Lifeboats are visible on deck and the ship's name "DROTTNING VICTORIA" appears on the hull near the stern. Under the image is a German caption describing the Swedish ferry and its route between Trelleborg and Sassnitz.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a forested valley with scattered village houses and a prominent church tower in the foreground. The scene shows a mountainous landscape with rolling hills and woods typical of Central Europe. Printed German text at the top identifies the view as looking towards Kipsdorf in the Saxon Ore Mountains, with the neighboring localities Schellerhau and Bärenfels labeled on the left and right.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a posed studio-style photograph of an African chief and his entourage. The central seated figure wears a dark jacket and traditional striped cloth, surrounded by men and women in wraps, beads, and head coverings. Several drums and other objects are placed in front of them. The card has a printed border, worn edges, and Portuguese captions at the bottom.

Colorized historic view of a hospital complex with red‑brick buildings and red tile roofs surrounding a landscaped garden. Numerous people in white coats or gowns walk along paths and sit in the garden near a fountain. The main central block and side pavilions are labeled in German, and the scene has the look of an early 20th‑century military hospital.

Vintage divided-view postcard with two colorized photographs. The upper image shows a rustic inn with a long wooden veranda under a red-tiled roof, labeled 'Stampfe's Gastwirtschaft'. Several people in period clothing stand in front, with a horse-drawn cart nearby, and forested hills in the background. The lower image is a panoramic view of a small valley town surrounded by wooded hills, centered on a church with a tall steeple and clock tower, labeled 'Frauheim.'. Printing along the left edge and bottom credits the publisher and describes it as a hand-colored art card.

An old black‑and‑white seaside postcard showing sand dunes with children and adults in early 20th‑century clothing walking and playing on the beach. In the background, a long pier extends into the sea with a pavilion-like building on it. The printed caption at the top left reads "Libau. Strand", and there is a small vertical serial number on the left margin.

Colorized view of a landscaped park with curved gravel paths, manicured lawns, rose beds, clipped shrubs, and tall trees in the background. The scene is tranquil and formal, showing a section of a rose garden within an old city park. At the top of the image, German text identifies the place.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a dramatic snowplow train clearing deep snow from a railway cutting in mountainous terrain. A huge plume of snow arcs high over the tracks as the rotary snowplow works its way along the line. Telegraph or power poles and overhead wires run beside the track. To the right there is a wooden snow fence on the slope. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a photographer credit at the bottom right.

A vintage illustrated greeting postcard featuring a cluster of pink and red roses with green leaves and buds, accompanied by a large blue butterfly. The artwork is decorative and framed by a thin brown border. On the right side of the card, curved text in a serif font reads in Swedish or older Scandinavian orthography.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an Italian city square and adjoining street. The scene shows historic multi‑story buildings with arcades, frescoed facades, wooden shutters, and a distinctive domed corner roof. A decorative cast‑iron streetlamp stands in the foreground. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the square. The caption at the top reads "Trento – Piazza del Duomo e via Larga," indicating this is the cathedral square and Via Larga in Trento.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large coastal sea arch known as Cathedral Rock standing on a beach with the ocean and rocky shoreline in the background. The rock has a prominent opening through which light shines. The front is printed with red captions along the bottom and sides and a red handwritten number in the lower right corner.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large castle-like building with light stone walls and red-tiled roofs, dominated by a tall round central tower with a dark dome and small spire. Trees and a fenced green area occupy the foreground. The sky is softly tinted in pastel blue and peach. German text is printed at the top identifying the location as Mügeln in the Leipzig district and naming the building Schloss Ruhetal.

Black-and-white view of a massive medieval stone fortress wall on a grassy hill, with large cylindrical corner towers featuring narrow slit windows. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds and there is a wooden fence along the slope in the foreground. No visible printed text on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a narrow rocky gorge with steep cliff walls and a waterfall plunging down the center. Trees and branches frame the top of the gorge. At the bottom margin, printed captions in red Italian text identify the location and city.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy central square with many parasol-covered market stalls, a prominent statue on a pedestal, street trams, and rows of historic multi‑storey buildings with shops and signs. In the background a steep wooded hill rises, topped by a clock tower. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Hauptplatz with Schlossberg in Graz, and the publisher Erika‑Verlag from Graz.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a masonry lookout tower attached to a rectangular building on a low hill. The tower has arched windows, a balcony near the top, and a decorative crenellated crown with a small spire. Some foliage appears in the foreground and to the right. Handwritten-style captions at the bottom read a city name on the left and the name of the lookout tower on the right.

A black-and-white studio portrait of a young man in an early 20th‑century suit, standing with his hands behind his back and looking slightly to the side. The background is neutral and blurred. Text with his name appears at the top, and small-print credits and date appear at the bottom corners, indicating a photographic postcard.

A monochrome postcard showing a long, vaulted arcade with ornate arches, columns, and elaborate tombs or memorials along the right side. The floor is tiled in a checker pattern. The architecture is richly decorated, with statues, reliefs, and wreaths or garlands hanging on the walls. At the bottom in red text it labels the location.

Old black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a monumental stone terrace with arched arcades and conical-roofed towers in neo‑Romanesque style. A man in dark clothing and a hat stands beneath a large archway in the right foreground. Ornamental battlements, small circular windows, and a tall streetlamp are visible, with a distant hilly landscape in the background.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large church complex with an arcade, central gabled façade decorated with lights or flags, and a tall bell tower on the right. In front there is a processional walkway lined with flags and people walking toward the church. Handwritten notes in Greek appear in the margins, and there is printed Greek text under the image.

A monochrome postcard showing a dramatic river with rapids flowing through a rocky gorge, flanked by forested cliffs. In the middle distance are small industrial or hydraulic structures by the water and two bridges crossing the river, one of them a tall truss bridge. Buildings of a town are visible on the horizon. Caption text is printed at the bottom of the image.

A color illustration of a quiet winter evening in the countryside. Snow covers the ground, bare trees stand to the right, and a large yellow sun or moon glows low in a greenish sky. In the middle distance is a small wooden house with lighted windows and smoke from the chimney. A person in a coat walks toward the house, while in the foreground a dog stands near a small wooden footbridge over a narrow stream. The scene has a soft, painterly, early‑20th‑century style and no visible printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval fortified riverside town. Dominating the left side is a massive round stone tower with machicolations and a battlemented crown, attached to a fortification on a rocky slope above a river and weir. Behind and to the right rise additional towers, steep‑roofed townhouses, and church spires typical of Central European architecture. In the lower right corner are riverside houses with tiled roofs and a small industrial or commercial building; faint signage is visible on one façade.

Colorized historical postcard view of a European town square with a central fountain and statue ensemble surrounded by café tables and parasols. Multi‑story buildings with green shutters encircle the square, and shops with German signage line the ground floors. On a hill in the background stands a prominent clock tower and fortification. At the top left, printed text reads "Graz. Hauptplatz".

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tall Gothic-style church with a clock tower and spire, surrounded by manicured trees and a garden path in the foreground. At the bottom left, white caption text reads "Kirche von Staucha."

A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a forested river valley with a winding river and a road running alongside it. Hills covered with trees rise on both sides. At the bottom margin, there is a handwritten-style caption identifying the scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a powerful river or rapids running through a rocky gorge with forested cliffs on both sides. A road or path follows the right bank, and a bridge spans the river in the distance. A church spire is visible on the right skyline. Printed captions at the bottom read the location name and the name of the falls.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large stone fortress-like building with a massive round tower in the foreground and a rectangular multi‑story block attached. In the background, a church spire rises above the roofline. There is a grassy field in front with a small path and a few tiny human figures. Printed German text at the top reads the location and the specific building.

Black-and-white postcard showing the courtyard of a rustic wine tavern. In the foreground stands a large historic wooden wine press with a roof above it. Behind it is an old plastered building with shuttered windows and a door, and to the right there are garden tables and chairs under a parasol, surrounded by trees and a picket fence. Caption text is printed along the bottom of the image.

A black-and-white portrait postcard featuring a formally dressed man with a mustache, wearing a checkered suit, white shirt with a high collar, and tie. He faces the camera directly against a dark background. In the lower right corner of the image, the name "EMIL SJÖGREN." is printed.

Black‑and‑white view over a river spanned by a multi‑span steel truss bridge carrying pedestrians, horse‑drawn carts and early vehicles into a dense European town. The banks are lined with boats and masonry buildings of 3–5 stories, many with steep tiled roofs, dormers, and ornate late‑19th‑century façades. In the distance are church spires and chimneys, with wooded hills behind the town. The image has the composition and tone of an early 20th‑century city postcard.

Sepia-toned portrait of a middle‑aged person with shoulder‑length hair, eyes closed, wearing a loose, high‑collared tunic gathered at the neck and a sash tied at the waist. The background is an interior wall or door panel, with soft studio lighting. In the lower right corner, there is small imprinted text.

Sepia-toned postcard view over a wide river with barges and a groyne in the foreground, a bridge and town along the riverbank, and a large hilltop complex with prominent spires and castle-like buildings on the right. Tree branches frame the scene above. Red German text is printed on the upper left, and a red handwritten number appears on the upper right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large monastic complex with a church and tower seen from across an open field. The building has Baroque-style architecture and is surrounded by trees. The lower portion of the card is blank except for printed captions in German identifying the site and publisher.

A black-and-white panoramic view over a small European spa town nestled among hills and vineyards. The image shows dense traditional houses with pitched roofs, a prominent church tower in the center, and wooded slopes rising behind the town with scattered buildings and fields on the plateau beyond. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in German identifying the place as Bad Sulza with its vineyards.

Vintage postcard with a central photograph of a multi‑story building with decorative tilework and wrought‑iron balconies. In front of the building is a commercial shop with bolts of fabric and textiles hanging outside and displayed on tables, with several people standing and shopping. Above and below the photo, red printed text identifies the location as Nazareth and the commercial house of Antonio Carvalho Laranjo.

A sepia-toned landscape view of a calm river or pond bordered by grassy banks and a line of trees in the background. In the foreground, a large dark tree trunk and overhanging branches frame the scene. The image has a quiet rural atmosphere. Handwritten-style text appears at the bottom left, and a small printed credit or mark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small pavilion-like spring building with a steep metal roof topped by a finial and flag, labeled "ANTICA FONTE PEJO". It is set between multi‑story Alpine-style buildings (one marked "HOTEL OLIVA") in a mountain valley. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the spring building. There is printed caption text in the lower right corner and handwritten script along the bottom margin.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a tramway scene in a semi-rural setting. Two light-colored trams run on curved tracks beside a brick building with large doors and windows, likely a depot or terminal. A few pedestrians and a cyclist are visible, with tree-covered hills in the background. The printed title at the top reads in Dutch about a place near Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white image of a long, two‑storey wooden building with vertical cladding and many tall windows. The structure stands in a landscaped area with young trees and a dirt path in the foreground. Several men in light trousers and darker jackets walk or stand near the building, while others look out from open windows on the upper floor. One person in a darker uniform or coat strolls alone on the path. The scene feels like a hospital, sanatorium, or institutional dormitory in a park‑like setting. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the image side.

The image shows the facade of an ornate Renaissance/Baroque urban palace on a narrow street. The main portal is heavily rusticated with large, rough‑cut stone blocks and is flanked by sculpted caryatid‑like figures supporting an elaborate balcony above. On the balcony stand small statues of putti (cherubic children), and more sculptures crown the upper frame of the doorway. The building's walls are plastered and light‑colored, with rectangular windows framed in stone and fitted with wooden shutters; the ground‑floor windows are protected by iron grilles. A rectangular plaque is mounted on the wall to the right of the entrance, but its text is not clearly legible.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a sloping village market square with a central stone fountain. Several children stand near the fountain in the foreground. Traditional multi‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs line the square; forested hills and fields appear in the background. Printed red caption text identifies the scene as the market of Lauenstein in the Saxon Erzgebirge. Publisher information is printed along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad avenue lined with mid‑20th‑century buildings. People walk and cycle along the sidewalks and street. To the right is a corner building signed as a bank, and in the distance stands a prominent historic building with a tall clock‑tower–like structure. The foreground signage and caption identify the location as Haparanda and the street as Köpmangatan.

Black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a simple church building with a tall, steep spire and a rectangular tower. The tower facade has the year "1932" written across the top just under the roofline, and small arched windows. The church has plain plastered walls, a gabled roof, and a modest classical entrance with a triangular pediment. Trees partially obscure the lower part of the building; the sky is lightly clouded. The image has a white border with scalloped edges typical of old postcards or prints.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings and shops. In the center distance stands a decorated triumphal-style arch spanning the street, with people walking beneath it and early 20th‑century pedestrians and a few officials in uniform scattered in the foreground. Overhead are numerous telegraph or electrical wires. The bottom border of the card has captions in Cyrillic and French, identifying the street and city.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand neoclassical building beside a water feature in a park. The façade has large windows framed by full-height statues and rich stone decoration, with a balustraded roofline topped by sculptures. In front, a rounded terrace or pavilion with a striped awning projects over a pond or canal; its rusticated base has round porthole-like windows and ornamental reliefs. A small fountain or water outlet with sculptural decoration pours water into the pond. Trees and a path with low railings fill the foreground, and additional historic city buildings appear in the distance.

A black‑and‑white vintage view over a snowy small town with scattered wooden buildings, a church with a tall steeple on the left, low hills or a forested ridge in the background, and open snow‑covered ground in the foreground. The printed caption "Arjepluog" appears in the upper right corner.

Colorized industrial-era postcard showing a large factory complex with tall red brick smokestacks beside a body of water and low rolling hills in the background. The main building is a long red brick structure with multiple tall chimneys, surrounded by smaller stone and metal-roofed industrial buildings, scaffolding, and construction materials. At the top of the image there is red printed text reading "POZDRAV IZ SOLINA, Adria Portland."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large church bell mounted as a monument on a stone pedestal with an inscribed plaque, placed in a small garden area beside a church wall with tall Gothic arched windows. The caption at the bottom reads "Dohna." and the publisher credit "Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town with fields and gardens in the foreground and dense buildings, church towers, chimneys, and some larger institutional buildings in the background. At the top left in red Gothic-style type is the caption "Waldenburg i. Sa." indicating the town and region. The overall style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white image showing the interior of a ruined stone and brick church whose roof has collapsed, leaving high Gothic arches and broken window tracery. The floor of the ruined nave is densely filled with graves and headstones, many with crosses and floral plots, forming a churchyard cemetery within the old walls. At the far end is an apse-like wall niche with a large crucifix and other religious monuments. Outside the broken window on the right a tall industrial chimney is visible on the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or text typical of a modern postcard front.

An old sepia postcard showing a rural inn or large house with two stories and a gabled roof, located beside a dirt road and surrounded by wooded hills. A group of people, including men, women, and children, pose in front of the building and by an adjoining barn or outbuilding. Logs lie near the road, and the setting appears to be a small village in a forested area. The caption in red German text at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Grünberg bei Petschau." Publisher information and a printer's mark appear at the bottom and right edges.

Colored vintage postcard view across a body of water toward a dense historic waterfront cityscape. In the foreground are small rowing boats on a calm sea or strait. Along the shore stand piers with moored sailing ships and steamers, and a prominent mosque with a central dome and minarets slightly right of center. The hillside behind is filled with tightly packed buildings and additional minarets. Printed captions in red at the top identify the scene and publisher, and a watermark with a web address appears at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a large open town square bordered by multi-story historic buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. Trees frame the scene, and people in early-20th‑century clothing stroll or stand in the square. Printed text at the top reads "Naumburg a. Saale — Markt," indicating the market square of Naumburg on the Saale River.

Black‑and‑white view over a calm river with a multi‑arch stone bridge in the middle ground. On the right bank stand several town houses and trees; on the left bank are industrial‑looking buildings with a tall chimney. Rising steeply behind the bridge is a rocky, wooded hill crowned by a large, fortified castle complex with high walls and a steep roof. The entire scene is reflected clearly in the water. The image has blank margins and surface blemishes typical of early photographic postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing a small mountain stream with rocks in the foreground, flowing through a valley of rolling hills. On the left hillside stands a large chalet‑style house with balconies and a steep tiled roof with a small turret, while another similar villa is visible further up the slope. On the right are fenced meadows and a tall wooden barn. A simple footbridge crosses the stream in the middle distance. In the lower right, three children in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing sit and stand on the stone embankment along the water. The scene is tranquil and alpine, with forested slopes in the background. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small wooden pedestrian bridge with diagonal cross-bracing spanning a tree-lined path or cutting. Light snow or fallen leaves cover the ground and banks on either side. Behind the bridge is a white picket fence and a multi-story building partly visible through bare trees. The card has printed vertical text along the right side of the image and a short handwritten note on the right margin.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with ornate 19th‑century buildings. A large corner building dominated by an advertising sign reading "HUNTER WHISKY" overlooks a busy square with pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicles and early motor traffic. In the right foreground stands a richly decorated small pavilion or kiosk. The signage on the façades appears in a Central‑European language using the Latin alphabet.

Vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a man in formal evening dress (white bow tie and tailcoat), seated in profile while holding a closed book. His hair is neatly styled and he has a prominent mustache. The background is dark and plain. In the upper right corner, elegant cursive handwriting reads a name, and a small serial number appears in the bottom left.

A colorized panoramic view over a river city with several bridges crossing a wide river, dense tile‑roofed houses in the foreground, industrial chimneys, church towers in the distance, and hills on both banks. The caption in German at the bottom reads "Blick von den Amtsstufen. Cölln‑Meissen." and a small printer's credit appears on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river curving through a densely forested valley, seen from an elevated vantage point. In the foreground there is a low weir or dam across the river; along the left bank runs a road or rail line with scattered buildings partly hidden by trees. Rolling wooded hills fill the background. A small caption is printed at the bottom left.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large arched bridge under construction over a body of water. Extensive wooden scaffolding supports the steel arch spans. A passenger boat is seen on the water below the bridge, and there are wooded banks and a few small buildings by the shoreline. Printed text at the top reads "Skurubro under byggnad".

Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground is an open grassy field bordered by a road with trees and a few pedestrians. Behind it stand farm buildings and multi‑storey houses with traditional German architecture, and further up the slope are scattered villas and houses leading toward a wooded hill in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image, along with a publisher line and number.

A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a rural settlement with scattered houses and farm buildings in a valley, fenced meadows, leafless trees, and forested hills leading up to snow‑covered mountains in the background. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the place as Ober-Schreiberhau in the Riesengebirge and the specific settlement as Siedlung Leiterweg.

Colorized winter view of a steep funicular railway climbing up a snow-covered hill toward a tunnel under a large building complex. The scene shows tracks of the Schlossbergbahn in the snow, a carriage with a driver ascending on the right, iron railings in the foreground, and the Café-Restaurant Schlossberg buildings above the tunnel. Printed caption text appears at the top in German.

Black‑and‑white view over a European city with dense historic buildings and steeply pitched roofs. In the foreground there is a tree‑lined road atop a stone embankment or viaduct, leading towards a multi‑arch stone bridge crossing a river. The middle ground shows a large, elongated masonry building with a tall, simple roof and dormer windows, likely a barracks or institutional complex. The background is filled with more traditional townhouses, church towers and mid‑rise structures, suggesting an older, compact cityscape.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a sloping meadow above a town. Two women in traditional rural clothing work on the hillside with rakes. Tall conifer trees frame the foreground. In the middle ground is a church with a bell tower and other village buildings, surrounded by mountainous landscape. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "Cavalese - Panorama".

Sepia-toned early-20th‑century street scene showing an open-top touring car with large spoked wheels and a spare tire on the side. Several uniformed men (likely military or police officers) sit in and around the car, with one man in a long coat entering or exiting the rear seat. Onlookers, including civilians and a clergyman, stand in front of a building with large doorway and shop windows. The architecture is European, with cobblestone pavement and a commercial storefront displaying various goods.

Black‑and‑white image showing a quiet tree‑lined path along the edge of a lake or pond. A wooden bench sits on the left, slightly sunk into the embankment. On the right, across the water, stands a tall classical column monument with a statue on top and a stepped base, reflected in the still surface of the water. The scene looks like a landscaped park or garden; there is no visible text or caption on the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a tree‑lined dirt road curving past a red‑brick house with white window frames and a green door, set in a landscaped garden. The scene appears rural, at sunset or sunrise. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style caption.

A colorized historic postcard view of a tree‑lined road and small houses along a street. A path curves in the foreground with a park or green hillside on the left and a row of low buildings with red and brown tiled roofs on the right. In the middle distance there is a bridge crossing the road, and further back a church spire rises above the trees. The style suggests an early 20th‑century European townscape. The bottom margin contains printed captions identifying the location and the publisher.

A vintage colored illustration titled in French and Ottoman Turkish showing four Ottoman-era men in traditional dress, walking in a line from left to right. They wear turbans, fezzes and baggy trousers, and carry musical instruments, bundles, or pipes. The style resembles a 19th‑ or early‑20th‑century 'collection of costumes' ethnographic postcard. Printed captions in red at the top and in French and Ottoman script at the bottom identify the characters as "Medjmouat tesaouir (Collection de costumes)" and variants of 'Karakoulouktchou / Orta Sakkassi', with a circular seal and a Greek website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".

A black‑and‑white vintage street view of a small rural town with wooden houses on both sides of an unpaved road. On the left are two-story timber buildings with fenced verandas; a hanging sign reads "CAFÉ." Several people, including women in long dresses and children, stand along the fence, and a dog is visible near the foreground. The road recedes into the distance, lined with wooden fences and trees. Printed at the top right is the caption "Alby – Järnvägsgatan." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black-and-white postcard showing a multi‑storey institutional building with a tiled mansard roof and large windows. A wrought‑iron fence with brick pillars surrounds the property, and several people in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk along a cobblestone street in front. On the façade appears the sign 'INSTITUTUL DE IGIENĂ'. A printed caption at the bottom reads 'CLUJ – Institutul de igienă Pasteur'.

A sepia-toned postcard view of a leafy city park with a pond in the foreground and several people standing on a path near a bench, looking toward a large round medieval tower in the distance. The tower rises above the trees and appears to be part of old city fortifications. The caption beneath the image reads "Kronenburgerpark – Nijmegen."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a riverfront cityscape with a bridge crossing the water and hills rising behind the town. On the left is a riverside promenade with streetlamps and a tall church tower. In the center a metal bridge spans the river on trestle supports, leading toward densely packed buildings and, higher on the hill, a large rectangular complex identified as Castel San Pietro. The caption at the bottom reads in Italian that the scene is Verona, featuring Ponte Umberto and Castel S. Pietro.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a powerful river rapid or waterfall rushing over rocks, surrounded by forested banks. In the distance there appears to be a small bridge or dam-like structure. Printed text in the upper right corner identifies the scene as a location in Trollhättan, specifically Västra Gullödfallet.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a river bending through a forested valley, with a railway line curving along a rocky hillside on the right. A steam train with several cars is traveling along the track. In the foreground are trees; in the far distance a flat plain and low hills. At the bottom of the image, there is handwritten-style German text identifying the location.

Black-and-white postcard showing the Gothic façade and choir of a large cathedral with elaborate stone tracery, pointed arches and a rose window. To the left is an adjacent historic building with steep roofs and small spires. The lower margin bears a handwritten German caption identifying the cathedral and referencing its towers before their construction up to 1903.

Colorized historic street scene showing Großhartmannsdorferstraße in Brand-Erbisdorf, a small town with two- and three-story buildings with steep roofs. People stand and sit along the roadside, and a horse-drawn carriage moves down the street. In the distance a church tower rises above trees and rooftops. German text captions identifying the town and street are printed at the top, and a large German shop sign is visible on the left building.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a white Lutheran church with a tall steeple topped by a cross, seen behind bare trees and a low fence in a snowy or slushy landscape. The sky is blue with light clouds. At the top are multilingual captions naming the town and the Lutheran church.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a view of a fortified complex. On the left is a multi‑storey building with several chimneys and shuttered windows, partly obscured by vegetation. In the center is a tree and a dirt path leading between stone walls. On the right stands a round stone tower with a conical roof, part of the fortification. Printed German text in red appears in the upper right and along the bottom edge.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing three people in elaborate folk or theatrical costumes, resembling traditional Russian or Slavic dress with large headdresses, patterned garments, and fur trim. They stand close together in the dark, illuminated from the front, and hold a rectangular sheet of paper or placard toward the camera. The text on the sheet appears inverted, as though the original negative was printed backwards.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, multi‑storey stone barracks building with rows of arched windows along a cobblestone street. A few small figures are visible on the sidewalk. The lower margin bears red printed captions identifying the place and building.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑span steel truss bridge crossing a wide river. In the foreground there is a steam-powered riverboat docked at a landing with several people standing on the pier. The bridge has prominent latticework arches and stone piers, and a tall metal signal or lighting structure rises above one of the spans. At the top of the image is the printed caption "Riesa a. Elbe" indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an old electric tram at a street stop in a village or small town. The tram is marked with route number 15 and destination "Südstadt." Several people, including a conductor and passengers, stand near the tram on a narrow street with trees, houses, and a church spire visible in the background. At the bottom is a German caption identifying the place and tram stop.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large cargo or passenger ship at sea or in a harbor. The vessel dominates the frame in a side view, with its bow on the left and the superstructure and funnel toward the right. The ship's name, "BERN," is clearly visible on the bow. Several masts, rigging, and deck structures are visible, and a small flag flies from a mast at the bow.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a river valley with vineyards on the surrounding hillsides. A prominent hilltop fortress or castle sits on the left, overlooking clustered houses with steep roofs below. Farmland and a winding river extend into the distance. The upper right corner bears the printed caption "Freyburg a. U." in a decorative typeface, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate historic theatre building seen from a landscaped park with trimmed hedges, flower beds and a large tropical-looking plant in the foreground. The building has a grand arched central façade with tall windows, rich stucco ornamentation and two high corner towers topped with sculptural groups of figures and chariots. Trees and a street with mid‑20th‑century cars or streetlights are visible to the right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a war memorial statue in a town square. The monument consists of a tall pedestal surrounded by an ornate metal fence, topped by a soldier holding a rifle and a large flag. Around the square are traditional European townhouses and shops with German signage. Red printed text at the top reads "Penig." on the left and "Kriegerdenkmal." on the right; small red printer's text appears at the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a heavily snow‑covered coniferous forest on a hillside. A wooden cabin or lodge stands on the right among tall trees laden with snow. Ski tracks and a skier are visible on the slope, with fencing and possibly ski equipment near the cabin. In the distance lies a broad valley with forests and open fields under an overcast sky. In the lower right corner there is small printed caption text typical of vintage postcards.

The image shows the address side of an old postal card with multilingual headings for 'Postcard' (German, French, Italian, English, Hungarian, Slavic languages, etc.) and the phrase 'Union postale universelle Weltpostverein Unione postale universale'. It bears two postage stamps on the left side (one green, one orange) with Cyrillic inscriptions and circular black cancellation marks. There are additional round postmarks in black ink on the right side, with a visible date that appears to be 1904 or 1906 and Cyrillic place names. The center is filled with handwritten address text in cursive Cyrillic script.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone landscaped structure in a wooded park. The central feature is a semicircular masonry wall built from irregular stones, with two nested pointed arches forming a niche that appears to frame a spring or small fountain. In front is a circular or oval flowerbed edged with rocks, and tall trees fill the background. In the lower right corner, printed text identifies the location as Geithain i. Sa. Hellquelle.

A sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. In the foreground are open meadows and a small shed; behind them lies a dense cluster of houses with gabled roofs. Dominating the skyline to the right is a large church with a tall, slender spire. The style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text reads "Neustadt i. Sa."

Colorized vintage postcard showing a wide tree‑lined walkway in a park. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll or sit on benches. A bust on a pedestal is visible on the left, and tall trees frame the path under a blue sky with clouds. At the top of the card is printed text reading "Belgrad. Kalemegdan."

A monochrome postcard view of a medieval castle courtyard with a large round stone tower with crenellations, surrounded by old buildings with steep tiled roofs and bare trees. A path leads through the courtyard toward an arched gateway. At the bottom of the image is handwritten-style text in German indicating the location.

A black-and-white postcard view of a large institutional building, likely early 20th‑century, with multiple rows of tall rectangular and arched windows. The main façade is plain and functional, surrounded by trees and a simple lawn and pathway. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story buildings and trees. In the foreground on the right is a shop with a large sign reading "Gustav Raatz, Glaserei." A few adults and children stand on the sidewalk. Farther down the street stand more shops and residential buildings; one corner building has an onion‑shaped dome. In the distance a tall church spire dominates the skyline. At the top of the image appears the caption "Senftenberg-L. — Bahnhofstraße." The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century European town scene.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the ocean liner R.M.S. Olympic at sea, viewed in full profile with four large smokestacks and smaller vessels nearby. The ship is decorated with string flags running from bow to stern. The lower border of the card contains printed text identifying the ship and a small serial number.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene of a European town. A wide cobblestone street is flanked by two‑ and three‑storey buildings with shops on the ground floor and apartments above. Hanging shop signs and long horizontal fascia boards show German text. People in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the pavement; a man stands by a doorway on the left, and several women and men are visible on the right. In the distance rises a tall church spire with ornate decoration and a cross on top. A wooden utility pole with a decorative streetlamp stands near the center of the image.

Black-and-white photograph of an outdoor tennis court with stepped concrete stands on two sides. A men's tennis match is in progress while a seated umpire watches from a tall metal chair. Spectators, many in light summer clothing or swimsuits, sit along the terraces. Behind the stands is a dense forest of coniferous trees. Two flagpoles rise above the trees at the left, each flying a dark flag. The scene has a mid‑20th‑century feel and appears to be a leisure or resort sports facility.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a large domed Ottoman mosque complex with multiple minarets overlooking a waterfront city. In the foreground is a building with a rooftop advertisement sign for perfumes. French text at the top labels the view as Constantinople and the Süleymaniye Mosque.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a photograph on the left of a small church with a bell tower and arched doorway, surrounded by trees. On the right is printed Spanish text describing the church, titled "IGLESIA DE SANTA SUSANA (SANTIAGO DE COMPOSTELA)." At the bottom left of the image area appears the credit "Biblioteca de Galicia." The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Colorized panoramic view over a spa town set in a valley with wooded hills around it. Large multi‑story spa hotels and residential buildings cluster along the slopes, with a long colonnaded building in the foreground labeled as the Mühlbrunnen. The caption in German identifies the scene as a panoramic view of Karlsbad, Westend, and the Mühlbrunnen. The card is printed in an old-fashioned style with red serif text and a blank lower area for writing.

A caricature-style illustrated postcard showing the profile of an elderly man with a wrinkled face, large nose, and white hair, wearing a tall black top hat with light vertical stripes. The background is a flat green. The drawing is signed at the lower right. At the top left is a printed heading in Portuguese, and at the bottom are a caption with the man's name and the publisher's information.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a wooden villa or pavilion in a forested lakeside setting. The building stands on a small rise with broad stairs and decorative railings leading up to a covered veranda. Tall pine trees surround the structure, and rocky ground is visible in the foreground. There is printed text in Finnish on the image and margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an interior view of richly decorated Islamic‑style horseshoe arches and columns in the Chapel of Villaviciosa within the historic mosque–cathedral of Córdoba. The photo emphasizes alternating light-and-dark voussoirs and intricate stonework. Spanish caption text is printed along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white view of a vast Neo‑Gothic hall with high ribbed vaults, richly decorated ribs and arches, and a largely empty polished floor. Around the perimeter stand large statues of armored figures on pedestals, Gothic arches with tracery, mural paintings on the walls, and rows of wooden chairs. The composition looks like a grand ceremonial hall in a historic European city hall or castle.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a dramatic jagged mountain range with rocky peaks rising above dense conifer forests and an alpine valley. In the foreground lies a small town or resort with scattered buildings and open meadows. Handwritten-style white text is printed along the bottom edge of the image, with a small number in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a festive parade or demonstration passing through a town center. People wear traditional folk costumes and suits, one man carries a large banner with an illustration of women harvesting grain, and another person carries a large tricolor flag. Crowds line the street and look from balconies of multi‑story buildings with many shop signs in Cyrillic script. The general atmosphere suggests a civic or labor celebration.

Black‑and‑white view over a dense row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses along a narrow street or promenade at the foot of a wooded hillside. The architecture is ornate, with gabled roofs, dormer windows and decorative facades. Ground floors contain shops and cafés with striped awnings and outdoor seating. One prominent building in the foreground bears the sign "HÔTEL HANNOVER." Other painted signs advertise a pharmacy and chemical or laboratory establishments. Pedestrians are visible below near a small monument or statue.

A black‑and‑white landscape image showing rows of an orange (citrus) orchard in the foreground with many ripe fruits on the trees. Beyond the orchard rises a dramatic, rugged mountain range with steep, textured slopes. The composition emphasizes the contrast between cultivated groves and high mountains. A thin white border frames the image, and faint reversed text appears along the top edge, as on printed photographic postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined avenue with a central fountain or rock garden in the foreground. Several people, including children and an adult, stand near the low stone border around the fountain. Behind the trees are colonial-style buildings with rectangular windows. The caption at the top reads "Mossamedes" on the left and "Um trecho da Avenida" on the right.

A scrapbook page containing two black‑and‑white postcards with handwritten notes in German and other scripts. The upper postcard shows a panoramic view over a lakeside town with several buildings and forested hills in the background. The lower postcard shows a riverside landscape with bridges and a stone monument or memorial column topped by an eagle. Surrounding the postcards on the album page are handwritten German captions mentioning concert tours in Finland and dates in 1902.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside promenade lined with trees and an ornate iron railing. A grand historic building stands ahead on the left, while hills with scattered buildings and a fortress-like complex rise in the background. At the top in red print are the words identifying the location in multiple languages.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a small railway station named Billingsfors. The main wooden station building has a steep tiled roof, dormer with the sign "BILLINGSFORS", flower boxes under the windows, and people sitting on a bench on the platform. Railway tracks run across the foreground. To the right is a smaller trackside building and some houses among tall trees. The corners of the image have white frame marks, and printed caption text appears at the bottom.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a building complex and surrounding walls in an open square, with low hills in the background. The lower part of the card contains handwritten cursive text. Printed caption at the bottom left reads "Souvenir de Stara-Zagora."

Monochrome postcard view of a forested, hilly landscape with scattered alpine-style houses and villas on a slope. Dense coniferous trees fill the foreground, while a small settlement lies beyond them. Printed German text at the top right identifies the location and elevation.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with historic buildings along the bank, a bridge crossing the river, and a paddle steamer moored near the bridge. On the hill above the town stands a large castle complex and a Gothic cathedral with multiple tall spires. The river dominates the foreground with reflections of the structures. Decorative script text is printed in German along the bottom margin.

Illustrated postcard showing a smiling woman in rustic clothing and a blue headscarf, standing behind a simple wooden table laden with rectangular cakes or bread loaves. She holds one tray in both hands. Beside the table is a metal container filled with decorative twigs or dried grain. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style greeting text and a small printed code "N:o 62/6". The illustration is signed with the initials "V.H".

Vintage printed postcard-style illustration showing a dramatic rocky cliff formation rising above a river, with forested hills in the background. In the foreground are small rowboats with people on the water and on the riverbank, and a promenade with ladies and gentlemen in 19th‑century clothing near a riverside pavilion or building. The main caption in red type reads "Hans Heiling bei Karlsbad und Eibogen." The publisher credit in smaller text at the bottom reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

Black-and-white postcard showing a tall pine tree towering over a traditional wooden log cabin in a forest setting. The cabin has small-paned windows and a shingled roof. Printed caption text appears at the bottom identifying the building and place. Additional small-print credit text is present in the lower-right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street flanked by multi‑story masonry buildings with shutters and balconies. A few pedestrians stand along the right sidewalk. At the far end of the street a lighter building closes the perspective, with hills or mountains faintly visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom border.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a church with a simple façade, round windows, and a small bell tower with a spire. People in 19th‑century dress and a person on a donkey stand in the square in front of the church. Below the image is an Italian caption identifying the scene as an 1842 watercolor by Jakob Alt of a church in Trento.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet street corner in a European town. In the foreground on the left is a three‑story brick building with a steep slate roof and a decorative gable; a striped fabric awning shades a ground‑floor window or shop entrance opening directly to the sidewalk. The street curves around the corner, bordered by a simple curb and a few pruned trees. Across the street are several detached houses with pitched roofs and fenced gardens, set against a backdrop of trees on a low hill. There are no visible cars; a single tall streetlamp stands at the intersection. The lower edge has a large blank margin typical of printed postcards. No legible signage or other text appears in the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rocky cliff face with a walking path curving around it, bordered by low hedges and a wooden rail, with trees in the background. A seated person in old-fashioned clothing appears at the left by the rocks. The lower caption reads "Graz. Schlossberg-Felspartie." and the left margin credits a publisher.

A colorized view of a large Baroque hunting lodge or castle with four round corner towers topped by red domes and a central spire, standing on an island and reflected in a calm lake in the foreground. Trees line the shore and the sky is softly tinted. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "JAGSCHLOSS MORITZBURG."

A monochrome sketch-style postcard depicting a flat riverside or polder landscape with farmhouses and a prominent village church with a tall spire on the right. Trees without leaves and low dikes or banks suggest a winter or early spring scene. Beneath the drawing is printed text identifying the location as Neder-Asselt and crediting the artwork to J. H. van Mastenbroek.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone memorial set in a wooded park. The monument is built from rough rocks with a central smooth plaque and a round portrait medallion at the top, all behind an ornate metal fence with spear‑shaped and cross‑topped bars. Dense trees and shrubs surround the structure. The main plaque carries a long German inscription and the year 1888 at the bottom.

Illustrated postcard featuring a large red wine glass in the foreground with an ornate stem. Inside the bowl of the glass is a circular vignette showing two people in traditional dress drinking wine, framed by grape vines and a ribbon. Behind the glass are large dark grape clusters and green leaves. On the right side is printed red German text sending greetings from Styria and mentioning the Landhaus in Graz, with additional handwritten notes across the bottom.

A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a tall clock tower with a steep, tiled roof and large clock faces with Roman numerals. Small figures in early 20th‑century clothing stand at the base. Trees and a partial cityscape are visible around the tower. Printed text at the top reads the location and the name of the tower, with faint handwritten script along the sides.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large early‑20th‑century building complex in a European city. The architecture features steep tiled mansard and gabled roofs with dormer windows, stucco façades with decorative details, balconies, and an arched entrance gate leading into a landscaped courtyard. To the right stands an older church‑like structure with thick stone walls and a bulbous onion‑domed tower. A few people walk on the wide street in the foreground; leafless trees suggest late autumn or winter. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Sepia-toned landscape view of a forested valley with hills in the background. In the middle ground stands an industrial complex or factory with a tall smokestack surrounded by several multi‑story buildings and pine trees. The scene is framed by tall conifer trees in the foreground. At the bottom margin of the image, the place name 'SCHMIEDEBERG' is printed.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural ferry terminal. In the foreground is a dirt road leading down to a small pier where a car and a few people wait for a car ferry approaching from the water. On the right stands a small kiosk-style building with a sign above the entrance and bicycles and motorcycles nearby. Across the water a scattered settlement and low hills are visible. Text printed at the bottom left identifies the location, and a publisher's logo appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned landscape view showing gently rolling terrain with fields and vineyards in the middle ground, surrounded by dense trees. On the far right stands a large multi‑storey building with a central tower or spire, possibly a manor house or small palace, with a flag flying on top. The horizon and what appears to be open water or distant flat land can be seen beyond the tree line. The photo has scalloped edges and some age-related stains, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed or handwritten text is present on the image side.

Color image of a tranquil lake framed in the foreground by long, drooping willow branches whose reflections ripple on the water. In the distance, on the opposite shore, stands an old villa‑ or castle‑like building surrounded by trees, with dark, forested mountains rising behind it under a clear sky. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view along a riverside or lakeside road leading toward an ornate building with multiple towers and domes. The structure has a tall central tower, smaller cupolas, and step‑gabled façades, combining eclectic and Northern European architectural elements. In the foreground are simple wooden benches and railings beside the water. The image has the look of an old photographic postcard.

An illustrated postcard in an Art Nouveau/Secessionist style showing a white church-like building with a large golden dome and small side towers, set on a gentle green hill with low red and dark hills in the background. The picture is framed by an ornamental black-and-white geometric border. At the bottom, a caption in German appears to identify the building.

Black-and-white postcard view of a manor-like castle building with a tall, narrow tower and steep tiled roof, surrounded by trees and a fenced garden. In the foreground is a dirt road with a horse and carriage and a driver, and a smaller outbuilding with a large arched door on the right. Printed German text at the top left identifies the place as Schloss Zottewitz near Priestewitz.

A vintage postcard showing a color photograph or illustration of cave formations, with long white and bluish stalactites or flowstones hanging down against a darker rock background. Below the image is a printed French caption describing the scene, with additional small text along the bottom margin.

Black-and-white postcard showing a rural farming scene with a few wooden farm buildings and a house standing in open fields of wildflowers, with low hills in the distance. The image is framed by a white border. At the bottom, there is printed Finnish text describing an agricultural exhibition and a model house.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a low-rise city with gridded streets and many detached houses surrounded by trees. In the foreground, within a wooded park, stand several large, multi‑storey stone institutional buildings arranged around open lawns; some appear partially ruined or roofless. Beyond the city is a broad flat plain leading to a large body of water (possibly a lake or bay) with mountains visible on the far horizon. A thin white border frames the image, and at the lower right there is a faint, handwritten caption that appears mirrored and partly illegible.

A color postcard view of a medieval stone tower rising above a high defensive wall with arches. A small red flag flies on top of the cylindrical tower. In front of the wall is a park-like path with grass, trees, and many pedestrians walking. To the right of the tower stands a light-colored building with a red/orange roof, likely part of a larger historic complex. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds and there is no visible printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a hilly landscape. The foreground shows solid masonry townhouses and a large brick institutional building, with streets radiating from a central junction where a horse‑drawn cart is visible. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "Eibenstock Rundblick 7".

Sepia-toned postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers with rifles and sabers moving down a wooded hillside in formation. The scene appears to be a military exercise. Printed red text at the top left identifies the unit and location, and red text at the bottom lists the publisher, place, year, and the German caption of the scene.

Color postcard view of a leafy urban park with wide gravel paths converging around a circular flowerbed and ornamental fountain. Large mature trees frame the scene and there are benches in the background. At the upper right in red text it reads "Graz. Im Stadtpark."

Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views and heavy handwritten text in Bulgarian. The upper images show a park scene with a fountain and a church spire in the background, and a long brick institutional building. The lower image depicts a large two‑story neoclassical building with columns, likely a public or charitable institution, with people gathered in front. The front side is filled with cursive writing surrounding the images and a round red postal cancellation mark.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a country road lined with low stone markers curving through a wooded landscape toward a white church with a tall, pointed steeple partially hidden by trees. The caption "Vangs Kirke" appears in the upper left corner, in a simple printed font, reinforcing the postcard-style layout.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small lakeside settlement. In the foreground stands a rectangular stone church with a steep metal roof and a square tower topped with an onion‑shaped dome and small spire. Tree‑lined paths and roads surround the church and a few adjacent buildings. On the right side of the image is a larger, plain multi‑storey building, likely a school or civic structure. Behind them lies a calm lake with reeds along the shore and forest and farmland beyond.

Colorized landscape view framed by dark tree branches in the foreground, looking across a river or lake toward open meadows and a wooded hill. On top of the hill stands a large baroque-style building with a red roof and small towers, identified in red German text at the top center of the image as Schloss Lichtenwalde in the Zschopau valley.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal ceremony around a large war memorial statue of a standing soldier in uniform on a high pedestal. The scene is outdoors in a landscaped park with tall trees and trimmed hedges. Crowds and uniformed or costumed men are gathered around the monument, suggesting an unveiling or commemoration event. The stone pedestal has faint inscription panels; at the very bottom edge of the card, some handwritten or printed text appears in reverse, likely the caption or location.

Black-and-white scenic view of a small European spa town set in a hilly, forested landscape. In the middle distance stands a tall church with a slender spire rising above clustered town buildings, surrounded by trees and fields. The foreground is framed by dark tree branches and meadow. At the bottom left, white printed text reads "Bad Elster." The photo has a white border with a slightly deckled edge, typical of vintage postcards.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a long, two‑storey barracks building with arched doorways and shuttered windows. Several soldiers and civilians walk or stand along the street in front. French text at the top identifies it as the Bouvet Barracks in Salonique (Thessaloniki) during the 1914–1917 Oriental Campaign. A modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large industrial complex in a semi-rural setting. In the foreground is an unpaved road and a field of crops or grass. The main structure is a multi‑story factory building with many tall rectangular windows, attached on the left to a more ornate, villa‑like administrative building with a steep, complex roof, dormers, and a tower-like corner with curved lines suggestive of Art Nouveau or early 20th‑century Central European architecture. To the right stand three tall smokestacks, two plain and one with a decorative band near the top, emitting smoke. Additional brick factory buildings are visible behind them. There are no people or vehicles in view, and the setting appears to be on the outskirts of a town with low hills or trees in the far background.

A colorized vintage view of a small town in a mountain valley. Steep rocky Andean mountains dominate the background, with terraces visible on the slopes. In the foreground lies a dense cluster of low, light‑colored buildings and narrow streets surrounded by fields and greenery. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Ollantaitambo (Perú)."

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a posed group of people in traditional dress in front of thatched buildings. A row of young women stand in the back wearing patterned wrap skirts, beaded tops, and headscarves. In the foreground sits a masked figure dressed in raffia, and another seated person in patterned robes appears next to a wooden xylophone-like instrument. A young girl stands to the right wrapped in cloth. The right margin contains printed caption text and publisher information.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large cargo or merchant ship moored alongside a concrete quay. The vessel dominates the foreground, with its bow to the right and superstructure and cargo masts visible amidships. Mooring lines run to bollards on the quay, where a few utility boxes and poles stand. Another ship is docked behind it on the left. A city shoreline with low buildings is faintly visible in the distant background. The image has light scratches and wear, consistent with an old printed postcard or photographic card.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a circular monument with tall neoclassical columns forming an open rotunda on a stone base. A few people stand near the entrance level. Mountains are visible in the background and landscaped grounds in the foreground. Italian caption text appears in the bottom margin.

A monochrome historical postcard showing a large, multi‑storey building with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows and bay windows, set in a landscaped garden with young trees and shrubs. The architecture is early 20th‑century Central European, resembling a villa or institutional residence. At the top of the front side, printed text reads "Aliceheim in Mainz."

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a small motor cargo ship named "JENJO" sailing close to a pier with a lighthouse at its end. The sea is calm with light waves, and a few crew members are visible on deck. The ship has a central mast with rigging and some bunting or signal flags hanging along the side. In the background to the right is a white lighthouse tower standing on a wooden or piled jetty extending into the water.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of an early industrial settlement with dirt roads leading through a cluster of wooden buildings and industrial structures, surrounded by low hills or mountains in the background. On the left stands a more solid masonry building on a small rise; on the right and center are several multi‑storey wooden houses and work buildings.
