A simple wooden entrance gate spans the road, and a few people and horses are faintly visible. In the top right corner is printed text reading "Fra Foldals Værk." Black‑and‑white riverside scene with a calm body of water in the foreground, reeds along the bank, and a small passenger ferry or barge on the river. Vintage sepia postcard with a framed photograph of a cobblestoned main street lined with low wooden and brick buildings, receding toward a distant church steeple in the center background. Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone square or broad street lined with tall leafy trees. Greek and French/English text identifying the place are printed beneath the image, and there is a publisher's mark and a website watermark on the card.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large fortified hilltop complex with massive walls and several tall, slender minarets and a prominent central domed mosque, overlooking a sprawling city and open ground with scattered buildings and trees. The scene is labeled in cursive at the bottom left, and there is a printed website watermark near the lower right corner along with a small number in the lower right margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large three‑story neoclassical building seen from the front, framed by tall leafless trees along a wide path leading to the main entrance. Several people stand on the steps and in the driveway. The facade features evenly spaced arched windows and an inscription along the upper central part of the building. Handwritten markings appear at the lower right corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide boulevard with cars and pedestrians leading to a tall column monument in the center of a square, surrounded by trees and multi‑story buildings. At the bottom in decorative script is the word "Riga", and there is a small printer/publisher mark with numbers and text in the lower right corner.

A colored historical illustration of a bustling harborfront in a colonial-era city. Tall‑masted sailing ships and small boats crowd the water, while people in traditional East Asian clothing with conical hats move along the quay. The waterfront is lined with large European‑style neoclassical buildings and a prominent clock‑tower-like structure on the right. A red flag flies from a tall mast in the foreground. Behind the waterfront, the city climbs up a hillside with more colonial buildings and a church on the ridge, and there is a fortified-looking structure on a hill to the left.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a river bend with steep rocky banks and rural buildings in the background. In the foreground a crowded paddle steamer with a tall smokestack moves along the river, leaving a wake. Trees and low fields line the banks. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Seußlitz‑Diesbar – Der große Elbebogen," referring to a large bend in the River Elbe between Seußlitz and Diesbar.

Black-and-white postcard view of a harbor at dusk or dawn, with a tall stone lighthouse standing on a breakwater in the center background. Sailboats or fishing boats are moored on the right side. The sea is calm and reflects the light from the cloudy sky. At the bottom margin there are captions in Greek and French and a website watermark.

A colorized night-time view of a grand historic city square with a large ornate neo-baroque/ringstrasse-style building dominating the scene. The building has a central dome, flanked by two smaller domes and several tall spires, with many lit windows. In front stands a statue on a pedestal and steps leading up from the square. Gas or early electric street lamps illuminate the square, where people in early-20th‑century European clothing stand and walk, and a tram can be seen further down the street. The sky is dark with a bright moon and dramatic clouds. The card edges show wear, typical of an old printed postcard. No legible text is visible on the front.

Colorized postcard view of a large multi‑storey sanatorium or convalescent home set on a hill in the countryside, surrounded by fields, forest, and a few trees in the foreground. The building has a long façade with gables, balconies, and red roofs. Printed German text appears at the top against a blue sky.

Black‑and‑white image of a mid‑20th‑century cargo or supply ship sailing along a calm canal or river. The ship is painted light in color with several masts, cranes, and deck equipment visible. On the bow the vessel's name "RÖNNÖSKÄR" is written, and on the superstructure there is a large funnel or housing marked with an "S". In the background stands a tree‑lined shore with scattered houses and farm buildings, suggesting a rural European riverside scene.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a rural landscape with open crop fields in the foreground, a small settlement with farm buildings and houses clustered around a tall factory‑like chimney at the center, and a forested shoreline with a lake in the background. The architecture consists mainly of wooden farmhouses and barns with steep roofs, typical of northern European countryside. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an outdoor barbershop scene. Several men sit on simple wooden chairs under a large tree while barbers shave or cut their hair, with towels draped around the customers' shoulders. In the background are low buildings and a fence, giving the impression of a street or market area. On the right margin there is printed red text in French, and at the bottom appears a website watermark added later.

Vintage colored postcard showing a seaside street scene with a large two–storey stone building with balconies, another smaller building with a sign in Greek, and a waterside café with tables under a red roof. Mountains and the sea are visible in the background. Greek and Latin-letter text identifying the place appears at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned historical photograph showing a group of well‑dressed men and women, likely early 20th‑century tourists, posing among tall, cylindrical stone pillars and rocks in a barren landscape. The rock formations are natural or eroded monoliths rather than built structures. The people wear suits, long dresses, and large hats, indicating an era around the turn of the 20th century. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate neoclassical/renaissance‑style building with arcades, towers, and terraces on a stepped hill, lined with trees and flagpoles in the foreground. Small figures and an early automobile are visible on the street. The caption at the bottom reads "EXPOSICION INTERNACIONAL DE BARCELONA 1929" with the number 35 at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone church ruin surrounded by trees and grass. The remaining walls and gabled end are partly collapsed, with an arched doorway still visible. Printed Swedish captions appear along the bottom edge, including the name of the ruin and the publisher.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a full-length side profile of an Indigenous person in elaborate traditional attire, including a patterned jacket, wrapped skirt or loincloth with beadwork, leg ornaments, and a long blade or sword at the hip. The subject stands barefoot against a plain backdrop. Text at the bottom identifies the person as coming from Davao. The overall style suggests an ethnographic or colonial-era postcard.

Colorized illustration of several traditional sailboats with large triangular sails (likely feluccas) on a wide river at sunset or sunrise. Low riverbanks with greenery and distant buildings appear on the right horizon. The style is typical of early 20th‑century tourist postcards. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a Nile boat in Cairo and includes a small serial number and publisher mark.

Illustrated Art Nouveau–style postcard showing the back of a red‑haired girl or woman bathing in pale yellow water, with orange reflections and dark patches suggesting shadows or rocks. She has a flower in her hair and is turned in profile. In the lower left of the main image there is a small white swan and a dragonfly. The illustration is framed on a pink background. At the bottom left is a circular emblem or logo, and near the bottom center is a printed website address.

Colorized landscape view over a hilly town with many villas and houses with red roofs surrounded by green trees and vineyards. On the hill to the left stands a light-colored building complex labeled 'Friedensburg.' In the middle distance and on the ridgeline are scattered buildings and a small tower-like structure. The title text at the top center names the locale as 'Niederlößnitz–Kötzschenbroda.' The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century German picture postcard.

Sepia-toned image showing the ruins of a medieval stone castle on a wooded hill. A tall, narrow round tower with small circular openings stands beside sections of curtain wall, and in the background a larger round keep with crenellations rises above the trees. At the top of the card, printed text in German identifies the scene.

A black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard-style panoramic view of a town with dense trees in the foreground and a hillside of prominent buildings in the background. Key structures are labeled in red German text: a large multi‑storey school building, two churches (one with a tall spire), and surrounding townhouses. The layout, typography, and architecture suggest an early 20th‑century European postcard.

Childlike colorful drawing of a riverside city with a large arched bridge in the foreground, cars and a cyclist crossing it, and a wide river with boats and waves. Houses appear on the left bank, people are shown enjoying the water and sun on the right, and a large boat painted in red, white, and blue sails on the river. The Dutch flag colors appear several times. The sky is bright blue with clouds, birds, and a red sun. Handwritten words label the scene and identify the bridge and river.

An old monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone square with a horse‑drawn tram in the foreground and a large academic building with a domed entrance in the background. Trees line the front of the building. Printed captions identify the location and the institution.

A black‑and‑white panoramic postcard view of the city center of Graz, showing ornate baroque and historicist buildings along a main street, with several church towers and clocktowers. In the background on a steep hill stands the prominent clock tower of the Schlossberg overlooking the city. The caption at the top identifies the scene as Graz and names the street and hill. At the bottom left is the photographer's or publisher's credit with the year 1920.

Vintage sepia-toned street view labeled "Grossenhain. Berliner Strasse." showing a corner building with the shop name "Karl Dietrich" on the facade, other storefronts along the street, several children and adults standing in the open square, mature trees framing the scene, and a church tower rising in the background. Printer information appears at the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over fields toward a small town with many houses and a distinct church steeple in the center. The town lies on a gently sloping hillside with scattered trees. At the bottom margin, there is a printed German caption.

Illustrated postcard showing an orientalist view of Egypt. The main scene depicts a group of people in Middle Eastern dress gathered near tents, with a man on a camel in the foreground overlooking a sprawling city of domes and minarets. At the top is the printed caption 'TOMBEAUX DES MAMELOUKS' indicating the Mamluk tombs. On the left inset is a vignette labeled 'Sphinx' showing the Great Sphinx and a pyramid with small figures and camels in the desert. Handwritten cursive text in Italian covers part of the lower right area.

Black-and-white postcard showing a lakeside forest landscape with rolling wooded hills and water in the distance. In the foreground, partly hidden among trees, is a pavilion-style building with large windows and a grass-covered roof. The image has white borders and printed caption text at the bottom left, along with a serial number at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view across a calm lake toward a small white church with a tower on a wooded hill. In the foreground are trees, bushes, and a small boat at the shoreline. A small white lakeside structure stands near the opposite bank. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, along with a small oval photographer/printer mark.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park with a winding path, small conifer trees, and a rustic wooden pavilion or gazebo with a thatched roof in the right foreground. In the distance stands a monument or obelisk. The top left corner bears red printed text reading the location name.

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a cobblestone road lined with two‑story buildings and trees. People walk along the sidewalk and a horse‑drawn carriage moves down the street. At the top left there is Greek and French text naming Thessaloniki/Salonique and indicating an inland customs office. A web address (www.elia.org.gr) is printed at the bottom right as an archival watermark.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the heavily damaged ruins of a stone church, with collapsed walls, a shattered tower and a broken vault. The scene looks like a war‑torn landscape under a cloudy sky. Printed captions in black text at the top identify the location and describe the building.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a grand neoclassical complex with a central building featuring a pediment and columns, flanked by two long colonnaded wings. Two tall columns each support a statue. There is printed multilingual captioning underneath the image and a large handwritten signature over part of the lower area, along with a small printed web watermark (elia.org.gr) on the right.

Tinted blue seaside view showing a sandy beach, a long pier with small boats moored alongside, and people gathered on the shore and promenade. Large trees frame the scene in the foreground. Along the bottom margin, there are captions in Bulgarian and French indicating the location as the maritime park coast in Varna.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view showing a grand wooden seaside casino building with twin domed towers, verandas, and flagpoles, set in front of a forested backdrop. Additional long wooden buildings line the beach to the right. The water fills the foreground, and printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard-style image of an outdoor café garden. The foreground shows carefully arranged flowerbeds and manicured lawns, with a path curving between circular and oval beds edged with low flowers. On the left a girl in a dress stands with a large dog and a basket; on the right another person walks along the path. Behind them is a vast seating area filled with many light-colored wooden tables and chairs set beneath tall leafy trees. In the background stands a large, elegant building with a glass pavilion or conservatory façade and classical architectural details. Signs among the trees read "Eis‑Café," indicating an ice‑cream café.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestoned town square with a Gothic‑style church centered in the background, featuring a rose window and pointed portal. To the right is a block of three‑ and two‑story townhouses with painted shop signs and awnings at street level. The facades carry German‑language commercial signage, including a restaurant and other businesses. On the left side of the square stand older multi‑story buildings; a few pedestrians walk across the open plaza toward the camera. The overall scene suggests a Central European small city around the turn of the 20th century.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant hall with high decorated ceilings, chandeliers, tall windows with drapes, parquet flooring, and classical wall paintings. Several armchairs, small round tables, and chairs are arranged in the room. White caption text at the bottom identifies the location as the Stefanien­saele in Graz and mentions the foyer with the painting 'Apollo unter den Hirten'. The publisher credit 'ERIKA‑VERLAG – GRAZ' and number '1258' also appear.

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing open agricultural fields with rows of haystacks, a few scattered farm buildings and houses, and a lake with low forested hills in the background. In the foreground is a simple wooden fence and a conifer tree. The lower margin contains Swedish text identifying the view, and a small oval logo with publisher and photographer information.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene with a tall medieval city gate tower at the left, traditional gabled houses with shops and inns in the middle, and a stone fountain with a column and statue in the foreground where several children are sitting on the basin edge. The cobbled street curves past the fountain toward the gate. Printed captions at the bottom read "FREIBURG i. Br." and "OBERLINDEN."

A monochrome postcard showing a winding road running through a forested valley with steep rock faces. Tall conifer trees cover the hillsides and a large rocky outcrop dominates the right side of the image. At the top, German text identifies the location as a place near Olbernhau in the Erzgebirge mountains.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a canal or river lined with ornate late‑19th‑century brick buildings on the left bank and a row of trees on the right bank. A couple of moored boats sit in the foreground, and a small bridge or jetty extends from the left bank. The sky is light and cloudy. Printed captions in Dutch identify the scene and photographer, and there is a handwritten year at the bottom.

Black-and-white postcard showing a forested valley with two railway bridges. In the background is a large multi‑arched stone viaduct carrying a steam train; in the middle ground is a tall metal railway bridge on trestles. At the bottom are several houses nestled among trees. Handwritten German text runs along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing fishermen in small wooden boats on calm water, using large horizontal nets mounted on poles. In the foreground a man stands and another leans over the side of the boat adjusting the net; in the background another boat is visible. Greek and Latin‑alphabet captions are printed in the lower margin, along with a website watermark.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall stone monument with an ornate crowned column and a seated female figure at its base. The monument stands in a landscaped area with low fencing, plants, and a dirt foreground. Printed red text at the top identifies the location and the monument.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European town street running along a hillside. On the right, a stone retaining wall with railings leads up to a large church-like building with a steep gabled roof and a tall, slender tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and spire. Modest houses with steep tiled roofs stand along the road further back. Wooden and stone fences line the street, and there are a few pedestrians. Utility poles with insulators suggest early electrification. Trees cover the hill in the background.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley with forested hills behind it. The foreground and middle ground show dense clusters of steep‑roofed houses and small apartment buildings, some with dormer windows and simple ornamentation typical of Central European architecture from the late 19th to early 20th century. A road winds up the hillside on the right toward several large villas or manor‑like houses standing alone on the slope. Trees and gardens are interspersed throughout the town. The lower part of the image contains a large blank white rectangle, likely where a caption or message would appear on a postcard. No printed text is visible on the photograph itself.

Black‑and‑white view looking down a broad residential street lined with ornate late‑19th‑ / early‑20th‑century townhouses. The buildings have steep tiled roofs, dormers, turrets and decorative gables typical of Central European historicist architecture. A single person walks or cycles in the middle distance; there are fences, small front gardens and overhead utility wires. The sky area is blown out, giving a high‑contrast appearance. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image itself.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard view taken from a hillside café terrace under large trees, overlooking a city with low buildings and several mosque minarets. In the foreground people sit at tables of a Turkish café, with bottles and glasses visible. The scene looks out across fortifications or ramparts toward the city and plain below. Printed captions in French and English appear along the bottom, and a website watermark appears across the lower right.

Color photograph of a city street with a mountain backdrop. On the left is a long 19th‑century style building with arched windows and balconies; on the right stands a modern, elevated glass-and-concrete office or civic building. Cars and a bus from the 1960s–1970s are visible on the street and crosswalk, with trees lining the road and mountains rising steeply behind the town under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural village landscape. The image shows patchworked fields bordered by hedges and fences, scattered farm buildings and detached houses, and a small cluster of larger buildings near the center that looks like a village core. Beyond the cultivated land there is a dense forest stretching to the horizon under a cloudy sky. No captions or printed text are visible on the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a forested valley with a few traditional rural buildings featuring steep, hipped roofs. The scene is framed by tall, thin tree trunks in the foreground, looking down toward the houses nestled among dense woods. At the bottom border, there is cursive text identifying the place.

A vintage black‑and‑white view of a wide tree‑lined boulevard with tram tracks running down the center. Low buildings with balconies and flags line the left side, pedestrians and a few riders are visible along the street, and bare trees suggest winter. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location as a boulevard in Thessaloniki (Salonique). The overall style and printing indicate an early 20th‑century postcard.

A sepia-toned photograph of a large round stone defensive tower with a conical roof, likely part of a medieval fortification. The tower has small arched windows and rough masonry walls. A tree‑lined road passes in front of it, with a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walking along the sidewalk. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate museum room with a richly decorated stucco ceiling, polished floor, and glass display cases filled with mineral or geological specimens lining the walls. A long, low glass display case runs down the center of the room toward the back wall, where a bust on a pedestal stands between two large cabinets. Another bust on a pedestal is visible on the left wall. Printed caption text runs vertically along the right margin of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white interior photograph showing an elegantly furnished bedroom in a historic hotel. The room has patterned wallpaper, a large padded bed in the foreground, an ornate wardrobe with mirrored doors, a dressing table with a mirror, and a small seating area with two upholstered chairs and a round table with a fringed cloth. Heavy curtains hang on the right. The lower margin bears handwritten-style captions indicating the hotel name, city, and that this is a bedroom.

A sepia-toned postcard view of a historic hilltop castle surrounded by dense trees, overlooking a small town with traditional European houses and sloping roofs. The castle dominates the left side of the image, while the right side shows rolling hills and scattered buildings. At the bottom right, there is printed text identifying the place as Liebstadt in Saxony and Schloss Kuckuckstein.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a shaded pathway running alongside a rocky cliff and tall trees. In the middle stands a small pavilion or shelter with people sitting beneath it, likely at a spa or spring area. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a view near the Johannisquelle in Bad Kösen on the Saale River. Publisher and date information are printed along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a brick and stone cinema building with the sign "BIOGRAFEN" above the main entrance. The structure has arched windows and a mansard-style roof with small oval dormer windows. To the left are ornate wooden townhouses lining the street, where a few pedestrians stand on an unpaved road. At the bottom of the image, printed captions read "Elverum." on the left and "Eneret: Alf Furhreims Boghandel." on the right. Handwritten notes at the top label some buildings or people.

Sepia-toned photograph showing an older, bald man in a suit and glasses seated at a wooden desk, writing in a large ledger or book. The room is lit by daylight from a window with simple curtains on the right. On the desk are an inkwell set, ruler, notebook, and stacks of papers; in the background is a cross on the wall, suggesting a modest office or study, possibly in a religious or institutional setting. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Black-and-white image of a quiet residential street lined with two large, late‑19th/early‑20th‑century bourgeois villas featuring stucco façades, gabled roofs with chimneys, and classical decorative details around the windows and entrance. The houses are fronted by mature trees, hedges, and a white picket fence with gates and a small gatehouse. A wide unpaved road with a sidewalk and streetlamps runs along the front. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two landscape photographs. The upper photo shows a long, elegant estate or manor house seen from a tree‑lined path through a park or garden. The lower photo depicts a small wooden pavilion or boathouse on stilts over a pond or lake, surrounded by trees and open grass. Between the two images, there is red printed text in Hungarian.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a Lutheran church with wooden pews, ornate pulpit on the left, chandeliers hanging from the arched ceiling, and an altar with a large crucifixion painting and decorative columns. Hymn number boards are visible on both sides. Printed caption text in Swedish appears at the bottom along with a photo credit and publisher information.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a steam-powered cargo ship named "VINDÖ" seen broadside in calm waters near a shoreline with several houses and trees. The vessel has a tall mast, a striped funnel emitting light smoke, and crew visible on deck. The setting appears to be a northern European harbor or river.

A black-and-white postcard showing a riverside church with a tall square bell tower and steep roof in the foreground, next to a path running along the river. On the opposite bank there is a row of buildings at the base of a mountain range. The caption at the bottom identifies the church and its location in Trento, Italy.

Color panoramic view over a valley city surrounded by steep green mountains. In the foreground are vineyards, orchards, scattered houses with red-tiled roofs, and a large roundabout where several highways converge. A distinctive, almost oval, tree‑covered hill with exposed rock on its sides stands near the center-right, with the dense urban area stretching behind it along a river at the foot of the mountains. The scene is photographed on a clear day with blue sky and cumulus clouds. No visible printed text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formal banquet in an elegant dining room. Long tables covered with white tablecloths, plates and flowers form a U‑shape, and many well‑dressed men and women sit closely together, facing the camera. The room has simple wall paneling, large curtains, and ceiling lamps. Handwritten text appears across the upper part of the image and a small signature or caption at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing an ornate stone well or fountain in front of a stucco building with two large windows. The well has a richly decorated wrought‑iron canopy supported by slender columns, topped by a small statue of a figure holding a flag. The light and shadows emphasize the baroque ornamentation. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal city and harbor. Dense low-rise buildings spread up a hillside, with several chimneys and masts visible, and a bay with ships anchored to the right. At the top left is the printed caption in French, "Vue de Syra." There is a faint circular postal-style mark with Greek letters in the upper right and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" across the bottom.

Black‑and‑white landscape view with birch trees in the foreground beside a river or lake, looking across to open fields and a farmhouse or rectory with outbuildings and trees on a low hill. The caption at the bottom left reads "PRÄSTGÅRDEN, ÖR" and at the bottom right credits the photographer "Foto: Konstantin Andersson, Mellerud."

A color illustration of a lively market square surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs. Numerous stalls with white umbrellas fill the square, and vendors in traditional dress sell flowers and produce. In the center stands a large monument with a statue on a high pedestal, and in the background, on a hill, there is a prominent clock tower with a pointed roof. German writing is visible on the facades of the buildings.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a town market square surrounded by multi‑storey gabled houses with shops at street level. In the foreground is an open square with a low, covered well or fountain structure. Leafless or sparsely leafed trees line the elevated sidewalk in front of the right-hand buildings. The scene is labeled in red Gothic/antiqua script at the top, and a vertical imprint appears along the left edge.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European town square with cobblestone streets and late‑Baroque / Biedermeier townhouses. In the foreground stands a tall Marian column: a statue of the Virgin Mary crowned with stars atop a high pedestal surrounded by several saints. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and gather around the monument. Shop signs in German are visible on the right‑hand buildings.

A sepia-toned view of a forested hillside with a large, turreted hilltop castle overlooking the town rooftops below. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the castle in Wernigerode in the Harz region. The layout, border, and printed caption suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Rovereto with a river, a stone bridge, and a hilltop castle complex featuring towers and a clock tower. The lower margin has printed captions identifying the town and the castle, along with a publisher credit and number.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal city with a curved shoreline, low-rise buildings along the waterfront, and mountains in the background. The sea occupies the right side of the image, while the left side shows dense urban housing and a main road running parallel to the coast. Printed text at the bottom includes a website watermark and the location name.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide path running uphill through a formal botanical garden, lined with tall conifer trees and manicured shrubs. Several people walk along the path, and a multi‑storey building stands in the background. Printed text in Romanian appears at the top of the image, identifying the location as a view from the botanical garden in Cluj.

A sepia-toned photograph mounted on a postcard card-stock showing a somewhat dilapidated multi‑storey residential building forming a corner in a small courtyard. Leafless trees stand in front, along with a wooden fence, cart, and scattered materials. The facade has classical window framing but peeling plaster. A person stands in a doorway at the right. Handwritten captions in German appear around the image, including one along the bottom margin identifying the corner and street, and another at the upper right margin. A small signature is at the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a group of soldiers in uniform standing guard at the entrance steps of a barracks building. Several soldiers with rifles and sabres pose on and beside the stairs under an ornate gas lamp, with a striped guardhouse in the foreground and long barracks blocks in the background. German text in red is printed at the upper left, and the publisher's credit is printed vertically at the left margin.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large neoclassical building with a colonnaded central entrance and ornate façade, fronted by trees and a formal square. There is printed caption text beneath the image and along the side, and handwritten cursive text in Italian across the sky area and lower margin. The printed text includes the words "Alexandrie" and "Palais de Justice".

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the main entrance of a brick military barracks building. Soldiers stand in front of a large arched gateway with a sentry box to the left. Above the arch is an inscription on the stone, and printed caption text runs along the bottom margin of the image in French and Dutch, identifying the place as the main entrance of the 4th Line Regiment in Bruges.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard with an oval-framed street scene showing a lively European city street with cobblestones, horse-drawn carts, early automobiles, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. Multi‑story historic buildings line both sides of the street, with shop signs visible, including one reading "HIRSCH ADLER." A church or tower with a spire rises in the distant background. The caption at the bottom reads in Hungarian: "Kolozsvár. Wesselényi Miklós-utca."

A vintage printed postcard showing a wide street or waterfront fronted by low neoclassical buildings and a prominent two‑storey rectangular building on the right. The scene is in sepia tones with captions in French and Greek above and below the image. The layout and typography are typical of early 20th‑century picture postcards.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a tree‑lined promenade and a railing in the foreground, with several uniformed men walking along the path. Behind the avenue of trees rises a large historic church with a tall central tower and a steep gabled roof, and to its right a robust rectangular tower that appears to be part of a castle or fortified complex. The overall scene looks like an early‑20th‑century European cityscape taken from a park or embankment.

A vintage colorized postcard showing a wide river or canal lined with traditional Dutch houses on the right and a large windmill behind them. A sailing boat with a single large sail moves along the water toward the background town. The scene is calm and rural, with low buildings and flat landscape along the banks. Printed captions in red and black appear at the bottom of the card.

Colorized historical postcard showing a ceremonial military parade on a city street. Soldiers line both sides of the road while a mounted escort accompanies a central figure on horseback, likely a king, moving through the crowd. Civilians with umbrellas watch from the sides. The background features early 20th‑century multi‑story buildings. A caption panel at the bottom is printed in Greek and French, and a modern website watermark appears on the right.

A color-printed postcard reproducing a medieval-style mural or fresco showing a royal or imperial ceremony. Colorized vintage view of a small lake surrounded by trees and parkland. People sit on benches and walk along the promenade in the foreground, while a few rowboats are on the water. A color-tinted historic postcard showing a large hilltop building with arched loggias, stone and brick walls, and steep red-tiled roofs with conical corner towers. The structure resembles a romantic lookout or small castle surrounded by dense greenery, under a lightly clouded sky. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Brüx. Landeswarte."

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a long, three-story institutional building with a tiled roof and many windows, behind a high plastered wall with trees along the inside. Black-and-white postcard view of a stone castle with round corner towers standing on a small island surrounded by calm water, seen through trees in the foreground. Handwritten-style white text at the bottom identifies the scene and the photographer.

Colorized vintage postcard showing monumental ruins with massive stone columns and rows of headless seated statues from an ancient Egyptian temple. Two figures in early 20th‑century attire stand in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom identify the site as the Ramesseum in Luxor, in both English and French, along with publisher information.

A vintage color postcard-style image of a crowded seaside resort beach. The foreground shows people swimming and playing in the sea and sunbathing on a wide sandy beach lined with umbrellas. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a detailed Gothic stone tympanum with multiple registers of sculpted biblical figures. Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a quiet town square and adjoining street lined with multi‑story buildings with gabled roofs. Sepia-toned postcard showing a military steamship decorated with signal flags sailing close to a harbor. The shoreline in the background features a dense townscape and a prominent church with domes. Vintage postcard with a monochrome photograph on the left showing the apse of a large Romanesque cathedral and an adjacent tall square tower in a city street. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a path lined with leafless trees leading towards buildings on a hill. Black-and-white photograph showing a quiet rural road bordered by trees on the left and fenced grassy yards with wooden houses on the right. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside cityscape with a broad river in the foreground, embankments on both sides, carriages or small boats along the water, and a bridge crossing the river. In the background, a hill rises steeply, crowned with fortification structures and a prominent tower. Handwritten cursive text overlays the image. Printed caption text appears at the top.

Vintage tinted photograph showing many people in rowing boats on a calm river bordered by wooded banks. The scene appears to be a local festivity or excursion, with several boats crowded with passengers and people gathered along the shore. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small-town street with stone and wooden buildings. To the left, a row of houses lines a gently curving street with a few pedestrians. In the distance, there is a church with a steeple partially obscured by trees and a stone wall. A vintage monochrome postcard featuring a large round medieval brick tower and an ornate historic building behind a tree-lined embankment. The printed captions in red read "Nijmegen" at the top right and "Kronenburger Park" at the bottom center, with a small publisher's mark and number at the lower left.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a full-length portrait of a bearded man dressed in traditional dervish attire, including a turban and long robes. A black‑and‑white vertical image showing a straight tree‑lined path leading to a tall church-like building with a central tower. Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small European town dominated by low, pitched‑roof houses and a central open square or market area. A vintage stereoscopic postcard showing a double, side‑by‑side black‑and‑white photograph taken from the Acropolis in Athens, looking over the ruins of classical columns and cityscape below. A sepia-toned street scene showing a wide cobblestone avenue with tram tracks running down the middle, lined with multi‑story shop buildings with awnings and signage. Sepia-tone postcard showing a large early-20th‑century villa or boarding house with half‑timbered upper floors, bay windows and a steep gabled roof, surrounded by trees and a garden. Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a coastal town with low white buildings along a waterfront and low hills behind. The sea fills the foreground. Black‑and‑white photograph of a lakeside recreation area. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone arched bridge crossing a calm, tree‑lined lake or canal. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a historic market square bordered by traditional half-timbered houses and a large building with a clock tower and steep roof. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a night view of a city skyline with heavy smoke and fire illuminating the sky. A minaret and low buildings are silhouetted against the glow of the blaze. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a coastal town taken from the sea, showing densely built houses climbing the hills around a harbor. The town name appears at the top in Latin letters on the left and Greek letters on the right. A website watermark is printed near the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of the spa town nestled in a narrow valley, with densely packed 19th‑century buildings in the foreground and terraced, forested hills rising behind. An old monochrome postcard view of a town square and adjoining street. On the left is a cobbled street lined with modest two‑story houses and shops. Black‑and‑white vintage view of a broad, tree‑lined avenue with tall deciduous trees forming a canopy over the road. Sepia-toned photograph of a long historic European building along a cobblestone street. Black‑and‑white view of a busy fishing harbor in a rocky coastal town. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with three inset photographs framed by ornate floral decoration. Black‑and‑white interior view of a large brick church with wooden ceiling beams, chandeliers, and long rows of pews leading up to an altar with a cross. A sepia-toned postcard showing a large Gothic brick cathedral dominating an open square. The façade has a central rose window, pointed arches, and three main doorways with ornate decoration. A sepia-toned vintage postcard with an oval frame featuring a large Gothic church with a tall central spire and pointed-arch windows, opening onto a landscaped square with paths and a monument in front. Sepia panoramic view of a seaport and customs area mounted on a cardstock border. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a town on a river, showing a modern-looking road bridge over the Elbe with pedestrians and early automobiles. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European city square lined with ornate multi‑story buildings with arcades at street level and shuttered windows above. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small harbor scene. In the foreground are sacks piled along a stone quay, with several people standing and walking nearby. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a gently rising street lined with multi‑storey buildings and trees. Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley with a river running through the center. Black-and-white image showing the ruins of a hilltop fortress with two prominent cylindrical stone towers. Black‑and‑white view of a cloister garden with dense vegetation and a central tree, stone steps leading to a doorway on the left, and a robed Franciscan friar standing on the steps. A monochrome image showing a narrow old European street beside a large brick Gothic church. In the foreground is an ornate pointed-arch side portal with tracery and a steeply pitched, curved roof. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm river or pond with reflections of trees along both banks. Colorized vintage view over a river valley town surrounded by green hills and distant snowy mountains. Black‑and‑white view over a small town taken from a terrace on a hill. In the foreground there is a gravel path, a metal bench, railing and flowering bushes. A black‑and‑white portrait postcard showing a bearded man in three‑quarter profile, facing left. He has tousled dark hair and a short, pointed beard, wearing a dark high‑collared garment or coat. Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a two‑storey wooden commercial building with steep tiled roofs and ornate, Nordic-style carved woodwork around the central entrance. Sepia-toned interior view of a richly decorated Gothic chapel with an arched ceiling, stone floor with grave slabs, central altar, side altars, crucifix, statues and religious artwork. The lower margin of the card bears a caption in German in a decorative script.

Vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small town photographed from across an open field. Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a European city street scene, likely from the early 20th century. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene. In the foreground is a calm river with a small boat moored at the bank, stone embankment, and wooden stairs and jetties leading up the slope. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large two‑storey wooden building with a steep tiled mansard roof and many rectangular windows, situated in a rural landscape of fields, scattered houses and trees. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a powerful river with rapids or falls, industrial buildings and mills along the banks, and small footbridges crossing the turbulent water. Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a cobblestone main street lined with two-story houses and shops in a small European town. Black‑and‑white view of a tall cylindrical stone tower with a conical roof rising from a fortified base on a riverbank. Black‑and‑white vertical street view showing a cobblestone road flanked by tall buildings. Colorized panoramic view over a small historic European town with many red‑tiled roofs and abundant trees in the foreground. Colorized historic postcard view of a large multi‑storey sanatorium building with red tiled roofs and many windows and balconies, set in a landscaped garden with flower beds and walking paths. Two small figures stroll in the foreground. Printed text at the top reads the spa town name and identifies the building as Dr. Köhler's Sanatorium.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a large cobblestoned town square lined with multi‑storey townhouses with arcades on the left and ornate façades on the right. Dominating the background is a large Baroque church with twin onion‑domed towers and a tall nave roof. In the right foreground stands an elaborate Baroque column or fountain with multiple statues. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll across the square and a child rides a bicycle. The image has speckling and wear consistent with an old photographic postcard. No legible caption is visible.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with multi‑story apartment buildings on the left and detached houses with gardens on the right. A few people, including children, stand or walk along the unpaved road. The image has printed captions at the bottom indicating the location and the publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large stone church with a tall, slender spire and a distinctive rose window above the main entrance. The photograph shows the northern entrance, framed by trees and a garden path leading up to the doorway. Printed white text in Swedish appears at the lower left, and a small oval printer's mark appears at the lower right.

A colorized vintage postcard view over a lush, tree‑covered coastal settlement. In the foreground are gardens and wooden houses behind a fence. To the left rises a large white Orthodox church with multiple green onion domes. In the background lies a broad body of water with small islands, boats, and industrial chimneys along the far shore. At the top right is red printed text reading "N.-Jõesuu. Hungerburg."

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small historic town seen from an open field. Wooden houses and barns line the foreground, with a larger church-like building with a steep roof and small tower rising above the town in the center. The sky is lightly clouded. In the lower right corner, handwritten-style text reads "Piteå, Gamla stad".

Colorized historic street view showing a European town square with cobblestone streets. A tall clock tower stands in the center background, flanked by multi‑story townhouses and a prominent school building labeled with German text. A horse-drawn cart moves along the street, and a few pedestrians are visible. At the top of the image the captions read "Elbogen." on the left and "K. K. Staats-Realschule." on the right.

Black-and-white aerial photograph of a stone countryside church surrounded by trees, fields, and a few farm buildings. The church has a steep roof, a distinctive dome-like tower, and arched windows and doors. The caption in Swedish at the bottom left identifies it as Frötuna Church, and a publisher's imprint and military clearance notice appear at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a powerful steam locomotive coming directly toward the viewer with headlights shining, steam and smoke billowing around it, and a set of rails turning into the pages of an open book in the foreground. Above the train is a large winged wheel, symbol of rail transport. To the side are telegraph or signal masts. On the open book are handwritten inscriptions with dates and German words related to railways. A hand holding a quill pen writes on the right-hand page. In the lower right is the artist's signature and the date 1920.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large European town square with formal gardens, walkways, and people strolling or gathering around market stalls. The square is surrounded by ornate multi‑story stone buildings in late‑19th‑century style. Handwritten cursive text in Swedish is overprinted on the lower half of the image. Printed captions include the town name and identify the square. A small imprint at the bottom credits a local bookshop in Sundsvall.

Color-tinted historic street scene showing a busy urban street with horse-drawn carts, pedestrians, and multi‑story commercial buildings. A tall, ornate building with turrets stands near the center, with a vertical sign reading "AUTOMAT". Another large building on the right has signage along the facade. The image has printed red caption text at the top left.

Color photograph of a Baroque palace-like building with elaborate stone façades, statues, and a high mansard roof. A broad double staircase leads from the central entrance down toward a reflecting pond or small lake in the foreground, where many white swans and ducks are swimming. People are visible walking along the water's edge, and there is greenery and a smaller yellow building to the left. The image fills the card; no printed caption or other visible text appears on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree-lined promenade in a town. A cobbled foreground leads into an avenue of tall trees with people walking in the distance. On the left is a woman in a long dress holding an umbrella near a small kiosk or stand set against a large tree, with a building partially visible behind. The lower part of the card has printed red German text identifying the view as a promenade in Grimma and the publisher's imprint.

A colorized vintage view of a formal garden with winding flowerbeds, small palm-like plants, lawns, paths, benches, and a central fountain. A few people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths. The top corners contain printed red text reading "Harkányfürdő" on the left and "Rózsakert" on the right.

Colorized vintage view from a park terrace with rustic wooden railing and benches, looking across a tree-filled garden towards a large baroque-style palace with a central dome. The printed red caption at the top reads in German, indicating a view of the castle in Weißenfels on the Saale River.

A colored postcard-style image showing a large medieval clock tower with wooden upper structures and a steep tiled roof, standing on a hill above a town. Two large clock faces with Roman numerals are visible on the stone tower. In the foreground are trees and a path; in the background lies a panoramic view of the town and surrounding hills under a blue sky. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Gras – Uhrturm."

Illustrated Art Nouveau style postcard depicting a fashionable woman indoors. She wears a long yellow dress and an opulent fur coat with an ermine-like lining, standing on a tiled floor beside a small round wooden side table that holds a tall slender glass vase with a single flowering stem. The background is a simple, stylized wall with a patterned panel on the left. The lower half of the card is blank for writing.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing large medieval stone ruins surrounded by trees. The structure has thick stone walls with several tall arched openings and partially collapsed upper sections. In the foreground is a small path or courtyard with steps leading up to the ruin. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place and the publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate, ivy‑covered hillside villa or small palace in eclectic neo‑Gothic/romantic style, with towers, arched loggias, decorative roof patterns, and statues (including a winged figure on a dome). In the foreground stands a simpler rectangular building with arched windows and a hipped roof, partially obscured by trees. Forested hills rise behind the main villa.

Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers standing in front of a large gated entrance to a military barracks. The gate is flanked by brick and stone walls with decorative lamps, and a striped guardhouse stands on the right with a sentry holding a rifle. At the bottom, printed in red German text, is a caption identifying the place and military unit.

Black‑and‑white image showing a tall baroque-style church tower with a clock and onion-shaped dome rising above attached buildings with steep gabled roofs. In the foreground are trees, a fence enclosing a garden or yard, and a dirt path where three people—two adults and a child—stand, one adult holding a bicycle. The overall composition and border suggest an early 20th‑century postcard view of a small European town church.

A monochrome postcard reproducing a painted portrait of a middle‑aged man with light, wavy hair and a mustache, wearing a dark suit and cravat with a white shirt. His right hand is visible at his chest. The background is dark and indistinct. At the top left, small printed text identifies the artwork and sitter; in the lower right there is a small code.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing soldiers marching in formation on an open training ground in front of several long, wooden barracks with large grid-patterned windows. The scene is bordered by tall pine trees and forest in the background. Printed text at the top identifies the location as a military exercise field.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a country guesthouse surrounded by trees and a flower meadow. The building has a simple gabled roof and several windows, with people standing in the garden and on a path in front. German text is printed in red at the upper right describing the inn and its location in the Ore Mountains.

Sepia-toned interior view of a grand hunting lodge hall. The room has two ornate fireplaces on either side, a central double door with elaborate stucco decoration and mounted antlers and a stag skull above it. Numerous deer antlers and hunting trophies are mounted high on the walls. Portrait paintings of royals or nobility hang between the fireplaces and doorway. Simple wooden chairs with heart-shaped backs line the walls, and a carved wooden table stands in the center. Printed German captions identify the place as the royal hunting lodge Moritzburg and the specific room as the stone hall, with a publisher credit along the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a mountain guesthouse with steep roofs and wooden siding, labeled as the Zackelfallbaude in the Riesengebirge. In the foreground are many empty outdoor café tables and chairs arranged on terraces overlooking a valley and forested mountains in the distance. A smaller wooden pavilion stands to the right.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large monumental building with a tall clock tower and statue on top, seen from a cobbled square or street. The façade features arcades on the ground level and rows of windows above. Trees and ornate street lamps stand in the foreground, and another richly decorated building borders the right edge. Printed captions at the top read "Dresden." on the left and "Neues Rathaus." on the right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a small municipal bridge over a rocky river in a lush tropical landscape. Dense trees and vegetation surround the bridge, with a prominent conical mountain and hills in the background. A few people appear on or near the bridge. Printed text in Portuguese runs along the top margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a river scene with a long paddle steamer named "DRESDEN" traveling past grand riverside buildings and a castellated villa labeled "Geipel-Burg". Forested hills rise behind the buildings. Printed captions at the top read "Meissen." and "Geipelburg."; additional German text is visible on the riverside building, and a red handwritten number appears in the sky area.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a circular stone war memorial with large pointed arches forming an open pavilion. It stands in a landscaped park with trees and a gravel path curving around it. Inside the pavilion there appears to be a commemorative wall or plaque with wreaths laid around the base. German text is printed at the top of the postcard identifying the place and the type of memorial.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European spa town with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings on a steep cobbled street. On the left is a building marked "PHARMACIE." In the center distance stands a circular colonnaded pavilion with a domed roof, while to the right is a tall tower with a bulbous Baroque-style spire. In the lower right corner are long, richly decorated wooden colonnades along a promenade, with people walking and horse-drawn carriages on the street. The scene is set in a narrow valley with wooded hills rising behind the town.

Black-and-white image of a large Romanesque cathedral or church seen from a courtyard behind an iron fence with pointed arches. The building features tall, plain stone walls with narrow arched windows, a series of decorative arcades, and a prominent multi‑story octagonal tower with round-arched openings. In the courtyard there is a small, canopy-like structure resembling a baptistery or shrine. No printed text is visible on the front of the card.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone winery building behind trees and a low stone wall. The structure has multiple gabled roofs, many windows, and a central tower with a chimney. Printed caption text appears below the image, with an additional red handwritten number at the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural spring scene with blossoming orchard trees. In the foreground a farmer with a hat stands beside a horse hitched to a simple plow on freshly worked soil. A wooden ladder leans against a tree, and in the background a path or road runs behind the orchard where two women in light dresses are walking. The printed caption in red German text at the upper left reads "Cossebaude. Partie in der Baumblut."

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a broad intersection with early 20th‑century cars parked in the foreground and many pedestrians. On the left are several ornate multi‑storey apartment or hotel buildings with turrets and balconies. On the right stands a large, richly decorated neoclassical theater or opera house with columns, statues and arched windows. Tram or trolley tracks run diagonally across the lower part of the image. The overall look suggests a European city center in the interwar period.

Color postcard view of a broad European city street or square lined with ornate historic buildings. On the left is a light-colored, richly decorated corner building with a rounded tower and dark dome. On the right are tall, narrow buildings with steep red roofs and Gothic-revival details, including pointed towers. The street is busy with pedestrians, a few early motor vehicles, and what appears to be a small tram or trolley. Low hills are visible in the distant background under a blue, partly cloudy sky. The overall look is mid‑20th‑century, likely in Eastern or Central Europe.

A colorized historical postcard showing a lively open‑air market in a European town square. Vendors, mostly women in long dresses and shawls, sell vegetables and other goods from carts and baskets. In the center stands a tall statue on an ornate pedestal in front of multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows and arched ground‑floor openings. A clock or bell tower with crenellations rises in the background. At the bottom of the image is an Italian caption identifying the place.

Vintage Christmas-themed illustration showing a 19th‑century Central European family in their parlor around a decorated Christmas tree with candles and ornaments. A man in uniform, likely a postman or soldier, is delivering letters or cards to the father, mother, and children. At the bottom, ornate decorative text in a Czech style script reads "Poštovní knížka" with the year "1900" on the right. Additional small print at the bottom credits the publisher A. Neubert in Jilemnice, in Bohemia.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an Indigenous person standing in front of a tipi on open grassland. The person is wrapped in a patterned blanket and wears traditional clothing and a feathered headdress. Various items hang on the outside of the tipi. The image is framed by a cream border with printed red text below and along the left side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a powerful river with rapids and waterfalls cascading through a rocky gorge. On the left is a steep, forested cliff with a narrow path along the rocks; on the right are man‑made stone structures and an industrial building near the falls, likely related to waterworks or hydroelectric power. In the distance a dam or bridge crosses the river. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a tall stone war memorial tower standing on a stepped base in a landscaped area, surrounded by trees and hills in the background. The monument is built of large rectangular stone blocks with a plaque on one side and a bowl-like element on top. At the bottom of the image, the caption in German reads "Kriegerdenkmal Ottenhöfen."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large open square used as a hay market, bordered by trees and a low fence in the foreground and multi‑storey buildings in the background. Numerous carts loaded with hay and people are visible across the square. Printed captions in German identify the scene as a hay market near a city gate. There is cursive handwriting across the bottom margin.

An old monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with low wooden and brick houses, telegraph poles, and a few pedestrians. Larger multi‑storey buildings rise toward the background on a gentle incline. The caption at the top right reads "Walk. Kuperjanowi tänaw". Black‑and‑white image of a quiet residential street lined with newly built middle‑class houses in a similar historicist/early 20th‑century style. A man walks on the left side of the road and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the street. The road is unpaved and there are no motor vehicles, giving the scene an early 1900s suburban feel.

A monochrome postcard view of a landscaped city park with a wide path bordered by trimmed hedges and large trees forming an arch overhead. Three men in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the path. In the distance, above the trees, rise towers and a smokestack of a townscape. Handwritten-style captions at the bottom read the town name and identify the park as the Stadtpark (city park).

Colorized vintage postcard showing a long multi-arched stone bridge crossing a calm river, with its arches reflected in the water. A townscape with minarets and domes appears in the background on the left, suggesting an Ottoman-era city. Trees frame the right edge of the image. At the top is printed text in Ottoman Turkish script and in French, and at the bottom right is a modern website watermark.

Old Russian Imperial-era postal card or money transfer coupon printed in Russian. It has pre‑printed text in green, handwritten address information in ink, and a circular postal stamp. There is no photograph or scenic image, only text fields and handwriting on a tan card.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate historic building with a tall, elaborate tower rising above lush trees and gardens. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded market square lined with traditional gabled houses and a prominent historic building with an ornate façade in the center. Vintage black‑and‑white view of a large formal city square with lawns, paths, and tall cypress trees. The image has an old, slightly faded print quality, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. A website watermark, 'www.elia.org.gr', is visible at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white street-view postcard showing a broad avenue lined with two‑ and three‑story historic buildings in European architectural style. Black‑and‑white image of the entrance to a corner wine and delicatessen shop housed in an ornate stone building. Two women in early 20th‑century clothing and hats stand in the doorway. The text on the signs is predominantly Swedish, and some boards list types of wines and foreign products. The overall look suggests an old commercial street scene, likely reproduced as a historic postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing an industrial mining site with wooden mining buildings, a tall headframe-like structure, a tower, and elevated conveyor or walkways. A sepia-toned street scene showing a quiet, tree-lined avenue with two- and three‑story wooden and masonry buildings, cobblestone pavement, and overhead tram or power lines. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Storgatan in Lilla Edet.

Sepia-toned vintage street view of a small town with two large wooden houses surrounded by bare trees and picket fences. Several people stand along a dirt road next to horse-drawn carts and wagons. A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a busy street scene with many people in traditional cloaks and head coverings gathered near shops. Dominating the background is a tall clock tower with arched openings and decorative elements, identified as the city's clock tower. The postcard has printed captions in French at the bottom.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Baroque church and monastery complex with twin onion-domed towers and a central dome, set on a hillside with trees and rolling hills in the background. Color photograph of a large Gothic cathedral with multiple ornate towers and pinnacles, seen from an elevated angle on a bright, clear day. A vintage black‑ink illustrated postcard showing a round medieval stone tower with a conical roof, standing among trees beside a path or road. Bare trees suggest autumn or winter, and stylized clouds curve across the sky. At the bottom edge of the drawing is a caption that identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Baroque palace with many windows and a central tower topped by an ornate cupola and a small stag figure. The tower has a clock face. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large villa or hotel complex in a hilly, wooded landscape. Black-and-white photograph of the interior of a large Gothic church or cathedral, showing a long central nave flanked by tall clustered columns and pointed ribbed vaults. Wooden pews line both sides of the central aisle, which leads toward a distant altar and a large tracery window. A colored illustration showing a Renaissance-style courtyard framed by massive stone arches in the foreground. The architecture features vaulted ceilings, pilasters, and balustrades typical of a European palace or castle. There is no visible printed caption, only a small artist's monogram and date-like mark in the lower left corner.

A vintage postcard-style image showing a nighttime or dusk panoramic view of a city in a valley surrounded by mountains. Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a city square with a prominent statue of Otto von Bismarck on a pedestal marked "BISMARCK". Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with shops on the ground floor, and in the background a tall church spire rises above the roofs. Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town with vineyards or gardens in the foreground, dense residential blocks in the middle, and prominent historic church towers and other multi‑storey buildings rising above the roofs. Hills and fields stretch across the distant background. In the lower left corner, white text is printed directly on the image, identifying the place.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town nestled among rolling hills and fields, framed by tree branches in the foreground. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing old stone fortification ruins on a hillside. A dirt path leads through an arched gate in the wall, with a solitary figure walking toward it. Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded hill with a stone lookout tower and a large villa or hotel complex on the ridge. The building has the word "Schweizerhöhe" on its facade. Decorative red script text is printed beneath the image, and small vertical text appears on the left margin, indicating the publisher and location.

A sepia-toned street view showing a broad, straight avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings. Tram tracks run along the center of the street, with overhead wires visible. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Leonhardstrasse".

Colorized view of a historic Italian-style town square dominated by a tall medieval stone clock tower with battlements and large circular clock faces on two sides. The image has a printed, slightly painted look typical of early 20th‑century postcards and shows light grid lines from the printing or artwork process. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a small harbor scene. A steam-powered passenger ship is moored at a simple wooden pier next to a rocky shoreline with a few wooden sheds or boathouses. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex overlooking a town with pitched-roof houses in the foreground. Printed German text identifies the location at the top of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall neo‑Gothic stone monument with a crenellated top, statues in niches and reliefs on its sides, surrounded by an iron fence and dense trees in a park setting. At the top in red print is a caption identifying the scene.

Black-and-white colonial-era postcard showing an elephant pulling a wooden cart under a large tree, with a person riding the elephant and another person walking beside it. In the background are thatched buildings and a palisade-like fence. The bottom margin contains printed captions in French and Dutch identifying the scene as from the Belgian Congo and describing elephants pulling a cart.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. Behind the town are patchwork fields, tree-covered hills, and a forested ridge in the distance. There is no visible border or printed caption on the front side.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square showing a large civic building with a steep hipped roof, dormers and central entrance, likely the town hall, and in front of it a tall war memorial column topped with an eagle sculpture. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with people walking and bathing along the shore. Printed captions at the top provide the place name in French and Bulgarian/Cyrillic.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large ornate classical building complex with a monumental fountain and formal gardens in the foreground. Pathways, trees, and small figures of people and carriages can be seen in the surrounding park. Printed caption text appears at the top center of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a coastal settlement with rocky terrain and grassy plots in the foreground, bordered by low stone walls. Several large wooden villas or houses with steep roofs and decorative trim stand on the rocks. In the distance are more houses and low hills under an overcast sky. Printed caption text appears at the lower left and lower right of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy seaside beach scene. Elegantly dressed men, women, and children in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll and play along the shoreline. In the background are seaside resort buildings and beach huts/strandkorbs along a sandy beach, backed by a wooded hill. A small boat lies on the sand in the foreground. The scene is labeled with red printed text in German at the bottom left and right.

A vintage monochrome (green-tinted) postcard showing a brick railway station building with a gabled central section, chimneys, tall windows, and a metal roof. Printed text below the image reads "Klippan, Jernvägsstationen." and along the left edge appears the publisher information.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval fortress on a hillside beside a wide body of water, with towers and walls stretching along the shore. A small rowboat floats in the foreground. Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene with several multi-storey buildings in a small town. Two people stand in the street in front of the gate. The architecture appears early 20th-century Central European. Printed text at the top identifies the location as Grünhainichen in the Erzgebirge and indicates that the building is the imperial post office.

Colorized panoramic view over a European city with red‑roofed buildings surrounding a steep, green hill topped by structures. A river with bridges runs through the city toward distant mountains. In the upper left corner there is printed text reading "Graz vom Rainerkogel." The image has the typical borderless, chromolithographic look of early 20th‑century postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large early‑20th‑century institutional building with steep hipped roofs, dormer windows, and a small roof tower. Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a winding path through a tree-filled park. On the right side a man in dark clothing walks along the path. A hand-colored postcard showing a grove of large, leafy trees forming the entrance to picnic grounds in Santiago Canyon near Santa Ana, California. A colored illustrated view of a European city along a river, with a metal bridge in the foreground and rows of historic buildings with red and brown roofs along the riverbank. Black-and-white vintage waterfront scene showing a broad quay lined with elegant multi‑storey buildings and rows of masted sailing ships moored along the promenade. A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small historic European town taken from a slightly elevated, ploughed field in the foreground. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a massive late-Roman/Byzantine stone structure with high arched windows and thick walls, partially in ruins, with small houses at its base. Red printed captions in French identify the site, and a greeting from Constantinople appears at the top right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone church tower with a clock and wooden upper structure, surrounded by trees. The image is printed on a light background with red caption text at the top and along the right edge.

Black-and-white postcard showing the minimalist modern interior of a church with high arched ceiling, long narrow windows on the right, a tall central stained-glass window behind the altar, rows of wooden pews, and hanging chandeliers. Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a large Baroque castle complex with two prominent round corner towers topped by domed roofs and lanterns, a central multi-storey palace wing, and an adjacent chapel with a tall spire. Black‑and‑white (with red overprint) postcard showing a street‑front view of multi‑storey town buildings housing the furniture factory and workshop of Otto Birkner Jr. The façades are brick and stucco with decorative window frames and signage. Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue beside a river or canal. Sepia-toned historic street view showing a large medieval stone wall and tower covered partly with vegetation on the left, clearly a ruin with tall arched windows. An old military postcard addressed in cursive handwriting. It is printed on a light, bark‑like background and bears postal markings and a stamp in the upper right corner. Vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a slightly curving cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses. People, including several boys in dark clothing, stand on the sidewalks. Colorized vintage postcard view of a steep hillside with switchback stone stairways climbing up the rock face, leading to a clock tower with a red roof on top of the hill. Colorized panoramic view over a densely built Mediterranean city surrounded by hills. Sepia-toned, aged photographic postcard showing a long two‑storey (with partial third storey) brick tenement building in an urban street. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Baroque hunting lodge or castle set on an island in a lake, with four round corner towers topped by domes and a central chapel-like wing with a tall spire. Vintage sepia postcard showing a studio portrait of a family in elaborate traditional folk costume. Colorized vintage view of a tranquil waterway labeled as the Mahmoudieh Canal in Alexandria. The canal runs through a flat landscape with palm trees and low vegetation along the banks. A snowy, narrow street lined with single‑story wooden buildings on both sides. The architecture is Northern/Eastern European, with simple facades, large windows, and signs above the shop doors. Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate corner building in historicist style with a prominent tower and decorative façade. Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural railway station area. On the left is a one‑story station building on an embankment beside a stone railway bridge with an underpass road. Black‑and‑white view of a European town square beside a river or canal. In the foreground are trees, a stone embankment, pedestrians, and horse‑drawn carriages. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance school building on a street corner. The multi‑storey structure has tall windows, decorative cornices, and a mansard roof.
