Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modern-looking church surrounded by pine trees. The church has a tall, rectangular bell tower with a simple cross on top and a long, sloped roof on the nave. In the bottom left corner, printed text identifies the church, and a small publisher's logo with a number is in the bottom right.

A colorized vintage view over the rooftops of a European city with a river in the middle ground and a steep, green hill crowned by fortifications and a clock/bell tower. Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, long three‑storey institutional building with a steep hipped roof and dormer windows, likely a school, barracks, or administrative facility. Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance of a police school complex. Two symmetrical multi-storey buildings with steep tiled roofs flank a central gated archway. Black‑and‑white view over the rooftops of an old European town. In the foreground are densely packed, steep‑roofed houses and some trees. Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park leading to a monumental stone entrance built into a grassy mound. Black‑and‑white image showing a vast parade ground filled with troops in formation, cavalry and horse‑drawn artillery. Spectators line the edge of the field. Colorized historical postcard showing a long, light‑colored barracks complex with red tiled roofs and a clock tower, behind a white wall and in front of railway tracks. Color-tinted historic street view showing a corner building with ornate façades and a pointed turret roof, ground-floor shops, and signs in German. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a hillside village scene with traditional multi‑story houses featuring wooden balconies, stone retaining walls, scattered trees, and mountains in the background. A monochrome vintage postcard showing a forested mountain slope with a small town nestled among dense trees. Illustrated postcard showing a woman in traditional folk costume standing in profile. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a richly decorated stone building in a hilly, wooded setting. A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three rural scenes of a small village. The top image features a church with a tall onion‑shaped tower rising above trees and farm buildings. Color postcard-style aerial view over a Scandinavian-looking coastal city at the head of a wide bay or fjord. Black-and-white winter street scene showing a large brick building with a cinema or theatre on the left bearing the sign 'GLORIA PALACE'. Sepia-toned panoramic photograph of a city in a valley, surrounded by mountains. A wide river flows in the foreground with a metal bridge on the left. A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town nestled in a wooded valley. Dense historic buildings with ornate facades fill the valley floor and climb the surrounding hillsides. A black‑and‑white panoramic aerial view of a densely built European spa town nestled in a narrow valley, with ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑story buildings along a river or canal in the foreground, tree‑lined promenades, a prominent domed or polygonal theatre‑like building with arches on the right, and terraced hillsides and forested slopes rising behind the town.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing several scenes of a town: a central image of a tall‑steepled church partly hidden by trees, surrounding images of residential or institutional buildings among forests, a bridge with cars, and a town overview. Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large three‑storey corner building with many uniform windows and a small tower or cupola on the roof. Black‑and‑white view of a European small town street, likely early 20th century. Vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting the central market square (Markt) of a small German town. Black‑and‑white/early tinted postcard showing a wooded area with a small pond or spring. Sepia-toned postcard showing a steamship at sea listing in rough waters, with smoke billowing from its funnel. Superimposed around the ship are four oval portrait photos of sailors in naval uniforms and caps. Handwritten Cyrillic captions identify each sailor beneath their portraits.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm lake scene. A lone person rows a small wooden boat on still water, with forested islands in the background. A black‑and‑white view of a two‑story villa or manor house with a steep tiled roof, twin chimneys, arched windows with brick surrounds, and an ornate central gable. A monochrome postcard showing a tall, square brick observation tower rising above surrounding trees, with a steep path leading up to the entrance. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow street lined with traditional houses leading to a tall medieval city gate tower with a clock and steep roof. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street with a small canal or ditch beside the road and a villa-like house on the left, surrounded by a manicured garden. At the lower right there is printed Dutch text identifying the location as Hees near Nijmegen and the street corner being shown.

Vintage sepia postcard with a photograph of an open park scene in Athens, showing the Statue of Byron (Lord Byron) standing on a pedestal, with trees and buildings in the background. Color postcard showing a richly decorated interior in Mudéjar style: carved stucco arches, slender columns, and walls covered with intricate geometric tilework. At the bottom there is printed red text in Spanish identifying the view, and dark handwritten ink message over part of the floor area.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large metal Roland statue in armor standing against the wall of a building on a cobblestone square. A colorized (hand-tinted) historic postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex above a town. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town seen through a row of stone columns and arches in the foreground, looking out over tiled rooftops, church towers, and mountainous terrain in the background. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a studio portrait of four young women in traditional attire, seated and standing around a wooden bench. An old monochrome postcard showing a residential street lined with ornate multi‑story townhouses featuring steep roofs, dormer windows and small towers. Colorized historic postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century school building with arched windows, columns flanking the main entrance, statues above the doorway, and a balustraded terrace facing a tree‑lined street. A monochrome vintage view over a small industrial town seen through slender birch trees in the foreground. Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a stone terrace or memorial with steps leading up to a central bronze statue of a man in military-style dress standing beside a dog. Colorized historical postcard showing a large, ivy‑covered stone aqueduct with multiple arches. On top of the aqueduct stand several small human figures. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm pond or small lake bordered by a promenade with railings and trees, and elegant villa-style buildings on the left bank. A sepia-toned postcard showing a forested landscape with tall conifer trees in the foreground, a body of water in the middle distance, and rolling wooded hills beyond. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an alpine landscape. In the foreground at left there is a wooden roadside crucifix or shrine with a figure of Christ hanging beneath the overhanging roof. Black‑and‑white postcard view of the entrance to a formal institutional complex, likely a military or government facility, with tiled‑roof buildings and trees lining a central street. Black‑and‑white view over a wooded hillside spa town with grand historic buildings. In the foreground on the right is a classical-style statue seen from behind, overlooking a curving path lined with many outdoor café tables and chairs. In the middle distance stands a large multi‑storey building with the word "RICHMOND" on its facade. Other large villas and hotels rise on the hill beyond. The word "Karlsbad" is printed on the white margin of the card.

Black-and-white historic postcard showing a cobblestoned square with several two- and three‑story classical buildings. In the center background stands a larger municipal-looking building with a flagpole or telegraph structure on the roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the open square. Printed caption text appears at the top left.

Monochrome printed postcard showing a historic European walled city with several stout cylindrical stone towers and a tall Gothic church with a very slender spire rising above the rooftops. The street in the foreground is lined with vegetation and low fencing, and the overall style resembles an etching or pen‑and‑ink drawing.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a woodcut‑style illustration of a narrow cobblestone street in an old European town. Tall plastered and brick buildings with steep, tiled gable roofs line both sides. The street curves under a large arched gate or bridge that connects buildings above the street. Light and shadow are rendered with dense hatch marks and dramatic clouds in the sky. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a small European town with a prominent large Gothic-style church featuring two tall square towers with steep spires and a long nave with pointed-arch windows. In the foreground are fields, trees, and a footpath leading towards half-timbered and stone houses. The town spreads out behind the church with additional buildings and a distant smokestack. The caption "Geithain i. Sa." appears at the bottom left.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard featuring a studio portrait of an elderly man with a full white beard, wrapped in a dark cloak or coat, looking toward the camera. Beneath the portrait, on the lower margin of the card, there is a facsimile signature reading "G. Bernard Shaw." The card has a plain background with no additional imagery or printed text.

Colorized panorama of a small European town seen from a green meadow in the foreground. Trees and hedges lead toward a cluster of traditional houses with gabled roofs and some half-timbered buildings. Dominating the skyline is a tall church with a pointed spire, and additional steeples and chimneys are visible in the distance. The sky is lightly clouded with a warm hue near the horizon. The word "Geringswalde" is printed at the top center.

An illustrated postcard in an Art Nouveau style showing a grand baroque palace with domes and elaborate façades, framed by a decorative black-and-white border. In the foreground are trimmed hedges and a pathway leading to a green door. At the bottom center, within the frame, the building is labeled "SCHLOSS BELVEDERE". Small text in the lower right notes the artist and year, and the bottom left outside the frame has a credit line for an organization.

A black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a cobblestone road lined with trees and wooden houses on the right, and a larger masonry building in the distance on the left. Telephones or power poles with overhead wires run along the street. The scene is quiet, with a few pedestrians walking. In the lower right corner the place name "LIMBAŽI" is printed.

Historic black‑and‑white postcard view of a European spa town with a narrow river or canal running through the middle, tree‑lined promenades on both banks, and multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century fashion stroll along the promenade while horse‑drawn carriages move along the street. A small pedestrian bridge crosses the water. Shop signs and awnings are visible on the right‑hand side, including a restaurant.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large waterfront mansion-like building identified as the English Embassy, standing on a shore with trees to the left and hills across a wide body of water. A boat or small ship sails on the right. The style is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century, and there is printed caption text in French at the bottom left and additional text in Arabic script at the bottom right, along with a faint website watermark.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a street corner with a large multi‑story hotel building. The façade bears painted signs reading "ALBERGO S. MARCO" and "LUIGI GREGORI." People sit at café tables under small trees, while others stand at the entrance; several horse‑drawn carriages wait along the street lined with tall shuttered buildings. At the top of the postcard, printed in red, is the title indicating the hotel's name and the city of Trento.

Colorized panoramic view of a small industrial town in a rural valley. A winding river runs through green fields and meadows, with numerous red‑brick factory buildings and tall smokestacks scattered along its banks. Around the factories are clusters of detached houses and larger villas with steep, dark roofs and light facades. In the middle distance stands a church with a tall spire. Low wooded hills and patchwork farmland surround the settlement under a lightly clouded sky. The image looks like an early 20th‑century lithographic postcard; there is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.

A monochrome image showing an ornate, baroque-style wooden portal with a chevron-patterned door set in an old plastered stone wall. Above the door is a decorated pediment with carvings and an inscription, and the number '32' is visible on one side of the portal. To the left is a multi-paned window, and in the foreground a person is sweeping the cobblestone street. At the bottom margin of the card, printed text reads 'Narwa, Portal Anno 1653,'.

Colorized historical postcard showing a long colonnaded building with arches and a raised gallery accessed by staircases. There is a classical-style statue in the foreground and people standing near the stairs. The structure is labeled as the Palais de Faïences in Stamboul (Istanbul), Constantinople. Handwritten purple ink appears at the top, and printed publisher/photographer information appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑storey historic townhouses with shops on the ground floor. On the left stands an ornate town hall with a tall clock‑tower featuring battlements and a slender spire. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll across the square; signage in German is visible on several shopfronts.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with paths, lawns, and a circular fountain with a high water jet at the center. The foreground shows neatly arranged garden beds and trees; in the background are red-roofed buildings and a larger, elegant house or small palace rising above the townscape. The sky is clear blue. At the top in red Gothic-style letters it says "Radeburg." on the left and "Promenade mit Springbrunnen." on the right.

Vintage sepia/green-tinted postcard with three photographic views: at the top a railway station building with an attached or adjacent hotel; in the middle a small ornate building labeled as a telephone station; at the bottom a long brick building identified as the public elementary school. The captions are printed in Swedish, and at the bottom the locality name 'Teckomatorp' is given.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance to a large wooden manor house behind a picket fence and two stone gateposts. Trees frame the view on both sides, and a central path leads to the house with a balcony and columns at the front. The printed caption at the top reads "Matfors Herrgården."

Sepia-toned photograph with scalloped postcard edges showing a calm river or lake in the foreground and a tree-covered hill on the opposite bank. A person is paddling a narrow boat or kayak on the water. Handwritten text appears along the bottom left, and a small monogram and date appear at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a steep funicular railway ascending a hillside into a brick tunnel portal. In the foreground, an old funicular car with two men standing at the open front platform is visible, with the tracks rising sharply behind it. Above the tunnel there is a building with timber-framed details and a balustrade. At the top left margin, the caption reads "GRAZ. SCHLOSSBERGBAHN".

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental equestrian statue on a high pedestal, surrounded by four standing figures in armor. The central rider is depicted in medieval attire on a horse, forming a dramatic silhouette against the sky. In the background there is a historic building with a pitched roof and windows, and some trees. Low flowerbeds encircle the monument, and a child can be seen near the base. The title text is printed at the top of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large Gothic cathedral dominating a landscaped park and square. The church has prominent pointed arches, stained-glass windows, and multiple towers and spires, with surrounding historic multi‑story townhouses. A central monument or statue stands in front of the cathedral within a circular flowerbed. The sky is tinted blue and pink, typical of early color postcards. Hungarian text is printed at the top.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a compact European alpine town nestled on a hillside, backed by high, barren mountains. The town is dominated by several church buildings: one large Gothic-style church with a very tall, slender spire on a hill above the town, another with a bulbous Baroque onion dome near the center, and a smaller chapel-like church with an arched entrance in the foreground. Traditional multi‑story houses with steep roofs cluster tightly along narrow streets. Fields, trees, and haystacks appear in the foreground, and forested slopes rise behind the settlement.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large early 20th‑century steamship moored alongside an industrial dock with warehouses and cranes in the background. The ship has a single funnel, multiple cargo booms, and a long dark hull. Caption text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet street scene in a small historic town. A large tree dominates the center, standing on a raised terrace with a retaining wall and stairs or ramp leading up. Behind it are steep‑roofed, multi‑story masonry buildings with small gabled dormers, characteristic of Central European architecture. To the left is a building bearing painted German signage, and a person with a cart is visible on the street. The card has printed red captions on the front: the town name at the top and publisher information and number at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an old brick chapel-like building partly in ruin, set among trees, with a large arched steel bridge in the background. A path curves around the building in the foreground. At the bottom margin there is printed text in Dutch mentioning the Waalbrug bridge, eleven centuries, and the Carolingian chapel at Valkhof.

Vintage illustrated postcard showing a scenic hillside with grass and wildflowers, tall trees, and a round belvedere tower overlooking a river landscape. A bridge is visible on the left side, and several large white birds (likely seagulls) fly across the sky. The illustration is framed with a wide blank margin where short red captions and a handwritten name appear.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed officers posing in front of a building with large open doors. The men wear early 20th‑century military dress with peaked caps and boots. Under the image there is printed bilingual text in Swedish and Finnish referring to the Finnish Guard Battalion officer corps. Across the lower part of the image, a large handwritten Finnish word is visible.

A black-and-white postcard view over the rooftops of a historic town set in a mountainous valley. Prominent church towers and an old stone church dominate the middle ground, with tiled roofs and narrow buildings in the foreground. Hills and cliffs rise in the background. At the bottom margin of the postcard there is printed caption text.

Black-and-white view along a tree‑lined promenade with benches and an ornate metal railing overlooking a large historic riverside palace in the background. A man in early 20th‑century attire, holding a cane and wearing a hat and suit, poses near a tree in the foreground. The palace has richly decorated façades, mansard roofs, and towers, and stands on a slope above a river valley.

Illustrated devotional postcard showing a Catholic church in a hilly landscape at the bottom, with cypress trees and simple surrounding buildings. Above the church, on clouds, is a crowned Madonna holding the infant Jesus, flanked by two angels holding tall candles and a smaller angel head beneath. The style is soft, pastel-colored religious art; no visible printed text appears on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The image shows a straight, quiet street with a few pedestrians and a central streetlight hanging from a wire. On the left corner building a curved balcony bears the sign "HERZ JESU APOT" for Herz Jesu Apotheke (Sacred Heart pharmacy). At street level another sign reads "APOTHEKE". In the distance a building with a baroque onion‑shaped dome is visible. Printed text at the bottom left identifies the location as "GRAZ – NAGLERGASSE" and at the bottom right the publisher is noted as "ERIKA‑VERLAG – GRAZ. 551".

A black-and-white panoramic rural landscape showing a small settlement with scattered wooden houses, fields, low rolling hills, and winding country roads. Power poles line the road, and there is a church-like building with a tower on the left. The word "Kode" is printed in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 9279 appears in the lower right.

Monochrome postcard showing a large two‑storey wooden building with ornate trim and a balcony, likely an inn or hotel, standing beside a wide open unpaved area. A horse-drawn wagon is in front of the fence. Smaller single‑storey buildings are visible to the right. Russian text is printed in the upper left corner identifying the town and the establishment.

Black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large medieval hilltop castle with massive plain walls and a single tall round tower rising near the center. The castle stands on a steep grassy slope with a straight stairway leading up the hill. Trees and foliage frame the right side and background, and the sky is partly cloudy. There is a narrow vertical strip on the right with some handwritten or printed numbers, but no visible title on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a dirt road with a wooden guardrail running downhill along a tree-covered slope, opening onto a wide rural valley with fields, scattered trees, and distant forested ridges under a cloudy sky. Handwritten-style white text is printed at the bottom of the image.

A colorized aerial view over a European city with red-roofed buildings, church towers, and a river running through the right side spanned by several bridges. The scene appears to be an old lithographic postcard print. At the top, in red German text, it reads: "Graz gegen Süden vom Schlossberg gesehen."

Colorized interior scene of a large institutional room filled with rows of young women or girls in traditional Dutch-style uniforms and white caps, each seated at wooden desks with laundry items or baskets in front of them. A woman at the front appears to be instructing or supervising. Large windows line the back wall and several hanging ceiling lamps are visible. Red printed text at the lower left identifies the location as Rotterdam and refers to a laundry room in a civic institution.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view of grand multi‑storey buildings with ornate façades along a quay. Several boats are moored in front of the buildings on calm water. At the top, printed in red, is the caption indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town with fields in the foreground, rows of houses and industrial buildings in the middle distance, and a wooded hill crowned by a large castle‑like complex and a church tower in the background. The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard. Red printed German text appears at the top identifying the place and the viewpoint.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, fortress-like institutional building with multiple wings and steep, pyramidal-roofed corner towers. The long façade, many windows, and tall central blocks sit behind a line of leafless trees and a fence. In the foreground is an open parade ground or field with scattered pedestrians; on the right stand two uniformed soldiers holding rifles, wearing dark tunics with rows of buttons, tall boots, and pickelhaube-style helmets. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street curving toward a tall round medieval tower with a conical roof. Stone walls and older buildings line the street; houses with shuttered windows appear on the right. Printed caption text runs along the bottom edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large tree in the foreground and, in the distance across open fields, a complex of multi‑storey military barracks buildings. Printed red text at the upper right identifies the location as Freiberg in Saxony and specifies a barracks of the 3rd Battalion, 12th Infantry Regiment No. 177. Additional small red vertical text at the left margin gives the publisher's information.

An old black‑and‑white panoramic postcard showing a large hilltop fortress complex above a river. Massive stone ramparts and bastions step down the slope, with several substantial classical-style buildings on top, one with a small tower or belfry. Lower defensive walls run along the waterfront. The image is printed across two halves and is worn and creased along the middle; there is no visible printed caption on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterfront cityscape. Multi‑story stone buildings line the quay, with boats moored along the harbor and a small rowboat with a single person in the foreground. The water reflects the buildings and vessels. Printed text in Swedish appears at the top identifying the scene as Sundsvall's harbor and Sjögatan.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street with cobblestones and a few pedestrians. On the right stands a prominent neoclassical building with columns and a pediment, likely a church or public hall, partly obscured by large trees. A small monument or obelisk stands in the tree‑filled square in front of it. Low wooden houses line the street to the left, and forested hills are visible in the distance. The word "Hamina." is printed in white in the lower right corner of the image.

A monochrome postcard showing a calm river or canal bordered by dense vegetation and tall papyrus-like plants, with trees and foliage reflected in the water under a soft sky. At the top right there is an Italian caption identifying the view.

A colorized panoramic waterfront view of a coastal city with low houses and a visible mosque minaret along the shoreline, backed by rolling hills. The caption at the top is in French and there is a smaller French phrase at the bottom left. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears over the water area.

Color postcard showing a rural scene with traditional wooden buildings and farm structures on a grassy field. On the left stands a tall, slender wooden church tower with a steep shingled spire and small belfry openings below the roof, typical of Eastern European wooden churches. In the foreground and middle ground are several simple timber sheds with high-pitched plank roofs sheltering farming equipment or machinery. To the right is a larger two‑story wooden house or barn with a balcony. Low, hazy hills form the background under a pale blue sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a rustic, early‑20th‑century tavern or lounge. The room has dark wood wall paneling, a fireplace with a brick surround, and patterned rugs on the floor. Wooden tables and chairs are arranged around the room. The mantel and a high shelf running along the walls are crowded with beer steins, pitchers, and decorative ceramics. Several deer heads are mounted on the walls, and a large antler mount above the fireplace supports a hanging light fixture. There is handwritten numbering or labeling along the left edge of the image, consistent with archival postcard markings.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a bustling early‑20th‑century European main street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings with shops at ground level. People in period clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a car and horse‑drawn carriage are visible on the street. At the bottom there is a caption in Cyrillic and Latin/Esperanto mentioning Zemun and a street of King Alexander.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a townscape with a prominent round medieval tower with a conical roof (Torre Verde) near a line of trees and low buildings with red-tiled roofs, backed by hills. In the foreground is an open grassy area with paths and a few people walking. The caption in red text at the top reads in Italian about Trento and the tram station.

A black‑and‑white landscape view of a European spa town nestled in a wooded valley. Grand late‑19th‑century hotel and spa buildings with domes, towers, and ornate façades rise above dense trees. The town climbs the hillside with multiple large resort complexes and villas in a forested setting; a couple of tall chimneys are visible among the roofs. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a church with wooden pews leading toward a chancel and altar. The altar has a large multi‑panel painting dominated by a crucifixion scene, flanked by flower arrangements. Elegant chandeliers hang from the ceiling, and a raised wooden pulpit with a decorative canopy stands to the left. On the back wall are hymn boards with numbers. Printed text along the bottom identifies the location as Alingsås Stadskyrkan and credits the photographer and publisher in Helsingborg.

Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town nestled in a wooded valley. A main street with tram or rail tracks runs along the right side, lined with multi‑storey houses and shops. In the center and left are densely packed residential buildings with steep roofs, and in the background on the hillside stands a larger complex of buildings and, further up, a ruin or castle site. At the top of the image there is printed red text in German identifying the view.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a fortified, elongated church or monastery complex with white walls and red roof tiles, built on a rocky hillside. A prominent bell tower with a clock stands near the center of the structure. Rugged green and brown rock formations rise behind the building. Faint printed Greek text appears at the upper left, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with a prominent church tower and other buildings on a raised bank above a river or lake, seen from across the water. The lower part of the card is blank except for printed red text in German and a small publisher's line.

A black-and-white street scene showing a calm town street lined with two- and three‑story buildings, trees along the sidewalks, pedestrians walking, and a horse‑drawn cart in the middle distance. The architecture is Northern European, with wooden facades and steep roofs. At the bottom left, the caption identifies the view as a street in Vänersborg, and at the bottom right are credits to the photographer/publisher.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an urban square with a tram, several pedestrians, early motor vehicles, tall street lamps, and a large brick building with ornate rooflines in the background. Trees line one side of the square. The caption at the bottom right reads "Nijmegen. Keizer Karelplein."

Black‑and‑white view into an enclosed courtyard between multi‑storey brick buildings. The architecture is late‑19th‑century European industrial or institutional style, with tall rectangular windows and simple brick facades. A central garden with trees and paths fills the yard, enclosed by wooden fences and a gate opening to a dirt road where a horse‑drawn water wagon stands. Several women in long light‑colored dresses stand near the entrance and along the right‑hand building, suggesting a school, convent, or hospital complex.

A black‑and‑white historic street view showing a cobblestone road flanked by tall brick buildings on both sides. A few people in old-fashioned clothing stand or walk along the street. The perspective looks down the street toward smaller houses and stepped gables in the distance. Printed text at the top identifies the location.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a military training camp complex surrounded by forest and fields. In the foreground there is a fenced area with a small garden and a round gazebo-like structure. Behind it stand long red-brick barracks buildings with many windows and a small bell tower. In the distance, scattered houses and gently rolling wooded hills are visible under a pale blue sky. The title is printed in red Gothic-style script at the top.

Old monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with brick buildings and shopfronts, with many pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption at the top is printed in German and Russian: a greeting from Windau and a label for Schloss-Strasse (Castle Street). Several shop signs in Cyrillic are visible on the right-hand side.

Color-tinted vintage street view showing a wide cobblestone road lined with low townhouses and one larger ornate building on the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the sidewalks. In the distance stands a church tower with a green onion-shaped dome. Red text at the top reads a greeting from Bjelovar and the street name Preradovićeva ulica.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a wide urban avenue lined with mid‑rise buildings featuring enclosed balconies, with a large plaza and park area on the left and busy pedestrian and car traffic on the right. Festive bunting hangs across the avenue. In the foreground on the right stands an ornate column topped with a clock. The lower border bears printed captions identifying the scene and photographer, with a scalloped edge typical of old postcards.

A greenish card addressed in handwriting, bearing printed French text at the top reading 'LABORATOIRE RUSSE DE ZOOLOGIE VILLEFRANCHE-SUR-MER'. Below, there is cursive Russian handwriting with the recipient's name and address. Several circular postal stamps are visible, indicating it was mailed.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo steamship at sea, viewed from the port side under an overcast sky. The vessel has a white superstructure with a dark funnel, several masts and cargo booms, and moderate waves in the foreground. The image has the clean, bordered look of a printed maritime postcard or ship photo card.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestoned town square with early 20th‑century buildings around it. A tramcar and a horse‑drawn cart are in the middle of the square, and several pedestrians walk about. The style of architecture is Central European, with multi‑storey stucco houses and a prominent corner building with a decorative façade and tower. The caption at the top left in red ink reads "Zittau. Kaiser Wilhelmplatz."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal flower garden in a city park. Flowerbeds with blooming plants line a wide path. A woman in early 20th‑century dress stands on the path holding a hat, while wooden benches sit beneath wooden trellises covered with climbing plants. Trees and a hazy cityscape appear in the distant background. The caption at the bottom reads "CHEMNITZ. STADTPARK. BLUMENGARTEN."

Black‑and‑white street view of a European town, likely from the early 20th century. In the foreground on the right is a prominent two‑storey corner building with ornate façades and window decorations; above the entrance the word "APOTHEKE" (pharmacy) is visible. There is a metal utility pole with wires, a gas-style street lamp, and cobblestone or dirt streets with a few pedestrians. Further down the street stand several multi‑storey townhouses, and in the distance a church-like or civic tower rises against a low hillside.

Black-and-white postcard showing a heavily damaged multi-storey building with collapsed walls and debris, likely from bombing or an earthquake. Below the photograph is printed Italian text identifying the place as the Minor Seminary in Trento and including a short religious invocation.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a street scene with several children standing on a road beside a fenced area and wooden building, with multi‑storey brick houses in the background and telegraph poles along the street. The lower part of the card contains printed and handwritten Swedish text, including a New Year's greeting and museum attribution.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snowy rural road with a person driving a horse‑drawn sleigh. Farm buildings and a fenced field are visible on the left, with leafless trees and dense coniferous forest on the right. The foreground is covered in snow with sleigh tracks, and printed caption text appears at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a busy quay or harbor square lined with multi‑story European buildings. In the foreground many men, women, and children stand or work around barrels and carts on an open paved area. At the left are masts of moored boats and a small dockside office. Prominent building façades carry large advertisements and signs, including one for a café on a corner building. The lower margin is filled with handwritten cursive text in ink.

A sepia-toned portrait postcard featuring a woman with waved, short blond hair, wearing a high lace ruffled collar and a dark, pointed cap. The photo is framed by a cream border with scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. Her name is printed below the image, and there is a small line of text in the lower right corner.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a church with a tall tower and spire rising above trees and rocky ground in the foreground. The architecture is classical with a square bell tower and an ornate top. At the bottom of the image, in red text, is the printed caption identifying the church and city.

A black‑and‑white view looking along a curved road with a simple railing, leading through trees towards a tall, cylindrical brick tower with battlements and a steep spire topped by a weather vane. The tower rises above surrounding foliage and a few adjacent buildings partially visible behind the trees. The photograph shows age, dust and scratches, and has no visible printed caption on the front.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an ornate Renaissance‑style civic building on a cobbled square, with a person walking in front, trees to the right, and handwritten cursive text across the bottom. Printed caption at the lower left identifies the scene as the provincial government building and the Place du Bourg in Bruges.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a grand historic riverside hotel set against a forested hillside. The ornate multi‑storey building bears the sign "Grand Hôtel Pupp" on its façade, with a flag flying from the roof. In the foreground there is a river, a bridge, and a riverside promenade with railings. The lower margin contains printed captions identifying the place and publisher.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a European town scene with a tall church tower and spire rising above gabled houses and trees. The drawing style is simple line art printed on beige card. At the bottom edge there is small text giving the location and name of the church.

Vintage postcard showing a monochrome illustration of a large classical theatre building fronting an open square. A few small human figures stand in front of the building. In the upper right corner is a red printed greeting in German, and in the lower right there is a black heraldic lion beside a shield in the colors black‑red‑gold. The caption beneath the image identifies the building as the Franzens theater.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a coastal scene with rocky shore and two men fishing in traditional clothing. In the background across the blue water stands a fortified hill with walls and buildings, identified as a citadel. There is printed French captioning at the bottom and handwritten text over the lower margin.

Faded sepia-toned postcard showing a park scene with large trees in the foreground and an ornate exhibition hall in the background. The building has Art Nouveau style decoration around arched windows and rooflines, with a sign on the facade. Red printed Hungarian text appears in the sky area above the building.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard laid out in a cross pattern. Four rectangular photos surround an oval central image. The top-left shows a wooden pier with boats and buildings labeled "Bryggan." The top-right shows a large school building flying a Nordic-style flag, labeled "Västkustens Ungdomsskola." The center oval depicts a church with a tall steeple by the water, labeled "Ljungs kyrka." The bottom-left image shows a fjord landscape and shoreline buildings labeled "Ljungs kilefjorden." The bottom-right shows a general view of a small coastal town labeled "Ljungkile." The words "Hälsning från Ljungskile" (Greetings from Ljungskile) are printed across the middle.

Tinted winter scene showing a dense forest of tall conifer trees heavily covered in snow. A narrow snowy path leads into the dark woods. In the foreground, a lone person in a long coat carries a large sled or board and walks along the snow. In the upper right corner there is printed text identifying the place as Altenberg in the Erzgebirge mountains.

A black-and-white panoramic view over a small town surrounded by forest and flat landscape. The town has low-rise buildings and houses spread out across the horizon. In the lower left corner the caption reads "Kalix Municip." and in the lower right corner is a photographer credit.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the harbor entrance of Port Said. In the foreground is calm water with a sailing vessel moored along a breakwater. At the end of the breakwater stands a prominent statue of a man on a tall pedestal, identified as the bust/statue of Ferdinand de Lesseps at the entrance to the port. Low buildings line the distant shoreline. French text appears at the top, and a modern website watermark is printed across the lower right.

A minimalist postcard with a blue upper half featuring a scalloped lower edge reminiscent of a stylized skyline or stadium roof, and a white lower half. At the top, spaced-out letters spell 'TORINO 2006'. Near the bottom center is the logo of the Estonian Olympic Committee, consisting of a blue-and-black flame above the Olympic rings, with text beneath.

Black-and-white postcard showing a conical, thatched-roof shelter supported by wooden posts, with a bench underneath, standing in an open grassy area bordered by trees. The sky is cloudy. Caption text in two languages appears along the bottom border.

Sepia-toned vintage seaside scene showing people, including children and adults in early 20th‑century swimwear and clothing, enjoying a rocky shoreline. Some are standing near the water, others are seated on the rocks and grassy areas. A small boat is on the water in the distance. In the lower right corner, white printed text names the location as Vänersborg and describes bathing at Skräcklan.

Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone market square bordered by 3–4‑story townhouses and a prominent historic building with a steep tiled roof and tall spire on the right, resembling a town hall. On the left are arcaded shopfronts with display windows and people walking along the street. In the far background stand additional gabled houses and church spires. The scene is calm with only a few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing.

Vintage sepia postcard featuring two printed views of ancient Greek temples in classical style with Doric columns on rocky hillsides. Much of the center and right side is covered with handwritten text in Greek script. At the lower right margin a printed credit line in Greek letters appears, and at the bottom center a modern watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" is visible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing large medieval stone walls and a round tower on a hill, with a rough dirt path leading up and a single person standing in the foreground. Small houses or shacks appear to the right. Printed captions in French identify the scene as fortifications of Salonique. There is a vertical handwritten message in ink along the right margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a mid‑20th‑century modernist interior, likely an exhibition space about letters and mail. At the center, an elderly man and woman sit at a round table on simple wooden chairs, appearing to read or write. To the left, display stands show documents and graphics; above them hang panels with circular motifs. On the far left is a wall‑mounted mailbox. On the right, a slatted wooden partition bears the large text "VÅRA BREV." Additional text panels in the background discuss the significance of letters, in what appears to be Swedish.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, jagged rock pinnacle with a metal statue of a mountain goat or ibex standing on its very top. In the foreground there is a rough footpath and simple wooden railings along the rock. In the distant background, slightly hazy, one can make out buildings and a valley town surrounded by hills. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early 20th‑century boulevard with tram tracks running down the center, several vintage automobiles and a bus, lined with neoclassical villas and palm trees. Low mountains rise in the background. Handwritten caption at the bottom identifies the location as a boulevard between Kifissia and Athens. A modern printed URL appears on the right side of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style illustration featuring a zebra standing on a small patch of ground, framed by a thin border. At the top is the slogan 'aldrig långrandigt...' and at the bottom the name and location of a natural history museum in Swedish.

A sepia-toned studio portrait of a young woman, shown from the chest up, wearing a dark dress with a light, wide collar and a decorative brooch or pendant. The photo is oval-shaped and mounted on a brown card backing. At the bottom right of the card is the photographer's imprint, including the name and town.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy open‑air market scene in a small town. Numerous women, men, and children in early 20th‑century clothing stand among stalls with baskets of produce and goods in front of low stone houses and a covered market hall with a tiled roof and bare trees. The caption at the top reads "CHELLES – Le Marché," and printer information appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned studio photograph of a uniformed soldier standing beside a striped guardhouse or sentry box. The soldier wears a long greatcoat, tall leather boots, a belt with a sword, and a metal spiked helmet (Pickelhaube-style). The background is a painted outdoor scene, typical of early 20th‑century studio portraits. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a barefoot man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a sarong-like cloth, carrying two very large woven baskets filled with what appears to be straw or agricultural material, balanced on a pole across his shoulders. The style suggests an ethnographic or colonial-era depiction of a laborer. Text is printed at the bottom of the image.

Colorized view from an elevated vantage point framed by two tall trees, looking down onto a small European town nestled in a valley with a river curving through it and low rolling hills in the background. The sky is softly graded from blue to a pale pink near the horizon. At the top of the image there is red printed text reading "Blick auf Flöha i. Sa."

Colorized historical postcard depicting the Industriehalle (industrial hall) during the autumn fair in Graz. The foreground shows well‑dressed men, women and children in early 20th‑century clothing walking and socializing in front of a decorated entrance arch with greenery and flags. The archway bears the words for the Graz autumn fair, and the facade of the ornate exhibition building behind it is labeled "INDUSTRIE-HALLE." Ticket booths labeled "KASSE" flank the entrance. At the top in red print there is a German caption describing the scene.

Vintage colored postcard showing a river with a wooden bridge supported by several stone or wooden piers. A grassy hillside and scattered trees rise behind the bridge, with a few small buildings with red roofs near the right side. The scene is rural and tranquil. Printed text at the top left identifies the location as a bridge in Piatra Neamț.

Sepia-toned interior view of an old pharmacy or apothecary. The room is filled with ornate wooden cabinets and drawers, each with metal label holders, and shelves lined with glass jars and bottles. There is a large decorative counter, an elaborate early cash register, balance scales, apothecary jars on the work surface, and a classical bust on top of a cabinet. Floral wallpaper borders the upper wall, and hanging lamps descend from the ceiling. The overall style is late 19th–early 20th century European.

A vintage black‑and‑white cityscape showing dense mid‑rise buildings near the coastline, with a few trees and palm trees in the foreground. The architecture looks late‑19th to early‑20th century Mediterranean/European style. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "ALEXANDRIA. — West Bay. — LL." and a small serial number "35" on the left. A modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed across the lower right.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a lakeside scene with swans in the foreground, a tree-framed shoreline, and a town on the opposite bank. Prominent is a large church with a tall pointed spire rising above surrounding houses and trees. The card has printed captions at the bottom indicating the location, and a red handwritten number at the top.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large group of formally dressed men, some in clerical robes, posing in front of a very long Renaissance-style stone building with many small rectangular windows in regular rows. At the far right, the structure ends in a corner tower with a spire. The composition and architectural style suggest a historic European monumental complex.

A vintage sepia-toned street view of a European city, showing cobblestone streets lined with brick buildings of two to three stories. In the distance a church or tower rises above the rooftops. The foreground shows narrow sidewalks and building facades close to the street. At the bottom, red printed caption text identifies the scene, and additional small printer's text appears along the margin. A shop sign on the right reads "OLOF DE VE…".

Vintage black‑and‑white/hand‑tinted street scene showing a busy urban square with multi‑story buildings featuring balconies and traditional enclosed glass galleries. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the cobbled square, with horse‑drawn carriages and an early tram or cart visible. A large circular purple stamp from a public library appears in the upper right. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Vigo. – Puerta del Sol." indicating the location as the Puerta del Sol square in Vigo, Spain.

A black‑and‑white view of a quiet street in a European town, likely early 20th century. Two cyclists ride along a wide unpaved road lined with sidewalks and modest two‑ to three‑story houses with steep tiled roofs. On the left stands a more stately building with classical detailing and a gabled roof, partly obscured by a flowering tree and a metal fence. The right side shows houses set above the street behind a stone retaining wall with exterior staircases. In the far distance, the street narrows toward a cluster of gabled townhouses. The overall scene is calm and residential, with no motor vehicles visible.

A sepia-toned postcard showing extensive ruins spread across a field, likely the remains of buildings destroyed in war. Crumbled stone walls and arches dominate the foreground, with scattered standing pillars or gravestones. In the background stands a largely intact church or similar religious building with a tower. The landscape around is flat and rural. Printed text appears in the upper left corner, and another small text mark is in the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by trees. The complex features round defensive towers, a gabled central building, and a church-like structure with a baroque dome and spire. The words "Wurzen." and "Schloss." are printed in red at the top of the image on a mostly blank white background, typical of early picture postcards.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European riverside town. In the foreground there is a river with embankments; behind it stand early 20th‑century apartment buildings and streets. Dominating the middle ground is a tall church with a slender Gothic spire and clock. In the far background on a hill stands a large cathedral-like complex with twin towers, along with other civic and residential buildings. The handwritten caption in the upper left reads "Meißen–R."

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a European river city with hills in the background. Several bridges cross the river; in the foreground is a metal truss bridge, and farther upstream two more bridges are visible, with a column-like monument standing in the river between them. On the right side stands a baroque-style church tower and dense old-town buildings. High on the hill to the right is a fortress complex. At the bottom margin, cursive text reads "Graz: Die 3 Brücken." On a riverside building a sign reads "JOS. S..." indicating a business name.

Black‑and‑white historic street view of a Nordic town. On the right stands a large, ornate white public building with twin corner turrets, arched windows, balcony and broad steps. On the left is a row of 2–3‑storey wooden and masonry shopfronts along an unpaved main street with a few pedestrians. Handwritten notes label several buildings at the top of the image. Printed captions at the bottom read the town name on the left and the publisher's credit on the right.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a bird's-eye view of a small spa town with many trees, grand buildings and surrounding hills. Above the town, a humorously edited image of a well-dressed man with hat, coat, suitcase and open umbrella appears to float or fly through the sky. At the bottom there is German text printed in red and smaller publisher information.

An old sepia-toned illustrated postcard with ornate floral frames around four small photographic views. The central large script reads "Gruss aus Dorpat". The upper-left image is labeled "Universitäts Bibliothek" showing a classical building. The upper-middle image reads "Garten des Handwerker-Vereins" depicting a formal garden with a fountain or statue. The upper-right view is labeled "Domallee" showing a tree-lined avenue with a bridge or walkway. The lower-left is labeled "Mollatz" with a countryside or villa scene. The card is heavily filled with handwritten German text around and over the images.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a wide, straight avenue lined with two‑ and three‑storey neoclassical buildings. People are walking along the sidewalks and in the street; leafless trees and telegraph or electric poles line the road. At the far end stands a larger civic building. Greek text appears at the upper left, and a modern watermark with a website URL appears at the lower right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-span truss and arch bridge crossing a wide river. In the foreground there are flat fields with grazing animals, and in the lower right corner a heraldic shield with an eagle is printed. The image has a vintage photographic style and no visible caption on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a slightly curving town street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. People walk along the street, including a woman pushing a baby carriage. In the distance stands a large church with a steep roof and twin towers. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location, and small publisher information appears in the lower left corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined square with benches and people walking or sitting. In the background stands a large, multi‑storey corner building identified as Pension Utz on Friedrichstrasse 37. The lower margin contains printed location and publisher information, and the front is heavily covered with handwritten cursive text, dated December 3rd, 1905.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European town with a stone bridge crossing a river in the foreground. The bridge has metal railings and a gently curving road with a few pedestrians or cyclists. On both sides of the bridge stand multi‑story houses with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European architecture. Behind them, more houses rise up a wooded hillside, and on the distant ridge a church or institutional building with a tall spire is visible. The scene is quiet and semi‑rural, with trees, gardens, and laundry lines. Some faint signage is visible on the facades but is not clearly readable.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large ornate government building on a square, with people walking and a few horse‑drawn vehicles. Leafless trees line the street. Printed French text at the bottom identifies the view as the "Prévôté et bureaux du gouvernement" in Bruges. The card has a wide white margin and a vertical printer's credit along the left edge.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing three women seated on the ground in an outdoor setting, each wrapped in cloth garments and headscarves. In front of them are stacked woven baskets covered with cloth, suggesting a market scene. The background is bare earth with scattered sticks and debris. The printed captions on the image read "Loanda" in the upper left and "Quitandeira de Farinha" in the upper right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, empty street lined with large neo‑Gothic brick buildings. The main structure on the right has tall arched windows and a fenced-off frontage; farther down the street are more ornate facades and a distant tower. French captions and handwritten notes appear around the image.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard-style photograph of a rocky seaside cape with low cliffs descending into a calm sea. In the foreground on the right, several people in 19th‑century clothing sit or stand on the grassy, rocky shore. Across the water, a long headland forms the background. The photo is printed within an ornate decorative border with floral corners and a coat of arms at the top and bottom, and has captions in Cyrillic and French beneath the image.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a group of five uniformed men, likely World War I military personnel. Three men in flight or leather coats stand at left, one of them being examined or searched by an officer in the center, while another officer in a peaked cap stands to the right. The background shows a simple outdoor setting with a corrugated wall and a bench. Printed French text appears below the photograph.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large late‑19th‑century neoclassical building along a broad street or square. In the foreground a military band and soldiers in parade formation march past, watched by civilians in early 20th‑century dress. Mature trees and ornate metal fencing line the street, with a lamppost carrying a small rectangular sign.

Colorized illustrated postcard. On the left, a panoramic view over a river valley town with red‑roofed houses, a large church or town hall with a tall tower, several factory chimneys and bridges, surrounded by wooded hills; the caption at the top reads "Waldheim. Blick vom Eichberg." On the right, a separate cartoon panel shows a smiling, well‑dressed man with glasses, hat and umbrella standing on a rock, gesturing toward the landscape below, with a humorous dialect text printed beside him.

Hand‑colored vintage street scene showing an elegant European spa town. Multi‑story historic buildings line a square with trees and a lamppost. A horse‑drawn tram or carriage full of passengers moves through the street. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand nearby. The caption at the bottom identifies the view as 'Karlsbad. Neue Wiese.' The publisher's imprint and the phrase 'Handkolorirte Künstlerkarte' appear in red at the lower edge.

Black-and-white postcard showing a modest railway station building with a steep tiled roof and wooden upper facade. Several men stand in front of the entrance. Above the door is a sign reading 'TORSBY' with smaller text beneath. At the bottom margin of the card, the caption 'Järnvägsstation' identifies the scene as a railway station.

A black‑and‑white image showing a large, ornate brick school building with a tall clock‑tower‑like structure and arched entrance. In front of the building stands a group of schoolboys in early 20th‑century clothing, scattered across a lawn with young trees. Above the entrance, a sign reads "HIGH SCHOOL." The architectural style is late 19th‑century American, with a mix of Romanesque and Victorian details.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural mountain landscape with a few large houses or guesthouses in the foreground, open meadows, and a densely forested hillside in the background. The scene appears calm and pastoral. At the top left, there is red printed text reading "Oberbärenburg i. Erzgeb." indicating the location in the Ore Mountains.

Old sepia-toned postcard divided into two horizontal photographs. The upper photo shows a white masonry church with two tall square towers and a central dome, partly obscured by large trees in a park-like setting. The lower photo shows a wooden church with a high central tower and smaller side tower, surrounded by a low picket fence; the building has tall, narrow windows and a metal roof. Faint handwritten captions in cursive are visible above each photograph, and a vertical note appears along the left margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a city nestled in a valley surrounded by mountains. The foreground shows a river with a bridge, rail tracks, and dense urban buildings. In the center and right are several church towers and historic-looking structures, indicating an old town core. The image is bordered like an old postcard, with the caption "Trento" printed in cursive at the bottom.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a tall, slender concrete viaduct or bridge crossing over a road with tram or rail tracks. The bridge stands in a wooded, hilly landscape. Printed text in Dutch appears at the top of the image, describing the location and the bridge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over the city of Graz from an elevated vantage point. In the foreground on the left is a steep-roofed tower among trees, looking down over dense historic rooftops, church spires and civic buildings stretching into the distance with hills on the horizon. Printed German captions and publisher information appear at the bottom, along with cursive handwritten notes.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large cargo steamship alongside a quay or in harbor waters. The vessel has multiple cargo masts and booms, a central superstructure, and a single funnel toward the stern. Printed text in Swedish appears at the top describing the ship and its location in a harbor.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a large lake bordered by forested hills and open meadows, with a village spread along the shore. A winding road follows the lake edge through trees. The surrounding mountains are mostly treeless on top with darker forest bands. At the top margin in red print are place names indicating the scene is of Titisee in the Black Forest and the nearby mountain Hochfirst with its elevation.

A monochrome postcard view of a formal city park. A straight path leads through a decorative archway covered with climbing plants, flanked by potted trees and manicured flowerbeds. In the background are more landscaped beds and tall trees. At the top, in red German text, it identifies the location as a city park in Wurzen.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a city nestled in a valley with hills in the background. In the foreground stands a large complex of multi‑storey institutional buildings, likely a hospital, with many windows and flat roofs. Behind it stretches the city with church towers and other historic buildings, while wooded hills rise further back. The printed caption at the top reads in German about Graz and a new hospital with a view of the city. There are faint postal cancellation marks near the top.

Sepia-toned interior view of a richly decorated basilica with Byzantine-style arches, columns, and ornate capitals. A prominent stone column stands in the foreground. In the background there is an altar or sanctuary area with patterned walls and arches. The layout and caption indicate this is the Basilica of Saint Sophia in Salonique (Thessaloniki). The front includes printed text in French and a photographer credit.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an elaborate Renaissance-style monumental tomb inside a church. The multi-tiered sarcophagus is richly decorated with columns, reliefs, and numerous small statues of kneeling and standing figures. On the upper level there are recumbent lion figures, and on the very top stands a large statue of a man in armor with a sword, next to a tall crucifix with Christ on the cross. The monument is elevated on steps and partly roped off. Gothic vaults and church décor are visible in the background.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a sandy path winding through dense green shrubs toward a small rise, where a lone person in early-20th‑century dress stands near a tree at the viewpoint. The sky is pale blue with light clouds. Along the bottom margin there is printed red text identifying the location and the publisher, in Dutch and German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town street with a bridge in the foreground leading toward several townhouses. A man walks on the bridge and a horse‑drawn vehicle is visible further up the street. On the right side rises a prominent Baroque‑style Catholic church with an ornate tower and cross. Decorative lampposts line the bridge. Red printed German text appears at the top and bottom margins.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a rural coastal area with fields, scattered houses, conifer trees and a bay with small boats. In the foreground are rocky outcrops, a road with an early‑mid 20th‑century car and bicycles, several tall utility poles, and a two‑storey building with signage on its facade. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner. A small oval publisher mark with a number is in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Renaissance-style courtyard with a formal garden. The image shows a two-story palazzo enclosing a small, manicured garden featuring neatly trimmed bushes, small trees, and a circular fountain on the left. One wall is covered with ivy; another has an arcaded loggia with five rounded arches supported by columns. Above each arch is a circular medallion relief, likely depicting faces or coats of arms. The upper floor has rectangular windows and round oculi near the roofline. The building surfaces appear somewhat weathered, giving a historic character. No visible printed title or caption appears on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an entrance gate and path leading toward a domed bell tower (Glockenturm) surrounded by trees. Small buildings flank the gate. The lower margin of the card contains printed captions indicating the location, as well as publisher information along the left edge and a handwritten signature at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vertical postcard showing part of an old plastered building with steep tiled roofs and simple rectangular windows, partly obscured by tall trees and vegetation. The lower portion shows a high, plain wall in shadow, while the upper part reveals gables and rooflines typical of Central or Northern European architecture. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a steamship named "FORTUNA" moored along a waterfront lined with tall, narrow, half‑timbered warehouse buildings. Smoke is rising from the ship's funnel and from the quay area, suggesting an active industrial port. The architecture in the background consists of densely packed gabled storehouses facing the waterway.

Colorized seaside view taken from the water looking toward a beach resort town. In the foreground are dark green ocean waves; in the midground stands a long wooden pier with a white building on top. On the sandy shore behind the pier are beachgoers and beach huts, and further back several large, ornate villa-style buildings with towers and steep roofs line the waterfront. The card has printed captions in German at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing the exterior and interior of a traditional half‑timbered building that houses a historic tavern or restaurant. The left panel depicts a steep‑roofed, timber‑framed house with small dormer windows and a signboard reading "Vincentz Richter" above the ground floor, reached by a stone staircase. The right panels show the interior: a rustic dining room with wooden tables and carved chairs, decorated with collections of old weapons such as swords, halberds, rifles and other antique items mounted on the white walls, plus lamps, a bar counter and arched windows.

Colorized view of a landscaped park with a curving path, a brick arched bridge or viaduct on the left, and a tall brick tower-like building with battlements and a viewing terrace on the right, mostly surrounded by dense trees. A single old-fashioned streetlamp stands near the path. At the bottom, printed text reads "Nymegen Belvedère."

Sepia-toned view over a bridge leading toward a large waterside complex of historic stone buildings with corner towers and domed or conical roofs. Cars and pedestrians move across the bridge; trees and a small park frame the foreground while a calm body of water lies between the bridge and the buildings. The architecture suggests a fortified castle or palace integrated into a town setting. No visible printed text appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a European city center with 19th‑century stone and brick buildings bordering a tree‑filled square or park. In the foreground are large, ornate multi‑story buildings with arched windows and classical facades; in the background are hills dotted with houses and some industrial chimneys. The lower left corner contains a printed caption in a Scandinavian language.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural village scene with a baroque-style church with a distinctive onion-shaped tower on the left and adjoining school buildings on the right, set behind trees and hedges. The foreground is an open grassy area. German captions are printed in red beneath the image.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing the sea entrance to a harbor with a prominent white column or lighthouse‑like structure on a breakwater, low coastal fortifications or buildings to the left, and distant shoreline on the horizon. The top margin bears a printed French caption, and the front is heavily covered with handwritten cursive text in another language. A small printer's mark and the code "49" appear at the bottom right, along with a faint website watermark added later for archiving.

Black-and-white street view showing Piersonstraat in Nijmegen. Brick row houses and small businesses line both sides of a cobblestone street. Garlands or festoons are strung across the street overhead, suggesting a celebration or holiday. Several adults and children are walking or standing in the street; one child has a bicycle. The overall scene has an early-20th-century European urban atmosphere. In the lower left corner, white caption text identifies the location as 'NIJMEGEN, PIERSONSTRAAT'. On the right, a shop sign is visible above a doorway.

A hand-colored postcard view of a small European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings, including multi‑story townhouses and larger institutional-looking structures around an open yard or square. In the background are low hills with scattered trees and a few villas. The lower half of the card is blank for writing, with printed captions in German identifying the place and publisher.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a large historic complex on a hill above a town and river. The complex combines a castle-like structure with many windows and steep roofs alongside tall Gothic cathedral towers with spires. Below the hill are smaller town buildings and riverside structures. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Meissen and labels the Albrechtsburg castle and the cathedral (Dom); part of the printed text has been crossed out by hand.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated view over a town square bordered by trees and low houses, with larger institutional buildings and twin‑towered structures in the background. A few people walk across the largely empty, sunlit square. The caption in red at the top left reads "Grossenhain. Rahmenplatz."

Black‑and‑white view of an industrial harbor. In the foreground a cargo boat is moored along the quay. Behind it stands a large steel harbor crane on tall lattice legs reaching over warehouse buildings. Coal or similar bulk material is piled in the background, and additional cranes are visible further away. On one of the central buildings the word "BUNKE" (likely part of a longer word such as 'BUNKER') is painted.

Black-and-white panoramic view from an elevated hillside looking over a small town surrounded by fields and low hills. In the foreground are paths, fences and tall curved streetlamps on a sloping park-like area with a few people walking. Beyond, the town shows traditional European buildings with gabled roofs and church towers. The caption in German is printed at the bottom left.

Colorized postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a landscaped city park, surrounded by lush trees, lawns, and flowerbeds. Water jets arch from the multi-tiered fountain with statues at its base and center. There is printed red text at the top naming the location in German, and handwritten cursive notes over parts of the image.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural town with scattered houses, fields in the foreground, and low hills or mountains in the background. The settlement has farm buildings, small roads and a church visible in the distance. In the top left corner, printed text identifies the place.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a large brick church with a tall, slender spire topped by a cross. The facade has a central arched entrance, circular windows, and a clock on the tower. People are standing on the steps and in the foreground, with trees and a lamppost framing the scene. Text at the top identifies the church, and a photographer credit appears at the bottom.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large historic building complex on a slope or rampart, likely part of a castle or palace. The long, multi-windowed building with steep rooflines stands above a wooded embankment. Below, a small decorative bridge crosses a ditch or stream, and two figures walk on a path in a landscaped park. Tree branches frame the upper edge of the image, enhancing a picturesque, romantic view.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a wooden pier extending into the sea, with several small sailing boats moored or approaching. People are standing on the pier and in the boats. The lower margin contains printed German text in red and small publisher information.

Sepia-toned postcard showing leafless trees in the foreground with parts of a medieval stone structure visible behind them, including a steep conical roof and a cylindrical tower. In the upper-right corner of the card border there is a heraldic-style emblem with the word "CESIS".

Black-and-white postcard view of a large Baroque-style waterside castle with multiple round corner towers topped by domes and lanterns, a central façade with an ornate entrance and balcony, and a tall church-like spire rising behind. The castle stands behind a formal garden and trees on the opposite bank of a calm lake or moat, photographed from across the water under a lightly clouded sky. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a canal lined with old brick buildings and towers, with swans in the water. In the distance a large belfry rises above the city skyline. Printed at the top are the words identifying the scene as a quay in Bruges.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a steamship navigating a narrow lock cut between steep rock faces. People stand along the quayside as the vessel moves through the canal-like lock system. Forested hills and further waterways can be seen in the background. Printed text in the lower left corner reads "Trollhättan, Slussparti," and the ship's stern shows additional text.

Color postcard showing a busy street scene with two round medieval stone towers topped with red, conical tiled roofs forming a gate into an old town. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk between the towers and along the adjoining commercial street lined with multi‑story buildings and shop awnings. Trees frame the scene on both sides.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town seen from a grassy field with trees in the foreground. In the background are clustered houses with pitched roofs and prominent church spires rising above the townscape. The word "Geringswalde." is printed in red in the upper right corner.

Colorized vintage view of a small town in a mountain valley. In the foreground there is a dirt road lined with trees leading toward a cluster of buildings with red roofs and a prominent church steeple. Behind the town rise green hills and snow‑capped mountains under a sky with clouds. The caption in red text at the upper left reads "Cles, Val di Non".

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a classroom full of young girls seated at long wooden desks, all facing the camera. A nun or teacher in a religious habit stands to the right side of the room. The classroom has high windows, wall maps or pictures, and at the back a framed religious image, likely of the Virgin Mary. Printed caption text appears in red at the bottom center of the card.
