Color postcard view over a town in a wide green valley with mountains in the background. In the foreground there is a river, fields, and a light-colored villa-like building. Flowering tree branches frame the upper right side of the image. The town is composed of mid‑rise buildings with red-tiled roofs stretching toward the foothills of a large mountain. The word "TRENTO." is printed at the top left of the image.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town in a valley with a church tower rising above low buildings, backed by a dramatic mountain range. In the foreground is an open field with a few figures and animals walking toward the town. Handwritten-style white text runs along the bottom margin of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing the entrance façade of a stone fortification with three large round towers and arched gateways, partially overgrown with ivy and surrounded by trees. Two small human figures stand in front. The caption at the bottom identifies it as Fort Thüngen (Drei Eicheln) in Luxembourg, and publisher information is printed along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street with a long, two‑story building featuring arched windows on the ground floor and rectangular windows above. Leafless trees line the sidewalk and cast shadows on the facade. A tall fence and an old street lamp stand on the left. On the right, a wooden gate and fence bear a sign for a restaurant. Printed red lettering at the top identifies the place as a restaurant named Glashütte in Radeburg, and another signboard near the gate repeats the restaurant name along with the proprietor's name.

Sepia-toned image showing a single tall Roman-style column standing on a raised mound, flanked by stone sphinx statues and smaller pedestal sculptures. The composition and framing resemble an old touristic postcard. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the lower right.

Vintage postcard with a sepia-toned photograph on the right showing a grand neoclassical bank building with columns, ornate pediment, balcony, flag on the roof and a metal fence in front. The caption under the image reads "BANCA DALL' ORSO GALATI." The left side is filled with handwritten French text beginning with "Cher frère." In the upper right margin appears a printed or written date, and along the right edge a vertical imprint of the printer/publisher.

Vintage sepia-toned view over a hilly, wooded landscape with scattered houses in the foreground and a dense cluster of multi‑storey buildings and church spires in the background. The lower margin is blank except for printed captions, suggesting an early picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a harbor scene with moored sailing ships and a man crouching on the quay handling ropes in the foreground. Buildings and additional vessels line the waterfront in the background. The caption at the bottom left reads "Motala. Hamnen." indicating the harbor area of Motala.

Black-and-white postcard view of a mid‑20th‑century institutional building in front of a town, with rugged mountains rising in the background. The foreground features a long, rectangular school or institute complex with multiple stories and balconies, behind a fence and bare trees. Apartment blocks and industrial-style buildings are visible further back. Handwritten-style text along the bottom identifies the place and institution.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large brick building with decorative striping, steep gabled roofs, and turrets in a Neo-Gothic/Neo-Renaissance style. In front are small gardens and a drive where carriages or early vehicles are visible. At the bottom of the image the word 'Nijmegen' appears on the left and 'Station.' on the right, indicating it is the railway station of Nijmegen. Publisher information is printed along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant early 20th‑century café or ice‑cream parlor. The room has ornate stucco ceilings, chandeliers with floral glass shades, patterned wallpaper, and dark wooden counters and cabinets. The long front counter is covered with cakes and pastries; a woman in traditional dress works behind it. At the back and right, small round tables with bentwood chairs fill the room, and display cabinets hold dishes and goods. A single customer sits at a table on the right. A hanging sign near a column reads "EIS-CAFE."

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a botanical garden with a large glass greenhouse complex in the foreground and dense trees in the background. Paths, flowerbeds, benches, and a classical statue are visible among the landscaped grounds. Printed text in the upper left corner identifies the location as the botanical garden's palm greenhouse in Cluj.

Black‑and‑white image of a wooden villa or lodge on a hillside edge of a dense coniferous forest. The house has steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, log‑cabin style walls, and a large covered veranda supported by posts on a stone base. A flagpole in front flies a light–over–dark two‑stripe flag. Terraced paths and stairways lead up the slope, with small trees or shrubs planted along the way. Two people in early‑20th‑century clothing stand on the path in the foreground. The overall style suggests a rural or mountain retreat. No printed captions or inscriptions are visible.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a photograph of an ancient Roman-style mosaic. The composition centers on a circular medallion with the bust of a figure wearing draped clothing and a laurel-like headpiece, surrounded by intricate geometric and braided patterns. Smaller panels in the corners contain animal or fish motifs. At the bottom margin of the image is a printed caption in French identifying the subject as a mosaic from Timgad.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a neo‑Gothic / neo‑Romanesque church with a very tall, steep central spire rising from an octagonal tower. The church stands in a landscaped square or small park with trees and paths around it. Surrounding the church are late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century brick and stucco buildings, including a large institutional-looking block on the left and an industrial building with a tall chimney on the right. The sky is left blank/overexposed, and there is a wide street with lamps and fences in the foreground. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.

A colored vintage postcard view of an Ottoman-era cityscape labeled Constantinople. In the foreground is a large mosque with a central dome and two tall minarets, adjacent to a clock-tower-like structure and an open square with carts or early automobiles. Densely packed houses climb the hillside in the background. The caption in French at the top reads 'Vue de Tophané' and 'Constantinople.'

A vintage multi-view color postcard titled "GRAZ." showing nine small scenes of the city. The views include a riverside panorama with a hill and fortification, a city park fountain with people walking, an overlook with a bear statue and wide valley view, a wooded lake, the ornate city hall on a busy square, a city square with trams and buildings, a grand opera house, a bridge over the river with adjacent school buildings, and a street scene with tall corner building and row of houses. Each vignette has a short red German caption naming the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view taken from an elevated, forested vantage point looking down over a small town or resort area nestled among hills. Tall conifer and birch trees frame the foreground, while scattered buildings and a winding road with a few people walking are visible in the mid‑distance. Text in Swedish is printed at the bottom left, and a publisher's imprint and logo appear at the bottom right.

A black-and-white vintage view of a small railway station complex on a hillside. In the foreground there are large stacks of cut wood and several barrels. Behind them stand low station buildings and a slightly larger two‑story station house with a sign on the facade. A horse and cart are visible near the buildings. Modest houses sit on the hill in the background. The title text at the top reads "MÖLNDAL. JÄRNVÄGSSTATIONEN."

A monochrome postcard reproducing an old engraving of a cityscape with many low buildings, a prominent large cathedral with a tall spire in the center-right, windmills on a hill to the far right, and rocky, wooded foreground. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds. At the bottom right there is bilingual text in Finnish and Swedish describing the city in the 1700s.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, ornate early‑20th‑century university building on a broad, mostly empty street. The multi‑storey structure has tall rectangular windows, a stone base, decorative window frames, and a central section with a tower-like element and steep tiled roofs. The style is Central European, and printed Hungarian text appears in the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large two‑storey wooden building with a central gable and tiled roof, set at the end of a curved gravel driveway and framed by tall trees and hedges. The architecture looks like an early 20th‑century Nordic manor or community house. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and a small serial number is printed in the lower right.

A colorized vintage view of a large steel truss bridge crossing a wide river. In the foreground there is a riverside area with sand or gravel, carts, barrels, and small wooden structures on the water. A paddle steamer and other boats are moored near the bank. The bridge has multiple arched truss spans on brick piers. Printed text on the image reads "Riesa." in the upper left and "Elbbrücke." in the upper right. On one of the boats a sign with the word "RIESA" is visible.

Vintage portrait postcard featuring a seated military officer in formal uniform framed within a rectangular vignette. To the left stands a tall flagpole bearing an early Greek flag with horizontal light and dark stripes and a small canton with a crown. The background is plain and tinted in sepia tones. Printed French text beneath the portrait identifies the person as a royal prince of Greece, and there is handwritten script along the upper edge.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a small ornate pavilion or spa building in a dense forest. The structure has a steep, gabled roof, decorative wooden elements, and large arched windows at the front. In the foreground there is a rustic wooden bench and a pile of rocks along a dirt path. Printed red text at the upper left reads "Bad Elster. Waldquelle."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a historic hunting lodge complex on the left with a tall tower and ornate gabled roof, and a church with a tower and spire on the right. Trees and a bare open square or courtyard lie in the foreground. The printed caption at the top reads in German, "Wermsdorf – Jagdschloß u. Kirche".

Black-and-white vintage postcard view of a European town square and adjoining street. Cobbled streets curve around a tree‑lined square bordered by multi‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and timber framing. In the background are two church towers rising above the rooftops. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is a German caption naming the place depicted.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs of the spa town Bad Elster. The top image shows a distant view of the town with a church tower surrounded by dense forested hills, labeled in German. The middle image depicts a long, modernist interior hall with large windows, columns, and display cases, labeled as the Wandelhalle (promenade hall). The bottom image shows an outdoor bathing or spa area with a rectangular basin or lawn, paths, and people gathered around, set against wooded hills, labeled Badeplatz.

Multi-view postcard showing a modernist seaside hotel complex called Hotel Ambassador. The top-left image shows a low, wide, terraced hotel building with balconies; the top-right image shows a crowded sandy beach with sunbathers and parasols by the sea; the bottom images show the hotel's interior lounge and dining room with red ceilings, pendant lights, and neatly arranged tables. In the center is a red ribbon banner with the hotel name written in Cyrillic script.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an elegant historical interior, likely a drawing or sitting room furnished in Baroque or Rococo style. The room has a large multi‑paned window with heavy curtains, an ornate chandelier, carved wooden tables and chairs with upholstered or caned seats, richly decorated mirrors and wall sconces, shelves with porcelain vases and figurines, a tall elaborately ornamented tiled or faux‑marble stove, and a writing desk with books. The polished wooden floor and wall treatment suggest a room in a European palace or grand town house.

Black‑and‑white panoramic landscape view over a lake surrounded by dense coniferous forest and gently rolling hills. In the foreground are scattered farm buildings, fields, and a few dirt roads lined with trees. On the far shore there are more rural houses and what appears to be a long industrial or farm building near the water. The overall look is of a quiet, northern European lakeside countryside. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white romantic postcard showing a young couple in early 20th‑century clothing. The man in a dark suit and tie gently holds both hands of a woman wearing a light-colored dress with puffed sleeves and a long skirt. They look at each other intimately. At the top there is a printed Spanish verse, and at the bottom appears a small credit line to the Biblioteca Regional de Madrid along with a circular logo and the number 509/1.

Colorized aerial or elevated view of a river bend with small red‑roofed houses along a riverside road and terraced hillsides in the background. Two workboats or barges are on the calm river in the foreground. At the top left, red printed text reads "Diesbar a. Elbe". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a hilly, forested valley with scattered farm fields and villas. A small settlement stretches along a winding road; at the bottom of the image stands a multi‑storey building labeled "Hotel Engelmann" with traditional Alpine-style architecture. Behind it are more houses, a church‑like villa with a small tower, tree‑lined avenues, and wooded hills in the background.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a densely packed street procession through a European historic town. Hundreds of people line a narrow cobblestone street bordered by multi‑story masonry buildings with shutters and arcades. In the foreground and middle distance are clergy in vestments, acolytes, and lay participants, suggesting a Catholic religious procession or funeral. At the far end of the street stands a church façade with a bell/clock tower rising behind it. The architecture appears early‑modern Italian, with stuccoed walls, arched porticoes, and wooden window shutters.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a line of evenly spaced trees along a path. Beyond them lies a river with more trees on its banks. On the opposite bank stand numerous villas and townhouses on sloping ground, and, prominent on the right, a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire rising above the settlement. Forested hills and patchwork farmland stretch into the distance. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a wide river with a lattice iron bridge in the foreground and wooded hills in the background. On top of the hill stands a large historic building complex with a tall red spire, and other villas and structures dot the slopes. A large tree frames the scene on the left. German text is printed at the top of the image.

Monochrome historic-style postcard showing a medieval hunting scene in a river valley. In the background, a large fortified castle complex stands on a hill above a winding river, with mountains behind it. In the foreground, mounted nobles, footmen, dogs, and peasants are depicted as part of a hunt. German text is printed in red at the top and in white script at the bottom.

A color illustration of a large black and yellow ocean liner with two tall black smokestacks, identified as the P. & O. steamship 'Malwa', anchored off a tropical port. Smaller sailboats and rowboats filled with people surround the ship on vibrant blue water. In the background is a palm-lined waterfront with colonial-style buildings and a clock or bell tower, suggesting a busy harbor scene at Colombo.

Black‑and‑white street view of a small European town, likely around the turn of the 20th century. People in period clothing, including women with long dresses and children, stand and walk along a broad unpaved street lined with two‑ and three‑storey masonry houses with steep tiled roofs. On the right, a large painted wall advertisement for a bakery is visible; in the background rises a sizable baroque‑style church or town‑hall tower with a domed cupola and lantern. The scene has the character of an old photographic postcard of a German town.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a semi-rural townscape with several simple two-story houses in the foreground, orchards and fenced gardens, and a more densely built town in the background. Church towers rise above the rooftops, and several factory chimneys indicate industrial activity. The title text printed in red at the top reads "Grossröhrsdorf. Mitteldorf."

A vintage black‑and‑white portrait postcard showing a bearded man in a striped suit, bow tie, and pince‑nez glasses, facing the camera. The background is plain. Under the photograph there is printed Russian text identifying the sitter, along with a small circular publisher's mark in the lower left corner.

Monochrome religious postcard showing an artistic depiction of the Last Supper. Christ stands in the center with a radiant halo, holding the Eucharistic bread, surrounded by the twelve apostles seated and reclining around a semicircular table with a large menorah in front. Above them a larger, faint figure of Christ appears in blessing. The scene is framed by an arch, and behind/around the image there is dense printed text in a serif font.

A monochrome postcard styled as the front page of the Italian newspaper 'IL BRENNERO – Quotidiano Fascista Tridentino'. The layout includes the masthead at the top, a large quotation in Italian attributed to Mussolini on the right, and two photographs on the left and bottom. The upper photo shows Mussolini speaking from a decorated podium under arches to a crowd. The lower panoramic photo depicts a vast crowd filling a city square, surrounded by multi‑story buildings; one roof shows the sign 'LANO'. The imagery and text celebrate Mussolini's visit to the city of Trento.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide river, with several traditional lateen‑rigged sailboats on the water and low buildings along the opposite bank. On the right, a tree and a riverbank wall frame the scene. At the top right are two postage stamps and postmarks. There is handwriting across the lower middle of the image. Printed text at the bottom identifies the view as a site in Egypt associated with the biblical story of Moses.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a military guardhouse complex with low and higher plastered buildings with tiled roofs surrounding a courtyard. Soldiers in uniform stand in formation near a striped guard post, while civilians, including children, walk in the open square. An arched gateway on the left bears German text, and printed captions in red at the bottom identify the view and publisher.

A monochrome image printed across two panels showing a long, low, whitewashed adobe or plastered building with a shaded veranda supported by posts. The structure has exterior stair-like buttresses around a window and a simple wooden railing along the porch. In the foreground are sparse shrubs and an unpaved yard or driveway. To the left stands a very tall, thin agave (century plant) flower stalk, and in the distant background low mountains or hills are visible. In the upper right corner the red number "6713" is printed. There is no other visible text or decorative border.

Colorized historic postcard view of a small industrial area by a stream or millrace. Several multi‑story masonry and wooden buildings stand around a small waterfall and dam, with leafless trees in the foreground and a few people on a footbridge or walkway near the water. The scene has a rural Nordic feel. Red printed text at the top left reads "Stampen, Karlshamn." and a smaller text underneath indicates the photographer or publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a coastal Scandinavian town with many wooden houses clustered on rocky terrain. In the center stands a large stone church with a tall spire, and in the background are bare rocky islands and water channels. The word "SMÖGEN" is printed in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 22 appears in the lower right.

Sepia-toned image mounted on a worn card backing, showing a tree-lined dirt road curving toward a modest, light-colored house or farmhouse with a porch. Leafy deciduous trees flank both sides of the road, suggesting a rural or small-town setting in a temperate climate. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a formal park with a circular fountain and flowerbeds in the foreground, cone-shaped trimmed shrubs, paths, benches with people sitting, and a broad staircase leading up through tall trees. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Freiberg i. Sa. Anlagen im Albertpark".

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the interior of a limestone cave filled with stalactites and stalagmites. The rocky formations dominate the scene, with a relatively flat floor area in the foreground and tall columns and dripping formations rising behind. Printed French text at the bottom identifies the location as caves near Tlemcen and notes the view as the interior of the Grottes d'Aïn‑Fezza.

Colorized postcard view of a riverside scene showing a large historic building or small castle on a rocky hill above the water. Terraced slopes and trees lead down to the riverbank. In the foreground a long paddle steamer travels along the river. On the left are several smaller houses and farm buildings. The sky is lightly clouded with a pastel pink and blue tint. At the top left, German text identifies the location.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a large medieval castle with two tall pointed towers and an elongated main building on a hill above a river. Trees frame the scene, and small riverside buildings and a wooden riverside structure are visible below the castle. At the top right in red text it reads "Schloß Rochlitz i. Sa." with a handwritten red number beside it.

Vintage multi-view postcard with three black‑and‑white photographs and handwritten text in old Bulgarian script. The top left image shows a city garden with lush plants and a tall monument/obelisk commemorating those fallen in the Russo‑Turkish War. The top right image shows a large two‑storey institutional building behind trees, likely a school (gymnasium). The bottom image shows another substantial rectangular school building with people standing in front. Printed captions in Bulgarian are beneath the photos, and the right side is filled with cursive handwritten correspondence. The main printed greeting reads "Поздравь отъ Ст.-Загора." (Greetings from Stara Zagora).

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a semi‑rural town with orchards or gardens in the foreground, a few villas and houses with tiled roofs, and terraced hills or vineyards in the background. A telegraph/electric pole with wires is visible near the front. In the top left corner, the red printed caption reads "Oberlößnitz." The sky area is mostly blank, in the typical style of early picture postcards.

A black‑and‑white photograph of two women standing outdoors on fallen leaves, wearing elaborate traditional folk costumes. Each has a long dark skirt with floral embroidery near the hem, a wide belt or sash, and a high, pouch‑like bodice. The woman on the left wears a light blouse with embroidered vest and a rounded cap; the woman on the right wears a darker jacket and a distinctive tall, folded white headdress. Trees with dense foliage fill the background. There is no visible printed caption on the front.

Black‑and‑white view of a coastal town and harbor with many small sailboats on calm water. In the foreground is a fenced seaside bathing facility built on the rocks with covered walkways and pavilions over the water. On the hill to the left stands a large stone church with a tall spire dominating the town. Wooden houses and rocky terrain surround the bay. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Colorized historical postcard showing a rural scene with large half-timbered houses and farm buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the foreground a man stands with a horse or mule in a field, while two small children sit on the grass to the right. The main building appears to be an inn or guesthouse. Printed German text is present along the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a formal public garden with manicured flowerbeds, trimmed lawns, and elaborate topiary. In the foreground on the right is a very large urn‑shaped topiary planter overflowing with foliage and a palm; another smaller basket planter stands to the left. A straight paved path cuts through the lawn, with dense mixed plantings and shrubs on both sides. Tall conifer trees form a backdrop, and behind the trees a slender church steeple rises in the distance, partly hidden by foliage. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a calm canal or lagoon lined with tall, narrow trees, likely poplars. Several people stand or pole narrow wooden boats along the water; they wear light-colored clothing and broad-brimmed hats. The scene suggests traditional flat-bottomed boats moving through a watery landscape used for agriculture or transport. There is no visible printed title or caption on the front, only a small numeric code in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly rural landscape with patchwork fields, small villages and scattered villas. In the middle distance there is a long, elevated wooden or steel trestle railway bridge curving across a valley. Forested slopes frame the scene; on a distant hilltop to the right stands a larger building or small complex, and a tall, slender tower or spire is just visible on the far horizon to the left. The image has wide margins and looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard or plate reproduction. No printed caption or writing is visible.

Black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) historic street view showing a broad cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops on both sides. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. Church towers are visible in the distant background. The red printed caption at the top reads the town and street names in German: "Rochlitz i. Sa." on the left and "Marktstrasse" on the right.

Black‑and‑white winter view of a busy industrial river port with many long, covered cargo barges moored side by side along a quay. Snow covers the boats and the ground, and there is ice on the water. On the left are cranes, warehouses, rail tracks and freight wagons, with smokestacks and factory buildings visible in the background. At the top of the image there is German text identifying the location as Gröba‑Riesa and mentioning a new harbor and chemical factory.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a tinted illustration of two women in long dresses seated on stone steps in front of ancient ruins. In the background is a small classical temple-like structure with columns, likely part of the Acropolis. French and Greek captions are printed in red, and there is handwriting and a circular seal near the bottom. The publisher information at the bottom reads that it is from Athens.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large motor ship at sea. The vessel has multiple masts and cargo gear, with a long white hull and superstructure amidships. Calm water fills the foreground, and partly cloudy sky is in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom: at left the company name and city, and at right the ship's name, indicating this is a promotional or commemorative postcard of the cargo/passenger ship M/S Meonia operated by The East Asiatic Company Ltd., based in Copenhagen.

A colorized view of a hilltop medieval stone castle ruin seen from a wooded foreground. Two large trees frame the image on the left and right, with dense green foliage and shrubs below. On the hill stands an elongated fortress wall with several square towers, partly collapsed, overlooking the surrounding landscape. In the top left corner, red printed text reads "Wesenberg Rakwere," indicating the location. The overall style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a large rectangular manor or small castle beside a pond. Leafless trees surround the multi‑storey building, which has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows. A swan is swimming in the foreground pond. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town with scattered houses, fields, and trees in the foreground. In the distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire and another large church-like building. The printed caption at the bottom center is in German, identifying the view as Dahlen from the Burgberg hill, and there is a publisher credit along the lower left edge.

Black-and-white postcard view of a European city square with tram tracks, market umbrellas, and rows of old gabled-roof buildings. In the background a steep, wooded hill rises, topped by a clock tower and fortification structures. The printed caption at the bottom reads "GRAZ HAUPTPLATZ m. SCHLOSSBERG". Additional signage on buildings includes "CAFE NORDST" and "Reise Artikel".

A multi-view vintage postcard with eight small colored photographs bordered in black, each showing different urban and waterfront scenes. Captions in a Scandinavian language label streets, the town square, harbor, a school for the deaf, the national bank, a panorama, and a waterside spot. At the bottom, large stylized white letters spell the city name "Wenersborg".

The image shows the address side of an old postal card printed in Russian with red pre‑printed text and lines, a red imperial double‑headed eagle emblem on the left, and handwritten address text in Latin script. A blue-green postage stamp at the upper right reads "EESTI POST" with a value of 15k and is cancelled with several circular postmarks that include the town name in Cyrillic and the date "15.2.19". The card is addressed to Tallinn (written in Latin script) and bears multiple postal markings.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a dense European town with many gabled roofs and chimneys, set in a hilly landscape. A tall church with a pointed spire dominates the right side of the skyline. At the top left is printed the caption "Hainichen i. Sa." in a decorative script, indicating the town's name.

Black‑and‑white street scene in a European small town or suburb, likely mid‑20th century. A narrow paved street with a pedestrian crossing runs into the background where low two‑story houses stand. On the left is a small utility or delivery vehicle with several men on board; a bicycle with a trailer and various pedestrians are visible. Old cars are parked along the street. On the right side is a larger building with signage and a child standing near the wall. Mature trees line the road, giving the scene a leafy, peaceful atmosphere.

A color-printed pastoral landscape showing several slender birch trees in the foreground beside a small stream or river. Beyond the trees lies a green meadow leading to a distant farmhouse with a red roof and surrounding trees, under a softly tinted sky at either sunrise or sunset. The style resembles an early 20th‑century painted or retouched rural scene.

Colorized historic postcard showing a tall bronze statue of a robed clergyman (Mgr. Hamer) on a large stone pedestal in a landscaped park or square. The base is decorated with many wreaths and floral arrangements, and a few people stand nearby. Trees and some buildings are visible in the background, under a clear blue sky. The top-left corner bears printed red text indicating the location and subject of the monument.

Colorized postcard view of an elaborate fountain installation in a landscaped park. Multiple water jets and sprays rise from a long rectangular basin surrounded by dense trees and shrubs. The sky is blue above the dark green woodland, and the tallest central fountain jet dominates the composition. At the top of the card, printed red text identifies the scene.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small steam‑boat pier on a calm body of water, with a tiny wooden pier house labeled "HÖGANÄS" on the roof. The pier projects from a stone embankment road. Behind it rise rocky, tree‑covered slopes and a terrace with a balustrade fence at the top. The overall look is rural and tranquil.

A vintage black‑and‑white harbor scene showing a small steam-powered boat in the foreground and larger ships moored along a quayside lined with multi‑story buildings and a church with a tall spire. A bridge crosses the river in the distance. The setting appears to be an urban waterfront. The printed captions read "HALMSTAD." in the upper left and "Hamnen." in the upper right.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑storey masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The corner building on the left has a small tower with a spire and clock‑like feature, and ground‑floor shopfronts with large windows. Painted signage on the façades advertises shops selling colonial goods, delicacies, tobacco, and cigars. A few pedestrians and a bicycle stand near the entrances; there are no cars visible.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a grey-blue background and ornate white frame around a small photograph labeled 'Bahnhof' showing a grand 19th‑century railway station building in winter. To the right, in large decorative script, it reads 'Gruss aus Reval' with a handwritten date '20. Sept. 1901'. The rest of the front is filled with dense cursive German handwriting.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a street scene labeled 'Trento – Via San Vigilio'. It depicts a Romanesque/medieval complex with a round apse on the left, crenellated palace walls, and two tall clock/bell towers along a wide street with pedestrians in early 20th‑century dress. There is cursive handwriting in ink over the sky area of the image.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a grand, white, two‑story courthouse with a central dome and cupola, surrounded by manicured trees and a few people on the grounds. The neoclassical building has arched windows and a pedimented entrance. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage stereoscopic postcard showing two nearly identical black-and‑white images of a classical stone gateway with tall fluted columns and entablature, part of an ancient ruin on a hill. Two men in early-20th‑century attire stand in the doorway. Beyond the gate, more ancient columns and the city below are visible. There is a small handwritten‑style caption in Greek beneath the images.

Colorized vintage view from a grand stone staircase with ornate railings and lampposts looking down into a lush city park. Several children stand at the balustrade overlooking a path lined with dense trees and decorative plantings. Printed red text in German appears at the bottom describing the location as the city park in Riesa on the Elbe, seen from the broad staircase.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone street in a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings on both sides. People in period clothing walk or stand along the street, including a uniformed figure in the foreground. In the distance rise two prominent Gothic church towers. German‑language shop signs are visible on the right side of the street. At the very bottom, upside down, appears a handwritten caption that looks like a place name and a number.

Monochrome vintage postcard showing a large Romanesque-style church with two tall, pointed-roof towers and several smaller gables. The church stands by a cobblestone square with trees in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom read "Freyburg a. U." on the left and "Kirche" on the right.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a mountain village in a valley, with scattered houses and a prominent church with a tall bell tower in the foreground. Behind the village rise dramatic rocky peaks of the Dolomites. At the bottom left, white cursive text printed on the image reads "Andalo m. 1070 (Dolomiti di Brenta)".

Colorized postcard view of a large white warship with three yellow funnels and tall masts, flying Swedish flags at bow and mast, lying at anchor near a shoreline with buildings in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads "Pansarbåten Fylgia."

Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a long paddle steamer full of passengers moving along a river in the foreground. On the steep bank behind it rises a large hilltop complex of Gothic and medieval-looking buildings with towers and spires, resembling a cathedral and castle ensemble. Below the hill stand smaller riverside houses and commercial buildings. The steamer's stern bears a clearly visible name, and there is a painted riverside advertisement on one of the buildings.

Colorized historic view of a railway station with people gathered on the platform and railcars at the tracks. A tree‑lined path and a narrow canal run along the left side, while in the background a conical stone tower and hillside with scattered buildings and cypress trees are visible. The caption at the top right identifies the scene as the Trento railway station and line to Malè.

A monochrome, early 20th‑century style image showing a very large crowd of men gathered in front of a long, two‑story building with arched windows. Many are wearing traditional Eastern European or Balkan rural clothing (sheepskin coats, caps, boots) while some are in military uniforms. Numerous horse‑drawn wagons with canvas covers stand in the foreground, and the scene appears to be a mass assembly or mobilization in a town square.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a decorative frame and German text. At the top it reads "BERGSTADT BRAND." The main illustration shows two traditionally dressed miners in ceremonial mining uniforms, standing on either side of a large coat of arms. The shield bears crossed mining hammers above what looks like a beehive or mound surrounded by many small dots, likely symbolizing ore or industry. Floral embellishments surround the composition. At the bottom is a printed German poem in red type, ending with the greeting "Glück Auf" and two crossed-hammer symbols.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a large stone church with a tall clock tower and steeply pitched roofs, standing on bare rocky ground. The image is captioned at the top with the name of the church and the city. A few small human figures walk among the rocks in the foreground, emphasizing the scale of the building.

A black‑and‑white winter street scene in a historic town. Snow covers the ground and roofs, bare trees line the left side behind a fence, and a row of wooden and masonry shopfronts with large display windows runs along the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the snowy street. The image has printed captions at the bottom indicating the place and publisher.

A hand-colored panoramic view of a European town with many low-rise buildings, greenery in the foreground, and a prominent large red-roofed church tower rising above the rooftops. The sky is softly tinted, and most of the lower part of the card is left blank for writing. German text identifying the town and publisher appears in red at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a row of old European-style houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The large building on the right has small-paned windows with shutters and notice boards mounted on the exterior wall at street level. There are a few pedestrians walking along a quiet, tree-lined street. The overall look is of a small town or village, likely in Central or Eastern Europe, photographed in the early to mid‑20th century.

Black-and-white view of a harbor scene taken from a boat, with rigging and part of the vessel visible in the foreground. Across the water are quays, cranes, industrial buildings, piles of lumber or raw materials, and a docked passenger or cargo ship. Forested hills rise behind the town. Caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom margin, along with a photographer/publisher credit.

Colorized view over a calm lake with a small rowboat carrying two people in the foreground. On the opposite shore there is a line of trees, a large light‑colored building with red roofs to the left, and a few small red wooden houses along the shoreline to the right. The sky is pale blue and beige, and printed text at the upper left reads "Savonlinna – Pääskylahti." The image has a worn, vintage look typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town along a river. On the left is a timber‑framed house built directly on a stone embankment; at center and right are several houses and a larger building behind trees. A road slopes upward from the riverside, with a low stone wall and fences. On the right spans an iron lattice footbridge or small road bridge across the river. Printed red text at the top identifies the town and vantage point; a red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a hillside in a European town, showing several large, old residential buildings with steep tiled roofs and many small rectangular windows. The left building has a small half‑timbered tower or bay and a stepped gable, while the right building has a curved, Baroque‑style gable. The houses are set above terraced gardens or vineyards overgrown with vegetation; in the foreground are lower rooftops with clay tiles and chimneys. The scene has an early‑20th‑century photographic style and no visible border text on the front.

Black-and-white winter scene showing a large alpine-style mountain hotel surrounded by deep snow and heavily snow-laden conifer trees, with mountains in the background. The building has steep gabled roofs and chimneys with smoke rising. Printed German text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Sepia-toned printed postcard showing a panoramic view over the dense historic cityscape of Cairo with many minarets and domes rising above low buildings. The style is early 20th‑century, with decorative serif captions printed in red at the top left and lower center. A publisher credit appears at the bottom left and a website watermark at the lower right.

Black-and-white photograph of a broad, quiet residential street lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century bourgeois townhouses and villas. The buildings have stucco facades, decorative cornices, and balconies with wrought‑iron railings. Trees and metal fences run along both sides of the street. A few pedestrians, including children, stand or walk along the unpaved road. In the distant background, gentle hills and a church spire or tall roof can be seen. The image has irregular black borders at the top, suggesting it is a reproduction of an old negative used as a postcard image.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide sandy beach with scattered bathers and beach furniture along a shoreline. On the left are large wooden pavilion-style seaside buildings nestled against trees, and in the distance a long pier with structures extends into the sea. The foreground architecture and the orderly beach scene suggest an early 20th‑century European spa resort. Printed German text appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal garden with a central shrub topped by a small statue, surrounded by paths and lush plants. In the background is a neoclassical building with columns and a veranda. Printed captions in French identify the location as Achilleion in Corfu, Greece, and there is a circular seal on the left plus a large website watermark at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden stave‑style church surrounded by tall trees, with an adjacent stone bell tower. The architecture has steep gabled roofs and multiple small spires. Printed caption text appears below the image, and there is a short handwritten note at the top margin.

Colorized historic postcard view of a town square with several adjoining multi‑story buildings in late 19th/early 20th century architectural style. The image shows shops at street level, ornate gables, tiled roofs and a small kiosk or guard hut in the middle of a largely empty market square. A few people, including women and children, are visible. Red printed captions at the top read the town and location name. German shop and restaurant signs are visible on the facades.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilltop Renaissance fortress or palace overlooking a small town with traditional gabled houses and dense trees in the foreground. The large multi‑winged building with corner towers dominates the skyline. Handwritten German text appears along the bottom margin.

Art Nouveau style illustration of an elegantly dressed woman walking two small brown dogs on leashes. She wears a long skirt, patterned blouse, large purple hat, white gloves, and holds a white parasol. The background is a speckled, decorative pattern rather than a real scene. At the lower right there is a stylized artist signature, and along the very bottom a black border with the white logo and text of "OÖ LANDES-KULTUR GMBH."

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town with many low houses, several factory chimneys, and a prominent church tower in the distance. In the foreground are trees and a park-like area. At the top, a red handwritten number '1583' appears. At the bottom, in red script, is a German caption identifying the town and viewpoint, and in small print at the lower left is the name of the publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped town park with lawns, flowerbeds, and tall trees framing a background of 19th‑century style town buildings. People are visible walking and sitting near the square. In the lower left corner there is a caption and in the lower right a small printer's logo with a number.

Black-and-white interior view of a rustic dining hall or restaurant with wooden tables and chairs, long tables covered with patterned cloths and potted plants, a wooden floor, and shelves at the back filled with bottles and glassware. Round decorative objects hang high on the walls, and two large hanging lamps are suspended from the ceiling. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge and a handwritten number is visible in the lower right corner.

A colorized illustration of a narrow, old European street lined with multi‑story stone buildings with shuttered windows and arcades at ground level. At the end of the street rises a tall, rectangular medieval tower with a crenellated top. A few small human figures are walking or riding along the otherwise quiet street. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing several sailing and cargo boats moored on a wide river with a low, tree‑lined riverbank and village buildings in the background. At the bottom left the caption reads "Nijmegen." and toward the right it reads "De Waal en Lent." There is a handwritten name across the bottom margin. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard with an oval photo framed by decorative reeds. The image shows a rural watermill complex (a mill building with a tiled roof) on a river or millpond, connected to the shore by a long wooden footbridge. Forested hills are visible in the background. Red printed captions in German appear on the front.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with 2–3 story plastered townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormers, typical of Central European small towns. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks, and in the distance two slender church towers rise above the rooftops. The scene feels calm and residential, with no visible motor traffic and no printed caption or border on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a corner building housing a café and wine tavern. The two‑storey house with a tiled gable roof and dormer windows stands on a street corner with an iron fence and small garden terrace where guests are seated. Long painted signs on the facade advertise "Stelzner's Kaffee- u. Wein-Stuben." A hanging sign at the entrance reads "Wein-Stuben Georg Stelzner." The surrounding buildings and streetlamps suggest an early 20th‑century Central European city.

Vintage black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a town market square. On the left stands an ornate town hall with a decorative gabled façade and a clock tower; on the right side of the square is a tall church with a pointed spire. Other multi‑storey townhouses line the square. The caption in red Gothic/Latin script at the top identifies the scene as the market with the town hall and church in Geringswalde.

Colorized vintage image of an ornate gated entrance to a lush municipal garden with tall palm trees and dense greenery. A few people in early 20th‑century colonial-style clothing walk through the gate. Along the bottom margin, printed captions identify the location and provide translations in Portuguese and English.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small European village with pitched‑roof houses, tree‑lined dirt streets, gardens, and fields stretching toward low hills in the background. The village name "Brockwitz" is printed in red script at the bottom center, while at the lower left in small type it reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen." A red handwritten number "1245" appears at the top right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph on the left and handwritten message on the right. The photo shows a woman standing by a rocky spring or cliff in a wooded landscape. At the bottom of the image is the caption "Parikkalan Lähteellä." Along the left border is printed "H. Heinosen Kirjakauppa." The right half is filled with cursive handwriting in Finnish, dated 1914 at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor café or beer garden set in a dense deciduous forest. Numerous folding metal chairs and tables with white tablecloths fill a clearing beneath tall trees. A few people, including women and children in mid‑20th‑century clothing, sit or stand among the tables. In the background are simple wooden pavilions or kiosks, and on the right a small covered bandstand or gazebo with a domed roof. Hanging lanterns or lights are visible among the trees.

Sepia-toned postcard-style illustration of a brewery complex with a decorative clock tower and attached buildings set against mountainous terrain. The façade carries large Italian inscriptions advertising a large beer hall with garden and a steam-powered brewery. The architecture suggests a late 19th–early 20th century Central European/Italian Alpine town.

Color-tinted early 20th‑century postcard showing a wooded hilltop with a fence and narrow track along the edge of an eroded clay pit or quarry. A small mining or transport cart sits on rails near the steep sandy cliff. The lower margin contains printed captions in Dutch and German, including place names and publisher information.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long truss bridge spanning a wide river, viewed from a cobblestone quay. In the foreground are several people standing near a horse-drawn cart and white railings by the water. A tall lamppost stands to the left. The caption at the bottom reads "NIJMEGEN. Pont en Brug".

A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a distant panoramic view over a wooded foreground toward a town with church towers and buildings nestled in a valley, with low hills in the background. The caption in red German text at the bottom identifies the scene as a view of Oliva from Karlsberg, and the publisher's line is printed in small type at the lower left.

Sepia-toned image showing a large castle complex with a tall round tower rising above surrounding trees and buildings. In the foreground there is a dirt road with a simple wooden fence and utility poles, bordered by meadows and dense woodland. The printed caption in German at the top left reads "Schloss Gnandstein b. Kohren." The overall style looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white view from a terrace with ornate balustrades and gas‑style streetlamps, showing an equestrian statue on a richly decorated pedestal in the foreground. Below is a formal garden and steps with several women in long dresses and hats, suggesting early 20th‑century fashion. In the background, across a wide river, stands a grand suspension bridge with stone towers leading into a dense cityscape of classical buildings stretching along the riverbank.

A black‑and‑white image showing a small rural church complex behind stone walls and trees. The main building has a steeply pitched roof with a cross on the ridge and simple rectangular windows. To the right stands a separate wooden bell tower with a distinctively shaped, tiered roof. In the foreground are low stone walls, a dirt road, and neatly laid garden paths leading toward the churchyard.

A vintage, sepia-toned aerial view over a lakeside town. In the foreground there is a densely built settlement with low houses, narrow streets and scattered trees. Beyond the town lies a wide lake with a mountainous, barren shore on the opposite side. The overall style and tone suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. A small printed number appears in the bottom left corner, and a web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed across the lower right.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of an Italian piazza featuring a large baroque fountain topped by a statue of Neptune, surrounded by mythological figures. Behind it stands a richly frescoed Renaissance building with arched porticoes at street level and shuttered windows above, alongside a domed church. The handwritten caption along the bottom identifies the scene and has a scalloped postcard border.

Black‑and‑white streetscape showing a European city square with a small park, leafless trees, cobblestone streets and tram tracks. A single electric tramcar travels through the intersection. On the left is an ornate neo‑Gothic facade; in the center background stands a large classical railway‑station‑like building with a clock above the main entrance, and behind it a broad iron‑and‑glass train shed. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. A round advertising column stands at the right edge of the image.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town surrounded by trees and fields. In the foreground is a landscaped park or garden with paths, lawns, shrubs, and several very tall flagpoles. In the middle distance stand low houses with pitched roofs, and in the center background a church tower with a clock and spire rises above the town. The word "Radeburg." is printed in red in the upper left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street in a European town. On both sides are early‑20th‑century townhouses and shopfronts with German signage. In the background stands a tall church tower with clock and slender spire dominating the streetscape. A horse‑drawn carriage is traveling along the street toward the foreground. The scene is quiet, with no motor cars visible.

Sepia-toned image showing a neoclassical complex with a grand central building featuring a columned portico and sweeping curved staircases, flanked by long rectangular wings with rows of columns or tall windows. The architecture is monumental and formal, occupying a large open square or plaza in the foreground. At the bottom right faint text reads "Library - Athens," and at the lower left a circular seal or logo is visible. A web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the lower part of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a sloping road bordered by a steep, grassy embankment on the right and dense trees on the left. A horse-drawn carriage and a few pedestrians travel along the curving street toward a small building at the bottom of the hill, with a river and wooded landscape visible in the distance. Printed captions at the bottom read the city name and the street name.

Black‑and‑white view down a narrow cobbled lane leading to an arched gate in an old masonry complex dominated by a tall round tower with a domed roof and small lantern on top. Leafless tree branches frame the scene on the left, and simple plastered houses with tiled roofs line the right side. On the left front side there is a wooden fence with a signboard projecting over the lane. The overall appearance suggests an early‑20th‑century European town scene focused on a historic tower and gateway.

Black-and-white postcard view of an urban square with a large ornamental pool and balustraded terraces in the foreground. Several people stand by the water. In the background are rows of multi-story Haussmann-style buildings lining a broad street, and trees without leaves frame the scene. Printed caption text runs along the bottom border.

Vintage divided-view postcard with two tinted photographs of a harbor. The upper image, labeled in German "Hafen" (harbor), shows a wooden pier with rail tracks running along it, leading toward moored sailing ships and steam vessels at sunset. The lower image, labeled "Die Rhede" (the roadstead), depicts several ships anchored offshore on a calm sea beneath pastel clouds. In the center of the card between the views appears the caption "Port Kunda".

A black‑and‑white view of a vaulted Gothic arcade with pointed arches supported by sturdy stone columns. One side is lined with rough masonry wall, the other opens to a courtyard or street where a cart wheel is faintly visible. The perspective looks along the length of the covered walkway toward an opening with light and distant buildings. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century architectural photograph possibly reproduced as a postcard. Some faint, handwritten numbers or marks appear along the lower left edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide street and a large, symmetrical school building in front of a hilly townscape. The multi‑storey structure has a stone base, tall rectangular windows, and a central entrance with small columns. Behind it, a hill dotted with houses rises, topped by a prominent church building. Handwritten Hungarian text appears at the bottom of the image, identifying the location and the institution.

Black-and-white image of a grand, symmetrical Beaux-Arts style palace-like building with richly ornamented façades, domed corner pavilions, and a central section topped by a flagpole and dome. In front lies a formal garden with winding gravel paths, manicured flowerbeds, shrubs, and small trees. A few people in early-20th‑century clothing stroll or stand on the paths. The sky area is blank and there are no visible inscriptions or border decorations on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a Central European industrial town with several factory buildings and tall smokestacks in the foreground, surrounded by houses, fields, and a wooded hill in the background. At the top of the image are printed captions in German identifying the location as Warnsdorf in Bohemia and the hill as Spitzberg.

A monochrome postcard showing a large Romanesque brick church with a long nave and a tall multi‑tiered bell tower ending in a spire. The building stands alone beside an empty square or street. Below the image there is a printed caption in Russian describing the location and the church.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small Central European town square, showing tiled-roof houses, a central open square with people and a column or monument, and two prominent church towers—one with a slender spire and one with an onion-shaped dome. The scene is surrounded by low-rise historic buildings, with distant fields and hills in the background. Printed text at the bottom in red and smaller black type identifies the town and publisher.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard with scalloped edges showing a calm river bordered by reeds in the foreground, reflecting a sandstone cliff and dense coniferous trees in the background. At the bottom, printed captions identify the location, and a small printer's logo and number appear in the lower left.

Sepia-toned vintage image showing a group of barefoot children standing outdoors in simple, worn clothing. The background appears to be a rural village with huts or simple structures. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads "Pungo-Andongo" and at the bottom right "Crianças da Villa No. 2" in Portuguese.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large, ornate two‑storey villa or civic building in a landscaped park. The structure has light brick walls with strong stone corner quoins, a low hipped roof edged by a decorative balustrade, and symmetrical windows with classical pediments. A curved entrance canopy projects above a grand staircase with stone balustrades, leading from a gravel drive bordered by small palms and shrubs. Mature trees and dense foliage frame the view, suggesting a city park or garden setting. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.

A sepia-toned, vintage street view labeled at the top with the words 'Trento - Corso S. Croce'. The image shows a long, straight avenue bordered by tall trees and stone posts, leading toward a cluster of buildings and a church-like structure in the distance. Snow is visible on the ground and on the mountains that rise in the background, suggesting a winter scene in an Alpine town.

Sepia-toned landscape postcard showing a tranquil pond or small lake with reflections in the water, bordered by trees and a meadow. In the background rises a rocky sandstone ridge covered with forest. The scene is natural and quiet, with no visible buildings. Red printed German text appears at the top naming the location.

A sepia-toned postcard view of a riverside town with a large Gothic cathedral and castle complex on a hill above the Elbe River. In the foreground, a long barge moves along the water. Below the image, white caption text identifies the location as Meissen on the Elbe, showing Albrechtsburg Castle and the cathedral (Dom).

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European city with dense pitched-roof houses in the foreground and a steep rocky hill rising behind them. On top of the hill stands a fortress complex with walls and buildings, while on the right side of the hill there is a prominent clock tower with a large clock face. A long staircase ascends the hillside. The surrounding area features rolling hills in the distance.

Black-and-white winter scene showing a wooden church with a tall, slender spire and weather vane, surrounded by snow-covered trees and a graveyard behind a fence. Deep snow blankets the roof, gateposts, and gravestones. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A sepia-toned portrait of a young man in an ornate military dress uniform, facing the camera with arms crossed. The uniform features braided cords, medals, and decorations on the chest and shoulders. Greek text and French text identifying him as a crown prince appear at the top. At the bottom is a small printed website address and a reference number.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑storey institutional building with mansard roofs and decorative gables, fronted by an iron fence and gate along a street where a few people are walking. The right side and lower part of the card contain handwritten text. Printed text in Hungarian appears vertically along the left margin and at the upper right.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a grand spa promenade lined with ornate cast‑iron colonnades and domed pavilions. Crowds in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the wide walkways. On the right is a straight avenue with horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians, flanked by multi‑story buildings with balconies. In the distance are wooded hills and scattered villas typical of a Central European spa town.

An old black-and-white postcard showing a large wooden railway station building in a Nordic architectural style, with steep gabled roofs and ornate detailing. A crowd of people stands in front of the station, and there are lampposts and some outbuildings visible. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text identifying the station, and there is handwritten cursive text across the bottom of the image.

Monochrome reproduction of a painting showing a two‑storey rectangular building along a curved road or square, with trees surrounding it. The building carries a large flag on a tall pole at the roof ridge. In front are people walking, a child with a dog, and a horse‑drawn carriage. The scene appears 19th‑century, semi‑rural or small‑town European. The image is bordered like an old printed card, with worn corners but no visible writing on the front.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a broad, unpaved road lined with multi‑story townhouses and commercial buildings. Several people stand and walk along the sidewalks. On the left is a long building with a large painted sign. In the distance a tall industrial-looking chimney or tower rises above the rooftops. Printed caption text appears at the top, and a business sign is visible on the left facade.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an outdoor gymnastics or acrobatic display in front of a crowd. Men dressed in dark tops and light trousers perform human pyramids and shoulder stands on a grassy field, while spectators watch from stands and balconies of nearby buildings. Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a Spanish‑Mission style arched bell wall and courtyard. Multiple women in long Edwardian-era dresses pose on and around the arches and in the bell niches. Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled town square with late‑19th‑century buildings. In the center stands a large statue of a man in a long coat on a high pedestal inscribed "ALBERT." Black‑and‑white printed postcard view of a riverside street in a historic European town. At left a small bridge crosses a shallow river, with wooded hills in the background. Colorized vintage postcard showing a large white building complex with red tiled roofs, surrounded by trees and a low white fence. A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a large stone church in a Neo-Romanesque style with a tall square bell tower topped by a steep spire, clock faces on the tower, arched windows, round turrets, and a grand entrance with arches. A black‑and‑white maritime view showing several tall-masted sailing ships and a side‑wheel or river-style steamship emitting a large plume of smoke. A black-and-white, early-20th-century style postcard showing a large red-brick institutional building in neo-Gothic style behind a tall wrought-iron fence and brick pillars. Several women, children, and a few men stand or walk along the cobbled street in front of the gate, suggesting a school, orphanage, or hospital setting. A monochrome panoramic view over a small European town surrounded by fields and low mountains, seen from a slightly elevated, wooded foreground. A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. The foreground shows ploughed farmland, and the background is hilly countryside. The upper sky area of the card appears damaged or overexposed, leaving a bright white band across the top portion of the image. There is no legible printed caption or handwriting visible.

Monochrome illustrated postcard showing a dramatic front view of a steam locomotive rushing toward the viewer on railway tracks that emerge from the pages of a large open book. Black‑and‑white image of a Gothic ruin in a forested setting. Colorized vintage postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground two children in traditional Alpine-style clothing stand on a riverside path with a wooden railing. Across the river are grand multi‑story buildings and a bridge. Behind the city rises a steep hill topped with fortifications and towers. The river flows through the middle of the scene. The printed caption in red at the top right reads "Graz. Mur, Schlossberg."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestoned square framed by historic multi‑storey buildings with shuttered windows. In the center stands a tall baroque column or monument surrounded by greenery. At the far side of the square a grand building with an arched gateway opens toward a street. On the hillside behind the square rises a clock tower on a wooded hill. The scene is quiet with only a few small figures walking. Printed caption text appears at the top left of the image.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing an uphill street lined with trees on the left and ornate late‑19th‑century/early‑20th‑century buildings on the right. In the distance there is a church-like structure with a dome or tower. The printed caption at the top in red letters reads "PÉCS." on the left and "Kardos Kálmán-utca." on the right.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard-style image showing a coastal scene with a fortified tower beside the sea, palm trees, rocky shore, and people with donkeys or goats along the beach. In the distance there are further fortifications on a headland. The image is mounted on a card with French caption text printed below.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large town market square with rows of historic multi‑story buildings along one side. At left is a town hall–like building with a clock and an onion‑shaped dome tower. The open square is filled with carts, vendors' stalls, people walking, and a central fountain and lamp post. Low hills rise in the distance. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the market in Leitmeritz.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing the aftermath of a serious railway accident. Several steam locomotives and railcars are derailed and piled up amid scattered debris. Sepia-toned vintage image of a wide sandy beach with a long wooden pier or bathing pavilion on stilts extending over the shoreline. Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story historicist buildings with ornate facades. Several horse-drawn carts and wagons are scattered around the empty square, with only a few pedestrians visible. Prominent signage on two buildings identifies them as hotels. The scene evokes a Central European town around the early 20th century.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural village scene with a pond or spring-fed pool in the foreground where many ducks or geese are swimming. The caption at the bottom in German reads "Gruss aus Luppa." and "Quellteich", with a publisher line mentioning Paul Lehr in Dahlem.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a two‑storey municipal building with a central tower and clock, surrounded by trees and benches in a small square or garden. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the municipal chamber in Praia, Cabo Verde.

A black‑and‑white coastal landscape showing rocky shoreline and sea under a bright sun or moon reflecting on the water. In the foreground several sheep graze on dark grassland. Text is printed along the bottom edge indicating the location and photographer.

Black‑and‑white riverfront view of a European city, showing a wide stone staircase lined with trees descending to quays with several steamships moored along the river. Black‑and‑white historic street view showing the facade of a multi‑storey brick and stone building with an ornate arched entrance on the left. Black-and-white postcard photograph showing a man standing on a concrete stairway and bridge built into a steep rocky hillside. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy street scene framed by a large ancient stone arch. Printed captions at the top identify the location as Rue Egnatin/Egnatia street and an Arch of triumph in Salonique/Salonica.

Colorized historic view of a railway station with steam locomotives, tracks, platforms, and station buildings. An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century mansion or villa in a park-like setting, surrounded by leafless trees. The house has steep roofs, decorative gables, and tall windows. Printed text appears in the lower right corner.

An official beige postal card formatted as a telephone bill or payment notice. Colorized vintage view across a rocky riverbed toward a large riverside hotel complex nestled among forested hills. A long metal pedestrian or light-traffic bridge crosses the river in the foreground. At the top, printed red text in Romanian identifies the hotel and viewpoint.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a stone castle tower complex partly hidden by trees in a landscaped park. A winding path bordered by a low stone wall leads towards the castle. At the top, printed German text reads "Schloß Stolpen i. Sa. Koselturm."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the entrance gate and walls of a fortress with a large rocky hill and stronghold rising behind it. Several people are standing or walking near the gate. Sepia-toned postcard view of a large Renaissance castle complex beside a river, with round corner towers, a central multi‑storey block, and a tall stair-tower. Black‑and‑white photograph of a small piazza dominated by a stone church with a tall campanile clock tower. Black-and-white postcard showing a large historical hall with a wooden beamed ceiling, plain plaster walls, tall arched windows and simple wooden tables and chairs arranged along the walls and in the center. Sepia-toned panoramic view over fields with young trees in the foreground and a small town in the background. German text is printed in the upper left corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a palm‑lined residential street in Southern California. Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard showing a tall stone war memorial obelisk topped with an eagle, standing in a wooded park and surrounded by a low barrier of short stone posts and chains. German text is printed in red at the top identifying the location and the monument. On the front face of the monument there is a dark dedication plaque with smaller German inscription.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town nestled in rolling hills and fields. Surrounding the town are forests and patchwork farmland; the foreground shows a grassy slope with a few standalone houses or farm buildings. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a wide curved sandy beach bordered by dense pine forest and low hills. Vintage multi-view postcard with sepia and pastel-colored illustrations of several city landmarks arranged decoratively with flowers and a heraldic shield. Black‑and‑white winter scene of a snowy village or mountain settlement. Deep snow covers the ground, trees, and rooftops. Power lines stretch between the buildings, and a dense forest appears in the distant background. The image has the aesthetic and composition typical of an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph shows a small reflective pond surrounded by dense bushes and low forested hills. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town taken from fields in the foreground. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a covered market square with an obelisk-like fountain in the center. Around it is a colonnaded structure forming a rectangular courtyard. Color photograph of a large open-air stadium built almost entirely of pale stone with continuous oval seating tiers. In the center is a green football (soccer) field surrounded by a running track. Black‑and‑white image showing a traditional felt-covered yurt mounted on a large two‑wheeled cart on an open grassy plain. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural townscape with cultivated fields in the foreground and a row of trees leading toward a cluster of traditional houses. Sa."

Tinted vintage postcard showing a tranquil canal or lake bordered by trees and grassy banks. In the foreground several swans, both white and black, glide on the water. A tinted studio portrait of a young woman with wavy hair and braids, seated and holding large pale flowers. A hand-colored panoramic view of a European town seen from a field in the foreground. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European riverside town. A broad river with several boats and a paddle steamer runs through the foreground, bordered by stone embankments and sandy banks. A black-and-white postcard showing a forest landscape with tall conifer trees and a winding dirt path leading into the woods. In the background are rolling, forested hills under a cloudy sky. At the bottom margin there is printed German text indicating the location and elevation.

A color-tinted vintage postcard showing a rural scene on a hilly island covered with pine trees. A colorized historic street scene showing Broerstraat in Nijmegen, with narrow brick townhouses lining a curved cobblestone street. People are walking and a cyclist rides toward the viewer. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Orthodox church with onion domes in the foreground and a large grand hotel complex on a hill in the background. The caption at the top identifies the view as the new Russian Church and the Imperial Hotel in Nice.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance style building on a corner square. A sepia-toned aerial view of a historic European city dominated by a large castle complex with a prominent Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires (St. Vitus Cathedral) within a fortified area on a hill (Prague Castle). A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large flock of ostriches in a dusty, fenced paddock. A vintage sepia-toned postcard bordered in beige, showing a rural scene with many tall palm trees and cultivated fields in the foreground. Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small town by a lake. In the foreground are wooden houses, farms, and buildings along dirt roads. Fields and gardens surround the settlement. A monochrome view of a stone interior passageway or corridor, likely within an old fortress or religious structure. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a small Byzantine church surrounded by a low metal fence on a street corner. Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an industrial harbor with docks, warehouses, rail tracks and ore wagons in the foreground, and multiple cargo ships in a bay in the background. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone main street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings on both sides. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European spa or resort town nestled in a valley with forested hills in the background.
