Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town seen from a sloping field in the foreground. Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, rural valley. Black-and-white postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a lake surrounded by dense forest and scattered villages in a mountainous region. Snow-capped peaks rise in the background. A black-and-white postcard view of a large Baroque-style castle set on a wooded hillside. A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a gently sloping cobblestone street lined with two‑ to three‑story townhouses. People, including women with prams and children, walk along the street. Black‑and‑white landscape view over a wooded area with a large wooden church featuring steep roofs and a distinctive bulbous spire on the left, and a sizeable wooden residential or civic building with a metal roof on the right. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a pavilion-like spa building with a conical roof and surrounding colonnade, set among trees. In front there is a landscaped flowerbed, a low railing and a small fountain with a bird sculpture. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right.

A color-tinted illustration of a railway station at sunset or sunrise. Illustrated maritime scene showing an icebreaker ship named "MURTAJA" steaming through sea ice, with dark smoke rising from its funnels. A black‑and‑white photograph of an early 20th‑century steamship at sea, viewed in full side profile. A vintage decorative postcard with a textured, fuzzy horseshoe shape in light blue with dark red ends, overlaid on a colorful floral motif featuring a prominent pink rose and smaller blue flowers. On the right side, there is ornate script text printed diagonally.

Colorized historic postcard view over a European town with many red-tiled roofs. In the right foreground stands a tall stone church tower with a green domed roof. A colored illustration of a large neoclassical building with a prominent golden dome, surrounded by trees and landscaped grounds. Black-and-white aerial photograph of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by curtain walls and corner towers, set above a patchwork of agricultural fields and winding country roads in a wide valley. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a busy railway station building with a platform crowded by people in early 20th‑century clothing. Sepia-toned postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic brick manor or palace on a raised hill. A broad staircase leads up from the lawn to an ornate double stair and terrace at the central entrance. A color illustration in classical religious style showing a young Jesus teaching in the Temple among a group of older men dressed in robes. Jesus, with a halo, stands in the center speaking, while the scholars around him listen, read from scrolls and books, and gesture in discussion. The background suggests the interior of an ancient temple or synagogue with columns and dim lighting.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a park scene in winter with bare trees, people walking along a snowy path, and a large traditional windmill on a hill in the background. The printed captions read "HÖGA MÖLLA." at the top center and "Malmö." at the top right.

A colorized vintage view over a Nordic fishing town's harbor. Small wooden boats float in a calm bay lined with quays and piers. On the opposite shore stands a dense cluster of wooden houses, many with bright red roofs, among bare rocky hills. A tall, slender‑spire church dominates the skyline on the right. In the foreground, a coastal road and simple sheds follow the rocky shoreline, with scattered building materials and a few vehicles, giving an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century feel.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural village scene with a Protestant church featuring a tall spire and arched windows, surrounded by trees and several farm-style buildings in the foreground. The image is framed by a white border, and a printed caption appears underneath in Dutch.

A color postcard showing a large modernist building with dark glass and concrete, characterized by a polygonal upper volume with sloping curtain walls and a broad, stepped base. People walk across an open paved plaza in the foreground, where numerous national flags are displayed on poles. On the roof terrace of the building are rows of sun loungers and umbrellas with several people relaxing. The architecture suggests a conference or cultural center from the late 20th century in an urban setting.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly river valley with fields, factories with chimneys, railway tracks and small town buildings surrounded by forests. At the top left corner there is printed German text identifying the scene as a view of the Mulde valley at Leisnig.

Color postcard view of a lush city park with many trees, shrubs, and flowerbeds. A curved gravel path runs through the foreground, bordered by low posts and wire fencing. On the right stands a white pedestal with a bust statue (the Schiller monument) partly framed by greenery. Printed red text at the top identifies the location in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional half‑timbered mill building in a wooded rural setting. A fenced water channel or mill race runs in front of the house, with large trees partly obscuring the facade. The caption at the bottom reads "Gruß aus der Schiebekmühle" (Greetings from the Schiebekmühle). There is a small sign on the building and a few indistinct figures near the entrance.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a straight, tree‑lined avenue receding into the distance toward low buildings at the base of a large forested hill or mountain. The view is taken from behind a stone balustrade, likely from a bridge or terrace, with decorative streetlamps featuring multiple round globes visible in the foreground and along the street. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn or early motor vehicle are on the road. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.

Color postcard showing an interior courtyard with three stories of arcaded loggias in Renaissance style, surrounding an open space. A small domed pavilion with a green roof and stairway appears on the left. The building has a steep red-tiled roof with dormer windows. At the bottom front is a printed caption identifying the scene.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing several large passenger steamships in a harbor. Two ships dominate the foreground, one moored on the right with gangways to the quay and another moving or berthed on the left. Additional ships and harbor structures are visible in the background. The scene is calm, with gentle water and a hazy sky. Printed caption text appears at the bottom-left of the front image.

A vintage monochrome winter scene showing a snow-covered path leading downhill between heavily laden fir trees toward a chalet-style building in the distance. Mountains or hills are visible on the horizon. On the right side there is printed handwritten-style text in German giving the location and elevation.

Commemorative illustrated postcard honoring a Catholic bishop. In the center is an oval portrait of an elderly clergyman in black cassock with red piping and a pectoral cross, framed by a green oval with a bishop's coat of arms and mitre above. Dates 1875 and 1925 appear below the portrait, and 1899 and 1924 above, indicating jubilees. On the left is a church with a tall spire set against mountains; on the right stands an angel holding an image of cherubs. Decorative panels with angels run along the top, and a chalice-like element and draped garlands frame the lower part. Below the illustration is German text dedicated to Dr. Paul Wilhelm von Keppler, Bishop of Rottenburg.

An illustrated historical scene in winter showing King Charles IX (Kaarle IX / Karl den IX) on horseback in fur-trimmed clothing, meeting a delegation of peasants. The peasants, dressed in simple 17th‑century garments, approach respectfully, some holding documents. In the background stands a large stone church or castle-like building and additional figures. The caption in Finnish and Swedish is printed along the bottom margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a view from an ornate, arched loggia with stone columns and balustrade, looking out over the rooftops and church spires of a town surrounded by mountains. The image has a printed caption at the bottom naming the location and publisher information along the lower edge.

Vintage monochrome image of a harbor waterfront with sailing ships and small boats docked along a pier. Several people stand on the open quay, and a group of men, some seated and some standing beside a horse, are posed in the foreground. The card has printed captions in Greek and in Latin script, including a place name and the word 'Grecia', and a circular emblem or seal on the left.

A monochrome postcard view of a town square with historic buildings. On the left stands a tall tower with a spire and a clock on its façade, attached to lower residential and commercial houses. Along the ground floors, signs advertise shops and a hotel-restaurant. On the right is a large stepped‑gabled building with the sign "Ratskeller," suggesting a town hall complex. The square in front is mostly empty, with a few small figures of people. At the top in red print is the caption indicating the town and the market square.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large hilltop castle with multiple towers and ramparts, surrounded by defensive walls and overlooking a valley. The central building is rectangular with many small windows and sloped roofs, set against distant mountains. The title 'CASTEL CLES (Val di Non)' is printed in red at the top right, with a faint handwritten date or note beside it. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, as typical for early picture postcards.

Black‑and‑white view over a small fishing harbor filled with wooden boats and sheds, with clusters of wooden houses climbing the rocky shoreline. In the foreground are boathouses and moored sailing vessels; behind them, tightly packed homes stand against a backdrop of low, bare rocky hills. The word "HOVENÄSET" appears in the lower left, and a small triangular publisher's mark with text is in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural church with a bell tower and attached buildings in an alpine meadow. Behind it are forested hills or low mountains. The church has a simple plastered exterior, a steep shingled roof and a square bell tower topped with a pointed spire and cross. Next to it is a two‑storey house or guesthouse with shutters and dormer windows; a mid‑20th‑century car is parked in front. A large tree stands in the foreground and wild grass covers the field. The scene is quiet and pastoral, with no visible people. A signboard appears above the entrance of the right‑hand building, but the text is too small to read.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an indoor swimming pool with swimmers in the lanes. The pool hall has a flat, low ceiling with repeating square panels, a large wall covered in small rectangular tiles forming an abstract pattern, and an entire long side made of tall grid‑framed windows looking out onto a river or canal and distant buildings. Metal railings line the windows, and there are benches and plants along the poolside. A rectangular sign in German is visible near the windows.

Colorized vintage view of a large military supply and barracks area with wooden huts and warehouses. Soldiers, wagons loaded with crates, and an early motor ambulance with a red cross are visible. The scene shows an organized encampment with dirt roads and many stacked boxes in the foreground. At the top center, there is red printed text in French.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town with dense, traditional gabled houses surrounded by trees and farmland. In the middle distance a long arched viaduct or bridge crosses the landscape; beyond it are open fields and wooded hills. At the top of the card there is a printed caption in German identifying the locale.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large ornate university building behind a formal city park with paths, lawns, and flowerbeds. The building has arched windows, decorative brickwork, corner towers, and a central dome-like structure on the roof. At the bottom margin of the image, German text identifies the scene as the university in Riga.

A black‑and‑white winter street scene in a small town, with snow covering the ground and wooden houses lining both sides of the road. A lone person is visible in the distance. Printed caption text appears in the upper left corner of the image.

A color postcard showing a wide boulevard lined with low‑rise, rectangular apartment blocks in a planned housing estate. There is a broad grassy median and open lawns, with a few small trees. Several mid‑20th‑century cars drive along the road under simple curved streetlamps. The architecture is stark, uniform, and functional, typical of socialist-era prefabricated housing. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds, and there is no printed title or caption visible on the front.

A vintage tinted view of the Step Pyramid in the desert at sunset, with a few small human figures and a camel in the foreground. The border is cream-colored and includes printed captions in a decorative script at the top and bottom.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing an arched city gate integrated into adjoining buildings on a cobbled street. Above the arch is a small balcony and a pavilion-like structure with shuttered windows. Two boys stand at the left side of the arch while a figure walks through the passageway. Printed German text appears beneath the image, and a red handwritten number is at the right edge.

A monochrome postcard view of a large brick convent complex enclosing a formal garden with flowerbeds, paths, and a low fence in the foreground. The long façade has many evenly spaced windows and dormers set into a steep roof, with small spires and a church section with a cross visible to the right. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene as an English convent and monastery in Bruges, and there is a handwritten note along the upper margin.

A hand‑colored historic postcard showing a tree‑lined street with an elegant two‑story villa named Villa Bechler. The house has light walls, green shutters, ornate wrought‑iron balcony and veranda, and a small front garden behind an iron fence. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk on the sidewalk. In the background a church spire rises above the trees. Printed captions and publisher information appear along the bottom border.

A color postcard showing a busy outdoor café terrace filled with people seated closely together under tall closed yellow umbrellas. Leafless trees stand among the tables, and in the background are brick and glass buildings with shop and bar signs, including a circular Heineken sign. The image is framed with a colored border on a white card, and the word 'Nijmegen' is printed below the picture.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a long, two‑storey railway station building with multiple chimneys and arched ground‑floor windows, seen from across several sets of train tracks. A steam locomotive with tender is standing near the station. The card has printed German captions at the bottom and a brief handwritten note at the top.

A colorized vintage waterfront scene showing a busy quay with many small boats moored along the edge and people walking on the promenade. Low-rise buildings line the waterfront, with a taller tower visible in the distance on the right. The caption at the bottom reads "Port-Said. Quai François Joseph." and there is a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" over the water.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional Old-World tavern or beer hall. The room is filled with carved wooden tables and high-backed chairs with clover-shaped openings. Along the wall hang medieval-style polearms, swords, and helmets. Behind a wooden counter is a bar area with shelves full of beer steins and jugs, framed by wrought-iron work and an arched niche. Decorative lanterns, flowers in vases, and a large tiled stove or heater are also visible, creating a rustic historic atmosphere.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a mid‑20th‑century cargo or tanker ship at sea, viewed from the port side. The vessel has multiple masts, cargo booms, and a prominent central superstructure with a dark funnel. The sea is relatively calm and the sky is overcast and empty. The name "TEXAS" is painted on the bow and also faintly visible amidships. No other clear landmarks or coastline are visible.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a forested coastal village on a bay, showing scattered wooden houses, boathouses along the shoreline, farmlands in the distance, and a winding road leading inland. Printed white captions appear along the bottom edge of the image.

An old colorized postcard view of a flat Dutch polder landscape with drainage canals and grassy fields. Two large traditional wooden windmills dominate the scene, one in the center-left foreground and another in the right background near the canal. A few small buildings stand beside the windmills. Printed red text at the top left reads the location, and there are several handwritten notes and dates in dark ink across the bottom and right edges of the image.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a coastal town beneath a rocky hill crowned by a large fortification or barracks-like complex. The shoreline is lined with low buildings facing a calm harbor. Handwritten Greek text covers the upper and lower margins. Printed captions at the bottom include the French phrase "Vue de Nauplie" and a Greek place name on the left.

Black-and-white postcard view of a colonial-era building partially obscured by tall trees and palm trees, set in lush tropical vegetation. The structure has a gabled roof, veranda, and appears to be a public or commercial building. Printed caption text runs along the bottom border.

Sepia-toned landscape view of a sandy and heath-covered hill, with low vegetation and a gently sloping terrain. The style and coloration resemble an early 20th‑century printed postcard. At the bottom, there is a caption in Dutch identifying the location as the Papenberg on the Mookerheide near Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white vintage image showing a small railway station building with a steep tiled roof and several chimneys. The facade bears the name "STANGE" in large letters, and people are standing on the platform beside benches, lamps, and bicycles. Railway tracks run along the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Stange Jernbanestation." Trees and a tall chimney are visible in the background.

A colored vintage postcard view showing an ornate Ottoman baroque fountain with multiple small domes and finials in the foreground, and to the left a large stone gate or wall section of a fortification. Behind them is a waterfront with the sea or a strait and a distant shoreline covered with low hills and buildings. At the bottom margin, printed captions in red identify the location as Constantinople and specify the Sultan Ahmed fountain in French.

A black‑and‑white image showing a long canal barge moored along a waterfront lined with narrow, tall brick townhouses. The houses have stepped and ornate gables, tiled roofs, large sash windows with curtains, and ground‑floor shopfronts, typical of historic Dutch canal architecture. The calm water in the foreground reflects the boat and façades.

A black‑and‑white historic city view showing a busy European square with horse‑drawn carriages and early streetcars in front of a large ornate Neo‑Baroque/Art Nouveau style bank building. The bank has a central dome, statuary on the roofline, and the word "SPARKASSE" above the main entrance and clock. Surrounding it are dense late‑19th‑century townhouses and commercial buildings with steep roofs and shop awnings. In the background, hillside villas and grand hotels rise up a wooded slope, indicating a spa or resort town setting.

A monochrome postcard view of a European city square. On the left is a church with a tall pointed steeple labeled as the Evangelical Church. On the right is a large ornate neoclassical building with columns and statues, facing a busy square filled with market stalls and umbrellas. The caption at the top identifies the scene as Kaiser Josef-Platz in Graz.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large stone statue on a high pedestal in a park or garden. The statue depicts a seated figure (Lord Byron) with a female allegorical figure embracing him from behind. There are trees and low fences in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom in English and Greek, and a web watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is visible across the lower-right portion of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden church-like building with a steep gabled roof and arched windows, set on a grassy clearing bordered by dense forest. To the right stands a wooden bell tower structure and some small rustic buildings. Handwritten-style Swedish text is printed along the bottom margin identifying the location and publisher.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large gabled historic building with a clock tower and belfry, standing on the edge of a cobbled town square. Several pedestrians walk across the open square, and surrounding buildings display late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European architecture. The caption in the upper left reads "Zwickau, Gewandhaus."

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European town taken from a grassy hillside with a dirt road in the foreground. Laundry hangs on long lines between young trees. Below, open meadows lead to dense rows of late‑19th‑century townhouses and villas with steep roofs and ornate façades. In the background, on slightly higher ground, stands a large church with a tall, slender spire dominating the skyline. Forested hills rise behind the town.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large, fortress‑like historic complex with high plain walls and steep gabled tiled roofs. The building has many small rectangular windows, several chimneys, a corner tower with a steep roof, and a domed turret with a cross. It is surrounded by high perimeter walls and leafy trees in the foreground; no people or vehicles are visible. The style suggests a Central European castle or palace adapted to later uses. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an amusement park building and a wooden roller coaster. The foreground is an unpaved road with a few people walking and pushing a cart. The main building has an ornate façade with a sign on top reading "LUNA PARK." The printed caption at the bottom reads "HELIOPOLIS - Luna Park." There is also a modern watermark with a website address.

Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a small railway station named Melluži. A steam locomotive with a line of carriages stands by the platform while passengers in early 20th‑century clothing wait or walk along the platform. The station is a wooden building with a covered platform, surrounded by trees and telegraph poles. The station name appears on a sign above the platform, and the handwritten caption "MellužI" is at the bottom of the card.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing an arcaded walkway with vaulted ceilings along a town square. Sunlight creates strong contrasts of light and shadow, with a small child standing in a bright patch of light under one of the arches. To the left, beyond the arches, are cobblestone streets, historic multi‑story buildings, and several early‑ to mid‑20th‑century cars. Potted plants and a lantern hang from the arcade ceiling. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black-and-white street view of a European town showing a corner apartment block with balconies along a cobblestone street. A few vintage cars are parked on the right side of the road, and a church tower with a dome and spire rises in the background. Trees, street lamps, and older houses line the street. The lower left corner contains the caption 'VÄNERSBORG Kyrkogatan' and a serial number '55577' appears in the lower right.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a small rural railway station labeled "HJELLUM" on the station building, with train tracks running toward the foreground. To the right is a wooden house with a balcony and garden shrubs. There are level‑crossing gates, telegraph poles, and trees in the background. The caption in Norwegian at the bottom reads "Parti ved Hjellum St." and a small credit in the lower right mentions the photographer/publisher.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd of people, many in early 20th‑century clothing, walking and standing on a path and rocky hill in a wooded park. Trees surround the scene and the atmosphere suggests a public gathering or promenade. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Vintage sepia postcard showing the exterior moat or ditch along the side of a large stone castle. The path in the moat has several low stone or earth structures laid out. Superimposed at the upper right are three oval portrait medallions of men in military or formal dress, each with a small caption bearing their names and dates, presented as martyrs. At the bottom is an Italian caption identifying the scene as the castle moat in Trento and referring to the Trentino martyrs.

A hand‑colored early 20th‑century postcard showing a grand neoclassical government building on a cobblestone street. The yellow, three‑story structure with a dark mansard roof is fronted by a fence, gate, and lampposts. Several people in period clothing stand and walk along the street under large trees. Printed German captions and publishing information appear at the bottom.

A sports-themed postcard featuring Estonian discus thrower Gerd Kanter in mid-throw inside a stadium, wearing blue shorts and a white shirt labeled 'ESTONIA TDK 525 OSAKA 2007'. The left side includes printed text about him becoming world champion, while the right side shows a postage stamp with his portrait, an airmail label, a circular Tallinn cancellation mark, his large autograph across the center-right, and blank lines for the address.

Black‑and‑white postcard view framed by tree branches, showing a large Renaissance castle complex on the far bank of a river with a multi‑arch iron bridge in the foreground. The buildings have towers and spires, and a church tower is visible to the right. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Torgau a. d. Elbe. Schloß Hartenfels."

Color postcard view of a European city canal or river bend lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings. A low arched bridge crosses the water in the center. In the foreground there is a grassy park with benches where a few people sit, and a tourist boat full of passengers cruises along the water. Trees and lampposts border the park, and more greenery appears on the right. On the rooftop of one of the central buildings a sign with large letters is visible.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a German townscape dominated by a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires, alongside a castle complex and surrounding houses with red-tiled roofs. Trees and a stone wall are in the foreground under a cloudy sky. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom border.

Colorized vintage view over a small European town with red‑roofed houses among trees. In the background rises a tall baroque-style church tower. A dirt path bordered by stone posts and trees leads downhill toward the town, where a woman in traditional dress stands by a fence. At the top center of the image the word "Königsbrück." is printed in red.

Black‑and‑white image of a large historicist town‑hall–style building on a square. The structure has steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and a tall central clock tower capped with an onion dome and smaller cupolas. There is a fountain or monument in front of the main façade and a few people visible in the square. Surrounding streets are lined with early 20th‑century European townhouses. No legible caption or writing appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white view of a seaside bathing area in a rocky archipelago. In the foreground a sandy beach with people sitting and walking; in the water several bathers are swimming and wading. To the right, a large rock outcrop has a tall wooden waterslide structure built on it, with the slide ending in the sea. A pier or floating platform with a small boat is anchored just offshore. In the background are low rocky islands. A flagpole on the rocks flies a Nordic cross flag that appears to be Swedish. Printed caption text is at the bottom left, and a triangular logo with a serial number appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph showing a countryside church with a rectangular nave and a square tower topped by a small cupola. The church is surrounded by a tree‑lined cemetery with orderly rows of graves. Nearby are a few small buildings and a road intersection. In the background there are open fields, a forest, a lake or river shoreline, and a larger institutional‑looking brick building set among trees. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a tropical street lined with tall palm trees and colonial-style buildings. People stroll and ride bicycles along the road; one small carriage or rickshaw with a red umbrella is visible. The buildings are labeled as a club-house and restaurant associated with the Panama Canal in Cristobal, in the former Canal Zone.

Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone street lined with 3–4‑story masonry buildings. On the left are older plastered houses with shuttered windows and arched doorways, one bearing a hanging sign; next to them is a long, monumental stone building with repetitive arched windows and a heavy cornice, resembling a public or institutional facility. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the sidewalk and a few figures stand further down the street; gas‑style street lamps are visible.

Black‑and‑white view of a ceremonial military parade on a city street. A long formation of uniformed soldiers in dress uniforms, helmets, white gloves and saber belts stands at attention facing the camera. Behind them are multi‑story European‑style buildings with balconies and businesses. Crowds watch from the sidewalks and upper‑floor windows. Signboards in Spanish and English advertising professional services and an electrical construction company are visible on the façades.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing the interior of a simple Protestant-style church. The image looks toward the altar at the far end of a long nave with wooden pews on both sides, arched windows, a pulpit on the left, and a central altar with a large framed painting or altarpiece above it. Printed caption text appears below the image indicating the place and publisher details.

Black-and-white postcard view through tall dark tree trunks toward a rural guesthouse complex. In the foreground stands a large traditional multi-storey timber house with many windows and a steep roof, set along a road with small trees and a fence. Behind it lie open meadows and another farmhouse-like building, bordered by dense forest. At the bottom of the image, printed text identifies the place as the guesthouse "Waldesruhe" in Steinbach near Johanngeorgenstadt.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a bustling historic main street lined with two‑storey buildings featuring ornate facades and shopfronts with awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and several horse‑drawn carts and carriages move along the street. At the top of the image multilingual text identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy pontoon or ferry bridge across a wide river. People with bicycles stand on the floating structure, and there are small cabins and railings on the pontoon. Trees and a few buildings line the far bank. Printed caption text in Dutch appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly, rural landscape. The foreground shows a sloping meadow with trees leading down to several multi‑story masonry buildings and factory structures with tall chimneys. Beyond them lies a dense cluster of gabled houses and narrow streets surrounded by fields and orchards. On a distant hill stands a large church with a tall, slender spire dominating the skyline, with additional institutional‑looking buildings nearby. The overall style and vehicles/industrial buildings suggest an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard. No visible caption or border text can be seen on the image side.

Sepia-toned aerial or elevated view of a large urban square with wide streets and early-to-mid 20th‑century cars and pedestrians. On the left is a multi‑storey block, in the center a prominent theater‑like building with an ornate façade, and in the background a street leads uphill toward a church with several onion domes and a bell tower. The right margin contains a short printed caption in Russian in the upper corner.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a tree-lined promenade or road with a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground. The scene is lush with greenery and open fields to the right. At the bottom center, the caption reads in French: "ALEXANDRIE Promenade de Ramleh". A small website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears on the lower right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing massive stone fortification walls and a gate amid rocky terrain. At the top there is bilingual printed text in Greek and French identifying the site, and there is a circular postmark stamp on the left. At the bottom right, a website watermark is visible.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small church or chapel with a bell tower, surrounded by dense trees and an overgrown cemetery with gravestones and crosses in the foreground. Printed German text in red and black appears at the bottom margin, including the place name and publisher information.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a riverside scene with a metal bridge over water, stone embankments, trees on the left and large classical multi‑storey buildings on the right. The bridge has railings and gas-style street lamps. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place as Göteborg and gives the viewpoint as Stora Nygatan från Slussen. Small printed numbering appears at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large classical stone building along a canal, with several flags on its façade and pedestrians and trams on the street in front. To the right rises a tall church tower with a clock and spire. Printed caption text is overlaid in Swedish at the bottom right, and a small publisher logo appears at the bottom left.

Illustrated military-themed postcard showing a uniformed soldier standing beside two pack ponies loaded with gear in a light winter or autumn landscape with birch trees. The border has a decorative pattern of red, black, and white squares. Text in Swedish and Finnish appears under the illustration, and there is a date and signature-like mark at the lower left ("Haga 12/4 1918").

Sepia-toned photograph showing a stone passage or tunnel built with large rough boulders, forming a corbelled, triangular roof. The entrance is framed by massive rocks and some dry vegetation on the right. At the bottom right, English text identifies the scene, and a small web address is printed near the bottom center.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a waterfront street lined with long wooden buildings in a Nordic/European architectural style. In the background rises a tall, slender church spire with a clock or decorative panels near the top. A stone embankment with a small stairway runs along the front, and a few people are visible walking along the road. The word "Kotka" is printed in the upper left corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional fishing scene on the seashore: a sailing boat with a large triangular sail is close to the waterline while fishermen work on board. In the foreground, a man guides a team of oxen pulling something from the shallow water. Additional small boats are visible on the horizon. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Valencia and labels the scene as "Pesca del Bou"; a small imprint "DURA" appears at the lower right.

A black‑and‑white panoramic winter view over a low‑rise town with snow on the roofs. Wooden and masonry buildings with metal roofs fill the scene, and in the distance a church with a tower or dome rises above the skyline. Leafless trees line the streets. On one prominent building in the middle‑right area there is large painted text, and in the foreground a small number "211" is printed in the lower left corner.

Colorized view of a historic European city square with a statue in the foreground, cafe tables and umbrellas, a small electric tram, and multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and shop signs in German. In the background a steep hill rises with a fortification wall and a distinctive clock tower on top. The printed caption at the upper left reads "Graz-Hauptplatz."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a tall classical column standing on a large pedestal in an open square, with a multi‑storey European‑style building to the left and trees in the background. The top left bears printed caption text identifying the view as in Alexandria and referring to the "Khartoum" column. A website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town with a dominant Baroque onion‑domed church tower in the foreground, dense traditional houses with steep tiled roofs, several church spires, and in the background large factory buildings with tall chimneys. In the front are fenced vegetable plots and gardens, with a person working in the field. The landscape beyond the town is flat, open countryside. No visible printed title or caption appears on the image.

Collage-style black‑and‑white postcard showing four scenes of uniformed soldiers with rifles conducting shooting drills outside brick barracks. The men wear early‑20th‑century uniforms with peaked caps and long rifles with bayonets. Some scenes show soldiers kneeling and aiming from a grassy bank; others show them standing in a firing line in a courtyard beside long brick buildings. An officer in a long cloak appears in a couple of the views. The images look like formal training or demonstration photographs from a barracks or military school.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a quiet tree-lined street bordered by late 19th–early 20th century townhouses. On the right is a more prominent building with an ornate corner tower-like roof and arched windows, likely the local post office. A few pedestrians, including a child in short trousers and adults in period dress, walk along the street. Printed red text in German at the top identifies the town, region, and street with the post office.

A sepia-toned commemorative postcard featuring an oval portrait of a uniformed royal officer with medals and a sash, surrounded by laurel branches and Greek flags. Greek text appears above and below the portrait, and the date 8 March 1913 is printed on either side. The style is early 20th‑century patriotic/royalist.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central square with a large statue of a robed man on a high pedestal, surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. In the background stands a crenellated tower. A lone man is visible near the monument. Printed caption at the top identifies the scene as Piazza Erbe with the Monument to Alessandro Vittoria in Trento, Italy. A handwritten date appears in the lower right corner.

A monochrome postcard view of a rural landscape with a traditional wooden farmhouse and outbuildings on a hillside surrounded by trees and fields. A dirt path leads up to the house, and a split-rail fence follows the road. A few small figures stand on the path. Printed captions in Finnish and Swedish appear at the bottom, and a handwritten note in the upper right reads "v. 1905."

A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a spa town nestled in a green valley. Numerous grand 19th‑century style buildings line tree‑filled streets, with large bath or spa complexes in the foreground and gently rolling hills in the background. German captions are printed at the top and bottom, and there is a red handwritten number in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a semi‑rural residential area transitioning into a modern housing estate. In the foreground there is dense forest and scattered detached houses with pitched roofs and gardens along curving roads. In the background stand multiple blocks of mid‑rise, rectangular apartment buildings arranged in rows, with open grass fields and some undeveloped plots between them. No text is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ruins of a medieval stone castle with a large round tower and another conical‑roofed tower rising above partially collapsed walls. Forested countryside and scattered houses stretch into the distance. The lower border contains printed and handwritten captions, and there is a small printer's mark in the bottom‑right corner.

Color illustration of a Native American man identified as Chief Gall, standing on rocky ground by a shoreline with waves and distant bluffs. He wears a green fringed coat, leggings, moccasins, and a feather in his hair, with a red‑and‑white striped cloth draped over his shoulder. Trees rise at the left, and the sea or large lake is on the right. The image is bordered by a white margin with printed text.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a packed marble stadium surrounded by hills. Thousands of uniformed schoolchildren stand in formation on the track and field area, while the stands are full of spectators. Flags fly along the top rim of the stadium. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, mentioning school exercises in the stadium and the presence of a king of Italy.

An old black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) street scene showing a narrow European town street lined with two‑ and three‑story houses. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including women in long skirts, children, and men in uniform-like attire, stand and walk along the street. A church or tower with a small spire is visible in the background. At the top in red Gothic-style script it reads "Bischofswerda. Innere Kamenz er Straße.", and there is a red handwritten number in the upper right corner. Shop signs in German are visible on the right-hand buildings.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large statue of Dante Alighieri on a tall pedestal surrounded by seated allegorical figures and trees, set against a mountainous backdrop. In the mid‑ground a bell tower rises above the trees. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the scene as Piazza Dante with the Dante Alighieri monument in Trento, Italy.

Hand-colored historic postcard showing a street scene titled "Bergstrasse mit Reichsbank" in Köslin. The view looks down a gently sloping street lined with substantial late‑19th‑century buildings; on the left is a large brick edifice with a prominent balcony and awning (the Reichsbank building), on the right a lighter-colored multi‑story structure. Trees line the street further down, with several pedestrians visible. Printing at the bottom identifies the location and publisher, along with a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.

Black-and-white postcard view over an elegant spa town street lined with ornate historic buildings, shops, and hotels along a river or canal. In the foreground stand stone statues holding fruits and garlands on a balustrade. Vintage cars drive along the riverside road, and wooded hills rise behind the town. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place as Karlsbad and indicates the view is from the Mühlbrunn.

An old monochrome postcard showing a small town landscape with a river or ravine in the foreground, traditional buildings on the banks, and a prominent slender minaret of a mosque rising among the houses. The terrain behind is hilly and mostly bare. At the top of the postcard, there is printed text in Latin and Greek script indicating the location and a café name.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small village nestled in a forested valley with hills in the background. Traditional timber and stone houses line a narrow road running up the slope. Dense trees surround the settlement, and on the upper right stands a prominent church with a tall steeple at the edge of the forest. Printed German text appears at the top and along the left edge.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small, canal-like river lined with stone embankments and railings, bordered by dense trees and foliage. A fenced walkway follows the water on the left; on the right are trees and part of a building with a gabled roof. A few white ducks are swimming on the calm water. Red printed German text appears at the top and bottom of the card.

Black‑and‑white image showing several traditional wooden windmills along a flat riverside or canal, with low farm buildings on the bank and a small boat on the water in the foreground. A church spire is visible in the distant background. A small printed number "759." appears at the lower left and again centered at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned street scene in a historic European city. A gently curving street is lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops with awnings and signage. Pedestrians crowd the sidewalks and a tram or streetcar runs on tracks in the street. At the end of the street stands a church-like tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock faces. The overall style is late 19th to early 20th century central-European architecture.

Sepia-toned photograph of an old stone archway leading into a cobblestoned courtyard. Above the rounded arch, faint characters that look like a date are carved into the stone. Inside the courtyard, a building with plastered walls and multi‑pane windows is visible. Ivy or climbing plants cover much of the inner arch and wall. On the right side inside the courtyard stands a simple wooden handcart. The architecture is medieval or early modern European and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large brick institutional building with many tall arched windows and a hipped roof with several chimneys, set in landscaped grounds with paths and lawns. Smaller auxiliary buildings appear to the left. Printed text at the top identifies the place as Vänersborgs Hospital and Asylum at Restad.

A black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing fields in the foreground and a small village in the distance. At the center stands a white church with a tall, slender spire, surrounded by scattered wooden houses and farm buildings, with forested hills behind. In the top left corner, there is printed caption text in a Scandinavian language.

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a large parade or public procession moving through a broad, tree‑lined avenue in a European city. Crowds in early‑20th‑century clothing line both sides of the street and fill a cobbled square in the foreground, while cavalry and people on horseback ride along the avenue. Multi‑story stone and brick buildings with ornate facades stand on both sides; on the right corner building many people watch from balconies and windows. Shop signage can be seen at street level. At the top center of the image, the handwritten year '1918' is visible.

A monochrome vintage street scene showing a wide, busy boulevard flanked by multi‑story European‑style buildings with balconies and shutters. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century dress, horse‑drawn carriages, and a few carts move along the street. A tower rises in the distance. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Alexandria and specifies the street name.

Black‑and‑white street scene in a small town with early‑20th‑century houses lining both sides of a gently curving road. Picket fences and trees border the sidewalks; several children stand or walk in the street. In the background low hills rise beyond the town. Printed caption text appears in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white image of people gathered on a stone quay as a small passenger boat is docked. Adults and children in mid‑20th‑century clothing stand near the gangway; rocky islands are visible in the background. A handcart and wooden pallets lie on the pier. Printed caption text appears in the lower right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white view of a small railway station. On the right stands a two‑storey station building with arched ground‑floor openings and a signboard on the wall. Railway tracks run through the center of the image, with a simple covered platform and bench on the left and trees in the background. The scene is quiet and appears rural or small‑town. The photograph has the look of an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black-and-white postcard view over a calm lake with reeds in the foreground and a couple of small rowboats at the shoreline. Across the water stands a tree-covered shoreline with a church tower rising above the trees and a few buildings nearby. The sky is cloudy. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, including the name of the place and the publisher.

A black-and-white photograph of a sunset over a calm lake surrounded by dense coniferous forest. The sun is low on the horizon, casting reflections on the water. Tall fir trees frame the right side of the image. At the bottom border there is printed white text identifying the scene and a small number at the lower right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing an early biplane on the ground in front of hangars at an airfield. Two men sit in the aircraft's open cockpit, and a large hangar and wooden sheds form the background. At the upper right there is a small circular inset portrait of the pilot in uniform seated at the controls. A green 5 centimes French postage stamp is affixed near the top center, with a circular postmark over it. Red printed captions in French identify the squadron and the aviator.

A colorized panoramic view over a European town beside a river. The foreground shows grassy banks and trees along the water. Behind them are brick and stucco buildings with red and gray roofs. Dominating the center is a large church with two tall, slender spires. Industrial chimneys and more town buildings fill the background. The word "Grimma" is printed in red at the top left.

A sepia-toned portrait of an Eastern Orthodox bishop seated and facing the camera. He wears a black clerical robe and a kalimavkion (tall clerical hat), with a long beard and two ornate pectoral crosses and a medallion hanging on chains. The background is plain. At the bottom there is Greek text identifying him and giving a serial number and location.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a rustic wooden gazebo with a high conical thatched roof, standing on a terrace overlooking a green, hilly landscape. Shrubs and flowering plants surround the structure, and a person is seated on a bench inside the gazebo enjoying the view. At the top, printed red text reads "OMSTR. NIJMEGEN BERG en DAL. — Paraplui."

Black-and-white interior view of a large, bright lounge or dining room with polished wooden floors, wicker armchairs and tables covered with tablecloths. Large windows line the far wall, letting in natural light. Some framed pictures hang on the walls. Text at the bottom left identifies the location as Uddevalla, Bohusgården, and a printer or photographer credit appears in the lower right corner.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand Renaissance-style arsenal building with richly decorated gables, statues, and large rectangular windows. In front is an open square with a streetlamp and a small fountain or pedestal. A few pedestrians are visible. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Zeughaus in Danzig and the publisher Brück & Sohn, Meissen.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, three‑story neoclassical public building with simple ornamentation and tall rectangular windows. The structure stands behind a low fence and a row of small conifer trees, with a broad lawn or square in front. Flagpoles rise in the open area, and leafy trees line a sidewalk along the right edge of the image. The scene appears calm and slightly formal, suggesting a civic or institutional building in a European town. A handwritten number "45-27" is visible at the top center of the postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Central European town on a wooded hill. At the top of the hill stands a large church with a tall spire and several substantial historic buildings, likely part of a castle complex. Below, dense trees cover the slope, with a winding path and retaining wall in the foreground and smaller houses and factory buildings with a chimney in the lower town. The scene is framed by a white border, and cursive writing appears at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white view of a riverside promenade in a European spa town. Well‑dressed men and women in early 20th‑century fashion stroll along a paved walkway with a metal railing beside a shallow river lined with stone embankments. In the background stand large ornate multi‑storey spa or hotel buildings with mansard roofs and chimneys, set at the base of densely forested hills. A small bridge crosses the river in the distance.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large Russian Orthodox cathedral with multiple golden onion domes and richly decorated white façades, viewed from a garden or park with trees and a stone wall in the foreground. A tall church spire stands to the left in the background. The caption at the bottom right reads "Souvenir de Reval."

A hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a large historic church with a tall square tower topped by a spire, likely in a town square. Trees, small garden beds, and a few people can be seen in front of the building. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink. German text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

A monochrome portrait postcard featuring a close-up photograph of a solemn middle‑aged man in formal 19th‑century attire. The image is bordered by a white margin. Beneath the portrait, printed text identifies him and gives his profession and life dates in French. Small credits appear in the lower corners, including the photographer and a Paris mark.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Gothic‑style church with a tall central spire, pointed-arch windows, buttresses and an attached rectory or parish house. Trees and a few additional buildings appear in the background. Printed text at the top identifies the church and its location in Nijmegen.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a European town with dense red and gray roofs and a prominent church with a tall spire in the right middle ground. Above the town, against a pale blue sky with clouds, a woman in early 20th‑century clothing appears to float or fly while holding an open umbrella and a handbag. German text is printed over the sky, and additional publisher information is printed along the left and right edges.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large hilltop complex with a medieval castle-like structure and an attached Gothic cathedral with tall twin spires. The buildings stand above a riverfront town with smaller houses and industrial-looking structures in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Meissen and mention the royal Albrechtsburg castle and cathedral.

Color-tinted historical postcard showing a large neo-Gothic church with two tall twin towers and a rose window on the main façade, fronted by a mostly empty square with a few young trees and a streetlamp. The sky is pale and blank, and printed text at the top names the location and church.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a domed Islamic structure beside a waterway lined with tall palm trees. People in traditional garments, including someone on a camel, gather near the water's edge. The scene is tranquil, with reflections in the water. Caption text appears at the bottom margin, and a circular stamp mark and a small website credit are also visible.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town framed by tree branches, with rolling hills in the background. Dominating the skyline is a large Gothic cathedral with a very tall, delicate spire and a long nave; other church towers and historic buildings with steep roofs surround it. The photo has slightly scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside harbor scene with multiple moored barges along a quay. On the opposite bank are trees, several buildings and a church with a tower and dome. In the distance a metal arch bridge crosses the river. The caption in German at the top left reads 'Gröba. Hafenpartie.'

A colorized vintage postcard showing a large wooden mountain lodge perched on a steep grassy slope with rocky outcrops. In the background, a prominent conical mountain rises under a partly cloudy sky. The foreground features alpine terrain, and the building appears to be a high-altitude hut. Printed captions in German are visible in the lower margin of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small town nestled at the edge of a dense forest and rolling farmland. In the foreground are early 20th‑century houses and villas along a tree‑lined street; behind them rises a wooded hillside, with open fields visible on the crest. The caption at the top left in red print reads "Tharandt. Wilsdrufferstrasse," identifying the view as a street scene in Tharandt.

Colorized vintage view of a German town street with old multi‑story houses and gardens in the foreground. A church tower with a baroque onion dome and spire dominates the right side, while additional historic buildings with red tile roofs rise in the background. The sky is softly tinted. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.

A monochrome postcard showing a rocky cliff or steep riverbank rising directly from a wide river. The foreground is the flat surface of the river, while behind it a rugged rock formation dominates most of the image. Low hills or mountains are faintly visible in the background. At the top left there is printed Russian text in pre‑revolutionary orthography.

Sepia-toned view of a Mediterranean harbor with a tall stone column in the foreground topped by a statue of a stag or deer. Behind it are moored sailing boats with tall masts and triangular sails. On the left stands a square bell tower attached to a church-like building, and on the right a long arcaded waterfront building with multiple arches. The image has a beige border and appears as an old photographic postcard. A modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible along the bottom right.

A monochrome postcard showing a wide, fast‑flowing river in the foreground, framed by dark tree silhouettes on the right. On the distant riverbank, a large, fortress‑like building or complex is visible in silhouette against a cloudy sky. The printed caption at the top left reads "Trollhättan — Hojums varp."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped public park with a circular fountain and flower beds in the foreground, paths and walking visitors, dense trees, benches, and a large glass conservatory/greenhouse building in the background. Caption text is printed along the bottom edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rocky river landscape with forested hills on both sides and an iron bridge spanning the river in the background. In the foreground a person sits on rocks by the water. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, with handwritten notes and a date over the image.

A colorized historical postcard view of a large open square bordered by multi‑story buildings and an old brick wall, with mountains rising in the background. There is a decorative street lamp in the center foreground and several trees along the left side. At the top of the image, captions in Italian read "Piazza di fiera" and "Trento," indicating the scene is the fair square in Trento, with classical urban architecture and a mountainous landscape behind.

A black‑and‑white historical view of a European spa or resort town built on a hillside. In the foreground is a long row of ornate multi‑story townhouses and hotels with mansard roofs and many windows. One prominent building bears the sign "HOTEL NATIONAL" on its facade. Behind this row, on the ascending slope, stand several large villa‑like mansions with turrets and decorative gables, separated by terraced lawns and paths. In the far background is a wooded hill. The image has worn edges and looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a tall, narrow brick tower attached to a gabled building with a tiled roof. Leafless pruned trees and hedges stand in front of the structure, with a small gate and pathway leading toward it. The style is historic Flemish. The caption at the top identifies the scene as 'Bruges — La Gilde St-Sébastien.' Additional small text appears along the bottom edge.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a dense coastal town with low houses and tiled roofs, looking toward a harbor with piers, sailing ships, and a large vessel in the distance. The sea forms the background. Printed captions in Greek and French appear beneath the photograph, along with a small reference number and a website watermark.

Vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a broad, gently rising avenue lined with late 19th–early 20th century townhouses and villas on both sides. The architecture features steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, bay windows and small turrets typical of German Gründerzeit style. A solitary person walks along the nearly empty street. At the top left in red print appears the caption indicating the town and street name.

A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a tree-lined promenade beside a small lake. Elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. On the right there is a decorative railing and wooden bench, and in the background spa buildings are partly visible among the trees. The caption text in red at the bottom identifies the location and publisher in German.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard-style photograph showing several children and a dog on a wooded hillside. Leafless or sparsely leaved trees frame the scene, with a faint building visible to the right background. Some children sit on the ground while others stand on the slope above. The image has a coarse halftone print texture and a small rectangular mark with the initials 'PAG' in the lower-right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural wooden church complex in an open field: a separate wooden belfry with a distinctive multi‑tiered, curved roof stands on the left, and a simple wooden church building with a steep roof and small tower or ridge ornament is on the right, both surrounded by a low fence and leafless trees. At the top of the image is a printed caption reading "Kyrkan Jukkasjärvi."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large stone fortress on a hill, with high defensive walls, towers, and arched openings. Several people in mid‑20th‑century clothing stand or walk along a path in the foreground. There is Greek text captioning the image at the bottom left and a website watermark at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural European village in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are orchards divided by simple wooden fences. Behind them stand several farmhouses and barns with steep gabled roofs, timber‑framed upper stories, and plastered walls. More scattered houses and farm buildings extend into the middle distance, surrounded by trees and fields. Rolling hills and patchwork farmland form the background. There are no visible modern vehicles or infrastructure, giving the scene an early‑20th‑century appearance.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town dominated by massive stone fortifications. In the foreground stands a round medieval watchtower with a crenellated crown and conical roof elements beside portions of a city wall. Behind it rises a large Gothic church or former castle-like complex with steep tiled roofs and narrow pointed spires. Farther back, densely packed townhouses with steep gabled roofs fill the hillside, and a tall, slender church tower with a baroque-style spire punctuates the skyline. Vegetation and fields occupy the immediate foreground. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a town square with a two‑storey neoclassical building on the left, a one‑storey building in the center, and a tall bell tower with a cross on top to the right. Several people stand in the square. Printed French text at the top identifies it as a souvenir from Zante and notes a café. Handwritten script in dark ink appears over the image, and a watermark with a website address is visible at the bottom.

Monochrome view inside a large glass-and-iron pavilion or hall, with ornate cast-iron columns and tall arched windows. At the center is a circular basin with a strong vertical jet of water like a thermal or mineral fountain. Elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion, including women with large hats and men with bowler and boater hats, stand and walk around the fountain, some apparently drinking or collecting water. The scene suggests a fashionable spa or pump room in a European resort town.

An old sepia-toned postcard view over a spa-town landscape with villas and guesthouses surrounded by trees and gentle hills. In the foreground stands a prominent multi‑storey building with timber-framed decorative gables and a small tower, labeled as a specific establishment. The lower margin of the card carries printed captions identifying the place and publisher, along with a year.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet village or small‑town scene with a narrow canal or stream in the foreground, lined by tall leafless or early‑spring trees and wooden fences. Traditional European houses with steep, tiled roofs stand on the opposite bank along a small road. The water reflects the trees and buildings, giving a tranquil, pastoral atmosphere. At the bottom edge, there appears to be a hand‑written caption on the negative.

Colorized vintage street view showing a broad tree‑lined avenue with sidewalks, tram or carriage tracks, and early 20th‑century multi‑story residential houses with red tiled roofs and small gardens. In the background are low rolling hills under a partly cloudy sky. The printed captions at the top identify the location and street.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large wooden seaside pavilion-style building on a brick foundation, with wide exterior staircases leading up to a central entrance and wraparound verandas. A square tower with a flagpole rises on the right side of the structure. Trees frame the scene, and a person stands on the lawn in the foreground. Printed caption text appears below the image.

Black-and-white postcard showing a long, modernist three-story school building behind a white picket fence and trees. A tall flagpole flies a Nordic cross flag with a dark field and light cross. In the lower left corner is printed text identifying the location, and there is a small circular printer's logo in the lower right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard with an Art Nouveau illustration of three women in flowing classical-style dresses picking and hanging flowers in front of a backdrop filled with blossoms. At the upper right are two smaller panels, one showing a close-up of a woman in profile among flowers and another decorative floral vignette. Much of the remaining space is filled with handwritten cursive text in Greek. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears along the bottom.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a public park with a modernist fountain in the foreground. The fountain shows a crouching human figure holding up a large bowl from which water spills in thin vertical streams into a square basin. In the background are manicured hedges, a walkway with a few people, and historic buildings including a square defensive tower and a tall, slender church spire rising above trees and houses. The print has a white border with slightly deckled edges, typical of early–mid‑20th‑century postcards. No printed caption is visible on the front.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a natural history museum hall filled with taxidermied animals and skeletons. A tall giraffe mount stands prominently in the center, surrounded by display cases containing seals on artificial rocks, a zebra skeleton, and various other specimens. The walls are decorated with mounted antlers. The scene is clean and formal, with polished floors and glass vitrines. Swedish text is printed at the bottom indicating the mammal hall's foreign section and naming the museum in Gothenburg.

Color-printed historic postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with a large central dome and colonnaded façade, set behind a formal garden and a fountain or sculptural group in the foreground. Trees line the front of the building, and the sky is softly tinted. At the top, there is German text identifying the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal military scene in front of a barracks building. Rows of uniformed soldiers wearing helmets stand in formation in a courtyard while officers with swords oversee them. A building with steps and an iron‑roofed porch is behind them, and additional barracks and horses are visible in the background. Red printed caption text appears at the bottom, and a red manuscript number "1566" is written in the top right corner.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an arched bridge over a river with railings and pedestrians, leading towards a small town nestled at the base of a steep, rocky hill or mountain. Traditional houses and a tree‑lined street are visible at the far end of the bridge. Text is printed in the white margin below the image, including the town name and a caption describing the bridge and surrounding landscape.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue bordered by brick residential buildings. A boxy delivery truck and several horse‑drawn carts travel down the cobbled street, while a cyclist stands with a bicycle in the foreground on the right. The architecture is early 20th‑century European, with bay windows and tiled roofs. In the lower‑left corner, there is a printed caption identifying the view as a street in Nijmegen.

Vintage sepia postcard showing an old Ottoman-style cemetery with ornate tombstones and an arched mausoleum structure surrounded by metal railings. The scene is densely filled with carved gravestones featuring Islamic motifs and inscriptions, set in a walled yard with bare trees. Printed French caption at the bottom identifies the location, and a website watermark appears over the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large convent building behind a lush, tree‑filled garden with lawns and paths. The multi‑story brick structure has dormer windows in the roof and several regular windows on the facade. Printed French text at the top identifies the scene as the garden of the Convent of the Ladies of the Sacred Heart in Bruges.

A multi‑view illustrated postcard with old‑style artwork. The main image at the top shows the Pyramids of Giza with camels and people in desert clothing. At the left is a robed figure standing on a crescent moon, holding a large bell. At the bottom left there is a city square with a statue/monument, a large building behind it flying a flag, and people walking around. Decorative text in the center reads "Souvenir d'Egypte". Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside town beside a steep rocky cliff. On top of the high rock face stands a small castle- or villa-like building with a tower, surrounded by trees. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Bodenbach. Schäferwand."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural landscape with a tall, slender‑spire church standing on a low hill, surrounded by trees and fields. A road curves past the church toward a cluster of farm buildings or houses on the right. Handwritten cursive text appears in the sky area above the scene.

Sepia-toned historical postcard depicting an earthen fortification with cannons and artillery positions on a rough landscape, probably a battlefield scene. In the foreground are cannons on carriages set into earthworks and a broken wheel; in the background are open fields and distant structures. The overall style resembles an old illustration or photograph of a 19th‑century fort or skanse.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with a large church featuring a tall spire on the left and a castle‑like complex with a round tower and fortified buildings on the right. In the foreground are traditional gabled houses and trees; in the background, rolling fields and forested hills. At the bottom left, faint white text identifies the place as "Zschopau i. Sa."

Black-and-white postcard showing a tranquil lakeside scene with forested hills, scattered houses and boathouses along the shoreline, and trees in the foreground. The water extends into the distance under a partly cloudy sky. Printed text at the bottom left identifies the view, and there is a small oval logo with the word 'ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI' at the lower right.

Vintage, monochrome postcard view over the Danube river towards a riverside square with grand late‑19th‑century buildings and a tram line. The caption at the top in red ink identifies the scene as Gellért Square with the Technical University in Budapest, presented in both Hungarian and German. The layout and printing style suggest an early 20th‑century European cityscape postcard.

A black‑and‑white landscape view showing a solitary half‑timbered house or inn in front of a forested hillside. The building has a characteristic timber-frame façade with light infill panels, a steep roof and several small windows. It stands in an open grassy field bordered by trees, with large coniferous trees on the left and right and low hills covered with forest in the background. The image has a white strip or damage along the bottom edge, suggesting it is a scan of an old postcard or photograph. No clear printed caption is visible on the front.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a street corner with a large, ornate late-19th/early-20th-century building at the junction of two tree-lined streets. Signs on the corner advertise a bakery-confectionery and a tailor shop. A cyclist rides along the street in the foreground and a woman walks on the sidewalk. Printed red text at the top left identifies the location as Radebeul-Oberlößnitz and the streets Carola- und Albertstrasse. A vertical red imprint at the right margin notes the publisher.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town square. On the left is a long row of two‑storey houses with pitched roofs and trees or vines trained along their facades; several people stand in the open square in front. On the right edge is part of a large historic building with a stepped gable partly obscured by tall trees. The image has light age spots. Printed in red at the bottom are the words "Mühlberg a. Elbe" and "Neustädter Markt", with a small number "4456" in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town with a broad open green or square in the foreground, lined with young trees and dirt paths. Along the street stand several two‑ to three‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. One corner building has a balcony; another at right has the large sign "APOTEK" on its facade, indicating a pharmacy. In the background are fields, forested hills and a cloudy sky. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, including the town name and photographer information.

An old mailed postcard with several Estonian postage stamps on the front. The stamps show denominations such as 10 and 25 penni and are inscribed "EESTI POST". There are multiple circular postmarks reading "HAAPSALU * EESTI" with the date 9 7 20. The card is addressed by hand in ink to a recipient in Tallinn, with additional handwritten notes in Estonian.

A colorized panoramic view of a small historic town surrounded by fields or vineyards. In the foreground are rows of vineyard stakes on a hillside, leading down to a compact town with red‑roofed houses, church towers, and several larger civic buildings. The skyline shows multiple church spires and a slightly elevated hill with buildings on the left. The card is worn, with creases and torn patches near the top. Printed captions appear along the top margin, including a multilingual place name on the left and something like a view description on the right.

A sepia-toned illustrated postcard depicting a historic church complex with Baroque-style towers and spires rising above attached residential-style buildings along a narrow path or lane. The scene shows windows with shutters and curtains, a vaulted passageway, and a garden-lined walkway leading toward the entrance. Handwritten-style text identifying the location appears along the bottom border.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a seaside scene with several sailing boats moored along a stone quay. A wooden villa stands on a small rise behind the quay, with trees and shrubs around it and a tall chimney with smoke in the background. A flagpole flies what appears to be a Scandinavian flag. On the right, a path leads uphill where two people in early 20th‑century clothing are walking. Printed text appears at the bottom, along with a short handwritten note.

A monochrome postcard view of a countryside church landscape. On the right stands a simple white church building with a pitched roof, partially obscured by trees and bushes. On the left is a tall wooden free‑standing belfry made of several slanted supports holding a small roofed bell tower. The scene is set on a slightly rocky hill with a dirt path leading up toward a small entrance gate and the churchyard. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard view over fields toward a small town with traditional houses and a prominent neo-Gothic church with a tall tower on a slight hill. In the upper left corner, red printed text reads "Hartha i. Sa." against a blank sky.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a tree‑lined, gently curving path or road leading uphill toward a tall church tower with a slender spire. The tower has several tiers and windows, surrounded by lush foliage and a park-like setting. Two small human figures are visible on the path. At the bottom margin there is a handwritten note in a cursive script.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a river scene with small boats moored at a quay in the foreground and a larger ferry or barge carrying people across the river in the middle distance. A simple wooden pier with white railings extends into the water on the left, while on the right a man stands near a moored vessel and several large cylindrical barrels or buoys. On the far bank there are trees, low buildings and a faint bridge structure. The card has a cream border and printed red caption at the bottom.
