Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural lakeside or riverside scene with open grassy fields in the foreground, a small wooden shed-like building near the water, forested hills in the background, and a few traditional wooden houses on the far bank. Short printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the Parthenon temple on the Acropolis in Athens, Greece. The ruined classical columns and scattered stones are visible in the foreground. Under the image there are captions in Greek and French identifying the monument and the city, along with a circular Greek stamp-like mark on the left and a website watermark at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the grand façade of a multi‑storey brick hotel with ornate balconies, corner towers and mansard roofs. Large rooftop signs read "HOTEL" and "KEIZER KAREL". The entrance has a decorative canopy with additional signage, and there are trees, a small garden, and a street with a lamppost in the foreground. A separate sign on the left reads "GARAGE".

Vintage postcard-style photograph showing a riverside railway station and small settlement at the foot of a heavily forested mountain. In the foreground is a river with a stone embankment; behind it stands a long wooden station building with a covered platform. Scattered houses and what appears to be a church-like building are visible among trees further up the slope. The scene is framed by a large, forested mountain under a partly cloudy sky. At the top of the postcard is printed text in Romanian.

Colorized vintage view of a European riverside city. In the foreground there is a riverside path with a wooden railing running beside a calm river and an iron bridge. On the opposite bank stands a row of elegant multi‑storey historicist buildings and a church tower with a dome-like roof. Behind the city rises a steep hill topped by fortifications, and on the slope another prominent clock tower is visible. Printed text at the top right identifies the scene as being in Graz and mentions the Radetzky Bridge and the Schlossberg hill.

Black-and-white aerial view of a modernist rectangular building surrounded by forested landscape. The structure has a flat roof and large windows on the long side with a covered terrace and steps leading to the entrance. In the distance a large industrial or mining conveyor/structure is visible above the trees. Printed caption text at the bottom left identifies the place as 'Folkets Park "Malmia", Kiruna.' The photographer credit 'Foto: Sven Alm.' appears at the bottom right.

Colorized panoramic view of a small European town seen from a grassy hillside with trees and a path in the foreground where two girls in dresses stand. The town below shows dense late‑19th/early‑20th century buildings with red and gray roofs, a prominent church with a tall spire, and a large institutional-looking building on the right. At the top center, red printed text reads "Hartha i. Sa." against a pale sky.

Black‑and‑white view of a small historic European town with half‑timbered houses, a stone defensive wall on an arched bridge, and a squat tower with a steep conical roof. In the background stands a church‑like building with a baroque onion‑domed belfry. Vegetation surrounds the buildings and some laundry or hides hang on a line in the foreground. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Black‑and‑white historical image showing a busy railway platform. Uniformed postal or railway workers are gathered around a handcart stacked high with large mail sacks beside a passenger train. The platform is covered by an iron-and-steel canopy structure, and several men in early 20th‑century coats and hats stand observing.

A sepia-toned postcard showing an old European city scene. In the foreground is a multi-story historic house with steep, tiled roofs, dormer windows, and wooden shutters, some of them open. Behind and above it rises a prominent hilltop clock tower with a large clock face, wooden superstructure, and steep roof. Vegetation and a stone wall line the hillside. The print is bordered by a wide cream margin, with handwritten text at the bottom of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a park scene with a large fountain in the center, surrounded by tall trees and walking paths. People in early 20th‑century clothing sit on benches and stroll around the fountain. The bottom margin contains printed captions, including the park name, publisher information, and the city name, suggesting this is a touristic postcard.

A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting a busy street scene in an old European city as an electric tram arrives, causing chaos among pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and street vendors. A tall baroque church tower dominates the background. In the upper right is an inset with horses labeled as being out of service, and the foreground includes caricatured townspeople reacting dramatically to the new tram. Handwritten cursive text runs along the right edge, and printed captions and publisher details appear around the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tranquil coastal or riverside landscape framed by trees. Tall cypress trees and scattered buildings appear on a hillside to the left, with calm water and distant mountains in the background. Greek and French captions are printed along the bottom margin, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is superimposed across the lower right of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside townscape. On the left stands a prominent church with a tall spire above clustered wooden and masonry buildings on a slope. The river runs across the foreground with timber or bridge-pier structures in the water. On the right bank are more houses and a large multi-storey building among trees. Printed captions appear in Latvian along the bottom border.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a long pergola-covered path in a formal garden. Stone columns on both sides are overgrown with climbing plants and vines, forming an arched canopy over the walkway that recedes into the distance. At the bottom of the image there is bilingual caption text in French and Greek, along with a small circular emblem and a printed website watermark.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a long brick barracks complex with ornate gables and many evenly spaced windows. The buildings form one side of an open parade ground or field, with small trees planted in front. In the foreground stand a woman in a light dress and wide-brimmed hat and a man in dark clothing. The printed caption at the top reads in German, identifying the location and the barracks of a carabinier regiment.

Sepia-toned image showing a large Baroque-style palace or castle with several round domed towers and a central spire, situated directly on the shore of a lake. The view is from across the water, framed by large leafy trees and a path in the foreground, with low shrubs and reeds along the lakeside. The architecture suggests a European water palace or moated castle.

Vintage black‑and‑white view over a valley town with factories, tall chimneys, residential blocks and villas on terraced hillsides and surrounding farmland. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the scene as Meissen, Rauhenthal, with a small publisher credit at the bottom left and a red handwritten number at the top right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large public monument: a seated man in formal dress atop a high pedestal surrounded by numerous life-sized sculpted figures representing men, women, and children in various poses. The pedestal bears an inscription in Hungarian. Behind the monument stand urban buildings and some trees, indicating it is set in a city square or plaza.

Black-and-white street scene showing a tree-lined boulevard with a wide pedestrian and cycling path on the left and a cobblestone street bordered by multi‑story brick buildings with shopfronts and awnings on the right. Signs for a café and other businesses are visible. People ride bicycles and walk along the street. Printed caption text at the bottom left identifies the location as Trollhättan, Folkets Hus, Kungsgatan. At the bottom right is a printer/photographer credit.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a garden or yard bordered by a picket fence, with two multi‑story wooden buildings in the background that look like early 20th‑century Scandinavian houses. In the foreground stand three women in period clothing and hats among bushes and trees. At the top left is printed text identifying the place, and at the bottom right a reference number is printed.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing rows of young thornless cactus plants in trays in the foreground and larger prickly pear cactus plants growing in neat rows in the background. The image appears printed on the left side of the card with a light border. Below the photograph is a caption in red ink describing the scene and location, with an additional handwritten number in red at the lower right.

Black-and-white view of a European town square with a large fountain and monument at the center. The monument consists of a tall pedestal with columns and a kneeling female archer statue drawing a bow on top. At the corners of the fountain base are sculpted deer. Surrounding the square are multi-story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; one building has a clock tower. A few people stand near the fountain, and shopfronts with signs line the background.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rural house with decorative wooden porch details, set in a large grassy yard lined with young trees whose trunks are painted white. In the foreground stand two small children in light-colored dresses, holding hands and facing the camera. Another person stands near the house in the background. At the upper left, printed text reads "Fra Finstad, Hernes." The scene suggests a family farm or homestead in a Nordic countryside.

Colored vintage postcard showing a stone fortress complex with thick walls and a bastion beside a body of water, connected by a multi‑arched stone bridge. Mountains are visible in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French/English appear at the top, and a website watermark is at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial dam and hydroelectric facility on a river. In the foreground a large spillway and cylindrical structure release water, with small control houses and machinery on top of the dam. Behind the dam stand factory buildings with a tall smokestack and, further back, scattered houses and forested hills. In the bottom left corner there is a printed caption.

Sepia-toned landscape view of a small Alpine town nestled in a valley with surrounding hills or mountains. The settlement is composed of clustered houses and a church with a tall bell tower at the center. In the foreground are fields, trees, and a river. At the upper right of the image, printed text reads "Molina di Fiemme, 856 m s. m." indicating the town and its elevation.

Vintage advertising postcard featuring an illustration of many patterned socks and stockings fanned out in different colors and designs. At the top is the name of a hosiery factory in bold letters, with additional Danish text below describing capital, bank reference and charitable use of profits. The overall design is vertical with aged, yellowed paper and red and black print.

Sepia-toned photograph of a tall, cylindrical medieval stone tower standing on a raised fortification or castle wall. The tower has a crenellated top with a flagpole and flag. Behind and to the right is a long, rectangular building forming part of the same defensive complex. Trees frame the scene on the left and right, and a park-like area with paths and benches occupies the foreground. The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard. No visible printed caption or back text is present in the image area shown.

Black‑and‑white night view of a large illuminated hilltop complex reflected in a river. The complex combines a Gothic church with twin spires and an attached castle‑like group of buildings with steep roofs and towers. Lights outline the structures and scatter through trees on the slope; a small boat is visible on the dark water in the foreground. There is no visible caption or writing on the image side.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a well‑dressed man seated at a small round table, a woman in an ornate dress and large hat standing beside the table, and a greyhound‐type dog in the foreground. They appear to be in an elegant, early‑20th‑century interior with paneled walls and simple wooden chairs. Swedish text identifying the scene and publisher is printed on the image.

Colorized vintage view over a small European town with a river on the right, industrial chimneys, and a prominent church with a tall clock tower and steep spire near the center. The scene is surrounded by green fields and distant hills under a pale blue sky. At the top of the image, red printed text reads "Leisnig-Tragnitz."

A monochrome (black‑and‑white) panoramic view over a small European town set in rolling countryside, with a large castle complex on a hill to the left featuring two tall pointed towers, a river curving through the town on the right, and a prominent church with a steeple near the river. Traditional houses and small buildings are scattered in the valley and foreground. At the top left, printed in red Gothic‑style script, is the caption identifying the location.

Vintage monochrome view of a long academic or hospital building with multiple windows, trees and an iron fence along a cobblestone street. A tall street lamp stands on the right, and more buildings recede into the distance. The caption at the bottom, in Romanian and Hungarian, labels the location as the university clinics.

A black-and-white view of a rectangular, one-story Beaux-Arts style building with a raised basement, arched windows, and a prominent entrance reached by a double staircase. The frieze above the entrance reads "PUBLIC LIBRARY," and a small sign at the bottom edge of the image labels it as the public library in Pomona. A person is walking along the front, and trees and small houses appear in the background. The overall layout and border suggest an early 20th‑century postcard photograph.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing an intersection in an old European city. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along cobbled streets between multi‑story stone buildings. There is a bridge or canal railing with ornate street lamps on the right, and a gabled building with the sign 'APTEK' (pharmacy). Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin identifying the street corner and the city.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a lively public scene in front of a fortified, castle‑like building identified as the military club "Stella". People in early 20th‑century dress stroll and gather in an open square; horse‑drawn carriages are visible in the background. A flag with the Savoyard cross (Kingdom of Italy) flies atop the building. Printed caption text appears at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large two‑storey wooden building with many white‑framed windows and a gabled roof, set behind a garden with trees and a picket fence in the foreground. At the top is a printed caption in red text identifying the location in Estonian and German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway line curving through a rural landscape toward a small town. A steam locomotive runs along the tracks on the left, with telegraph poles beside the line and fenced grassy fields in the foreground. In the background rises a prominent church with a tall spire among trees and low town buildings. Red printed captions in Swedish appear at the top: one on the left describing the scene from the railway and one on the right naming the town, Mariestad.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small rural village set in rolling hills. In the foreground is a steep grassy slope with a fenced path leading down to a chalet-style house with a steep tiled roof and timber framing. Below runs a narrow river or stream with a curved pedestrian path alongside it, and a small multi‑arch stone bridge crosses the water. In the middle ground are several traditional farmhouses and village buildings surrounded by trees. In the background, gently undulating farmland with scattered barns and a few houses stretches toward the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings, shutters on the windows, horse‑drawn carriages and a few people. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large castle-like complex with a prominent tower. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street view (Badgasse) in Colditz, and the publisher information appears below.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic Lutheran church with a tall central spire topped by a cross, pointed arched windows, and decorative buttresses. In the foreground there is an open square or street with a small guardhouse or kiosk and a low fence. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location and the building.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large medieval brick city gate with two round towers and a central arched passageway for traffic. A street with early 20th‑century vehicles and people passes through the gate. The structure is surrounded by railings and trees. Red printed French text appears at the top left identifying the subject, and a publisher credit is printed at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white image showing an outdoor swimming pool complex with diving boards and many bathers in vintage swimsuits. Behind the pool stands a large, ornate grand‑hotel style building with turrets and steep roofs, set against mountainous scenery. The composition and style resemble an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century European resort postcard.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a church with a tall spire and large sloping roof, partially obscured by a row of leafy trees along a cobbled street. A small figure sits at the base of one tree in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Danzig and the building as St. Barbara Church, with a publisher credit and number.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the city of Clermont‑Ferrand from a high terrace or balcony. In the foreground are three people in early 20th‑century clothing standing by a balustrade, looking out over the city. A tall religious statue rises from the balustrade. Below stretches the town with dense rooftops and a prominent church spire, with hills and mountains of Auvergne in the background. Printed French text at the top identifies the scene and location.

A black‑and‑white studio photograph of two performers in elaborate theatrical costumes, posing joyfully in front of a curtain. The woman leans back smiling with arms partly outstretched while the man, wearing a decorated jacket, sash and boots, stands behind her supporting her. Printed text beneath the image identifies the actors and the production.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town dominated by a large multi‑span stone viaduct crossing a valley or river. Behind the viaduct rise dense rows of old townhouses with steep roofs, several tall church spires, and fortified towers. In the foreground are trees and a small open area with paths or gardens.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing an Indigenous woman in traditional dress smiling while baking bread in an outdoor adobe beehive oven (horno). She stands holding a long wooden paddle with dough near the oven opening; several loaves rest on a cloth-covered board in the foreground. In the background are scattered low buildings on a dry, open plain. Handwritten or stamped text near the bottom mentions a pueblo.

A hand‑colored illustrated postcard showing a panoramic view of a large monastic complex surrounded by forested hills and a river in the foreground. The complex includes a prominent church with a tall bell tower, long cloister buildings with red-tiled roofs, and ancillary structures. The scene is labeled at the bottom in German, and there is publisher information in small print.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm river with small rapids in the foreground, rocky banks and leafless trees on the right, and buildings visible along the shoreline. A bridge can be seen farther up the river. Printed Swedish text under the image identifies the scene as a part of the Bäfveån in Uddevalla. On the right side of the card there is a large stamp or overprint indicating that it belongs to Uddevalla Museum.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a village street leading to a large stone church with a tall square bell tower, clock, and steep roof. A horse‑drawn cart and a man stand in the street in front of the church. Residential buildings line the right side. Printed French text at the top identifies the location as the church in Davenescourt, in the environs of Montdidier. There is a handwritten date or note in ink near the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a brick railway station building covered partly in ivy, with arched windows and a tiled roof. Several bicycles are parked along the facade and a small wooden kiosk or shed stands in the foreground where a woman and a child with a bicycle are present. Large tree branches frame the top of the image. Printed text at the bottom left names the place as Kattarp railway station, and a small logo with the word 'Pressbyrån' and the year 1937 appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad, tree‑lined residential street with ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses or villas. The façades feature steep gables, dormer windows, decorative stonework, and a tall, narrow spire with a tiled roof, giving the street a Central‑European, Wilhelminian look. A few lampposts and utility poles line the sidewalk; a man in a hat stands on the right near a small cart. The street recedes downhill toward a wooded or semi‑rural background. No visible title, caption, or postal markings appear on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a paddle steamer named "DRESDEN" traveling along a river bordered by wooded hills and rocky cliffs. Small houses are visible on the far bank. The caption at the bottom reads "Aussig–Wannow." and the publisher line "Brück & Sohn, Meissen" with a catalog number. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century river‑scenery postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town with wooden houses, trees, and a river or open plain in the background, seen from an elevated point. In the mid-distance there are church buildings with domes or towers, and low hills beyond. Red-printed Russian text appears at the top and bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a river valley with a bend in the river, steep terraced slopes on the right (likely vineyards), and a clustered settlement of small houses along the riverbank. In the foreground is a large multi‑storey masonry building and, closer to the river, several gabled houses; one bears a sign identifying it as a restaurant. The opposite bank is largely open fields and trees, and a road follows the river on the right side. The scene has the appearance of an early‑20th‑century European riverside town.

A sepia-toned photograph of an ancient stone theatre set in a hilly, wooded landscape. The right side shows the stepped seating of the theatre and part of the circular orchestra. In the foreground are stone columns and scattered ruins. Handwritten text in Greek appears at the lower left, and a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is across the bottom center-right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town nestled in hilly countryside. The town has tightly clustered houses with pitched roofs, a prominent church or town hall with a dome-like tower in the center, and another church tower in the background. Fields and wooded hills surround the settlement. At the bottom, in red script, is a German greeting line, and in smaller print at the lower left is the publisher's information.

A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a wooden railway station building labeled "Mark Station." The one-story structure has a gabled roof, chimney, and decorative trim, set among forested surroundings. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on and near the station platform. Printed text appears at the bottom, along with handwritten Swedish greetings.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a long arcade with several arches and columns in front of a religious building. At the left there is a domed tower with an onion-shaped dome. The architecture combines Byzantine and Ottoman features. Printed captions at the bottom identify the view as the Church of St. Sophia in Salonica, with text in French and English and a date of 1917.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate multi‑story historicist building with a tall, steep spire and bay windows. The street in front is lined with trees and pedestrians in early-20th‑century clothing. At the entrance, a sign reads "Grand Hotel Schützenhaus". Printed red text at the top left identifies the location and hotel name.

Colorized vintage street-view postcard showing a wide road lined with one- and two‑story buildings with arcades and cafes, tables and chairs placed along the sidewalks. People walk and stand in the street, with low mountains visible in the background. Greek text appears at the top of the image and on shop signs. A Greek postage stamp with cancellation marks is printed or affixed in the upper center. The lower right bears the watermark of the website elia.org.gr.

Black-and-white rural scene showing an unpaved road lined with fences and trees, leading toward a wooded area. To the right stands a wooden house with a flagpole. In the background, partially hidden by trees, rises a church tower with a spire. Printed caption text and a photographer/publisher imprint appear along the bottom edge.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a coastal rural scene with a few houses or farm buildings set in flat open land near the sea. Simple fences, grassy terrain, and a farmhouse-style building dominate the view. The captions at the bottom identify the location as Greve Strand and Mosede.

Color postcard showing a formal garden with lush greenery, a statue centered among shrubs, and a neoclassical villa with columns on the right. There is printed caption text at the bottom and handwritten cursive text along the margins and lower edge.

Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town square with cobblestone pavement. In the center stands a rectangular stone fountain with a decorative column and statue. Surrounding the square are 3‑ to 4‑story masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The corner building on the right has a large sign reading "Apotheke." (pharmacy), while the corner building on the left has a shop sign "Alwin Eggler." People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand around; a horse‑drawn wagon is visible at the right edge. The overall look is that of a historical German small town or city square.

A vintage postcard with a sepia-toned portrait of an older bearded man in an oval frame on the right side, wearing a suit and tie. The left side is filled with dense handwritten text in German cursive (Kurrent/Sütterlin style). Below the portrait there is a short handwritten note, and at the bottom left is a dated line mentioning Graz, 8 July 1929. The card has a formal, commemorative appearance, like a portrait card or correspondence from an intellectual or public figure.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a path bordered by dense trees leading toward a large hilltop castle complex with a tall, slender tower and steep roofs. The view is partly framed by overhanging branches. At the bottom margin there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a picturesque courtyard scene with old half-timbered and masonry houses with red-tiled roofs, a large leafy tree in the foreground, and several children standing behind a low picket fence. In the distant background two ornate church or cathedral towers rise above the roofs. At the top center is a printed German caption, and a handwritten number appears in red ink in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural village scene in a hilly landscape: a multi‑storey house with balconies in the foreground, a barn-like building beside it, scattered trees, fenced fields, and several villas or guesthouses on the slope in the background with a dark forest behind. Printed title text appears at the upper left.

A sepia-toned interior view of a richly decorated Gothic room with vaulted ceiling, ornate stone doorway topped by coats of arms, a sculptural niche, wooden paneling, tables and chairs. The scene appears to be a historical municipal office or council room. Printed German text at the bottom identifies it as a room in the Breslau town hall, specifically the antechamber of the senior mayor and mayor.

Hand-colored vintage postcard showing a hilltop complex with a large, pale castle-like building with a red roof and a small tower, surrounded by dense greenery and smaller village houses with tiled and thatched roofs in the foreground. In the background to the right, a tall church tower rises above the trees. The lower part of the card is mostly blank for writing, with red printed German text indicating a greeting from Taubenheim and the printer's details.

A color postcard showing a panoramic view over the historic center of a Central/Eastern European city. In the foreground, on the left, there is a rooftop monument with a chariot-like sculpture: a figure reaching forward and a lion on a plinth decorated with a coat of arms. Below it are ornate 19th‑century buildings lining a main street. On the right stands a mid‑20th‑century modernist block with horizontal bands of windows and a cinema at street level; a red-and-cream trolleybus and several cars travel along the avenue. In the distance, numerous church towers and baroque cupolas rise above red-tiled roofs, with hills forming the backdrop.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a beach scene with fishing boats drawn up on the sand in the foreground, nets and gear spread out, and a man working on a net. Behind them is a wooden pier or sea bridge with many people strolling, some holding umbrellas. The text at the bottom identifies the place as Misdroy and notes that the view is in front of the sea pier. Publisher information is printed along the lower edge.

A sepia-toned postcard showing the terraced gardens and main façade of Sanssouci Palace in Potsdam. A large central fountain shoots water high into the air in the foreground, flanked by classical statues. Behind it rise symmetrical garden terraces lined with trees and balustrades, leading up to the domed palace building at the top.

An old monochrome postcard depicting a lush landscaped garden with palm trees, dense vegetation, and a formal parterre in the foreground. In the middle distance there is a fountain or circular basin. A person stands to the left among the trees. At the bottom is a printed caption identifying the scene, and beneath it there is handwritten text in ink.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a riverside cityscape with a metal truss bridge crossing a river and a tree‑lined embankment. On the far bank stand several multi‑story historic buildings and houses, with hills rising in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the scene as Graz and mentions Kaiser Ferdinand Bridge and Kaiser Franz Josef Quay.

Color-tinted historic postcard showing a large two-story brick building with a tower topped by a cross-shaped mast and a flat roof terrace. The structure has many tall windows and a modest garden or yard with small trees in front. The sky is softly shaded in pastel tones. Text in Russian, German/Latin script, and Estonian is printed at the top describing the place as a maritime school in Baltiski (Baltic Port).

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a cobblestoned market square bordered by 2–3 story townhouses. In the foreground stands a statue on a pedestal surrounded by a small fenced flowerbed. On the right side is a prominent building labeled "Hotel Adler". Additional shop signs are visible on the left. At the top left of the card, the printed caption reads "Wilsdruff – Markt".

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with dirt roads, scattered trees, boulders, telegraph poles and a few wooden houses on gently rolling hills. In the foreground is a rocky path and leafless tree; in the distance stand two prominent houses amid forested surroundings. Printed captions in two languages (Swedish and Finnish) appear in the white margin at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large institutional complex in a rural setting. The central building is a multi‑storey, symmetrical structure with a small tower or cupola and wings extending on both sides, flanked by several wooden houses. There is open grassland in the foreground and forest in the background. Printed captions appear at the bottom indicating the name of the place and the publisher.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilly spa town with many villas and houses among trees, and a prominent church with a tall spire on a higher terrace. In the foreground stands a large villa-style building with dormer windows and balconies. At the lower left edge of the image, cursive writing reads "Bad Elster."

A monochrome historical postcard showing a large military barracks complex with several long three‑story buildings arranged around interior courtyards, bordered by a road and a fenced wall in the foreground. The scene is set in a largely rural landscape with fields and low hills in the distance. German text is printed at the top identifying the place as the barracks of the 2nd Royal Saxon Jäger Battalion No. 13 in Meissen.

Illustrated interior view of an elegant early‑20th‑century restaurant or café, drawn in a Viennese Secession / Wiener Werkstätte style. The room is filled with square tables covered with white cloths and surrounded by wooden chairs with round seat cushions. The walls are made of light-colored glass blocks with geometric stained-glass panels and hanging flower baskets. A bar or service counter with bottles is visible at the back under a large wall clock. Above the room hangs a large circular chandelier with multiple lights. Along the left border runs vertical text, and at the lower right the artist's name is printed.

Sepia-toned rural scene showing a large traditional wooden farmhouse with a steep gabled roof, fenced yard, and surrounding meadows and hills. A few smaller outbuildings and people walking along a path are visible in the background. The image has printed German text at the top identifying the location, along with a vertical printer's mark along the left edge.

Black‑and‑white view of a tall neo‑Gothic brick church with a very slender spire capped by an ornate metal finial. The façade shows pointed arches, statues in niches, buttresses, and a clock on the tower. The church stands behind a low wall along a wide, mostly empty street lined with mature trees. A few pedestrians are visible in early‑20th‑century clothing, and several brick residential buildings appear in the background.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a low, rectangular house with a tiled hip roof, several shuttered windows, and a central entrance with small pillars and steps. The building is set in a landscaped garden with a curved driveway in the foreground and large leafy trees framing the scene. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image.

A colored illustration of a European city street with historic multi‑story buildings. On the left is a long, brown Renaissance/Baroque palace-like structure with many small windows and a clock tower with a green roof rising from the roofline. Ornate façades and bay windows line the street. In the distance, several church towers and domes with green copper roofs and tall spires dominate the skyline. The street below is busy with pedestrians, early 20th‑century style streetlights, and an electric tram car. There is no visible printed caption or legible text on the front.

A vintage Russian Imperial era postcard front, cream-colored with red printed elements. At the top center is the Russian phrase for "Postcard" (ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА). In the upper left is the imperial double-headed eagle crest in red. In the upper right is a red postage stamp with Cyrillic text, overprinted by a circular black postmark dated 23 5 12. Another similar circular postmark appears near the center top. The card is addressed in cursive Latin script to an addressee in Dorpat, with a street and name written below.

Black‑and‑white view of a European spa town set against wooded hills. In the foreground is a long colonnaded building with large windows and a rooftop terrace lined with trees in planters and benches. At its center rises a small circular pavilion with a domed roof supported by columns. To the right stands a tall square tower with an onion‑shaped cupola and open belfry. On the left and in the background are ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses and hotels. German‑language signage is visible on some facades.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a fenced, rural landscape with small wooden houses in the foreground and a larger red-painted wooden building complex on a low hill near a lake. Coniferous forest and hills are visible in the background. At the top-left is printed text reading "Sjukhusområdet, Arjepluog," indicating the local hospital area.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street in a European town. Two- and three‑story brick and stucco houses line both sides, many with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. Trees and picket fences border the sidewalks. In the distance a tall industrial smokestack rises against low hills, and a church or town‑hall tower with a clock or cross is visible to the right. Several pedestrians, a few standing in groups, and a horse‑drawn cart occupy the street; a man stands on the right foreground near a fence. The sky area shows damage or overexposure, suggesting an old photograph reproduced on a postcard. There is some faint, nearly illegible writing or emulsion scratching at the top center.

Black‑and‑white view of a large, ornate brick building with a mansard-style roof, dormer windows, and decorative brick patterns. The facade has a central entrance with an arched doorway and is surrounded by a wrought‑iron fence. At the top of the central section there is an inscription that reads "BIBLIOTECA UNIVERSITĂȚII," indicating it is a university library.

Black‑and‑white elevated view of a Central European town bordered by forested hills. The foreground shows leafy trees and gardens, with several 19th‑century buildings featuring ornate facades, mansard roofs, and tall windows. In the middle ground, dense rows of similar historic townhouses and spa‑style buildings fill a narrow valley. The overall impression is of a picturesque spa or resort town surrounded by wooded slopes.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped square and gardens with a large central monument, surrounded by trees and framed by mountains in the background. On the left is a tall tower with a domed top, and on the right a crenellated castle tower with a flag. The caption at the bottom reads "TRENTO - PIAZZA DANTE E GIARDINI."

Sepia-toned historic postcard-style photograph of a large early‑20th‑century institutional building behind an iron fence and brick gateposts. The architecture is monumental with tall vertical windows, a tower-like corner block, arched windows on a side wing, and a small domed turret to the left. Leafless trees line the street in the foreground. A signboard stands near the entrance gate.

Vintage sepia postcard with a monochrome photograph of a sculpted bust of the Italian poet Giovanni Prati on the left, and a handwritten Italian message on the right. The bust appears rough-hewn at the base and shoulders and is captioned below. Printer's credit is vertically printed in red along the left margin of the image. The card is oriented horizontally, with the photo and caption taking the left half and the manuscript text filling the right half.

The image shows the back side of a handwritten postcard or card. It is a cream-colored card filled with brown ink cursive writing in Estonian. At the top it is dated and mentions 'Tallinnas, 17. III. 1943'. There are no images or printed decorations, only handwriting.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town in a river valley. In the foreground there is a weir and a narrow bridge across the river, with multi‑storey industrial and residential buildings lining the banks. One prominent riverside building bears large painted signage, and another long block with many windows stands on the right. Behind the riverside quarter, densely packed houses climb a wooded slope towards a large hilltop castle complex with towers and ornate gables. On the distant right ridge stands a small church with a steeple. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial town dominated by a historic castle.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a spa or resort complex with a pavilion in the foreground and a two-story building with shutters in the background. In front is a landscaped garden with trimmed bushes, trees, benches, and people strolling or sitting, dressed in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption at the bottom identifies the place as a pavilion in Topusko.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large, open parade ground bordered by simple wooden fencing, surrounded by multi‑storey rectangular buildings with many windows and shutters. Some small groups of people and possibly soldiers are visible near the buildings. In the background there are low hills or mountains. Printed red text at the top identifies the location, and there is a short handwritten note in pen near the top left.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate metal bridge with decorative lampposts and pedestrians walking along the embankment. Across the river stand multi‑story townhouses and a church tower with a green onion dome and clock. In the background, a wooded hill rises with fortification buildings on top and a distinctive clock tower on the slope. The printed caption at the top left reads "Graz. Schlossberg."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a two‑storey stone building labeled as a hotel, with an attached lower wing. The architecture features masonry walls, arched ground‑floor openings, and a small central balcony. In the foreground there is a pile of stones or rubble beside an unpaved street. The card has printed captions in German‑style script at the top and along the left margin, and wide blank margins typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large cathedral with a tall central tower capped by an ornate dome and spire, rising above surrounding low townhouses and streets. The image is framed with a white border, and printed captions run vertically along the left side, identifying the location and the church.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a rural European village. In the foreground is an open grassy field. Beyond it runs a road lined with small trees and a low fence. Behind the trees stand several gabled houses with tiled roofs and shuttered windows. A horse‑drawn cart and a few people are visible on the road. In the background, partly obscured by trees and roofs, rises the tower of a church with a bulbous (onion-shaped) dome. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Colorized vintage view of a broad, tree-lined boulevard with wide pedestrian paths, early street lamps, horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians. The scene is calm and park-like, with tall rows of trees on both sides and a pale pink-and-blue sky. The printed caption at the top left reads "NIJMEGEN Oranjesingel".

Colorized panoramic view over a river valley town surrounded by low mountains and green fields. The river runs through the center with embankments and bridges, and clusters of early 20th‑century buildings with red roofs line both sides. A patch of the image near the foreground is damaged or missing. At the top center, printed text in German reads "Graz gegen Norden." The overall style resembles an old picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river with strong flowing water in the foreground, a bridge and a solid stone building with arched openings in the middle, and forested hills in the background. At the bridge pier is a large sculpted stone head, representing a river spirit. Printed captions and publisher information appear at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a gently curving cobblestone road lined with late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century townhouses and shopfronts. Signs in German advertise a restaurant and various businesses. A man in a white coat and a child stand in front of a building on the left. In the distance, a Baroque‑style church tower rises above the roofs. The overall look suggests a historic Central European town.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Bautzen with a prominent stone railway viaduct in the foreground. Behind the viaduct rise dense townhouses, towers, and church spires, including a large church dominating the skyline. Trees and vegetation fill the lower portion of the image. Printed caption text in German appears at the bottom along with publisher information and a date.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European village nestled in a valley. In the foreground are fields and scattered trees leading to a row of gabled houses. To the right stands a church with a tall spire and rectangular tower. On the wooded hillside above the town is a prominent stone castle or fortified manor complex with multiple wings and turrets. Rolling hills and forests extend into the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town with dense, low-rise houses, several church towers, a tall factory chimney, and wooded surroundings. In the foreground a train with multiple carriages travels along railway tracks. At the top left, the place name 'Bischofswerda.' is printed in red type, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Black‑and‑white night view of a town with snow-covered ground and buildings, captured during a large fireworks display. Long-exposure streaks of light arc and fall against a dark sky. At the bottom, white caption text in Swedish identifies the scene as fireworks at the inauguration of the town of Kiruna, and credits the photographer C. O. Lundberg.

Color photograph of a rural European village scene. In the foreground is a paved parking area with several 1960s–1970s cars, including a white sedan and green and red station wagons. Behind them stands a light-colored, three-story gabled building with a dark roof, likely a guesthouse or small hotel, with children visible near the entrance. In the background are traditional half‑timbered houses and farm buildings spread at the base of a green, tree-covered hill under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a semi‑nude woman reclining on cushions and textiles in an orientalist 'harem' or 'odalisque' pose. She wears a headscarf with a gold forehead ornament, a necklace and bracelet, and loose draped trousers or skirt. The background shows embroidered or woven decorative fabrics. In the upper right is printed text in French with a catalog number.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large Baroque church and monastery complex set on a hill in a rural, hilly landscape. The complex has red-tiled roofs, two tall twin towers with onion domes, and a central domed structure. Smaller surrounding buildings and paths lead through gardens and fields in the foreground. In the upper right corner, red printed text reads "Mariatrost bei Graz."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate doorway of a historic palazzo. The entrance is framed by two sculpted figures acting as caryatids or atlantes on either side of the door, with stone columns beneath them. Above is an iron balcony with decorative railing and shuttered windows. The facade has rusticated stonework and a small, grilled window to the left. Printed captions identify the scene as the gate of Palazzo Larcher in Trento, and the left margin bears the printer's information.

Black‑and‑white landscape view along a calm river with trees and meadows in the foreground. On a hill above the river stands a medieval castle ruin with a tall round tower, and farther to the right on the ridge a church with a tower and dome-like roof. The scene is rural and gently hilly. A printed caption in German appears at the bottom margin of the image.

Color image showing several mid-20th‑century red‑brick apartment blocks with pitched red roofs and small balconies, bordering a large grassy, partly undeveloped field under a blue sky with scattered clouds. The scene looks like a residential suburb. No visible printed title, caption, or handwriting appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over the Danube River in Budapest, showing the Széchenyi Chain Bridge with early automobiles and carriages crossing. The foreground features large riverside buildings, and across the river is the Pest side with a dense row of classical buildings. A large domed church, identifiable as St. Stephen's Basilica, rises prominently in the background. Text is printed in red at the bottom margin in Hungarian and German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a central photograph bordered by decorative scrollwork. The scene shows a waterfront street with a stone promenade, buildings rising closely along the left, pedestrians walking, and a man leaning on a railing beside a tall lamppost. The sea is on the right. There is a green Greek postage stamp with a postmark in the upper right of the photo area. French and Greek printed text as well as handwritten Greek inscriptions appear around the image.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a brick pedestrian bridge or walkway leading toward two square brick pillars with decorative caps, surrounded by dense trees. At the far end of the bridge stand a couple of people near a gate, with a hint of water or open space visible beyond the trees. The image has a white border with printed captions at the bottom indicating the location and subject.

A vintage, ornately framed advertising postcard featuring a color illustration of a young woman in traditional Spanish attire. She wears a lace mantilla over her dark hair adorned with red flowers, pearl necklaces, and a green dress. The portrait is set in an oval frame with gold decorative embossing and a bow motif at the top, all on a cream background. At the bottom, in red capital letters, appears the brand and city name.

Black-and-white postcard image of a sandy beach lined with small pointed-roof bathing cabins. People in early 20th‑century swimwear and light suits lounge and walk along the shore. A forested area is visible behind the cabins. Printed text at the top right identifies the location as Hangö / Hanko and the beach as Strandplagen.

An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city square with a large ornate fountain in the center. Water jets arc from the fountain into a circular basin. People are standing and walking around the fountain, and horse‑drawn carriages or early vehicles appear nearby. Surrounding the square are multi‑story stone buildings with elaborate facades and mansard roofs. Handwritten cursive text covers the bottom portion of the image, and faint printed text appears along the lower edge.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large four‑storey barracks building in a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century style, with a green roof, gables, and a central tower-like dome. The building occupies a street corner with trees and pedestrians in front. German text captions appear at the top identifying the location and the military unit housed there.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an archaeological site with extensive stone ruins and a low rectangular building with a pitched roof in the middle ground. The ruins stretch across the foreground with a few small human figures walking among them, while gently rolling hills and a road appear in the background. On the right side of the card there is printed bilingual text in French and Greek identifying the site as the royal palace of Minos.

A monochrome panoramic view over open fields leading to a small town. A dirt road runs from the foreground towards the town, with a horse-drawn carriage traveling along it. The town in the distance has clustered houses and a prominent church tower rising above the rooftops. At the top left in red print is a German caption.

Vintage monochrome postcard view over a river in an urban setting, showing tree‑lined embankments and three closely spaced bridges with pedestrians. Residential and commercial buildings line both sides of the river. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal promenade with neoclassical waterfront buildings, a pier with many people gathered, small boats in a calm harbor, and mountains in the background. The border has a scalloped edge typical of vintage postcards. Greek text is handwritten along the bottom edge, and the printed web address 'www.elia.org.gr' appears over the image.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet lakeside or riverside scene. In the foreground there is calm water with a small wooden rowboat tied to a post. The far bank is lined with rocks and a gently sloping shore leading up to dense trees and bushes. A small boathouse or shed stands near the waterline. The photo has a wide white border, rounded corners, and visible wear and creases consistent with vintage postcards. No text is clearly visible on the image side.

Black-and-white postcard showing a coastal town built amphitheatrically on a hillside beside a calm bay. Rows of white, cubic stone houses with flat or gently sloped roofs line the waterfront and climb the slope. Low clouds hang over the ridge behind the town. The sea in the foreground reflects the buildings. Greek text appears in a strip at the bottom, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate neoclassical building identified in Hungarian as the Palace of Justice. Above and to the right is a graphic design of a stylized sun with long radiating rays. The printed caption on the photo names the city as Kolozsvár, with additional Hungarian text under the image. The scene appears to be an official judicial/government building in an open square or wide street.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neo‑Renaissance city hall building with a large central dome and corner towers, opening onto a busy square filled with market stalls and umbrellas. Tram tracks and pedestrians run along a broad street lined with multi‑story buildings. A church tower rises in the background. Handwritten German text appears along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large round masonry tower with a conical roof on the left and a tall church with a high, narrow spire on the right. Leafless trees and snow-covered ground dominate the foreground, with some low buildings and a wall visible between the two towers. A handwritten number "4230" appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park on a hillside with a central water fountain, trees, and a winding path leading upward. At the top left stands a large ornate building with towers and a flag. In the foreground is a street with a picket fence and a horse‑drawn carriage. To the right, an entrance gate with a wooden arch bears the inscription "G. Remele's Naturheilanstalt." A tall building stands just beyond the gate.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide sandy open field with many people strolling and gathering in the distance. In the foreground are adults and children dressed in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing, including long dark dresses and hats. Hills or a shoreline are visible in the far background. The caption at the bottom reads "La Coruña — Campo de la Estrada," and there is a handwritten signature in the lower right. Along the left margin appears the printer's information printed vertically.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a staged theatrical scene inside an ornate paneled room with carved wooden doors and painted heraldic murals on the upper walls. At the right, an older, pale-faced man in evening dress leans over a fainting or swooning woman in a long dark gown who reclines on a sofa or chaise. At the left there is a table with tall candlesticks and an elaborate carved chair or throne. The image has no visible printed caption or border text on the front.

A monochrome vintage view of a small cobblestoned village square with traditional multi‑story houses. In the center stands a large building with arched windows and balconies; on the right side is a building with shutters partly covered in climbing plants and signage identifying a restaurant. Overhead wires cross the sky. The printed caption at the top names the place and the restaurant.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the massive stone fortification walls and towers of an old coastal city built on a hillside. A prominent round fortress dominates the upper part of the image, while defensive walls and bastions run down the slope beside clusters of Mediterranean-style houses and abundant trees. At the bottom margin in cursive script is the word "Dubrovnik," and on the right the phrase "Foto Tempo," indicating the photographer or studio.

A vintage black‑and‑white photograph of a canal lined with small wooden shacks and market stalls on the left and tall trees on the right. Flat-bottomed boats move along the water, some paddled by standing figures with poles. People sit and work along the canal bank, and low commercial buildings with painted signs can be seen behind the shacks. The scene evokes a traditional canalside market in a rural-urban setting.

Sepia-toned historic view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a river with moored wooden bathhouses or barges and a metal truss bridge crossing the water. Along the riverbank stands a row of multi‑story buildings with steep roofs; a tall church tower with an onion dome and clock rises prominently from the town. On the hillside behind the town are terraced paths and a large fortress complex on top of the hill, as well as a separate clock tower structure on the slope. The scene is framed like a classic early 20th‑century city postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobbled town square with an equestrian statue at its center. On both sides stand rows of 3–4 story buildings with shops, cafés, and traditional German signage. To the left is a building labeled "Cafe Central" and another sign for "Adolf Meyer". On the right are facades with painted signs including "Carl Lochmann". In the background rise two tall, identical neo‑Gothic church towers. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll across the square.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a richly painted wooden church. The photo shows wooden pews, a small altar with candles and flowers, painted biblical scenes on the walls, and a pulpit with religious paintings. A hymn-number board hangs to the right. At the lower left the caption identifies the church, and at the lower right is a printer's mark.

The image shows the handwritten back of an old French postcard. At the top center appears the printed heading "CARTE POSTALE" with the usual divisions "Correspondance" on the left and "Adresse" on the right. A diagonal pencil message fills the correspondence side, and a recipient address is written on the right. In the upper left a date is written in pencil. The card is sepia-toned and aged.

A vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a wide, unpaved avenue lined with low, colonial-style buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the sidewalks; a few children pose in the foreground. The caption at the top identifies the location as a street called Calle de San Lázaro in Figueras.

Color view over a small European town with many low wooden and masonry houses, red and grey roofs, and abundant greenery. In the distance stands a tall church with a pointed spire dominating the skyline, alongside a few other larger buildings and a water tower. The style and printing resemble a mid‑ to late‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a sparsely developed industrial settlement in a hilly, forested landscape. A dirt road curves through the foreground where a solitary man stands facing the camera. In the middle distance there is a cluster of long, wooden industrial and residential buildings with simple gabled roofs, some on stilts or scaffolding as if under construction. Tall bare poles, possibly for power or telegraph lines, stand among the buildings. Coniferous forest and low hills form the background. At the top left there is printed text in a Scandinavian language.

Rectangular card printed in German, formatted like an official notice or postal card. The heading line at the top right reads "Riga, Datum d. Poststempels". The body text refers to the Monument Administration at the Ministry of Education of Latvia sending out a publication. A typed insertion reads "E. Brastinsch Lettlands Burgberge Livland". There are dotted lines for filling in information and a closing line "Denkmälerverwaltung" at the bottom right.

A black-and-white postcard showing the façade of a Gothic cathedral with two tall, ornate spires and a central entrance tower. The view is from a street or square leading up to the building, with trees and lower buildings on the sides. At the bottom margin there is printed German text identifying the cathedral, and red handwritten numbers appear vertically on the right side.

A monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard view of a mountain landscape. In the foreground there is a two‑story house with dark shutters beside a winding road lined with trees and grass. Coniferous trees partially obscure the house, and beyond them a valley with terraced fields stretches toward high, snow‑streaked mountains under a partly cloudy sky. A caption at the bottom margin names the location and its elevation.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow street lined with traditional multi‑story buildings featuring overhanging wooden mashrabiya balconies. A mosque minaret rises above the buildings along the street. People are faintly visible walking in the street. The style and wear of the card suggest an early 20th‑century photograph.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large school building with a central tower and flagpole, set on a sloping lawn with many students and people walking along a path in front. Trees frame the scene, and there is printed red text in the upper right corner identifying the school, plus handwritten-style numbers in black at the top left and red at the bottom right.

A colorized vintage illustration showing a riverside or lakeside scene with trees and small houses in the foreground and a large brick Gothic cathedral with two tall, slender spires rising above the town in the background. The overall style and wear suggest an old printed postcard.

An old monochrome postcard showing a riverside street scene with ornate buildings on the left, a picket fence and bridge over the water in the foreground, and a hill with houses and a large church tower with a domed roof in the background. There is printed text at the bottom with the place name and publisher, and handwritten cursive text across the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural village in a hilly, forested landscape. Farmhouses with pitched roofs are clustered in a valley, surrounded by fields and tree‑covered hills. On the right side stands a church or similar building with a tower. At the top left of the front side, printed in red, is the caption identifying the place as Bärenstein near Dresden.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a barefoot man in traditional dress with a turban, leaning on a stick and carrying a large waterskin over his back, posed against a plain backdrop. At the bottom left the caption reads "Water Seller." There is a circular seal impression in the lower left and a small number "202" printed in the lower right.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a hillside town with traditional stone or tile-roofed houses scattered among trees. On the hilltop stands a prominent church complex with a bell tower and surrounding buildings, overlooking the town. The text at the bottom is in Greek.

A color postcard showing a busy urban square with pedestrians, trees, and several cars and buses from the mid‑20th century. On the right is a yellow historic theater-like building with a decorated facade and a banner above its entrance. In the center background stands a taller, more modern block with vertical window bays and a rooftop sign in a Baltic-style language. On the left edge there is a marquee with neon letters partly visible. The scene is framed by large trees and cobblestone pavement.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned square with a prominent historic town hall building (Rathaus) in the center. The facade has tall arched windows, four white columns, and decorative towers or turrets along the roofline. Flanking the square are older multi‑story buildings and small shops. Printed captions in German appear below the image and along the left edge.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a broad urban street intersection with early 20th‑century buildings, a clock on a decorative column, tram or trolley wires overhead, and pedestrians scattered in the street. The lower portion contains handwritten text in Greek. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the scene as a street view in Athens.

Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobbled town square or main street flanked by 3–4 story buildings with steep tiled roofs in a Central European style. On the right stands a tall clock‑tower with a tiered baroque/renaissance spire attached to the town hall; further back another ornate building with spires is visible. Pedestrians walk sparsely in the open square, a few carts or early vehicles appear in the distance, and several shop signs in German are visible on the façades.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior arcade of a mosque. Long carpets line a covered colonnade with arches and doors on the left. Two veiled figures sit on the carpets, while another figure walks in an open courtyard to the right, bordered by a wooden fence and trees. The caption in French is printed along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a statue of an armored medieval knight with a beard, holding a long spear and resting one hand on a book or shield. The statue stands on a tall stone pedestal inscribed in German Gothic script and bearing a heraldic shield. The monument is enclosed by short stone posts linked with chains, on a patterned pavement. In the background are leafy trees and plain facades of older European-style buildings.

Colorized historic postcard view of a landscaped public square with a central flowerbed bordered by low fencing, surrounded by lawns, trees, and paths. In the background are several ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs and decorative façades. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. Red printed captions identify the location as Riesa on the Elbe River and the specific square as Kaiser‑Wilhelm‑Platz.

Illustrated view of the Potala Palace on a hill above the city of Lhasa, surrounded by mountains and scattered buildings below. The image is framed like a collectible trade card or postcard with Dutch text describing Lhasa as the holy city of Lamaism and mentioning the Potala, the 'besielde berg' (ensouled or sacred mountain). At the bottom is an advertisement line for Liebig products, and on the right a facsimile signature 'J. Liebig'.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of powerful rapids or waterfalls rushing around a rocky island, with forested banks on both sides and some bridge or industrial structures in the far background. The caption at the bottom left identifies the location as Trollhättan Toppö- & Gullöfallet. At the bottom right, there is a photographer/printer credit and numbering.

Stylized illustrated view of a stone path bordered by low stone walls and lush green trees, leading toward a village of white-roofed houses nestled among greenery beside a river. In the forested hillside on the opposite bank a small castle or ruin is visible. At the bottom of the image appear the artist's signature and the captions indicating the Wachau region and the town of Weissenkirchen.

Black‑and‑white image showing a landscaped garden with flowerbeds, trimmed shrubs, a central stone planter, and curved walking paths in the foreground. A person is seated on a bench at the right. Behind the garden stand two sizable villa‑style buildings on a gentle slope, surrounded by dense forest. One building has a sign on its upper facade and balconies; the other, slightly to the right, has a more modest size with a sign on the gable wall. The scene evokes a spa or pension complex in a wooded hillside setting.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with old houses and stone walls, with several people in early 20th‑century dress walking or standing in the foreground. In the distance, part of the city fortifications or walls is visible on a hill. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Salonique/Salonica and describe it as a corner of the fortifications, dated 1917.

Black‑and‑white riverside scene showing a large iron arch bridge with masonry piers spanning a wide river. In the foreground are cobblestone quays with moored riverboats, cranes, stacked lumber, barrels, and a horse‑drawn wagon loaded with bricks. On the far bank and hills rise villas and larger buildings. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century European cityscape.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a busy urban street with two‑storey buildings, pedestrians, and a tram or carriage moving along the main road. Signs and architecture suggest an early 20th‑century Mediterranean city. Greek text appears at the top, and French text on the right identifies the scene as the Grande Rue du Vardar in Salonique (Thessaloniki).

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a central square with an ornate corner building and a large statue in the middle. The caption on the front reads "Ljubljana – Prešernov spomenik." The reverse shows handwriting, a postage stamp, postmarks, and the printed word "Dopisnica."

Vintage black‑and‑white picture postcard with an Art Nouveau frame. The front shows a view of a city square with a tram, pedestrians, and buildings, with a hilltop castle in the background. The image is captioned "Marijin trg." and the city name "Ljubljana" is printed decoratively. The reverse has handwritten message and address, a green Austro‑Hungarian stamp, and a circular postmark reading "LJUBLJANA," with the printed word "Dopisnica."

Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young mother in Edwardian dress with two children: a baby in a long christening gown lying on a cushion and a toddler standing beside her. German captions are printed on the image. Publisher and photographer credits at the bottom indicate Berlin/Hamburg. The reverse has a museum stamp from Bad Pyrmont and penciled numbers.

Color postcard showing a small lakeside restaurant with a red roof on a tiny peninsula, trees, terraces with tables, and a long pier on calm water. In the distance are low resort buildings with red roofs and a forested shoreline under a bright blue sky. The back side has multilingual caption identifying the place as the Albatros Restaurant in Neptun, Romania, a Romanian stamp and Bucharest postmark, and blue handwritten message and address.

Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The picture side shows four photographs from the city of Pécs, Hungary: the ornate City Hall building labeled "Városháza"; a wooded hillside scene with a building labeled "Üdülőszálló" (holiday hotel); a grand cathedral with towers and cascading fountains labeled "Székesegyház"; and a wide street view labeled "Ferenc József út", with tram tracks and buildings leading toward distant hills. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a Hungarian stamp reading "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" with a postmark, and the printer's mark "FOTO WEINSTOCK" and code "4206/41. sz."

A multi-view color postcard showing various landmarks of the city of Pécs. The main images include a large square with a domed former mosque in the center, surrounded by historic buildings and parked cars; a night view of the same domed building; a Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in the foreground; some stone ruins in a green park; and a modern-looking building set among trees. The word "PÉCS" is printed prominently on the front. The back shows handwritten Hungarian text, a red Magyar Posta stamp, and address lines.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural hillside with scattered villas and summer houses around the Tettye plateau, with trees, fenced fields, and a few flagpoles. The front caption in Hungarian reads "Nyaralók a tettyei fennsík körül." The reverse side has printed Hungarian text describing the place, space for correspondence and address, handwritten German and Hungarian messages, and a green Hungarian postage stamp with a postmark.

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a bustling urban street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. In the background stands a prominent Baroque-style church or tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Red printed captions at the top read a city name on the left and a street name on the right. The reverse side has a green 5‑fillér Hungarian stamp, printed red text along the left margin, and handwritten Hungarian correspondence and address lines.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large, ornate railway station building with towers and arched windows. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the open square in front of the station. Trees and a streetlamp line the left side. The caption at the top reads "Pécs — Pályaudvar". The reverse side is blank except for printed dividing lines, a circular stamp mark, and publisher information along the left edge.

Vintage colored postcard showing a broad, straight avenue lined with trees and tram tracks in a historic city. On the right stands a large Art Nouveau building with a tall spire; in the distance a cathedral with multiple towers rises against hilly, green surroundings. The front has printed captions at the bottom and appears slightly worn. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Hungarian, printed postcard dividing lines, and a publisher's stamp.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a military parade on a cobblestone street lined with crowds and traditional half-timbered buildings. Mounted soldiers ride in formation along tram tracks while onlookers stand densely packed on both sides of the street, many waving flags. The scene is labeled as the solemn entry of Marshal Pétain into Strasbourg on 25 November 1918, with troops parading at Pont du Faubourg National. Printed captions and credits appear at the bottom of the image.

Vintage sepia portrait of a young woman standing indoors in front of a painted studio backdrop. She wears a patterned headscarf, a dark buttoned jacket and a long patterned skirt over a checked underskirt, with dark stockings and shoes. Her left hand rests on her hip and her right hand rests on an ornate side table with a vase of white flowers. The reverse side is blank except for guide lines for address and a few handwritten notes and a label in one corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, rectangular three‑storey school building on a street corner. The structure has a tiled hip roof with dormers, many tall rectangular windows, and a stone base. There are two arched entrances with short stairways; one bears a relief sculpture and inscription above the arch. Hungarian text is printed along the top border of the image, and more Hungarian inscriptions appear on the facade, including a coat‑of‑arms panel. A few pedestrians walk along the street in front.

A multi-view black-and-white postcard showing several scenes related to Burg Kriebstein and its surroundings. The central image depicts a medieval hilltop castle rising above a rocky, wooded river valley. Other panels show a church-like interior with an ornate painted vaulted ceiling and altar, paintings or artwork associated with the castle, and river or reservoir views with boats and forested hills. In the lower center there is white Gothic-style German text on a black background.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, rectangular post office building on a broad, mostly empty square. The three‑story structure has a tiled gabled roof, many evenly spaced windows, and an entrance marked with the word "POSTAMT" above the doorway. Several early automobiles and bicycles stand in front of the building. Bare trees frame the image, suggesting late autumn or winter. On the right margin of the card there is handwritten script indicating the place and building.

Black‑and‑white view of a street corner with a large, ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century apartment and commercial building. The structure has four to five storeys with mansard roofs, dormer windows, decorative stonework and small wrought‑iron balconies. Ground‑floor shopfronts with large display windows line both visible sides. Several pedestrians stand on the sidewalk. Visible shop signs read "HERMES" high on the corner façade and again above a storefront, along with German‑language shop names on neighboring stores.

Color-printed postcard showing a lakeside view of a baroque hunting castle with four round corner towers and red domes, reflected in the water and framed by dark tree branches in the foreground. At the bottom margin, the caption reads "JAGDSCHLOSS MORITZBURG."

A vintage black-and-white panoramic view over a densely built small town with many detached houses and trees. In the foreground stands a long building with a bell tower and clock. At the top left, printed in red Gothic-style type, is the caption 'Kötzschenbroda-Niederlößnitz.' The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Sepia-toned street scene along a riverside embankment with bookstalls set up on a low stone wall. Several men in long coats and hats browse or stand chatting near the stalls. Trees line the walkway, whose fallen leaves suggest autumn, and a river with a distant bridge or buildings is visible in the background. The overall look is early 20th-century European.
