There is a striped awning over the ground‑floor terrace, climbing plants and a formal garden in the foreground, with benches along a path and a gazebo to the right, all surrounded by dense trees. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image.

Sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate neoclassical building with two stories plus a raised basement, tall rectangular windows, and arched windows on the ground floor. The facade has pilasters, decorative window pediments, and a central entrance with steps and a small portico. Along the roofline is a balustrade and an elaborate sculpted crest bearing Latin text, including the word 'INSTITUT.' In the foreground is a path or driveway bordered by a clipped hedge and lawn. At the bottom of the image, handwritten text identifies the location and date.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European small town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are dense rows of multi‑storey houses with steep gabled roofs, some half‑timbered. Further back stand detached villas and farmhouses, fields, orchards, and tree‑covered hills. A large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire dominates the center of the scene, surrounded by several prominent civic or school‑like buildings. The horizon shows patchwork farmland and forest. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A vintage, colorized postcard view of a powerful waterfall rushing through a rocky gorge, with pine-covered cliffs on both sides. Above the gorge spans a light metal truss bridge supported by stone abutments. At the top of the image there is printed text in Swedish that reads: "Trollhättan. Östra Toppöfallet." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural valley with dense conifer forest on the surrounding hillsides. In the foreground stands a large half‑timbered farmhouse with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, accompanied by a wooden barn across a narrow country road. Trees and meadows fill the scene, and framing branches overhang the top of the image. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a rural Scandinavian settlement with several wooden farmhouses and outbuildings, surrounded by fields, trees, and traditional wooden fences in the foreground. The scene is gently rolling countryside with a few scattered buildings and a dirt road. In the upper left corner, red printed text reads "Fra Elverum."

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a hillside spa town. In the foreground are several ornate multi‑story buildings lined with trees. High on the hill stands a large villa‑like building with towers and a steep roof, surrounded by dense forest. The caption at the bottom in red type reads "Marienbad. Café Egerländer." Additional small red text credits the printer and publisher.

Vintage sepia portrait of a formally dressed man in white tie, cape and top hat, standing and facing slightly left. The background is softly airbrushed. Under the image is the printed name "Harry Piel". In the bottom margin are small publisher and photographer credits indicating it is a studio publicity postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing the silhouette of a hilltop castle ruin against a bright, cloudy sky. Trees and forested slopes obscure the lower part of the structure, while broken walls and two prominent towers are visible on the right. The caption "Burgruine Gösting." appears in small white type at the bottom left of the image.

A vintage postcard printed in orange ink showing a simplified route map around Nijmegen and the Maas/Waal rivers. It is titled in Dutch at the top and includes place names such as Numege(n), Hatert, Heumen, Malden, Mook, Middelaar, Groesbeek, Berg en Dal, Grave, Beers, and Cuijk. Distances for marching routes (30 km, 40–50–55 km, etc.) are marked along the roads, with a north arrow and a scale of 1:150,000. There is a printed date line for an 'Eerste Marschdag' with a later stamp marking the year 1935. At the bottom right appears the phrase 'Nadruk verboden.'

Black‑and‑white view over a formal town square or small park with young trees and paths in the foreground. Across the square stands a grand late‑19th‑century building with ornate stone façade, mansard and hipped roofs, likely a municipal or institutional building. To the right is a freestanding villa with a steep, hipped roof and arched gable dormer. Surrounding blocks consist of multi‑storey brick townhouses and apartment buildings. The scene appears European, photographed in winter or early spring, with bare trees and clear sky. No visible caption or border text appears on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal town taken from the water, showing a waterfront lined with arcaded buildings and a prominent church tower with a clock. Small boats float in the harbor in the foreground. A caption is printed vertically along the left margin.

Colored vintage postcard view of a coastal bay surrounded by hills and mountains. A town with red‑roofed houses lines the curved shoreline, with a harbor full of small boats. A narrow peninsula with tall cypress trees and several white buildings extends into the water in the foreground. The scene is labeled at the top with multilingual text indicating the port of Gruž/Gravosa.

A vintage, color-illustrated Christmas postcard showing a snowy evening scene in a historic European city square. Old multi-story buildings with lit windows surround a central fountain or monument. In the foreground stands an angelic child figure holding a small decorated Christmas tree and a basket. In the background on a hill rises a clock-tower-like structure and fortifications under a full moon. Gold-colored German text appears at the top of the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide view of a military-style tent camp on open land with hills in the background and a small town in the distance. Numerous white canvas tents are arranged in rows, and several formations of boy cadets in dark uniforms stand in lines in front of the tents. At the top of the card there are handwritten archival notes, and along the bottom in red print is a caption describing the scene.

Black‑and‑white, multi‑view interior postcard showing four photographs of a modernist mid‑20th‑century restaurant or hotel café. The upper-left view depicts a dining area with small square tables, minimalist chairs, table lamps, and a large landscape painting on a dark wood-paneled wall. The upper-right view shows a long bar counter with high stools, glass shelves with bottles and glasses behind it, and spot lighting above. The lower-left view presents another seating section with small tables, upholstered chairs, decorative standing lamps and an elaborate ceiling light installation made of many small bulbs. The lower-right view features a larger dining space with several grouped tables, wood-paneled walls, patterned wallpaper, framed pictures, and a coffered ceiling. No visible handwritten or printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early‑20th‑century European city intersection with cobblestone pavement, horse‑drawn carts, a few pedestrians, and multi‑story masonry buildings. On the prominent corner building at right the sign "STADT DRESDEN" appears along the facade. Other shop signs include "Max Esche" and a grocery labeled "Kolonialwaren, Kaffee Kakao…". Overhead utility wires and a tall smokestack are visible in the background, and there is a kiosk or pillar with notices posted on it in the foreground.

Color-tinted vintage street view showing a large statue of a man in historical dress on a high pedestal in a European square. The statue stands by a canal, surrounded by stepped-gable houses and cobbled streets. Small groups of people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand nearby. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the scene as Bruges and the statue and square of Jean Van Eyck. Additional small text at the bottom notes the editor and location in Brussels.

Black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a row of multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows and ornate balconies in an old European city. Large painted letters on one facade read "HOTEL CARLONI." A horse‑drawn carriage with two horses and a driver stands in the foreground on a wide, mostly empty street lined with similar buildings. The printed heading at the top says "TRENTO Via Lunga – Hotel Carloni," and there is a small publisher credit at the bottom.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large military barracks building with corner towers and a central spire behind a line of trees. In the large open parade ground in the foreground, several formations of soldiers and horse-drawn artillery are assembled in review. At the top in red German text it identifies the scene as a barracks in Dresden for a Saxon rifle (fusilier) regiment.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an artesian well structure in the foreground, with water gushing into a rectangular stone basin and flowing out through a small channel. In the background is a geometric plantation of young palm trees laid out in rows across a flat, arid landscape. Printed caption text appears at the top.

Monochrome historic postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to an arched gate complex attached to large, multi‑storey buildings with tiled roofs and ornate towers. The central building has two rows of arched windows above three large passageway arches. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. The caption at the top reads "Graz. Burgtor, Erzherzog Johann-Allee."

Colorized interior view of a large Ottoman mosque, showing massive fluted columns, green and patterned tiled walls, pointed arches, and arched windows. Hanging chandeliers and calligraphic Arabic bands decorate the space. Along the right margin a printed caption identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large late‑19th‑ / early‑20th‑century brick complex behind a high wall and iron gate. The building has steep, slate-clad, mansard-like roofs with many small dormers and tall chimneys, suggesting institutional or official use (such as a school or government residence). A dirt road runs along the front with young trees planted by the sidewalk. The architecture is orderly and symmetrical, with tall rectangular windows and modest decorative brickwork.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with dense rows of 3–4 story masonry houses and steep tiled roofs. In the middle and background rise two large baroque or neo‑baroque church towers dominating the skyline. Smokestacks and factory buildings suggest early industrialization, while bare trees indicate either late autumn or early spring. The town is surrounded by gently rolling, cultivated hills. The image has the aspect and framing of an old photographic postcard, but no visible caption or border text.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long neoclassical building with many windows and a central arched entrance, set in front of cultivated fields and low trees. To the right is a church-like structure with a dome and bell tower. Behind, low hills and scattered houses rise up the slope. The caption at the bottom is in French and Greek, and there is a printed web watermark from a Greek archive.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small coastal village in a rocky archipelago. Wooden houses with pitched roofs line the shoreline around a calm bay in which a small sailboat is moored. Rugged granite cliffs surround the water, and a pier and boathouses extend into the bay. In the foreground, a house and dense bushes sit on rocky terrain. Printed caption text appears at the lower left and a small publisher's logo with a number appears at the lower right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, ornate brick courthouse complex with steep tiled roofs, gables, and decorative façades. The main building has a tall central section with large arched windows and elaborate roof detail. Another connected building stands to the left. A fence and trees line the front, and a broad street runs along the bottom where two small children are visible on the sidewalk. The caption at the top left reads "Rosswein – Amtsgericht".

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large half-timbered house with a tiled roof and dormer windows, labeled as an electricity works and post office. In front of the building stand several people, including a man on horseback, a man in uniform, and others near the entrance. The setting appears rural, with trees, a stone wall, wooden fence, and work materials stacked beside the house. The text is printed in German at the top and in red at the bottom, with a handwritten number in red ink in the upper right corner.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large crowd gathered beside a stationary passenger train. Most people wear early 20th‑century formal clothing: men in suits and hats, women in dresses and wide‑brimmed hats, some holding umbrellas or flowers. Two men in dark coats stand with their backs to the camera facing the crowd, suggesting a speech, greeting, or ceremonial reception on the platform. The train cars are wooden with vertical paneling and several open windows; there are trees in the background.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy urban square with multi‑story European‑style buildings, tram or power lines overhead, and groups of pedestrians and uniformed sailors in the foreground. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Liberty Square in Salonica/Salonique (modern Thessaloniki). A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible across the image.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large religious procession on a cobblestoned street. Priests and participants carry large decorated banners with sacred images and crosses, surrounded by a crowd of men, women, and children in early 20th‑century clothing. Historic urban buildings and a church tower rise in the background. Printed captions in Hungarian and German appear beneath the image.

Color image showing a calm blue lake surrounded by steep, forested mountains. In the foreground are a few houses with red-tiled roofs and a larger lakeside building, likely a hotel or villa, with light-colored walls and multiple windows. Trees and greenery fill the shoreline, and the scene is under a clear blue sky. No visible text appears on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view over a European city with a river curving through the scene, lined by multi‑story historic buildings and industrial chimneys. A metal truss bridge crosses the river in the foreground, with tree‑lined embankments and hills in the distance. The caption in red at the top left reads "GRAZ gegen Norden" indicating a view of Graz looking north.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges showing a pastoral landscape: two large trees frame a view over meadows and fields toward a lake in the distance, surrounded by forested shores. At the bottom left there is a caption in Latvian, and at the bottom right a small publisher's logo.

Colorized vintage image of a hotel garden: a courtyard with gravel paths, metal café tables and chairs, flowerbeds, and trees in front of a multi‑story building. On one table are a vase with red flowers and several white cups or jugs. The lower margin has printed captions identifying the scene as the garden of Hotel "Boggia" in Nijmegen.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with 2‑story townhouses and shops. People stand and walk along the sidewalk, and a bicycle leans against a building. In the distance, a church with a tall spire rises above the roofs. German text is printed at the bottom margin naming the town and the street, and shop signage in German is visible on the façades.

Black-and-white panoramic view from a hillside or mountain over a lake, forested slopes, and a rural town with scattered farms and fields. In the foreground are trees on a slope; in the distance are rolling hills surrounding the water. White printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image, including a title, a number, a date, and a photographer/publisher credit.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate city gate and adjoining fortified walls with a tall square tower. The architecture is Islamic/Maghrebi, with an arched entrance decorated with geometric motifs. In front of the walls are small market stalls and people in traditional clothing walking along a dirt street. Printed caption text in French appears along the bottom margin.

Illustrated postcard with a stylized line drawing of an ornate baroque gate and adjoining buildings, likely the entrance courtyard to a palace complex. The architecture features decorative sculptures, a rounded pediment, and tiled roofs, with trees in the background. Below the image, printed German text identifies the location. The lower half of the card is blank for writing.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a residential hillside town with villas and houses in the foreground and mid‑ground, surrounded by trees and gardens. A winding street runs between the houses. On the hill in the background stands a prominent building with a flag. The words "Südstraße." and "Niederlößnitz." are printed in red at the top.

A monochrome portrait of a standing man in formal colonial‑era attire. He wears a light-colored jacket with buttons over a long striped wrap or skirt and holds a round hat and a walking stick in his right hand. The background is plain studio style. At the top of the card, printed text reads "Loanda." on the left and "Creado Cabinda, No. 1." on the right.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a busy lakeside bathing area surrounded by dense forest. In the foreground many people sit or lie on deckchairs and benches along the sandy shore, some wrapped in towels, others in swimsuits. Children and adults wade and swim in the lake. In the middle distance a wooden pier stretches out into the water, with ladders, diving structures and a slide where numerous bathers are gathered. Trees line the entire far shore under a partly cloudy sky. The caption at the bottom left reads "Schmannewitz/Sa. - Bad Waldteich".

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a large public square and garden with a prominent monument at its center. The statue stands on a tall pedestal in a circular plaza surrounded by trees and paths. In the background are mountains and several towers and historic buildings. Printed red text at the top identifies the location as Piazza Dante with its monument and public garden in Trento.

A color postcard showing an outdoor concert by a municipal brass band performing in a historic European square surrounded by pastel-colored buildings and a large audience seated on temporary bleachers and behind barriers. At the center-right of the square stands an ornate baroque fountain with statues, and in the background is a domed building with a tiled roof. The band members wear blue uniforms and play various wind and percussion instruments while facing the crowd. At the bottom of the postcard there is large printed text in Italian.

Colorized view of an arched cloister corridor with stone vaults and a row of decorated columns opening onto a lush green garden. The perspective looks down the length of the arcade toward a dark doorway; on the left wall are small sculptural brackets or lamps, and on the right side the garden is filled with trees and dense vegetation. The image has the grain and tinting typical of an early 20th‑century postcard, but no visible caption or writing on the front.

A sepia-toned photograph of a Romanesque church porch with three arched openings supported by slender columns. At the top of the porch is a gabled structure with a statue in a niche. On either side of the steps stand two sculpted stone lions facing outward. The facade behind shows striped masonry and a row of small arcades above. The overall style suggests an historic European cathedral entrance.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a ceremonial military inspection or drill. Two ranks of uniformed soldiers face each other, wearing ornate dress uniforms with tall boots, sashes, and distinctive czapka-style square-topped caps. A commanding officer stands in the center with his back to the camera, holding a sword. Some soldiers hold rifles with bayonets; a bugler stands on the left. In the background are barracks-like buildings and a striped guard box, suggesting a formal parade ground.

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped square with flower beds and trees in the foreground and ornate Renaissance‑style brick buildings in the background. At center is a tall, richly decorated hotel or commercial building with dormer roofs, finials and a large central gable bearing an inscription. Ground‑floor shopfronts include a restaurant and other businesses. To the right stands a monumental stone gate or archway adorned with reliefs and pinnacles. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand near the buildings.

A black‑and‑white image showing a cloister garden attached to a Gothic building. Pointed arches supported by columns are visible on the right, one column heavily covered with ivy. Above is a steep tiled roof with a small dormer window. The foreground contains dense plants and ferns, with a dirt path curving through the courtyard and a pile of rubble or stones on the right, suggesting partial damage or restoration. The scene is enclosed by stone walls and arcades typical of a medieval monastery or church.

Black‑and‑white image of a large ivy‑covered manor house set in a meadow with scattered flowers and framed by trees. The central building has a tiled hip roof with dormer windows and a classical pediment over the main façade. A stairway leads up through a landscaped lawn. A national flag flies on a tall pole above the house; the flag appears to be the blue‑and‑yellow Scandinavian cross of Sweden.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing the front façade of a large church with a rose window, classical pediment, and ornate portal. A bell tower with a dome rises behind the façade. There are a few people walking in the open square in front of the church, with trees and surrounding buildings visible. Printed captions appear along the bottom margin naming the location and church.

Black‑and‑white elevated view of a small European town with tree‑lined main street running from the foreground toward the horizon. In the foreground are brick and half‑timbered houses; in the mid‑ground stand larger villas and civic buildings with ornate roofs and dormers. In the distance are factory chimneys and, on a hill, a large castle‑like palace or manor with towers. The architecture strongly suggests Central Europe in the early 20th century. One building in the middle left bears a painted sign with German text.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a long, one‑and‑a‑half‑storey wooden building with a steep dark roof and several dormer windows, set among tall pine trees. A straight, sand or gravel path leads from the foreground directly to the front door. The setting appears to be a forested or park‑like area. In the lower right corner, handwritten text reads "Sanatorija Krāslavā."

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a rural plantation complex at the foot of a barren hill. Several long, low whitewashed buildings and a two‑storey house stand in open fields, with a winding path climbing the hillside behind them. Printed captions in Portuguese appear along the bottom margin, indicating the location and the nature of the estate.

Color postcard showing a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city with red-roofed buildings. The tower has two large clock faces with Roman numerals and a steep shingled roof. At the top left is printed red text, and faint handwritten German text is visible across the sky area.

A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a rural inn (Gasthof) beside a pond with swans. Large leafy trees line the water, and a long, light-colored building with a red roof stands in the background. In the foreground, a couple of figures are by the pond's edge. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed German text appears at the bottom, including a greeting from Göppersdorf in the Dresden district and a printer's credit from Meissen.

Illustrated postcard showing the Dalai Lama seated on a richly decorated throne in a Tibetan temple interior, with colorful murals, pillars, and framed images behind him. The lower part contains Dutch text describing Lhasa as the holy city of Lamaism and mentioning the Dalai Lama as the reincarnated Buddha, along with an advertisement for Liebig meat products and a facsimile signature.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑story alpine building labeled "CAFFÈ PLANK" in the foreground, with terraces, balconies, and outdoor seating. The house stands among dense coniferous forest, with a footbridge and path leading up to it. Dramatic rocky mountain peaks rise in the background. Printed captions at the top identify the location as S. Martino di Castrozza at 1444 meters and the nearby peak Colbricon at 2604 meters.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large, three‑story barracks or residential building with a red-tiled roof and light-colored walls, enclosed by a tall wrought-iron fence. There is a tree-lined street or pathway in the foreground, and several people standing or sitting near the fence. At the top of the card there is German text printed in red.

Black‑and‑white image showing a uniformed mail carrier standing beside a bicycle in a residential urban area. He is sorting or holding a stack of letters next to a brick apartment building. The bicycle has bags or panniers for mail. In the background are other mid‑century apartment blocks, a pedestrian, and a lightly snowy or slushy ground, suggesting a cold climate.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a marble bust of a man on a tall pedestal in a landscaped park. The bust is mounted on a large stepped stone base with several broad steps leading up to it. Evergreen trees and an open, slightly rural landscape appear in the background. The pedestal bears the inscription "ALBERT."

A sepia-toned, antique-style illustration of a large Baroque or early-18th‑century palace with a formal geometric garden in the foreground. The main building has a long central block with a steep roof and a tall central spire, flanked by two lower wings or separate pavilions. In the garden, symmetrically arranged parterres, paths, and topiary are visible, with a few finely dressed figures strolling on the main walkway. The sky is filled with stylized, heavy clouds, typical of old engravings. There is no visible printed text on the image itself.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large wooden pavilion-style building with a central two‑storey veranda, surrounded by lush trees and a picket fence. A Swedish flag flies from a tall flagpole on the roof. People are visible standing on the balcony and in front of the entrance. In the foreground, a path runs along a landscaped park with a few figures walking.

Black‑and‑white view down a broad, unpaved street lined with trees and fenced front gardens. On the right stands a large, ornate late‑19th‑century villa with half‑timbered upper floors, steep slate roof, small tower and balcony winter‑garden. Next to it is a multi‑storey brick building, and further along are several elegant apartment or town houses. In the distance a small bridge or arch crosses the street. The scene is quiet, with no cars visible. There is no printed caption or legible text apparent on the image.

Black‑and‑white industrial view showing a large mining or ore‑processing facility in a barren, rocky landscape. Wooden conveyor structures and trestles run across the scene, with piles of processed material in the foreground and several wooden buildings scattered along a hillside in the background. The printed caption "Foldals Verk" appears in the upper left, and a reference code "MINØ.25991" is printed in the lower right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a square medieval stone tower ruin on a slope planted with small trees or vines. Several people stand on the flat roof behind a railing, with a flag flying from a pole. The image is printed in sepia tones with a large blank area at the bottom for writing. At the bottom in red script it reads "Eilenburg. Sorbenthum." and along the right edge in small vertical print appears the publisher information.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide urban street scene with two‑ and three‑storey neoclassical buildings, horse-drawn carriages, trams on tracks, and pedestrians. Low hills appear in the background. At the bottom are captions in Greek and French, along with the word "Greece" and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".

Vintage sepia postcard showing a small stone memorial structure with a conical roof at the top of a terraced, stone‑lined staircase set in a leafy park or garden. Plants grow along the steps and around the monument. The card has a decorative white border and printed caption at the bottom in Latvian.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground is framed by dark conifer trees, with scattered farm buildings and houses leading into a compact village. A prominent church with a baroque-style tower stands among other multi-storey houses. In the background are open fields and meadows rising toward a forested ridge, with a light-colored road or path winding up the slope. The image has a white border and a caption printed at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large hilltop castle complex with multiple steep-roofed buildings and a round central tower, alongside a baroque-style church with an onion-shaped spire. Below the rocky, wooded slope sit several smaller houses and a stone bridge crossing a stream in the foreground. The overall style and setting suggest a central European medieval townscape. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical/late‑19th‑century mansion with balconies and decorative cornices, set behind a low fence and gate on a mostly empty, unpaved foreground. There is a tall utility pole in front and additional buildings to the right. Greek text is printed along the top margin, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rough, wavy body of water with two small wooden rowboats in the foreground. Two people sit in one of the boats near the rocky or concrete shoreline, while another empty boat floats nearby. Across the water is a low, forested shoreline with scattered buildings and a distant smokestack. At the top of the card are printed captions in Russian, German, and another language identifying the place as Wöso in Estonia.

A monochrome postcard-style image showing a bustling market square in front of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance building with domes and towers. Numerous stalls with umbrellas line the square, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and trade. On the left side a church tower rises above the surrounding buildings. Printed German text in the upper left identifies the scene as Graz and mentions the town hall, Herrengasse, and parish church.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a central town square with cobblestone paving. A prominent building with a clock tower and steeple (likely the town hall) stands on the left, flanked by gabled houses with shopfronts. Vintage cars and bicycles are parked around a fountain in the middle of the square. On the right is a grand three‑storey building with balconies and signage for a guesthouse or hotel. The caption at the bottom reads "Pulsnitz/Sa. Hauptmarkt," indicating this is the main market square of Pulsnitz in Saxony, Germany.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural scene with wooden, multi‑windowed buildings in the background, likely institutional or residential blocks painted in a dark color with light trim. They stand beyond cultivated fields and in front of a forest of coniferous trees. In the foreground, a large birch tree with drooping branches frames the scene, and a lone person sits in the grass looking toward the buildings.

Black-and-white postcard view of a small riverside village with several houses at the foot of a wooded hillside. In the foreground is the riverbank with a path or road running alongside the water. A small landing or dock is visible at the river's edge. Behind the road stand trees and a cluster of buildings, including what appears to be an inn or guesthouse. Terraced slopes and dense forest rise up the hill behind the village. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Colorized view of a European riverside city with a bridge crossing a blue river, lined by trees and historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the background, a steep wooded hill rises, crowned by fortification walls and buildings; to the right on the hillside stands a prominent clock tower. The caption at the top left reads "GRAZ, Schlossberg," and additional commercial signage is visible on one of the riverside buildings.

Black-and-white postcard showing an image of Our Lady of Guadalupe framed in a stone or marble wall. The Virgin Mary stands with hands joined in prayer, surrounded by rays, wearing a star‑covered mantle. Around the central painting are small shields or coats of arms. Beneath the image there is Spanish text dedicating her as Queen of Mexico and Empress of America, mentioning the miracle at Lake Texcoco and Pope Pius XII with the date 12 de octubre de 1945. Additional plaques with text appear at the bottom.

A vintage postcard showing the interior of a large stone cathedral with tall arches, side chapels, and a prominent staircase leading up along the wall. There are wooden railings and choir stalls, religious statues, and dim light streaming in from tall windows. The entire front, including the image area, is heavily overprinted with handwritten correspondence. At the bottom, printed red text identifies the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an open square with trees and a two‑storey building, likely a train or tram station, in a leafy suburb. People are visible in the distance. Handwritten Greek text appears at the top, and printed Greek captions run along the bottom. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a young man in a suit and bow tie, leaning his arms on the back of a white chair and looking directly at the camera. At the bottom right is an embossed studio mark, and across the lower part of the image there is a large white handwritten signature reading a name similar to "Allan Matson" (exact spelling unclear). The style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard portrait.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Orthodox cathedral with domes and crosses on the left, opening onto a very broad, tree‑lined square or boulevard with scattered pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and surrounding low buildings. Inset at the bottom right is a view of an obelisk‑like monument. Printed captions in Bulgarian (Cyrillic) and German identify the cathedral and send greetings from Varna.

A sepia-toned historic street view showing an elegant boulevard lined with late-19th/early-20th century townhouses and villas. The buildings feature ornate facades, bay windows, and steep, pointed roofs or towers. A tree-lined sidewalk and a few pedestrians are visible. At the top of the card, printed text identifies the location as Leisnig in Saxony and the specific street as König Albert-Strasse.

Black‑and‑white image of a rocky seaside bathing area and informal campsite. Vintage cars from the 1930s–1940s are parked on the sandy and grassy shore, with several canvas tents pitched nearby. People in swimsuits are wading in a shallow, protected bay formed by rocks, while others walk, cycle, or relax on the beach and rocky slopes. Low, rocky islands and headlands stretch across the horizon, suggesting a rugged northern coastline.

Colorized panoramic view of a town nestled in a wide Alpine valley, surrounded by mountains with some snow‑capped peaks in the distance. The foreground shows a dense cluster of multi‑story buildings, churches, and streets, with open fields and rail lines at the very front. At the top center, the word "Trento." is printed. The lower margin and right side contain handwritten cursive text in dark ink, suggesting it was mailed as a message postcard.

Black‑and‑white image showing a formal cavalry review on open grassland. In the foreground at left, an officer in ornate uniform with a tall fur cap sits on a light‑colored horse, holding a baton or staff. Behind him stretches a long formation of mounted lancers in uniform, each holding a long lance with a pennant attached, forming parallel rows that recede into the distance. Another officer on horseback faces the line at the far right. The sky is blank and overexposed; there is no visible writing or border decoration.

Black-and-white winter panorama showing a snow-covered town viewed from an elevated hillside behind a rustic wooden fence. Church towers and dense roofs dominate the townscape in the middle ground, with open snowy fields and woods stretching into the distance. The caption in red German text appears at the top left.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with a prominent historic church in the center. The church has multiple steep-roofed towers and Gothic/Romanesque-style windows. It stands among tightly packed houses with pitched roofs, while terraced hills or vineyards rise in the background. At the bottom, in a decorative script, the caption reads "Freyburg a. U. St. Anna-Kirche."

A sepia-toned photograph showing a prominent medieval-style clock tower standing on a steep, rocky, and wooded hill. The tower has a large clock face and a steep shingled roof, overlooking rooftops below. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text in German.

A black‑and‑white vintage panoramic view over a rural settlement by a river or lake, surrounded by low hills or mountains. Wooden houses and farm buildings with pitched roofs occupy the foreground, with more scattered buildings and fields stretching into the distance. The word "Tønset" is printed near the top left of the image, and a reference number "MINØ.43826" appears in the top right.

The image shows a color reproduction of an old Christian wall fresco in an Eastern Orthodox style. The upper part depicts Christ (or God the Father) in a circular mandorla, blessing with one hand and holding a book with the other, surrounded by angels and decorative motifs. Below is the Virgin Mary with raised hands in the traditional Orans pose, with the Christ Child depicted on her chest, also in a circular medallion. The fresco is worn and partially damaged, with flaking plaster and faded pigments.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a lakeside or pond (the Barbarateich) with reflections of a tall Protestant church with a clock tower on the right and a school building on the left, both behind trees and fencing. The printed caption at the top in German identifies the scene.

Old black‑and‑white panoramic postcard-style photograph of a railway freight yard. A long, low station or warehouse building stands on the left, with multiple rows of boxcars and open freight cars on tracks to the right. The yard is stacked with bales or bundles of goods. A horse‑drawn cart moves along the dirt road in the foreground, and a few small groups of people are visible walking near the station. Black-and-white interior view of a historic church with arched ceilings, wooden pews, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, a decorated pulpit on the left wall, and an altar with a large cross and plants at the far end. The lower right corner contains printed caption text identifying the church.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a European street lined with multi-story townhouses on both sides. A monochrome postcard-style image showing a large plantation complex consisting of two long, white buildings surrounded by dense forest on a steep hillside. A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, ornate multi‑storey building on a gentle hill in the countryside. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a substantial multi‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, set along a curved tree‑lined road. Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small rural village surrounded by fields and forested hills. Traditional gabled houses line curving roads and tree-lined paths, with open lawns and scattered trees in the foreground. At the bottom center there is printed caption text indicating the place name.

Color image of a seaside resort: in the foreground is a low stone wall with three white penguin statues and colorful flower beds behind them. Colored illustrated postcard showing an ornate Ottoman-style public fountain on a street in the Arab quarter of Cairo. Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town in a valley, showing houses with pitched roofs among many trees, a factory chimney, railway tracks and fields in the mid-ground, and a church with a tall spire dominating the townscape. A colorized panoramic view of a small European town with tightly packed multi‑story buildings and red roofs, surrounded by green hills and fields in the background. At the bottom of the image is a white border with printed red text indicating the town name and publisher information.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a calm river or lake toward a town skyline with red‑roofed buildings and a prominent church tower with two spires, reflected in the water. Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural dirt road leading through trees and shrubs toward distant hills and villages. Two figures with a pack animal walk along the road. Black-and-white photographic postcard showing a central, two‑storey building with a tiled roof and dormer windows, flanked symmetrically by two smaller houses with similar roofs. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hillside cityscape with stone defensive walls and houses built along the top of the walls and on the surrounding slopes. A monochrome panoramic view of a small town set in a hilly rural landscape. Black-and-white waterfront view with many small boats tied to piers in the foreground and larger ferries and ships in a busy harbor beyond. Historic multi‑story buildings line the shoreline on a hillside under a cloudy sky. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, along with a photographer/publisher credit.

Black‑and‑white view down a quiet cobblestone street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses. A man walks in the center of the street, with a cart and a horse‑drawn wagon farther away. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow street lined with old townhouses. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a statue of a uniformed man on a high pedestal inscribed "ALBERT," with a curved stone bench at its base. A monochrome portrait of a young Indigenous boy wrapped in a fur garment, looking slightly to the side and smiling. The photograph is softly vignetted against a light background. Beneath the image there is a printed caption in Spanish and a small number printed in the lower right corner.

Black-and-white postcard view of a harbor with small rowboats in the foreground tied along the quay. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small rural railway station with a single electrified track curving into the distance. Vintage sepia-toned postcard view from a coastal fortification looking down over a bay and city. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a barren, rocky landscape with rugged mountains in the background and a few isolated low white buildings in the middle distance. V." on the upper right, indicating the lazaretto (quarantine station) area on the island of São Vicente.

Black‑and‑white view down a narrow cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings with shops at ground level. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop complex consisting of a castle-like palace and a Gothic cathedral with tall spires, rising above a town and trees. At the bottom center, white printed text in German identifies the location.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cargo ship named BIRKALAND at sea, accompanied by a small tugboat in the foreground. Color-tinted historical postcard showing a large open square with carriages and pedestrians in front of a monumental arched gate flanked by buildings. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rustic log cabin or shed built on the edge of a narrow water channel in a flat, marshy landscape. Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a corner multi‑story townhouse with ornate façade, balconies and shopfronts on the ground floor. Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town in a hilly landscape. A broad river with barges and small boats curves through the middle, crossed by a metal railway or road bridge. Black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal town built on rocky terrain. A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley surrounded by large mountains. In the foreground are rocky hills and a winding dirt road. Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a tranquil lake surrounded by snow‑topped mountains and forest. In the foreground are fields with scattered wooden farm buildings and conifer trees. A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a cobblestone square with a central statue and fountain in front of a long brick building featuring multiple stepped-gable façades. Black‑and‑white image showing a uniformed ceremonial guard standing on duty beside a striped wooden sentry box in front of a large brick building with tall windows and an iron fence. Vintage sepia-toned art postcard reproducing a dark, atmospheric painted portrait of a bald man with a long mustache and beard. The image is framed by a cream border. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a castle‑like hilltop guesthouse with crenellated towers, a long veranda terrace, and a large flag flying from the main tower. The building overlooks a sloping, tree‑covered hillside. At the bottom, there is a handwritten German caption.

Black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a tram running along a cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑storey buildings on the right and a tree‑lined pedestrian path on the left. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a brick railway station with steep gabled roofs and ivy-covered walls. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view taken from across a body of water, showing a large historic church or cathedral complex with a prominent square tower topped by a baroque-style dome. Black‑and‑white image of a landscaped courtyard between two multi‑storey classical-style buildings. In the center foreground is a garden with small fir trees and flower beds. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town with medieval stone towers, church spires, and old houses clustered on a hill above a valley. Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia aerial view of a large institutional complex and surrounding town. A vintage black-and-white landscape postcard showing a lake surrounded by forested hills and mountains. A winding road and scattered houses or buildings lie along the shore and on the slopes. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an urban waterfront scene with trams, cars, pedestrians, and boats. A black‑and‑white view over a formal town square or park with young trees planted in a grid. A monochrome, vintage view of a narrow medieval street with steep‑roofed houses and a tall, slender Gothic tower rising behind them. The tower has a long, tapering spire topped with a weather vane. A vintage monochrome/green-tinted postcard showing a busy bridge in Constantinople with pedestrians, a tramcar running along tracks, and boats at the sides. Black‑and‑white street scene in a European town, likely late 19th or early 20th century. A broad unpaved street is lined with two‑ and three‑story masonry houses. A black-and-white panoramic view over a small town nestled in a wooded valley with rolling hills and farmland in the background. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing domed white roofs and an ornate entrance of an Islamic mosque with intricate arches and decorative carvings. A monochrome postcard showing a large Romanesque‑style Catholic church with multiple towers, arched windows, and decorative stonework. Small figures walk near the entrance. On the right side, there is a vertical strip with printed title text at the top and handwritten message text below.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a broad city street intersection with tram lines and early electric trams. Sepia-toned postcard showing a medieval stone castle ruin on a rocky, columnar basalt hill, surrounded by vegetation. A black-and-white winter scene showing a snow-covered railway station building behind a low fence and leafless trees. People are standing in the snowy foreground. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and photographer/printer.

A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a forested valley and hills near Karlsbad, with tall conifer trees in the foreground, a building in the middle distance identified as Café Kaiserpark, and misty hills under a pale sky. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside view with a steamship on the water, low buildings and a wooded hill with a tower in the background. The lower margin has printed captions identifying the location and publisher, and handwritten date and signature on the front.

A black‑and‑white view of a long row of large brick institutional buildings with tiled roofs and many regularly spaced windows, likely late‑19th‑century construction. A watercolor-style illustration of a ruined stone building with tall rectangular window openings and a steep triangular gable, reflected in a calm body of water in the foreground. Black-and-white aerial photograph of a rural farming landscape with fields, scattered trees, and several farm buildings including a larger farmhouse and barn. A country road runs along the right side. At the bottom left there is white caption text, and at the bottom right there is a stylized logo.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large Neo-Gothic/Neo-Renaissance palace partly hidden by trees. The building has several corner towers and a central clock tower rising above the roofline. Sepia-toned historical view of a European city street with an electric tram in the foreground, horse-drawn carts, pedestrians, and tree-lined avenues. Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a dirt path leading through open fields toward a small village of farmhouses and barns. Black‑and‑white street scene showing a large parade moving down a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings. A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a European city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings featuring ornate facades and shuttered windows. A black and white image of a steamship at sea, with visible funnels and rigging, named 'SS Bruxellesville.' There are passengers or crew visible on the decks. A black-and-white photograph on a postcard shows a historic, stuccoed building with a prominent square bell tower topped by a small dome. There is an external staircase leading to the upper floor. The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a waterfront scene, with rustic wooden buildings on stilts, rocky shorelines, and a pier where a steamboat is docked. A vintage black-and-white postcard showing an elegant street view with ornate 19th-century European buildings, decorative wrought-iron balconies, shopfronts, and a small park or landscaped area with a fountain. A sepia-toned postcard depicts a large open square surrounded by classical buildings with distinct European architectural styles. There are people strolling around the square, streetlights, and a generally tranquil atmosphere. The text on the bottom of the postcard reads 'Nyköping. Stora Torget.'

A sepia-toned image showing a calm waterway lined with trees, with a small boat carrying people in the foreground. There are stone structures along the sides of the water, possibly remnants of a bridge or locks. A building is partially visible among the trees to the right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing four small children outdoors on a mat and chair in a garden setting. Below the photo is a printed caption naming the place. The reverse has German printed text, handwritten message and address, two green Deutsches Reich stamps, and a 1916 postmark.

Antique German postcard with a whimsical illustration of tuxedo-wearing frogs by a pond framing an inset photograph of a forested restaurant. The inset is captioned 'Restauration z. kühlen Grund bei Jugenheim.' The reverse shows German and French postal headings, a red 10 Pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp, and a postmark reading 'Jugenheim Bergstrasse' dated 31.5.05, addressed to a recipient in Malmö.

A vintage multiview postcard depicting Brussels, with illustrated panels of the Manneken-Pis, the Brussels Town Hall and the Maison du Roi around the Grand Place, plus a vignette of a Brussels milkman. The reverse shows a Belgian stamp with the bilingual Sunday-delivery warning and bilingual postcard headings.

Colorized night view of the Singer Building skyscraper illuminated against a cloudy sky; reverse side has printed description, address lines, two green 1-cent U.S. postage stamps, and a New York postmark dated 1921.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the facade of Hotell Höganäs with a group of children standing on a tree‑lined street. Caption reads "Hotell Höganäs. Höganäs." The reverse has Swedish handwriting, a 10 öre Swedish stamp (SVERIGE), a purple archive mark, and an address to Malmö.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone lane lined with shuttered houses and several people in early 20th‑century dress. The street curves up toward a large tree marking the entrance to a public garden. Caption at the top reads in French that it is the entrance to the public garden in Cassel. The reverse has French "Carte Postale" layout, a red French stamp, a French postmark, and an address written to Malmö, Sweden, with a long handwritten message in French.

Vintage postcard published by Granbergs of Stockholm. Front shows a hand‑tinted scene of three girls indoors beside a tall birdcage, covered with handwritten message; red caption along the bottom. Reverse has multilingual 'Carte postale' layout, a Swedish green 5 öre stamp with royal portrait, and is addressed to Fröken Hildur Borg in Tingsryd.

Illustrated postcard showing an indoor scene with people in Swedish folk costumes dancing and socializing around a table in a rustic room. A Swedish caption appears on the front in cursive. The reverse reads "BREFKORT. Carte Postale." with a Swedish 5 öre stamp canceled in Malmö and a round red seal for the Red Cross in Malmö, 1906, and an address written to a woman.

Vintage real-photo postcard with two sepia photographs of a small child, hand‑tinted with a blue cap and pink pot, framed by green Art Nouveau floral motifs. Dense handwritten Swedish message surrounds the photos. The reverse bears a multilingual 'Postkarte – Carte postale' header, a green Swedish 5 öre stamp with a Stockholm cancellation, and is addressed to Fru Svea Österberg, Barkarby, Spånga.

Antique postcard with a chromolithograph of a young woman in a yellow dress reclining and smoking inside a heart-shaped vignette, with drawings of books and banknotes below and handwritten Swedish text across the image. The reverse shows address lines with the heading 'BREFKORT. Postkarte.' and a green Swedish 5 öre stamp canceled with a circular postmark, addressed to Norberg.

Colorized view of the Albert Memorial in Kensington Gardens, London, framed by an ornate printed border. The reverse shows a divided-back British layout with a royal-warrant line and an 'AFFIX STAMP' box, plus a blue-ink handwritten message and address to Sweden.

Vintage chromolithograph postcard showing two girls in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century dress in a meadow, one kneeling with a small trowel and both holding flowers. Reverse has a multilingual UPU postcard back, Swedish handwriting, and a green Swedish stamp with circular postmark.

A Swedish illustrated New Year postcard. The front shows a Jenny Nyström scene of a red‑capped tomte in a stable petting a horse, with a cat nearby; printed greeting reads "Godt nytt år." Publisher credit at the margin: "Axel Eliassons Konstförlag, Stockholm." The reverse has a green ornamental border with Swedish headings "BREFKORT (CARTE POSTALE)" and the note that this side is for the address only, with handwritten address to Malmö; the stamp area is torn.

A decorative German birthday postcard. The front shows a small painted view of a yellow-walled gatehouse with red roof framed by a garland of red roses on a tan background. Below is printed and handwritten German greeting text. The reverse has multilingual 'Carte postale – Post card' header, German handwriting, and a red 10 Pfennig 'Deutsches Reich' stamp with a Danzig postmark, addressed to Malmö, Sweden.

Illustrated Christmas postcard showing two Scandinavian gnome/tomte children dancing in folk dress with red caps. The front carries the greeting 'God Jul' and a small artist signature at bottom right.

Old stereoscopic postcard with two identical black‑and‑white images showing a group of local traders gathered at a wooden colonial building on raised stilts. French caption printed beneath the images. Publisher credit appears at lower left.

Black‑and‑white photo of a street scene in West Africa showing two costumed male dancers performing with ritual/amulet-laden outfits; one raises a knife or blade, the other plays a one‑string fiddle. At right, a man in flowing robe holds a Yoruba talking drum while others watch in front of earthen/mud buildings.

Sepia photo postcard showing the interior of a large wooden hall where hundreds of inscribed wooden rice paddles (shamoji) are tied to pillars and hang from beams. The caption mentions a memorial related to the Russo‑Japanese War. The back reads "Carte Postale," has Japanese text for "postcard," and a printer's line from Hiroshima.

Hand‑colored photographic postcard showing a row of Japanese women in brightly tinted kimonos standing in front of an establishment with hanging lanterns and a sign that reads "NECTARINE N°9." The scene is at the entrance of the venue. Reverse side bears multilingual "Post Card" header, vertical "MADE IN JAPAN," and handwritten notes mentioning Yokohama.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd gathered on a street lined with blossoming trees. Flags and decorations hang from a two‑story building where people watch from a balcony; below, a person holds a large parasol amid the crowd. The back reads "UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE CARTE POSTALE" with floral ornament and Japanese vertical text.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall multi‑tier brick pagoda behind a temple gate among trees. The lower caption identifies it as the Pagoda 'Tien-ning-ssu' with publisher credit 'S. Yamamoto, Peking.' Reverse is a divided-back card marked 'Union Postale Universelle – Carte Postale.'

B/W postcard showing an interior tableau of fearsome Buddhist/Daoist statues depicting hellish punishments, captioned in French and English. The reverse is a split‑back with the French headings for correspondence and address.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the interior of a traditional Chinese hall with carved and painted beams, columns, wooden chairs and tables. Caption in French and English identifies it as the Temple of the Sun in Peking (Beijing). The reverse reads 'CARTE POSTALE' with 'CORRESPONDANCE' and 'ADRESSE' sections.

Sepia postcard showing a courtyard with a large bronze armillary-sphere instrument set on a raised platform, in front of a traditional Chinese building with tiled roof and lattice windows; bare tree branches at right. French caption at the bottom reads "2. - PÉKIN. - Observatoire." The back is a divided French postcard layout labeled CARTE POSTALE with sections for CORRESPONDANCE and ADRESSE.

Sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a seated Chinese woman in traditional dress beside a small round table with a teacup and candle. Caption in English, German, and French appears below the image. The reverse is a divided back with 'POST CARD', publisher credit 'L. Wannieck - Peking', handwritten Christmas greeting, and an address to Hotel des Wagons-Lits in Peking with postal marks.

Black-and-white studio photograph of three Javanese performers in traditional attire. Caption at top reads "Pétrok en Dewie Srikandi." Publisher credit at bottom: "Uitg. N.V. v/h H. van INGEN, Soerabaja." The reverse has address lines in Dutch with fields labeled "naam" and "adres," a stamp box, and a small printed number.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a Javanese theatrical/dance character in elaborate costume with a kris, crown and large mustache, captioned "Bâlâ Dèwâ." Publisher credit at the bottom indicates Soerabaia. The back is a divided postcard with Dutch fields "naam" and "adres" and a stamp box.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large inscribed Chinese stone stele (tablet) beside a waterway, with a man standing next to it. The printed caption below the photo reads "Tablet of the Jews K'aifengfu." The reverse has a multilingual "POSTKARTE / Carte postale / Cartolina postale / Post card / ОТКРЫТОЕ ПИСЬМО," the publisher line "CHAS. F. GAMMON PHOTO SERIES. NO. 233." and Japanese "郵便はがき."

Black-and-white postcard showing a Tibetan bronze figure with an animal-headed, flame-haired deity in a dynamic dancing pose. The caption identifies it as a piece in the Musée Guimet in Paris. The reverse has multilingual 'post card' headings.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a long stone gallery of Angkor Wat with balustraded windows and palm trees, showing the inner first terrace on the north side. A red French caption is printed along the top.

Black‑and‑white photo postcard showing intricate sandstone bas‑relief carvings and a standing apsara (devata) figure beside balustraded window columns. Caption at the bottom in French identifies the scene as architectural details of the main gate of the outer enclosure of Angkor Wat.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with red French caption showing a stilt-house village of thatched wooden houses amid tropical trees, described as the monks' village near Angkor Wat. A few figures and chickens appear in the sandy open area. Publisher credit is printed at the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a stone tower with four serene faces at the Bayon temple complex, surrounded by jungle foliage. The caption in French at the bottom identifies the site as Angkor Thom in Cambodia and specifies a tower with four faces.
Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone guardian lion sculpture in dense jungle vegetation. A printed French caption along the bottom mentions Cambodia and Angkor Thom.

A black‑and‑white view of a walled Khmer complex with ornate multi‑tiered roofs and several slender stupas rising above the perimeter wall. The main pavilion has a high, intricately tiered Cambodian roof, with other shrine-like towers and a tall central spire visible deeper in the compound. Foreground shows a road and trees; there are no modern buildings.

Colorized early-20th-century harbor scene showing the busy Muelle Fiscal in Guayaquil: a large sailing ship and steam launch at the pier, many small boats loaded with goods and workers along the waterfront. The reverse has a handwritten message dated 12/9/1916 and an Ecuadorian red postage stamp (Correos del Ecuador, 4 centavos), addressed to Sweden.

Black‑and‑white promotional postcard for a Swedish dance band. The front shows four men in matching dark double‑breasted suits with white turtlenecks posing outdoors among birch trees. The reverse is a standard divided back with a stamp box and Swedish text advertising the group, listing the bandleader's name and phone numbers, an agency in Nybro, and the photo/print shop Thornbergs Foto in Vimmerby.

Tinted view of a rural white church behind trees and a stone wall, with a steep green roof and belfry. A Swedish caption appears at the top right. The reverse reads 'BREVKORT' with multilingual postcard headings, bears a green 5 öre Swedish stamp postmarked 1907, and is addressed to Skarblacka.

A painted alpine landscape showing a broad lake with a dramatic mountain massif rising behind it. In the foreground are fields with red flowers, a woman and child in traditional rural clothing, and a team of horses working a field near a cottage. The style is that of an early 20th‑century chromolithograph art postcard. A small artist's signature appears in the lower right.

Old monochrome panoramic view of a small Alpine village in a narrow valley, with steep forested mountainsides and cultivated fields in the foreground. A church spire rises among clustered houses. The caption "Uggowitz" is printed in red at the upper left.

Colorized vintage view of a lakeside peninsula with a tall-steepled church above red‑roofed houses and trees. In the foreground is Wörthersee with a pier and a small lighthouse-like fountain spraying water.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a village and a lake set among forests and mountains. Printed caption at the bottom reads 'Faak mit dem Faakersee.' The image has the look of an early 20th‑century collotype postcard with a light vignette at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small Alpine town with fields in the foreground, a church with a tall spire and clock tower, a smokestack, and mountains in the background. Printed caption text in German appears along the bottom margin, along with a publisher code.

Vintage divided-image postcard showing the interior and exterior of a grand café with vaulted ceilings and bistro tables. The exterior view depicts a corner building with the sign of Café Europa and people standing in front. Handwritten German script covers much of the front. The back has address fields, a postage stamp with a Marburg postmark, and a purple library stamp.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large late‑19th‑century building on a tree‑lined street. The printed caption reads "Marburg a. D. Deutsches Töchterheim." The reverse bears a green 5‑heller Austro‑Hungarian stamp with a circular postmark reading "MARBURG," a handwritten message, and an address to a recipient in Tržič (Gorenjsko).

Colorized postcard showing a massive square stone tower with a red hipped roof behind a gated wall and entrance. Caption in German reads that it is an old city tower near the cemetery. The front bears a handwritten message dated 1902. The reverse is a German-language "Correspondenz-Karte" with an Austrian stamp and postmarks, addressed to Laibach (Ljubljana).

Sepia postcard showing a rural scene with leafless trees, a farmhouse and a small chapel or bellcote in the background. Caption at bottom reads "Gruss von Stuenberg bei Marburg." The reverse is a German-language 'Correspondenz-Karte' with an Austro‑Hungarian stamp and a circular postmark reading LAIBACH.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the storefront of a jeweler/watchmaker named Karl Karner. The facade has large windows filled with watches and silverware, a hanging clock, and several signs in Slovene. The reverse is a printed advertising back giving the business details: Karl Karner, jeweler and engraver in Maribor, Slovenska ulica 3, with a large stock of gold, silverware, and watches. There is a library stamp and a pencil note with an approximate date.

Vintage German-language postcard showing a Swiss-chalet style house in a wooded rural setting with a small inset of two St. Bernard dogs. Caption identifies the place as the Schweizerhaus "Krüger" (formerly Wolfzettel) near Marburg. Publisher credit appears on the left edge. The reverse is an Austro‑Hungarian Correspondenz‑Karte addressed to Fräulein Emma Richner with Marburg postmarks.

Colorized divided-back postcard with two views of a restaurant. The top shows the exterior of a two‑story corner building bearing signage including 'RESTAURATION'; the caption beneath reads 'Grand-Restaurant Gambrinus, Marburg a. Dr.' The lower image shows the interior dining hall with white‑clothed tables and chandeliers. The reverse is blank for address/message with a circular library stamp and small printer numbers.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a two‑storey brick corner building with shuttered windows and a large tree in front. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Gambrinussäle in Marburg a. d. D." The front carries numerous handwritten notes and a purple business stamp. The reverse side is a German "Correspondenz‑Karte" with handwritten address lines, cancellation marks and the destination noted as Meran.

Antique multi-view illustrated postcard with the caption "Gruss aus Marburg an der Drau," showing a panoramic view of the city and vignettes of Hauptplatz with the town hall and a monument/plague column, framed by floral and grape motifs. The reverse is an Austro-Hungarian Correspondenz-Karte with a 2-value stamp, cancellations (Marburg and Laibach), and a handwritten Italian message addressed to Riva sul Garda.

Colorized panoramic view of a town on a river with a prominent steel arch bridge in the foreground, dense historic buildings and a church tower behind, set against low hills. The reverse shows a divided back with a 1914 imprint and a circular library stamp.

Double-view postcard showing an exterior corner view of a two‑storey restaurant building and, below, its elegant dining hall with set tables. A printed caption beneath the top view mentions Marburg a. D. The reverse shows a divided back typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Color lithographed town view with hills and several buildings, including a church with twin spires and a central civic-looking building; captioned "Gruss aus Marburg a. D." The reverse is a German-language postcard with an Austro‑Hungarian stamp and cancellations, addressed to Laibach (Ljubljana).
Black‑and‑white village scene showing a large house/inn with shuttered windows and people standing in front under tall trees. The bottom caption is bilingual, printed in German and Slovene.

Vintage multi-view postcard showing four black‑and‑white scenes labeled in German: a devotional image titled 'Gnadenbild Maria Hilf', a manor or small palace labeled 'Schloss', a twin‑tower baroque church labeled 'Kirche', and a village inn labeled 'Gasthaus'. The central caption reads 'Ebenthal bei Klagenfurt,' indicating the locality near Klagenfurt, Carinthia.

An old monochrome view of a village courtyard with traditional Alpine houses, a walled yard and a small fountain, set against mountain slopes. Printed caption at lower left reads "Egg im Gailtal." A vertical publisher's line on the right margin reads "Verlag. Guter Hermagor." There is cursive handwritten message across the bottom margin.

Color-tinted panoramic view of a Central European town with church spires and dense rooftops, captioned in German 'Marburg a. d. Drau. Totale.' The reverse has handwritten German text, an Austrian green 5-value stamp, and postmarks, addressed to Graz.

Colorized panoramic view of a river city surrounded by hills and vineyards. Caption on the front reads "Marburg a. d. Drau." The reverse shows handwritten German text, an Austrian stamp with a Marburg postmark, and a purple archive stamp from Ljubljana.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a European city with villas, tree‑lined streets and a railway line in the foreground. The front caption reads "Maribor." The reverse has a Yugoslav postage stamp, a cancellation marked Ljubljana, handwritten message and an address to Zagreb.

Sepia panoramic view of a Central European town with many rooftops and several church spires, captioned "Marburg a. Drau." The reverse shows a red 10 heller Austrian stamp with cancellations reading "MARBURG a. DRAU" and "LAIBACH," and handwritten address text mentioning Ljubljana.

Colorized panoramic view of a Central European town in a valley with church towers, factories and low hills in the background. Printed caption reads "MARBURG a. d. Drau." The reverse shows dense German handwriting, an Austrian 5-heller green stamp and a circular postmark from Marburg a. d. Drau.

Colorized lithographic panoramic view of a town with fields and vineyards in the foreground and a dense settlement with church towers and factory chimneys in the distance. Caption at the bottom reads "Marburg a. d. Drau." with a handwritten dated message. The reverse is a German-language Correspondenzkarte addressed to Vienna, with postal cancellations from Marburg a/d Drau and Wien, a blue manuscript number, and a purple stamp of Univerzitetna Knjižnica Ljubljana.

Colorized panoramic view of Marburg an der Drau (now Maribor) at sunset, photographed from Kalvarienberg (Calvary Hill). The foreground shows trees and a few people; church spires and dense town roofs spread across the valley. The reverse has dense German handwriting, an Austrian 10‑heller stamp, a MARBURG postmark, and is addressed to Belgrad.

Colorized panorama of a Central European town with red-roofed houses and hills in the background. A prominent twin‑spired church rises above the town. Caption on the front reads "Gruss aus Marburg." The back is a German "Correspondenz-Karte" with address lines, an Austrian stamp and cancellations, and a purple ownership stamp.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a Central European town with dense late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings and a church with twin spires. A handwritten message runs along the top margin of the photo. The reverse shows an Austrian 10‑heller stamp with postmarks, a purple wartime censor mark, and an address written in German; the destination reads Laibach (Ljubljana).

Color postcard showing the Gothic St. Michael's Church with a high spire dominating a central square. In front stands an equestrian statue (Matthias Corvinus Monument) within landscaped gardens and benches, with historic façades and a red bus on the street. The back has multilingual caption naming Cluj and Liberty Square, Romanian publisher and price, handwritten Romanian message and address, and a 1975 postmark.

Color view of a grand Orthodox cathedral with a large central dome and smaller domes, opening onto a broad square with flowerbeds, trees, and traffic circles. Across the square stands a long historic building with domed corner pavilions. The scene is an urban square with pedestrians and cars under clear skies.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined cobblestone street in Dej with long 19th‑century façades, pedestrians, benches and an ornate planter in the foreground. Caption reads "DEJ — Vedere." Verso has a Romanian 40‑bani stamp (R.P. ROMÎNĂ, ȚARA OAȘULUI) and a DEJ postmark from 1959, with a handwritten message and address.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a medieval gate tower with a steep shingled roof and wooden gallery, forming an arched passage through the old town fortifications. A small roundabout, 1960s streetlights, trees and wrought‑iron fencing frame the view; historic houses stand beside the tower. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue address, a Romanian stamp (POSTA ROMANA, 40 B, depicting Pioneers), and overlapping postmarks of Mediaș and București dated 15.10.1968. Printed credits include Editura Meridiane and the photographer Al. Florescu.

Color postcard showing a fortified church complex with a tall clock tower topped by a green patterned tiled spire, seen over red roofs and gardens full of flowers and trees. The reverse side has Romanian handwriting, a brown 40 BANI 'POSTA ROMINA' stamp, and circular postmarks from Mediaș and Roman. Printed caption indicates it is a view from Mediaș.

Color photo postcard showing a busy bathing resort with jetties and many swimmers on a large salt lake, with red‑tiled village houses and a church tower on a green hillside in the background. The reverse has handwritten Romanian text, a Romanian postage stamp (40 bani, POSTA ROMANA, flower), a București postmark dated 1976, and printed credits mentioning Ocna Sibiului.

Color postcard showing a spa resort scene: a large historic pavilion with a red tiled roof and arched balconies on a wooded hillside, a landscaped park and a lake with a long row of colorful bathing cabins reflected in the water. The back has Romanian handwriting, a 40 B POSTA ROMANA stamp (DENSUȘ), and postmarks from Ocna Sibiului and București.

Color postcard showing a grand red‑roofed spa hotel by a salt lake with a beach and bath complex, surrounded by forested hills. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, two Romanian stamps (5 Bani with a train, 35 Bani with a worker/industrial scene), a circular postmark dated 21.10.63, and printed Romanian layout text indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate wooden spa 'club' building with balconies and verandas on a terraced hillside in a resort town. Pedestrians walk along a promenade with lampposts and low fences. The reverse has Romanian printing identifying Sovata, two 20‑bani stamps with Mark Twain, and handwritten message and address.

Sepia/black‑and‑white postcard showing a baroque palace with a garden in front. Caption at top-left reads "SIBIU – Muzeul Brukenthal (sec. XVIII)". The reverse has Romanian printed text, a 40 Bani orange fish stamp marked "P. Romînă / Poșta", multiple circular postmarks dated 1963 from Sibiu, Cugir and Geoagiu-Băi, and handwritten Romanian message and address.

Black-and-white postcard showing people gathered and dancing or socializing under large pine trees along a shoreline. The sea is visible in the background. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, identifying the scene as Xylocastron in Greece, under the pines near the sea. A reference number is printed at the lower left, and a website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears across the image.

A vintage postcard showing a black‑and‑white photograph of a battlefield scene with destroyed fortifications, cannons, and debris. Below the image there is a printed caption in Danish, and the rest of the card is filled with handwritten text in a cursive script, oriented vertically on the right-hand side as was common with old postcards.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing traditional cylindrical windmills with thatched roofs on a rocky seaside landscape. A person and donkeys stand beside the nearest windmill; additional windmills line the coast, with the sea visible in the background. The caption at the bottom is in French, and a website watermark appears on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a church partly hidden by tall trees and dense shrubs. The church has a rectangular nave with tall arched windows and a square tower topped by a steep spire with a clock face. At the bottom right, small printed text reads "Kirche zu Niederau."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large early-20th‑century school building surrounded by trees and garden-like grounds. The multi-storey structure has a pitched roof with dormers, tall chimneys and decorative gables. The caption printed at the top left reads "Folkskolan, Strömslund".

Black‑and‑white vertical postcard-style photograph showing a dirt path leading between very tall, narrow, fantastically eroded rock towers in a forest. Conifer trees stand around the rocks, and low shrubs grow along the path. The rock formations are jagged and stacked, resembling pillars or figures.
