There is a bright, almost white sky without visible clouds. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.

A black-and-white photograph showing a riverside path with a simple metal railing running alongside the water. The river curves into the distance on the left, lined with bushes, reeds, and trees. On the right, a narrow dirt footpath climbs slightly uphill, where a few people are walking. In the distant background on a wooded hill stands a church with a Baroque-style tower and spire. The overall look is tranquil and rural, with no visible modern buildings or vehicles.

A colorized vintage postcard-style view over a hilly town with many trees in bloom. At the top of the hill stand several prominent buildings including a large church with a tall spire and other substantial masonry structures, likely historic civic or religious buildings. Below, clustered townhouses and small industrial buildings fill the valley. A curving path or road runs through a green foreground hillside. The sky is softly tinted blue with scattered clouds. The caption in the upper left reads "Leisnig i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white image of a richly decorated Gothic church portal with pointed arch, dense sculpted figures around the doorway, and statues in niches on both sides of the entrance. Below the image, faint handwritten text appears reversed, as if the card has been photographed from the back.

A colorized postcard view of a grand lakeside hotel complex with tower-like roofs surrounded by dense greenery, set against a backdrop of forest and snow‑topped mountains. The main building bears the sign "HOTEL Schloß-Velden" on its facade, and above the image, printed text identifies the location as Velden on the Wörthersee and the hotel as Schloss Velden.

A monochrome postcard view of a countryside church surrounded by hedges and trees. The building has a rectangular nave with arched windows, a pitched roof, and a square tower with a cross on top. A pathway runs along the right side of the image. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Kullings Sköfde Kyrka."

Color-tinted interior view of an ornate historic room with wood-paneled walls, coffered ceiling, chandelier, large green tiled stove, carved furniture, and shelves with plates. Portraits hang on the walls. Red German text is printed along the bottom margin, with a handwritten date at the left.

A black‑and‑white (with red caption) vintage postcard showing a small village in a hilly, forested landscape. Several multi‑story houses and farm buildings stand along a curving dirt road, with people in early 20th‑century clothing gathered in front. The scene is framed by wooded hills in the background. The lower margin bears a printed German caption in red type.

A monochrome postcard view of a formal park with manicured flowerbeds, cone-shaped topiary bushes, benches, and a few strolling figures in early-20th‑century clothing. In the background stands a multi‑storey historic spa or hotel building partially obscured by trees. At the top of the postcard are printed captions identifying the location as Bad Elster and the Kurhausanlagen (spa gardens).

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide dirt street bordered by substantial multi‑storey masonry buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European architecture. On the right is a long barracks‑like building with regularly spaced windows and small trees along its facade. Several men in dark uniforms or formal clothing walk along the street. In the foreground is a fenced open yard, while in the background low hills rise beyond the town. A faint, inverted handwritten caption appears at the top right edge of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a walled hilltop town surrounded by open, hilly terrain. The fortifications and buildings spread along the ridge, with scattered houses and roads in the foreground. Printed captions in French appear beneath the image, along with a small serial number at the lower left.

Vintage sepia postcard showing loggers cutting down enormous conifer trees in a forest. Several men work in pairs with long crosscut saws at the bases of the trunks, with more trees and forest in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Destroying the Giants." Vertical text along the left margin mentions printing in Germany and being hand colored, and along the right margin identifies the publisher in Los Angeles, California.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a lakeside rural landscape dominated by a large church with a central tower and spire surrounded by a graveyard. Trees line a road running beside the lake, with scattered houses, fields, and forested hills in the distance. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, along with a publisher's mark and date.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a European spa town promenade along a narrow river. On the right is a long colonnade building with statues on the roof and people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing strolling beneath its arches. On the left, multi‑storey townhouses line the river, and steep hills with villas rise in the background. Several shop signs in German are visible, including a pharmacy sign and another hanging sign on the colonnade.

Colorized panoramic view over a European town with dense tree cover in the foreground and tightly packed buildings with red and gray roofs in the middle. A tall church with a pointed spire and a large castle-like complex stand on a rocky hill to the left, overlooking the town. Factory chimneys and multi‑story townhouses are visible, with open countryside and fields stretching into the distant horizon. The caption "Leisnig i. Sa." appears printed in red at the top left.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a gently sloping hill with blossoming trees and a winding path where several people stroll in formal early‑20th‑century clothing. Atop the wooded hill is a small building flying flags, labeled "Bergschlösschen". The printed caption at the top reads "Nossen i. Sa." on the left and "Bergschlösschen" on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly riverside town with a large castle-like building on a forested hill to the left and smaller houses and streets below. A river and bridge run through the right side of the scene, and rolling wooded hills and fields extend into the distance. The caption "Scharfenstein i. Erzgeb." is printed at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a wooded valley towards a hillside town with dense traditional European houses. A prominent church with a tall tower stands on the ridge, and another tower is visible further right. In the foreground are trees and a curved-roof structure; at the bottom is a printed caption in German.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped city park with large trees, dense shrubs, and a curved balustraded terrace or promenade with ornate stone railings and gas-style street lamps. The image has printed captions identifying the location as Albertpark in Freiberg. A small publisher's imprint appears vertically along the left edge.

A sepia-toned aerial illustration of a large industrial complex with multiple long factory buildings, tall chimneys emitting smoke, rail tracks with trains in the foreground, and open fields and low hills in the distance. The image is captioned at the bottom with the name of the establishment and its location: 'ETABLISSEMENT BRÜDER REININGHAUS, GRAZ.'

Stylized, minimalist silhouette of a historic cityscape with towers, domes, walls and clustered buildings, rendered in flat dark colors on a white background. Trees and a foreground embankment or riverbank are visible. In the lower left corner is a small handwritten-style signature reading "O. Paju -27".

A black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated view over a coastal town with scattered houses, trees, and gardens in the foreground, opening onto a wide bay or fjord with wooded hills on both sides and several boats on the water. At the bottom left there is printed caption text, and at the bottom right a small triangular publisher's logo with a number.

Black‑and‑white view of a European historic city square with a large monument and fountain in the center, surrounded by multi‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and arcades at street level. Market stalls with umbrellas and pedestrians fill the square. In the background on a hill stands a fortified wall with a prominent clock tower (the Uhrturm). The overall look is early‑20th‑century urban Europe.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobbled street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. People are walking in the street. In the center background is a house with a sign for a restaurant. The caption at the bottom identifies the street and city, and a small printer's line appears at the very bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a historic European town built along a small river. In the center stands a tall round stone tower on a fortified base beside a narrow bridge crossing the river. Nearby is a large Gothic‑style church with a steep spire and tall pointed windows. Surrounding them are dense clusters of traditional gabled houses with tiled roofs, set against rolling open fields in the background. The image has the framing and composition typical of an old picture postcard. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing several women in headscarves and long skirts sweeping a cobblestone square with long brooms. In the background stands a large masonry church or cathedral with tall arched windows and a steep roof, partially obscured by trees. A freestanding kiosk or small pavilion is visible near the church, and a distant church tower or spire rises on the left side of the image. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century European town square.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a wide sandy street lined with palm trees and low, single‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the background there are hills or low mountains. Several people walk or stand in the open space. At the top is a printed caption in Portuguese that identifies the location as Rua dos Coqueiros in São Vicente, Cabo Verde.

Illustrated vintage postcard showing a tall stone monument or obelisk standing on a mound in a rural landscape. The name "JAHN" is carved near the top of the monument, which has a framed relief or plaque on its front. At the base stands a muscular, almost mythic-looking man with long hair and primitive clothing, holding a sword and shading his eyes as he looks up at the monument. Trees and distant hills appear in the background. The design is framed by a yellow border with printed text and a circular archival stamp in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a panoramic view over a forested mountainous valley with open meadows and a small village nestled in the center. The village has scattered houses, a church-like building, fields and a road running along the valley. Tall conifer trees frame the foreground. At the bottom of the image, printed white text reads "WILDENTHAL i. Erzgeb. 732 m".

Monochrome vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with a large hilltop castle complex dominating the skyline, identified as the Schloss. Below it are clustered roofs, church towers, and trees. In the foreground a river with a low weir (Muldenwehr) and a wooden structure crosses the water. The caption in German is printed at the top in red letters.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a side view of an early steam locomotive on rails. The engine has a boxy side‑tank design, large driving wheels, a tall chimney, domes on the boiler, and an enclosed cab with arched windows. The background is blank, emphasizing the locomotive as a studio or catalogue style photograph. Small printed text and numbers appear in the bottom corners.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small tram or streetcar traveling along a tree‑lined road. Pedestrians walk on the road beside the tracks, and a classic streetlamp stands near the center. Printed captions in red Dutch text appear at the bottom, with additional publisher information on the left and a handwritten annotation at the bottom right.

A colorized historic street scene showing a wide avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings with balconies and awnings. Horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing move along tram tracks in the street. Shopfronts with French signage are visible on the right, and the view recedes toward the distant end of the avenue under a clear blue sky. The top left bears printed French text identifying the location as a street in Alexandria.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a snowy winter landscape with dense coniferous forest heavily covered in snow. Ski tracks cross the foreground, and a lone skier stands near the trees. At the bottom, there is a printed caption in German that identifies the location as Schellerhau and mentions 'Rauhfroßt'. The image is bordered by a light-colored frame typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a seaside view with waves breaking on a rocky shoreline and a sandy beach. Along the beach are rows of bathing huts or cabins and a large bathhouse building. In the background stands a low, built‑up coastal town. Printed caption text in Spanish appears at the bottom of the image, along with a small serial number.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town and its railway station taken from an elevated grassy field. In the middle stands a brick station building with a gabled roof and a long platform structure. Next to it is a taller station house with several windows. Railway tracks and an empty, wide dirt or gravel area run horizontally across the foreground. Behind the station are compact townhouses, a church spire in the distance, and to the far right a larger ornate brick building with decorative gables. The landscape beyond the town is flat, open countryside stretching to the horizon. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European rural railway town.

Colorized historic postcard showing a multi‑storey palace tower with a domed roof and balustraded terrace, attached to a lower building behind a decorative fence and gate pillars. Trees surround the structure, and several people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing stand on the path in front. Red printed text in Polish appears at the top and along the left edge.

A colorized aerial-view postcard showing a large red-brick military barracks complex set in a green valley and surrounded by forests and fields. Multiple long rectangular buildings and courtyards form a regimented layout, identified in German text at the top as barracks for the 5th Field Artillery Regiment in Pirna on the Elbe River. The style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Colorized landscape view of a rural settlement in a valley with surrounding hills and mountains in the background. Scattered farmhouses and village buildings with red roofs are visible among green fields, orchards, and a winding road in the foreground. The scene has a vintage printed look. At the upper left, red text reads "Wetzelsdorf bei Graz."

Colorized vintage view showing a riverside embankment with a row of historic multi‑storey buildings in front, labeled shops at street level, and a tree‑lined promenade along a stone river wall. Behind the houses rises a steep, wooded hill with fortification walls and buildings on top, and a funicular or incline railway (Schlossbergbahn) running straight up the slope to the hilltop fortress. The caption at the top is in German.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over the rooftops of a dense town with historic buildings, chimneys, and church towers on a hill in the background. The scene shows a European townscape with trees interspersed among houses and a larger church or town hall tower dominating the skyline. The word 'Glauchau' is printed in cursive in the upper left corner on a plain background.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a ballerina in a long, light-colored classical tutu performing on an outdoor stage before a very large crowd. The dancer is in an elegant arabesque pose, facing a dense audience that fills the entire background. Behind the crowd are rows of trees, flagpoles with raised flags, and large multi‑story buildings with traditional European architecture. A large statue or monument is visible to the left in the distance.

Colorized postcard view of a rocky hill with the ruins of a castle on top, overlooking a river or canal with a long steamship passing by and leaving a plume of white smoke. Small houses with red roofs sit at the foot of the hill and along the valley. The scene is framed by green hills and a blue sky. Title text in German appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large baroque/neo‑baroque government building with an ornate tower and spire on a street corner. Pedestrians are visible in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads "CLUJ – Sfatul popular regional".

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town and surrounding flat countryside. In the foreground is a roughly triangular market square bordered by 2–3 story townhouses with gabled roofs and shopfronts. Dominating the scene near the middle is a large medieval brick gate tower with crenellations and an arched passageway, attached to remnants of town walls and other buildings. Beyond are tree‑lined streets, scattered houses, and a church with a tall, steep roof visible further back. The photograph is framed by a broad white painted border typical of an old printed postcard or photographic plate. No printed caption or handwriting is visible.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large monument dominated by a standing statue of Dante Alighieri atop a multi-tiered pedestal richly decorated with sculptural groups. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk around the base of the monument. Behind it are trees, a bell tower, and steep rocky mountains. At the top left is handwritten text indicating a date, and printed text at the top right names the monument.

Black-and-white landscape view of a valley town surrounded by forested hills and distant mountains. In the foreground there is an outdoor swimming pool complex with curved pools and small buildings around it. Scattered houses and fields extend up the slopes, and wooded ridges rise in the background. White German text is printed along the bottom border describing the scene.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a narrow dirt path winding through a dense conifer forest in hilly or mountainous terrain. The trail leads into the distance with successive tree-covered ridges under a cloudy sky. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text identifying the location.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a coastal town with small sailing boats and wooden piers along a calm bay. Low, closely packed houses line the waterfront and rise up a gentle hillside. The printed French caption at the top reads "CONSTANTINOPLE — Iles de Princes. La Baie de Halki," and a web address "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a leafy park-like area with birch trees, a dirt path, a small stone bridge over a narrow moat or ditch lined with rock walls, and a large brick castle-like building partially visible through the trees in the background. Text is printed in white in the lower left corner.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a busy market square in front of a large Baroque-style town hall with a central tower and clock. Numerous stalls and people fill the foreground. To the right stands a substantial church with a tall tower. The caption at the bottom in German reads "Weißenfels a. S. Rathaus."

Colorized vintage postcard depicting a large, two-story neoclassical building with arched windows and a central entrance portico. The structure is surrounded by trees and a wooden fence in the foreground. People, likely students, are visible in front of the building and looking out from the windows. Text in Cyrillic and Latin script appears in the top left corner naming the institution as a girls' gymnasium in Stara Zagora.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a garden and lawn in front of a modest, classical villa partially covered by trees and ivy. Flower beds border the grass, and a small pavilion or conservatory stands on the right. A child in light clothing stands in the middle foreground. Along the right margin there is vertical printed text in Dutch describing a guesthouse named "Pension 'Klein Stockenhoff'" and its proprietor G. J. Entink in Beek near Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white image of a grand historic building in Beaux‑Arts style, with two corner towers topped by dynamic sculptures of chariots and figures holding flags. The central arched entrance is richly decorated with columns and reliefs; people walk on the curved driveway in front. Mature trees frame the view and tram or trolleybus wires run across the sky. The architecture and composition resemble an early–mid 20th‑century city postcard.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting the entrance courtyard and towers of a large Renaissance castle complex. Steeply pitched tiled roofs, ornate gateway with statues and coat of arms, and tall spires dominate the scene. The architecture is framed by older stone houses in the foreground. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location and the castle entrance.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural townscape with fields in the foreground, a small river or pond, and a compact town on gently rising hills in the background. The town includes clustered houses and a prominent church with a tall spire on the right. A rounded hill stands behind the settlement. The lower part of the card is blank except for red Gothic-style German text reading "Gruss aus Altenberg i. Erzgebirge." There is also small vertical printer information along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square or park. In the foreground is a geometric stone fountain basin with several spouts spraying water into a pool. At the top of the fountain, on an axial stairway leading up a grassy slope, stands a bust of a man on a tall pedestal flanked by plaques. Young trees and paths curve through the landscaped park. In the background are multi‑story masonry and stucco buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormers. One long building along the back wall bears a painted sign in German, and the street at right has shopfronts with awnings.

Colorized historic view over a European town with red‑tiled roofs along a river in the foreground. Two people stand on a riverside path. Behind the houses rises a large Gothic church with multiple tall spires and an extensive walled complex or castle. The scene is printed in a painterly style typical of early 20th‑century postcards. In the sky area at the top left is a short German caption.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a Protestant-style church with wooden pews, arched windows, a decorative coffered ceiling, large chandeliers, and a central altar area framed by an arch. At the lower left, there is a printed caption in a serif typeface, and additional small text appears at the lower right, consistent with vintage postcard layout.

Color illustration showing a domed baroque-style building with a lantern and spire rising above terraced arcades covered in dense flowering vines (purple and pink blossoms). In front there is a grassy lawn with a path; above, a bright sky with large cumulus clouds. The style resembles an early 20th‑century painted tourist postcard. No visible printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural farming area surrounded by dense forest. Several farm buildings and houses sit along a road, with cultivated fields in the foreground and scattered houses on the hillside in the distance. The lower left corner has a printed caption with a location name and number, and the lower right bears a stylized "Widerøe" logo.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a snowy outdoor scene at what appears to be a freight or postal depot. Several men in long coats and military- or official-looking uniforms stand in front of a wooden loading platform piled high with parcels and boxes. Behind them are rail freight cars or storage wagons. Handwritten text in a cursive script appears in the right margin, and a reference number is written at the top edge.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large military barracks complex with several brick buildings, arcaded wings, and a tall tower surrounding an open parade ground. On the field in the foreground, soldiers are assembled in formation while an officer stands to one side. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the Prins Hendrik barracks in Nijmegen, associated with the colonial reserve.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a winter scene of old fortification walls with multiple brick arches along a snowy moat or path. Leafless trees stand on top of the walls, and a large arched gateway is visible in the background. On the right margin, there is vertical German text and a small coat of arms, suggesting it is a historical view of a European fortress structure.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural, hilly landscape with meadows and scattered trees. In the middle distance stand several large villa‑style houses and farm buildings along a winding road, surrounded by fields, fenced plots and forested hills. One building has a small tower or turret. The foreground shows a flower‑covered meadow sloping down toward the settlement. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.

A black‑and‑white panoramic photograph shows a hillside fortification with round towers and walls overlooking a dense coastal city and harbor. The image caption at the bottom identifies the view as a panoramic view of Yedi Koule in Salonica (Thessaloniki). The style and print look like an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large mural or wall painting set within a vaulted interior. The scene depicts a crowded Renaissance gathering with nobles, townspeople, children and dogs in front of a cityscape with towers in the background. The mural is framed by ornate architectural details above a decorated wooden panel and a pointed doorway. German caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a tranquil riverside scene with trees, reeds, and a wooden arched bridge crossing a calm river. A rowboat with people is on the water, and a few figures stroll along the riverbank. The sky is lightly clouded. French text appears at the top, and a small publisher's monogram is at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large historic building with a multi‑tiered tower and onion‑shaped dome roofs, standing on a hillside. Below the structure are terraced vineyards with stone retaining walls; a lone person is working among the vines. The style of the building is Central European, reminiscent of a manor or small palace overlooking wine‑growing slopes. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a low stone structure and spring or fountain beside a shallow body of water in an open, barren landscape. Two men in early 20th‑century attire stand on the stone platform, while another figure and animals appear in the distance. The lower margin contains printed captions in Greek and French identifying the scene as a picturesque view of Macedonia and the Fountain of Alexander the Great at Yenidje-Vardar.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a village at the foot of a hill. In the foreground stands a small church with a tower and baroque-style roof. Behind it are several villas and terraced vineyards climbing the hillside. On the hilltop is a prominent tower-like building. The words "Zitzschewig" appear at the top left and "Wettinhöhe" at the top right.

Black-and-white postcard view of a harbor scene with several boats. In the foreground is a small sailboat moored at a wooden pier with people on board, and another rowboat at the lower right. In the background is a large passenger steamship labeled "EXPRESS I" on the bow and on a sign near the upper deck, with a smokestack and several lifeboats. The setting appears to be a coastal or archipelago harbor with low land on the horizon and scattered sailboats. Printed text in Swedish is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century/early‑20th‑century villa or hotel in a forested setting. The multi‑storey building has steep gabled roofs, half‑timbered façades and several small towers with weather vanes, in a Central European historicist style. A glassed‑in veranda or café wraps around the ground floor. In the foreground, a well‑dressed couple and a child with a dog walk along a wide road. On a post near the entrance are several signs advertising the establishment. Dense woods and a small bridge path recede into the background.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large mandolin ensemble of young men in suits, arranged in several rows with their instruments (mandolins, guitars, a cimbalom/psaltery, and a tambourine) in a studio setting. At the bottom, there is a handwritten caption in Cyrillic describing the group and giving a date.

Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or lake toward a tree‑covered embankment with elegant villas and a large Gothic‑revival church featuring a very tall central spire and a smaller side spire. Swans rest and preen along the near shoreline, with overhanging trees framing the right side of the image. The sky is blank and washed out, and there are no visible printed captions or border decorations.

Multi‑view colorized postcard with nine small landscape photographs framed on a dark background. At the top, a title panel reads "Wetzelsdorf bei Graz." Each inner view shows a rural or small‑town area with rolling hills, scattered houses with red roofs, fields, and a church. Small captions under the images include several labeled "Wetzelsdorf," one labeled "Johann u. Paul" with a church on a hill, one labeled "K. k. Garnisons‑Schießstätte" showing open ground near a forest, one labeled "Krottendorf" showing a valley settlement, and one labeled "Schweizerhof" depicting a larger building complex by wooded hills.

A monochrome postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic complex on a hill. In the foreground, a crowded paddle steamer sails along a broad river. On the hill above the town rises a fortified palace with multiple steep roofs and towers, next to a Gothic cathedral with tall spires. Printed text at the top left reads "Meissen – Albrechtsburg u. Dom".

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a line of German soldiers in parade formation on a cobblestone street in front of large brick barracks buildings. The men wear pickelhaube-style helmets and dark uniforms, holding rifles with bayonets fixed. Young trees line the street. German text is printed at the top and bottom of the image, identifying the location and the military unit.

Black‑and‑white street view of a busy urban avenue lined with multi‑storey neoclassical and early‑20th‑century buildings. Pedestrians and a few vehicles move along the street, which recedes towards low hills in the distance. At the bottom margin, bilingual captions in Greek and French identify the location, and there is also a small website watermark (elia.org.gr) over the image.

A sepia-toned postcard featuring a film still of a man resembling Charlie Chaplin's Tramp character standing in a shabby alley or courtyard with worn walls and doors. He wears a bowler hat, mustache, and ill‑fitting clothes. A sleeping person lies on a bed or makeshift cot behind him. The lower border contains printed text in German identifying the actor and film title, along with a small publisher/series imprint.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a busy city gate with two large arched entrances in an old North African town. People in traditional clothing walk and ride donkeys through the gate into a narrow street lined with buildings and small market stalls. Along the top of the wall are crenellations. At the bottom of the image is printed caption text identifying the location and the specific gate.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal park avenue bordered by tall hedges and trees, with three men and a child standing on the wide path. In the distant background rise church-like towers and a smokestack above the treetops. Red caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as a city park path in Riesa on the Elbe River.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobbled town square bordered by old two‑ to three‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs. Signs on the ground‑floor shops are in German, and a horse‑drawn carriage stands in front of one building. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square. On the hillside behind the square rises a large fortified complex with long walls, gabled roofs, and a tall church spire, suggesting a historic castle or monastery dominating the scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a large Gothic-style church with twin towers and an attached school or cloister-like building. The foreground shows trees, gardens, and half-timbered houses. Printed German text at the top identifies the town and the church with its associated gymnasium (secondary school), and there is a vertical publisher credit along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial factory complex surrounded by dense forested hills. The main building is a multi‑storey modernist structure with long horizontal rows of windows and a tall smokestack. Several cars and smaller buildings are visible in the courtyard in front. There is a pink discoloration or mark over part of the trees on the right side. Caption text is printed along the bottom margin.

A colorized historic postcard view of a riverside town with a large castle complex and cathedral on a hill above the river. In the foreground are barges and a steam-powered boat on the river, a quay with people walking, and red‑roofed houses along the bank. On the hill stand a tall round tower, an extensive palace-like building with many gables, and a Gothic church with twin spires. The sky is clear blue and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the names of the castle and cathedral, with an added handwritten number in red ink on the right.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large Renaissance-style riverside castle with multiple wings, towers, and a tall spire, situated on the bank of a wide river. In front of the castle is a metal bridge crossing the river. A sailing boat with two people is in the foreground, and the buildings and bridge are reflected in the calm water. The printed caption at the top reads "Torgau a. Elbe. Schloß Hartenfels".

Black‑and‑white street view showing a brick corner building with shops at street level and apartments above. A tree frames the left side of the image; an old car is partly visible on the right. A lamppost stands at the corner, and several storefront awnings extend over the sidewalk. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Trollhättan, Folkets Hus, and a small imprint mark in the lower right credits a Stockholm-based publisher.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a Nordic coastal inlet full of floating timber logs. On the right shoreline stand several small wooden boathouses and sheds, with rowing boats and small motorboats moored along the water. Forested hills line the background under a partly cloudy sky. The lower left printed text reads "Lövånger. Kallviken." and in the lower right corner is a printer's credit indicating a photo publisher from Hälsingborg.

Black-and-white interior view of a Roman Catholic church taken from the central aisle looking toward the high altar. The nave has wooden pews on both sides and balconies with wooden railings above. The sanctuary wall is covered with large murals showing scenes from the life of Christ, with a prominent crucifix at the center surrounded by rays of light and groups of saints. Additional narrative frescoes fill the arched ceiling above the chancel. Lighting fixtures hang from a relatively plain, modern-style ceiling, suggesting an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century church. No clear postcard caption or border is visible on the image itself.

Vintage sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a wide agricultural valley with gridded fields, orchards, scattered farm buildings, and small town structures, viewed from an elevated vantage point (Slover Mountain). Snow‑capped mountains form the background. The image is bordered by a light frame with red printed captions including the title along the bottom and publisher/production details along the sides, plus a red handwritten or printed number in the lower-right corner.

Sepia-toned portrait postcard of a young man in profile, wearing a dark suit and white shirt, looking to the right. The style is an early 20th‑century studio photograph. Dark ink handwriting, likely a dedication and signature, is scrawled across the lower half of the image. In the bottom left corner, the photographer's imprint reads "EUGEN SCHIFFNER / DRESDEN / Bismarckplatz 8."

Vintage postal card with ornate printed design and handwritten address in ink. A circular postmark at the top right reads "ROMA" indicating it was sent from Rome. The printed background includes decorative borders and text bands typical of early 20th‑century international reply cards. The word "CARTE POSTALE" is printed in red at the top center. The address is written in Spanish, directed to Madrid, Spain.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a steep, rocky hillside covered with dense vegetation and garden terraces, with a small house and a pointed, turret‑like structure on the Schlossberg hill overlooking a town and valley below. At the bottom margin there is printed text identifying the view, and handwritten cursive text across the lower part of the image. A small handwritten date "1905" appears in the upper right corner.

A vintage postcard-style image shows a calm canal or river lined with trees on the right bank and small boats moored on the left. A traditional Dutch windmill is visible in the hazy distance along the waterway. The lower margin contains printed captions in a serif typeface.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a white stone church tower with a cross on top, partially obscured by trees. The church has arched belfry openings and a simple pitched metal roof. In the foreground there is a grassy area with a path and what appear to be gravestones, suggesting a churchyard. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Spånga, Kyrkan".

Colorized vintage postcard view of a calm river bordered by grassy banks and dense trees. A small footbridge or low bridge crosses the river in the distance under a pastel sky. In the upper right corner, printed text identifies the location as Elsterwerda and a riverside area of the Elster.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside rural scene. In the foreground is a dirt road and rocky shoreline leading to calm water with floating logs and small tree‑covered islets. On the right stands a large wooden house with decorative timber framing, alongside smaller outbuildings and coniferous trees in the background. Low hills or mountains rise in the distance across the lake. Printed caption text appears in the upper left.

A printed art postcard featuring a painting of three stylized male figures in dark suits standing on a low hill against a deep blue background. Each figure raises one arm dramatically upward, as if taking an oath or making a vow, with light seeming to radiate behind them. Below the image, on the white border, is printed text identifying the artist and the work.

Black‑and‑white street view of a mid‑20th‑century town scene. A three‑storey corner building with shops at street level and apartments above stands along an unpaved or lightly paved road. Several people are visible on the sidewalk and near parked vehicles, including an older car and a truck. A bicycle leans against a low wall. A decorative streetlamp and trees or forest appear in the background. Text printed in the image identifies the location as Lensmannsbygget in Elverums leir and credits the photographer/publisher E. Syringen in Elverum.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a small historic Lutheran church. The photo shows wooden pews, an ornate altar with a crucifix and statues, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, a tall Swedish longcase clock, and a wooden pulpit with painted panels. A hymn board with numbers stands to the left. At the bottom edge there is a printed caption identifying the church and a photographer/publisher credit.

A black‑and‑white postcard view across a calm bay or harbor framed by slender trees in the foreground. Small boats and a larger sailing ship are visible on the water, with low shoreline in the distance. The lower part of the image contains printed caption text followed by several lines of handwritten correspondence in ink.

Vintage black‑and‑white city view looking down a tree‑lined street flanked by ornate multi‑story buildings, hotels, and cafés. The perspective shows a narrow valley with hills in the background. Text at the top reads "Karlsbad. Untere Parkstrasse." Numbers in red ink are written and crossed out on the upper center. Signs on buildings include hotel names such as "Hotel …" and "Weilburg." and a shop sign "Ernst Die…". The scene is busy with terraces, awnings, and outdoor seating, typical of a spa resort town.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a street corner with a large early‑20th‑century residential apartment block featuring bay windows, balconies, and ornate façades. The streets in front are cobblestone and mostly empty. Red printed text at the top identifies the location as Torgau on the Elbe River and notes the corner of Fischerdörfchen and Schulstraße.

Colorized scenic view over a mountain lake surrounded by forested hills at sunset or dusk. In the foreground stands a large multi‑storey lakeside building, likely a hotel or guesthouse, with a sloping roof and several windows. A road or path runs along the shore, and small boats or piers are visible on the water. The scene is tranquil and idyllic, typical of an early 20th‑century travel postcard. The word "Schluchsee" is printed in red at the upper left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large equestrian monument in a European city square. The statue shows a bearded man in military attire and cloak, wearing a spiked helmet, on horseback atop a tall stone pedestal decorated with relief panels and wreaths. Two boys in early‑20th‑century clothing sit on the railing around the monument. In the background are multi‑story townhouses with steep roofs and shop signs in German lining the square.

Vintage postcard showing an open‑air theatrical performance in a large stadium filled with spectators, many holding light-colored umbrellas. In the foreground, actors in ancient-style robes perform on the track area. Greek and French captions are printed on the image, referring to a representation of Sophocles' tragedy Antigone in a stadium in Athens.

A black‑and‑white postcard with two historical industrial views. The upper image shows a large factory complex with a tall smokestack beside railway tracks. The lower image is a broader view of an old mill or factory settlement by a river, with multiple buildings, water channels, and surrounding countryside. Below the upper image is Swedish text reading "Från det gamla Ödeborg".

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval castle perched dramatically on top of a steep rocky cliff, surrounded by tall cypress trees. In the foreground are dense palms and other lush vegetation, giving a strong contrast between the rocky height and the verdant garden below. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed text identifying the place.

An old Italian postal card with printed heading 'CARTOLINA POSTALE ITALIANA (CARTE POSTALE D'ITALIE)', the royal coat of arms of the Kingdom of Italy in red at the center, and Italian and German postmarks. A red Italian stamp is cancelled with a circular postmark reading 'PISA'. The front is filled with handwritten address text in German, including the recipient's name and address in Heidelberg, Germany.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small timber church with a steep roof and tower on the right, surrounded by trees and a low stone wall, and a two‑storey wooden building with vertical cladding on the left. A dirt road or square occupies the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left.

A colorized vintage street scene showing a gently curving road lined with telegraph poles, detached houses with verandas and tin roofs, trees and a small garden area in the foreground with a red cylindrical post box. In the distance more low buildings and the shoreline are visible. Printed caption text at the upper right identifies the scene as a street in Lourenço Marques, Delagoa Bay.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard image showing the entrance to a mountain hotel. A wooden archway with the word "HÔTEL" stands over a path lined with tall cedar trees. People are visible near deck chairs on the left and with horses on the right, suggesting an alpine or hill resort. Snow patches are visible on the ground. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the entrance of Hôtel des Cèdres at Col de Chréa near Blida.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural valley scene with a densely wooded hillside in the background and several detached villas and houses along a curved road in the foreground. The printed caption in red Gothic-style script at the top identifies the place as Kötzschenbroda and mentions a view from the Lössnitz valley (Lössnitz-Grunde). Additional red vertical text is printed along the right edge, likely indicating the publisher from Kötzschenbroda.

Colorized vintage view of a canal lined with narrow, gabled houses. A moored sailing boat stands in the water to the left, and a stone quay with a railing runs along the right side in front of the houses. The overall style is that of an early 20th‑century printed postcard, with a brief caption in the upper left and a reference number in the upper right.

A monochrome postcard showing a tall Romanesque-Gothic bell tower rising above a cluster of old stone rooftops. The tower has several stacked arcaded levels and ends in a pyramidal spire topped with a cross. A few birds sit on the foreground roofs, and the sky behind the tower is cloudy with some visible stains or damage on the photograph. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Colorized historic postcard showing a tall stone medieval tower with a green domed roof and open lantern, standing in the middle of a cobbled square. On the tower's façade is a relief sculpture of a mounted figure, the König-Albert monument. Surrounding the tower are multi‑storey buildings with shops at street level and additional church or tower spires visible in the background. The sky is lightly clouded and the whole scene has an early 20th‑century hand‑tinted look. Printed German text at the top identifies the location.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a large outdoor gymnastic or calisthenics display on a raised platform. A group of uniformed young men or boys, wearing light shirts and dark shorts or trousers with suspenders, perform synchronized exercises with rifles or wooden rifles. In front of the platform sits a military band with helmets and instruments, led by a conductor standing at the left edge of the stage. A tall flagpole with a large flag and string bunting dominates the background, along with a tall rectangular scoreboard- or sign-like structure. The scene takes place on an open field, suggesting a public festival or sports event.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural school environment with several wooden buildings in a grassy landscape. In the foreground is a large timber schoolhouse with many windows and a gabled roof; in the background stand smaller houses and outbuildings, with trees framing the scene. Printed text at the upper center identifies the location in Swedish.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central church square in a European town. A large church with a tall clock tower and cross-topped spire dominates the left side, facing an open, mostly empty square. To the right stand 2‑ to 3‑storey townhouses with ornate façades and trees lining the street. The printing style and layout suggest an early 20th‑century German postcard.

The image shows the written/mailed side of a vintage brown postcard labeled 'CARTE POSTALE' in blue. Two French stamps (one red 50c and one blue 25c, both 'REPUBLIQUE FRANÇAISE') are affixed in the upper right corner and canceled with circular Paris postmarks dated 1932. The recipient's address is handwritten in ink on the right, including an address in Amsterdam, Netherlands, while the sender's name and Paris return address are written diagonally at upper left. There are additional light pencil notes in the correspondence area.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a wooden railway station building taken from the track side. The long, two‑storey structure has steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and small entrance porches. Railway tracks and the platform occupy the foreground, with trees and a few bicycles visible around the station. Printed captions in Swedish appear in the lower corners of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a peaceful town square or park. In the foreground are garden beds bordered by low wire hoops, gravel paths, and iron benches under tall trees. On the right is a wooden building with a columned veranda. In the distance, around an open square, stand several 2–3‑storey classical-style buildings, one with a distinctive mansard or pavilion-like roof. The word "Hamina" is printed in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing five Navajo men seated on the ground creating an elaborate sand painting inside a large indoor or tented space. Bowls of colored sand surround the circular design. Behind them hang many woven rugs and textiles displayed like at a fair or exhibition. A printed caption appears at the bottom right of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large late‑19th / early‑20th‑century stone building on a street corner. The structure has steep tiled roofs, dormers, a small clock turret with a weather vane, and an oriel-style bay with large windows decorated with geometric patterns. The street is lined with young trees, fencing, and lampposts; a few pedestrians are visible. On the right side there is a street sign mounted on a pole.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a steel railway viaduct crossing over a small valley with houses and farm buildings beneath it. The bridge has truss supports and stone piers, with gentle hills and a pastel sky in the background. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

A sepia-toned panoramic view over a hilly town with dense clusters of traditional European houses in the foreground and scattered villas and farm fields in the background. A prominent church with a tall spire rises near the center. Trees frame the scene, and a simple wooden fence runs along the bottom edge. In the lower left corner, the caption 'SEBNITZ i. Sa.' is printed.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade of a large brick educational building with a stone base and steep tiled roofs. The structure forms an L‑shape around a courtyard and features many rectangular windows with decorative brickwork and some window flower boxes. In the foreground is a street with a low wall and sparse young trees; a few pedestrians are visible. Printed Hungarian text at the top left describes the institution and mentions Kolozsvár.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex overlooking a river valley with terraced slopes and a factory building below. The castle sits on a steep, wooded hillside and is surrounded by substantial stone walls and towers. Printed German captions in red at the top left and right identify the location.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with multi‑storey brick and wooden buildings, shopfronts with awnings and signs, many children and adults posing on the sidewalk, and a horse‑drawn wagon in the middle of the street. The printed caption in the sky area reads "Göteborg Haga Nygata," indicating the location.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural valley settlement with scattered farmhouses and barns, a road lined with trees, and forested hills in the background. On a slope above the village stands a prominent large hunting lodge or manor complex. Printed German text at the top identifies the place and elevation.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing children and adults bathing and wading in a river, with low wooded hills and scattered houses in the background. People stand and play along a pebbly shoreline. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as a bathing beach on the Elbe River near Diesbar.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square with market stalls and umbrellas in the foreground and a grand, ornate town hall building with multiple towers and a central dome in the background. Trams, horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians populate the square, and multi‑story historic buildings with awnings line the streets. The caption printed at the top left reads "Graz. Hauptplatz, Rathaus."

Black-and-white panoramic view over a semi-industrial European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground is a factory complex with a tall chimney and multi-storey industrial buildings. A curving road or rail corridor leads through the valley, bordered by modest houses and open fields. In the distance are more residential buildings, several multi-storey institutional-looking blocks, and church-like towers, all set against rolling cultivated hills. Trees frame the image in the front corners, giving it a composed, scenic look typical of early 20th-century postcards.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large early-20th‑century ocean liner at sea. The ship has a single dark funnel, twin masts and multiple passenger decks. The vessel's name, "GARTH CASTLE," is printed on the bow. At the bottom margin, printing credits and the line name identify it as a ship of the Union-Castle Line.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of a small European town set among fields and gentle hills. In the foreground are tightly packed townhouses with gabled roofs and some half‑timbered buildings. In the middle stands a prominent church with a tall spire surrounded by larger villas and institutional buildings. Beyond lie cultivated fields, scattered farmhouses, and a forested ridge on the horizon. Printed red text appears in the upper right corner and along the right edge on the otherwise blank margin.

Black-and-white postcard view from a stone terrace and stairway on a hillside, shaded by a large tree, overlooking the historic rooftops and domes of a European city. In the distance are ornate buildings and church towers. Printed text at the bottom identifies the viewpoint as the Bürgerbastei on the Schlossberg in Graz.

Sepia-toned image of an ornate Gothic doorway inside a historic building. The pointed arch door is richly decorated with carved stone tracery and a patterned wooden door. On either side of the doorway hang framed portraits. To the left is a wall calendar showing 'Februar 11 Montag.' The lower margin of the card bears printed German text identifying the location as the Gothic door in the town hall of Breslau.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal town with many low wooden houses, a prominent church with a steeple near the center, and water with forested islands in the background. The lower margin is left blank for writing and contains handwritten notes and a date. Printed text on the image identifies the town in both Finnish and Swedish, and there is a small printer's credit at the bottom left.

Sepia-toned early 20th‑century street scene showing an open-top automobile covered in flowers and branches, carrying a uniformed driver and several women in light-colored dresses and hats. The car is part of a formal procession or celebration, with many spectators in period clothing lining a broad cobblestone street flanked by multi‑story stone buildings and trees. The architecture appears Central or Eastern European. There is a small printed mark in the lower right corner.

Black-and-white postcard showing the interior of an industrial dairy facility with tiled floors, large metal vats, pipes, machinery, and hanging light fixtures. The scene is clean and orderly, with equipment lining the walls. A Norwegian caption is printed at the bottom, and there is a small signature or imprint in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a memorial plaque set into a stone wall. The plaque is dark with light engraved Hungarian text commemorating Dr. Emil Bokor and dated 1919. The shape is roughly pentagonal, and the surface shows wear and some cracks in the surrounding masonry.

A black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing three people (two adults and a child) standing on a simple wooden pier extending into a calm lake. Across the water lies a small town with mid‑rise, stuccoed buildings and arcades facing the shore, backed by steep rocky hills and distant mountains. The architecture looks southern European, and the overall style feels like an early 20th‑century holiday or travel postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage waterfront view showing a long seaside promenade lined with multi‑story buildings on the right and a harbor with sailing vessels and small boats on the left. The scene is captured from an elevated perspective along the coast. Handwritten Greek text appears along the bottom edge of the image, and a modern printed watermark with a website URL is overlaid near the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view up a cobbled street lined with old multi‑storey houses, leading directly to a large round medieval brick tower with a conical roof and small windows. Gas-style street lamps and a hanging shop/inn sign are visible on the left, with a single pedestrian in early 20th‑century clothing walking along the pavement. The overall style suggests an old European town scene intended for a historical postcard.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large Neo‑Renaissance palace‑like building with elaborate roofline, balustrades, and sculptural decoration, set behind a formal garden with lawns, flowerbeds, and pathways. Another similar institutional building stands at the right, with a monument or column in the garden between them. The setting appears to be an academic or governmental complex in a Central European city. A small number "1127-20" is printed in white in the lower right corner; no other text is visible.

A multi-view vintage postcard with several small colored illustrations of landmarks in Budapest arranged on a black background. The central bottom area has the word "Budapest." in red. The small views include the Fisherman's Bastion (Fischerbastei / Halász-Bástya), the Gellért monument (Szent Gellért szobor – Gellhardus Monument), the Margaret Bridge (Margit híd – Margarethen-Brücke), Buda Castle area and surrounding structures including the castle bazaar (Ybl-bazár, Burgbazaar), Matthias Church / Matthias stairs (Mátyáslépcső – Matyásstiege), the Franz Joseph Bridge (Ferenc József híd – Franz Josef-Brücke), and an equestrian statue on a high plinth. The texts are in a mix of Hungarian and German, written in decorative script next to or over each vignette.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a tree-lined path in a park. Tall leafy trees arch over a curving walkway with benches along the sides and low fencing on the right. The scene is tranquil and largely natural, with a few small human figures visible in the distance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in French, along with a serial number.

A monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate villa with towers and elaborate wooden balconies, set on a wooded hillside with bare trees in the foreground and hills in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Băile Govora" on the left and "Vila Ştefanescu" on the right.

A black‑and‑white view of a narrow cobblestone street lined with old stone-and-wood houses whose upper stories overhang the lane. A man on horseback rides along the street while a few pedestrians stand or walk nearby. The architecture looks Ottoman/Balkan. At the bottom edge there is a caption in Bulgarian and French identifying the scene as an ancient street in Nessebar.

Black‑and‑white postcard with two oval photographs. The left image shows a metal bridge spanning a river in a lush, hilly tropical landscape. The right image shows a large tree surrounded by small buildings or huts. Above the photos is a coat of arms with the words 'CONGO BELGE', and below them is the caption 'BOMA'.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a narrow cobbled street flanked by low townhouses leading to a tall church with a slender spire and cross on top. A few pedestrians stand near the church entrance. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Church of Saint Anne in Bruges and includes publisher information. There is also some red handwritten text near the bottom.

A sepia-toned studio portrait of three young women wearing white dresses, pearl necklaces and sashes. The woman in the middle also wears a jeweled tiara. The sashes on the left and right women include the word 'ESTONIA', suggesting they are beauty contestants or ceremonial representatives. The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a street scene in front of a large institutional building identified as a hospital. The building has several stories, dormer windows, and a small dome or tower. A cobblestone boulevard with horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians runs alongside. The caption at the top identifies the location as Boulevard Saint-Lazare and the hospital in Mantes-la-Jolie, France.

Black-and-white postcard view of a town square with a low three-story brick building in the background, identified as the post office. In the foreground is a landscaped park area with paths, benches, flowerbeds, and a large leafy tree. To the right stands a prominent statue of a nude female figure raising an arm, set on a stone plinth. People are sitting on benches and walking through the square. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom of the image, along with the photographer/publisher information.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town nestled in a valley, with dense historic buildings, church towers, colonnades and a river or canal running through the center. Forested hills rise in the background. At the bottom, red printed German text identifies the scene as "Karlsbad. Blick von Cafe Panorama." and the publisher "1315 Brück & Sohn, Meissen." The number 1315 is also handwritten in red at the top.

A colorized vintage street scene showing an old stone fountain structure with arched openings on the left and several people gathered around it. A cobbled street leads up between traditional multi‑storey houses. In the foreground stands a robed figure identified in the caption as a Greek priest. The caption at the top is in French and there is a website watermark at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic square with a monumental fountain in the foreground, decorated with statues of Neptune and other figures. Behind the fountain stands a Romanesque cathedral with a rose window and tall drum-like tower, and to the left are older civic buildings lining the square. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Fontana del Nettuno in Piazza Vittorio Emanuele III in Trento.

A sepia-toned vintage photograph showing the interior of a Christian church, focused on a richly decorated neo‑Gothic altar. The altar has three tall pointed arches with tracery, crocketed pinnacles, and a central cross at the top. Within the niches stand white statues of saints and, in the center, a crucifix or depiction of Christ. In front of the altar are many flowers and greenery, possibly arranged for a religious feast. On the left side a pulpit with a small cross and ornate paneling is visible; hanging lamps or chandeliers descend from the ceiling. The card edges are worn and rounded, consistent with an old photographic postcard. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone church with a tall clock tower and spire. The tower façade includes mining symbols above the clock. The building has high arched windows and a steep roof, with a small graveyard visible in the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Røros, Kirken". The style and print suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square or street corner with cobblestones and a low picket fence in the foreground. On the left is a two‑story building with a sign reading "Hotel zur ..." partially obscured by ivy and bushes. In the center background stands a taller, ornate public building with a tower and spire, likely a town hall or civic building. On the right is a three‑story historic building with arched ground‑floor openings and shopfronts; one clearly bears a large sign "MILKA" above the entrance and another smaller "MILKA" sign in the window. There are mature trees and a small monument or column in a planted area between the buildings.

Black-and-white postcard showing a wooden lakeside house with a large terrace on stilts, surrounded by trees. The lake and distant forested shoreline are visible to the left, with gentle hills on the horizon. At the bottom-left is printed the caption identifying the place, and at the lower-right are small-print credits for the photographer or publisher.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing an ornate Baroque/Classicist town hall façade with statues on the roof, elaborate window decorations, and a wrought‑iron balcony above an arched central entrance. The street in front is almost empty, with a few pedestrians and old-style street lamps. At the top in red lettering appears a place name and the word for town hall in Hungarian, while shop signage (including 'MAURER ADOLF') is visible at street level.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elegant park scene with well‑dressed people strolling on a path in front of a domed pavilion surrounded by tall trees. The right side of the card is left blank for writing and contains red printed captions including the place name.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formal group portrait of men in suits and bow ties, seated and standing in rows inside what appears to be a parliamentary or assembly hall with columns in the background. Along the bottom is a white banner with a handwritten caption in Finnish and a printer's credit including the city name Helsinki.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide rural landscape with fields, forests, a river with floating logs, a road lined with utility poles, scattered farmhouses and barns in the foreground, and a small settlement in the distance. Printed Swedish text at the bottom identifies the view and the photographer/publisher.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small baroque-style pavilion with an ornate roof and cupola set in landscaped gardens. On the right is a long tree-lined avenue, and a woman in late 19th- or early 20th-century dress leans against a tree holding a parasol. Red printed captions in German appear at the top and bottom of the card.

A monochrome aerial view of a small town in a valley surrounded by patchwork fields and forested hills. The settlement has dense clusters of traditional European houses and farm buildings; roads and railway lines are visible in the foreground. At the top of the image there is printed German text identifying the view as being from the Geisingberg tower.

Black‑and‑white winter view of a stone embankment or small dam with a railing, heavily covered in ice and long icicles, beside a turbulent river or waterfall. Snow and frozen formations cover the structure and the surrounding rocky landscape. The word "Trollhättan." is printed in the lower left corner, and a photographer's imprint appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a wooden café or restaurant dining room. The room has wood‑panelled walls and ceiling, large multi‑pane windows with sheer curtains, and polished wooden floors. Square tables with tablecloths are neatly arranged, each with simple wooden chairs and small flower vases as centerpieces. Hanging plants and wreaths decorate the space, along with framed pictures on the walls and a wooden sideboard or cabinet at the back. Ceiling light fixtures with round bulbs hang from above. No people are present.

Black‑and‑white rural scene showing an unpaved country road lined with irregular stone posts and wooden fences, leading toward a cluster of small buildings in the distance. Farmhouses and fields lie on both sides of the road, with a forested area and a partly cloudy sky in the background. Several people are gathered further down the road. In the upper left corner appears the printed caption "Parti fra Midtskogen".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall baroque-style church tower with multiple tiers and clock faces, attached to a large church building behind leafless trees and an iron fence. A few people and a horse-drawn vehicle are visible in the street in front. Printed German text appears at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated Baroque crucifixion altar. At the center is a large crucifix of Jesus on the cross, surrounded by putti (cherubs), clouds, rays of light, and ornate columns. Below the crucifix stands a statue of a female saint above a framed depiction of a holy face. The text at the bottom identifies the scene as an altar in a church in Graz.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an exhibition room with framed photo collages of many people on the walls and a glass‑topped display table and single wooden chair in the center. Two large signs at the top of the walls read "VÄRLDPOST-FÖRENINGEN". The overall look is of an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century museum or exhibition dedicated to the World Postal Union or a similar postal association.

Colorized postcard view of a river scene with a side‑wheel steamship full of passengers in the foreground. Behind it rises a steep rocky hill topped by a medieval castle ruin and associated buildings, surrounded by terraced vineyards and a few houses along the riverbank. Printed text at the top reads in German about the castle ruin near Aussig.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide river scene with small rowing boats in the foreground and wooded hills on both sides. On the left bank, a town and a prominent complex on a hill (likely a castle) are visible. The printed caption at the top left in red ink reads "Leisnig i. S. Muldenpartie."

Black‑and‑white vertical postcard view of a quiet cobblestone street lined with stone townhouses and garden walls, leading toward a large Gothic‑style church with a very tall, slender spire. Trees frame the scene on both sides and a few people stand on the sidewalk and in the street. The architecture appears Central European, likely late 19th century. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet wooded scene with a few small white houses with tiled roofs nestled among trees. A dirt path and garden or landscaped area lead toward the houses, while tall trees line the right side of the image. Printed captions in Dutch and German at the bottom mention the area near Nijmegen (Berg en Dal) and a Salvation Army colony house.

Colorized historic street view showing a wide cobblestone street lined with multi‑story European townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the sidewalks; horse‑drawn carts are visible on the right. In the background and on the right side rise tall church spires. The lower margin has printed captions indicating the city and the street name, and a vertical text line on the left identifies the printer in Leipzig.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with a tall clock tower and historic buildings reflected in the calm water. Trees frame the left edge, and the tower with a pointed spire dominates the skyline. At the bottom center of the front image is a printed caption reading "Waldheim i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white street scene of a European city with cobblestones and people in early‑20th‑century clothing. On the right stands a large, richly decorated neo‑Renaissance/Baroque palace‑like building with statues, gables and pilasters. To the left are smaller two‑storey townhouses with shopfronts and striped awnings. Various shop signs in German hang above the windows. A sign reading "APO…" (likely Apotheke, pharmacy) projects into the street on the far right. Handcarts and pedestrians populate the square in front of the grand building.

The image shows the address side of an old German postcard. It has printed green text 'Postkarte' and a green postage stamp with a postmark. There is an oval purple hand‑stamp reading 'Bund deutscher Frauenvereine'. The card is addressed in cursive handwriting to a recipient in Hamburg, with other circular postal cancellations on the left.

Colorized postcard view of a tranquil pond or small lake surrounded by trees and parkland. People are boating on the water in small wooden rowboats. A decorative stone urn stands in the foreground by the water's edge, with benches and grassy areas nearby. On the far shore is a promenade lined with trees, a pavilion-like building with columns, and in the background a structure with two distinctive pointed towers. The sky is softly tinted in pastel hues. The caption "Graz-Hilnteich" appears printed in red at the upper left.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a dense Central European city with many 19th‑century buildings and several church towers. The skyline is framed by distant hills. At the bottom center of the front side, bilingual text reads in Romanian and Hungarian. The overall design, border, and print style suggest an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a narrow canal running between dense rows of old town buildings. Wooden structures and small jetties extend over the water, where several people stand or work along the canal edge. The top text identifies the scene as Kolberg and the Mühlenkanal, nicknamed 'Kolberger Venedig'. At the bottom, a red imprint credits the publisher and place, dated 1887.

Color postcard view of a compact alpine town in a narrow green valley surrounded by steep, forested mountains. In the distance, pale rocky peaks rise above the tree line, resembling the Dolomites. The town features dense clusters of pastel-colored houses with red-tiled roofs and a prominent church with a tall, dark spire at the center. Trees and foliage frame the scene in the foreground, and the image has the slightly tinted, printed look of mid‑20th‑century postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.

Monochrome historic postcard showing a cobblestoned street lined with old stone buildings and steep gabled roofs in a medieval town. A shop in the foreground bears the sign "Franz Würfel." In the background, tall Gothic spires rise above the roofs. Printed red text at the top reads "Meißen. Am Burglehn." and at the bottom there is a publisher credit.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a European town with dense late‑19th/early‑20th‑century apartment blocks and large barracks buildings. In the foreground are landscaped park grounds, footpaths, and a pond or small lake with boats and a boathouse. The town stretches across a low valley with church towers and factory chimneys visible in the distance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a red number is written at the top right margin.

Black‑and‑white street view of several substantial early‑20th‑century residential or institutional buildings with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, bay windows and modest ornamentation, lining a broad, mostly empty road. A small clock tower is visible on one of the buildings, and in the distance there is a church‑like tower with an onion‑shaped dome. People in long coats walk along the sidewalk, and a few horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians use the road. Trees line the right side, giving the scene a suburban or garden‑suburb feel.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European city nestled in a valley surrounded by high, rugged mountains with some snow on the peaks. The foreground shows dense historic buildings, church steeples, towers and a fortified-looking structure. Handwritten text and printed captions appear along the bottom margin, including the word 'Trento' in red and a photographer's credit.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a cobblestoned main street lined with two‑storey houses and shops on both sides. A few children walk along the left sidewalk, and a small group of people and carts are visible further down the street. German shop signs are painted on the façades. The caption at the top reads in red type and identifies the town and street.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway line and small station in a valley, with semaphore signals and level‑crossing barriers in the foreground. Trees and a fenced property line the tracks, and in the distance, on a wooded hill, stands a large baroque palace or castle complex. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large spa or resort building with two towers, flags on the roof and a formal garden in the foreground with paths, lawns, flowerbeds and strolling people in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption at the bottom reads "Zoppot. Kurhaus." and there is a red handwritten number "376" in the upper right corner.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a rural alpine village named Lavarone, with rolling green fields in the foreground, stone walls, and a man in period clothing standing near the wall. In the midground are several multi‑story buildings with red roofs and a prominent church with a tall bell tower (capella) rising above the houses. Forested hills stretch across the background under a pale sky. At the top left, red printed text reads "Lavarone, Capella, 1170 m".

A black‑and‑white photograph showing two children sitting with their backs to the camera on a low stone wall beside a river or lake. Across the calm water a European town is visible, with trees along the banks and the skyline dominated by two church towers: one tall, slender neo‑Gothic spire in the center and a shorter baroque‑style tower with a dome and cross to its left. The church spire and surrounding buildings are reflected clearly in the still water. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image side.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large suspension bridge over a river in an urban setting.
