The foreground shows landscaped gardens, paths, and fountains, while the bridge's ornate towers and approach ramps dominate the center. In the background stand church spires and city buildings. At the top are multilingual captions (Hungarian, German, and French/English) identifying the scene as the Elisabeth Bridge in Budapest and comparing its span to the Niagara Bridge.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a European town square bordered by Baroque-style buildings. In the center stands an ornate column or monument. Behind the square, on a hill covered with trees, rises a prominent clock tower with a steep roof. Handwritten-style text at the bottom reads "Graz. Karmeliterplatz mit Schlossberg-Aufgang."

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a castle-like building with a square tower and crenellated roofline, surrounded by trees and orchards in a valley landscape. The structure appears historic and fortified, and there are additional outbuildings on either side. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Italian.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi‑story building labeled "GRAND HOTEL DES ALPES" along a tree‑lined promenade. Well‑dressed men and women in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit outside under tall conifer trees, some beneath parasols and a tented area. On the façade near the entrance there is signage for postal/telegraph services. Printed text at the upper right provides the location and altitude.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural settlement with scattered wooden houses, barns, cultivated fields divided by fences, and rocky foreground terrain. In the distance there is a lake or large body of water and low hills on the horizon. The word "Orivesi." is printed in red in the upper left corner, and handwritten text "v. 1908." appears in the upper right corner.

Monochrome postcard showing a coastal town in a fjord-like landscape surrounded by rocky hills. In the foreground are bare rock islets and a sailing boat; in the background a compact town with a prominent church tower sits along the shoreline. There is printed caption text at the bottom and handwritten cursive text across the lower margin.

A colorized landscape view of a manicured garden or park. A curving path winds through a bright green lawn bordered by dense flower beds filled with red, pink, yellow, and white blossoms, possibly azaleas or rhododendrons. Behind the flowers stands a backdrop of tall mixed deciduous and coniferous trees under a clear blue sky. There is no visible text or border design on the image side.

A black‑and‑white divided postcard with two photographs. The top image shows a riverside neighborhood with houses and streets along a broad river, labeled as a quarter of Belgrade on the Sava River in its former state. The bottom image shows the same location after heavy destruction, with rubble, a damaged structure, artillery piece, scattered debris and a few figures, illustrating wartime devastation. Both images have the small imprint 'ORELL FÜSSLI' in a corner, and German captions explain the contrast between the two views.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a long neoclassical palace building with arcades and many windows, set behind an open square where people in traditional dress walk and riders on horseback move across the foreground. The sky is lightly clouded. At the bottom left, a caption in French reads "Le Caire. Palais d'Abdin." There are handwritten signatures and a circular postal or archive stamp on the lower part of the card.

Vintage monochrome postcard with two framed photographs separated by ornate Art Nouveau decoration. The left image shows a crowded shoreline with many people standing in shallow water near boats, palm trees visible in the background. The right image depicts a busy pier or jetty with lines of people, some carrying luggage or goods, and ships in the harbor. Decorative floral motifs appear beneath the photos, and printed captions in Portuguese identify the location and subject.

Colorized postcard view of a complex of historic buildings and castles sitting high on a steep, rocky, tree‑covered cliff above a river valley at sunset. The left foreground shows a multi‑gabled Renaissance‑style house with red roof (Goethe-Schloss), and further along the ridge are additional palace-like structures with towers and domes. German text, including the place name and Goethe quotations, is printed in red at the top.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with gently rolling fields, a dirt path in the foreground with a few people walking, dense trees, and a watercourse or millpond beside a cluster of buildings partly hidden by trees. At the top left the caption reads "Radeberg i. Sa." and at the top right "Partie an der Hüttermühle".

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside town with a prominent Gothic-style castle complex on a hill above the river. A paddle steamer named "SAXONIA" travels along the river in the foreground. At the bottom in red print it is labeled with the town name and the castle, and there is a small publisher credit and number along the lower edge.

An old Italian postal card with printed red heading and coat of arms, featuring postmarks and a printed stamp. The front shows only handwritten address lines in cursive Italian/French, no photograph or illustration. The top reads 'CARTOLINA POSTALE ITALIANA (CARTE POSTALE D'ITALIE)' with cancellation marks over the coat of arms and stamp on the right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a city street scene with a grand multi‑story hotel on the left labeled "Palast-Hotel Weber" and an adjacent large theater building with a high, blocky roof. People walk across an open square and an old electric tram marked with the number 506 runs on the right. At the top in red script is printed "Dresden" on the left and "Palast-Hôtel und Kgl. Schauspielhaus" on the right.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a baroque church with a tall bell tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and cross, situated along a narrow street framed by multi‑story townhouses. To the left of the church stands a slender stone obelisk or column monument with relief decorations at its base. Overhead electrical or tram wires cross the sky. The scene appears quiet with a few small figures near the monument, and there is a simple chapel-like building just behind the church tower.

Vintage portrait postcard featuring a monochrome illustration of an older bearded man identified as Friedrich Ludwig Jahn, framed by curtains. The left margin bears the printer's credit, and the right half is filled with handwritten cursive text and signatures. At the top in red print are references to a German gymnastic association and Graz.

Sepia-toned landscape view over a historic town in a valley framed by lush vegetation in the foreground (palms, flowering shrubs and trees) with snow‑covered Alpine mountains in the background. A tall church tower with a pointed spire dominates the center of the town, and to the right on a hillside stands a rectangular medieval tower or castle keep. The image has a white border with slightly scalloped edges, typical of vintage postcards.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue with a sidewalk in the foreground and an empty road beside it. On the right side stand ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses with bay windows and balconies. The caption at the bottom left reads "Nijmegen. Batavierenweg." suggesting it depicts Batavierenweg street in Nijmegen.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large brick railway station building with arched windows and a central clock above the main entrance. A flag flies from the roof. In front of the station there is a landscaped square with flower beds, a road with an early/mid‑20th‑century car, and several pedestrians. The style and print layout suggest an early 20th‑century European postcard.

A black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a grand spa or resort complex nestled in a forested landscape. The large multi‑wing hotel and pavilion-style buildings feature mansard roofs, ornate facades, and long verandas overlooking formal gardens and walking paths crowded with elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion. In the foreground runs a tree‑lined road with a horse‑drawn carriage and an early automobile. The whole scene suggests a fashionable health resort or casino in a wooded, hilly area. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front of the card.

Vintage monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with a central octagonal dome and a tall bell tower with an onion-shaped roof, opening onto a broad square with a prominent baroque fountain in the left foreground. Decorative blank cartouche at the top and red printed captions identify the location and subject.

Sepia-toned portrait of an older man in profile facing left, wearing a soft cap, neck scarf, waistcoat, and velvet-looking coat. The style is formal 19th‑century. At the lower left, the caption reads "RICHARD WAGNER," and there is a small publisher's mark and the number 8556 in the bottom right corner.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a European riverside city, photographed from a high stone terrace or fortification wall where several people are leaning on the parapet. Below is a wide river with at least two steam-powered boats with tall funnels. A sturdy stone-and-metal bridge spans the river; on the near bank the bridge has a massive stone arch, and on the far bank the shoreline is mostly open sand. Behind the bridge rises a dense cityscape of 19th‑century townhouses and larger villas on the slopes of low hills. In the farther hills there are scattered buildings and a prominent structure on a hilltop. The overall style and technology suggest an early 20th‑century European city postcard.

Black‑and‑white image of a large, two‑story wooden manor house with a metal roof, many evenly spaced windows, and a small central balcony. A monument or column stands directly in front of the building on a gravel forecourt, with lawns and trees framing the scene. The layout, typography, and small imprint at the bottom right resemble an old printed postcard.

A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a grand palace complex on a hill above a river, with large neoclassical buildings along the riverbank and several steam-powered boats on the water. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene in Hungarian and German, and the word 'Budapest' is printed prominently in red.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a busy waterfront quay with sailing boats and small ships in the foreground and multi‑story neoclassical and Ottoman‑era buildings lining the promenade in the background. People are visible along the quay. At the top left there is printed bilingual text in French and English describing the view, and a small dome with a clock tower is seen on one of the buildings. The overall style is early 20th‑century.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of four photographs of modest buildings in a rural or small‑town setting. The upper left image shows a traditional half‑timbered house with a steep tiled roof, arched doorway, benches, and a wooden fence with plants. The upper right image depicts a long, rectangular institutional building (likely a school or factory) with many uniform windows, a flat façade, and a tall brick chimney along a roadside. The lower left view shows a simple rendered residential house with a gabled tiled roof and utility pole nearby. The lower right view focuses on the façade of a low, elongated apartment‑like building with multiple windows and some laundry hanging outside. All scenes include trees and give a mid‑20th‑century central European village impression.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a cobblestone riverbank with several small boats, including a sailing boat with a tall mast and another boat overturned in the foreground. Leafless trees line the shore on the left, while across the wide river a low, slightly hilly bank with scattered buildings is visible. A small rowing boat is on the water in the distance. The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a wide, gently curving path running through a densely wooded park or garden. Low rustic wooden fences made of crossed stakes border both sides of the path. Mature leafy trees create a canopy overhead, with dappled light falling on the ground. Two children stand on the pathway, one closer to the foreground and another further down the path. There are no visible buildings or monuments and no visible printed caption on the front.

Black-and-white photograph showing six well‑dressed adults standing outdoors by a wooden fence in front of a powerful river or waterfall in a forested area. The men wear suits, long coats, and hats; the woman wears a dress, coat, and cloche-style hat, suggesting early 20th‑century fashion. Coniferous trees line the bank and the water appears white and turbulent, indicating rapids or a large waterfall. There is no visible printed caption or text on the front.

Colorized view of a large historic castle complex rising above dense trees. The building has thick stone walls, several round towers with conical and domed roofs, and an adjoining long white wing with a red-tiled roof and dormer windows. The sky is blue with a few clouds. At the top left, printed text reads "Wurzen. Schloss." indicating the depicted castle in the town of Wurzen.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of Monaco. The image captures the rocky promontory of Monaco-Ville (the Old Town) jutting into the sea with dense buildings on the cliff, the harbor and coastline stretching into the distance, and hills in the background. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe it as a general view of the principality.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grassy open field with a few colonial-style buildings in the distance, likely part of a trading or company compound. Low hills and trees form the background. Printed captions at the bottom read "Cabinda" on the left and "Compa do Congo Portuguez" on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a leafy park with a pond in the foreground and a small wooded island. A round medieval stone tower rises above the trees in the background. At the bottom of the image there is printed text indicating the city name and the specific park location.

Sepia photograph mounted on a card border, showing a street parade of girls in elaborate traditional folk costumes with floral headpieces and embroidered bodices. They walk along a decorated street lined with multi‑story buildings whose windows are draped with garlands. Crowds watch from the sidewalks and windows. At the bottom margin, a caption in German identifies the scene.

A colorized view over a river bordered by lush trees toward a hillside spa town. Elegant villas and townhouses line the slope, and a tall church with a pointed spire dominates the skyline. At the riverbank there is a wooden boathouse or pavilion with several small boats moored nearby. The sky shows a soft gradient from pink to blue. In the upper left corner, the caption "Bad Elster" is printed.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a hilly shoreline with many houses and villas along the water, looking across a wide strait toward a green hillside on the opposite bank. The lower margin contains printed titling in French mentioning Constantinople and the Bosphorus, and the bottom area is filled with handwritten message text.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet riverside harbor with small sailboats and houses reflected in the water. Trees and low hills form the background. The caption printed below the image reads "PADRÓN — Muelle de Puente Cesures." The lower and right margins are filled with handwritten correspondence. At the bottom right is a printer's credit, "Fotgl. Ferrer: Coruña," and at the very bottom, a commercial line for "Comercio de Manuel Suarez Castro."

Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone town square with a central statue of a man in a long coat standing on a pedestal inscribed 'ALBERT.' The statue is surrounded by short posts linked with chains. Behind it are 3–4 storey gabled houses with many windows and flower boxes. Shop signs on the ground floors read in German, including a shoe store and other merchants with striped awnings.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque palace courtyard with ornate facades, arched windows, balustrades lined with statues, and a central gate-like pavilion. In the foreground are formal gardens with curving pools and fountains, and many people strolling around in early 20th‑century clothing. At the bottom, German text identifies the scene as the Zwinger courtyard in Dresden, looking toward the Wallpavillon.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs from the Kriebethal/Kriebstein area. The upper left shows a country inn labelled "Gasthof Kriebethal" surrounded by trees. The upper right shows a railway line entering a truss bridge with a prominent hilltop castle in the background, captioned "Burg Kriebstein". The lower left image depicts a concrete dam with water spilling over, titled "Talsperre Kriebstein". The lower right view shows a wooded reservoir landscape with a boat on the water, captioned "Partie an d. Talsperre".

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town taken from a wooded hillside. In the foreground are rocks and tall trees; beyond them lies a dense urban area with multi‑storey stone buildings, factory chimneys and railway tracks. A large church with a tall spire stands prominently to the right. Low mountains rise in the background. Handwritten white text is visible at the bottom of the image.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a tree-lined cemetery with tall cypress trees, gravestones, and a small stone fountain building with an arched niche on the right. A road curves past the cemetery wall in the foreground. Printed captions in French identify the location as a fountain in the Scutari cemetery of Constantinople.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a grand spa building set in a landscaped garden with curved paths, flowerbeds, trimmed bushes, and many identical white chairs arranged in rows. Behind the building is a densely forested hillside. The architecture suggests an early 20th‑century European spa resort. Text at the top right reads "Bad Elster. Albertbad".

A tinted pink postcard showing a park scene with a large round medieval tower beside a waterway, trees, a small bridge, and people walking and boating. On the right is part of a grand building and handwritten cursive text. Printed captions read "Nijmegen." at the top right and "Kronenburgerpark." at the bottom center.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tranquil pond surrounded by dense trees. On the left is a simple wooden footbridge spanning a narrow part of the water, its reflection visible below. On the right stands a small wooden hut or duck house on the water's edge, next to which a single white swan is visible. The image has a soft, slightly faded look typical of early 20th‑century landscape postcards. No printed captions or visible handwriting appear on the image side.

Sepia-toned image showing a large medieval-style clock tower on a hill, with a steep shingled roof and wooden gallery. A giant clock face is mounted on the tower wall. In the foreground, a man in traditional clothing holds a bucket while a woman in a dirndl-like dress kneels on the path, seemingly posing playfully. Below the hill a townscape stretches into the distance.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an Islamic cemetery with stone tombs and gravestones. A large domed mausoleum with an ornate, ribbed dome stands on the left, and other domed structures and tombs recede into the background. A robed figure walks among the graves. The image has a printed caption at the bottom margin.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a tree-filled park with benches and people in early 20th‑century clothing. On the left stands a large monument with a tall statue of a standing figure atop a multi-tiered pedestal (the Dante monument). On the right is a bust of a man on a high plinth (Giuseppe Verdi). Distant mountains are visible beyond the trees. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large neoclassical building set back from a broad avenue lined with trees and lampposts. The structure has a central block with columns and symmetrical wings, likely a parliamentary or governmental building. At the bottom are printed captions in Greek and French, and there is purple handwritten script across the lower margin.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of steep, terraced mountains. The foreground shows dense urban blocks with multi‑story buildings and tree‑lined streets; in the middle distance rise church towers and older stone structures typical of a historic European city. The rugged hills behind dominate the scene. In the upper right corner the caption 'TRENTO-TRIENT' is printed.

Colorized night-view postcard showing a large round red-brick tower with a steep, dark, conical roof and several smaller spires. The moon and clouds dominate the dramatic sky. At the base of the tower are lower buildings with lit windows and people in early-20th‑century clothing walking in the street near a gas streetlamp. Faint red text at the top reads a place name, and white text at the bottom right appears to be a publisher or collection mark.

Vintage sepia postcard showing small houses built on a rocky hillside at the base of a large cliff, overlooking a city and plain below. In the foreground, people move along narrow paths between the houses. The right side has three identical Greek postage stamps arranged vertically. Printed captions in French and Greek appear beneath the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a circular stone fountain in the foreground of a cloistered courtyard. Behind the fountain is a stone bench and an arcade of round arches supported by columns along a building façade. The image is bordered by a wide cream margin. Below the photograph there is multilingual printed text identifying the scene as the fountain of the convent of Santa Isabel.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the left foreground stands a prominent church with a tall square tower topped by an onion‑shaped dome and cross. Clustered around it are steep‑roofed houses and low masonry buildings. In the mid‑distance a large, lighter‑colored institutional building (likely a school or town hall) sits beside a winding country road that leads into open fields and wooded hills. On the right, a grassy slope with a simple wooden fence and a few trees descends toward the town, framing the scene.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a European riverside town. Dominating the scene is a tall clock‑towered building with ornate neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance features, likely a town hall, standing beside a river with its full reflection visible in the calm water. A small bridge crosses the river in front of the main building. Surrounding it are lower, 19th‑century style townhouses and industrial-looking structures, with a smokestack in the background and gently wooded hills behind the town. The sky is bright, trees are bare or sparse, and there are no cars visible. The upper right corner of the image is irregularly cut, as if from an old negative or print. No legible text appears on the image.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a rural roadside scene with cows in the foreground, a dirt road, a telegraph pole, wooden fences and buildings, and trees in the background. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as Stockvik, Sundsvall, along with an additional publisher/location line.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a European city showing an iron truss bridge over a river lined with multi‑storey historic buildings in eclectic and neo‑gothic styles. People and carriages or early vehicles can be seen on the bridge. The caption at the bottom reads "Podul de fier peste Someș," and a small circular logo appears in the lower‑right corner.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing two theater performers in costume from the production "Die Schmiedin von Kent." One woman sits on an ornate armchair in a long dress while another stands beside her in a medieval-style tunic with a floral head wreath. The setting appears to be a stage interior. Printed credits at the top name the play and the actors Helena Forti and Waldemar Staegemann. At the bottom, the publisher and photographer are credited, along with the city Dresden and the year 1916.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a waterfront promenade lined with neoclassical and early 20th‑century buildings. People in period clothing walk along a wide, mostly unpaved quayside street with sparse lampposts. Printed captions in Greek and French at the top identify the scene as the quay of Kalamata.

Black-and-white postcard showing a historic train station building with brick walls, arched windows, and steep dark roofs with small spires and decorative ironwork. Several people stand in front of the entrance, and many bicycles are parked along the facade. In the foreground is a cobblestone square with a lamppost and a freestanding information/phone kiosk. The lower margin of the image contains the caption 'KARLSTAD. Centralstationen.'

A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested valley. In the foreground are fields and scattered trees; behind them lies a compact village with traditional European houses and a prominent church with a steeple. On a hill above the village stands a sizable castle-like complex. The landscape extends into rolling hills in the background. The title text "Liebstadt i. S." is printed in red at the top.

A colorized historic street scene showing a large crowd of elegantly dressed people walking and riding in carriages along a broad avenue lined with trees. In the distance stands the Arc de Triomphe. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as an avenue leading to the Bois de Boulogne in Paris, along with a series number and publisher initials.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a neoclassical open pavilion or colonnade set in a park or garden, surrounded by tall trees. The structure has a low hip roof, a pedimented end, and a series of evenly spaced columns on a raised platform with steps. At the top of the postcard there is red text in Cyrillic and German.

An old monochrome illustrated postcard showing a harbor scene with sailing boats moored beside a quay. In the background stands a tall stone clock tower with a pointed roof, surrounded by traditional multi‑story buildings and distant hills under large stylized clouds. At the lower right is a heraldic shield with two towers above wavy lines of water and a scroll bearing the inscription "RIVA".

Black-and-white postcard view of a rocky shoreline and coastal cliff seen through the silhouettes of trees in the foreground. A narrow road or path curves along the base of the cliff beside the water. In the lower right corner, cursive text identifies the location, and a small serial number appears in the lower left.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town in a hilly landscape. Foreground buildings include a manor‑like structure with a round corner tower and several multi‑storey houses with steep roofs, while to the right stands a larger fortified complex or castle on higher ground. The background features terraced hills and scattered houses along a valley road. The caption at the bottom reads "Petschau." The publisher line at lower left reads "1044 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

Black‑and‑white photograph of a lush garden courtyard with a circular fountain and small statue in the center, set before an old building with dormer windows and a steep tiled roof. Dense foliage surrounds the fountain and partially covers the building. White printed captions appear at the lower left and right margins.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a woman in traditional Ottoman/Turkish dress lying on her stomach on a carpeted floor inside a room, reading or writing at a small low table. She is surrounded by cushions, a brass or copper decorative vessel, and a screen or room divider. The scene is presented as an Orientalist interior view.

Black‑and‑white image of a long, multi‑storey institutional building with brick and stone façades, mansard‑style roof sections, tall chimneys, and arched windows. The structure stands behind a brick-and-iron fence with young trees planted along a wide, empty street in the foreground. Large mature trees frame the scene on both sides. Another similar multi‑storey building is visible further down the street. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the front.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Baroque-style palace complex with a central clock tower topped by an onion-shaped dome. The building has multiple stories and many windows, with ivy climbing the façade and a low wall and trees in the foreground. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Schloß Lockwitz."

A colorized historic street scene showing a broad cobblestone square with tram tracks and several yellow and red electric trams. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square and along sidewalks. Surrounding the square are ornate multi‑story buildings with shops at ground level, striped awnings, and decorative facades. Trees and a few lampposts line the right side. The top of the image is captioned with the location name.

A monochrome historical postcard depicting an ornate multi‑storey palatial building on a city street. The façade features elaborate stonework, columns, balconies, and corner towers. People and a horse‑drawn carriage stand in front of the building. Printed captions at the top read the city and country and identify the building as the Kolmar Palace. Shop signs in the ground floor windows are also visible.

Black-and-white postcard view of a leafy park or garden walkway with several white slatted benches along a dirt path. On the right is a wooden pavilion or veranda attached to a light-colored building, with decorative railings and posts. Trees and bushes line the path, and a single person walks in the distance. In the lower-left corner, the place name is printed in white lettering.

Color postcard-style image showing a distant panoramic view of a historic European harbor city seen from across a body of water. The skyline features multiple tall, slender church spires and older masonry buildings, with port cranes and industrial structures visible along the waterfront under a partly cloudy sky.

Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a field outside a small European town. In the middle distance stands a large church with two slender Gothic spires dominating the skyline. Around it are compact townhouses, factory chimneys, and tree‑lined streets. Low hills rise in the far background, including a solitary conical hill. The foreground consists of cultivated fields and a rural dirt road lined with trees. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned portrait of a seated woman in elaborate traditional dress, likely from North Africa or the Middle East. She wears layered garments, a richly decorated headscarf with a veil, heavy jewelry including large earrings, necklaces and chains, and holds what appears to be a pair of scissors or metal implements in her hands. The photo is bordered by a cream card typical of early photographic postcards. No text is visible on the front.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a large villa-like building surrounded by trees and gardens. In front of the main building is a circular driveway with a decorative round flower bed or fountain in the center. The property is bordered by roads and open fields, with several smaller houses and farm buildings in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's mark is in the lower right corner.

A monochrome postcard showing a tall, rectangular stone monument standing on a small rise among pine trees. The pillar-like structure has a darker rectangular plaque on its front face, decorated with a vertical sword or cross motif and surrounded by text that is difficult to read. Above the plaque is a circular wreath relief. In the foreground are low stone posts connected by chains and simple white crosses, suggesting a war memorial or commemorative grave site.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a wide dirt street bordered by wooden buildings. On the right is a large, ornate wooden school-like building with many tall windows, a small tower on the roof, and decorative gables, behind a low wooden fence. A few people, including children, walk along the street. There are telegraph poles on the left side and another wooden building in the distance. Printed captions in Finnish/Swedish appear at the top.

Black-and-white postcard image of a large wooden villa-style building with ornate railings and a prominent balcony, surrounded by trees and greenery. A person stands on the front steps. Printed text in the sky area reads "Trosa, Societetshuset."

Illustrated view of a narrow rocky gorge with a fast-flowing stream or waterfall running between steep cliffs. A wooden walkway with railings is attached high along the right rock face, winding through dense coniferous forest. The image has a painterly style and a small caption under the picture.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a hillside town scene with stone houses and walls above a valley or ravine, with several people standing along the path. Greek text appears at the top and left margin, and French and Latin‑alphabet Greek text along the right side. The caption identifies the location as Veria (Berroia), in the region of Macedonia.

A vintage tinted postcard showing several large domed mausoleums and a minaret on the edge of a desert landscape. In the foreground stand a donkey and a kneeling figure. The image is framed in an oval with a beige border. French captions identify the scene as in Cairo and specifically the tombs of the caliphs.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a vaulted stone passageway with heavy masonry arches, likely part of an old cloister or church ruin. In the background are Gothic-style window openings without glass, and in the foreground a later-added electric lamp hangs from the stone arch. The scene has a narrow corridor feel, with rough stone walls and worn floor. Along the lower border of the postcard there is cursive text.

Sepia-toned photograph of a European market square with historic multi-storey townhouses, a few early automobiles, pedestrians, and a large building with a tall clock tower and baroque-style dome on the right. The scene is spacious, showing the central marketplace area of a town. In the lower left corner, printed text reads "BORNA. Markt." indicating the market square of Borna.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex dominating a small town. The multi-winged fortified building with towers and high walls overlooks clustered village houses and trees in the foreground. Printed red Gothic-style text appears below the image on a blank cream margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a half‑timbered manor or small castle with a steep tiled roof and a round corner tower topped by an onion‑shaped dome. In the foreground stands a large wooden wine press surrounded by low stone walls and a simple wooden fence; trees and a path frame the scene. Handwritten German text appears along the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph shows a long Spanish Colonial style mission church with a stepped bell gable (campanario) at the front and a row of heavy buttress-like pilasters along the nave. Several bells hang in the arched openings at the top of the façade, which is topped with a cross. In front of the building are palm trees, a low white wall, and a dirt foreground, suggesting a warm, arid climate. The image has a white border and some faint, upside‑down handwritten text along the bottom edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate three‑storey building with a flag flying from the roof, set in an open field with a dirt path and telephone pole in the foreground. Smaller outbuildings and additional houses stand to the left and right. A few people are visible near the main entrance and on the path. The caption beneath the image reads "Posthuset, Tierp".

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a historic European town hall complex with gabled roofs and arcades. The main building has multiple windows with shutters, arched ground‑floor openings, and ivy climbing one wall. The scene is a quiet square with no visible people or vehicles. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small number is printed at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels. The upper left view shows a domed tower structure overlooking a town and river valley, labeled "Jacobstein." The upper right view shows a hillside manor or small castle with a tower, surrounded by terraced vineyards, labeled "Friedensburg." The lower left view portrays a curving river with a bridge in the foreground and a settlement on the hillside, labeled "Die Lößnitz." The lower right view shows a panoramic view of a town with a church spire and a river bend in the background, labeled "Radebeul-West." All captions appear in German.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilltop complex consisting of a castle and an adjacent church tower above a forested slope. Below are winding roads and several smaller houses. The title in red Gothic-style script is printed at the top, and a vertical printer's credit appears along the right edge.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small wooden bridge or sluice structure over a calm river, surrounded by trees and grassy banks. Stones line the embankment. At the bottom is printed text in a Baltic language, and there is a small publisher's mark and number in the lower-right corner.

Hand-colored postcard showing two mounted soldiers in early 20th‑century German uniforms, posed on horses on a sandy forest path with birch trees in the background. The left rider wears a blue tunic and pickelhaube-style helmet, the right rider a gray-green uniform and helmet. The lower part of the card contains German text in red print and blank lines for the date.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade with a stone seawall and railings, small boats in the water, and a hillside of multi‑story buildings with enclosed balconies above. Printed caption at the bottom center identifies the scene as Plaza de Abastos and Paseo del Berbés in Vigo. There is cursive handwriting across the sky and lower margin, and a date written at the top right.

A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a large institutional complex set on a hillside, with multiple long classical-style buildings, towers and surrounding smaller houses and fields. Forested hills and low mountains appear in the background. Printed text at the top reads "Graz, Landeskrankenhaus", identifying the scene as the state hospital area in Graz.

Colorized historical postcard showing a landscaped hospital complex with a small octagonal or polygonal pavilion building in the left foreground and a larger multi‑storey building with red roofs in the background. Several people in white medical or patient clothing stroll along garden paths. German captions label the scene and the specific buildings.

A vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a large brick school building in winter, with bare trees and snow on the ground. The school has several stories, many windows, and a small tower-like structure on one corner. In the background are tall church spires. There are purple postal cancellation stamps on the right side and a red handwritten number "75:" near the bottom. Printed captions beneath the image identify the location and building.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a hilly industrial town with many small factories and houses scattered along terraced slopes. Smokestacks and long factory buildings are visible among the residential structures, surrounded by mountainous terrain and vegetation. The border has a wavy decorative edge and a caption printed at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white image of a small wooden railway station building labeled "STÄKET". The station has a steep gabled roof, flower boxes hanging under the eaves, and a covered platform with benches. Several people, including what appear to be railway staff, stand or sit along the platform. Railway tracks run in the foreground, and there are trees and a few houses on a slope behind the station. The caption at the lower left reads "STÄKET Järnvägsstationen," and a small serial number "712092" appears in the lower right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, old fortified building with high walls and a sloping roof, partially covered in vegetation. In the background stands a church tower with a clock and cross. A park-like area with trees and a path lies in the foreground. At the bottom, white printed text reads "Čakovec – Stari grad Zrinskih."

Illustrated postcard showing a lively terrace restaurant beside a large building, filled with people sitting at tables under lanterns. A red sign on the wall advertises regular concerts. To the right, the scene opens to a panoramic view over a wide river with boats, tree‑covered banks, and distant mountains topped with small buildings or ruins. A flagpole with the black‑white‑red German Imperial flag stands prominently. Decorative lettering in German and handwritten text overlay part of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a round stone tower or memorial building on a hilltop. The structure has a cylindrical body with small windows, a heavy cornice, and a crenellated upper section, all built of rough stone. A rectangular base with an entrance and steps leads up to it. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the entrance. Large flags with horizontal light–dark–light stripes fly on poles around the monument. Trees and a simple fence line the foreground.

A vintage beige postcard-like card with printed Estonian text. At the top center it reads 'EESTI SPORDI KESKLIIT' and below, a line noting national gymnastics and sports games with dates in June 1934 in Tallinn. On the left is a circular emblem showing athletes with flags and sports gear, encircled by Estonian text. The left side has dotted lines labeled 'Saatja aadress:' for the sender's address, and the right side has a line beginning with 'Tallinn,' followed by space to fill in the year '193...'. There are two punched holes at the bottom edge.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large neoclassical building complex with green roofs and ornate façades, viewed from across an open square. The building is labeled as the Estonia Theatre in Tallinn, with captions in Russian and Estonian printed at the top of the image.

An old monochrome postcard showing a large, elegant building surrounded by a landscaped garden with trees, shrubs, and a stairway leading up to the entrance. A person is seated on a bench in the foreground. The bottom margin contains printed captions in German identifying the place and the publisher.

Black-and-white postcard showing a symmetrical manor complex: a central two‑storey mansion with a gabled pediment and two single‑storey side buildings, all set around a circular drive with trees in front. The style is typical of a Scandinavian country estate. Printed caption text appears along the lower border.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand historic street in Cluj, showing a long neoclassical building with ornate façades, arched windows and Corinthian columns. To the left stands a church tower with a baroque onion dome and clock. Trees line the sidewalk and early‑ to mid‑20th‑century cars are visible on the road. The caption "CLUJ — Vedere" appears in the upper left corner.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a ruined stone city gate with an arched entrance in a defensive wall. The structure is partially collapsed, with vegetation growing on the masonry. A dirt road passes through the arch, where several people and a cart or carriage are visible in the distance. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Constantinople. Edirné Capou" along with additional text in Arabic/Ottoman script. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a street scene lined with ornate wooden and brick buildings, likely shops and houses, with pedestrians walking along a wide unpaved or lightly paved road. A church spire is visible in the background to the left. The lower margin of the card contains printed captions.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. A road lined with trees runs along the bottom of the hill. The castle has long, sloped tiled roofs and several wings extending along the ridge. Printed captions in German appear in the lower margin, naming the location and the castle.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a tree-framed view of a historic building with a tall tower and stepped gables, set in a lush garden or park. The structure resembles a small castle or manor house. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "Berg en Dal de Wijchert".

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road with tram tracks, lined by tall brick and stone buildings. On the left are many statues mounted on the facade of a large historic building; on the right are shopfronts with awnings. Numerous pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and cyclists move along the street. In the distance stands a prominent historic tower and building complex in the town square. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Korte Burchtstraat."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal harbor lined with wooden houses and boathouses on rocky shores. Several sailboats and small fishing boats are moored along both sides of the narrow inlet, while a small rowboat with two people is in the foreground on calm water. In the background, a church with a tower rises above the village. The word "GRUNDSUND." is printed in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 2102 appears in the lower right.

Album page containing four black‑and‑white picture postcards mounted on cream paper. The cards show views of the town of Mikkeli (S:t Michel) and surroundings: a street with large public buildings labeled "Guvernörshuset"; a panoramic view with a large church labeled "Prst. ja Vaplan Kirkko"; an elevated view over a riverside townscape; and a riverside bridge or pier scene labeled "Porrassalmi". Each postcard has printed captions in Finnish/Swedish and red type "Mikkeli – S:t Michel" plus handwritten German notes and dates from 1899–1902. At the bottom of the album page is a handwritten German title describing Eastern Finland and St. Michel dated March 1902.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a pastoral scene with a large tree-lined meadow, a horse grazing in the distance, and several people (adults and children) walking or standing in the field. On the right is a small white cottage with a thatched roof at the edge of a wooded area. A narrow path curves from the foreground toward the cottage. The caption in Dutch is printed below the image within a white border.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large historic manor-like building with steep gabled roofs and many shuttered windows, covered partly in ivy, standing on a high stone embankment beside a calm river. The building and surrounding trees are clearly reflected in the water. The caption at the top reads "Schloss Trebsen a. Mulde."

A monochrome postcard showing a rural industrial or railway settlement in a forested, hilly landscape. Several low wooden and brick buildings, rail tracks, and what appear to be loaded freight cars are visible. The scene is printed in an old photographic style, with a large blank space at the bottom where the caption and photographer's credit are printed.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a slightly sloping main street lined with two‑storey wooden and masonry buildings. Several pedestrians walk along the road, and there are business signs on the façades. At the top center of the image is the printed caption "Storgatan, Vilhelmina". On the right, a larger building bears the painted sign "VILHELMINA KOO…". A hand‑written style code "Js. 58‑2." appears in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing several sailing vessels moored along a quay. A person with a bag over their shoulder walks on the waterfront in the foreground. In the distance, part of a city waterfront is visible. Printed captions in French and English at the bottom describe the scene and identify it as Salonique/Salonica, with vessels near the quay and the White Tower.

Sepia-toned image of an ornate, historic horse-drawn ceremonial carriage or hearse displayed indoors. The carriage has large wooden-and-metal wheels, highly detailed carved panels featuring heraldic or mythological figures, and a canopy with draped curtains and finials. It stands in a hall with trophy antlers mounted on the walls and arched windows in the background, suggesting a castle or hunting lodge interior. No printed caption or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a busy wooden quay or pier with many men in early‑20th‑century clothing, some in uniform, walking in a line toward or from a gangway. In the background there is a rail yard with freight cars and a passenger coach, and low wooden town buildings behind the tracks. Handwritten text at the top identifies the scene and date, and a catalog number is written at the bottom.

Vintage propaganda-style postcard showing a young man in a suit holding a staff with the Latvian red‑white‑red flag, with multiple Latvian flags waving behind him. He raises his right arm in a salute. In the background are industrial scenes with cranes, smokestacks and arched bridges. At the bottom, bold text in Latvian highlights the date "15 MAIJS" and a slogan.

A sepia-toned street scene in an older European town. On the left are multi‑story masonry buildings with simple facades and street lamps; two people stand on the sidewalk. On the right are low, weathered wooden houses or sheds with pitched roofs and a large leafy tree behind them. A narrow paved road runs through the middle with a small car parked further down the street. The overall look suggests an older residential district captured in a vintage photograph.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate hotel complex with arcaded façades and corner towers around a landscaped circular plaza with trees, lamp posts, and early 20th‑century automobiles. A central tower with a domed top rises above the building. Postal markings and cancellation are visible at the top right, and a handwritten caption appears along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white view of a wooden railway station building surrounded by trees. The two‑storey station has dark wooden upper walls, a lighter masonry ground floor, and a tiled, multi‑gabled roof. A sign above the entrance reads "HÖRKEN". Railway tracks and platforms run across the foreground, with overhead electric lines and a pole visible. Printed caption text appears along the lower edge of the image.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a horse‑drawn stagecoach loaded with passengers in front of rustic wooden buildings and palm trees, set against a mountainous backdrop. The coach side reads "MATILIJA HOT SPRINGS" and the lower margin of the postcard states "Matilija Hot Springs, Cal." Vertical text on the left says it was printed in Germany and hand colored, and on the right credits publisher M. Rieder of Los Angeles, California. A red number "5670" is printed in the lower right corner.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Gothic church with tall pointed windows and a slender spire rising above a cobblestone street. Trees line the side of the church, and a horse-drawn carriage stands on the street corner. The lower margin has printed captions in German identifying the place and the publisher.

A black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone town square with a circular fountain in the foreground and several 2–3 story historic buildings with gabled roofs in the background. Shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including an inn, a fish hall, a bakery, and a tannery. A horse‑drawn carriage stands at the left, and a single child or small figure is walking near the center of the square.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a small rural railway station with a wooden station building in the foreground, a picket fence and railway tracks, and a few people standing on the platform. Modest wooden houses and trees are visible in the background. The caption at the top reads "Ilseng Jernbanestation." and the sign on the station building reads "ILSENG".

Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled town square with a large historic building in the center, featuring a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, a small central clock above a balcony, and a tower with a weather vane. Signs on the façade read "Stadt‑Sparkasse" and "Rathskeller," indicating a city savings bank and town hall cellar/restaurant. Several people and dogs stand in the square, with period streetlamps and additional multi‑story townhouses lining the far side of the square, one bearing the sign "A. Gentzsch." The architecture and signage suggest a small German town in the early 20th century.

Black-and-white view over a coastal village nestled among rocky hills. Dozens of wooden houses with steep roofs are scattered across the landscape, with a white church standing on a slight rise in the background. Vegetation and small gardens fill the spaces between homes. At the bottom left, the caption 'BOVALLSTRAND.' is printed, and at the bottom right there is a small triangular logo with the number 4099.

Black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a busy riverside or harbor scene in winterless weather. A truck loaded high with parcels and mail sacks stands on a wooden quay while men in uniforms and bowler hats load and throw packages. To the left is a passenger boat flying a Scandinavian-style flag, with seated passengers. In the distant background across the water stands a prominent church with a dome and tower surrounded by trees. Handwritten text runs along the top border of the card.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing two lines of German soldiers in dress uniform standing opposite each other with rifles, apparently during a changing of the guard ceremony in a brick-built barracks courtyard. An officer and a drummer are visible to the left, with other officers in the background near an iron gate and a striped guard post. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an ornate museum interior with gothic architectural elements and sculpted tombs surrounded by railings. The room is richly decorated with reliefs, statues, and wall paintings. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the guard room in the museum at Dijon, containing the tombs of the Dukes of Burgundy.

A black-and-white postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with columns and a drum-shaped dome on a small hill, with people walking along paths in front of it. To the right is the entrance to a metro station with large letters on the roof spelling out "МЕТРО" and people entering and exiting. The style and clothing suggest a mid‑20th‑century Soviet urban scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style view of a European town with a shallow river in the foreground, crossed by a simple metal truss footbridge. Along the right bank stands a row of late‑19th‑century townhouses and small apartment buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the background, on a rocky hill above the town, rises a large hilltop fortress with a long, curved main building and a tall tower crowned by a statue or figure. A few pedestrians walk along the riverside promenade. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an ancient Roman theater in ruins. Stone seating rises in semicircular tiers around a central orchestra, with fragments of columns and walls in the foreground. The landscape stretches out in the distance. A printed caption in French appears at the bottom margin, identifying the site as the Roman ruins of Timgad and specifying the theater.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned square lined with traditional timber‑framed houses. Trees stand in front of the buildings, and the architecture is distinctly central‑European, with steep tiled roofs and many small windows. At the bottom, printed in red Gothic‑style type, is a caption identifying the view and location.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic building with Gothic-style arched windows and a long balcony with ornate balustrades, partly covered by climbing vegetation casting shadows on the facade. Two people stand on the balcony. At the bottom margin there is printed text identifying the view as a specific palace in Hvar.

A vintage Swiss postal stationery card with a printed red 10-centime Swiss stamp at left and multilingual heading 'Carte postale.' with references to the Universal Postal Union in French, German, and Italian. The card is addressed in black ink in Russian to St. Petersburg, Russia. There are several postal cancellations, including circular date stamps from Montreux and Caux/Les Planches, as well as a blue circular Russian arrival postmark. A purple vertical handstamp at the right reads 'Hotel-Pension Vautier MONTREUX (Suisse)'.

An old postal card printed in Russian. At the top center in red it says "ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА" with the Imperial Russian double‑headed eagle coat of arms on the left. On the upper right is a red postage stamp with the same imperial emblem, canceled with circular black postmarks dated 25.6.16. The rest of the card contains handwritten address text in Russian cursive ink.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a Gothic chapel built of stone with a steep tiled roof and pointed arched windows. On one side there is an elevated balcony or oriel with sculpted figures, and a stairway leads up to a doorway. The scene looks like an inner courtyard. Printed captions at the bottom identify the place and publisher.

Black-and-white postcard view of a semi-rural street lined with early 20th‑century villas and houses behind fences and gardens. In the foreground is a grassy field. On the left is a large house with a small cross on the roof, and to the right are additional gabled houses, one with a small tower-like corner structure. The scene is calm and residential. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the street name.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hillside covered in terraced vineyards with scattered trees and small paths. At the foot of the hill stand several early‑20th‑century villa-style houses with gardens and fences. On the hilltop to the right there is a larger building or small castle-like structure flying a flag. The caption at the bottom left, printed in red, identifies the location as Kötzschenbroda–Niederlößnitz, and a publisher line appears beneath it.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a ceremonial gathering of Eastern Orthodox clergy. A central patriarch in ornate vestments and a large crown stands surrounded by bishops and priests in richly decorated robes and tall black hats. In front of them are several large, elaborately decorated metal vessels, likely liturgical urns or ewers, flanked by palm or laurel branches. The setting appears to be in front of a church entrance. Printed caption text runs along the bottom in French, and there is cursive handwriting over the lower margin.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a tree-lined path running beside a calm body of water in a landscaped park. A wooden bench sits on the left side of the path, while on the right, across the water, stands a tall commemorative column with a statue or sculptural group on top, its reflection visible in the water. There are no visible inscriptions or captions on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm river with a sandy bank in the foreground and wooded hills with scattered houses in the background. At the bottom right, caption text in a serif script identifies the scene. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century landscape photograph.

Black-and-white illustrated postcard showing the interior of a rustic, wood‑paneled farmhouse room with shelves holding jugs, plates, and decorative items, a bench, and potted plants. Beneath the illustration is a block of stylized German text inviting people to view the newly built farmer's room at an address on Münsterplatz, followed by a note about a permanent folk‑art exhibition and a small artist signature.

Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a calm river winding through a rural valley with tree‑lined banks and open meadows, low wooded hills in the background, and a few ducks at the water's edge in the foreground. At the top in red Gothic-style script it reads "Waldenburg i. Sa." on the left and "Blick ins Muldental." on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a lakeside rural landscape with farm buildings and several large villas or hotels in the foreground. A broad lake stretches across the middle, backed by forested hills and low mountains in the distance. At the top left area of the image there is a printed caption in German.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses with stucco facades and mansard roofs. Trees line the sidewalk, which is busy with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, including men in suits and hats and women in long dresses. Fenced front gardens and a few shopfronts occupy the ground floors. Large painted signs in German are visible on the facades.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large institutional complex in the countryside, with expansive fields in the foreground and several long multi‑storey buildings with a central chapel-like structure and surrounding staff houses in the background. Caption text in German appears below the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rocky artificial grotto with a small waterfall and dense foliage in a park. In the foreground, three men sit in a rowboat on a pond in front of the grotto. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and the publisher.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a low, elongated building set behind a grassy field and framed by several trees in the foreground. The structure has a tiled gabled roof with small dormer windows and many rectangular windows on two stories. On the long façade a large sign reads "Konzert‑Balletablissement." On the gable end another sign indicates an inn or guesthouse (beginning with "Gasthof…"). In the background at right, partly hidden by trees, there is a taller, more ornate building or small tower. The scene suggests a semi‑rural edge of town with open meadow in front of an entertainment or dance hall complex.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet European village canal or small river. On the left stands a plastered two‑ or three‑storey house with shuttered windows and a steep tiled roof. Trees and ivy grow along the bank and beside a dirt path that runs alongside the water. In the background, a small arched stone or brick bridge with railings crosses the canal, leading toward more gabled houses. A tall conifer tree stands on the right side, and the still water reflects the buildings and trees, giving a calm rural impression. Some faint signage is visible on the facade of a house beyond the bridge.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park or garden with large trees, a curving path, and planted flowerbeds or shrubs. The scene looks quiet and well‑kept, suggesting a public garden or manor park. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center of the image.

Vintage illustrated postcard with two main vignette images framed by small green leafy branches. The left vignette shows a tall lighthouse tower labeled in French, standing by the sea with surrounding low buildings. The right vignette depicts a busy seafront promenade with colonial-style buildings, people walking, a horse‑drawn carriage, and a monument with a statue in the foreground, with ships and smoke in the harbor background. Printed captions mention Port Said and Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee, with handwritten messages over part of the card and a watermark from the website elia.org.gr.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with historic multi‑story townhouses in a European city. The façades feature arched windows, ornamental cornices, and some neo‑Gothic or neo‑Renaissance details. Parked 1960s–1970s style cars appear in the foreground and mid‑ground; a few pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. One corner building has a small projecting bay and ornate reliefs. The scene is calm and appears to be from a historic inner‑city street.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree‑lined avenue with elegant multi‑storey residential buildings on the left and right, distant hills in the background, and a horse‑drawn carriage on an unpaved road. The left side contains the photograph, while the right side and lower margin are filled with dense handwritten text. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene and location.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European valley town surrounded by low wooded hills and patchwork fields. In the foreground are steep‑roofed houses typical of Central Europe, with a mixture of farm buildings and villas. In the middle distance an industrial complex with tall chimneys emits smoke next to a railway line and small station or freight yard with several sidings. Further back the town spreads along the valley floor, with scattered church towers and farmsteads on the opposite slope. No visible printed caption or border text appears on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad European boulevard with tram tracks, horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, and multi‑story buildings along both sides. A clock‑towered building dominates the left foreground, while a large monument or fountain stands on the right in the middle of the square. The image caption in red script at the bottom reads "Dresden-N. Hauptstrasse." Additional small printing appears along the lower left edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, powerful waterfall with industrial buildings and tall smokestacks on the riverbank. The water fills most of the foreground, crashing over the falls, while trees and factory structures line the horizon. Cyrillic text appears in the lower right corner, and a small number "91." is printed near the bottom left.

An old sepia-toned postcard view taken from the water looking toward a low shoreline with several simple rectangular buildings and trees behind a beach. The sea occupies the foreground, slightly choppy, while the horizon shows a small coastal settlement. In the lower right corner there is decorative cursive writing.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a small Russian Orthodox church with a large onion dome topped by a Russian Orthodox cross. The façade has ornate arches and columns framing the main doorway, above which is an icon painting of religious figures set in a curved niche. The building is enclosed by a low fence along a quiet street with early 20th‑century style lampposts. Hills or wooded slopes are visible in the background.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a European city with a river running through the center, lined with trees and multi‑story buildings on both banks. Several bridges cross the river. On the left shore a building shows the sign "HOTEL FLORIAN". On the right side, a hill rises with a fortification or castle-like complex and a tower on top, overlooking the city. Mountains are visible in the distant background. The top left corner has the printed word "Graz".

Black‑and‑white street view of a small town with wooden houses on both sides of an unpaved road. There is a telegraph pole with multiple cross‑arms in the foreground, and several people standing near the buildings. At the top of the image is printed text reading "Parti fra Løiten".

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a lakeside town with a railway station and rail yard in the foreground. Several tracks curve past low station buildings and freight cars, with larger residential houses and trees in front. In the distance is a wide body of water and a low shoreline. Printed text at the top reads the town name and identifies the railway station and yard in Swedish.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European town street. In the foreground is a wide, mostly empty road lined with young trees, simple fences, and a gas streetlamp. On the right are timber‑framed houses with steep roofs; two women in long dark dresses and head coverings stand on the sidewalk by a fence. In the middle distance are more small houses and gardens. Dominating the background is a large Gothic or late‑Gothic church with a high nave roof, buttresses, and a tall tower topped by an onion‑shaped spire. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century small town. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bustling European street scene with multi‑story historic buildings lining both sides, pedestrians in late‑19th‑century dress, horse‑drawn carts, and a church tower visible in the background. Decorative script in German at the bottom reads a greeting from Graz, Styria, and the central caption labels the view as the Murplatz.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural riverside landscape surrounded by forested hills. In the foreground are scattered farm buildings and fenced fields. Near the center stands a white church with a tall, slender spire. Across the river are more fields and wooded slopes. Printed Norwegian captions appear at the bottom, with additional handwritten greetings in cursive.

Black‑and‑white view along a bridge beside a lake or wide river. A few pedestrians walk on the roadway, which is lined on the right by slender birch trees; railings run along both sides of the bridge. Low hills and a town with scattered buildings appear in the distance. At the bottom edge there is small printed caption text and a handwritten‑style signature in the lower right, typical of vintage postcards.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard-style photograph showing a large group of villagers—men, women, and many children—posed in front of a country house covered in dense ivy. The adults wear flat caps, vests, and work clothes; the children are in dresses, pinafores, and short trousers typical of early 20th‑century rural Europe. A simple wooden picket fence runs along the right side, and hilly countryside is faintly visible in the background. The image is bordered by a thick white frame and pinned at the corners, suggesting it is a reproduced photograph. There is some faint, barely legible script along the bottom edge, but it cannot be clearly read.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a tram on a broad, tree‑lined avenue flanked by multi‑storey buildings. A church dome or bell tower is visible in the distance. The layout and typography, plus multilingual captions at the bottom, indicate this is an old postcard view of a street in Athens, Greece.

Colorized historic street view showing a fenced Gothic-style monument with statues in a small square at a street intersection. Surrounding it are multi‑story European buildings with green roofs and dormer windows. The sky is tinted blue and peach in typical early color postcard style. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Freiberg in Saxony and names the monument and street (Schwedendenkmal and Peterstrasse).

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic city gate complex with a crenellated stone tower, adjoining half‑timbered and tiled‑roof buildings, and a rounded gatehouse structure with an arched entrance. Trees frame the scene in the foreground and background. In the upper left corner printed in red Gothic‑style lettering is the caption identifying the place as Naumburg on the Saale and the specific gate as Marientor.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a two‑storey inn or guesthouse with arched windows and a hipped roof, set along a tree‑lined road. An early automobile is parked in front and a person with a bicycle stands by the wall. The building bears signage above the entrance, and handwritten script at the bottom identifies the place as a guesthouse named Alt‑Kella near a location called Nößten (or Nossen). The setting appears rural or small‑town and the image has an early‑20th‑century look.

A black‑and‑white aerial view over a vast, forested hilly landscape with lakes in the distance. On a rocky hilltop stands a large multi‑storey building complex, likely a hotel or lodge, with a flag flying from a flagpole. The scene is surrounded by dense coniferous forest. In the lower left corner the printed caption reads "KOLI 964". The image has a white border typical of vintage photographic postcards.

A monochrome view down a wide, straight boulevard lined with ornate late‑19th‑century apartment and civic buildings in a Central or Eastern European style. The façades have heavy stone rustication, arched windows, iron balconies, and corner turrets with decorative domes. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and a few small carts or carriages appear on the street. Low hills or mountains are faintly visible at the far end of the avenue. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large stone building with a steep gabled roof. In front of it stands a very large group of children and adults posed for the camera, suggesting a colony or camp. The caption at the bottom is in Italian and mentions the alpine and marine colonies 'Regina Margherita' of the municipality of Trento.

A black-and-white vintage street scene showing a broad urban street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops on both sides. People are walking and cycling along the road, and several early 20th‑century vehicles are visible in the distance. A tall church spire rises in the background, and on the right side of the image a prominent tower with patterned brickwork can be seen. At the bottom right, caption text reads "NIJMEGEN. MOLENSTRAAT" indicating the location.

Color image of a traditional European windmill standing on a grassy rise beside a paved country road, with trees around it and a clear blue sky. The mill has a dark, tapering body, a white gallery/balcony encircling it, and large lattice sails. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large, ornate multi-story historic building with mansard roof and decorative window surrounds, set in a landscaped garden with trees and shrubs in the foreground. The image has a white scalloped border typical of vintage postcards. At the bottom is a German caption naming the building and its location.

Black‑and‑white harbor scene showing a cargo ship named "THIESSOW" moored beside a large quay crane and grain-silo complex. The ship bears the home port name "ROSTOCK" on the stern area. Industrial port facilities with conveyors and tall storage silos rise behind the crane.

Colorized vintage view along a river lined with multi‑story European buildings on both banks. In the background rises a steep, green hill crowned with fortifications and a prominent clock tower. Multiple bridges cross the river. The caption printed in red at the top right reads "Graz. Mur, Schloßberg."

Sepia-toned rural landscape showing a line of conical haystacks on a gently sloping field, with a forested valley and wide sky with clouds in the background. The bottom border carries printed text in Latvian and a small publisher's mark on the right.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural farming landscape with scattered wooden houses, barns, fields, and surrounding forested hills. The view looks over a valley dotted with small farms and tree-lined roads. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text with a number and place name, and in the lower right corner appears the photographer/publisher logo 'Widerøe'.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town railway station set in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are several tracks with freight wagons and open cars loaded with goods. The main station building prominently displays the word "GLASHÜTTE" on its gable. Around the station are warehouses with large painted advertisements, and multi‑storey townhouses and factories with smoking chimneys behind them. Tree‑covered hills rise in the background, giving the scene a typical Central European valley‑town appearance.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestone street with a small fenced garden in the foreground. On the right stands a large three‑story neoclassical building with arched windows and a formal façade, likely a school or administrative building, fronted by trees and low fencing. On the left are several lower houses and, further down the street, a more ornate multi‑towered structure. People in early‑20th‑century dress walk along the street, and there are tall gas or early electric streetlamps. The scene is calm and urban, suggesting a European city boulevard.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside bathing area. In the foreground are reeds growing in shallow water. Farther out many people are wading and bathing in the lake. On the right stands a long wooden bathhouse or pavilion on stilts over the water. The top margin is mostly blank with printed text in red that names the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a gently sloping hillside landscape with paths zig‑zagging up the hill, scattered trees, and a small stone building in the foreground. At the top of the hill there appears to be a small lookout or structure among trees. Printed in red Gothic-style script at the top are the words identifying the place and viewpoint.

Black‑and‑white view over a small European village in a hilly, forested valley. In the foreground are half‑timbered houses and farm plots; at right stands a pointed‑tower church with Gothic‑revival elements. On a hill in the background is a ruined square tower or keep, likely part of a medieval castle. The scene is rural, with winding paths, scattered trees, and wooded hills surrounding the settlement. Faint, reversed handwriting appears along the upper edge.

Black‑and‑white view of a hillside covered with trees, with a large villa in the foreground and a stone church with two tall, slender spires rising behind it. The villa has a steep tiled roof with dormer, half‑timbered gable, and balcony, characteristic of Central European architecture. The twin‑towered church has simple lancet windows and steep spires topped with finials. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand multi‑story hotel building labeled "HOTEL DE SAXE" in a spa town setting. In front of the hotel are trees, small pavilion tents, a decorative fenced terrace, and a richly ornamented half‑timbered structure.
