People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and stand along the street in the foreground. Printed captions identify the location and publisher/date.

Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) postcard view of a large, tree‑lined square or park with formal paths in the foreground and a long row of ornate multi‑story residential buildings with towers and decorative roofs in the background. At the top of the image, printed in red, are the words identifying the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a wooden fence in the foreground, trees and open field, and a large church building with a central dome and cross in the middle right. To the left stands a separate bell tower topped with a cross. At the top of the card there is a printed caption in a decorative font.

Black‑and‑white seaside view showing a sandy beach with dunes, a long wooden pier stretching into the water, and wooded hills in the background. On the right stand ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century resort villas among trees. In the foreground a man with a walking stick and a woman in long skirt and hat stroll along a sandy path. A signpost stands near the dunes with German text on it.

Colorized historic postcard showing a tall rectangular stone clock tower with multiple stories and arched windows. A clock face is visible near the top and several flags fly from the roof. At the base of the tower, a crowd of people is gathered. The sky is tinted pink and blue. Multilingual captions (French, Ottoman Turkish, and German) are printed at the top, and a small logo or URL appears near the bottom.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a crowded street procession in Bruges. Spectators in early 20th‑century dress line both sides of a cobbled street, while costumed riders on horses form a ceremonial parade. Medieval‑style buildings frame the scene. Printed captions in French at the bottom identify the event as the 'Cortège du Pas de l'Arbre d'or 1468' taking place in July 1907 and credit the publisher/photographer.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a group of men and women in traditional European folk costumes dancing in a circle on an outdoor wooden platform. The men wear knee-breeches, vests, long socks and boots; the women wear long dark skirts, aprons, blouses, and distinctive peaked or white caps. In the background, a large audience sits or stands among trees, and a flag on a tall pole is visible. The scene looks like a folk dance performance or festival.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of rock walls covered with historic carved inscriptions and a crown motif, partly framed by tree branches. At the lower left is a printed caption identifying the site as "TROLLHÄTTAN Kungsgrottan," and a small serial number appears at the lower right.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing exterior and interior scenes of a historic castle complex. The upper row presents three different views of a stone castle with towers, gables and steep roofs, surrounded by trees and forested hills. The lower row shows two interior rooms furnished as a dining hall and lounge, with wooden ceilings, tables, chairs and armchairs. In the center is a black panel with German text identifying the place as Schloss Reinsberg and mentioning a holiday home of the VEB Kombinat Schwarze Pumpe.

Black‑and‑white panoramic photograph of a small rural town surrounded by fields and gentle hills. In the foreground there are trees and a simple wooden fence running along a slope; behind them stand detached wooden and brick houses with gabled roofs, barns and farm buildings. The settlement stretches into the distance with farmland and scattered houses on the horizon. In the lower right corner, handwritten text identifies the view as "Sabile …" followed by a number, suggesting a numbered postcard in a series.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Gothic-style town church with tall pointed windows, steeply pitched roof, and a small spire at the front. At the rear right are two baroque-style tower structures. Trees and a few surrounding buildings are visible in the foreground. The printed captions at the top read "Pegau." on the left and "Stadtkirche." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard featuring a photograph of a marble seated statue of Lord Byron on a pedestal, surrounded by lush vegetation and cactus plants. Below the image there are printed captions in Greek and French identifying the location and subject, along with a circular seal and a handwritten signature or note.

A black‑and‑white, likely early 20th‑century postcard-style photograph showing a large Gothic and Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The church has one massive Gothic tower at the west end, a long nave with flying buttresses and pointed windows, and a Romanesque‑looking east end with two large rose windows and round‑arched details. Smaller towers and surrounding multi‑story European townhouses frame the scene, with a tree‑lined open space in the foreground. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground and middle ground are tightly packed houses with steep gabled and hipped roofs, dormer windows, and plastered facades typical of Central European architecture. Near the center-right stands a church with a baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome. Behind the town, wooded hills and a patchwork of fields extend into the distance, with a large villa on a hill to the left and what appears to be a small castle or ruin on a distant ridge. The image has the framing and quality of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long wooden school building with many windows, a steep roof and a central tower or belfry. The architecture is typical of late 19th–early 20th century Nordic wooden public buildings. Printed text at the top names the town and the school in Swedish and Finnish, and a vertical caption on the left gives the publisher.

Color photograph of a large Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The church has pale stone walls, a tall octagonal dome-tower topped with a cross, an ornate façade with a large rose window, and an attached porch with arches and columns. Adjacent buildings have medieval stonework and crenellations. Several 1960s–1970s European cars are parked in the open square in front. Mountains rise in the background under a clear blue sky.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a European town with church spires and traditional buildings in the lower half, and, in a whimsical photomontage, a woman in early 20th‑century dress floating above the town holding an umbrella and a handbag. The caption at the bottom is printed in red German text, along with a publisher line and date.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large 19th‑century military barracks complex behind a railway embankment and bridge, with flowering trees and greenery in the foreground. The sky is bright blue with stylized clouds. Red printed German captions at the top identify the location and the specific barracks of a Royal Saxon infantry regiment.

A simple beige postcard-style card with elegant black cursive text in Estonian, conveying Christmas and New Year's greetings from the chocolate factory "Progress." At the bottom it lists an address on Narva Road in Tallinn.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a market square and adjoining street in a European town. The scene shows historic multi‑story buildings with gabled roofs and decorative facades. In the center-right stands a building labeled "Hôtel Goldener Löwe," with horse‑drawn carriages and people in early 20th‑century clothing in front. On the left side is a row of shops, one with an awning and a bicycle leaning against the curb. The caption at the top reads "Wurzen. Am Markt." indicating that this is the market area of Wurzen.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a narrow street with groups of people standing and walking. At the center stands an ornate neo‑Gothic structure with pointed arches and pinnacles, built into a raised terrace and staircase. Historic buildings and a gatehouse line the street on the left, with trees on the right. At the bottom margin, printed red text reads the city name and a description of the place, with a handwritten signature below.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a countryside inn called "Gasthof zum Erbgericht" with a long, low building and an attached larger house, set on a dirt road with a few trees and distant hills. Several small groups of people stand or walk near the building and along the slope behind it. Printed red and black German text appears at the bottom and on the facade of the inn.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an inner courtyard with arched colonnades and latticework in an Islamic architectural style. A central fountain stands in the middle of the open courtyard. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a courtyard of the Bahia Palace in Marrakech, and a small credit reads "Photo Flandrin."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside village scene with houses, trees, and a wooded hill. On the hill are visible stone walls and remnants of a ruin. In the foreground, a calm river flows with a rocky bank; two figures stand on a small landing or raft by the water. Printed German text labels the view and there is a red handwritten number at the top.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with a tall central tower and a portico supported by large columns. People walk on a cobblestone street in the foreground, and leafless trees frame the scene. The printed captions at the bottom read "LATVIJA", "Gimnazija" and "JELGAVA".

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped public square with circular flowerbeds and a small palm at the center, surrounded by a low fence and large trees. In the background stands an ornate red-and-white multi‑story building with balconies and striped awnings. The sky is lightly tinted and there are printed captions at the top of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the archaeological site of Olympia with scattered columns and ruins in the foreground and low hills in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the view as the palaestra with the museum at Olympia. There is also small printed publishing information in Greek and French at the bottom margin.

Illustrated sepia-toned postcard showing a detailed drawing of a large historic castle with multiple steeply pitched roofs and towers rising above dense trees. At the bottom is printed German text identifying the site, with space left blank for a message, and a small artist's signature on the right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a historic Moorish-style hall with intricate stucco and tilework, scalloped arches, and high walls. A small figure stands near a doorway in the ornate space. The lower margin carries a printed Spanish caption identifying the view as a general view of the Capilla de la Masura in Córdoba.

A black‑and‑white image bordered like an old photographic postcard shows a long, straight sidewalk lined with large trees and dense shrubs. On the left is a low wall with metal fencing and lush plantings; on the right young trees are staked beside the walk and a wide, mostly empty street runs parallel. In the distance there are a few detached houses or mansions. The lower border includes some faint, handwritten numbers or letters that appear reversed, as if the image is from a negative.

A black-and-white postcard showing a large modernist multi‑storey institutional building with rows of identical rectangular windows. In the foreground is a sloped dirt area, a stone retaining wall with stairs, and a low entrance structure supported by concrete pillars. There are a couple of bicycles near the entrance. Printed white text appears at the bottom identifying the location and photo credit in Swedish.

Black-and-white vintage image showing a horse-drawn wagon on a dirt road, with at least three horses and two men in suits and hats standing beside them. The large covered wagon bears painted commercial text in Dutch advertising a steam washing and ironing establishment, including a company name that appears to be 'Firma B. Jansen'. The background is a wooded or rural area.

Vintage sepia postcard featuring a formal studio portrait of an elegantly dressed royal woman wearing a tiara and jewelry, centered on a plain background. Greek text appears at the lower left identifying her, and French text at the lower right describes her as Madame la Princesse Nicolas de Grèce. A circular emblem or stamp is printed at the bottom left, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible at the bottom.

A vintage illustrated winter scene showing a young couple ice skating. The woman wears a long pink skirt, light-colored jacket, fur stole, and small hat, while the man in a greenish suit and hat leans in affectionately toward her. Other skaters are visible in the snowy background with bare trees. Handwritten cursive text appears along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a street scene with traditional multi-storey houses and a prominent minaret rising in the background. The caption at the bottom, in French, identifies the scene as a street in the upper town of Salonique (Thessaloniki). The layout and style are typical of early 20th‑century picture postcards.

Black‑and‑white image showing a grassy field with several children or youths standing apart, possibly playing. In the background on the right is a medium‑sized Gothic‑revival church with pointed-arch windows, steep tiled roof, and a slender spire topped by a cross. To the left are a few multi‑story residential or civic buildings with simple 19th‑century Central European architecture, plus lower farm-like or school buildings with hipped roofs. The scene suggests a small European town or village; there is no visible printed text on the front.

Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy bridge and street scene with a prominent church tower featuring an onion-shaped dome. Pedestrians and a tram marked with the number 68 cross a richly decorated iron bridge with ornate lampposts. Behind the bridge stand multi‑story buildings with shop signs in German. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene, and the publisher's imprint appears along the lower edge.

A hand-colored historic postcard showing a central street scene in a European town. Multi‑story 19th‑century buildings line both sides of a broad street, with shop signs on the façades. On the left is an inn or guesthouse labeled "Gasthof zum Amthof" and "Restaurant"; on the right corner building a shop sign reads "Eisenwaren" (hardware). In the distance is a domed tower. The lower margin contains printed captions and publisher information in German, indicating the town name and street, as well as the publisher and date.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tree-lined dirt path running alongside a body of water, probably a lake or river. Bare or lightly-leaved trees arch over the path, with calm water visible through the trunks. Printed text in a serif font appears on the image itself, including a location reference in a Scandinavian language.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view showing a busy harbor with several steamships and smaller boats docked along a quay. Crates and goods are stacked on the pier, with people walking and working. Across the water stands a large, ornate palace-like building and a dense row of multi‑story historic buildings behind it. The scene is urban and clearly northern European. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location in Swedish.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of Athens with the Acropolis hill and the Parthenon prominently visible on the right, overlooking the surrounding city. Greek and French captions are printed below the image, along with a publisher's note and website watermark.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large lattice steel arch bridge with massive stone towers crossing a wide river. Below the bridge runs a railway line with several freight cars in the foreground. On the river a paddle steamer with passengers is visible. The caption "Riesa. Elbbrücke." appears printed at the top left.

Colorized vintage view of a red wooden church with steep gabled roofs and a separate tall bell tower, both surrounded by birch trees and low stone walls. A gently sloping road leads up to the church entrance from the foreground. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds, and there are no people or vehicles visible. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century hand‑tinted postcard.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a broad European street lined with ornate late-19th / early-20th-century apartment buildings. The main corner building has bay windows, balconies, and a small tower-like roof structure. People in long dresses and hats walk along the sidewalk. Printed titles at the top read "Meissen-R. Kaiserstrasse." and a publisher's line at the bottom reads "7251 Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1908". The word "Modes." (fashion) appears on the shopfront at the street level.

Sepia-toned historic coastal scene showing a small harbor with whitewashed buildings along the waterfront and hills behind. In the foreground, people stand and sit on a low wall near the shore, some with luggage and a pack animal. In the bay are two masted ships, one flying a Greek flag. Handwritten Greek text appears along the bottom edge, and a faint round emblem plus the website 'www.elia.org.gr' are visible.

Black‑and‑white night view of a richly decorated Baroque palace complex, illuminated against a dark sky. The long façade has tall arched windows and a balustrade lined with statues. At the center stands an ornate pavilion crowned by a large, onion‑shaped dome topped with a crown. In the foreground is a moat or canal crossed by a simple wooden bridge leading toward the palace wall.

Vintage sepia photographic postcard showing six costumed theatre actors posed in a studio setting. They wear early 20th‑century formal and theatrical outfits including top hats, feathered hats, gowns and coats. At the top left is the title 'Der Graf von Luxemburg' and 'Centraltheater.' At the top right is a German phrase. Along the bottom are the printed names of the actors, and in the lower right corner appears the photographer's imprint with place and year 'Dresden 1910.'

Black-and-white photograph of an ornate Catholic chapel interior showing the richly decorated altar that houses the relics of St. Peter Canisius. The scene includes a marble altar with lace cloth, tall candlesticks, vases of flowers, a central crucifix, and a large religious painting above depicting the Virgin Mary with child and saints, set within an arched niche. Decorative inscriptions frame the arch.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large Gothic and Gothic‑revival cathedral complex with twin ornate spires rising from a fortified hilltop ensemble of long, steep‑roofed buildings. The complex stands above a slope planted with what appear to be vineyards, and is surrounded by trees and smaller historic buildings. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small town surrounded by fields and low hills, seen from a rocky, wooded vantage point. In the foreground are pitched-roof houses among trees; beyond them stretches a compact settlement of wooden and masonry houses, barns, and a church or industrial buildings, with open countryside in the distance. The lower left corner bears printed caption text, and a small publisher's logo with a number appears in the lower right corner.

An illustrated view of a European old town square with cobblestone streets and gabled houses. The buildings have steep red-tiled roofs and light-colored facades, with some shopfronts at street level. In the background rises a tall, slender church spire in Baroque style. The perspective shows a quiet intersection of streets framed by historic merchant houses. There is a small signature of the artist at the bottom.

A monochrome seaside panorama showing a densely built coastal town with low-rise buildings and a few larger hotels or villas on the slopes, backed by mountains. Several boats are anchored in a calm harbor in the foreground. At the top in red Cyrillic text it identifies the location and view.

Historic-looking postcard depicting a 19th‑century town square with wooden buildings on both sides of an unpaved street. On the left is a tower with a clock and a distinctive spire, while people in period clothing stand and walk along the street. On the right side of the card, there is printed text in Finnish and Swedish describing the scene.

Vertically divided color postcard showing two views of the same large, ornate institutional building set behind fields and a fence. The architecture is late‑19th‑century European with white walls, red roof tiles, and decorative gables and pinnacles. The top image is a more distant view over ploughed fields, emphasizing the surrounding grounds and trees. The lower image is a closer street‑level view, showing a brick‑and‑iron fence, entrance gate, and a few small figures walking along the road in front of the main façade. No printed caption or legible text appears on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a forested landscape with dense conifer trees in the foreground, a small lake in the middle, and rocky, wooded hills in the background. At the top-left of the image, printed text reads "Ed. Högankas o. Tössbotjärn." The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century Scandinavian nature postcard.

An illustrated postcard showing a stylized landscape with sloping hills, scattered trees in autumnal colors, and a light-colored fortification or castle wall with an arched gate on a hill. At the top it is captioned in German, and there is a circular archive stamp and the year 1903 printed at the lower right.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a hillside town or city, photographed from a grassy field in the foreground. Dense clusters of early‑20th‑century houses and villas with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows cover the slope. Larger masonry buildings, including what appear to be churches with towers and a substantial institutional building, stand out among the residences. The upper hillside shows terraced or cultivated fields, patches of forest, and several isolated villas. Two tall structures rise on the ridge line: one resembles a mast or narrow tower, and another squat structure stands on a cleared terrace. A leafless tree frames the right side of the picture. There is no visible printed caption or back text, only the photographic scene itself.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with dense low‑rise buildings in the foreground and several prominent church towers and a large domed structure rising above the rooftops. In the distance, low hills form a gentle backdrop. The architecture suggests Central European styles, and the image is framed with a light border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.

A monochrome postcard view of a small town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground and mid‑ground are several two‑ to three‑story houses along a road, surrounded by trees and gardens. In the background, terraced fields rise up the hillsides. A prominent church or castle-like building with a tower stands on a wooded hill to the left, while another church spire is visible on the right. At the top of the image there is printed German text identifying the place and street.

A monochrome postcard view of an old mission-style building with thick stucco walls, buttress-like pillars, arched doorways, and an exterior stone stairway along the side. Trees stand beside the structure. The top margin contains a printed caption identifying the scene, and a red handwritten catalog number appears on the right.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small village at the base of a steep, flat‑topped rocky hill or mesa covered with pine trees. A church with a small tower and several large houses stand among trees in the middle ground. In the right foreground there is a large tree and what appears to be a pavilion or veranda of a villa. The scene looks rural and tranquil, typical of an early 20th‑century tourist or souvenir postcard. At the top right margin there is a handwritten notation, possibly an archival reference number.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a frontal view of an elaborately carved wooden double door or cabinet front. Each leaf is divided into three vertical panels with high‑relief figures in niches, likely Christian saints or apostles, framed by scroll and foliage motifs. The surrounding frame is richly decorated with Renaissance‑style vine and acanthus carving. The object stands on a tiled floor against a plain interior wall. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Monochrome postcard view of a small lake or pond with rowboats on the water and people strolling along a tree‑lined promenade. On the right stands a round or polygonal pavilion with many windows and a pointed roof. In the distance are more buildings partly hidden by trees. The scene has an old European park atmosphere. The caption at the bottom left reads "Graz. Hilmteich."

Colorized postcard view of a tree‑lined street with a long, classical-style barracks building behind a brick wall and iron fence. A tall red-brick tower with narrow vertical windows and a domed top rises prominently in the background. At the bottom in red text appear the words "Nijmegen" on the left and "Prins Hendrik Kazerne" on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural tree-lined road labeled "Mariatosterstrasse". On the left is part of a house with a tiled roof; on the right runs a fenced path bordered by tall conifer trees. In the distance, partially obscured by trees, stands a church-like building with a tower on a hill. The overall style suggests an early 20th-century European scene.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a cobblestone street with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background is a large multi‑storey building complex with a steep tiled roof and many chimneys, identified as a castle or palace. Trees and a low wall with gate pillars line the street. On the right edge stands a substantial building facade. The caption at the bottom reads in German, indicating the view is of Hofgasse street with the castle in Graz.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with wooden and stone houses. Many children and a few adults stand and walk along the street. In the distance rises a large church tower with a clock and dome. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as a street named Norra Kyrkogatan in Vänersborg.

An old monochrome postcard showing a large Renaissance-style building with a steep roof, dormer windows and an ornate central gable. A double exterior staircase leads up to a doorway above an arched entrance. People, including men in hats and children, stand in the open square in front. At the bottom and left of the card is printed and handwritten text in Dutch; the red printed title in the center reads "Waag, Nijmegen".

Old monochrome postcard depicting a cobblestone market street lined with low shops and houses. People in early 20th‑century Ottoman/Balkan dress walk and stand along the street, and a large tree arches over the roadway. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin in French, and a modern website watermark is visible near the lower center.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a massive old oak tree in a park-like setting. Two men in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit at the base of the tree, and paths with a wooden fence run behind it. The title in red German text at the bottom identifies the tree as the 'Körnereiche in Dallwitz bei Karlsbad.' A small framed sign or plaque is attached to the trunk.

Black‑and‑white landscape view showing a rural settlement in front of steep, rounded limestone hills. In the foreground are cultivated fields and dense banana or similar tropical plants with a thatched hut. Farther back stand several small houses, some with thatched roofs and some with tiled roofs, forming a village. Laundry or cloth hangs on a line at the right, and the dramatic rocky hills rise vertically behind the settlement. A small number "542" appears at the lower left margin and "03211.0001" at the lower right border.

Black‑and‑white view along a gently rising urban street lined with ornate, multi‑storey historicist apartment blocks or townhouses. The façades are richly decorated with pilasters, pediments, window surrounds and balconies, typical of late 19th‑century Central European architecture. A wrought‑iron fence and bare trees separate the sidewalk from the buildings. Gas‑style street lamps run along the curb. At the far right downhill, a few pedestrians walk, and commercial buildings are visible; one corner building bears a vertical sign. The image has wide white margins and the framing typical of an old photographic postcard.

A colorized panoramic view over a small European town with red‑roofed houses and several church towers rising above the rooftops. In the foreground there is a rocky, sandy slope and dense greenery; in the background flat countryside stretches to the horizon. The title text "Ostritz i. Sa." appears in the upper left corner, suggesting the scene is the town of Ostritz in Saxony.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a grand railway station with large arched glass train sheds and a central domed entrance building. The station stands on an elevated viaduct with arches, overlooking a broad open square where early 20th‑century trams and horse-drawn or early motor vehicles are visible. At the top left, the printed caption reads "Dresden — Hauptbahnhof."

Colorized vintage postcard view of a narrow canal cut through high rock walls, with a metal bridge spanning the top of the gorge. The waterway runs between steep cliffs, and the sky is clear blue. Printed captions in Greek and French/English at the bottom identify the scene as the Corinth Canal.

Black‑and‑white view of a large church with a tall, steep spire and a square tower standing on an open cobblestoned square lined with trees and low townhouses. People in early‑20th‑century clothing, including children, walk across the square; a horse‑drawn vehicle is visible in the background. The church has a massive brick tower with tall belfry openings and a decorative gabled clock stage near the top, attached to an older, lower nave with smaller Gothic-style windows. A few classic streetlamps and a kiosk or small pavilion stand near the church. The scene suggests a quiet European town center.

A black‑and‑white image showing a single railway mail coach standing at a station platform. The coach is marked with the words "KUNGL. POST" and a postal emblem, with trees and a faint building tower in the distant background. The photograph appears slightly aged and could be used as a historical railway postcard.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a green hilly valley with scattered farmhouses and village buildings. A river with a stone bridge curves through the foreground. In the mid‑ground there is a mill or factory complex with white buildings and a tall red smokestack, surrounded by trees. More houses are dispersed across the fields and forested hills in the distance. A cursive German caption is printed along the lower border.

Color postcard view of a hilltop complex with red-tiled roofs and a large Gothic church with twin spires, likely a cathedral, rising above surrounding historic buildings and a cylindrical tower. In the foreground, people walk across a small bridge or street with red‑and‑white railings and traffic signs, under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

A colorized postcard view of a European city along a turquoise river, with a bridge crossing the water and rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs on both banks. A steep hill rises behind the city, crowned by fortification walls and buildings, and to the right is a prominent clock tower on the hillside. Mountains are faintly visible in the background. The caption at the top is in German and identifies the scene as Graz with the Schlossberg and the Schöckl.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a town with several large, old buildings and a stone bridge crossing the river. The buildings resemble a historic castle or manor complex along the riverbank, with trees and gardens in the foreground and gentle hills in the background. Printed text in German appears at the top left.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an industrial landscape with several factory buildings and tall chimneys in a flat rural area. In the foreground are open fields; in the background an extensive complex of industrial works stretches across the horizon. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing and contains printed captions in German, including the locality name and publisher details.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a church with a prominent onion-shaped dome and a square bell tower in the foreground, surrounded by a metal fence along a street where a few people in traditional dress are walking. Printed multilingual captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Church of Saint Sophia in Salonica (north‑west view).

Black-and-white postcard showing an outdoor café terrace with many empty folding chairs and tables beside a calm river or lake. Several people sit at a few tables in the foreground, while others are boating in rowboats on the water. Dense forested hills surround the water. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in German indicating the location as Volkspark "Buschmühle", Niederau-Oberau.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, rectangular brick school building with a steep roof and gabled ends, in a fairly empty open area. There are a few people and horse-drawn vehicles in front of the building. The image is mounted on a beige card with handwritten French captions at the bottom: on the left, identifying the building as a boys' gymnasium (secondary school), and on the right, noting the city name.

A black‑and‑white interior view of a richly decorated Catholic church, showing rows of wooden pews leading toward an ornate altar with statues, paintings, and a domed apse. The vaulted ceiling and arches are covered with religious frescoes and medallions. Italian text is printed at the bottom describing the church and noting its restoration date.

Black‑and‑white view of a small wooden railway station building with two stories and decorative trim, set among trees. A sign on the facade reads "SAMVIK". Several people, including women and children, sit on a bench by the platform, while another child walks a bicycle near the entrance. Old‑style fuel pumps stand in front of the building. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century rural train station scene.

A black‑and‑white view of a village street with leafless trees in the foreground and a row of brick-and-plaster houses behind a wooden picket fence. Two bicycles lean against the fence near the left side. The central building has tall arched windows, decorative brickwork and signage above the doors, suggesting an inn or shop. Handwritten vertical numbers/letters appear along the right border, as on many early photographic postcards.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal lined with historic brick and stone buildings in Bruges. On the left is a tree‑lined quay with a few pedestrians, while on the right and in the distance stand ornate gabled facades reflected in the still water. A small arched bridge crosses the canal in the background. Handwritten ink notes and a date appear across the sky area of the image. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as the quay of Marble Workers and the Palace of the Franc.

Sepia-toned street view showing a gently curving road lined with buildings. Dominating the scene is a large multi-storey school building with a decorative gable and small tower, fronted by a columned porch. To the right is a traditional half-timbered house. In the distance, additional multi-storey buildings line the rising street, and a clock tower is visible further up. A few pedestrians, including children and a woman, stand on the cobbled street, and an early horse-drawn or small vehicle is seen further up the road. Printed captions at the top read 'Sebnitz i. Sa.' and 'Weberstrasse und Schule'.

A colorized historic postcard showing a symmetrical two‑story neoclassical building set in a park with large trees on both sides and a lawn in front. The facade has arched windows, a central entrance, and a pedimented central section with a crest. Hungarian text is printed at the top and on the facade of the building.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a residential neighborhood with clustered houses and inns with pitched roofs, surrounded by greenery and low hills in the background. The foreground shows a vine-covered garden and a small inn building labeled "Gasthaus zum Bachwirt". The upper left corner has printed red text indicating a street name, and the upper right corner names the district and city (Graz–Ruckerlberg). The architecture is early 20th‑century Central European.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square or street corner, showing cobblestone pavement, rows of pollarded trees within a fenced planting strip, and several two‑ to three‑storey plastered buildings with steep tiled roofs. On the left is a building with an arched entrance and balcony; a horse cart stands nearby. In the center background is a house with signage on the facade. Two men in early 20th‑century clothing stand talking in the open space at right, near stairs leading up to a large gabled house.

An old sepia-toned postcard view over a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground there is a wooden fence, some foliage, and what looks like a barrel or drum lying on its side. The town lies in a valley with clustered houses featuring steep roofs, tree-lined streets, and several church spires rising above the buildings. A prominent large church with a tall pointed steeple stands on the right side. The sky is pale and empty, with some age spots visible on the card. At the top left in red printed letters is the caption 'Neuhausen i. Sa.'

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town dominated by a large medieval stone church surrounded by trees. The church has a steep gabled roof and a separate wooden belfry with a pointed roof. Around it lie wooden houses, a larger multi‑storey building in the foreground, open fields and farmland in the distance. In the bottom left corner the word "LOHJA" and the number "2760" are printed.

Monochrome postcard showing an interior view of an armory hall filled with suits of plate armor and helmets. In the foreground on the right is a life‑size armored horse with a rider's armor, set on a low platform. To the left and in the background are rows of standing armors and many helmets hanging from the ceiling. The caption printed at the bottom reads in German and mentions Graz and the Landeszeughaus (provincial armory).

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a valley town surrounded by wooded hills. In the left foreground stands an ornate, turreted structure with pointed arches and decorative tile roof, described as a ruin, while below and to the right lie clustered houses, a main street with tram or rail tracks, and a small formal garden. The image is captioned in red Gothic-style script at the top.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad intersection lined with ornate late‑19th‑century / early‑20th‑century buildings. On the right is a prominent corner building with elaborate façades, bay windows, dormers, and a steep tiled roof with small towers. Awnings cover shopfronts at street level; one bears partially legible writing. Leafless trees line the sidewalks, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A decorative cast‑iron streetlamp stands in the center foreground, and horse‑drawn vehicles or early carriages are visible further down the street.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a line of mounted cavalry soldiers posing in front of a barracks-like building. The soldiers wear early‑20th‑century uniforms with tall, flat-topped caps and are holding lances with pennons. The background structure has arched windows and a central entrance topped by a small clock tower.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a river bend with a long multi‑arch stone bridge carrying a tram line and roadway. On the near riverbank there is a rail yard with several tracks, warehouses, and industrial buildings with tall smokestacks and a large gas holder. On the far heights stand dense residential quarters and, to the right, a tall spired church dominating the skyline. The scene is framed by trees and shrubs in the foreground and steep rocky slopes on the right. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by multi‑storey historic buildings. On the right is a town hall with a clock‑tower topped by a weather vane; at street level a sign reads "Ratskeller." Across the square are several shops and businesses with German signage painted on their facades. A fountain or monument stands near the center of the square, and a church spire rises in the background. A few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the otherwise empty square.

Black‑and‑white image of a large ocean liner with two funnels sailing close to shore, with a dramatic, flat‑topped mountain massif in the background. The ship's name "DOMINION MONARCH" is visible on the bow, and printed caption text at the bottom reads "Q.S.M.V. 'DOMINION MONARCH' 26,500 tons." The scene appears to be a vintage promotional or souvenir postcard of the ship in front of a coastal landscape.

An old monochrome postcard view of a small European town street beside a narrow stream crossed by a stone arch bridge. On the right stands a large ornate civic building with classical detailing, likely the town hall and post office, and other multi‑storey houses line the street. Leafless trees, wooden railings along the road and canal, and a few figures give it a late‑autumn or winter feel. German text is printed at the top and along the right edge.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a tree-lined path with a railing, along which a horse-drawn carriage is traveling. On the left across an open field stands a large Gothic-style church with multiple tall spires. In the background are small town buildings and gentle hills. The printed caption on the upper left reads "Neustadt i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with a paddle steamer or river barge in the foreground on a wide river. On the opposite bank stand rows of houses, industrial buildings with tall chimneys, and a water tower, lined with trees along the embankment. At the top in red Gothic-style print it reads "Strehla a. Elbe." on the left and "Riesaer Strasse." on the right, indicating the scene shows Riesaer Straße in Strehla on the Elbe River.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a city surrounded by mountains. In the foreground are dense low-rise buildings; in the mid‑ground stands a large ancient temple complex with tall columns (the Temple of Olympian Zeus) and an open archaeological area. Beyond it lies a wooded hill and, further back, a large stadium-like structure. Handwritten-style text near the bottom left reads something like "VIEW OF ATHENS," and a printed watermark at the bottom right shows a website address.

Color image of a tranquil river crossed by a low stone arch bridge with five arches. A light‑colored vintage car drives across the bridge. Both banks are lined with dense green trees and shrubs, reflected clearly in the calm blue water under a bright, clear sky. There is no visible printed text on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a traditional wine tavern or restaurant. The room has neatly set tables with white tablecloths, wooden chairs, framed pictures and plates on the walls, a hanging guitar, and decorative objects such as vases and a bust. Below the photograph there is a rhyming German text inviting visitors to rest and drink wine, and at the bottom it names the place as a wine bar called "Weinstuben zum Kellermeister" in Meissen.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet river scene with several moored boats and barges on a wide river, with low, flat banks in the background. The caption printed at the top in red reads "Gröba-Riesa. Elbepartie." indicating it is a view of part of the Elbe River near Gröba and Riesa.

Black-and-white postcard view of a small railway station complex with low brick buildings, loading ramps and freight sheds. Railway tracks and overhead electric lines run across the foreground. A sign on a rear building reads "STALLDALEN," and in the lower left corner printed text identifies the location. A logo at the bottom right corner reads "PRESSBYRÅN Copyright 73297," indicating a commercial postcard publisher.

A colorized winter cityscape shows a street and tram line descending between snow‑covered trees toward a small square. In the middle distance stands a cylindrical red‑brick tower with a conical, snow‑covered roof and an attached lighter building. Further back rises a distinctive church with an onion‑shaped golden dome and lantern. People and an old tram are visible on the street, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European city.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a broad town square with people walking and several horse-drawn carriages. On the left stands an ornate town hall with a stepped gable facade and an attached clock tower. Behind it rise two tall Gothic church towers and the large roof of a church. Surrounding the square are traditional multi‑story buildings with steep roofs. Decorative German text is printed at the top and along the left margin.

A black‑and‑white landscape view of a town taken from outside the urban area. In the foreground are cultivated fields and small allotment-style garden plots with sheds. Behind them rises a wooded embankment. On the left is a multi-arched stone or concrete railway viaduct. The skyline of the town in the background shows dense late‑19th‑century housing, several tall church steeples, and at least two tall industrial smokestacks, indicating a mixed religious and industrial town. The image has a wide panoramic composition typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad river with a stone embankment in the foreground. A paddle steamship with a smoking funnel moves along the water. Across the river stands a large castle-like complex with high walls, a round corner tower and several tall spires and roofs, behind a line of trees and lower houses. To the left a multi‑span iron bridge crosses the river. The sky area on the upper left is heavily damaged or overexposed, leaving a large white blotch.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an open sports field with flagpoles flying long pennant flags. People in early 20th‑century clothing sit on benches and stand around the field, where a football (soccer) goal is visible in the background. Trees encircle the grounds, and the sky is partly cloudy. The caption at the bottom reads "Idrottsplan, Tierp."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a historic European town. In the foreground is a weir and rocky river (the Spree). Along the riverbank stand multi‑storey houses and small timber‑frame buildings, with a low bridge and people walking by the water. Behind them rises a fortified town with stone walls, taller buildings, and a prominent church tower. Printed German captions at the top label the view with location details, and a vertical imprint on the right margin shows the publisher information.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small riverside town set in a heavily forested, hilly landscape. In the foreground are several large wooden houses among mature trees. A suspension bridge with tall towers spans the river to the right, connecting wooded banks and a compact town center with low commercial buildings and church spires. In the far background a solitary conical hill or small mountain rises above the tree line. The lower border of the image shows faint handwritten numbers, suggesting a catalog or negative reference rather than a title.

Black‑and‑white view of a river landscape with two adjacent road bridges crossing a narrow channel between forested banks. The nearer bridge has a metal lattice arch; the farther one has stone abutments and a simple roadway. In the background are low wooden buildings and boathouses on the shoreline of a calm lake or wide river, surrounded by dense coniferous forest. A birch tree trunk and the roofs of a few small houses appear in the foreground. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Color postcard-style view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate iron bridge and riverside promenade with a few pedestrians and decorative lampposts. Across the river stand several historic multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and, to the right, a tall church tower with a distinctive onion-shaped dome. Behind the city rises a green hill topped with structures, including a prominent clock tower on the slope. The overall look suggests an early-20th‑century printed postcard of a central European town.

A sepia-toned historical photograph of a railway station building with a long platform canopy. A steam locomotive stands on the left side near the platform, and numerous people, including soldiers and civilians, are gathered along the platform in front of the station. The architecture is 19th–early 20th century European. At the top of the image there is printed text in Bulgarian Cyrillic.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic church dominating a cobbled town square. The building has a tall central tower with a baroque onion-shaped dome topped by a slender spire and cross. The lower tower and west front are in a more Romanesque/early Gothic style with small arched windows and a decorative roundel, while the long nave to the right has pronounced Gothic buttresses and pinnacles. A few small figures stand on the square, and plain multi‑storey townhouses frame the background.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad, straight city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses and apartment buildings in historicist/Neo‑Baroque style. The foreground shows richly decorated facades with mansard roofs, domed corner turrets, dormer windows, and shuttered windows. Several pedestrians walk along wide sidewalks and there are simple street lamps but no cars, giving the scene an early 20th‑century feel. The street recedes toward a slightly rising hill with more buildings and trees in the distance. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town in a valley. In the center stands a prominent Gothic‑revival brick church with a tall spire and buttresses, next to a rectangular civic-looking building fronted by a tree‑lined promenade. In the foreground are rows of 2–3 storey houses with steep tiled roofs. Behind the church are larger institutional blocks, industrial buildings and a cylindrical gas holder, while terraced fields or vineyards and gentle hills rise in the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet residential street lined with early 20th‑century multi‑storey houses featuring steep tiled gable roofs, stucco facades, bay windows and balconies decorated with flower boxes. Wooden picket fences border small front gardens. Several utility poles with multiple crossbars run along the street. Children and a few adults stand or play in the unpaved roadway. In the background a larger institutional or residential building closes the vista. The overall scene has a Central European, pre‑World War II atmosphere.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex overlooking a small town. The castle has tall light-colored walls with narrow windows and steep red gabled roofs, plus towers and a church-like building with a spire. Below the castle are clustered townhouses and trees. The caption at the top left reads "Schloss Nossen." Vertical text at the right margin indicates the publisher, and there are some smaller printer or artist credits along the left side.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European market square with tram tracks running through a cobbled street. On the left is an arched passageway with posters and a standing figure in shadow. On the right are tall historic buildings with gabled facades and window boxes. In the distance stands a church-like tower with a clock and baroque spire rising above surrounding houses. Outdoor tables or stalls line the square. Handwritten-style German text is printed beneath the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow canal flanked by tall multi‑story buildings with many windows. Laundry hangs from some windows and balconies extend over the water. In the distance, a prominent neo‑Gothic church spire rises above the surrounding buildings. At the bottom margin, cursive text identifies the location as a canal (Fleet) near Stockelhörn and St. Nikolai Church in Hamburg.

Hand‑tinted historic postcard showing the entrance to an iron pedestrian bridge with ornate railings and a decorative arch topped by a large round clock. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on or near the bridge. To the right is a timber‑framed building partly covered with ivy, and trees line the left side. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs of the same rural courtyard from different angles. Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered road lined with houses and telegraph poles on the left, and a fenced churchyard with leafless trees and a church whose steeple rises above the trees on the right. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned town square with a central circular flowerbed surrounded by a low metal fence and a tall pedestal bearing a bust statue. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey neoclassical villa partly hidden among tall trees. Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a tree-lined park road with a rustic wooden pedestrian bridge crossing overhead. A vintage black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional Scandinavian room with patterned wallpaper, a tiled masonry stove, long woven rugs on wooden floors, carved wooden bench and chairs, a tall longcase clock, a curtained alcove bed, and decorative shelves on the wall. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal landscape with a large gnarled tree in the right foreground, sloping grass with a few seated figures in hats, and a wooded peninsula extending into a calm body of water. Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town with open fields in the foreground. On a hill behind the town sits a large medieval castle complex with several towers. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide paved square bordered by arcaded buildings and traditional houses with balconies. Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate neo‑Baroque building with many large arched windows, sculptural decorations, and domed roof pavilions. A black‑and‑white image of a large two‑funnel ocean liner at sea, viewed from the starboard side. Tinted historic postcard showing two long, attached institutional buildings with high, sloped roofs and dormer windows. A black‑and‑white nighttime photograph of a large fortified castle with a massive round tower on the left and a long facade of multi‑story buildings with many rectangular windows and crenellated battlements. Black‑and‑white view of a grand European spa‑town street bordered by ornate 19th‑century buildings. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal fishing town with wooden boats moored in a calm harbor. Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small iron bridge with decorative railings spanning a narrow canal or river in a tree‑lined park or rural road. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Corinth with barracks buildings in the foreground and mountains and sea in the background. Greek and French captions identify the scene as the barracks of Corinth.

Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a wooded path with bushes and trees on both sides and a wooden bench in the foreground on the right. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a lively bathing scene at a lake. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a busy harbor scene with numerous sailing ships and steamers moored along both banks of a wide waterway. Colorized vintage postcard showing two long, rectangular stone military buildings on a rocky, grass‑covered hill under a blue sky with clouds. Vintage monochrome view of a European street scene titled "Reval Grosse Karri strasse". Color postcard showing a young Burmese woman in traditional dress standing outdoors in a garden-like setting. She wears a white blouse and long golden sarong, adorned with jewelry and flowers in her hair, and holds a pink paper parasol. Printed captions appear below the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone multi‑arch bridge crossing a calm river with ducks in the water. Trees line the riverbank and a paved promenade runs along the right side. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide river with a road bridge crossing it. In the foreground is a riverside promenade with a rocky embankment, trees, and several people walking. Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a horse‑racing track. On the left are ornate grandstand buildings with flags flying on the roofs and crowds of spectators lining the rail. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic building with multiple wings and a steep tiled roof, reflected in a calm body of water in the foreground. Trees and shrubs surround the structure. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a catalog-style display of many small metal jewelry pieces (brooches, pendants, charms, chains). Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an ornate multi‑storey corner building with richly decorated facades and a tall, elaborate dome-like roof tower. Sepia-toned postcard showing a narrow country road winding through a forested mountain valley. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large cobblestoned market square bordered by several classical and late‑19th‑century buildings. Sepia-toned vintage view of a European city on a river. A multi-arch stone bridge crosses the water, with numerous moored riverboats below. A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a full-length statue of a man in 19th‑century dress, standing with one foot raised on a rock and one hand on his hip. Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town with church spires, dense rooflines, gardens, and surrounding countryside. The photo is printed in the upper part of the card, with German text in red and smaller print below the image on a cream background.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a lively open-air market in a European square. Dozens of stalls with canvas awnings fill the plaza, crowded with vendors and shoppers in early-20th‑century clothing. Black‑and‑white postcard view across a calm river or lake toward a small town. A black‑and‑white panoramic view of several large villa-style houses with steep, tiled roofs and ornate balconies, standing along the edge of a wooded area. In the foreground is an open meadow or field, with a few small figures visible in the grass. The buildings appear to be early-20th‑century European villas, possibly part of a residential or spa district on the edge of a town. The sky area at the top looks overexposed or cut out, as in an old photographic print. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village street with unpaved road, telegraph poles, and small brick houses. Several people, including women in long dresses and a person with a bicycle, stand in front of a house on the right. The caption in the upper left corner reads "Parti fra Snejbjerg." The scene looks early 20th century.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a European city square with cobblestone streets, tram tracks, and two electric trams in the foreground. People walk along the street lined with multi‑story brick buildings with awnings. In the background stands a prominent old tower rising above gabled roofs on the main square, labeled as the 'Groote Markt' of Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white view of a large town square with a church tower in the center background. The square is unpaved and mostly empty, with a few pedestrians and small groups of people scattered around, and a horse‑drawn wagon near the church. Surrounding the square are 2–3‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central European small towns. On the ground floors are shops and inns, with German signage visible above the entrances. The church tower has a clock, a balcony below the clock, and a slender spire topped with a cross.

Black‑and‑white historic street view showing a wide, mostly unpaved road lined with trees in the center and two‑story townhouses and shops on both sides. In the distance a church tower or similar spire rises above the roofs. The captions in red Gothic-style script at the top read "Königsbrück." on the left and "Weissbacherstrasse." on the right. German signage is visible on building facades, such as a business sign for an inn or restaurant. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century European town postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of an arcade with stone columns and arches overlooking a terraced area with trees and a distant body of water or landscape. The foreground shows a colonnaded walkway; to the left are low stone walls, bare trees, and a path descending toward the background. Printed captions in French and another language identify the scene as Salonique/Salonica – Vláteon-Mouni. A publisher mark and photo credit appear at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a rural landscape. In the foreground are tree‑lined parks and lawns; beyond them stand clustered houses and industrial buildings with tall chimneys. A prominent church or town‑hall tower with a clock and onion‑shaped spire rises near the center. Fields and gently rolling, forested hills frame the background, with a river or lake visible to the right.

The image shows the handwritten message side of an old postcard. The card is filled with cursive writing in black ink on yellowed paper. There is no visible photograph or illustration on this side, only text. The handwriting is in Finnish and includes a date and place name at the bottom, ending with a signature.

A sepia-toned old photograph showing a wide, tree-lined boulevard in a European city, viewed from an elevated position. On the left stands a large, ornate corner building with columns and balconies in late 19th‑century European style. A row of multi‑story buildings continues along the boulevard, while smaller houses and gardens occupy the right foreground. People walk along the street and sidewalks, and a horse-drawn cart is visible. Low hills form the backdrop behind the city. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a Baroque pilgrimage church and complex on a hillside, with multiple domes and spires above arcaded walls and a sloping grassy foreground. Printed red captions in Czech appear beneath the image, and a red manuscript number is written in the top right corner.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a railway station building labeled 'STATION D'ISMAILIA'. The structure has three stories with arched ground-floor entrances and shuttered windows above. In front of the station stand several people in early 20th‑century attire, along with a horse‑drawn carriage to the right. The lower margin of the postcard bears a printed caption identifying the place and an attribution.

Black‑and‑white image showing four mounted soldiers in formal cavalry uniforms lined up in the foreground of an open field. Each rider carries a lance with a small flag and wears a tall shako-style hat with an emblem on the front. One rider is pointing into the distance while the others look ahead. In the hazy background are low buildings and more mounted troops on parade, suggesting a military exercise or review.

A black‑and‑white studio portrait of a smiling young woman with wavy, light-colored hair, wearing a dark dress with large light buttons, light-colored gloves, and a beret-style hat. She is posed in a confident, slightly sideways seated position with her hands on her hips. The photo is framed by a white border, and beneath the image is printed the name "M. Zilava." There is a small printer's mark and number in the lower right corner of the margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large multi‑story sanatorium building with steep gabled roofs, balconies, and numerous windows. The structure is surrounded by trees and landscaped grounds, with a small lake or pond in the foreground reflecting the building. In the upper left corner, printed text identifies the place as a sanatorium in Bad Elster.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilly, wooded landscape with a small town. On the hilltop stands a large fortified complex resembling a castle alongside a church with a tower or dome. Below, near a road, there are a couple of standalone houses or industrial-style buildings. The printed caption at the top reads "Wolkenstein i. Erzgeb." in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad, tree‑lined street with late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings on the left and right. The left side features an ornate stone building with classical details, likely a post office or official building, while large leafy trees line the right side of the street. A few pedestrians are visible in the distance. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.

Vintage winter scene of a straight, tree‑lined avenue covered in snow. Bare trees form an alleyway leading into the distance, with a few pedestrians visible. On the left stands a row of ornate wooden buildings, one likely a bookstore. The image has a monochrome/hand‑tinted look typical of early 20th‑century postcards. Caption text is printed along the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a sloping market street in a small European town, looking toward a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire in the background. Multi‑story buildings line both sides of the street; signs on them advertise an apothecary and a business named Carl Sprotte. People are walking and working on the street, with a horse-drawn cart visible. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene, and a vertical imprint on the right margin credits a printer and the year 1905.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a solitary stone observation tower standing on a small cleared hilltop, surrounded by tall trees. The tower has a rough‑hewn, blocky base, narrow vertical slit windows, and an upper section with a projecting rounded corner turret that rises slightly higher than the main structure and ends in crenellations with a flagpole on top. The scene is rural and there is no visible text or people.

Colorized historic street view showing a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings along a broad street. On the left is a large house with green shutters and a fenced garden; on the right stand multi‑story masonry buildings with ornate façades and red tiled roofs, including a corner building with a tower and weather vane. A few pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles are visible on the street. At the top of the image are printed captions in German indicating the street name and town.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing the passenger steamship S/S BRYNHILD cruising on calm water. Smoke is rising from the central funnel marked with a large letter "S". Lifeboats line the upper decks, and several passengers are visible on board. Trees and shoreline appear faintly in the background under a partly cloudy sky. Caption text is printed along the bottom border.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a tree‑lined dirt road curving toward a large brick building in the background. The scene looks semi‑rural, with mature deciduous trees on the left, coniferous trees on the right, and telegraph or power poles following the road. The multi‑story brick building has a steep, gabled roof; a small cross or finial sits at the roof peak, suggesting a religious institution or school. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Colorized vintage view of a small rural railway station. A steam locomotive with a short train stands on the tracks, releasing a bit of steam. To the right is a modest station building with a steep red-tiled roof and half‑timbered gable. A small green kiosk or shelter stands on the platform, and a semaphore signal rises beside the tracks. The landscape around is flat and open countryside. The scene has the soft tones typical of early 20th‑century printed postcards. A station sign on the building reads a short name beginning with the letter "L", likely the station name.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small village beneath a steep, forested rocky hill. On the slope stands a church with a tower and several village houses in the foreground. At the top of the hill, partly hidden by trees, are ruins of a medieval castle or monastery complex. The word "Oybin." is printed in red at the upper left, and the number "5288" and a small "20" appear in red at the lower right.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a wide, tree‑lined avenue with early 20th‑century houses on both sides. Several children in dresses and coats stand and play in the street, while a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the road. Gas-style street lamps line the sidewalks. At the bottom of the image, printed captions identify the city and street, with additional small publisher text and a large handwritten signature across the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white image showing a group of uniformed soldiers and nurses gathered around a medical tent in a forest clearing. Several patients lie on stretchers on the grass in front of the tent while others are being attended by medical personnel. All adults wear armbands with a cross symbol, suggesting a field hospital or Red Cross training scene. The style of uniforms and photographic quality indicate an early 20th‑century setting. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image itself.

A monochrome postcard-style image showing a medieval European walled town with multiple round defensive towers and a very tall, slender church spire rising above the rooftops. Trees and a park or open green space frame the view in the foreground, while the fortified walls and towers form a continuous line across the middle of the image. The photograph has an old-fashioned, slightly sepia look. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing people gathered outdoors in a seaside park or garden. Several individuals stand and sit around tables beneath bare trees, overlooking a bay or coastline with cliffs and buildings in the distance. The scene appears calm and social, possibly a café setting by the sea. At the bottom there is printed text in Cyrillic.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wooded mountain valley with tall conifer trees, a rocky stream in the foreground, a small wooden footbridge crossing the water, and people standing near the stream and bridge. In the distance, on a higher ridge above the forest, there are several large buildings. The caption at the top reads "Parthie im Rabenauergrunde." On the right margin, vertically, appears a printer or publisher line with a number.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad, partly unpaved avenue lined with two‑ and three‑storey houses and small shops on the left and trees on both sides. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children and pedestrians, walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the street. In the distance, a church spire rises above the trees. The printed caption at the top reads "Senftenberg-L." and beneath it "Kaiser-Friedrich-Straße".

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a forested ravine with a high concrete arch road bridge crossing above a narrow waterway. Below, a passenger boat full of people travels along an elevated canal or aqueduct through the gorge. On the right, rocky slopes rise steeply with pine trees and a small pavilion-like structure at the top. Printed captions in Swedish are visible in the lower left and right corners.

A vintage, sepia-toned panoramic view of a town or small city with low houses, trees, and a few taller buildings, seen from an elevated vantage point. Greek text appears at the top left, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed near the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, rectangular, three‑storey villa with simple neoclassical lines, a glazed veranda, and several tall chimneys. The house stands above a stone wall and dense trees, next to a broad paved terrace bordered by a metal railing. To the right, along the wall, is a small round watchtower with a conical roof, resembling part of a fortification or castle enceinte. Hills or mountains are faintly visible in the distant background. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A colorized historical postcard view of a busy waterfront promenade lined with multi‑story buildings and crowds of people. Several small wooden rowing boats with figures on board occupy the foreground, floating on calm water at sunset. At the top there are printed captions in French and English identifying the scene as the Niki wharf in Salonica (Thessaloniki), between Venizelos Street and the White Tower. A watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower part of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural industrial complex in a snowy valley surrounded by forested hills and a river. Several large rectangular buildings, likely mill or factory buildings, stand near the water, with scattered conifer trees in the foreground. The image is vignetted in an irregular shape against a blank background. Red printed German text at the top identifies the scene as Reutte in Tyrol and mentions a former paper mill now used as an electricity plant; additional publisher information appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town and surrounding countryside. In the foreground are densely packed, steep‑roofed masonry houses with chimneys, typical of late 19th–early 20th century central European architecture. Further back stand larger institutional or residential buildings set among many trees and gardens. Beyond the town are fields, gentle hills, and scattered farmhouses. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image.

A yellow postal card from the Museum of Physical Education and Sports in Budapest. The left side shows a round image of a sports medal, labeled with the number 6, and Hungarian and English text about an exposition of sports medals in 1987. On the upper right is a green Hungarian postage stamp depicting a tennis player (W. C. Wingfield) with a trophy and tennis racket, labeled "MAGYAR POSTA" and "WIMBLEDON 1877". There is also a circular commemorative postmark featuring a female athlete and Hungarian text, dated 1987.08.22. Address lines appear on the lower right.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a densely crowded public ceremony in front of an ornate European townhouse or municipal building. A large outdoor altar with a crucifix and many candles stands at the top of a staircase, richly decorated with garlands. Clergy in vestments, military or veterans in uniform, and officials gather on the steps, while numerous flags and standards are held by people below. Spectators look on from open windows and from a second building on the right. Bunting and wreaths decorate the façades, and tall flagpoles with striped flags rise on both sides.

Black‑and‑white view taken from the sea toward a rocky shoreline with a large wooden seaside villa or restaurant standing alone on low cliffs. Coniferous trees line the background. The scene is tranquil with calm water in the foreground and a cloudy sky above. Caption text in Finnish and Swedish is printed along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing Freiberger Straße in the town of Wilsdruff. Two- and three-story buildings line a gently curving cobblestone street. On the right is a long building with signs for a restaurant named "Stadt Dresden". On the left, shopfronts include a sign for artificial flowers. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and a few horse-drawn carts are visible further down the street. The title "Wilsdruff – Freiberger Straße" appears at the top.

Color photograph of a lakeside or riverside campground filled with 1950s–1960s European cars, caravans, and brightly colored tents on a grassy shore. The water and a low, flat townscape are visible in the background under a wide, slightly overcast sky. The image has the texture, toning, and composition typical of a mid‑20th‑century travel postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a narrow cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings with shutters and balconies. At the end of the street stands a prominent church with a tall bell tower and dome. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. At the bottom edge, printed text identifies the scene as Trento – Via Camillo Cavour.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal urban garden or square with paths radiating around a central fountain and statue, bordered by multi‑story neoclassical and early 20th‑century buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk through the park. Greek text appears at the lower left and French text at the lower right; a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overprinted across the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a seaside quay with people walking and sitting along the waterfront. Stacks of lumber lie on the left, boats float in the harbor on the right, and a dense row of multi‑story buildings lines the far shore. Printed caption text identifies the scene as the pier and marina of Coruña, and there is cursive handwriting in French and Spanish across the bottom.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, castle-like administrative residence with crenellated rooflines and a tall corner tower. The multi-storey building faces a curved street where a horse-drawn carriage and a few pedestrians are visible, suggesting an early 20th-century urban setting. Printed captions in Swedish and Finnish appear at the top, identifying the building and location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a winding mountain road climbing in zigzags up a steep peak.
