In the middle distance stands a prominent church or cathedral with two tall square towers and a long nave, set within a dense historic town that spreads out across a flat plain to the horizon. The image has the look of a mid‑ to late‑20th‑century tourist postcard, but no visible printed text or caption appears on the image side.

Color image showing a planned residential district with mid‑rise modernist apartment blocks arranged around landscaped green courtyards and curving paths. The buildings are simple rectangular structures with balconies and small decorative square insets on the façades. In the foreground is a cone‑shaped glass pavilion attached to a low building. The background shows rolling green hills dotted with small houses under a partly cloudy sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Color postcard showing a large central square with gardens, steps, and fountains. Dominating the view is a historic stone building with a prominent green dome, with surrounding classical buildings, statues, and a horse-mounted statue at the right edge. The reverse side carries Hungarian handwriting, printed multilingual caption identifying the square, a Hungarian postage stamp, and address lines.

Color view of a large historic square with a central stone-domed building in the background, a tall dark plague column or religious monument on the left, and a prominent equestrian statue on a stone pedestal on the right. People sit on benches and steps in the foreground, with 1960s-era cars and buses visible near the buildings. The architecture blends Ottoman-style domed masonry with Central European civic buildings.

A vintage, sepia-tone postcard showing a large multi-storey institutional building in a landscaped setting. The façade has arched windows on the ground floor, rectangular windows above, and gabled roof sections; one gable has a bird perched on top. Trees and a curved driveway or path appear in the foreground. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and the institution in Hungarian. The reverse side is blank apart from standard postcard dividing lines, a printer's mark, and Hungarian text indicating all rights reserved.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque/church building, stepped terraces with a fountain, and surrounding historic buildings. One façade bears the sign 'NÁDOR SZÁLLÓ'. People are walking and sitting around the square, and mid‑20th‑century cars are parked on cobbled streets. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text identifying the location as 'PÉCS Széchenyi tér', handwritten greetings in blue ink, a Hungarian 'Magyar Posta' tram stamp (20 Ft), and an address in Budapest.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with historic buildings. Dominating the scene is an ornate city hall with a tall clock tower and baroque details, fronted by a stepped stone terrace. Surrounding it are multi‑story façades with shop signs and a church in the background. The caption at the bottom reads in Hungarian: "Pécs. Széchenyi tér és városháza." The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a blue Hungarian stamp, and a circular postmark from Pécs.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy European square with a domed church or mosque-like building with a bell tower on the left and an ornate multi‑story historicist building with shops on the right. Horse‑drawn carriages, a tram, and pedestrians fill the street. At the top left the printed caption reads "PÉCS" and below it "Széchenyi-tér". The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a green Hungarian stamp and printed publisher information along the left edge.

The front shows the richly decorated interior of a historic pharmacy with dark carved wooden cabinets filled with apothecary jars, marble-topped counters, a decorative fountain, and ornate wallpaper and chandelier. The reverse side is a classic divided-back postcard layout with Hungarian text giving the location and photo credit, plus a printed price of 20 forints.

Color postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a large Roman Catholic cathedral with high arches, ornate coffered ceiling, frescoes and mosaics, and an elaborate altar and baldachin at the far end. The reverse side is a typical divided-back postcard layout with printed multilingual caption identifying the cathedral and publisher details.

A black‑and‑white aerial view of a large, formal city square with lawns and flowerbeds. At the center stands an ornate Baroque column or monument surrounded by an octagonal platform, and in the foreground there is an equestrian statue on a high pedestal. Benches line the paths and people are walking and sitting around the square; a multi‑storey building and a street with vehicles border the square. The reverse side has printed multilingual text identifying the place as Széchenyi tér (Széchenyi Square) in Pécs, Hungary, along with handwritten Hungarian text, an address, postage stamp and a Pécs postmark dated 1967.

A color postcard showing a panoramic view over the city of Pécs with residential blocks in the foreground and the historic city center further back, framed by green hills. On the reverse side, it has multilingual captions identifying the view, vertical publisher credit, price, and space for address and stamp.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated view over the central square of Pécs, with the large domed mosque‑church (former Pasha Qasim Mosque) dominating the foreground and a four‑towered cathedral visible in the background. Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or lake toward an ornate iron bridge with decorative lampposts and stone pylons. Behind the bridge stands a large neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance style complex with steep roofs, turrets, spires, and pointed arched windows, partly obscured by leafless trees. The buildings, bridge, and trees are reflected in the still water in the foreground. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image.

Black‑and‑white rural view showing a large wooden farmhouse or manor (gård) in open fields. A flagpole in front flies the Norwegian flag. Trees surround the house, and harvested or growing crops occupy the foreground. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner indicating the name of the farm and its locality in Norway.

Black-and-white scenic postcard showing a vast coniferous forest in the foreground, opening onto farmland, scattered houses, and barns, with a lake and low hills in the distance under a partly cloudy sky. Printed Swedish text appears along the bottom, identifying the viewpoint and the photographer/publisher.

Sepia-toned aerial view of a small European town nestled in hilly countryside. In the foreground stands a prominent civic building facing a square, with a clock on its roof. Around it are tightly packed townhouses and narrow streets. Further back, a church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire rises above the roofs. In the background are wooded hills and farmland. At the bottom margin of the image, a printed caption identifies the town.

Color-tinted historic postcard view of a landscaped park or boulevard. A central grassy island with flowerbeds and a statue on a white pedestal is framed by curving paths and tree‑lined avenues. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. The printed caption identifies the scene as 'Nassausingel' in Nijmegen. Publisher and date information are printed along the bottom margin.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over an industrial riverside town with hills in the background. A large river flows across the foreground with a steamship and barges on the water. A metal bridge spans the river toward the left. The town is dense with factories, chimneys, warehouses, and residential buildings. The caption text in German is printed at the top in red letters.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a rural lakeside landscape with rolling grassy hills in the foreground. Several people sit on the hillside looking toward a cluster of wooden houses and farm buildings surrounded by long wooden fences. In the background is a large lake bordered by low, rounded hills. The caption at the top left reads "Parti fra Sjusjøen". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century Scandinavian countryside scene.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a detailed illustration of a large historicist town hall building with a prominent central tower and clock, set on an open square with small figures walking in front. Decorative red Gothic-style script text appears below the image and vertically along the left border.

Vintage monochrome postcard with two circular photographs of ancient sculpted heads. The left shows a male (or youth) marble head labeled as being from the Acropolis, and the right shows a female head labeled as being from Candia (Crete). Above them is the title in Greek and French indicating Athens. There is a central circular postal cancellation dated 1902 and Greek and French captions printed below each image, along with a small printed note about the Hellenic postal service at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view of a large wooden public building with a steep metal roof and central cupola, standing in an open grassy field. Small groups of people, possibly children and adults, gather in front of the structure. Surrounding it are other wooden houses and, in the distant right background, a tall church with a pointed spire. The architecture and setting suggest a small Northern European town or village in the early 20th century. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a hillside crowned by a large villa or small castle-like building with a central tower and crenellated sections. The building stands above terraced slopes and orchards or gardens filled with blossoming trees; a tall poplar rises on the right. At the very bottom, in a decorative script, there is a German caption identifying the site.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a calm coastal scene with rocky shoreline, pine trees, small wooden boats, and a log boathouse or shed at the water's edge. Several people, including children and adults, stand on the shore and sit in a rowing boat near a wooden pier. Low buildings are visible across the water in the background. The words "Lovisa." and "Antbystrand" are printed at the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a paddle steamer sailing along a wide river with grassy banks in the foreground. In the background is a town skyline with towers and church spires silhouetted against a pale sky. The printed captions at the top read "Wittenberg." on the left and "Partie an der Elbe." on the right.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a wide urban avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings. A prominent large building with an ornate towered corner dominates the center-right, while pedestrians, bicycles, and a few early automobiles move along the street. At the bottom are printed caption words in German naming the city and location.

Sepia-toned street scene showing an early 20th‑century European city. Cobblestone streets with several sets of tram tracks curve past rows of gabled townhouses. Two trams are visible on the right, with overhead wires crossing the sky. On the left is a small square bordered by low buildings with tiled roofs; one house has arched windows on the ground floor and a sign on the façade. Tall, slender poles and old-fashioned street lamps stand on the square, and a few pedestrians are scattered along the street.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside scene with a grand castle‑like building on a wooded hill to the right, labeled "Schloss." A metal truss bridge spans the river on the left, leading into a small settlement. People are visible walking along the riverbank and near the water. The main caption in red at the top left reads "Gruss aus Aich b. Karlsbad." and a publisher line appears at the bottom.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a canal lock with stone gates and water in the foreground, bordered by a tree‑lined promenade with large classical buildings on the left and an iron railing bridge with gas-style street lamps on the right. Several people stand on the bridge and near the lock machinery. The image is oval‑framed on a light background, with red printed text at the bottom identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style cityscape showing a fortified medieval town built on a river bend. Dominating the scene is a tall round stone tower with crenellations and a lower rectangular gate tower at its base, integrated into old city walls. Behind and around it rise steep-roofed houses and several church towers and spires with crosses, characteristic of a historic Central European town. A small bridge crosses the river in the foreground, and the overall view is taken from an elevated vantage point, capturing much of the old town.

A monochrome postcard reproducing a detailed historical painting of a ceremonial reception scene from the Council of Trent. The image shows cardinals and clergy in ornate vestments, nobles, soldiers, and townspeople gathered in an arcaded courtyard with Renaissance architecture in the background. The scene is framed by a large stone arch. Below the image there is Italian caption text in decorative fonts, with the title in red and additional description in black cursive, plus a blue handwritten signature on the right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a statue on a tall pedestal in the foreground, trees behind it, and a fortified hill with walls and a cross on top in the background. There is an ornate gateway in front of the fortress. Printed caption text appears below the image in French, and there is cursive handwriting along the lower edge. A web watermark with the domain 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible.

A sepia-toned waterfront cityscape showing grand multi-story stone buildings along a broad boulevard beside a harbor. Several passenger boats are moored along the quay. The perspective looks down the length of the waterfront street lined with trees and vehicles, with a church spire visible in the distance. At the bottom right there is printed text identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide view of an ancient stone amphitheater with concentric rows of seating rising around a circular orchestra. Ruined blocks lie in the foreground, and there is a monumental entrance structure to the right. The caption at the bottom is in Greek and French, identifying the site as the Theatre of Epidaurus. A copyright line and a web address are also visible.

Black‑and‑white view of a neo‑Gothic church with two tall, ornate spires rising above dense trees and rooftops. In the foreground are terraced stone walls covered with vegetation, a tiled roof, and lampposts along a path. The photo is vertically framed and appears to be an early 20th‑century postcard photograph of a European cathedral or large church seen from a lower garden or vineyard area. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned photograph of an ornate interior hall in Art Deco or late Beaux-Arts style, likely a grand lobby or ceremonial room. The space features a coffered ceiling with elaborate hanging light fixtures connected by chains, marble-clad walls with decorative panels and pilasters, and a central wooden door at the far end framed by rich ornament. The perspective is centered down the length of the hall, emphasizing symmetry. A small printed number "301" appears in the lower right corner, typical of series postcards.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a town square with a fenced garden and a large pedestal supporting a bust monument of Kaiser Wilhelm. Behind the monument are ivy-covered church walls on the left and a row of traditional multi‑story buildings with shop signs on the right. The title text at the top reads that this is the church square with the Kaiser Wilhelm monument in Großenhain.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a formal baroque-style garden leading toward a city center. Symmetrical paths, fountains, and manicured flowerbeds stretch from the foreground toward a large statue in the middle distance, beyond which stand arcaded buildings and several prominent towers. The image has an old photographic style typical of early 20th‑century postcards. The printed words 'Karlsruhe' and 'Totalansicht' appear at the top.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of well‑dressed men and women gathered around an ornate indoor fountain or mineral spring. The people wear early 20th‑century European clothing, including bowler hats, long coats, and wide‑brimmed women's hats. The fountain basin is elaborately carved, and the surrounding structure has large glass windows and decorative columns, suggesting a spa pavilion or pump room. There is red handwriting across the right side and lower center of the image, and a crossed‑out printed number near the top.

Colorized postcard view of an industrial riverside scene with factory buildings and several tall brick smokestacks on the far shore, backed by forested hills. In the foreground a long white river steamer crowded with passengers travels along the water. Red printed German text appears at the top naming the location and the electrical works.

Sepia-toned landscape view taken from an elevated terrace with a wooden gazebo and railing in the foreground and the wall of a large building (likely a castle) on the right. Below, a small town with clustered houses lies in a valley surrounded by wooded hills and fields. Leaves and branches partly frame the image at the top. Printed caption text in German runs along the bottom edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large ocean liner named VALDIVIA underway on the water. The ship has two funnels, multiple decks crowded with passengers, and cargo cranes at the bow. The caption, printed in French at the top, identifies the ship as a passenger vessel of a maritime transport company.

Black-and-white winter view of a snow-covered town featuring a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall clock tower and spire, seen from across a small bridge over a frozen river. People walk along the bridge and paths; bare trees line the foreground. Printed caption text appears in the sky area at the upper left.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town taken from an elevated vantage point across open fields. In the foreground are trees and gently rolling farmland with paths and small tracks. Beyond the fields lies a compact town of mostly 2–3‑story gabled houses and larger masonry buildings. Dominating the right side of the skyline is a tall church with a slender tower and spire. Low hills and patchwork fields extend into the distance under a bright sky. No visible text appears on the image.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a leafy, vine-covered house with shuttered windows and a tiled roof surrounded by lush trees and garden plants. A dirt path runs in front of the house. At the bottom of the image there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large industrial complex in a steep valley, with long multi‑storey factory blocks and several smaller residential or administrative buildings in the foreground. Forested hills rise behind the complex. Printed German text in red appears along the bottom margin, and a handwritten number "1554" is in red ink on the right.

The image shows the address side of an old postcard labeled "BRIEFKAART" in green print. It has a handwritten address in dark ink, including a name and a Madrid address, with a word that looks like "Granzi" written at the top left. In the upper‑right corner there is a red postage stamp from the Netherlands, cancelled with a circular postmark reading "UTRECHT" and a date in June. The card has an aged, yellowed appearance and no photograph or illustration is visible.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a group of children in ancient-style costumes posing in a choreographed stance inside an ancient stone theater. The stepped stone seating of the theater is clearly visible in the background. The children wear light-colored tunics with wide sleeves and dark wigs or headpieces, evoking ancient Greek attire. In the lower right corner there is a printed website address, and in the lower left a circular archival stamp or logo.

A vintage two-panel postcard. The upper image shows a panoramic view of a valley town with hills in the background and a large rectangular Baroque-style building with corner towers in the foreground. Above it is printed the German caption "Gruß aus Eggenberg bei Graz." The lower image shows a village street scene with several people in traditional clothing standing on a curved road between plastered houses with tiled roofs. A caption above this lower view reads "Anton Suppan's Gasthaus 'zur Alpe.'" The overall print is in monochrome/sepia, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a cobblestone square lined with multi‑story buildings. On the left are tall residential/commercial facades with shop awnings and a horse‑drawn cart. In the center background a street rises uphill between buildings. The right side shows trees and a small square with an obelisk‑like monument and a cylindrical advertising column. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square. At the top of the card in red text it reads "Wurzen." on the left and "Wettinerplatz." on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of tall rock pillars and cliffs in a rugged landscape. At the bottom margin there is printed text in Greek, including the word "ΜΕΤΕΩΡΑ" followed by further Greek words in brackets, and partly visible Latin characters on the right. The style and tone suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A monochrome vintage street scene showing a wide, busy urban street lined with multi‑storey brick buildings in late‑19th / early‑20th‑century style. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move along the street. Church spires rise in the background. Printed captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen" and "Molenstraat," and there is cursive handwriting across the lower margin.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a river with a metal truss bridge and riverbank promenade. Behind the bridge stands a row of multi‑story historic buildings and a church tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock. On the hillside above the town are fortification walls and buildings, and to the right a prominent clock tower on the hill. Printed title text appears along the upper edge, and a commercial building bears painted signage.

A black‑and‑white vintage Christmas and New Year greeting postcard. The left side contains Swedish printed text in decorative Gothic script wishing a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year, along with the sender's name and the business imprint "STRÖMS JERNHANDEL, Strömsund." The right side has address lines with a typed/printed addressee "Handl. K.V. Lindberg, Hafsnäs." In the top right corner there is a 5 öre Swedish postage stamp marked "SVERIGE." There is no photographic image of a place, only text.

Black‑and‑white image of a street with traditional half‑timbered houses and ornate wooden balconies. Several people stand on the sidewalk in early‑20th‑century clothing, and a small steam locomotive with carriages passes on tracks at the right edge. Mature trees line the street; one large tree dominates the right foreground. The architecture mixes plastered walls with visible timber framing typical of Central European towns.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a sloping meadow with wooden railings and young fir trees in the foreground. On the upper slope there are several large villa-style houses and, to the right, a small church-like building with a tower, all backed by dense coniferous forest. In the sky area at upper right the caption reads "Oberbärenburg i. sächs. Erzgeb."

Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural railway station with a train of wooden carriages at the platform. A group of people stand along the platform in front of a long, low station building with a tiled roof and chimneys. There is a tall telegraph or signal pole near the train and trees and fields in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads "Siringe", and publisher information appears faintly below.

Colorized vintage view of a large fortified complex with high stone walls and a tall cylindrical tower, surrounded by smaller buildings and trees with mountains in the background. A person in dark clothing stands in the open space in the foreground. At the top of the image, red text reads "Trento, Castello del buon Consiglio."

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a straight, elegant street lined with multi‑story residential buildings with classical facades. People, including children and a man with a cart, stand in the middle of the quiet street. In the background, framed by mountains, there is a church-like building with a round rose window and a bulbous dome-topped bell tower. At the top in red lettering it reads: "Trento — Via Alessandro Vittoria."

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a town with straight, tree‑lined streets, detached houses and some larger institutional buildings. The settlement lies on relatively flat terrain with open countryside and low hills in the background. In the lower left corner there is a small caption printed in a sans‑serif font.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with dense rows of houses, church towers and a large Gothic cathedral dominating the left side of the skyline. The foreground shows open fields leading toward the town. The bottom half of the card is blank for writing, with the town name printed in red and the publisher's credit in small type.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large multi‑storey school building with a central tower-like section and steep, complex rooflines. The structure features many tall windows in vertical rows and sits behind a fence with small trees in front. The printed captions in German at the top identify the city and the school.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a river with fast-moving water and a suspension-style bridge crossing it. A train or tram is visible on the bridge, with smoke rising from a locomotive. Forested banks and rocky shores frame the scene, and there is a small wooden jetty or pier in the foreground. Printed red text in Swedish appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large, ornate, ivy‑covered villa or small palace on a wooded hillside. The central building has a tall, decorative tower with pinnacles and Gothic‑revival details, flanked by wings with arched loggias and domed or balustraded roofs. In front is a terraced garden with paths, low stone walls, small trees and shrubs. To the far left stands a separate, older-looking round masonry tower or ruin partly hidden by trees. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century postcard view of a romantic castle-like residence set in landscaped grounds.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a grand neoclassical colonnade with arches and statues on the balustrade above. In front of the building, a dense crowd of people in early 20th‑century clothing walks along a riverside promenade. On the lower left margin, cursive text reads "Karlsbad. Mühlbrunn". The card has a white border with a scalloped edge.

Black‑and‑white view of a planned residential square with a landscaped central garden, low hedges, a sand or gravel area, and a raised rectangular feature in the middle. Surrounding the square are uniform two‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of early 20th‑century German housing estates. A central street leads through an archway in the background building. A tall lamppost stands in the foreground. In the lower left corner the caption reads "Naumburg a. d. Saale".

Colorized postcard view of an Ottoman mosque courtyard with an octagonal ablution fountain surrounded by columns and a green domed roof. People and pigeons are visible around the fountain, with arcaded cloisters and domes of the mosque in the background. Printed text at the bottom includes the word 'CONSTANTINOPLE' and a French caption describing the courtyard fountain of a mosque.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an interior chapel or side aisle in a historic church or cathedral. The image centers on a stone doorway framed by classical columns and an ornate entablature. Above the doorway is a sculpted relief of the Pietà (the Virgin Mary holding the body of Christ, with other figures) set within an architectural frame. Latin text is inscribed above the relief. The vaulted walls are decorated with draped, carved swags, and there is a simple metal railing in the foreground. Handwritten marks or numbers appear near the lower corners of the image.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European industrial town nestled in a valley with forested hills in the background. In the foreground are farmhouses and small industrial buildings with pitched roofs and a tall factory smokestack. Further back, there is a row of multi‑story residential houses following a curving road or river. The scene shows a mix of rural fields, scattered trees, and compact town buildings, typical of an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century industrial settlement.

Sepia-toned postcard-style photograph showing a tall, multi-story stone bell tower (campanile) attached to or standing beside a church building. The tower has arched openings on each level and a small cross on top. Leafless trees frame part of the scene. At the top of the image there is a printed Greek caption, and at the bottom a small website watermark.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street in a small town. On the left are substantial brick-and-plaster buildings with decorative façades, one with a balcony and arched windows. On the right runs a long wooden fence with leafed trees behind it. A few people walk along the wide dirt road. At the top of the image is printed the caption "Fra Elverum".

A monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with clustered houses and a prominent church with a tall spire on a hill. In the foreground there are open fields, and in the background trees line the horizon. Below the image there is a caption in Latvian.

A monochrome postcard view of a wide river in the foreground with tree branches framing the scene from the left. Across the water, on a rocky, elevated bank, stands a tall neo‑Gothic church with a spire. In the distance there appears to be a bridge over the river. In the upper right corner, printed in red, is the caption 'Kyrkan med fallen.'

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a valley, seen from a wooded hillside with a tall tree in the foreground. Fields and forests surround a dense built‑up area with churches and multi‑storey buildings, backed by low mountains under a cloudy sky. Caption text appears in German along the bottom border.

Black-and-white street view showing a broad boulevard with tram tracks and overhead wires, lined with neoclassical buildings and a long fence with columns on the right. In the background a rocky hill with a small structure on top rises above trees. Vintage automobiles and pedestrians are visible. Printed captions in Greek and English appear along the bottom border, and a website watermark is faintly visible across the image.

Black‑and‑white image of a rural scene with a uniformed mailman walking along a dirt driveway carrying letters and a bag toward a small wooden house. A mid‑century car is parked beside the house. In the foreground on the right is the front of a postal van bearing a crown emblem and a stylized post horn. Forested hills and a mountain rise in the background, suggesting a northern countryside.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic complex with steep gabled roofs and church-like spires standing on a wooded hillside above a valley with scattered town buildings and a factory chimney. The caption in red German text appears at the top right on a blank sky background.

Colorized view of a European city scene showing a church with a tall green steeple and clock tower on the left and a large ornate opera house on the right, separated by a tree-lined square with a tram or bus and pedestrians. The caption at the top right reads in German: "Graz. Evangelische Kirche und Opernhaus."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view taken from a wooded shoreline, looking through tall pine trees toward a long, narrow wooden pier or jetty that extends out into a calm body of water. Low forested land is visible on the opposite shore. The word "Lovisa" is printed in simple type at the upper left.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooded, hilly landscape with a winding path or road in the foreground and tall trees framing the right side. On a distant hilltop to the left stand a domed sanctuary and a bell tower rising above the forest. The caption at the bottom margin reads "MONTAGNAGA DI PINÈ".

A black-and-white postcard view over a European city from an elevated hillside. In the right foreground stands a small historic chapel-like building with arched windows and ivy on its walls, beside stone terraces, a path, and a small turreted structure. Below and to the left stretches a dense townscape of multi‑storey buildings along a river, with industrial facilities and chimneys visible further back. Low hills or mountains form the background. Along the bottom border there is a handwritten-style German caption.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad, tree‑lined street with a cobblestone surface and several pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. Dominating the background is a tall round tower with a richly decorated Gothic spire and pinnacles, belonging to the Schlosskirche (Castle Church). Printed text at the top right identifies the location as Wittenberg and the street as Dessauer Straße with the Castle Church.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small village nestled in a hilly, wooded landscape. Traditional multi‑story houses with steep gabled roofs line a narrow valley, with more villas and guesthouses scattered on the slopes above. Forested hills surround the settlement. In the upper left corner, the word "Rathen." is printed in red type.

Black‑and‑white rural scene showing an old water mill complex beside a narrow mill stream. Several wooden and half‑timbered buildings with steep shingled roofs stand among large trees. Water is visibly cascading from a sluice or waterwheel area into the channel. In the foreground are a grassy lawn and a wildflower meadow bordered by bushes and trees. The overall style evokes an early‑20th‑century European countryside. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a city with wooded hills in the background. In the foreground is a lake or pond with many people rowing small boats. Behind the trees along the shore stands a prominent building with a tower and spire. Beyond this, the city of Graz spreads up the hillside. Printed text at the top in German identifies the scene as a view over the city from Hilmteich.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a gently sloping cobbled road lined with multi‑story townhouses and commercial buildings. A horse‑drawn carriage is visible farther down the street. The architecture appears late 19th–early 20th century European. At the top center there is printed caption text indicating the location as Borna in the Leipzig district and naming the street Grimmaerstraße. Shop signage such as "Richard Schürmer" is visible on the corner building.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a young woman standing in front of a stone wall. She is dressed in traditional Pueblo attire, including a dark shawl wrapped around her head and shoulders, layered clothing with an apron-like garment, leggings, and jewelry. The bottom margin contains a caption identifying her and the location.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a tall, skeletal wooden structure resembling an old windmill or water-lifting device standing on a stone base in a rural landscape. Bare trees and a few farm buildings or houses stand nearby. At the bottom left there is a printed caption in a serif font.

A black‑and‑white view of a riverside promenade with several multi‑storey 19th‑century buildings. In the foreground is an ornate wrought‑iron bridge railing and a shallow riverbed. Along the opposite bank stand grand hotels and cafes with awnings and shutters; horse‑drawn carriages wait in front. The most prominent building bears the sign "Hôtel Paradies" with "Café & Restaurant" at street level, and another sign reading "Paradies Hôtel". The scene suggests a spa or resort town in central Europe in the late 19th or early 20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small hilltop village surrounded by dense coniferous forest. A cluster of traditional multi‑storey houses and pensions stands on gently sloping fields with a path leading through the meadows. The village is framed by forested hills under an overcast sky. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge.

A color aerial view over a small, dense town with light‑colored masonry buildings and dark roofs surrounded by abundant green trees. In the background there is a large lake or wide river with forested hills along the far shore under a blue sky with scattered clouds. The architecture looks Northern European, with low‑rise blocks and some wooden houses; there is no prominent single monument, just a harmonious townscape by the water.

Black-and-white postcard view of a quiet street lined with early 20th‑century houses. In the foreground is a circular traffic island with a small monument or pedestal at its center. Trees line both sides of the street, and the sky is partly cloudy. At the bottom left is a caption indicating the place and street name.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a hilltop castle complex overlooking a dense town in a river valley, framed by trees in the foreground. The castle consists of several connected, plain-roofed buildings sitting on a steep, wooded slope. In the distance a tall, slender Gothic-style church tower rises above the town's pitched-roof houses. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard from Central Europe. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the front.

Color-tinted vintage postcard view over a body of water toward a line of traditional Dutch windmills and low farm or warehouse buildings along the shore. A sailing boat is visible on the water. The card has printed captions at the top edge.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Renaissance-style town hall building on a broad square. The façade has multiple gabled dormers, many rectangular windows, and a small central tower. In front of the building are two ornate Gothic-style fountains or monuments enclosed by railings. People are sparsely visible in the square. At the top left, printed text reads "Wittenberg — Rathaus". Commercial buildings with painted signage line the right side of the square.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a tree-lined riverside or promenade beside an old building with a cylindrical tower and conical roof. A woman in early 20th‑century clothing walks along a path covered with leaves; simple wooden fences and benches run along the left. The image has a white border with scalloped edges and handwritten captions at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a neoclassical villa with a tiled roof, tall shuttered windows, and a columned veranda. The house is surrounded by vegetation and trees, with mountains faintly visible in the background. Printed captions appear at the top indicating the name of the villa and its location in Greece, along with the word 'PANCION'. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is overlaid at the bottom.

A color postcard showing a snowy winter scene of a grand historic square. In the foreground stands a chimney sweep carrying ladders. To the right is a large neo‑Renaissance city hall building with a central dome and towers, fronted by a fountain and market stalls covered in snow. The left side shows old townhouses with colorful shutters along a street. Yellow German text at the top reads a New Year greeting from Graz, and a caption at the bottom names the location as the main square and Herrengasse.

Colorized vintage postcard depicting a stone sculpture group of a bearded river god with flowing hair and drapery, accompanied by putti, seated on a platform in the middle of a reflective pond or lake. The statue stands in a formal palace garden with dense trees in the background at dusk. Printed German text appears at the top center identifying the location as the palace garden in Schwetzingen and the specific sculpture group.

Colorized panoramic view of a town and military complex. In the foreground are residential buildings with red roofs and a distinctive round brick structure with a conical roof. Beyond this lie large barracks‑like buildings and open training fields, stretching into a flat rural landscape under a light sky. Red German text is printed at the top of the image indicating the place and the view toward specific barracks and an airfield.

Antique hand‑colored multi‑view postcard with floral decorations, showing four small images: a school building labeled "Schule", a manor or castle front labeled "Schloss", an inner castle courtyard labeled "Schlosshof", and a village square with a chapel labeled "Ortsplatz m. d. Kapelle." In the center is the caption "Gruss aus Enzowann." The border is ornate with pink flowers, and there is printing information along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a quiet village street lined with gabled houses. A horse‑drawn cart stands on the left side near an inn or guesthouse, and a small child is visible in the middle of the unpaved road. The architecture is typical of early 20th‑century Central Europe. Printed at the top in German is the caption identifying the place and the specific street.

Multi-view color postcard showing different scenes of a lakeside town surrounded by mountains. Images include a waterfront with a sailing boat, palm trees, a clock tower near a building labeled 'Hotel Sole', aerial and promenade views of the town along the lake, and a fortified, ivy-covered building by the water. A red band across the center carries the greeting text indicating the location.

Color panoramic view of a mid‑20th‑century European city in a wide valley surrounded by high, steep mountains. The foreground shows residential houses with gardens and a railway line, while the middle ground contains a dense urban area with red‑tiled roofs and several mid‑rise modern buildings, including a prominent long, terraced office or civic building. In the distance, the city center with church towers and historic cores is visible. The background is dominated by dramatic rocky mountain walls under a blue sky. Two red hand‑drawn lines arc across the mountains, seemingly marking a route or geological feature. No printed caption or text is visible on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the small town of Groitzsch. In the foreground are trees, garden plots and farm buildings; behind them a dense cluster of houses and, on the right, a large church with a tall tower and steep roof dominates the skyline. Industrial chimneys and a water tower are visible in the distant background. The image caption is printed in red German script at the top.

An illustrated postcard showing a stylized riverside view of a large neo‑Gothic building with a central dome and many spires, seen from across a wide river with small boats in the foreground. Below the image are printed captions in Hungarian and German indicating that the building is the Parliament in Budapest.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate exhibition hall in Secession/Art Nouveau style, with towers at each end and a decorative façade featuring multiple clover-shaped windows and arches. In front of the building are planted young trees and several tall flagpoles bearing long vertical flags. There are low hills in the background. Red printed Hungarian text appears at the top, and a large purple handwritten signature is across the sky area.

A vertically arranged postcard showing three black‑and‑white photographs of early 20th‑century cycling events, all mounted on a decorative clover‑patterned backing. The top image depicts a parade or mass start of cyclists on high‑wheel and safety bicycles riding along a city street lined with spectators and shops. The middle image shows a group of male cyclists posing together, some in racing jerseys, with a bicycle in the foreground. The bottom image captures a steeply banked velodrome track with a motorcycle pacer and cyclists racing along the concrete wall while spectators watch from above. Handwritten German captions are visible on the photographs, mentioning Dresden and Leipzig and naming winning riders.

Vintage monochrome postcard featuring two circular images of classical marble heads on a plain background. The left shows the head of the orator Demosthenes, the right the head of Melpomene. Greek and French captions identify the figures, and the word 'ΑΘΗΝΑΙ – ATHÈNES' appears at the top. A small emblem of the Hellenic postal service and French publishing note are printed at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal city with a long, wide pier or waterfront promenade extending into the water. Low-rise buildings line the shore, and a range of mountains with snow-capped peaks rises in the background. A few small human figures walk along the pier. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, and a small publisher's logo appears in the lower right corner.

An old monochrome postcard view over a dense hillside city with low houses and tiled roofs. In the right foreground are segments of old stone fortification walls running along the ridge; in the distance on the right a larger citadel-like section of walls crowns the hill. Printed French captions identify the scene as the upper town and ramparts of Salonique. A modern web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neo‑baroque theater building at night with a bright full moon in the sky. People are gathered in the square in front of the building. The left margin has vertical printer information, and below the image is a caption identifying the building as the Croatian National Theater. The right half of the card is filled with handwritten message text, with a red printed heading at the top indicating Zagreb/Agram and a year notation.

A colored vintage postcard showing a calm coastal landscape with green hills in the background, a tree‑covered shoreline with tall cypress trees and a house on a small promontory, a boat with two people on still water, and a small ruined arch or gateway near the shore. The caption in French at the top identifies the scene as being near the village of Ipsos on Corfu. A website watermark appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white vintage street view of a small town with wooden houses lining a dirt road that rises uphill through trees. In the foreground three children stand barefoot in the middle of the unpaved street. On the left corner is a wooden building with signage reading "JOH. WALTON…". At the top left of the image is printed the caption "Jyväskylä", indicating the town. Utility poles and simple early‑20th‑century architecture suggest an old Northern European setting.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large neo‑Gothic brick complex seen from across a tree‑lined street. The central block has pointed‑arch windows in several stories, decorative brick gables with pinnacles, and a tall flagpole flying a plain flag. A monumental pointed arch gateway in matching brick leads through a forecourt in the middle of an iron fence; people are visible walking near the gate and under the arch. The long wings of the building extend left and right in the same style, giving the impression of a major institutional building such as a barracks, school, or hospital.

A vintage, monochrome postcard depicting a long brick railway station building with ornate brickwork and tall chimneys. There are railway tracks in the foreground, a platform with a few people and carts, and telegraph poles and a lamp post along the track. The text at the top left reads "Walk / Raudteejaam." indicating the name of the station in Estonian.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a forested landscape with a sandy path running through dense trees and bushes. In the background, a small bridge or viaduct carries a tram or train across the scene. At the bottom right, printed text reads "Berg en Dal. Mooi Nederland."

Black-and-white postcard showing a long rectangular two‑storey building on a hillside, identified as the municipal hospital of Xanthi. The structure has many windows, simple neoclassical lines, and a small central entrance projection. There are hills in the background and rough, undeveloped terrain in the foreground. Printed captions in Greek and French appear below the image, and a web address is faintly watermarked across the lower right.

Sepia-toned historical street scene showing a festive horse-drawn carriage lavishly decorated with flowers. Two horses stand on a cobblestone street in front of a grand late‑19th/early‑20th‑century building. The carriage is covered with floral garlands and wheels wrapped in flowers; elegantly dressed men in top hats and women in large hats sit inside, one holding a parasol. A large crowd in period clothing gathers around and looks on from the street and the building's balconies. Signs with Cyrillic lettering are visible on the facade.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a paved ancient street flanked by ruins in Pompeii. On the right side stand the remains of a temple platform and walls, with steps leading up from the street. The caption in Italian is printed at the top left.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a seated Hopi man in a stone-walled interior, carving and painting a small figure. Various carved figures and cylindrical pieces of wood are scattered around him on the floor and ledges. Handwritten caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small settlement with wooden houses and farm buildings surrounded by open fields and a river or lake in the background. The architecture is Northern European, with simple gabled houses. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small oval publisher/photographer logo appears at the bottom right.

Colorized vintage view of a small rural village street bordered by modest houses with pitched roofs, fenced gardens, and laundry hanging on a wooden fence in the foreground. The street curves through the settlement, telegraph poles line the road, and wooded hills and fields rise in the background. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a powerful river rapid or waterfall rushing through a rocky gorge lined with dense trees. On the left bank stands a multi‑storey light‑colored building close to the turbulent water. In the distance the river drops further under a pastel sunset sky. Handwritten cursive text is visible along the bottom margin, with faint printed captions beneath the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a bust of Otto von Bismarck atop an ornate pedestal surrounded by a decorative wrought‑iron fence and wreaths. Behind the monument stands a multi‑story residential building with dormer windows and balconies, framed by trees along a street or small square.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large brick convent building with a mansard roof behind a formal courtyard lined with pruned trees. Several women and children are visible walking or standing in the open area, which is labeled as tennis courts. The scene has an early-20th‑century European feel. Printed caption text appears at the top right.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a waterfront cityscape. Large classical buildings stand along the opposite shore, including a prominent rectangular palace-like structure. A church spire rises in the distance. In the foreground is a wide promenade with trees, vintage street lamps and a few pedestrians. Printed caption text appears at the top right.

Black‑and‑white postcard image showing vaulted arcades opening onto a busy urban square. Two men in early 20th‑century dress stand under the arches near advertising columns. In the background is an ornate historicist building with a dome and statues, carts or stalls, and shop signs. German text is visible on advertising boards and hanging signs. Along the bottom border, a caption identifies the location as arcades at the square in Graz.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural monastery complex nestled in a hilly, wooded landscape. The main building is a two‑storey structure with tiled roof and several windows, adjacent to a small church with arches and a square belfry or tower. Dense trees and shrubs surround the buildings. Greek text is printed vertically along the right side, and the website address 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower part of the image.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate historic room with a large fireplace, classical paintings, a chandelier, carved columns, a long table with chairs, and a bust near a tall window. The caption at the bottom identifies the room as the famous wedding chamber in the town hall of Nijmegen.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large bronze statue of a medieval Hungarian warrior on a high pedestal, overlooking a cityscape with church towers and the Danube River in the background. People sit and stand around the monument's base. The bottom margin bears printed captions in Hungarian and German identifying the location as Budapest and the Hunyadi statue.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal panorama of a small town along a bay backed by steep hills. Low buildings line the shoreline and a larger complex stands slightly elevated. The sea occupies the foreground. Printed captions in French and Greek describe the view as a souvenir from Crete and a view of Souda Bay.

Sepia-toned historic view of a spa complex with grand buildings along a tree-lined promenade and a stone bridge in the foreground. The architecture features large roofs, arched windows, and decorative sculptures on the bridge balustrade. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. Printed title text at the top right reads "Bad Elster. Kgl. Albertbad."

Colorized vintage postcard showing a passenger steamship in a narrow canal, moored beside a towpath and a flight of locks surrounded by trees. Printed red text at the top identifies the location as a section of the Göta Canal and the Borenshult locks. The ship's name is faintly visible on the side of the superstructure.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a square with a prominent stone fountain or monument at its center, surrounded by low buildings and trees. People and horse-drawn carriages appear in the background. The top of the card contains printed bilingual text in French and English identifying it as a souvenir from Salonica and mentioning 'The White Fountain'. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large Romanesque‑Revival Catholic church with twin square towers, a rose window, and an arched main portal. The church stands at the top of a stairway, surrounded by trees and landscaped paths. In the foreground, a woman in early 20th‑century clothing stands near a path and a small cart. The right half of the card is mostly blank for writing. Red printed text at the top identifies the church and location; additional red text appears along the bottom edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large outdoor café or beer‑garden set beneath rows of tall trees. Numerous small tables and chairs with patterned tablecloths fill the foreground, with many waiters and waitresses in aprons standing ready. On the left is a long glass‑fronted pavilion with ornate decoration; on the right is a multi‑story European building with storefronts at ground level. The image border suggests a printed postcard, and faint inverted text appears along the edges.

Black‑and‑white view over a historic European town with steeply pitched tiled roofs and a large Gothic-style church dominating the scene. The church has a tall square tower with a spire and cross, attached to a long nave roof. In the foreground to the right is a tree‑lined terrace or promenade on top of a stone wall where a person stands at a railing, overlooking the town. The background shows a wide river plain or valley and distant industrial chimneys. No printed text or caption is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a busy European square lined with early 20th‑century buildings. People in period clothing gather at outdoor café tables and walk through the square. A two‑storey corner building bears an awning sign reading "MATARASSO‑SARAGOUSSI et ROUSSO." At the bottom, bilingual French‑English captions describe the view as a corner of Republic Place in Salonique/Salonica.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with cobblestone streets. A large, multi‑story building labeled "Hôtel zur grünen Tanne" dominates the right side, with horse‑drawn carriage, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, and surrounding historic townhouses. In the background a tall church tower rises above the roofs. At the top in red script it reads "Zwickau. Regierungsplatz und Schulstraße." indicating the depicted square and street.

Sepia-toned view along a riverside promenade with trees and pedestrians on the left and a bridge crossing the river toward a historic cityscape. A baroque-style church tower with an onion dome stands prominently on the right, with densely packed buildings at the base of a steep hill. On top of the hill are fortification structures and, to the right, a clock tower. The image caption at the bottom reads "GRAZ, an der Mur."

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a naval destroyer steaming at sea, with smoke coming from multiple funnels and sailors visible on deck. A smaller group of warships appears on the horizon to the right. The sea is choppy and the sky is cloudy. There is printed text at the bottom identifying the ship as 'Jagaren Wale.' and publisher information at the lower right. An artist's signature and date appear at the lower left.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town taken from an elevated position, showing foreground allotment gardens divided into small fenced plots with sheds and a few people working. Behind them are farm buildings, barns, and houses with steep roofs. In the distant background, several prominent church spires and towers rise above a low, hazy skyline, giving the impression of an old historic town surrounded by rural land.

A monochrome panoramic view over a small town and river valley, seen from an elevated terrace or promenade with a stone-and-wood railing and ornamental flower pots in the foreground. The town with clustered houses and fields stretches across the background. Red printed German captions at the top read the location and viewpoint, and a red handwritten number appears on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large stone-and-plaster building with strong early‑20th‑century modernist / National Romantic features. The façade has tall vertical windows, a large gable with an emblem or coat of arms, and massive stone walls. Attached to the side is a distinctive rounded tower-like volume with a conical roof. Behind, higher roof structures with rounded caps are visible. In front, a street scene shows a tram on the left, several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, a horse-drawn cart, and an early automobile on the right, indicating an urban European setting of that era. The postcard border is plain and aged, with no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a Protestant-style church, showing rows of wooden pews leading up to an apse with an altar rail, altar table, large hanging chandeliers, and three tall arched windows with stained glass. A raised pulpit with a canopy stands on the left wall, hymn boards hang on both sides, and flower arrangements and candlesticks decorate the altar area. At the bottom right, printing indicates a photo credit and publisher information.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, ornate war memorial column standing on an octagonal stone base, surrounded by short posts with chains and trees in the background. The top of the card bears printed German text identifying the location and monument. The central pillar carries carved plaques with names and decorative reliefs.

Black‑and‑white image of a small railway station complex beside several train tracks. A steam locomotive with freight wagons is arriving or departing on the right, emitting a large plume of smoke. The main station building is a large two‑storey structure with stone lower walls, timber framing and wooden cladding above, in a Central or Northern European vernacular style. People stand by the tracks; two men are working on the roof, and a person looks out from an upstairs window. A low wooden fence runs along the platform. A sign with the word "EINGANG" is visible near the entrance.

Black‑and‑white view over a quiet European town street with cobblestones and early‑20th‑century houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. Trees line a small triangular island or square at a fork in the road, with a kiosk or pavilion beneath them. In the distance, two prominent church towers with baroque / neo‑baroque spires and crosses rise above the low roofs. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.

Vintage sepia postcard depicting a classical colonnaded terrace with several statues of draped female figures (Muses) in front of a building richly decorated with murals. The architecture is neoclassical, with tall columns and a partially visible interior. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, and there is additional Greek text along the right margin. A website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears over the image.

Colorized historical postcard showing a two‑storey sanatorium building with a large wrap‑around veranda and red tiled roof. Several people, possibly staff and patients, stand or sit on the veranda and in front of the entrance. Leafless trees frame the scene, suggesting late autumn or early spring. At the top left there is a red medical cross symbol and printed text in pre‑reform Russian orthography. A small imprint appears in the bottom‑right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century industrial complex with multi‑storey brick mill buildings and two tall smokestacks. The factory is situated in a valley with a town of dense masonry houses and low hills in the background. Trees frame the foreground on the left and right, suggesting the view is taken from an elevated vantage point overlooking the factory district.

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped spa park with tall trees, curving walking paths, manicured lawns, and a terrace lined with many white chairs. A few people sit on the chairs in the foreground. At the bottom right the caption reads in German: "Bad Elster Kurpark an der Wandelhalle".

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, elegant 19th‑century villa or institutional building on a hillside, with a central square tower and wings on both sides. The structure has a mansard-like roof with dormer windows, classical decorative elements over the windows, and a long veranda or terrace facing the foreground. In front of it is a terraced garden with curved paths, trees without leaves (likely winter or early spring), and retaining walls leading down toward a fenced road with tram or electric poles. In the distant background, there are rolling hills with scattered buildings, including a solitary structure on top of a hill. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

An old Russian Imperial postal card with pre-printed Cyrillic text. At the top it reads 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (Postcard). The left upper corner bears the double-headed imperial eagle emblem. On the right is a boxed area for a stamp with printed text, and circular black postal cancellation marks showing a date (likely 11.6.16). The rest of the card is filled with handwritten address information in cursive Cyrillic, and there is a printed line of instructions at the bottom indicating that only the address is to be written on this side. At the lower right, small print includes the word 'Киевск.' indicating production in the Kiev postal district.

A sepia-toned photographic portrait postcard of an elderly man with a large white beard, dressed in a military-style uniform with medals. He is seated in an elegant interior with paneled walls, resting one arm on a table. The caption at the bottom identifies him as the Grand Duke of Baden, and there is a printed date of 28 September 1907 along with the publisher's imprint in small text.

A vintage sepia-toned photograph of a large steel truss bridge spanning a wide river. The bridge rests on massive stone piers and dominates the composition from the lower left to the upper right. Trees and low buildings line the far riverbank. At the bottom of the image there is a caption in a serif font that identifies the bridge as "Daugavpils-Grīvas tilts." The overall style and wear suggest an early–20th-century postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard view from a rocky lookout over a densely forested hillscape with a large lake and islands visible in the distance. The scene is natural and hilly, covered with coniferous trees under a cloudy sky. The word "Koli." appears in small type at the lower left, and the number "151" at the lower right.

Black-and-white photograph of a wooded park scene with a small rustic wooden footbridge crossing a narrow stream. Dense trees and foliage surround the water, and sunlight filters through the leaves. At the bottom of the image there is a caption identifying the location as part of Kloster St. Marienstern park.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm lake with rocky, tree‑covered shoreline in the foreground and a townscape in the distance. The town includes several low buildings and a prominent church tower. A small rowboat is visible near the rocks. Printed text at the top identifies the view as Wänersborg with a note that it is a view from Dalbobergen.

A colored vintage postcard showing a rural, hilly landscape with scattered vegetation, ruins barely visible among the greenery, distant mountains, and a body of water in the background. At the top left, there is printed text in Greek and French indicating the subject and location. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.

Black-and-white winter scene of a small snowy town or village. A wide snow-covered street runs downhill between wooden houses and a plain three-story building with shops on the ground floor. Two children are walking or pulling sleds along the road. Evergreen and leafless trees surround the buildings, and there are low wooded hills in the background. Christmas lights appear strung between some trees and over a fence, and there are a few road signs partly buried in snow.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded street procession in a historic European city. Large stone buildings with ornate facades line the street, with spectators watching from windows and balconies. The street is filled with uniformed men marching, followed by costumed figures on horseback wearing capes and headpieces, observed by dense crowds on both sides. Printed French text appears at the top of the card describing the event and location.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a grand seafront hotel building with several balconies and an arched central façade, labeled at the top in red print "Crikvenica" on the left and "Gr. Hotel Miramare" on the right. In the foreground are trees, a garden path, and people walking or gathered in front of the hotel. The reverse side contains dense handwritten text in German, an address written in large cursive, a green postage stamp, postmark, and archival stickers or labels.

A monochrome postcard view of a courtyard framed by leafless trees and simple wooden fencing. Historic masonry buildings with tiled roofs, small windows, and decorative stonework surround the yard. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the economic courtyard of the Fürstenschule St. Afra in Meissen. A red handwritten archival or catalog number appears above the printed caption.

Vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a seated woman in an ornate light-colored gown with lace details, long gloves, and multiple rings, draped in a fur-trimmed cloak. She leans her head on one hand and gazes toward the camera. The background is plain, and the image has a narrow border typical of early photographic postcards. At the bottom is the printed name "AINO ACKTÉ," and along the left edge in small letters appears "ALBIN, PARIS."

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large ceremonial parade along a city street lined with multi‑story European-style buildings and dense crowds on both sides. A mounted figure in elaborate historical armor rides at the center toward a large temporary triumphal arch decorated with garlands and inscriptions. Many spectators wear early 20th‑century clothing and military uniforms, some watching from balconies. Cyrillic text is printed along the bottom border of the image.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a rural village surrounded by fields and woodland. In the mid‑ground is a clustered settlement with a church featuring a bulbous steeple, farmhouses, and other small buildings spread across gently rolling agricultural land. At the top of the image, printed in red Gothic-style letters, is the caption identifying the place.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small market square in a historic European town. In the foreground is an octagonal fountain with a statue. Around the square are half-timbered and plastered houses with steep tiled roofs. At the center background stands an ornate gatehouse with a decorative gable, statues, and an arched passageway. Behind the town, rolling hills and fields form the landscape. Printed captions identify the scene as the market of Lauenstein in the Erzgebirge (Ore Mountains). A red handwritten number is in the upper right.

Vintage tinted photographic postcard showing a panoramic view of the alpine town of Predazzo set in a narrow valley between steep, forested mountains. In the foreground are clustered buildings with light façades and tiled roofs; a tall church with a slender spire dominates the town center. In the background, high mountain peaks (the Dolomites) rise above layered ridges. There is cursive handwriting in ink across the top margin, and printed caption text along the bottom reading about Predazzo and Cimon della Pala.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a dense street procession with crowds lining both sides of a narrow city street. At the front are men in formal dark clothing and hats, some wearing sashes or ceremonial regalia, followed by uniformed participants and flag bearers. The façades are tall European-style buildings with arched windows. The caption at the bottom is printed in both French and Dutch.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a small townscape beside a pond or river. Several houses and a larger multi-storey building stand on a gentle slope above the water, surrounded by trees. The foreground shows reeds and reflections in the water. At the top left, German text is printed, identifying the location.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a European town from an elevated vantage point. In the foreground is a landscaped park or garden with winding paths, trees, and terraced slopes. Industrial chimneys rise among dense trees and rooftops. Beyond, a compact townscape of gabled houses and low buildings spreads out, dominated near the center by a large historic church or town-hall–like tower with a baroque or late‑Gothic spire. Low hills form the distant background. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image.

A black‑and‑white street view of a mid‑20th‑century town. The scene shows a relatively wide street lined with multi‑storey functionalist buildings. In the left foreground is a two‑storey building with large windows and flags; a sign reads "APOTEK" indicating a pharmacy on the ground floor. Period automobiles and a few pedestrians are visible along the street. At the bottom left and right corners there is white caption text identifying the location and the photo/publisher details.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a historic market square. On the left stands a large Gothic church with a tall clock tower and arched windows, opening onto the square. In front and to the right are several multi‑story townhouses with shops at street level, their facades bearing business names. Behind them rise wooded slopes and additional buildings. The title "Meissen. Markt." appears at the top, and the left margin lists the publisher.

A sepia-toned postcard showing large stone ruins in the foreground, likely the remains of a medieval fortress wall or tower with an arched opening. Behind the ruins is a small town with wooden houses and a prominent church featuring two tall spires dominating the skyline. The image has a wide border, and the bottom-left corner bears a printed caption with the place name.

Sepia-toned interior view of an old Byzantine-style church or cathedral, showing stone columns with capitals, arches, an ornate chandelier, and an iconostasis with religious icons and candles. The image is framed by a postcard-style border, with a caption in French at the bottom and a modern archive watermark on top.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a mounted cavalryman in parade uniform holding a lance, seated on a horse in a sparse birch forest. The rider wears a traditional helmet and military tunic. Printed captions in German appear beneath the image, including a title identifying the subject as a guard rider from Dresden and publisher information.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small European village street with fenced front gardens, simple two‑storey houses with tiled roofs, and low hills in the background. On the right side stands a larger building with people gathered in front, likely a shop or inn. The printed red caption at the bottom left reads "Gruss aus Andritz," and at the bottom right "Anton Engenhard jun. Gemischtwaren-Handlung."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, slender minaret rising above low village houses and stone ruins in the foreground. The scene is printed with multilingual captions in Greek, French, and another Latin transcription identifying the place as the minaret of Yenidjé‑Vardar in picturesque Macedonia (Greece). The layout and style are typical of early 20th‑century touristic or documentary postcards.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a large, ornate castle-like mansion with multiple turrets and a central tower flying a flag. The building stands on a hill, partly screened by mature trees. In the foreground, several well-dressed people in late-19th- or early-20th-century attire sit and stand on an open field, as if picnicking or posing. To the right below the hill are smaller houses or outbuildings with simple roofs. In the distant left background, a tall, slender tower or possible minaret rises above a wooded ridge. No printed caption or other visible text appears on the image.

Vintage sepia postcard showing an outdoor café terrace with many people seated at tables and others standing. The café has a striped awning and large windows; men wear suits and hats, and women wear long dresses and wide‑brimmed hats. A lamppost and small trees line the street in front. Printed captions in French appear at the bottom, along with a website watermark.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade with stone paving and a low sea wall, in front of a row of low buildings and a prominent two‑storey neoclassical corner building. Handwritten text in ink covers the upper part of the image. Along the right side, printed vertical captions in French and Greek identify the view. A web watermark with a modern URL appears near the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural inn or guesthouse complex labeled "Daubnitz. Gasthof." The main building is a two‑storey gabled house with a tiled roof and several windows, surrounded by a fenced garden. A small stream runs along the right side bordered by leafless trees, and a footpath follows the water. In the foreground, a simple wooden fence encloses a yard where a few people stand. The overall appearance suggests an early 20th‑century Central European village scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an inner courtyard with a formal lawn, flowerbed, and young trees in front of a large Renaissance‑style castle complex. The building has high gabled roofs, ornate stepped gables, towers with clock and lantern, and an elaborate arched portal with coats of arms. Text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

Black-and-white image of a rural church with a square tower and a pitched roof, surrounded by a cemetery with gravestones and trees. The style suggests a Northern European, possibly Scandinavian, countryside church. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and right corners.

Colorized panoramic view of a historic harbor with sailing ships and stone quays. Elegant multi‑storey waterfront buildings line the shore, and a dense, tree‑covered hill with more buildings and a prominent tower or minaret rises in the background. Printed caption text in French and Ottoman script appears at the top, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome view of a leafy public square with a central flower bed and fountain in the foreground. Behind the park stands an ornate historic building with arched windows and corner turrets, fronted by a large statue on a pedestal. Streetlamps and surrounding multi‑story urban buildings frame the scene. At the top, printed in red, is the title indicating the location as Chemnitz and the old town hall.

Sepia-toned photograph of an ornate Baroque or Renaissance-style arched gateway in a stuccoed building, framed as a vintage postcard with scalloped edges. The stone portal is richly decorated with scrollwork, medallions, and a sculpted face above the arch. A heavy metal door with diamond panels stands partly open, revealing a cobbled passage and another arched doorway with double doors in the background. The foreground shows a gravel courtyard.

A black‑and‑white image of a richly ornamented late‑19th‑century mansion in a landscaped garden. The house is built of brick with strong horizontal string courses and corner quoining, a steep mansard/hip roof with dormers, and a prominent corner tower. There is a columned porch, stone balustrades, and a glass conservatory or winter garden projecting into the garden. The grounds feature trimmed bushes, several tall conifer trees, and mature deciduous trees forming a frame around the building. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
