A black‑and‑white postcard view over a harbor with calm water. In the foreground a small passenger ship or ferry sails toward the right. To the right shoreline there is a fortification with trees and buildings behind it. In the distance are piers, naval ships and low waterfront buildings. The caption at the bottom left reads "Karlskrona. Kungsbron."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a dense urban neighborhood with rows of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑story buildings featuring ornate facades and gabled roofs. In the foreground is a prominent, elaborate residential or commercial block facing a tree‑lined street, labeled as the Nürnbergerhaus at the Lendkai area of Graz. The background shows tightly packed houses and apartment buildings typical of a Central European city.

A colored postcard showing a richly detailed historical mural or painting framed by vaulted arches and decorative borders. The scene depicts a large group of finely dressed people in Renaissance-style clothing gathered in an outdoor setting, with dogs, children, and nobles interacting. In the background a church or cathedral tower rises above the town. The lower border of the image is decorated with ornamental panels and a doorway, and beneath this is a German caption printed in a decorative script.

Black‑and‑white image of a tree‑lined stone approach to a fortified gatehouse. A large, old tree with spreading branches dominates the foreground at left, overhanging a cobbled path and low stone parapet that lead to an arched entrance in a thick stone wall. Beyond the arch is a heavy wooden door; the masonry appears medieval. On the right in the distance there is a half‑timbered building visible through the mist, suggesting a historic European castle or town fortification. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a busy riverside or port scene with piles of postal parcels in the foreground and workers handling them. In the middle distance there is a small white building with a sign on its roof, and a crowd of civilians and uniformed men gathered near a fenced area with trees behind. A handwritten caption runs across the top of the image in a Nordic language, dated 1917 and mentioning Haparanda.

Black-and-white postcard view of a wide outdoor staircase lined with trees and railings, leading up a hill toward colonial-style buildings. A few people stand or walk on the steps. At the top left of the image is printed text reading 'Cabo Verde - S. Thiago - Entrada da Praia'. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century colonial streetscape at the entrance to the city of Praia on Santiago Island, Cabo Verde.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the ruins of a Byzantine church complex on a rocky hillside. The structure has partially collapsed walls, arched windows and doorways, and a distinctive dome with Byzantine brickwork. Printed captions in several languages appear along the bottom border, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid on the image. In the upper right corner, handwritten-style text identifies the site.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up of Gothic stone sculptures on the façade of a cathedral. Four standing figures in draped robes are set in ornate vertical niches with intricate architectural canopies above and decorative carvings below. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as part of Strasbourg Cathedral and describes the figures as the fiancé and the wise virgins.

Sepia-toned historical beach scene with many wicker beach chairs and people in early 20th‑century clothing strolling, sitting, and playing along the shore. A long wooden pier with a building and flag extends into the sea in the background. Printed captions in German identify the place and the scene.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, four‑story corner building with neoclassical and early‑modern architectural elements: multiple balconies with balustrades, arched windows on the ground and first floors, and decorative cornices. Small early‑20th‑century cars and pedestrians appear in front of the building. There are electric poles and a metal lighting structure in the street. Greek script is visible at the bottom left of the image, and a website watermark appears in the lower right.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfall plunging into a narrow gorge, with industrial buildings and houses above it on the surrounding slopes. Mountains with some snow are visible in the background. Handwritten white text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

A sepia-toned postcard view of an old European town with cobblestone streets and historic houses in the foreground. Two people and a horse walk along the street. In the background rises a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and another tall church spire nearby. Trees and a striped pole stand near the center. At the bottom left, white printed text in German identifies the location as Meissen on the Elbe River and mentions the Freiheit (a square or street) and the cathedral (Dom).

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town or village at the edge of a forested hillside. The foreground shows rows of mature trees and densely packed houses with steep, gabled roofs and stucco facades. Behind them, slightly larger late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century villas and apartment blocks rise up the slope in orderly rows. At the center is a distinctive building with a tall, narrow spire or turret. Fields and a thick coniferous forest cover the upper slopes and background hills. No visible text appears on the front side.

A monochrome postcard showing a waterfall cascading down a rocky forested hillside into a calm body of water in the foreground. Dense coniferous and deciduous trees surround the falls. At the top left, printed text in a serif font reads "Ed.  Vattenfall vid St. Lee." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A multi‑view illustrated postcard with tinted photographs of a river valley and wooded landscape, showing villas and a mill complex by the water and forested cliffs. The images are framed by decorative oak leaves and twigs. Each small view has a German caption such as "Gastwirtschaft mit Garten," "Aus der Vogelschau," "Eingang," "Wappenfelsen," and "Überfahrt." At the bottom right, bold stylized text reads "LAUENHAINER MÜHLE bei MITTWEIDA." A red manuscript number "22252" appears at the top.

Hand‑tinted historic street scene showing a tram marked with the destination "Borna" traveling along a broad avenue lined with multi‑story buildings and trees. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk, and a pavilion or kiosk stands near the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Chemnitz. Hartmannstraße." indicating the location as Hartmannstraße in Chemnitz.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street corner. A sidewalk runs along a fence, with tall mature trees casting shade. In the distance a steepled building, likely a church or seminary structure, rises above the trees. In the foreground, two women in long white dresses carry parasols and walk along the sidewalk, with another figure holding an umbrella further back. Large handwritten numbers in black and red ink appear across the lower center of the image.

Black‑and‑white image showing soldiers drilling in formation in an open sandy yard bordered by young trees. Behind them stands a large two‑storey brick or stucco military building with a gabled roof and several chimneys, surrounded by a tall fence. More uniformed men stand near the fence and buildings, suggesting a barracks or training ground. The style looks early‑20th‑century European.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a rustic wooden log‑cabin interior. The room contains a simple table with a chair by a multi‑pane window, a wooden bed or daybed along the log wall, another plain chair, and an ornate cast‑iron stove on the right. Two small framed pictures hang on the walls. Along the bottom edge is printed descriptive text and a photographer's signature.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century brick school building on a tree‑lined street. People in period clothing and several horse‑drawn carriages stand in front of the building. The caption at the bottom identifies the town and the institution, and the printer's imprint appears in small type.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a rustic stone structure with pointed, gothic-style arches built into a low wall, set in a wooded area. In front is a landscaped garden bed edged with rocks and a cleared path or forecourt. The style and print suggest an early 20th‑century German postcard. There is a short caption printed at the bottom left.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow, slightly curving street lined with tightly packed multi‑story houses with steep tiled roofs. The street slopes gently downward between older masonry buildings; in the distance leafy trees rise above the rooftops, possibly indicating a hill or town wall beyond. At the bottom right corner there is a printed heraldic coat of arms featuring a double‑headed eagle with a small central shield.

Sepia-toned vintage interior photograph of a small shop or café, likely a bakery or confectionery. The room has a wooden floor and a paneled ceiling with a single bare lightbulb hanging from it. Glass display counters along two walls are filled with pastries or sweets, and shelves behind the counters are stocked with tins, boxes, and jars. Several large round hatbox-like containers sit on the top shelves. Three women stand behind the main counter area and a man in a white coat, possibly the proprietor, stands at the rightmost glass case. In the foreground there are tables covered with white cloths and simple wooden chairs, suggesting a place to sit and eat. The print has scalloped edges typical of old postcards or photo prints.

Sepia-toned view of a small river or canal bordered by a footpath and stone wall, with old multi-storey houses on the left and trees on both sides. On the hill behind the houses a larger historic building or castle complex is visible. The scene is tranquil and rural, and printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a rural valley with rolling hills, meadows, and forested slopes. Several large houses or small villas stand in the foreground and midground, with fields and scattered trees surrounding them. A modest church with a steeple is visible further back along the valley road. The printed caption at the top reads "Lauenstein. Schützenhaus. Villa Anna." indicating specific buildings in the scene. On the right edge there is vertical printer information.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a river steamer crowded with passengers in the foreground and a large Gothic hilltop complex with tall spires and steep roofs rising above a town in the background. The boat is moving along a broad river; on the opposite bank are small houses and riverside buildings at the foot of a wooded hill crowned by the imposing cathedral-like structure and castle-like wings.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a young man in a suit seated sideways in a wicker chair indoors, reading a newspaper. The room appears to be a well‑furnished parlor with a framed picture or painting on the wall, a plant near a window, and other household furnishings partially visible. The print has rounded corners typical of early photographic postcards.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European town square or park with flowerbeds and low iron fencing in the foreground. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stand and sit near the paths. Behind the park stand several multi‑story townhouses with ornate facades and shop signs. In the center background rises a tall church tower with a steep spire, clock or blank roundel on the tower face, and a weather vane on top. Trees frame the scene on both sides.

Old monochrome postcard view of a busy waterfront with moored boats and small ships along a quay. People walk on the promenade beside the water, with low buildings and harbor structures visible in the distance. The image has a caption at the bottom in French and a web watermark overprinted.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a row of ornate late‑19th/early‑20th century apartment or town houses along a wide, mostly empty street. The buildings feature mansard roofs, decorative gables, bay windows, and wrought‑iron cresting on the roofline. The view is taken from across an open foreground area, and a few pedestrians can be seen on the sidewalk. At the top left, printed in red, is the caption naming the town and street.

A monochrome panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows densely packed two‑ to three‑story houses with steep gabled roofs, some half‑timbered, and narrow streets. In the middle ground are several churches with tall spires and one onion‑domed tower typical of Central European Baroque churches. Behind the town stretch open fields, scattered farm buildings, and forested hills under an overcast or hazy sky. The image has the grainy, slightly faded look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No clear caption or border text is visible on the front.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a high‑altitude mountain refuge with red roofs and white walls set in a rocky alpine meadow. Dramatic, jagged peaks and cliffs of the Brenta group rise around the buildings, with some snowfields or glaciers visible in the background. Italian text is printed along the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a large neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance style castle or palatial villa on a slope, partly obscured by trees and shrubs. The building has crenellated rooflines, several cylindrical corner turrets with battlements, and a central clock tower. Arched windows with shutters line the façades. The foreground is a grassy hillside, and there is no visible caption or border text on the image side.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a coastal hillside settlement along the Bosphorus. Numerous low-rise buildings line the waterfront and climb the slope, with a larger institutional-looking building set higher on the hill. The foreground shows the calm waters of the strait, and the background features green hills under a pastel sky. Printed captions appear at the top in Latin characters and another script, and a website watermark is visible at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a European town in a valley, photographed from an elevated, wooded vantage point. A tall tree dominates the right foreground. Below are dense rooftops and a visible church tower. In the middle distance, a long multi‑arch railway viaduct crosses the valley, with scattered houses and farms on rolling hills and fields in the background.

Colorized historical postcard showing a two-story building with a richly patterned red-and-white tiled roof and a central arched entrance. The façade is light-colored with rectangular windows, and several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the building. To the right, part of a church tower with a clock is visible. Hungarian text appears at the top and above the entrance.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large Moorish‑style building complex labeled as a casino, with an arched colonnade and a central dome. The foreground is mostly bare ground with a small cart, and an early airplane is illustrated in the sky at left. There is printed caption text at the top and a website watermark at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned photograph of a courtyard or garden beside a large brick building. On the left stands a lion statue on a rectangular pedestal near benches and shrubs along the wall. A path leads inward toward smaller buildings in the background. On the right side, at an iron gate, is a striped wooden guard box with a uniformed soldier wearing a helmet standing at attention beside it. A vertical metric ruler appears along the right edge of the image, suggesting archival measurement.

Colorized illustration of a large stone public building on a street corner, likely early-20th‑century. The structure has light grey brick or stone walls with tall narrow windows, steep red-tile roofs, and several volumes at different heights, including a rounded dome-like roof on one section. A coat of arms is visible high on the main gabled façade. Streetlamps and leafy trees frame the foreground, and the sky shows a soft gradient suggesting sunset or sunrise. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a densely wooded forested valley with rocky hillsides on either side. In the distance, a tall structure (likely a tower or column) rises above the trees. Beneath the image there is bilingual text in Greek and French, and at the bottom a line indicating it is an edition of the Hellenic postal services. A round postal or publisher's seal appears in the lower left, and a small serial number (257) is printed at the bottom right.

A sepia-toned historic street scene printed within a beige card border with a thin red frame. The wide boulevard is lined with multistory 19th‑century European buildings on both sides, with awnings over shopfronts. Numerous pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and horse‑drawn carriages travel down the center of the street. The bottom margin of the card bears a caption in red Gothic-style lettering reading "Der Alexander-Boulevard."

A black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing a scattered village in a wide valley with low hills in the background. Traditional wooden farmhouses and barns are spread across open fields divided by fences. In the foreground there is a cluster of larger wooden buildings and a group of people sitting on the grass. At the bottom right, a caption is printed directly on the image.

Colorized vintage view of a calm river bordered by steep rocky, forested banks and distant tree‑covered hills. Along the top margin there is red Russian text. The scene is entirely natural landscape with no buildings or people visible.

Colorized historic postcard view labeled "Marienbad." It shows a landscaped park with winding paths in the foreground and, beyond the trees, a cluster of grand spa and resort buildings with domes and ornate facades, set against a forested hillside. Small printed captions appear at the top left, along the right edge, and at the bottom right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a steep hill rising prominently in the center. The hill is topped with fortification structures, likely a castle or fortress, and the foreground shows a patchwork of fields, trees, and low buildings leading into a denser urban area. At the top margin, German captions identify the viewpoint and the hill, and on the upper right the city name is printed.

A black‑and‑white view of a quiet tree‑lined street with a large stone tower on the left side behind a low wall and dense foliage. The tower has a steep tiled roof with stepped gables and small windows, reminiscent of a medieval church or fortified tower. Old-style street lamps line the unpaved road, which curves off into the distance. There are no visible people or vehicles, and the surrounding area appears semi-rural.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large group of men, women, and children on a wooden pier or boardwalk, posed closely together for a formal photograph. Most adults wear early 20th‑century clothing: suits, ties, and boater or flat caps for men; long skirts, light coats, and wide‑brimmed or cloche‑style hats for women. Several children are seated in front, some in sailor outfits. Behind the crowd, on a hillside, stand numerous wooden villas and resort-style buildings, including a prominent large hotel or sanatorium overlooking the town. The setting suggests a coastal or resort town in a temperate climate. No visible text or caption appears on the image side.

A vintage colorized postcard view of a lush city park lined with tall palm trees. In the center foreground stands an ornate multi-globe streetlamp on a stone base, with walkways, trimmed shrubs, benches, and additional trees visible in the background. The printed caption at the bottom margin reads "St. James Park, Los Angeles, Cal."

Black-and-white image of a quiet, tree-lined residential street bordered by elegant late 19th–early 20th century villas. On the right are large houses with stucco facades, shuttered windows, a glazed veranda, and ornate iron fencing on stone posts. On the left are similarly grand villas partly covered with ivy and topped with steep roofs and decorative spires. The unpaved road runs straight into the distance with a few utility poles, but no cars or visible people. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene with a rocky hill behind a row of houses and a larger villa-like building on the left. In the foreground, a paddle steamer labeled 'VICTORIA' travels along a wide river, whose calm water reflects the boat and the rocky slope. The printed caption at the top left reads 'Meißen — Spaar'.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned market square lined with 2–3 story historic townhouses. Shop signs and advertisements in German are visible on the façades, including a hotel, bank, biscuit factory, butcher, and other businesses. Several people stand near the entrance of a building marked as a hotel. The printed caption at the top reads "Lommatzsch i. Sa. Markt." indicating the marketplace of Lommatzsch.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European city street lined with late‑19th‑century townhouses and small trees. The cobblestone road curves gently into the distance. On the left façade, large painted advertising text promotes a business named Paul Weber related to building and water/closet installations. Fenced front gardens and modest urban architecture dominate the scene; there are no cars or people clearly visible.

A hand‑colored vintage postcard depicting a large two‑story house with a steep red tiled roof, half-timbered upper gable, and stucco walls. The building stands behind a low fence along a street with lampposts. Text at the top identifies the location as Oberfrohna i. Sa. and labels the building as the parish office (Pfarramt). Additional small German text is printed along the bottom margin, including a reference to the photographer O. Wichmann and the notation that it is a hand-colored artist postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town set amid fields and trees, with low rolling hills in the background. The town consists of clustered gabled houses and a prominent church with a tall spire on the right side. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Heidestadt Dahlen i. Sa." indicating the location.

Illustrated postcard showing two men in traditional-style clothing with caps, wide trousers and clogs walking in the foreground. Behind them is a stylized night-time cityscape with gabled houses and a tall church tower, lit streetlamps, a couple walking in the distance, and a large anthropomorphized moon with a face in the dark sky. The word "Nijmegen" is printed below the scene. Along the left edge appears the publisher's imprint and a small logo with a number at the bottom left.

A vintage New Year greeting card featuring an illustration of a snowy winter landscape framed by bare, snow‑dusted branches with several small birds perched and in flight. In the center is a moonlit scene of a cottage with a lit window, smoke from the chimney, and a winding snowy path. At the bottom of the card, in ornate script, is a New Year greeting in a Scandinavian language.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene crowded with people along a quay in front of a large domed church-like building. Small boats are in the water in the foreground, one with people aboard, suggesting a ceremony or celebration taking place on the harbor. The text at the bottom reads in French "Argostoli - Fêtes de l'Épiphanie", indicating Epiphany festivities, with additional printing credits in the lower left and a website watermark across the image.

Black‑and‑white image of a long neoclassical colonnade with rows of Corinthian columns and a coffered ceiling. Well‑dressed men and women in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century fashion stroll or stand along the walkway. At the far end are large arched openings. Benches line the wall on the right. The architecture suggests a prestigious spa or public colonnade, and there appears to be faint handwritten text along the bottom edge.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a tall brick lookout tower attached to or standing directly behind a villa-like building with stone lower walls and a steep tiled roof. The structure is set in a coniferous forest, with straight tree trunks framing the scene. A solitary man in early 20th‑century clothing and hat stands on a dirt path leading up to the building, holding a walking stick. The tower has narrow vertical windows and a large open viewing platform with a balustrade at the top.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard mounted on a tan background showing a traditional Dutch windmill standing on flat polder land with a few low buildings in the distance. Below the photograph there is typewritten text in Dutch that identifies the polder and location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside railway track with a man walking along the rails. On the right stands a large ornate wooden hotel building with balconies and a tower-like roof. Trees and forested hills rise behind the hotel, and water with small wooden structures lies to the left. At the top, red printed text in Swedish identifies the location and the hotel.

Color-tinted historic postcard showing a ceremonial gathering around an obelisk-style fountain set on a multi-tiered pedestal with ornate lamps. People in formal dress stand on both sides, with flags bearing crescents and stars. A green 10-para Ottoman stamp is affixed in the upper-right corner. At the bottom, printed captions in French identify the location as Salonique, Turquie and the monument as Fontaine Hamidie, with additional handwritten script over the lower part.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European city nestled in a valley with mountains in the background. A river runs through the foreground crossed by a bridge leading into the city. The skyline includes several church towers and historic buildings. In the bottom margin there is white handwritten-style caption text identifying the scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large neoclassical three‑storey building with a central portico and colonnade, set behind an open square with trees and paths. Printed captions in French and Greek at the top identify the place, and there is handwritten text in ink across the upper part of the image. A watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.

Colorized vintage street view showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue with early 20th‑century buildings on both sides. On the left is a substantial civic building with red tiled roof and fenced grounds, and on the right a row of ornate townhouses. The sky is softly tinted blue and yellow. Printed captions in German at the top identify the town and street.

Colorized historic street scene showing a wide cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings with red tiled roofs. Numerous pedestrians in late 19th–early 20th century clothing, including soldiers, women in long dresses and hats, children, and a dog, stand and walk along the street. Shopfronts with German signage are visible on the right. The caption at the top reads "Theresienstadt. Prager‑Gasse." indicating the view of Prager Gasse in Theresienstadt.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large stone arch bridge spanning a deep, tree‑filled valley. On the far side of the bridge stands an ornate historic building with towers and a tall clock‑like spire. The scene is framed by trees in the foreground. At the bottom center of the image, a caption identifies the location.

A colorful, humorous postcard featuring cartoon-like ostriches wearing hiking boots, walking among orange gladiolus flowers on a blue and white background. One large ostrich in the foreground also wears boots and has gladiolus flowers on its back. A speech bubble in Dutch appears in the center, and a web address is shown in a banner near the top. At the bottom, text references the '4 Daagse Nijmegen', the famous multi‑day walking event.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a metal truss bridge spanning a river landscape. In the foreground is a narrow canal or stream bordered by a curved stone embankment, leading the eye toward the main river and bridge in the middle distance. Trees and grassy banks surround the scene, and a couple of small human figures stand near the river. The sky is light blue with scattered clouds. Printed text in German appears at the top of the image.

The postcard features a black and white panoramic view of a European town with classical architecture, wide streets, and tree-lined avenues against a hilly backdrop. The caption at the bottom reads 'St. Zagora. Gesamtansicht', indicating a general view of Stara Zagora. The back of the postcard has handwritten text, postal stamps, and a green stamp from Bulgaria dated 1940, with images of people in traditional attire and a portrait. The writing is mostly in Italian and Cyrillic, and there are date marks from 1950.

A panoramic, vintage, colorized image showing a seaside city with numerous fishing boats and ships anchored near a long breakwater. The city beyond features a dense cluster of low-rise historic European-style buildings and a prominent minaret, suggesting a diverse cultural influence. The reverse of the postcard shows handwritten messages, Bulgarian text, a Bulgarian postage stamp featuring a portrait, and several postal markings.

A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a monumental mausoleum with a classical facade and an arched entrance. On top of the hill above the mausoleum stands a tall column with a prominent cross, and several people are seen walking on the stairs and around the site. The facade is inscribed with 'VLADISLAO VARNENSI,' and there are coats of arms visible above the lettering. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a group of people standing on rocky ground in the foreground with a large spa or bath complex of long, low neoclassical buildings in the background, set in a barren, hilly landscape. The layout resembles an early 20th‑century thermal bath resort. Printed captions identify the scene as the baths of Kythnos in Greece, with both Greek and French text on the card.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a Gothic-style building identified as a library. The façade features tall pointed-arch windows, decorative stonework, a small ornate entrance pavilion with columns and a coat of arms, and a steep gabled roof topped with a cross. The building opens onto a cobblestone square, with a few small figures visible near the base. Printed caption text appears at the top in red.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor café or beer garden in front of a small brick pavilion surrounded by large trees. Several people sit at tables with bentwood chairs; a server appears near the right. The building has tall multi‑pane windows and a central door with brick arches above the windows. On the right edge of the card, part of the reverse or margin is visible with ornate printed lettering, likely the photographer's imprint, and chalk or pencil numbers.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Gothic interior room with ribbed vaulting decorated with floral patterns, tall traceried windows, and a richly decorated tiled stove and doorway. A white margin at the bottom contains printed German captions identifying the location and room, along with the photographer's credit.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, tree‑lined boulevard flanked by multi‑story historicist apartment and commercial buildings. The view looks along the avenue with horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians visible. Ornate façades and a domed rooftop with statues appear on the left. The printed border has red text, including the city name on the left and a street name on the right.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a Neo‑Gothic building with stepped gables and pointed windows, identified as a library. The facade includes ornate stonework, arched entrances at street level, and tall mullioned windows above. Printed captions in French at the bottom read "La Bibliothèque" and "Bruges." The printer's credit and card number appear in small text along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small wooden church with a steep gabled roof, arched windows, and a graveyard with headstones in the foreground. Trees frame the scene. A vertical white strip on the right margin contains printed text indicating the location, and small credits for the photographer and publisher appear at the bottom.

A colorized aerial view of a large yellow neoclassical theater complex and surrounding city blocks. The building has two main wings with green roofs, forming a curved frontage onto a tree‑lined square. Around it are streets, smaller buildings, and an open area crowded with people, carts and horses. The image is framed like an old printed postcard, with a white border and red caption text along the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural alpine landscape with rolling green hills, scattered houses, and a prominent baroque hilltop church with twin towers on the right. In the foreground stands a boy in traditional alpine clothing holding a statue of the crowned Virgin Mary with the Child Jesus. Mountains rise in the background. Printed captions in German appear at the top left and bottom center, and there is a vertical publisher credit on the right edge.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a historic European town on a river, showing an industrial building in the foreground, dense traditional houses with gabled roofs in the middle, and a large church and castle complex with towers and spires dominating the skyline. Printed captions in German identify the town and key buildings.

A black‑and‑white historic view over a European riverside city. In the foreground is a large statue of an armored knight with a plumed helmet, standing on a richly decorated stone pedestal and holding a sword. Two children sit on the base of the monument while a uniformed man stands nearby. Curved stone balustrades frame the terrace. In the background, across a wide river, are church towers with baroque spires and dense urban buildings fading into the distance. The image has damage or overexposed areas in the sky and no visible printed caption.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. The foreground shows a line of trees and open fields; behind them are scattered villas, farmhouses, and village buildings. In the background, rolling hills and dense forest rise behind the settlement. Printed text in German appears at the upper left giving the place name and elevation.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal spa square with manicured hedges, paths, benches, and large potted plants in the foreground. Behind the garden is a long colonnaded building with shops or facilities, and a larger historic spa building with a clock and flagpole on the roof in the background. Trees surround the complex, giving it a park‑like setting. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Bad Elster and specifically the bathing place (Badeplatz).

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a dramatic mountain valley with a river, stone bridge and a steep serpentine road climbing the hillside. There are waterfalls cascading down both sides of the valley. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a publisher credit at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white image showing a small lake or river with a rowboat carrying three people in early-20th‑century clothing; one man rows while a woman with a parasol and another figure sit in the boat. On the far bank stands a small Neoclassical circular pavilion with a domed roof and several columns, enclosed by a low white fence, surrounded by dense trees and parkland.

The image shows the back side of an old postcard with a vertical divider line in the center. At the top, the word 'BREVKORT' is printed, and there is light handwritten text in green ink on the left half and near the center/right. The card is yellowed with age and otherwise mostly blank.

A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a European city with a wooded hill rising steeply in the center-left. On top of the hill there are fortifications and buildings, while at its base and along a river to the right stretch dense city blocks, bridges, churches, and multi‑story buildings. The title text at the top left reads in German. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Vintage postcard with a monochrome photograph of a large bunch of grapes hanging with leaves visible at the top. The image occupies the upper portion, while the lower part is blank except for the printed caption in red ink. Along the left and right margins there is vertical publisher and printing information.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside settlement surrounded by forested hills. The bridge leads into a small town with scattered wooden buildings, church spires and houses amid trees. The overall scene is rural and panoramic, taken from an elevated vantage point. In the upper left corner there is printed text in a Scandinavian language.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense historic city quarter with tiled roofs. The foreground shows a large, ornate public building facing a tree‑lined street. The image appears to be an old photographic postcard with no visible printed caption on the front.

Colorized historic postcard showing the entrance gate of an industrial complex with a decorative archway reading "Sächs. Kupfer- und Messingwerke F. A. Lange." A black‑and‑white photograph taken from inside a car looking out through the windshield onto a narrow rural road. Cows are standing on the road, partly blocking the car. A man in work clothes and cap stands among the cows, and a woman in a dress and apron walks away on the right side of the frame. The road is flanked by trees and vegetation, giving a forested countryside feel. No visible printed text appears on the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with a two‑storey building labeled "Hotel Vel Kaptol" in the foreground, a tree‑lined road along a river with a horse‑drawn carriage, and a town with a bridge in the background. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene with three men in traditional Albanian costume seen from the back, walking in a muddy road among a crowd of people. Sepia-toned image mounted on a decorative dark border, showing a large barge or floating platform used in harbor construction. Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a long neoclassical railway station building with domed pavilions and a central portico. Black-and-white postcard view of a large, multi-storey building with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and a small onion-domed turret. The facade carries the inscription "ST. LORENZHEIM". Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide cobblestone market square lined with 2–3‑storey houses with steep gabled roofs. Tinted historic postcard view of a large multi‑span steel truss railway bridge crossing a wide river at night or dusk, with a full moon in a cloudy sky. A traditional sailing boat is in the foreground under the bridge. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Spoorbrug." in red lettering.

A black‑and‑white view up a gently curving path toward a tall, slender church tower with a high spire rising above treetops. The tower has several distinct stages and arched windows, set on a small hill or park-like area. Two small figures walk on the path in the middle distance, and mature trees frame the scene on both sides under a cloudy sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a metal bridge with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn or early motor carriage, and tram tracks crossing a wide river. On the opposite bank stands a dense old town of gabled houses climbing a hill. Dominating the skyline is a large medieval hilltop complex with fortified walls and tall twin‑spired Gothic church towers, resembling a cathedral integrated into a castle‑like palace. The overall style and clothing of people suggest an early‑20th‑century scene.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a large stone castle with steep multi‑gabled roofs and a small spire, standing on a rocky outcrop above a river valley thickly covered with trees. Black‑and‑white view of an elaborate baroque palace complex beside a water-filled moat or canal. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined square with a large brick concert hall in the background. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a coastal fortification with massive round stone towers and crenellations. Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small European town in a narrow valley. The town is surrounded by wooded hills and terraced fields; there is a factory chimney in the distance and many private gardens in the foreground. No printed caption or text is visible on the image.

A sepia-toned illustrated postcard depicting a narrow cobblestone street flanked by tall, old residential buildings with wooden shutters on the windows. A curved streetlamp extends over the lane, and at the end of the street stands a house with a tiled roof and small rooftop chimneys. The scene evokes a quiet, historical European town. No visible printed text or caption appears on the front.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene in a small European town. Lined with two- and three-story houses with gabled roofs and dormer windows, the broad street has small trees along the sidewalks and several pedestrians walking in the middle. At the top center, printed text reads "Bad Sulza — Obermarkt" indicating that the view depicts the Obermarkt (upper market) area of Bad Sulza.

Colorized historic postcard view of a street with a large brick and stone academic or hospital building on the right, featuring arched windows and decorative roof details. Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a bustling outdoor market or fair. A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a narrow, slightly curving road lined with traditional overhanging houses. Several people, including men and children, walk or stand in the street. At the bottom center of the image there is a printed caption identifying the location.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural scene with a dirt road curving through tall pine trees toward a modest two‑story house near a body of water. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a tree‑lined dirt road leading toward low wooden buildings. Tall coniferous and deciduous trees frame the road, with fences and rural structures in the background. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Lovisa. Casino – vägen." in a serif font.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a small Gothic-style church with ribbed vaulted ceilings, wooden pews, a pulpit on the left wall, and an illuminated chandelier hanging before the altar area. The image is slightly faded, with printed caption text along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a lakeside resort or village surrounded by dense coniferous forest. A calm, elongated lake dominates the upper center, with reflections of trees on its surface. Sepia-toned postcard showing a tropical shoreline with dense forest and a small headland. In the foreground, several fishermen in canoes or wooden boats are setting out through gentle surf. Printed caption text appears at the top and publisher credit along the bottom edge.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing dramatic rock formations rising from a rocky, forested landscape. At the bottom edge of the image, printed text reads "Greifensteine Ehrenfriedersdorf."

Sepia-toned vintage street scene in a small European town. On the right stands a tall signpost with multiple directional arms pointing toward nearby towns and a larger city. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal in an old European city. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a brick church with a tall tower and spire on the left, and modern mid‑20th‑century apartment blocks on the right, separated by an open grassy area and curved paved street in the foreground. At the bottom left there is printed text identifying the scene.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over fields toward a small European town nestled in low hills. In the center stands a prominent church tower rising above clustered houses. Sepia-toned vintage view of a waterfront city scene. A grand multi-storey hotel and adjoining ornate buildings line a quay with trams, horse-drawn or early motor vehicles, and many pedestrians. Colorized photograph showing a stone fortress building seen through a dark archway in the foreground. Black-and-white panoramic view taken from a plowed field overlooking a small European town nestled in rolling hills. The overall appearance is that of an early 20th‑century rural townscape.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a formal rose garden with a central decorative fountain. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural residential area with detached houses bordering an open field of tall grass. The sky is filled with large cumulus clouds. Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large multi-storey institutional building complex with mansard roofs and small towers, situated beside a pond with ducks. Black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European townhouses and shops. A sepia-toned postcard showing a close view of stone arcades and Corinthian columns forming part of an ancient Roman-style peristyle courtyard. In the background are old buildings with tiled roofs. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as the Peristil in Split.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Renaissance-style brick building with a steep gabled roof, dormer windows, ornate central gable, and twin exterior staircases leading up to a first-floor entrance. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town in a rural, hilly landscape. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a general view of a small historic village nestled in a valley, with stone houses, narrow streets, and a central church tower. Colorized historic postcard showing a grand neo-Gothic building with ornate towers and a patterned roof. In front of the building there is a tall sculpted column or monument. A black-and-white postcard showing a waterside scene with a large brick building on the left labeled as the post office, a quay in front, and a steamship with smoke rising from its funnel on the right. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large villa-style house surrounded by dense trees and a garden or park in the foreground. A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a country church with a tall tower and slender spire, flanked by bare trees and surrounded by a low stone wall. Black‑and‑white historic view along a busy seaside boulevard with many horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians. Colorized view across a river or lake with reeds and trees in the foreground, looking toward a small historic town on a hill with several church spires and domed roofs. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped terrace with decorative stone planters, railings, and lamp posts, in front of a pavilion or café building with large arched windows. A monochrome postcard view of a large, early‑20th‑century military barracks complex standing behind a stone wall and open fields. A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European spa town nestled between wooded hills and an open plain. Colorized vintage view of a riverside or lakeside promenade in a landscaped park. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town surrounded by rolling hills and patchwork fields. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, traditional wooden building with a gabled roof and three chimneys, set on a slightly sloping, grassy landscape with a few bushes and a circular garden bed. A black‑and‑white, likely early‑20th‑century postcard showing a quiet tree‑lined street with single‑story wooden houses on the left and right. A monochrome historic postcard showing a street view with a substantial brick building on the left, likely a restaurant or inn, with several windows, dormers, and flagpoles. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the main entrance of a spa or sanatorium complex. Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a market square with a distinctive round or polygonal tower with a steep roof in the center-left and a long market hall with an arched gateway on the right.
