A monochrome winter scene showing a small church with a steeple labeled 'Peterskapelle'. The chapel stands on slightly elevated ground surrounded by leafless trees and snow-covered fields. A narrow bridge and a fence lead toward the church, and the landscape is rural and forested.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand estate building with towers and arches set in a sparsely treed landscape at the base of rugged hills. The card has printed captions in red ink, including the site name and publisher information, and a red serial number on the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view of an Italian square with a tall medieval clock tower and adjacent historic building, photographed from under an arcade with columns and stone lion sculptures in the foreground. Caption text is printed along the bottom white border.

A monochrome postcard view of a large seaside fortress seen from the water, with several small boats in the foreground. The fort stretches horizontally along a low peninsula. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "ALEXANDRIA. — Fort Kait Bey — LL." and a small number "8" appears at the far left. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible across the lower right.

Colorized vintage street view showing a gently curving dirt road lined with modest houses and tall trees. Several children and a few adults stand or walk along the road. In the distance, a factory chimney rises above the trees and buildings. Printed text at the bottom left reads "Elbogen. Fabrikstrasse." along with the publisher's information in German, indicating this is a hand‑colored artist postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an ornate Baroque terrace and staircase called the Belvedere, decorated with statues and balustrades, overlooking a town with church domes and surrounding hills along a river valley. The text at the top reads "Schloss Tetschen a. Elbe" on the left and "Belvedere" on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard with an oval-framed photograph of a large Gothic-style church with a tall central spire opening onto a landscaped square with paths and a statue group in front. The caption in Hungarian is printed below the image on the beige card stock.

Colorized historical postcard view of a narrow street leading toward a tall round stone tower with a dark dome roof. Old plastered houses with red-tiled roofs flank the lane, one with an arched wooden gate in the foreground. Leafless tree branches frame the scene on the left, and a small signboard hangs beside a wooden fence. The sky is bright blue with a single small cloud. Printed caption text appears in the upper right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large round stone tower with a high domed roof topped by a small lantern and cross. The tower stands on a gentle hillside with rows of trees and vegetation in the foreground and additional wooded slopes in the distance. In the upper right corner, red printed German text identifies the view as a scene by the castle tower in Freyburg.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a valley with railway tracks curving through the landscape, industrial chimneys, factory buildings, scattered houses, open fields, and wooded hills in the background. The scene is printed with red caption text at the top reading the town name and the viewpoint.

Hand-colored vintage postcard view of a riverside townscape. A calm river flows in the foreground, with trees lining the left bank and a small weir or dam across the water. On the right bank stand traditional European houses with red-brown roofs and a prominent medieval tower next to a stone bridge. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors, giving an old-fashioned appearance. Printed captions identify the scene and publisher details.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy waterfront street scene in front of a large brick railway station building. Sailing ships with tall masts are docked beside the station, while people, horse‑drawn carts, and an early tram or streetcar occupy the foreground. The architecture is 19th‑century, with arched windows and a clock tower. Printed caption text appears below the image.

Hand-colored historic postcard showing a street scene in a European spa town. Two large ornate late-19th-century buildings dominate the view. The left building bears the name "Schloss Heilbronn" and the right one "Villa Nizza." In front stands a tall street clock with decorative lamps. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street; a horse-drawn vehicle is visible near trees at the right. The title "Marienbad." appears at the top, and descriptive captions "Schloss Heilbronn." and "Villa Nizza." appear at the bottom, along with the printer's imprint.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a rustic, smoke‑blackened wooden room furnished with a table, stool, cradle or bed, and simple household objects. The scene is labeled as a historical 'smoke room' exhibit in a folk museum in Graz, Austria. White printed German text appears in the lower left corner, with a small code in the lower right.

A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled at the base of wooded hills. The foreground shows a tree‑lined road and open fields leading into a compact settlement of multi‑story houses, farm buildings, and a church tower. Scattered buildings extend up the slopes, with terraced fields and dense forest in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "EGGENBERG BEI GRAZ."

A reproduction of a medieval fresco or manuscript illumination showing two peasants harvesting grain. One figure, in a white hooded garment, kneels low to the ground tying sheaves of wheat; another, in a white tunic, cap, and bluish trousers, bends forward carrying a bundle of stalks. The scene is rustic, with multiple tied sheaves scattered across a field and a darker band, possibly a fence or woven barrier, at the bottom. There is no visible overprinted modern text on the image side.

A color image of a modernist concrete church with a tall, conical, tent‑like spire formed by multiple vertical ribs converging to a point topped with a cross. The lower part has sharp angular roofs and dark entrances, surrounded by manicured lawns, bushes, and small trees under a pale sky. The image fills the front with no visible caption or border text.

Illustrated Easter/spring postcard showing three large colored eggs in the foreground beside pussy-willow branches and small flowers. Behind them stand ruins of an old stone castle or fortress on a hill. To the right is a townscape with a church featuring a tall, narrow spire and simple clock or round window on its tower, with low houses and a river or plain beyond. The greeting text at the top is in Estonian.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural Scandinavian scene labeled "Ökna." In the foreground is a dirt road lined with traditional wooden fencing and haystacks in a field. To the right stands a dark wooden farmhouse or manor with white‑framed windows and a tall ladder leaning up to the attic gable. In the middle distance, a group of people and a horse‑drawn carriage gather near a gate shaded by large trees. Behind the trees rises a round church tower with arched openings, balcony railing, and a cross on top, suggesting a village church.

Colorized panoramic postcard view of a river valley with a town on the left bank and a steep, wooded rocky hill on the right. Atop the hill stands a large villa or hotel-like building labeled "Goldene Höhe." The town across the river features church towers, red-roofed buildings, and a tall factory chimney. Foreground shows trees, fields, and a riverside path.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a quiet, tree‑lined urban street with a row of multi‑story residential or institutional buildings on the left. The nearest corner building has an arched entrance with steps, railings, and a round window above, plus a sculpted coat of arms or relief plaque on the façade. A woman in early 20th‑century clothing walks with a child along the sidewalk, and the unpaved street stretches into the distance with more historic buildings visible at the far end.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a stone frieze with standing and seated figures laid out on the ground, photographed with Athens and surrounding hills in the background. Greek text is printed beneath the image, accompanied by French text identifying the scene as a frieze from the Theatre of Bacchus in Athens. There is handwriting and postal cancellation marks on the card.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large town hall building with a central clock tower and tall spire, facing an open cobblestone square. The multi‑storey facade has arched entrances with staircases, rows of windows decorated with flower boxes, and an adjoining building marked 'Klosterkeller'. Small figures and a cart are visible in the square. Printed captions at the top read 'Rosswein.' and 'Rathaus und Klosterkeller.'

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing interiors of the Thomas‑Müntzer‑Haus in Oschatz. The four photographs depict: a dance bar with round tables and cushioned chairs; a restaurant with neatly arranged square tables and simple wooden chairs; a large hall with many table rows and a balcony gallery; and another view of a bar area with a long counter, bar stools and small café tables. The central band carries the name 'Thomas‑Müntzer‑Haus Oschatz', and small captions label the scenes as Tanzbar, Restaurant, Großer Saal, and Tanzbar.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street with tram tracks leading toward a large, turreted brick building labeled as Fyrishall. To the right is a metal arch bridge over a river, lined with trees and multistory buildings in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Upsala. Fyrishall."

Black-and-white industrial postcard showing three workers posing on and around a huge ore crusher inside a wooden and steel structure. The machinery dominates the image, with large flywheels and belts. Swedish text is printed at the bottom describing the machine as the world's largest ore crusher in Kiirunavaara, capable of crushing ore blocks of 12–13 tons.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a broad cobbled road lined with two‑ and three‑story masonry buildings. On the right is a prominent classical-style building with a balcony, identified as the post office, while further along the street is a war hospital. A tall telegraph/telephone pole with multiple crossarms stands in the center distance, and a horse-drawn wagon is visible on the street. Handwritten German text appears at the top, and small printed credits at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproducing a Minoan fresco of three elaborately dressed women in profile, with curly hair and patterned garments. Beneath the image there is a caption in Greek (and partly in Latin characters) identifying the scene as from Knossos along with a serial number.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy European city street lined with ornate historic buildings. A tram line runs along the center of the street with pedestrians and carriages. On the right side stands a tall baroque-style church or tower with a clock, while domed and spired buildings are visible on the left. At the top left, printed in small text, it reads "Graz. Herrengasse."

A black-and-white panoramic view over a small European town with densely packed, 2–4 story houses featuring steep gabled tile roofs and some half‑timbered detailing. The foreground shows orderly streets and villa-like houses, while farther back there are larger institutional or factory buildings with smokestacks. Beyond the town lie gently rolling fields and low hills. The sky area is blank white, as in many early printed panoramic postcards. No visible caption or other printed text appears on the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with gently rolling fields, scattered farm buildings with light roofs, and a church with a tall pointed steeple standing on a small hill near a body of water. In the bottom left corner decorative German text reads "Gruss aus Festen.", and there is handwritten script along the right margin.

Black‑and‑white street view showing an old town commercial street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings with shops on the ground floors. People walk along the sidewalks, some with children, and several 1930s‑era cars are parked on the street. Signs in Swedish hang above the shops. At the bottom left, white text reads "Söderhamn. Köpmangatan." and at the bottom right is a photographer/publisher imprint "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI Foto & Ensamrätt: A/B Almquist & Cöster, Hälsingborg."

Colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a coastal town with dense, low-rise houses and tiled roofs on a hillside beside a bay. In the foreground are stone walls or ruins and a small group of people walking along a path, while hills rise in the background. French caption text appears at the top, and a website watermark is printed at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street corner with a multi‑story building on the left bearing the word "Sparkasse" (savings bank). In front of the building are a few people standing by an arched entrance. On the right is a small memorial area with two artillery pieces (cannons) flanking a stone monument topped with a sphere and bordered by cannonballs. Mature trees stand behind the monument. In the lower right corner is a printed photographer's credit and location.

Black-and-white historic view of a brick railway station complex with steep tiled roofs. The main building has large arched windows, a central entrance canopy on the platform side, and the word "HÖGANÄS" on the façade. To the left is a smaller pavilion-like brick building with a hipped roof. In the foreground are railway tracks and a gravel platform; benches are visible near the entrance. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Vintage monochrome view of a river or rapids flowing between rocky, forested banks, with industrial buildings and a long truss bridge spanning the water. The scene is labeled in the upper right corner with the location name in Swedish.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a river scene with traditional sailboats (likely feluccas) passing through an open metal bridge. The bridge's central span is rotated open to allow river traffic. People stand along the riverbank and on the bridge. The watermarked website 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed on the image, and printed caption text at the bottom reads "CAIRO. - The Kasr-el-Nil Bridge open."

Colorized vintage view of a large city square bordered by trees and neoclassical buildings. The square is mostly open, with paths and scattered greenery, and multi‑story houses line the background. On the right side stands a prominent neoclassical building with columns. The top left contains printed multilingual text identifying the place, and postal cancellation marks are faintly visible over the sky.

A monochrome postcard view of a rural valley with a large arched stone bridge or viaduct carrying a road or rail line across a gorge. Below and beyond are scattered houses and farm buildings, with a winding road and dense forested hills in the background. The scene is captioned in German at the top left.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a riverside town with barges and a paddle steamer on the river. On the hill above the town stands a large Gothic ensemble with towers and steep roofs identified in the caption as Albrechtsburg and the cathedral. Handwritten-style captions in German appear along the lower border.

A colorized historical postcard showing a bustling harbor scene with several docked boats and barges alongside a quay. Cranes and small warehouses line the waterfront, with workers and figures visible on the pier. Palm trees and low buildings appear in the background. The caption at the bottom, printed in red, identifies the location as the Beira Port in Portuguese East Africa and provides the name in Portuguese and English.

Colorized vintage view of a tranquil city park with curving gravel paths, benches, tall leafy trees, a decorative lamppost and an ornamental stone urn in the background. The scene is calm and idyllic, with soft pastel tones typical of early 20th‑century postcards. At the bottom, red printed text identifies the location.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a river winding through a wooded valley with rocky hillsides. A country road follows the riverbank in the foreground. In the distance stands a large mill building with several stories and a gabled roof nestled among trees. At the bottom margin, there is cursive German text identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a long, multi‑storey residential or institutional building with dormer windows and a corner tower-like projection. The structure stands along an unpaved open area or street, with a few people visible in front. At the top in red Gothic-style lettering is a brief caption identifying the location as Torgau on the Elbe River and specifying the street section near the water tower.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European city taken from an elevated vantage point, probably a hill or castle. In the foreground are trees and steeply roofed buildings; to the lower right stands a richly decorated neo‑Renaissance building with a large central dome and smaller corner domes, facing a square. Numerous church towers punctuate the dense historic roofscape beyond, with flat plains and distant low hills in the background. A small white number "656" is printed in the lower left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm park landscape with a pond or canal in the foreground and reeds along the water's edge. In the middle distance a path curves through low hills and trees, with a person walking or cycling. On the left stands a traditional wooden windmill on a small rise; farther back and slightly right is a large rectangular building that looks like a manor or public building. The sky is lightly clouded. The printed captions "Slottsparken." and "Malmö." appear at the top corners.

Black‑and‑white view of a grand spa-resort complex in a narrow valley backed by dense forested hills. The foreground shows a long, ornate colonnade or pavilion with domed roof sections; behind it stand several large, multi‑storey neoclassical and belle‑époque style hotel buildings with many windows and balconies. A tall chimney emits smoke, and on the wooded hillside above is a solitary monument or lookout. The overall layout and architecture suggest a European spa town from the early 20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor café or beer garden shaded by trees. Several people in traditional central‑European dress sit at tables or stand in the garden. Behind them is a light‑colored building with tall arched windows and simple classical ornament. To the left is a glass pavilion or conservatory structure. The overall scene feels relaxed and social, likely in the courtyard of a restaurant or inn.

Color postcard-style image showing a large waterfront building complex with a central, flat-roofed, light-colored block and an ornate, historic-looking facade on the right. Several floors of windows and balconies face a calm harbor. Two white passenger boats are moored along the quay in front of the buildings. Cars are visible along the street by the water. At the bottom border of the image, handwritten text reads "WAXHOLM II".

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a broad city street bordered by ornate multi‑story stone buildings with awnings on the left and trees and smaller buildings on the right. A tram or streetcar tracks run along the street, with a few pedestrians scattered about. At the top of the image there is printed text, and cursive handwriting crosses part of the sky area.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large steel railway bridge under construction over a river in a valley. Extensive scaffolding and trestle work support the structure, and a steam locomotive with carriages is crossing the finished section. Trees, a dirt road with a simple fence, and water flowing below are visible. At the top right there is printed Swedish text describing the bridge and its dimensions.

Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a large hilltop castle complex with tall Gothic spires and fortified walls dominating a small town below. In the foreground a steam-powered riverboat named "GERMANIA" with a striped flag sails along the river. The scene looks like a historical European riverside city with a prominent cathedral-castle ensemble above terraced houses.

Colorized historic postcard showing an elegant villa-style building with a tower and ornate veranda, identified as Café Kaiserpark. Numerous tables and chairs are arranged outdoors along a central pathway, with trees and a forested hillside in the background. Printed captions in German appear at the bottom and along the left margin, along with a publisher's credit and number.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooden bathhouse building on piles by the water, with a central tower flying a flag and people walking along the shore in the foreground. Trees frame the image. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place, and a purple museum stamp and date are overprinted on the card.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a riverside town dominated by a large brick public building with ornate gables and a metal roof, a church spire behind it, leafy parkland in the foreground, and a round tower‑like structure near the river on the right. The caption "Umeå" appears in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town with tree‑lined streets and fenced gardens. In the background stands a large historic church with a tall tower and spire, surrounded by compact two‑ and three‑story houses with steep gabled roofs. Telegraph poles line the streets. Along the right border of the image there is handwritten white text on the negative indicating a place name and date.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a side view of a single cargo steamship at sea. The vessel has a tall central funnel, masts with cargo booms, and a low freeboard hull. A flag is visible at the stern, and faint land can be seen on the horizon in the distance. The composition is simple, focusing entirely on the ship against a clear sky.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a town with a long multi‑span bridge crossing a river filled with floating logs from timber rafting. On the far riverbank stand various buildings, including larger masonry houses and a church with a tall steeple, with forested hills in the background. In the lower right corner, white text identifies the scene, publisher, and date.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a row of historic gabled houses along a narrow street. The buildings have stepped and ornate Flemish façades with tiled roofs and tall, narrow windows. Some façades display signage above the ground‑floor doors and windows, and there are flagpoles mounted on the fronts of the houses. Printed caption text in French appears at the top left, and small red printer's marks are visible at the lower left margin.

A vintage multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard with five images related to Countess von Cosel and Stolpen Castle. The central image shows a hilltop town with a fortified complex above surrounding fields. Other images depict a portrait of Gräfin v. Cosel, the Coselturm tower of the castle, an ornate model of her travelling coach, and an interior salon furnished in historical style. Gothic script in the center reads "Burgstadt Stolpen i. Sa." with caption labels under each smaller image.

Color postcard view of a European historic town square seen through a stone archway. The square is paved with cobblestones and busy with people, market stalls, and umbrellas. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with steep red-tiled roofs and ornate stepped and curved gables in a late Gothic / Renaissance style. The central yellow building has several decorative gabled dormers; adjacent grey and cream buildings show typical North/Central European historic town architecture. The clothing styles of the people suggest mid‑20th‑century (post‑war) Europe. There is a round road sign with a red border on the right side.

Vintage monochrome winter view of a small town in a snow-covered valley, with many steep‑roofed houses, a prominent church tower in the center-right, railway tracks and trains in the foreground, and wooded hills in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in red and smaller printer's information in black.

Black‑and‑white image of a mid‑20th‑century cargo or tanker ship underway at sea. The vessel is photographed in profile from the side, flying a line of decorative signal flags from bow to stern, suggesting a ceremonial or maiden voyage. The superstructure is concentrated toward the stern and midships, with cranes or loading arms visible on deck. The ship's name is painted on the bow, and large initials appear on the funnel.
Sepia-toned postcard showing a person kneeling in prayer in the desert beside a standing, saddled camel. Sand dunes fill the background. Printed caption in French appears at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a canal sluice with a small drawbridge structure and trees on both banks. The scene is tranquil, with water in the foreground, masonry walls of the canal, and mechanical arms of the sluice above. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image and a website watermark is superimposed over the picture.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing an Orthodox-style church with onion domes and a tall bell tower in a town setting. Bare trees surround the church, and multi‑storey classical buildings stand nearby. German text printed at the top reads "Gruss aus Goldingen" on the left and "Die russische Kirche" on the right.

Colorized aerial view of a mid‑20th‑century Nordic town: low apartment blocks with red roofs, scattered wooden houses, and many conifer trees. In the background stands a long, white, modernist high‑rise building dominating the skyline. A few vintage cars are visible on unpaved or newly built streets. The sky is clear and blue, and there is no printed caption or visible text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a European hillside town. In the foreground are trees and a rail line; a low train or tram runs along the bottom edge. Above it rise dense trees and villas on the slope. Dominating the skyline are an ornate multi-storey institutional building on the left, a tall church tower with a steep spire in the center, and another tower-like structure to its left. A very tall factory chimney with decorative brick patterning stands to the right, near a hillside building marked as a restaurant. The overall scene mixes industrial and historic architecture.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small town scene with a prominent church tower rising above trees and, to the right, the ruins of a hilltop castle. In the foreground stands a large villa-style house partially obscured by foliage. The lower margin bears a printed German caption identifying the location.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a lake surrounded by forested hills and scattered houses and farms in the foreground. The scene is tranquil and rural. At the bottom left, white text identifies the view, and at the bottom right there is a small oval logo with the word "ÄKTA" above "FOTOGRAFI" and the photographer's name "Einar Erikson."

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a coastal city with dense low buildings leading to the sea. In the right foreground is the stone wall and round tower of a hilltop fortress. The caption at the bottom is printed in Greek, English, and French, and there is a website watermark across the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the foreground near an iron railing and lampposts. Large painted advertisements in German cover the building façades, including signs for a café and colonial-goods delicatessen. At the top in red script it reads "Kötzschenbroda. Bahnhofstrasse." and at the bottom in small red type the publisher credit appears.

A black‑and‑white view of a lakeside or riverside promenade with many wooden tables and folding chairs arranged like an outdoor café or beer garden. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing sit or stand by the tables, including men in suits and hats. Dense shrubs line a fence that separates the seating area from the water. On the calm water, small rowboats and one person in a boat are visible, with forested hills rising in the background. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white rural landscape photograph showing a dirt road leading into a small village surrounded by fields and forested hills. On the left stands a wooden barn; further along the road are telephone poles and several multi‑story farmhouses. Some buildings have traditional half‑timbered facades typical of Central European villages. The image has wide margins and the look of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No visible printed text appears on the front.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a busy harbor with many ships, docks, cranes, and waterfront buildings. In the far distance a lighthouse is visible at the entrance of the port. The image has a printed caption at the bottom identifying the scene as Alexandria and mentioning the docks. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower right.

Sepia-toned historic view of a stone railway station with arched windows and doors, steep tiled roofs and multiple chimneys. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the platform. A picket fence and low hills are visible in the background. The image has the composition and tone typical of old travel postcards.

Color view over a busy northern European harbor with many cranes, docked cargo ships, and a white passenger ship moving through the water. In the foreground are small marinas with pleasure boats, red wooden waterfront buildings, and a brick church with a small steeple. Rolling green hills and an industrial port area line the distant shore under a partly cloudy sky. The image has the typical border and print style of a mid‑20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing several people cross‑country skiing across a wide, snow‑covered slope. A few houses or cabins stand near the top of the hill. The foreground shows ski tracks and skiers with poles. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge identifying the place and photographer/publisher.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large coastal sea stack with a natural arch, standing in shallow surf on a beach. The rock is labeled as Cathedral Rock at La Jolla, California. The card has printed captions along the bottom and left/right margins, and a red handwritten number in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a bustling European market square filled with people, stalls and umbrellas. Surrounding the square are ornate multi‑story buildings with steep gabled roofs and elaborate facades. German shop signs are visible on the buildings. In the background a tall, richly detailed church tower rises above the townscape.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square with early 20th‑century buildings surrounding an open market area. The roofs are steep and tiled, with dormer windows. Several shopfronts line the ground floors, including a bakery and café, and signage is in German. A few people stand or walk in the largely empty square. At the top left, printed text identifies the scene as "Neustadt i. Sa., Markt."

An ornate, early‑20th‑century postcard with four photographic portraits of monarchs in circular frames surrounded by richly decorated floral and interlaced patterns and numerous crowned heraldic shields of various Slavic states and regions. The central upper portrait is of a bearded emperor in military uniform; three other rulers are depicted beneath. At the top right is the year "1910". The design is in red, gold, blue, and green, with Cyrillic text in a decorative panel at the bottom.

Sepia-toned street view of a European town, showing multi‑story residential and commercial buildings with ornate facades on both sides of a wide street. Young trees line the sidewalks, and three children with school satchels walk in the foreground at right. In the distance, more historic buildings and a church-like tower are visible. The caption at the top identifies the location as Olbernhau and the street as Albertstraße; additional German shop and building signs are visible on the left side further down the street.

A monochrome vintage view of a small lake or pond in a landscaped park. Tall trees surround the water, and a fountain with several jets rises from a sculptural base at the center of the pond. On the right side, a small rowboat is moored at the shore under a large tree. The scene feels calm and pastoral, with no visible people or buildings in the immediate foreground.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a countryside church with a tall, ornate clock tower and spire rising above a rectangular nave. The church stands on slightly elevated ground surrounded by trees and bushes. At the top left of the image there is printed text reading "Väster Löfsta kyrka." The sky is light and mostly empty, giving ample white space around the building.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a gently sloping cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses on both sides. People, including children with carts, walk along the street. In the distance stands a prominent tower with an onion-shaped dome. At the top of the image there is printed caption text identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental historicist building with two small corner towers and a grand arched portal reached by a broad stairway, set against a wooded hillside. On the left side are several multi‑story town buildings along a street; in the distance a hilltop monument is visible. The caption in red at the top identifies the scene as a grave and gymnasium complex associated with Turnvater Jahn in Freyburg an der Unstrut, Germany.

A black-and-white postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with detached houses and gardens. The homes have steep gabled roofs and wooden facades typical of early 20th‑century Scandinavian villas. A low fence and gate border the foreground property, and there is an unpaved or lightly paved road with grassy verges. Trees and shrubs obscure much of the lower parts of the houses. Handwritten-style text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

A monochrome postcard showing a small Gothic-style chapel partly obscured by a leafless tree in the foreground and dense foliage on the right. The chapel has steeply pitched roofs, ornate pinnacles, and pointed-arch windows. There is a pile of stones at the base of the building, suggesting construction or renovation. Printed captions in red appear at the bottom in Hungarian and German, along with a small number on the lower left.

Vintage commemorative postcard featuring an oval portrait of a seated man writing (the poet Bocage) framed between two stylized trees. Around the portrait are books, a quill, nautical instruments, and an old sailing ship. A banner at the top reads "PRIMEIRO CENTENARIO DE BOCAGE". Black‑and‑white historic view of a stone arch bridge over a broad river, with trams and pedestrians crossing. On the far bank rises an ornate baroque cityscape with tall church towers and domes, dense multi‑story buildings, and monumental riverside facades. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the embankment and bridge; trees and grassy terraces appear in the foreground.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad urban avenue lined with ornate multi‑story buildings in Central European architectural style. In the background stands a large Gothic‑revival style building with steep roofs and pointed towers, and to the right another corner building with a tall spire. The street is busy with pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. At the bottom margin there is a caption in both Romanian and Hungarian.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard titled "Mooi Nederland." The left side shows a romanticized illustration of an armored trumpeter on horseback by a large tree, overlooking a broad rural landscape. The right side is a panoramic view of rolling fields, scattered trees, small roads and farmhouses, with people walking in the foreground and a bird flying above. At the bottom is an ornate coat of arms flanked by decorative text panels in Dutch.

Color image of a hilltop medieval castle ruin surrounded by stone walls and towers, set above a forested slope with patches of snow. Behind the fortress rises a dramatic range of snow‑covered mountains under a clear sky. The image fills the whole card, with no visible caption or text on the front.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a circular fountain in a tree‑lined city park. Several people, including a child bent over the fountain and adults standing nearby, are visible around the water. At the top of the image there is printed text in Cyrillic and French describing the scene and indicating that it is in Varna.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a leafless, tree‑lined foreground with a low earthen rampart or embankment, and in the distance a large white church with two tall symmetrical towers. The photo is framed artistically between dark tree trunks. At the bottom there is a caption in a Latin-script language and a small circular number '66' at the lower right.

Color postcard view of a busy industrial harbor canal lined with cargo ships and cranes on both sides. In the foreground is a small pier or landing stage with stairs, railings, a clock, and several small boats moored alongside. Large freighters fly what appears to be a Swedish flag. Warehouses and rail tracks run along the quays, and many lattice cranes dominate the skyline under a clear blue sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with mid‑20th‑century apartment buildings, fences, and power lines. The perspective looks straight down the street with low-rise, functionalist style houses on both sides. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large manor house with a steep tiled roof, central gable, round attic windows and symmetrical façade, set in a formal garden with hedges, paths and small statues or urns. Mature trees frame the building. A caption is printed at the bottom left of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of an Eastern Orthodox church. The view looks toward a large, multi‑tiered iconostasis covered with icons of saints and biblical scenes, surmounted by ornate arches filled with frescoes. A massive multi‑branch chandelier hangs in the center. The columns and vaults are densely painted with iconographic images and ornamental patterns. The framing and sepia tone suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Color-tinted vintage view of a rural riverside scene with a multi‑storey wooden industrial building beside the water and several wooden houses on a low hill in the background. Leafless birch trees stand along the riverbank, rustic wooden fences cross the foreground, and dense forest lies beyond. The image has a printed caption in the sky area that reads "Möbelfabriken, Kvillsfors."

Colorized old postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple green onion domes and crosses, rendered in a painterly style. The building stands alone on an open square, and at the top left of the card is printed text in German identifying the location.

Colorized historic postcard view of a medieval stone fortress tower and walls on a rocky hill, with trees and landscaped greenery in the foreground. To the right, a straight, tree-lined avenue recedes into the distance. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed red text in German appears at the upper left of the image.

Black-and-white view of a tree-lined urban park or square flanked by ornate late‑19th‑century apartment buildings. On the right stands a large statue of a uniformed man on a tall pedestal, surrounded by flowerbeds and shrubs. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the paths. The pedestal bears the inscription "BISMARCK" indicating a monument to Otto von Bismarck.

Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of two large villas in a rural, hilly landscape. The left building is labeled "Villa Lydia" and the right, larger building with a tower-like structure is labeled "Villa Felsenburg." A colored view over the historic town of Meissen, showing a hillside covered with trees and red‑roofed houses leading up to a large hilltop complex with a cathedral featuring twin Gothic towers and surrounding buildings. In the right foreground stands a separate church tower with a greenish dome roof. The sky is blue with a few clouds, and red German text is printed along the top.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession or gathering of men in dark coats and uniforms, many wearing peaked caps, in front of a large neoclassical building with tall columns and sculptural relief above the entablature. The scene appears ceremonial, with people assembled in rows on a cobblestone square, trees without leaves in the background, suggesting a cool season.

Color photograph of a large equestrian statue in front of a Gothic church with a steep red-tiled roof and clock tower. The foreground shows a monumental bronze group around a stone pedestal, with the central rider on horseback elevated above several standing and kneeling figures holding flags. Decorative pennant banners hang along the church façade, and a bed of flowers borders the base of the monument.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large villa and adjoining institutional building behind trees and hedges, seen from an open field in the foreground. The architecture features steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, chimneys, and arched windows on the larger hall-type structure. In the lower left corner, a caption is printed on the image.

A black‑and‑white view along a dirt road in a small town. Large leafy trees line both sides of the road; to the right is a wooden house with a porch and picket fence. Utility poles with overhead wires follow the road on the left. In the middle distance there is a church or chapel with a pointed steeple partly hidden by trees. Low hills or a small mountain rise in the background, with a faint structure or lookout on a ridge. The image has no printed caption or visible writing on its face.

Illustrated vintage postcard bordered with grapevines, showing a riverside town with a stone bridge over a wide river, several boats and a steamer, and on the hill above a large church and castle-like complex with towers and spires. At the top it reads "Gruss aus Meissen." Small printer information is along the left and bottom margins.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a church with a square tower topped by a small belfry and cross, surrounded by trees and a graveyard with many headstones and crosses. At the bottom left the caption reads "Målilla kyrka", and at the bottom right there is a photographer/publisher imprint.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a seafront promenade with a tall ornate lamppost, stone balustrade, and several people walking along the quay. At left stand multi‑story Mediterranean buildings packed closely together; at right is the sea with small boats and distant hills. Printed captions in French appear at the bottom, along with a publisher credit mentioning Corfu.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town with dense low-rise buildings and a prominent clock tower near the foreground. The architecture is early 20th‑century European, with tiled roofs and a few larger public buildings. Printed captions in two scripts run along the bottom border.

Old brown postal card with printed red Spanish coat of arms, the heading 'UNIÓN POSTAL UNIVERSAL / UNIÓN POSTALE UNIVERSELLE / ESPAÑA', and a printed 10 céntimos Spanish stamp at the upper right, canceled with black postmarks. Black‑and‑white commemorative postcard with decorative framing. At the top center is a photograph of a coastal fort and nearby buildings, labelled in Greek "ΑΥΓΟΥΣΤΟΣ 1824". Below is another coastal view with neoclassical buildings along the waterfront. Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small forested settlement centered on a railway station area and square. In the foreground is a dirt parking area with a few 1950s-era cars, a small white shed, and a simple gas station with two pumps. Printed caption text at the lower left reads "UTTRAN. Stationsplan" and a small circular logo with the word "Copyright" and number "301215" appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view over a large European square with grand stone buildings. On the right stands a richly decorated neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire, tracery windows and buttresses. In the center is a monumental theater or opera house with a domed roof and classical façade. To the left are substantial civic buildings with steep roofs and a clock tower. The open square in front is mostly empty except for scattered pedestrians and a few trees without leaves, suggesting winter. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Black-and-white multi-view postcard with four photographs of a modern socialist-era town: a tram running between prefabricated apartment blocks with a town coat of arms, a low modern shopping center with parked cars, a formal building with a small monument bust in front, and a large housing estate with many parked cars. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural valley with a small European village on a hillside. There are scattered houses, orchards, fields, a pond or river in the foreground with a simple wooden fence, and a church-like building with a tower on the hill in the distance. The image has a large blank space at the bottom where the caption and publisher information are printed.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm lagoon or harbor with two people in a small rowboat in the foreground. Low traditional houses line the waterfront on the left, with low hills in the distance. The water is still, reflecting the buildings. Greek text appears at the lower left, French and/or transliterated text at the lower right, and a circular seal and website watermark are visible.

A colorized vintage postcard depicting a wooden railway station building with green-trimmed windows and a gabled roof beside train tracks. People stand on the platform in front. At the bottom, there is ornate handwritten text and printed captions in a Scandinavian language. The left caption reads "Lidköping" and the right one reads "Jernvägsstationen." The publisher credit and number appear in small print along the bottom edge.

Colorized vintage view of a crowded promenade beside a large neo‑classical colonnade building next to a river. Text in German at the bottom identifies the place as Karlsbad and the Mühlbrunnen colonnade.

Black‑and‑white panoramic postcard showing a view over fields and trees toward a town with dense rows of houses and larger institutional buildings in the background. The caption in German at the top left reads "Frankenberg i. Sa. Neue Kasernen." indicating it depicts the new military barracks of Frankenberg in Saxony, Germany.

A monochrome postcard showing a coastal fortress and settlement on a rocky island or peninsula, viewed from the sea. Stone walls and circular fortifications rise above small buildings along the shoreline. At the top center there is French text identifying the scene, and at the bottom right appears a modern website watermark.

Hand-colored vintage postcard showing an indoor hot spring fountain erupting in a grand glass-and-iron hall. Elegant visitors in late 19th–early 20th century clothing and staff in white uniforms stand around a large circular basin from which a strong jet of water rises. The architecture features tall arched windows with decorative stained-glass elements. Printed German text identifies the scene as the 'new spring' in Karlsbad.

Sepia-toned historic street view labeled "Budapest. Alagut-utczca — Tunnelgasse." It shows a tree-lined avenue with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. At the end of the street there is an arched tunnel entrance in the hillside, and above on the hilltop stands a large palace-like building complex. The overall style and vehicles suggest an early-20th-century cityscape.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from a slightly elevated, tree‑covered slope. In the foreground are leafy trees, dirt paths and a few detached houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the middle distance a dense historic townscape with many gabled roofs is visible. Dominating the skyline are several large church buildings: to the left a massive church or cathedral complex with multiple towers, toward the center another church with twin towers, and to the right a prominent large church with a tall spire and long nave. Low hills or vineyards form the background horizon. Along the right vertical edge there is a handwritten or printed number sequence, but no clear caption on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a straight, narrow street lined with colonial-style buildings, some with arcades and simple facades, receding into the distance. The lower image shows a broad, tree-lined avenue or path, with large trees forming a canopy over a dirt or gravel road. At the top margin of the postcard is printed the credit line: "J. P. Fernandes, Photographer, Lourenço Marques."

Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a European spa town or riverside promenade. In the foreground is a dirt road with pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing and a horse‑drawn carriage. A narrow stream or canal runs along the right with a low bridge and railing. Modest single‑story buildings line the left bank, while on the right a long row of ornate multi‑story townhouses rises above a high retaining wall. In the hazy background on a hill stands a large romantic‑style château or spa complex with towers. A large wall advertisement on one of the tall buildings promotes a bottled drink labelled "Krondorfer Sauerbrunn".

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view framed by large stone columns and arches, looking into a sunlit courtyard with Romanesque/late Roman architecture. On the right is a building with shuttered windows and a shop sign reading "G. DEL BIANCO." At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the scene as Split and mentions the entrance to the cathedral.

A monochrome historic postcard view of a European city square with a large, ornate Neo‑Renaissance building featuring a central dome, clock, and corner towers. In front of it stands a multi‑tiered monument with statues, surrounded by an open plaza with café tables and umbrellas. A broad street with tram tracks, early motor vehicles, and pedestrians runs alongside rows of traditional townhouses; a church tower is visible further down the street.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a powerful river or waterfall with strong rapids rushing around a rocky island covered with trees. On the right side of the image there are man‑made structures, possibly mills or dams, along the riverbank. The scene is framed artistically, and printed text appears at the bottom center.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over gently rolling fields leading up to a cluster of substantial late‑19th‑century houses and institutional buildings. In the foreground is a small pond and grassy embankments with a few trees and farm structures to the right. On the horizon stands a prominent multi‑storey mansion or school‑like building with ornate rooflines, flanked by villas; farther right, a tall, slender church spire rises above trees. The image has irregularly cut borders typical of an old photographic postcard. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white landscape view across a calm lake toward a small settlement on a gently rolling hillside. Farm buildings and houses line the shore, and a church with a tall steeple stands on the right. Trees and grass frame the foreground. In the lower left corner the word "RÕUGE" and the photographer credit "Foto Niilus." are printed.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a Central European riverside town. In the foreground is a metal truss bridge on stone piers crossing a broad river with embankment walls. Behind the bridge stands a compact town of 19th‑century multi‑story masonry buildings and villas on a slope, with a prominent institutional building on the right and a squarish tower or church in the middle distance. The background shows gently rolling hills, fields, and a distant solitary tower or windmill on the ridge. No visible caption or text appears on the image.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large historic building complex partly hidden by trees on a hillside. The main structure on the left has multiple stories, steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and a small dome-like corner tower. To the right stands a smaller villa-like building with a tiled roof. Black‑and‑white postcard view of an archaeological site filled with stone ruins in the foreground, with a prominent rocky mountain rising behind it. At the bottom is printed bilingual text in Greek and French/English indicating the entrance to a sacred precinct (temenos) at Corinth. Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a dense historic town with steep tiled roofs, a church tower with a clock in the foreground, a central market‑square area, and a long multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a broad river in the background. Black‑and‑white image showing a motor vessel at a wooden pier. Several uniformed men stand on the deck and on the dock. The vessel's hull bears the marking "NV 38."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside view of Grenoble. In the foreground is the Isère River with a bridge crossing it. On the opposite bank are buildings at the foot of a steep rocky hill, with additional fortifications visible higher up the slope. A large mountain rises in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide, straight street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings leading toward a tall neo‑Gothic church tower. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. LANDES-ARCHIV" and the year "1903" on the lower right margin. Along the left edge appears a vertical publisher/date line.

A vintage monochrome postcard-style illustration showing an electric tram or train travelling over an elevated viaduct through a wooded, hilly area. The bridge has high arches and railings, with tall catenary poles carrying overhead wires for the tram. On the right is a road and parapet with countryside and distant flat landscape beyond. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin in Dutch.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the background are rolling fields, forests, and low hills. The architecture appears late 19th–early 20th century, with a mix of simple apartment houses and a few larger civic or villa-style buildings. No clear monumental structure dominates the view, and there is visible film damage on the corners, suggesting an old photograph reproduced as a postcard.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large, rectangular barracks building along a wide, unpaved tree‑lined street. Red printed text at the top identifies the scene, and vertical text appears along the left edge.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small chapel-like structure with a pointed roof perched on a rocky cliff, accessed by a wooden railing or walkway. Below the image is a printed caption in German and a circular archival stamp. The year 1903 is printed on the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic river with powerful rapids cutting through a steep, forested gorge. Printed at the bottom of the image is a caption identifying the view.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a railway station complex with several connected two‑storey buildings along a wide street or forecourt. Leafless trees line the street, and there is a path and shrubs in the foreground. At the top, typed text reads "Jelenia Gora – Dworzec".

Vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over a historic European town with dense pitched-roof houses, church towers and a large gabled hall-like building. Black‑and‑white winter landscape showing a snowy forest scene in bright low sun. A small river or stream flows between banks heavily covered with snow, while snow-laden trees and branches cast sharp shadows across the ground. Text is printed at the bottom margin of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard shows a line of Cambodian colonial soldiers (tirailleurs cambodgiens) in light uniforms and hats standing barefoot or booted in front of old brick fortress walls and cannons. A colorized vintage postcard view of a formal garden in a city park. A sandy path runs straight ahead under a green metal arch covered with climbing plants and flowers. Sa." on the left and "Im Stadtpark." on the right.

Black-and-white view of a large stone church shot through trees and a fence in the foreground. The building has multiple steep, tiled roofs, a large round rose window, and a central tower with wooden cladding. At the bottom left there is a printed caption in Swedish describing the church, and in the bottom right a small oval logo stating it is a real photograph.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large outdoor banquet or garden party. Sepia-toned postcard showing a sandy path running through a lightly wooded area with birch trees and shrubs. In the distance, on a low hill, there is a large cross, likely part of a Calvary site. At the bottom margin of the image there is a printed Dutch caption.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large half-timbered guesthouse or inn on a country road in a forested area. An early motorcar is parked in front and a man in period clothing stands in the road. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a stone tower and adjoining building in an open field. The structure has a square lookout tower and castle‑like architecture with arched windows. Vintage sepia postcard showing a hillside village with traditional houses surrounded by trees. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a Russian naval minelayer/transport ship at sea, with two tall smokestacks emitting dark smoke and a naval ensign flying at the stern. A vintage, monochrome postcard view over tiled rooftops and a church spire in the foreground, looking out toward a wide river with several sailing boats and flat riverbanks in the distance. Black‑and‑white street scene showing a mid‑20th‑century town center with a tall modernist high‑rise bearing the logos "SKB" and "Tempo". Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a broad curved square lined with multi-storey buildings and shops, tram tracks running through the middle, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, and mountains in the background. Colorized historical postcard showing a tree‑lined pond or small lake with several rowboats and people boating in the foreground. Sepia-toned postcard with a wide border showing a bustling market square filled with horse-drawn carts and people. Gabled merchant houses surround the square, and another church or towered building is visible to the right. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops, with church towers rising in the background. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Below the image is a printed caption identifying the scene, and the lower margin is filled with handwritten correspondence in Dutch.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a sloping street lined with traditional multi‑story houses and trees. Two people walk down the unpaved road toward the town center. Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Islamic-style public fountain with intricate geometric tilework and carved decoration. Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a long neoclassical colonnade packed with people strolling along a promenade beside a narrow river or canal. Vintage monochrome view of a tree‑lined urban street with late‑19th‑century townhouses and a building labeled "Parkschänke". Printed red text at the top identifies the location, and there is a handwritten red year notation.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a wooded park with tall deciduous and conifer trees and sandy paths diverging in the foreground. No printed caption or visible border text can be seen.

A vintage colorized postcard view of a landscaped park with lawns, trees, and footpaths on a slope above a pond. Vintage sepia postcard showing a rocky river with rapids flowing through a forested valley. Several people sit or stand on large rocks beside the water. Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a riverside industrial town.
