On the hill above are factories with tall chimneys, mixed with townhouses, trees, and a church with a slender spire.

Colorized historic view of a grand neo-baroque town hall building with a central dome and clock tower, flanked by symmetrical wings and smaller spires. In front stands a large monument with multiple statues around a fountain, and a public square with people walking and market stalls with umbrellas. The caption at the top left reads "Graz. Rathaus."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad urban street lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and in the street, and there is a prominent church tower with a clock rising on the right side in the distance. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in German identifying the scene as Bismarckplatz and Herrengasse in Graz.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an industrial and rural waterfront landscape with stacked timber, fenced areas and a river or harbor in the foreground. In the middle distance are factory buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, and in the background low forested hills. On a hill to the right stand several large houses. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom, and there is cursive handwriting over the lower part of the image.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a tall round defensive tower and adjoining walls on a sloping street with small buildings and pedestrians in the foreground. Decorative red text at upper right reads 'Salut de Constantinople.' At the bottom left there is a caption in French identifying the location, and a printed publisher line runs along the lower edge.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a broad street lined with trees and a large multi‑storey institutional building with classical detailing and a small onion dome tower. A few people stand on the sidewalk near wooden utility poles. Printed Russian text appears at the top of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an industrial mining complex beside a body of water. On the right stands a large brick and timber industrial building with a smokestack; on the left, additional mine buildings and a tall chimney emitting smoke, with a headframe structure visible. The foreground is a pond or reservoir with grassy banks. The caption at the bottom left in red letters reads "Freiberg. Grube Himmelfahrt," and the bottom margin contains a small printer's imprint.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large circular fountain complex with several jets of water in a rectangular basin labeled 'Kleine Leuchtfontäne'. Numerous empty folding chairs are arranged in rows in the foreground, suggesting performances or displays. People stroll around the fountain and across a broad plaza. In the background stands a long low pavilion building with large windows, café tables with umbrellas on a terrace, and an extended colonnade to the right. Beyond are residential houses and trees. Handwritten at the top is the word 'Dusseldorf', and there is a round exhibition-style stamp in the upper right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a multi‑arched stone bridge over a river with people walking across it and figures on the riverbank. Low mountains and trees appear in the background. The margins are filled with handwritten text in Greek, and a red place name is written at lower left. A printed website watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible at the bottom.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard with an oval-framed photograph mounted on a textured card border. The image shows a massive medieval city gate with round towers and battlements beside a canal, a small bridge in front, and a traditional windmill standing on a mound in the background to the right. At the bottom of the card, printed text identifies the scene.

A vintage postcard-style image showing a calm river or canal bordered by leafless trees. Small rowboats are on the water; one boat in the foreground carries a person rowing. The scene has a muted, painterly look. Along the bottom margin there is printed caption text.

Monochrome postcard showing a cylindrical medieval-style brick tower with a conical roof in a landscaped park. In the foreground there is a pond or moat with a small iron footbridge crossing the water, trees without leaves around it, and an islet. The image is framed in a circular vignette. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as Nijmegen and Kronenburger Park, with publisher and photographer credits.

Illustrated historic postcard showing elegant people in late‑19th‑century clothing strolling in a landscaped city park with a large ornate fountain labeled "Franz Joseph Brunnen" in the Stadtpark. To the right are inset views of a statue of a woman on a pedestal in a wooded area and a small decorative structure or shrine with a person looking at it, plus a tower in the background. Floral decorations and the title "Gruss aus Graz" appear in stylized script, and the lower part of the card is filled with handwritten purple ink text.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large cargo or refrigerated ship underway on calm water. The vessel is seen in profile, with multiple deck cranes amidships and an enclosed bridge and accommodation block forward. On the funnel there is a round company emblem, and the ship's name and home port are visible on the bow area.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox church with domes and arched windows in a mountainous landscape. The church dominates the foreground, with smaller buildings and cypress trees around it. Greek text is printed along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's mark and the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appear on the right.

A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignettes of city views. The main scene shows a riverside panorama with historic buildings and a church tower along the Mur river, with a hill topped by a fortress in the background. Smaller images depict a city square, a theater building with a domed roof, a tall lookout tower in a park, and a lake with trees and boats. The central caption reads "Gruss aus Graz," and the vignettes are labeled with German place names.

Vintage sepia postcard showing two black‑and‑white photographs of ancient Greek funerary reliefs framed like small temples. The left image depicts a standing warrior in armor within a niche; the right image shows a seated figure in a similar architectural frame. Greek and French captions identify the subjects, and at the top appears the bilingual title "ΑΘΗΝΑΙ — ATHÈNES." There is a postal cancellation mark dated 1902 and a handwritten signature or note in purple ink.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural settlement with a dirt road curving uphill between wooden fences. In the foreground is a white wooden house with a gabled roof and chimney; a vintage automobile is parked on the road beside it. Another similar house stands further up the hill. Trees line the road on the left. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

A sepia-toned photographic portrait of a man in a suit, holding a cigarette and looking toward the camera. At the top left is the printed name "ERNST LINKO". Across the lower half of the image there is a handwritten dedication in dark ink, ending with a signature and a date that appears to be 1926.

Black-and-white postcard showing a flooded urban street scene. Water covers the roadway up to the base of a large multi‑story building on the right, with trees and a submerged riverside or embankment on the left. The image documents a flood event. Printed caption text in German is below the photograph, and there are faint postal cancellation marks at the top.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a man standing on a wooden staircase built along a rocky cliffside, with railings and a dirt path in the foreground. Below, a city with tightly packed buildings and distant smokestacks is visible. At the bottom margin there is a caption in German.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside town with several multi‑storey buildings along a stone embankment and a steep rocky hill behind them. On top of the hill stands a large villa or small palace-like house, and further right is a smaller towered building. In the foreground a side‑wheel river steamer named "JOHN PENN" travels along the river. The title "Meissen‑R." is printed at the top left in red, and there is a red publisher's line near the bottom center.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornamental fountain with a central statue in a circular basin, surrounded by landscaped park greenery. Water jets arch around the statue. The caption below reads "GRAZ, Stadtpark - Brunnen." An oval red advertisement in the upper right corner says "Schichts Seifen die besten." There is also fine print along the left edge naming the publisher.

Black-and-white postcard view of a wide, elegant street corner in a European city. A long, curved Haussmann-style building with many windows and balconies lines the street; ground-floor shops have signs in French. Horse-drawn vehicles and pedestrians are visible on the broad avenue. Beneath the image is a caption printed in Cyrillic script.

A color postcard showing a staged theatrical performance inside a rustic wooden-set interior. Several actors in traditional Nordic folk costumes are seated or standing across the stage, with fishing nets, wheels, and tools hanging from the ceiling. At the top, large white text reads "KIMITO UNGDOMSFÖRENING rf". At the bottom, a caption in white text reads "TEATERTRADITION SEDAN 1897 (FRITT SVALLAR HAVET)". The overall style suggests a promotional postcard for a local theater association and its long-standing theater tradition.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a landscaped public square with a central octagonal bandstand or gazebo surrounded by paths, benches, and trees. In the background are low, colonial-style buildings and rugged mountains. A printed caption runs along the bottom border.

Colorized vintage view over a river with an iron bridge in the foreground, ornate lampposts, and a promenade. Across the water is a row of historic multi‑story buildings with red roofs and a tall church tower. In the background rises a wooded hill topped with fortifications and a prominent clock tower. Printed caption text appears at the top in German.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a fountain statue in a lush park or garden. The fountain features a young woman standing barefoot on a rocky pedestal, carrying a bucket beside a timber-like trough with water. Behind her is a column with sculpted details and what appears to be a bird on top. The foreground is landscaped with rocks and plants. Printed titles at the bottom identify the scene and the publisher with a date.

Vintage postcard featuring a large Greek flag with a royal crown emblem in the top left and a sepia photograph of the Parthenon temple on the Acropolis below. Beneath the image are printed captions in French: 'LE PARTHÉNON' and 'ATHÈNES'. There is cursive handwritten correspondence across the lower part of the card.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a waterfront scene with small sailboats moored along a wooden pier leading to a neoclassical building with an arcade facing the harbor. Other low-rise buildings line the waterfront. Handwritten text in Greek covers the lower margin, and a faint circular postal stamp is visible.

A multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard composed of five photographs. The images show: a riverside town with industrial buildings in a valley; a large stepped‑gabled town hall on an open square with people and early automobiles; the ornate twin‑tower west front of a Gothic cathedral; a view along a river with a bridge, boats, and a tower in the foreground; and a panoramic scene of the same river crossed by a long bridge leading toward a hilltop cathedral complex and old town. The layout and style suggest an early‑20th‑century European city postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a richly decorated Catholic church sanctuary. In the center is the main altar with a tabernacle, tall candlesticks, crucifix, statues, and floral arrangements. Side altars with statues of saints and potted plants flank it on both sides. Stained‑glass windows rise behind the altars, and wooden communion rails and benches are visible in the foreground. On the right border of the postcard is printed information about the photographer and location, along with several heraldic coats of arms.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide, unpaved street in a European small town. Two‑storey masonry houses with simple facades line both sides of the road; wooden fences and shuttered windows are visible. A church with a tall tower and spire stands at the end of the street in the background. Numerous children and a few adults in early‑20th‑century rural clothing gather and walk along the right side of the street, suggesting a lively village scene. Large leafy trees hang over the left side of the road.

Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city with dense, red‑roofed buildings seen from an elevated, green hillside. A prominent church-like structure with a steep, pointed roof appears on the left, and a grand civic building with ornate façade is visible near the center. The lower margin has printed German captions and publisher information, with handwritten cursive text across the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young man in a checked dressing‑gown style jacket, sitting sideways on a wicker chair and holding a smoking cigarette. Elegant early‑20th‑century style. Handwritten-style text in Danish appears at the top of the card, and a small studio credit and number are printed at the bottom.

Black-and-white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a mosque. The image focuses on an ornate mihrab niche framed by arches and intricate Islamic geometric and floral patterns. Tall candlestick-like stands or lamp holders flank the scene. At the bottom there is printed caption text in French identifying the location as Sidi-Bou-Medine and describing the interior of the mosque and its mihrab.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall stone obelisk‑type war memorial standing in an open landscape under a cloudy sky. The base has an inscription in Latvian and the shaft bears a relief with a crossed sword and shield or similar military symbols. Low flowers or shrubs surround the monument. The print and border style suggest an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcard.

Sepia-toned photograph of a large Romanesque-style church with two very tall, slender square towers topped by steep spires flanking the façade. The central front has a large rose window and rounded arches, with a smaller entrance arcade and a forecourt with gates and low walls. Behind the façade rises a massive octagonal crossing tower. Trees partly frame the building, and a few small human figures stand near the entrance. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a European city with densely packed rooftops in the foreground and a steep hill in the background. Atop the hill are several buildings and fortification structures, including a prominent clock tower on the right side. The printed words "GRAZ" and "Schloßberg" appear at the top against a plain sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a harbor scene with several traditional wooden sailing boats moored closely together. In the foreground, a man in traditional dress stands beside a long display of pottery: large amphora-style jars lined up in a row behind many smaller pots and jugs arranged on the ground. The scene appears to be a market or quay-side pottery stall. Printed captions in Latin characters and some Greek appear at the bottom, including the words "EGINE. POTERIE" and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".

Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside scene with a docked paddle steamer in the foreground, a rail track curving along the quay, and a hillside town in the background. On top of the hill stands a large historic building with a tall tower, identified as the Ferdinands­höhe. The caption in red German text at the top reads "Aussig. Blick nach der Ferdinandshöhe."

Vintage tinted photograph of a rural landscape near Freiberg, showing a tree-lined dirt road on the left, open meadow in the foreground, and forested hills with scattered buildings or farm structures in the background. Large tree branches frame the top edge of the image. German text is printed in red at the top center, and small publisher information appears along the bottom edge.

Black-and-white postcard view of a rural village landscape with a dirt road lined by leafless trees in the foreground, open fields in the middle ground, and several farmhouses and a prominent church with a tower in the background. The caption in red print at the upper left reads "Wendishbora. Post Nossen."

Black-and-white panoramic view over a rural riverside landscape with fields, scattered houses, and a prominent rocky cliff formation by a river. In the foreground there is a wooded slope, and in the lower margin there is a German caption printed in a decorative script.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large, rectangular multi-story brick institutional building standing alone in an open, sparsely landscaped area. The structure has many uniformly spaced windows and a glazed top floor or sunroom. A curved path or road leads toward the building across grass and bare ground. In the lower left corner, white caption text identifies the location as Vänersborg and names the facility Korseberga Kuranstalt.

A black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a dramatic rocky mountain massif with patches of snow on its steep slopes. A tall conifer tree stands on the right foreground, while the base of the mountain shows sparse vegetation and remnants of snowfields. The image is framed by a white border with scalloped edges, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a lake with a wooded island in the middle distance. Tree branches frame the scene from above. In the foreground a young woman sits on a simple wooden fence beside a dirt path at the lakeshore; a signpost stands to the right. The captioned handwriting at the bottom identifies the place.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long, low institutional building with many windows and a tiled roof, labeled as a police school. In front of the building is a garden area with a path, a small pavilion or gazebo, and a few people in uniform standing near the entrance. Additional multi‑story buildings can be seen in the background. The style suggests an early 20th‑century European scene.

Colorized historic view of a riverside promenade in a European spa town. Elegant multi‑story buildings line the left bank of a canal or river, while on the right is a grand neo‑classical colonnade with many columns and balustrades. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the wide walkway. The scene is framed by wooded hills and dense town buildings in the background. Red printed titles at the top read "Kreuzstrasse.", "Karlsbad.", and "Mühlbrunnen‑Kolonnade.".

A sepia-toned historic postcard depicting a central market square with a prominent church and tower in the background. Traditional European houses line both sides of the open square, and a small child stands alone in the middle of the square. The style suggests an early 20th‑century German town scene. Printed caption text appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European spa town nestled in a narrow forested valley. Dense wooded hills rise on both sides, enclosing a tightly packed ensemble of multi‑storey townhouses and grand hotels along a curving valley floor and river. Several ornate buildings with towers and spires line the central axis, with narrow streets and terraced structures climbing the slopes. The overall look is early‑20th‑century Central European architecture. No printed text or caption is visible on the card front.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a grand, tree‑lined riverside promenade in a Central European spa town. Elegant multi‑storey historicist buildings line the street on the left, while on the right is a colonnaded structure with statues on its roof, filled with strolling people in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background, more buildings climb the wooded hills. German text at the top identifies the scene as Karlsbad and specific streets or quays; publisher information appears at the bottom.

Sepia-toned industrial postcard showing a large clay and chamotte works facility with several long low factory buildings, two tall chimneys, and a dirt yard with narrow-gauge industrial tracks in the foreground. A few workers stand near the buildings. The top contains printed German text identifying the works, and the bottom margin has a publisher imprint and number.

Colorized panoramic view of a historic European city taken from a wooden pavilion or balcony with carved railings in the foreground. A river runs through the city with quays and multiple bridges; dense blocks of 3–5‑story buildings with red roofs line both sides of the river. Church towers rise among the houses, and low mountains or hills appear in the distance. The scene is framed ornamentally by the pavilion structure. Faint printed text in German appears in the upper left sky area.

Black‑and‑white image showing a landscaped park or garden with lawns and shrubs in the foreground and a long, ornate wooden pavilion or spa building in the center-right. The structure has a covered veranda with many arches and a gabled central section with decorative trim. Behind it are wooded hills and additional chalet-style buildings, suggesting a mountainous or forested resort area. The architecture appears Central European, likely from the early 20th century.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bustling cobblestoned square with people in early 20th‑century clothing walking in front of ornate Gothic-style buildings. Tall decorated trees and a small pavilion marked "Exposition" indicate a horticultural exhibition taking place in the city's main square. Printed caption text is visible beneath the image and along the left margin.

A stylized postcard featuring an illustrated medieval woman holding a basket, with another smaller medieval female figure depicted within the outline of her dress. The background is olive green with faint historic-looking script text. On the left, a large white letter 'M' appears above the printed name 'Mariken van Nieumeghen'. The overall design references a historic literary figure rather than a physical place.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a town street lined with trees, showing a prominent historic building with a tall clock‑tower-like structure and ornate roof, likely a post office, and a church spire in the background. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk in front of the building. Printed captions in German identify the location as Bad Elster and reference the imperial post office and the publisher.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Renaissance Revival opera house on a busy city street corner. The multi‑story building has arched windows, elaborate stonework, and a prominent mansard roof. In front and alongside run wide streets filled with pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicles or carriages, early automobiles, and several electric trams. At the top right of the image is a printed caption identifying the scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall rocky outcrop with a statue of a deer or chamois standing on its peak. At the base there is a simple wooden rail beside a path, and in the background a town lies in a hilly, wooded valley. At the top left, in red print, is the caption identifying the location.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a leafy park and garden toward a walled town with red roofs and a large church featuring multiple tall spires. In the right foreground are stone fortifications and an arched gateway with a few people standing nearby. At the top right is printed German text identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural estate surrounded by fields and forest. Several farm buildings, a silo-like tower, and a larger manor‑style house are visible among trees. Text is printed along the bottom of the image, including a Swedish caption identifying the place and production details of the photograph.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large institutional complex composed of several multi‑storey buildings with steep, hipped roofs and dormer windows, arranged around a curved entrance road. A gated archway with a striped barrier stands at the main entrance, where a few people are walking. The architecture is early‑20th‑century Central European, with brick or rendered facades and stone bases. There are bare trees, open grounds, and utility poles with overhead wires, suggesting a suburban or edge‑of‑town setting.

Black‑and‑white view of a European market square with cobblestone ground and rows of stalls selling goods, many people in early‑20th‑century dress, and horse carts. On the left and center stand narrow gabled townhouses with steep tiled roofs and painted façades bearing German‑language shop signs. In the background, on a hill above the town, rises a large fortified castle complex with towers and massive walls, overlooking the square.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a city square with trees and a carriage in the foreground and a prominent church with a tall steeple and adjacent multi‑story buildings in the background. The style suggests a late 19th–early 20th century European urban scene. Printed captions identify the view as a greeting from Graz and label the church as an evangelical church.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm bay with gentle waves in the foreground and forested landmasses on both the left and right sides, forming the entrance to a bay. At the top is printed text in Portuguese identifying the location as Ilha do Príncipe in Bahia.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. The town is composed of dense clusters of traditional houses with pitched roofs, traversed by a winding road and a small river or stream. A prominent church with a tall spire and Gothic-style windows stands on the right side, dominating the skyline. Forested hills and fields surround the settlement. At the top center of the card, printed in red, is the caption identifying the place.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a neoclassical complex with a central temple‑like building featuring a columned façade and triangular pediment, flanked by colonnaded wings. Two tall columns with statues stand in front, and there is a formal garden with palm trees and paths in the foreground. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, and there is handwriting and postal ink on the image.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city. The tower has a steep shingled roof, projecting wooden galleries, and huge clock faces with Roman numerals on its sides. In the foreground is a path and trees; in the background, the city spreads out across a valley. Printed caption text at the top reads: "Graz. Uhrturm am Schloßberg".

Colored postcard view framed by trees, looking down onto a coastal village with clustered houses and a prominent church tower, set by the sea or a large bay. The lower left printed caption identifies the scene as a village on Corfu. There are handwritten notes and a printed photographer/editor credit on the left margin, plus a modern website watermark across the bottom right.

Black-and-white landscape view over a small settlement and surrounding meadows in a hilly, densely forested region. A few buildings line a road in the foreground, while open fields and coniferous forests stretch across rolling hills into the distance. In the lower right corner there is a printed caption indicating the location and altitude.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square lined with multi‑story historic buildings with gabled roofs. Shop signs in German run along the façades, including an apothecary, bakery, inn, and a place labeled "Raritätenheim." Numerous adults and children in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand or walk around the open square.

Black-and-white postcard view of a rocky shoreline and bay with pine trees, small sailboats anchored in the water, and a large wooden clubhouse-style building on a low hill by the sea. A pier extends from the shore, and forested land surrounds the scene. Printed caption text appears along the bottom identifying the clubhouse and photographer.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style illustration of a small cinema and theatre building with simple Art‑Deco lines. On the upper front, the word "CINEMA" is displayed, and beneath it is the name "TEATRU ADREANI". The building sits in a grassy area with a straight pathway leading from the foreground to the entrance, and there are low structures or fences on either side with trees in the background.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large curved institutional building with many identical windows, stone base and stucco upper walls, fronted by a high stone wall and iron fence. At the center rear rises a tower with an onion‑shaped dome and clock, topped by a weather vane. In front is a cobblestone square or street where several adults and many children in early‑20th‑century clothing are walking or standing, some near a small circular fountain or planting area. The architecture is monumental and slightly baroque, suggesting a school or municipal building in a European city.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental, mound‑shaped memorial complex with a central staircase leading up the slope. At the front is an arched entrance facade with the inscription "VLADISLAV VARNENSI" and decorative plants. Two tall, minimalist pillars stand symmetrically in the foreground. The printed caption along the bottom edge is in Bulgarian and German and identifies the site and city.

A black‑and‑white view of a historic European market square lined with ornate gabled houses and a prominent town hall–like building on the right. On the left stands a tall clock tower with a distinctive bulbous crown. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk across the open square in the foreground. At the bottom center of the image, the caption reads "MARKT — NIJMEGEN."

Colorized vintage view of a broad, tree‑lined avenue with tram or streetcar tracks and early 20th‑century buildings on both sides. At the bottom margin, decorative script text identifies the location as a street in Nijmegen. The overall style and aging of the paper indicate an old postcard.

An old monochrome postcard view of a tree‑lined path in a wooded park or moat area. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the dirt path, surrounded by large mature trees and dense foliage. The title text at the bottom identifies the scene as a part of the city moat in Eisleben, and a printer's line with date appears along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside promenade and small harbor. In the foreground there is a landscaped park with curved gravel paths and young trees. Beyond a fence and road, a wide river or canal runs horizontally across the image. A pier or small bridge extends into the water where a steamship and a few small boats are moored. On the opposite bank are low wooden buildings and a forested area. Two people walk along the waterfront, one holding an umbrella. The caption "Joensuu" appears printed in the upper left corner, with a handwritten number above it.

A sepia-toned rural scene showing a substantial stone-and-wood farm or manor building behind wooden fences, with trees in the yard and a gently sloping countryside with scattered houses in the background. The image has a handwritten-style caption at the bottom left.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a dense crowd gathered in front of ornate multi‑storey neoclassical buildings. Banners and decorations hang from the façades, suggesting a public celebration or event. On the right side, printed vertically in French and Greek, is a caption identifying the scene as the Grand Hotel Splendid in Salonique (Thessaloniki).

Black‑and‑white image showing a traditional windmill beside a small house with a tiled roof, viewed from across a body of water with reeds in the foreground. The sky is clear and there is a tree to the left of the windmill. The image has the proportions and border typical of an old photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a vaulted stone courtyard seen through a large Gothic-style arch. The image shows a two‑storey arcade with rounded arches and a central courtyard where a sculpture or fountain stands. The scene has a medieval, cloister-like atmosphere. At the lower right, a modern website watermark is visible.

Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a corner city block with a large historicist four‑story building housing 'Café Central' on the ground floor. People walk along the street and awnings cover shopfronts. The caption at the top identifies the scene as Jakobstraße in Naumburg an der Saale.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a seated woman in a long dark dress with a high lace collar and cuffs, likely from the early 20th century. She sits on a rustic-looking bench in front of a painted backdrop showing trees and a lake or river landscape. She holds a rectangular object, possibly a document or book, in her lap. There is faint studio text along the left edge of the image.

Sepia-toned postcard image of a large stone hydroelectric power station building beside a fast-flowing river. The structure has a series of tall arched windows and multiple water outlets at its base. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, multi‑storey administrative building with many rectangular windows and a small attached veranda or annex in front. The foreground contains a garden with paths, trees and shrubs. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location in Dresden and specify that it is the administration building of the garrison hospital. A vertical imprint along the left edge lists the publisher.

Black-and-white postcard featuring a high-contrast graphic print of an abstract architectural installation or model viewed from above. At the very top, typed text reads "Kennedy & Violich Architecture Installation Design & Model." There is no handwriting, stamp, or other visible postal markings on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a river with a multi‑arched stone bridge or weir in the center, large mill buildings on both riverbanks, and trees and low hills in the background. The reflection of the structures appears clearly in the still water. At the top in red print is a caption in Czech.

Vintage black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view over a wooded valley with a village and a large castle-like complex on a hill. The castle has a tall tower with a spire rising above multi‑storey buildings. The settlement lies along a narrow valley with scattered houses and a railway or road running through. At the top center, in red print, is the word "Weesenstein."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy coastal waterfront with many small boats in a harbor and crowds along the quayside. Behind the harbor is a line of low waterfront houses, and further up the hill stands a large rectangular institutional building identified as 'Casa Caridad'. At the bottom margin appears a printed caption in red, and there is a handwritten message in English across the lower front. A circular library stamp is visible in the upper right area.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small European town from a slightly elevated vantage point. In the foreground there is a wooden fence and dense trees and gardens. Behind them stand low industrial or warehouse-type buildings with many identical windows. Further up the hillside are rows of residential houses with steep roofs, and among the trees in the distance a church tower with a dome or onion-shaped spire rises above the town. A wooded hill forms the backdrop. The print has white borders with slightly scalloped edges, typical of early–mid 20th‑century postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of the small frontier town of Williams, Arizona. In the foreground are multiple railroad tracks running horizontally across the image, with telegraph poles beside them. Behind the tracks stands a row of simple wooden and brick buildings comprising the town, with a few two‑story commercial structures visible. Smoke rises from a building in the mid‑distance. Pine‑covered hills and low mountains form the background under a light sky. The card has printed captions along the borders and at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic Italian square with cobblestone pavement. In the foreground is a stone lion sculpture at the base of a column. In the background stands a tall medieval clock or civic tower with Ghibelline-style battlements, attached to or overlooking a long palazzo façade with arched doors, balconies, and shuttered windows. Several people are gathered in the square. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'TRENTO - Torre Grande' along with a small serial number.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a European town. Multi‑story buildings line both sides of a wide street with trees and a sidewalk; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the pavement and a horse‑drawn carriage travels down the road. In the distance, a baroque church with two onion‑domed towers dominates the background. At the top of the card, printed in a serif typeface, is the caption "Bodenbach-Rosawitz."

Colorized historic postcard view of a church tower rising above trees and a park-like square. In the foreground, a path or street with a few pedestrians and a tall street lamp is visible. Behind a fence and dense greenery stands a large church with a tall steeple and clock tower. The sky is clear blue. Red printed captions appear at the top of the card.

Colorized panoramic view over a coastal town with many villas and buildings on a hilly island foreground, looking across the sea toward another hilly island. The style is early 20th‑century, with French caption text printed along the top and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cylindrical medieval brick tower with a conical roof and a cross-topped spire. The tower stands at the end of a wet, reflective street bordered by multi‑story buildings. Small figures of pedestrians and an early 20th‑century car are visible. Below the image is a caption indicating the location and name of the tower.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall medieval church with a massive square tower and a very high, slender spire rising above an old town with pitched-roof buildings. In the foreground is the church roof and nave; in the background another church tower is visible. At the bottom right the caption reads "NIGULISTE KIRIK".

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story residential and commercial buildings. A few pedestrians and a cyclist move along the street, and a horse-drawn cart is visible in the middle distance. The architecture appears late 19th to early 20th century European. At the top center, the caption reads "Cottbuser Straße", and on the right-hand building there is a sign with the word "Atelier".

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over the historic center of a city framed by mountains. In the foreground is a square with arcaded buildings and a domed church roof. A tall medieval clock tower with battlements rises prominently on the right. The caption at the bottom margin reads "TRENTO - Panorama dal Duomo."

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small rural town surrounded by flat, open farmland and forests in the distance. In the foreground is a prominent church with a tall spire and adjoining graveyard, with scattered houses, barns, and narrow roads around it. The landscape is largely agricultural fields divided into rectangular plots, with a straight road leading out toward the horizon. No visible printed text or caption appears on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white view of a busy town square with market stalls and many people in traditional European clothing. The focal point is a large Renaissance‑style town hall with a steep tiled roof, gables, small towers with spires and a central clock. In the foreground, groups of women wearing regional folk costumes gather near a fountain; horse‑drawn carts and early carriages are visible at the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground there are rocks and trees, behind them a large multi-storey sanatorium-like building with towers and chimneys on the left, and a compact town with steep-roofed houses and a church or clock tower in the middle distance. Rolling hills and fields stretch into the background. Printed German text appears at the top left of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small wooden railway station building labeled "Kastlösa" beside a single‑track railway. A steam locomotive with several carriages is stopped in front of the station, and a few people stand near the platform. The station is fenced and set slightly above the tracks. Printed red text at the top identifies the location.

Black-and-white photograph showing a procession of riders on horseback in elaborate, historical-style uniforms with plumed helmets crossing a narrow bridge toward a fortified gate. The gate is part of a large stuccoed building with many rectangular windows and a tiled roof. Above the arched gateway is an ornate baroque coat of arms flanked by two lions and surmounted by a row of crowns or plumes. People on foot follow the riders through the gate. The image has the appearance of an old printed postcard, with some handwritten or printed marks at the very top edge.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene looking toward the sea, lined with neoclassical buildings and palm trees. Early automobiles are parked at the end of the street by the waterfront. The architecture is typical of early 20th‑century Mediterranean port towns. Greek text appears along the bottom margin, and a modern website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is visible across the lower right.

Vintage illustrated postcard featuring a costumed stage actress in a long red and white robe, pointing outward in a dramatic pose. She wears a large white hat with a feather. The border has decorative flowers in the corners. The top text reads "THEATRO DA TRINDADE" and below the figure is the name "THEREZA TAVEIRA", followed by Portuguese text describing her role in a theatrical revue titled "O PAIZ DO VINHO". The printer credit at the bottom mentions Lisbon.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town at the foot of a rocky hillside. In the foreground there is a prominent neoclassical-style building complex beside a road and railway or tram tracks, with additional smaller buildings and tree‑lined streets stretching toward the base of the hill. Densely packed houses climb up the slope in the background. Greek text is printed at the bottom, and a website watermark appears on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with 2–3 story masonry townhouses, dominated in the foreground by a large, ornate corner building with classical details (rusticated ground floor, pilasters, pediments over windows, and an attic pediment with a circular opening). Leafless trees line the left side of the street; several people stand near doorways and on the sidewalk. The scene suggests a small European town in the late 19th or early 20th century.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a pavilion-like building with ornate gables and a columned porch, surrounded by a picket fence and rows of wooden benches in the foreground. Tall trees line the background. Red printed Hungarian text appears in the upper left corner.

A monochrome postcard depicting an old stone ruin surrounded by trees. The structure has partially collapsed walls, arched windows, and remnants of columns, indicating a historic building in decay. At the bottom center of the card there is printed text indicating the location of the ruin.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an old arched stone bridge in a rural or small-town setting. A person with an animal (likely a donkey or horse) stands on the bridge. In the background are trees, low buildings, and at least one tall, slender tower that resembles a minaret. The overall style looks like an early 20th‑century printed postcard. There is a short printed caption at the bottom center of the image, but it is too small and blurred to read clearly.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European town square paved with cobblestones, surrounded by 2‑ to 3‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled roofs. On the left are shopfronts with German signage; in the middle stands a building with the sign "Hermann Hanse" and a tall factory chimney rising behind it. To the right, more houses line a narrow street leading toward a larger building with a clock tower and cross. A lone person stands near a low wall and gate in the center distance.

Illustrated postcard showing a stylized drawing of a grand neoclassical building with a large dome, colonnaded façade, sculptural pediment and statues on the roof, surrounded by trees in the foreground. Below the image there is printed text indicating the location and building name, with additional publisher information at the very bottom margin.

A color postcard showing a mountainous alpine landscape with dramatic rocky peaks in the background, labeled with their local names. A simple open ski‑lift/chairlift crosses the scene above a forest of dark green conifer trees. In the foreground there is a grassy meadow and bright red flowering shrubs. The sky is clear blue with a few clouds. The labels on the peaks identify various summits in the Brenta Dolomites.

Monochrome postcard view of a rural landscape with forested hills in the background, cultivated fields in the foreground, and several houses clustered around a small church with an onion-shaped dome tower. The text at the top reads "Maria Grün bei Graz".

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European village. In the foreground is a calm river crossed by a simple concrete bridge with metal railings, framed by trees and foliage. Beyond the bridge lie open grass and several modest houses with pitched roofs. In the distant background, a church tower with a pointed spire rises above the trees. The caption text is printed in white at the bottom edge of the image.

Old black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing a large gabled building complex identified as the Seemannshaus (Sailors' Home), with two main exterior views, a small scene of a cornerstone‑laying ceremony, and a vignette of two uniformed naval officers. Decorative caption banners and handwritten-style title text appear on the card, along with the city name Wilhelmshaven.

Multi-view black-and-white postcard showing night scenes of a modern street with shops, apartment blocks, a central abstract fountain with jets of water, and a statue in a small square. The middle band bears the title 'Dresden - Straße der Befreiung' in a decorative Gothic script. Lower images display illuminated storefronts with German signage such as a jewelry and watch shop, a department store, and a youth fashion center.

Black‑and‑white vintage photograph showing a very large crowd gathered outdoors in a park or tree‑lined avenue. Most people wear hats and coats typical of the early 20th century. In the background there is a small monument or statue on a pedestal and some placards held above the crowd, but no legible writing. The card has the typical white border and format of an old photographic postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped park or garden lined with tall cypress trees and a curved path. There are buildings partly visible in the background. The lower margin contains captions in Cyrillic and in French identifying the place as Stara Zagora and calling it the city of cypresses.

An old sepia-toned postcard designed over the front page of a Portuguese newspaper titled "Novidades" dated Friday, 4 April 1902. In the center, a torn-paper effect reveals a photograph of a waterfront fortress tower with battlements, identified below as "Lisboa. Torre de Belem." The photo is overprinted with a large circular postal cancellation. There are multiple postal marks and extensive handwritten script in ink addressing the card to a person in Spain. The overall style is antique and journal-like.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a row of standing and ruined Doric columns from an ancient Greek temple, viewed from below among stone blocks. Beneath the image there is an Italian caption identifying the site as the Temple of Hercules in Girgenti (Agrigento), from the Greek period.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural village landscape with fields in the foreground and a cluster of houses and farm buildings in the middle distance. On the left stands a prominent church with a tall tower and spire. The text "Gruss aus Planitz." is printed in red at the bottom, and a small publisher's line "Brück & Sohn, Meissen" with a number appears lower left.

Sepia-toned historic street and riverside view showing a bridge with pedestrians and a tram, leading into a city square lined with multi-story buildings. A prominent church with an onion-domed tower rises near the center. The river runs along the right side, bordered by a stone embankment. At the bottom margin is a printed caption in German identifying the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large four‑storey corner building in a European city. The façade is richly ornamented in a late 19th‑century style. Printed captions at the bottom identify the intersection of two streets and note that the building houses a private gymnasium and boarding school run by Franz Scholz. On the right side there is handwritten German text in ink, and in the top right corner the city name and date are written. The left bottom corner bears a small printer's mark.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a bust monument of a bearded man mounted on a stone pedestal in a grassy park. The pedestal bears a relief sculpture and the large inscription "CARDUCCI". Behind the monument stands a tall conifer tree and, further back, a multi‑storey neoclassical building with the words "PALAZZO DEL GOVERNO" on its roofline.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a partial view of a long institutional building with a bell-tower on the left, a tree-lined street and people walking and standing along the road. At the top in red print is a Spanish caption describing the view of the institute and San Pablo street in Figueras.

Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined open square with a prominent two‑story red‑brick railway station building in the center-right. The station has arched windows and an ornate entrance, with smaller wooden station buildings and a cart or wagon visible further back. The ground is unpaved and there are large leafy trees framing the scene. At the top center, red printed text reads "Karlshamn. Järnvägsstationen."

Black-and-white waterside scene showing a small Nordic town with wooden houses along a stone embankment. Two early-20th‑century cars are parked by a road in front of the houses. On the right, a larger multi-storey house stands partly on stilts over the water, whose still surface clearly reflects the buildings. Trees and low wooded hills appear in the background. The caption "STENUNGSUND." is printed at the bottom left, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 3494 is at the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard photograph showing a forested mountain landscape with coniferous trees on both sides of a narrow stream or path running downhill. In the distance, layered hills or low mountains are visible under a cloudy sky. At the bottom margin, there is printed German text identifying the location.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a complex of large brick and stucco hospital buildings surrounded by trees, gardens, and what appears to be vineyards on a hillside. In the distant left background a windmill stands on a ridge. The architecture features steep, gabled roofs with dormer windows and decorative spires. At the bottom center, printed text in German identifies the view as the municipal hospital in Meissen on the Elbe River.

A hand‑colored historical postcard showing elegantly dressed men and women gathered around a fenced mineral spring inside a grand hall with tall windows and ornate architectural details. The scene is indoors, with large doors opening toward a leafy park outside. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the salt spring in Bad Elster. The style of clothing and printing suggests an early 20th‑century European spa resort setting.

Black-and-white photograph of a tree-lined park with a round fountain at the center, water jets spraying upward. People sit on benches and on the fountain rim, and paths and lawns are visible among the trees. The bottom corners of the image contain printed location text.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a calm river bending through a rural landscape with grassy banks and forests in the background. On the distant bank stand several houses and a tall metal tower or mast. The image has a white border with scalloped edges and printed caption text at the bottom.

A black-and-white street scene showing a large formal parade proceeding down a cobblestone main street lined with wooden commercial buildings and awnings. Soldiers in uniform march in formation behind several men on horseback; at least one carries a large U.S. flag. Crowds in early-20th‑century dress pack both sidewalks and storefronts, many wearing straw boaters or wide‑brimmed hats. Overhead are telegraph/telephone wires and some bunting and flags decorating the buildings. The image is framed in a way typical of a photographic postcard.

Color postcard view of a large river curving through a green landscape with meadows on the inside of the bend. A historic white paddle steamer with a red‑topped smokestack and many passengers is sailing in the foreground; the name "RIESA" is visible on the side of the vessel. On the right bank stands a hilltop complex dominated by a large Gothic‑style church with tall spire and attached castle‑like buildings overlooking a town of red‑roofed houses. Bridges cross the river in the middle distance, and low wooded hills form the background.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of workers outdoors in a quarry- or hillside-like setting. They stand in a semicircle with large wooden wheelbarrows in front of them. The men wear hats and simple work clothes. Above the image is printed text, and below there is printed greeting text in red plus handwritten cursive text covering the lower half of the card.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide river landscape with several cargo boats on the water and low, flat banks typical of a delta. In the foreground is a quay with moored boats and the roof of a brick house. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white photograph postcard showing a small rural church complex with a steeply pitched tiled roof and whitewashed walls, accompanied by a separate wooden bell tower with shingle cladding. The foreground includes a path, lawn, and low landscaping. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the church as Grevbäcks kyrka, and publisher information appears on the right.

Color photograph with scalloped edges showing a white three‑masted sailing ship moored by a green, tree‑lined shore. In the blurred foreground there is a large rusted iron mooring ring on a quay, framing the ship in its center. Behind the ship stands a historic brick building with towers and spires, and a small flag that appears to be the Swedish flag. The scene is on calm water under a cloudy sky.

Illustrated postcard showing a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river with several steam-powered boats below. The bridge carries roadway traffic and connects to a historic town with church towers and dense traditional buildings on the far bank. Dutch text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of an industrial complex beside a body of water and surrounding fields. The facility has long factory buildings with pitched roofs, a tall smokestack, several cylindrical silos, smaller outbuildings, and nearby roads and farmland. In the lower‑right corner there is a printed logo with the text "HAMMAR." The image has the aesthetic of a mid‑20th‑century industrial postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square with several multi‑story historic buildings. On the right, a corner building carries large German shop signs, including a confectionery advertising Baumkuchen, and next to it is a taller building with an external stair and a clock‑tower cupola on the roof. In the background stand more traditional townhouses enclosing the square and a central fountain or monument; a few pedestrians walk across the open square.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade and side view of a large cathedral with a decorative gabled front, arched portals, and a dome and bell tower behind it. Surrounding city buildings and a distant landscape are visible to the left. The caption at the bottom margin reads "MESSINA - Duomo - Secolo IV."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor garden restaurant with tables and folding chairs under leafy trees. People in early‑20th‑century clothing sit and drink wine; waitstaff stand nearby. In the background is a house or inn with a veranda, surrounded by dense plants. At the bottom is printed red text identifying the location as a wine tavern garden in Meissen.

Colorized panoramic view of a historic European city with red-roofed houses and public buildings nestled around a wooded hill, beyond which lie soft, rolling mountains. Atop the hill and nearby elevations are small pavilion-like lookout structures. The caption in German at the top identifies the scene as a view of Graz from the Hilmwarte. Additional small print at the upper right edge indicates the publisher and city.

Colorized vintage view over a calm lake in a landscaped park. Small rowing boats with people are on the water, surrounded by lush trees and shrubs. On the far shore stands a round, temple‑like pavilion with columns. In the foreground is a lakeside promenade with a stone balustrade. Printed German text appears at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a heavily damaged waterfront city block. A large multi‑storey building, identified as the Olympe(s) Hotel, stands in ruins with its façade gutted and interior exposed. Surrounding structures on the quay are also partially destroyed. In the background are additional damaged buildings and a domed structure with a statue or finial. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe the scene, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a leafy pergola walkway on a hillside terrace. A wooden railing runs along the left side overlooking a hazy valley, while a wall covered in vines lines the right. In the foreground on the right, a man sits leaning on a long wooden table with chairs beside it. Stairs and another pergola structure are visible in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the pergola on the Schlossberg in Graz.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow, steep, cobblestone alley lined with old houses and stone or brick walls on both sides. The buildings have tiled roofs and overhanging upper stories, typical of traditional Balkan architecture. At the bottom right there is printed text in Cyrillic and Latin scripts, and a small serial number and initials appear at the lower left.

A colorized historical postcard showing a grand railway station building in an Orientalist architectural style, with arched windows, domes and corner turrets. People walk and ride horse‑drawn carriages along a broad street in front of the station. Printed multilingual captions (French, German, and Ottoman Turkish) identify the building and its location.

A sepia-toned portrait postcard featuring a bearded man in a suit and bow tie, presented in a formal studio style with his upper body facing slightly to the side. Beneath the image is printed text identifying him, along with his profession and city in French. There is a handwritten date at the top in Greek and extensive handwritten Greek text covering the lower half of the card, typical of an early 20th‑century correspondence postcard.

An old sepia-toned panoramic view of an industrial and residential area with many small wooden houses in the foreground and larger brick buildings, chimneys, and a church visible in the distant background. At the bottom there is printed caption text in Romanian and French and handwritten correspondence across the margin, indicating it is a mailed postcard.

A colorized panoramic view of a historic European city with red-tiled roofs, several church towers, and a hilly green landscape in the background. A tall tower with an onion-shaped dome dominates the right side, while a large multi-story building and smaller shops line the foreground. The scene has the look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. At the top left, the word "GRAZ." is printed in red capital letters.

A vintage sepia-toned winter view over a harbor area with snowy trees, railway tracks, horse-drawn vehicles on a road, and smoking ships at the quays. In the distance a low, industrial and civic skyline of a northern European city is visible across the water. Handwritten-style captions appear in two languages along the bottom border.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large military formation on a wide parade ground with soldiers on foot and on horseback, with artillery pieces, in front of a hillside town backed by mountains. In the upper left corner there is an inset portrait of a woman inside an ornate frame. Along the right margin, red printed Italian text identifies the location and publisher, and there is a handwritten name in dark ink.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an illustration of a street corner with multi‑storey townhouses. The main building is a traditional European inn or wine tavern with shuttered windows and awnings; pedestrians stand in front. On the right, a decorative scroll cartouche bears a greeting and the name of an establishment. The lower half of the card is filled with handwritten German text and a date.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm river or lake with rippling water and reeds in the foreground on the right. On the opposite bank a wooded hill rises, topped by a townscape with a prominent tall‑spire church and a castle‑like complex with towers. In the bottom right corner, printed caption text identifies the scene.

A vintage multi-view postcard designed as a strip of photographic film winding across a grey background. Each film frame shows a different landmark or city view in color: a panoramic river-and-mountain view of the city, monumental buildings, a circular colonnade, a war memorial or monument, a fountain in a square with historic buildings, and a church with a tall bell tower. On top of the film strip there are cut-out labels with Italian text.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a river or mill pond bordered by trees, with a large multi-story brick or stone industrial building (likely a mill) on the right bank. A small dam or weir spans the water in the mid‑background. Two children sit on the grassy bank in the lower right corner, looking toward the water. The scene is rural and tranquil, with forest in the background and clouds in the sky. In the lower left corner there is a photographer's imprint.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a broad valley with farms, scattered houses, forested areas and a large lake or fjord. Low mountains rise in the background under a partly cloudy sky. In the foreground are cultivated fields and farm buildings. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge, and a cursive photographer or publisher signature appears in the lower right corner.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a calm river or canal lined with trees on both banks, with a multi-arch stone bridge carrying a simple wooden railing across the water. A few people stand by the stone embankment in the left foreground. The scene is framed by overhanging tree branches, and handwritten-style text appears at the bottom center of the image.

Color postcard featuring a central illustrated map of the Nijmegen area with roads, rivers, small drawings of animals, buildings, and repeated labels reading "NIJMEGEN." Around the map are photographic views of sandy dunes, countryside landscapes, and people relaxing or walking outdoors. At the bottom, in cursive script, is a greeting in Dutch.

A color postcard-style image showing a coastal hilltop fortress overlooking a seaside town. In the foreground are tropical trees, including palm fronds and a flowering tree with vivid red-orange blossoms. Below are red-tiled roofs and low-rise houses; in the distance, on a green hill, a large, light-colored fort dominates the skyline with the ocean visible beyond under a blue sky.

Color image of a lakeside leisure area with pedal boats and rowboats on calm blue water, a sandy beach crowded with sunbathers and swimmers, and willow trees lining the shore. Flower boxes filled with colorful blossoms sit on a metal fence in the foreground, with spherical lampposts on either side. In the background rise steep, rocky mountains under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds. The style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist resort in an Alpine region.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing the interior of a Gothic church or cathedral. The view focuses on tall pointed arches, clustered stone columns with carved capitals, ribbed vaults, wooden pews in the foreground, a pulpit or confessional, and an elevated choir area with decorative wooden screens and tracery. On the right side there are sculpted stone doorways and wall plaques. The image has the look of an old printed postcard with a white border and slightly deckled edge.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a tree‑lined boulevard with a central statue on a pedestal surrounded by a low decorative metal fence and a small fountain or basin. People walk along the street and near the statue, and multi‑story neoclassical buildings line both sides of the boulevard. Printed captions in French appear along the bottom border, and a modern website watermark is overlaid.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a medieval cylindrical stone tower with a steep conical roof standing along a broad street or square. The tower has small rectangular windows and is flanked by multi‑story townhouses. Leafless trees line the street, mountains are faintly visible in the background, and several pedestrians, including a child in the foreground, walk or stand near the tower.

A commemorative postcard featuring an old rural scene with a dirt road, cyclists, pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicle, wooden fences, and farm buildings in a village landscape. At the left upper side there is an oval portrait of a uniformed man. At the top center is a circular postal cancellation mark with a ship and text in Estonian. Along the bottom is a white caption in Estonian mentioning Peet Julge and Heltermaa on 23 November 1918.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European village in a valley with wooden and masonry houses, two prominent church buildings with steeples, and drying laundry in a fenced meadow in the foreground. Behind the village rises a steep, forested rocky hill crowned with the ruins of a medieval castle or fortress, including towers and curtain walls. The whole scene has a tranquil, rural character and appears on a single photographic card with no visible caption or printed text.

A sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly landscape. The scene shows scattered houses, farm buildings, leafless trees, and winding roads. Dominating the right side is a large church with a tall, pointed steeple, likely the central landmark of the town. The foreground is framed by dark conifer trees, giving the impression that the photo was taken from an elevated vantage point. Handwritten-style captions appear in the lower margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad tree‑lined promenade filled with people strolling and socializing, many wearing early 20th‑century European clothing. Bare trees suggest winter or early spring. Printed caption in red at the bottom reads "Figueras — Paseo Nuevo." with a small number "4525" at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The building has a tall, polygonal bell tower with paired arched openings, an apse with blind arcades, and a smaller, ornate porch-like structure with columns and a gabled roof in front. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the fenced area in front of the church. Townhouses line the street on the left; a large domed structure and additional stone buildings appear behind the cathedral.

Black‑and‑white nighttime winter scene of a snow‑covered park in front of a multi‑story building. In the foreground there is a bench and a tree blanketed in snow, with snowy ground and bare trees lining a street. In the background, a tall vertical neon sign on the building reads "OPERKKAFFEE," indicating a café. Street lamps illuminate the falling or settled snow, creating a quiet, atmospheric city view. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white rural scene showing a dirt road passing between wooden fenced fields and simple wooden houses with tiled roofs. Several people stand along the roadside, some near a horse and cart, giving the impression of a small village or farm center. The caption at the bottom reads "OTTESTAD. MEIERI". The image has the visual style of an early 20th‑century postcard.

Sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a busy urban street scene with early 20th‑century buildings, horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians, and a tram. Text in Greek and French at the top describes the place and date; a modern watermark with a website appears at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a large inn or guesthouse with multiple windows and a gabled roof, labeled as Nürnberger's inn 'zum Gerichts-Kretscham' in Siebeneichen, Kreis Löwenberg, with people standing and sitting in front of the building under trees. The lower image shows the railway station of Siebeneichen (Bahnhof Siebeneichen) with tracks in the foreground and a modest station building surrounded by trees.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a dramatic, foaming river rapid or waterfall rushing between rocky banks and forested shores. Dense coniferous trees line both sides, and in the background a narrow bridge spans the river above the rapids. The print has a grainy, slightly faded look with worn corners, consistent with early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.

A colorized historic postcard view over a European city street lined with multi‑story masonry buildings with tiled roofs. The scene looks down Ullrichstrasse with a large neoclassical building on the right and residential blocks stretching into the distance. In the background, houses climb a hill crowned by a pavilion-like structure. The lower margin bears printed captions identifying the location and publisher.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing the apse and rear side of a large Romanesque cathedral. The central octagonal dome-tower with arched windows rises above heavy stone walls, semi-circular apses, and decorative blind arcades. A small entrance porch stands on the left, with a fence and a few pedestrians in front. The lower margin has a printed caption in Italian identifying the location, and the remaining white space is filled with handwritten Italian text and a date.

Black‑and‑white view of a large public square packed with people attending a festive procession or celebration. Many women wear traditional dresses and carry parasols; men wear dark suits and hats. The façades of several 3‑ to 4‑story townhouses line the square, heavily decorated with garlands, wreaths and large vertical striped flags. A maypole‑like pole with ribbons stands near the center. The architecture is Central European, late 19th–early 20th century. Some shop signs are faintly visible on the buildings.

A color postcard featuring a mountain refuge in front of dramatic rocky peaks under a clear blue sky. The central image shows the Rifugio Ciampedie hut with white walls, blue-trimmed windows and people relaxing outside, set against the steep spires of the Dolomites. The surrounding border is white, with vertical text along the left margin and a large caption "DOLOMITI" at the bottom.

Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a German town with many tightly packed houses, church spires on the left, and a castle-like complex with towers and surrounding parkland on the right. In the lower part, a decorative frame with a laurel wreath and lyre emblem contains German text and a ribbon announcing a singers' festival in Waldenburg, Saxony, dated June 13–14, 1908.

Black-and-white image showing a large baroque water castle on an island, photographed from across a broad lake. The building has four round corner towers with domed roofs, a central church-like projection with a tall spire, and formal tree-lined terraces along the shoreline, with two small pavilion buildings near the water. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a central square with a statue monument in the foreground, umbrella‑covered market stalls, a tram and pedestrians. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey historic buildings with shop signs in German. In the background, a steep hill rises with fortification walls and a prominent clock tower on top. The printed caption at the bottom reads "KÜNSTLERKARTE" and "GRAZ, HAUPTPLATZ".

Black-and-white aerial photograph of a small lakeside village with scattered houses, gardens, fields, and a prominent white church with a tall spire. A forested area borders the lake in the background, and a road runs along the shoreline with additional houses. The style is typical of an early-to-mid-20th-century rural Scandinavian postcard. In the lower-left corner there is printed text indicating the place and type of photograph.

A vintage colorized postcard showing an industrial brewery complex with tall chimneys set behind a grassy foreground and trees. The buildings have brick facades and factory-style roofs. Printed text in Greek and French at the top identifies the scene, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a traditional guesthouse with a steep gabled roof and timber cladding, set along a village street lined with trees. In front of the building are outdoor tables and chairs with several people seated, suggesting a café or inn terrace. A fuel pump stands near the road. The building signage and the printed caption are in German, and the scene evokes a rural holiday or spa village atmosphere.

Colorized scenic postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground, lined by trees and multi‑story historic buildings. A bridge crosses the river toward a church tower and other urban structures. Behind the city rises a green hill crowned with fortifications and towers. In the background are soft, rolling mountains under a pale blue sky. At the top of the image the caption reads "Graz Mur, Schloßberg."

Colorized vintage postcard view of a lively park scene with many people strolling and socializing near a tall, octagonal tower with a domed roof and lantern. Leafy trees surround a wide lawn in the foreground where a child sits, while crowds with early 20th‑century clothing gather on the paths near the tower. At the top in red German text it identifies the location in Graz and names the site with its bell tower.

An old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with fields and gardens in the foreground, a cluster of low houses in the middle ground, and a church with a tall spire rising above the town skyline. The style and aging of the card suggest an early 20th‑century production. Printed captions in three languages appear at the top.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Baroque monastery complex behind leafless trees. The main church has a steep roof and an ornate tower with a bulbous spire. In the foreground, people walk along a path or road with a low fence, giving a view of the monastery courtyard buildings. The printed caption in German at the upper right reads "Kloster St. Marienstern."

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large brick institutional building complex with tiled roofs, multiple stories, balconies, and verandas overlooking a formal garden with paths and hedges. Small groups of people are visible near the entrances and on the balconies. The caption at the bottom reads "Gevel Gemeente-Paviljoen."

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a church tower with a clock, attached to a multi‑storey structure, next to a rectory-style house and a small war memorial in a cobbled square with trimmed trees. The printed caption in German at the top identifies the scene as the church, parsonage and war memorial in Königsbrück. Printer information appears vertically on the left margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a town square with a cobblestone street, several people (mostly children) standing in the foreground, and a central town hall building with a clock tower. The building bears ornate baroque details and a balcony, and is labeled as the city savings bank. Shops and houses line the left and right sides of the square. The printed title in ornate script at the top identifies the scene as the market and town hall of Wildruff. A printer's credit is visible at the bottom right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a riverside village with wooden houses along a raised bank. The calm river occupies the foreground, reflecting the shoreline; low vegetation lines the near bank. Printed Russian and Latin-script text appears at the upper left, identifying the view and its location.

Black‑and‑white view of an industrial complex in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground is a landscaped garden with paths, lawns, and small trees surrounding a reflective pond. Behind it stands a large villa-style main building with steep roofs and dormer windows, surrounded by several attached and detached factory buildings and long greenhouse structures. In the middle distance, tall brick and concrete chimneys emit smoke, with additional factory halls and rail tracks visible further up the valley. Forested hills and terraced slopes rise in the background. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

A black-and-white postcard view of a religious complex at the foot of a wooded hillside. In the foreground is a large multi‑story building with arched windows and a small central bell tower topped with a cross, likely a monastery or religious hospital.
