To the left stands a church with a tower and onion-shaped dome. Scattered houses sit higher on the slope, surrounded by trees and orchards. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural village surrounded by trees and fields. In the middle distance stand wooden houses and farm buildings, with a tall church tower rising above the settlement. The scene is labeled in printed text at the bottom, and there are small handwritten numeric marks (1. and 2.) over buildings in the image, plus a handwritten number in the lower left margin.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a row of massive round stone defensive towers with city walls behind low-roofed buildings along a quiet street. In the background a church or town-hall spire rises above the old town skyline. The style suggests a historic European walled city. No visible text appears on the front of the card.

Black‑and‑white street view of a multi‑storey historic building with dormer windows and a central arched gateway. On the façade is a large sign reading "Dollroths Gasthaus" with smaller text beneath. Next door is another building with a shopfront sign "Moritz Erdmann". An early 20th‑century automobile is parked on the street in front, suggesting the scene was photographed in the interwar period. The architecture is typical of a central European town house row.

Colorized historic view of a central town square with a large, light-colored town hall building featuring a tall clock tower and ornate gable roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather in the square. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with red roofs, including one signed as a hotel and restaurant. German captions are printed at the top identifying the place as Pirna in Saxon Switzerland and specifying the market square and town hall.

A black-and-white aerial or elevated view of a formal city park with tree-lined paths, a central fountain, and landscaped gardens. A river and bridge run through the middle distance, with dense trees and a backdrop of multi‑story historic buildings and church spires. At the bottom margin, multilingual captions identify the scene as the gardens near the opera house in Riga.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a monumental stone staircase and retaining wall, with a large potted palm tree on a pedestal in the foreground. The stairs lead up alongside a patterned stone wall, under a sky filled with clouds. At the bottom edge there is multilingual caption text printed in Bulgarian and German.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone paving. Along the left side stands a row of 3–4‑storey historic townhouses with dormer roofs and shopfronts at street level. Signs in German script appear on the façades. In the middle of the square there is a group of leafy trees, some benches, a fenced-off feature, and several people walking or sitting, including a woman with a child. On the right, a tall church or town‑hall tower with a bulbous spire topped by a cross rises above lower buildings. A decorative lamppost stands in the open square.

A colorized early-20th‑century view over a landscaped park with a winding path. A woman holding a red umbrella walks along the path in the foreground. In the distance, on a hill, stands a large grand hotel complex with red roofs and corner towers. The printed German caption at the top mentions Karlsbad and a view from the Posthof Promenade toward Hotel Imperial.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a seafront street along high stone walls, with multi‑story buildings crowded at the edge of the cliff, a tall streetlamp in the foreground, pedestrians walking along the quay, and sailing/steam ships on calm water. Printed captions in French identify it as a souvenir from Corfu and name the street as Rue Arsène (Aux Murailles). There is handwritten ink script across the lower part of the postcard.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a studio photograph of six women in elaborate traditional folk costumes with heavy jewelry and head coverings. They are posed around household objects such as large clay jars and baskets. French text on the card identifies it as a souvenir from Salonique (Thessaloniki) and labels the scene as a group of women. There is cursive handwriting in French on the right and bottom margins.

Black‑and‑white image of a richly decorated church interior with a Gothic-style stone and carved-wood pulpit reached by a spiral stair, elaborate tracery and heraldic shields on a gallery, stained-glass windows, patterned wall hangings, and a commemorative wall relief of a robed man beside an arched door. The floor is tiled with light-and-dark diamond patterns.

Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a village with a prominent church on a low hill to the left, surrounded by forest. In the foreground is a dirt road lined with wooden fences, with a horse‑drawn cart, a few pedestrians, and a dog. Wooden houses and farm buildings are scattered across gently rolling fields. There is a telegraph pole by the road. At the bottom margin, partially overexposed handwritten and printed text appears.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with hills in the background. A long truss bridge with masonry piers crosses a wide river, with a steamboat and barge passing underneath. On the far bank are clustered houses and small buildings; roads and embankments follow the river's curve. Printed red text at the top left reads "Altstadt b. Tetschen a. Elbe."

Sepia-toned postcard showing an old, somewhat dilapidated multi‑storey manor or palace-like building beside a pond or moat. Leafless trees stand in front of the facade, partially obscuring tall arched windows and open loggias or balconies. A small figure walks at the far left and a horse and cart stand to the right. The reflection of the building is visible in the still water in the foreground. Handwritten text appears faintly at the lower left of the image.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo ship at sea or in a harbor. The ship's name "KRAGEHOLM" is painted on the bow, and a flag with a Nordic cross (likely the Danish flag) flies from the mast. The sky is cloudy, and industrial storage tanks or harbor structures are visible faintly in the background.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing scenes from a small European village or small town. The main upper‑left image depicts a simple Romanesque or early Gothic stone church with a tall square tower, surrounded by a churchyard cemetery with many gravestones. Other panels show half‑timbered houses along a main street, a central traffic island or small square with an obelisk‑like monument, a row of modest modern single‑storey buildings, and a larger village house or inn with a loading canopy and parked car. The architecture is rural and vernacular, dominated by timber‑framed houses and narrow paved streets. No printed caption text is visible on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a coastal town with wooden houses and a shoreline in the foreground. Two children sit on bare rock in the lower right. Behind them are fenced yards, small boats, and trees sloping down toward the sea. In the distance lies an island with a prominent square stone fortress tower surrounded by trees. The word "Kotka" is printed on the image, and publisher information appears along the bottom margin.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a wide rural landscape with forests, fields, scattered farmhouses with red roofs, and a big sky with a few clouds. At the top, there is German text printed in red.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional wooden two‑storey house standing on a slightly elevated, rocky, and grassy plot surrounded by trees. The house has vertical wooden cladding, many-paned windows, and a gabled roof with a central chimney. In the lower right corner there is a small printed credit line indicating the photo publisher from Uppsala.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a river port with several steam-powered boats and barges on a calm, wide river. Smoke billows from the funnels of two paddle steamers in the center. On the left bank there is an industrial facility with cranes and a red-roofed building partly visible behind trees. The sky has a pastel gradient from light orange near the horizon to blue above. The caption "Gröba-Riesa." appears in the upper left corner.

Sepia-toned photograph showing an inner courtyard with a long arcaded loggia on the right and a balustrade in the foreground. On the left stands a small domed turret-like structure with circular windows and a steep external staircase leading up toward an upper level of a Renaissance-style building with arched windows and a tiled roof.

Sepia-toned photograph of a corner wooden building on a muddy, partly snowy street. The house has ornate window frames, horizontal siding, a tiled gable roof with snow patches, and a small stoop with steps leading to a central door. Telegraph poles and adjacent low-rise buildings line the street. A small rectangular wall sign with Cyrillic text is visible near the corner but is not legible.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting the Mosque of Qaitbay with its domed mausoleum and ornate minaret, part of the Tombs of the Caliphs in Cairo. The left side shows the architectural view, while the right side contains handwritten Arabic text. At the bottom, there is printed French text identifying the site, along with a serial number on the left and a small publisher mark and website watermark.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a village street labeled "Schlossstrasse," leading toward a tall church or tower with a clock and spire. On both sides of the unpaved road are fenced houses with tiled roofs and trees. Several villagers stand along the street, and a horse-drawn cart is visible near the middle distance.

Black‑and‑white view of a busy European city street crossing or small square, lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings in historicist style. The prominent corner building on the left carries large rooftop lettering reading "GLASPALAST." and a sign "KLEIDER SALON." Below are shopfronts and trees in front of the façades, with pedestrians in period clothing and a small streetcar or omnibus on the central street. Another building to the right has many open windows and balconies. The scene suggests an early‑20th‑century urban commercial district.

Black‑and‑white postcard view across a pond toward a long, low modernist pavilion set among trees in a park. A tall flagpole with a Scandinavian cross flag flies on the left. Shrubs and flowerbeds edge the water in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tranquil pond with small rowing boats and a little pavilion on an islet. On the right shore stands a picturesque lakeside building with two domed towers, backed by a large classical-looking structure on a hill. A tall tower rises among trees on the left. The scene is framed by trees and parkland. The printed captions at the top read "Dresden" on the left and "Zwingerteich" on the right.

A black-and-white panoramic view over a small town with low wooden and masonry houses, a few larger multi‑storey buildings in the background, and tree‑lined streets. The image has the visual style of an early 20th‑century photograph printed as a postcard. In the lower right corner, white caption text identifies the scene as a panorama of Nyköping, viewed from a church tower.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad public square beside a canal with a small bridge in the foreground. The square is bordered by multi‑story classical buildings; the most prominent one in the center has an ornate façade and arched windows, identified as the Exchange (Börsen). People, horse‑drawn vehicles, and early street life are visible. Printed red caption text appears below the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a corner building on a cobblestone street, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The three‑storey structure has ornate neoclassical decoration, a mansard‑like roof with small chimneys and finials, and many regularly spaced windows. A wrought‑iron balcony at the corner is crowded with people posing for the camera, and there are shopfronts at street level with signage in a Germanic-looking script. Women in long dresses and hats walk along the sidewalks, and there are tram or trolley wires overhead, suggesting an urban European setting.

Sepia postcard view over a forested valley with a town in the foreground and two railway viaducts: a nearer steel trestle bridge carrying a steam train and, in the distance, a large stone arch viaduct. At the top left is German text identifying the scene as Waldheim in Saxony and specifying that the railway viaducts are seen from the 'Goldene Höhe'.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a vast wheat field stretching toward low rolling hills in the distance. In the mid‑distance there appears to be a small cluster of farm buildings or trees. The sky is light and mostly empty. Printed red text at the top left reads "W. P. Reser's Wheat Field, Walla Walla, Wash." and there is dark handwritten ink across the upper right portion with numbers and words resembling catalog or registration notes.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large, multi‑storey historic hotel building with ornate façades and balconies, set among tall trees. In front of the hotel is a garden terrace filled with many tables and chairs, with people seated outdoors. At the bottom center of the postcard is a printed caption with the hotel's name: "Hotel Groot Berg en Dal."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooded park scene with a winding path and rustic lattice wooden railings. In the foreground is a small stone spring or fountain structure built into an embankment. Further up the path stands a pavilion or gazebo among tall trees. Printed text in German at the bottom identifies the place and publisher, dated 1904.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a village street with single-story houses with tiled roofs and wooden fences. A large group of people, including men, women, and children in traditional rural clothing, stand along both sides of the unpaved road. At the bottom, red printed text reads "Pozdrav ze Suchdola n. Lužnicí." and smaller publisher information appears in the lower left corner.

Sepia-toned panoramic photograph mounted on a card, showing a large complex of long, low, stone barracks buildings surrounded by walls and dirt roads. The foreground features open, slightly hilly ground with stones, while in the distance there is a town with scattered houses and a church or clock tower, backed by low hills. At the bottom center of the card, a slip of paper bears a typed or printed title in Cyrillic.

A colorized postcard showing a cylindrical brick tower ruin partly covered with ivy, standing beside a calm watercourse surrounded by trees and greenery. The lower left has printed location text, and there is handwritten cursive text across the bottom margin.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large crowd gathered in front of a pavilion-like exhibition building decorated with flags. The scene appears to be a public event or fair, specifically an exhibition of women's handicrafts, with people filling an open square in front of the structure. Printed captions in Greek and French appear along the bottom, along with the city name "Chalcis (Grèce)".

An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a large three‑story stone building identified as the Rathaus (town hall). It has symmetrical windows, a central pediment, and a small cupola with a clock and weather vane on the roof. In front is a monument with a bust (the Keller-Denkmal), steps, and a low balustrade. Cobblestone streets and smaller surrounding houses with a few pedestrians and carriages suggest an early 20th‑century European town scene. Red printed German text appears at the upper right.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a large riverside castle complex with towers and fortified walls, seen from across the water. Trees line the embankment in front of the castle, and a church tower rises further in the background to the right. The lower margin contains printed German text in red and small publisher details in black.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a grand exhibition-style building with two tall corner towers and an arched central entrance. Several flagpoles stand in front; one tall pole flies a flag with a dark field and lighter corner, and smaller flags on the right bear the word "ASTRA." People gather in front of the building, suggesting a fair or exposition scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing the front façade of a large church with a rose window, classical columns and an ornate entrance portal, standing on an open square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings. A tall bell tower rises on the left side of the church, and mountains are visible in the background. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square. The printed titles at the top read "TRENTO" on the left and "Chiesa di Santa Maria Maggiore" on the right.

Black-and-white aerial view of a small European town with tree-lined streets and detached houses surrounding a large stone church with a prominent tower at the center. The foreground shows blocks of gabled residential buildings and gardens. Printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom edge of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard view through a large pointed city gate arch onto a cobbled street lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. People in early‑20th‑century clothing, including women, children and men, walk and stand in the street. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location and publisher, with the year 1905.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small European town street or station area. In the foreground is an unpaved, wide road; behind a hedge line stand several late‑19th‑century buildings, two stories high, with arched windows and simple ornamentation. A lamppost and a small kiosk or shelter are visible near the center-right, with a man standing nearby and a cart beside one of the buildings. On the far left, the facade of a larger building has partially visible German text near the roofline. At the bottom border of the image there is handwriting or numbering that appears mirrored, likely from the negative.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a broad town square lined with trees and outdoor café chairs. On the left stands a neoclassical public building with columns and a balcony; on the right, a church with two bell towers. Hills rise in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the scene as a square in Lamia, Greece.

Black‑and‑white reproduction of a mural or painting framed by Gothic stone ribs and ornamental borders. It shows a crowned medieval ruler in rich robes holding a tall processional cross and a large banner with a Christian cross and an eagle. A kneeling armored warrior offers him a scroll, while another soldier with shield helps raise the banner. In the background are more warriors, a man holding a model of a city wall or fortress, and distant troops. Helmets and shields lie on the ground in the foreground. Beneath the image is a caption line in Latin.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a leafy urban park. Large mature trees frame the scene, with curved gravel paths, flowerbeds, benches, and a fenced circular fountain with multiple tiers on the right where several children are standing. In the background there are ornate 19th‑century style buildings and a lamppost, giving the impression of a European city garden.

Hand-colored vintage view of a town square with a prominent round stone tower on the left, featuring many green-shuttered windows and vines at street level. On the right is a crenellated stone wall resembling old fortifications, with posters on a billboard near its base. In the background are multi‑story buildings and a distant tower or castle, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk through the square. The caption text in Italian at the top identifies the scene as a location in Trento.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm body of water with small boats moored to a long wooden pier or jetty extending from the left shoreline. A densely wooded area lines the far shore. The lower caption reads "Gruß aus Werro." The left margin bears the publisher line in German, and the right side has a handwritten message in blue ink.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural landscape with cultivated fields, rows of trees, and a small cluster of farm buildings with a tall smokestack or chimney in the background. The foreground is open farmland; the horizon shows low wooded areas and distant fields. The lower part of the card is blank except for red printed German text in the center and publisher information printed vertically along the left edge.

Illustrated panoramic view of a mountainous landscape around a large lake, labeled with place names. The lake (Lago di Garda) is surrounded by towns and valleys such as Riva, Arco, Nago, Torbole, Tenno, and others. Mountain peaks including Mt. Altissimo and Mt. Baldo are indicated, with rivers and roads drawn and named, giving the image the style of a bird's‑eye tourist map.

Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a uniformed man from the early 20th century, wearing a peaked cap and tunic with shoulder straps and cross‑belt, holding a riding crop or baton. A large white signature is printed across the lower part of the image, with the caption "i. Zapfenstreich." beneath the figure. Along the very bottom margin, small print credits a Dresden art publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with cobblestone street in the foreground, a line of neatly trimmed trees and shrubs in the center, and two‑ to three‑story buildings with steep gabled roofs surrounding the square. One prominent building on the left bears the sign "Weinstube F. Leonold" and has a small onion‑domed tower rising behind it, suggesting a nearby town hall or church. Other façades show German‑language business signs, including a guesthouse or inn toward the right side.

Sepia-toned photograph of a stone war memorial monument in a park or forested area. The monument consists of a multi-tiered pedestal topped by a bronze statue of a soldier holding a rifle and flag. The base is surrounded by heavy chains. Trees fill the background. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies the place, and faint inscriptions appear on the monument itself.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverfront city with elegant historic buildings along the bank, a bridge over the river, and a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortifications and towers. A prominent church tower with a bulbous dome rises among the riverside buildings. On the hillside stands a famous clock tower and other structures. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a steamship moving across calm water. The vessel is decorated with signal flags running from bow to stern. There are crew or passengers visible on deck, and smoke is coming from the funnel. Printed text beneath the image describes the ship S/S Bencas, its owner in Oslo, its tonnage and cargo capacity, and the Norwegian shipyard where it was built.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a busy European harbor quay lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings and shop awnings. Numerous small sailing vessels and fishing boats are moored closely along the waterfront. In the background to the right there is an iron bridge spanning the waterway. The image has the look of an old photographic postcard, with a handwritten numeric notation along the right border.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall church tower with a clock and spire on the left, a large brick church with a steep gabled roof behind it, and in the foreground an ornate wooden and stone building complex on a landscaped slope with trees and bushes. Handwritten text and a date appear at the top, and printed publisher information runs vertically along the right edge.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large building with a pitched roof and decorative gables, featuring a long pergola-covered terrace with climbing plants and a formal garden with paths and shrubs in the foreground. German text identifying the military training ground at Königsbrück and the officers' casino appears at the top.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a grassy park or meadow toward a European town. In the foreground are trees and a path with simple railings. Beyond the open field stands a dense cluster of brick buildings, several tall factory chimneys, and at least two ornate church towers with baroque or late‑renaissance style domes and spires. One large industrial building on the right has a high smokestack and rows of arched windows. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial cityscape, printed as a photographic postcard with a wide white sky and no visible caption on the front.

Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing two ornate Catholic banners crossed above a small church complex. The left banner reads "Katholisches Casino Radeberg 1884 1906" framed by laurel leaves. The right banner bears an image of Saint Joseph holding the Christ Child, surrounded by decorative foliage and scrollwork. Below, a vignette depicts a neo‑Gothic Catholic church with an adjoining parsonage and school; a small sign in front labels them. Grapevines and a tree frame the composition.

Art Nouveau style illustration of a young woman with flowing red hair, adorned with flowers and jewelry, holding an abundant bundle of grapes and other fruits. The image is framed decoratively with curved lines typical of Art Nouveau design. There is handwritten script along the bottom margin and a signature with a date on the right side.

Sepia-toned photograph of a gently sloping, cobblestoned street lined with large trees on both sides. On the left is a multi‑story classical building with rectangular windows and simple decorative panels; on the right is a high stone wall and a sidewalk. A few pedestrians walk along the pavement. In the distance, partly framed by the trees, a cylindrical water tower or similar structure rises above lower buildings. At the very top center of the card, the number "1034" is handwritten in red ink.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a lush, tree‑lined basin or spring with reeds in the foreground and water flowing toward the viewer. Stone steps rise at the center to a terrace with balustrades, behind which are tall palm and conifer trees. On the right side stands a multi‑story classical building with arched windows and balconies. The printed captions beneath the image label the place in several languages.

Black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing a small harbor filled with wooden rowing boats and sailboats in the foreground, with a town's quayside buildings and a large multi‑storey hotel or civic building behind. A flag with a Nordic cross flies above one of the buildings. The lower left corner contains the printed caption "MARSTRAND", and a small number "8642" appears in the lower right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural valley scene with a steam train crossing a long iron bridge on elevated trestles. Below the bridge stand several farm-style and mill buildings beside open fields and scattered trees, with wooded hills in the background. At the bottom is German text printed in red and smaller publishing information in black, including a 1906 date.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town, taken from a descending lane with simple houses in the foreground and massive medieval stone fortifications behind. Prominent round defensive towers with crenellations, tall spires and a large Gothic‑style church or castle complex dominate the skyline. There is a water tower with a conical roof further back, and dense town buildings stretching into the distance.

A colorized historical postcard view of a German town square labeled as the marketplace. It shows a broad, curved market square with trees and unpaved ground, a woman walking and a horse‑drawn cart. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with German signage, including hotels and municipal offices. The central building has a clock above the entrance and carries institutional inscriptions.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an airy dining hall with wooden floors, many square tables covered with cloths, and simple wooden chairs. Large windows line the walls, looking out onto trees and landscape. Small vases with flowers sit on the tables. The bottom margin contains printed Swedish text identifying the place and the photo publisher.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town in a hilly landscape with a large multi‑arch stone railway viaduct crossing the valley. In the foreground, several women and children in late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century clothing stand and sit in a grassy field. The town with scattered houses and fields lies behind the viaduct. Handwritten red text at the bottom identifies the location as Sebnitz and the structure as a railway viaduct; a red number is written in the upper right corner, and a small printer's credit appears at the bottom left.

Black-and-white winter scene showing a snow-covered park with tall bare trees, a bench, and a solitary person in a long dark coat standing in the snow. The image is framed as an old postcard with printed Swedish text at the bottom and a museum stamp dated February 1903.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a circular neoclassical rotunda with many columns and a domed roof, standing in an open area framed by large leafless trees. Multi‑storey buildings appear in the background. Decorative text in French and a souvenir stamp-like emblem are printed on the front.

Black-and-white divided-view postcard showing two scenes from a rural German village. The left image depicts a small church with a steep tiled roof, tower and spire, surrounded by a stone wall and garden, labeled "Kirche". The right image shows a tree-lined village street with fenced gardens and several people walking along the road, labeled "Dorfstraße". At the bottom, in decorative script, it reads "Schönfeld bei Großenhain".

Sepia-toned street view showing a complex of early 20th‑century buildings with steep, hipped roofs and dormers behind a fence. Tram tracks run along the road in the foreground. The printed caption at the top reads "Frankenberg i. Sa. - Unteroffiziersschule," indicating a military non‑commissioned officers' school in Frankenberg, Saxony.

Tinted view of a historic spa complex set amid trees and low hills. In the foreground are terraced outdoor pools; behind them stands a pale building with red roofs bearing an inscription. At the top of the card, bilingual Croatian–German titles identify the location as a thermal bath.

Sepia-toned view of a very long Renaissance‑revival school complex on a riverside, with trees along the embankment and the building reflected in the calm water. A chapel-like wing with a small spire is visible on the left. Small boat on the river. Printed captions at top read the subject and city.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a quiet cobblestone corner lined with stucco houses with steep tiled roofs. A central building has a small roof turret. Two pedestrians walk in the street. Printed German captions appear at the top: "An der Mühle" on the left and "Wurzen" on the right.

Colorized early 20th‑century view over a bustling outdoor market square filled with stalls and crowds. Ornate market buildings line the right side; multiple tall church spires rise in the background and a domed building appears to the left. The caption at the lower left reads "Libau. Petermarkt."

Sepia-toned view of a neo‑Gothic church with a very tall spire rising above a row of steep gabled roofs, seen from across a tree-lined river with a small bridge at right. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Pforzheim. Stadtkirche."

Color-tinted rural view along a forest road leading to a small settlement. A few light-colored houses stand at the bend, with dense conifer woods on both sides. A German caption is printed at the top.

Colorized early-20th-century postcard view of a brick Gothic Revival church with a tall spire and clock tower, next to a brick rectory behind a fence and garden. Caption strip along the bottom reads the place name and subject; printer details run vertically along the right edge.

Sepia cityscape of Graz showing the River Mur with a steel truss bridge in the foreground, rows of historic buildings and a baroque church tower with an onion dome, and the Schlossberg hill behind with fortifications and the prominent Uhrturm clock tower. A printed caption at bottom right reads "Graz. Mur und Schloßberg."

Black‑and‑white view of a rustic wooden footbridge with twig railings crossing a narrow pond or canal in a forested park. Two swans glide in the water beneath the bridge. A carved wooden figure stands near a split‑rail fence at the left; dense trees fill the background. No clear printed caption on the image front; only faint handwritten marks along the left border.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snowy valley with ski tracks, scattered pines, and rounded snow‑covered mountains in the distance. A printed caption appears at the lower left and a photographer credit at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a wide river cutting through a dry, terraced basalt gorge with high cliffs on both sides. The water dominates the foreground; scrub and rock appear at the near bank, and arid hills and plateaus recede into the distance. No buildings or people are visible; it's a natural landscape scene.

Moonlit scene of a landscaped park with people strolling and children playing near an octagonal brick/stucco tower topped by a bulbous onion dome with a small lantern. Trees and a small pavilion sit nearby; the image looks like a painted view reproduced as a color postcard.

Black-and-white interior view of a church hall with an ornate altar, carved wooden screens, statues, and religious reliefs. The scene appears to be a museum display of ecclesiastical art. A Swedish caption is printed along the bottom edge.

Illustrated colored postcard showing a green wooden mountain inn with a terrace and people seated outside, set in a forested hillside. A sign on the building reads "Schutzhaus". Caption below: "SILBERHUBERHAUS — HERMANNSKOGEL."

Hand‑tinted street scene showing a central grassy square with a statue on a tall pedestal, surrounded by late‑19th‑century brick buildings. Pedestrians are visible, and the printed caption at top right reads "Bisschop Hamerstraat NIJMEGEN."

Color postcard reproducing a mural scene framed by an ornate arch: a haloed bishop (Saint Maurus) returns and blesses kneeling townspeople while monks stand behind him; a cathedral appears in the background. The reverse is in Hungarian and identifies the artwork as a wall painting in the Pécs Cathedral, with a seal of Szent Mór Kollégium/Maurinum, Pécs.

Black‑and‑white night view of a solemn religious ceremony staged in front of a large Romanesque cathedral façade with arcaded gallery and three portals; clergy and choir are visible. Caption at lower left reads "Pécs. Missa Sollemnis." The reverse bears Hungarian handwriting, a green 10 fillér stamp of Hungary, and a PÉCS postmark dated 1936.

Vintage black‑and‑white divided‑back postcard showing a stone observation tower with arched openings and crenellations, a balcony near the top, and a small lodge at its base, set on a hill with a footpath and trees. Hungarian caption printed at the upper left of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street façade in Pécs, Hungary. The two‑story neoclassical building bears a large sign reading "BUDAIKÜLV. KATHKÖR." (Budai suburb Catholic Circle). People stand on the sidewalk; a small shop sign reads "RITS JÁNOS." Handwritten greeting appears across the image. The reverse says "LEVELEZŐ LAP" with a green 5 fillér Hungarian stamp and a Pécs postmark, plus a handwritten address within the city.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand Eclectic/Neo‑Baroque bank palace on a square. The caption at the bottom reads "Üdvözlet Pécsről." and "Pécsi takarékpénztár." A vertical publisher credit appears at the left margin. The building façade also bears the inscription "PÉCSI TAKARÉKPÉNZTÁR." The reverse side has the Hungarian heading "Levelező‑lap" with dotted address lines.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the main square of Pécs with the ornate Baranya County Hall (captioned Megyei Tanácsháza) behind the Holy Trinity column and a landscaped plaza with cars and pedestrians. The reverse has Hungarian handwriting, a MAGYAR POSTA stamp, and an address to Budapest dated 1957.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an ornate historicist building with towers and an arched entrance on a broad street; trees at left and a few pedestrians. Printed caption at top reads "Pécs. Indóház.", indicating the city and the railway station.

Sepia-toned wartime scene showing a damaged early motor car with a uniformed driver in a broad valley with forested hills and a few buildings behind. Bilingual vertical caption printed along the right edge identifies the place as the Fecht Valley in Alsace.

Hand‑tinted street scene showing an early motorcar driving along a narrow European street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. At left is a brick and stone corner building signed as Hotel Deutscher Kaiser. The printed caption at top identifies the location as Poststraße in Meerane, Saxony.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a spacious modernist interior hall with polished stone columns, long service counters, and slanted display racks filled with forms or pamphlets. Rectangular luminous ceiling panels repeat in a grid, reflecting on glossy floors. A desk with a rotary telephone sits in the foreground; a few people stand near the counters.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a snowy mountain landscape with a lake/valley view. Sparse shrubs dot the foreground slope; rounded fells and a long lake stretch into the distance. A printed Swedish caption appears at the bottom left.

Black-and-white postcard view of a stone arch bridge with a balustrade of small arches crossing a river. A truck and a few cyclists are on the bridge; small boats are visible on the river and a second, more modern bridge appears in the background. Trees and low town buildings line the far bank. Captioned text appears in Swedish at the bottom corners.

Vintage black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snowy forested valley with a guesthouse complex in the foreground, fenced and surrounded by fir trees. A tree‑lined road curves below, with scattered houses and hills in the background. Printed red caption at the top identifies the winter sports area and the guesthouse.

Black‑and‑white street view postcard showing a wide unpaved avenue lined with bare trees and telegraph poles. Horse carts are on the road. At right stands a large twin‑spired church with adjacent buildings. Printed captions at the top read "Zemun — Semlin — Zimony" and "Franzthal," with some handwritten notes across the image.

Black-and-white landscape view of snow-patched mountains and a glacial valley. The caption 'ABISKOFJÄLLEN.' appears at bottom left, and an oval mark 'ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI' with the credit 'Foto: T. Dahlöf' appears at bottom right.
Black‑and‑white postcard with deckle edges showing a Renaissance castle with round corner towers and many small windows, framed by tree branches. A white caption is printed at the bottom.

Sepia-toned photo postcard showing a changing of the guard by Royal Saxon hussars in ornate uniforms with plumes. The scene is in front of a striped sentry box and wrought-iron gate with barracks buildings in the background. German captions are printed in red at the top and bottom.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a war trophy: a mitrailleuse mounted on a plinth and chained off in a barracks courtyard. A uniformed soldier stands to the right; long one-story barracks buildings surround the parade ground. The caption identifies Großenhain and the K.S. 1 Husaren-Regiment "König Albert" Nr. 18, and notes the gun as a gift from King Albert from the 1870/71 war. Publisher credit Bruck & Sohn, Meissen appears.

Color postcard view of a dramatic alpine landscape: a towering dolomitic peak rising above a cirque with lingering snowfields, dense larch and pine forest in the middle ground, and red alpine rhododendrons in the foreground under a clear blue sky. No visible printed captions on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a woman covered in peat/mud stepping out of a spa tub inside a bathing room. German captions appear beneath the image and along the left margin, with a blank line to write the date beginning with "19..".

Sepia-toned vintage view of two hilltop castle ruins above a river valley and patchwork fields. On the left, a ruin sits dramatically on a limestone cliff; on the right, a castle with two prominent towers crowns a separate hill. A small river with a boat curves below. A German caption is printed in cursive along the bottom margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the alpine hamlet of Mestriago nestled on a slope in Val di Sole, with scattered houses in the foreground and forested mountains rising behind. A printed caption runs along the bottom within a white border.

Sepia panoramic view of a rural village with orchards, a small stream and footbridge in the foreground, half‑timbered houses and farm buildings, and a church with a tall spire at the center. The caption "Niederschöna" is printed at the top left.
Black-and-white vintage postcard showing the stone ruins of a medieval church with a broken tower and apse, surrounded by trees. A printed caption at the top reads 'Sigtuna. S:t Olofs ruin.'

Sepia-toned vintage view of a landscaped park with paths and a small fountain basin with spouts in the foreground, topped by a bust on a pedestal. Historic town buildings line the background. Printed caption at the top left reads "Hainichen i. S. Keller-Denkmal."

Colorized vintage postcard view of a tree-lined square with low buildings and market stalls, with a wooded hill and fortifications above. A red-roofed clock tower is visible on the hillside. Printed caption reads "Gruss aus Graz. Lendplatz."

Color postcard with an orange border showing a panoramic view over a Dutch riverside city. Rooftops of the old town are in the foreground, a large river with cargo barges runs through the middle, and an arched steel bridge spans the river. The caption "Nijmegen" is printed below the image.

Sepia panoramic view of a small town seen from a wooded hillside. At left on a hill stands a castle-like complex; at right a church with a tall spire rises above town houses. The caption in red reads "Neuhausen i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑storey institutional building with steep gabled roofs and many windows, set on a sloped lawn with bare trees. A few pedestrians walk along the street in the foreground. Printed red caption at the top left reads the location and name of the hospital.
Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a sculptural stone bench with a modernist seated figure on a pedestal in a wooded park. The caption "BALDONE. 62." appears in the lower-left corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex above a riverside town. The caption in red at top left reads "Meissen. Königl. Albrechtsburg." A tall cathedral spire and another tower under scaffolding rise behind the castle. The Elbe river and timber rafts are visible in the foreground. Publisher credit is printed vertically at the right edge.

Monochrome winter scene on a misty dike or levee. A narrow path with wooden railings runs along the top; three cyclists ride on the right while two walkers approach from the distance. Frosted fields and a lone tree sit below the dike; low buildings fade into the fog. The sun is hazy behind clouds. No printed captions are visible.

Colorized early-20th-century view of a village inn and adjacent buildings. The main facade bears a sign for the inn, and the printed caption at the top reads the place name and the inn's name in German. Small trees and a column-like post stand on an unpaved square.

Black‑and‑white multiview postcard with four numbered city scenes (1–4). It shows a large European square with arcaded, post‑war buildings, outdoor café terraces, pedestrians and cyclists. One view includes a baroque church tower and, behind it, a domed town‑hall tower.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a bustling market square with stalls, pedestrians, bicycles and horse‑drawn carts. On the right stands an ornate town hall with arched windows and a clock tower. A church tower rises in the background. Handwritten captions appear along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white street view with tree-lined median and mid‑century apartment blocks along a wide cobbled road. Several 1950s-era cars are parked and driving. A printed caption appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing uniformed soldiers with rifles resting along a stone-faced building on a cobblestone street. Rifles are stacked in pyramids; some soldiers sit near piles of stones and timber as if at a temporary camp. Bilingual caption at right identifies the scene as a soldiers' camp on Mariankatu/Mariegatan in Helsinki.

Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century tenement buildings on a curved boulevard. A corner building with a towered cupola dominates the view; there are balconies, a small kiosk, young street trees, pedestrians, a cyclist, and a horse‑drawn cart. The red caption at top left reads "Danzig. Neue Pfefferstadt." and the publisher credit appears at bottom left.

Sepia panoramic view over a forested valley with a hilltop medieval castle on a rocky spur. Below are a winding road, a few houses, and a railway bridge across the valley. Red printed German caption at the top reads: 'Blick auf Schloß Scharfenstein.'

Vintage sepia postcard depicting a rocky creek and small cascade in a wooded canyon. Captions identify the scene as Matilija Hot Springs, California. Side text credits the publisher M. Rieder of Los Angeles and notes it was printed in Germany as hand-colored work. A red number 5673 appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo view of a ruined hilltop castle. A smooth, slender cylindrical tower with several round holes stands in front of a rough stone curtain wall; behind, a larger round keep rises above the trees. Dense foliage covers most of the slope; no printed captions are visible.

Black‑and‑white rural view of a small European village seen across fields and orchards. Half‑timbered (Fachwerk) houses cluster on a gentle hill. A prominent parish church with a Baroque onion‑domed steeple and weather vane rises on the right. The scene is misty, with autumn trees and tiled roofs; no printed captions are visible.

Black-and-white oblique view of a European boulevard with a tree-lined median. A long column of soldiers marches along the cobbled street, followed by a horse-drawn wagon. On the right stands a prominent church with a tall spire topped by a cross, surrounded by late 19th‑century residential buildings with mansard roofs and ornate facades.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a crowded weekly market in a central square, with many people in traditional dress, tents and stalls. Surrounding the square are ornate 19th‑century buildings and church towers. Caption text at the top identifies the place.
Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small hilltop pavilion with a hipped roof, rooftop balustrade and flagpole, perched on a terrace wall above trees. Caption in German appears along the bottom.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a cobblestoned road with telegraph poles leading toward a Lutheran‑style church with a tall spire in a small town. Low houses and a neoclassical public building stand around open ground and conifer trees. Rural setting, no cars visible.
Colorized view from a wooded path with a rustic railing and a bench, looking toward a multi-arch viaduct spanning a forested valley at sunset. A printed caption in German appears at the bottom.

Vintage postcard showing a printed engraving of a neoclassical rotunda chapel with a large dome, a colonnade of columns, and a crucifix inside on an altar. A small cupola with an angel statue crowns the dome. Below the image there is a German caption line in script, plus handwritten notes and numbering on the margin ("No. 111", "Graz, 1802").

Black‑and‑white winter panorama of a snow‑covered conifer forest and rolling hills. A fenced villa/chalet sits in the foreground beside a road lined with leafless trees; a few isolated houses stand on the ridge in the distance. Handwritten negative number appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white photo postcard showing a substantial late‑19th‑century masonry building with a gabled end, quoined corners, brick window arches, and stringcourses. The house stands behind a low stone wall and wooden gate, surrounded by trees along a rural road. Small flagpoles/antennas and multiple chimneys rise from the roof. No printed caption is visible.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a tree-lined square leading to a low wooden railway station building with a central portico. On the right stands a taller ornate building with a spire. The top caption is in Swedish and Finnish, identifying the location as the railway station in Vaasa.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a grand neo‑Renaissance bank building on a corner with arched windows and ornate reliefs, fronted by a cobblestone square and trees. A caption in Russian and German appears at the top left, and a Russian inscription runs along the façade above the entrance.

Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a large hilltop complex with a castle-like building and an adjacent Gothic cathedral. The cathedral's twin west towers are surrounded by dense scaffolding while a slender completed spire rises between them. Below, along the riverside, lumber yards and workshops line the embankment; a smokestack and several small boats are visible. German signage appears on riverside buildings.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a sloping urban street lined with ornate late-19th/early-20th-century apartment buildings and streetlamps. A printed red caption at the top identifies the scene as Kanzlerstrasse in the Kaßberg district of Chemnitz.

Illustrated city view of Graz showing the river with a truss bridge in the foreground, the old town with an onion‑domed church tower, and the Schlossberg hill topped by fortifications and the prominent clock tower. Mountains appear in the background. The front bears printed and stamped text including the city name, an archival stamp, a date, and the artist's signature.

Colorized view of a serene park pond with rowboats at a small dock, benches around the water, and a turreted, ivy-covered pavilion or café at left. People in early-20th-century attire stroll along the path under large trees with forested hills in the background. The printed caption at top left reads the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an Art Nouveau floral frame showing two small photographs of cattle being unloaded from a barge onto a shallow beach. Men wade beside oxen; sailing boats and a low pier/harbor line appear in the background. Caption and publisher credit are in Portuguese.

Sepia-toned street scene showing multi-story residential buildings with dormer roofs and iron fences along a broad, quiet road. Several pedestrians are visible. Printed captions at the top read "Hohensteiner Strasse." and "Limbach i. Sa."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a canal lined with trees leading to a brick medieval city gate with twin round towers and spires. Printed captions read "Stargard i. P." and "Am Mühlentor." Publisher credit and date appear along the bottom.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a woman standing with eyes closed, wearing a loose dark dress with a decorative belt, drop earrings, and strap shoes, against a plain backdrop. A handwritten studio note appears at the lower right mentioning Paris.

Monochrome postcard depicting a neoclassical war memorial in a forest: a domed, circular pavilion with columns and broad concentric steps, wreaths at the base, and a plaque inside. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom border.

Colorized vintage view of a grand civic building with a red tiled roof, dormer windows and neoclassical façades. The entrance bears the word "STADTMUSEUM." Printed captions read "Bautzen" (upper left) and "Stadtmuseum" (upper right). A handwritten number "18525" appears in red. A few pedestrians walk along the street under a blue sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard photo of a small statue on a pedestal in a landscaped park along a tree‑lined boulevard, with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings in the background and a few pedestrians. The caption beneath the image reads "NASSAUSINGEL — NIJMEGEN."

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a grand seated statue on a multi‑figure pedestal in a gardened square, with a neoclassical colonnaded building behind. Red caption at the top identifies the subject as the Deák Ferenc memorial in Budapest, also given in German.

Early 20th‑century monochrome postcard showing a rural road leading to a complex of institutional buildings set below a wooded hill. A horse-drawn cart is on the road. Printed red caption at the bottom reads "Königl. Lehrerseminar. Nossen." and a vertical publisher imprint appears on the right margin.
Hand‑tinted panoramic town view with red‑tiled roofs and a dominant baroque church tower rising over trees and low buildings. The caption "Königsbrück." appears in the upper left.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a broad circular square with trees and late-19th-century/early-20th-century townhouses and a large villa on the right. A horse cart and a few pedestrians are visible, along with telegraph poles. The front text labels the location and publisher.

Black-and-white view of a lavish, palace-like spa hotel on a wooded hillside. The caption in red at the top reads "Marienbad. Hotel Miramondi." The grand white building with domes and ornate façades rises above trees; telegraph/electric poles are visible in the foreground.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, tree‑lined boulevard bordered by ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. In the distance rise slender neo‑Gothic spires resembling a city hall. Few pedestrians and a cyclist appear on the nearly empty street; leafless trees suggest winter. A faint number is written on the lower border of the image.

Black-and-white street view showing a prominent, symmetrical building with a balcony, grand stairs, arched windows, and a large clock on the facade. A woman with a pram appears in the foreground; traditional townhouses line the street to the left. Caption text is printed along the bottom edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white street scene with many pedestrians in early 20th‑century attire along an ornate boulevard; large historicist buildings flank the street. Printed captions read "Király-utcza." and "Pécs." with a handwritten message across the front.

Sepia-toned view of a wooded hill with stone retaining walls and a building perched on the edge, labeled as a restaurant on the Schlossberg. A tower rises partly behind trees to the right; rolling hills are visible in the background. The caption is printed in red at the top.

Colorful Italian postcard with a yellow-to-red gradient border showing a panoramic view of the alpine town of Andalo at about 1000 meters, nestled among forests with rocky Dolomite mountains in the background. Text includes a humorous slogan in Italian and a handwritten-style label noting the town and elevation.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a very long wooden graduation tower (saltworks) with slanted buttresses and a walkway along the top. A central pump/observation scaffold rises above the structure, and a low wooden inhalation building with many windows runs along its base. In the foreground are shrubs, a footpath, and a reflective pond in a landscaped spa park.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a castle complex with a large round tower topped by a small spire and clock, surrounded by lower buildings and trees. Printed captions identify the location as Mügeln and the site as Schloss Ruhethal. Publisher credit and serial number appear along the bottom.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a grand historicist/secession-era bank building on a street corner. People in early 20th‑century attire stand along the sidewalk. Hungarian captions appear at the top identifying the city and the institution.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a Scandinavian town square with a white church and clock tower at right, parked mid‑century cars, bicycles, and people in the square. A tall light or festive pole stands on the left. The caption printed on the image reads "KUNGSBACKA. Torget," and there is a publisher's copyright seal in the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a village intersection with a small fenced tree in the middle, a walled compound containing a church with a tall spire, and a neighboring parsonage/rectory building. The printed caption at the top identifies the place.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a study/classroom with heavy wooden armoires, a long table with books and inkwells under a hanging electric lamp, framed pictures on the walls, and a doorway to an adjoining room. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the location as a boarding school in Nijmegen.

Black-and-white postcard showing a small Gothic Revival stone church with a square belfry topped by a cross. Pointed-arch windows line the side; above the arched entry the facade bears the inscription "ST. STANISLAUS." Dirt road and simple wooden railings suggest an early 20th‑century mining-town setting with hills in the background.

Sepia-toned view of a manicured spa garden with topiary beds and a small domed pavilion (spring house) labeled 'JOSEF-QUELLE', set against a wooded hillside. German caption printed along the top reads 'Bilin - Sauerbrunn. Josefs-Quelle in den Anlagen.'

Sepia-toned view of a central market square featuring the Kamenz town hall with a tall tower on the left and a fountain topped by a statue (Andreas-Brunnen) in the middle. Historic buildings line the square. Printed German caption at the top; a red handwritten number appears on the right.
Sepia-toned view of a castle complex sitting atop white limestone cliffs above a river valley with a few houses below. The caption in German at the bottom identifies the scene.

A black‑and‑white, long‑exposure view of a harbor canal at dusk with many tall ship masts and small cranes lining both banks. A small boat sits mid‑channel, and a bright gas lamp glows on the right beside a moored vessel. The skyline includes a hill with fortress‑like buildings. Hand‑scratched caption appears inverted along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a seated woman in profile, wearing an early 20th‑century dress with a lace collar, posed against a high-backed chair. A small printed caption appears at the lower right.

Colorized panoramic view over a European city with a prominent green hill topped by a small tower-like structure, farm fields in the foreground, and scattered church spires and historic buildings. Red printed caption appears at the top.

Tinted vintage view of a grand boulevard in Budapest framed by two identical ornate corner palaces (the Klotild Palaces). People stroll in the square; in the background stands a church with twin towers. Red printed captions appear at the top in Hungarian and German.

Old monochrome lake scene with forested hills. In the foreground two men row a decorated boat; another small boat is on the water. On the opposite shore stands a pavilion/restaurant complex. Handwritten red number appears at the top; red caption in German identifies the location as Buschmühle near Niederau. Printer's credit runs vertically on the left.

Hand‑colored postcard view of a hilltop building labeled Café Egerländer surrounded by trees, with a large spa‑town pavilion or café structure and adjacent villas. The caption at the bottom reads "Marienbad. Café Egerländer." Publisher credits are printed in German.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard with scalloped edges showing a small concrete bridge crossing a stream in a rural town. There are telegraph poles, a few houses, and an early automobile on the bridge. The caption "Lejasciems" is handwritten at the bottom right; a photographer's imprint appears at bottom left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal ceremony by the water: a suited official bends over an open square manhole/shaft and places a rolled document or tube inside. Several other men in formal attire stand nearby. A long caption in Bulgarian Cyrillic is printed beneath the photo.

Sepia street view lined with trimmed trees and historic buildings. A person walks along a quiet cobbled road toward a town center with a small tower in the distance. Caption in German at the bottom identifies the scene as Bautznerstraße with the gymnasium (Turnhalle) in Bischofswerda, Saxony.

Black‑and‑white view of a mountain spa settlement: a central two‑storey villa with a hip roof, dormers and a small spire, flanked by two low pavilion‑like buildings inside fenced lawns. In the background stands a larger chalet‑style hotel or sanatorium; forested hills surround the valley and an unpaved road runs across the foreground.

Colorized vintage view of an urban square in Chemnitz centered on a bridge over a canal/river. Ornate late‑19th‑century buildings surround the scene; pedestrians, a horse‑drawn wagon with barrels, and tram tracks are visible. The sky is softly tinted. Printed captions at the top read the city and bridge name.

Monochrome postcard showing a devotional painting set in an arched niche of a chapel façade, protected by an iron fence. The scene depicts Jesus being offered a chalice by an angel. Printed German caption identifies the location; a publisher credit and year appear at the bottom.

Sepia-toned street scene showing a gently rising cobblestone street lined with late 19th–early 20th century buildings, shopfronts, and an ornate streetlamp in the foreground. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn cart are visible. The printed caption at the top reads "Frankenberg i. Sa. Am Baderberg." German shop signs such as "Albin Karl" and "KAUFHAUS" appear on the buildings.

Tinted vintage panoramic view of a walled coastal city with orange rooftops, a round tower by the sea, and a large fortress on a rocky cliff at right. Mountains and the Adriatic are in the background. Caption text appears at the top left.

Address side of an old postcard with the word 'Postkarte' in Gothic type and bilingual Spanish/German prompts. It bears a red Cuban 2 centavos stamp canceled with a circular postmark reading 'HAVANA CUBA JUL 15 190?'. The card is addressed to 'Sr Perez Galdos, Paseo de la Magdalena' in Santander, Spain. Additional printed text includes 'Via Extranjeras', 'An', and 'Wohnung (Straße u. Hausnummer)'.

A vintage colorized postcard view of a sailboat with a white lateen sail gliding on a calm lake in front of a waterfront town backed by steep rocky mountains. The town shows pastel buildings, a church with a bell tower on the hillside, and signage on a hotel. The printed caption at the top reads in Italian, and the boat bears the name 'IDA.'

Black‑and‑white view inside an ornate glass-and-iron hall with large arched windows and circular rosette glazing. In the center, a powerful vertical jet of hot water erupts from a circular basin surrounded by attendants in white spa uniforms and visitors in early 20th‑century dress.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a curving seaside promenade lined with grand hotels and villas at the base of a wooded hill. The waterfront has a stone seawall and small beach. Printed caption reads "Südstrand mit Hôtel Bellevue," and the place name "Abbazia" appears at the lower right. A handwritten message runs across the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned interior view of a large auditorium with rows of wooden chairs facing a stage. The stage has a table with a cloth and chairs, small pendant lights, and plants. Captions printed along the lower border read the location and hall name.

Hand-tinted aerial view of a riverside town with a large castle complex of red-roofed buildings and towers beside a bend of the Elbe River. Printed captions read "Strehla a. Elbe" and "Schloss." A handwritten number "13665" appears at the top right.

Vintage monochrome winter scene showing heavy snow covering a small mountain village with timber‑framed houses and an inn. Snow-laden trees stand in the foreground; several buildings sit on a slope, one labeled as an inn. The caption is printed in German at the top.

Sepia-toned street view showing war-damaged brick houses along a cobblestoned road with several townspeople standing nearby. Printed French caption at the top notes Haussy (Nord) after the 1914–1919 war and identifies the street as Rue Saint-Pierre. Publisher credit appears at bottom right.
Vintage black‑and‑white view of a winding river through forested hills and conifer trees, seen from an elevated vantage point. A printed Russian caption appears below the image.

Tinted vintage view of a lakeside promenade with a turreted building and outdoor café on the left, a decorative double-lantern streetlight in the foreground, iron railing along the water, rowboats on the lake, and a wooded park beyond. People in early-20th-century attire stroll by. Caption printed at top right.

Hand-tinted view over the Danube from a terraced garden with balustrades and flowerbeds, looking toward the grand Parliament building on the opposite bank. The caption is printed in multiple languages at the top, identifying the scene as a view from the royal garden in Budapest.

Black‑and‑white street view showing an ornate brick courthouse on the left, children and pedestrians on a broad street, and a church tower with an onion-shaped spire in the distance. The printed caption at top identifies the Royal District Court and the street in Riesa.

Black‑and‑white view across a riverside embankment toward a large Baroque cathedral with an ornate tower topped by a bulbous dome and cross. Statues line the roof balustrade. A broad staircase leads up from the river; a small 1960s‑era car drives along the quay. Urban buildings stand around the cathedral under a lightly clouded sky.

A multiview alpine collage showing meadows, forested slopes, chalet-style buildings, a mountain hut, and village scenes with a church bell tower. In the center is a red panel with white script reading the destination. The scenery is clearly mountainous, typical of the Dolomites.

Vintage multi-view lithographic postcard with floral ornaments and the caption 'Gruss aus Graz.' It shows illustrations of Graz City Hall (labeled 'Rathhaus'), the Herz Jesu Kirche (Sacred Heart Church), a boating scene at the Hilmteich, and the main post office building ('Post.'). The right side has a printed checklist area for a traveler's notes.

Sepia beach scene showing a long seaside bath complex with rooftop promenades and many bathers on the sand and in the water. A pier and cliffs line the Black Sea shore. Captions in Bulgarian (old orthography) and German are printed at the bottom.

Sepia wartime postcard showing a destroyed truss bridge with several collapsed spans sinking into a river. A neoclassical building stands behind the bridge, with bare trees and telegraph poles nearby. A German caption is printed at the top right.

Colorized postcard showing four mounted German hussars in field uniforms on horseback, carrying lances with black‑white pennons. One soldier uses binoculars while another points forward. Trees form the background. A red German caption is printed at the top right.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a steel truss bridge over a wide river with stone piers. A lone person stands on the riverbank in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads "Daugavpils. Vienības tilts." and the bridge portal bears the words "VIENĪBAS TILTS."

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal town with dense wooden houses and rocky terrain by the sea, photographed from an elevated point. Swedish caption appears at lower left and a publisher credit with catalog number at lower right.

Hand‑tinted view of a formal rose garden with paths, rows of staked rose bushes, a round fountain basin, and a raised wooden gazebo/bandstand reached by stairs, surrounded by mature trees. Caption printed at top left reads "Komotau. Rosenpark."

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. A curving road runs through clustered houses and larger villa-like buildings. The printed caption at the top reads in German, indicating the town's name and region.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view showing many people in early‑20th‑century clothing walking on a wooden riverside bridge or pier. Behind them are birch trees and low wooden houses with fenced yards. The printed caption "Joensuu" appears in red at the top left; a handwritten number is also visible.

Vintage German New Year greeting postcard decorated with clover motifs. It features a collage of cycling photographs and printed captions about a rider, with a large greeting 'Prosit Neujahr!' in the center. The top panel shows three images of a track cyclist with captions referencing world championships in Copenhagen (1903) and London (1904) and a professional photo in Leipzig (1906). Below are sepia photos of cyclists, including a motor‑pacing scene.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a coastal town approached by a curved cobblestone road with rail tracks alongside. Across the water is a compact townscape dominated by a tall‑spire stone church on a hill. Wooden houses, harbor structures, telegraph poles, and two pedestrians are visible. Swedish captions and publisher mark are printed on the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a Nordic city with dense low‑rise buildings, leafy streets and a few church towers on the horizon. Caption text in Swedish at bottom left identifies the viewpoint as from the Trinity Church. A publisher credit and an oval 'ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI' mark appear at bottom right.

Black‑and‑white rural view of a wooded valley with a country house, a small arched bridge/culvert and a path with trellises. The printed caption in German reads "Parthie im Lössnitzgrunde." At the bottom left is the publisher credit "Verlag von Carl Pittius, Kötzschenbroda." A red serial number 2376 appears.

Black-and-white street view of a quiet residential neighborhood with low two-story houses, hedges, a cyclist in the foreground, and a 1930s-style car on an unpaved road. A larger institutional-looking white building with tall poplar trees stands to the right background. Small caption text is printed at the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a small town street and bridge in the Bernsdorf district, with pedestrians walking over a bridge toward ornate early-20th‑century buildings. A corner house bears a butcher's shop sign. Forested hills lie in the background.

Tinted early-20th-century postcard showing a grand red-brick hotel with a central mansard tower topped by a sign reading HOTEL, balconies, awnings, and a fenced garden. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Hotel Keizer Karel."

Vintage black‑and‑white photo postcard of a crowded bullfight inside a large bullring. Several toreros and a picador on horseback face a charging bull while spectators fill the stands. Captions along the bottom credit the photographer and date the image.
Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a large group of soldiers in uniform training with tripod‑mounted machine guns in a pine forest. A caption is printed along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white photo postcard showing two connected two‑story wooden buildings with vertical cladding amid tall pine trees. A gravel drive leads past a brick gatepost to the entrance; several late‑1930s/1940s cars and a few bicycles are visible, with a small group of people near the right building.

Colorized postcard view of a landscaped city park with tree-lined paths, a small lake with an island structure, and a long pavilion-like hall with a metal roof. Behind the park are 19th‑century buildings and church towers, with a wooded hillside and mountains at sunset. The reverse reads ROMÂNIA CARTA POSTALĂ and bears a purple library stamp.

Multi‑view vintage postcard showing scenes of Kronstadt (today Brașov): the large Evangelical church (the Black Church), a bustling market in the main square with the Council House and the street labeled Klostergasse, a vignette of the Schützenhaus, and the Reformed Church. Caption in German reads "Gruss aus Kronstadt." The reverse is a Hungarian "LEVELEZŐ‑LAP" with Austrian postmarks and an 1898 date, addressed to Vienna.

Colorized view of a medieval town scene with a prominent square tower rising above a gate and adjacent roofs. An iron railing/bridge is in the foreground, with people walking along the cobbled street and trees lining the right side. Printed captions identify the place as Hermannstadt and the tower as the Ratturm. Publisher and photographer credits run vertically along the left margin. The back reads LEVELEZŐ-LAP and bears a purple collector's stamp.

Colorized street view of a curving lane lined with old houses with red tile roofs; in the background rises a tall Gothic church tower with pinnacles. Caption under the image gives the street's name in Romanian, German and Hungarian.

Colorized street view of central Oradea showing a tram crossing a bridge over the Crișul Repede, with a neoclassical theater building on the left and Austro‑Hungarian style blocks around a busy square; cars and pedestrians are visible. The reverse has Romanian text and a Romanian postage stamp with 40 bani, postmarks, and the printed caption "ORADEA — Vedere."

Multi-view color postcard labeled TULCEA, showing modernist cityscapes: a pedestrian promenade with apartment blocks, a civic building with a sweeping curved roof, a large socialist-era administrative building with a coat of arms, a high-rise hotel, and the Danube waterfront with boats and the port. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp, and address lines.

Black-and-white real photo postcard showing a crowded seaside scene with dunes and rocky shore. Many people relax and bathe along a long sandy beach. On the right, hotel/resort buildings with flags stand on the ridge above the beach. Swedish captions are printed along the bottom.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a coniferous forest with two striking mountains: a sharp cliffed peak on the right and a rounded table‑like mountain on the left. A Swedish caption is printed along the bottom left, and an oval mark reading ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white scenic postcard showing a coniferous forest and wooden fences in the foreground with a mountain range on the horizon. The caption in Swedish identifies the view as Anåfjällen seen from Funäsdalen. Photographer credit appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white oblique aerial view of a small, forested northern European town or village. Scattered wooden houses with steep gabled roofs, garden plots, a larger school- or municipal‑looking brick building, winding gravel roads, and dense coniferous woodland surrounding the settlement. No visible printed caption.

A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting a historic European square bordered by ornate multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. In the foreground stands a tall Baroque column or monument in the square. At the back of the scene a hill rises with a prominent clock tower on top. The handwritten caption along the lower margin reads in German. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century view card.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing an ornate historic building with richly decorated façades and statues. The central structure has Flemish Renaissance-style gables and columns, flanked on the right by a Gothic façade covered in sculpted figures and pointed-arch windows. At the bottom is a caption in French and English identifying the scene as the law courts in Bruges.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by trees. The central feature is a tall, rounded tower with a layered spire rising above multi‑storey castle buildings with many windows and steep roofs. The scene is printed in sepia tones, and the upper left contains red printed caption text identifying the site.

Sepia-toned rural view with a wooden farmhouse in the foreground, its shingled roof sloping low to the ground and a ladder leaning against it. A large tree stands beside the house next to a winding dirt path that leads across gently rolling fields toward a small village on a hill. In the distance there is a church with a tower and a few other buildings. The word "Schellerhau" is printed in the upper left corner.

Color postcard showing ornate wooden resort villas with turrets, wrap‑around balconies and decorative latticework, set among tall conifer trees. People stroll on the lawn and steps in front of the buildings. No caption on the image side; caption and message are on the reverse.

Vintage black-and-white multiview postcard titled "Sinaia," showing four views: the central image is Peles Castle with multiple spired towers on a hillside; a modernist hotel/sanatorium on a mountain road; a panoramic view of the Prahova Valley resort; and a civic/casino-type building with a tower. The reverse has Romanian text, 40‑bani stamp, and Bucharest postmarks.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view collage labeled "CLUJ," showing notable sights of Cluj: the skyline with church spires, the National Theatre/Opera façade, the equestrian statue in the main square, St. Michael's Church, a street scene, a bastion of the old fortress, and a park view. The reverse reads "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMINĂ," has a stamp box with "1943," and printer credit for Casa Scînteii with lines for address under "CARTE POȘTALĂ."

Black‑and‑white view of a narrow medieval lane with brick walls and an arched gateway, tiled roofs and a clock tower above. Pedestrians walk through the passage. Reverse shows Romanian text and a 20 bani R.P. ROMÎNĂ stamp with Sibiu/București postmarks.

Color postcard showing a modernist high‑rise hotel with a geometric window facade and a rooftop sign reading HOTEL. A rounded annex at street level bears the words restaurant - bar. In front are 1970s streetlights, cars, and a bus, with trees lining the street. The reverse is printed in Romanian with postal fields and identifies the view as the Traian Hotel in Brăila.

Color postcard showing Peleș Castle set in a green park with forested mountains behind. Three visitors stand on a stone balustrade terrace; an old cannon is visible to the right. The back is printed in Romanian with publisher and price, and contains a handwritten message in pink ink.

Sunset view of a marina with calm golden water. Several small rowing boats and sailboat masts are moored in the foreground near a pier. A larger white passenger boat is docked at the quay. The sky is hazy orange with the sun low near the horizon.
