Color postcard showing the large decorative fountains at Piața Unirii (Unirii Square) in front of a massive modernist building bearing rooftop ads for Panasonic and Technics. The word "BUCUREȘTI" appears prominently on the front border.

A black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a young men's basketball team posing outdoors beneath a simple wooden backboard with a netted hoop. Six players are arranged in two rows in front of trees; three stand with arms crossed, while three are crouched or seated on the ground, one holding a basketball marked with a large letter. In the upper left corner, stylized printed text in Cyrillic indicates the year 1925 and describes the team.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing four playful kittens against a light beige background. One kitten at left carries a small pastry-like ring in its mouth, the second wears a blue ribbon and touches an orange ball, the third crouches low with black-and-white fur, and the fourth at right holds a bundle of sticks or wrapped item in its mouth near a small apple. The card is slightly aged with a postmark stamp on the right side and cursive handwriting along the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view of an ornate European street lined with multi‑storey historic buildings featuring elaborate façades, balconies, mansard roofs and decorative statues. Shops and cafés occupy the ground floors, with awnings extending over the sidewalk and people walking or riding carriages in a small square in the foreground. Forested hills rise steeply behind the tightly packed houses.

Colorized historic street view showing a gently curving cobblestone road lined with old townhouses on the right and a large building with a steep hipped roof and small tower on the left, likely the town hall by the market square. A few pedestrians are visible in the foreground. The sky is tinted in pastel evening colors. German text is printed at the top and on a shop sign to the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a valley town with a river and small bridge in the foreground, forested hills on the left and right, and a large hilltop castle complex dominating the background. The scene is framed by tree branches. At the top of the card there is red printed German text identifying the site as Schloss Nossen and noting the viewpoint.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European village nestled in gently rolling hills. The scene shows clustered timber‑frame and plaster houses with steep gabled roofs, trees scattered between the buildings, and narrow unpaved streets. The image has a printed caption in the upper left corner reading "Klingenberg i. Sa." and a handwritten number "15698" in red ink in the upper right.

A sepia-toned photograph of a World War I memorial monument set in an urban square. The monument consists of a tall stone pedestal and obelisk with a dramatic sculptural group of a rearing horse and several human figures in combat posed around it. Behind the monument stands a grand historicist-style building and leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. The caption at the bottom margin reads in German: "Graz, Kriegerdenkmal der Universitätshörer."

Black‑and‑white street scene in a small European town, likely early 20th century. Cobblestone road lined with two‑storey houses and shops with gabled roofs. A horse‑drawn cart loaded with barrels moves down the middle of the street; a man drives it while children push handcarts nearby. Several pedestrians walk in the distance. Telegraph poles line the street. On the right is a more ornate corner building with a clock sign projecting above a shop entrance, its facade partly covered with climbing plants. There is some faint shop signage on buildings but it is not fully legible.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a rural village and surrounding farmland viewed from a hillside. In the foreground two boys sit on the slope looking over fields with rows of stacked hay or grain sheaves. Below lies a cluster of farmhouses and village buildings with gabled roofs, trees, and a few industrial chimneys. In the distance, a church spire rises from a larger town on a flat plain framed by low hills. A tall tree stands on the right side of the image. At the upper left, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the caption identifying the place.

A vintage sepia-toned street view showing an elegant row of multi-story historic buildings with ornate facades and towers, viewed along a cobblestone street with pedestrians walking near the sidewalks. The architecture is Central European, and the image caption is printed at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an arched vine-covered walkway in a spa garden leading to a niche with a bust on a pedestal. Two children stand in the foreground. Caption at the bottom reads in German that it is the Queen Louise monument in the Kurpark of Bad Pyrmont. The reverse says POSTKARTE with German postmarks and a museum stamp.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a vine‑covered pergola walkway beside a balustrade along a pond, lush with palms and shrubs. Caption reads "Bad Pyrmont – Rosengang am Schloßteich." The reverse has a divided back with German publisher information and a blue stamp "MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT."

Black-and-white real photo postcard showing a war memorial statue in a park by the castle. The monument depicts four uniformed soldiers standing together atop a large pedestal with wreaths laid at its base. A bench and large trees are visible in the background. Caption at the bottom reads "Bad Pyrmont Ehrenmal am Schloß."

Hand‑colored historical postcard showing a grand cast‑iron spa colonnade with large arched windows and an ornate pavilion in a spa town. Well‑dressed people in late 19th–early 20th century clothing stroll and sit along the promenade. The caption at the top names the place as Marienbad and refers to the Kreuzbrunnen colonnade and an evening concert. Publisher information is printed vertically on the right edge.

A black-and-white postcard view of a large Baroque palace with a central tower topped by a clock and cupola, fronted by landscaped gardens and flowerbeds. The multi-storey façade is richly decorated with pilasters and reliefs. In the lower right corner, the caption 'Schloß Hubertusburg' is printed.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town nestled in a forested valley. A winding main street runs through densely packed houses with steep roofs; in the mid‑distance stands a large church-like building and another tall church tower rising above the trees. Hills covered with thick woodland surround the settlement. In the lower right corner, the caption "Tharandt." is printed.

Sepia-toned view of a historic European town dominated by a large Gothic-style church with twin square towers and steep spires, surrounded by smaller houses, trees, and a gently sloping field in the foreground. The printed caption at the top left reads "Geithain i. Sa." indicating the town and region.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a war memorial statue in a landscaped park with hedges, paths and several people walking, including children and a man with a hat. Behind the monument stands a multi‑storey masonry building with many windows. The caption at the top reads in German: "Pirna a. Elbe — Kriegerdenkmal im Friedenspark."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone fortification wall or tower along a narrow street. The left side shows a tall masonry structure with small windows and iron bars; people, including children, walk along the street below. On the right are more modern masonry buildings and a stone wall, with leafed trees in the background. At the bottom margin, there is printed caption text.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town built on a hillside, with orchards or gardens in the foreground. A row of traditional German houses, some half‑timbered, stretches across the middle, and on the right stands a large church with a distinctive tower and dome-like roof. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location, and smaller publisher information appears in the lower left corner.

The postcard depicts a scenic rural landscape with a prominent steel bridge crossing a river. There is a steamboat visible under steam next to the bridge, several buildings along the riverbank, and a forested hillside in the background. The image is sepia-toned, indicating an older photograph. The text 'Parti från Bergeforsen' is printed in the top right corner of the image. The reverse side has a typical divided-back design for address and message, with the logo 'SVENSKA LITOGRAFISKA AB STOCKHOLM' printed at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large 19th‑century railway station-style building with neoclassical details, arched windows, and corner rustication. A dirt road runs alongside, with trees without leaves and several horse-drawn carriages waiting in front. At the top, the name of the town Zemun/Semlin/Zimony appears in multiple languages, followed by the word for railway station.

A monochrome postcard image showing stone ruins of a large medieval building surrounded by leafless trees. The structure features tall arched windows and doorways in crumbling walls. In the foreground there is an open yard with paths, simple wooden fences, a bench, and a small wooden hut or shed on the right. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a vaulted outdoor arcade lined with sculptures on pedestals. The statues appear to be expressive bronze or stone figures placed along a wooden floor under repeated arches; benches line the wall on the left. At the far end of the colonnade there is an opening to a courtyard with cobblestones and a low wall. The overall style and tone suggest an early‑20th‑century art postcard. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town seen from fields in the foreground. The settlement has compact, pitched‑roof houses, factory chimneys, and a dominant central church with an onion‑shaped spire topped by a cross. Low, cultivated hills and patchwork farmland rise in the background. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early‑20th‑century landscape postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate multi‑span bridge crossing a river. On the right stands a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped dome. Along the riverbank are multi‑storey buildings with shops; one large wall advertisement reads "QUAKER OATS". In the background, on a wooded hill, stands a fortress complex. Printed at the top is the title "Gruss aus Graz mit Erzherz. Franz Carl-Brücke." Handwritten notes and a date appear faintly above the image.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a single‑storey wooden building with a hipped roof behind a low picket fence, surrounded by tall trees. A dirt road curves in the foreground with a telegraph pole near the center. The card has printed captions in two languages at the bottom: on the left in Swedish, "Lovisa, Tryckeriet" and on the right in Finnish, "Loviisa, Kirjapaino".

Vintage, monochrome printed postcard showing a panoramic view of a European city with dense historic buildings, church spires, and a domed classical building on the left. The foreground shows a square or wide street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. The lower left has printed red text "Graz." and small red printing credit along the bottom margin.

A colorized panoramic view of a European city in a river valley, seen from an elevated vantage point. The scene shows dense blocks of multi‑story buildings with red and light-colored roofs along both banks of a winding river. A metal bridge crosses the river in the foreground. Rolling green hills and distant mountains frame the background. At the top left, red printed text reads in German, likely serving as the postcard title.

Colorized historical postcard showing civilians walking through a street devastated by fire and destruction. Buildings on both sides are burned-out shells, rubble and broken tram tracks cover the road, and smoke billows in the background. People in early‑20th‑century clothing move through the ruins, some in small groups, with a woman and a bearded man prominent in the foreground. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears along the bottom right.

A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a scenic river with a bridge across it, and a hilly town or village in the background dominated by a large historic building resembling a castle or fortress, and a church with a tower. Trees line the river, and old-style European buildings are visible. The text on the front is in German, and there is a dedicated area for a message.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard. Printed Hungarian text at the top reads a greeting from Pécs and names the street. The reverse side is divided for address and message, with the printed Hungarian words for postcard, handwritten address and message in Hungarian cursive, and a green Hungarian stamp postmarked in the early 20th century.

A sepia-toned portrait of a young man in theatrical costume, wearing a feathered headpiece and ornate clothing, posed dramatically with both hands on his chest. The style suggests an early 20th‑century studio photograph used as a publicity postcard for an opera performance. Text is printed at the bottom in a Latin-script language.

Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a massive brick city gate or fortification portal with a central arched entrance closed by heavy wooden doors, flanked by two smaller arched openings. Above the main arch is a sculpted coat of arms with an eagle, and higher up a relief with a shield supported by two lions plus two niches with standing figures. Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a large brick church with a tall tower and clock. In front of the church stands a two‑storey gabled building with many rectangular windows and shutters, likely an inn or civic house. A few people are visible near the entrance, and young trees line the sandy open square. At the very top edge of the image, faint mirrored handwriting appears, as if from a caption on the negative.

Colorized panoramic view over a European city taken from a wooden pavilion or lookout with ornate railing. A river with bridges runs through the middle of the city, lined with multi‑story historic buildings and church towers. The image has a printed caption at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned street view of a European town showing an ornate corner building with a clock tower on the left, a bridge with metal railings in the foreground over a stone-lined waterway, and a straight street lined with multi‑story buildings leading toward a church tower in the background. People are faintly visible along the street and shopfronts. The top of the image bears printed captions indicating the town and street name.

A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view over a small European town with steep-roofed houses, a prominent church tower rising in the center background, factory chimneys in the distance, and a stairway and building with arched windows in the right foreground. Red printed title text appears at the top left and a handwritten red date or note is at the top right.

Sepia-toned image showing an old stone fortification with thick defensive walls and a dry moat or ditch curving along the right side. The walls are made of rough-cut stone blocks, with the far wall containing small rectangular openings resembling embrasures. Vegetation and scrubby grass grow on and around the ramparts, giving the site a slightly overgrown, ruin-like appearance. A dirt path follows the base of the inner wall, leading to a small arched gateway at the far right. In the distance appears a flat horizon, possibly a shoreline or open plain. There is no visible text on the front of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobbled path and small bridge leading to an arched gateway covered in ivy, with a large historic building complex and a church-like tower in the background. On the right is a stone staircase leading up to a pointed-arch doorway of the castle. Two figures (an adult and a child) are walking over the bridge. At the bottom in cursive German script are captions indicating the location and subject.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a narrow rocky passage or cleft, with rough rock walls on both sides and a dirt- and stone-covered ground. A thin tree trunk stands in the middle distance beyond the rocks. The image has a white border typical of vintage postcards. In the lower right corner there is a handwritten signature/date and printed caption reading "Brudsängen, Brobacken."

The postcard features a black-and-white aerial photograph of a public swimming pool complex (Badeanstalt) beside a lake or pond, surrounded by trees and grass, and a residential neighborhood in the background. The reverse side has standard postcard formatting, German text, and a blue museum stamp.

The front of the postcard shows a sepia-toned image of a large villa with two-story wooden balconies, framed by foliage and garden plants. The caption at the bottom reads: 'Bad Pyrmont Villa Severin, Gartenseite.' The reverse side has handwritten German text, a green postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich, and a blue ink stamp from the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont. It is addressed to Elise Klavenau in Vegesack, Bremen, with the street address 'Lange Str. 54'.

The postcard shows a beautifully maintained, formal garden with geometrically trimmed hedges, vibrant flowerbeds, and a white bench set amongst greenery, with tall palm trees and other ornamental plants in the background. The caption at the bottom front reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Partie aus dem Palmengarten,' suggesting a view from the Palm Garden in Bad Pyrmont, Germany. The reverse side contains handwritten correspondence in German, an 8-pfennig German stamp, postmarked 'Bad Pyrmont', and blue stamp of the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a grand, neoclassical building with a portico of columns and mansard roof, with people in period clothing and horse-drawn carriages in front. Trees line the broad street, and benches are visible. The front side has the printed text 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Fürstl. Kurhôtel.' The reverse has standard postcard markings, a publisher's imprint, and a logo for 'Museum Im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'

A black and white aerial view photograph of a town dominated by a castle-like building surrounded by lush gardens, water features, and manicured paths. The postcard features the caption 'Bad Pyrmont. Schloß mit Kurhaus' at the bottom. The reverse side contains printed lines for address and message, a logo for the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and some handwritten and printed German text.

This is a vintage postcard. The front features a colored illustration of a garden party scene, with tables and chairs set among landscaped flowerbeds and tall trees. In the background, a building is partially visible, and several people in period dress are sitting and conversing. There appears to be a statue on the left side. The text at the top reads 'Gebirgsausflugsort u. Sommerfrische Sennhütte-Burgwaldhof bei Bad Pyrmont (Fernruf 50)' indicating a mountain excursion site and summer retreat near Bad Pyrmont. The lower right corner reads 'Gartenpartie' (garden party). The reverse side features handwritten German text and address information, as well as printed text stating 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.

The postcard's front image shows an old-fashioned, colorized scene featuring a prominent, decorative well pavilion (Trinkhalle) surrounded by people in early 20th-century attire. The structure is set in a park-like setting with trees and gas lamps, and the text reads 'Bad Pyrmont. Hauptquelle.' On the reverse: German script handwriting, a green 'Deutsches Reich' stamp postmarked, the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont' stamp, and more printed German text.

The front of the postcard depicts the interior of an ornately decorated room with vaulted ceilings, filled with chairs, tables, animal mounts, glassware, framed pictures, and various curiosities on the walls. The setting conveys the feeling of an old-tavern or 'Kneipe' style room, suggesting tradition and history. The back features standard postcard layout elements in German, including printed lines for an address, and a logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'

The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of an ornately carved historic bed in a richly decorated room. The bed features detailed woodwork with medallions, figures, and other decorative elements, suggesting it once belonged to someone of high status. The caption at the bottom is in German, and the reverse side includes printed postcard lines and a museum stamp.

The postcard features an old multistory building with timber frames and a distinctive pointed tower. The setting is lush and green, with trees and hills in the background, suggesting a scenic, possibly spa-town location. The front is filled with handwritten text in German around the image, and part of the text reads 'Christliches Hospiz' and 'Bad Pyrmont.' The reverse side has handwritten address details, a blue museum stamp, and an early 20th-century German postage stamp.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a forested hill with a tall, slender lookout tower rising from the summit. The lower half of the image is a meadow or open field, while dense coniferous trees cover most of the hillside. Printed German text in red at the top identifies the location as Altenberg in the Erzgebirge and names the tower on the Geisingberg mountain.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand neoclassical theatre building with a large central dome, ornate sculptures and columns. The building stands on a corner with a curved driveway and landscaped garden in front. Surrounding streets feature horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians, suggesting an early 20th‑century city scene. The printed captions at the top read "Graz." and "Stadttheater."

Black-and-white postcard view of a large brick neo-Gothic barracks building with steep roofs, gables, and small towers. The structure fills most of the image, with a tree-lined street and iron fence in the foreground. Printed captions at the top identify the location as Naumburg an der Saale and the building as the Jäger-Kaserne (riflemen's barracks).

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing several perspectives of a medieval hilltop castle complex and its surrounding town. The top panel displays a panoramic view of a town with steep‑roofed houses, church spire, and multiple stone towers rising above the trees. The three images in the lower row show close‑ups of the stone towers, curtain walls, arched gateway, and inner courtyard of the castle. In the center, a dark title panel bears white script text.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large brick neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire and lancet windows, situated next to smaller houses. In the foreground is a fenced green area and a road with a group of people walking along it. Printed captions in Dutch appear below the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rocky stream running through a forested canyon. Tall, leafless trees stand on the left, and a large rock face dominates the right side. The water flows over and between boulders in the foreground. Sepia-toned printing with captions in red ink surrounds the image, including the title at the bottom and publisher and printing notes along the sides. A red number appears in the lower-right corner.

Colorized panoramic view of Maribor showing a spread of red‑roofed houses and the city skyline with notable church towers. The reverse has handwritten German text, two red stamps of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes, a circular postmark, and is addressed to Klagenfurt.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small wooden pedestrian bridge leading from a park area toward a path that curves to a low building with a tiled roof, surrounded by trees and open grass. The scene is tranquil and rural. At the bottom there is a printed caption in Latvian and a small printer's/logo mark with a number.

A sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a large Gothic-style church located in the center of a spacious urban square. The surrounding area features ornate 19th-century buildings and a statue in front of the church. The architecture and vehicles (if any) suggest an early 20th-century European city. Text in Hungarian is visible at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard with two side‑by‑side photographs showing war‑damaged waterfront streets and buildings. People walk along the quay amid ruins, with boats or a harbor edge in the foreground. A circular postal cancellation mark is stamped over the center. French captions are printed along the left and right margins, and there is also a printed reference to the Eastern Campaign and the city of Salonique (Thessaloniki).

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small town in a valley surrounded by forested hills. A prominent Gothic-style church with a tall spire and clock tower stands on the left, with clustered residential and village buildings in the foreground and middle ground. The landscape suggests a rural, hilly region. At the top left, printed text identifies the place as Neuhausen (Bez. Dresden).

A black‑and‑white view of a grand Neo‑Renaissance building with two domed corner towers and a richly decorated façade, fronted by a large open square. In the foreground is a circular fountain with an expressive sculptural group of intertwined human figures, surrounded by curved steps and low concrete benches where people sit and relax. Pedestrians walk across the spacious plaza; surrounding the main building are other late‑19th‑century urban buildings.

Illustrated New Year postcard showing a smiling postman delivering letters to a young woman leaning over a stair railing. Above them are festive fir branches with white bells, and in the background is a large hilltop complex with cathedral spires and a palace-like building. At the bottom center is a red circle with "1941". Decorative cursive text in Czech appears along the lower margin, including a stamped purple name.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town street by a bridge. On the left are gabled houses with tiled roofs and climbing plants on the façades; on the right is a metal railing of a bridge and a large tree. Several pedestrians, including women in early 20th‑century dress, walk along the street toward the camera. Printed German captions appear at the top and bottom of the image.

Color-tinted historic postcard showing a landscaped hilltop scene with a tall bell tower with a domed roof on the right and a pavilion/restaurant building on the left, linked by curving paths lined with bare trees and garden seating. The caption in German is printed in red at the top.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a river curving through a town with a large castle complex featuring two tall pointed towers on a wooded hill to the left. On the right side of the river is a compact town with a prominent church and a bridge crossing the water. Rolling farmland stretches into the distance. Printed caption text appears in German at the bottom left.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a three-story corner building labeled as an inn or guesthouse, with trees around it and a few people and carts in front. The facade has simple classical detailing and tall windows. There is handwritten cursive text across the lower and right margins. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the scene and location.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large group of people gathered outdoors on a hillside. In the foreground sit many Indigenous women in traditional dress and bowler hats, with baskets and bottles on the ground, and a few men in suits among them. Behind them stands another group of men, some with musical instruments like drums. Along the right border, printed vertically, is a caption indicating the scene and its location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a Baroque church with twin towers and clock faces, each tower topped with a bulbous dome and cross. In the foreground is a dark statue, likely part of a fountain. Large Nazi flags with swastikas hang from the church façade. At the bottom margin, a German caption identifies the location as the deanery church in Karlsbad.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, two‑storey villa or guesthouse on a sloping street with bare trees, a fence, and several people posing in front and on the hillside. Printed red text at the top right reads "Hintermauer – Meissen. Kämpfe's Heim." and along the left edge appears the publisher credit "973 Brick & Sohn, Meissen." The lower foreground is left blank for writing, in typical old postcard style.

A sepia‑toned, early photograph print mounted on a postcard backing showing a quiet townscape with cobblestone streets and low, tiled‑roof houses in the foreground. A few pedestrians walk along the main street to the left. In the middle and far distance stand several larger, neoclassical public buildings with symmetrical facades and many windows. Behind the town, low hills form the horizon. The top margin of the card is blank except for a red guideline and a handwritten number or symbol in the upper left.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a narrow valley surrounded by wooded hills. A narrow stream parallels the road in the foreground, and terraced buildings and paths are visible climbing the hillside in the background. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century central European spa or hillside town.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a large domed imperial building labeled "Kaiserpalast" in the background (the Kaiserpalast in Strasbourg). In the foreground is an equestrian statue of Kaiser Wilhelm I with rows of artillery pieces and soldiers marching with rifles and bayonets along the street. Handwritten script borders the image, and a large blue handwritten number "158" appears near the top.

Monochrome printed postcard-style illustration of a narrow European street with tall brick and stone townhouses in ornate Northern Renaissance style. The left building has a richly decorated stepped gable, scrollwork and circular ornaments, with a coat-of-arms–like panel and many small-paned windows with shutters. Below is an arched gateway supported by a column leading into a passage. Adjacent houses have stepped gables and rectangular windows. In the background rises a tower with an onion-shaped dome topped by a spire.

A vintage black‑and‑white aerial view over a dense European city along a river with several bridges. The foreground shows tightly packed historic roofs and church towers; in the distance the river bends through the town and low hills are visible. A small caption in German script appears along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a railway facility in Katrineholm. The upper part features an elevated pedestrian bridge or gangway with many people walking across it, above rail tracks and railway buildings. The lower half is blank writing space with preprinted Swedish prompts and dotted lines for the sender to fill in.

Vintage sepia postcard with two interior photographs of a richly decorated Baroque church. The upper image shows the nave with ornate ceiling paintings, carved galleries, and an elaborate altar. The lower image shows an intricately carved and painted gallery or box seating area within the same church. Decorative Art Nouveau-style framing surrounds the photos, and German captions identify the place.

Black-and-white winter scene showing a long row of large institutional brick buildings, likely military barracks, with snow covering the ground and roofs. A flagpole flies a Scandinavian-style cross flag and leafless trees line the snowy street. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left.

Sepia-toned historic street view of a European town. The image shows a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story masonry buildings, shop signs, gas-style street lamps and some trees on the right. A horse-drawn cart stands in the middle of the street, and several pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the scene as 'Rosswein. Bahnhofstrasse.' indicating a view of the town's station street.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a railway station and the town beyond. Further back are church towers and larger institutional or castle‑like buildings on a gentle hillside, with rural fields in the distance. The caption in red German text along the bottom names the town and describes the view.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a row of similar gabled residential houses along an unpaved street bordered by wooden posts and trees. A woman and two children walk on the dirt road in the foreground. The setting appears to be a planned housing estate at the edge of a forest. Printed caption text is at the top of the image.

An illustrated vintage postcard showing the rear of a steam locomotive with smoke at the bottom and a panoramic view of a town and surrounding hills framed within the back of the train. Vintage sepia postcard showing a large two‑story house with wide porches and balconies, surrounded by tall trees and a prominent palm tree in the front yard. Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from a field in the foreground. Dominating the skyline are several large Gothic church towers and spires; on the right stands a massive brick hall‑church with a stepped‑gabled façade and another stepped‑gabled building attached. The image has no visible captions or border text on the front side.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large manor complex. On the right is a long, two‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and many shuttered windows, largely covered in ivy. Printed red text at the top names the estate, and more text is printed vertically along the left edge.

Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a wooded lookout with a simple wooden railing in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the scene as a view over the Lützeltal valley from the Emilientempel near Frankenberg in Saxony.

Black‑and‑white image of a large European town square dominated by an ornate town hall with a tall clock tower and steep tiled roofs in a late‑historicist / neo‑Renaissance style. In front of the building stands a richly decorated fountain or monument. Surrounding the square are rows of narrow multi‑storey houses with dormer windows and shops at street level. A few pedestrians are visible in the open cobbled square.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Alpine town nestled in a valley surrounded by forested hills and high snow-covered peaks. On the right slope a woman in a long dress stands in the grass. The lower part of the card is mostly blank with the town name printed in ornate red script.

Color postcard showing an ornate stone gate with two pillars topped by potted plants. Between the pillars is a wrought‑iron archway reading "NUOVO STABILIMENTO BAGNI." A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the grounds of a Catholic educational institute with a fenced tennis court in the foreground and a winding path leading through gardens toward hillside villas and school buildings. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a river flowing through a rocky gorge with a small town in the background. On the distant hill a domed building rises above other houses and factory chimneys. Printed text at the top left reads "Uddevalla – Bäveån".

Black‑and‑white panoramic riverside view of a historic European city. In the foreground is a calm, wide river with a long, low passenger steamer or riverboat moored near the bank. Further right are more 19th‑century civic buildings and another church with twin towers in the distance. The scene is framed like an early 20th‑century landscape postcard, without visible borders or captions on the front.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a tree‑filled park or garden behind a decorative metal fence. Several men and boys in early 20th‑century European clothing stand along the sidewalk in front of the fence. A tall, ornate streetlamp stands near the right side of the image. The only marking is a handwritten number in dark ink at the top edge.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large tree with autumn foliage next to a stone wall and a small fountain or well. Several people in traditional clothing, including a veiled woman carrying buckets, are gathered around the fountain in an open yard. The caption at the bottom is in French and there is a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white image showing a grand cast‑iron and glass colonnade with ornate Baroque‑style decoration on the right and a domed pavilion with columns in the center background. A wide promenade stretches across the foreground, lined with benches and large trees on the left. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll or sit along the promenade. The scene appears to be from a European spa town. No visible printed text appears on the front.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a waterfront village scene with traditional wooden houses and tall trees on the left, a calm wide river or canal in the foreground, and two classic Dutch windmills on the opposite bank in the distance. The lower margin has printed captions in red and black type.

A sepia-toned ethnographic postcard showing a large group of African people—men, women, and children—posed outdoors in front of round thatched huts. Many are standing while others sit or crouch in the foreground, some with woven materials or palm fronds laid on the ground. The setting appears to be a rural village, with trees on the left and several conical-roof huts in the background. At the top of the image there is printed text in Portuguese.

Black-and-white postcard showing a tree-lined pond or small lake with rowboats along the shore and a few people boating on the water. In the background behind the trees stands a historic-looking building with two pointed towers. The lower margin bears printed German captions identifying the view as from Graz and naming the location as Hilmteich, along with a publisher credit from Vienna.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a rural road leading into a small town. In the distance stands a prominent church with a large dome-like roof and tower, surrounded by modest houses and trees. Open fields border the road in the foreground. Printed captions in Swedish appear at the bottom left and right, including the town name and photographer information.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large castle complex with formal Renaissance gardens in the foreground. Rectangular lawn sections are divided by gravel paths and low walls, with small trees and shrubs planted symmetrically. The multi‑story stone castle buildings have many windows, arcades, and distinctive chimneys, with mountains and the town spreading out in the background. Printed captions appear in a cursive typeface along the bottom margin.

Colorized vintage view over a forested valley with a river in the foreground and buildings and ruins visible on a hilltop in the distance. At the top of the image there is bilingual text in Russian and German.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a small European town nestled in rolling, forested hills. In the foreground there is a fenced meadow with a lone person standing near a wooden rail fence. Behind this are traditional steep-roofed houses. Dominating the middle-right is a large church with a tall, baroque-style tower and dome. Further up the hill stands a sizable multi-storey institutional building. The scene is rural and hilly, suggesting central Europe. Handwritten-style text appears along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white street scene of a small Nordic village with wooden houses, a dirt/gravel road, a 1930s–40s style car, and a bicycle. Low rocky hills rise in the background. In the lower left the word "RIXÖ" is printed, and in the lower right a triangular photographer/printer logo with the number 2557 is visible.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a European town with dense historic buildings, church towers and a round fortified tower. In the foreground there is a stone arched bridge over a river with reflections in the water. At the bottom left, printed red text reads "Gruss aus Bautzen." and in small print below appears the publisher information.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a complex of multi‑storey institutional buildings arranged around landscaped gardens with paths, shrubs and trees in the foreground. Printed German text along the bottom identifies the site as the Saxon State Police School in Meißen and specifically the officials' residence. A red handwritten number "25633" appears on the upper right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a coastal town with low, veranda-style buildings among many palm trees, near the shoreline. The upper portion contains the photograph, while the lower portion is blank for writing. Red printed captions identify the view as 'Mossamedes – Vista Geral', and a vertical publisher credit appears along the left margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with rolling fields, forested hills in the background, and a farm complex with long barn-like buildings and a line of tall trees beside them. Cows graze in fenced pastures in the foreground. In the upper left corner there is red printed text reading "Löbau i. Sa.".

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Roman-Byzantine aqueduct wall rising behind a cluster of small wooden houses. The style and clothing suggest an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.

Black-and-white postcard image of a large Baroque/Neoclassical manor or palace with a central portico supported by columns, a triangular pediment with a clock or cartouche above it, and a long, symmetrical façade. The building is surrounded by trees and a landscaped drive and lawn in the foreground. The caption at the bottom left reads "Schloß Remten (Kurland)".

A colorized panoramic view of a small European town in a valley, framed by fields and low hills. In the foreground is a river with a bridge and tree‑lined banks; behind it stands a church with a tall white tower and spire surrounded by red‑roofed houses and a few factory chimneys. The style is that of an early 20th‑century lithographic postcard with printed red text at the top and side margins.

Colorized panoramic view of a historic European town set against mountains. In the foreground are stone towers, fortified walls, and multi‑story buildings with red and gray roofs. Cypress trees line the hillside in the mid‑ground, and a large mountain dominates the background. At the top in red text it reads "Trento - Torre Verde e Convento dei Cappuccini."

Colorized historic postcard showing an ornate multi‑story villa with steep red roofs, a tall pointed turret, and decorative balconies, set in a landscaped garden with paths, flowerbeds, and a small pavilion. The setting overlooks a valley or hills in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as "Karlsbad, Westend 'Villa Strunz'"; additional small-print text is along the left and right margins.

Black-and-white postcard showing a hilltop building with a tall central spire and smaller corner turrets, overlooking terraced slopes (likely vineyards). The structure resembles a historic manor or pavilion with large windows facing the valley. At the bottom left of the image there is printed caption text naming the site.

Colorized panoramic view of a European city with a steep, wooded hill rising from the middle. On top of the hill stands a fortified complex with walls and a prominent tower. Below are dense red‑roofed buildings and a large light-colored institutional building. A river with bridges curves through the city to the right, and distant mountains are faintly visible under a cloudy sky. The image has a painted/printed look and a white border typical of vintage postcards. No legible text appears on the front.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large three-story rectangular school building with many tall windows and a hipped roof, surrounded by a fence and garden. The school stands in a rural or small-town setting with hills or low mountains in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the school and its location.

A black-and-white aerial photograph of a coastal town, showing a dense grid of houses, some larger institutional buildings among trees, and a shoreline with small boats pulled up along the water. At the bottom edge there is white printed text in Swedish identifying the location and publisher/photographer.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a small town on a hillside surrounded by forests and fields. A church with a prominent tower rises above rows of traditional houses along the ridge, while a few villas and smaller buildings sit lower on the slope and in the valley. At the bottom left a light area is reserved for caption text in red, identifying the town and the publisher.

Illustrated postcard showing the entrance to a fairground or exhibition hall decorated with garlands and flags. A large crowd of people in early 20th‑century clothing gathers in front of the building, with several ticket booths labeled "KASSE". Above the entrance is signage for the "Grazer Herbstmesse" (Graz Autumn Fair). At the bottom, in a wide border, the title "GRAZER HERBSTMESSE" is prominently printed.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in rolling countryside. In the foreground is a pasture with grazing cows. Behind it lies a cluster of traditional gabled houses and farm buildings surrounded by trees. Dominating the center-right is a large white church or abbey with two tall, slender spires and a baroque or neo-gothic appearance. The background shows patchwork fields and low wooded hills under a cloudy sky, with overhanging tree branches framing the top of the image. No visible printed caption or handwriting can be seen on the front.

A monochrome postcard view of a landscaped public park with curved walking paths, lawns, benches, and rows of trees in the foreground. In the distance on a rocky hill stands a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire. Behind the trees to the left are town buildings and another tower-like structure. The caption at the bottom reads "Hangö – Hanko."

Vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young woman with long wavy hair and flowers in her hair, wearing a light-colored lace-trimmed dress with a corseted waist and floral decorations. She is seated, holding flowers in her lap. The lower part of the image includes printed credits and a caption with her name and the role 'Undine'. The style and typography resemble early 20th‑century European photographic postcards.

Black-and-white image of a large Baroque water castle reflected in a calm lake. The building has four prominent round corner towers with onion-shaped domes and lanterns, a central section with a tall spire, arched windows, and a landscaped terrace with trees and small outbuildings along the water's edge. The photograph is vertically oriented, emphasizing the reflection of the castle in the water. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a uniformed military officer with a prominent mustache, wearing a peaked cap and double-breasted tunic with shoulder boards and stand-up collar. The photo has a white border and bears a bold cursive signature across the lower part of the image; in the bottom right corner appears a small studio imprint that seems to read "Salon Strindberg." The style suggests an early 20th‑century military portrait postcard.

Colorized historic postcard view of a broad public square with statues and trees set against a mountainous backdrop. A large monument with a standing figure on a high pedestal is visible on the left, while a bust on a plinth stands on the right. People and horse‑drawn vehicles appear in the square. Printed red text at the top left reads "TRENTO – TRIENT Piazza Dante," and there is cursive handwriting across the upper center.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a crowded harbor scene with multiple masted sailing ships and small boats moored side by side. The water in the foreground reflects the hulls and rigging. A printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Greek sailing boats in the harbor of Alexandria, Egypt, and there is also a website watermark.

Sepia-toned photograph of a large two‑story neoclassical building seen from the front, with evenly spaced arched windows on both floors, three prominent arched doorways at the center, a balcony with balustrade above the entrance, and a flat roof with decorative cornice. The building faces an open cobblestone square, partially framed by tree branches in the foreground. A small handwritten red number appears in the upper right corner of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a monument in a town square. The central feature is a statue of a uniformed soldier holding a raised sword and a flag, standing on a high pedestal surrounded by an ornate wrought-iron fence. Behind the statue is a multi‑story historic building with gabled roof and dormer windows. Large signage on the facade reads "Weisser Adler" and "Dietzelt's Hôtel, Weisser Adler." At street level another sign advertises a hairdresser, "Bernh. Pollack Friseur." There is a dark plaque with German text on the pedestal of the statue.

A black‑and‑white image with a white printed border, showing a large villa or small mansion with steep, multi‑gabled roofs and dormer windows, partly hidden behind tall trees and dense foliage. The house has a central tower‑like roof section and balconies, in a style reminiscent of Central European or Germanic country houses from the early 20th century. The scene is framed by overhanging branches, giving it a picturesque, rural‑estate feeling. The edges of the image show wear and light damage typical of old photographic postcards.

A colored illustrated postcard showing multiple vignette views of a town labeled "Gummersbach". The central image is a panoramic view of the town in a valley with hills and smokestacks in the background, captioned "Total-Ansicht v. d. Louisenhütte". Around it are smaller scenes: a building labeled "Sommerfrische Hermannsburg" with a windmill-like structure, a war memorial tower among fir trees captioned "Krieger Denkmal", and street views with buildings including a hotel labeled "Hotel Kögler Königl. Amtsger". Decorative flowers and ornate golden scrollwork frame the images. The lower half contains cursive handwriting in German, characteristic of an old mailed postcard.

A colored vintage street scene showing a narrow alley with multi‑story buildings and a mosque with an ornate minaret in the background. People in traditional Middle Eastern clothing walk and gather in the street. The top text identifies the location as a street in Cairo near the Citadel. There is also a website watermark at the bottom.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings leading to a large round defensive tower with a conical roof in the background. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A shop sign with the word "KODAK" hangs on the right. Handwritten-style caption at the bottom reads "Riga – am Pulverturm" and small printed text in the lower right reads "ZUDUSI LATVIJA".

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers on a military pontoon raft or improvised ferry, working with oars and poles on a calm river. The opposite bank has a few buildings, trees, a tall poplar, and a church tower on a hill in the distance. German text is printed along the lower edge and a red manuscript number appears in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small rural village with a church tower, traditional houses, barns and people walking along a road beside open meadows and distant forested hills. The caption at the top names the place, and there is German text on a building advertising a sport hotel or inn.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a gently rising street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. In the foreground are early 20th‑century European buildings, including a corner shop with a large sign reading "PHOTOGRAPHIE." Pedestrians and a few carts are visible on the street. In the distance, two tall Gothic church spires dominate the skyline. The lower margin bears handwritten captions indicating the town and the street name.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑story brick school building with arched windows and a corner tower, seen from the street behind an iron fence and framed by leafy trees. In the foreground is a sloping path and sidewalk; in the lower margin and bottom‑right corner there is printed caption and publisher/photographer information.

Black‑and‑white view over a small European town with a stone arch bridge in the foreground crossing a shallow river. Along the riverbank are telegraph poles with many ceramic insulators, and a few people appear to be walking or wading in the water. On the far side of the river stand villas and townhouses with steep tiled roofs and half‑timbered gables, behind which rise larger institutional buildings. At the right is a church with a Baroque-style tower topped by a dome and cross. In the background are rolling fields and a smokestack on a hill, suggesting a semi‑industrial rural town. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early 20th‑century postcard, but no visible printed text on the front.

Black‑and‑white vertical view through a pointed archway onto a cobbled street leading to a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire topped by a cross. There is a clock on the church tower. Several children and adults in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the street. On the right side are multi‑story townhouses with shops; one facade bears the large sign "Stadt‑Park."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow, gently curving street in a historic European town. On both sides are plastered houses with steep tiled roofs; one façade is patterned with dark and light triangles, and further back stand larger gabled buildings and a small tower-like structure. In the background a church with a tall, slender baroque-style spire rises above the rooftops. Townspeople in early 20th‑century clothing—men in hats and coats, women in long skirts, and children—stand or walk along the street and by a stone retaining wall with steps. Trees overhang parts of the scene, and there are no motor vehicles visible.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a tall, rectangular medieval tower with a crenellated top, standing alone in an open square with a few adjacent low buildings and distant hills. In the upper left corner there is a circular emblem with the colors of the Italian flag (green, white, red) and a small black eagle-like symbol. At the bottom center, printed text reads the location and name of the tower.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small village nestled in a wooded valley, with several gabled houses, narrow roads, and cultivated fields surrounded by forested hills. In the foreground are residential buildings and trees; in the background, gently curving fields and hills dominate the landscape. A caption in German appears along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white image showing a dense religious street procession moving along a cobblestoned city street between rows of multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. Hooded and cloaked participants carry long staffs or spears and religious statues, followed by clergy and other costumed figures, while large crowds line both sides of the street and look on from windows above. The scene evokes a Catholic Holy Week or Passion procession in a European town.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a funeral procession in a European city street. Uniformed men in long coats carry a large, dark-draped coffin while soldiers or guards line the street and civilians watch. The background features multi‑story stone buildings with shopfronts; large commercial signs in a Finno‑Ugric–looking language are visible above the ground-floor shops.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide street lined with trees and ornate late‑19th‑century villas or townhouses. In the foreground at right stands an elaborate multi‑arm street lamp. The main building complex on the left has steep roofs, turrets, and decorative gables, surrounded by a fence and small garden. Printed red text appears along the bottom margin identifying the location and publisher, along with a date.

Black‑and‑white image showing a group of substantial late‑19th/early‑20th‑century urban buildings behind a tree‑lined street and brick/stone perimeter wall. The main structure on the left is a richly decorated brick and stone mansion or civic building with a steep hipped roof, dormers and elaborate window pediments. To the right stands a slightly newer villa with a large, curved gable and simple classical detailing. In the background are more institutional‑looking blocks with steep tiled roofs, chimneys and small tower‑like roof structures. Leafless trees and empty street suggest late autumn or winter. No visible caption or border text appears on the image.

Vintage postcard featuring three black‑and‑white portrait photographs of a woman named Kirsti Suonio (one head‑and‑shoulders portrait at the top center and two smaller circular portraits in costumes at the bottom). The right half and lower center are filled with handwritten text in German. At the upper right is a dated note that begins with the place name written as "Helsingfors den 11/12–13."

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a grand stone railway station with a large arched entrance, flanked by monumental statues holding spherical lamps. A tall clock tower rises behind the main facade. Early automobiles and a few pedestrians are visible in the broad square in front. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom margin in two languages.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined park or courtyard in front of a large, elegant multi‑storey building with tall windows and a steep tiled roof, typical of Central European architecture. In the foreground, behind an iron fence, stands a pedestal monument topped with a sculptural military helmet and perhaps a laurel wreath or shield. The pedestal bears inscribed panels of text in a serif script. The setting suggests a memorial in front of a public or institutional building, photographed in an early 20th‑century style.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a panoramic view of a large hilltop complex with a Gothic cathedral and a castle-like structure above a river. The scene is framed artistically by dark tree branches and leaves in the foreground. Below the hill lie small houses and buildings along the riverbank and open fields. No printed text is visible on the image.

Colorized historic postcard view of a central market square lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. On the left stands a large Baroque church with twin onion‑domed towers and a white façade, opening onto the square. In the middle and right foreground are rows of commercial buildings with display windows and signs, with pedestrians walking along the street and a horse‑drawn vehicle. In the distance a brick tower rises above the roofs. The sky is rendered in pastel blue with light clouds. The captions "Komotau." and "Markt." are printed in red at the top.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a large hilltop castle-like building labeled as Schloss Bieberstein, overlooking a wooded slope and a rocky river or stream in the foreground. Tall trees and dense foliage surround the hillside, with the multi‑storey structure rising above the treetops. The image has an early 20th‑century photographic style and printed captions along the top and right edges.

Sepia-toned vintage view from a high rocky cliff with a multi‑storey villa or hotel perched right on the edge, featuring arched windows and a large balcony overlooking a wide valley. Below lies a town along a river with bridges and gridded streets, surrounded by mountains. A cable‑car line with pylons and a suspended cabin runs between the cliff and the valley, indicating a tourist or scenic transport route.

Sepia-toned view over a river valley toward a historic hilltop complex with multiple Gothic spires and large buildings, overlooking a town of dense houses and factory chimneys along the riverbank. A bridge crosses the river in the distance and a steamboat travels on the water. The foreground is framed by trees and foliage. Red printed German text appears in the upper left, with an additional handwritten red number on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a fortified hilltop complex with towers and stone walls, seen from a sloping cobbled path. On the left are large medieval-looking buildings with conical roofs and battlements, likely part of a castle or fortress. On the right runs a high stone wall with a narrow path beside it, bordered by trees. In the foreground a woman and two children walk along the path. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the caption indicating the location and viewpoint.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate historic complex of civic buildings around a cobbled courtyard. On the left is a neoclassical façade with arched doorway and pediment; on the right is a richly decorated Baroque/Flemish Renaissance façade with statues and gables, forming an archway passage beneath. The layout and caption indicate it is the law courts and registry building in Bruges. The image is bordered by white space, with printed captions beneath and along the side.

Colorized vintage view of a landscaped square with trees, benches, and people walking along a paved promenade in front of a large pavilion-like building with multiple pitched roofs and decorative finials. The caption at the bottom reads "PRAÇA DE SERPA PINTO." Mountains are visible in the distant background, and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a broad town square bordered by ornate multi‑storey buildings on the left and a tall church with a clock tower and spire on the right. Timber‑framed houses line the background. A few people walk across the open square. Printed red captions at the top read the town name, reference to an inn, and the name of the square.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the historic center of a European city with dense tiled rooftops in the foreground and a steep, wooded hill crowned with fortifications and buildings in the background. A funicular or hillside railway line can be seen running up the slope. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border identifying the scene.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a winding road passing a two‑storey baroque building with an arched passage and a tall open bell tower. A woman in long skirt stands in the street. In the background, on a hill, a large estate or castle‑like structure is visible. The printed caption at the top in red reads "Niederlößnitz. Altfriedstein."

A vintage sepia-toned street view showing a grand multi-storey hotel building with balconies and ornate rooflines on the left, identified as 'Wettiner Hof'. The ground floor has shops and arcades; several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the broad, tree‑lined street. Large leafy trees line the right side of the scene. The printed title at the top reads 'Bad Elster — Wettiner Hof'.

A monochrome postcard view of a waterfront in a small northern town. In the foreground are rocky shallows and several wooden rowing boats pulled up on the shore. On the right stands a distinctive wooden building with a tall square tower and a steep metal roof, with a few smaller houses behind it. Across the water more wooden sheds or boathouses line the opposite shore. The sky is cloudy and the overall scene has an early‑20th‑century feel. At the top of the postcard is printed text in Finnish.

An old monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate three‑story stone school building with a central arched entrance and symmetrical wings. The façade features many tall windows, decorative cornices, and a prominent central section with columns above the main arch. Small trees line the front, and there is an open street or square in the foreground. Swedish text is printed at the top identifying the building and the city.

Black‑and‑white image of a small medieval hilltop church complex with a tall, narrow stone bell tower and adjoining buildings, all enclosed by a low defensive wall. The complex stands on a rocky outcrop above a valley, backed by densely forested mountains. There is no visible caption or writing on the image side.

Black‑and‑white image showing a small, octagonal or circular chapel with a shingled, conical roof topped by a tiny belfry or turret. The chapel stands on a slight rise at the end of a narrow dirt path bordered by low posts and wire. Leafless or sparsely leafed trees surround the building, and the overall mood is rural and quiet, resembling an old photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white historic view of an elegant European spa town with ornate multi‑storey facades along a narrow river or canal. A colonnaded promenade with statues on its roof runs on the right side, crowded with well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century fashion. Hills with villas rise in the background. Visible shopfronts and signage include a clearly readable sign for a pharmacy on a building in the distance.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographic views. The left image shows a rural hillside village with several houses and a church featuring a bulbous (onion) dome tower, surrounded by forested hills. The right image shows a small memorial column or commemorative pillar set among tall trees, with many wooden benches and tables arranged around it, resembling a forest beer garden or rest area. Printed caption text in German appears beneath the images, along with a small number at the lower left.

Color postcard showing a city square with a bronze fountain sculpture of three muscular male figures working with hammers and anvil on a circular pedestal. Around the base are flower stalls and people walking on the cobblestone square. In the background stands a modern glass office building covered with company names in large letters, and an older ornate building on the right.

Sepia-toned photograph mounted on a cardboard backing, showing a large rectangular neoclassical building with multiple wings, arched windows on the ground floor, and a central entrance with a small staircase. The structure has flat roofs with balustrades and several low towers. In front there is an open, bare area and some leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. Handwritten text in a cursive script appears on the mount below the image.

Sepia-toned aerial or elevated view of a valley settlement with a large hilltop complex dominating the left side, likely a castle with a tall tower and church-like spire. Below it is a river or stream with tracks or a road running alongside, bordered by numerous small houses and gardens. Forested hills surround the village, and open fields lie in the distance. In the upper-right area of the image is the printed caption "Weesenstein i. Sa."

Colorized vintage postcard view of a railway line curving into a stone tunnel beneath a townscape. The scene shows tracks descending between high retaining walls into a masonry tunnel portal. Above and around the tunnel are multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs, a tall industrial chimney, flowering trees, and fenced gardens. A person in dark clothing stands with a dog on the path to the left. The sky is clear and blue. Printed red text labels the location and feature depicted.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession of men in top hats and long coats walking along a broad street or square. A uniformed guard with a tall plume helmet stands at the left foreground holding a rifle. Grand neoclassical buildings line the right side; more classical façades and distant monuments appear in the background. The scene looks ceremonial, likely in a European capital in the early 20th century.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a mountainous rural area with dense coniferous forest. In the foreground are a few small alpine farmhouses with tiled, slightly sloping roofs and whitewashed walls, set on a grassy hillside with scattered rocks and low vegetation. A simple wooden fence and a dirt path connect the buildings. In the background, on a higher slope across a wooded valley, there is a village or resort town with several chalet-style houses, small lodges or hotels, and a winding road running along the hillside. The overall scene suggests an alpine region; no visible text appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white view along a calm river or canal toward a medieval brick city gate with two tall conical spires and crenellated round towers. The gate straddles the water with an arched passage for boats beneath it. On the left bank stands a simple white riverside house and farm buildings; on the right, trees and a quay line the water. The overall look is of an old European town gate reflected in the water, printed in postcard-like format without a visible border or caption.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a brick school building seen from a courtyard with trees and benches in the foreground. The facade has tall rectangular windows and a small clock mounted high on the right section. At the bottom edge there is printed caption text identifying the school and location.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a stone church with a clock tower and belfry, identified at the top as the church in Fismes. The façade has arched windows and decorative stonework, with a lower annex to the right and a large tree and group of people standing in the square in front of the church.

Illustrated postcard showing a dense tiled-roof town framed by hills. Dominating the view are two church towers and a large church-like building above the clustered houses. In the foreground, a heraldic shield with a wing is topped by a banner reading "ALA." The image is rendered in a monochrome, engraved style with a decorative border.

Illustrated postcard showing a haloed, medieval-looking youth in a cape harvesting grapes into a basket beside a vineyard. In the background stands a small round chapel with a conical roof on a hill. The style is Art Nouveau/early 20th century, with warm pastel colors and decorative outlines. The artist's signature and date appear in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a large modernist office or institutional building with seven stories, flat roof and long rows of rectangular windows. In front there is a parking lot filled with 1950s European cars, a sidewalk, a simple post‑war style streetlamp and, to the right, a glazed elevated walkway connecting to another wing. A flag flies on the roof, but the design is not clearly legible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large rectangular military barracks building with a dark tiled roof and many identical windows. A formation of uniformed soldiers stands in front of the central entrance. In the foreground there is an empty sports ground with a football goal. Handwritten numbers appear at the top right, and a German caption is printed along the lower edge.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval clock tower with a steep shingled roof overlooking a city. The tower has a prominent round clock face with Roman numerals on its wall and is set on a hill with trees and a path in the foreground. On the right side of the card there is a printed decorative shield containing a portrait of an older, mustachioed man in a decorated military uniform, and beside the shield stands a heraldic lion with a crown. There is no visible printed caption or other text.

A colorized vintage postcard view over a riverside town with red-roofed houses along a broad river, surrounded by hills. In the foreground and to the right stand prominent church buildings with towers. On a hill to the left sits a striking neo-Gothic church overlooking the river. At the top center of the image is the caption text in German: "Remagen mit Apollinariskirche." The overall print and wear suggest an early 20th‑century chromolithographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of an Alpine village in a valley surrounded by dramatic rocky peaks of the Dolomites. At the bottom are clustered houses, fields, and a church with a bell tower; on the upper part loom steep mountain faces. Printed labels in Italian identify the Dolomite road and the surrounding peaks, including Sassolungo/Sassolungo group and nearby summits.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded promenade along a river beside a large neo‑classical colonnade with arches and statues on the roof. The scene is lively, with many people in early 20th‑century clothing walking near the spa building and along the embankment. At the bottom left, a caption in German identifies the location as Karlsbad, Mühlbrunn.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large rectangular institutional building with many windows, set among cultivated fields and terraced vineyards on a hillside. Mountains rise in the background. At the bottom margin there is an Italian caption identifying the place as a Franciscan college in Villazzano, near Trento.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a courtyard beside a large stone or masonry building with arches and high walls. Groups of men, some seated on the ground and others standing or walking, occupy the open yard; the scene appears to depict prisoners or soldiers during a mealtime or break. The image has printed caption text at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a steep funicular railway climbing a wooded hillside toward a large building complex at the top. Two funicular cars are visible on parallel tracks, one ascending and one near the bottom. At the summit stands a multi‑storey structure with signs on the facade, and the slope is rocky and forested. The caption at the top reads "Graz. Schloßbergbahn."

A simple vintage greeting postcard on beige card stock with elegant cursive text in Estonian, conveying Christmas and New Year wishes from the chocolate factory "Progress" in Tallinn. There are no images or illustrations, only text centered on the card.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small coastal town. The image shows clusters of early 20th‑century European-style houses, several larger institutional buildings with pitched roofs, tree‑lined streets, railway tracks, and a shoreline with piers or docks extending into the water. In the lower left corner there is a printed caption in a Scandinavian language.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex above dense trees. The complex includes several connected stone buildings with steep roofs and a prominent round tower with battlements. At the top left of the image there is red printed text identifying the location.

Color-tinted postcard showing a gently rolling rural landscape with fields, trees, a stream or path in the foreground, and several farmhouses with red or brown roofs scattered across the middle distance. The horizon is flat and expansive, typical of lowland countryside. At the bottom margin, there is printed Dutch text identifying the location near Nijmegen and a smaller line of text naming the specific valley. A printer's credit appears on the right, and there is a handwritten signature and date on the lower right.

A colorized postcard-style illustration of a small red-brick railway station building set in a green, grassy landscape with trees around it. The building has a steep metal roof, arched windows, and a sign on the facade reading "HARDEBERGA." At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Järnvägsstationen, Hardeberga." The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century depiction.

A monochrome postcard showing a large historic building with a steep, dormer‑filled roof and ivy‑covered façade, set within a landscaped garden. There is a central portico entrance with columns, manicured shrubs, trees, and a fountain or basin in the foreground. Printed German text appears at the top left identifying the scene.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a lively European city street lined with multi‑story buildings, storefronts with striped awnings, pedestrians, cyclists, and a few early 20th‑century vehicles. Shop signs are visible on both sides, including a prominent corner building with the word "BISCHOFF" and various hanging signs. In the background, several church spires or tall towers rise above the rooftops. At the bottom margin, printed caption text reads "Nijmegen, Molenstraat."

A black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a cobblestoned road lined with telegraph or power poles and early street lighting. On the left are stone and masonry buildings; on the right, behind trees and a low wall, is an older church-like building. Several pedestrians and a horse-drawn vehicle appear on the street. The caption at the top reads "Kuopio. Kauppakatu.", indicating this is a view of Kauppakatu street in Kuopio.

Colorized vintage view of a landscaped pond and park with a tree-lined shore, small boats at the water's edge, walking paths, and benches. On the left is a building covered in ivy with two pointed turret-like towers and an outdoor café terrace furnished with many white chairs. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. At the top left, printed text reads "GRAZ Hilmteich."

Black‑and‑white view from an elevated terrace with a semicircular neoclassical colonnade and a large statue of a robed figure holding up a cross, standing on a rocky pedestal with sculpted figures below. Two well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the terrace. In the background, across a river valley, stands a large palace complex on a hill and church spires rising from the city below. Parts of the image edges appear damaged, as if from an old negative or printed postcard.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the interior of a bath facility with two deep wooden bathtubs with white linings, plumbing fixtures between them, a small wall‑mounted sink, pipes, hoses and a pump. A pair of slippers lies on the wet wooden floor. The caption in a Baltic language appears along the bottom edge.

A color illustration of a small riverside town with red‑tiled roofs and wooden houses nestled among dense green trees. A church tower with a red roof stands at the right, and a bridge crosses the river on the left. The townscape is reflected in the calm water in the foreground. Printed text appears in the lower left corner.

An old monochrome postcard showing a busy harbor scene with many small rowing boats full of people on calm water, with a densely built coastal town in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Regates – Mitylin." and there is a modern web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" across the image.

Black‑and‑white waterfront view of a small Nordic coastal town. In the foreground are wooden piers and boathouses on stilts along calm water.
