A river runs through the center with several bridges, flanked by dense mid‑rise buildings and tree‑lined embankments. Steep, wooded hills rise on both sides, with terraced slopes on the right. A church with a tall steeple stands on the left hillside near a curved road and rail line. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large three‑storey school building with classical architectural details and arched windows. A few people stand near the main entrance. Overhead utility lines run along the street in front. At the top left, red printed Hungarian text identifies the location and the type of school.

A historical black‑and‑white postcard showing a large column of British troops marching through a coastal town with Venetian-style fortifications and an old harbor. Many soldiers and officers are visible, along with civilians watching from rooftops and balconies. In the background are stone walls, bastions, and mixed Ottoman and Venetian architecture, including a minaret. On the right side of the postcard there is printed bilingual text in French and Greek describing the departure of British troops from Candia/Heraklion in July 1909.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a hilltop castle complex rising above dense forest. The large building has multiple gabled roofs, a prominent rounded central dome-like tower, and a church-like tower with an onion-shaped spire on the right. The image has a white border with handwritten-style German caption at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white aerial view of a large industrial complex surrounded by forest, lakes and a scattered town. Several long factory halls with saw‑tooth and gabled roofs, tall brick smokestacks emitting light smoke, and rail sidings dominate the center. In the foreground stands a prominent multi‑storey manor‑like building with a central dome and formal entrance, set within landscaped grounds and trees. Beyond the factories are wooden houses and villas along the lakeshore and within the forested hills. There is no printed caption or other visible text on the image.

Sepia-toned street scene showing an early 20th‑century European city. The view looks down a cobblestone avenue with tram tracks and a tramcar in the center distance. Multi‑story stone buildings with ornate facades line both sides; awnings shelter storefronts and pedestrians in period clothing (long dresses, hats, suits). A clock projects from a shopfront on the left, and several business signs hang above the sidewalks. The architectural style is central‑European and urban, suggesting a commercial main street.

Black‑and‑white vertical postcard-style photograph showing a steep stone stairway with metal railings climbing along a stone wall. A few women in long skirts and blouses are descending the steps, suggesting an early 20th‑century scene. At the top left rises a large church tower with a distinctive onion-shaped dome and lantern, typical of Central or Eastern European Baroque architecture. Trees and vegetation line the right side; older masonry buildings sit above the wall on the left. The bottom edge of the print shows damage and torn paper, but no visible caption or border text.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a slightly uphill cobblestone street lined with two- and three-story houses and small town buildings. A woman in traditional dress walks on the right sidewalk. The architecture is late 19th to early 20th century Central European. At the top margin there is printed text identifying the view as a street in Rumburg in Bohemia, specifically Elisabethgasse.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large, single‑storey Victorian-era club building with multiple chimneys, verandahs and decorative gables. A flag flies from a tall flagpole on the roof. In front, there is a street scene with small trees, a horse and cart, and several people walking near the fence. The caption at the bottom identifies the building as the Settlers Club in Mildura and credits the publisher.

A colorized panoramic view of a small European town set in a hilly landscape. In the foreground, fields stretch toward a steam locomotive pulling passenger cars along a railway line. Behind the tracks lies the town with red‑roofed houses, larger villas, a few factory chimneys, and a prominent church with a tall spire to the right. The sky is lightly clouded. At the top center, in red lettering, is the caption identifying the place.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with traditional European houses, a church with a tall spire, and several fortress-like towers on a hill behind the town. In the foreground is an empty ploughed field bordered by a wooden fence. Red printed text at the top left reads "Gruß aus Stolpen." and sideways along the left edge is the publisher credit.

Color-tinted historic street view labeled 'Stationstraat.' showing a broad, tree‑lined avenue with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn cart, and tram tracks in the foreground. Dominating the scene is a large ornate corner building with a tower and mansard roof bearing the sign 'HOTEL' and 'RESTAURANT'. At the bottom the caption reads 'Nijmegen.' The image has a printed border typical of early picture postcards.

A multi-view color postcard with three images. The top image shows a panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by high green mountains. The bottom left image depicts a brick church or abbey with a decorative fountain in front, set in a landscaped garden. The bottom right image shows a medieval hilltop castle ruin covered in greenery. Across the center, there is printed text reading "Saluti da PERGINE VALSUGANA".

Black‑and‑white postcard with a panoramic rural view of a village and farmland in a valley surrounded by low hills. In the foreground are fields with haystacks and a dirt road lined with stones or small standing rocks; farm buildings and industrial-looking structures are visible in the mid‑ground. The upper half of the postcard is filled with handwritten text in a Scandinavian language. The printed caption "ALVDAL" appears at the top left, and at the bottom right are the printed credits "Eneret Fot K Bredstrøm" and the reference "MINØ.38436".

A black‑and‑white view of a large, elongated neo‑Gothic / neo‑Renaissance style building with multiple steep-roofed corner towers and dormers, set behind a line of leafless trees. In the right background is a tall, slender church spire. In the foreground stretches a wide open field or parade ground with several small groups of people, possibly soldiers drilling, and a single figure walking toward the camera. The image has film scratches and dust typical of early 20th‑century photography. No printed title or caption is visible on the image.

A colorized panoramic view of a European city nestled between green hills and mountains. In the foreground are villas and buildings with red-tiled roofs surrounded by trees and fields; further back is a denser urban area with church towers. On a wooded hill to the right stands a prominent tower-like structure. At the top left of the image, printed text in German reads 'Graz von der Hilmwarte.'

Sepia-toned postcard showing a scenic viewpoint with benches and people sitting under trees, looking toward a muscular lion statue on a stone pedestal. The statue overlooks a hilly landscape in the background. Printed captions in German identify the location as the Hackher monument on the Schlossberg in Graz. The publisher information appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an urban square featuring a central equestrian statue on a high pedestal, enclosed by a decorative fence with landscaped plants around it. Surrounding the square are multi‑story European‑style buildings, streetlamps, and a few people on the sidewalks. Printed captions identify the location as a square dedicated to Mohamed Ali in Alexandria.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a long, historic spa or bath building with a high, pitched roof and many chimneys and windows. In front of the building there is a fenced garden or park with paths, trees, and a central lamp post. The printed captions beneath the image read "Varaždinske Toplice. Kupališna zgrada. Curhaus."

A sepia-toned street scene in a European city, showing a steep cobblestone street lined with multi‑story brick buildings that have many metal balconies. Horse‑drawn carts stand on the right side of the street. Various shop signs hang from the buildings. On the right, one sign clearly reads "Carl J. Olsson Kött Fläsk Charkuteri." The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century urban neighborhood.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central stone monument on a stepped base surrounded by an iron fence. Around the fenced monument are several canvas tents, with people and belongings visible near them, suggesting temporary shelter in a damaged urban area. In the background are low, partially ruined buildings and a cloudy sky. The lower border of the postcard contains printed Greek and English captions identifying the location as Solomos Place in Zante (Zakynthos), along with a website watermark and publisher details.

A monochrome view of a large, ornate 19th‑century stone building bordering a wide cobblestoned square. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the open space, and a few horse-drawn vehicles are visible. The lower part of the card is blank except for printed captions in Swedish stating the city and square name, and a photographer's credit.

Sepia-toned studio portrait showing a woman seated on a rustic wooden bench and a uniformed man standing behind and leaning toward her. The woman wears an early 20th‑century long dress, fur stole, large hat with decoration, and holds a handbag. The man wears a dark military-style tunic with stand-up collar, a flat round cap, and white gloves. The background is a painted pastoral backdrop, typical of professional photographic studios. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

A vintage Spanish postal card with a red 10-centimos España stamp on the upper left, cancelled with a black postmark. The printed heading reads 'TARJETA POSTAL'. The right half is filled with elegant handwritten cursive in Spanish, addressing a recipient and mentioning Santander and Sardinero. The card is aged, with yellowed paper and some stains, and there is no photograph or illustration on this side.

A sepia-toned architectural photograph of a Mughal-style pavilion built of light-colored stone, with intricate jali (latticed) screens, carved brackets, and a domed chhatri on the roof. The structure stands at the edge of a fort wall or high platform, with railings and balconies overlooking a drop on one side. There are no printed captions on the front aside from a small numeric code in the bottom-right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined river or canal with dense foliage on both banks. On the left bank, near the background, stands a large multi‑storey historic building with a steep roof and dormer windows, likely a civic or institutional structure. The water reflects the trees and part of the building. Handwritten-style text is printed along the lower margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European town. A broad, unpaved or lightly paved road runs into the distance, lined with substantial late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left are ornate multi‑story townhouses or civic buildings with decorative roofs; on the right is a large, simpler building signed as a hotel. People walk along the sidewalks and a few horse‑drawn vehicles are on the street. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as Bahnhofstrasse in Wurzen, and a printer's line notes Brück & Sohn, Meissen.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town set in rolling hills and farmland. In the foreground is a central square bordered by multi‑storey townhouses and dominated by a large church with a tall tower and spire. The lower margin contains printed captions in red ink on a cream background.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly spa town nestled in a forested valley. Dense late‑19th‑century and early‑20th‑century buildings with steep metal roofs fill the foreground, while large hotels, villas, and sanatorium‑like structures line the slopes in the middle distance. A distinctive white villa with a tower stands to the right against the wooded hillside. In the far background, forested hills encircle the town. The image has no visible caption or border text on its front side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing the garden of the Achilleion palace in Corfu. It depicts a formal landscaped garden with hedges, palm trees and statues, including a prominent seated figure in the center. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk among the paths and stairs. At the right is a neoclassical building with columns. Printed captions in French and another language identify the scene as the garden of the Achilleion in Corfu.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing people standing inside stone ruins decorated for a celebration. The walls are rough masonry, likely the remains of an old church or castle. A large white panel with garlands and Swedish text is mounted on the central wall. More handwritten Swedish text appears below the image and along the left edge ("Adolf Gumerus Bokhandel"). The printed caption below the photograph mentions a fiftieth‑anniversary celebration at Gla Wasa in 1902.

Black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped park with paths, benches, flowerbeds, and a fountain in the foreground leading up to a brick town hall building with a clock tower and ornate facade. Several people are visible near the entrance and on the paths. Text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a small fenced park or green with a stone war memorial obelisk topped by a figure, set on a base surrounded by rocks. Trees dominate the foreground; behind them are late‑19th/early‑20th‑century town buildings along a street. The printed caption in red at the bottom identifies the location and the monument.

Black‑and‑white view across a wide river toward a hill crowned by a large medieval castle complex. Below the castle, closer to the water, stand industrial and residential buildings with a tall chimney. A low weir or series of posts crosses the river, and a stone arch bridge is visible in the distance on the right. In the foreground, a small rowboat with two people is on the water. The image has wide white margins like an old photographic postcard. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone square lined with traditional European townhouses. The central building is a mid‑size hotel with the word "HOTEL" prominent on its facade and an awning‑covered terrace with climbing plants labeled "goldne Sonne". Neighboring buildings host various shops and businesses, and several pedestrians stand or walk along the street. The architecture suggests an early 20th‑century small town in a German‑speaking region.

Hand‑colored postcard showing a forested river gorge with steep pine‑covered hillsides. Several small wooden and half‑timbered buildings with red and dark roofs stand along the left bank. A narrow path and a small bridge lead down to the water, where rowboats are moored. In the foreground, three people in early 20th‑century clothing sit in a rowing boat on the calm river. German text in red is printed in the top‑right and along the right edge.

Sepia-toned historic postcard-style photograph of a large neo-Renaissance public building with a central entrance portico, ornate columns, and arched windows, set within a landscaped park with paths, lawns, young trees, and gas-style street lamps. A street with tram or rail tracks runs in the foreground. Below the image is a modern archival strip with a scale and library credit labels.

The page of an album contains two old black‑and‑white postcards mounted on brown paper with handwritten notes in German. The left postcard shows a narrow river or lake gorge between steep rocky, forested cliffs with a boat in the distance; it is labeled "Sortavala" and "Orjasaar(i)" with a handwritten message along the bottom. The right postcard shows a harbor scene with many boats moored in front of an ornate waterfront cityscape including prominent multi‑storey buildings and towers; it is labeled "Wiburg / Wiborg" with dense handwriting below. The album page headings mention Finland in German and are dated 'Februar – März 1902'.

Vintage multi-view postcard with three hand-colored street scenes of a German town. The upper left image shows a broad street lined with two- and three-story buildings, labeled "Bahnhofstrasse." The upper right image shows a narrower street with similar houses, labeled "Lindenstrasse." The lower image shows another street scene titled "Äussere Schillerstrasse." Decorative floral artwork separates the images from the caption text on the right. The main greeting reads "Gruss aus Ebingen." Publisher information and a note that this is a hand-colored artist card appear along the margins.

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a settlement of a few large wooden buildings in the foreground with sparse vegetation and rocky ground, set against a dramatic backdrop of snow‑patched mountains and a distinctive U‑shaped valley. Printed captions identify the view and the publisher in Swedish.

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a cobblestone street lined with two- to three-story buildings with pitched roofs. A few pedestrians and a handcart are visible in the foreground, with horse-drawn vehicles farther down the street. At the top center of the card is printed text identifying the location as Borna, in the Leipzig district, specifically Kirchstraße.

Colorized view of a serene pond or small lake bordered by trees, with a person paddling a small boat on the water in the foreground. On the opposite bank stands a large historic-looking building with several towers and ornate windows, partly framed by trees. The scene is park-like and tranquil. In the upper right corner, the caption reads "Hilmteich Graz."

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a hilly lakeside landscape with scattered village buildings and a church in the distance, framed on the right by tall conifer trees. At the bottom margin there is an Italian caption identifying the location as Baselga di Piné in Trento and specifying the nearby lake Lago della Serraia and elevation.

An old Spanish postal card with cream paper and red printing. At the top it reads "TARJETA POSTAL" with a red Spanish royal coat of arms on the left and a printed red stamp on the right showing a crowned portrait and the word "ESPAÑA CORREO" with the value "10 Cs". A serial number "T.531963" appears in black at the top left. The address side is filled with elegant handwritten script in Spanish, with lines crossed out in blue pencil. At the bottom left, small red printed text indicates only the address should be written on this side. The card is lightly foxed and aged.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a river with a sandy bank and tree-lined shores, with tall poplar trees and the Alps mountains in the background. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as the Isère River at Île d'Amour near Grenoble, with the Alps. Small numbers and initials appear in the margins.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a metal truss bridge crossing a river or canal in a park-like landscape. In the foreground, a narrow watercourse runs alongside a curved stone embankment. Trees line the banks and several small human figures stand near the river under the bridge. At the top of the image, printed text in German reads "Torgau a. Elbe" and "Partie im Glacis."

Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with a pond or small lake in the center. In the foreground several people in early 20th‑century clothing sit on white benches along a path facing the water. Across the pond is a tree‑lined shore with umbrellas or kiosks and a small pavilion or café building with a red roof on the right. Dense trees surround the water, and faintly in the distant background there appear to be spires or towers rising above the treetops. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view over a European city with red-tiled roofs, green parks, and a large tree-covered hill in the middle distance. On top of the hill a tower-like structure is visible, with mountains in the far background. At the top of the image there is a printed German caption.

Advertising postcard in German featuring a young boy in traditional Alpine clothing (green hat with feather, grey jacket, dark shorts, green legwarmers) holding a walking stick. The upper part is dominated by stylized text with an imperial double-headed eagle coat of arms and promotional wording for a specialty clothing shop in Graz, Styria, offering Edelweiss-loden and weatherproof garments. The lower margin includes the caption identifying the child as "Mein Söhnchen Alexander" and a small printer's credit along the left edge.

An old monochrome postcard showing a street scene with a large two-story inn or hotel building labeled "Hôtel zum Schwan" and neighboring houses. Leafless trees, a fence, and a few people standing on the sidewalk are visible. The image has a sepia tone, and printed captions in German appear at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a city with tree‑filled parks in the foreground and dense low‑rise buildings and church spires in the background. The horizon shows gentle hills and open countryside. In the top‑right corner, the caption 'TAMPERE - TAMMERFORS' is printed in red uppercase letters.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a tram line running along a wide avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings. Pedestrians, cyclists and early automobiles share the cobbled street. Numerous shop signs in German hang from the buildings, including cafés and dental ateliers. The caption at the bottom left reads "GRAZ. ANNENSTRASSE." and at the bottom right "W. KRAMER. 3725." The perspective looks along Annenstrasse toward the city center, with church towers visible in the distant background.

Old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic rural scene with a railway station and tracks on the left and a small village with scattered houses and fields on the right. Forested hills lie in the background. The bottom portion is left blank for writing, with printed red text reading "Gruss aus Reitzenhain." and smaller publisher information along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a river in a steep valley. A suspension bridge with two heavy masonry towers spans the river, while farther downstream a low footbridge crosses near the water. On the right, atop a forested hill, stands a sizable medieval castle complex with thick walls and a high central keep, attached to which is a church with a tall tower and steeple. On the left bank and in the background are smaller village buildings and wooded hills. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs of ancient marble busts on a cream background. The left image shows the bust of a curly‑haired male figure; the right image shows the bust of a woman. Greek and French captions identify them. Center‑top the card is labeled "ΑΘΗΝΑΙ – ATHÈNES." There is a circular postmark dated 6‑F‑1902 and a handwritten signature. At the bottom left there is a bilingual publication note in Greek and French, and at the bottom right the number 105 is printed.

Black‑and‑white view of a European small town dominated by a large hilltop castle complex with a tall, tiered Baroque tower rising above multi‑winged stone buildings and steep tiled roofs. Below the castle are several modest houses, tree‑lined streets, and a riverbank road curving to the right. Forested hills surround the settlement. On the gable of a large building in the right foreground there are several painted advertisement panels in German.

A hand-colored historic postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town with red-roofed houses, a prominent church with a tower in the center-right, and a large stone castle with round towers on the left. The town is surrounded by open fields and gentle hills. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the town and publisher in German.

Illustrated maritime postcard showing the ocean liner RMS Celtic of the White Star Line at sea. The large black-hulled ship with two buff-colored funnels steams through choppy water under a pale sky. Promotional text for the White Star Line and the ship's specifications appear in blue lettering, and the artist's signature, Montague Black, is visible in the lower right corner.

Colorized vintage view over a hilly town with dense greenery. In the foreground there is a winding white path through a park or landscaped hillside, with trees and flowerbeds along fences. Below the hill stands a cluster of small houses and industrial buildings with red and light-colored roofs and a tall brick smokestack. On the ridge above are larger bourgeois-style houses and mansions, and on the right a prominent Gothic-style church with a tall spire. Beyond, a river plain or lowlands stretch into the distance. The card shows heavy age stains and discoloration, especially in the sky area. No legible printed text is visible on the image side.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a town square with people walking and standing, a few carts, and early 20th‑century buildings around an open plaza. Hills are visible in the background. Greek text is printed at the top of the image.

Vintage monochrome (greenish) illustrated postcard. On the left side, there is an outdoor scene in a forest or rural setting: a woman stands near a large pot hanging over a fire while another figure sits blowing into the fire. Trees and a path are visible in the background. The right half of the card is filled with dense handwritten text in a cursive script. Additional handwriting and signatures appear at the bottom margin.

Multi‑view color postcard with a dark red border showing a formal baroque park and palace. The upper images depict wide lawns with flowerbeds, stone balustrades and statues, including a large ornamental vase with sculpted figures on a pedestal. The lower left view shows a dynamic baroque sculpture group of two figures on a high base amid gardens. The lower right image shows a grand baroque palace with ornate façade and central pediment, fronted by a large pond or lake with many swans and a low, terraced shoreline.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural lakeside scene. In the foreground there are ploughed fields sloping down toward a body of water, with a seated person near the shore. Across the lake stands a long pavilion‑like building with a pointed spire or small tower. Behind it are wooded hills, with a structure on top of a hill to the left and a house on a hillside to the right. Printed caption text in red is at the bottom center, and a small number appears at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestone square with a few children and pedestrians scattered across it. On the left stands a three‑storey historicist building with a steep tiled roof and ornate windows, likely a municipal or school building. In the center background is a larger, more industrial‑looking multi‑storey block with chimneys emitting smoke. On the right is a long, low row of older houses with shops at street level; signs above two entrances are visible. The architecture suggests a Central European town square in the early 20th century.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a drawing/engraving of a hilltop city with large stone buildings and fortifications on a bluff, a gate and bridge in the foreground, carriages and soldiers on the road, and handwritten greetings along the bottom margin. German captions are printed at the lower left and right edges.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large neoclassical building with a central domed tower and two long wings with red roofs, labeled as a museum. The building faces an expansive open square or parade ground where small figures of people stroll. The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and low hills and trees are visible in the distance. The words "Zwickau." and "Museum." appear at the top.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the interior of a grand glass-and-iron spa hall with tall arched windows and ornate decoration. In the center stands a large classical statue above a spring opening, around which workers—mostly women in aprons—are filling bottles and crates with mineral water. On the right, there is printed red German text describing the scene and publisher information at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an inner castle courtyard lined with multi‑storey buildings with steep gabled roofs and small windows. Ivy climbs the facades on the right; at the back a round tower and another high building with a pointed roof and finial rise above the courtyard. Two small figures walk along the path in the middle distance. Printed text at the top left identifies the scene.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly, partly terraced landscape with vineyards and scattered villas. In the foreground are residential houses and bare winter trees; on the hilltop stands a larger building complex identified as the restaurant "Wilhelms-Höhe." On the far right a tall tower-like structure is visible. The bottom margin contains printed German text in red and publisher information.

A vintage beige postcard with printed text and handwritten address. The top reads "POSTKAART — CARTE POSTALE." It bears a green 5-senti Estonian postage stamp with a portrait and is postmarked "TARTU EESTI" dated 24.I.1937. The left side has printed sender information for Johann Toming in Tartu, including address and telephone number. The right side has handwritten recipient information addressed to a woman in Haapsalu, with a street address.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view of ornate multi‑story buildings along a river or canal, with hills rising steeply behind them. People walk on the promenade and a horse‑drawn carriage passes in the foreground. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European. At the top left in red print is the caption "Karlsbad. Kreuzstraße." Various shop signs in German, including a bank and other businesses, are visible on the façades.

A vintage postcard view of an urban square with cobblestone streets and people in early 20th‑century clothing walking and standing around. Multi‑storey stone buildings frame the scene, with a prominent, lighter‑colored building in the background. The style is monochrome with light color tinting. Printed captions in Swedish identify the location and publisher, and there is a museum credit strip at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a park. The fountain has multiple tiers with classical statues: three draped female figures stand below the upper basin, while several seated or kneeling figures and putti surround the lower basin. Strong water jets arc outward in a ring. Trees and gentle hills form the background, with a church or tower visible in the distance. At the top left is printed German text identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a Renaissance-style painted portrait of a solemn man in three-quarter view, wearing dark clerical clothing and a white collar against a plain light background. The image is tightly cropped around the head and upper torso, with a simple black border framing the card.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval hilltop castle surrounded by dense forest. The multi‑story stone fortress has steep gabled roofs, turrets, and a central tower. At the bottom left of the image there is a printed caption identifying the site. The photo has a white border typical of vintage postcards.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a close-up of a woman and a man about to kiss or kissing, holding each other's faces affectionately. The clothing and hairstyle suggest early 20th century European fashion. There is cursive handwriting along the right edge and at the bottom left of the image, where a location and date seem to be written.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town surrounded by rolling fields and distant hills. The foreground shows harvested farmland with stooks of grain and a few trees, while the middle ground contains a compact town with houses, several factory chimneys, and a church tower rising above the rooftops. At the bottom-left corner, the caption "PULSNITZ i/Sa." is printed, indicating the name of the town.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large cobblestoned square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with arcades at ground level. In the background, a church tower rises above the rooftops. On the right side stands a large baroque fountain with statuary. A few pedestrians and a cyclist cross the nearly empty square. A handwritten-style caption along the bottom white margin identifies the square.

Sepia-toned divided image postcard showing two residential buildings partly obscured by trees. The left image depicts a two-story house with a steep tiled roof and a small flagpole; the right image shows a larger three-story brick building with shutters and a balcony. Below the images is printed caption text identifying the location.

A monochrome postcard showing a rustic wooden hut in a forest. The building has a shingled roof, a small balcony with carved wooden railing, exterior stairs, and is surrounded by tall trees. In the foreground there is a stone or wooden post and a trough beside a path and stairway leading up to the house. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white view of a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river. The bridge has a prominent central arch with vertical supports and lower approach spans on either side. In the foreground there is a riverside embankment and some moored boats or barges. At the lower left corner, white printed text reads "De nieuwe Waalbrug". The overall style resembles an early– to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a busy harbor with piers lined by warehouses and port buildings, several steamships and sailing vessels in the water, and a lighthouse in the distance. Printed caption at the top reads "No. 39. Port Said - Port" and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a bell tower with an onion-shaped dome rising above trees on a landscaped hill. A curving path leads toward the tower, and several people in old-fashioned clothing stroll or stand on the grass in the foreground. The printed red caption at the top identifies the scene as a bell tower on the Schlossberg in Graz.

Black‑and‑white night view of a modernist two‑storey seaside building with terraces, likely a yacht or sailing club. Numerous people sit on chairs and tables on the quay and upper terrace, suggesting a social event by the waterfront. Greek text is printed along the bottom border, and a website watermark appears across the lower right of the image.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant dining room with arched openings, long tables covered with white tablecloths, and rows of wooden chairs. Decorative light fixtures hang from the ceiling, and there is an ornate tiled stove or cabinet with painted panels on the right side. The word "Speisezimmer" (German for dining room) is printed in the lower right corner, indicating this is likely a formal restaurant or hotel dining hall.

Black‑and‑white photographic portrait of an African woman wearing a patterned headscarf and a fringed, embroidered shawl over her clothing. She faces the camera and smiles slightly. At the bottom of the image there is small printed text, likely the title and publisher's code, and a separate small number in a white box at the lower right corner that appears to be a catalog or series number.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a semi-rural hillside area with terraced slopes covered in vineyards or fields. A prominent baroque-style church or monastery with twin towers and a dome stands on top of the hill to the left. Below are orchards with rows of small trees, a walled complex of buildings, and a straight paved road with early streetlights, where a few pedestrians walk. On the right are two multi‑storey masonry houses along the road. Handwritten numeric markings appear along the left edge of the image, suggesting a catalog or postcard notation.

A multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard showing various landmarks of Budapest. The images include the Fisherman's Bastion, Gellért Hill with the Gellért monument and colonnade, the Castle Garden Bazaar and a monument, Matthias Church and its stairs, several bridges over the Danube such as Margaret Bridge and Franz Joseph Bridge, and an equestrian statue. Captions are printed in German and Hungarian Gothic-style script under each vignette.

Sepia photograph showing a historic European bridge with statues and a tall Gothic tower at its entrance. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the bridge and a horse‑drawn cart is visible. In the background, a large castle complex and cathedral dominate the hill above the city. Below the image are captions in three languages.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a studio scene of four people in traditional dress labeled as Jewish costumes from Salonica: three women wearing long dresses, aprons, and headscarves stand around a seated man in Ottoman-style attire with a fez. The photo is bordered by a printed caption in French at the bottom and publisher credit along the left edge. The right half of the card is densely filled with handwritten text in Greek, including a date in 1904.

A monochrome postcard showing a large multi‑arched stone railway viaduct spanning a valley surrounded by forested hills. The structure has tall piers with horizontal banding and round openings above each main arch. In the foreground is a rural scene with fields, trees, and a small signpost. Red printed lettering at the top right reads "Viadukt bei Hetzdorf."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a crowded river ferry in the foreground carrying many people across a wide river. On the opposite bank there is a sloping shore with paths, small wooden structures and a long pavilion-like building with a distinctive roof and spire, backed by dense forest on a hill. There is red-printed caption text at the bottom and extensive handwritten message text in dark ink along the right side and bottom.

A colorized historic postcard view of an elegant pavilion-like building in a landscaped park. The structure has two prominent corner towers with spires, arched windows and doorways, and decorative rooflines, with paths and lawns in the foreground. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink. Red printed captions appear at the top left and right of the image.

Vintage sepia-toned illustrated postcard showing views from Graz. The main image depicts a tall, multi-story tower with an onion-shaped dome set among trees and hills. Below it is an arched stone structure resembling old fortifications or ruins, with people walking along a path. In a smaller circular vignette on the right, there is an ornate iron pavilion or bandstand with a domed roof in a park, surrounded by trees and figures in late 19th‑century clothing. Decorative lettering at the top right reads "Gruss aus Graz." Publisher and printer information is printed along the lower edges.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century restaurant or café. The room has round tables covered with white tablecloths, wooden chairs, a large tiled fireplace with a decorative relief and vase of flowers on the mantel, wood‑paneled lower walls, and wall sconces. A prominent circular chandelier with shields or coat‑of‑arms motifs hangs from the ceiling. In the background, a second dining room is visible through an open partition, also with chandeliers and set tables. At the very top edge there is a handwritten note.

The image shows the back side of an old French postcard with handwritten cursive text in French covering most of the surface. Printed elements include the vertical words "CARTE POSTALE" on the right, typical dividing lines for correspondence and address, and a printer's mark mentioning "LEVASSEUR, LEVALLOIS‑PERRET". A date that appears to be 1916 is written at the top, and the card has no visible picture side in this image.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a European riverside city. In the foreground a wide river is crossed by two adjacent bridges: an older stone-arch bridge and a newer steel-girder bridge on concrete piers. A long river barge steams upstream, and densely packed houses line the opposite bank. On the hill above stands a large fortified palace complex with multiple towers and steep roofs; one tall structure is surrounded by scaffolding. A church with a pointed spire is visible nearby. The scene suggests an old town with a castle overlooking the river and bridges.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad urban avenue with horse‑drawn carriages and an early electric or cable streetcar running on tracks down the center. Multi‑story Victorian and late‑19th‑century commercial buildings line both sides of the street; one corner building in the mid‑ground has ornate bay windows and a balustraded roof. Numerous telegraph or power poles with overhead wires run along the sidewalks and across the street. There is a faint border around the picture suggesting a printed postcard or mounted photograph. Some very small, upside‑down writing appears at the bottom edge of the card.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an outdoor café terrace shaded by large trees. On the left, a building heavily covered in climbing plants borders the terrace, where flower boxes line a wooden railing. Several men in dark suits and hats, some with bow ties and one in a white waiter's jacket, stand or walk along the tree‑lined path. On the right are many empty tables and chairs stretching into the distance beside a riverside or park setting. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as a café in Graz.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing an industrial complex in a rural, forested landscape. Several factory buildings with tall brick chimneys stand near piles of timber and rough ground in the foreground. Smaller wooden houses and outbuildings are scattered around the site, with dense forest and low hills in the distant background. The word "Klevfoss" is printed in simple type near the upper left of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet small‑town street with people pushing handcarts along a cobbled road. On the left corner stands a two‑storey building with signs for a business named "Moritz Henker" and the establishment "Zur Börse"; another painted sign partially visible reads "Bäckerei" on an adjacent wall. Traditional half‑timbered houses, telegraph poles, and a large ornate streetlamp line the road, which recedes toward a church‑like building in the background.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard divided into two photographs. The upper image shows a rural landscape with fields, haystacks, fences and a small village with several houses and a church set against wooded hills. The lower image depicts a Marian grotto or shrine set into a rocky hillside, with a statue of the Virgin Mary in a niche and a fenced entrance gate labeled "MARIA-QUELL"; several women or girls in light dresses stand near the gate. In the center between the two images is printed text identifying the place as Ulrichsbrunn near Graz.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a sculptural relief with multiple draped human figures forming part of a large monument base. The image focuses on the detailed statues, likely allegorical figures, arranged around a pedestal. The front includes printed Italian captions and a photographer credit on the left margin, with a small handwritten signature near the bottom.

A vintage, sepia-toned landscape view showing gently rolling, terraced fields and farmland with hedgerows, a road in the mid‑ground, and a few scattered farm buildings or houses on the hills. Dense shrubs and trees occupy the foreground. In the lower left corner there is a small printed caption with the place name.

Colorized panoramic view over a lakeside area with rowboats in the foreground and a grand historic building with red roofs and turrets on the shore. Behind it stretches a hilly cityscape with many houses, churches, and green hills in the distance. At the top left is printed red text in German: "Graz. Hilmteich aus der Vogelschau."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural riverside village scene. A grassy bank and a small waterway or canal run along the left and foreground, with a simple bridge and railings crossing a sluice or weir. Several people stand or walk on the path by the water. In the background are clustered village houses, farm buildings, and leafless trees, with low hills and fields beyond. Printed red German text appears at the top left of the image area.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tranquil garden lake with a small pavilion on an islet topped by a tall palm tree. Ducks or swans swim in the water, there is a bridge on the left, and dense trees in the background. In the foreground on the right stands a young girl by the water's edge. The caption at the bottom reads "ALEXANDRIA. - In the Nouzha Garden." and there is a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" across the lower right portion.

A colorized postcard view of a large neo-Gothic country house and grounds identified as Margam Castle. The image shows stone walls, battlements, towers, and a central gatehouse with ornate windows and turrets. At the bottom is a printed caption strip with the place name.

A black-and-white postcard showing the front facade of a large brick Roman Catholic church in neo‑Romanesque style. The church has a central tall, steep roof flanked by two tower-like structures with pointed roofs and belfry openings. A large circular window and several arched windows dominate the upper facade. In the foreground there is an iron fence with stone pillars topped by statues or crosses, and a wide paved approach. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Vintage sepia postcard with two landscape photographs. The upper image shows a pond or small lake with sandy banks, surrounded by forest and fields, with a small bridge visible in the distance; it is labeled "Grödener Teich." The lower image is a panoramic view over the rooftops of a rural village set in flat countryside; this view is labeled "Totalansicht." At the bottom of the card, the location is printed as "Gröden, Kreis Liebenwerda." The layout and typography resemble early‑20th‑century German postcards.

Black‑and‑white divided-view postcard showing two separate wooden buildings. The left image depicts a large Protestant-style church with a tall square tower topped by a steep spire and finial, louvered belfry openings, and a broad gabled nave; there is a raised entrance with steps and a porch, and stained-glass windows visible in the entry. The right image shows a substantial three-story institutional building, likely a school or town hall, with a prominent corner turret capped by a conical roof and finial, symmetrical facade, central stairway leading to a porch with pediment, and many tall sash windows. Both structures sit in lightly developed surroundings with grass and a few trees. The card margins are wide and white, with some retouching or paint obscuring the bottom edge. At the very bottom edge, upside down, there is a handwritten number and a brief word.

Black‑and‑white old German postcard back side with the printed word "Postkarte" at the top, addressed in cursive handwriting to "Herrn Walter Pagel" in Berlin. It bears a 5‑pfennig German stamp with a cancellation mark dated 18.2.07 and multiple round postmarks, one reading "BERLIN". Parts of the address are obscured by torn labels or tape remnants.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town framed by hills. In the foreground is a broad river with a stone embankment; a man in dark clothes stands near a small structure with a red-tiled roof. Across the river are trees, a small church-like building, and several larger houses or public buildings ascending a road toward the hills. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene in Romanian.

Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a guardhouse in front of a brick military building with arched openings. Several uniformed soldiers wearing spiked Pickelhaube helmets stand behind an iron fence and at a striped sentry box. At the bottom there is printed red text identifying the scene and the publisher.

Black-and-white postcard view of a cobblestoned square with a historic gabled building labeled "Ratskeller" (a town hall cellar restaurant). A statue of a man in a long coat stands on a pedestal in the foreground. Surrounding are multi-story town buildings with traditional German architectural elements. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Ratskeller in Pulsnitz with the Rietschel monument.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with a broad weir or small dam in the foreground. On the left bank stands a large, ornate multi‑storey building with steep roofs and dormer windows, reflected in the calm water. Dense trees line the riverbank, and further in the background a church spire rises above lower buildings. In the upper left corner there is printed German text identifying the location as Grimma in Saxony and mentioning a royal administrative district.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded street parade in a European city. Spectators in early‑20th‑century dress line both sides of a cobblestone street in front of tall townhouses with arched window shutters. A large decorated float drawn by two horses moves through the street; it is covered with drapery and carries several costumed figures, including a woman in white and another high on a platform. A banner on the float reads something similar to "Carnaval N E V???s Don." The angle and framing are typical of a commercial postcard photograph.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a cobblestoned road with tram tracks running down the center. Lined with multi‑story buildings hosting shops and awnings on both sides, the street is busy with pedestrians, a dog, and a few early vehicles or carts. German shop signs are visible on the left and right façades. At the top, printed caption text reads 'Meissen.' on the left and 'Vordere Neugasse' on the right, with a handwritten red number '17816' between them.

Color postcard view of a large boulder emerging from a lake or coastal water at sunset, with a small human figure seated on the rock. The calm water fills the foreground, while in the distant background a low shoreline with factory chimneys and buildings is visible under a pastel sky. Short printed captions appear in the upper left, upper right, and along the left edge.

A vintage sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a formally dressed man in a tuxedo with white bow tie and waistcoat, posed against a plain dark studio background. The lower margin of the image shows a small serial number and a photographer's mark, while the card's caption area below the photo bears the printed name 'Harry Liedtke'. At the very bottom left it notes the publisher and location in small print.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a museum exhibition hall showing rows of old horse‑drawn carriages and sleds on a wooden floor. Along the wall to the left are neatly arranged farming and household tools such as pitchforks, rakes, saws, and harnesses. Light enters through large windows at the back. White caption text is printed at the bottom edge of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a park area with a pavilion-like building in the foreground and the dense historic townscape with church towers in the background. The caption in red German script at the top identifies the scene as a view of the lower town of Freiberg with the Teichwiese and the school museum.

A sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a small group of people in formal late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing standing and playing by a shallow rocky stream in a wooded rural valley. In the foreground, a woman in a long dark dress and elaborate hat stands on a rock by the water, while a man in a long overcoat and cap stands slightly behind her. Farther upstream, two children are near the water's edge and another adult or older child crouches by the bank. Leafless shrubs and dense trees fill the background; a dirt road and simple wooden utility or telegraph poles can be seen higher up the slope. The image has the borders, tone, and composition typical of an early photographic postcard, but no visible caption or printed text on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall, narrow rock formation standing in a forest clearing. A man in early 20th‑century attire stands beside the rock for scale. The image is framed by a cream border with red German text printed above, below, and along the left edge.

Black-and-white vintage view over a small European spa town in a valley surrounded by hills and fields. In the foreground stands a large multi-storey bath or sanatorium building with a clock on its facade, surrounded by smaller houses with steep roofs. Further back, more residential buildings spread up the hillside, and on the distant hilltop to the right a prominent church tower dominates the skyline. The lower margin of the image includes a printed caption identifying the place.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large multi‑storey masonry building with a steep metal roof and a tall corner tower topped by a spire. A smaller domed pavilion stands by the street entrance. The building is surrounded by a wooden picket fence and leafless trees, suggesting late autumn or winter. There are telegraph poles and wires along the street. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, multi‑storey early 20th‑century building on a street corner. The house has steep, tiled roofs, dormer windows, and smooth plaster façades with many tall rectangular and some oval windows. A decorative entrance with a curved pediment faces the street. Below one window is a signboard above a doorway, and a small two‑wheeled cart stands nearby. The overall scene is urban and appears to depict a public or commercial building.

Colorized vintage view of a broad tree-lined promenade with people walking and a street sweeper in the foreground. At the left stands a large statue on a pedestal in front of a mountain backdrop. Decorative street lamps and a fountain or monument appear further down the avenue. The scene is tranquil and framed by tall trees under a partly cloudy sky. The upper left corner bears a printed caption.

Color photograph postcard showing a historic clock tower and loggia at the end of a narrow stone street lined with older buildings. People are walking and standing in the street. The reverse side has a green 15-value stamp, a circular postmark, handwritten text in a South Slavic (Croatian/Serbian) Latin script, and printed postcard layout details.

A monochrome postcard with a large blank margin below a printed reproduction of a religious painting. The image shows the Crucifixion of Jesus: Christ on the cross in the center, a kneeling or collapsed figure at the foot of the cross, and an angelic female figure to the right holding a chalice or vessel to catch the blood from Jesus' side. The background includes a stylized landscape or city. The print is worn and textured, and there is no visible caption or writing on the front.

Sepia-toned pastoral view of a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground a child wearing a hat tends a grazing sheep on a sloping meadow. In the background, on top of a wooded hill, stands a prominent church-like building with a dome and tower. The bottom border bears an Italian caption reading "Motivo in Montagnaga di Pinè."

Vintage illustrated postcard featuring a large pansy flower. In each petal there is a small inset black‑and‑white photograph of different views of the city, and at the top center is a portrait of a smiling woman with an elaborate hairstyle. The background is plain, and at the bottom right is French text reading "Souvenir de Salonique." Additional small captions in French label the views, such as a white tower, quays and boulevards.

Illustrated postcard showing two German soldiers in blue uniforms with pickelhaube helmets shaking hands in the foreground, one holding an Imperial German flag. Behind them are inset black‑and‑white photographs: one of a building with towers and another panoramic view of a riverside cityscape with church spires. Decorative foliage frames the images. The greeting text on the right reads "Gruss aus Lübeck." A small red number "No 1225." is printed at the bottom.

A vintage illustrated postcard depicting a uniformed mailman holding a letter in his right hand and resting his left hand on what appears to be a mailbag or parcel. He wears a dark cap and coat with brass buttons. The background is a plain light color. The word 'Tervehdys' is printed in red in the upper right, and the word 'Hämeenlinnasta' appears in white on the dark mailbag across the lower center.

Color postcard view of a richly decorated Baroque pavilion and surrounding courtyard. The central building has large arched windows, elaborate sculptures and reliefs, and a mansard-style roof. Curved colonnades extend from both sides, enclosing an oval forecourt with terraced steps and rows of benches, suggesting it may be used as an open‑air venue. Trees form a green backdrop behind the ornate stone architecture. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.

A black-and-white panoramic photograph of a historic European city surrounded by mountains. The dense old town with church towers, civic towers, and compact buildings fills the valley floor. A river and railway infrastructure appear in the foreground. At the bottom center, printed text identifies the view as a panorama of Trento.

A monochrome postcard view through a vaulted archway with a hanging lantern. Beyond the arch lies an historic courtyard framed by old stone buildings and a prominent domed church with baroque-style towers. The composition focuses on the play of light and shadow in the passageway. Printed captions appear along the bottom border.

Vintage sepia postcard with three photographs of villagers, mostly women in traditional dress, gathering water at a domed stone well and around stone walls. The images are captioned in French and numbered. The right side of the card has printed location information indicating Greece and Corfu.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, a sloping lawn with fences and rows of trees in the middle, and behind them a richly decorated Orthodox church with multiple onion domes and crosses. Surrounding the church are grand late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century apartment and villa buildings with eclectic and half‑timbered façades. A small signboard stands by the path near the right side of the image.

Sepia-toned street scene showing a wide, tree-lined road with multi‑story residential or institutional buildings on the left and a park‑like line of trees on the right. In the foreground is a corner building with arched entrance steps and a coat of arms relief on the wall. A woman and a child walk along the sidewalk. The caption at the top reads "Grimma — Schroederstrasse," indicating the view is of Schroederstrasse in Grimma.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a large urban square surrounded by multi‑story neoclassical buildings. The square is busy with many people walking and congregating, early automobiles and trams, and formal garden plantings. Mountains are faintly visible in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French appear at the bottom margin, along with a website watermark.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a narrow rocky gorge with water rushing through and plunging in a waterfall. Above the gorge spans a stone arch bridge with a simple fence or railing along the top. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads "Polhems sluss. Trollhättan."

Black‑and‑white view of an old European market square bordered by ornate, multi‑story townhouses with arcades at street level. There is a small tower with a cupola on one of the buildings. Horse‑drawn carts and a few pedestrians are visible on a cobblestone square. Shop signs are visible on the facades, and a caption is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a formal garden with flowerbeds and a straight path leading toward a large, elegant building in the background. The structure is a French Second Empire–style mansion or palace with a mansard roof and a tall central clock tower. Trees and ornamental shrubs frame the garden, and the image has a grainy, early color-printing look with a white border.

Colorized vintage view of a river with green banks and a path in the foreground. Across the river lies a low settlement and, prominently on the horizon, a large domed building with a tall minaret, suggesting a mosque. Trees surround the buildings. Greek text is printed at the top, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned landscape view over a wooded coastal inlet with scattered houses and piers along the shoreline. Conifer trees frame the foreground, while rocky, forested hills surround the water in the distance. The scene has an early 20th‑century photographic style, and the caption 'Gustafsberg' appears in the upper left corner.

Black-and-white postcard view of a mountain valley town with densely packed traditional alpine houses, several church towers, and surrounding fields and forests. High wooded mountains rise in the background. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed text identifying the location and a small numeric code.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo steamship sailing on a calm waterway. The vessel has a single funnel with the letters "KIA" on it and a tall superstructure amidships. The ship's name "MARIENBURG" is visible on the bow or stern area. Reeds are visible in the foreground along the shore; the background is mostly empty sky and faint horizon. The image has the framing and style of a vintage maritime postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large, elegant multi‑storey hotel complex labeled "Hôtel Trento," set against mountainous scenery. The buildings form a U‑shaped frontage with many windows, balconies, arcades, and an entrance courtyard. Trees occupy the left foreground, and mountains dominate the hazy background. Printed captions in red identify the location and hotel. A handwritten message in Italian appears across the bottom.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large Baroque water castle with round corner towers and a chapel-like wing, reflected in a surrounding pond or moat. Trees and a promenade line the water and several small figures walk along the path. The sky is cloudy and the card has the typical white, slightly deckled border of mid‑20th‑century postcards. At the bottom, a German caption identifies the site as a Baroque castle near Dresden.

A black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a romantic landscape along a river. In the center background rises a dramatic line of steep, jagged rock formations covered with scattered trees, with dense forested hills behind them. On the left is a large riverside building with arched windows, possibly a hotel or Kurhaus, with promenading figures in 19th‑century clothing. At the lower left inset, several rowboats are moored at the riverbank as elegantly dressed people board or disembark. On the right, a curving path follows the river through tall conifers while a small boat with passengers moves along the water. Handwritten captions run faintly along the top margin, and at the lower left the artist's signature and a place name are visible.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with sailing boats moored on the Nile, tall masts and rigging in the foreground, a bridge or embankment in the background, and several people standing near palm trees and a stone wall on the left. The main printed caption in French identifies the view as being in Cairo on the Nile. There is also a circular logo and a website watermark from the Greek ELIA archive.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a Baroque church and adjacent ornate buildings lining a cobbled street with tram tracks. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. At the bottom, printed captions identify the view as in Graz, depicting the Barmherzigen-Kirche and Café "Helm". A vertical imprint along the left edge gives the publisher information from Graz.

Black-and-white postcard view of a lakeside town with traditional steep‑roofed buildings in the foreground and a tall clock tower with a pointed spire rising behind them. The scene is taken from the water, with mooring posts visible along the quay. The architecture is central European, and handwritten captions appear in German at the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white/sepia panoramic view over a valley town surrounded by rolling hills. In the foreground are trees framing the scene; below runs a river and a railway line with tracks curving along the valley. Industrial chimneys and factory buildings occupy the lower right, while the middle distance shows a dense cluster of houses and several taller towers or church steeples. The town extends up the hillside. At the top right in red Gothic-style script is the caption identifying the location and viewpoint.

Black‑and‑white view along a straight, slightly sloping residential street lined with 3‑ to 4‑storey townhouses. On the left foreground is a more ornate late‑19th‑century building with bay windows and floral decorations; on its corner a shop sign reads "Artur Modes. Korbwaren-Geschäft. Sport- und Kinderwagen-Lager." Several women, children and a man stand or walk on the sidewalks and in the street. At the far end stands a larger institutional building closing the perspective. The architecture is typical Central European, with steep slate roofs and dormer windows.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large military or scout-style encampment in an open field near a river or lakeshore, with rows of white tents, many uniformed people, and a few horses. Trees line the background. The image is framed by a white border with printed captions in red at the bottom and left side, and handwritten text in dark ink across the lower margin.

Old monochrome postcard showing a large, elegant late‑19th‑century or early‑20th‑century pavilion-style building in a landscaped park. The structure has a central domed section with arched windows and two smaller domed corner pavilions connected by long glass-fronted galleries. In the foreground there are paths, benches and a few people sitting or standing in the garden. The architecture suggests a spa or bath pavilion in Central or Eastern Europe. A small, faint word appears above the central arches on the building's façade.

Colorized historic postcard view of the main entrance gate to a military barracks complex. The scene shows a large arched gateway with the inscription "Jäger-Kaserne" above it, flanked by multi‑story barracks buildings with red-tiled roofs and many windows. A uniformed guard stands in front of the gate, and iron railings enclose the entrance. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, typical of early 20th‑century color postcards. The caption at the top identifies the location in red script.

Colorized vintage view of a river scene with small boats and houseboats moored along grassy banks lined with trees. In the background a large metal bridge spans a wide river. The caption in red text at the upper right reads "NIJMEGEN Gezicht op de Waal," indicating a view of the River Waal at Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a large four‑masted sailing ship moored along a riverfront or harbor promenade. Smaller boats are tied nearby. Behind the quay is a tree‑lined park and a low‑rise town with detached houses and a few institutional buildings. Several mid‑20th‑century cars are visible near the waterfront. The overall look suggests a historic tall ship preserved at a city waterfront. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard featuring a stone funerary monument showing a large sculpted bull standing on a rectangular base. The bull is depicted in profile, walking, on top of what appears to be a grave monument. Beneath the image there is printed bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the subject as a tomb with a bull in Athens. Postal marks and some handwriting are visible on the right side, and there is a small publisher's mark and number at the bottom.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a busy European city street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. A wide avenue leads into the distance with small figures walking and a few early street fixtures visible. On the right stands a large Baroque church tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock, attached to a steep-roofed building. On the left are richly decorated facades with cupolas and multiple slender spires. Trees and people in period clothing occupy the foreground. A handwritten note with a date appears at the top edge.

Hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a landscaped park path with dense greenery and small pavilions or gazebos. A woman in a long red dress stands near a wooden pavilion with a conical roof. The foreground shows a sandy path bordered by low wooden posts and rope. The caption text in German is printed along the bottom margin, along with the publisher's information.

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a wide panoramic view over forested hills, patchwork agricultural fields, and a village in a valley. In the foreground are dense coniferous woods, with rolling hills and farmland stretching into the distance under a hazy sky. Printed white text in German appears at the bottom margin of the image.

Black-and-white postcard showing a tall white wooden church with a steep spire topped by a cross, partly framed by leafy trees and a grassy foreground with a simple wooden fence. At the bottom of the image, there is printed caption text identifying the place and a small number in the corner.

Black‑and‑white image showing a modernist multi‑storey hospital complex surrounded by conifer trees. Several large rectangular buildings with many identical windows and balconies dominate the scene; scaffolding is visible on one wing, suggesting ongoing construction or extension. In the foreground is a smaller building with a pitched roof. White printed captions in Swedish appear in two corners of the image.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene along a narrow canal or stream. On the right, several plastered townhouses with tiled roofs line a cobbled sidewalk protected by a simple metal railing. A signboard reading "Ernst Müller" hangs from one building, and lettering on the shop window is in German. People in early 20th‑century clothing—women in long dresses and aprons, men in hats, and several children—walk along the path and stand on a small iron bridge crossing the water. In the distance more gabled houses close the view, creating a typical small‑town Central European atmosphere.

Colorized postcard view of a large waterfront palace with white façades and green domes, seen from across the sea under a clear sky. At the top it is labeled in French "ALEXANDRIE - Le Palais Ras-el-Tin." A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears near the bottom over the water.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade with people walking and small boats along the shore. A large round tower with crenellations stands prominently beside the water. The card has printed captions in French at the bottom and a publisher credit on the left.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a stone stairway leading down through trees to a small brick arch bridge or viaduct in a landscaped park. Above the arch is a balustraded brick wall with decorative openings, and dense foliage surrounds the path. At the far end of the archway, a person stands near a gate. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned vintage view from a hillside terrace overlooking a city. On the left stands a distinctive medieval clock tower with a large round clock face and steep, shingled roof, partially obscured by a leafy tree in the foreground. A path and low stone wall run along the viewpoint, with the cityscape spreading out in the background on a plain below.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a garden in the foreground and several large early‑20th‑century villas or sanatorium-style houses in the background, one with a small dome and cross suggesting a chapel. Trees surround the buildings. Printed white caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white image of an ornate late‑19th‑century villa or small palace in landscaped gardens, backed by a forested hillside. The building has a tall central tower with steep, decorative roof and weather vane, timber‑framed upper level, balconies, and elaborate roof finials. People stand near the entrance. The overall look is of a grand spa or resort hotel photographed from the garden.

Colorized view of a mountain village in a valley, with alpine houses, a small stream in the foreground, terraced fields on the slopes, and dramatic rocky peaks of the Dolomites in the background. A church tower is visible among the houses. The caption at the top reads in red script: "Campitello (1442 m) Fassa. Tirol."

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with curving paths, benches, manicured shrubs and tall trees. A decorative street lamp stands near the path in the foreground. Rising above the trees in the background is an ornate historic tower with a domed, pinnacled roof. The sky is lightly clouded. Printed German text appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square with children and adults in early‑20th‑century clothing, a horse‑drawn wagon, and small market stalls with umbrellas in the foreground. The square is surrounded by three‑ to four‑story historicist townhouses with shops on the ground floor. In the background are wooded hills with scattered buildings and a church tower. A corner building at right carries shop signage in German, including the name "Paul Wachsm…".

A black‑and‑white image showing a long brick building with steep tiled roofs and several tower-like corner pavilions. The façade is covered partly with ivy and lined with small balconies and fabric window awnings. A single early- to mid‑20th‑century automobile is parked along the gently sloping street in front. The sky is filled with large, dramatic clouds, giving the scene a composed, almost promotional feel, as in an architectural postcard.

Black‑and‑white image showing a long line of soldiers in old-style uniforms lying or kneeling along a sandy embankment in a wooded area, aiming bolt‑action rifles up the slope as if in a training or combat scenario. They wear peaked caps with prominent brims and backpacks with rolled blankets or greatcoats attached. No printed caption or other visible text appears on the image side.

Black-and-white historic street view of a small European town with cobblestone streets and two-story buildings lining an intersection. Shops with large windows and Swedish signage are visible on both sides, along with old-style gasoline pumps, street lamps, and overhead utility wires. In the far distance there is a church tower or similar structure. The bottom caption reads "Vetlanda. Vitalagatan." and the publisher credit appears at the lower right.

Black-and-white view of a modernist European town square with a tall clock‑ or bell‑tower on the left bearing a large statue at its base, a curved corner apartment block with balconies on the right, and mountains with snow in the background. Pedestrians, bicycles, and early-to-mid 20th‑century cars are visible. At the street corner there is a direction signpost with several Italian place names.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a large crowd gathered along a seaside promenade and railway line. On the right, train carriages stand on tracks running parallel to the waterfront, with the sea, small boats, and a pier with masts and ships in the distance. On the left, multi‑story buildings line the street. The scene depicts a festive or ceremonial event with dense crowds filling the street. Printed text in Greek and French at the top identifies the scene as being in Patras and referring to shooting games or competitions. A website watermark appears at the bottom.

Color postcard showing an equestrian bronze statue on a high marble pedestal in an urban square, with a multi‑story neoclassical building in the background. Low greenery and a decorative fence surround the monument. Printed caption text appears at the bottom edge of the image.

Black-and-white postcard view over a forested mountain valley with a small town or village nestled among dense conifer woods. In the foreground are several alpine-style buildings and guesthouses; in the distance, more scattered houses and a church-like structure appear. Handwritten-style German text runs along the bottom margin.

Colorized illustration showing a riverside cityscape with a bridge over a wide river in the foreground, a hill densely covered with trees and crowned by fortifications and towers in the middle, and distant mountains under a pastel sky. Historic multi‑story buildings line the riverbank, and a prominent clock tower stands on the hillside. Printed text at the top left names the scene in German.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an old inner courtyard with medieval-style plastered buildings, a rounded corner tower, wooden stairs leading to a doorway, small windows, and a pitched tile roof. In the yard there is a cart and some scattered objects, with a chicken walking across the cobblestone ground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a slightly curved street lined with 2‑ to 3‑storey buildings, many with shop signs in German. People stand and walk along the sidewalks. In the distance, a tall baroque church tower rises above the roofs. The caption at the top reads "Großenhain — Meißner Straße".

Black-and-white panoramic view of an industrial complex surrounded by forested hills. Multiple factory buildings with tall chimneys dominate the foreground, with railway tracks and trains visible below. In the background are rocky cliffs and dense woods. Along the bottom edge, white printed text identifies the location and the factory.

Colorized vintage view of a large European town square surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with red and brown tiled roofs. In the middle of the square stands a monumental fountain or statue with multiple figures and steps, around which people stroll and small market stalls and café umbrellas are set up. In the background, on a wooded hill, a prominent clock tower rises above old fortification walls. The caption at the top left reads "Graz. Hauptplatz."
