Vintage sepia photograph of a grand neoclassical–baroque theatre building seen from the front-left corner, with ornate facades, arched windows, sculptures, and statues on the roof. A curved driveway and landscaped area lead up to the entrance. Decorative street lamps stand in the foreground. At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the building as the national theatre.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting the entrance courtyard of a brick school building behind an iron gate. Children and a few adults stand and play in the yard. On the left is a tall, ornate street lamp and bare tree branches. The architecture appears late‑19th or early‑20th century. Printed captions at the bottom identify the school and publisher in Dutch.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a quiet small town near a body of water. In the foreground is a long, one‑and‑a‑half‑storey wooden or brick house with a steep tiled roof, multiple chimneys and large rectangular windows. Dirt roads border the house, and across the road there is a small fenced park or garden densely planted with mature trees and a few paths. Behind this are more low houses partly obscured by trees, and in the distance a broad lake or river with low hills on the far shore. The image has a white border, light wear on the corners, and faint handwriting at the bottom edge that appears mirrored and is difficult to read.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of an ancient stone relief showing a bearded, helmeted figure in profile holding a goat or ibex over his shoulder. The figure wears a knee‑length garment and substantial boots, rendered in a distinct Near Eastern style. The relief is carved on a roughly rectangular stone slab, with visible cracks and a textured background. No printed caption or writing is visible on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large fortified complex on a riverside hill. A long rectangular building with many small windows sits on top of a high stone wall. Rising behind it is a tall Baroque-style church tower with an onion-shaped dome and slender spire. Trees and landscaped slopes descend toward a calm river in the foreground, with a small decorative wooden footbridge near the water. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide, busy boulevard lined with multi‑storey historic buildings and tram tracks. Crowds of people, several trams, and what appears to be a marching formation fill the street. In the foreground stands a monument with a sculpted figure on a pedestal. Church or clock towers rise in the background. The caption at the top reads "Dresden. Hauptstrasse." and a small imprint with publisher information appears near the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey hotel building with arched ground‑floor colonnade and balconies, partly hidden by tall trees. In the foreground is a street with tram or trolley wires above. Greek and English captions are printed along the bottom margin, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed on the image.

Colorized landscape view over a rural lakeside scene. In the foreground there are wooden farm buildings with tiled and thatched roofs surrounded by trees and fields. Beyond them lie flat green meadows, a line of trees, and a broad lake stretching across the image, with low hills and a partly cloudy blue sky in the distance. Red printed text appears in the top right and top left corners, and vertically along the left edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large open square bustling with pedestrians. Early 20th‑century multi‑storey buildings with balconies line the edges of the square. People in period clothing walk and gather across the plaza, with a few street fixtures visible. The caption at the bottom is printed in French and Greek, and there is also a website watermark across the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd in a stadium with stepped marble seating and a ceremonial entrance. Uniformed soldiers, dignitaries, and elegantly dressed spectators fill the scene. Text in Greek and French along the bottom identifies the event as the arrival of the King and Queen of Italy and Greece at the stadium in Athens.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone pavement. A tall clock tower with a bulbous spire and cross stands prominently to the left, attached to an older stone structure. In the background on a slightly higher elevation is a large building with multiple small towers, resembling a castle or palace. On the right side is a building with painted signage reading "Hôtel Stadt D…" and smaller German text below, indicating a hotel and restaurant. On the left is another building with shop fronts, one labeled "Möbel‑Magazin" and "Ernst Voigtländer & Söhne". A hanging sign in the foreground reads "Zum … Haus". A few people are visible walking in the open square and one man in a hat stands at the left edge.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small town square bordered by multi-story masonry houses with shuttered windows and garden walls, set against hilly or mountainous terrain. People, including children and adults, stand scattered across the open piazza in the foreground. The caption at the bottom margin reads "GALA VINO - Piazza."

A sepia-toned image shows a landscaped lawn with curved concrete walkways leading to a stucco building in a Mission/Spanish Revival style. The structure has arched colonnades, decorative curved gables, and two small domed bell-tower–like elements. Mature trees frame the scene. A red hand-written number "6727" appears at the bottom right of the image.

Vintage postcard showing a black‑and‑white photograph of a multi‑arched stone bridge spanning a river, with trees on both banks. The upper area includes several green Greek postage stamps postmarked in 1905. Along the bottom are printed captions in Greek, French, and English identifying the bridge, with extensive handwritten text in Greek filling the lower margin.

Illustrated postcard featuring a stylized stained‑glass-like figure of a woman in blue and gold, with a haloed Virgin Mary image embedded in her cloak. The left side shows a large decorative capital letter 'N' and the printed text 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' on a bluish patterned background with faint medieval-style script.

A monochrome postcard view of a river crossing with a ferry landing. In the foreground are cobblestones, railings, a horse-drawn cart, and several people near a small pier structure with posts and cables. Across the wide river a long metal bridge spans from left to right. The style is early 20th century. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as the ferry from Nijmegen to Lent and a small serial number appears in the lower left.

Historic postcard framed by a brown stone arch with a city coat of arms at the top left. Through the arch is a black‑and‑white view of a large neo‑Gothic parish church with a tall central spire and clock, located on a town square flanked by multi‑storey buildings with shops and people, carriages, and trees in front. There is printed multilingual text at the bottom left and center, and handwritten script across the lower part of the card with a date.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large rectangular castle with corner towers, partly hidden by trees and situated above a stream or small river in a valley. At the top in red lettering is the caption 'Castel Cles Val di Non.' Additional small red text appears at the bottom margin, likely a printer's line and date.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a crowd of people gathered outdoors in a rustic settlement with wooden houses and timber stacks. The image is framed by a printed caption in Greek and French at the bottom, while handwritten text in French covers the margins and top area. The scene appears to depict village life or workers assembled in front of simple buildings.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a white stone church with a tall, slender spire and clock tower. The church stands in a slightly elevated position, framed by leafless trees and conifers under a cloudy sky. At the bottom center of the image, a caption is printed in a script resembling Cyrillic characters.

A black‑and‑white winter scene showing a rustic wooden hut with a thatched or shingled roof beside a snowy country road. Bare trees surround the building, and a horse‑drawn cart with people or goods is visible in the foreground near a wooden fence and benches. Snow covers the ground and trees, giving a quiet rural atmosphere. The caption in white letters appears at the bottom left, and there is a small mark or letter in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white landscape view across a calm river or lake, framed by tall conifer trees in the foreground. On the left stands a wooden, likely dark‑painted house close to the water's edge. In the distance, on the opposite bank, there is an industrial complex with a very tall chimney stack and several low factory buildings surrounded by trees. The setting appears rural and heavily forested, with soft rolling terrain. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a hilly rural landscape with scattered villas and large houses on terraced slopes, bordered by forest. In the foreground are open fields; in the background, multiple multi‑storey houses with steep roofs line a gently rising hillside. At the bottom of the image, there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) postcard showing an urban street scene lined with ornate multi‑story historic buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and there is a wheelbarrow in the unpaved or partially paved street. At the top, printed in red, is the caption identifying the city and street.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a large tree and a stone monument in the center, surrounded by modest multi‑story buildings. One building on the right is a restaurant with large painted signage and a fenced garden in front. A man stands near the monument in the street. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Dippoldiswalde and specify Bismarckplatz and its monument.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a coastal town built on low hills beside the sea. Small, flat-roofed houses line the waterfront and rise up the slope, with a church featuring a dome and bell tower visible among them. The sea occupies the foreground, and the shoreline curves gently. Printed captions in Greek and French appear beneath the photograph.

Black‑and‑white image of a cobblestoned town square bordered by low historic buildings with gabled roofs. The left side shows a row of two‑story houses with shop signs; the right side has several large trees with benches or carts underneath. In the background, across the square, stand more houses with arcaded gateways and German‑language business signage. A church steeple rises behind the roofs. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century postcard photograph of a Central European market square.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a small stream or drainage ditch in the foreground and, beyond it, the ruins of several houses or farm buildings with collapsed walls and roofs. Leafless trees and scrub surround the scene, giving a bleak, war-damaged rural atmosphere. At the top center of the image, in small printed letters, is the caption 'Jouvincourt.'

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a colonnaded pavilion with large windows and a conical roof, set in a landscaped park with flowerbeds and a curved path. Trees rise behind the structure. Handwritten-style captions at the bottom read the name of the spa town and of the spring pavilion depicted.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a busy central square with market stalls, umbrellas, and people walking. Historic multi‑story buildings with shop signs line the square, and a statue stands on a pedestal in the middle. In the background, on a hill, a prominent clock tower rises above the town. The bottom margin of the card is printed with German text including the place name.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural scene titled in Spanish. It depicts a simple adobe or stone ranch house with a thatched or earthen roof, surrounded by a low stone wall. Illustrated postcard with a stylized black‑and‑white drawing of a woman overlaid on a richly colored medieval religious miniature that shows a crowned figure (likely Christ) surrounded by angels and saints. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small pavilion or gazebo with a domed roof topped by decorative elements, standing on a grassy area with tree stumps arranged around it. A black‑and‑white photo postcard showing a large military band posed in several rows, all wearing dark uniforms with high collars and shoulder straps. Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a relatively wide, tree‑lined street bordered by multi‑story masonry buildings with shop windows on the right and a fenced area with bare trees on the left. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd gathered in a town square in front of low neoclassical buildings and a decorated archway. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a school campus consisting of several wooden buildings around an open grassy area with trees and footpaths. Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and sidewalks. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate resort hotel set amid lush gardens with palm trees and winding paths. Black‑and‑white street scene in a small Northern European town. A vintage bus loaded with luggage and bicycles on the roof is turning onto a dirt road in the foreground. Colorized vintage view of a riverside promenade with a woman in traditional dress leaning on a wooden fence by a wide river. A sepia-toned historic postcard showing an ornate neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance castle complex on a wooded hillside. Black‑and‑white view of a small half‑timbered cottage with a tiled gable roof and four front windows decorated with lace curtains and flower boxes. A monochrome (black‑and‑white) postcard view of a pond or small lake in the foreground, bordered by grass and trees. A black‑and‑white view of a formal public garden or park with manicured hedges, rose beds, young trees on stakes, and wide gravel paths. Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ornate façade of a late‑19th‑century building with a large arched glass entrance and rich stucco decoration. A black‑and‑white photograph of a weathered stone statue of a robed cleric or saint holding a long rectangular object, likely a cross or plaque. Vintage Russian postal card with printed heading and imperial coat of arms on the left, addressed in cursive script. Black-and-white image showing the interior of an early 20th‑century industrial power plant or engine room. An old sepia-toned postcard view over a snow-covered town with churches and multi‑story buildings around an open square. Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic/Romanesque hilltop complex comprising a cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle-like palace and round tower, rising above a riverside town. Black-and-white postcard view of a grand historic opera house in neoclassical/Baroque style with a large central dome, ornate sculptures on the pediment and roof, and a columned portico. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph on the left side showing a canal lined with buildings and trees, a small stone bridge crossing the water, and a tall church tower with a spire (Notre‑Dame) rising in the background. Black‑and‑white photograph of a street parade featuring a marching brass band in traditional Balkan-style folk costumes (dark hats, vests, wide trousers and boots). A hand‑colored postcard view of a tree‑lined railway station platform with tracks in the foreground and a two‑storey station building at right. A black‑and‑white postcard‑style photograph showing two smiling women wearing similar cape-like garments and hats, sitting at a small desk in a cozy room. Colorized postcard view of a large hilltop castle surrounded by dense greenery. The multi‑story building has white walls, red gabled roofs, and green domed towers. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic river rapid or waterfall rushing between rocky cliffs, with mist rising from the water. Hand‑colored early 20th‑century postcard showing a forest path with a horse‑drawn carriage in the foreground leading toward a large stone monument topped with a cross. The scene is surrounded by tall trees under a softly colored sky. Printed captions in German appear at the bottom margin.

A colorized landscape view of a rural lakeside scene with wooden fences, small red farm buildings, and several wooden boats pulled up on the grassy shore. The lake is calm, bordered by green fields and forest in the background. At the top, printed text identifies the place and country.

A monochrome postcard showing a steep rocky cliff covered with shrubs and low vegetation. An old black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a substantial villa-like building with a steep tiled roof and curving gables, seen from the street behind an ornate metal fence and low wall. A colorized historic panoramic view of a dense district with long, rectangular barracks-like buildings featuring red-tiled roofs, set in a valley surrounded by hills or low mountains. A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Renaissance-style castle with multiple windows, ornate gables, and a prominent central tower topped with a spire. The structure appears old and weathered. The upper left contains German text printed directly on the image.
