A black-and-white postcard view of a historic fortified hill with stone walls, old buildings, and a tall church tower rising above trees and a park-like path in the foreground. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Tallinn and the Toompea hill, with text in Estonian and German.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of ancient stepped pyramids and platforms in a wide open archaeological site surrounded by low hills and distant mountains. The structures are stone ruins arranged around a central plaza. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center, and a small signature or name appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small stone lookout tower on a hill, partly surrounded by trees and shrubs. A dirt path leads up to the tower, with rocks scattered along the ground. A person is seated near the base of the tower. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a railway station building with arched openings and striped masonry, with a large train shed roof to the right. A few pedestrians and a cart are visible in the foreground. At the upper left is a French caption identifying the scene as the Cairo station in Alexandria. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned vintage waterfront scene showing a long wooden pier extending into a bay, with low-rise seaside buildings along the shore and hills in the background. At the top are printed titles in French (left) and Greek (right). A faint round seal appears on the lower left, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid at the bottom.

A monochrome/sepia postcard view of a long, ornate brick military barracks complex behind a tall fence and gate. The architecture is late‑19th‑century German style with gabled roofs, decorative brickwork, and tall chimneys. Two uniformed soldiers or guards stand at the entrance gate in the foreground. At the top, red printed text reads "2. K. S. Pionier-Bataillon No. 22. Kaserne."

Vintage sepia postcard showing a tall medieval city tower rising from a gateway at the edge of a town square. Surrounding the tower are low historic buildings and a larger neoclassical school building. People walk and ride horse-drawn carriages across the square. The captions in German at the top identify the scene as Bautzen with the Reichenturm and the industrial and trade school.

A black‑and‑white view of a large hilltop complex with a tall, ornate baroque tower rising from a multi‑storey castle or monastery building. The structure has steep tiled roofs with dormer windows and is surrounded by dense forested hills. Smaller houses with gabled roofs lie below the main complex in a valley town. The overall scene is rural and Central‑European in character. No visible text appears on the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a street corner with ornate multi‑storey buildings and numerous German shop advertisements. The largest building displays a huge painted sign reading "Pönitz Colonialwaren" on the gable, with smaller signs for cigars, wine, delicatessen and other products. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the cobbled street and sidewalk. At the top of the card is the caption "Kötzschenbroda. Bahnhofstrasse." The left margin bears the printer's imprint and date.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large traditional Alpine-style hotel building set among tall conifer trees. The hotel has a steep gabled roof with a small tower, balconies, and signs on the façade. A couple of early- to mid‑20th‑century cars are parked on the road in front. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style captions identify the location and the building.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) postcard view of a rural townscape across a calm river or pond. In the foreground is the water with grassy banks and some reeds; further back are fields, rows of trees, and a dirt road with utility poles. On the gently rising hills behind stand several detached houses and a building with a small tower or steeple, giving the impression of a small Central European village. The word "Zitzschewig" is printed in red in the upper left corner.

A hand‑colored historic postcard showing a large three‑storey school building fronting a broad square. The central section has an entrance with steps, arched windows, and a clock above, flanked by symmetrical wings with many rectangular windows. Small trees line the front of the building. Surrounding the square are other multi‑storey town buildings, and a tall factory chimney is visible in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Sophienplatz with the Bürgerschule in Colditz.

A colorized historic postcard view of a grand concert hall building set behind trees and a small garden with flowerbeds and a fountain. The facade has arched windows, ornate roof details, and awnings bearing the word "VEREENIGING." At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a concert building in Nijmegen.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a group of armed men in traditional Albanian highland dress, posing in front of a wooden wall. Most wear white fustanella-style garments, embroidered vests, sashes with ammunition, and traditional caps, and carry rifles. One man kneels in the front holding a long staff. The scene is ethnographic, emphasizing traditional costume. French caption text appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view from a forested hillside looking down onto a Central European town in a broad agricultural valley. Conifer trees frame the foreground. In the middle distance there is a dense cluster of traditional multi‑story buildings with steep roofs and at least one tall church spire. Smokestacks or factory chimneys rise on the valley floor, and beyond the town are patterned fields and low rolling hills. The margins of the image are rough, suggesting an old photographic print reproduced as a postcard. There is very faint, nearly unreadable mirrored handwriting or printing along the upper edge of the image.

Vintage sepia postcard with two inset photographs framed by light floral/berry illustrations. The left image shows a small historic church with a tall, simple tower, pitched roof, stone wall and trees in front. The right image shows a broad village square or main street lined with low plastered buildings, a few carts and people. Red printed text in German appears between and below the images, and a small red manuscript number is written in the upper right corner. A publisher's line is printed in red at the bottom.

An old monochrome postcard showing a semi‑rural townscape with a road running along a fortified wall and a multi‑storey building in the foreground. In the middle distance are low houses and a prominent minaret, with hills in the background. Printed text at the top left reads in French: "Canée. Rue menant à Halépa". There is a postal cancellation mark in the upper right corner and a modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a church complex on a small hill with staircases and a terraced garden in the foreground. A large residential-looking building with a steep tiled roof stands to the left, while a stone church with pointed roofs and a tall spire rises behind trees on the right. The lower edge bears printed red captions naming the place, and there is a red handwritten number in the top-right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an icy shoreline with rocks covered in snow or ice. To the right is a tree‑lined coast, and in the distance near the center stands a small lighthouse or beacon on a jetty extending into the water. At the top of the image is printed text in Swedish: "Karlsborg. Parti från Vanäs udde."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large church with twin central towers and a smaller side tower, set in a hilly town with vineyards or terraced slopes in the background. Traditional European houses surround the church. At the bottom, in cursive script, is a German caption identifying the scene.

Old black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a two‑storey brick house with a steep tiled roof, dormer gable and chimneys, likely in a small town or village. In front of the house is an unpaved street with three blurred figures—two adults in dark clothing and one child or person in light clothing moving toward the camera. Trees and a simple wooden fence appear on the right side. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, like unused postcard space, with a handwritten number at the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white vintage image showing a steamship approaching or leaving a small wooden pier. A group of people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the pier, apparently boarding or greeting the vessel. Low rocky islands with scattered wooden houses and trees are visible in the background, suggesting a coastal archipelago. The steamer bears the name "SKÄRGÅRDEN" on its side.

Sepia-toned winter scene of a snow-covered city street or park. Bare trees line the foreground, with a substantial multi-storey building in the background. To the right stands a small pavilion-like structure with a hipped roof supported by columns. Snow blankets the ground, roofs, and tree branches. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a central town square with unpaved ground in the foreground and rows of old gabled buildings lining the sides. Several houses have arcaded ground floors and dormer windows in steep tiled roofs. A large tree with dense foliage stands near the middle-right, beside a streetlamp. In the background, two church towers with baroque-style domes rise above the roofs. Shop signs in German are visible on the façades, including a corner store and a larger commercial building on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of an old parliamentary assembly hall with curved rows of wooden benches facing a raised platform and windows. The caption in Norwegian at the bottom identifies it as the old Storting chamber at the Norwegian Museum of Cultural History.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing tram tracks running along a broad avenue lined with multi‑storey residential and commercial buildings. On the right, a building bears the sign "Gasthof zur Post." The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Hirschberg‑Cunnersdorf on Warmbrunner Straße.

Sepia-toned street view showing early 20th‑century buildings at a street corner. A few pedestrians stand near a fenced property with trees and a small bridge-like railing in the foreground. The architecture is typical central European town style. Handwritten-style caption text is printed along the bottom border.

Color image of a forested campground filled with many small, brightly colored tents and several mid‑20th‑century cars parked among them. The scene is surrounded by lush green trees and appears to be a family or holiday camping site in summer. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

A black‑and‑white night view of a wide city street flanked by tall buildings. Dominating the scene are two symmetrical high-rise towers connected by a bridge in the distance, with light trails from cars on the street below. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Kungsgatan with the Kungstornen (Kings' Towers) in evening illumination in Stockholm. Printer/publisher details appear in the lower right corner.

Color-printed postcard showing an ornate Baroque church interior with a richly decorated high altar featuring a crowned Madonna and Child surrounded by golden rays, garlands, angels, and twisted columns. At the bottom, decorative German text identifies the altar and location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the grand interior of a vast domed building with galleries, arches, mosaics, and large circular Islamic calligraphic medallions hanging on the walls. The architectural space is clearly that of Hagia Sophia. Greek text is printed below the image, and a vertical caption with the editor's name appears on the right border.

Colorized historical street scene showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story bourgeois buildings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn carriage is visible on the right. Shop signs such as "Kaufhaus Adolf Lassmann & Co." and "Max Baumann" appear on the corner building. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds. Printed titles at the top read "Döbeln i. S." and "Bahnhofstraße."

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a Russian naval vessel at sea, emitting dark smoke from two tall funnels. The ship is side-on to the viewer, flying the Russian naval ensign at the stern. Russian text is printed beneath the image identifying the ship and the publisher/photographer.

Black‑and‑white image of an early 20th‑century steam cargo/passenger ship moving along a harbor or river. The vessel has a dark hull, a single tall funnel, and cargo masts with booms. Behind the ship is a dense waterfront of low-rise row houses, warehouses, chimneys, and cranes, suggesting an industrial European port city. The photo has the framing and tonal style typical of vintage maritime postcards.

Black‑and‑white street scene with an early electric tram marked with the route sign "Borna" and the number 29, running along a tree‑lined avenue. People in early 20th‑century European clothing walk on a wide sidewalk beside iron railings. To the left is a multi‑story building with partly visible signage indicating a restaurant, and a small kiosk on the sidewalk. In the background are factory chimneys and substantial masonry buildings, giving an urban, slightly industrial impression.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas along tree‑lined streets in the foreground, fields and gardens in front, and a denser townscape with church towers and hills in the background. The caption in the upper left reads "Naumburg a. Saale", indicating the town of Naumburg on the Saale River.

Monochrome illustrated religious scene showing an angel seated at the entrance of a rock-cut tomb, pointing upward toward three trumpeting angels in the sky. Three robed women approach the tomb over a rocky ground, one carrying a jar, evoking the biblical scene of the women at Jesus' empty grave on Easter morning. The bottom right bears the artist's signature.

Black-and-white postcard showing an ornate Renaissance-style arcade with a long row of arches supported by columns and richly decorated friezes above. Behind and to the left rises a more massive building with steep roofs and dormers, and in the background a tall baroque church tower with a bulbous dome. The scene is an open courtyard or square with metal railings and bollards in the foreground. No printed captions or text are visible on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a grand exterior staircase (Freitreppe) in a landscaped park. Manicured conical shrubs line the path leading to the broad steps, which are flanked by ornate stone balustrades and lampposts. Several people walk or push a pram along the path and up the stairs. Dense trees frame the scene, and a monument-like structure stands at the top of the staircase. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image.

Color-tinted vintage postcard view of a calm waterfront scene bordered by lush green trees. A small passenger boat is moored along a quay on the left, with a path running beside the water. Farther out on the water a sailboat is visible against a pale yellow sky. The caption in red text at the top reads "Stockholm. Parti från Djurgården." indicating the scene is from Djurgården in Stockholm.

Black-and-white image of a large, cylindrical masonry tower on a hill, surrounded by trees and sloping terrain. The tower has a tall, smooth drum with small windows or slits and a prominent domed roof topped by a small lantern structure and cross-like finial. In the distance, partially hidden by trees, are a few buildings and a broad landscape. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Sepia-toned historical view of a broad town square bordered by older houses and industrial-style buildings with chimneys on the left, and several multi‑story townhouses on the right. Ornate street lamps stand in the open square. The printed captions at the top read "Limbach i. Sa." on the left and "Marktplatz." on the right, indicating this is the market square of Limbach in Saxony.

Colorized historic postcard view of a grand neoclassical building with a large dome topped by a winged statue, identified as part of an art academy. In the foreground are curved stone stairways and a formal flower garden with geometric beds. In the background rises a large domed church and surrounding city buildings. The scene is tranquil with a single figure walking down the stairs. The printed caption at the top is in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villa on a terraced hillside, surrounded by lush gardens and woodland. A forest of tall conifer trees rises steeply behind the building. In the foreground are pathways, stairways climbing the hill, small trees, fences, benches, and a gazebo-like pavilion. The house has several balconies and ornate window details typical of Central European spa or resort architecture. Text is faintly visible on the facade of the house.

A black-and-white aerial view of a large baroque fountain in an open square. The fountain features multiple tiers and statuary, with a central figure holding a trident, likely Neptune. A few small human figures walk around casting long shadows, and a tree canopy appears at the bottom of the image. On the right margin there is printed handwriting-style text identifying the scene.

Black-and-white postcard showing a brick railway station building with ornate gables and a metal roof. A sign above the entrance reads "BRÄNNARP". There are railway tracks in the foreground, a wagon on the left, and several people standing on the platform. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower part of the image, with printed captions including the Swedish words "Stationen" and "Brännharp" (or Brännarp).

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings facing a tree‑lined square or park. There are people walking and a horse‑drawn carriage in the open foreground. Printed captions read "Zagreb (Croatie)" on the left and "Mihanovićeva ulica" above the buildings. The bottom margin is filled with handwritten cursive text in an old style.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a calm harbor or canal with several sailing ships and a steam boat. A long narrow wooden pier or breakwater extends into the water. In the background are warehouse-like brick buildings with red roofs and other small structures along the waterfront. The title 'Rendsburg a. d. Eider.' is printed in red at the bottom, and a vertical imprint of the publisher appears along the left edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a town marketplace with two‑ and three‑story buildings lining a wide, empty street. The left foreground shows a corner building with tall windows; on the right are older houses with stairways leading up from the street. In the distance, a few people and horse‑drawn vehicles are visible. The sky area is mostly blank, with red printed German text at the top and publisher information at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground is a tree‑lined dirt path with a wooden railing. Below the path are closely packed houses with steep, tiled roofs. In the distance on the right stands a prominent church with a tall spire and adjoining buildings, likely forming a historic center. The scene is rural and tranquil. At the bottom left of the card there is a handwritten-style caption.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a sloping street lined with multi‑storey houses. At the end of the street stands a church with a tall spire and belfry. Trees line parts of the road and a few small figures walk downhill. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

Color postcard-style image showing a large Orthodox monastic complex with red-tiled roofs and a small domed church, surrounded by trees and greenery in a valley, with hills and mountains in the background. At the top, there is bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the convent. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a large arched-roof theater building made of wood or corrugated material. The front facade has a central round window with the word "TEATER" displayed inside it, flanked by two smaller circular windows. Long rows of rectangular windows run along the side of the building. In the foreground there is rough grassland, and tree branches frame the upper left corner. Printed captions appear at the bottom describing the location and the photographer/publisher.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox cathedral with multiple onion-shaped domes topped by crosses. The church has ornate neo-Byzantine / Russian Revival detailing, arched windows, and a prominent central dome with smaller side domes. To the left stands a stone obelisk monument on a pedestal, surrounded by short posts linked by chains. Low-rise European-style buildings frame the square in the background. The surface of the card is worn and stained, with faint handwritten marks near the top edge.

Vintage sepia postcard depicting the inner courtyard of a large Renaissance castle complex with ornate façades full of statues and windows, ivy-covered walls, a central tower, and an arched colonnade in the foreground. Trees and a path run through the courtyard. The caption at the top reads "Heidelberg. Schlosshof." and a printer's credit appears at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street flanked by multi‑story stone and wooden buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. The image caption, printed beneath the photo, identifies the street and town. The lower half of the card is blank for writing.

A vintage black‑and‑white coastal view showing a small Mediterranean town clustered around a prominent church with a tall bell tower near the shoreline. White, low-rise buildings line a curved bay backed by dark, rounded hills or low mountains. In the foreground, waves break against rocky shoreline and a stone or concrete promenade running along the coast.

Black‑and‑white riverside view showing a grand late‑19th‑century corner building with ornate façades and a tower, a quay with warehouses and railway structures behind it, and a hill with a baroque church or chapel in the distance. A long side‑wheel paddle steamer is moored along the riverbank, with its paddle‑box bearing a decorative inscription. The foreground shows a pebbly shore with a small wooden rowboat pulled up on land.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a historic European town with dense traditional buildings, church towers, industrial chimneys and countryside in the distance. The foreground shows a large multi-storey building with ornate gables and a central tower. Printed German text at the top identifies the scene and location.

Colorized postcard view of a riverside castle complex with a long white building covered partly in ivy, red gabled roof, green shutters, and adjacent older gabled wings. In the foreground is a calm river reflecting the buildings and a high stone embankment. To the right stands a small pavilion with a red roof among trees. German text at the top identifies the location and type of building.

Vintage black‑and‑white (hand‑colored work) postcard showing a grand Victorian stone mansion with a central round tower and ornate gables, set behind a curved driveway and landscaped garden with palms and other plants. The image is framed by printed text along the borders, and a handwritten number appears beneath the caption.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing an early‑20th‑century European town square. Several automobiles and horse-drawn vehicles line the street, with people walking and gathering along the sidewalks. The architecture features multi‑story buildings with ornate façades and tiled roofs, and a church with domes is visible in the background. In the upper left corner is printed text identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal town's small harbor. A group of people stand along a stone pier that extends into the water; a small rowboat is moored beside it. Low, traditional buildings line the waterfront with hills or mountains in the distant background. Printed captions appear below the image indicating the location in French and Greek. There is also a circular logo on the left and a website watermark at the bottom.

Colorized historic street view showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops with striped awnings. In the background rises a large church or cathedral with multiple towers and spires. The caption at the top reads "Naumburg a. Saale. Steinweg und Dom.", indicating the scene is of the Steinweg street leading toward the cathedral (Dom) in Naumburg on the Saale River. Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a grand hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral and attached castle-like buildings overlooking a river with boats in the foreground. At the bottom of the image, there is cursive text identifying the scene.

Sepia-toned interior view of an early 20th‑century European café or coffeehouse. The foreground shows small round tables with bentwood chairs, a piano with several soda or syrup dispensers mounted above it, and wood-paneled booths along the right side. The back of the room is visible through an arched opening with curtains, leading to another seating area. The walls are decorated with patterned wallpaper, framed oval pictures, and a portrait of a man above the arch. Lighting consists of simple ceiling fixtures and daylight from a window on the right. The image has the look of a promotional photograph printed as a postcard.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left stands a large historic building with a tower and steep roof, resembling a small castle or manor, surrounded by dense trees on a rocky bank. In the foreground is a calm river or lake with reeds along the shore. Across the water on the right is a long low bridge or weir structure and small buildings with red roofs, all set against a tree-lined horizon under a pastel sky. Red printed text at the top reads the location and subject in German.

Colorized photograph of a mid‑20th‑century European urban square or shopping area. Low, curved strip of shops with large glass windows lines the right and center, beneath yellowish apartment blocks with red mansard roofs. A broad open plaza or roundabout with parked and passing cars (including a yellow car in the foreground) dominates the middle. People walk on the sidewalks and in front of the shops; two women in light dresses cross a path from a grassy park with birch trees on the left. The overall style suggests a modern residential‑commercial district rather than a historic center.

Color postcard view of a partly ruined stone castle surrounded by lush green trees and landscaped gardens. A round medieval tower with a conical roof and weather vane rises behind crumbling curtain walls with tall window openings. A few small figures walk along a curved path in the foreground under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural valley with a prominent Christian church at the center, seen from a distance through rows of trees and hedges in the foreground. The church has a tall square bell tower topped with a cross, a steep tiled roof, arched windows, and an entrance façade with classical detailing. Around it are fields, small conifer plantings, and low hills or forested slopes in the background, suggesting a Central European countryside. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a small European town with many tiled rooftops surrounded by trees and countryside. A church with an onion-shaped dome tower rises on the right side, and in the foreground there is a small round tower with a conical roof in a park-like setting. The word "Radeburg" is printed at the top left.

Color image showing a low, modern brick building with flat roofs, white‑framed rectangular windows, and a landscaped courtyard. A stone stepping‑stone path crosses a yellowed lawn, with trimmed bushes and tall pine trees around the yard. Simple metal lampposts with green poles are visible, and the sky is lightly clouded. The architecture and landscape suggest a mid‑20th‑century institutional or residential complex in a northern climate.

Black‑and‑white view of a European city street lined with tall 19th‑century apartment or hotel buildings in neoclassical style. The façades have ornate window frames, iron balconies and shutters. A busy sidewalk scene shows many pedestrians in early 20th‑century dress. A ground‑floor establishment with a sign reading "café" has awnings and hanging lamps above its entrance. Trees shade the left side and market or shop awnings extend along the street.

Black‑and‑white street view of a coastal town square bordered by rocky hills, early–mid 20th‑century European buildings, and several vintage cars on a cobblestone road. A railway carriage stands on a raised track to the right, with flagpoles and a small landscaped area in front. In the lower left corner the caption "STRÖMSTAD." is printed, and in the lower right there is a triangular publisher's logo with the number 7362.

A monochrome postcard showing a Byzantine church complex on a rocky hillside with fortified stone walls and cypress trees. In the background are rugged mountains and a valley. At the top margin there is Greek text, and at the bottom a small website watermark.

Monochrome winter scene showing a snow-covered road bordered by tall fir trees and a small wooden shelter or pavilion on the right side. Overhead utility lines run through the image. The landscape is mountainous and heavily forested. Script text is printed along the bottom margin and a red handwritten date or number appears vertically on the right side.

A multi-view color postcard with a yellow-green border featuring four photographs of historic buildings and gardens in and around Dresden, Germany. The upper left circular image shows a manor house by a pond. The upper right rectangular image shows an ornate Baroque gallery along a water moat with a bridge in front. The lower left image shows a large palace with multiple domed towers behind trees and water. The lower right image shows a courtyard or garden with a fountain, flowerbeds, and people walking in front of a grand building. In the center, red German text reads "Dresden und Umgebung."

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wooden bridge over a river with a town in the background. The bridge has substantial timber supports and railings, and the riverbank is lined with trees and small houses. Below the image are multilingual captions identifying the bridge as the Gauja Bridge in Valmiera.

Black‑and‑white postcard view through an arched gateway into a cobbled castle courtyard. The sides are framed by high, somewhat weathered masonry walls covered with vines and old windows. At the far end stands a multi‑windowed residential wing with a central passageway arch and a distinctive small baroque tower or cupola rising from the roof. At the top of the card is printed the caption "Wildenfels — Schloßhof".

Colorized vintage street view of a large corner hotel building labeled "Hotel Petersburg." The scene shows a two‑story structure with a gabled central section, many windows, and a green roof. Signs in both Russian and German cover the facade, advertising the hotel and a wine shop. Several horse‑drawn carriages stand in front, and numerous people—men, women, and children in early 20th‑century clothing—are gathered in the cobbled street. The caption at the upper left reads "Libau - Hotel Petersburg."

Illustrated panoramic view over a river valley and the city below, seen from an elevated terrace with a railing and flowerbeds. On the right is a monumental stone pedestal bearing a crouching lion statue (Major Hackher monument). In the foreground, several people in early-20th‑century clothing stand on the terrace. In the background are hills and mountains surrounding the town. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as the Schlossberg and Major Hackher monument in Graz, with a view of the city.

Vintage monochrome view over a small industrial town with factory buildings and tall chimneys in the foreground, rows of houses and a prominent church steeple in the background, with low mountains or hills behind the town. The title "Neugersdorf i. Sa." is printed in red at the top, and a vertical imprint with a number and publisher name appears along the left edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a river scene with a half-timbered house and waterwheel on the left bank, a stone retaining wall along the river, and a lattice iron bridge crossing the water toward a row of town buildings and a small villa-like structure with towers in the background. Trees frame the right side and top of the image. The caption is printed in red German text at the top.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet cobblestoned town square in a European town. On the left is a row of narrow gabled houses and a prominent building with an ornate tower and spire topped by a weather vane, likely the town hall. In the foreground a man stands by a horse cart and a small handcart. Across the square stands a large inn or hotel with several dormer windows and a sign on the facade. More small houses close the perspective toward the back of the square.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet canal or river lined with a stone embankment and a row of mature trees along a cobbled promenade. Iron railings run beside the water, and buildings are visible on the right side across a street. The scene looks tranquil and historical. The word "Uddevalla" is handwritten or printed in script at the lower left, and there is a small oval publisher's mark with additional text at the lower right.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large statue of a robed man, József nádor (Palatine Joseph), on a high pedestal in a landscaped square. Trees, paths, and a chain fence surround the monument, with grand multi‑story buildings forming the backdrop. The title text at the top identifies the location as Budapest and names the statue in Hungarian and German.

A black-and-white vintage view of an outdoor café in a leafy city park. Wooden benches and folding tables are scattered among trees, with striped awnings and parasols providing shade. Vintage illustrated postcard showing a tall brick observation tower with a clock near the base and a pointed roof, standing in a wooded area beside a gabled house. Vintage monochrome postcard showing two uniformed cavalry soldiers on horseback, posed frontally in an outdoor riding ground with trees in the background. They wear plumed helmets and carry lances. Printed caption text in German appears along the top edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal village seen from across a calm inlet. Black-and-white postcard showing a tall, minimalist modernist tower connected to a rectangular building along a tree-lined street. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a rocky shoreline with calm water in the foreground. In the lower left corner there is printed text identifying the location, and in the lower right corner a small triangular printer's logo.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic multi‑storey stone building with ornate arched windows and classical detailing, fronting onto an open square with a single street lamp in the foreground. The image is captioned along the bottom margin, identifying the location as a place in Graz.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard framed in a decorative arch shape, showing a very large baobab tree that has been converted into a meteorological observation tower. Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a small town main street lined with two‑story buildings and large trees. Printed red text at the top left identifies the place, and publisher information appears at the bottom left.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a formal landscaped garden framed by multi‑story European-style buildings on both sides. Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk. A sepia-toned panoramic view of a historic European spa town nestled in a valley with hills in the background. Blick vom Stadtgarten.' indicating the scene is a view from the city garden.

A sepia-toned panoramic view of a riverside town with mostly low wooden houses and a few larger masonry buildings. A wide, unpaved main street runs from the foreground up a hill into the distance. Black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial riverside settlement in a valley. In the foreground is a tree‑lined dirt road with telegraph poles and a wooden house. Monochrome postcard showing a photographic reproduction of a classical stone bust of an 18th‑century European woman, dressed in an ornate gown with ruffles and a necklace. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a fairground or exhibition entrance built like a castle gate with round towers and battlements. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk toward the gate. Old monochrome postcard showing a crowded town square with many people gathered in front of a tall stone clock or bell tower, surrounded by traditional low buildings. Handwritten purple ink text covers part of the top-right sky area. Printed captions in Greek and French appear at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large four‑storey brick school or institutional building with decorative stone bands and a steep tiled roof topped by ornate dormers and finials. A monochrome postcard showing a large hilltop castle or manor surrounded by dense forest, seen from across a wooded ravine. A long stair or path climbs the slope towards the building. The image has a white border and handwritten-style captions along the bottom.

Colorized aerial view over a historic European city with dense red-tiled roofs along a greenish river crossed by several bridges. A church tower with a bulbous dome rises prominently in the foreground. The landscape extends to flat fields and distant hills. At the top left, printed text reads "GRAZ vom Schloßberg."

Colorized vintage postcard showing a steam train with wooden passenger cars crossing a tall steel bridge over a deep canal cutting. At the top left there is bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the scene as a bridge at Corinth. A web address watermark appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural railway station building labeled "Lindholmen" beside train tracks. Black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate Baroque or Renaissance stone portal forming the entrance to a courtyard or passage. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a monastery complex seen from a road or bridge lined with white posts and trees. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and a tall baroque church tower with a spire. Black‑and‑white view of a grand neo‑Baroque building with richly decorated façades, large arched windows, mansard roofs, and a central tower. Black‑and‑white coastal scene showing a rocky shoreline with a sheltered bay. In the foreground are two small wooden cottages with steep, tiled roofs typical of Scandinavian seaside houses. Sepia-toned historic street scene of a German town square. A row of multi-story gabled houses with tiled roofs lines a wide cobbled square. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a central neoclassical building with a tower, surrounded by trees, open grounds, and low-rise houses in the background. Black‑and‑white view of a European spa or resort town square or park, with people in early‑20th‑century clothing sitting on benches and strolling along paths. An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural settlement at the foot of a hillside. A broad unpaved road runs through the village, lined with small houses with tiled roofs. A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly town with numerous villas and small houses scattered among trees and vineyards. In the far distance lies a broad valley with fields and a river plain. A painted street scene in a small European town with cobblestone road, wooden houses with steep red-tiled roofs, and people walking or standing by the buildings. A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Gothic cathedral with a tall square tower and pointed spires. Black-and-white postcard showing a small harbor with boathouses along the shoreline, several small wooden boats and one larger ship at a pier, and low wooded hills and farmland across the water. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined road with a long, low building on the right partly hidden by trees. A hand-colored historical postcard view of a broad cobblestone square lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large Gothic church complex viewed from a nearby street or terrace. Sepia-toned postcard showing an ornate exhibition avenue lined with potted trees and rows of empty folding chairs. Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an ornate neoclassical theater building on a corner square. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard featuring a large illustration of an early biplane flying above a panoramic photograph of a military tent camp. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a mountainous forest valley with dense conifer woods. Black-and-white postcard showing a rural church with a tall rectangular tower topped by a small belfry and cross. The nave has arched windows and a pitched roof. Vintage monochrome postcard view of a cobblestoned market square with a central ornamental fountain surrounded by a metal fence and gas street lamps. A colorized historic street scene showing a broad square with people walking and riding in horse-drawn carriages. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a river or lake toward a large multi‑storey military barracks complex and surrounding buildings. Color-tinted vintage street scene showing a wide cobblestone square lined with two‑ to three‑story European-style buildings. A vintage-tinted photograph of a mountainous forest landscape. In the foreground there is a rough dirt road or path with rocks and a small stone structure or spring beside it. Black‑and‑white view of an inner courtyard of an old European building with timber eaves and a continuous wooden balcony running along the upper floor. Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small industrial town with dense trees in the foreground and rows of modest houses and factory buildings behind them. Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic and neo‑Gothic complex on a hill, with a massive multi‑storey building in front and an ornate church with two tall, slender spires and openwork tracery rising behind. Sepia-toned historic postcard showing the ornate Gothic façade of a large civic building with tall spires, pinnacles, and richly decorated window tracery. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand spa town. In the foreground stands a large neoclassical Kurhaus building with arched windows and balustraded terraces. Sepia-toned studio portrait of a seated woman in elaborate traditional dress. Black-and-white rural landscape view showing a large wooden chalet-style house in the foreground, with fenced meadows leading to a small village of scattered houses and farm buildings. Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor terrace with tables and chairs beside a railway line in a mountainous rural landscape. Colorized vintage postcard view over a European city with red‑roofed buildings along a river flanked by embankments and tree‑lined promenades. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone colonnaded arcade with arches and columns, likely part of a Byzantine-style monastery or church. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal town built on a hillside by the sea. Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex with multiple connected buildings and a round tower rising above surrounding trees. A colorized postcard view of a lively European town square surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a Gothic cathedral with two tall, ornate spires rising above a medieval-looking bridge and fortified wall. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historicist university building with ornate façades, arched ground‑floor windows, statues along the roofline, and a landscaped lawn in the foreground. Black‑and‑white view up a gently curving cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑story masonry houses. Several children and a few adults stand or walk along the sidewalks. Colorized vintage postcard view of a historical street and square with a long Renaissance‑Gothic palace featuring an arcade of arches on marble columns. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, multi‑storey historic building with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, partially covered with vines, set in a rural landscape with trees and low stone fencing in the foreground. A monochrome postcard view of a large historic castle-like building behind tall trees and a grassy field. A path runs through the trees toward the structure, and there is a pond or moat in the foreground. In the upper right corner, red printed text reads "Schloss Frohburg i. Sa."

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a quiet town with two- and three-story buildings along a wide road. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy outdoor market scene in a large cobblestoned square. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside town. In the foreground is a calm riverbank with a small boat pulled up on shore and several people standing or playing near the water. Black-and-white street scene showing a modernist low commercial building on a corner with large windows and awnings. Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a narrow mountain gorge with steep rocky slopes on both sides. Sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded landscape with a small river or stream in the foreground and a path along its bank. In the background, partly obscured by trees, stands a large castle-like building with a tall pointed tower. At the bottom margin there is printed text naming the place.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large historic spa or villa building with ornate roofs and turrets, viewed through trees and a wooden entrance gate with an arched trellis. Sepia-toned photograph showing a long, straight pathway through a park or garden, lined on both sides with mature trees that form an arching canopy over the path. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Monochrome postcard-style image showing a river with a stone and timber bridge in the foreground. Below the bridge is a small weir or dam. On the riverbank stands a modest building with a smoking chimney and, higher up the slope, a large multi‑storey villa or hotel surrounded by trees and forested hills. The printed caption in German appears at the top left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an elaborate Baroque palace complex along a water-filled moat or canal. A long façade with many identical arched windows and rich sculptural decoration runs horizontally across the image. On the right stands an ornate pavilion with a tall, onion‑shaped crown dome topped by a large crown. In the foreground a wooden pedestrian bridge crosses the water, with people standing or walking on it. Trees are visible to the left and the sky is partly cloudy.

Vintage postcard with a monochrome illustration of a narrow European street lined with historic gabled brick buildings. In the distance is a small tower or belfry-like structure with a dome. Below the image, curved text identifies the scene as a specific street. Along the left margin of the illustration there is a small vertical publisher credit.

Black-and-white aerial or elevated panoramic view of a European spa town nestled in a valley between forested hills. Dense rows of multi‑story historic buildings with ornate facades line the curved valley floor, while villas and larger establishments rise up the slopes. At the bottom margin of the card appears a printed caption in German identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural scene with a large parsonage house on the left and a church with a tall tower and spire on the right, seen from across cultivated fields. There is a low white fence and trees surrounding the buildings. German captions at the top identify the view as a greeting from Börnichen near Grünhainichen and label the parsonage and the church.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside or ravine with a stone wall, scattered grave markers in the foreground, and a townscape in the background. Prominent is a mosque with a minaret among low houses and bare winter trees. Printed red text at the top identifies the location in Latin and Greek script.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined cobblestone street bordered by two‑story European‑style buildings on the left and a long low building with a tall minaret on the right. Several men in dark coats and hats stand on the sidewalk. Printed Cyrillic text is present along the bottom margin, including a greeting and the street name.

Sepia-toned image of a Gothic stone relief showing the Crucifixion of Christ. In the center, Jesus is on the cross above a skull, flanked by soldiers and saints below, while above him a row of seated figures, likely apostles or prophets, sit in niches beneath small arches. The style suggests a medieval cathedral façade or tympanum, reproduced as an old photograph suitable for a devotional or art-history postcard.

Black‑and‑white winter street scene in a small town. Wooden houses line both sides of a snow-covered road. An early 20th‑century automobile stands on the left side, and a few pedestrians walk in the distance. A telegraph pole is visible along the street. Printed text at the top left reads "Parti från Arjeploug". The overall style resembles an old photographic postcard.

Sepia-toned photograph of three uniformed soldiers or border guards in a forested area. One man stands at left holding a rifle and looking through binoculars; another kneels at right with a rifle, and a third crouches in the middle restraining a dog. All wear dark tunics with rows of buttons, high boots, and peaked caps with insignia. The background shows trees and undergrowth, with no visible buildings or text.

A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of four young men posing in front of a painted backdrop showing trees and landscape. Two men sit on a decorative balustrade while the other two stand behind them with their hands resting on the seated men's shoulders. All are dressed in early 20th‑century suits with bow ties and high lace‑up shoes. The photograph is printed with a wide white border typical of real‑photo postcards.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned city street intersection lined with multi‑story historic buildings. On the left, arched shopfronts with German‑language signage occupy the ground floor. On the right is an ornate corner building with a domed turret, bay windows, and decorative reliefs above the windows; shops are on the ground floor, including one with a curved sign above the entrance. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll or stand in the street; a few children and a cart are visible. The scene feels like a central street or square in a historic German town.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a wide river with a steamship and barges. On the opposite bank lies a historic European town with dense traditional houses, church spires, and a large complex on a hill. The caption in red German script at the top right reads "Blick auf Pirna a. Elbe." indicating a view of Pirna on the River Elbe.

Black-and-white postcard view of a forested mountain valley with dense conifer trees. A winding road runs through the valley and several large villa-style buildings or guesthouses are visible among the trees. In the background are wooded hills of the Ore Mountains. Printed German text at the top identifies the location and elevation.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide city street with horse‑drawn carriages, an early tram, gas street lamps, and pedestrians. On the left stands a neoclassical church with a bell tower and large dome, fronted by columns. The street runs into the distance between multi‑story stone buildings. Printed text in Russian and French at the top identifies the location as St. Petersburg and Sergievskaya Street.

Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard with ornate floral borders. It shows three vignettes: at top left a hilltop castle labeled "Castello da Pena"; at top right a palace in a wooded park labeled "Monserat" with people strolling in the gardens; at bottom left a closer view of the same ornate palace façade labeled "Monserat." An illustrated postcard showing a grand historic theater building with ornate classical architecture and a green dome, set on a city square. Surrounding it are multi‑story urban buildings, trees, and small figures of people walking and a person with a cart in the foreground. The sky is stylized with scattered white clouds on a blue background. Along the bottom border, printed text identifies the scene in multiple languages.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a panoramic view of a small town in a valley, showing fields in the foreground, several villagers (including one holding a large banner or cloth) and a cluster of houses and church spires backed by low hills. The lower part is blank for writing and printed with red German text referring to a sanatorium and the place name Bad Kreisch(a) near Dresden.

Vintage postcard with sepia photographs of a lake and surrounding forested landscape. A vintage sepia postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of a small European town with two‑ and three‑storey buildings around an open square. BOREWITZ WENDEN."

Vintage sepia postcard showing a modernist multi‑storey post office building on a tree‑lined street. Pedestrians and an early automobile are visible in front of the building. Beneath the image, captions in three languages identify the building.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a white stone church with a tall, dark spire and tower, partially obscured by large leafy trees. In the foreground is a churchyard with gravestones and paths. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text identifying the church as Nors kyrka and credits to the photographer and publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of people sunbathing and relaxing on a grassy riverbank under birch trees, with a wooden pier extending into a wide river. On the opposite bank distant buildings are visible. Caption text in Swedish is printed along the bottom left, and publisher/photographer information with a numeric code appears at the bottom right.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone road across a low bridge with wooden railings, leading toward a tree-lined area with scattered wooden houses. Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy harbor with several sailing ships and steamers docked at piers. A small rowboat is on the water in the foreground. Black‑and‑white aerial view of a town beside a large lake with rail tracks and a curved shoreline in the foreground, surrounded by farmland and scattered islands in the distance. The image has printed captions in Norwegian at the bottom left and right.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small European village in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows tightly clustered houses with steep, gabled roofs and a few larger multi‑story buildings that resemble inns or townhouses. Winding country roads lead through cultivated fields and meadows toward scattered farmhouses and two prominent larger buildings on the hills, one of which is likely a church or chapel. Dense forest covers the higher surrounding hills. The image edges are worn and irregular, suggesting an old photographic postcard or plate.

Black-and-white photographic postcard showing a large corner building in a European city, with a tram-lined street and pedestrians. The building's rounded corner bears the name "Rosseggerhaus". In the lower left margin, the caption reads "Graz, Rosseggerhaus." The scene depicts an early–20th-century urban streetscape with trams, cars, and people in period clothing.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elegant interior salon scene. A well‑dressed man in a suit stands beside a round tea table, speaking with a seated woman in a long formal gown who holds a teacup. The room is richly furnished with a carpet, upholstered chair, footstool, decorative screen, framed pictures on the wall, and a tea service on the table. Printed French caption and series information appear at the bottom, while handwritten messages in blue ink run along the top and bottom margins.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a hilltop castle dominating a rocky outcrop, surrounded by forested mountains. In the foreground stands a person in traditional rural clothing holding a cow on a pasture path. The lower left border contains a caption in Italian identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white image of an ornate suspension bridge with tall decorative towers and ironwork, crossing a river. In the foreground are tree‑lined walks and a landscaped square; on the right stand large stone pylons with sculptural reliefs. The overall composition and framing resemble an early 20th‑century postcard view of a major European city bridge.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small rural settlement surrounded by large cultivated fields and patches of forest. The village consists mainly of detached wooden or masonry houses with gabled roofs, a few small farm buildings and barns, and an emerging residential area where several new houses appear under construction. Black-and-white view through tall conifer trees onto a valley with a large multi‑story villa or guesthouse. The building has a small corner tower, wooden balconies and half‑timbered details. A narrow road and bridge cross a stream in front. Hills with scattered houses and forest rise in the background. On the façade and a roadside sign the name of the establishment is visible.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a central square bordered by traditional European townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. Vintage postcard-style collage advertising a cinema named "Stora Biografen." A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly, semi‑mountainous landscape. Scattered houses and buildings sit among trees in a valley and on the lower slopes, with largely barren hills rising behind. At the bottom margin there is Greek caption text, and on the right‑lower area a faint website watermark is visible.

Colorized vintage view of a riverside or lakeside scene in a lush forest, with birch trees in the foreground and dense greenery all around. In the background, partially obscured by trees, stands a medieval-looking castle complex with two tall, steeply roofed towers and large stone walls, reflected in the calm water below. There is no visible writing on the image side.

Black‑and‑white historic street view labeled "Graz. Glacisstraße." It shows a broad, tree‑lined avenue with tram tracks curving along a cobblestone road. On the right are multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades; on the left is a promenade with bare trees, benches, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. A tram and several people are visible in the distance.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a vintage electric tram with two cars turning along curved tracks on a cobblestoned street in an old European town. The license or route plate on the tram and the kiosk sign appear to use a Central European script.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a town square or street scene with two-story historic buildings featuring balconies and ornate facades. Cogălniceanu in Piatra.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet residential street lined with multi‑story houses with pitched roofs and fenced front gardens. Lutherstraße." indicating the street name and town.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing the ocean liner S.S. Leviathan at sea, viewed from the front-left bow with three tall smoking funnels and visible rigging. Below the image is printed technical information about the ship, describing it as the world's largest liner.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a street corner with a two‑storey stucco building housing a restaurant. Black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle with thick walls, towers, and steep gabled roofs, surrounded by dense trees and forested hills. Below the fortress stand several late‑19th‑century villa‑style houses and town buildings, giving a layered perspective from the foreground residences up to the castle above. No visible caption or border text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a coastal town built along a bay. The web watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large domed Orthodox church with two bell towers and a neoclassical façade. Vintage sepia-toned postcard with an illustration of the Parthenon temple on the Acropolis at the top left, depicted in a classical drawing style. Vintage monochrome postcard with an Art Nouveau style border framing a coastal scene. A black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing extensive rubble and ruins in a village, with a damaged church visible in the background. Leafless trees line the right side. Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing traditional sailing boats (likely feluccas) on a wide river at sunset or sunrise. A black‑and‑white landscape view over a wooded valley toward a European town. In the foreground are steep‑roofed half‑timber houses partly hidden by trees. To the right is a prominent Baroque-style church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire. Black-and-white image of a large brick Gothic Revival church with a tall central steeple topped by a cross. The church occupies a street corner with early-20th‑century houses visible nearby and unpaved or minimally developed streets in the foreground. The image is framed with a white border, resembling an old photographic postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view showing a large castle complex on a wooded hill to the left and a city with church towers and a river valley to the right. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a man riding a camel in a desert foreground with large domed mausoleums and minarets in the background. The architecture is Islamic, with several prominent domes and towers. At the bottom in French it identifies the scene as the tombs of the caliphs in Cairo.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a coastal town built among rocky hills. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a three‑storey late‑19th‑century building with a mansard roof, central tower-like bay and a date "1896" on the front gable. A rectangular signboard with German text is mounted on the right side of the facade, suggesting an inn or public building.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural hilly landscape with cultivated fields divided into bands and patches. In the foreground stands a detached house with a tiled roof and several windows. At the bottom of the image, there is Dutch text identifying the view as Vossenberg and Keteldal near the village Berg en Dal by Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a seaside promenade lined with trees and people walking along the waterfront. Low-rise buildings extend inland toward hills and a mountain in the background. Handwritten Greek text appears at the bottom left and right, and a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid across the lower-right portion of the image.

A monochrome postcard showing an opulent Baroque interior with ornate wall panels, gilded decorations, large framed paintings, sculptures, and an elevated canopied bed surrounded by a balustrade. A black‑and‑white photograph of a rather dilapidated three‑storey masonry townhouse with classical details. Colorized historic postcard view of a broad square with a large brick school building with a steep red roof and central tower in the background. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey residential or civic buildings with red roofs and classic European architecture. The title text is printed in red at the top of the card.

A monochrome winter view of a large historic castle-like complex on a hill, surrounded by leafless trees and snow. Dresden" indicating the location.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a winter scene with many people ice skating in front of a long neoclassical building. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade with moored sailboats in the foreground and a row of neoclassical buildings with shops and pedestrians along the quay. Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a Baroque or late‑Renaissance style townhouse with ornate window surrounds, sculptural decorations, dormer windows in a steep tiled roof, and ivy growing over a balcony. Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor terrace café-restaurant on a wooded hillside with many tables covered in patterned cloths and numerous people seated and socializing. Vintage black‑and‑white streetscape showing a gently sloping urban street lined with multi‑story stone or stucco townhouses on both sides. The top of the card bears printed red text in German, and there is a shop sign on the right side of the street.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large equestrian statue on a tall plinth in the foreground. The rider wears historical military dress and a plumed hat. A colorized vintage street scene showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with tall multi‑story buildings in warm light, with mountains visible in the background. Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a harbor with several sailing ships and steamships moored along a wooden quay. Tall masts, rigging, and smokestacks dominate the scene, with calm water in the foreground. At the bottom of the image there is printed bilingual text in Swedish and Finnish describing the harbor view.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large neoclassical/cultural palace with ornate facades, arched windows, and a mansard-like roof, seen from across a landscaped street. Black‑and‑white historic street view showing a cobbled road lined with multi‑storey townhouses on the left and smaller houses on the right, leading up to a large round medieval stone tower with a conical roof. Red printed captions at the top read the town and the street/tower names in German.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a narrow valley town with a river or canal and a main road running along it, lined with multi‑storey houses typical of Central Europe. In the distance on a hilltop are the ruins of a castle overlooking the town. The scene is rural‑mountainous, with wooded hills enclosing the settlement. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image itself.

An old sepia-toned image showing a large public gathering in front of a row of two‑story houses with tiled roofs on a hillside. No legible printed caption is visible.

A monochrome historical postcard showing a broad unpaved street of a Russian town, seen from an elevated wooden walkway with railings. In the distance stands a large white Orthodox church with multiple domes and towers. Russian text in pre‑revolutionary orthography is printed at the top and bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a tree‑lined foreground towards a historic European town. A black-and-white postcard view of a riverside promenade lined with multi‑storey historic buildings and trees. A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European village with traditional half-timbered houses and farm buildings, surrounded by trees and gently rolling fields. Black‑and‑white image of a waterfront bathing or leisure pavilion built on piles over the water, with ornate wooden balconies, many windows with curtains and striped awnings. A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a dramatic cliffside building perched high above a valley. Black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor fair or exhibition ground with garden beds and paths in the foreground and various buildings, including a large hall with a tall sign, in the background. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden building with many windows, surrounded by tall trees and a gravel path. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small northern town in winter, showing snow-covered ground and a partially frozen river or lake in the foreground. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a coastal view toward a harbor with several ships anchored in the bay and low hills in the background. Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside industrial and residential area in a valley with a weir and small bridge across the river.
