The printed title at the top identifies the scene as Bautzen and the Seidauer Spree bridge with the weir and Hammermühle (hammer mill). Several buildings bear signs, including one for a bicycle works and another labeled Hammermühle. Publisher information is printed vertically along the right edge.

Color postcard showing a striking mid‑century modern building with a dramatic wave‑shaped concrete and copper roof. Several 1950s American cars are parked in a row in front on a circular drive, with a manicured lawn in the foreground and a blue sky with scattered clouds above. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing two uniformed cavalry soldiers on horseback holding lances, posed on a dirt path bordered by trees. The lower part of the card has printed red text identifying Dresden and the K. S. Gardereiter-Regiment, with publisher and style information along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view from a hillside over a valley with fields, scattered buildings, and low mountains in the background. On the right edge, a building with large windows and timber details stands dramatically on a steep, wooded slope. The upper half of the front is filled with handwritten cursive text. Printed near the top appears a caption identifying the view as a castellated structure on the Schlossberg.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a full-length studio portrait of a woman in traditional Ottoman/Turkish street dress, veiled and wrapped in a long cloak. Architectural columns with ornate details form a backdrop. The caption in French appears along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned view of a small wooden building in a forested area, with decorative timber details and a metal roof. A sign above the entrance reads "VESELIBA". Several people are walking toward the entrance along a path. Tall trees and utility poles surround the building. At the bottom margin, in elegant script, is the caption "Kemeri".

Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a wide cobblestoned market square bordered by rows of multi‑storey townhouses with gabled roofs and shopfronts. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn wagon stand in the open square. The printed caption at the top reads "Wurzen. Markt." and the left margin bears the printer's credit. German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a forested mountain landscape with tall conifer trees in the foreground. In the left background, a hillside village with clustered light-colored buildings and a church tower is visible. At the bottom center margin of the image, a caption in Italian identifies the place as 'Montagnaga di Pinè.' The picture is framed with a white border typical of early to mid-20th-century postcards.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a group of uniformed men, likely military volunteers or cadets, in a snowy forest. Some are holding axes while others are tending a small campfire. The printed caption at the top reads in Swedish about Karlsborg and exercises of the volunteer school.

Colorized historic postcard view across a river toward tree‑lined embankments and brick buildings, including a riverfront bathing or bathing‑club pavilion on piles over the water. At the bottom is a beige margin with captions in Russian and German identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand waterside castle reflected in a calm lake. The building has four large round corner towers with domed roofs and lanterns, steep central roofs with small spires, and a formal garden and tree‑lined terrace along the water. Two small pavilion buildings flank the lakeshore in front of the castle. Forested hills are visible in the background. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small European town with dense historic buildings, church towers, and surrounding farmland. The foreground has trees partially obscuring some houses, while the background shows gently rolling fields with scattered farm buildings. In the lower left corner, white text reads " Döbeln i./Sa.", indicating the place depicted.

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a cobblestoned avenue lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People walk and stand along the street; a cart with bicycles is visible in the foreground. The right side features German shopfront signage on the façades. At the top in red print it reads a location and street name. The overall layout and color tone indicate an old photographic postcard.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a steep cobbled street with several people standing near a small, ornate neo-Gothic structure featuring pointed arches, pinnacles, and tracery. Trees line the right side, and older town buildings stand on the left. In the upper left corner the caption identifies the location as Nijmegen and refers to 'Kasteel Hallo'.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a coastal resort with sand dunes, a beach promenade and pier, wooded hills in the background, and several large seaside villas or hotels. In the foreground a man with a cane and a woman in long dress walk along a sandy path. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location as Binz on the island of Rügen and mentions Villa Agnes and Hotel Seeschloss. Publisher information is printed along the lower edge.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a path running through dense vineyard-style vegetation, with trellised plants or vines on both sides. In the center stand four men in light colonial-era clothing and hats, two of them with bicycles. In the background are tall metal tower structures, possibly windmills or water towers. At the top of the image there is printed text identifying the scene as the entrance to 'Quinta Thomaz Ferreira' in Benguella.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a wide cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑storey historic buildings. On the left are townhouses with shops at street level; on the right is a long building with a steep roof, exterior staircase, and small tower. Several people walk across the open square toward a fountain in the center background. At the top in red print is the caption identifying the location as the marketplace of Grimma.

A black‑and‑white view of a formal city park or promenade framed by symmetrical tree‑lined paths and flowerbeds, leading toward a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance building at the center background. The building has three main stories with arched windows and a colonnaded ground floor; in front of it stands a fountain or statue in a circular basin. Multi‑story 19th‑century townhouses line both sides of the park. Low hills or forested slopes rise behind the city. There is faint signage on one of the left‑hand buildings.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from an elevated lookout with a simple wooden railing in the foreground, overlooking a compact European town in a hilly rural landscape. The town is composed mainly of multi‑storey masonry houses with steep gabled roofs and a few church towers visible among the buildings. Fields and scattered farmhouses surround the settlement, and winding roads lead out into the countryside. The upper edge of the image appears damaged or overexposed, suggesting this is a reproduction of an old photographic postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical public building with a rounded corner dome and ornate façade. The street in front is unpaved, with several men and children standing and walking. At the bottom, in red print, is a caption in a South Slavic language identifying the city and the building.

A black‑and‑white historical view of a busy harbor area in winter, with warehouses, rail tracks, cranes, cargo bales, horse‑drawn carts, and steamships at the quayside. In the background across the water rises a prominent hill with a large church or tower on top. Printed text at the top reads in Swedish about a view from the harbor in Gothenburg.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over the rooftops of a historic European city, showing dense traditional houses, church towers and distant hills. The caption at the bottom identifies it as a view from Schlossberg looking east over Graz. There is a publisher credit on the right and a circular archive stamp with the year 1903 printed in purple.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street with multi‑story residential or commercial buildings on the left and fenced front gardens. A person walks along the largely empty street. Overhead utility poles line the road. At the top right in red print it says "Freiberg i. Sa. Weissbachstrasse." On the left ground‑floor facade a shop sign reads "Julius Ihle." The scene appears to depict Weissbachstrasse in Freiberg.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a canal lined with historic brick buildings and towers on both sides. The water reflects the architecture, including stepped-gable houses and a prominent belfry in the distance. At the top of the postcard is a printed caption identifying the view as a quay in Bruges, described in French.

Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a rural village street. On the left is a traditional house with a steep tiled roof and wooden fence. A dirt road curves into the distance, lined with young trees and telegraph poles. Two children stand by the fence while two women in long dresses walk away along the road. In the background, beyond open fields, stands a church with a tall pointed steeple surrounded by village houses. The printed caption at the top right reads "DEUTSCH-EINSIEDEL im Erzgeb."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Orthodox-style church with multiple onion domes and a tall bell tower, seen from a cobblestone street behind a line of trees and an iron fence. The architecture is richly ornamented, and at the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in German.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey alpine hotel with balconies labeled "Hotel Zanella" on the facade. The building is surrounded by mountains and trees, and several people in early 20th‑century clothing are standing or sitting at tables with a striped parasol in the foreground. Handwritten Italian captions run along the bottom margin.

Colorized vintage street view of a small European town at sunset, showing a gently curving street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings in historicist style. On the right are plastered houses with red tiled roofs and an ornate corner building with a small tower-like structure on top; on the left are white and brick façades with fenced front gardens. A few pedestrians and distant figures are visible. Handwritten-style captions appear in the lower margin.

A monochrome postcard showing a large religious complex with multi‑storey buildings and a tall church steeple, situated along a street with smaller houses and a wooded hillside in the background. Handwritten German text covers the upper part of the image in a curved pattern and along the margins. Printed German title text at the top identifies the site as a convent in Graz.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small pond surrounded by leafless trees in a rural landscape. A person stands on the left bank near the water's edge. The foreground is a dirt path leading down to the pond. Printed captions in German appear at the bottom in red and small black type, indicating the location and publisher.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with several photographs of a seaside resort town. Images include a grand curved arcade with columns and cars parked in front, tennis courts, manicured gardens with palm trees, a large casino-like building, a thermal baths and hotel complex, a coastal panorama with boats/rowing on the water, and extensive park grounds. The right side has the address area labeled 'CARTA POSTAL' with a Portuguese postal stamp. A caption panel reads 'ESTORIL — COSTA DO SOL' and other small captions label each vignette.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Baroque pilgrimage church with twin onion-domed towers rising above trees and a pathway in the foreground. In the upper left corner, the caption reads "Mariatrost bei Graz," indicating the location near Graz.

Vintage postcard-style image showing a long barrage or dam with many arches across the Nile River. There are distinctive towers and structures on the barrage, with calm water in the foreground and a small docked boat with a canopy and a flag near the riverbank. The scene is framed with a wide margin typical of early 20th‑century postcards. French text is printed below the image identifying the location in Cairo and the Nile barrages.

A collage-like postcard page featuring four black‑and‑white portraits and group photographs mounted on a decorative backing with pale green illustrative borders. At the top and bottom are identical group photos titled "Bazar 1903." Each shows a large group of people in folk-style clothing posed indoors, with two small circular inset portraits of women at the upper left and right corners of the group image. Between these, in the center of the card, are two separate studio portraits of women: one younger woman in a striped blouse with a bow at the collar (left) and one older woman with light hair pinned up, wearing a patterned dress (right). Red stamps and printed credits are visible under some images. The overall layout resembles an early 20th‑century commemorative or event postcard.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town in a steep river valley, surrounded by wooded hills. In the foreground on the right stands a large villa with steep tiled roofs, multiple chimneys, half‑timbered details, and a terraced garden leading down a stairway. Below and into the distance stretch rows of 2‑3 story houses with pitched tile roofs along winding streets; electric poles line the road. On a hill farther back stands a sizable institutional building, likely a school or town hall, and a church with a slender tower rises from the middle distance. The landscape is hilly and partly forested; the overall scene has an early‑20th‑century Central European feel. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large spa‑hotel style building in a landscaped garden, with wooded hills in the background and another villa on the hillside. Red printed title text at the top reads "Bad Harzburg. Juliushall und Belveder." and a vertical publisher credit appears at the left edge. On the façade of the main building, the name of the hotel company is visible.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street in a historic European town. On the left stands a tall, ornate multi‑story building with decorative gables and a pointed turret roof. The ground floor has a shopfront with display windows and hanging garments, while several pedestrians walk or stand nearby. On the right, part of a large stone structure with an archway frames the view; under the arch a couple of figures stand looking toward a river or lower street beyond. The image is printed on the upper portion of the card with a blank area for writing below.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long two‑storey building with balconies and external staircases, set among trees at the base of a hill. The foreground includes a dirt or gravel area and low walls. Printed captions in Greek and English identify the location and the hotel, and a publisher's mark appears along the bottom edge.

Colorized view of a large historic hilltop castle complex with red and green roofs surrounded by dense green trees and smaller village houses in the foreground. A tall church-like tower rises from the central castle structure against a blue sky with white clouds. In the upper left corner the caption 'Schloss Weesenstein.' is printed in red letters.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph showing a lakeside town surrounded by forest. There are scattered detached houses, a few larger apartment-style blocks, roads laid out in a loose grid, and water with a wooded shoreline at the top of the image. Printed white text appears along the bottom edge, including a title at left and publisher information at right.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town nestled in wooded hills. In the foreground and center are densely packed gabled houses with steep roofs, a prominent ornate building with a tall clock‑tower or town‑hall tower near the riverbank, and a stone bridge crossing the river with pedestrians visible. Smokestacks or chimneys rise near the water, and church or civic towers can be seen on the hills behind. The scene looks like an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard. No printed text or caption is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a hilly alpine countryside with fields, scattered farmhouses, and a small village dominated by a church with twin spires in the center distance. Evergreen trees and wooden fences frame the foreground. Printed white text along the bottom identifies the location, and a small numeric code appears in the lower right corner.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy river harbor with multiple barges moored along a quay beside railway tracks and freight cars. On the opposite bank stands a small town with church towers rising above trees and houses. The postcard has a printed caption at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small village in a narrow valley surrounded by forested hills and patchwork farmland. A cluster of traditional gabled houses, some half‑timbered, stands along a road and small stream in the center. Rolling grassy slopes with scattered trees fill the foreground, and dense conifer woods cover the hills on both sides. Faint handwritten numbers or words appear upside‑down along the top margin.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a hillside village built on terraced slopes. Small houses are scattered along the rugged terrain with mountains in the background. At the bottom, captions in Greek, French, and English identify the village as Brallo in Greece; a website watermark appears near the lower right.

A black-and-white postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with multi-storey wooden and brick houses featuring steep roofs and dormer windows. A fenced garden runs along the right side of the street. The scene looks early 20th century. Printed text at the top left reads "Elseberg, Uddevalla." and there is a handwritten addition after it.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a railway station with several freight wagons on tracks, platforms with small shelters, and low buildings and trees in the background. The image is captioned in French at the bottom and has a modern website watermark across the lower right.

A black‑and‑white vintage photograph showing a quiet cobblestone street bordered by small young trees. On the left are low, whitewashed buildings with arched doorways and shuttered windows. Further back stands a small, square tower with a hipped roof and chimney, and behind it a pointed church-like spire rising from the trees. On the right side of the street is a building with striped awnings over its windows. The print has worn, scalloped edges typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A colorized industrial-era postcard showing a large factory complex with multiple long brick workshops, sawtooth roofs, and several chimneys emitting no visible smoke. Rail tracks and wagons run through the yard among stacks of materials and machinery. The complex is surrounded by rocky ground and forested hills under a pastel sky. At the top is printed text in Swedish identifying the workshop complex in Trollhättan.

Colorized postcard showing an ornate proscenium stage with columns, drapery, chandeliers and decorative vases. Within the frame is a miniature marionette theater scene: a small puppet figure stands beside a bicycle before a painted backdrop of a winding road leading to a castle-like structure and a wooded landscape. German text is printed in red at the bottom margin, with publisher information in smaller type.

Sepia-toned devotional postcard depicting a statue of the Virgin Mary as Our Lady of Sorrows (B.V. Addolorata), with seven swords piercing her heart and radiant rays behind her head. She stands in elaborate robes, flanked by two kneeling putti or cherubs on either side. Below the image is an Italian caption indicating that this statue is venerated in the Cathedral of Trento.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a close-up of a sculptural group on a monument. The sculpture depicts several nearly nude, muscular human figures in dramatic, expressive poses, draped with cloths, positioned around a stone base. At the top margin is printed text identifying the location as Trento and the subject as the Monument to Dante (detail). Along the lower margin there is an Italian quotation from Dante's Purgatorio, Canto IV. The left edge shows perforations from a booklet or album.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a quiet shoreline scene at Skeppsviken, Uddevalla. In the foreground three women in long dresses and hats stand by a narrow stream leading to a calm bay. Across the water are a few low buildings and, farther right, a tall‑masted sailing ship near steep rocky cliffs. Printed caption text appears at the top and along the right edge.

Color-tinted coastal view showing a rocky shoreline and low stone wall in the foreground, with waves of the sea and a long, sloping, scrub-covered hillside in the background. A small seaside town with low buildings lines the shore along the base of the hill. Greek text is printed at the lower left, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears along the bottom.

A vintage, tinted interior view of a large Romanesque/Gothic cathedral. The image shows a long stone nave with high vaulted ceilings, rounded arches, tall narrow windows, and an ornate pulpit reached by a staircase guarded by sculpted lions. Wooden choir stalls, kneeling rails, and religious furnishings line the right side; a solitary figure kneels in prayer in the distance. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and the publisher.

Black‑and‑white view along a tree‑lined urban street with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century residential and commercial row houses. The buildings have steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and stepped or curved gables typical of German architecture of that era. Shop signs are visible at street level on several façades. One clearly readable sign on the nearest corner building says "Kaiserl…", likely referring to a business named after the Kaiser. A single pedestrian walks along the wide sidewalk at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white image with scalloped borders showing a large multi‑storey alpine hotel with wooden balconies and gabled roofs on the left, facing a dramatic backdrop of steep, jagged mountains and dense conifer forests on the right. The foreground includes a terrace or open area in front of the hotel and shrubs or low vegetation.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand formal dining hall in a European palace or stately home. A very long, formally set dining table with many identical chairs runs along the room, laid with white tablecloths, candelabras, flower arrangements and folded napkins. The space has a high ornate ceiling with elaborate molding and large multi‑globe chandeliers, wood‑paneled lower walls, and large double doors. Above the panelling hang large framed portraits of aristocratic figures and several classical busts placed on cabinets and shelves, giving the impression of a royal or noble residence prepared for a banquet.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide street lined with late‑19th‑century buildings. On the right is a large, ornate institutional building with tall windows and pilasters; beside it stands a corner tenement with balconies and decorative facades. Leafless trees line the street, a few horse‑drawn carriages are visible in the distance, and a person stands near a wooden fence in the foreground. There is handwritten text across the sky area, and printed caption text at the top left.

A black‑and‑white view of a hilltop complex with two tall, narrow, pointed-roof towers, likely part of a castle or fortified church, seen from a wooded slope in the foreground. Leafy trees and bushes frame the scene, partially obscuring several smaller buildings below the main structure. The sky is overexposed in the upper left, creating a large white patch. Along the very top edge there appears to be faint handwritten or printed numbering or notes in white.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone embankment or bridge leading into a small town with low houses and hills in the background. A horse‑drawn carriage moves along the road, and several people are visible further down the street. Greek and French captions are printed under the image, and there is handwritten Greek text and a dated postmark on the lower part of the card.

A monochrome printed view showing a wooden bridge crossing a wide river, with a few small figures on the bridge. In the foreground and left side there are trees and some small rural buildings or huts. The landscape beyond the river appears flat and open. At the bottom margin there is a Russian caption and a number indicating the card in a series.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a narrow cobblestone street leading toward a church with a tall tower and spire. Traditional European houses with tiled roofs line both sides of the street. At the top, printed in red, is the caption naming the location near the church in Ortrand.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a townscape with a tall stone clock/bell tower on the left, a curved road and low wall in the foreground, and a park or open grounds with several classical-style buildings in the middle distance. Trees frame much of the scene. Along the bottom margin are printed captions in Greek and English identifying the location as Chania (Canea) in Crete and noting it as a partial view. There is also a website watermark and a handwritten signature or printer's mark.

Vintage illustrated postcard showing an urban square with grand 19th‑century buildings. In the center is a large ornate hotel façade with flags flying on the roof and the sign "GRAND HOTEL"/"HOTEL NACIONAL". A tram pulled by horses, carriages, pedestrians, gas street lamps and a bridge or quay railing are visible in the foreground. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place, and there is handwritten cursive text over the lower margin.

A black-and-white panoramic view of a rural village set in rolling fields with scattered houses, farm buildings, and a few larger villas at the edge of a dense forest. The scene is tranquil and pastoral, with a lightly clouded sky above. At the bottom, white script text identifies the place as a summer resort area near the Tharandt Forest.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside settlement with a railway line running parallel to a broad river, a steamboat on the water, clusters of houses along the slope, and hills in the background. Printed German text appears at the bottom and vertically along the left edge.

Colorized historical postcard view of a large circular public square with gardens and walkways, centered on a prominent statue standing on a white pedestal. Trees and flowerbeds surround the monument, with cyclists, pedestrians, and a tram visible in the background. The scene is bordered by elegant late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century buildings and lots of greenery. The caption at the bottom in red type identifies the location as Keizer Karelplein in Nijmegen.

Vintage black-and-white image showing a crowded outdoor café terrace under large leafy trees. Many well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing sit at metal tables and folding chairs, socializing and drinking. A pavilion or café building is visible in the background. Printed red text along the bottom reads the name of the café, the park, the city, and the photographer/publisher.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a street scene in an Italian town. People walk along a curved, relatively modern street bordered by multi‑story buildings with shops at ground level and apartments above. A few bicycles and pedestrians are visible; mountains rise in the background. The image has a white border with scalloped edges, and a caption is printed at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view along a cobblestone street in a European town. Two‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and shuttered windows line both sides. In the middle of the street is a horse‑drawn wagon with several people, followed by another cart; a small dog runs ahead. In the background, on a hill above the town, rises a large fortified building or castle with a tall tower and spire. The image has wide white margins typical of an old photographic postcard; there is no visible printed caption on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the Sanctuary of the Madonna of Caravaggio in Montagnaga di Pinè. In the foreground is a neoclassical church with a dome and small bell tower, decorated with banners and flags as people stand and walk near the entrance. To the left, across an unpaved square, are several multi‑story buildings, one with a visible hotel sign. Trees and hills frame the religious complex, giving it an alpine village atmosphere.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modest modernist institutional building in a rural setting. The light‑colored, two‑storey structure with a tiled gable roof and several chimneys is surrounded by lawns, paths and trees. A large tree stands in front of the main entrance, and exterior staircases lead to side doors and balconies. The foreground shows a gravel yard and landscaped garden. Text printed at the bottom left identifies the place as 'Gamleby Sjukhem', and text at the bottom right credits the photographer and publisher.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a bearded man in traditional clothing standing indoors near a doorway and window, heavily bound in large chains around his shoulders and wrists, with shackles on his feet. Below the photograph is a printed caption in Bulgarian using pre‑1945 orthography, describing the person (Ivanitsa Danchev) and his imprisonment. At the very bottom, in Latin script, it reads: "Edition D. Voynicoff, Varna."

Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a large stone Methodist Episcopal church with a tall central steeple, arched windows, a rose window, and smaller turrets. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand near the entrance. Handwritten text appears along the bottom margin, and partial reference numbers are visible on the right edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooden military pontoon or makeshift bridge over a river or canal. The bridge is constructed from logs and timber supports, with simple railings along the sides. Trees and low banks are visible in the background. At the top of the postcard, there is red printed German text identifying a pioneer battalion and describing the bridge.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a wide landscape view of forested hills and dramatic rocky peaks on an island. In the foreground is dense tropical vegetation; in the background are steep volcanic-looking mountains. At the top of the card there is printed text in Portuguese identifying the scene as a general view of the peaks on Ilha do Príncipe.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick industrial complex with tall chimneys and multiple long factory buildings surrounded by trees. The architecture suggests a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century industrial plant. Handwritten-style white text appears in the lower corners of the image.

Black‑and‑white image of a quiet, tree‑lined urban street with cobblestones and gas street lamps. On the left side stands a large late‑19th‑century masonry building with ornate cornices and balustrades, behind an iron fence and stone wall. The street is empty of people and vehicles, giving a tranquil impression typical of early photographic postcards.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a stone fortress complex on a hill. It shows thick defensive walls, a sloped cobblestone road leading through an arched gate, and several stone and plaster buildings with tiled roofs. In the foreground are railings and a low wall, while terraces and rocky outcrops rise toward the ramparts above. Printed caption text in a Scandinavian-style font appears at the top right.

Black‑and‑white winter scene of a snow-covered village surrounded by dense coniferous forest and hills. Several wooden houses stand among tall fir trees, and a road or path curves through the snow toward a small bridge in the middle distance. On a slope higher up stands a larger building, possibly a hotel or sanatorium, overlooking a cleared snowy field. The caption at the bottom left reads "Bärenfels im Winter."

A sepia-toned historic postcard view of a small European town with a riverside promenade. People walk along a curved path beside a narrow river or canal lined with a low railing. Traditional gabled houses and larger town buildings stand on both sides, with leafless trees in the foreground. In the background rise several towers and church spires dominating the skyline. Printed text in the upper left reads "Döbeln i. Sa. Am Salzgraben".

A sepia-toned historical view over a landscaped city park with curved paths, flowerbeds, and a small river or canal crossed by a stone bridge. People stroll along the walkways. In the background rise multi‑storey European buildings and distant church spires. In the bottom left corner there is handwritten text in Cyrillic.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a wooded valley and a rural village. The village consists of scattered farmhouses and steep‑roofed buildings, surrounded by forests and patchwork agricultural fields. Rolling hills and low mountains appear in the hazy background. No printed captions or border decorations are visible on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a neoclassical building with a colonnaded façade and pediment, fronted by a landscaped square with palm trees, statues, and walking pedestrians. Tram or rail tracks run along the street in the foreground. Greek and French captions appear at the bottom, and a faint website watermark is printed across the lower right.

Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate spa building with a central pavilion and arched colonnades extending to both sides, set behind a formal garden with manicured shrubs, flowerbeds, and paths. The architecture is grand and symmetrical with a high roof crowned by decorative finials and crosses. On the upper left is printed the place name "Bad Elster." On the upper right appears the text "Kgl. Kurhaus."

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a Central European spa town nestled in a wooded valley. Dense clusters of ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings with mansard roofs and grand hotels fill the scene, surrounded by forested hills. At the top center of the card the caption "Marienbad." is printed in a simple serif font.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a river gorge flanked by steep rocky cliffs and dense forest. On the right side stands a masonry structure with arches, likely part of a hydroelectric facility or dam, and in the distant background a church spire rises above the landscape. In the lower right corner, elegant handwritten-style text reads "Trollhättan Kopparklinten."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing two views related to a railway signal box. On the left, an inset image depicts a railway signalman standing inside a signal box operating a long row of mechanical levers and looking at electrical instruments mounted above them. On the right, the main image shows the exterior of a large elevated signal box beside multiple railway tracks, with semaphore signals and rail cars visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the right image.

A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view over a dense spa town nestled in a valley with wooded hills behind. Tall 19th‑century urban houses line a narrow river or canal. Along one bank runs a long colonnaded promenade filled with pedestrians; several bridges cross the water. On the hillside stand grand hotel‑like buildings and a church spire. Red printed text at the top reads "Karlsbad. Blick von der Stefanspromenade." Additional German text appears on a riverside building advertising a bank and a dentist.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph of a large historic brick building with towers and steep roofs beside a canal or body of water. Trees and a quay are visible in the foreground, with the building reflected in the water. At the top left is printed Dutch text. In the center a blank hinged flap or card is mounted, partly covering the picture, with a small metal fastener on the right.

Colorized vintage view over a tree-filled park with curved paths, flowerbeds, and open lawns. In the distance stands a long multi‑story building complex with chimneys and a central dome-like structure. The sky is clear blue. At the top of the image, printed text in red identifies the location as Riesa on the Elbe River and Kaiser Wilhelm-Platz.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley surrounded by rolling fields and wooded hills. In the foreground and mid‑ground are compact rows of traditional houses with pitched roofs. A large, prominent institutional building stands slightly above the town; above it, the printed caption 'Volksschule.' identifies it as a public school. At the bottom of the image, printed in red, is the caption 'Glashütte i. S.' along with the publisher information '6919 Brück & Sohn, Meissen'.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with people standing in the foreground and two oxen pulling a cart. A tall clocktower rises in the background above low buildings. Signs on the buildings read in Italian, including a café and a bazaar. The word "Cavalese" is printed in red at the upper left, and there is a large inscription "GRAN BAZAR AL BUON MERCATO" on the right building.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a hilly rural landscape. The foreground shows fields and scattered farm buildings, while the middle ground is filled with dense clusters of houses, larger spa‑like buildings, and a smokestack, surrounded by trees. In the distance are gently rolling fields, tree‑lined roads, and forested hills. Text printed at the bottom left reads "Radiumbad Oberschlema i. Erzgeb."

Black‑and‑white (with red caption) postcard view of a long, four‑story military barracks building lining a broad, mostly empty street. The structure has a fortified, castellated roofline and many evenly spaced windows. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalk with small pruned trees planted in front of the building. The printed red text at the top identifies the barracks and the town on the Elbe River.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with a large hilltop complex featuring Gothic towers and a castle-like building. In the foreground is a modern road bridge over a wide river, with pedestrians on a curved embankment and early 20th‑century vehicles in the distance. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Meissen on the Elbe River and its new Elbe bridge.

Black‑and‑white view of a formal urban garden with manicured flowerbeds, shaped shrubs, and small trees. In the background stand several multi‑story historicist buildings with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows. Near the street is a tall, ornate advertising or notice column with a clock on top and posters on its sides. Mature trees line the street behind the garden.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large waterfront palace with neoclassical architecture, seen from across a body of water with several boats and yachts in the foreground. The multi-storey palace dominates the skyline, with smaller adjacent buildings and a distant church spire visible to the right. The printed caption at the top reads "Stockholm. Slottet".

Sepia-toned postcard-style image showing a long row of connected historic buildings on a raised stone terrace or fortification wall. Below the wall are arched supports and dense greenery, with a park-like open space and walking path in the foreground where a few people stroll. A slim church-like spire rises above the central roofline. The sky is dramatic with streaked clouds. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the front.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a rock-hewn building or cell with whitewashed walls and several windows set into a cliff face. A man sits on carved stone steps leading up to the entrance under an overhanging rock. Trees are visible to the left. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Cyrillic script.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a large historic castle complex with a tall round tower and adjoining multi-storey buildings, likely medieval in origin, surrounded by trees and smaller gabled structures in the foreground. The scene is rural and picturesque. Printed German text at the top left reads the name of the castle and its location.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view showing a grand multi‑story building with domed roofs and ornate facades along a quay. Numerous sailing ships and passenger boats are moored in front of the promenade. The image has aged marks and printed caption text along the bottom margin.

Colorized vintage view of a large public square framed by multi‑story classical buildings and a garden with paths and trees. In the left foreground stands a tall monument on a stepped base. Mountains, some snow‑capped, rise in the background under a gradient sky from pink near the horizon to blue above. Printed text at the top left reads "Trento – Piazza Dante."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone villa with a tower on the left and a portico with columns in the center, set on a landscaped lawn. Another long building stands to the right. Two people are visible in the foreground. The bottom margin contains printed Italian text identifying the villa and publisher, along with a circular stamp marked "M.C.T." and handwritten numbers.

Black‑and‑white image showing a stone railway tunnel with two sets of tracks entering beneath a road bridge. The bridge has a balustrade of oval openings and decorative stonework along the cornice. Trees and shrubs line both sides of the cutting; a fence and pedestrian path run above the tunnel to the left. In the background stand several multi‑storey buildings with steep, tiled roofs, and a slender tower or church steeple rising over them. Utility poles and early street lamps are visible, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban setting in Europe.

Vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley surrounded by rolling hills and fields. Compact, multi‑story houses with steep roofs fill the foreground, with factory chimneys visible among them. In the distance stands a tall church with a prominent spire. At the bottom, there is a blank white area typical for message space on old postcards, with printed captions in red and small publisher information.

A monochrome street scene showing a small bridge leading into a town street lined with multi‑story buildings. People walk and cycle across the wooden bridge and along the street. On the left corner is a curved building with commercial signs at street level. On the right side of the bridge stands a post with a weight‑limit sign. Trees frame the upper right of the image. At the top of the postcard is the printed caption "Graz. Ehlergasse".

A sepia-toned street view shows a tree-lined avenue with tram tracks running along cobblestones, flanked by multi‑storey townhouses with shops at street level. In the distance rises a tall church with a pointed spire. People walk along the sidewalks and a tramcar approaches in the right lane. At the top of the image is the printed caption in German: "Meißen‑Triebischtal – Talstraße." Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, straight path flanked by balustrades and two large sculptural groups on pedestals in the foreground, leading toward an ornate Baroque palace-like building framed by trees. The printed caption at the bottom in red ink identifies the scene as the royal Great Garden in Dresden. Publisher information and date appear in small type along the lower edge.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large multi-storey sanatorium-style building with steep gabled roofs and many windows, set among trees and gardens and reflected in a small pond in the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Bad Elster." on the left and "Köhlers Sanatorium." on the right.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to a grand stone railway station building. People, horse‑carts and early vehicles stand in front of the entrance. On the right is a separate smaller building and iron fencing, and in the background are additional historic multi‑storey buildings. The title text in Gothic‑style red lettering at the top reads "Chemnitz. Hauptbahnhof." indicating the main train station.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling market square. On the left is a large baroque-style town hall with a tower and clock; beside it stands a Gothic church with tall pointed windows and a steep roof. The square in front is filled with rows of market stalls and many people. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with shops. The caption at the top in red German text reads "Weissenfels a. Saale. Markt und Rathaus."

An old embossed postcard with a central black‑and‑white photograph of a masonry ruin in a wooded park. The ruin has a large rounded apse and tall narrow arched windows. Several people in period clothing stand in front of it. Ornamental floral embossing decorates the cream-colored border. Red printed captions identify the location as Nijmegen and the ruin as Valkhof.

A monochrome winter street scene showing early 20th‑century military or transport trucks parked in a row beside a large, ornate stone building with arched windows and classical detailing. Many people in long coats and military-style uniforms stand or walk along the snowy, unpaved street. Bare trees and other multi‑story European-style buildings line the background, and a tall telegraph pole rises near the trucks. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large Gothic-style brick building with stepped gables and several slender spires, standing directly beside a canal. The facade is lined with tall windows and ornate stone details. Printed at the bottom margin are captions in French and English identifying the scene as 'La Maison du Franc' / 'The House of the Franc' in Bruges, along with a small number '12' at the left and a printer's monogram at the right.

A color postcard view of a European city along a river, with rows of historic buildings and churches in the foreground and a bridge crossing the river. Above the city rises a steep, wooded hill topped by a large fortified complex with walls, gates and towers. On the right slope of the hill stands a prominent clock tower. Mountainous terrain fills the distant background. The printed caption at the top reads "Graz. Mur Schloßberg."

Black‑and‑white / sepia postcard view of a large three‑storey historicist school building with a central risalit, arched windows on the upper floor, and a small clock or roundel in the gable. A tree‑lined yard and gravel piles are in the foreground, with a few people—likely children and adults—standing near the entrance. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the German caption identifying the school in Ehrenfriedersdorf in the Erzgebirge region.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large, ornate stone government building with rusticated walls, arched windows fitted with striped awnings, and a dark roof. The building occupies a whole block, with a cobblestone street and small landscaped garden areas surrounding it. In the top left corner the caption appears in two languages identifying the building in Riga.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large ocean liner steaming across the sea, emitting smoke from a single funnel. The ship is seen in profile, with multiple decks, lifeboats, and tall masts with rigging and flags. Centered in the bottom margin is the caption in Italian: "Piroscafo 'Orazio'". The borders are plain, typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small passenger steamship on calm water. The vessel is decorated with strings of triangular flags running between two tall masts. The ship's funnel rises from the center, and several people stand along the railings on the bow. The name "MOTALA EXPRESS" is visible on the hull, and a caption reading "S/S Motala Express." appears in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate interior room with neo‑Gothic and Indo‑Moorish arches, chandeliers, decorative cabinets, large vases and a richly carved fireplace. The image occupies the left and central part of the card, while the right side is used for handwritten correspondence. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the room as the Indian Room on the south side of the Monserrate Palace in Cintra, Portugal. There is also a printed serial number and printer information.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a harborfront city with rows of waterfront buildings facing a calm bay. The architecture is a mix of Ottoman and Venetian-style houses and public buildings. Low hills rise in the background. Along the lower border there is bilingual Greek–French captioning and a web address printed across the image.

Vintage Romanian postcard back with handwritten purple ink message and address. Printed heading in multiple languages at top left mentions the Prefecture and Café Transylvania. On the right are two brown 20 bani Romanian stamps of the People's Republic of Romania, postmarked. The card is divided by a central line for message and address.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a riverside scene with a large mill building marked "Hammermühle" on the left, trees and smaller riverside houses along the water, a path with stone posts and railings in the foreground, and a small bridge and more buildings visible further up the river. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, and small publisher text is faintly visible in the lower left.

Color-tinted postcard view of a grand historic theatre building with a large green domed roof and ornate classical façade featuring columns, statues and reliefs. The front pediment bears the inscription "STADT-THEATER" and the top-left corner of the card is printed with the words "Graz Stadttheater". The scene is set on a broad street or square with some greenery and surrounding buildings, in a slightly faded, vintage style.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an image on the left and blank space on the right. The image shows a narrow old European street bordered by tall brick buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street toward an ornate arched passageway connecting buildings above the street, crowned with statues and decorative gables. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street in Bruges.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a substantial brick courthouse-style building surrounded by trees and an iron fence. In the right foreground stands an obelisk-shaped war memorial within a small garden. In the background a church or town-hall tower with a clock is visible. The German caption at the top identifies the location and the subjects.

Colorized postcard view of a castle complex situated dramatically on a high rocky cliff above a forested valley. The fortress has light-colored stone walls, a central tower with a greenish conical roof, and several adjoining buildings and towers along the cliff edge. The sky is softly tinted, suggesting sunset or sunrise. Printed caption text appears in the lower margin.

A monochrome postcard-style print showing a narrow street or courtyard dominated by a tall, slender minaret attached to a former church building. Leafless trees and old masonry surround the mosque complex. Below the photograph, printed captions in Italian, English, French, and (likely) German identify the subject as "The minaret of the church of Saint George / Il minareto della chiesa di San Giorgio / Le minaret de l'église de Saint Georges."

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a river with rapids, a bridge crossing to a wooded island or peninsula in the foreground, and a small town with scattered houses, industrial buildings, and distant hills in the background. The bottom border contains printed text in a Scandinavian language.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a complex of rectangular stone buildings on a hillside, likely part of a fortified old town. In the foreground there is a low, whitewashed chapel or dome with a cross on top and a palm tree to the left. The caption area at the bottom includes Greek and French text indicating French schools in Naxos, Greece, and a printed website watermark.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European city. On the left corner stands an ornate late‑19th‑century building with signs identifying it as "Hotel Klosterhof" with a restaurant, operated by Heinrich Sandmann. Across a cobblestone square in the background is a grand historicist building with a central tower, decorative gables, and spires, likely a town hall or similar civic building. Street lamps and a tree‑lined avenue extend to the right; a few pedestrians are visible, dressed in early‑20th‑century clothing.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a coastal panorama of a town viewed from the sea. Low buildings line the shoreline with a few taller chimneys or towers in the distance. In the calm water, a small rowboat carries several people. Rocks frame the foreground at the right edge. The lower part of the postcard includes printed captions in Greek, English ("Patras"), and French ("Côte australe"), along with handwritten text and postal cancellation marks dated 1903.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large baroque water castle with four prominent corner towers topped by bulbous domes, reflected in a calm lake in the foreground. The castle is surrounded by trees and small ancillary buildings, and the scene is framed by dark foliage along the edges of the image. No printed caption or writing is visible on the front.

Colorized vintage view over a European town with narrow winding streets and red-tiled roofs. A prominent stone tower with a clock and domed top rises above the surrounding buildings. In the background are wooded hills, a tall factory chimney with steam, and a large historic building. Printed red text at the top reads the name of the town and the viewpoint.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate, high‑ceilinged dining or reception hall with long banquet tables laid with white tablecloths, chairs lined along both sides, elaborate chandeliers, large framed portraits on wood‑paneled walls, and decorative arches with balustrades above. Printed red text at the lower right identifies the location as an officers' casino (mess) of a field artillery regiment in Dresden, and smaller red text at bottom left credits the printer.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad, tree‑lined boulevard with a grassy park strip in the foreground and middle. Pedestrians in long dresses, hats and suits stroll or stand along the sidewalks; one woman carries a parasol. There are no motor vehicles visible, only wide carriage‑style streets and lampposts, giving an early‑20th‑century European city atmosphere.

A monochrome vintage view of a coastal city taken from the sea, showing a busy harbor with several ships and boats, low waterfront buildings and warehouses along the shoreline, and a calm water surface in the foreground. The image has a sepia tone typical of early 20th‑century postcards. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a rural dirt path lined with tall birch trees on both sides, leading into a forest. Two people with backpacks walk along the right side of the road into the distance. At the bottom, white printed text in German labels the scene.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Dutch city street dominated by a tall ornate church tower with a clock and cupola. In front are narrow gabled houses and shops with signs, bicycles, pedestrians, and an early automobile. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen, St. Stevenstoren," indicating the tower of St. Steven's Church.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a stair hall with a straight staircase and metal railings leading to an upper floor. The walls are lined with framed portrait photographs of various people. There is printed caption text along the bottom edge and a handwritten-style photographer's signature in the lower right.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped city park with curving gravel paths, manicured lawns, dense trees and shrubs, a small stone tower-like structure on the left, and terraced stairs and balustrades on the right. The postcard features a historical cityscape with a river running through the middle, at least two bridges crossing the river, and a prominent hill crowned by fortress structures and a clock tower. A black-and-white vintage street scene showing a bustling European city, with ornate multi-story buildings on the left and a prominent Baroque-style church with a tall spire and cross on the right. A black and white postcard showing a lush landscaped park with geometrically trimmed rows of trees and a decorative round pond or fountain at the front. Behind the park, there are large, ornate European buildings and a hillside covered in forest. The text at the bottom of the image is in German.

A vintage black and white postcard depicting a European town square with several historic buildings. The most prominent buildings are labeled 'HOTEL GOLDENER LÖWE' and 'Hotel Deutsches Haus'. The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a stone monument consisting of a bust atop a rocky pedestal. Bare trees and some shrubbery are present in the background. The image is a black-and-white nighttime photograph of a monument with several statues. This postcard features a sepia-toned, hand-colored photograph of a dirt road lined with tall trees, a wooden fence, and a house with a porch on the left. The landscape is rural, with hills visible in the distance. The edges have printed text in red describing the scene and the publisher.

The image is a black-and-white vintage postcard showing a river with a paddle steamer, an iron bridge, and a grand historical castle on a hill in the background. This is an old black-and-white postcard featuring three photographs of notable buildings and a small pond or garden. The images are bordered and annotated in German. Floral embellishments decorate the card. It appears to depict important locations in Lungwitz, likely in Germany.

A black and white image showing a cavalry unit lined up on horseback. The soldiers are wearing ornate uniforms with distinctive hats featuring a plume and a prominent badge, and they are holding long lances with pennant flags. The background suggests an outdoor field with trees and grassy mounds.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of three detached, two-story houses with distinctive European architectural features such as steep, pointed roofs and decorative balconies. A black and white postcard image showing a rugged stone monument in a wooded park setting. The monument features a relief portrait of a man, with the name 'JÓKAI MÓR' clearly inscribed underneath. The base of the monument is covered in ivy, and it is encircled by decorative posts with chains. The area looks quiet and natural, with trees and a pathway visible in the background.

The image is a colored, vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a town surrounded by hills. This postcard shows a historical town square, as labeled 'Marktplatz,' featuring a central baroque column adorned with statues. This is a sepia-toned postcard featuring a panoramic view over the town of Waldheim. The image displays a picturesque scene of a Baroque-style abbey or monastery complex nestled in a lush, hilly landscape. The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a rural town scene with a wooden bridge crossing a small river or stream in the foreground. In the bottom left corner, the word 'Madliena' is written in a stylized script, and in the bottom right corner, there is a watermark-like text reading 'zudusilatvija.' The image is a colored vintage postcard showing a wide view of a coastal fortification with classical architecture, with a rocky hill rising behind it and a cross atop the summit. The postcard is labeled 'Corfou - Citadelle (côté nord.)' at the top left, and there is a visible postmark/stamp.

A black-and-white image of a large industrial complex with multiple smokestacks, factory buildings, and a railway track curving through the foreground. The surrounding area features densely packed worker housing and industrial infrastructure, with hills visible in the background. There is a faint number or code in the bottom left corner, and an overall early 20th-century feel.

A black and white postcard image depicting a scenic river valley with a winding river, terraced hillsides possibly used for agriculture or vineyards, and a cluster of historical buildings with steep gabled roofs. The area is lush with trees and vegetation. A prominent building resembling a mill or warehouse is visible in the foreground near the water, and the constructed terraces on the hillside indicate traditional European viticulture.

A black and white postcard depicting a rustic wooden house surrounded by pine trees and rocky terrain. The house features classic Scandinavian architecture with shuttered windows and a small porch. The postcard is a vintage black and white photograph depicting two women in what appears to be a backstage dressing room. One woman is applying makeup or adjusting the costume of the other. A black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a wooden bridge or walkway with several people, mostly women and children, walking along it. The bridge is set in a natural landscape with tall trees on one side and an open meadow on the other. At the top right, there is German text in red.

A vintage postcard featuring multiple images of a church building and its interior, with decorative floral illustrations. The church has notable architectural elements such as a tall steeple with a clock, arched windows, and an ornate organ. German text is printed in red in the bottom right and left corners.

A black and white postcard image of a lush, tree-filled park with manicured lawns and flowerbeds. There are multiple benches along a stone pathway, on which a few people are sitting. In the garden, there appears to be a sculpture or statue surrounded by plants. The postcard contains printed text identifying the location and the photographer/publisher.

A colored postcard showing a red-brick industrial building surrounded by a brick fence and gate, with some trees and early 20th-century street elements visible. The postcard features a black-and-white image of a large villa-style house (named 'Villa Anna') nestled at the edge of a forested hill. A sepia-toned historic postcard showing the skyline of Bautzen with distinctive medieval towers and buildings. The postcard shows a historical town square with a large equestrian statue prominently placed in the center. The photo is monochrome and appears to be from the early 20th century. The text 'Oschatz. Altmarkt.' is printed in the upper left corner.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph taken from a colonnaded balcony or gallery, overlooking a cityscape with historical buildings and a body of water in the background. The scene is framed dramatically by a series of arches and columns, possibly from a grand hotel or public building. There are chairs and tables visible under the colonnade, suggesting a terrace or promenade. The lower portion of the image contains printed text in Greek and French, identifying the location and perspective.

The image depicts a group of uniformed soldiers standing in formation outdoors, likely for inspection or parade. The scene is set against an imposing stone building with a barred window and wrought iron gates, suggesting an urban location or government/military facility.

A black-and-white image depicting several large, ornate houses with steeply pitched roofs and decorative woodwork, characteristic of late 19th or early 20th-century Central European architecture. The houses are situated atop a stone terrace above a small river with a manmade weir or water gate, and are surrounded by leafless trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a straight, old street bordered by large wooden and brick buildings, with wooden stairs and large windows. Black‑and‑white photograph showing a sloped path running beside a stone wall and stream. A boy in early 20th‑century clothing stands on the path. Above the path are plastered stone buildings with steep, tiled roofs typical of Central European historic towns. A wooden picket fence lines the upper side of the path, while trees and dense vegetation frame the scene. In the background, a timber‑framed house is partially visible beyond the wall.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large mass gymnastics display in a stadium. The foreground features rows of boys in dark tops and light shorts or trousers performing synchronized calisthenics with arms raised, while the stands behind them are filled with spectators. The lower part of the card contains printed captions in Greek and French referencing the 1904 Panhellenic and school games in Athens, along with some handwritten script.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a wide, straight street lined with multi‑story classical buildings on both sides, with mountains visible in the background. A few people walk along the sidewalks and an early automobile is seen on the left. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Corso Vittorio Emanuele III in Rovereto.

Black‑and‑white view of a residential or institutional street corner with a large, multi‑storey villa in the foreground. The building has steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and an arched main entrance reached by a short flight of stairs. Surrounding it are similar early‑20th‑century houses with tiled roofs and stucco façades, as well as trees, garden walls, and a quiet paved street. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image itself.

Black-and-white postcard view of a quiet main street lined with wooden and masonry buildings, shopfronts, and awnings. The perspective looks straight down the street, which is empty except for a distant figure. At the top is printed the caption "MELLERUD. Storgatan." Several shop signs in Scandinavian style lettering hang from buildings along the street.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene in a European city. The view looks along intersecting streets lined with multi‑storey brick townhouses and a prominent corner building with mansard roof and decorative window awnings. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the sidewalks and stand on the street. Handwritten text frames the image along the top and sides and covers the lower margin. The caption printed beneath the photo reads "Nijmegen."

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a calm fjord with several small rowing boats and sailing boats on the water, and darker hills or mountains in the background. Some smoke rises from a steamboat further out on the fjord. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text giving the location and publisher/photographer information.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of several photographs of historic monuments in Thessaloniki, Greece. The images show: the Galerius Arch; sections of the city walls; the Rotunda of St. George; the church of St. Panteleimon; and the Aladja Imaret mosque complex. Captions in English and Greek identify the sites, and the city name appears both as "ΘΕΣΣΑΛΟΝΙΚΗ" and "SALONICA."

Black‑and‑white view down a tree‑lined, unpaved street in a small European town. On the left stands a two‑storey building with the word "Gasthof" painted on its wall, indicating an inn or guesthouse. To the right are substantial masonry houses with fenced front gardens. In the middle distance a horse‑drawn carriage and a few people are visible in front of more buildings with arched windows. The style and vehicles suggest an early 20th‑century scene.

Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a woman with short wavy hair, wearing a light-colored dress with a high, frilled, translucent collar. She is turned slightly to the side, looking calmly at the camera against a dark background. At the lower right there is a faint embossed studio stamp and cursive text, suggesting a professional photographic postcard.

Color postcard showing a Romanesque-Gothic stone cathedral with an apse and octagonal drum, attached to a crenellated medieval civic palace with tall bell towers and a clock tower. The scene looks down a quiet street with a zebra crossing, railings around the church, a few parked cars, and old buildings in the background under a clear blue sky.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view over central Stockholm, showing boats moored along a quay, a broad riverside street with cars and trams, arched bridges crossing the water, and monumental buildings including the Parliament House and City Hall in the distance. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene and vantage point.

Historic black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with two‑story buildings and shops. On the left is a corner building with signs, one reading "Cigarren" and another "Otto Krause". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk and a small cart stands in the street. A row of trees and a railing run along the right side beside the street, with a tall utility pole visible. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as Schliebenenstraße in Herzberg (Elster).

A colorized historical postcard showing a landscaped promenade with flowerbeds, paths, and a pavilion-like spa building surrounded by trees and hills. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the path. On the right side stands a white statue on a pedestal. The captions in German identify the place as Bad Elster and the Salzquelle Promenade.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing four Ottoman-era men in traditional robes and large white turbans inside an interior with a green divan. One seated figure appears central and authoritative, with others standing or sitting around him, possibly in council. The style is colored lithography. Along the bottom in red and black print is French text, and there is also a small printed number at the lower right.

Black-and-white postcard-style landscape photograph showing open fields with grazing cows in the foreground, a line of forest beyond, and a large lake or fjord with surrounding hills and mountains in the distance. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text in Norwegian and a photographer credit.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers and a few civilians, including women and children, posing in front of a train at a station. The soldiers wear early 20th‑century military uniforms and caps. Some people stand on the platform while others are in the open train doors. Handwritten Portuguese text appears along the bottom border of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, dramatic monument in a park. The statue features a standing male figure atop a swirling sculptural base on a high pedestal, framed by large trees, with a classical multi‑story building visible in the background. Caption text at the bottom left identifies the scene as the Abel monument in Oslo; a printer or publisher credit appears at the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple domes and a prominent bell tower topped with a cross, set in a city square with trees, buses, and people. Low-rise buildings and distant hills are visible in the background. Printed captions in Bulgarian and French at the bottom identify the scene.

A black‑and‑white rural scene showing wooden farmhouses and fields. In the foreground, a large timber house with steep roof and white‑framed windows stands on the left, with people and bicycles near the fence. A dirt road runs into open farmland toward several scattered wooden buildings in the distance. The style evokes an early 20th‑century Scandinavian countryside. Printed text at the top reads "Parti ved Hov i Løiten."

Illustrated postcard showing two young women in richly decorated traditional folk costumes standing by a riverbank. One woman carries a wooden yoke with a dark water jug hanging from it, while the other holds a small book or box. Both wear embroidered blouses, full patterned skirts, necklaces, earrings, and large red ribbons in their hair. In the misty background are calm waters, low trees, and a distant vertical structure such as a church tower. At the lower left appears an artist's signature reading something like "Pecsi Pich D 93".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad tree‑lined street with ornate late‑19th‑century residential buildings in a row. Several people stand or walk on the sidewalk in front of the multi‑story façades with decorative gables and balconies. Printed captions at the top identify the town and street.

Sepia-toned view over a small town or city, taken from a dirt road leading onto a bridge. On the left foreground are several wagons or early trucks loaded with stacked goods and a few people standing beside them. The road crosses a low bridge and continues slightly uphill into the town, lined with wooden and masonry buildings typical of early‑20th‑century architecture. In the background are several church steeples and a larger institutional building with a small dome or cupola. Utility poles with overhead wires line the street, and an early motorbus or tram is crossing the bridge toward the photographer. The postcard is bordered by a neutral frame, and below the image is a modern color calibration chart used for digitization.

A black-and-white photographic postcard showing dramatic, churning rapids on a river, viewed very close to the water surface from a boat. In the background there is a low, forested shoreline under a cloudy sky. In the lower right corner there is printed text in Finnish and Swedish describing the scene.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large early-20th‑century institutional building complex with three main wings, steep hipped roofs and dormer windows. A fenced garden occupies the foreground, with a cobblestone street, gas street lamps, and several children and adults standing along the sidewalk. Printed German text at the top identifies the location and institution.

A vintage printed postcard depicting a hillside landscape with a fortified monastery‑like complex or large building on top, surrounded by cypress trees and sparse vegetation. The sky is lightly clouded. Under the image there is Greek text, a caption at the left and a publisher credit at the right, along with a faint circular emblem and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'. There is also handwritten text in purple ink on the right side of the card.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside building in a rural or small-town setting. The two-story house has many windows and signage along the facade indicating it houses a restaurant, bakery, and materials store. Bare trees and a simple fence line the riverbank in the foreground, with several people standing on the path and near the entrance. The style and clothing of the figures suggest an early 20th‑century European village scene. The lower margin of the card bears printed captions, including the place name and the publisher's details.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small town with a church steeple, industrial chimneys, fields, and a river curving in the foreground. The scene is framed by trees on both sides. In the bottom right corner, the caption reads "FRANKENBERG i. Sa.", indicating the town name.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered street lined with wooden houses in a small town. Heavy snow blankets the road, fences, roofs, and bare tree branches in the foreground. In the background stands a church-like building with a tower beside a frozen river or lake. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and the photographer credit is in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a rural road leading toward a lakeside village with scattered wooden houses on the slopes of large forested mountains. A railroad and telegraph poles run along the water on the left, while fenced fields, haystacks, and trees line the road. In the distance are high rounded peaks with a few snow patches. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small oval publisher's mark appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, low building with a gabled central section on a river embankment. The sign on the facade reads "Erzgebirgische Hutzenstube" and there are advertising signs for "Freiberger Brau" beer. Leafless trees stand in front of the house and there is a terrace or garden area along the river wall. Handwritten captions appear along the bottom border.

A colorized historic postcard view of a bustling European town square lined with multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. Market stalls with umbrellas fill the square, and a large fountain or monument with statues stands in the center. In the background, on a hill, there is a prominent clock tower structure. The printed caption at the top reads in German about Graz and its Hauptplatz with Schlossberg.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a river crossing with a wooden raft or pontoon ferry carrying people across the water. Logs float in the river and simple wooden structures line the banks. In the background there is a town with trees, low houses and a church-like building, backed by a large wooded hill. The caption at the top reads in Romanian: "Piatra-Neamţu – Trecarea cu pluta peste Vale."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a fortified medieval-style castle or fort on the waterfront, connected by a small bridge over a narrow body of water. Small boats are visible in the foreground. Printed captions in French and Greek appear at the bottom, and there is handwritten Greek text across the lower part of the image.

A vintage, monochrome postcard view of a large stone academic building on a corner, lined with bare trees and early street lamps. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. The architecture is classical with arched ground‑floor windows and a long balustraded terrace along the roofline. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a Protestant church with a small bell tower and red-tiled roof behind a stone wall lined with tall cypress trees. A tram and several pedestrians are visible in the street in front. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the church, and a vertical handwritten note is on the right margin.

A monochrome postcard view of a large suspension bridge crossing a calm river, with two massive stone towers at each end.
