Small boats are moored along the riverbank, and a town with multi‑storey buildings lies behind the bridge, backed by wooded hills. At the top in red German text it identifies the scene as the Empress Elisabeth chain bridge and the view toward Obergrund in Jetschen‑Bodenbach.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a tree‑lined bridge leading to an ornate wrought‑iron gate with two brick pillars, opening into a park or square. Three figures walk away from the viewer toward the gate. Below the image is a printed caption indicating Nijmegen and the entrance to Valkhof, along with publisher information and a handwritten greeting.

A black-and-white postcard view of a European town seen from a distance across fields and a wooden fence. In the middle distance there are trees and low industrial buildings with a plume of smoke, while the background is filled with dense townhouses. Dominating the skyline is a large church with a tall tower and baroque-style dome roof. The overall appearance suggests an early-20th‑century photograph printed with a white border. At the bottom, in cursive script, is a caption naming the town.

Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped city park with paths, lawns, and dense trees in the foreground. In the background stands a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings with classical façades. One central building has a tall domed tower topped by a cross or finial, flanked by similar residential or institutional blocks. The scene is photographed from an elevated position, as in a typical early postcard of a European city park.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large central square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. In the middle of the square stands a monumental fountain or statue group on a raised, stepped platform, with people walking and a few carriages or early trams visible. On a wooded hill in the background rises a clock tower with a steep, pointed roof and large clock faces. The printed captions at the top read "Graz." on the left and "Hauptplatz." on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet cobblestone street lined with trees and early 20th‑century townhouses. A large two‑storey building with a metal roof stands on the right, and the road recedes into the distance with a few more houses and a lone pedestrian. The lower margin contains printed and handwritten Swedish text identifying the location.

Sepia-toned photograph mounted with a light border, showing a street corner with an old, battered brick house and, in front of it, a low crenellated wall and gate built in a faux-medieval style. The wall has merlons, narrow arched openings, and a tall pointed-arch gateway facing the cobblestone street. There are tram or trolley tracks in the foreground. Any caption at the bottom is extremely faint and not legible.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town with many houses and trees in the foreground and open fields in the distance. At the top in red Gothic-style script is German text reading "Freiberg i. Sa. Blick auf Friedeburg." The image shows a dense residential area around a small body of water, set in a gently rolling landscape.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the high altar inside a small church. The central image is a richly decorated baroque altar with columns and statues, dominated by a statue of a bishop saint holding a crozier, with smaller religious figures below. The photograph occupies the left and central parts, while the right margin has printed German caption text bordered by dotted lines, leaving space for writing.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestoned European street lined with 3‑ to 4‑storey historic buildings. On the left, shopfronts carry German‑language signs for a drugstore and glassware shop; people stand and walk along the sidewalk, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the street. The architecture suggests a late‑19th‑century Central European town or small city.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large church with a tall tower on the left and an extensive brick institutional complex on a hill to the right, with a chimney emitting smoke. In the foreground is an open field or park with paths and people walking and playing. At the bottom, white printed caption text identifies the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing river traffic on a broad river. In the foreground are moored sailing boats with tall masts and people standing on the quay. In the middle distance are steam or motor vessels with several flags and, to the left, an arched steel bridge spanning the river. Low tree‑covered banks and cloudy sky form the background. Printed captions identify the scene as the Waal at Nijmegen, and the left margin bears the printer's line. A handwritten name or note appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large concert hall building in a park-like setting. The structure has an ornate façade with many windows, decorative reliefs, and a lower veranda or terrace in front furnished with tables and chairs. A taller tower-like section rises on the left. Mature trees frame the scene, a fence and walkway run along the foreground, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing are visible. Caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow courtyard with old wooden houses and tiled roofs. In the background rises a building with a tower and small dome, likely part of the town hall. Children are seated near a doorway in the foreground. At the bottom, there is a German caption in a decorative script.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a lush oasis with many palm trees, a small building or shelter near the center, and a pool of water in the foreground with a few people standing around it. There is a handwritten note in purple ink along the upper right edge. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Suez and names the scene as the Fountain of Moses.

Black‑and‑white view of a dramatic rock cliff dominating the scene, with a small path leading toward a narrow cleft in the rock. In the foreground there is a landscaped park with young trees and flower beds, and on the right side stands a wooden house with a steep roof and a tall flagpole. The image has a white printed caption at the bottom left reading "FJÄLLBACKA." and a small publisher's logo with the number 354 in the bottom right.

Color image showing a grass airfield with several gliders and people in summer clothing preparing for flight. The gliders have registration numbers beginning with "DM-" and are parked on a large meadow. In the background there is a forested hillside dotted with villas, a tall slender TV tower on the ridge, and a distinctive steel truss cantilever bridge over a river to the right, under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings, balconies with flags, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The view looks straight down the street; the lower border contains captions in Greek and French identifying the location as an avenue named after Eleftherios Venizelos in Salonique (Thessaloniki). A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower center.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing an open square bordered by multi‑storey buildings with shops on the ground floors. People walk and cycle across the square, some cars are visible, and in the distance a large lake can be seen between the buildings. The architecture includes an ornate corner building with a tower and cupola on the right and more modern, simpler facades on the left. Text is printed along the bottom margin identifying the view and numbering the card, and a photographer/publisher signature appears in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a long wooden spa or bathing complex with a central pavilion and side wings, set in a hilly, forested landscape. Several people are standing in front of the building. Printed text at the top right reads "Băile Claus Ocnele Mari (Vâlcea)."

Colorized historical street view showing a gently curving city street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the wide street. A prominent corner building has striped awnings and signage including "La Rosa Habanera." At the bottom edge of the image the street name "Houtstraat" and the city name "NIJMEGEN" are printed.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with curved paths, benches, ornate lampposts, and a large monument at the center. The monument consists of a rocky pedestal crowned by a winged angel-like figure holding a cross, known as the Russalka monument. In the background are pavilion-style wooden buildings and trees. People sit on benches and stroll through the park, giving the scene an early-20th‑century atmosphere. The captions on the front identify the place and the monument.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs of urban landmarks. The top image shows a modernist glass and concrete building with a jagged roofline, cars from the mid‑20th century parked in front, and historic church towers rising in the background. The bottom left image features a large city hall–type building with a prominent clock tower. The bottom right image shows an ornate Baroque courtyard façade with statues, balustrades and a richly decorated gate crowned by a large dome‑like crown; in front is a fountain basin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large stone church with twin western towers and steep spires, plus a high-roofed nave and small ridge turret. The church stands on a slightly elevated area behind a low wall and trees, with open ground and a path or road in the foreground. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher in German.

Nighttime street scene in a European city after rain, showing a row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings with ornate facades. Shop windows are lit, including a bright storefront on the left with a neon sign, and another building with a red illuminated sign further along the street. A small kiosk stands near the curb, trees line the sidewalk, and the wet pavement reflects the lights and facades.

Vintage illustrated postcard showing four kittens interacting with ornate floral china on a table. One kitten stands on its hind legs drinking from a tall jug, another drinks from a teacup and saucer, a third with a red ribbon around its neck is lapping from a shallow saucer, and the fourth with a blue ribbon has its paw in a two-handled sugar bowl. The background is a light cream color. Handwritten text appears at the top left and along the bottom margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural landscape with cultivated fields in the foreground and a village in the distance. The village features a prominent church with a tall spire surrounded by small houses and farm buildings. On the right side is a large barn or farm complex. The bottom margin of the card is blank except for printed red text identifying the location and publisher.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a dramatic rocky gorge with a natural stone arch over a river in the foreground and a high suspension bridge spanning the cliffs at the top. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Sidi M'Cid footbridge in Constantine.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a two‑storey modernist building with a tiled gable roof, set on a grassy slope with trees and garden benches in the foreground. Concrete stairways lead up to the entrances. The sky is partly cloudy. Printed captions at the bottom identify the building and photographer/publisher.

Black‑and‑white view of a large European manor or small palace with a corner tower and steep tiled roof, seen from an elevated angle over dense trees in the foreground. The building has several floors of tall rectangular windows and dormer windows in the roof. In the background, there is another long wing of the complex and a distant church or chapel tower with an onion‑shaped dome, typical of Central European Baroque architecture. No visible caption or border text appears on the image.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a man and a woman dancing in theatrical, ornate costumes. The man wears a decorated cap, embroidered jacket and sash; the woman is in a long embellished dress and headpiece. They hold each other in a dance pose on a studio set with a curtain and a vase in the background. Printed text at the bottom identifies the performers and the production, in a Scandinavian language.

Illustrated historical scene showing a mounted officer in early‑modern military dress riding a horse in the foreground during a coastal siege. Soldiers and an officer with a map stand nearby, cannon fire and ships appear in the background near a fortified town by the sea. At the bottom is a printed caption in French referring to the reign of Albert and Isabella and the Siege of Ostend (1601‑1604), plus an advertisement for Liebig products. A facsimile signature 'J. Liebig' is visible on the right.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a small rural tavern or open-air eatery among tall pine trees. People sit at simple tables outdoors and a low building stands in the background. Greek handwritten text appears along the bottom edge of the image, and a watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is printed over the lower right part.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene in an old European city. The focus is a multi‑story historic building with a gabled roof and a small bay-window turret. German text on the facade identifies it as an inn or guesthouse called "Gasthaus zur Pastete" with additional signs such as "Gastwirtschaft zur Pastete" and "Speisezimmer 1. Stock". A narrow, slightly sloping street with other attached houses runs to the right. At the bottom margin, printed caption text reads: "GRAZ, Gasthaus 'zur Pastete' Sporgasse."

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a slightly sloping cobblestone street lined with narrow multi‑story buildings and shopfronts with awnings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the sidewalks; a bicycle and small carts are visible in the street. A very large vertical flag hangs from a building on the left. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Kezelstraat in Nijmegen, and there is a small publisher's line at the lower left.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large Ottoman mosque complex with a central dome and two tall minarets beside a multi‑arched stone bridge and a river in the foreground. Low buildings surround the complex. Printed text in French at the upper left reads "Souvenir d'Andrinople. Mosquée Sultan Bayazid." and there is additional Ottoman/Turkish text at the upper right. A modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone street lined with early‑20th‑century townhouses featuring steep tiled roofs, dormers and some half‑timbered details. Ornamental fences and small front gardens border the sidewalk. On the right side of the image stands a relatively simple stone church with a tall, pointed spire topped by a cross, round‑arched windows and a main entrance facing the open square in front. Additional similar houses recede into the distance behind the church. The overall scene suggests a quiet residential district around a parish church.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with rolling fields and a distant farmhouse. In the center stands a wooden signpost with two arrow‑shaped signs indicating directions to the Netherlands and Germany. A man in early 20th‑century clothing and straw boater hat sits on a bench beside the post, while a boy stands further away in the field. The style and clothing give an old, historical impression.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a multi‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows. The façade is relatively plain except for a richly decorated bay window or oriel, framed by ornate Baroque-style carvings and columns. A wooden fence and climbing plants line the street in front of the building. In the upper right corner there is printed red text in German, and a red handwritten year-like note appears vertically along the right edge.

A monochrome postcard reproducing an old engraved city view: a fortified town with walls and gates spreads across the foreground, while a steep hill rises behind it, crowned by a large fortress complex with multiple towers, churches and defensive walls. Smaller houses, fields and trees occupy the front, and low mountains or hills appear in the distance. The overall style resembles an early‑modern (16th–18th century) Central European city panorama.

Black‑and‑white image of a large neoclassical stone courthouse with rusticated masonry, a prominent central portico supported by tall Corinthian columns, and a domed clock‑tower or cupola rising above the roof. Broad steps lead up to the main entrance, and a tall empty flagpole stands in front. The pediment above the columns is inscribed with the words 'COURT HOUSE'. Mature trees frame the building on both sides.

Colorized view of a lakeside scene with many wooden rowboats moored along the shore, people boating on the water, and an outdoor café terrace with numerous empty tables and chairs beneath trees. On the right stands a light-colored building with a small round tower and conical roof. At the top of the image, red printed text reads "Graz, Hilmteich."

A black-and-white historic postcard view of a waterfront scene with a raised bascule bridge at a lock or canal. A steam-powered passenger boat named "FERN" (partly visible) is in the foreground beside the quay, with people standing on the deck and along the promenade. Other vessels and small boats are visible further along the water. On the quayside, pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing, bicycles, carriages, and a tall, slender pole or mast can be seen. The image is captioned at the top with the location name.

Black‑and‑white street scene in a European town, showing a cobblestoned main street lined with 3‑story buildings and shopfronts. On the right are signs for various businesses with window displays and hanging plants; on the left a road sign points toward nearby towns. In the center background rises a large church with a tall onion‑domed tower and cross finial behind bare trees. Numerous people, including children, walk or stand in traditional early‑20th‑century clothing, suggesting an everyday market‑day atmosphere.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a crowded sandy beach in front of a modernist, flat‑roofed beach pavilion or bathhouse. Many people, mostly families in mid‑20th‑century swimwear, sit or lie on the sand and on deckchairs. Behind them is a long, low, rectilinear building with large windows, a terrace with railings and parasols, and three flagpoles flying light‑colored flags. Coniferous trees stand behind the structure. The photo is bordered by a light postcard-style frame.

A black-and-white view of a calm river at dusk with dramatic clouds overhead. Trees line both banks, a moored boat is visible on the right, and a low bridge can be seen in the distance. Handwritten-style text at the bottom reads "Skymning vid Nissan."

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town in a valley, photographed from a path leading downhill through trees and bushes. In the middle distance are tightly clustered houses with steep gable roofs, some half‑timbered. Above the town, on a wooded hill, stands a prominent castle‑like complex with a church tower or keep, dominating the skyline. The surrounding terrain is hilly and forested. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Colorized historic postcard showing an industrial complex with tall factory chimneys by a riverside, titled "Penig i. S. Patentpapierfabrik." The scene includes multiple factory buildings with smokestacks, a tree‑covered hill in the background, and grassy foreground with a person standing near the riverbank. Printing and publisher information appears along the left and right margins in German.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings. Hanging shop signs in German are visible on both sides. At the end of the street rises a large church with a baroque-style tower and dome. At the bottom, handwritten-style text reads "Riga - Kramerstraße-".

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a fenced monument in a small town square, with an obelisk-like stone pillar and a statue on top. Trees and low buildings surround the monument. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location and monument. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century Greek postcard.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex with a tall round tower and several multi‑storey buildings. The castle stands above terraced slopes, trees, and smaller farm and village buildings in the foreground. At the top of the image is printed German text identifying the site as Burg Gnandstein near Kohren.

Black-and-white photograph showing a calm harbor or canal with trees and wooden houses along the shoreline. Several boats are moored, including a large passenger steamer on the right side. The scene is tranquil, with reflections in the water, and the caption text is printed in white at the bottom left. A small oval printer's mark appears in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship named "S/S Trafik" alongside a breakwater or pier. In the foreground is a stone jetty leading out into the water, with rocks on one side. To the left stands a small lighthouse at the harbor entrance. The ship is moored beside the pier, and smaller sailboats are visible to the right. The image has scalloped postcard-style borders and a small printed serial number in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside street in a European town. On the left stand ornate multi‑storey buildings and industrial facilities with a tall factory chimney. A river runs through the center with a metal footbridge crossing it. On the right is a tree‑lined road with railings along the riverbank and houses in the background, with low forested hills beyond. Printed caption text appears in the upper right corner.

A vintage multi‑view postcard with a sepia/washed color tone featuring several small illustrations of streets, plazas, and notable buildings of a town. In the center, decorative script reads "Recuerdo de Figueras" surrounded by floral motifs. Around the text are vignettes showing a long avenue, civic buildings, an interior of what appears to be a church or large hall, and outdoor urban scenes.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm canal lined with trees and houses. A traditional Dutch-style windmill stands in the background on the left side along the water. The image has printed captions in small type, and there is a handwritten-style word across the lower center. The overall design and typography are typical of early 20th‑century European postcards.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large fortified complex with a tall ornate church tower on the left and a massive round defensive tower on the right, connected by a long multi‑story building. The style is Gothic/medieval with later modifications. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Wittenberg on the Elbe, with references to the Lutherkirche and the Schlosskaserne.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy open‑air fair or market. Numerous tents and stalls line a wide area crowded with people, horses, and carriages. In the background stands a row of low urban buildings and a church‑like structure with a small steeple. The photograph is mounted on a white card border, with a handwritten inscription in a cursive script beneath the image and the year 1934 noted at the right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a steam train crossing a metal truss railway bridge over a river, with a wooded hill and a small ruin or tower on the hilltop in the background. German captions are printed in the bottom margin.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a long stable building with arched windows and brick detailing. In front of the building, a line of soldiers or military personnel are tending to several horses—brushing them and checking their hooves—under the supervision of uniformed officers. The scene appears to be part of a military horse‑care routine. Red printed German text is at the top of the postcard, identifying the location and unit.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a broad European town square bordered by ornate 19th‑century buildings. The foreground shows an open, mostly unpaved square with a central fountain and elaborate gas streetlamps. Cobblestone streets run along the edges, with pedestrians in period clothing and a few horse‑drawn vehicles. The architectural style is late‑19th‑century Central European, with multi‑storey brick and stone facades, dormer windows, and steep tiled roofs. Some shop signs are faintly visible on the left and right sides of the square.

Black‑and‑white image of a large rectangular town square with a dirt or unpaved surface, framed by late‑19th‑century multi‑storey brick buildings. In the center background stands a prominent three‑storey institutional building with a symmetrical facade, arched main entrance, balcony, and small clock or crest above the doorway. A tall decorative streetlamp or flagpole rises from the middle of the square. On the left and right edges are rows of attached townhouses or commercial buildings with shop signs in German on the ground floors.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined urban boulevard with tram tracks and pedestrians. On the right stands a large ornate multi‑storey building with turrets and decorative facades, while older low buildings line the left side of the street. The view looks down the avenue toward distant domed public buildings. At the top of the postcard is printed text reading "Belgrad. Terazia."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing three boys in a striped rowboat on a calm pond or small lake. In the background stands a large villa-style building with trees along the shore. The lower part of the card has printed captions and a red handwritten number on a mostly blank area for writing.

Black‑and‑white view of a large Neoclassical town-hall-like building with a central portico of four columns and an ornate balcony above, surmounted by a tall square clock tower with two large clock faces and a flagpole. The building opens onto a broad cobblestoned square where people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European clothing stroll and socialize. To the left is an adjoining building with arched shopfronts; a large awning reads "CAFE WIEN." The architecture and signage suggest a Central European city square.

A black‑and‑white riverside view showing a long, low paddle steamer named "PIRNA" moving along a calm river, its reflection clearly visible in the water. The steamer has an enclosed central cabin and open decks with passengers. On the opposite bank stand a few large houses, trees, terraced slopes and fields, and in the distance on the hilltop a church with a tall spire dominates a small town or village.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a view across a river toward a hillside with trees and several buildings. On top of the hill stands a large historic castle complex with multiple gabled roofs and towers, identified in the caption as Schloss Nossen (east side). In the foreground are smaller houses or farm buildings near the riverbank. The lower margin contains printed German text including the castle name and the publisher information.

Colorized vintage view of a brick railway station building beside multiple train tracks. A few people stand on the platform, with rail cars and wagons visible on the left. The sky is pale blue and there are trees in the background. At the top in red print is the caption identifying the station and town.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a line of uniformed soldiers standing at attention with rifles, likely on guard duty in front of a brick military building. A drummer stands to the left with a snare drum, and two officers or NCOs stand to the right observing. The image has a formal, posed composition typical of early 20th‑century military postcards. Red printed caption text appears at the bottom.

Colored illustrated postcard showing a hilltop baroque church with twin towers and red domes labeled "Maria Trost." A long stairway leads up through trees from a park-like area below. In the foreground are buildings and pavilions of a leisure or spa establishment with people walking and sitting outdoors. Decorative lettering at the lower right reads "Etablissement Weitzer." There is cursive handwriting across the lower margin.

A monochrome postcard image showing war-damaged urban buildings on a street corner. Several multi-storey brick buildings stand partially destroyed, with missing roofs and walls, surrounded by piles of rubble. The scene is largely empty except for a few indistinct figures or animals at the left edge. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Black-and-white postcard view of a coastal rocky landscape with sparse trees and a lighthouse station. The main building is a light-colored wooden structure with a lantern tower and dome on one side and a tall signal mast in front. To the right stands a smaller outbuilding among the trees. Printed captions appear in white text at the lower left and right corners.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing an ornate courtyard with slender columns and richly carved Moorish-style arches. Light streams into an open patio surrounded by intricate stucco decoration and tiled walls. At the bottom, red printed text identifies the scene and location.

Vintage multi-view postcard printed in monochrome tones with red captions. The upper image shows a broad panorama of a town along a winding river with hills on both sides and a suspension bridge crossing the river. The lower left image depicts a steep rocky hill or cliff (Schäferwand) rising above houses and a riverside road. The lower right image shows another stretch of the same river with boats, bridges, riverside buildings, and hills. The captions in German identify the scenes as views of Tetschen-Bodenbach on the River Elbe.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a narrow river flowing through a forested valley with steep rocky cliffs on the right and dense conifer trees on the left. Small rowboats are on the river, and a path with a few riverside buildings runs along the left bank. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink. At the top in red lettering is a caption in German.

Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views of a rural settlement. The upper, wider image shows a panoramic view of a village behind open fields, labeled "Total-Ansicht." The lower left inset shows a two‑storey inn building with several people standing outside; the sign text names it as an inn (Gasthof). On the right side there is a blank area for writing, printed with a greeting from Raum near Schweizmühle and the printer's imprint at the bottom.

Vintage printed postcard depicting two church buildings in a leafy setting. On the left is a larger church with tall arched windows and a tower; on the right is a smaller church or chapel with a square tower and steep roof. The image is monochrome with a sepia tone, and Dutch captions are printed below the picture.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a small European town bordered by rolling hills and farmland. In the foreground are narrow streets lined with closely packed, steep‑roofed houses and small town buildings. A curving road and railway or path separate the town from a wooded slope with a large, manor‑like building or small castle partly hidden by trees. Further in the distance are scattered houses, church‑like structures, chimneys, and open fields stretching to low hills on the horizon.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooden church building with a tall square bell tower featuring arched openings and a steep roof. The church has Gothic-style arched windows along the side and front, and a short flight of steps leading up to the entrance. Large trees surround the building, partially obscuring the tower. Printed in red at the bottom is the caption identifying the church and location; there are also some red handwritten or printed numbers on the right side.

A colored vintage postcard depicting a waterfront scene of Port Said with sailing boats and a tall lighthouse-like tower on the right. Inset at the left is an illustration of two men in traditional Middle Eastern clothing conversing under an archway, and above them a small round vignette of a veiled woman. The upper border is decorated with blossoming branches and fruit. French caption text appears below the main image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a tranquil riverside or lakeside scene with tall leafy trees on both banks, a few white buildings with red roofs, and a small wooden footbridge over calm water in the foreground. The sky is softly lit as if at dawn or dusk. Red printed captions appear at the top and a small serial number at the bottom.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a European city with hills in the background. In the foreground is a lake with several rowboats and a large lakeside building with two round corner towers. Behind it, scattered villas and larger institutional buildings stretch up the hillside. The printed caption at the bottom left identifies the view as of Hilmteich in Graz, seen from above.

A black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a busy harbor with numerous ships, cranes, and industrial docks along both sides of a wide river or estuary. In the foreground are dense rooftops of older multi‑story buildings; in the distance the waterway stretches toward low hills. The image has printed captions at the bottom identifying the scene and the museum ownership, plus an archive number.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tranquil mountain reservoir or pond surrounded by densely forested hills. The water curves gently along a rocky shoreline on the left, with conifer trees and a path or fence line. The valley narrows into the distance between wooded slopes. The top left bears a red title "Goslar. Herzberg-Teich." and the bottom center has a red printer's credit and number: "9759 Brück & Sohn, Meissen".

Black‑and‑white portrait of a seated man in profile facing left, with neatly combed hair and moustache and wearing a formal suit. The composition is studio‑like, with a dark background. At the bottom of the image there is a short line of text in Cyrillic characters and a small number on the right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a coastal town with traditional sailing boats moored along a curved waterfront. Low houses line the shore and climb the hillside, with a few taller church or monastery spires visible in the distance. The image has printed captions in French identifying the scene as part of Constantinople and the Princes' Islands, specifically a view of Halki.

Black‑and‑white image showing a calm river in the foreground with a flat wooden raft or barge moored at the bank. Tall trees line the riverside, reflected in the water. Behind them is a stone multi‑arch bridge carrying a railway or road. On the hill above rise two cylindrical ruined stone towers, remnants of a small castle or fortress, largely surrounded by forest. In the distance to the right are a few village buildings or a manor on another hillside. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a detailed model of a side‑wheel steamship with sails, displayed in a museum case. The paddle wheel is labeled "CONSTITUTIONEN" and there are framed ship pictures in the background. Norwegian text along the bottom identifies the museum and ship; the right corner has the photographer/printer information and a number.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a religious painting showing the Virgin Mary with the Christ Child seated in a richly patterned rose garden, surrounded by angels. There is a circular stamp‑like mark with the letters "M.C. T." in the upper right of the image. Below the picture is a printed caption identifying the artwork and its location, along with the publisher's details. A handwritten number appears in the bottom right margin.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and rolling hills. In the foreground and center are dense clusters of traditional multi‑story houses with gabled roofs, several larger institutional or factory-like buildings, and a tall industrial chimney. On the left stands a prominent castle complex with towers and a fortified appearance. Near the center is a church with a tall spire rising above the town. The landscape behind the settlement shows open farmland and scattered farmhouses. In the upper left corner of the card, the word "Zschopau" is printed in a serif typeface.

Black-and-white postcard view framed by tree branches, showing a historic hilltop complex with a large castle-like building and a church with tall twin spires above a town on the riverbank. In the foreground a paddle steamer with a smoking funnel travels along the river. German caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a war memorial made of large stone blocks with domed elements and the inscription "TREUE UM TREUE" on its entablature. The memorial stands on a small hill with low stone walls in front. In the background to the left is a large multi‑storey timber building resembling an inn or lodge, surrounded by trees and open ground. Printed German text appears at the top, and a red hand-written number is in the upper right corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a panoramic view of a hilly town with many traditional houses and a prominent church tower. Industrial buildings with a tall chimney stand to the right, while open meadows and trees occupy the foreground. At the top left, red printed text reads "Grünhainichen i. Erzgeb."

Black‑and‑white view down a gently curving pedestrian path between several modernist mid‑rise residential or dormitory blocks. The buildings are rectangular with flat roofs and repetitive window rows; one has a distinctive grid of small square windows. A few people walk along the path, and open fields or hills are visible in the distant background. The image has the look of a mid‑20th‑century campus or housing estate. Faint printed text from a library watermark is visible across the center.

A black‑and‑white panoramic photograph of a small town in a valley surrounded by mountains. The image shows rows of early 20th‑century multi‑story buildings, open fields, and winding roads, likely taken from an elevated viewpoint. At the top of the image, Italian text reads "Panorama di CAVALESE m. 1000", indicating a view of Cavalese at 1000 meters elevation.

Black‑and‑white view across a small lake or pond toward a large, early‑20th‑century villa with a steep tiled roof and half‑timbered gable. Behind and beside it are more modest residential buildings and gardens. Trees frame the scene on both sides, and a path runs along the water's edge where a few people are walking near a small structure and a fenced area by the shoreline.

Sepia-toned street view of a European city with a two‑storey neoclassical building lined with shops at street level and curtained windows above. Signs on the shops are in Cyrillic, including a prominent "КОНПАНIЯ ЗИНГЕРЪ" (Singer Company) sign. Pedestrians in early‑20th‑century dress walk along the sidewalk. The lower part of the image is overlaid with handwritten script. Printed German text at the bottom left identifies the scene, and a handwritten year appears at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a Baroque riverside palace with mansard roofs and ornate balconies on the right, its terrace and formal garden overlooking a broad river. Several people stroll or stand along the riverside parapet and path. On the left a river steamer with a flag at the stern travels upstream, while wooded banks extend into the distance under a cloudy sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a left-facing profile of a bearded man in a dark suit on a light background. The lower part contains printed text with his name in capital letters, and small publisher information in the bottom-right corner.

A sepia-toned historic postcard-style illustration of a spacious castle courtyard. On the left is an ornate multi-storey Renaissance stair tower with rich decoration; in the center background rises a tall, slender tower with a spire. Surrounding buildings form an enclosed court with arched doorways and windows. In the foreground stands a fountain with a sculpted figure holding a trident beside a rectangular basin. German text is printed at the top in red Fraktur-style script.

A hand-colored early-20th-century postcard depicting a historic multi-story Renaissance-style town hall with ornate bay windows and a green copper dome on the corner turret. The building has many rectangular windows and decorative reliefs on the facade, with shops and awnings at street level. At the bottom of the card, printed text identifies the location and publisher, including the words "Torgau. Rathaus." and a 1904 publication line.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small European town nestled in a valley with surrounding rolling fields. Dense rows of multi‑story houses and small apartment buildings fill the foreground and middle, with a prominent church tower rising near the right side of the town. In the distance are patchwork agricultural fields and scattered farmhouses. The word "Rosswein" is printed in a cursive typeface at the upper left, suggesting the town's name.

Black‑and‑white view of an old European street corner focused on an ornate exterior stairway leading to a doorway with a domed canopy. The stair balustrade is decorated with sculpted reliefs and crests, and an elaborate wrought‑iron gate stands to the left. The wall surfaces are worn, with windows protected by heavy iron grilles. A street sign reading "Neumarkt." is fixed to the corner of the building. To the right stands a townhouse with shopfronts; a hanging sign advertises "Uhren & Goldwaren". A small archway and a cart covered with cloth are visible under the main building, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban scene.

Black‑and‑white winter street scene in a small town with snow‑covered road and wooden fences. Large wooden houses line both sides; signs on two buildings read "Victoria Hotel" and "Sevaldsen Hotel". People are visible in the distance. At the top right is printed the town name "Tønset." The rest of the front is covered with handwritten text in a Scandinavian language.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a European square with a prominent baroque church featuring twin towers with onion domes. The scene shows people walking in the square, early 20th‑century shopfronts with awnings on the left, and trees on the right. Printed caption text appears at the top of the card, identifying the place as Graz and Mariahilferplatz.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large river paddle steamer named "Императоръ Александръ II" (Emperor Alexander II) sailing on calm water, with another smaller steamer visible in the distance. The vessel flies flags and is crowded with passengers on multiple decks. The image is bordered by a wide cream margin with a printed caption in Russian at the bottom.

Sepia-toned panoramic aerial view of a city in a valley surrounded by mountains. A river with a metal bridge crosses the foreground, leading into a densely built historic center with church towers and urban blocks. At the top left is printed the caption "Trento - Veduta generale". The left edge shows holes, suggesting it was once bound in an album or booklet.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad bend in a river with wooded banks and fields. A paddle steamer with passengers is seen in the foreground on the river. On the right bank there are rocky slopes and a few houses along the shoreline. The scene is rural and framed by low hills in the distance. Printed German text along the bottom reads the location and the feature of the river bend.

Sepia-toned postcard photograph showing a large neoclassical building with a tall portico of six Ionic or Corinthian columns and a triangular pediment. The façade is three to four stories high, with regularly spaced rectangular windows and modest ornamentation. In front is a cobblestone street or square, wrought-iron fence, stone posts, and old-fashioned street lamps. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk near the steps. A utility pole with multiple cross-arms and wires appears on the left. A metric ruler is placed along the left edge of the image for scale.

Black-and-white postcard view of a small town in a forested mountain valley. Numerous villas and houses are scattered along the slopes, with a prominent church tower visible on the left. Dense coniferous woods cover the hills surrounding the settlement. At the top left of the image is printed text identifying the place.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large old tree in the foreground beside a fence and rural path. Behind it, on a hill, stand scattered houses and a square stone tower that looks like part of a castle ruin. At the bottom front, there is cursive German text printed in the margin.

Black-and-white postcard view of a small European town with dense trees in the foreground, a row of 19th–early 20th century townhouses in the middle, and on the hill above a large castle-like complex and a church tower dominating the skyline. At the bottom center, printed text reads "Nossen i. Sa." indicating the place depicted.

Black‑and‑white view of a large castle or palace complex built on a high stone bastion above a wooded slope. A long façade with many rectangular windows runs along the right side, while to the left a taller section has a steep mansard-style roof topped with a decorative cupola and weather vane. A stone terrace with iron railings follows the edge of the fortification wall, leading toward the buildings. The image has wide white margins typical of vintage postcard prints. No visible printed text or caption appears on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the town of Nossen from the east side. In the foreground are fields and a railway or road, with leafless trees suggesting late autumn or winter. Behind them stands a cluster of townhouses and small buildings. On the hill above the town is a large castle-like complex with towers and steep roofs, dominating the skyline. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the view and the publisher.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical palace with arcades and a colonnaded wing, surrounded by gardens and an open square where two people are walking. There is cursive handwriting across the image and margins. Printed caption at the bottom reads in French "SOUVENIR DE CORFOU - Palais Royal." A small printed credit appears along the left edge, and a watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural valley settlement with scattered houses, a church on a hillside, and a prominent castle complex on a wooded hill. The image has printed captions in German at the top, along with a handwritten red number. The setting appears to be a historic European village landscape.

A monochrome postcard showing a long wooden school building on a wide dirt street. The structure has many tall, evenly spaced windows, a pitched roof with several chimneys, and simple classical detailing. In the foreground, a group of children in early 20th‑century rural clothing stand and walk along the street. At the top of the card are printed captions naming the city and the school.

A monochrome postcard-style image showing a wide, tree-lined boulevard with a central landscaped strip and tram tracks. A tram is visible traveling along the street, with pedestrians walking on sidewalks and people in a small park area in the foreground. Residential villas line the right side of the street, and there are lampposts and power poles along the road. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed caption text identifying the location.

Color image of a large brick railway terminal labeled "CENTRAL STATION" with a classic European facade, arched windows, and mansard roof. In front are 1950s–60s style cars, pedestrians, traffic lights, and a street scene. A circular sign with a white "T" on a dark background, typical of Swedish metro signage, is visible near the left.

Colorized historical postcard view of a grand neoclassical spa-town square. In the center stands a large ornate building labeled "HABERLAVES HAUS" (likely Haberl's Haus) with three stories, arched entrance and balconies. In front is a landscaped garden with paths, low hedges, flowerbeds, and a sculpted fountain. Surrounding the square are multi‑story hotels and townhouses; two buildings at the right and far left are marked as hotels. Forested hills rise in the background. The printed caption at the top reads in German about the fountain and square in Marienbad.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic riverside view of a historic European city. In the foreground is a wide riverbank and water, while on the opposite side stand dense rows of old buildings, church towers, and a large cathedral or basilica dominating the skyline. On the far right there is an industrial complex with multiple tall chimneys. The sky is filled with large clouds. Along the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Dutch.

An old, worn map-style postcard printed in French, showing the department of Pyrénées-Orientales in southern France. The map is bordered in red and displays roads, towns, railways, and relief shading. A prominent inset map in the upper left details the city of Perpignan. French labels, a legend, and postal-related information are printed around the map. The paper shows fold marks, stains, and aging typical of an early 20th‑century card.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a riverside street lined with elegant multi‑story spa and hotel buildings set against a steep, wooded hillside. At the top, a large ornate spa/hotel complex dominates the ridge. In the foreground are long pavilion-like structures along the river. The caption at the top reads "Karlsbad. Alte Wiese." in German type.

Sepia-toned rural scene showing a small village. In the foreground, a shallow stream or pond is bordered by trees, with a woman and several cows or oxen standing in the water. Further back, another person leads livestock, and a horse-drawn cart is visible on a dirt road. Modest single-story houses with pitched, shingled or thatched roofs line the background, partially obscured by trees and wooden fences. The overall style suggests an early-20th‑century European countryside photograph.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a narrow valley settlement with dense forested hills on both sides. A river runs through the foreground, crossed by an arched bridge for pedestrians and vehicles. Parallel to the river is a curving railway line with several train cars and industrial buildings including a tall smokestack. Residential houses and small gardens line the road and tracks. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner of the image.

A black-and-white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, barges are moored along the riverbank. Above them rises a large castle-like building with many windows and steep roofs, and behind it stands a Gothic cathedral with tall, ornate twin spires and additional towers. Smaller houses and vegetation cover the slope below. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right of the image.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a church at the end of a snow-covered path lined with leafless birch trees and wooden fences. A domed tower rises above the main entrance. In the foreground, two children sit on a sled on the snowy path, with another person walking toward the church door in the distance. Printed captions at the top read "Kyrkan." on the left and "Piteå." on the right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting the parish church of a small town. The image shows a stone church with a richly decorated entrance portal, a circular window above it, and an attached tall bell tower with a baroque-style upper section. The foreground includes a simple, somewhat rough open space in front of the church. Printed caption text appears at the top and along the bottom margin.

Black-and-white rural scene showing two men working in a hay field in the foreground, one in work clothes with a scythe and the other in darker, more formal clothing. Behind them stretches a patchwork of cultivated fields leading to a compact village with white and light-colored houses. At the center of the village stands a prominent church with a tall, slender spire. Low rolling hills form the distant background. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a ruined stone gate or arch standing alone in a field of tall grass. The structure is heavily damaged, with a large arched opening and rubble on top, suggesting an ancient ruin. Printed captions in French and Greek identify the site as the gate of the temple of Lysimachus at Ephesus. A web address (elia.org.gr) is faintly visible at the bottom.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a waterway with a steamship passing under or near a large, raised railway bascule bridge. The bridge's steel structure dominates the right side, with railway tracks leading to it, while the left side shows the opposite bank and a low bridge or pier. The image has a vintage photographic style and scalloped postcard edges. At the bottom, a caption in Swedish identifies the scene.

An illustrated wartime postcard showing Bulgarian artillery in action on a battlefield. Soldiers in early‑20th‑century uniforms operate a large field gun amid smoke, explosions, and fallen comrades in a rugged landscape. At the top there is Bulgarian text describing the scene, and at the bottom right there is a small printed credit line in Bulgarian.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a corner view of a large brick building with a tiled roof and dormer windows, partly obscured by trees along the street. There are shopfronts at street level, a small car parked on the right, and a lamppost in the foreground. White printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Trollhättan and the building as Folkets Hus, and credit the photographer Ragnvald Hörne with an address in Trollhättan.

A black-and-white multi-view postcard with three landscape photographs from a spa town. The top image shows a calm lake surrounded by forested hills with small boats at a dock, labeled "Gondelteich." The middle image is a panoramic view over a green valley with a clustered town and church spire, framed by trees, and the central caption reads "Bad Elster." The bottom image shows a formal spa complex with colonnades, flower beds, paths, benches, and a large main building in the background, labeled "Badeplatz."

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the entrance to a seaside bath complex. In the foreground is a curved staircase with railings and decorative planters with palm trees on both sides; a tall ornate street lamp stands to the left and right. Beyond the stairs is a symmetrical, flat‑roofed building facing the sea, with several windows and a central section topped by a mast and a sign. At the bottom margin, captions in Bulgarian and French identify the place as the sea baths in Varna and note that this is the entrance.

A black-and-white vintage street view showing a cobblestone bridge lined with ornate lampposts leading into a town. On both sides of the bridge are multi‑story classical buildings with tall windows and simple facades. Several pedestrians are walking along the bridge. At the top of the image there is printed text indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a very large old linden tree in a fenced village setting. At the base of the tree is a small shrine or framed image mounted in the trunk. Behind the fence are gently sloping orchards and, on a distant hill to the right, a medieval-looking tower or castle ruin. Printed caption text runs along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a country church surrounded by tall trees and a graveyard. A dirt path lined with trees leads toward the church entrance on the left, while on the right a wooden belfry with a spire rises above the surrounding foliage. The scene is quiet and rural, and the words "Trosa Kyrka" are printed in the upper right corner.

A monochrome winter scene of a European city square covered in snow. Leafless trees with frosted branches line a curved street around a fenced central area. In the background stands a tall church-like tower with a clock and a baroque-style spire. Historic multi‑story buildings flank both sides of the street. The card has printed captions at the top and a purple archival stamp with a handwritten year at the bottom right.

A vintage sepia postcard showing the tall medieval belfry tower rising above a large square building with arched arcades and crenellated roofline. People and market stalls are visible in the square in front. Printed French text at the top left identifies the scene as the belfry of Bruges, and a printer's mark appears at the top right.

Sepia-toned studio photograph showing three women in patterned dresses seated on the ground, surrounded by three uniformed soldiers wearing pickelhaube-style spiked helmets. One soldier reclines at the women's feet, another kneels beside them with a backpack and canister, and a third stands behind them, holding a bugle or small horn to his mouth as if playing it. The backdrop is a painted pastoral scene, suggesting a staged, light‑hearted portrait likely intended as a postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small village nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. Numerous gabled houses are scattered along a valley, with fields and dense coniferous woods rising on the surrounding hillsides. A church tower is visible among the trees toward the center-left. The caption at the bottom left reads "WILDENTHAL i. Erzgeb."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a partly ruined stone fortification and the minaret of a mosque rising behind or within the walls. The landscape in the foreground is rough ground with two people on horseback. At the bottom, printed captions in French and English identify the scene as being in Salonique/Salonica and mention a mosque whose minaret was cut by a shot.

Sepia-toned aerial photograph of a small town built around a lake. Dense clusters of houses and several larger industrial-looking buildings line the lakeshore, with tree-lined streets and cultivated fields stretching into the surrounding countryside. The image has a white border, and German caption text appears at the lower left.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard featuring a large Ottoman‑era building with a central dome, ornate arched windows and façades, and an adjacent tall minaret. A dense crowd gathers in front, likely for a ceremonial event. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower part of the image. Printed French captions appear at the top left and right, and there is a visible website watermark added later for archival purposes.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a very large old pine tree enclosed by a low fence in a rural landscape. A child and an adult stand on either side of the tree, emphasizing its size. In the background are fields, farm buildings, and a flagpole with a Scandinavian-style flag. Text is printed along the bottom edge of the image, and a handwritten-style signature appears in the lower right corner.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a leafy rural or park-like scene with dense trees and a rustic wooden fence or footbridge running diagonally through the foreground. At the bottom margin, there is bilingual text in Latin and Greek characters, along with a small circular emblem and a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white photo of a devastated urban neighborhood: rows of brick building shells and standing chimneys amid rubble and ruined foundations. In the background stands an intact multi‑storey building with a gabled roof and many windows. The handwritten caption at the bottom right reads "Tampere. Tammela." The overall appearance suggests a wartime or post‑conflict ruin scene reproduced as a postcard.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a dense low-rise neighborhood of flat-roofed houses in the foreground, labeled as an Arab village, with a large fortified citadel on a hill in the background. On top of the citadel stands a prominent mosque with a central dome and tall minarets, overlooking the cityscape. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge and a faint circular stamp mark is visible on the left. There is also a modern website watermark across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white winter photograph showing two uniformed men on skis standing in deep snow, each holding long ski poles. Snow‑covered evergreen trees and a rural landscape or barracks-like buildings appear in the background. In the lower right corner there is a cursive studio mark that appears to read a photographer's name followed by the word "KARLSBORG".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet street lined with tall historic brick houses in Bruges. The central building is a high, narrow Gothic facade with tall vertical windows; adjacent are other stepped‑gabled townhouses. A person in dark clothing walks along the cobbled street near a shop entrance filled with goods. Printed captions in French appear at the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a rocky shoreline path lined with trees, leading along the edge of a calm body of water. The sky is cloudy and there are distant low hills across the water. Printed caption text in Swedish appears at the top of the image.

A color illustration of an ocean liner at sea, with waves in the foreground and a dramatic cloudy sky behind. The ship has two large black funnels and extensive superstructure with lifeboats along the side. Printed text at the top left identifies the vessel as the P. & O. S.S. "Kaisar-i-Hind" along with its tonnage and horsepower.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a metal bridge over a river with reflections in the water, trees along the banks, and two neoclassical multi‑story buildings in the background. The image is bordered by a blank area at the bottom containing printed and handwritten Greek and Latin‑alphabet text, including the place name. There is also a printed website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view across a river toward a riverside bathing complex and surrounding city buildings. A long, low riverside structure with crowds and parasols stands behind a fence, with apartment blocks and a church steeple in the background and an electricity pylon in the center. In the foreground is the riverbank and a wooden fence. Caption text is printed in white along the bottom edge, and a small credit with date appears at the lower right.

A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a large neoclassical government building identified as the Konak (Palais de Justice) in Salonique (Thessaloniki). A dense crowd fills the square in front, with soldiers in formation, horse‑drawn carriages, and people gathered for a festivity. A minaret is visible on the left. Multilingual captions describe the scene as a holiday celebration related to the Constitution.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from an elevated vantage point over a small European town in a narrow valley. A straight main street runs through the center, lined with 2‑ to 3‑story masonry houses with steep, tiled gable roofs. On the left stands a larger institutional-looking building with a tower-like projection and hipped roof, surrounded by trees; behind it and on the hillsides are more villas and houses. Forested hills enclose the town on both sides. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the street, and there appears to be a trench or canal beside the road. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Color postcard showing a panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by mountains, identified as Trento with the Valsugana railway. In the foreground a steam locomotive with passenger cars travels along a raised railway line; below it is a long arched viaduct. Tree branches frame the upper right. In the upper right corner there is a printed stamp-like vignette with an allegorical female figure and two children and the words "LEGA NAZIONALE".

A monochrome postcard showing a moated brick castle with corner towers and crenellated walls, surrounded by water and adjacent town buildings. The caption at the bottom identifies it as 'Castello di Fontanellato.' Additional small-print publisher information and initials in a circular logo appear in the lower area.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a tree-lined public square with a central lamppost, surrounding buildings, and a few people walking or standing. The caption at the top identifies it as Place Splanzia in La Canée (Chania) and labels it as a souvenir from Crete. A website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears at the bottom right.

Black-and-white view of a Baroque church with an ornate façade, arched doors, statues in niches, and a tall clock tower rising behind it. To the right stands a high column topped with a statue of the Virgin and Child, enclosed by a low wrought-iron fence. Adjacent to the church is a long, plain building with many identical windows and shutters, facing onto a cobbled square or courtyard. The corners of the image are darkened as if from an old photographic plate, and there is a small strip with faint handwritten text at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense historic town with tiled roofs and narrow streets, opening onto a broad square in the foreground. Dominating the square is a large, somewhat worn-looking town hall building with many rectangular windows and a central entrance, attached to a tall clock tower with a baroque-style roof and spire. In front of it stands a row of multi‑storey bourgeois houses bearing shop signs. Further back appear church towers and a round defensive tower, with open countryside and industrial facilities visible on the horizon.

A black-and-white postcard with two photographs of the same large wooden building surrounded by trees and a picket fence. The house has a steep tiled roof with a central chimney, dormer windows, and small balconies. The lower image shows the building from another angle, and below it there is a printed caption identifying the location and institution.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense European town with 19th‑century masonry houses and steep tiled roofs. In the foreground are tightly packed multi‑storey buildings and a few larger public edifices with ornate facades. A river runs across the middle distance with a long metal truss bridge. Beyond the river stretch more residential blocks and factory chimneys, then rolling hills. Several steeples and a hilltop church are visible, along with a tall memorial‑like column in a park area. There is no printed caption or visible writing on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a wooden pavilion-like structure built over a well or fountain on a hillside, with stone walls and buildings of a fortification rising behind it. Sparse trees and a path with a railing surround the structure. Printed captions in German appear at the bottom on a wide white margin.

A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a tree‑lined promenade or avenue with numerous people walking along it, dressed in early‑20th‑century clothing. At the top, there is printed text in Bulgarian (Cyrillic) and French identifying the scene as the entrance to the Sea Garden in Varna.

A colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with flower beds, paths, and trees in the foreground. A gardener works on the lawn. In the background stands a large brick railway station with a central entrance, tall windows, and a small tower. People and a tram or trolley are visible in front of the station. At the bottom, there is printed text in Dutch reading "Nijmegen — Gezicht op Station."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterside scene labeled "Uddevalla, Gustafsberg." The image shows a calm bay or river with a small boat in the center and several low buildings along the wooded shoreline, including a long pier-like structure and detached houses. Trees and gently rising terrain form the background under a cloudy sky.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a town square with a wooden market hall or pavilion in the foreground and a church with a tall, pointed spire behind it. Traditional European buildings with tiled roofs flank the square. Printed German text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river with a low dam or weir in the foreground forming a curtain‑like waterfall. Behind the river, partly hidden by trees, stands a house and, high on a wooded hill, a large rectangular castle-like building. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Schloss Sachsenburg near Frankenberg.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with fields in the foreground and a low wooded hill in the background. On the left side near the treeline stands a large villa-like building. The scene is labeled in German at the bottom, identifying the place as Kamenz and the view of the Hutberg from the east. Printer information appears along the lower edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large brick institutional building with Gothic-style arched windows and gabled roofs. In the foreground are a few small figures walking along the street. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Luleå and name the building. There is also a printer's line in smaller text.

A vintage Spanish postal card with brownish paper and red printed text. It shows a red pre-printed stamp on the right side with cancellation marks and a circular postmark reading 'MADRID' and a date. The heading reads 'TARJETA POSTAL' and 'UNIÓN UNIVERSAL DE CORREOS (CARTE POSTALE–UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE)' with 'ESPAÑA' beneath. There is an ornate Spanish coat of arms on the left. The card is filled in with black handwritten address text, and at the bottom left there is a printed note in Spanish indicating that only the address should be written on this side. A small modern label at the lower left reads 'M.C.D.2020'.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a lakeside park scene. In the foreground is a pond or small lake surrounded by dense trees. On a small peninsula or island stands a neoclassical round pavilion with a domed roof and columns. On the right edge there are multi-story villas or spa buildings with balconies. In the background are rolling wooded hills and a small town. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads the place name and the specific site.

A vintage, monochrome collage postcard with large block letters spelling out a greeting phrase filled with small photographic views of a city—streets, houses, riverside scenes, bridges, and public buildings. The background is dark with scattered stars, and there is handwriting at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobblestone street or market square in a European town. On the right stands a large church with a tall clock tower topped by an onion-shaped spire and cross. Surrounding the church are multi‑story townhouses with painted signage; some are inns or restaurants. A decorative column or fountain stands in front of the church. Few pedestrians are visible, dressed in early 20th‑century clothing. The signs on buildings appear to be in German.

Color image showing a dramatic mountain valley with very steep, green slopes and a narrow winding road of sharp hairpin bends climbing the side of the mountain. In the foreground a group of tourists stand at a viewpoint beside the road, looking down into the long valley below. The scene is entirely natural landscape apart from the road; there is no visible printed text on the image side.

Old monochrome postcard with a central photograph of a historic city gate and surrounding buildings on a sloping street. At the top is the printed caption "Kamenita vrata." The bottom margin has printed text and handwritten cursive writing, and more handwriting fills the right side. A round postal cancellation stamp on the upper left reads "KRAPINA 98 SEP 10." The photograph shows Stone Gate with houses closely built along the street and trees on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a teal-tinted background showing a Gothic-style church with a tall spire and pointed arched windows, surrounded by leafless trees and a low fence, under a full moon. Decorative captions in German appear below and along the side, identifying the view as a greeting from Mitau and naming the church St. Johanneskirche.

Black-and-white view of a landscaped park with a small pond and several water fountains, surrounded by dense trees and plants. In the center of the pond is a small pavilion-like structure on a platform. At the bottom, a German caption identifies the place as Schlosspark Lichtenwalde in the Zschopau valley.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century houses lining both sides of a wide road. The right side features large multi‑story residential blocks with ornate gabled facades; the left side has smaller townhouses and fenced front yards. A horse‑drawn delivery cart with advertising on its side travels down the street while several children walk or play nearby. Wooden picket fences, telegraph/telephone poles, and cobbled or packed roadway are visible. The image has the framing, perspective, and subject typical of an early 20th‑century urban postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a lock and bridge structure at a reservoir with large cranes lifting construction elements over a canal-like lock. In the background is a wide river and low hills. French caption text is printed below the image, and there is small publisher information along the bottom edge as well as some handwritten script.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a countryside guesthouse complex surrounded by trees and shrubs. A two‑story wooden building with a balcony stands in the center, with other wooden houses and a picket fence in the background. A person is standing in the garden. The setting looks rural and peaceful. White printed captions appear along the bottom edge, giving the name of the place and the photographer.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small historic town with dense rows of gabled houses, a few larger institutional buildings in the foreground, and open fields and low hills in the background. German text is printed at the top identifying the viewpoint and the town (Mittweida in Saxony). The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white image showing a romantic historicist villa or small castle with a tall, slender spire and a round turret, set on a wooded slope above a broad dirt promenade. A long stairway climbs the hill beside the building, and a wooden fence lines the path. In the foreground, a few people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the road. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing deep snow covering wooden cabins in a mountainous, forested landscape. Heavy snow blankets roofs and the ground, with ski or sled tracks in the foreground. Distant wooded hills and a clear sky stretch across the horizon. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small publisher's mark is at the bottom right, consistent with an old photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white view over a small ornamental pond in a park or garden, bordered by low fencing and dense vegetation. Mature trees frame the image, and across a street in the background stands a row of European‑style town buildings with shopfronts and awnings. One façade clearly bears the word "PHOTOGRAPH" indicating a photography studio; other vertical and horizontal shop signs are visible but too blurred to read. The scene has an old‑fashioned, early‑20th‑century appearance typical of real‑photo postcards.

A black‑and‑white winter scene of a rural railway station labeled "Ottestad Station". The wooden station building stands on the left beside snow‑covered tracks that stretch into the distance on the right. Frosted trees and bushes surround the building, and a few people stand on the platform near the entrance. Overhead wires and telegraph poles line the tracks, contributing to an early 20th‑century atmosphere.

Vintage illustrated postcard showing the harbor and skyline of Riga with sailing ships in the foreground and a row of pastel-colored buildings and church spires along the waterfront. The image is bordered by handwritten cursive text across the top, bottom, and right side. Printed captions include the name of the city in Cyrillic and Latin, and the river name in German.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a coastal city with multiple church spires and towers seen across a body of water, framed by tree branches and foliage in the foreground. The skyline appears old European. Red printed text at the top left reads in German, and there is small publisher text along the right edge.

Colorized vintage scene of several men in traditional Ottoman/Balkan dress in an open dusty square or yard. Two men stand in the center engaged in what appears to be a mock fight or folk dance with sticks, while others sit and watch in the foreground wearing fezzes and sashes. Simple low buildings line the background, and a child walks toward the group. The overall style and composition resemble an ethnographic or 'local life' postcard. The only visible text is a small website watermark at the bottom.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a rural-urban landscape with red-roofed houses, farm fields, and gentle hills. In the foreground are farm buildings and homes on green slopes; further back is a small town with scattered houses, fields, and a low hill beyond. The sky is light blue with soft clouds. At the top left, printed text reads "Wetzelsdorf bei Graz."

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small Alpine town nestled in a broad valley surrounded by mountains. In the foreground stands a large church with a patterned tile roof and a tall Gothic-style bell tower, dominating the clustered roofs of the town. Beyond the town are open fields stretching toward distant mountains. At the bottom left, stylized white text reads "Predazzo  Panorama," identifying the place and the type of view.

Black‑and‑white image showing a busy wooden pier where a crowd of people in early‑20th‑century clothing watch or board a steamship named "STYRSÖ". The vessel is moored alongside the pier with smoke coming from its funnel, and another similar boat is visible in the background.
