Low rocky shores with scattered wooden houses line the opposite side of the waterway, and flags fly from poles near the pier. The overall look is that of a historical coastal ferry scene.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from an elevated, wooded vantage point. In the foreground are dense trees; beyond them lies a compact town with traditional gabled roofs and prominent church towers, one especially tall on the right. Open fields and gently rolling countryside stretch into the distance under a cloudy sky. A printed caption in German appears along the bottom edge.

A hand‑colored postcard view of a rural landscape with a long red‑roofed farmhouse or estate set among trees at the base of a green hill. A dirt road and fields are in the foreground. On the hilltop in the distance stands a small tower. Red printed German captions identify the scene as being near Sangerhausen and mentioning the Engelsburg with the Moltke‑Warte.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European spa town nestled among forested hills and fields. The town has a notable church with a tall spire in the left foreground and a compact cluster of villas and multi‑storey houses extending along a valley. The surrounding countryside is largely wooded with patches of farmland. At the bottom left of the image, the caption 'Bad Elster' is printed.

A black‑and‑white view down a narrow, rock‑cut path or ravine framed by high stone walls, with a simple stone arch bridging the gap overhead. Two women in long dresses and wide-brimmed hats walk along the path. Through the arch one can see a town with low, flat-roofed buildings, a prominent church tower with a dome or belfry, open fields beyond, and distant hills or mountains under a hazy sky. The overall look is early‑20th‑century rural or small‑town setting.

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a broad river in the foreground with trees and bushes along its banks. Across the river lie open fields and a cluster of buildings, including a prominent light‑colored institutional building, likely a school, with forested hills in the distant background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and a photographer's signature at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling European city street with a grand neoclassical theatre building dominating the right side. The building has a richly decorated pediment with sculptures, arched windows on the ground floor, Corinthian columns above, and statues along the roofline. Electric trams, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing move along a broad cobbled avenue with tram tracks. Multi‑story historicist buildings line the street, and in the far distance a tall, narrow Gothic‑style church spire rises over the city. Trees and a small garden sit in front of the theatre.

A black‑and‑white image showing the ruins of a tall, steep‑roofed stone building with narrow arched windows, likely part of a medieval church or monastery. The gabled stone walls are partially collapsed and surrounded by an orchard or garden with several fruit trees and grass in the foreground. Dense trees and bushes grow around and behind the ruined structure. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Scandinavian fishing harbor lined with wooden houses and boathouses, many with pitched roofs and small docks. Numerous fishing vessels and small boats are moored along both sides of the narrow inlet. In the foreground are moored sailboats and a wooden ramp or pier. Low rocky islands are visible in the background. The caption at the bottom left reads "Smögen. Hamnen." and there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 284 at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned photograph of a planned residential square with several four-story apartment blocks surrounding an open grassy area. In the center stands a statue on a stone pedestal. A 1930s-style car is parked on the unpaved road running along the right side. The buildings have simple, functionalist facades and gabled roofs typical of interwar Central European workers' housing estates.

Color-tinted postcard showing a riverside landscape with steep cliffs and a castle complex on the left hill, another ruined castle with two towers on a hill in the center-right, and the river Saale flowing through a wooded valley. On the right side of the card there is a short poem printed in red Gothic-style script. At the bottom, in red text, are the caption identifying the view and the publisher details.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small wooden house with a tiled roof nestled in a dense forest. In the foreground there is a small pavilion or gazebo with a hipped roof and railings. The scene is entirely wooded, with tall trees and heavy foliage surrounding the structures. Handwritten-style text appears along the bottom margin of the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm lakeshore landscape. There are reeds in the foreground, small rowing boats at the water's edge and on the lake, and forested shores in the distance. Trees frame the right side of the image. Along the bottom border, printed text identifies the scene as being in Finland and specifies the locality Kuhmoinen.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a coastal village with scattered wooden houses among rocky terrain, trees, and fences. In the background are low, rugged islands and calm water with a few small boats and piers. The scene looks out over an archipelago landscape. Printed text at the top left reads "Parti från Styrsö Tånge".

Sepia-toned scenic postcard showing a broad forested landscape with fields, scattered farm buildings, and a lake in the distance. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text describing the landscape of Edsleskog, along with a regional designation, publisher mark, and photographer credit.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an elegant, tree‑lined avenue in a spa town. Ornate multi‑story buildings with decorative facades, balconies, awnings, and ground‑floor shops line the left side of the street. Signs on the buildings include hotel names and shop fronts. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and a few horse‑drawn carriages are visible on the right. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as Marienbad, Obere Kaiserstraße, with the building Fürstenhof noted.

Sepia-toned photograph of a richly decorated Gothic Revival church interior, centered on a tall stone altar and reredos with pointed arches, pinnacles, and statues of saints. Behind the altar are large stained-glass windows; on either side are side aisles with traceried railings and coats of arms. Statues stand in niches to the left and right. In the foreground is a baptismal font or lectern on a small pedestal, with steps leading up to the sanctuary.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a Macedonian rural family posed in front of a stone wall with hanging cloths. Several women and men in traditional Balkan folk dress stand or sit, some holding small children. The scene appears ethnographic and rustic, likely in a village near Monastir/Bitola.

A black-and-white postcard image depicting a coastal Scandinavian village with wooden houses characterized by steep roofs and decorative woodwork. Rocky terrain surrounds the calm water, and a few boats or docks can be seen. The architecture features traditional Nordic elements and the landscape is rugged with minimal vegetation. The distinctive name 'Hällevikstrand' appears at the bottom left of the image, and a triangular insignia with the number '138' appears at the bottom right.

The postcard displays a panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a green, hilly landscape. Several clusters of red-roofed houses are visible, along with two prominent churches with steeples—one in the center and one larger church on a hill to the right. The name of the town is written in elegant script at the bottom of the postcard.

A vintage black-and-white illustration showing a fortified castle or town under siege, with smoke clouds from cannon fire and curved trajectories of cannonballs overhead. The main building appears to have a church-like structure and watchtowers, all behind strong walls set on a raised mound. The words 'Düna' and 'Fluvius' are labeled on the rivers, and the caption below reads 'Die Belagerung von Kokenhusen i. J. 1700.'

The image shows an illustration of a woman in traditional folk costume, holding a large wicker basket. The design is vintage, with muted colors typical of historical postcards. There is printed text in Russian and German, with a mention of 'Oeselsche Bauertrachten' and 'Pyha', suggesting a focus on regional folk dress. The publisher's imprint is printed vertically along the left edge.

A black-and-white image depicting a hillside with terraced vineyards and scattered trees, overlooking a small town or suburb with neat, early-20th century European houses and a winding road. On top of the hill to the left stands a small domed structure that appears to be a chapel or a mausoleum. Additional buildings and villas are visible dotted across the hillside.

A vintage, color-tinted postcard showing a wide boulevard lined with ornate, historic buildings, with visible tram tracks and an old-fashioned tram traveling along the street. Pedestrians and a horse-drawn carriage add a turn-of-the-century feel. The street is named 'Herrengasse' and is located in Graz, as indicated by the text at the top right. The buildings feature classical European architecture with decorative facades and domed towers in the background.

The image is a colorized vintage postcard showing an electric tram on a tall, arched bridge. On the left, there are trees, while in the distance is a wide landscape view with water and green fields on the right. There is a sign in Dutch and text printed in the upper left corner that reads 'Mooi Nederland, Nijmegen.' The tram runs under overhead electrical wires supported by lattice towers.

Two western towers have pointed spires and the two eastern towers are more squat and rounded. In the foreground are traditional townhouses with tiled roofs. At the lower right, white script text identifies the location as "Naumburg a.d. Saale."

Black‑and‑white streetscape showing a broad, slightly curving avenue lined with ornate late‑19th‑century brick and stone townhouses on the left. Ground floors contain shops and a clearly visible sign reading "HOTEL" above an arched entrance in one of the buildings. On the right stands a high wrought‑iron fence with stone gate pillars topped by round finials, enclosing a leafy garden and a large villa or institutional building with a tiled roof and decorative gables. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the pavements and a horse‑drawn carriage is visible further down the road. The street surface appears unpaved or only lightly paved, and there are telegraph poles along the road.

A sepia-toned view of a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a calm river, with its arches and the buildings beyond reflected clearly in the water. On the far bank stands a large, plain, multi‑storey industrial-looking building (possibly a mill or factory) and a smaller residential or administrative house to the right. Trees line the background. The image has wide margins like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a rural riverside settlement with fields and scattered houses in the foreground, a large multi-span steel truss bridge crossing a wide river at mid-ground, and gently rising hills with more villages in the distance. The caption in the upper right reads "Niederwartha a. Elbe." The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A religious postcard featuring an image of the Madonna holding the Christ Child, framed by a decorative floral and green vine border. Below the image there is Italian text referring to the Sanctuary of the Madonna dell'Aiuto in Segonzano. A postmark is partially visible in the lower right corner, reinforcing that this is a mailed postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an urban square with a tall obelisk-style monument on the left and a large domed Orthodox cathedral on the right. The cathedral has multiple domes topped with crosses, ornate façades, and a wide staircase leading to the main entrance. Printed multilingual captions appear at the top in Bulgarian, English, and French.

Black-and-white landscape view across a calm river toward a forested hillside. At the foot of the hill stands a small half-timbered building surrounded by trees and a fence. In the foreground is the riverbank; in the background dense woodland covers the slopes. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Black-and-white postcard view of a church largely hidden behind tall leafy trees in a park-like setting. The church has tall spires in a neo-gothic style. At the bottom margin, white printed text identifies the location and photographer/publisher.

A black‑and‑white postcard view taken from under a stone arch, likely a bridge, looking along a shallow rocky river. On the right side stand old, overhanging traditional houses with white facades, wooden beams, and many windows, built directly on a tall stone wall lining the riverbank. The setting appears to be a historic Balkan town. In the top left corner there is printed text in Cyrillic.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a middle‑aged man wearing round glasses, a dark suit, white shirt, and tie. The background is plain and softly blurred. In the lower left corner appears the photographer's name, printed in white: "H. RAUDSEPP." The image has the aesthetic of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic sunset behind a dark hill line, with rays breaking through clouds over calm water in the foreground. Low vegetation lines the shore, and part of a small boat appears at the lower left. Printed captions in Greek and English at the bottom describe the scene as a sunset in the Gulf of Volo.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing an urban street scene lined with tall mid‑20th‑century office buildings. Cars and a few pedestrians move along a wide avenue running through the center of the image. The caption at the bottom reads "COMMISSIONER ST., JOHANNESBURG," indicating a view along Commissioner Street in central Johannesburg.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a woman in an early-20th-century dress and hat walking down a stone stairway built into old masonry walls, surrounded by dense foliage. The scene is labeled as being from Kronenburgerpark. Printed captions and a handwritten signature are visible on the front.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a busy European square with ornate late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings, shop awnings, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians. A decorative column or statue stands in a small garden in the foreground. Prominent façades include an Art Nouveau building labeled "AMERICAN HOUSE" and adjacent shops with large glass windows. Storefront signage in Hungarian is visible on multiple buildings.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a wooden railway station building with a gabled central section and two lower wings. A sign on the upper façade reads "BODAFORS" and there is a clock above the main entrance. Multiple railway tracks run across the foreground, with overhead power lines above. Trees frame the station on both sides. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border and a small number is printed in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) postcard view of a town square with a central stone monument topped by a large eagle sculpture. The monument stands within a low fenced area and bears several German inscriptions. In the background are trees, a church or large brick building to the left, and a two‑story house to the right with signage for a restaurant and café. At the top of the postcard, printed in red, is the location name "Dommitzsch a. Elbe."

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the richly decorated interior façade of an Islamic madrasa with arched doorways and intricate geometric tilework. The lower border contains a printed French caption identifying the location in Meknes and the Bou Inania Madrasa.

A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a dense religious procession moving through a town square. Clergy and robed participants walk in formation around a richly decorated reliquary carried on poles, with a statue and banners visible. Large crowds line both sides of the street in front of Flemish-style gabled buildings. Printed captions in French appear under the image, identifying the scene as the Procession of the Holy Blood in Bruges with English pilgrims carrying a relic of St Thomas of Canterbury, and crediting the phototype printer in Antwerp.

Colored historic street scene showing a broad intersection lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. On the right is a long, light-yellow building with a red-tiled roof and a church tower with a cross rising behind it. Horse-drawn carts and carriages stand on the street, and pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. The image is framed by handwritten script along the right margin and printed text in Hungarian at the top and along the left side, indicating it is a greeting from Pécs and naming the street as Ferenciek utca.

Black‑and‑white postcard with two panoramic photographs of a large historic estate surrounded by trees and lawns. The upper photo shows a partly obscured mansion behind tall trees; the lower photo shows a grand, ornate castle-like building with towers and a wide lawn in front, where a few animals (likely cows or horses) are grazing. Dutch captions identify the site as Kasteel Oud Wassenaar and note a connection with The Hague. There is some faint handwritten text beneath the printed postcard image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined street with early 20th‑century multi‑story stone buildings on the left, including a corner building with steep spires and ornate detailing. People and a cart are faintly visible in the distance. Printed captions at the bottom read the place name and the street name, with a handwritten message in Swedish across the lower margin.

Vintage tinted photograph of a large two‑storey school building on a hillside, with symmetrical wings, tall rectangular windows, and wooden siding. A picket fence runs along the street in the foreground, and there are steps and railings leading up to the entrance. Low hills or a wooded slope rise behind the building. At the bottom margin, printed in red, is a Romanian caption.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European village taken from a distance across open fields. A winding country road leads toward clustered houses and farm buildings. One prominent structure on a hilltop is a church with a square tower and steep spire. The village is surrounded by trees and gentle hills, with no modern cars or infrastructure visible.

A colorized historic postcard view of a curved, tree-lined street flanked by tall, ornate multi‑story buildings with 19th‑century European architecture. The street runs through a park‑like setting with pavilions or kiosks among the trees. At the bottom, red cursive text identifies the place, and there is small printer information along the margins.

Black‑and‑white view of a central European town square with cobblestone ground, lined with 2–3‑storey gabled houses bearing painted shop signs in German. In the background rises a large church with a tall, slender spire and smaller flanking spires. People and a few carts or early automobiles are visible at the edge of the square. The image has wide white margins like an old photographic postcard.

A colorized vintage view of a large urban square with gardens, palm trees, walking paths, and people strolling. Surrounding the square are multi‑story neoclassical buildings with shops and signage. There are ornate street lamps, a few carriages, and low hills in the background. The caption at the top identifies the location in Greek and French.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a gently sloping market square in a small town surrounded by low hills. Several multi‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs line the square; one has a small tower or steeple. In the foreground stands a large stone fountain or trough, with a person nearby, and another person is walking across the open square. Printed red text at the top identifies the place as Lauenstein in the Saxon Erzgebirge and the view as the market. Publisher information is printed at the bottom.

A colored cartoon illustration showing anthropomorphic animals around an early automobile. A bear wearing a cap and smoking a pipe stands at the left near the car's hood. A smaller animal, possibly a monkey or dog in clothes, works on the open front of the car. Another figure lies on the ground under the vehicle, apparently repairing it. On the right stands a well‑dressed female animal in a long green dress and hat, with two small white dogs nearby. The car is an old-fashioned open tourer with large padded seats and brass-colored front.

An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a small ornate classical pavilion or gate with arched openings and sculptural decorations, standing among tall trees in a park-like setting. To the right is a long, low building with arched windows. The word "Gulbene" is printed in red at the top of the image, and a small number appears in white in the lower left corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large brick institutional building on a corner, likely a hospital, with three stories and a mansard-style roof. Trees line the street in front, with a few pedestrians walking on the sidewalk. In the background to the right stands a church with a tall, narrow tower and spire. The captions in red German text at the bottom identify the location and buildings.

A vintage black-and-white street scene labeled in French as "SALONIQUE — Boulevard Roi Constantin". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather around a monument or column in the middle of a broad boulevard, with low buildings, carts, and a distant hillside cityscape visible in the background. The style and layout resemble an early photographic postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a dusty main street lined with low, flat‑roofed buildings and market stalls. Many people in traditional dress walk along the street, with carts and small structures visible on both sides. At the top of the postcard there is printed Russian and French text referring to Manchuria and a general view of the city taken from the city tower.

A black-and-white postcard showing a country road lined with trees and a low stone wall leading toward a tall, white church tower with a distinctive domed roof and small cupola. The tower has arched openings near the top and a small circular window on its side. In the lower left corner is a caption, and in the lower right is a small oval logo indicating a photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a tree-lined road leading to a narrow bridge over a river. On the left side there is a large multi‑windowed building, likely a house or inn, in a small rural settlement. People can be seen walking on the bridge. The setting appears quiet and village-like, with forested land in the background. A faint printed word in the upper left seems to read something like a place name, possibly starting with 'Maltors' or 'Mulfors'.

The image shows the back side of an old, yellowed postcard with printed French heading "CARTE POSTALE" and the phrase "Ce côté est exclusivement réservé à l'adresse". Below, in elegant red cursive handwriting, the card is addressed in Spanish to "Sr. D. Benito Pérez Galdós" with the address "Rambla de Cataluña, Interior". At the top there is a penciled numeric note "25–89–1 – D". The card has no visible stamp or picture side in this view.

A sepia-toned portrait of a young man in a light-colored military-style uniform with shoulder boards, standing and facing the camera. The background is plain and softly faded, giving a studio-portrait look. Printed text appears along the bottom edge in Greek on the left and in French on the right, and there is a round seal or emblem at the lower left plus a website credit at the bottom center.

A monochrome vintage view over a wooded valley in the Ore Mountains with several villas and guesthouses in an open meadow at the base of steep forested hills. The foreground shows fenced gardens and fields, while large bourgeois-style houses with steep roofs and small towers stand along a road at the edge of the forest. Printed captions on the sky area label the locality and individual buildings.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal town with many low, tiled-roof buildings in the foreground and a rugged mountain rising steeply behind it. At the top left, printed text reads "Vista Geral - S. Vicente, Cabo Verde," suggesting a general view of São Vicente island in Cape Verde.

A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a riverside view of a historic hilltop complex with Gothic cathedral spires and a large adjacent palace above the Elbe River. Trees frame the scene in the foreground, with houses and riverfront buildings at the base of the hill and a boat on the water. A caption in German is printed in cursive at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterfront park with many ducks and birds along the shoreline. A tree and seated people appear on the right, while a long bridge crosses the water in the mid‑ground toward a forested hillside. Printed captions in Swedish identify the scene and the photographer/publisher.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a church with a tall clock tower and spire beside a landscaped square with a pond and small fountain in the foreground. A turreted corner building stands on the left, trees and paths encircle the water, and a few people walk along the paths. Printed German text appears at the top of the image indicating the location as Coswig in Saxony and the Anlagen (gardens/grounds) at Wettin Square.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene in Suez, with several people in traditional clothing walking along a narrow street lined with low buildings and balconies. On the right a signboard for a hotel ("Hotel Orient") is visible, and the overall style is early 20th‑century urban architecture.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a formal terraced garden with stone arches, balustrades, and decorative finials. A path leads through a rosarium toward a domed pavilion and staircase structures adorned with statues. In the background are town buildings and a hilly landscape. German text is printed at the top identifying the site and locality.

Black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped public square with paths, benches, flowerbeds and trees. In the foreground a woman pushes a baby carriage and people sit on benches. At the center is a nude statue on a pedestal. In the background stands a large ornate brick building with steep roofs, gables, and a clock above the entrance. The caption at the bottom left identifies the location, and there is a small printer/photographer credit in the bottom right.

Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet village street with a cobblestone road in the foreground. On the right are simple one‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs, wooden framed windows with shutters, and plastered facades; one house appears more worn. A picket fence and dense bushes or trees run along the middle of the scene. There is a tall, thin wooden pole at the edge of the street, and a signboard above a window in the brick building partly hidden by foliage. The overall atmosphere is rural and early‑20th‑century.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a forested hilly landscape with a large grand‑hotel style building dominating the center. Smaller villas and buildings are scattered on the slopes, and a tower stands on a distant hilltop to the left. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Karlsbad and mentions Hotel Imperial and Freundschaftshöhe.

Sepia-toned vintage interior view of a hairdressing salon with mirrors along the wall, barber chairs, and workstations. The layout suggests an early 20th‑century European barbershop/ladies' hairdresser. Printed text in a Scandinavian language appears at the top and bottom margins and along the sides.

Sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a small European town with densely packed houses, villas, and larger institutional-looking buildings on a hillside. A prominent church tower rises above the complex of large roofed buildings, possibly part of a monastery or castle. In the foreground there are open fields, while the midground and background are filled with trees and multi‑story townhouses. Printed red caption text appears along the bottom margin, with publisher information printed in smaller text.

Black‑and‑white printed postcard view of a busy urban street lined with large historic buildings in a European architectural style. The scene shows multi‑storey stone structures, including one with domed corner towers and another with a columned façade. The street is filled with pedestrians, cars, and a double‑decker bus. At the bottom margin, a caption identifies the scene as 'ADDERLEY STREET, CAPE TOWN.'

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels, each showing a different building in a small town or village. The upper left image shows a wide open square with a traditional half‑timbered house and other gabled houses. The upper right image shows a more formal institutional building with a central entrance portal and a small tower or belfry above the roof. The lower left view depicts a solid three‑storey building with arched ground‑floor windows and a steep tiled roof, likely a civic or school building. The lower right image shows another half‑timbered house attached to a simpler building, surrounded by trees and garden plots. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.

An old, sepia-toned postcard showing a small spa settlement by a pond or lake, with several wooden buildings and a couple of larger houses in front of a forested hillside. The printed caption at the top left reads "Sobányafürdő Torda." There are age spots and wear marks on the card.

Color postcard view of a historic Italian piazza on a sunny day. On the left is a red‑stucco Baroque church with a green and yellow tiled dome. In the center stands a row of old palazzi with arcades at street level and green awnings over shopfronts. To the right is a large ornate baroque fountain crowded with statues and water basins, and behind it rises a tall stone medieval clock tower with battlements. People walk around the square and a few 1960s–1970s-era cars are parked along the buildings. Red flowers are visible in the foreground.

Colorized landscape view of a rural village nestled in rolling green hills, with scattered farmhouses and buildings with red-tiled roofs. A road winds through the valley and there are fields and wooded areas in the background. At the top left is printed text indicating the place name, and there is faint handwritten script across the sky area.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a long, two-storey plastered building with a pitched roof and evenly spaced rectangular windows. Simple decorative frames surround the upper-storey windows. There are trees and a dirt path in the foreground, and a single man standing near one of the trees. Red printed Hungarian text appears at the top of the image.

Black-and-white postcard showing a wooden chalet-style building perched dramatically on a rocky slope in a forested park. Several people stand on the balcony and by the entrance. The photo is framed by bare tree branches. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in red, along with a publisher line and a serial number.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large masonry railway viaduct with multiple tall arches crossing a river in a valley. There is a dirt road with stone posts along the right edge, dense vegetation by the river in the foreground, and wooded hills in the background. German text is printed in the sky area at the top left.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of camels and riders halted on a dirt road beside low stone buildings and cypress trees. Several men in light colonial-style clothing stand or sit on camels, while other camels are resting on the ground with loads. At the top left there is a small printed French caption. The lower part of the image is heavily covered with handwritten cursive text in French.

A monochrome postcard showing a stone wall with large ancient inscribed blocks bearing Greek text (the famous law code inscription) set outdoors beside a tree and a simple railing. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Greek and French identifying the subject, along with a small circular number and the website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".

Colorized vintage postcard showing a severely damaged house with collapsed wooden roof trusses and piles of bricks in the foreground. Behind it is a tall brick wall of another building. The sky is pale blue. The image is heavily overprinted with handwritten text in ink. At the top margin there is printed text with several language variants of the place name: 'Zemun. – Semlin. – Zimony.'

Vintage monochrome view of a European plaza with a circular fountain at its center, surrounded by manicured trees and people walking. Dominating the scene is an ornate Renaissance-style palazzo with arcades on the ground floor, arched windows on the upper floor, and a balustraded balcony. The square is framed by multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows and shopfronts at street level. Hills or low mountains with scattered villas and cypress trees rise in the background, creating a picturesque Italianate landscape. The image has an aged, sepia-toned appearance and a thin white border, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the picture side.

A vintage multiview illustrated postcard showing several scenes of a riverside or lakeside town. The top left view depicts a large classical building and surrounding parkland; the bottom left shows quays, boats, and waterfront buildings; the right view shows steamships and sailing vessels on open water with a pier or harbor. In the center is a circular vignette of a smaller civic-looking building. Decorative flowers and ornate lettering spell out a greeting and the town name, "Wenersborg." The layout leaves a blank space on the right for writing.

Sepia-toned wartime postcard showing ruined buildings and rubble in the foreground with a tall church steeple in the background. The scene depicts heavy destruction, likely from shelling or fire. Printed German text appears at the upper right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large multi-storey school building with many rectangular windows, a columned entrance porch on the left and a smaller portico with balcony on the right. The architecture is early-20th‑century German style. In the foreground is an open yard or street casting long shadows. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place and type of school.

Black‑and‑white photo of a rural mountain scene with a wooden lodge or café on a hillside, a gravel road in the foreground, and a row of mid‑20th‑century cars parked along the roadside. Forested slopes rise behind the building, and a small ski‑lift or rope‑tow structure is visible on the hillside, suggesting a ski or mountain resort. No visible caption or printed border text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside path lined with tall trees leading toward a body of water on the left, and on the right a wooded hillside with stairs and a railing ascending to an ornate historic building featuring a tower and steep roof. At the top of the image are printed captions naming the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a small industrial town with many chimneys and dense, low buildings, seen from a slightly elevated vantage point with trees and fields in the foreground. At the bottom in red print it reads "Rumburg i. B." and in smaller type "6491 Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1905."

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a serene park landscape. In the foreground there is a small arched wooden pedestrian bridge with railings, leading to a winding path that curves through lush trees and shrubs. In the background, partially framed by trees, stands a small church with a tower and steep hipped roof, typical of Central European village churches. Low wooded hills rise behind the church.

Colorized view of a large, pale-colored, multi‑storey barracks building with a red roof and a central clock tower. The long rectangular structure faces a broad tree‑lined avenue or promenade where small, finely dressed figures are walking. The words "Turnau." appear at the upper left and "Kaserne." at the upper right.

Black-and-white image of a church complex with a modern-looking main nave and a traditional tower. The tower has a prominent onion-shaped dome topped with a cross and a clock face, characteristic of Central European Baroque church towers. The nave features a steeply pitched roof and a long row of vertical windows. A low stone wall borders the street in the foreground, with some trees partially obscuring the buildings. Forested hills are visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky. There is no visible caption or printed text on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street with tram tracks and a tramcar moving toward the viewer. Tree‑lined sidewalks and low houses flank the road. In the distant background, a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires dominates the skyline. The caption at the top reads "Upsala. Sysslomansgatan." and the sign on the tram also says "SYSSLOMANSGATAN."

Hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a tree‑lined park path with an obelisk‑shaped war memorial enclosed by a decorative metal fence and flower beds on the left. There is a bench and a few people walking along the path. The sky is softly tinted in orange and blue. Red printed German captions appear at the bottom.

A vintage tinted photograph of a seated woman wearing elaborate traditional Greek folk costume, including an embroidered dress, apron, vest, and headscarf. She is posed in a studio setting with a painted landscape background. Printed captions appear at the bottom margin of the card.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wooden railway station building with a tiled gable roof, chimneys, and several windows framed in white. Railway tracks run along the front platform. Trees surround the station. In the upper right corner is printed text indicating the name of the place and that it is the railway station.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the entrance to a castle complex. A curved stone bridge and walls lead to a gatehouse and main building with steep tiled roofs. A small tower with a bulbous dome and cross rises above. Several people, including children, stand or walk along the approach. Trees frame the scene. Printed red text at the top reads the location and indicates it is the entrance to the castle.

Black-and-white vintage street scene showing a European town with cobblestone pavement, tall masonry buildings with shutters, people in early-20th‑century clothing walking and gathering around carts or market stalls, and mountains rising in the background. A domed church or chapel is visible further down the street.

Black-and-white postcard showing an interior view of a richly sculpted Romanesque-Gothic cathedral portal, with multiple archivolts filled with dense reliefs of biblical scenes and rows of elongated standing saints on tall columns. The photograph looks obliquely along the portal so that the carved figures and columns recede into the distance; the floor is a checkerboard pattern. In the lower left corner there is faint printed text indicating an institution name.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town in a broad valley with patchwork fields, scattered farmhouses, and low hills or mountains in the background. The settlement has mainly wooden and low masonry buildings, a railway line with train cars along the edge, and a larger institutional-looking building in the foreground. Printed white caption text appears near the bottom right of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide urban boulevard lined with multi‑story neoclassical buildings on the left and a fenced garden or park on the right. A few pedestrians and early motor vehicles appear on the road. In the distance, a rocky hill with structures on top rises over the city. Text at the bottom in English and Greek identifies the scene as Amelie Boulevard in Athens. A modern watermark with a website URL is also visible.

Old sepia-toned Spanish postal card with printed heading "TARJETA POSTAL", a pre-printed 10-céntimos stamp showing a profile portrait, and the Spanish royal coat of arms in the center. Handwritten address lines fill the middle, and a printed note appears at the bottom left.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a stone wall and large metal cage structure with arched iron bars, likely an animal enclosure, in front of terraced stone landscaping and greenery. At the bottom edge there is faint red printed text identifying the place.

A colorized historic street scene showing a busy European square with multi‑story brick and plaster buildings, awnings, shop signs, pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and electric trams on tracks. In the background stands a tall white church tower. The lower right corner contains handwriting in black ink and a red printed greeting caption.

Black‑and‑white printed postcard showing an industrial sawmill complex beside a waterfront or log yard. Several long wooden buildings stand on slightly raised ground with elevated ramps or conveyors leading down toward a muddy shoreline strewn with logs and timber. Three small human figures are visible in the yard. The image is bordered by a white margin containing printed Finnish text and a photographer credit, plus a handwritten number at the lower left.

Vintage illustrated Easter postcard showing a young girl with red hair and a red bow, wearing a red dress and white apron, holding a rectangular wicker basket on a table. On the table is a cloth decorated with floral patterns and beside her stands a vase filled with yellow daffodils. At the bottom, in cursive script, is the greeting 'Glad Påsk'.

A black-and-white rural scene showing several large wooden houses and farm buildings surrounded by orchards or fields, with forested hills in the background. Tree branches frame the view from above. The image has a printed caption at the top left indicating the location.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large multi‑storey hospital complex in a rural valley with forested hills and patchwork fields in the background. The main building has a central tower-like section with vertical windows and long wings extending on both sides. Small houses and garden plots dot the hillside behind it. At the bottom margin there is a white printed caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned street curving between a large corner building labeled "HÔTEL DE SA…" on the left and a tree‑lined park with a bust statue on a pedestal on the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand along the street, including children and adults, some with prams or carts. The architecture is European, with three‑story stucco townhouses receding into the distance.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm lake or river bordered by dense forest. In the mid‑ground there is a small wooden house or cottage on a narrow peninsula or island, its reflection visible in the still water. A rowboat with a person inside is on the water in front of the house. Trees frame the scene in the foreground, including a birch tree on the right. The sky is cloudy, and in the lower right corner there is printed text in Finnish.

Color-printed interior view of a large beer hall or restaurant with high wooden ceilings, ornate yellow chandeliers, white tablecloth-covered tables, and carved wooden chairs. Deer antlers line the walls, and decorative woodwork and arched windows frame the back of the hall. Text at the bottom identifies it as a concert hall in the Bräuhaus restaurant in Puntigam.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a riverside town with hills in the background. In the foreground, several steam-powered boats and barges move along a wide river with quays and railway tracks on the bank. On the right, a large baroque-style castle or palace complex with a tall tower sits on a wooded hill above the river. The town with dense historic buildings stretches into the valley behind. Red printed German text is visible at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white street scene in a small town. A dirt or lightly paved road runs through the center, lined with two‑storey wooden and masonry buildings. On the left is an older wooden house with a shopfront at street level and a signboard above the entrance. A few pedestrians walk along the street, some in coats or long dresses, and bicycles are visible. Telephones or power lines run along wooden poles beside the road. Trees partly shade the buildings and the sky is mostly clear.

Colorized historic postcard view of two grand multi‑story hotels or villas in a landscaped park. The buildings are ornate with towers, domes, balconies, and red roofs, and are labeled on the façades. Well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along paths and gather near an automobile and a decorative fountain. Statues and lush greenery surround the scene. Red printed German text at the top reads the location and names of the buildings.

Colorized vintage view of a riverside scene. In the foreground is a calm river crossed by a narrow wooden footbridge on supports. On the far bank stands a large wooden house with a red roof and several adjoining outbuildings, surrounded by tall trees and greenery. At the top center of the image the word "OBERPAHLEN." is printed in red capital letters.

Colorized vintage street view of a spa town promenade. On the left stands a large multi‑story classical building with green shutters and manicured trees in front. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the wide avenue, while a horse‑drawn carriage moves down the center. The street is lined with trees and elegant buildings, with a red‑roofed structure visible in the distance. The caption at the top reads "Bad Elster."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close view of large, precisely cut Inca stone blocks forming a wall. On the left stands an Indigenous person wearing traditional Andean clothing (a poncho and cap). At the top, printed text in Spanish identifies the location as Cuzco, Peru, and refers to the famous twelve‑angled stone in the palace of the Inca Roca.

Black-and-white postcard showing the interior of a Romanesque church with massive stone piers and noticeably leaning arches. The view looks down a side nave toward the altar area. At the bottom margin is printed caption text in Spanish along with an editor credit.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a Central European riverside town. In the foreground there is a steeply roofed villa with timber detailing and turrets. Below, curving railway tracks run parallel to the river, with a station area and several multi‑storey urban buildings in late‑19th‑century style. On the right, passenger steamers are moored along a quay where people walk beside the water. In the background, terraced fields and wooded hills rise sharply, including a bright rock or quarry face cut into the hillside.

Black-and-white postcard showing an ancient marble structure with two fluted columns supporting a heavily decorated entablature featuring relief sculpture. The object is displayed indoors like in a museum setting. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two main images and floral ornaments. On the left is a narrow old European street scene labelled "HOFGASSE MIT STIEGENKÄCHE" showing tall town houses, shop signs and a small church tower in the background. At the top left a banner reads "Gruss aus Graz." On the right is the storefront of a shop with the sign "ANTON A. SCHWARZ" above arched windows and a central door. Below this image a ribbon‑style caption mentions the types of goods sold. There is faint handwritten correspondence in pencil covering the lower right area of the card.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a traditional wooden windmill on the edge of a wide canal or river, with attached low buildings and industrial chimneys in the background. The image has a white border with deckled edges, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Black‑and‑white street scene of a European city, showing a cobblestone avenue lined with mid‑rise stone and brick buildings. On the left is a large bank building with the word "PANKKI" above the entrance and a circular emblem on the wall. On the right is another substantial masonry building with bold exterior columns and signage high on the facade. Vintage cars and a few pedestrians occupy the street. In the lower right corner, the printed caption reads "KOTKA".

Sepia-toned historic photograph showing a Catholic religious procession in front of a Baroque-style church or monastery. Clergy, altar boys and many women and girls in white dresses line up outside the main portal, which has a gabled pediment with a cross on top and decorative relief. To the right stands a small chapel or side structure with a dome-like roof and a canopy set up for the ceremony, with banners and processional lanterns. The architecture has stuccoed walls, rectangular and arched windows with wrought-iron grilles, and a tiled roof, evoking a Central European Baroque church complex.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a wide rural landscape with rolling green hills, scattered farmhouses, fields in the distance and a small road or path in the foreground. At the bottom margin is handwritten text, and printed in red is the place name. Along the left margin, vertically, is the printer's credit.

Color postcard showing a river scene with a hydrofoil boat cruising in the foreground. On the opposite bank stands a classical city embankment with trees and large historic buildings, dominated by a large domed cathedral with a golden cupola. The printed Russian captions below the image read "ЛЕНИНГРАД." on the left and "На Неве." on the right, with handwritten blue ink in the lower-right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an old stone house with a wooden arched door, cracked masonry, and a leafless tree leaning across the foreground. A rectangular window with metal bars is visible on the right side. Below the image there is multilingual caption text in Greek and French identifying the location in Ierapetra, Crete, and mentioning that Napoleon spent a night there. The web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed over the lower right corner.

Black-and-white image of a grand suspension bridge crossing a wide river in a European city. The bridge has massive stone pylons and ornate steel towers topped with sculptural details. Pedestrians and a few carriages are visible on the roadway. On the far riverbank stands a dense row of historic multi‑story buildings with spires and domes; boats line the quayside. Trees and a landscaped park occupy the near foreground.

Black‑and‑white view of a walled courtyard or inner bailey of a large stone castle or fortress. The scene is lined with tall, pruned trees along a broad path leading toward an arched gateway set in a Renaissance or Baroque portal on the far wall. High, steeply pitched, tiled roofs with small dormers and irregularly spaced windows top the thick masonry walls. A few men in early 20th‑century attire stand and talk on the path, giving a peaceful, park‑like impression inside the castle complex.

Colorized historic postcard view of a town hall with a tall clock tower rising above a multi‑story building with ornate façades and red-tiled roofs. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across a square in front of the building. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. Printed captions at the top read "Löbau i. Sa." on the left and "Rathaus." on the right.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a cobblestoned market square with a circular fountain in the foreground and a row of 2–3 storey townhouses with shops, inns, and signage in German along the ground floor. A horse-drawn carriage is visible at the left and another near an archway on the right. At the bottom in red print it reads "Königsbrück. Marktplatz." and publishing information dated 1906.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground stands a dark stone obelisk‑like monument partly surrounded by bushes and shrubs. Beyond it lies a village with scattered houses, larger villas and buildings among trees, with rolling fields and wooded ridges in the background. The caption at the top reads "Bärenfels — Ost-Erzgebirge".

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large baroque-style convent or school complex with a central tower and long wings, set in front of wooded hills and a small city. In the distant left hillside a clock- or watch‑tower is visible, and there is another small chapel or tower on the hill ridge. Trees and a fenced area or garden occupy the foreground. White printed caption text appears in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left, buildings and a villa-like structure stand at the foot of a wooded hill, with a castle-style structure labeled as Geipelburg further along the bank. A cobbled path runs beside the river, where a lone figure walks. On the right, a river steamer with a tall smokestack moves along the water, and in the distance a metal truss bridge spans the river, with a town and church towers on the far bank. Red printed text at the top identifies the location, and a publisher credit with date appears at the bottom.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a crowd gathered around an early experimental flying machine or airship gondola mounted on a wagon with large wooden wheels, in a field. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing are working on or inspecting the machine, which features a large propeller at the rear. In the lower left corner appears a handwritten studio mark reading "Atelier Pünat" (or similar). The image has the proportions and border style of an old photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white view through tall leafy trees of a landscaped park or garden, with lawns, shrubs, and flowerbeds in the foreground. In the background, partly hidden by the trees, stands a large late‑19th‑century style building with arched windows, a steep roof, and a tower-like gable topped by a slender spire or finial. The image has wide borders like an old photographic postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.

Color image of a round medieval stone tower with a conical red-tile roof and a wooden gallery encircling the upper part. The tower stands by a dirt road bordered by leafless and budding trees, suggesting early spring. The sky is clear blue, and there are a few buildings in the distance. The overall style and print quality resemble a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

Vintage tinted postcard showing a grand neo‑Renaissance building with a formal garden and a central fountain with a sculpture group in front. The left side bears printed captions identifying the scene and the publisher; the top right reads "Pozdrav iz Zagreba" beside a large handwritten message in a South Slavic language. Additional handwriting and the date "15/X. 1899" appear over the image. The printed caption under the image says "Jugoslavenska akademija. – L'Académie Iugo-slave."

Black‑and‑white photograph with scalloped edges showing a small rural village nestled among rolling fields and wooded hills. In the center stands a church with a square tower and tall pointed spire, surrounded by modest houses with pitched roofs and gardens. Patchwork farmland and distant low hills fill the background under a sky with scattered clouds. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a small European town with a river in the foreground spanned by an arched bridge. Traditional multi‑story houses line the riverside, and a church with a tall, slender steeple rises above the rooftops on the left. In the background are tree‑covered hills with scattered villas. The caption at the bottom center reads "Lunzenau (Mulde)".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small European town scene labeled "Grossenhain." A canal or mill stream runs along the right side beside old houses; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along a tree‑lined square on the left. In the foreground is a building right next to the water, with a small tree in front and railings along the edge.

Black‑and‑white riverfront view of a European town. In the foreground a paddle steamer with passengers moves along a wide river, with barges and small boats moored near a quay. On the right bank stand 19th‑century townhouses and villas, behind a high embankment wall and promenade. Rising on the hill above the town is a large hilltop complex of fortified buildings and towers that looks like a castle or former monastery dominating the skyline. The surrounding landscape is hilly and partly wooded. No printed caption or other visible text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene in a European city, showing a narrow plaza or intersection lined with multi‑story masonry buildings with shutters and awnings. A distinctive overhanging corner house supported by arches dominates the center-left. In the middle of the square stands a small kiosk-like structure with a domed or cage-like top. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the buildings and kiosk. The card has a printed border but no visible caption or writing on the image side.

Colorized historic postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with brick and stucco buildings behind a long wall with decorative pillars. The focus is on a large red-brick complex with gabled roofs and arched windows, identified as a military barracks. The sky is tinted blue with light clouds, in a typical early 20th‑century postcard style. German text identifying the town, street, and building is printed at the top.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a full‑length side view of a bearded man in traditional dress carrying a large rectangular load on his back, supported by a strap over his shoulders. The background is a painted or stylized landscape with trees and distant hills. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin identifying the scene and location.

Black‑and‑white view of a hillside town. In the foreground stand several large, ornate villas with steep tiled roofs and decorative façades, set behind fences and small trees. Behind them rises a terraced hillside that appears to be used for vineyards or agriculture. At the top center of the hill is a round tower‑like structure, and on the distant right crest of the hill is a church or monastery complex with multiple roofs and a tall spire. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European spa or vineyard town.

Illustrated color postcard depicting a sunlit town square bordered by historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and a central column or monument. In the background on a hill stands a prominent clock tower. Two figures in light clothing walk near the monument, and trees add greenery to the scene. The word "GRAZ" appears at the top, and "KARMEITERPLATZ" (likely intended as Karmeliterplatz) is printed at the bottom. Handwritten script in German fills the right margin and lower edge, including a date notation along the top right.

Black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing French (and Allied) soldiers disembarking from a ship onto a cobbled quay. The scene is a busy military landing with officers and men carrying bags and equipment beside a harbor with masts, cranes, and warehouses in the background. Printed captions in French and English at the bottom identify the view as a World War I scene in the Balkans at Salonica (Thessaloniki).

An old monochrome postcard view of a harbor inlet with a large steamship in the left foreground and numerous sailing boats gathered on the right. In the distance, multi‑story buildings line the waterfront. The caption printed in the upper right reads "Stockholm, Nybroviken." The ship at left has the word "NORRKÖPING" visible on its stern.

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with curved paths and benches in the foreground, dominated on the right by a large monument: a standing military figure on a high pedestal, with allegorical statues, rocks and a lion at the base. Behind the park rise ornate spa-style buildings on a hillside, surrounded by forested slopes. On one hillside building a large sign advertises a hotel. The overall scene evokes a Central European spa town from the late 19th or early 20th century.

Old Spanish postal card with cream background and handwritten black ink address. The heading reads "Tarjeta Postal – Unión Postal Universal – España". A red 10-centimos Spanish stamp with a portrait is affixed in the upper-right corner and postmarked. The left side contains diagonally written sender information, while the center and bottom right show the addressee's name and location, including "La Magdalena" and "Santander".

Black‑and‑white interior view of a chapel with wooden pews and a central aisle leading toward a doorway under a dark wooden gallery or organ loft. Statues of religious figures are set into wall niches on both sides, surrounded by decorative painted cartouches with inscriptions. The lower left corner bears a printed caption in Swedish, and the lower right has a small oval publisher's mark.

Colorized historic postcard showing a neoclassical building behind a central monument with an angel-like statue holding an object aloft. The monument stands on a pedestal accessed by steps, surrounded by gas-style street lamps and a small landscaped lawn. In the background are additional older buildings and trees. The printed captions at the bottom read "Valkhof." in the center and "NIJMEGEN." at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a large church with wooden pews, tall classical columns, arched windows, chandeliers, a pulpit to the left and an altar at the far end. The image is captioned in Swedish at the bottom margin.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard depicting a small railway station with wooden buildings beside train tracks. Several people stand on the platform and on the slope behind the station. The main station building has a sign reading "MELLÖSA" and various advertisements on the facade. The caption at the bottom identifies the station and region, and credits the photographer/publisher.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a wide river with a long, narrow riverbank and a pathway running alongside it. On the near side there is a wooded hillside dotted with detached houses and villas with steep, tiled roofs. In the river, several barges or boats are visible. On the far shore lie more houses and small buildings, with low hills and forested slopes in the background. The image has the proportions, border, and wear consistent with an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No printed title or caption is visible.

Sepia-toned desert scene showing several people in traditional North African dress with camels beside a stone-lined desert well or fountain. The image is printed with French captions identifying the location as Biskra and describing the scene as a well in the desert. Additional small-print credits appear along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned studio photograph of a young couple with a baby carriage. The man wears an early-20th‑century uniform and cap, while the woman is dressed in traditional folk-style clothing with a patterned dress, shawl, and head covering. They look down fondly into a wicker pram with large spoked wheels, covered with a fur blanket. Behind them is a painted backdrop of an old European city with church spires and historic buildings, giving the image a nostalgic, romantic feel.

An old black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three photographs of the same or related villas/buildings with neoclassical details, verandas, and pitched roofs. Above the images is the title "Villa Nicu N. Albu, Piatra‑N." On the left margin, printed vertically, is the publisher credit. The overall layout and typography resemble early 20th‑century European postcards.

Color-tinted historical postcard view of a railway station building with multiple tracks in the foreground. The two‑story masonry station has a gabled roof and a covered platform. Several railway staff and people stand in front of the building. At the top in red letters is the title identifying the station as Waldenburg in Saxony. A station sign reading "Waldenburg" is visible on the platform. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century German postcard.

Vintage colorized postcard showing, in the upper part, a man and a woman in Alpine-style hiking clothes holding long walking sticks, seemingly standing in mid‑air. Below them is a panoramic view of a city with a prominent, steep, wooded hill rising from the center, crowned by buildings. At the bottom is German text printed on the card.

A color postcard showing a striking modernist arena-like building with tall outward-leaning concrete supports and large glass panels. In the foreground there is a flowerbed full of red flowers and a parking area with several 1970s-era cars, some covered with tarps. In the upper right corner, there are postal cancellations printed over the image, one rectangular with Cyrillic text and a rocket illustration, and one circular postmark that reads "VARNA" and includes Cyrillic text and a date.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an industrial brick building beside a powerful river or waterfall. The structure appears to be a hydroelectric power station built into the rocky riverbank, with scaffolding and walkways along the water. Hills or low mountains rise in the background. Printed captions in Swedish identify the place as Uddevalla and refer to an electricity works and the Uddevalla Museum, with a date of February 1903.

Stylized Art Nouveau / early modernist illustration of a bird resembling a peacock, rendered in flat black and blue shapes on a cream background. The bird has a fan of long thin tail feathers ending in small floral shapes and vertical blue-and-black stripes on its body. The design is minimal and graphic, with the artist's signature at the lower right and a museum or collection credit strip along the bottom.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow dirt road through a leafless forest. On the left, a horse-drawn carriage with two people travels along the road. On the right, a steep rocky hillside rises among tall trees; a person in dark clothing is standing or sitting on the rocks. Handwritten and printed text is overlaid at the top left and top center of the image.

Color aerial view of a small European town surrounded by forests and low hills. A main road with 1960s–1970s era cars runs from the foreground across a bridge toward the distant part of town. Low-rise buildings with red-tiled roofs and detached houses are interspersed with many trees and patches of water. In the bottom right, a building with an orange awning reads "VERTSHUS KAFETERIA." Another sign by the road has the logo and letters "OK," likely for a fuel station. The overall scene suggests a calm, green town in a Nordic country.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a coastal scene with a stone Franciscan convent and a tall bell tower beside the sea. A low waterfront wall and small quay line the calm water, with hills in the background. Printed captions in Italian at the bottom identify the location and publisher, with some handwritten notes over the margin.

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped garden or park. In the foreground is a large tree with a circular bench around its base on the left and a woman in an elegant long dress and wide‑brimmed hat standing on a path at the right. The middle ground shows rectangular garden beds bordered by low hedges. In the background stands a small pavilion with a tiled hipped roof supported by four columns, surrounded by trees. A larger building with a steep gable roof is faintly visible through the trees on the left. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing the entrance gate to a military area or camp. Two large masonry pillars support iron gates that are partly open. Above the gates is a horizontal beam with Greek writing and symbols. A soldier or guard stands by the entrance. In the background, aligned with the central axis, is a tall obelisk-like monument surrounded by trees. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tall statue of an Orthodox bishop or saint standing on a high pedestal, holding a staff and blessing with his right hand. Greek text is inscribed on the base of the monument and printed under the image. There is also handwritten cursive text along the right margin.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing an Indigenous woman standing outdoors amid tall dry grass, leaning on one knee and looking toward the camera. At the bottom margin there is printed text indicating the location and subject, along with a small number on the right.

Black‑and‑white view of a European small‑town street with historic gabled houses and two church or town‑hall towers in the background. The facades carry German inscriptions for a savings bank, an inn called "Zum Ratskeller", a lodging "Auspannung", a shop "Gustav Ziermann" and a pharmacy or drugstore with a red‑cross sign. Trees frame the scene on the left and a horse is visible at the right edge. The sky area is damaged, suggesting an old photograph reproduced as a postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall, slender spire topped by a cross, pointed arches, rose window, and ornate detailing. The church stands in a landscaped garden with paths, trees, and a gated entrance in the foreground, and city buildings in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge.

A color illustration of a riverside town with red‑roofed wooden and brick houses, a small arched bridge over a canal, boats moored along the water, and a prominent church with a tall, slender spire in the background. Trees line the waterfront, and larger, more monumental buildings rise behind the older town. In the lower left corner there is a short printed caption in a decorative script.

A black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with a small lake in the foreground, where a few waterfowl are swimming. Gentle grassy slopes and dense trees surround the water. At the top of the hill, partly hidden by foliage, stands a large historic-looking house or small manor with steep roofs and a small tower or spire. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image.

Black‑and‑white winter landscape showing a snowy valley with scattered evergreen trees, small wooden cabins or huts partly buried in snow, and a low mountain in the background. A rustic wooden fence runs across the snowfield. Text is printed along the bottom edge, including the place name and the photographer's credit.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterfront scene in Stockholm. In the background stands a large rectangular palace building with many windows, and other classical buildings along the quays. Several boats are moored by the shore, while a passenger boat crosses the water in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the scene, and the boat bears a readable name on its side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront scene with calm water in the foreground, port warehouses and cranes on the quay, and several large steamships docked along the pier. The image has a light border and handwritten-style captions along the bottom edge in Portuguese.

A black-and-white vintage image showing a two‑storey manor house with a hipped roof and neoclassical details, including a balustraded terrace and three large arches on the ground floor. The building stands on the far bank of a calm lake or river, its reflection visible in the water. Dense trees and shrubs surround the house, and there are stairways leading from the terrace down toward the water. Tree branches frame the scene in the foreground. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century European country estate photographed from across the water.

A vintage black‑and‑white portrait of a young man in a dark three‑piece suit with a patterned waistcoat and tie, standing with his hands in his pockets against a dark studio backdrop. Below the image is a white border containing printed text identifying him and his role in a theatre in Tallinn.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over open fields, farm buildings and a waterfront, with a church featuring a tall spire near the shoreline. Pine trees frame the foreground, and a lake with wooded shores and low hills lies in the distance. The caption in Swedish is printed at the top.

Colorized scenic view over a European city with red-tiled roofs and a river running through the center, crossed by several bridges. The image is taken from an elevated vantage point with trees and a wooden railing in the foreground. At the lower left, an illustrated girl in traditional dress holds a large bouquet of yellow flowers. In the distance, church towers and dense urban buildings stretch across a flat plain. In the top right corner, printed text reads "Graz vom Schlossberg."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a broad tree-lined street in an urban setting. Many men and boys sit or crouch along the sidewalk providing shoe-shine services (bootblacks), while pedestrians walk along the street. On the right there is a decorative metal fence and buildings with arched windows and palm trees inside the compound. Bare trees arch over the road, suggesting winter or early spring. Printed caption text appears at the bottom.

Colorized vintage view over a riverside industrial town. In the foreground, steam-powered riverboats are moored at a quay along a calm river with railway tracks and freight wagons beside the bank. Behind them rise factories with tall chimneys, warehouses, and a mix of residential and civic buildings on a low hill. The image is captioned in red text at the top with a German title describing the steamship landing place in Riesa on the Elbe River.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tram passing in front of a historic castle-like building with towers and steep roofs, surrounded by bare trees and fencing. Pedestrians walk along the street and a small cart stands on the right. The bottom of the card has printed red text identifying the location, and small publisher information is printed in red at the lower left.

Sepia-toned interior view of a very long, formal dining hall with rows of neatly set tables and wooden chairs. The room has high decorated ceilings, hanging lamps, tall windows on the right, and framed pictures and a crucifix on the far wall, indicating a Catholic institution. Text printed at the bottom reads the name and location of the college and identifies the room as the dining hall.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a landscaped park with a circular flowerbed and low wire fence in the foreground, a tree‑lined path and streetlamps, and a tall neo‑Gothic style memorial column or tower (the Schwedendenkmal) in the background. There is also a cylindrical advertising pillar on the left. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Freiberg i. S. at the Schwedendenkmal, and an additional red line of text appears at the lower right.

A vintage, faded photograph of a coastal landscape showing a wooded cliffside descending to a calm sea. Small buildings or a villa appear silhouetted among the trees atop the bluff. The shoreline curves away into the distance, and the overall tone is blue-tinted. At the bottom margin there is text in Cyrillic and German.

Colorized early 20th‑century street scene of a broad town square with ornate two‑story historicist buildings on the left, simpler houses and shops on the right, and low hills in the distance. Horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians move along the unpaved square. The caption "Torda" appears near the top, and handwritten text in the upper right seems to label the square.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a neatly planned small town or suburb. The view shows an orthogonal street grid with detached wooden houses, each on its own plot with gardens and small orchards. In the center‑left is a formal geometric park with paths and lawns, and just above it a tree‑filled block containing a dark, steep‑roofed wooden church with a tower. The overall scene looks calm and semi‑rural, likely from the early to mid‑20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural European village in a hilly landscape. In the foreground there is a pond surrounded by trees and dense vegetation. Beyond it lie open fields and scattered farmhouses and village houses with steep gabled roofs, arranged along gentle slopes. Forested hills rise in the distance under a cloudy sky. The print number "6523B" appears in the lower right corner of the image; the card has a white border with deckled edges, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards.

A colorized historic postcard view of an urban square with a central green area, trees, flowerbeds and a monument. Around the square stand multi‑story buildings with awnings and terraces; one of them is labeled as a restaurant. A tram or bus is visible on the right, and several small figures walk across the open paved space. The caption at the top identifies the scene as Keizer Karelplein with the buildings Germania and Vereeniging in Nijmegen.

Illustrated military-themed postcard showing a uniformed soldier walking at the front of a column of pack donkeys laden with crates and sacks. The man smokes a cigarette while leading the animals. The scene is bordered on the left and top by a pattern of black, red, and white squares. Handwritten-style text in two languages appears at the top, and a signature and date are on the left side.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned main street in a European town, lined with 3–4 story historic townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and roadway. German shop signs are visible on the façades, including a large painted advertisement on the side of a building. The architecture features gabled roofs and stucco fronts typical of Central European towns.

Vintage postcard showing two large standing statues of the pharaoh Ramses II among massive stone columns in an ancient Egyptian temple. The image is tinted in sepia/hand‑colored tones, with caption text printed in English and French on the right margin.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a snow‑covered Orthodox cemetery with many cross-shaped gravestones set among tall trees.
