The lower margin contains multilingual printed captions identifying the scene as an Orthodox cemetery in Salonica covered in snow, along with a serial number on the left.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large group of people in traditional rural dress celebrating a grape harvest. Women and men stand and dance in front of an ox-drawn cart piled with grapes, set against a backdrop of vineyards and low hills. At the top of the image, multilingual text identifies the scene as a harvest near Varna and Euxinograd.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a hillside settlement of whitewashed cubic houses built on a rocky slope above the sea. A line of people in dark clothing stand along a stone wall in the foreground. The architecture is typical of Cycladic islands with terraced buildings and narrow paths. There is a stamp with a circular postmark in the upper left corner and Greek text printed vertically along the right edge.

Colorized historical postcard showing a large group of Eastern Orthodox clergy in ornate vestments gathered on the steps of a grand church or cathedral. The clergy form two lines on either side of a stairway leading to the entrance, with bishops and patriarchs in the center. Printed French captions appear beneath the image along with a small serial number on the left and a website watermark on the lower right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand, ornate stone bank building labeled "WASABANKEN" facing a circular public garden with flowerbeds and a central statue on a pedestal. The scene looks down a straight city street with tramlines and early 20th‑century urban buildings. Printed captions in Swedish and Finnish identify the building and the city, and handwritten greetings appear in the lower part of the card.

Black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped city park with a circular fountain in the foreground, conical topiary bushes, flowerbeds bordered by a low metal fence, and wide steps leading up through tree-lined paths. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Albertpark in Freiberg.

A black‑and‑white image of a large historic building in Renaissance style, likely a palace or manor. It has steep tiled roofs with ornate gables, a central tower with a clock and cupola, rows of rectangular windows, and walls partly covered in ivy. A tree and open courtyard or park occupy the foreground.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a humorous montage: in the upper part, a man in an overcoat, bowler hat, and suit is seen floating in the sky while holding an open umbrella and a suitcase. Below him is a panoramic view over a small European town with dense rooftops, trees in the foreground, and a river to the right. German text is printed beneath the image, with publisher information at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white image showing a group of uniformed soldiers operating and cleaning a field artillery piece with large wooden wheels in a courtyard. The background is a two‑story barracks‑like building with repeated round‑arched openings and white trim around the windows and arcades. The men wear early 20th‑century style military uniforms with flat caps and high boots. There is faint handwriting or markings near the bottom edge of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a French torpedo boat named "Carquois" moored in a harbor. Sailors are visible on deck among lifeboats, rigging, and equipment. Industrial harbor buildings, a smokestack, and cranes line the waterfront in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as La Pallice, the outer port of La Rochelle, France, and names the ship.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm pond or small lake bordered by forest. Trees densely line the far shore, and the water reflects the treeline. The foreground shows a rough, natural shoreline and path. At the bottom, printed in red German text, is a caption describing the scene and the publisher details.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy town market square with many people, horse‑drawn carts, and simple wooden stalls. Two- and three‑story brick buildings line the square, with shop signs on the façades. At the top of the card is printed the caption "Dobele. Tirgus laukums." indicating the market square of Dobele.

Black-and-white postcard showing a curving lakeside or fjord-side road running between steep dark mountains. A vintage car drives along the road while a lone person walks on the roadside, with dramatic clouds over the water. Small printed caption text appears at the bottom edge.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a hilly old town with brick houses and steep tiled roofs. In the foreground is a terrace-like building with neo‑Gothic windows and decorative balustrades, and behind it several larger brick structures and a square tower. A narrow street lined with houses descends to the right. In the distant background, a large arched steel bridge crosses a river. There is a handwritten-looking caption along the bottom edge and a small number on the right.

A black-and-white postcard view of a large institutional building complex in a rural setting, with several connected wings and smaller adjacent houses, surrounded by open fields and a wooden fence. The central building has a tower-like structure with a spire. Text is printed at the bottom identifying the place and the publisher.

Sepia photograph of a formal city park or promenade. A wide path lined with large trees runs from the foreground into the distance, with people strolling and sitting on benches in early 20th‑century clothing. On the right is an ornamental flowerbed with exotic plants, and a man in dark clothes stands beside it holding a hat or walking stick. At the bottom of the image there is a handwritten caption in a cursive Cyrillic script.

Colorized vintage view over a European city from a hillside covered in dense green vegetation. On the right is a gravel path with stairs, terrace, pergola, railing, and a building façade; on the left is a panoramic view of red‑roofed houses, church towers, and a river with a bridge crossing it. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors, giving an early 20th‑century postcard look. At the top left is printed text indicating the location.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings, shops, and pedestrians. Horse‑drawn vehicles and people in early 20th‑century clothing appear along the street. Text printed on the image identifies the location as Uddevalla and mentions Uddevalla Museum and Drottninggatan.

Colorized historic view of a European spa town with grand multi‑story hotels and villas on a wooded hillside, seen from a landscaped park with paths, trees, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walking and riding in horse‑drawn carriages. At the top left, red printed text reads "Marienbad. Parkanlagen." indicating the park area of Marienbad.

Black‑and‑white landscape view from a forested hillside, looking through tall tree trunks toward a valley with a compact European village of gabled houses and a church tower. A simple wooden bench sits at the overlook in the foreground, while patchwork fields and gentle hills extend into the distance.

A black-and-white studio portrait of a young man in a formal dark suit with a white shirt and bow tie, seated at a desk with papers in front of him. He rests his left temple on his hand and looks slightly to the side with a thoughtful expression. The background is plain, and the name "Wäinö Sola." is printed at the bottom right of the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town. In the foreground are fenced gardens, fields, and several two‑ to three‑storey houses with steep gabled and hipped roofs. On the right stands a prominent multi‑storey civic building with a clock tower and a spire topped by a weather vane. In the distant background, among trees and low hills, several church towers and spires rise over the townscape. The architecture appears late‑19th to early‑20th‑century Central European. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Renaissance facade with arched windows, statues in niches, decorative coats of arms, and ivy climbing the stone walls. On the right is an arched passageway leading through the building. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German, identifying the scene as part of Heidelberg Castle (the Friedrichsbau with the portal to the Altan).

Black-and-white postcard view of a forested mountain valley town. It shows a cluster of alpine-style houses and larger spa or hotel buildings nestled among dense coniferous woods. A church with a clock tower stands on a slope to the left. The hills behind are heavily forested. Printed caption text appears in the lower right corner.

Old black‑and‑white riverfront view showing several paddle steamers and barges moored along a quay. Behind them stands a long, continuous row of ornate late‑19th‑century apartment or office blocks with mansard roofs, domes, and decorative facades. In front of the buildings is a tree‑lined embankment with a tram or streetcar running along it. The overall appearance suggests a European capital city in the early 20th century.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped public garden with a narrow canal or watercourse running through it, crossed by small footbridges. Tall trees and dense greenery line the banks, with multi‑story buildings and hills visible in the background. The caption at the top reads "TRENTO - Giardini Pubblici."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large motor ship at sea, viewed from the port side. The vessel has multiple masts and superstructures along the deck. In the lower left corner, printed text identifies the shipping company and its location, while in the lower right corner the ship's name, "M. S. 'LALANDIA'", is printed. The overall design and typography suggest an early–to–mid 20th‑century promotional postcard for an ocean‑going cargo or passenger ship.

Black-and-white postcard image showing a historic two‑storey building with a steep tiled roof and a tall central clock tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and belfry. The facade has multiple rectangular windows and a doorway at street level. Above one central window on the first floor is the word "MUSEO". In front of the building stands a slender metal lattice structure with a small hut-like base. The cobblestone square around the building is visible. The upper left corner of the card bears the printed caption "Rauma."

Illustrated scene of an Arab wedding procession in a Middle Eastern town. Several elaborately decorated camels carry riders in traditional dress, including a veiled figure likely representing the bride. Other men, women, and children in robes stand or sit nearby in front of low plastered buildings with wooden awnings. The style is vintage, with muted colors and a printed caption at the bottom left. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic castle complex with a cylindrical tower and surrounding buildings, set against a mountainous backdrop. The scene looks over rooftops toward a valley. Printed Italian text at the top identifies the location, and there are some handwritten annotations on the image.

Black-and-white view over a dense historic town with steep, tiled roofs climbing up a hillside toward a large Gothic cathedral with two ornate western towers and a tall, slender spire behind it. To the right stands a bulky complex with a tower topped by an onion-shaped dome. Narrow streets and trees weave between the tightly packed houses. The overall look is of a Central European medieval cityscape photographed from an elevated vantage point.

A sepia-toned photograph shows a large historic building complex on a high stone terrace or fortification wall, likely part of a castle or palace. Below the wall is a park-like green area with trees and a small decorative wooden bridge over a path or stream. In the foreground, two figures—an adult and a child—walk along the path. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and the sky is filled with dramatic clouds. The style and printing suggest an early-20th-century picture postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal panorama with a curving bay, wooded cliffs, a long pier or breakwater extending into calm water, and a large palace-like building set on a hill in the distance. At the bottom there is bilingual printed text in Cyrillic and French referencing Varna and the Euxinograd palace.

Vintage colorized postcard showing a riverside scene with buildings on a hill above a quay and small boats on the water. Printed captions in Cyrillic and Latin describe the location as Ferdinand Boulevard in Ruse/Rustchuk. Handwritten text in Bulgarian covers the lower part of the card, and there is a partial postmark on the right margin.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a riverside or coastal fishing settlement. In the foreground are baskets, nets, boats pulled onto the shore, and people working with fishing gear. The background shows a low tree line along the water's edge and a small flag on a pole. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as a fishing district in Cabinda.

Black-and-white postcard showing a small village nestled in a wooded valley with hills in the background. Traditional houses with pitched roofs are surrounded by dense trees and gardens. On the left side, atop a hill, stands a tall, cylindrical tower or castle ruin. At the bottom edge, printed text reads "Sommerfrische Tautenburg i/Thür."

A sepia-toned postcard view across a waterfront toward a large rectangular palace-like building with many windows and a flat roof. In the foreground, several people stand or walk along the quay while a small steam-powered boat moves on the water. Trees frame the right side of the image. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A sepia-toned portrait of a man with thick dark hair and a large mustache, wearing a suit, white shirt, and patterned tie. The image is studio-style, centered on his head and shoulders. In the lower left corner the printed caption reads 'Guy de Maupassant', and a small number '476' appears in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal harbor with calm water in the foreground and a low shoreline village in the background. Several small fishing boats lie on the water, and on the right a concrete pier extends into the harbor, with a crowd of people gathered and a small motor vessel moored alongside. Low wooden houses and sheds line the shore, and at least one flagpole flies a Scandinavian-style cross flag. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and lower right corners.

Multi-view postcard showing dramatic rocky peaks and narrow ledges of a high‑mountain via ferrata route. The upper main photo labels individual peaks and passes with Italian names (e.g., Sentinella, Camp. Alto, Sfulmini, Torre, C. d. Armi, Bocch. Camp. Alto, Bocch. d. Armi) and traces the route with a red line. The bottom half has two smaller images: one of a hiker walking along a very narrow path cut into a cliff and another of a similar exposed rocky traverse. Large red text across the middle reads "VIA DELLE BOCCHETTE".

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a park with a curving waterway, a small boat with people, and walkers along a path in the foreground. Dominating the scene is a round medieval brick tower by the water, with a bridge and trees surrounding it; more buildings and a bridge appear in the background. The border is styled like a turned-up page corner. Printed captions identify the place as Nijmegen and Kronenburgerpark, and the left margin lists the publisher. There is a handwritten note at the bottom.

Black-and-white landscape postcard showing a calm river or reservoir bordered by densely forested hills. A small excursion boat moves along the water in the foreground. Trees frame the view on both sides. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right of the image.

Colorized view of a European riverside city with a metal bridge crossing a turquoise river, lined with 19th‑century buildings and a church tower with a green onion dome and clock. Above the city rises a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortress walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill stands a distinctive clock tower. Printed in red at the top left is the caption 'Graz‑Mur‑Schlossberg'. A commercial sign on a riverside building reads 'JOS SOBEL'. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist postcard.

A black-and-white postcard view of a small lake with several rowboats on the water and tied along a wooden pier. On the right shore stands a round pavilion with a hipped roof and white columns, surrounded by lush trees and garden plantings. Benches line the lakeside path, and in the background a large villa-like building is partly visible behind the trees. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Gondelteich with the pavilion 'Haus am See' in Bad Elster.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy waterfront square with several multi‑story historic buildings, market stalls, crowds of people, and small boats docked along the quay. A tall church spire rises in the background. At the top of the card the printed captions read "Stockholm" and "Kornhamnstorg."

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a tall statue of a medieval armored figure, identified as Olaf Tryggvason, standing on a high geometric stone pedestal. The figure holds an orb in his outstretched right hand and wears a helmet, tunic, and sword. The background is blank sky. Caption text appears along the bottom edge.

Color reproduction of a Renaissance painting of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ Child. Mary is shown half‑length, wearing a blue mantle and white veil, seated before a red curtain with a distant hilly landscape and a church or small town visible at the left. The infant Jesus stands on her lap, nude, leaning against her. Along the lower border of the image there is a small inscription with the painter's name.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a small white church with a central tower topped by a cross, surrounded by trees and a graveyard enclosed by a stone wall. The church stands in a rural landscape under a pale blue and orange evening sky. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Kyrkan, Odensjö."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a church with a tall spire and clock tower, surrounded by leafless trees and curved walking paths in a park-like setting. The printed caption at the top reads "Eskilstuna. Kyrkan." in a serif font.

Black‑and‑white view over a field toward a small European town with early‑20th‑century houses in the foreground and a large, ornate institutional building (likely a school or administrative building) on a hill in the background. To the right stands an industrial or workshop building with signage in German. Rolling farmland and scattered houses extend into the distance.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a calm canal or river lined with dense trees on both banks. Small rowing boats are moored along the right bank, while a stone quay and a few pedestrians appear on the left. In the distant background, a tall white church or tower with a domed roof rises above the treetops. The lower margin of the image contains printed captions.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a wooded lakeshore or coastal inlet with scattered detached houses. In the foreground, on a small rocky peninsula, stands a striking flat‑roofed, white modernist villa surrounded by trees and a low shoreline wall. A narrow road leads from the villa into a sparsely built residential area with additional villas and forest. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white image of a large, ornate half‑timbered villa reflected in a still pond in the foreground. The house has steep tiled roofs, balconies, decorative woodwork, and a small tower with a spire. Mature trees frame the scene. Above the central balcony door there is a signboard with the word "Inhalatorium". The setting looks like a landscaped park or sanatorium grounds.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a group of women and girls in traditional folk costumes standing on a balcony with decorative balusters. One person is holding a dark flag with a light horizontal stripe (resembling the Latvian flag in monochrome). The building façade behind them has tall arched windows and classical detailing. At the bottom of the card is printed text in Latvian.

Sepia-toned interior view of a historical study room with a window on the left, light curtains, a wooden floor, and a classic wooden writing desk with drawers and cubbyholes. Two cane-backed chairs stand in front of and beside the desk. A small bookshelf is partly visible to the left of the desk. On the wall above the desk hang two large silhouette portraits facing each other and two smaller framed pictures between and below them. A closed wooden door is on the right. The bottom margin of the image contains a handwritten-style caption in German indicating this is Goethe's study on the second floor.

An old official postcard that doubles as a telephone fee notice form, printed in Estonian. The left side lists various telephone-related charges with handwritten entries in purple ink and amounts in kroons and sents. The right side is formatted like a postal card, with the heading 'AMETLIK POSTKAART', handwritten address to 'Piirsalu algkool', postal cancellations and stamps including circular postmarks reading 'EESTI' and 'RISTI 2.VIII.33'. The overall look is that of a 1930s Estonian state telecom billing postcard.

A colorized view of a European city with a river in the foreground crossed by a metal bridge, rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs, and a church tower with an onion-shaped dome. Behind the city rises a steep hill crowned by fortress walls and structures, with a prominent clock tower standing on the slope. Distant hills form the background. Printed caption text appears along the top edge.

Tinted vintage view of a park path with benches and a gas-style lamppost in the foreground, where two figures in old-fashioned clothing are seated. Behind the trees rises a square stone bell tower with arched openings and a small cupola on top. Roofs of nearby buildings are visible, and in the background are steep, rocky mountains. The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century colorized postcard of a European town in a mountainous region.

Sepia-toned panoramic photograph showing a general view of a densely built town with low houses, trees, and a few taller buildings or towers. The image has a beige border with printed captions in French and English identifying the scene as a general view of Veria in Macedonia.

A black-and-white postcard showing a traditional Dutch windmill beside a narrow canal in a flat rural landscape. The windmill has a thatched, tapered body and large sails, with a small bridge and fence in front. Trees and open fields appear in the background. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption in Dutch that reads "Molen bij Zwammerdam."

Colored illustrated postcard showing a large Alpine hotel complex called Mendelhof with adjoining restaurant and dining hall buildings at Mendel Pass, surrounded by dense coniferous forest and mountains. Early automobiles and carriages stand in front with several people walking around. The image is framed by handwritten cursive text in Italian along the margins and bottom. Printed captions in German at the bottom identify the scene as 'Tirol: Spreter's Mendelhof am Mendelpass b. Bozen' with altitude information and the artist's credit.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with scattered low buildings on gently rolling hills, backed by arid mountains. In the foreground there is a dense grove of palm trees. Beneath the photograph, printed captions in Portuguese and French identify the scene as a partial view of the city of Praia in Cabo Verde / Cap‑Vert. A small serial number appears at the bottom left.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense trees and orchards. The castle features multiple connected buildings with steep gabled roofs and a prominent round tower with a crenellated top. At the top in red type it is labeled with the place and castle name; there is also vertical red printing along the left edge with publisher information and a date.

Black‑and‑white view of a narrow medieval passageway between stone buildings. On the left is a large Gothic window with tall vertical panes and tracery, likely part of a church or chapel apse. A small patterned stained-glass panel is visible in one of the lower window sections. In the center is a pointed, arched stone gateway in a thick wall, leading to a tree‑lined path beyond. On the right is a smaller building with a tiled roof and shuttered windows. The path is cobbled or dirt, bordered by low stone walls and overgrown vegetation. There is no visible text on the image side.

A vintage sepia-toned view over a coastal town with many low, tile-roofed buildings, a small harbor with boats and ships, and a tree-lined shoreline. Printed captions appear at the bottom, including the town name and the publisher's details.

Black‑and‑white / sepia postcard view of a quiet street lined with early 20th‑century residential and commercial buildings. The foreground shows a large, multi‑storey house with a steep tiled roof, dormer windows, and a fenced front yard. Similar houses and small apartment blocks extend into the distance along a wide, mostly empty street with telegraph poles. At the top, printed in red, is the caption identifying the location as Flöha and the specific street as Carolastrasse.

A colorized vintage postcard-style image showing a tranquil river scene with a small stone arch bridge of three spans crossing the water. Dense trees and bushes line both banks; a tall tree dominates the right side of the image. On the left foreground, a small rowboat with three people glides along the calm river toward the bridge. The sky is softly tinted in pastel tones with scattered white clouds, giving the scene an idyllic, romantic atmosphere. No visible text appears on the image side.

A vintage black-and-white portrait postcard showing a seated man with wavy hair and a mustache, wearing dark clothing and high boots, sitting sideways in an ornate, studded armchair. The background is plain. Beneath the photograph, the name "MAXIM GORKI" is printed in capital letters, with small publisher information and a number in the lower right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large neoclassical castle-like building on a hill surrounded by dense trees, seen from across a calm body of water that reflects the structure. The caption strip at the bottom identifies the location in Spanish and French and includes publication details.

A vintage sepia-toned view of a European town market square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with gabled roofs and shopfronts at street level. Several women in long dresses walk across the open square. Simple streetlamps stand along the edge of the plaza. At the top of the image, printed text reads "WURZEN I. SA." on the left and "MARKT." on the right, identifying the scene as the market square of Wurzen.

Hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a man in elaborate traditional costume, including a large sombrero and ornate suit, standing on a stone street and speaking with a woman who leans out from an iron‑railed window balcony. The scene is titled "A Spanish Courtship." Marginal text notes the publisher in Los Angeles, California, and that it was printed in Germany.

Black-and-white postcard showing a mountain scene with dramatic rocky peaks and snow in the background, dense conifer forest on the slopes, and a small building complex in the foreground labeled as a café. Several tables and chairs sit outside the main low building, with a two-story chalet-style structure attached. Italian text is printed at the top describing the café and location, including the elevation.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a multi‑arched stone bridge spanning a calm river, with triangular cutwaters and a tower-like structure rising from the bridge deck. On the far bank stand low houses and, in the distance to the right, a large Ottoman mosque with multiple slender minarets. The upper margin bears French text identifying the scene and an additional inscription in Ottoman Turkish.

Colorized postcard view of a large sanatorium-style building with red roofs and cream-colored walls, set on a hillside amid forests and fields. The multi‑storey structure has balconies and many windows, suggesting a health resort or convalescent home. The surrounding landscape is rural with trees, paths, and open meadows. At the top in red German text is the title identifying the place.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a wide strait with green hills on the opposite shore and traditional houses with red-tiled roofs in the foreground. A sailing ship is visible on the water. The caption at the top, in French, identifies the scene as a view of Bebek on the Bosphorus in Constantinople. A small logo with the initials 'MB' appears in the lower right corner, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is printed across the lower part of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a long row of ornate brick townhouses on a corner in winter, with bare trees lining the street. The main corner building has a small tower-like structure and decorative gables. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the street and city, with an additional handwritten note below.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a semi‑rural hillside town. In the foreground are cultivated fields bordered by low fences. Beyond them rises a hill dotted with villas and houses surrounded by trees. On the left summit stands a church with a steep roof, tower, and large cross. On the right hilltop there is a tall cylindrical water‑tower‑like structure with a conical roof. The style of the buildings suggests early 20th‑century Central European architecture. No text is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a grand, castle‑like hotel complex on a steep, forested hillside. The main multi‑story building has several round corner towers with conical roofs, central cupola, and many balconies. Smaller villa‑style buildings and terraced gardens surround it, with a town scattered along the slopes and dense forested hills rising behind.

Black‑and‑white view of a railway station area with several parallel train tracks in the foreground and people walking across the tracks. On the left stands a multi‑story corner building labeled "VICTORIA-HOTEL," with balconies and traditional Central European architecture. Other urban buildings line the tracks further back, including a brick structure with turrets, and semaphore railway signals. Rolling hills and fields form the background landscape. There are various telegraph or power poles and a small trackside hut visible.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a rural landscape with fields in the foreground and two people working on the land. In the background is a small town with traditional houses and a prominent church with a tall steeple, set among rolling hills. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the place and publisher, with a date.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a vaulted hall displaying rows of historic cannons and artillery pieces. The guns are lined up on polished floors under a series of arches; military banners with ornate heraldic symbols hang from the ceiling above them. Light enters from an arched window at the far end, giving the space a museum‑like atmosphere.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a tall rectangular medieval brick tower with crenellations and small square windows standing in an open square, with mountains in the background and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing in the foreground. Trees line a street on the left and multi‑story buildings border the right side. The word "Trento" appears at the upper right, "Torre Vanga" at the bottom center, and a publisher's imprint runs vertically along the left edge.

Sepia-toned image of an old European courtyard framed by high plastered stone walls with rectangular windows. Ivy and climbing plants cover much of the walls and an arched passageway. A small curved stairway leads up to a door on the left, while an inner pointed archway with a sculpted element above it opens into a shaded passage under the building. The roof is steeply pitched with small dormers, typical of historic Central European architecture. There is no visible printed caption on the front.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small European town with traditional half-timbered houses, a large church with a tall clock tower and spire, several institutional-looking buildings (likely a school and station), and tree-lined roads and fields in the foreground. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town in a hilly landscape. In the middle stands a large medieval castle complex with thick stone walls and at least two prominent round towers with conical roofs and small finials. Around the castle are trees, gardens, and clustered houses with steep gabled roofs. In the right background there is a tall factory chimney, suggesting early industrialization. Rolling fields and wooded hills form the distant backdrop. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal harbor with stone fortifications extending into the sea. A large square fortress dominates the left side of the harbor entrance, with sailing masts and a long breakwater visible behind it. Calm water fills the foreground. Printed captions in French and Greek appear at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned street scene of a European town square or courtyard with bare winter trees and multi-story historic buildings. A central building with three large arched passageways at ground level and rows of arched windows above forms a gateway onto another street. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing stand near posters and shopfronts. In the lower right corner there is a printed decorative element: a heraldic lion with a crown standing beside a shield containing a portrait of an elderly, bearded man in a decorated military uniform, likely an Austro‑Hungarian imperial figure.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square and street lined with historic multi‑story buildings. On the right stands a corner house bearing the sign "Gasthaus zum Schwan," suggesting an inn or guesthouse. At the center-left is a small tree‑covered square with an obelisk‑like monument and other stone elements. A few pedestrians are visible in early 20th‑century attire. The architectural style is Central European, with steep tiled roofs and ornamented facades.

Vintage black‑and‑white view over the town of Meissen toward a hilltop complex dominated by a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and surrounding castle buildings. Printed red German text appears in the upper left, and a vertical publisher imprint is on the right margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a long, two‑storey brick or plastered office building with a gabled roof, small dormer windows, and many windows fitted with exterior awnings. The building is set behind a line of trees and bushes, with an open grassy field in the foreground and a tall flagpole to the right. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads ""Bolagskontoret", Kiruna." In the lower right corner is a photographer/publisher mark with the word "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI" and the credit "Foto: T. Dahllöf."

Sepia-toned photograph showing a large outdoor crowd seated closely together, many wearing early-20th‑century style hats and coats. They face a stage or open-air structure built in a rustic, stone-like style, with an arched tower or church-like façade to the right and trees surrounding the area. The image appears aged at the edges, typical of vintage postcards. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European riverside town with a stone and metal bridge crossing a wide river. A long barge is on the water in the foreground, while trams, pedestrians, and streetlights line the riverbank road on the right. On the hill above the clustered old town stands a large complex with twin Gothic cathedral towers and adjoining castle‑like buildings. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies the place.

A vintage, monochrome panoramic view over a city surrounded by hills and dense trees in the foreground. The skyline shows scattered church towers and historic buildings. At the top center-left is the printed title "Graz." and at the top right the word "Panorama." On the left margin, vertically, appears the publisher information. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Color-tinted historic street scene showing a broad tree-lined avenue leading toward a bridge and low buildings in the distance. Pedestrians walk along fenced sidewalks on both sides, and horse-drawn carts travel along the unpaved central road. Utility poles line the street. The caption in German at the top right reads "Mitau - Schloß-Garten."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a fenced Gothic funerary complex with elaborate canopies, statues and iron railings beside a narrow street lined with historic buildings. A church-like structure with a pointed spire rises in the background. At the bottom center there is printed text identifying the scene.

Black-and-white postcard showing a paved square in front of a grand 19th‑century building with arched windows and an ornate central pediment. In the middle stands a monument with a winged female figure on a tall pedestal, surrounded by steps and lampposts. Tree‑lined paths extend to the right where people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll. A printed caption appears along the lower margin.

Colored vintage postcard view of an alpine village in a narrow valley surrounded by steep, forested and rocky mountains. A river with a small waterfall runs in the foreground beside stone walls and wooden waterworks. Traditional Tyrolean-style houses with wooden roofs and balconies stand in the middle ground, one flying a red‑white‑red horizontal flag. A church with a square bell tower and pointed spire is prominent on the right. Snow‑covered peaks of the Dolomites rise in the background. The caption text is printed along the top edge.

Black-and-white landscape photograph with a white border and scalloped edges, showing an alpine meadow with low shrubs in the foreground and dramatic, cloud-covered rocky mountains in the background. The scene is high-altitude, with sparse vegetation and snow patches visible on the distant peaks. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a steep hillside with a dramatic zigzagging stone staircase built into the rock. At the top of the hill stands a distinctive medieval clock tower with a steep, irregular roof and large clock face, partially surrounded by trees and fortification walls. Traditional European houses with tiled roofs appear at the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town with scattered houses among trees, agricultural fields, a railway line on the left, and a lake with islands in the upper background. In the lower left corner the place name "Moelv" is printed, and in the lower right corner there is a photographer/publisher mark including the word "OSLO" and a code.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a stone arch bridge crossing a river in a dry, hilly landscape. At one end of the bridge stands a decorative gate or portal; at the other end, medieval-looking fortification walls and towers rise above the river. In the distant background there is a hilltop castle. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene in Spanish.

Art Nouveau–style illustration featuring a circular medallion with the head of a young woman with long red hair crowned with white flowers. A large white lily with green leaves rises along the left side. The background is a textured mix of dark green and brown tones. There is an empty light-colored label area at the bottom for writing, with a faint round postal-style mark. Stylized letters in what appears to be Greek script are printed near the top right and left.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town surrounded by forested hills. Wooden houses and farm-like buildings line a straight dirt road that runs through the middle. In the foreground there are trees and fenced plots, and a sloping roof edge is visible on the left. The scene has an old, rural Scandinavian feel. In the upper left corner the printed word "Arvidsjaur" appears, suggesting the town's name.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural village surrounded by fields and rolling hills with dense forest in the background. Farmhouses and small village buildings are scattered along the base of the hill. At the bottom left of the image, there is a caption in German that reads "Sommerfrische Hetzdorf." The card has a white border typical of older photo postcards.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an urban scene with women washing clothes at an outdoor wash-house along a canal or water trough, bordered by stone posts. Behind them rise several multi‑story residential buildings with balconies, hanging laundry, and tiled roofs. To the right is a high wall and an open paved area. The postcard has printed captions at the bottom identifying the scene and location, plus handwritten notes in Italian both across the lower margin and along the right side.

Sepia-toned photograph mounted like a postcard, showing three people in front of a rustic wooden log house. An elderly woman sits on a bench wearing a knitted sweater, long skirt, and white cap. Beside her stand two girls in elaborate traditional folk costumes: long patterned dresses with embroidered bibs, white blouses with wide sleeves, aprons, and distinctive white headdresses. The scene appears rural and early 20th century.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two inset photographs from Glimåkra. The left image, labeled "Hotell," shows a large wooden house with a gabled roof, fenced garden, and lawn. The right, rotated image, labeled "Jernvägsstation," depicts a small railway station building along train tracks with a sign on the building. The word "Glimåkra" appears at the top in red. The bottom portion contains handwritten cursive text in Swedish, dated 1902.

Black‑and‑white portrait of a man operating a large-format camera mounted on a tripod. He is framed tightly by a rectangular border studded with large round light bulbs, giving the appearance of a stage, studio, or illuminated sign. The style and equipment suggest an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century professional studio or cinema environment.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a monumental Orthodox-style cathedral with a large central dome topped by a cross and two smaller domed towers flanking the main façade. The building sits on a raised platform with broad steps leading to three arched entrance doors. The architecture features rounded arches, columned drum under the main dome, and decorative stonework. In front there is a landscaped square with paths, low ropes as barriers, and a tall streetlamp with two hanging lanterns. Surrounding the cathedral are lower historic buildings. The number "97" is printed in white in the bottom-right corner. Very faint library/collection marking is visible across the image center.

A hand-colored early-20th-century postcard showing a broad cobblestone market square lined with two‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. Several people in period clothing are walking or standing in the open square, with trees planted along the center. On the right side is a large building labeled "Rathskeller," suggesting it is part of the town hall complex. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed captions identify the view as the market square of Dommitzsch.

Black‑and‑white landscape view showing a wooded hill with a small building and tower on its summit, overlooking cultivated fields and a few large houses at the foot of the hill. The caption at the bottom left reads "Kamenz i. Sa. Hutberg". The style and framing resemble a classic tourist postcard.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a small cargo vessel or coaster sailing on calm water near a low shoreline. The ship is seen in profile and appears to be carrying timber or similar deck cargo, stacked behind high wooden railings. It has a wheelhouse at the stern, two masts with rigging and wires, and a dark hull with a light-colored stripe near the bow. On the bow, the vessel's name "STÖR" is painted. The background shows a flat coastal landscape with scattered trees and buildings under an overcast sky.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a street scene in a village or small town. On the left is a brick villa with a small porch bearing signage; a person sits on the steps. To the right stands a large arched gate leading into a courtyard, flanked by trees and timber or stone buildings. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place as Olbernhau-Oberneuschönberg in the Erzgebirge (Ore Mountains). Additional small commercial and postal signs are visible on the building.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the front facade of a large brick hospital complex framed by tall trees. The central entrance building is flanked by two wings. A few early automobiles and a person in dark clothing are visible in the courtyard. Printed captions in Dutch appear at the bottom margin.

Color photograph of a mid‑century modern office or civic building, elevated on piers above the ground floor and featuring long rows of windows and curtains. It stands at a street corner with zebra crossings and several small 1950s–60s European cars parked along the curb. In the background are steep, green mountains under a blue sky with scattered clouds. An older building with balconies appears on the left, and pedestrians walk along the sidewalks.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside panorama of a town with low, traditional buildings along both banks of a wide river. A bridge crosses the river in the middle distance. In the foreground is a riverside promenade with a few people and a horse-drawn cart. French caption text appears along the top, and there is a handwritten word near the center. A logo and website watermark (elia.org.gr) are printed at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic mountain valley with steep rock walls and scattered clouds. A steam train with a long trail of smoke runs along a railway line in the foreground, passing through a rural landscape of fields, trees, and a few small buildings. Text at the bottom identifies the scene and the photographer.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a studio portrait of a woman in elaborate traditional Greek costume. She is seated on the floor, leaning against a large clay amphora-like vessel, with potted plants in the background creating an outdoor effect. The costume includes a long embroidered dress, apron, and headscarf. Printed captions at the bottom read "COSTUME GREC" and "Athènes", with a circular seal-like mark on the left and a web address-like mark at the very bottom.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a street scene in an old European city. The view looks down a broad street lined with historic stone buildings. On the left is a large church with a rounded apse and Romanesque-Gothic details; beside it rises a tall, narrow bell tower topped with a cross. Further along stands another crenellated tower with a clock. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A caption at the bottom identifies the location as Trento and names the street Via San Vigilio, with a serial number preceding the city name.

A colorized historic postcard view of a stone-paved main street lined with old stone buildings and arcaded columns in the foreground. People in early 20th‑century attire walk and stand in the square; a small fenced monument or column stands to the left. The scene is a classic European old-town street. Printed captions identify the place as Stradun/Stradone in Dubrovnik/Ragusa.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a large, low, symmetrical pavilion-like building with two tall corner towers topped by domes and thin spires. The structure has extensive windows, a flat roof with railings, and a central entrance reached by a short staircase with a fountain basin in front. Simple garden furniture and benches sit on the gravel and lawn in the foreground, while tall coniferous trees form a backdrop behind the building.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy European street scene in front of an ornate Baroque/Rococo façade with stucco decoration and shuttered windows. The ground floor has arcades with several shop signs and many pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing crossing a cobbled square. The lower margin has handwritten text identifying the view.

Sepia-toned landscape postcard showing an industrial complex with long factory buildings and tall chimneys in a valley surrounded by rolling, cultivated hills and scattered woodland. The view looks down across fields toward the factory, with more hills and a few structures visible in the distance. At the top in red Gothic-style print is a German caption.

A vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a walled sidewalk and several groups of people gathered or walking along the street. Leafless trees line the road, and behind the wall stand ornate multi-story buildings with balconies and decorative facades. The caption at the top, printed in red, identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European town with densely packed tiled roofs, narrow streets, and multiple church towers. In the foreground is a tall baroque-style church tower rising from a large roofed building in the town center. To the left, on a wooded hillside, stands a complex that looks like a small castle or monastery with two Romanesque-style towers. Beyond the town are rolling hills, fields, and scattered villages, giving a picturesque valley setting. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.

An old, tinted postcard showing the ruins of a rounded Romanesque structure set in a wooded park. The central ruin has tall, narrow arched windows and a large semicircular apse. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit in the foreground. The image is framed by trees and surrounded by a light vignette. At the bottom, red printed captions identify the location as Nijmegen and the ruin as Valkhof.

Black‑and‑white panoramic rural scene showing patchwork fields, scattered farmhouses and a small village with a prominent church steeple at the center. Rolling hills rise in the distance. Along the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the view and publisher information, indicating it is a printed postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy fishing harbor filled with small sailing and row boats tied to wooden posts, with larger masted ships and a townscape in the background. In the foreground several people stand by a beached boat. The title in red German script at the top identifies the scene as the fishing‑boat harbor on the north side of Kolberg. A small blank rectangular area is reserved for writing, and a red imprint at the bottom left credits the publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque palace-like building with a central clock tower and ornate pediment, seen across a lawn with statues and framed by trees. At the bottom left, the caption reads "Landesanstalt Hubertusburg."

Black-and-white postcard showing a brick industrial-style building with tall arched windows and several chimneys, reached by a wooden bridge or ramp over a water channel. The structure stands in a rural landscape with trees and a curving dirt road in the background. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing the large four‑funnel ocean liner 'Imperator' at sea, viewed from the starboard bow, with another similar liner sailing behind it. Smoke pours from the funnels and small boats are visible near the hull. The image is bordered and has German text printed along the bottom margin describing the ship.

An old black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with ornate floral borders. The upper left image shows a large, elegant corner building in late 19th‑century style, likely a hotel or civic hall. The upper right image is a panoramic view of a European town with rows of houses and a prominent large church or cathedral with twin towers dominating the skyline. The lower left image shows an ornate interior hall with arched windows, decorative ceiling, chandeliers, and a long bar or stage at the far end. At the center of the composition a ribbon with floral decoration bears the German phrase 'Gruss aus' (Greetings from). A smaller partial image of a stone bridge or archway appears at the bottom right.

An old sepia photograph mounted on a decorated card showing two adjacent two‑storey houses with tiled roofs and wooden facades. A narrow passage and simple wooden gate stand between them. A man in dark clothes and a hat and a boy stand in front of the buildings. The mount has floral ornamentation in the corners and handwritten captions in a Cyrillic script at the bottom and faintly at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of colonial soldiers with bicycles resting along a dirt road lined with tall palm trees. The men wear tropical helmets and military uniforms and are lying or sitting beside their bicycles under the shade of the palms. At the top appears a printed header from the Belgian Ministry of Colonies, and in the bottom-right corner there is an official stamp indicating authorization for publication. The caption at the bottom left identifies the scene as cyclists at rest.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a calm river with a single rower in a narrow boat, long timber logs floating and stacked along the near bank, and a dirt path lined with tall pollarded trees on the right. In the middle distance there is a steel truss bridge crossing the river, with buildings and additional bridge structures visible beyond it. The scene appears semi‑rural/industrial with no printed caption visible on the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall rocky outcrop in a wooded area with a statue of a chamois (mountain goat) standing on its summit. A man in early 20th‑century attire leans on a railing along the path at the base of the rock. Printed German text appears at the bottom, along with the publisher's information.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a leafy park with benches and people sitting and strolling in the foreground. To the right stands an ornate wooden bandstand or pavilion. Rising behind the trees is a large medieval stone church with a steep gabled roof and a tower topped by a bulbous cupola and clock. Printed text at the top names the place in two languages.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small riverside town with a stone multi‑arch bridge crossing a river in the foreground. A horse‑drawn carriage is moving across the bridge. On the far bank stand several multi‑storey traditional buildings and houses, with gently rolling, cultivated hills and fields in the background. At the top left in red Gothic‑style script is a printed caption identifying the place.

Colorized vintage view of a lake surrounded by low, arid hills. In the foreground is sparse vegetation and a person on horseback on a dirt slope. Across the center is a calm body of water, and behind it rolling hills under a light sky. At the top left, printed text reads "Laguna de Alalay, Cochabamba." A small number "3686" appears in the bottom right corner, suggesting a catalog or series number.

Old monochrome postcard showing a wooded valley with dense trees surrounding a small pond or river. At the center is a wooden platform or pavilion on stilts extending over the water, possibly part of a watermill or viewing structure. Along the bottom margin there is printed text in Dutch/German mentioning a waterfall, hotel and a place called Plasmolen near Mook on the river Maas, with handwritten cursive notes over the margin.

Colorized winter landscape of an alpine village in a valley, surrounded by dense evergreen forests and dramatic jagged mountains. Snow covers the roofs and trees; several multi‑story hotels or lodges are visible, suggesting a ski resort. The sky is bright blue with scattered white clouds, and there is a scalloped decorative border around the image, typical of vintage postcards.

A vintage postal card with printed and handwritten text in Russian and Estonian. The top features the Russian word "Печатное". There are address lines printed in Estonian, with handwritten recipient information including the name "Peeter Sünd" and an address. A green 2‑kopeck Imperial Russian postage stamp is affixed in the upper right corner and is cancelled with circular date stamps marked 24 9 17. At the bottom left is the printed sender information "Tallinna Eesti Laenu- ja Hoiu-Ühisus." The card is otherwise plain, with no photograph or illustration.

A black-and-white photograph of a narrow cobblestone street lined with old plastered buildings. The most prominent building has a baroque-style bay window with small-paned glass and ornate tracery, topped by an onion dome and pointed spire. The roofs are covered with small tiles, and the street curves gently downhill between high walls and older townhouses. Leafless trees suggest late autumn or early spring. The overall look is of a quiet historic European town. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by open farmland. In the foreground there is a lumber yard with stacked timbers, sheds and some garden plots with laundry hanging on lines. Behind it stand several 2–3‑storey masonry houses with steep tiled roofs and simple historicist facades. Two tall brick factory chimneys rise among trees, suggesting light industry at the edge of the settlement. Larger institutional-style buildings are visible on the left, and long tree-lined field boundaries stretch into the distant flat countryside.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large, elegant late‑19th‑century mansion used as a university building. It has a mansard roof with dormer windows, ornate stone façade and tall windows. A few pedestrians and a dog walk along the broad street in front. Trees and a garden surround the building, with another structure and a church or tower visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the top left.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the façade of a grand multi‑storey hotel building with ornate balconies and arched windows. A covered entrance canopy extends toward the street, with trees and people visible in the foreground. At the top of the building the sign reads "Grand Continental", and printed text on the right identifies the scene as the Continental Hotel in Cairo. A modern website watermark appears along the bottom.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded street parade in a tree‑lined urban area. In the foreground, a marching band in uniform plays instruments such as drums and brass, while many spectators line the sides of the street. Early 20th‑century automobiles and period clothing suggest an historical scene. In the distance, an ornamental arch or gate spans the street. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a waterfront promenade and garden with palm trees in the foreground and a partial panoramic view of the city behind. A small harbor with boats lies along the left side, while low historic buildings and civic structures line the square. The caption in Portuguese at the top identifies the scene as a garden and partial view of Faro.

A vintage illustration of a young female angel with large white wings, wearing a flowing white robe accented with gold dots. She stands in front of a stylized Gothic-style window or arch with blue sky panels and green grass visible through the openings. The angel holds the hem of her robe in one hand, with a small bouquet of colorful flowers resting in the fold. The card has a decorative, religious, and somewhat Art Nouveau look, with gold embellishments around the borders.

A monochrome photograph of a Byzantine-style church complex on a rocky hillside, with tall cypress trees rising beside stone fortification walls. A large arched gateway sits at the base of the hill, above a rough path, while above it stands a multi‑storey bell tower with arched openings and a domed church behind it. The landscape is mountainous in the background. At the bottom center, there is a modern printed website watermark.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view across a river toward a small town with early 20th‑century wooden and masonry buildings, including what appears to be a church and several large houses or civic buildings. Fields stretch between the riverbank and the town, with forested hills in the distance. The word "Elverum" is printed in red in the upper left corner.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a staged scene with numerous people in traditional folk costumes arranged in a theatrical tableau. At the center and right, women in long dresses and men in uniforms and peasant clothing enact an allegorical or historical scene, with props like a spear, drum, zither‑like instrument and tree branches. Along the right side is a vertical printed text block in Finnish, with smaller lines of publication information at the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a walled monastery complex with a central church façade and a tall bell tower with a green dome. Several people stand or walk in the courtyard and along the road in front. Trees line the background, and the image has a printed website watermark at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, multi‑storey hotel or sanatorium‑style building situated on a forested hill. Dense coniferous trees surround the main structure, which has a long, rectangular form with many windows and a prominent central entrance. In the foreground, rooftops of smaller buildings are partly visible among the trees. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century mountain or spa resort. There is a small printed caption at the bottom left of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of Budapest showing steamships on the Danube River in the foreground and the large hilltop palace complex in the background. The image is lightly sepia-toned with printed red caption text at the top in Hungarian and German.

Black‑and‑white image of a broad cobbled town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story gabled houses with shops on the ground floor. Awnings extend over the sidewalks, with several clearly visible German shop signs. A few women in long dresses walk across the otherwise open square, and tall ornate street lamps with hanging flower baskets line the space. The architecture is late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century Central European, giving a calm small‑town atmosphere.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a village street scene with a large church dominating the right side, featuring a tall steeple and clock. A curved road runs in front of the church, with a man walking along it and carts or barrels further down the road. Traditional houses and trees line the left side. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "HATERT. Dorpgezicht."

A monochrome (black‑and‑white) historic postcard view of a cobblestoned street lined with multi‑story traditional houses. On the right is a small square with trees and a tall stone obelisk-like monument surrounded by hedges. A person dressed in dark clothing walks up the street holding an umbrella. The caption at the top reads in German, indicating the town and the specific square.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a small tower-like structure on a tiny islet in a calm strait, with a historic city shoreline and many minarets visible in the distant background. The central building has a square base, tiled roofs, and a tall spire. There is printed caption text along the bottom edge and a circular stamp mark on the left, plus a modern website watermark.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the full front facade of a multi‑storey brick building with a central entrance and balconies. A large rooftop sign reads "HOTEL de PAUW". On the ground floor are shopfront windows with awnings and signage for a lunchroom and café-restaurant belonging to the hotel. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the establishment as Hotel-Café-Restaurant 'de Pauw' in Nijmegen, with its street address and telephone number.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large arch bridge crossing a wide river. Crowds of people line both sides of the bridge and the riverbank; a few vehicles, including a bus, are on the roadway. On the right riverbank several moored sailing ships are visible. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and highlights the bridge's notable span.

A black‑and‑white view of a large waterside baroque castle with several round corner towers capped by domes and lanterns, a central section with a steep roof and a tall spire, and a formal tree‑lined garden between the castle and the water in the foreground. The image is framed like an old photograph or postcard, with no visible caption or border text on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick fire station with a tall, ornate hose‑drying/watch tower rising above the main building. The architecture is 19th‑century historicist with arched windows and decorative brickwork. The foreground shows a cobblestone street, fence, and hedges; there are telegraph poles and a streetlamp. Printed captions in red read "Helsingfors" on the lower left and "Brandstation" on the lower right. The lower part of the card contains handwritten cursive text.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a tree-lined avenue in late autumn or early spring, with tall bare trees forming a corridor. A procession of people in early 20th‑century clothing walks along the path; some appear to be carrying banners or flags. Many onlookers stand on either side of the road. Handwritten text in a decorative script is visible at the bottom, and a date is written on the right side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of sandy dunes covered with low shrubs and grasses at a seaside location. Several people in early 20th‑century swimwear lie sunbathing among the dunes, with the sea and a distant shoreline visible in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom left, and a small oval publisher's mark with additional text is at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street leading toward a tall church with a sharp spire. Multi‑storey stone buildings flank the street, and a few pedestrians and a cart are visible on the unpaved road. The words "Skara." and "Järnvägsgatan." are printed at the top.

A monochrome commemorative postcard featuring a central oval portrait of a bald man with a beard and glasses, framed by laurel leaves. Above the portrait appears a star with the dates "1912" and "1913" around it, and Greek text curving along the top. On the left side is the Greek flag, and on the right side another flag (likely Balkan ally). At the bottom, more Greek text identifies him as prime minister during the Greek‑Turkish wars, with his name signed below. There is also a circular seal-like mark and a small printed number in the corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street in a small European town. Multi‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows line both sides of the street. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and push baby carriages along the road. At the top, red printed German text identifies the place, and a red handwritten year appears on the upper right.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a hilly, forested rural landscape with scattered farms and houses. A railway line and a small station with several buildings are visible in the right foreground, running through the valley. Text in Norwegian is printed at the bottom of the image, identifying the view near Veldre Station and crediting the photographer/publisher Carl Normann with a date of 1926.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small alpine town nestled in a valley surrounded by densely forested mountains and snow-capped peaks. The settlement consists of traditional multi-story buildings and a prominent church with a tall steeple near the center. Foreground trees frame the scene. At the bottom right of the image, white caption text indicates the town name, its altitude, and the word 'Panorama.'

Sepia-toned postcard showing a formal military parade in a city square. Uniformed officers with sashes and ceremonial swords march in formation; one officer walks prominently in the foreground. Multi‑storey neoclassical buildings line the background, with onlookers visible on balconies and rooftops. The caption at the top reads in French, and a website watermark and a small printed number appear at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a railway station building beside several sets of train tracks. The station is a wooden structure with decorative timber framing, a steep roof, and a central gable. Several people stand on the platform in front of the building. Large trees line the area beside the station. Printed text at the top right identifies the scene as the railway station in Emmaboda, and signage on the building also reads "EMMABODA" along with some smaller, less legible text.

Vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a busy marketplace in a European town. Crowds of people in late‑19th or early‑20th century clothing fill a wide street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops on both sides. Market stalls, carts, and a horse-drawn wagon are visible. A tower with a small dome and flag rises in the background. Printed captions at the bottom read "Grossenhain. Frauenmarkt." and a publisher credit "Brück & Sohn, Meissen" together with the number 3463.

Vintage sepia postcard with extensive handwritten Spanish text on the right and embossed lettering on the left. The right side contains printed Spanish headings related to an industrial exhibition and centenary celebration in Buenos Aires, along with a small red diamond logo containing the letters "AG". Below the writing is a black‑and‑white photograph showing a rural pampas landscape with cattle gathered at a waterhole and a few trees on the horizon. A printed caption under the image reads "Un Rodeo en la Provincia de Buenos Aires".

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a landscaped city park. The fountain has multiple tiers with sculpted figures and water basins, surrounded by smaller statues, flower beds, lawns, benches, and tall trees. At the top of the card, printed text identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a historic European town with dense, steep‑roofed houses in the foreground and a large fortress‑like complex with towers and spires dominating the mid‑ground. A tall industrial chimney and a long factory building stand to the left, while wooded hills frame the background. Streets curve between the tightly packed old buildings; the architecture appears Central European, likely German-speaking, early 20th century.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a river with a small waterfall and curved stone embankment, benches along a path, and several buildings including an industrial brick structure on the right, set among rocky terrain and leafless trees in a townscape.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, a paddle steamer is sailing on a wide river. Behind it rise terraced houses and, dominating the hill, a large castle-like complex with a Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires and steep roofs. The printed caption along the bottom identifies the scene. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town with many pitched‑roof houses, a prominent church tower in the center, surrounding fields and trees in the foreground, and low hills in the distance. In the top left corner there is red printed text reading "Blick auf Radeburg," indicating the view of the town of Radeburg.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph depicting a large, elegant villa or manor house set in landscaped gardens. The building has two main stories plus an attic with dormer windows, a tiled hip roof, symmetrical façades with classical elements such as columned porticos, pediments, and balustraded balconies. Ivy climbs one side of the house, and tall trees and manicured lawn surround it, suggesting a wealthy suburban or countryside residence. The image is framed with a white border typical of vintage postcards.

A monochrome (greenish-tinted) vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with open fields in the foreground and a cluster of farm-style buildings in the background, including a larger main house with a tall chimney and adjacent outbuildings. There are simple wooden fence posts stretching across the field. In the upper left corner, text is printed in red.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large stone church with a tall clock tower and slender spire reflected in a pond in the foreground. The building has neo‑Gothic / neo‑Romanesque features, arched windows, a steep slate roof, and an ornate entrance. Trees and a low fence stand between the church and the water; low hills are visible in the distant background. The corners of the print are cut, emphasizing its postcard or plate format. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the front.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a gently curving cobblestone street lined with old townhouses. In the distance rises a tall clocktower with an ornate spire, likely the town hall tower. The foreground shows shopfronts with German signage on both sides of the street. At the bottom margin of the image there is a caption in German identifying the view as a look into Schloßstraße with the town hall tower in Waldheim, Saxony. On the right façade a sign reads "Blumenhaus Nizza" and large letters "Nizza".

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town along a river. A masonry and metal bridge crosses the river in the foreground. On the right bank are rows of trees, modest multi‑story houses and civic buildings, and an open grassy area with laundry hanging on lines. In the background rise several church towers and spires dominating the skyline, and low wooded hills beyond the town. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree-lined park with an ornate circular bandstand or kiosk surrounded by a low fence and gas-style lamps. The caption at the bottom identifies it as a kiosk in the Parque de Méndez Núñez in Coruña. Handwritten notes appear along the right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a harbor scene with a large passenger steamship moored at a quay and another smaller vessel in the background. Trees and low buildings line the waterfront. The calm water reflects the ships. Printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom edge of the image.

Vintage black-and-white postcard with two inset photographs. The left image shows a hillside village with several houses in the foreground and, above them on the hill, a large pilgrimage church with twin towers. The right image shows a forest scene with an outdoor roadside crucifix (a wooden cross with a roofed shelter) and fencing around it. The captions beneath the images read "Maria-Trost bei Graz" under the left view and "Waldandacht" under the right, with a small printed serial number at the bottom left.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from an elevated grassy slope with garden plots in the foreground. The middle ground is filled with tightly packed two‑ to three‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of Central Europe. In the distant background rise several large church buildings with tall, narrow spires and neo‑Gothic details, along with a few more massive institutional buildings and smokestacks from early industry. Trees line many of the streets, and two people stand on the hillside at the right edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town in a narrow valley, with ornate multi‑story hotels and townhouses lining both sides of a canal-like river. Tree‑lined promenades and colonnade‑type buildings follow the watercourse. Steep, forested hills rise directly behind the town; on the hilltop to the right stands a small lookout tower or pavilion. The architecture is late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century Central European, and one rooftop sign with German text is visible in the foreground.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a large riverside or lakeside building complex (a castle or manor) lined with tall trees, reflected in the still water in the foreground. In the distance on the left is a town with a church spire. The lower right contains printed German captions in red type describing the scene and the publisher.

Black‑and‑white image showing a wide, empty square with a tall column topped by a winged statue at the center. Curved colonnades with large pillars frame both sides of the monument. A few pedestrians walk across the broad, tram‑track‑marked pavement in the foreground, and trees as well as a distant church spire are visible behind the structure.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into three adjacent panels within a simple decorative border. The left panel shows a modest Gothic‑style church with pointed arched windows and a tall slender spire, standing beside another brick building, with bare trees and a low fence in front. The central panel depicts a substantial two‑story brick house with shutters on the windows, set behind a hedge and small gate along a roadside lined with leafless trees. The right panel shows another large brick house with a tiled, fairly steep roof and many windows; several children in light‑colored clothing stand or walk along the road in front of the hedge. The scene appears to be a quiet village or small‑town street in winter or early spring.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small rural town surrounded by forests and fields. A railway line with a station and parallel road runs diagonally across the image, with scattered houses and farm buildings on both sides. In the bottom left, white text identifies the view; in the bottom right, a logo and publisher information are printed.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad tree‑lined urban avenue flanked by several‑storey townhouses with ornate façades and mansard roofs. On the right, tall residential buildings with wrought‑iron balconies and fenced front gardens form a continuous block; pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing and a few children walk along the sidewalk.
