The left side shows more modest buildings and bare winter trees along a wide, mostly empty carriageway where a horse‑drawn vehicle is visible in the distance. The sky area is blank and unprinted, giving the image a vignetted look typical of old postcards. No legible text appears in the picture area.

A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting a simple rural church with a tall square tower topped by a cross and a long nave with arched windows. There is sparse vegetation around the church and a small figure standing by the main entrance. Printed caption text appears below the image identifying the church and its diocese.

Sepia-toned winter scene showing a small brick church with a tiled gable roof and a modest wooden bell tower topped by a cross. Bare trees surround the building, and snow covers the ground. A lone figure wearing a long dark coat and light head covering walks along a path next to a simple wire or rope fence. Some construction materials or wooden benches lie near the church walls. The image has the proportions and border style typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards. In the lower right corner there is faint mirrored text, likely part of a publisher's imprint.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a woman in a trench coat standing on a sidewalk beside a row of parked 1950s-era cars. Behind her are partially damaged or rough-rendered building walls and, further back, modernist mid-rise office or apartment buildings with large windows. A tree frames the right side and a utility truck is parked to the left. The image has the composition and framing typical of a vintage urban postcard.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a river harbor with several paddle steamers and barges moored along a quay. The foreground shows a steamboat named "BOHEMIA" with passengers on deck. On the right side run rail tracks with wagons, small buildings, people, carts and industrial facilities with chimneys in the background. The text at the top identifies the location as Riesa on the Elbe River and labels the steamship landing place.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a portrait of a Catholic bishop on the upper left and a large twin‑towered cathedral with a dome and surrounding buildings on the right and bottom. The text at the top and below the portrait is in Croatian, and there are purple handwritten notes and a date on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet riverside village with a timber‑framed house in the foreground, a bare tree and telephone pole beside a canal or small river, and a covered wooden bridge over the water in the mid‑distance. A child leans on a wooden railing near the water. In the background on a gentle hill stands a church with a tall baroque-style tower and spire, surrounded by clustered village buildings and fields.

Black‑and‑white image showing a stark, monumental modernist building with strong vertical lines. The foreground has a lower wing with rectangular windows and pilasters around a paved courtyard with small shrubs, while the background is dominated by a very tall, flat facade with long vertical recesses, giving an austere institutional or governmental appearance. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a mounted soldier in parade uniform. The rider wears an elaborate blue and white hussar-style uniform with tall boots, a shako-style hat, and carries a lance with a small flag. He sits on a brown horse in a park-like landscape with trees and grass. Red printed titles at the top read "Torgau." and "In Parade." Additional fine print at the bottom credits the publisher and notes that it is a hand-colored artist card dated 1906.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an outdoor public swimming pool complex in a rural or small‑town setting. In the foreground, people in 1950s–1960s style swimwear are bathing and playing in the rectangular pool. Along the pool edge runs a concrete deck with a series of white pergola-style columns and potted plants. Behind the pool are low modernist buildings, one with a circular or polygonal pavilion topped by a small dome or cupola. Further back are trees, fields, scattered houses with sloped roofs, and gentle hills, suggesting a countryside spa or recreation resort.

A sepia-toned postcard photograph of a Renaissance-style arcaded courtyard with multiple levels of round arches and balustrades. On the left is a domed tower-like structure with small windows and an external staircase; on the right, a long façade of repeating arches. The courtyard is mostly empty, with light and shadow on the ground. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town in a river valley, photographed from an elevated hillside path in the foreground. The river curves through the scene with at least two masonry bridges crossing it. On the right side lies a dense cluster of multi‑story townhouses and civic buildings with steep, tiled roofs, and a few church spires or towers visible among them. Beyond the town are industrial chimneys and rail or road bridges, and in the distance rolling hills and patchwork farmland. The image has the aesthetic of an early 20th‑century postcard. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the front.

Black‑and‑white vertical postcard-style photograph showing the corner of an elegant multi‑storey historic building, likely from the 19th century. The façade has large arched windows with decorative leaded glass, rectangular upper windows with pediments, and quoins at the building's edge. A trellis system with climbing plants covers much of the lower façade, and a small formal garden bed with young trees stands in the foreground along a gravel path. In a side bay with a balustraded balcony, two people can be seen looking out of an open window. The surroundings suggest a park or landscaped grounds. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a landscaped city garden with tall trees, a circular fountain in the foreground, and a white stone obelisk monument on steps at the center. Several formally dressed people stand and sit around the monument. Behind the trees, the roof and upper façade of a large building are visible. There is printed Cyrillic text at the top.

Sepia-toned photograph of a quiet European street lined with attached three‑ to four‑story buildings featuring shuttered windows and modest shopfronts at ground level. The architecture is 19th‑century urban style, with simple classical detailing around windows and doors. A few pedestrians and a cart are visible in the distance, and the street appears relatively empty. There is no visible printed caption or border title on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a quiet street beside a fenced property with long, low buildings and a small tower-like dome. On the main façade, large painted German words advertise a sparkling-wine cellar called "Sektkellerei Niederlößnitz." A stone wall and wooden picket fence run along the street, with telegraph poles and tall poplar trees lining the road. In the background are additional residential-style buildings and more trees, suggesting a semi-rural wine-growing town.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the ornate Gothic rooftop and central spire of a large cathedral, viewed from the roof with two small human figures walking along the stone slabs. Numerous pinnacles and statues line the roof. Printed captions in Italian and French are below the image.

A vintage sepia postcard showing a large three‑storey neoclassical barracks building with a central entrance arch and a flag flying on top. The view looks straight down a wide, empty road lined with young trees toward the façade. Greek and French captions are printed at the top, and a modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing an old brick octagonal chapel surrounded by trees. The building has narrow arched windows and a steep pyramidal roof on an upper tower section. At the bottom margin, the printed captions read "Nijmegen" on the left and "Karolingische Kapel." on the right.

Illustrated postcard showing a stylized view of the Hofburg palace complex with a large open square and lawns in the foreground, a mounted equestrian statue on a pedestal, and long baroque/renaissance palace façades in the background. Small walking figures are scattered across the square. Beneath the image there is printed text and a large blank area for writing.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing people sledding on a snowy forest path. In the background stands a tall masonry tower rising above the trees. The scene is lively, with several figures on sleds and one person lying in the snow. At the bottom of the image there is a German caption printed in a decorative typeface.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small town in a wide valley with mountains in the background. The foreground shows tightly clustered tiled-roof houses, while more scattered buildings and cultivated fields stretch toward the base of the mountains. A church with a bell tower stands out near the center-right. The caption beneath the image identifies the location as Mattarello, near Trento, and labels the view as a panorama.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a large, ornate neo-baroque/neo-renaissance building along a street lined with trees and lampposts. The façade features multiple stories with arched windows, decorative statues, and an elaborate central pediment. Pedestrians are visible on the sidewalk in front. In the upper left corner, red printed text reads "Leitmeritz a. Elbe. Korps-Kommando."

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene with an ornate Renaissance-style town hall building lined with statues and tall windows on the left, pedestrians walking along a cobblestone street, and a church tower rising in the background. The captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen." on the left and "Stadhuis." on the right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a rural landscape with a church featuring a tall tower and bulbous spire on the right, and several school or residential buildings to the left, set behind trees and open fields in the foreground. At the top, printed text in Swedish reads "Färentuna kyrka och skola." There are a few handwritten annotations and marks near the top center and next to the church tower.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural school building surrounded by fields and forested hills. The central two‑story house has a flagpole with a Scandinavian-style flag and is approached by a dirt road where groups of children and adults are gathered. The image has a printed caption in Swedish at the bottom.

A monochrome illustrated advertising postcard for the flower growers and florists firm Gerretsen & Valeton. It shows a bird's‑eye view of extensive greenhouses and nursery fields with a few houses and paths, decorative roses, and an inset of an ornate city building labeled as a flower shop. There is a royal coat of arms at the top left and multiple Dutch texts promoting the company's nursery in Hees and flower shop in Nijmegen, the Netherlands.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, grand neoclassical-style building with two rounded corner towers and a long central facade facing a landscaped garden with paths and flower beds. The image is bordered by a printed frame, and handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom edge.

Black-and-white postcard view from inside a lounge or dining room with modernist armchairs and small tables. Large windows look out over a calm fjord with steep, snow‑topped mountains in the distance and a white wooden railing and trees in the foreground. The lower margin of the image contains printed captions identifying the scene and photographer.

Color photograph of a hilltop Gothic cathedral complex with two tall, dark spires rising above a long, slate-roofed building that looks like a castle or palace. The structure stands on a wooded hillside, with dense green trees in the foreground and a few small houses with steep, tiled roofs at the bottom. The sky is clear and blue with light clouds. No visible text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small harbor with two docked vessels: a larger passenger steamer and a smaller sailing ship or fishing boat. Behind them stands a low wooden quay building with a gabled roof. In the foreground are grassy banks with a small rowboat pulled up on shore and a tree framing the right side of the image. The water and distant low shoreline are visible under a cloudy sky. Printed captions appear at the lower left and right edges.

A monochrome photographic postcard showing a forest scene with dense conifer trees and a rocky stream flowing through the middle. The water runs over large boulders, creating a picturesque natural landscape. At the bottom margin, there is printed red text identifying the location and a serial number.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy harbor scene with a large sailing ship docked at a quay in La Coruña. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk and work along the waterfront, with small boats in the foreground and a townscape in the background. Printed captions and publisher information appear below the image and along the left margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs. The upper left shows a large medieval hilltop castle with multiple towers and a forested backdrop. The upper right depicts a lakeside or riverside resort with boats, piers, and many people seated under umbrellas at an outdoor café. The lower left shows a dam or lakeside promenade crowded with visitors, with timber buildings nearby and dense forest in the background. The lower right displays a winding river or reservoir running through a wooded valley with a small boat on the water. In the center, elegant script text reads "Zschopau-Talsperre Kriebstein."

Black‑and‑white image showing a tranquil riverside or mill pond scene in a rural European town. In the foreground three people stand and sit on a simple flat boat tethered to the shore. Across the water is a wooden dam or weir, timber buildings including a half‑timbered house, and a large multi‑storey white industrial building with a small cupola on the roof, likely a factory, brewery, or mill. Trees and low hills surround the settlement, and a bench and tree with posted notices appear on the right edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone-paved square in an old European city. On the right stands a large Baroque church with statues on the façade and dome, fronted by steps and a lamppost; to the left is a colonnaded arcade framing the scene with several people in dark coats and hats walking or standing. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Dubrovnik" and the photographer credit "Foto Berner".

Sepia-toned historical street view showing a cobblestone road lined with early 20th‑century buildings, telegraph poles, a horse-drawn carriage, and an early automobile. People stand along the sidewalk. A prominent light-colored building with pillars appears on the right. Printed caption text in Latvian is visible along the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a canal in a historic European city with brick gabled houses on both sides and a tall belfry tower rising in the background. A small bridge with railings crosses the canal in the foreground. On the right is a stepped‑gable building with signage on its facade, and a small square with people and market stalls can be seen. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the card.

A vintage cable telegram form from CABLE AND WIRELESS LIMITED, Athens Branch, printed in red and black. The pre‑printed header includes fields for local number, clerk, date, time, and origin/destination, with typed entries indicating a telegram from Athens to Helsinki on 22 August 1939. The addressee line reads "VEKIARELLI ATHENS." Below, in the message area, there is printed instruction text and several lines of handwritten pencil notes mentioning Olympia, Helsinki, and the 1940 Olympiad.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a wide, straight street lined with substantial late‑19th / early‑20th‑century townhouses or institutional buildings on both sides. The architecture shows steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, ornate gables and modest decoration, typical of Central European cities. Wooden and brick fences border leafy gardens, and a woman in a long dress walks along the left sidewalk while a cyclist rides in the distance. A tall utility pole stands in the center of the street, and handwritten white markings appear along the right edge of the image, suggesting cataloging or postcard titling.

Black‑and‑white view of a small coastal resort town backed by dry, chaparral‑covered hills. A curved shoreline is lined with hotels and commercial buildings facing the water. Numerous small rowboats and a few larger passenger vessels fill the calm harbor, with a wooden pier extending into the bay. Houses climb the hillside behind the waterfront. The border and perspective suggest a vintage postcard or promotional photograph.

Vintage colored postcard view of a covered market square with colonnades surrounding an open central space and a tall stone column in the middle. In the background are stepped‑gabled houses and Gothic church towers typical of Bruges. Printed captions at the top and bottom identify the location as the fish market in Bruges and give the name and address of a local shop.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early‑20th‑century city intersection. On the left stands an ornate historicist corner building with a tall, steep roofed tower; on the right is a large, modernist/Art Deco style building labeled "Hotel Astoria". People in period clothing walk across the street, and a horse‑drawn carriage and an early motor bus are visible, suggesting a transitional era between horse and motor traffic. The printed caption at the top reads "Cluj" and "Hotel Astoria — Asztoria Szálloda".

Multi‑view vintage postcard with five small images bordered by floral decorations. Scenes include a restaurant terrace with a statue, a small pavilion in a wooded area, a tall commemorative column, a rocky outcrop labeled as an obelisk, and another restaurant or inn with outdoor seating. The captions are printed in German and reference monuments and restaurants named Buchholz and Löwenberg.

Colorized historic postcard showing a small neoclassical public-bath building with a tall brick chimney and the inscription "Stadt Volksbad" above the main entrance. A curved path, grass, and young trees occupy the foreground, with two people in long coats standing on the walkway. Behind are houses with red-tiled roofs. The printed caption at the top right reads "Graz, Städt. Volksbad Friedrichstrasse."

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a tranquil river or lake bordered by dense forest and a path with a fence on the left bank. In the distance, on a wooded hill, there is a small pavilion or lookout tower. The sky has a soft gradient from light yellow near the horizon to blue above. The caption text in German is printed at the top.

Colorized historic postcard showing a grand civic building with red-tiled roofs, ornate façades and a tall clock tower with a green spire. The front lower part of the building bears the word "SPARKASSE" above arched windows, indicating a savings bank. At the top of the postcard appear the captions "Bilin." on the left and "Neues Rathaus." on the right, suggesting this is the new town hall of Bilin. A cobbled street and metal railing run in front of the building under a clear sky with a few clouds.

Monochrome postcard showing a seated statue of a bearded man on a high pedestal surrounded by wreaths. The figure is in formal 19th‑century dress, sitting in an armchair; on the pedestal the name "HAMERLING." is clearly inscribed. The statue appears to stand in an outdoor setting framed by two architectural posts. There is cursive handwriting along the bottom margin and faint writing along the left edge.

Color-tinted postcard view of a round medieval brick tower standing in a landscaped park. The tower has crenellations and a small pointed roof with a finial. In the foreground is a grassy lawn with trees, paths, benches, and several people in early-20th‑century clothing strolling or standing. At the top right, printed red text reads the name of the city and park.

Black‑and‑white view along a broad, clean street bordered by substantial multi‑storey buildings in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European historicist style. On the left stands a large corner block with ornate gables, turrets, and a steep tiled roof; people are visible looking out from the open windows. On the right are lower institutional‑looking buildings with hip roofs and a domed pavilion in the mid‑distance. A few pedestrians walk along the street and sidewalks; there are no cars, only open space and simple fencing in the foreground. The sky is blank and overexposed, and the image has the framing and proportions typical of an old postcard or plate photograph.

A colorized historical street scene showing a large Ottoman mosque with a central dome and two tall, slender minarets. The mosque stands to the right, while to the left there is a row of European-style buildings with arcades, shops, awnings, and pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century dress walking along the wide street. The image has a printed caption along the right margin and a small website watermark at the bottom.

A vintage sepia-toned aerial view of a small European town nestled among hills and fields. Dense rows of houses with pitched roofs fill the foreground, with a prominent ornate building featuring a tall clock tower rising near the center-right. Industrial buildings with chimneys stand to the left and in the background, and forested hills and farmland stretch into the distance. The word "Waldheim." is printed in red at the top left, and there is small vertical red printing along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European town taken from a grassy foreground. A simple wooden bridge with a low railing crosses a stream or small river. Behind the bridge stand trees and, further back, tightly packed houses with steep gabled roofs. Dominating the background is a church tower topped with an onion‑shaped dome and cross. On one of the buildings near the center there is a painted commercial sign in German. The upper left corner of the image is missing or overexposed, suggesting damage or cropping of an old photographic postcard or plate.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a European town square. The image shows a broad cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑storey historic townhouses with arcades and ornate facades. In the center distance stands a lamppost; a few people and children are scattered around the open space. On the right edge are shopfronts with signage, including one for a business named Paul Grossmann. A building on the corner carries the sign 'Hotel Huppert'. At the top left of the card, handwritten text reads 'Radetur g. Markt'. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century German town market square scene.

Black-and-white postcard view of an ornate spa pavilion with a domed roof and elaborate wrought-iron railings and colonnades, opening onto a landscaped city park with flowerbeds, paths, trees, and surrounding hillside buildings. The caption at the bottom right reads "Weltbad Karlsbad. Stadtpark."

A black-and-white postcard view of a waterfront fortress complex with high stone walls, a round tower on the left, and harbor waters in the foreground with boats and a small sailing vessel. In the distance are city buildings and a large crane-like structure on the right side. Printed text at the top identifies the location as Fort Saint-Jean in Marseille.

Color postcard depicting a large multi-arched stone aqueduct crossing over a town built on a hillside. Traditional houses with red-tiled roofs stand beneath the arches. Greek text is printed at the top left, with French text at the top right identifying the structure as the aqueduct of Cavalla. A web address is faintly visible at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white view of a small rural church with a tall, slender wooden spire and steep roof, surrounded by leafless trees and a low wooden fence made of rough horizontal rails. A large crowd of people in dark, old‑fashioned clothing stands along the fence and by a road in the foreground. In the distance, there is a glimpse of open countryside or water. Classic European architecture lines the street, and people dressed in old-fashioned clothing stand in the square. Trees and a fountain are visible in the foreground. The overall tone and imagery suggest an early 20th-century setting. The postcard contains German-language text.

A black and white photograph of a hilly town with multiple mid-sized buildings and villas scattered along winding roads. The town is set against a mountainous backdrop with some snow-capped peaks, and there are many trees and cultivated plots of land in the foreground. At the top of the card, handwritten text reads: 'Rovereto - Viale dei Colli'.

A sepia-toned postcard depicting an elegant and ornate building with arches and towers along a wide avenue. The architecture features strong Middle Eastern/Islamic influences, with domes and minarets. There are gardens and pathways in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads 'HELIOPOLIS - Pyramids Avenue.'

A black-and-white image depicting a quiet residential street lined with trees and early 20th-century European-style buildings. There are a few pedestrians, including a woman in period dress and a boy. The architecture features arched windows, decorative brickwork, and steeply-pitched roofs typical of late 19th or early 20th-century Central European urban areas.

A vintage black and white photograph of a cargo or passenger ship sailing on calm waters. The ship has the name 'LELYSTAD' clearly visible on its bow, and a flag (likely Dutch) is flying at the stern. The style and condition of the ship, as well as the overall sepia tone, suggest it is from the mid-20th century.

A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting the ornate entrance of a grand building with Moorish architectural features, such as an arch and intricate tilework. The caption at the bottom identifies the site as the 'Entrée du Palais de Justice' in Casablanca.

The image shows an old postcard featuring an ornate stone bridge with decorative lamp posts and balustrades. There are several people on the bridge, as well as a horse-drawn carriage and an early tram. In the background stands a large, classical-style building. A vintage seaside postcard showing small wooden fishing boats on the water near a sandy shore with a tree-lined promenade. A low building and a high stone wall can be seen in the background, along with a castle-like structure or tower on a hill. The overall coloring and print style suggest an early 20th-century production.

A vintage postcard depicting people in Edwardian-era clothing rowing boats on a wooded lake. The background shows houses and foliage, suggesting a tranquil leisure spot. The postcard has sepia tones, typical of early 20th-century photographic prints. Text at the top left reads 'Bad Elster. Partie am Luisa-See.'

A sepia-toned postcard featuring a rustic wooded landscape with a traditional log building, a small outdoor dining area with empty wooden benches and tables, and several people seated by the building. A sepia-toned postcard showing a narrow street bordered by old residential buildings, balconies with laundry hanging out to dry, lush trees, and a prominent clock tower with a spire in the background. The text at the bottom of the postcard reads '11378 - Borgo Valsugana - Lungo Brenta Superiore.'

This postcard features a historic European market square surrounded by ornate buildings in a small town. A vintage postcard showing a wide, elegant public square with ornate buildings in the background. The square is landscaped with walkways, grass, and trees, and there are people strolling and sitting around. The postcard's text is in three languages (Hungarian, German, and possibly another), and the style of buildings suggests early 20th century European architecture.

A black-and-white aerial view of a European city center, dominated by a prominent church with a rose window and pointed arches. The square around the church is lined with older buildings and some people walking or cycling. Signs in German are visible on the shopfronts in the foreground, and the distant landscape includes rolling hills and an impressive building complex on the horizon.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing an ornate building with baroque architectural features, domed towers, and classical façades. Bare trees line a square in front of the building. The postcard includes text giving location information.

A black and white vintage postcard showing a rugged, hilly landscape with visible remnants of mining structures at the bottom of a valley, next to a river. The surroundings are natural, with rocky outcrops and sparse vegetation. At the top, there is printed text in French identifying the location as the old lead and silver mines of Pranal and the Sioule, part of the Auvergne region's picturesque sites.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a cable car (ropeway) ascending or descending over a hilly, forested landscape. There are some buildings visible at the bottom left, likely a station or small mountain village, surrounded by fields and dense patches of trees. The overall impression is that of a picturesque mountainous region, possibly intended as a tourist destination.

A historical black-and-white photograph showing a large, formal gathering in a public square. There are military officers, troops in formation, and groups of civilians. The main building in the background is neoclassical, flying a large flag, and in front of it stands a prominent statue. The cobblestone square and scale suggest an important civic location. The lower right corner contains printed text: 'NYBLIN 1918'.

A vintage black and white image depicting a grand, castle-like building with corner turrets and a central tower, perched on a wooded hillside. The architecture looks Central European, with steep clay-tile roofs and baroque or art nouveau details. There is no legible text on the front.

The postcard is a black-and-white photograph showing a historical European street view. A tall church or cathedral tower with a clock and a baroque-style dome dominates the background. The street is lined with old buildings and trees, with a few people visible, including someone standing and others sitting on the right. In the foreground, there is printed red text at the bottom identifying the location as Dippoldiswalde.

A black-and-white postcard featuring a busy river scene with many boats and junks on the water. Dense urban buildings line the riverbanks and a crowd of people is visible on the street adjacent to the docks. The image is early 20th century, with a mix of traditional Chinese and some early modern Western architecture. The caption appears to be in Danish or Norwegian.

A black and white night-time photograph showing two steam locomotives at a train yard. The locomotives are illuminated by their own headlights and nearby street lamps, creating dramatic beams of light in the night. Visible on the right locomotive is the number '23 1113,' which can give clues to its origin. There are train tracks and some blurred infrastructure visible in the background.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a grove of large, sprawling, ancient-looking oak trees (possibly cork or holm oak) with thick trunks and abundant foliage. In the foreground, a prominent tree trunk has visible carvings, and the overall scene suggests a park-like or natural setting. The lower margin of the image has some reversed or upside-down text, most prominently 'Brun 5232.'

A black and white image showing a rectangular, multi-windowed historic building with climbing vines on its walls. The structure has a steep pitched roof with multiple chimneys and dormer windows. A vintage postcard depicting a dense cluster of old buildings dominated by a prominent medieval stone tower with a conical roof, known as the Galata Tower. The sky is tinted in pastel colors. The image depicts a vintage, partially damaged postcard with three nude women arranged in an artistic, symbolic pose. The top left corner has the faint inscription 'Un con...' and a small publisher or artist monogram appears in the lower left corner. The image is black and white, or sepia-toned.

The image depicts an old, stone-built fortification or battery with a large cannon mounted on top. The scene is arid, with rocky ground and hills visible in the background. A black-and-white postcard depicting a historical church with a clock tower and a large, domed chapel. Crosses adorn the top of both the tower and the dome. A black-and-white postcard depicting a modernist-style hotel building situated on a shore, with a stone bridge and large concrete breakers in the water in front of it. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a smiling group of Sámi schoolchildren in traditional gákti clothing standing outdoors with a young teacher, mountains and a lake in the background. Caption text in Swedish is printed along the bottom edge, with a photographer's imprint.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a lake and dense forest with the mountain Vällistefjället in the background near Undersåker. In the foreground are electrified railway tracks with catenary poles. Caption and photographer credit are printed on the image with a catalogue number.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a town square with people around an early automobile and a bus. On the right stands a two‑storey town hall with a small cupola and the word "Rathaus" on its pediment. Shops line the left side. The printed caption at bottom left reads "Ortrand - Altmarkt."

Black‑and‑white vintage townscape showing numerous wooden houses and unpaved streets in a Nordic mining town. A large wooden building with many windows and a decorative dormer is prominent in the foreground. The caption reads "Parti av Kiruna." and there is an oval hallmark "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI."

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined avenue with telegraph poles and several pedestrians and carts in the distance. Printed captions identify the location, and a handwritten date appears near the bottom.

Vintage chromolithograph holiday postcard with holly and snowdrop sprigs framing a bell-shaped vignette of a snowy rural scene at sunset: thatched cottages with smoking chimneys, bare trees, a fence, and a lone figure in a long skirt walking along a snow-covered lane.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a view over a town with a church tower in the background and, in the foreground, a military cemetery filled with rows of wooden crosses decorated with cockades and wreaths. Black‑and‑white real‑photo view of a wooded riverside scene with a small dark wooden house in the foreground, a larger villa behind it, and a steep hill with a staircase or ramp leading to the top. Black‑and‑white street view of an elegant spa promenade lined with richly decorated facades and hotels. Well‑dressed pedestrians in early 20th‑century fashion stroll along a wide boulevard with lampposts and a wooded hillside in the background. A vintage black‑and‑white view of a small urban square lined with shuttered buildings and shops with awnings. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled space, with mountains visible in the background. A printed caption at the top reads "Trento - Largo Carducci."

Vintage black‑and‑white village street scene with an inn on the left (sign reading "Gasthof …"), fenced yards, large trees in bloom, and several people with bicycles and a dog. Red caption text is printed along the bottom.

Sepia-toned interior of a European dining room or inn: long tables with white cloths and small flower vases, many wooden chairs, ornate ceiling border and striped wallpaper, globe chandeliers, a large radiator, and two large framed oval portraits of an imperial-looking man and woman on the wall; a tall glazed door with curtains stands to the right.

Commemorative postcard with a collage of World War II images: crowds celebrating, soldiers in a jeep, and troops paddling assault boats across a river. Bold Dutch text highlights the 70th anniversary of Operation Market Garden. Dominant colors are orange and green.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the interior of Gothic stone ruins with large pointed arches and tall window openings. Captioned in cursive at the bottom with the place name and the word for monastery ruins.

Panoramic black‑and‑white view of a Central European spa town: ornate cast‑iron and glass colonnade pavilions with small domes in a park at the bottom, long rows of multi‑story townhouses, and on the hillside above a cluster of grand eclectic villas/hotel‑palaces set among gardens and fields.

Old universal-style address side of a postcard with multilingual headings (Levelezö-Lap, Postkarte, Dopisnice, Cartolina postale, Carte postale, Briefkaart, etc.). Hand‑colored early 20th‑century postcard showing a riverside scene on the Elbe with barges and small boats moored along the shore, a half‑timbered house and farm buildings, and a steep rocky cliff rising on the opposite bank. Rural trees and fields appear on the heights above.

Colorized historic view of a busy European main square with a grand domed city hall building, streetcar tracks, awnings and umbrellas for market stalls, a central statue fountain, and people in early 20th‑century attire. Illustrated seaside scene of two women in early 20th‑century striped bathing suits. A mirrored publisher mark appears along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white view of a Gothic stone church on a small hill, with a very steep gabled roof topped by a small ridge turret with a cross, a square side tower with a pointed spire, tall lancet windows, and ivy on the apse. Black‑and‑white real photo postcard showing the richly carved Baroque pulpit inside a stone church with round arches. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Varnhem Abbey Church and specifies the pulpit. An oval mark reads "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI."

Black‑and‑white rooftop view of a grand late‑19th‑century eclectic palace fronting a curved street with a small traffic island and zebra crossing. Many 1960s-era cars and pedestrians line the façade. Black‑and‑white landscape view of a forested hill and valley with a curving railway line and a country road running parallel. A small farmhouse sits near the base of the hill. Printed captions identify the scene and photographer/publisher.

Black-and-white studio portrait of two women in ornate, sequined theatrical costumes with extravagant headdresses, posing closely against a soft-focus backdrop. Margins show printed text and light handwritten marks.

Black‑and‑white view of a Central European town dominated by a Baroque Catholic church with a tall onion‑dome steeple. The church sits on a small rise amid leafy trees, with surrounding gabled houses and a larger rectory or monastery‑like building. No printed captions are visible.

A blue marbled cover card for a set of souvenir photographs titled 'Meißen' printed in blackletter. It states there are 10 small collectible photos in real photography and lists the publisher Brück & Sohn of Meissen, with a serial number.

Hand-colored view across a calm river with small rowboats in the foreground and a long pontoon bridge spanning the water toward a town with church spires. German captions at top read "Gruß aus Mitau" and "Die Aa-Brücke."

Black-and-white view of a plastered Gothic church with tall pointed-arch stained-glass windows and a small ridge turret topped by an onion dome. Steep tiled roof, simple gable, and conifer trees in the foreground. No printed caption visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white evening view of a large curved mid‑century building with shops at street level, neon signs reading things like MUSIK, BANK and TOBAK, and several 1950s–60s cars parked along the road. Vintage black‑and‑white view of a seafront avenue with neoclassical two‑story buildings and balconies along a wide, mostly empty waterfront. A lone figure stands in the open space; a tall, slender chimney/minaret‑like structure rises at right. Greek caption identifies the location, and there is an archive watermark on the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large curving school building with many windows and a small clock tower. The printed captions in German read 'Bautzen.' and 'Pestalozzischule.' A street, stone wall, and small pavilion-like entrance are visible in the foreground.

Black‑and‑white street view of a large late‑19th‑century institutional building behind trees and a wooden fence. A uniformed postman and children stand in the foreground. On the right gabled facade, the word "POLIKLINIK" is visible.

Black-and-white winter view across the Elbe River with ice floes and a bridge carrying pedestrians. On the hill dominates a large castle complex with Gothic spires—snow-covered roofs of the town below. Caption at lower left reads "Meißen im Winter."

Sepia-toned real-photo postcard showing a small courtyard of a wooden/half‑timbered house. Tinted historic postcard view of a large ornate school building with neoclassical details and a lawn in front. Small figures stand near the entrances. German captions at the bottom read 'Gruß aus Graz.' and 'Pestalozzi-Schule.'

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with a small arched pedestrian bridge over a pond, a strong fountain jet, outdoor café tables on the right, and ornate late‑19th‑century villas with turrets and spires lining a wooded hillside in the background.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European valley town with terraced vineyard hills in the background. In the left foreground stands a tall neo‑Gothic brick church with a slender spire and cross. At the bottom edge are roofs along a rail line with steam/smoke. Two tall factory chimneys rise on the far ridge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view along a leafy riverside path looking toward a stone arch bridge spanning a calm river. Boats are moored along the banks. Caption text at lower left identifies the scene; a publisher's oval mark and imprint appear at lower right.

Colorized vintage view over a formal garden with blossoming trees, lawns and paths, a central fountain, and a tram crossing a bridge over a canal, with city buildings and a church spire in the distance. Caption at the top appears in Russian and German.

Colorized early 20th‑century view of a military hospital. Staff in white coats and uniformed soldiers stand before a stone building marked 'LAZARETT'. At right is an early motor ambulance. The printed caption below reads 'Dresden. Garnison-Lazarett (Reserve-Lazarett I)'.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing the interior of a church with arched ceiling, rows of numbered pews, chandeliers, pulpit, and an altar with three stained‑glass windows. Caption and publisher imprint are printed on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a villa‑like institutional building with the word AGNESHEIM on its facade, behind a fence and garden. At left stands a tall factory chimney and multi‑story industrial buildings. Red printed captions at the top read "Grossröhrsdorf." and "Agnesheim." Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing the snow‑patched peaks of the Kebnekaise massif seen from the Latjodalen (valley), with dwarf birch in the foreground. A printed caption appears at lower left and a photographer's mark at lower right reading "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI Foto: T. Dahllöf".

Black‑and‑white cityscape showing rooftops and treetops of Östersund with water and the wooded island of Frösön in the distance. Caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom; photo credit and publisher info are printed at lower right.

Black‑and‑white seaside scene showing children in vintage swimsuits playing with a model sailboat at a rocky beach while many bathers wade in shallow water. Swedish caption and a round publisher mark appear in the margins.

Black‑and‑white real photo postcard showing a small wooden bridge and low weir with cascading water and rocks in a town center. Traditional wooden buildings with Swedish architectural details line the stream; one façade bears a photographer's studio sign. Printed captions identify the view as in Söderhamn, and a publisher's oval mark appears in the lower right.

Colorized townscape showing a riverside view with a herd and people wading across the water in the foreground. Behind them are red-roofed houses, remnants of a town wall, and a prominent church with twin spires. The caption "Grimma i. Sa." is printed at the top left.

Black-and-white view of a large mid-century institutional complex with a tall central slab building, surrounding low service blocks, a brick smokestack, rough unpaved road and wild grass in the foreground. Swedish publisher credit is printed at the lower right.

Sepia photograph of a vaulted cloister with repetitive stone arches and pillars opening to a courtyard on the left; a seated figure is visible at the far end. A vertical caption is printed along the border mentioning a cloister in Graz.

Sepia-toned street view labeled "Trento," showing pedestrians in traditional early-20th-century dress beside Trento's ancient city walls and a round tower (Torrione). Black‑and‑white view of a vast eclectic/Neo‑Renaissance brick building with corner towers capped by steep, patterned roofs and a grand central loggia supported by large pillars. The complex is fronted by an ornate iron fence and a broad, mostly empty boulevard; low hills rise in the background.
A vintage blue-tinted photographic postcard showing a riverside fortress on a hill with stone ramparts and buildings above the water. Cyrillic captions are printed along the bottom border.

Tinted vintage street view showing rows of brick townhouses along a tree-lined avenue with scaffolding on one building and groups of schoolchildren and adults in front. The captions identify it as a scene in Nijmegen featuring Groesbeekschestraat and the Huishoudschool.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a long railway station building with arched windows and decorative half‑timbering, with multiple rail tracks in the foreground. The caption and photographer credit in Latvian are printed on the margin.

Black‑and‑white town view taken from a church, showing tree‑lined streets, wooden houses, and a prominent brick building with a small turret. Printed caption at bottom right reads in Norwegian, attributing the image to Carl Normann of Hamar and dated 1912.

Sepia-toned town view with a tree-lined street leading toward a center of low buildings. A tall Gothic church spire dominates the skyline; faint castle structures appear in the background. A crest in the upper-right margin reads 'CESIS'.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a steep-sided fjord with mountains, a tourist ship on calm water, and turf-roofed stone huts in the foreground near a hillside with two seated figures. The back has a divided layout with printed Norwegian captions.

Black-and-white winter scene showing a snowy landscape with conifer trees, a curving ski track and footprints across deep snow, and a forested hill in the background. White caption text appears at the lower left and a photographer credit at the lower right.

Hand-colored street view showing a cobblestoned lane lined with historic gabled buildings. A wrought-iron fence and lamps frame steps at right; pedestrians and a woman with a pram are visible. Early 20th‑century printed postcard showing a fenced garden and a statue of an armored figure set in a decorative arch and gate on a town square, flanked by tall lanterns and lined with German townhouses. The red caption at top identifies the place and monument.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo image of a Catholic church interior. It shows a vaulted Gothic apse with two stained‑glass lancet windows flanking a tall carved winged altarpiece (retable). Black-and-white real-photo postcard showing a calm shoreline with birch trees and their reflections along a curved embankment in a city park by the water. Caption text appears at the bottom left; a photographer/publisher mark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia vintage postcard showing an equestrian statue of King Saint Stephen on a decorated pedestal with lion figures, set before the arcaded terraces and conical tower of the Fisherman's Bastion. People in early 20th‑century attire stand around. Red caption at the top reads in Hungarian and German.

Vintage sepia postcard view over a small town with two prominent churches: a large twin‑spired Catholic church on a hill in the center-left and a neo‑Gothic Evangelical church with a tall clock tower at right. Vintage black-and-white elevated view over a small valley town with clustered houses and a central church with a clock tower and spire. Rolling fields and wooded hills surround the settlement. A printed caption at the top left reads "Glashütte i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white view of a lakeside sports ground with an oval cinder running track around a football field. A wooden covered grandstand with roof flagpoles and exterior stairways sits to the left; paths with short white posts border the track. Black‑and‑white view framed by a heavy stone archway looking up a cobbled ramp to a rough‑hewn stone fortress building with a seam‑metal roof and a small bell turret. Hand‑colored postcard showing German soldiers constructing a pontoon bridge across a broad river. Small boats support the bridge, a river steamer passes, and terraced vineyards and village houses line the far bank. Red printed German caption appears at the top.

Sepia postcard showing an ornate late‑Renaissance stone epitaph attached to a church's ashlar wall. Monochrome blue-toned postcard view across a river toward a hilltop castle complex with steep roofs and a round tower, with a church spire behind it. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a moonlit seaside scene with wooden bathhouse buildings on stilts, connected by piers and walkways, a cylindrical tower on the pier, and beach structures behind. Caption at the top left reads "Libau. Herrenbad."

Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a straight, tree-lined path (an alley of large oaks) beside a calm body of water. A stone bench sits to the right by the shoreline; no people are present. Strong afternoon shadows fall across the gravel path.

Black‑and‑white view of a solitary stone alpine hut with shuttered windows and a light roof, plus a small outbuilding, set on a barren rocky terrace high in the mountains. Snow patches and a rugged cirque/ridge rise behind under cloudy skies. No printed caption is visible on the image side.

Hand-tinted view of a lively city square with an oval fountain and water jets in the foreground. Behind the basin stands a tall Marian column topped with a haloed statue of the Virgin. Black-and-white view of a vaulted arcade with thick stone columns around a historic courtyard. A shop sign is visible on a building at left. The caption at the bottom reads in German about the arcades of the Paradieshof in old Graz.

Color postcard view of a German city square with a large dark clock tower topped by a gilded statue, attached to a grand town-hall building with arcades and red-tiled roofs. Colorized early-20th-century street scene showing a tree-lined boulevard with a large ornate school building behind an iron fence, a gas streetlamp, and quiet cobblestone road. Printed title at the top reads the location and subject.

A vintage postcard displaying a bustling urban street scene with people walking and interacting, various stores, and buildings with balconies. A sepia-toned, vintage image depicting a large, ornate, 19th-century building with neoclassical architectural elements. The settlement lies in a valley with terraced hillsides and larger mountains in the background. At the bottom margin there is printed and handwritten Italian text, including the place name Tesero (Trentino).

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town in a river valley, surrounded by fields and wooded hills. In the background stands a prominent flat-topped mesa-like mountain. At the top of the image, in red German text, it reads: "Blick auf Stadt Königstein und Lilienstein." The style and printing resemble an early 20th-century picture postcard.

An old, tinted postcard showing a tree‑lined canal or river with small boats moored along the right bank and a tower visible in the distance. The photograph is framed by an ornate golden border with stylized flowers on the left. Below the flowers is a small shield or coat of arms featuring three green fir trees on a gray background. Various stamped and printed texts, including the word 'Uddevalla', appear beneath the image, suggesting a museum collection item from the town of Uddevalla.

A minimalist, typographic postcard advertising an art fair. The background is white with large overlapping outlined letters forming the word 'Art' and '23:92'. Smaller black text includes an original number at the top and the event dates and location near the bottom. In red text at the very bottom it reads 'The International Art Fair'.

Sepia-toned photograph of a large Baroque/early neoclassical civic building with a steep tiled roof and a tall, slender clock/bell tower rising from the center. The facade has evenly spaced rectangular windows framed by light pilasters. A staircase leads up to a central arched doorway topped by a sculptural figure and a small coat of arms. There is an open square in front, and overhead utility wires cross the sky.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small town square with trees, wooden houses and commercial buildings, and a prominent church with a tall steeple and cross in the background. The scene is quiet, with no visible vehicles, and the word "Virserum" is printed in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a bridge over the Elbe River with a tram crossing it. In the background rises a hilltop complex with twin-towered cathedral spires and a large castle-like structure overlooking the town of Meissen. The foreground includes pedestrians and early 20th‑century street lighting. German text is printed at the top of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand alpine hotel building surrounded by dense coniferous forest. The hotel has a steep, decorative roof with dormer windows and a central tower-like section. A large sign on the roof reads "HOTEL REGINA DEL BOSCO". In the foreground are trees, a path or road, and rustic fencing. At the bottom margin there is a caption identifying the hotel and location.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Italian piazza with a central fountain, a tall clock tower on the left, and a Romanesque cathedral complex with a prominent rose window and octagonal dome on the right. The square is bordered by historic buildings and trees. Italian caption text and handwritten Italian message appear at the bottom.

A sepia-toned, vintage photograph of an industrial harbor. In the foreground are fenced yards, sheds, and open ground with scattered construction materials. Beyond this are rows of rail freight cars, indicating a rail yard adjacent to the docks. In the background, several large steamships with tall masts and smokestacks are moored along the waterfront, with faint outlines of distant shoreline or hills visible through the haze. The overall look is early 20th‑century port infrastructure. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Italian square with mountains in the background. Prominently visible are a tall medieval clock tower with crenellations at the top, a large baroque fountain in the center of the square, arcaded buildings and palazzi surrounding the piazza, and a church with a domed roof and ornate façade. The caption at the top left reads in red script: "Trento - Piazza del Duomo".

Black-and-white image of a large Alpine-style wooden hotel building with a steep gabled roof, dormer windows, and wide verandas. The hotel stands beside a rural road lined with small trees and a fence. On the facade a long sign displays the hotel's name in German script, and another signboard is visible by the roadside.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style landscape view of a small European town on a river. In the foreground, a narrow road and path lead to a simple riverside landing where several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand near a small pier. A white passenger boat with an enclosed cabin and people on board moves along the river. A low bridge crosses one branch of the river to the left. Beyond, open fields stretch towards a compact town with multi‑storey houses and several prominent church towers or steeples. Low, rounded hills form the background under a hazy sky.

Black-and-white panoramic view across open fields and a river toward a hillside town densely built with villas and houses. Terraced slopes rise behind the town, and a prominent tower stands on the hilltop. Blossoming branches frame the foreground at the bottom of the image. A caption in German is printed at the lower left.

Black-and-white postcard view of a small harbor with wooden quays, moored sailing boats, stacked timber on the pier, and a village of wooden houses climbing a forested hillside in the background. The scene is calm and rural, with a wide expanse of water in the foreground and a few small boats. Text in Swedish is printed along the bottom indicating the place and the photography company.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground and middle distance are tightly clustered houses with steep gabled roofs and several tall factory chimneys, suggesting textile or light industry along a winding river or stream that cuts through the valley. Farmland fields and patchwork meadows cover the surrounding hills, with scattered farmhouses. Near the center stands a church with a prominent tower and spire. The overall appearance is early‑20th‑century Central Europe. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the front.

Colorized vintage view of a landscaped hillside park with paths, young trees, benches, and a stone structure topped by a decorative wooden pavilion or gazebo. Terraced slopes and vineyards are visible in the background. Printed brown text in Romanian appears near the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large, early‑20th‑century office or institutional building on a cobblestone square. The facade has several rows of rectangular windows, a central portico with columns, statues over the entrance, and a mansard roof with dormer windows. Along the top of the facade runs a long inscription in German, rendered in large block letters.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over orchards and trees toward a town with several multi‑story historic buildings and villas nestled at the foot of wooded hills. Printed text beneath the image reads in German, with a greeting from Graz and the specific viewpoint or hill named 'Rainerkogl.'

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the town of Vigo with hills in the background. In the middle stands a large multi‑storey classical building, surrounded by smaller houses and greenery. In the foreground there is a stone wall with laundry hanging over it. A circular library stamp marked 'BIBLIOTECA PUBLICA PONTEVEDRA' appears in purple at the top. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the view as seen from Calle de Policarpo Sanz in Vigo.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly carved medieval stone tomb resting on two animal figures (likely bears) inside a church or similar historic building. The sarcophagus features sculpted scenes on its sides and a recumbent armored figure on top. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet village street with unpaved road and wooden utility poles. On the left is a two‑storey plastered house with a steep tiled roof, shuttered windows and a rectangular signboard on the wall; two women in early 20th‑century clothing walk in front of it. Farther down the curving street are several timber‑framed or wooden houses with multiple windows and gabled roofs. A couple of other figures stand near the middle distance. Trees and a long wall line the right side of the road. The overall scene suggests a small northern or central European town.

Colorized historical postcard view of a long row of ornate brick and stucco barracks buildings with red roofs, behind a fence and trees along a broad street with telegraph poles. German text identifies the location as a military barracks in Naumburg an der Saale.

Vintage black‑and‑white rural landscape view of a village surrounded by rolling hills and open fields. A dirt road leads from the foreground toward a line of houses and larger buildings. On the right stands a church with a tower and spire. Red printed German captions at the top label the village and individual buildings such as the sports home, school, and church.

Old sepia postcard showing a large multi‑storey brick industrial building beside a river with a low waterfall or rapids in the foreground. Trees and a few smaller factory buildings with chimneys stand on the riverbank. The lower margin and right edge are filled with handwritten cursive text. Faint printed captions appear along the bottom, partly readable in different languages.

A colorized vintage view over a river running through a European city, with promenades and streets lined with trees and historic buildings. In the background, on a hill, stands a fortified complex and a prominent clock tower. In the foreground, people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the riverside and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. At the top left of the image appears the caption 'Graz mit Schlossberg'.

Colorized historic view of a European town square with cobblestone streets, multi‑story buildings with red roofs, and church towers in the background. People walk and a horse‑drawn carriage stands near the houses. German text labels the scene as the market square of Colditz in Saxony, and shop signs such as a bank and an apothecary are visible on the facades.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large baroque/renaissance-style town hall building featuring a clock tower and onion-shaped turret on the right, and a long row of gabled houses lining a street to the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or push carts; a horse-drawn carriage is visible. A small fountain stands in the foreground of the square. German words are painted on the façade of the main building and on a side building.

A multi‑view vintage postcard with the caption "SOUVENIR DI CORFU" showing several small colored views of Corfu, including a classical statue, a harbor panorama with ships, a grand neoclassical building, a garden with palm trees and statues, and a large public building on a square. Decorative flowers are placed among the views, and a watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a forested valley landscape with low hills in the background and scattered buildings at the edge of the woods. A road cuts through the trees along the valley floor. German text is printed at the top describing a summer resort named Buschmühle in the Erzgebirge near Schmiedeberg.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural valley landscape with a single large building complex, likely a mill or inn, nestled among leafless trees on a winding road. In the background are wooded hills and a line of trees along the ridge. At the top of the postcard there is printed red German text.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a cobblestone road and bridge lined with bare trees leading straight toward a large Baroque-style palace with an arched central gateway. The building forms a long façade with many windows and modest decorative details. Printed German text appears in the upper right corner identifying the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two main images. The left side shows a panoramic view of a mountain valley town with clustered buildings, church towers, and surrounding terraced fields. The right side shows a street scene in front of a hotel with a carriage and people standing by the facade. Italian captions identify the town and the hotel. A large amount of handwritten text in blue ink covers the lower and right margins.

A monochrome (sepia-toned) postcard view across a body of water toward a historic European city with a dense old town skyline. Several tall, slender church spires and towers rise above compact low buildings, suggesting a medieval cityscape. Tree branches frame the scene in the foreground on both left and right sides, while small boats can be seen on the water under a sky with scattered clouds.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town with dense pitched‑roof houses, a church tower with a baroque-style spire on the right, and wooded hills in the background. At the top left in red Gothic-style script is the caption 'Lunzenau a. d. Mulde.' The layout and typography resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing multi‑story stone buildings lining a cobblestone street. Three men in dark suits and hats stand in the middle of the street with walking sticks. Shop signs in Swedish are visible on the buildings, including one reading "N. A. Nygrens Manufakturaffär." On the left is a gable wall filled with advertising text. The lower part of the image contains handwritten cursive text in Swedish along with printed captions indicating the street name and city.

Black‑and‑white studio portrait of a woman in an ornate gown and tiara, seated sideways on a carved wooden bench, resting her head on her gloved hands. The style is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century theatrical or aristocratic fashion. A scripted name appears in the upper right corner, and a small number is printed in the lower left corner, suggesting a mass‑produced picture postcard of a performer or celebrity.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a richly decorated Baroque-style church altar. The altar features sculpted columns, angels, relief scenes including the Crucifixion and the Resurrection, ornamental scrollwork, and a statue of Christ with a banner on the top. The image is vertically oriented, and along the right edge there is printed white text indicating the subject of the photograph.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a dramatic rocky cliff on the left with several people standing and sitting near the edge, overlooking a broad rural landscape of fields, scattered farm buildings, dense forest, and a large lake in the distance. Printed text at the top reads "Parti från Skytteklef. Hälleberg". The overall style and tone suggest an early 20th‑century tourism or scenic view card.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded hill with a tall rectangular stone tower or keep standing on its summit. At the foot of the hill are several half-timbered village houses. In the upper right corner, printed in a serif typeface, is the caption 'Sommerfrische Tautenburg'. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century central European rural resort view.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formal square with geometric paving in front of a monumental stone terrace and steps. At the center is a landscaped area with shrubs; on the right is a ceremonial guard box in front of a long wall. Behind the terrace rises a grand neoclassical building. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk across the square. Printed captions in Greek and French appear along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white image showing two uniformed ground crew loading or unloading mail bags from the cargo door of a propeller airliner. A baggage cart filled with sacks stands beside the aircraft. On the fuselage large letters include the word "SWEDEN" and the aircraft registration beginning with "SE‑…", typical of Swedish civil aircraft.

Black‑and‑white image of a street or promenade with wet pavement, showing people walking in front of low, pavilion‑like buildings with tiled roofs. The right building has striped awnings and several large wall signs, one reading "RÖMELINGS WURST‑BUDEN" and mentioning "Pumuckl." Another building on the left has a sign over the entrance reading "DOLLS THEATER." Trees without leaves and lampposts suggest a cool season. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century fairground or amusement area.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snow-covered park bordered by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. Bare trees laden with snow frame the view, while several figures in long coats walk or pull small sleds with children across the snowy ground. The photograph is printed with a white border, typical of early photographic postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A black-and-white postcard view of a mountainous valley landscape. In the middle distance stands a large historic building complex that resembles a castle or manor, surrounded by trees and cultivated fields. Hills and terraced slopes rise in the background. Tree branches frame the scene in the foreground, along with a simple wooden fence. Along the bottom border, printed text identifies the location as Castelfondo in Val di Non at an elevation of 947 meters.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a Baroque-style church with a tall clock tower and onion-shaped spire. The church has high arched windows and ivy growing along its lower walls. Surrounding it are multi‑storey townhouses with shops on the ground floors. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled square. Shop signs in German are visible on the left and right buildings.

Colorized panoramic view of an alpine valley with scattered wooden chalets and farm buildings, surrounded by forested slopes and high, jagged, partly snow‑covered mountains in the background. Light blue sky above. At the top left there is red printed text identifying the panorama and its elevation in meters, along with the region name 'Tirol'.

Color-tinted historic postcard view of a formal park with flowerbeds, lawns, and tree-lined paths in the foreground, looking toward a large, light-colored 19th‑century railway station building with arched windows and a clock tower or central pavilion. The printed caption at the top reads "Norrköping. Järnvägsstationen."

A monochrome panoramic view taken from an elevated terrace shaded by a large tree, overlooking a river valley and the city below with surrounding mountains. The cityscape stretches along the river with bridges, clustered buildings, and towers visible. At the bottom center of the card appears the caption identifying the view.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a formal group of men in long coats and bowler or top hats standing on a rocky slope near a cliff face. Some men stand at the top of a small hill, others at the bottom near a rough wooden structure or shed built against the rock wall. The scene appears to be an official visit or inspection. Printed German text runs vertically along the right margin of the card.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of two large school buildings separated by a tree‑lined lawn and footpath. The right building has arched windows and a classical façade; another multi‑storey building stands to the left partly obscured by trees. Printed text in Swedish appears in the upper right corner.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large U‑shaped barracks courtyard. A long two‑story building with a tiled roof, dormer windows, and an arched entrance gate dominates the background. In the foreground, several children play with hoops while a man leads a horse; carts and a lamp post are also visible. Printed caption text at the top identifies the place as the barracks in Pontarlier and credits a local publisher.

Color image of a busy marina filled with small sailboats and yachts, their tall masts reflecting in the calm water. In the background a large white cruise or passenger ship is docked, and along the right side stand several angular, red‑brown wooden warehouse‑like buildings by the quayside. The sky is clear and blue, giving a bright summer atmosphere typical of a coastal tourist town. No visible printed title or caption appears on the front.

A sepia-toned studio portrait of a stylish woman in a dark fur coat and wide-brimmed hat, posed in three-quarter profile against a softly blurred background. The bottom margin bears printed credits and her name, indicating this is a film-star publicity postcard.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large ornate corner building with turrets bordering a broad square with pedestrians, a pram, and a small kiosk in the foreground. The scene is an urban intersection with multi‑storey stone buildings lining the street. Handwritten greetings appear across the lower part of the image, and printed Swedish text identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white rural scene in a mountainous valley. In the foreground stands a small log cabin with a sod/grass roof; a woman and a child are in the doorway, and other women and children stand nearby. A cow grazes beside the hut. Scattered wooden farm buildings and fields stretch across the valley, backed by forested hills. At the very top right is a printed archival number "MINØ.43841". At the bottom, handwritten text reads something like a place name.

A colorized historic street scene showing a wide avenue lined with trees on the left and a row of multi‑story buildings with striped awnings on the right. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalk and a few flags fly in the distance. A large shop sign on the nearest building is visible, and the word "Elverum" is printed at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an industrial harbor. In the foreground lies a medium-sized cargo vessel moored alongside the quay. Behind the ship are rail wagons loaded with bulk material and large piles of coal or similar cargo. Industrial buildings, silos and loading structures with cranes dominate the background, with a townscape faintly visible on a hill beyond. Part of a large word painted on a structure along the quay reads "IBELIUS".

An old Russian Empire postal card addressed in handwritten Cyrillic script. The printed heading reads in Russian and French, with the imperial double-headed eagle emblem at the top left. It has a red 3-kopek stamp with postmarks dated in May, and several circular cancellation marks. The card side shown is the address side only, with no picture, featuring lines for the recipient's address and a printed note at the bottom indicating that only the address is to be written on this side.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a city square or broad avenue in the background with a park-like setting and distant multi‑storey buildings with spires. In the foreground, a young child in early‑20th‑century clothing stands holding a large bouquet of flowers; this figure appears to be a studio photograph composited onto the city view. At the bottom there is a printed caption in a Scandinavian language followed by smaller publisher text.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ruins of a hillside castle complex with several remaining walls and towers, partly surrounded by bare trees and sloping pasture. A tall conifer stands near the central keep. There is a handwritten inscription along the left margin of the card in dark ink.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard shows a large Orthodox church with multiple domes and tall bell towers rising behind lower buildings and trees. The architecture is Byzantine‑revival, with arched windows and a prominent central nave. At the bottom of the image there is a dark banner with Greek handwriting identifying the church. A web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible across the lower right part of the image.

Black-and-white photograph showing a formal garden pond or small lake with numerous ducks swimming. Dense, lush vegetation including tall coniferous trees and palms surrounds the water. In the background, partly hidden by foliage, stands a small round classical pavilion or temple-like structure with columns. In the foreground on the right, a small ornamental stone pedestal or planter rises from the water.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small European town nestled in a river valley, surrounded by rolling agricultural hills and vineyards. Dense clusters of traditional gabled houses with tiled roofs fill the foreground, with church towers and industrial chimneys visible in the middle distance. At the upper left, printed in red serif letters, is the caption 'Camburg a. Saale.' indicating the town and river.

Sepia-toned image framed by tree branches showing a large rectangular castle-like building with a gabled end and many small dormer windows on the roof. In front of the building are trees, a landscaped garden, and what appears to be a moat or water feature with a bridge or small dam. Printed German text on the image reads "Schloß Frohburg Wehranlage."

A black-and-white postcard depicting a large, multi-storey building complex set in a forested, mountainous area. The architecture looks like an early 20th‑century Central European lodge or health home, with steep gabled roofs and many windows. Tall conifer trees stand in front of the buildings, and wooded hills rise in the background. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style caption in German identifying the place as 'Erzgebirgsheim Wald – Bärenburg i. Sächs. Erzgeb.'

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined boulevard crowded with pedestrians and a few horse‑drawn vehicles. Multi‑story European‑style buildings line both sides of the street, and low hills or a citadel appear in the background. The right side margin contains printed French text reading "Souvenir de Salonique," while the bottom caption identifies the scene as "Salonique, Boulevard Hamidie." The rest of the front is heavily covered with handwritten cursive text.

A colorized postcard view of a large, two‑story school building with a red-tiled roof, central portico with columns, and a small bell tower. A tall flagpole stands in front of the entrance, and palm trees frame the scene. The setting is grassy with a clear sky above. Spanish text at the top identifies it as a public school in Cristobal in the Canal Zone, and English text at the bottom calls it the Panama Canal School at Cristobal, Canal Zone.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, ornate neoclassical building with a central cupola, seen across an open square where a few people stand near simple carts and market stalls. The architecture suggests a public or municipal building in a European town. Beneath the image, centered on the front margin, is the printed caption "KUOPIO."

Black‑and‑white view of a riverside European town. In the foreground a wide river flows past; small wooden boats are pulled up near the stony shore. A large side‑wheel steamship crowded with passengers moves along the river, emitting a tall plume of dark smoke. On the opposite bank stand a line of houses against a high stone embankment wall with arches. Above them, on a wooded hill, is a vast multi‑winged palace or castle complex. To the right, in the town, rises a large church with a tall tower and steep roof, plus additional spires in the distance.
