Black‑and‑white photograph of a large, monumental neoclassical/Beaux‑Arts style building with two tall corner towers facing a wide forecourt. The façade has evenly spaced vertical windows, ornate balconies, a central clock above the main entrance, and heraldic coats of arms or crests on the towers and above the entrance. Early automobiles and carriages are parked in front, and people gather near the main doors. A decorative metal fence and landscaped garden occupy the foreground.

Color image of a large Eastern Orthodox cathedral in Neo-Byzantine style with multiple domes topped by crosses and a prominent bell tower bearing carved crosses. The stone façade has ornate arched windows and decorative reliefs. In the lower right, an older red-and-white bus is parked by the entrance, and trees frame the scene under a clear blue sky.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an ancient rectangular stone building set against a steep rocky mountainside. The structure is composed of large stone blocks with a simple pitched roofline, standing alone among ruins and rough terrain. At the bottom, white handwritten-style text labels the scene, and a website credit appears near the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall monument with a standing figure on top, set against steep mountains. The pedestal is decorated with sculptural groups and inscriptions. At upper left there is a heraldic shield with a double‑headed eagle and a banner. At the bottom is an Italian quotation attributed to G. Carducci.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large neoclassical building with many windows and balconies, identified as the prefecture palace. In front of it there is a crowded public scene with soldiers in formation, carriages, early automobiles, and a large gathering of people. A church steeple is visible in the background. Greek text appears above the image, and French text describing the palace is printed on the right.

A tinted vintage postcard showing three people in traditional clothing gathered outdoors in front of a brick or mud-brick arched doorway. A standing man in white is preparing and pouring coffee from a large pot on a small brazier or stand, while a seated figure in green drinks and another seated figure in a veil and robe holds a child. Lush foliage is visible to the right. The French caption at the bottom reads 'Cafetier arabe.' The lower margin also contains small-print publisher information and a circular stamp-like emblem.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large brick industrial complex beside a river. The multi‑storey mill buildings with gabled roofs and many arched windows stand behind trees, with a tall chimney visible. In the foreground, a bridge with a decorative metal railing crosses the river. Printed titles in German at the top identify the location as Northeim in Hanover and refer to the Rhume mill; along the left edge is the publisher information.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a tram (car no. 35) running through a tree-lined square. Historic buildings and church towers are visible in the background, with a hill and additional structures behind them. At the bottom of the image is printed text identifying the scene, and beneath that is dense handwritten text in German dated 30 November 1903. The card has a decorative embossed border typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Vintage sepia postcard with two photographic views of an old Ottoman‑style public fountain in an urban setting. Both images show a stone Turkish fountain with arched niche and trough, cobbled street, nearby buildings, and people in early 20th‑century clothing. The captions underneath identify the location as Salonique and describe the subject as a Turkish fountain in French and English. There are circular postal cancellation marks at the top, and light aging stains around the edges.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town taken from a grassy path or country lane leading toward the settlement. In the foreground, a group of women and children in light Edwardian-style clothing and hats walk along the dirt path beside a field. In the background is a compact town with steep‑roofed houses and several church towers; the most prominent is a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire and buttresses. Trees frame the right side of the scene. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Sepia-toned image of an interior exhibition room or showroom. Along the back wall is a large panoramic winter mural or diorama depicting snow-covered mountains, dense pine forests, and a horse‑drawn sleigh gliding through deep snow. In the foreground are glass display cases with objects, shelves filled with bottles and artifacts, a table with chairs, and a framed portrait at the center. The overall appearance suggests an early‑20th‑century museum or fair pavilion highlighting alpine or winter culture.

A vintage multi-view postcard with six colored photographic scenes of dramatic river rapids, rocky cliffs, and a walkway carved into rock. Captions in Swedish appear under each image, including Östra Toppöfallet, Turistvägen till Kopparklinten, Kopparklinten, Helvetesfallet, Östra Gullöfallet, and Vestra Gullöfallet. At the bottom, in large decorative letters, is the title "TROLLHÄTTAN."

Black-and-white image inside a tunnel-like underground station with arched corrugated metal ceiling. Several men in work clothes load or unload large metal mail containers and canvas bags on trolleys along a platform. Overhead lights hang from the ceiling and there are rails and machinery along the side. A small sign in the background reads "Station".

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a cylindrical brick water tower with a conical roof, small rectangular windows, and a doorway at the base. The tower stands among tall leafy trees and bushes in a rural or park-like setting. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white studio photograph shows two young children standing side by side, dressed in elaborate traditional Southeast Asian ceremonial attire. They wear patterned long sarongs, fitted jackets, and are adorned with multiple layers of necklaces, belts, bracelets, and hair ornaments with flowers. One child rests an arm on the other's shoulder. The background includes a draped curtain and a decorative pedestal with an ornate vase or urn, suggesting a formal portrait setting. A small printed reference number appears in the lower right margin.

Colorized postcard view of a stone and concrete bridge crossing a calm river, with its arches and piers reflected in the water. Behind the bridge rises a steep, wooded hill topped by a white medieval castle complex with green roofs. The sky is clear blue. Printed captions in German identify the scene as being in Leisnig and show Schloss Mildenstein with the Fischendorfer Brücke.

Colorized historic view of a town market square with cobblestone paving, a curved balustrade and steps in the foreground, and several 3‑ to 4‑story bourgeois townhouses with shops on the ground floor. Signs on the buildings advertise a Kräutergewölbe (herbal shop), a confectionery and café, and other businesses. On the right stands a larger building with a clock tower. The sky is lightly clouded and tinted blue. The top of the card is printed with the location and the word 'Markt.'

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European village in a valley, with densely packed gabled houses and farm buildings surrounded by trees and fields. In the middle distance a long multi‑arched viaduct or railway bridge crosses the landscape, and a tall industrial chimney stands near the settlement. Beyond are cultivated fields laid out in strips and low forested hills on the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

A black‑and‑white view of a large Renaissance‑style manor or small castle partly hidden behind tall conifer trees. The building has steeply pitched tiled roofs with ornate gabled dormers featuring scrollwork and circular windows. A tower with a bulbous dome and cross rises in the background to the right. The photo has a wide black border, and faint handwritten text appears inverted along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a slender, tall‑steepled village church set on a mountain slope, surrounded by pine‑covered hills. In the background rise dramatic, sheer rock faces typical of the Dolomites. A rustic wooden fence runs in the foreground, and the church has a steep shingled roof and narrow lancet windows.

Sepia-toned street scene showing a dense crowd of people in winter clothing gathered along a broad city street lined with multi‑story buildings on the left and lower storefronts on the right. The ground appears muddy or slushy, some rooftops have snow, and tram or trolley wires are visible above the street. Most people wear dark coats, caps, or fur hats, suggesting an early‑20th‑century urban setting in a cold climate. No clear signage or printed caption is visible on the front.

A black‑and‑white, likely early-20th‑century postcard showing two side‑by‑side photographs of substantial masonry buildings along broad streets. The left image depicts an older complex with a high, simple gabled roof, a small round tower, and bare winter trees, set behind a low wall and an open square with a streetlamp. The right image shows a more ornate, three‑story neoclassical or historicist building with arched ground-floor openings and symmetrical windows. The card edges are ragged, and part of a German‑language printed text is visible cropped at the far left and right margins, suggesting it was mounted on or near a German text page.

A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a rocky canal or lock cutting through steep cliffs, surrounded by dense trees. At the far end is an older concrete lock structure or sluice gate with small openings and mechanical elements. Water fills the narrow channel in the foreground. Printed captions and a publisher's mark appear along the bottom border.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a town in a valley, framed by blossoming trees in the foreground and snow-capped mountains in the background. The town has traditional European buildings and a prominent church with a tall steeple. Handwritten-style text appears along the bottom edge describing the location.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large neoclassical school building with three main stories, arched ground-floor entrance and a green mansard-style roof, set behind a landscaped garden with trees and flowerbeds. At the top center of the image is printed text in multiple languages identifying the town and the school (a 'Realschule').

A black‑and‑white historic view of a crowded promenade beside a narrow river in a European spa town. On the left is a long neoclassical colonnade with arches, columns, balustrades and statues on the roof. Hundreds of well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing and hats stroll along the wide walkway, some carrying umbrellas. On the right side of the image are multi‑storey historic buildings lining the river and continuing into the distance along a curving valley.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate wooden signpost in a village street. The post is topped with carved figures, including people and animals, and has several directional arms labelled with town names. Traditional timber houses and a small fountain or well are visible in the background. Caption text appears along the bottom border in German, and a photo credit is printed at the lower right.

A vintage monochrome postcard with a decorative floral border framing a panoramic photograph. The image shows a view over a city landscape with fields and buildings in the distance and, in the foreground, a large historic complex with towers and pitched roofs surrounded by trees. The caption at the top reads "Blick von Eggenberg." and at the bottom "Graz." Publisher information is printed vertically along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet, early‑20th‑century European street with cobblestones and sidewalks lined by trees and substantial bourgeois townhouses or villas. Toward the background stands a prominent church with a tall spire, a clock on its tower, and cross on top. In the right foreground a small herd of horses is being led along the street, while a few pedestrians walk farther back. The scene is calm and orderly, with no automobiles visible.

Black-and-white aerial view of a spa town in a narrow valley between forested hills, with many grand multi‑storey buildings, hotels, and bath houses lining a winding river and streets. The photo is bordered by a white margin, and printed vertically along the right edge is the caption 'Weltbad Karlsbad'.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large Catholic sanctuary complex with a central basilica and tall bell tower topped by a cross, flanked by long colonnades forming a semicircular square. A prominent tree stands in the foreground in a circular planter, and a small kiosk-like building appears to the right. The lower border of the image includes multilingual captions identifying the site as the Sanctuary of Fátima.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings. Pedestrians in late‑19th/early‑20th century clothing stand along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further up the street. Hanging shop signs include one reading "Wirthschafts Bazar." In the distance, on a hill above the street, a large castle-like complex can be seen. At the bottom in red script is the caption "Meissen. Burgstrasse." and along the left edge is a vertical printer's credit.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a long brick fire station with arched upper windows. In front of the building are multiple horse-drawn fire engines lined up with uniformed firefighters standing and sitting on the wagons. Trees partially frame the street scene on the left. The caption in red print at the bottom left reads "Göteborg," and on the right "Brandkåren rycker ut." A small code "D. No. 315" appears at the bottom, along with "Vk:2000:208" in black.

Black‑and‑white view down a wide tree‑lined avenue with lattice fencing on both sides, leading to a large pavilion‑like building in the distance. The building has a steep gabled roof, dormer windows, arcaded ground floor and a small central tower. A few people walk along the path and there is an old‑style streetlamp on the right.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick high school building with a prominent tower and arched entrance. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century American, with tall windows and a square clock‑tower–like structure. In the foreground a group of boys and young men in period clothing stand or pose on the lawn. Mature trees partially obscure the building. Handwritten catalog numbers appear at the top right.

Black-and-white street scene showing an elegant late‑19th‑century European boulevard. Tall four‑story buildings with ornate facades, arched windows, shutters, wrought‑iron balconies, and striped awnings line the street. A prominent corner establishment with a sign reading "Café" has decorative lamps and large curtained windows. Well‑dressed pedestrians in early 20th‑century attire—long dresses, hats, and suits—stroll and converse along the sidewalk; some café tables are visible in the foreground under a large tree.

Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or pond toward a small European town. In the foreground is a rectangular, brick‑lined island planted with a tree and flowering shrubs. Along the opposite bank are orchards, gardens, and a simple wooden fence, behind which stand several houses: one plastered masonry house with a steep tiled roof, another timber‑framed house, and additional dwellings partly obscured by trees. In the background, above the tree line, rise two church towers or spires attached to large roofed buildings, suggesting prominent churches or a monastery complex. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a lively steel toboggan or sledding track with several lanes descending from a tall wooden structure. People, mostly in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing, ride sleds down the chutes while others crash or tumble at the bottom among scattered sleds, children, and dogs. On top of the ramp is a sign reading "RODEL BAHN," and at the upper left of the card is printed German text indicating the location of the steel toboggan run in Graz, specifically on Pfeifengasse.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone avenue lined with two‑story brick buildings that host shops on the ground floor and apartments above. An early 20th‑century automobile and a few pedestrians are visible in the foreground, along with a kiosk and telegraph poles. On the left is a building with a small dome. The caption at the bottom reads "REZEKNE – LATGALES PROSPEKTS."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a serene lake scene with a single person rowing a small boat in the foreground. Trees and bushes frame the water, and on the opposite shore stands a large building with towers and many windows, likely a lakeside pavilion or villa. The card has a printed caption along the bottom border.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a richly sculpted Gothic cathedral portal with statues of saints flanking a large wooden door and elaborate tracery above. The caption at the bottom identifies it as a portal of the cathedral in Strasbourg.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small, forested town or village. Detached houses with steep, simple gable roofs and neat gardens line curving streets. Beyond the neighborhood are dense coniferous woods and open fields with a few scattered farm buildings and larger institutional‑looking structures. The landscape is gently rolling and heavily wooded, suggesting a northern European rural setting. No visible text appears on the image.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a town in a mountain valley, with vineyards in the foreground, clustered buildings with tiled roofs in the middle ground, and steep mountains on both sides. Several church towers rise above the town. The border has a scalloped edge, and handwritten text appears along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, rectangular, multi-story masonry building with a flat roof and classical detailing, surrounded by trees and nearby residential blocks. In the background are rolling hills and a rural landscape. Printed captions in German at the top identify the location and the building.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand historicist building with domes and elaborate façades on a corner square with tree‑lined streets and people walking. The lower margin identifies the scene as Graz, Bismarckplatz, Café Kaiserhof. On the right is a printed advertisement in German for the firm Vinzenz Oblack in Graz, and along the left edge is a vertical publishing credit.

A colored illustration shows French soldiers in blue tunics with red trousers and kepis resting under a tree while a column of troops marches in the background. One soldier sits exhausted against the tree while others offer him a drink from a cup and a small bottle. Military packs and rifles lie on the ground. Below the scene is an advertisement image of a bottle labeled as Ricqlès mint alcohol and a French caption promoting it as a stimulant cordial.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a broad tree-lined avenue flanked by elegant late-19th/early-20th-century townhouses. A horse-drawn carriage and a few cyclists travel along the street, with telegraph poles and fenced front gardens visible. At the top, printed text identifies the view as a street scene in Torgau on the Elbe River, specifically Bahnhofstrasse.

Illustrated postcard-like trade card showing an old-time Chinese postal courier in orange robes and conical hat running through a palace courtyard, holding a mail bag and a vessel. Behind him are figures in traditional dress and a pavilion with East Asian architectural style, surrounded by blossom trees and a balustrade. The lower margin contains French text and a blue facsimile signature, suggesting a collectible advertising card.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a hillside settlement with ruins and buildings spread across the slope and foothills of a mountain range. In the foreground is a rocky, mostly dry riverbed with sparse trees. At the bottom margin there is multilingual caption text describing the view, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned image showing a historic town hall building with a steep gabled roof and multiple small windows. The foreground displays a square with a few people standing near the entrance. The facade includes arched doorways, decorative stonework, and coats of arms. To the right, a staircase rises along the side of the building, and adjacent structures and a church-like building are visible. Printed text at the top left reads "EISLEBEN Rathaus" and a red handwritten number appears in the top right corner.

Black-and-white image showing a cliff dwelling built into a large rock alcove, surrounded by trees and brush in the foreground. A ladder leads up toward the multi‑story masonry structures in the cliff face. The scene is framed like a tourist or historical site photograph. There is small printed text at the bottom identifying the site, along with a handwritten catalog number in the lower right corner.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an artillery regiment on parade. Soldiers in light blue uniforms ride horses and accompany a large artillery wagon with wooden wheels across an open ground. In the background stands a large Classical-style temple resembling the Parthenon. The upper part of the card bears printed French text and handwritten cursive notes.

Colorized historic view of a landscaped garden with a circular flowerbed in the foreground and a busy city street behind it. People walk along paths and sidewalks, and several multi‑story buildings, including a hotel, line the street. Smoke stacks and a church‑like building with a red roof and tower are visible in the background. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Chemnitz." on the left and "Albertstrasse. Anlagen am Bahnhof." on the right.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a crowded religious procession moving along a city street. Men in formal uniforms and sashes march in rows, many decorated with medals and chains, while large crowds in hats line both sides of the street to watch. The buildings in the background appear European and early‑20th‑century. Printed caption text in French appears across the top of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a stone suspension bridge crossing a river in a wooded valley, leading toward a hilltop castle complex with red roofs and towers, and a nearby church. The sky is pale blue with light clouds, and printed red text at the top left reads "Burg Elbogen b. Karlsbad."

A black‑and‑white studio portrait of a serious-looking man in a suit, posed with his hand resting against his chin. The background is dark and out of focus. In the lower right area of the image there is a facsimile signature in light ink, and beneath it, embossed in very small type, appears to be the photographer's or studio's name.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside cityscape labeled "Dresden." The image shows grand baroque and historicist buildings along a river, with multiple towers and spires, and a large stone bridge crossing the water. River steamers and boats travel on the river, while a grassy bank with timber in the foreground frames the scene. The sky is pale blue with a few white clouds.

Black‑and‑white image of a small harbor packed with wooden fishing boats and sailboats moored at wooden piers. Behind them are rows of traditional wooden boathouses and homes built against rocky hills. The scene shows a coastal fishing village with calm water in the foreground and rugged rock formations in the background. A small logo and number are printed at the lower right, and the location name is printed at the lower left.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large castle-like building with sloped tiled roofs and small dormer windows, partly hidden by trees, next to a body of water. Printed caption text in red at the top reads "Radeberg. Schloss u. Kgl. Amtsgericht." indicating the scene is of the castle and royal district court in Radeberg.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a waterfront street with tram tracks running along a quay. On the left are multi‑storey European‑style buildings with shops and balconies; on the right are piers with docked ships and masts. The caption identifies the scene as the quays and new railroad area of Salonique (Thessaloniki). There is printed text in French and English along the bottom margin and a website watermark across the lower right.

A colorized historic postcard showing a wide urban square lined with multi‑story neoclassical buildings, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Low green hills rise in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the bottom.

Vintage illustrated postcard with several vignettes of Egyptian scenes. At upper right is the Great Sphinx and a pyramid. At upper left is a panoramic view of a fortified complex on a hill, including a large mosque, labeled as the citadel and mosque of Cairo. Near the center is a scene of a square with a monument and buildings, labeled as a square in Alexandria. At lower left is a portrait of a woman in traditional attire framed by a crescent. Decorative French captions and the phrase "Souvenir dʹ Egypte" appear on the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an industrial harbor scene. Several steam-powered boats and barges are visible on a busy river or port, with one large floating crane structure in the center. In the foreground are moored boats loaded with cargo sacks. The image has printed German captions at the top identifying the location and the floating giant crane.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a dramatic mountain range (the Dolomites) behind a valley with partially destroyed multi‑story buildings and a church tower. The ruins line a road or wall in the foreground, suggesting war damage. Printed Italian text labels the scene, mentioning San Martino di Castrozza, the Grand Hôtel des Alpes burned by Austrians in May 1915, and the mountain Sass Maor with its elevation.

An old monochrome postcard with a small photograph printed in the upper left showing a cobblestoned square bordered by multi‑story buildings and a church spire in the background. A tall column or monument stands near the center of the square, which is enclosed by a fence. Beneath and beside the image are decorative flourishes and German text. The right side of the card is blank for writing. In the lower right corner small print credits a printer in Riga.

Black-and-white image of a large brick Gothic-style church with tall pointed-arch windows and a steeply pitched roof. A very high, slender spire rises from a square tower on the right. Leafless trees and a low brick wall line the street in the foreground; there are no visible people or vehicles.

Vintage sepia postcard with a rectangular photograph showing a broad road or boulevard running through an open, semi‑rural area with scattered buildings, garden walls, trees, and distant structures. Horse‑drawn vehicles and pedestrians can be seen along the road. Greek text appears at the top left of the card, and French text describing the scene is printed to the right of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an oval-framed photograph of a tall cylindrical stone tower with a conical roof, known as La Torre Verde. The tower stands by a street with a fence, nearby houses, trees, and hills in the background. The word 'TRENTO' appears at the top, and a caption identifying the tower as 'La Torre Verde (Opera Etrusca?)' is printed below the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town with tiled-roof houses, a visible mosque minaret, and a wide river flowing through a valley backed by low hills. The vantage point is from a hillside with a small foreground building. Cyrillic text is printed along the bottom border.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic manor or palace surrounded by trees and landscaped grounds. The building has Baroque-style onion domes atop corner towers, steep mansard roofs, and multiple windows. The image has a white border and printed caption text along the bottom.

Sepia-toned street scene showing an older man leaning against the wall of a stucco building on a cobblestone street. Above him is an ornate framed religious niche or shrine mounted on the façade, with flowers at a nearby open window. Other shuttered windows and an arched passageway are visible in the background, where a couple of people sit on the ground. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town. Printed captions appear at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small rural village surrounded by fields and gently rolling hills. The settlement consists mainly of simple gabled houses and farm buildings with steep tiled roofs, gardens, and orchards. A grid of fields and paths extends into the countryside; there are no modern high‑rise structures or cars visible.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide panoramic view of a coastal city on a bay. In the foreground are rows of low residential buildings; farther away a denser historic core extends onto a small peninsula with a fortified hill and harbor. The sea occupies the right side of the image. Large white letters in Greek spell the city's name in the lower right corner. A web address is faintly printed near the bottom edge.

Colorized historic postcard view of a European street scene at sunset or early evening. On the left stands a red-brick church or chapel with a tall, slender spire and a steep tiled roof, partly surrounded by trees. On the right are several multi‑story bourgeois townhouses with shops at street level and pedestrians walking along the curved street. The sky fades from orange near the horizon to light blue at the top. At the top center of the image is printed text indicating the city and street.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a forested river valley with rapids or falls in the middle distance. A metal bridge spans the river, with wooded hills on both sides and a tall industrial smokestack visible beyond. On the far right, partly hidden by trees, is the spire of a church. Text is printed along the bottom margin identifying the location and publisher.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large riverside castle complex with a tall tower and steep roofs, labeled in red text at the top. In the foreground is a promenade or path with railings along the riverbank, work equipment and piles of material on the shore, and several moored boats. To the right, an iron truss bridge crosses the river.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a quiet, tree‑lined street with cobblestones and sidewalks. On the right side stand several large brick townhouses or villas with ornate façades, gabled roofs, chimneys, and fenced front gardens with metal gates. The left side of the street is bordered by trees and a long fence. The printed caption at the top in red German text reads: "Dommitzsch a. Elbe. Bahnhofstraße."

Old monochrome postcard showing a riverside town with rows of houses along the water and a steep rocky hill behind them. On top of the hill stand fortification structures and a tower, labeled "Schloßberg." Handwritten text and a date appear below the image. The printed caption on the bottom left reads "Graz" with a handwritten date next to it, and on the bottom right it reads "Schloßberg."

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley, photographed from a field in the foreground. A wooden fence and scattered trees lead toward a compact cluster of houses with steep, tiled roofs. A church with a tall baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome stands prominently on the right. Behind the town are low, forested hills and open fields; on a distant hilltop to the left a faint outline of a castle or fortification is visible. The top-center area of the image has a damaged or overexposed patch. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall war memorial monument with a fluted column topped by a cross. The base bears reliefs and inscriptions and is surrounded by ornate posts linked with chains and decorative urns, set in a landscaped area with trees. Printed captions in red at the bottom read "Zittau." and "Kriegerdenkmal."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large alpine youth summer camp or colony. In the foreground many boys are gathered on a grass field with simple sports equipment and a wire fence. Behind them stand several large, plain buildings with tiled roofs and, further right, a small church with a steeple. A tall flagpole with a flag featuring a central symbol stands in the middle of the camp. Mountains and forested hills form the background. At the bottom border of the card, captions identify the location and name of the colony.

A monochrome aerial view of a small European town beside a river with a metal bridge. The town is composed of dense, low houses with gabled roofs, fields and rolling countryside in the background, and a church tower rising near the center. Printed German text appears along the top margin of the image.

A tinted historical postcard depicting a monumental Roman triumphal arch with richly carved relief panels. The view shows a large archway spanning a narrow street; an equestrian rider passes beneath it. The stone surfaces are weathered, and surrounding low buildings suggest an urban setting. French text at the top identifies the scene as a souvenir from Salonique and names the arch.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing an industrial riverside cityscape with factory buildings and tall chimneys along rapids. In the foreground are large brick mill complexes on both riverbanks, with water flowing through dams or sluices. In the distance a church tower and other city buildings are visible. The lower part of the card is filled with handwritten text, and printed in red is the caption identifying the place.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing an ostrich farm. In the foreground are numerous ostrich chicks and several large eggs scattered on the ground. Behind them stands a wire-and-wooden fence, with many adult ostriches gathered closely along it. Trees can be seen in the background. The lower part of the card is blank for writing, except for a small printed copyright notice on the left and a red handwritten number on the right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a cylindrical stone tower with a small domed roof standing on a wooded hill. A winding path leads up the hill, with scattered trees, bushes, and a few utility poles. In the hazy background are distant hills or a valley. In the top corners, printed in a decorative script, are the words identifying the location.

A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over a European town nestled in a valley, with dense rows of gabled houses, church towers, and a prominent clock-tower building to the right. The foreground shows rooftops and trees; in the middle ground is a large church and other civic buildings; beyond are factories, fields, and low hills. The word "Waldheim." is printed in red at the top left, and along the left edge there is a vertical printer's credit in German mentioning Meissen.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist rectangular building with large vertical windows and a colonnaded portico. The structure is set behind a low stone wall along an empty street. Text along the bottom identifies the building as the Archaeological Museum in Heraklion, Crete, in Greek and French, and a website watermark appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white image of a very large, ornate dining hall or hotel restaurant. The hall features high coffered ceilings with elaborate moldings, several enormous decorative chandeliers, and a two‑level gallery with balustrades running along the sides. Tables covered with white cloths and wooden chairs are neatly arranged in rows, with ice buckets or similar metal containers on many tables. Large windows with draped curtains line the walls, and decorative columns support the upper gallery. The image is framed with a white border, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a bustling commercial avenue lined with multi‑story shops and hanging signboards. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the street. Large signs read "SIMON ARZT", "THE TOURIST STORES" and others. At the bottom center in cursive is a caption identifying the location as Port‑Said, Prince Farouk Street, and there is a small printed number at the lower left.

Colorized postcard view of a wooded hilltop beer garden or outdoor restaurant with many empty wooden tables and chairs beneath tall trees. Behind the trees stands a large traditional building with white‑framed windows and gabled roofs, and in the background a stone lookout tower rises above the treeline. The caption at the bottom reads "MÖNCHSWALDER BERG."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a town in a broad valley with cultivated fields, vineyards on the slopes, and scattered houses and trees. To the right rises a distinctive steep, isolated hill with dense vegetation and a fortification or castle complex on its summit. In the far distance are low rolling hills. At the top edge of the card, in small red print, is the publisher's credit and a number.

Colorized vintage view along a path beside a stone city wall leading towards a fortified complex with round towers and red roofs. Trees line the slope on one side and the wall on the other, while a woman and two children walk in the foreground. The sky is softly tinted blue and yellow. At the top of the card, printed text in German reads "Bautzen." on the left and "Blick vom Mühltor." on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, elegant 19th‑century mansion or institutional building facing a broad street. The structure has a mansard roof with dormer windows, tall rectangular windows on the façade, and a small garden with a fence in front. Several pedestrians and a dog are visible on the sidewalk. Below the image, printed text reads "Nijmegen — R. K. Universiteit".

Black-and-white postcard view of a small rural railway station with wooden buildings in traditional Scandinavian style. A main two‑storey station house with steep gabled roof and white-trimmed dark wooden siding stands beside railway tracks. A semaphore signal and a small locomotive or railcar are visible to the left, along with additional small sheds. Text printed at the top identifies the railway and station, and signs on the station building display the station name.

A vintage, sepia-toned hand-colored postcard showing a one-story commercial building called the Bank Block with striped awnings, small trees along the sidewalk, and several people standing in front. There is an unpaved street with trolley or rail tracks and a horse-drawn vehicle to the left. The card has printed captions in red along the bottom and left/right margins and a red number in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a monumental statue of a man in 18th‑century military dress (Frederick the Great) standing atop a tall pedestal, holding a staff or cane. Below is a sculpted Prussian eagle and wreaths arranged around the base, all enclosed by a low white fence. Trees and buildings appear in the background. Printed caption text is at the bottom border, and inscriptions are visible on the pedestal.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a damaged two‑story urban building with ornate window frames and wrought‑iron balconies. The façade is pockmarked with shell or bullet damage, and some upper windows and parts of the roof are destroyed. To the right is a rounded corner pavilion with decorative elements. A horse‑drawn carriage stands on the left, and a blurred figure in a hat walks on the dirt street in front of the building. The image has a white border like an old photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestones, a central column topped by a lamp, young trees lining the open space, and pedestrians walking. Surrounding the square are Baroque/late‑Renaissance style buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. At the right edge stands a fountain or monument with a seated statue and lions. Behind the buildings rises a tall clock tower with an onion‑shaped spire. Shopfronts with German text are visible on the ground floors.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a public square with a tall Gothic-style war memorial featuring a statue beneath an ornate canopy. Surrounding it are late 19th‑/early 20th‑century buildings and a church-like tower. Several people, including children and a woman with a baby carriage, stand near the fenced monument. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place and publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an interior exhibition or showroom packed with wicker and rattan furniture: armchairs, tables, baskets, baby cradles, and decorative household items. At the back hang woven textiles with folk-style geometric patterns. Several Bulgarian-language signs advertise a wickerwork studio, with the largest sign reading the proprietor's name. The scene looks like a trade fair orcraft display from the early 20th century.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a wide cobblestone road curving past several substantial brick buildings with multiple chimneys and fenced grounds. Pedestrians walk along the street lined with young trees and telegraph poles. At the top left is the caption in German 'Gruss aus Windau.' and along the bottom are captions in Russian and German identifying the scene.

A sepia-toned old photograph showing wooden riverside houses in the foreground and, on the hill behind them, the ruins of a large brick castle or fortress wall with a tall, rectangular tower punctuated by several window openings. Snow patches lie on the slope leading up to the ruins, and the river in front appears calm or slightly frozen. The overall scene is rural and wintry, with no visible modern buildings or vehicles.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a curved urban seaside promenade with multi‑storey buildings on the right and a wide coastal road with early automobiles and pedestrians. The bay and shoreline recede into the distance. Script text along the bottom reads "Alexandrie – Promenade Irène Némi… (partially obscured). A printed logo appears in the lower‑right corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex above trees and rooftops. The multi‑storey building has many regular windows, steep tiled roofs, gables, and a tower with a lantern. At the top in red script is German text identifying the place. Some red numbers on the card are crossed out.

Colorized vintage view of a large stone arch bridge spanning a deep green valley with a stream below. The bridge has multiple arches, with a dominant central arch and smaller ones on each side, and connects tree‑covered slopes and masonry fortification walls. In the distance are buildings on the plateau. Red printed text along the top identifies the scene as Luxembourg and specifies the bridge's dimensions; additional publisher information is printed vertically at the left edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly, patchwork agricultural landscape with fields, trees, and a few scattered farm buildings. In the foreground, a single rail tram or trolley car travels along a line at the base of the hill. At the upper left, printed text reads "Berg en Dal" and below it "Panorama Keteldal." The overall style and printing suggest an early‑20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a large cobbled market square surrounded by multi‑storey 19th‑century townhouses. In the center stands a monument with a statue and landscaped base. People with carts and early automobiles are scattered around the open square, suggesting a market day. Low wooded hills and a church tower rise in the background. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the word for market square.

Black-and-white postcard showing a tree-lined avenue or path in a wooded park. Tall, gnarled trees form a dramatic tunnel over a dirt walkway, with a few small human figures walking in the distance. The scene feels natural and somewhat romantic. Handwritten-style text appears at the bottom edge of the image indicating the location and motif.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral fronting an open square with a prominent baroque fountain on the left and a tall bell tower with an onion-shaped dome on the right. The overall view is of a historic Italian piazza. Printed captions at the bottom read "Trento" on the left and "Il Duomo." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small river port with sailing boats moored along the bank in front of a row of traditional stone and timber houses with tiled roofs and wooden balconies. The waterfront has arcades and small storage structures. Rolling hills rise behind the town. Printed captions in Spanish/Galician identify the view as the pier of Betanzos and give the publisher's address in La Coruña.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing the interior of a richly decorated church. The nave is flanked by arches and columns, leading towards an iconostasis with icons and a central doorway. A large chandelier hangs from the domed ceiling. There are side altars, religious paintings, and crosses visible. The bottom margin contains captions in Greek and French identifying the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town nestled among hills with two striking volcanic rock outcrops. One rock carries a tall chapel or tower-like structure, and the other supports a large statue on its summit. Below, dense urban buildings, a prominent church, and surrounding farmland are visible. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a view of Le Puy taken from the Côte Rochearnaud.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a town district with several multi‑storey institutional buildings and a tall chimney, surrounded by trees and hills in the background. A street with an early automobile runs between the buildings. In the lower left corner the caption reads "Uddevalla. Lasarettet", and there is a small oval printer's logo in the lower right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central European city street with multi‑story historic buildings flanking a wide thoroughfare. A prominent baroque church tower with a clock rises on the right side in the distance. Small figures, carriages, and shop awnings line the street. Decorative red Gothic-style script in German appears in the upper right and lower left corners, and fine print is along the left edge and bottom.

Colorized photographic postcard showing a formation of German soldiers in dark green uniforms with red piping, boots, and rifles on their shoulders, marching on a dirt path in a park-like or training-ground setting. The men wear pickelhaube-style caps with plumes. At the top in German text it identifies the location as Freiberg and the unit as the K.S. 1. Jäger-Bataillon Nr. 12.

An illustrated street scene featuring old European town architecture with red-tiled roofs and a row of columned arcades in the foreground. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and converse on a cobblestone street, with a horse-drawn cart near the center. At the lower right corner, blue printed text reads "Kolonnades Jelgava."

Black‑and‑white historic view of a large European town square bordered by ornate multi‑storey buildings in Central‑European style. On the left stands a Renaissance/Gothic town hall with arcades; near its center rises a tall square church tower with clock faces and a steep spire. Next to it is a Baroque church façade. On the right are richly decorated burgher houses with gables and clocks, including one building with a distinctive bulbous onion‑shaped dome. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and gather around the open square, where there are a few trees and small monuments or fountains.

Monochrome image of a large stone church surrounded by leafless trees and enclosed by a low masonry wall. The church has a tall, square central tower with a steep pyramidal roof topped by a small finial or cross. The nave and side structures have sloped roofs, and there is a small chapel or gatehouse by the entrance in the wall. The style suggests a medieval or early modern rural church in Northern or Central Europe. The overall format and border indicate it is a vintage postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.

A sepia-toned group portrait in front of a stone building entrance with decorative iron doors. The group consists mostly of children in uniform, arranged in several rows, with a few adult men and women standing at the sides and back. Many boys wear dark shirts, shorts, caps, and long socks; a front row of girls or younger children wear light sweaters, dark skirts, ties, and caps. Several caps bear the word 'LAVIS'. One boy at the left holds a drum, and one person at the far left holds a flag.

The image shows the catalog or registration side of a postcard record, laid out as a typed archival form. It contains typed Danish text describing a postcard with a picture of a man in Lind, mentioning Kollundvej and Anton Kristoffersen Pugd. There is a reference number, date, and donor information; the right half of the card is largely blank.

Black‑and‑white view of a quiet, tree‑lined European street with multi‑storey masonry buildings in late‑19th‑century style. The right foreground shows a large institutional building with rusticated stone ground floor, arched windows, and an ornate arched doorway. Long angled flagpoles project from the façades, but the flags themselves are not visible. A few pedestrians stand on the otherwise empty sidewalk. The scene feels official or administrative rather than residential.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a street scene framed by two round medieval stone gate towers with conical roofs, leading into a historic city street lined with low buildings. A tall church or town‑hall spire rises in the distance. The caption in red German script at the bottom reads "Blick in die Lehmstrasse" and "Reval", and a vertical imprint at the left edge reads the publisher information.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a statue of a uniformed man in a coat and cap standing on a decorated pedestal. The monument has relief panels and inscriptions on the base, set in front of a multi‑story classical building. Printed red text at the top identifies the monument as dedicated to Herzog Wilhelm von Württemberg in Graz.

A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a busy market square filled with people, stalls, and horse‑drawn carts. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings, including a church-like structure with a steep roof on the left and a tall towered building on the right. The caption at the top in red print reads "Komotau. Marktplatz." indicating the main marketplace of the town.

A vintage illustrated Easter postcard featuring two yellow chicks among pussy willow branches and a bouquet of purple violets on a light background. At the bottom there is a Swedish Easter greeting in cursive script along with a handwritten signature.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view of a large monastery complex built on top of a steep rocky cliff, overlooking a valley with distant mountains. The monastery has stone walls and small domed roofs. In the foreground and below are rugged rock formations and sparse vegetation. French text at the top identifies the monastery, and the right side mentions the region of Thessaly. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white view through two tall trees across a lawn and small pond toward a circular, domed pavilion or bandstand in a landscaped park. The scene is framed by dense foliage, with a line of poplar trees behind the pavilion. There is a handwritten date or note near the top center, and faint printed text along the bottom edge that appears to identify the location, though it is not fully legible.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an industrial riverside landscape with several factory buildings, tall chimneys emitting smoke, a bridge over a river in the foreground, and hilly countryside in the background. The lower margin contains printed German text in red, including the place name 'Nossen' and references to local factories, along with a publisher line.

Colorized postcard showing an outdoor monument in a landscaped setting. In the foreground stands a bronze statue of a man in hunting attire with a rifle and a dog at his side, mounted on a stone pedestal. Behind is a curved white stone structure with relief portraits and a flower bed at its base, framed by balustrades and evergreen trees under a blue sky. The printed captions at the top read "Bad Elster." on the left and "König Friedrich-August-Standbild." on the right.

Sepia-toned photograph of a brick building on a cobblestone street, showing five young women in dresses standing and posing around the entrance. Large windows with curtains line the facade. Next to the doorway there is a vertical signboard with a full-length figure of a man in a coat and hat and some small text beneath, suggesting a shop or business entrance. A bicycle wheel is visible at the right edge of the image. The style of clothing and architecture suggests an early-20th-century urban setting.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural inn (Gasthaus) beside a dirt road, bordered by large trees and bushes. A horse‑drawn carriage with people is on the road in front of the long two‑story building, whose porch has tables and seated guests. The scene is tranquil countryside. Printed German captions at the bottom identify the place and publisher.

Color photograph of a large neo‑Romanesque church with two tall, slender twin towers topped by steep slate roofs and spires. The façade has multiple arched windows, decorative arcades, and a large circular rose window above three entrance portals, one of which includes a colored tympanum depicting religious figures. The church is built of light stone with reddish bands. Trees and a small park or square are visible in the foreground under a clear blue sky.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground are sloping fields and fenced gardens, with several detached houses and villas in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European style. Further back, more multi‑storey houses and guesthouse‑like buildings stand along a gently rising road, with dense coniferous forest covering the hill behind. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Bärenfels i. sächs. Erzgeb."

A black‑and‑white photograph of a single cargo or coastal ship at sea, viewed in profile from the starboard side. The vessel has two masts and a superstructure toward the stern, with a small national flag flying at the aft mast. The name "GERTRUD" is painted on the bow. The sea is calm and a low shoreline with some trees and buildings is faintly visible in the background under an overcast sky.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a wooded hill behind a small town or village. In the foreground are trees, gabled-roof houses and low white buildings. The background shows a forested hill labelled as Löbauer Berg, with a small tower structure on the crest identified as the Friedrich August Turm. Printed captions in German appear at the top of the card, including the locality Löbau i. Sa. and the spot Honigbrunnen.

Colorized vintage street scene showing an old market street with low shops and houses with wooden balconies and tiled roofs. People in traditional early‑20th‑century Balkan or Ottoman‑style clothing stand near baskets of produce in the unpaved street. The buildings are close together and there is a mix of men in long coats and women with head coverings. A faint web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower part of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Gothic brick church complex with tall pointed gables, tracery, and a prominent tower in the background. In front are smaller townhouses and a riverside or embankment with a fence and carts. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing. Printed captions in red identify the location and publisher.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad square with a large monument featuring a statue of a standing figure on a tall pedestal, surrounded by smaller sculptures. People walk and a horse‑drawn carriage passes in the foreground. Behind the square rise trees, historic buildings, and a church tower, with tall mountains in the background. Printed red text in the upper right reads "Trento Piazza Dante e Monte Terra Rossa," and at the bottom right "Luigi Marsoner, Trento." There is also a handwritten signature on the right side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a long, single‑story stone building with many rectangular windows and a gabled roof, likely a community or civic building. It stands beside a dirt road with some fenced plots and greenery in the foreground and dense trees in the background. A church spire is faintly visible above the trees on the left. Printed text in the sky area reads "Põltsamaa Põlluseimaja".

Colorized historic street view showing a gently curving cobbled street lined with two‑ to three‑storey buildings with red-tiled roofs. On the left foreground stands a stone monument or memorial column overgrown with ivy, topped with a pile of cannonballs and bearing a round portrait medallion. A fenced grassy strip with trees runs along the left, while on the right are shops with signage in German. A few pedestrians in long dark clothing and a horse‑drawn vehicle are visible in the distance. The sky is softly tinted blue and yellow. Printed German captions at the top read "Königsbrück." and "Schloßstraße."

An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a street scene with a prominent villa-style house on the left, surrounded by a fence and garden, and a row of multi‑storey residential buildings receding into the distance on the right. The foreground is an open, mostly bare plot of land or unpaved square. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the scene and publisher, including the town name and street. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century German urban landscape.

Sepia-toned historic waterfront scene showing fishing boats docked at a quay in front of a busy market square. People walk along the steps and stalls at the fish market, with horse-drawn carts and awnings visible. Prominent brick buildings stand behind the market, one signed for a clothing and tailoring business, with a large terraced residential block on the hill in the background. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the view as Göteborg, Fisktorget & Kungshöjd, and the publisher name Jolin & Wilkenson, Göteborg appears in the lower right.

A richly illustrated New Year postcard featuring a central niche with a classical female statue labeled "Hygieia" above a decorative fountain dated 1896. On the left is an interior with a tiled stove or bathhouse equipment, and on the right an industrial-looking room with basins and stacked trays, possibly related to hygiene or water facilities. The side panels are blue with floral ornaments and the top bears the name "ROB. HUBER". The New Year greeting is printed at the bottom in two languages, with city names given in two forms: "Helsingfors & Wiborg" and "Helsinki & Wiipuri".

A black‑and‑white, elevated view over a small European town with dense rows of 2–4‑story gabled houses and shops lining a cobblestone street. The foreground shows tiled rooftops; in the mid‑ground, several commercial buildings display German signage at street level. Beyond the town center are trees, factory chimneys, and open countryside. The architecture suggests late 19th‑ to early 20th‑century Central Europe.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a hilltop circular mausoleum/ossuary with a domed roof and colonnaded upper section, surrounded by trees and vegetation. In the foreground, there is a dirt path, stone benches, and a person seated under a large tree looking toward the monument. Mountains are faintly visible in the background. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the location.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑storey brick school building with arched windows and a tiled roof, surrounded by a low wooden fence and a few trees in the foreground. The scene looks early 20th century, with no cars visible and an unpaved street in front. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Vintage sepia-toned street view of a European town, showing multi‑story neoclassical buildings on the left, a broad street with pedestrians and a few carts, and low hills in the background. Greek text appears along the bottom left, with a French and Latin‑alphabet caption on the right identifying the scene as a street in Kalamata named Rue Venizelos. A web address is faintly printed across the lower right of the image.

Vintage illustrated postcard showing a riverside view of Graz, with a bridge in the foreground, horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians, a row of multi‑storey buildings along the river, a church tower, and a hill with a fortification and clock tower in the background. The left side is decorated with oak leaves and a heraldic shield featuring a silver lion on a green field. The top has ornamental elements with birds and the city name. A round emblem with floral motifs and text is printed on the upper right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of two substantial brick civic buildings separated by trees and hedges. On the right is a large, ornate, three‑story Victorian public building with tall arched windows, a central tower with a flagpole, decorative roof balustrade, and broad stairways leading to an elevated entrance, likely a courthouse or city hall. On the left stands a smaller, one‑story rectangular building with a hipped roof and evenly spaced arched windows, possibly a library or annex. The foreground shows a neatly landscaped street corner with sidewalks, hedges, and a fire hydrant. The sky area appears overexposed or retouched. No clear printed caption is visible.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large church with a tall, pointed clock tower topped by a cross. The nave has a steep roof and the walls are heavily covered with ivy or other climbing plants. In the foreground there is a lush garden or cemetery with flowers, shrubs, and gravestones. At the bottom margin of the image there is a printed caption identifying the location and the church.

Black-and-white postcard image showing a large late‑19th‑century brick villa with ornate window decorations and a steep tiled roof, partly obscured by tall leafy trees. In the foreground there is a riverside promenade with railings, a striped pavilion or kiosk, and pedestrians walking along the path. At the top, printed in red, is the caption indicating the place and building name.

A monochrome winter scene showing a fortified town with several large, round or slightly polygonal stone towers and high walls among snow‑covered buildings. Bare tree branches dominate the foreground, including a thick, gnarled tree trunk on the right. The landscape appears slightly misty, suggesting cold weather. Handwritten numbers are visible along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard view of an urban street with cobblestones, lined by multi‑story buildings and industrial structures with tall chimneys. In the foreground is a small fenced park with a monument or statue base. A horse‑drawn wagon loaded with barrels moves along the street. The caption at the top reads in German: "Radeberg i. Sa. — Brauerei".

Vintage sepia photograph of an elaborately sculpted Romanesque cathedral portal filled with biblical figures and decorative reliefs. The image shows columns with statues of apostles and a richly carved archway leading into the church interior. A printed caption in Spanish appears below the image.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a lakeside rural complex in a forested landscape. Several wooden buildings with pitched roofs are scattered among tall coniferous trees, connected by curved dirt roads. There is an open grass field near the shoreline and farmland visible in the background. The architecture suggests a Nordic countryside resort, camp, or institutional compound.

Colorized historic postcard showing the grand interior of a glass-and-iron colonnade hall with high arched windows, ornate metalwork, hanging chandeliers, palm trees and benches along the sides. Many finely dressed people in late 19th–early 20th century fashion stroll or sit inside the hall. Red printed caption at the bottom reads "Karlsbad. Inneres der Sprudel-Kolonnade."

A black‑and‑white waterfront cityscape showing a busy harbor or canal lined with multi‑story European townhouses and commercial buildings. Numerous sailing ships and small boats are moored along the quayside, with awnings over shopfronts at street level. In the distance to the left, an industrial skyline with chimneys is visible, along with a bridge and a small turreted structure in the water. The architecture appears late‑19th‑ to early‑20th‑century European. No clear caption or postcard markings are visible on the image itself.

A black‑and‑white historical street scene shows a gently curving cobblestone road lined with narrow multi‑story townhouses on the right and an older, massive round corner building with a tiled roof in the center foreground. On the left is a small ivy‑covered cottage. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street and a few carts or small vehicles are visible in the distance. At the far end of the street rises a distinctive town‑hall‑like tower with several tiers and a clock. The overall look suggests a Central or Eastern European old town. No obvious modern elements appear, and there is no clearly legible text.

A monochrome (sepia-toned) photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo ship at sea, taken from the side while it moves through slightly rough waters. The vessel has two tall masts, a bridge and accommodation block toward the stern, and several crew visible on deck near the bow. The name of the ship, "KÄTHE-MARIE," is painted on the bow. The background is an open sea with no coastline visible, and the sky is light and mostly empty.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a rugged mountainous landscape, likely part of a rocky cliff or mountain range. The image is tinted in sepia tones and has a wide panoramic view. At the bottom margin there is printed text identifying the location as Greece and Delphi, along with Greek script, and a modern watermark reading 'www.elia.org.gr'.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone bridge over a calm canal. The bridge's arch and nearby buildings are reflected clearly in the water. People and horse‑drawn vehicles can be seen on or near the bridge, and multi‑story classical-style buildings line the street behind it. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Göteborg and the specific bridge as Teaterbron.

A black-and-white aerial view of a small town or suburb surrounded by forest. The foreground shows open fields and a railway or road along the edge, with garden plots nearby. Beyond the fields is a neat grid of detached houses with pitched roofs and small yards, followed further back by larger, block-like institutional or residential buildings. Dense forest borders the settlement on most sides. There is no visible text on the image.

Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing an inner courtyard with arcades, balustrades and a domed stair-tower of a Renaissance-style building. Around the top border are various heraldic shields. At the bottom are two smaller vignettes: one of a street scene with historic buildings, and two groups of three figures in old-fashioned dress holding banners. One banner reads "LANDHAUS" and the other includes the word "GRAZ". Text at the very bottom notes the artist and location.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large 19th‑century, multi‑storey masonry building in an eclectic / neo‑Renaissance style, probably a railway station or major public building. It has a prominent corner block with gabled roof and battlement‑like details, long side wings with repetitive tall windows, and a tower visible further along the façade. In front are a wide paved area, horse‑drawn carriages, and a few pedestrians, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban scene. The image has the typical framing and border damage of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed text or caption can be seen on the image side.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a general view of a coastal town built amphitheatrically on a hillside beside the sea. Dense low houses line the waterfront with more buildings climbing up the hill. There is Greek postage in the upper‑right corner and several postal cancellation marks and handwritten notes across the bottom. The printed caption at the bottom center reads "Syra. – Vue Générale."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide tree‑lined avenue with benches on both sides, bordered by tall trees and palm trees, in a landscaped park. The top has red printed text identifying the scene as a palm‑tree street in Campo Grande, Lisbon. At the lower left there is an ornate publisher's mark, and at the bottom in red appears the word "Portugal" followed by a card number.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide driveway lined with palm trees and statues leading to an ornate building entrance. Horse-drawn carriages and people are visible on the road. At the right edge is the façade of an elaborate structure, likely part of a grand hotel complex. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center, and a website watermark is superimposed across the lower right of the image.

Black‑and‑white image showing a path lined with blossoming trees and a simple wooden fence in the foreground, leading toward a large medieval-looking brick complex with steep, tiled roofs and tall, narrow towers topped with spires. The upper sky area shows damage or overexposure, suggesting an old photograph that may have been printed as a postcard. No printed caption or writing is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white image of a monumental bronze statue of a man in early‑19th‑century dress standing on a tall stone pedestal in a park. The figure wears a long cloak, looks to his left, and holds a curved sword resting point‑down. The pedestal bears a relief with military symbols and the name "THEODOR KOERNER". Trees and a multi‑storey building appear in the background, and a wreath lies at the base of the monument.

Colorized vintage street view showing Bahnhofstrasse in a European town. Multi‑storey stone townhouses line the left side, while on the right is a large corner building with a sign reading "Neustädter Bank". People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the wide, mostly empty street that leads towards a church tower in the distance. The sky is softly tinted and the scene has the typical printed look of an old postcard. At the top, red text labels the location as "Neustadt i. Sa., Bahnhofstrasse".

Black‑and‑white view down a broad European city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. A tramcar runs along tracks in the middle, while pedestrians and a horse‑drawn wagon move along the cobbled roadway. In the foreground left is a small monument or fountain with a statue and an iron railing around it. Shopfronts with awnings and German‑language signs line both sides of the street. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century urban scene.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an industrial gasworks complex with several brick buildings, a tall smokestack, and a large round gas holder. In the foreground runs a street with a cyclist and a pedestrian, and there is a fenced-off area and gateway leading into the facility. The printing at the top in red German text identifies the location as Brockwitz–Sörnewitz and describes the gasworks on Bahnhofstraße.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal village seen across a bay. In the foreground are rocky, low vegetation‑covered shores. Across the water lies a compact settlement of wooden houses and boathouses, with several small sailing boats and rowboats moored in the harbor. A prominent church with a tall steeple stands on a rocky rise to the left. In the distance, a windmill and more clustered houses are visible. The word "FISKEBÄCKSKIL" is printed in white in the lower left corner, and a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 6638 appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a stone statue of a Christian bishop or saint holding a crosier, standing on a pedestal against a brick wall. Behind the statue hangs a richly patterned medieval-style tapestry or mural with stylized figures and animals rendered in a Romanesque or early Gothic manner.

A color image of a circular, modernist pavilion with a flat overhanging roof and a low green dome. Wide semicircular steps lead up to glass doors, with many people walking up and down, dressed in mid‑20th‑century clothing. Trees and a park-like setting surround the building. On the building's façade there is Cyrillic text, and a large blue letter "M" stands on the roof near the entrance.

Black‑and‑white image of a small steamship at sea, photographed in profile. The vessel has a single funnel with large letters on it and two masts, and it appears to be a coastal cargo steamer. A flag flies at the stern. The ship's name, "NORDLAND," is painted on the bow. The style resembles an early‑20th‑century photographic postcard of a ship.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard depicting a large European town square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and many awnings. In the center stands an ornate multi‑tiered fountain monument with statues and steps, around which small market stalls with umbrellas are set up. In the background a steep hill rises behind the town, crowned by massive fortification walls and a distinctive clock tower on top.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a busy town square with market stalls, horse-drawn carriages, people walking and trading, and a row of multi‑storey buildings in the background. The lower part contains printed Romanian captions and handwritten correspondence covering much of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined military compound with two large multi‑storey barracks buildings surrounding an inner yard, viewed from an elevated position over a wall and guarded gate. German text is printed in red at the top describing the unit and the officers' casino and barracks.

A black‑and‑white portrait postcard of a man with a small mustache, wearing a light-colored sweater and long scarf with checkered trousers. He is seated and turned slightly toward the camera. In the lower right corner there is printed text identifying him (likely an actor) and mentioning a role or production, along with the photographer's credit and city.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire, surrounded by compact town buildings. In the foreground and to the right are large detached villas with steep, gabled roofs and decorative timber framing, bordered by tree‑lined, winding paths and roads running through a park‑like area. The background shows rolling, wooded hills. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a large crowd gathered in a palace courtyard. In the left foreground several uniformed guards and a child stand near a raised podium draped with a cloth bearing multiple crowns. A figure on the podium addresses a dense line of people standing opposite in the open courtyard, backed by the long façade of a grand Baroque palace with many rectangular windows. Swedish text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

Black-and-white landscape postcard showing a large country house or inn surrounded by trees, fields, and gently rolling hills, with a forested ridge in the background. A path or road leads toward the building in the foreground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge.

A black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing a hilly landscape with defensive walls, a stone bridge, scattered houses, and a large round tower with adjoining fortifications on the crest. The scene is labeled as the citadel and Cicero's tower in Salonica (Thessaloniki) during World War I, with French and English captions printed along the bottom margin, plus a publisher's imprint on the right.

Vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a busy urban street scene lined with tall buildings featuring traditional enclosed glass balconies. The street is filled with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and a few cyclists. Overhead utility wires and a hanging streetlamp are visible. Printed caption text appears at the upper left indicating the location as Calle Real in La Coruña.

Black‑and‑white (sepia‑tinted) postcard view of a large multi‑storey barracks complex with several adjoining buildings, leafless trees in the foreground, wooden fences and a small shed. The image is printed with red caption text at the top, set against a light border area, typical of early 20th‑century German postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a very large Neo‑Gothic / historicist building with corner towers, steep roofs and many small dormers, seen from across an open, almost empty field. Leafless trees and a fence run along the foreground in front of the complex. A few small human figures walk in the field, and a tall church spire with a clock is visible in the distance on the right.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a rustic wooden farmhouse or chalet surrounded by trees. The building has a balcony with carved railing, a steep roof with overhangs, and small shuttered windows. A simple wooden fence lines a dirt path in the foreground, where several people, including a child, are standing or walking. The scene has an old rural, park‑like atmosphere. Red printed text appears along the bottom edge.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a narrow historic street lined with tall brick buildings in Bruges. An ornate arched passageway with statues and decorative gables connects the buildings above the street. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including women with long dresses and hats and children, walk along the street. Printed caption text and numbering appear at the bottom of the image, suggesting it is a commercial postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard with a studio portrait of a man in a suit and tie on the left side, looking downwards. The right side contains a handwritten message in blue ink in a Latin-based script, along with a rectangular blue stamp impression that appears to contain the word "COLLECTI[ON] SPECIALE" or similar.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a hillside settlement with stone houses and a prominent multi-arched stone building on the right. Two people stand on the rocky slope in the foreground.
