Mountains rise behind the town. There are visible postal cancellation marks on the image and a Greek caption at the bottom, as well as a printed website watermark.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large villa or small mansion set within a landscaped garden. The building has an asymmetrical facade with a tall, square tower on the left crowned by a steep, pyramidal roof and finial, and a lower central section with a balcony and rectangular windows. The walls show decorative brick or stone banding around the windows. Ivy climbs the lower walls, and dense trees and shrubs surround the house, framing it on both sides. The foreground is a lawn with patches of sunlight and shadow. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.

Colorized vintage postcard view showing a single-track railway line leading toward a metal bridge surrounded by dense green forest. In the distance on a hilltop stands a white medieval-looking castle complex with red roofs and a prominent tower. At the top of the image there is printed German text, and a red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.

Hand‑tinted panoramic view over a river city. In the foreground are leafy trees and several villas with light walls, metal roofs, and some bright red roofs. A tall pointed tower with decorative brickwork and a steep metal spire rises at the left. Across the broad river there is a long multi‑span bridge and, slightly downstream, an older and narrower bridge. On the opposite bank stand low wooden and masonry houses among many trees, with gentle hills in the far background. The coloring and style suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small European town with dense rooftops, church towers and a large Gothic-style church dominating the right side. The foreground shows foliage on a hillside; beyond the town lies flat agricultural countryside and distant hills. At the bottom center, a caption in a decorative script reads "Kamenz i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a ceremonial scene on a balcony of an old building. Three men in military and formal attire stand behind a draped balustrade, flanked by large flags. Above the balcony is a decorative star made of wreaths or garlands. A person looks out from an upper window to the left. Handwritten annotations include a date at the top and writing along the left edge and bottom, suggesting the location and event.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a long row of grey military barracks behind a wall, with leafless trees in the foreground and a town with church towers in the background. The sky is light blue and there is red German text printed along the top identifying the location as a barracks camp in Freiberg in Saxony.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped park scene with a small decorative wooden pavilion or hut surrounded by trees and shrubs. Several well‑dressed people from the late 19th or early 20th century—women in long dresses and hats, men in suits or uniforms, and a young girl—stroll along a curved path. A printed caption panel in German appears in the lower right corner, and the publisher's imprint is printed in red at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large multi-arch steel railway bridge spanning a river, seen from a curved dirt road in the foreground. Church towers and city buildings appear in the distant background on the left. The printed captions identify the view as Nijmegen and specifically the railway bridge by the Oosterhoutscheweg.

Vintage colorized view of a landscaped park with flowerbeds and tall trees surrounding a wooden pavilion or bandstand with a steep red roof and tall spire. The image has a cream border at the bottom containing printed text identifying the place in Hungarian and German.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large wooden chalet-style building with a balcony and decorative trim, partly framed by overhanging tree branches. There are tables and chairs set up outside on a terrace or yard in front of the house. Printed German text in red at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

Black-and-white photograph of a small church with a tall, narrow steeple topped by a cross. The building has arched windows and a simple façade, surrounded by leafless or lightly leaved trees and wooden fences. In the background there are additional houses and a forested hillside. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Svartviks kyrka."

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large arched steel bridge crowded with 1930s-era cars, buses, and pedestrians. Flags line the sides of the bridge and a dense crowd walks along both edges. At the bottom, a caption in Dutch identifies the scene as the Waal Bridge in Nijmegen and notes it as the largest span in Europe.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small town with dense rooftops in the foreground, church towers and factory chimneys in the middle distance, and patchwork fields and low hills in the background. The printed captions in German identify the view as Kamenz with Spittel, seen from the church. The publisher information appears along the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a large hilltop castle complex above a town. The castle has multiple tall, rectangular wings with steep tiled roofs, corner towers with conical roofs, and a small clock- or bell-tower with a spire. Terraced gardens and vineyard-like plantings descend the slope, with stone retaining walls and railings. Below the fortress sit several smaller residential houses with gabled roofs surrounded by dense trees. The landscape beyond is gently rolling farmland. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

Colored vintage postcard view taken from the sea, showing the harbor and waterfront of a historic city with sailing ships and early steam vessels in the foreground. Behind the port rises a densely built hillside crowned by a large fortress-like complex. The image is framed with a cream border and has printed red text at the bottom identifying the view, plus small red vertical printing along the left edge.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a young woman in an elaborate white lace blouse with a high Victorian/Edwardian collar and a large, styled coiffure. She is framed by an oval or circular arch decorated with flowers and foliage and stands behind a basket overflowing with flowers. The image has soft studio lighting and a romantic, staged composition, typical of early 20th‑century portrait or greeting postcards. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.

A black-and-white vintage photograph showing a horse-drawn carriage in front of a wooden house. A man in a cap stands by the horse, holding the bridle or harness, while a woman and a child sit in the carriage. Several women are standing in the open doorway and on the steps of the house, wearing long skirts and high-necked blouses typical of the late 19th or early 20th century. Birch trees stand in the foreground. The scene evokes a rural setting and appears to be a posed family or household portrait.

Color image of a busy harbor with large ships docked at a pier. Two huge bows of ocean-going vessels dominate the left and right foreground, with heavy chains and mooring lines stretching across the scene. The ship on the right bears a prominent red star on its bow, indicating a Soviet vessel. In the middle distance are cranes, cargo ships, and a white passenger liner. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing stand along the quay observing the ships under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a general view of a small village nestled in a valley with hills around it. At the center stands a large Romanesque church with a tall bell tower surrounded by clustered stone houses and farm buildings. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as being near Clermont-Ferrand and specifically Orcival. The overall design and typography are typical of early 20th‑century French postcards.

A color postcard featuring a bronze statue of a woman standing in front of an old stone building with arched entrance and decorative facade. Along the right border, vertically, is the greeting text 'Groeten uit Nijmegen'.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a historic church and surrounding town buildings. The tall central structure is a church with a prominent tower and spire, labelled at the top of the card as "Wenzelskirche." Below, early 20th‑century townhouses and shops line a square with trees and a few pedestrians. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Naumburg a. S., and the publisher credit appears in small type.

Black-and-white postcard view of a leafy, rural scene with an old fortified building or manor house on the left and a small church or chapel with a bell tower and turreted corner building on the right, partly hidden by trees and greenery. A low stone wall and dense vegetation occupy the foreground. In the lower right corner, white printed text identifies the location as "Mutzschen i. Sa."

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small rural railway station complex. In the foreground are several parallel train tracks and a dirt platform. To the right stands a wooden station building with a gabled roof, chimney, and decorative window frames; a small enclosed porch projects from the façade. To the left is a separate wooden shed or goods building. A few people, including a child, stand near the buildings. Forested countryside fills the distant background. At the top of the image there is printed caption text in Swedish.

Black-and-white postcard view of a rural landscape with ploughed fields in the foreground and a small settlement in the background. There are farm buildings, trees, and what appears to be a church tower rising above the trees. Printed text at the top reads 'Fra Ottestad, Hedemarken'.

A colorized panoramic view across a river toward a dense historic townscape with brick houses, churches, and towers. Smoke from a steam-powered boat or industrial facility drifts along the waterfront. In the foreground there is a riverbank with shrubs and low vegetation. At the top left, red printed text in Dutch reads "Gezicht op Nijmegen." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a tree‑lined street and square with a few people and bicycles in the foreground and older low buildings in the background. The caption beneath the image identifies the location in Uppsala, Sweden, and the publisher.

Colorized postcard view of a landscaped spa garden with curved flowerbeds and a central path leading to a large white statue on a pedestal. Two women in long dresses and wide-brimmed hats stand near the statue. Behind them is dense greenery and a pavilion-like building, with forested hills in the background. The caption at the bottom reads in German about Bad Elster and a Hygiea statue and walking hall in the spa park.

A Soviet-era aviation postcard featuring an illustration of a modernist waterfront building with moored sailboats, described as an Olympic sailing center. On the upper right is a printed stamp design for the XXII Olympic Games with Olympic rings and a stadium or venue plan, marked with a denomination of 4 kopeks and the text 'ПОЧТА СССР 1980 К'. The right side has preprinted address lines and index boxes in Russian for the sender and recipient.

Sepia-toned historic streetscape showing a broad, unpaved avenue lined with multi-storey brick buildings on the right and a raised promenade with a stone wall and trees on the left. Pedestrians walk along the promenade and the street, and a horse-drawn cart is visible. German captions identify the place and street.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing the interior of a large Gothic or neo‑Gothic church, viewed from the central aisle toward the main altar. The space has tall clustered columns, pointed rib vaults, and high lancet windows. Wooden pews line both sides of the aisle, leading to a richly decorated altar with paintings and statues. A large, ornate wooden pulpit is mounted on one of the right‑hand columns. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white winter view over a mountainous, forested valley with deep conifer woods and snow‑covered slopes. In the foreground and mid‑distance stand several large chalet‑style hotels or sanatorium buildings with steep roofs and dormers, typical of Central European spa or ski resorts. A winding road and scattered villas run along the valley floor. The surrounding mountains are densely forested, with one broad cleared strip on a slope that resembles an early ski run. At the very top edge of the image, some reversed handwritten numbers and characters are visible on the film border.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing deep snow along a curving road in a small town. On the left stands a large wooden house with ornate balconies, and several people are visible near the entrance. To the right a substantial truss railway bridge on stone piers crosses above smaller buildings and snowy yards. Leafless trees and fences line the foreground. At the top of the card there is a caption in a Scandinavian language.

A vintage tinted photograph of a crowded sandy beach in a curved bay beneath steep, stratified cliffs. Many people are sunbathing and swimming; simple beach structures or cabanas made from reeds or wood appear in the foreground. The sea is calm, and the coastline with wooded cliffs stretches into the distance. At the bottom left, there is a short title in Cyrillic script.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the rooftops and gabled townhouses of Meissen. In the foreground is a historic market square area with stepped-gable facades. On the hill in the background stand large historic buildings and a church with a tall spire; next to it a large tower-like structure is covered in scaffolding. The caption in red at the lower left reads "Meissen. Blick vom Stadtturm." The publisher line at the bottom margin says it was produced by Brück & Sohn in 1905.

A colorized early-20th-century postcard showing a hilly, green rural landscape with fields, scattered farmhouses with red roofs, and a broad river or floodplain in the distance under a pale sky. At the bottom margin, red printed text in Dutch identifies the view and a year: it describes the view from the terrace of Hôtel Berg en Dal "Vossenhutje" and includes the date 1905.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a side view of a steamship on calm water, with its reflection visible below. The vessel has two masts, a central funnel marked with a large 'G', and people visible on deck. A flag flies at the stern. At the lower left of the image area, the caption reads 'Hansa, Wisby'. The scene is framed by a light-colored postcard border.

Illustrated wartime scene showing Bulgarian infantry in green uniforms with bayonets charging uphill under a red military flag bearing a small yellow emblem. Smoke and gunfire fill the background, with a hilltop fortification or earthworks visible above. Fallen soldiers in blue uniforms lie on the ground in the foreground. The caption in Bulgarian Cyrillic appears at the top, and a small printer/artist credit is at the bottom.

A colorized historic street scene showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story brick buildings with shop awnings and shuttered windows. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A tall church tower rises in the background. On the right corner building is signage for a café, and at the bottom margin there is printed red caption text naming the place.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of an Alpine town in a valley, surrounded by high, partly snow‑covered mountains. In the center stands a tall church with a slender bell tower and pointed spire. To the right, on a rocky hill, is a prominent square tower and castle complex overlooking the town. Dense traditional buildings fill the foreground. Along the very top edge, faint reversed handwriting is visible, likely part of a caption.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an alpine valley with a rocky stream in the foreground, crossed by a small wooden or metal bridge. On the right, atop a steep hill, stand the ruins of a medieval castle with a prominent, square keep or watchtower surrounded by trees and crumbling walls. In the lower left inset, there is a second view of a tree‑lined path or road running beside the stream toward the same bridge. The print has scalloped edges typical of vintage postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a baroque manor or small castle with round corner towers, steep tiled roofs, and an ornate central façade with a balcony and a tower-like belfry. The building is surrounded by trees and a garden, with a curved driveway in the foreground. In the upper left corner, the word "OROSLAVJE" is printed, indicating the location.

Tinted historic street view showing a long straight road lined with low buildings on the left and a wall with trees on the right. In the distance stands a church tower with a dome and cross. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as a street and the Tower of St. Spiridon in Iași. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white seaside scene showing a sandy beach with scattered grass and a large pine tree in the foreground. A promenade or sandy road runs along the shoreline toward several grand wooden seaside hotels or villas with balconies and a pointed tower. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the path; women wear long dresses and men wear suits and overcoats. Behind the buildings is a wooded hill, giving the impression of a Baltic or North Sea resort town.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a long brick building complex along a straight, tree-lined street. The architecture is late-19th- or early-20th-century, with tall rectangular windows and three stories. A wrought-iron fence and gates line the sidewalk. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a rocky cliff with pine trees overlooking a forested valley and water in the distance. The bottom margin contains printed location text and a publisher credit. Across the lower half there is handwritten cursive text in Swedish.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the entrance gate and brick façade of a large institutional building with arched windows and a steep tiled roof, seen from a gardened courtyard. The caption beneath the image identifies it as the Pensionnat des Dames de Saint-André in Bruges; the left margin bears the printer's mark with the city name Bruges.

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a gently curving road lined with multi‑story townhouses and villas. A horse-drawn cart moves along the street while a few pedestrians walk on the roadside. In the background are more buildings on a hill and a church spire rising above the rooftops. At the top left, printed text reads "Döbeln i. Sa. — Dresdner Strasse".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street beside an old stone wall covered with ivy. Several men in dark academic-style cloaks are gathered; some hold long staffs or batons pointed toward a central man, suggesting a ritual or initiation. Another man in a coat stands to the right observing. The scene is outdoors, likely in an old university quarter. The top right bears the city name, and a caption in the lower right describes the scene.

A tinted vintage view over a riverside or coastal town, seen from an elevated position. In the foreground are tightly packed wooden and stone buildings with steep metal roofs, chimneys, and tree-lined streets. To the right is a long rectangular waterfront building with an arcade-like facade. The middle ground shows several small piers and boats along a curving shoreline. Across a wide expanse of calm water lies a low, sparsely built strip of land, with more water and low hills in the hazy distance. The sky is lightly colored blue with a few clouds. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

A monochrome postcard view of a large brick military barracks complex along a tree‑lined street. The architecture is late‑19th‑century German, with steep mansard roofs, dormer windows, and decorative brickwork. Overhead telegraph or power lines run along the street. Printed red text at the top identifies the location and the military unit stationed there.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing an older man in a suit and flat cap standing at a stall in an outdoor market. He holds a small statue of a woman descending a staircase, while in front of him and hanging from the stall structure are various metal objects and curios: bells, bowls, kettles, pitchers, figurines, and other antiques or bric‑a‑brac. A sepia-toned postcard showing tall, layered rock formations rising beside a road and trees. Two of the rock towers have crosses mounted on their summits. The style is early 20th‑century photographic print with a German caption at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a broad inlet with calm water, low forested hills and islands in the distance. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a road or railway. The lower left corner has printed caption text, and the lower right shows a small printer's logo with the number 153.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a town square with a small fountain in the center, surrounded by ornate multi‑story buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk, stand by carts, and shop at market stalls with umbrellas. One prominent building bears the sign "BANCA COOPERATIVA" on its roofline. At the top of the postcard, in red lettering, is the caption "Trento. Piazza della Posta."

Color photograph of a tall concrete telecommunications tower rising from a wooded hill above a city. The tower has a slender shaft, a large multi-level observation and equipment pod near the top, and a red‑and‑white striped antenna mast. In the foreground are green trees and several low red‑roofed buildings next to a broad paved area, with an expansive city and distant hills in the background under a blue sky with clouds.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad tree‑lined street with a grand historicist stone building on the left and a row of trimmed trees and street lamps on the right. At the far end of the street stands a station-like building with an arched façade. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed German text appears along the top margin.

Sepia photograph of an ornate reading room, likely in a library. Long wooden tables with classic library lamps line the foreground. In the center is a doorway labeled "ČASOPISY" leading to another study area with desks and lamps. Above the doorway are large mural paintings of semi‑nude allegorical figures surrounded by books and foliage; the inscriptions above them read "SCIENTIA NATVRALES" and "SCIENTIA SCHOLASTICA". Decorative columns and paneling frame the interior.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large historicist town hall building with a central dome and multiple spires on a busy square. The square is filled with cafe tables, umbrellas, people walking, and a tram line running through. The caption at the top identifies the location in German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town street with horse‑drawn wagons and wooden houses. On the left stands a corner building with a small tower and a sign in Cyrillic and French reading "Гостиница Руссиа / Hotel de Russie." The street extends into the distance between trees and low buildings. Printed in red at the bottom margin is the caption "Werro. Dörptsche Strasse."

A colorized historic postcard view of a large Renaissance-style hunting palace enclosing a wide courtyard. The multi-storey buildings have light-colored facades, steep red-tiled roofs, several gabled dormers, and a clock or bell tower on the right. Ivy climbs up much of the lower walls, and a large tree stands in the middle of the courtyard under a blue sky with scattered clouds. At the top of the image there is German text printed in a serif font.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside port with several piers and moored ships along a wide river. On the right, a dirt road runs parallel to the water with horse-drawn carriages and a few small buildings. The riverbank is sloping, and industrial structures, chimneys, and boats are visible in the distance. Printed text identifies the scene as the port of Braila, and there is cursive handwriting over parts of the card.

Recto of an old German-language postal card labeled "Postkarte" with handwritten address information. On the left is the sender address written in black ink, on the right the addressee in the city of Reval with reference to the "Teater Estonia". There is an orange postage stamp from "Deutsches Reich" overprinted "Postgebiet Ob. Ost" and cancelled at Hapsal. A purple circular registration mark with a large "R" is also present. The card is tan with a central vertical divider line.

Colorized panoramic view of a European town seen from a flowered meadow in the foreground. The town has many red‑tiled roofs, industrial buildings with a tall brick chimney, a church with a slender tower, and a large castle‑like complex on a hill. Trees and greenery surround the buildings, and the landscape extends into gently rolling fields in the distance. The word "Zschopau." appears printed in red at the top left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing three people in front of a round hut made of branches and thatch in an arid, hilly landscape. Two women sit at the entrance of the hut while another person stands to the left. Cooking pots and simple household items are on the ground. In the distant background on a hill there is a single rectangular white building. At the top left of the postcard is a printed caption in Portuguese that reads "Ribeira Bota (habitação indigena)."

A black‑and‑white aerial view of a mid‑20th‑century suburban residential district. The foreground shows tree‑lined streets with detached houses and gardens. Farther back are several blocks of 3–5‑story apartment buildings arranged in rows with open courtyards, and beyond them more single‑family homes in a grid pattern. There are open fields at the edge of the settlement, indicating ongoing development. No text or decorative postcard framing is visible on the image side.

Color postcard showing a tree-lined boulevard with tram tracks and two trams in the distance. In the background, on a hill, the Acropolis is visible. Text at the top identifies the location in Greek and French as Boulevard Olga and the Acropolis in Athens.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a bustling urban scene with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn vehicle, and rows of multi‑story wooden and masonry buildings on both sides. Shop signs and advertisements in Swedish line the façades. The printed title at the top reads "Göteborg Husargatan," indicating the street being depicted.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a large historicist city hall building with a central dome, clock, and ornate façade. In front of the building is a busy square with market stalls and umbrellas, trams, and pedestrians. The scene shows an urban street extending to the left with another church or tower in the distance. The caption at the top left reads in German: "Graz - Rathaus mit Herrengasse."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town square with rows of two‑storey houses on both sides and a church tower with a clock and spire in the background. Young trees line the open, unpaved marketplace area in the foreground. Printed red and black German text is at the bottom margin, including the town and scene description, plus the publisher and year '1905'.

A vintage multi-view postcard with nine black‑and‑white images surrounding a central greeting text. The images show notable buildings and views of Tallinn: a large palace-like building, a seaside panorama with the city skyline, a government building labeled as parliament, a tall church spire, the medieval Viru Gate, Toompea hill with the cathedral labeled as the Dome, a railway station, and a city square with modern buildings. The central panel reads "TERVITUS TALLINNAST". Captions in Estonian and English are written under most views.

Colorized vintage view over a European city with a prominent clock tower in the foreground on a hill, showing large clock faces on its sides and a steep red roof. The tower overlooks a river running through the city with multiple bridges and red‑roofed buildings. At the top left, printed text labels the scene.

Colorized vintage view of a large neoclassical building complex with two symmetrical pavilions topped by red hipped roofs and small lanterns. The main façade faces a formal garden with a large lawn and colorful flowerbeds in the foreground, lined with trees along a path. A tram or trolley is visible on the right side in front of the building. The scene is under a partly cloudy blue sky and has the soft, grainy look of early color printing. No visible caption or text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white image of a large villa or hotel with a prominent multi‑storey lookout tower rising above a steep tiled roof. The building is surrounded by tall coniferous trees, suggesting a forest setting. In the foreground is a terraced outdoor garden or beer garden with many white chairs and tables arranged in rows, separated by low hedges and bordered by a wooden fence. Several people in early‑20th‑century clothing are visible among the tables.

Illustrated winter night scene of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance city hall building fronting a snowy square. The façade has a central dome with smaller domes and towers at the corners, many lit windows, and statues around a central monument or fountain. On the left, a row of old townhouses lines a snow-covered street leading to a distant church tower. In the foreground at right stands a woman in traditional dress with a cart of flowers. Decorative cursive German text wishing a happy new year appears in the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a countryside landscape with a large rectangular school building on the right, surrounded by grass and trees. In the background are forested hills and a broad lake or fjord under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text appears along the bottom left, and a cursive signature or publisher's mark is at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. A gently curving road lined with two- and three-story houses runs through the scene, with iron railings in the foreground and telegraph poles along the street. People are walking in the distance. At the top of the image, printed caption text reads "Glashütte i. Sa. — Obere Hauptstraße".

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped city park with winding paths, benches, ornamental shrubs and tall trees. A decorative metal lamppost stands near a fenced path in the foreground. Rising behind the trees is a tall cylindrical tower with Neo‑Gothic detailing and a sharply pointed spire, visible above the foliage. No printed caption or text is visible on the front.

Colorized vintage view over a town in a mountain valley, surrounded by high rocky peaks partly capped with snow. In the foreground there is a curving stone path and wall, with trees and vegetation below. The middle ground shows a dense cluster of buildings with red roofs, a church with a tall pointed steeple on the left, and a large fortified-looking complex with towers on the right. The word "Trento" is printed in red at the top left of the image against the sky.

Black-and-white postcard photograph showing a historic church with a square tower, clock, and steep tiled roof, surrounded by trees and a low wall with a gated entrance in the foreground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border.

Black-and-white postcard view of a grand, two‑storey railway station building with a central clock tower and arched windows. The foreground shows tram tracks, a cobblestone square, several pedestrians, bicycles lined up along the facade, and mid‑20th‑century cars. The caption at the bottom left reads "NORRKÖPING. Centralstationen" and there is a small publisher's logo and number in the lower right corner.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a densely forested mountainous landscape. In the distance a rounded mountain rises above dark conifer woods, with a cleared swath or path running up its slope and a small structure or tower at the summit. On the right, a rocky outcrop drops into the forest, and along the far ridge a small village or scattered houses are visible. The image is framed by a light border with handwritten-style German captions along the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with low, tightly packed houses and a prominent church bell tower rising in the center. The settlement lies at the foot of a long, low ridge or hill. At the bottom of the image there is a French caption describing the scene, and a website watermark appears across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the neoclassical façade of a grand town hall building with a central portico and columns, flanked by palm trees. A statue stands on a pedestal at the top of a broad staircase leading up from a paved square. Greek text and a French caption are printed along the bottom edge, and a website watermark appears across the lower right.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a small printed photograph on the left side showing a large baroque fountain in a town square, in front of a Romanesque cathedral with a tall bell tower. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings. The rest of the card is mostly blank, with decorative script text identifying the view.

Vintage postcard view of a square in Trento with mountains in the background. In the foreground there is a park with benches, trees, a lamp post, and a monument (the Monument to Dante). Behind it stand large, elegant buildings with red roofs, including the Imperial Hotel. A horse‑drawn carriage is visible in front of the buildings. Printed captions and handwritten Italian text appear at the top and along the right edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tranquil riverside or coastal inlet with a small rowboat on the water, rocky banks, lush vegetation, and a hill crowned by tall cypress trees and buildings in the background. The card has printed Greek and French captions at the bottom describing the view of Ypsos near the sea in Corfu, as well as a vertical Greek inscription on the left and a circular postal cancellation on the right. There is a large handwritten signature in purple ink across the lower part of the image.

Sepia-toned panoramic photograph of an old Middle Eastern cityscape densely packed with low brick and stone buildings, domes, and several tall minarets. The style suggests an early 20th‑century view. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location, and a faint circular seal and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appear over the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century hotel or grand café with three main stories and a mansard roof. The façade has tall windows with decorative awnings on the ground floor, suggesting a restaurant or café; in front of it are many outdoor tables and chairs arranged under leafless or early‑spring trees, creating a park‑like terrace. A few people are seated at the tables. In the background there are hills with scattered houses. The overall look is that of a European spa‑town or resort hotel.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town with a prominent church tower on the left and a large hilltop castle above the town on the right. Below the hill are several stately houses and buildings surrounded by trees. Printed caption text in German appears at the bottom left, and a small numeric code is at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a dramatic, narrow rocky gorge with very high cliffs rising on both sides and a rough, stony riverbed or path running through the middle. A small human figure stands at the lower right, emphasizing the height of the canyon walls. At the bottom front there is a printed French caption and handwritten notes.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European street with a large, ornate three‑story school building labeled as a 'Realgymnasium' on the left side and smaller townhouses and shops along the cobblestone street. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the road. Printed red text at the top identifies the town and school, and a red handwritten number appears at the upper right.

Colorized street view of an early 20th‑century city with tram tracks running down the center, horse‑drawn carriages, pedestrians in period clothing, and multi‑story buildings with shops on both sides. Palm trees and street lamps line the road, which leads toward the sea in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location as a street in Patras. A website watermark appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy seaside resort bay with rocky shoreline, bathers in the water, small boats, and a pier crowded with people. There are several multi‑storey buildings and hotels along the coast, mountains in the background, and many pedestrians and cars on the coastal road. Captions in Greek and French identify the scene.

Sepia-toned panoramic view across a river toward a town with many gabled houses and trees, labeled in German at the top left. A long riverboat or steamer travels along the river, and tiled rooftops are visible in the foreground. Hills rise in the background behind the settlement.

A monochrome vintage postcard-style view taken from a wooded hillside, with a large tree in the foreground framing a distant hilltop castle complex. The castle with a tower and multiple buildings sits above a forested slope. In the upper right, printed in red Gothic-style letters, is a short German caption identifying the view.

Old black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooden church in a leafy rural setting. The building has a tall, slender spire with a weather vane, Gothic-style pointed windows, and decorative timber detailing. Low stone walls and bushes are visible in the foreground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped urban park with flower beds, paths, and a central fountain. Tree‑lined walkways run along the left side, with ornate residential buildings on the right and larger institutional buildings with gabled roofs and small towers in the background. The scene is captioned along the bottom margin with the location name.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic waterfront view of a historic city, with low-rise buildings, a minaret, and hills in the background. The water and quay are in the foreground. French and Greek captions appear at the top, and postal marks are faintly visible.

A sepia-toned photograph of an ancient stone structure in a mountainous landscape. The scene shows a large curved arrangement of stone blocks forming what looks like a small ancient stadium or theater, with a flat open ground in the middle. On the left is a rocky outcrop and a low stone platform; on the right, a semi-circular ring of squared blocks. Two people in traditional-looking rural clothing walk across the open area toward the camera. In the distance are rolling hills and higher mountains under partly cloudy skies.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panorama of a small town surrounded by fields and wooded areas, with low mountains in the background. In the middle distance stand several substantial buildings including what appears to be a monastery or convent complex with towers rising above the trees. The caption "Klösterle a. Eger." is printed in red at the upper left.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a small steam locomotive pulling a freight train loaded with logs and boxcars along narrow‑gauge tracks through a rural, forested landscape. Tall birch and conifer trees flank the line, with a dirt track beside the rails and a simple track switch in the foreground. Light smoke rises from the locomotive's chimney. There are no prominent buildings, only natural scenery and railway infrastructure.

A black‑and‑white postcard image of a large two‑story wooden Victorian house with a wrap‑around porch and decorative columns. The house stands on a well‑kept lawn with a straight walkway leading from the foreground to the entrance. Mature trees, shrubs, and ornamental grasses surround the property, and fluffy clouds fill the sky. The edges of the card show wear and a vertical crack through the image. On the right border there are handwritten or printed numbers running vertically.

Sepia-toned postcard photograph showing a large, light-colored manor or castle-like building with a tall square tower and steep roofs in a park-like setting. The view is from a dirt road leading up to a stone gate with pillars and metal gates, framed by large trees. In the lower left corner, handwritten white text reads "Forsby Pernå."

Colorized historic postcard showing a busy city square with people walking, horse-drawn carriages, and early street traffic in front of a neoclassical building with a clock tower. The building is the town hall. Greek and French captions are printed at the top left, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an outdoor restaurant garden with many tables and benches under tall trees, bordered by a stone wall along a small river or canal with a railing in the foreground. In the background are wooded hills. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the Schloss-Gasthof Weesenstein in the Müglitz valley, featuring a linden tree garden and dance hall.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural town surrounded by fields and forests. In the foreground are cultivated fields; beyond them lies a cluster of houses and institutional-style buildings among trees. On the right side a tall chimney emits a large plume of dark smoke, and a church tower is visible nearby. Rolling hills and open countryside form the distant background. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Black-and-white postcard showing the circular ruins of the Tholos in the sanctuary of Athena Pronaia at Delphi. The image features a ring of low columns and steps with three standing columns in the center, set against a mountainous landscape and surrounded by scattered stone blocks. Printed captions in Greek and English appear at the bottom, along with a photographer credit.

Color aerial-style view of a lakeside town nestled in a green valley with terraced fields and dense forests, bordered by steep mountains and rocky alpine peaks in the background. The calm blue lake dominates the foreground, with the town stretching along the shoreline and up the lower slopes. A winding road runs along the hillside on the right. The architecture appears European, with compact low-rise buildings and at least one tall church bell tower. No visible caption or printed text is present on the front.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural valley settlement surrounded by forests and low mountains. Scattered houses and farm buildings sit among fields and meadows; wooded hills rise in the background. At the bottom, a handwritten-style caption in German identifies the place and its elevation.

Black‑and‑white image showing a three‑storey early‑20th‑century apartment block around a sandy or gravel courtyard. The building has a steep tiled hip roof with dormers and tall chimneys, plastered facades, recessed balconies, simple geometric ornament, and evenly spaced trees in front. Children and a few adults are visible near the entrances and on balconies. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard view taken from a steel bridge, looking across a wide river toward a historic European city skyline. Prominent church towers and old multi‑story buildings line the far bank. The iron trusses and railing of the bridge frame the picture in the foreground. The words "LATVIJA" appear at the lower left and "RĪGA" at the lower right, with a small emblem beside them.

Sepia-toned landscape photograph showing a coastal hillside covered with dense vegetation, probably vineyards or low shrubs, sloping down toward a body of water on the left. The coastline curves away into the distance, with a few scattered trees and a small building with a light roof visible at the far right. The card shows age-related stains and damage. At the bottom margin there is a handwritten caption in cursive Cyrillic script.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large rectangular castle-like building with a round tower on the left and a clock or bell tower with a spire rising from the roof near the center. The foreground contains a park with paths, trees, and a street where several horse-drawn carriages are visible. Printed text at the top right identifies the subject in Russian and German.

A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting the assassination of a suited man in a simple interior room. The man, identified in the caption as Dr. António Granjo, stands near a bed or couch while a group of armed soldiers or militiamen surround him, aiming rifles and a pistol. One man in the center fires directly at him while others point their weapons from different angles. A tipped‑over chair lies in the foreground. On the right side of the postcard there is a printed vertical caption and explanatory text in Portuguese describing the scene as the death of António Granjo.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone city street lined with four‑ to five‑story masonry buildings featuring late‑19th‑century European architecture. A horse-drawn tram runs on tracks in the foreground, with several pedestrians and carts along the street. Visible signage on the façades is in German, including a building labeled "Hotel Kronprinz". Overhead are utility poles and wires, and shop signs hang from many of the houses.

A monochrome postcard showing the Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests, the round, three‑tiered roofed main hall of the Temple of Heaven complex in Beijing, China. The building stands on a large raised marble terrace with balustrades. Printed captions in English and Chinese appear beneath the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly park with wooden pavilions featuring tall, steep, pointed roofs. Terraced paths and fencing climb the slope, and the scene is framed at the front by a chain‑link fence along a sidewalk. Leafless trees suggest late autumn or winter. Printed captions at the bottom read "Piatra N." on the left and "Parcul Cozla" on the right.

Black-and-white rural view showing a small village with farmhouses and barns in the middle distance, surrounded by fields and gently rolling hills. In the foreground, three people – a man, a boy, and a woman in traditional-looking dress – stand on a ploughed field. At the top left is a caption in red Gothic-style script that appears printed on the card.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a low, long building partly hidden behind large leafy trees and a lawn in the foreground. The edges of the card are scalloped, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards. Along the bottom margin there is printed text indicating the location and title of the view.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small historic town set in a hilly rural landscape. Dominating the left side is a large church with a tall tower and spire, surrounded by traditional European houses with steep roofs. On the right side stands a castle-like complex with towers rising above dense trees. Fields and forests stretch into the distant hills. Centered below the image is the printed caption "Zschopau."

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone town square or main street with several three‑ to four‑story historic buildings. The leftmost building carries the large inscription "Stadt & Haus" and "Sparkasse" at street level, indicating a town hall or municipal building and a savings bank. Farther along the street are gabled houses with shop signs. In the center background a lower building shows the sign "Bier Halle." People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square; handcarts and bicycles are visible, but no motor vehicles. The roofs are steep and tiled, and the overall architectural style is typical of a small Central European—likely German—town.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view showing a large Gothic brick church with tall pointed roofs and tracery windows, dominated by a massive square tower with several clock faces and an ornate multi‑tiered spire topped by an onion‑shaped dome. The church stands among tightly packed old town roofs, with flat countryside and a river or waterway visible in the distance.

A vintage panoramic postcard showing a large open square bordered by elegant neoclassical buildings and tree‑lined gardens. There are tram tracks and horse‑drawn carriages in the foreground, with pedestrians walking around the square. In the background low hills are visible. The captions at the top identify the square in multiple languages and the city as Athens.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a uniformed guard in front of a striped sentry box. The soldier wears a spiked helmet (Pickelhaube), long tunic with decorative braiding, white trousers, and tall boots, and carries a rifle on his back and a sword at his side. He stands in a proud pose before the guardhouse. In the upper right corner there is a smaller inset image of a young woman in traditional folk-style dress reaching out with a flower or small object, as if addressing the guard. A small red number is handwritten near the lower right edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey industrial and residential building complex in a semi‑rural setting, backed by wooded hills. The right wing bears a large sign in German indicating a factory. A dirt road curves in front of the building, with fields and simple fencing in the foreground. Additional buildings and a small towered structure appear in the background. Printed location text is at the upper left, and the photographer's credit appears at the bottom left.

Colorized panoramic view over the city of Graz with a prominent baroque-style clock/bell tower in the foreground on a hill, and a river with several bridges running through a densely built town with red-roofed buildings. Light printed captions in German appear at the top, identifying the city and the tower.

Color illustration of a group of five people in traditional regional dress gathered indoors around a table in front of a large green tiled stove. Three young women wear tall orange cylindrical hats and dirndl-style dresses; an older woman in darker clothing and bonnet sits to the left, and a man in a black suit and hat sits at the table. The scene is bordered by a gray mount with handwritten German text beneath the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooded park or garden with tall coniferous and deciduous trees and a curving gravel path in the foreground. Two small human figures can be seen walking or standing on the path among the trees. At the top, in red Gothic-style script, is the caption 'Veteranenheim Wechselburg.'

A colorized vintage view of an Italian piazza. On the left is an ornate church façade with a domed roof behind it, and adjoining historic buildings with arched doorways and balconies. In the right foreground stands a large baroque fountain with multiple tiers and statues, topped by a figure holding a trident. A few pedestrians walk across the open square. The caption at the top right reads "TRENTO - Casa Rella".

A colorized panoramic view of a European city with a steep, forested hill dominating the left side, topped by buildings and a small chapel-like structure. Below and to the right stretches a dense cityscape of multi‑story buildings with red roofs, intersected by a river with bridges. In the foreground are fields and greenery. At the top center of the image there is printed red text that reads "Graz vom Rainerkogel."

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad urban square with tram tracks in the pavement, lined by bare winter trees. In the center background stands a large, three‑story neoclassical building with arched ground‑floor windows and symmetrical rows of upper windows, likely a civic or railway‑related building. On the left is a row of buildings and a high, glass‑roofed hall resembling a railway station. People in early‑20th‑century European clothing—men in long coats and hats, women in long dresses and hats—walk and stand along the sidewalks and near tall streetlamps.

Illustrated vintage postcard in black and white with red text. On the left stands a bearded man in formal clothing waving his hat and holding a flagstaff topped with a wreath inscribed "Nossen 8. VII. 1906". Behind him is a large historic building complex with steep roofs and a tower, likely a castle or palace, surrounded by trees. A ribbon above bears additional text. At the bottom are two heraldic shields. The right half of the card is mostly blank except for a red German greeting printed in Gothic-style script.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a full-length statue of a man in a 19th‑century suit, standing on a tall stone pedestal inscribed with the name "Richard Hartmann." The monument is set behind a decorative metal fence, with shrubs at its base. A brick building with arched windows forms the backdrop, and trees are visible to the left.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a busy European town square filled with market stalls, carts, and people. Surrounding the square are richly ornamented gabled brick houses and civic buildings in Dutch Renaissance style. Dominating the background is a tall church tower with an ornate multi‑tiered spire, while in the right-middle stands a smaller stepped‑gabled building fronting the square. The perspective is from an upper-floor balcony looking over the square. The overall look suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Some faint handwriting or printed caption appears at the very bottom but is largely illegible.

Colorized vintage view of a busy waterfront quay with many sailing ships and small boats moored alongside a wide promenade. People, carts, and an early tram or trolley run along the pier, with buildings lining the left side and low hills in the distant background. Printed captions in Greek and French appear under the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a European town with late 19th–early 20th century buildings, shops with awnings, pedestrians, and in the background a church with two tall pointed spires. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Grimma in Saxony on Leipzigerstraße.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a small industrial town set among rocky hills. In the middle distance are factory buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, surrounded by dense low-rise housing blocks. In the foreground there is a treed rocky outcrop and below it an open sports field or park bordered by a tree-lined street. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads "Uddevalla. The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a lush garden scene with palm trees, manicured bushes, and pathways with benches and stairs. The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph on the front side, depicting a group of people—mainly women and children—picking roses in a field with mountains in the background. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire, seen across a park. In the foreground there is a decorative pond with several fountains spraying water. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town taken from near a railway line. A sepia-toned winter scene showing a frozen pond with a simple wooden bench or sled-like structure on the ice. An old monochrome postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic civic building complex on a square. The facades have pointed arches, ornate windows, gables, pinnacles, and a steep roof. Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a rural European village surrounded by rectangular crop fields and pastures. Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of three people in early 20th‑century clothing standing and sitting on jagged coastal rock formations. A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rustic European manor or large farmhouse complex along a dirt road. A black-and-white night view of a large terraced mountain or mine behind a body of water with floating ice. A line of lights at the base of the mountain is reflected in the partially frozen water. The caption text appears at the lower left, and a photographer/publisher mark is at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view of an old European town with a large, ivy‑covered mansion or small palace on the right, built in a traditional style with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows. Black‑and‑white interior view of a Gothic‑vaulted church with high ribbed arches, a large arched window behind the altar, wooden pews, a pulpit on the left, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, hymn boards on the walls, and framed portraits. Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large institutional building with steep, tiled, hipped roofs and dormer windows, reminiscent of early 20th‑century Central European architecture. Sepia-toned postcard showing an earthwork fortification with sloping embankments, trenches, and several people walking along a central path. Sepia-toned landscape view of a hillside town with many villas and houses scattered among trees. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling European city square with tram tracks, horse-drawn carriages, street vendors with market stalls, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. Black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a historic stone church with a tall square tower, arched windows and doors, and a small belfry with a dome-like roof and cross on top. Sepia-toned street view of a historic European city with ornate multi‑story buildings, trams running along cobblestone tracks, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walking on the sidewalks. A black‑and‑white postcard view of powerful river rapids crashing over rocks in a rocky gorge, with forested hills and an industrial‑looking building and powerline structures on the horizon. Sepia-toned photograph of a historic multi‑storey building with steep gabled roofs and a prominent clock tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and slender spire. A black‑and‑white (or sepia‑toned) vintage street scene showing a wide, straight avenue lined with multi‑story residential townhouses on both sides. Black-and-white panoramic view of a historic spa town nestled in a forested valley, showing dense 19th‑century buildings along a narrow river and rising up wooded hillsides. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a forested hilly landscape with several villas or large houses nestled among dense trees. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rugged riverside landscape with rapids, rocks, sparse buildings and forested hills in the background.
