In the foreground are several ornate late‑19th‑century villas with steep, tiled roofs and one small tower or spire. A narrow road or path runs between the houses and the river. On the river itself there is a rectangular fenced structure or floating platform, possibly a bathing area or small harbor installation. In the background are additional houses and farm fields, with a forested hill rising beyond. The overall scene is tranquil and rural. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a cobblestone street with a tram passing through an urban scene. Several children and adults stand in the street near a large stone fountain with a statue (Marktbrunnen). Historic multi‑story buildings with shop signs line both sides of the street. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century German townscape.

Sepia-toned photograph of a narrow, cobblestoned medieval street passing under a series of stone arches between old stone buildings. A person stands in the middle distance, while another sits in the left foreground. The architecture is vernacular Mediterranean, with rough stone walls, shuttered windows, and overhanging upper stories. The image looks like an old photographic postcard reproduction. A modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.

An illustrated maritime postcard showing a large ocean liner at sea, viewed from the front-left bow. The ship has a black hull with a red waterline, white superstructure, and a single large funnel painted red with a black top, characteristic of the Cunard Line. Smaller boats are visible in the foreground on choppy water, and the sky is partly cloudy with evening light. Printed text along the bottom margin identifies the vessel as the new Cunard ship Laconia and notes its tonnage.

A colorized postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic hilltop complex overlooking the water. In the foreground a long, white paddle steamer labeled "BASTEI" travels along a wide river. On the opposite bank are small houses with red roofs and a quay, while above them rises a fortified palace-like structure and other large buildings surrounded by trees. The sky is lightly clouded with a gradient from yellow near the horizon to blue above. Printed captions at the top read "Pirna a. d. Elbe." on the left and "Schloss Sonnenstein." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a landscaped garden promenade with flowerbeds and paths leading to an octagonal pavilion-like building with ornate wooden trim. Ivy-covered arcades extend from the building, and a classical statue group on a pedestal stands on the right side. Trees and wooded hills form the background. Printed caption text is at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a Renaissance arcaded courtyard. A long façade with repeated round arches on slender columns forms a loggia; above the arches runs an ornate frieze with stucco scrollwork and sculpted heads between the windows. At the center of the upper façade is a circular sundial. The courtyard ground is open and mostly empty, bordered by short posts linked with chains. At the right, the building turns into a corner wing with similarly decorated upper stories and a large arched passageway.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped outdoor swimming or bathing complex with a large rectangular/irregular pool or pond, low concrete edges, bushes set in the water, and tall trees lining the background. A multi‑storey building stands behind the pool amid the trees. The image has a white border, with printed captions at the bottom indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a multi‑span arched bridge over a river, viewed from the riverbank with a few people walking and some boats or logs near the shore. The bridge has several large steel arches on masonry piers. Text is printed at the bottom identifying the scene and, on the right, the presumed author or photographer.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a semi‑rural town with rows of gabled houses in the foreground, fields and industrial chimneys behind them, and a wooded hillside dotted with villas in the distance. At the bottom edge there is a white caption in German that identifies the view as looking toward Neu-Sörnewitz and Weinböhla.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad European boulevard with tram tracks and horse‑drawn vehicles in the foreground. On the right dominates an ornate multi‑storey Art Nouveau / historicist corner building with towers, sculptural decoration and a central clock‑like feature. The ground floor hosts many shops and cafés with striped awnings and German‑language signs. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the open square; multi‑storey residential and commercial buildings line the street to the left and recede into the distance.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a lively street scene with horse-drawn carriages and people gathered in front of a building labeled "HÔTEL ANCORA." To the left stands a prominent church or clock tower with crenellations at the top. The image is framed by handwritten text in an old cursive script along the right and bottom margins. The word "Cavalese" and a date are printed or written in red at the top right.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a gently sloping street lined with 2–3 story historic houses with steep red roofs and light facades. A fence and large trees border the left side of the street, and a wooden fence and shrubbery appear on the right. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn vehicle are visible in the distance. The sky is softly tinted blue and orange. The caption at the top reads "Wesenberg - Rakwere."

Sepia-toned vintage image of a school playground filled with boys in early 20th‑century clothing playing with sticks while teachers or priests in long dark robes look on. The scene is set beside a large brick school building with arched windows, and there are trees and simple playground structures in the background. The caption "Speelplaats" is printed below the photograph.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobbled street in an old stone town with several people posing for the camera in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background stand the ornate Gothic ruins of a stone palace façade with pointed arches and tracery windows. The caption printed at the top reads "Ruševine Palače Leporini - Hvar".

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall steel railway viaduct spanning a forested valley with rocky slopes. Coniferous trees cover the hillsides and a small wooden hut stands in the foreground on open ground. The scene has an early-20th-century printed look. At the top in red Gothic-style lettering it reads "Bahnviadukt bei Grünhain." There is an additional small handwritten note next to the printed title.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a tree-lined cobblestone street with a fenced property and a prominent classical-style bank building behind the trees. There are pedestrians near an ornate gate in front of the building. Printed captions at the top identify the location in Russian, Latin, and German.

A monochrome (black-and-white) photograph of a narrow European street with tall, attached townhouses. The central building has a steep stepped or triangular gable with several small, irregular window openings suggesting a medieval or Gothic merchant house. Adjacent houses have simpler façades with rectangular windows and arched doorways. A few people stand or walk along the empty street. The rooflines are steep and tiled, and in the distance a larger roof or spire is partially visible. There is no printed caption on the front; only a small handwritten number appears near the top edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop castle overlooking a small town. The multi‑storey castle has steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, corner towers and a central onion‑domed turret with a finial. Below the castle, older stone walls and vegetation cover the slope. In the foreground stand two gabled townhouses with German‑style architecture and painted signs on their facades; horse‑drawn carts are parked in the street. A path with a metal railing and dense bushes leads toward the houses.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large two‑storey building labeled as a Bahnhofshotel (railway hotel) with people in period clothing standing in front. Leafy trees partially obscure the facade. The caption at the bottom, printed in red, reads "Moritzburg. Bahnhofs-Hôtel." Various German signs are visible on the hotel walls.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a dramatic rocky cliff face covered with coniferous trees at the top and dense forest below. In the foreground a person rides in a small open horse-drawn carriage along a dirt road. At the top edge of the card there is printed text identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with multi‑story buildings along the bank, small boats in the foreground, and a long iron bridge crossing the river. On the hill to the left are scattered houses and a small church-like building; in the distance to the right stands a large gothic cathedral complex with twin towers. The word "Meißen." is printed in red at the upper left, and the number "1931." is handwritten in red at the upper right.

Black‑and‑white view of a central European town with a prominent church tower in the foreground, featuring a tall spire and a clock on the square tower. Behind it stands a large Baroque or Renaissance chateau with a hipped roof and a small domed tower, and further up the hill are partial ruins of an older fortress. The scene includes clustered tiled‑roof houses, trees, wooden fences, and a distant hilly landscape. The borders and tonal style suggest an early photographic postcard or plate reproduction.

Black‑and‑white view from an elevated lookout with a curved metal railing and a bust statue in the foreground, looking over a small European town nestled in a wooded valley. In the middle distance stands a large, ornate 19th‑century institutional or civic building, flanked by smaller houses with steep gabled roofs. On a hill above the town is a tall church with a simple steeple and lancet windows. The landscape is hilly and heavily forested, and there is a river or stream running through the valley. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view over a small industrial town nestled in a valley with forested hills in the background. The foreground shows steep, slate-roofed houses, chimneys, and factory smokestacks among trees. A long straight street lined with houses leads towards the center of the town. The scene has a vintage, early-20th-century printed-postcard style. In the sky area at the top left, red text reads "Olbernhau i. Erzgeb."

Black-and-white winter scene showing a traditional wooden house covered in deep snow, surrounded by snow-laden trees. The building has a steep gabled roof and several small rectangular windows. A caption in German cursive script appears along the bottom border.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a ship sailing through a steep, narrow man‑made canal cut between high rock walls. At the top right it is labeled in French as "CANAL DE CORINTHE," and at the top left there is Greek text. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town in a hilly river valley. In the foreground are multi‑story masonry houses and institutional‑looking buildings. A tall church with a baroque or neo‑baroque tower and spire dominates the right side. Near the center stands a very tall, slender chimney or obelisk‑like industrial stack rising above factory buildings along the river. In the background, wooded hills and patchwork agricultural fields stretch across the horizon. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial townscape. No visible printed text or caption appears on the image.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small European town scene with traditional houses, a mill-like industrial building with chimneys, and a narrow watercourse crossed by a simple bridge. A group of adults and children stand on the bridge and along a fence, posing for the photograph. Trees and timber-framed architecture are visible. Red printed captions appear at the top and bottom of the image.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a small northern town with many wooden houses, tree-lined streets, and a foreground park with paths and benches. In the distance are forested hills. Printed white captions appear in Swedish at the bottom: one at left identifying the view and one at right giving the photographer/publisher details.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town with fields in the foreground, a tree‑lined road with a horse‑drawn carriage at right, and in the distance a cluster of buildings including a church with a tall spire and several castle‑like towers. Printed red text in German appears at the top: one phrase on the left indicating the town, and another on the right describing the view.

An illustrated winter battle scene showing three cavalry officers on horseback in the foreground, one holding a white flag, approaching fortifications in the distance. Snow covers the ground and low dunes or scrub surround the riders. A soldier lies prone in the snow at left, while other figures stand or walk in the background. A small red flag flies above the distant fort or earthworks. The image has the muted colors and framing typical of early 20th‑century military postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate pavilion in landscaped gardens, with a circular flower bed in the foreground, curved staircases on both sides, and a colonnaded, vine‑covered terrace above. Two towered kiosks flank the central structure, and mountains rise faintly in the background. The façade bears the inscription "KAISER FRANZ JOSEF-QUELLE".

A black-and-white postcard-style image showing a large wooden manor house behind leafless trees and a simple wooden fence. The house has two stories, a central entrance with a small porch, many windows, and surrounding verandas. A driveway or path leads up to the entrance, and the trees suggest a park-like setting. At the top of the image is printed text reading "Herrgården Vivstavavv" (likely a slight blur of Vivstavarv).

A vintage black-and-white postcard view of Venice's Grand Canal with gondolas in the foreground. On the left are ornate palazzi along the canal, and in the distance is the large domed church of Santa Maria della Salute. The top margin contains printed Italian text identifying the scene.

Colorized early-20th‑century view from the top of a stone balustrade stairway looking into a formal landscaped park. There are manicured lawns, flower beds edged with red blooms, cone-shaped shrubs, statues and urns along the railings, and a central fountain in the distance. Several people in Edwardian-style clothing stroll along the wide gravel paths. A multi‑storey building with a red roof is visible beyond the trees at the far end of the park. A handwritten red number "18144" appears in the upper left corner.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a broad, paved city street lined with multi‑story brick townhouses and shops with awnings. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and a lamppost stands in the foreground. The architecture is late 19th–early 20th century European. At the bottom, cursive text labels the scene as a specific street in Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white riverside view showing a long, grand neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance waterfront complex with many pointed corner towers and dormers, fronted by a stone embankment. In the foreground are moored barges and a small rowing boat on a calm river, with sand or gravel piles, carts and scattered benches on the bank. Multi‑storey residential blocks continue to the left and right of the main complex. The architecture suggests a late‑19th‑century European city. No legible caption or postage markings are visible.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing a wide cobbled avenue lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. On the left stands a large brick hotel with a rooftop sign reading "Hotel Kaiserhof." On the right are timber‑framed and brick houses with shopfronts and awnings. Small trees line the sidewalks and a few pedestrians are scattered along the quiet street. Printed red text at the top names the town and street; a small publisher's credit appears at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a richly decorated neo‑Renaissance corner building labeled "Börse," with arched windows, sculptural reliefs, and crowds of people and horse‑drawn vehicles gathered around the entrance. It is set in a dense European street with multi‑story buildings; shop signs in Latin and Cyrillic letters are visible on the left and right façades.

Monochrome image of a large, three‑storey Baroque or Neoclassical palace with a central pedimented section and clock, tall sash windows, and a balustraded balcony over the main entrance. In front of the building are people in early 20th‑century clothing, a horse‑drawn carriage, bicycles, and landscaped bushes or small trees along a low wall. The style suggests a European manor house or small palace used as an official or noble residence.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large central square bordered by multi-story buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the middle of the square stands a prominent monument surrounded by steps and small statues, with people, carriages, and market stalls scattered around. Behind the square rises a green hill topped by a clock tower and fortification walls. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Hauptplatz mit Schlossberg."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formation of mounted and marching soldiers assembled on an open parade ground. In the background are rows of trees and several simple barracks‑style buildings, likely part of a military post. The caption at the top left reads "Fort Walla Walla, Wash:" and there are manuscript catalog numbers "1638." and "8433." written in ink in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a rural valley framed by forested hills. In the foreground are a few houses with pitched roofs and leafless trees. In the middle stands an industrial-looking complex with long low buildings and a tall smokestack, likely a mill. To the left, partly hidden among the trees on a hill, is a stone tower and remains of a castle ruin. Printed text in red at the top identifies the location as Zöblitz in the Erzgebirge and mentions the castle mill with the Niederlauterstein castle ruins.

Sepia-toned early-20th‑century photograph of a group of finely dressed people (women in long dresses and large hats, men in suits and bowler/top hats) standing around a powerful indoor fountain or geyser. The scene is inside an ornate glass-and-iron pavilion with large arched windows and decorative ironwork. Steam or spray from the fountain fills the air, giving the image a hazy appearance.

A vintage black‑and‑white winter scene showing a steam locomotive approaching on snow‑covered railway tracks that run through a shallow cutting in a hilly, forested landscape. Leafless trees and telegraph poles line the track, and snow blankets the ground. Printed text appears at the top of the image.

A black‑and‑white landscape view over a calm lake bordered by forested hills. In the foreground are trees and a few buildings of a small town or village by the water. The scene is tranquil, with the hills reflected in the lake. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text in Swedish.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside city with grand historic buildings, a curving colonnade and statue in the foreground, a large palace complex on a hill to the left, a wide river with several bridges and boats, and a domed parliament building visible in the far distance along the embankment. A formal park with curved paths and a busy square with trams and horse‑drawn vehicles occupy the lower right.

Vintage sepia portrait of a young woman in three-quarter profile, looking slightly upward. She has short wavy hair and wears a dress or blouse with a large, rounded white collar tied at the neck. The photo is bordered by a lightly scalloped edge typical of old photographic postcards. Beneath the image is printed text with the person's name and a small line of additional text in a lighter font at the lower right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a richly decorated Baroque interior hall with chandeliers, wall paintings, hunting trophies and ornate stucco. There are chairs and tables arranged along the walls and in the center of the room. Text printed vertically on the right identifies the location as Kgl. Jagdschloss Moritzburg, and a smaller printer's line is at the bottom left.

Colorized historic view of a wide tree-lined boulevard with tram tracks and an early electric tram in the center, pedestrians and horse-drawn vehicles, surrounded by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. Two church or tower spires rise in the background on the left and right. At the top right there is printed text in Russian and German indicating the scene is Alexander Boulevard in Riga.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural church complex with low, tiled-roof buildings surrounded by a wall and gate. A larger, two‑storey structure with a hipped roof rises in the center. In the foreground is an open, rough field with a few people and animals. At the top of the postcard are French captions: on the left, 'Environs de Salonique' and on the right, 'L'ÉGLISE DE DUDULAR'. At the bottom right, a modern watermark reads 'www.elia.org.gr'.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a city park. The fountain has a central sculptural group of several robed figures beneath a domed canopy, with numerous water jets arching outward into a circular basin surrounded by statues of children or cherubs. Trees and landscaped greenery fill the background, and a few people in early-20th‑century clothing stand around the basin. The captions printed in the lower margin read "GRAZ." on the left and "BRUNNEN IM STADTPARK." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a hillside Alpine village with scattered houses, a prominent freestanding bell tower in the foreground, and a church with a tall campanile on the right. The settlement is surrounded by rolling hills and distant mountains. Italian text is printed in the lower margin describing the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographic views of the same large, plain three‑story house or manor. The upper image shows the front façade along a road, lined with leafless trees and shrubs and a gate in the foreground. The lower image shows the garden side of the building with trimmed topiary bushes and more bare trees. At the bottom, there is a red printed caption identifying the place.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large hydroelectric power station under construction along a rocky river gorge. Wooden scaffolding surrounds concrete structures by the water, with rugged rock faces and forested hills in the background. Handwritten-style white text is printed on the lower left of the image.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a town with many villas, trees, gardens, and fields in the foreground, and a broad flat plain with a larger city in the distance. The caption "Radebeul" is printed in white in the lower right corner, indicating the town being depicted.

Vintage monochrome postcard bordered in yellowish tone showing a tall stepped pedestal with a statue of an armed figure holding a flag, surrounded by chains and posts. In the background are town buildings including a church with a tall spire. Printed caption in Estonian appears below the image.

Sepia-toned historic view of a European city gate area. In the foreground there is a curved dirt road and a stone wall; behind it stands a large Baroque-style building with many dormer windows and an arched gate passage through its center. Trees flank the scene, and in the background a church tower with an onion-shaped dome is visible. Handwritten text in a decorative script appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Vintage-style postcard with a sepia background showing an old advertisement for a three-wheeled bicycle (tricycle). The illustration depicts a man riding a large-front-wheel tricycle with two children seated together on a double seat above the rear axle. The card is filled with German text promoting the product, headed by the name of a sewing-machine factory in Saalfeld (Saale, Thüringen) and the model name 'Antilope A.' The layout and typography imitate an 1890s advertisement.

A clean white postcard-style first day cover commemorating the Sydney 2000 Summer Olympic Games. At the bottom left is a graphic of the Sydney Opera House with the Olympic rings and the red and black text "Sydney 2000" followed by smaller Estonian text. At the top right there is an Estonian postage stamp featuring an athlete in motion over the Estonian flag colors and the word "Sydney 2000." Two circular first‑day postmarks read "TALLINN 05.09.2000" with the Olympic rings and Sydney 2000 logo.

A colorized panoramic view over a European city with red-roofed buildings and a prominent, forested hill rising from the middle of the urban area. On top of the hill are several structures, likely fortifications or a tower. A river with bridges runs through the city to the right. The sky is lightly clouded. At the top of the postcard is printed text in German: "Graz von der Rainerwarte."

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a large harbor filled with sailing boats and steamships. A curved breakwater and piers project into the water in the foreground, while a dense cityscape stretches along the distant shoreline. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption identifying the scene as a general view of the port of Alexandria. A modern watermark with a website URL appears across the lower right.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town nestled in rolling hills and fields. In the foreground are a few large buildings and scattered houses, while the middle ground shows a compact town with many gabled roofs and a prominent church tower. Forested hills rise in the background, with one hilltop bearing a structure or lookout. Printed text in German appears along the top margin, identifying the location and elevation.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large church under extensive scaffolding, flanked by medieval-style fortification towers and walls. In front of the complex is a square with a Marian/holy column and surrounding buildings. Decorative text in Croatian and German appears on the right and beneath the image, and a printer's mark is at the bottom right.

Colorized winter scene of snow-covered buildings on a hillside. A large striped spherical weather ball hangs in the foreground with the German greeting "Frohes Neujahr!" written across it. Two men in early-20th‑century clothing stand near the small building beneath the ball. At the top-left, printed text identifies the location as the weather ball and fortress at Schlossberg in Graz.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town: in the foreground are rows of 19th‑century townhouses and a few industrial or commercial buildings. Behind them rises a densely wooded hill crowned by a large castle‑like complex with steep gabled roofs, towers with spires, and a church tower on the right. A few words are faintly visible on the side of a foreground building.

A tinted panoramic view of a densely built city in a basin surrounded by low mountains, with a distinct conical hill rising in the center background. The foreground shows rocky terrain and lower houses, while the mid‑ground is filled with closely packed neoclassical-style buildings. The scene has a vintage, hand‑colored look. A website watermark, "www.elia.org.gr", appears in the lower right.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view labeled "Grünhainichen" at the top. The scene shows a gently sloping road lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century residential buildings, fences, and dense greenery. People, including children and adults, walk along the street, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible further down the hill. Telegraphed utility poles run along the road, and in the background the rooftops of a small town and a hilly rural landscape can be seen.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large indoor statue or figure of the mountain spirit Rübezahl, depicted as a cloaked, beaked-nose figure standing among rocks and roots, with a painted tree behind. The word "AUSGANG" (exit) is written on the wall in the background. The lower margin of the card contains a caption identifying the subject and location.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a church or parish hall with rows of wooden chairs facing a simple altar with a cross, flanked by flower vases. A carved pulpit with a spiral staircase stands on the left, a piano on the right, and hymn-number boards hang on the wall. The ceiling is high with hanging chandeliers. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a well-preserved ancient Greek Doric temple standing on a rocky hill. The temple is surrounded by barren ground with no modern buildings close by. At the bottom left are printed captions in Latin and Greek script, and at the bottom right there is a faint website watermark.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of an elderly Eastern Orthodox cleric with a long white beard, wearing a dark cassock and a tall clerical hat (kamilavka/miter). He is seated, facing slightly to the side, with his hands resting on his lap and on a support. Around his neck hangs a large, ornate engolpion/pectoral medallion bearing a small religious image. The background is softly painted with a column and landscape, typical of early 20th‑century studio photography. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an old market district with two‑storey buildings, narrow streets and several mosque minarets rising above the rooftops. Hills are visible in the background. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Kapan market in Salonique (Salonika/Thessaloniki). Publisher and photographer information also appears along the lower margin.

Colorized historic postcard view of an industrial mill complex in a forested valley. Several white masonry buildings with red-tiled roofs stand beside a small road and bridge, with wagons and carts in the yard. Dense conifer-covered hills rise behind the buildings. The caption in red German text appears at the top right.

A black‑and‑white image of a small early 20th‑century steamship or coastal cargo vessel underway on relatively calm water. The ship has a single funnel amidships, two masts with rigging, and a low superstructure. A flag flies at the stern and another from the main mast. The vessel's name, "ERNST", is painted on the bow near the front starboard side. The horizon is low and hazy, with no distinct shoreline or buildings visible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a formation of mounted soldiers on a cobblestone street, likely part of a German field artillery regiment. Several rows of men in dark uniforms sit on horses, with trees and brick buildings lining the street. Two men, one with a dog, stand to the left watching the column. German text printed in red appears at the top of the image.

Black-and-white landscape view across a lake toward a complex of hospital buildings set on a low hillside and surrounded by forest. In the foreground are grassy fields with wooden racks, likely for drying hay. Power poles and small structures dot the mid-ground. Printed caption text appears at the lower left and a small number at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white aerial/raised view over a river bend with numerous barges and a small passenger steamer. A long steel truss bridge with stone piers crosses the river in the foreground. On both banks there are quays, rail tracks, and mid‑European style houses and villas with steep tiled roofs. In the background a high rocky hill with a sheer cliff dominates the scene, with rail lines and a road curving around its base and more town buildings and distant hills beyond. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a large historicist building on a sloping plot, with ornate gables, tall windows, and a slender spire-like turret. The architecture features stepped and curved gables, brick details around the windows, and a steep tiled roof with dormers, typical of late 19th–early 20th century Central European civic or school buildings. The foreground has a fenced garden and small trees; in the background are other town buildings and low hills.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a vast Turkish cemetery with numerous irregular gravestones spread across an open field. A seated man in period attire appears in the foreground among the tombstones. In the distance are low buildings and a tree‑lined horizon. The caption at the top in French reads "SALONIQUE — Le Cimetière Turc," and there is a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom right.

A colorized vintage view of a tree-lined promenade in a city park. Well-dressed men, women, and children in late 19th–early 20th century fashion stroll and sit on benches along the wide path. Dense foliage and formal garden layouts are visible on both sides. At the bottom center there is a caption printed in a serif typeface.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a historic central-European town square dominated by a large Gothic/Renaissance building with a very steep tiled roof and several stepped gables. The façade has arched doorways, a balcony, a small clock on one of the central gables, and signage at ground level. To the left is a row of multi‑storey townhouses with shops at street level, and a cobblestone square with a few pedestrians in front.

Black‑and‑white historical image showing a line of uniformed soldiers standing guard at a wooden checkpoint barrier in front of a large, ornate European building. The soldiers wear early‑20th‑century dress uniforms with tall caps, rifles, and sabers. A small striped sentry box stands at the left. The overall look suggests a formal military guard post in an urban setting. There is a faint vertical notation along the left edge that appears to be a handwritten or printed catalog number.

Illustrated exterior view of a large striped-stone basilica with Romanesque-style arches and a bell tower, surrounded by trees. The image is captioned in Italian at the top and credits the architect at the bottom right, typical of an early 20th‑century Italian postcard.

A panoramic black‑and‑white view of a coastal town built around a curved bay. Whitewashed, flat‑roofed houses line the waterfront, with a small harbor and several boats. Low hills and islands appear in the background across the calm sea. In the foreground are scattered buildings and rocky terrain. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location, and a modern website watermark is visible along the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing an ornate baroque/rococo corner building with richly decorated stucco façade and arcaded ground floor on a cobbled street with tram tracks. Many people in late 19th–early 20th century clothing walk and gather under the arches. Several shop signs are visible on the façade, and a caption at the bottom reads "Graz. Luegg."

Black-and-white panoramic view taken from a hillside park or promenade, looking over a tree‑lined path toward a historic European town. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large fortified complex with multiple wings, towers, and steep roofs resembling a Renaissance or Baroque castle. Below the castle are dense rows of traditional gabled houses and at least one prominent church with a tall spire. The foreground shows open grass, young trees, wooden railings, and a small pavilion.

Black-and-white seascape showing a rocky islet rising from the ocean with a lighthouse and small associated buildings on top. In the distant background are rugged island mountains. At the bottom left, printed caption text identifies the place as the lighthouse of São Vicente in Cabo Verde.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river with small rapids in the foreground, stone embankments and trees along the banks, and a town with church towers visible in the distant background. Printed text at the top indicates the location.

A black‑and‑white view over a very crowded open‑air market in a European city square. Numerous stalls and umbrellas fill the foreground, with many people in early‑20th‑century clothing. Behind the market stand several multi‑storey stone and brick buildings, and in the background are tall church spires and a large historic town‑hall‑like building. A tramway or road with pedestrians and carriages runs between the market and the buildings.

A vintage, monochrome postcard depicting a rural street scene with leafless trees, a small chapel with a decorated entrance, and an adjacent inn or guesthouse. People stand near a horse-drawn or handcart vehicle in front of the buildings. The style suggests an early 20th-century Central European village near Graz. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Color aerial view of a medium‑sized town at the foot of a large green mountain. The urban area is dense with low- to mid-rise apartment blocks and red-tiled roofs, surrounded by factories and fields in the foreground and scattered houses and farmland extending into the valley. The mountain behind has steep slopes and a relatively flat ridgeline. The sky is blue with a few clouds. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.

Collage-style postcard with three photographs of narrow historic streets and traditional houses. The lower left image shows a cobblestone lane lined with low pastel-colored buildings with balconies and small shops. The upper right and lower right images depict old urban houses with overhanging upper floors, wooden shutters, and a mix of stone and plaster construction, typical of Balkan/Ottoman-era architecture. The word "Bijoux" appears in script at the bottom of the left image.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a prominent ornate town‑hall–like building featuring a clock tower, spires, and a tall weather vane. The ground floor has arched windows and an awning-covered entrance, and there are several attached buildings along the street in similar historicist style. In the foreground stand children, a horse and cart, and a few pedestrians, evoking a late‑19th or early‑20th‑century scene.

Vintage sepia postcard showing an elderly bearded man in traditional Middle Eastern attire, with a large patterned turban and robe, holding a walking stick. The image has printed captions and handwritten script on the front. The layout and typography are typical of early‑20th‑century photographic postcards.

Black-and-white waterfront scene showing several wooden fishing boats moored side by side in a small harbor. Behind them are wooden houses on a rocky shoreline, typical of a Nordic coastal village. In the lower left corner the word "Mollösund" is printed, and at bottom right there is a credit line to a photographer in Göteborg along with a small number "3".

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing the interior of a historical forge or smithy with a large mechanical/wooden hammer installation. The surroundings include rough brick walls, wooden planks, industrial debris and hanging lamp wiring. In the lower left and right corners, Swedish captions identify the hammer and location.

Black‑and‑white image of two large detached villas on a grassy hillside, enclosed by wooden picket fences. The houses have a distinct Central European alpine or spa‑town style with steep hipped roofs, timber framing on the upper floors, shutters on the windows, and small balconies or glazed verandas. A dense coniferous forest rises behind the houses, while the foreground shows an open slope of grass. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with domes and twin bell towers, set along a tree-lined street. A few pedestrians are visible in the foreground. Greek captioning appears at the bottom along with French text and a small serial number.

A color postcard showing a Baroque-style palace with a dark blue mansard roof, multiple chimneys and dormer windows, and a central portico with tall columns. The building is two stories high, painted in warm yellow and cream tones. In front of the palace is a formal garden with curved flowerbeds full of colorful flowers and neatly maintained lawns and paths. A few people are walking and standing on the terrace and in the garden. Hills covered with trees rise in the background under a clear blue sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Colorized historic postcard view of a castle courtyard with light-colored plaster walls, red-tiled roofs, decorative stepped gables, and towers. Ivy covers parts of the façade, and there is a landscaped lawn and path in the foreground. The scene is labeled in German with red printed text in the sky area.

A hand‑colored vintage postcard depicting the entrance road and gate to a hilltop castle complex. The scene shows a stone path leading uphill along a wooden fence toward an arched gateway in a fortification wall. Above and behind the gate stand medieval buildings with steep slate roofs and a tall square tower with a pointed spire. Trees surround the walls. The image has soft pastel sky colors typical of early colorized postcards. German text is printed in red beneath the image.

A monochrome postcard view of a vaulted Gothic arcade with stone columns and pointed arches forming a covered walkway alongside a building. Light enters from the open side of the colonnade toward a town square or street. Printed red text at the lower right identifies the location and publisher.

Colorized historic postcard view of a grand spa building with arched windows and a blue roof, set within formal gardens featuring paths, flowerbeds, and a circular fountain in the foreground. Behind the building and park rises a large, distinctively shaped mountain. Printed German text at the top identifies the place.

Illustrated historic view of a large urban square with a fountain, horse-drawn trams and early motor vehicles. Prominent in the foreground is a corner building with the name "ANTON OBLACK" on the facade, showing many pedestrians and shoppers. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey buildings and tree‑lined streets. In the lower right corner there is an inset interior view of a sales hall filled with neatly stacked goods. The caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as Bismarckplatz in Graz and advertises the Anton Oblack outfitting store.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a river flowing through a forested valley with steep rocky cliffs on the right and dense coniferous trees on both sides. On the left is a small road with a railing and a building near the riverbank. The bottom margin contains a caption in German that identifies the scene.

A black-and-white panoramic postcard view over a coastal town with wooden houses in the foreground, an industrial waterfront with piers and ships, and forested hills in the background. Printed text at the top left identifies the place and the viewpoint in Swedish.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town beneath a steep, rocky, forested cliff. A row of multi‑storey houses and hotels lines the riverbank, with boats or a steamer moored at a quay in the foreground. The massive rock face rises directly behind the buildings, topped by trees and a small structure on the summit. Hills covered in forest extend into the background. Printed captions in German at the top read "Schäferwand." over the cliff and "Bodenbach a. d. Elbe." on the right, indicating the location by the Elbe River.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a wide rural landscape with fields and scattered farmhouses on rolling hills. In the distance there is a village with a prominent church featuring a tall steeple and adjoining buildings. The image has an old photographic style and printed caption text at the top left that reads "Moldau i. Böhmen".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large half‑timbered villa or guesthouse standing alone by a forest edge, with a fenced meadow in the foreground and a small outbuilding to the left. Printed red caption text appears below the image, with publisher information along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned historic postcard depicting a straight urban street lined with multi-story stone townhouses and shops. A horse-drawn cart and a few pedestrians are visible along a tree-lined sidewalk. The buildings have ornate facades and mansard roofs. Printed text at the top identifies the location as Pirna in Saxon Switzerland and the street as Kaiser Wilhelmstrasse.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small waterway bordered by trees, a wooden hut on stilts with a picket fence, and a church or towered building rising in the background. The scene is tranquil and framed by foliage, with German text printed at the top and along the right edge.

Illustrated interior view of a large, crowded beer hall with vaulted, ornately painted ceilings and a huge circular chandelier. People in 19th‑century Central European clothing sit at long wooden tables drinking beer, while waitresses in traditional dresses serve them. In the background, wall paintings depict a cityscape. The image has a painterly style and a small caption printed along the lower edge.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate parliamentary chamber with wooden desks and high‑backed chairs arranged in rows. The room features rich wall paneling, large paintings or reliefs, tall columns, and grand crystal chandeliers hanging from a coffered ceiling. Along the right margin there is handwritten cursive text. Printed caption text in Finnish appears below the image, along with a small printer's mark and number.

A colorized historic view of a fortified medieval town with stone towers, church spires, and red‑roofed houses. In the foreground is a sloping path with small buildings and trees; in the middle stands a large church and several round and square towers connected by old city walls. Printed text at the top identifies the place as Bautzen in Saxony and highlights the Michaelis Church and the old waterworks tower.

Black-and-white postcard showing a statue on a high pedestal in a leafy square, seen from behind. In the background stands a classical building with shuttered windows and a pediment bearing the inscription 'SCHAUSPIELHAUS'. At the bottom border of the image, printed captions read 'GRAZ. FREIHEITSPLATZ' on the left and 'ERIKA-VERLAG - GRAZ.' on the right.

Hand‑colored postcard showing a busy street corner with a large three‑story building labeled as the concert and ball establishment "Deutsche Reichskrone". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand near the entrance; a tramcar marked with the number 7 travels along tracks on the left. Trees line the opposite side of the street. Printed captions identify the scene as part of Dresden, specifically Königslücker Straße and Bischofsweg. The style and printing suggest an early 1900s European urban scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style view over a historic European town built on and below a wooded hillside. On the left stands a large medieval hilltop castle with a prominent round tower and battlements, partly hidden by trees. Below and to the right stretches a dense cluster of steep‑roofed houses and narrow streets. Dominating the right side of the image is a large Gothic church with a tall spire and pointed-arch windows. The skyline includes additional church towers and old civic buildings. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the front.

Sepia-toned historic photograph showing two children and an adult street vendor in traditional East Asian (likely Korean) clothing. The central child stands beside a large A‑frame carrying rack piled high with vegetables or greens, with shallow trays of small goods (possibly food or wares) suspended in front. Another child at left carries a similar tray. In the background are low traditional tile-roofed buildings and another adult wearing a broad conical or mushroom-shaped hat. The scene appears to be an old street-market setting. Small numbers are printed in the lower corners of the image.

The image shows the address side of an old Spanish postcard labeled "TARJETA POSTAL" from the "UNION UNIVERSAL DE CORREOS". It has a red Spanish postage stamp on the upper right corner with a circular postmark. The card is addressed in cursive handwriting to "Sr Dn Benito Perez Galdós" at "Villa Sª nª Luminin" in "Santander". The bottom text notes that only the address should be written on this side.

Black-and-white postcard image showing a rural road lined with trees leading toward a hilltop baroque church complex with twin towers and a dome. The church stands amid rolling countryside with scattered houses. A bench is placed beside a large tree in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

The image shows the written/address side of an old postcard. Along the top are multilingual words for "postcard" in French, Hungarian, Italian, Czech/Slovak, German and Dutch. Below is handwritten text in cursive Russian, addressed to a recipient. There is a red Imperial Russian postage stamp in the upper right corner with a double‑headed eagle coat of arms and two postal cancellation marks in Cyrillic, one dated with the year 1913 (19 13/III). The card is aged and slightly worn at the edges.

An old black‑and‑white rural scene showing a large, elongated manor‑style house with a pitched roof and several dormer windows centered in the background. The building has a symmetrical façade and a fenced lawn in front. On both sides of the manor there are barn‑like outbuildings. Leafless trees with bare branches dominate the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter, and a rough, rocky, and somewhat muddy ground lies closest to the viewer. No visible captions or writing appear on the image side.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a rural church complex behind a low stone wall. A large tree dominates the center foreground, partially obscuring the main church building with a steep gabled roof and whitewashed walls. To the right stands a small white arched gatehouse or chapel-like structure forming an entrance in the wall. Handwritten text in Swedish appears along the bottom margin, and printed text is faintly visible at the lower left.

Colorized postcard view of a large early‑20th‑century military barracks building with a long facade, red tiled roof, dormer windows, and a central pavilion. In the foreground are fenced gardens or fields. The sky is softly tinted blue and yellow. German text identifying the location and military unit is printed along the top edge.

A colorized historical postcard showing a large baroque fountain topped with a statue of Neptune in a town square, surrounded by old multi‑story buildings with arched porticoes and shuttered windows. A domed building rises in the background, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk near the fountain. The caption at the top right reads "Trento - Fontana e Casa Rella."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy European city square with a large historic building featuring a central dome, clock, and ornate façade. The square is crowded with people, market stalls with umbrellas, and an old tram on tracks running through the street. Tall spires and older buildings line the left side of the street. Caption text at the bottom left reads "GRAZ. HAUPTPLATZ" and at the bottom right "ERIKA-VERLAG – GRAZ, 1001".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting an ornate Renaissance-style building with large arched windows, statues in niches, and a balustraded roof. In front of the building is a fenced fountain featuring a prominent statue, with people and trees around a cobblestone square. The lower margin contains printed captions in German identifying the location and the publisher.

A vintage black-and-white postcard view of the Los Angeles River in flood after heavy rains. The river is wide and fast-flowing, contained by rough embankments with scattered people standing on the banks watching the water. On the left side, a group of people gathers near a wooden structure or bridge. Utility poles line the river, and a low bridge is visible in the distance. Printed caption text appears in red at the top, with additional handwritten ink notes on the upper right.

A sepia-toned postcard view of a small town in a mountain valley. A straight road runs through the center, lined with trees, walls, and a few pedestrians. On both sides are early-20th‑century houses with tiled roofs and balconies. In the mid‑distance stands a church with a tall bell tower, and behind the town rise wooded hills and higher mountains. The lower border of the card bears a caption identifying the place.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural spring scene with blooming orchard trees. A man sits on a simple wooden sled or plow pulled by a single horse in front of a fenced property with a red‑tiled roof house. The sky is pale blue and the trees are covered with white and pink blossoms. Printed German text appears at the top and bottom of the image.

A black‑and‑white aerial view of a historic spa town nestled in a narrow river valley between wooded hills. Dense rows of multi‑story 19th‑ and early 20th‑century buildings curve along the valley floor, typical of a European spa resort. At the bottom of the image there is printed text in German that labels the view.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad square or open park area in front of a tree‑lined boulevard. Several people ride bicycles and walk across the open space, with tram tracks and a tram visible in the middle distance. Behind the trees stands a large classical building with a greenish roof, likely a concert hall. A decorative iron fence runs along the foreground. The caption along the bottom margin reads in red Dutch text.

A black-and-white photograph of an industrial harbor showing a cargo ship named 'FORTUNA' moored alongside a quay. The vessel, marked with the number '676' on its bow, sits in calm water. Behind it stand several large lattice cranes and long, low warehouse buildings with gabled roofs, and a skeletal steel frame of another structure. The scene has a mid‑20th‑century industrial feel, with no visible tourists or decorative elements, just working dock facilities and workers on the ship.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a two‑storey inn or guesthouse with arched windows and a hipped roof, labeled as an old German 'Gasthof'. In front of the building stand several people near the entrance, with outdoor benches and tables along the facade. To the right, a horse-drawn carriage is visible on the road. Trees line the street and there is open grassland in the foreground. The top of the card has German text indicating the name and location of the inn and the proprietor.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a formal group portrait of uniformed soldiers in a brass band. They wear dark tunics with shoulder boards, medals, and peaked or fur hats with cockades, and hold brass instruments such as cornets and tubas. The photo appears late‑19th‑century/early‑20th‑century. Beneath the image is a handwritten caption in Cyrillic, in Bulgarian, describing the musicians' corps, their regiment, years of service and decoration for bravery in the Serbo‑Bulgarian War.

A colorized historic postcard view of a domed mosque with a single tall minaret in a hilly urban area. Printed captions at the top read in French about Constantinople and the Kahrieh Mosque, and there is a web address watermark at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned interior view of an ornate rococo-style hall with elaborate stucco ceiling decoration, tall arched windows along the walls, large mirrors, and a tall tiled stove on the left. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies the place.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural village scene with several houses, farm buildings, fenced gardens, a winding path in the foreground, and a church with a tall onion-domed tower in the background to the right. The lower margin contains printed German text in red and smaller publisher information in black, including a date.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a flooded city street lined with tall trees on the left and multi‑storey buildings and shops on the right. Many people in 1920s clothing stand on raised wooden walkways above the floodwater, looking toward the camera. Shop signs are visible on the buildings, and printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white image of a small fishing harbor with wooden piers, several boats moored along the docks and one prominently marked "LL748" in the foreground. Fishing nets hang to dry on racks at the right. In the background are low rocky hills and a cluster of wooden houses and boathouses with gabled roofs, typical of a Nordic coastal fishing village.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an early–mid 20th‑century cargo ship at sea. The vessel is viewed from the side, showing its hull, deck structures, masts, cargo booms and funnel. Large painted letters on the hull read "GUDRUN MÆRSK". On the stern area, additional text includes the ship's name and a home port. A flag flies at the stern that appears to be the Danish flag (a Nordic cross). The overall style resembles a historical shipping postcard depicting a commercial vessel.

Black-and-white view of a large church with a tall clock tower and spire, surrounded by trees and a fence, with a spacious parsonage or manor house visible to the left. The foreground shows a road or open area, and printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom margin.

A colored vintage postcard view of a large open square bordered by buildings and green areas, with a circular monument or statue in the foreground-left and people walking around the plaza. Snow-capped mountains and rocky hills rise in the background. The caption at the top left reads "Trento. Piazza Dante." indicating the scene is Piazza Dante in Trento, Italy.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a calm river or canal lined with stone embankments and dense trees. In the foreground is a fenced riverside path with a few people walking or standing. On the water are several small wooden boats and a tiny decorative house‑like structure on stilts, with a pair of swans swimming nearby. The scene feels like an early‑20th‑century European park or riverside promenade.

Color-tinted vintage roadside scene showing a curved road in a semi‑rural area, with grass verges and several traffic signs. A red van and a light-colored car drive along the road. In the distance are low buildings and a red-brick tower flying national flags. The foreground sign shows a white arrow pointing down to the right. Other road signs include speed limit signs and a directional sign indicating destinations in Sweden.

Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a large two‑story wooden house with a steep tiled roof in the foreground, surrounded by trees and a fence. In the background on a hill stands a white church with a tall steeple, with forested hills and a lake or river beyond. There is some faint printed captioning along the bottom edge, but it is too blurred to read.

A black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined promenade or square with people walking in early 20th‑century clothing. At the right stands a large statue of a man in a dynamic pose on a tall pedestal inscribed with the word "PETOFI." Behind the statue is a grand multi‑storey historicist building with ornate windows and roofline. The foreground shows a cobbled street with chain posts separating the roadway from the promenade.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city along a river, with a metal truss bridge in the foreground, rows of historic multi‑storey buildings on the riverbank, and a steep hill behind them crowned by a fortress complex. A tall church tower with an onion dome and clock stands prominently to the right, and another clock tower is visible on the hillside. Printed caption text appears at the upper left, and commercial signage is visible on riverside buildings.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a Baroque urban square. In the foreground there is a low stone wall with iron railings and flower beds. Behind it stand ornate historic buildings with stucco decorations and shuttered windows. To the right is a richly decorated church façade with statues and a curved gable, and in the distance a slender church tower with an onion dome rises above the rooftops. The bottom margin contains handwritten German text identifying the location and a small photographer's signature.

Colorized landscape view of a small settlement on the edge of a forest. In the foreground, a narrow path winds through dense evergreen trees toward several houses with steep red or dark roofs and traditional half-timbered and plaster facades. The background shows a wooded ridge under a gradient sky from orange to blue. At the top center there is a printed caption in German.

Black-and-white panoramic aerial view of a historic European spa town, showing dense late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings, tree‑lined streets, and open fields and hills in the distance. In the lower right corner there is printed white text in German identifying the place and the vantage point.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a flooded landscape with palm trees and two people riding camels across shallow water. In the background are three pyramids, clearly resembling the Pyramids of Giza. There are postal cancellation marks on the image and handwritten cursive text in French along the bottom margin.

A monochrome vintage image of a low, sprawling bungalow-style house with a broad porch supported by heavy rustic columns set on a stone base. The house is surrounded by lush landscaping, including ornamental grasses, potted palms, and climbing vines along the porch. A neatly manicured lawn stretches across the foreground. In the upper right corner a red printed number "6711." appears, suggesting a catalog or series number.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a quiet street scene with low two‑storey buildings on both sides, unpaved road, several people walking in the distance and bare trees. Printed captions at the top right identify the town and street in two languages.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small village nestled in a wooded valley with rolling hills in the background. Traditional houses with pitched roofs and timber framing are surrounded by trees and gardens. On a hill to the left stands a round stone tower with crenellations. At the bottom margin there is printed white text identifying the place.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large, ornate stone school building complex along a tree‑lined street. The architecture features steep roofs, gables, arched windows and doors, and a prominent clock tower on the right. At the top of the image the words 'FREIBURG.' and 'Realgymnasium.' are printed.

Black‑and‑white postcard with two photographic views. The main image shows a railway station and level crossing beside multiple tracks, with telegraph poles, gas-style lamps, and several people near a barrier gate. Across the road is a tree‑lined square with a large, simple masonry building that looks like a public or municipal building. A sign near the crossing reads "EINGANG". The inset image at the lower left shows a two‑storey rectangular building with the words "STADT DÜDEN?" (partly obscured) on its facade, with horses and carriages in front. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town scene focused on the station area and adjacent civic building.

A black‑and‑white coastal view of a Scandinavian seaside village with wooden houses scattered on rocky terrain by the water. A narrow road winds out along a low peninsula lined with compact wooden homes. The landscape is rugged with bare rocks and low vegetation, and more buildings are visible on distant shores across the bay. In the lower left corner the word "HÄLSÖ." is printed, and in the lower right corner there is a triangular publisher's logo above the number 5330, consistent with vintage picture postcards.

Black‑and‑white split‑view postcard showing two buildings in Glaubitz near Riesa. The right image shows a church with a steep tiled roof, tower, and clock, partially obscured by trees, labeled "Kirche". At the bottom, in script, is the caption "Glaubitz bei Riesa".

Vintage monochrome military postcard showing a team of German (Saxon) soldiers in field uniforms riding a horse‑drawn machine‑gun wagon across open countryside. Several horses pull two large, spoked-wheel carriages with seated soldiers and equipment. Printed German text appears along the bottom, with additional cursive handwriting over the lower margin.

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a corner of Oschatzer Straße in Döbeln. An old sepia-toned postcard showing a two‑storey wooden railway station building with a metal roof and several chimneys. The front facade faces the railway tracks in the foreground. A group of people, including children, stand on the platform in front of the station. Trees and a lake or river are visible in the background. Printed at the top is the caption identifying the station, and a station nameboard is mounted on the building.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, straight, tree‑lined avenue with pedestrians walking along a dirt or early paved road. The margins of the image include captions in Greek and French/Latin letters identifying the place as Calamata and the specific street as Rue Faron. A modern website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears over the lower right of the image.

Black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate multi‑tiered monument in a town square. On the top stands a cloaked male figure looking downward. Around the lower tier sit several other robed figures in contemplative poses. The monument has rich decorative stonework and rests on a broad, stepped base of light stone. In the background are low, traditional European houses with tiled roofs and chimneys, and overhead utility wires.

Black‑and‑white view of a late‑19th‑century spa‑town street with grand historicist buildings, likely hotels or sanatoria, on a gentle hillside.
