A woman in a long dress and hat carries a parasol while walking along the path, and an early horse‑drawn or motor carriage is on the unpaved road. The largest corner building has a mansard roof and bears the name "RUDOLFSHOF" near the top facade. Behind the buildings rise wooded hills.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs. The top view shows a tree‑lined spa promenade with modernist buildings, benches, and people walking, captioned in German. The center view is a panoramic landscape of a wooded valley town with a church tower and river, with the town name written in stylized script. The bottom view shows a spa square with colonnades, fountains or springs, people strolling and sitting, again captioned in German. The overall style is classic central‑European spa‑town imagery.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wide parade or drill ground at a military fort. In the foreground and center, large formations of mounted soldiers on horseback are assembled and maneuvering. Behind them are rows of trees and several simple wooden or brick buildings typical of a late‑19th‑century U.S. Army post. Printed red text at the top left reads "Fort Walla Walla, Wash." Handwritten dark ink notations across the upper center and right include a date and some catalog-like numbers.

A winter scene showing a grand historic building with towers and steep roofs covered in snow, viewed through snow-laden trees. People in dark winter clothing stand and walk in the snowy foreground behind a low fence. At the bottom of the image, red text identifies the scene in Hungarian and German.

Sepia-toned historic postcard view framed by an archway, showing a cobblestone street, stone wall, gas streetlamp and a row of old buildings leading toward a prominent tower with a pointed roof. The caption in German at the bottom identifies the scene as a view toward the royal Albrechtsburg in Meissen. Publisher information appears along the lower edge.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a historic European town with dense old buildings, a prominent round defensive tower by a river, a church with a tall spire, and several other towers rising above the rooftops. A bridge crosses the river in the foreground, and the overall style is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Red printed text at the top names the place and main landmarks.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a small photograph on the left showing a lake with rowboats and people on the water, surrounded by trees. There is ample blank space on the right for writing. Printed captions in Portuguese identify the location as the lake at Campo Grande near Lisbon, Portugal, and the publisher information appears along the left border.

An old sepia-toned postcard with an ornate decorative frame around a central photograph of a calm waterfront with boats, houses and wooded hills in the background. At the top is a heraldic shield with three green fir trees. The word "Gustafsberg" appears near the top left in red script. Below the image there is stamped purple text indicating that the item belongs to a museum, along with a date in 1903.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a tree‑lined dirt road beside a fenced industrial complex of brick buildings with ornate gables and a small tower. The caption at the top reads "Radeburg. Gaswerk", indicating a municipal gasworks. On the main front building, another inscription with a year is visible above the central window. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century German industrial facility.

Monochrome printed postcard showing a round stone tower with a conical roof, standing on a small rise in a park‑like landscape. Bare trees with twisted branches dominate the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter. A path curves around the hill and a few small human figures walk along it. The scene has a slightly dramatic, artistic rendering rather than a straightforward photograph. There is a small handwritten archival code along the lower edge outside the image area.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small European village street with simple plastered houses and a prominent church tower topped by a cross. A few people walk along the gently curving road. The scene is rural with fields in the foreground and low hills in the background. At the top center the caption reads "Grünhainichen i. Sa." in a serif font.

Sepia-toned photographic portrait of a young woman with long wavy hair adorned with flowers, gazing slightly upward in a devotional pose with hands clasped. At the top right is printed text identifying her as Magdalena Seebe in the role of "Undine." The lower left has the studio imprint "HAHN NACHF. Dresden. 671." The front is heavily inscribed in dark ink with a handwritten German message and signature, dated 1.4.16.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet canal lined with traditional gabled houses and tall trees on both banks. Pedestrians walk along the quayside and iron railings edge the canal. The perspective leads the eye along the gently curving waterway into the distance. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the view as a quay in Bruges.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront panorama showing an old European city skyline with several tall church spires and historic buildings along the riverbank, viewed from across the water. At the bottom left the word "Riga" is printed, and at the bottom right there is a small publisher mark. Ships and smaller boats are moored along the quay.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large hospital complex in a historicist style with multiple connected buildings, gabled roofs, dormer windows and small towers. A garden and fenced yard stand in front, with a street and a few pedestrians in the foreground. At far right is an older chapel or church-like structure attached to the complex. The printed caption at the top in red reads "Freiberg i. S.  St. Johannis-Hospital."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene with several steam-powered riverboats moored along a quay. Smoke rises from the funnels, and people are visible on deck. Industrial buildings, a small riverside settlement, and a rail line or loading equipment stand at the base of a steep rocky hillside. On the hilltop, there is a small chapel or church with a steeple and cross, surrounded by fields and trees. The water in the foreground reflects the boats and smoke.

Color postcard showing a dramatic alpine lake whose shoreline water appears bright red, with forested slopes and rocky mountain peaks in the background. A lone person stands on the grassy shore looking at the lake. On the right side, there is a white margin with printed Italian text and a small scientific-style illustration of a green cell-like sphere filled with red dots, representing the organism causing the lake's reddening.

Colorized view of a large central square with market stalls, umbrellas and a prominent statue on a stepped pedestal in the middle. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and shop signs in German at street level. In the background, a steep, tree-covered hill rises above the town, crowned by a fortified structure and a distinctive clock tower. The printed words "Graz" and "Hauptplatz" appear at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large late‑19th‑century institutional building with three stories, a mansardlike roof, and a small onion-shaped dome at the center above a clock. The façade is symmetrical with many tall rectangular windows, rusticated stone on the ground floor, and smoother plastered upper stories. In front runs an unpaved road with a simple wooden railing; logs lie beside a drainage ditch in the foreground. Leafless trees and wooden fencing partly obscure the right side of the building. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image.

A black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate, Neo‑Renaissance style building with two corner towers, a central flag, and long arcaded wings opening onto a formal garden. Manicured conical shrubs, flower beds, and paths lead toward the building, with benches and several people visible in the foreground. On the right side stands a signpost with text, suggesting a spa or resort facility. The whole composition has the formal, front‑on style typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an urban street scene with a tramcar in the foreground, numbered 5, running along a wide avenue lined with multi‑storey neoclassical and eclectic buildings. A domed building appears in the mid‑distance on the left, and a large ornate facade on the right edge. At the top in red French text it reads "Souvenir de Salonique (Grèce)". The overall design and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard from a European city.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a taxidermied sea otter posed on a rock pedestal against a plain studio background. Along the right side, printed vertically, is descriptive text in Danish identifying the animal (Enhydris lutris), its habitat, rarity and origin, and noting a gift to a zoological museum in Copenhagen.

Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped park with curving paths and benches in the foreground. Behind the trees stand several ornate late‑19th‑century buildings; on the hillside above are terraced vineyards and large villa‑ or hotel‑like structures. On the slope, a painted sign on a building reads "WEINGRUBER CAFE PARK SCHONBRUNN." The scene suggests a spa or resort town surrounded by wooded hills.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural village scene with two women in traditional dress, one in the foreground and one leading a small animal. In the background there are damaged or ruined buildings and rubble, suggesting war destruction. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin in French and another language.

A vintage postcard-style image showing a long, pale-colored classical building with many windows and an arched entrance in the center. The foreground is shaded by large tree branches and leaves, with a cobblestone courtyard in front of the building. The style suggests an old town or historic castle complex. At the bottom of the card, printed text reads "TALLINN." on the left and "Loss." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a group of people in traditional North African clothing gathered outdoors in front of tents. A central figure stands in the foreground while others sit or stand around, some with drums, suggesting a performer or street entertainer scene. The image has a printed caption at the bottom and a publisher credit along the left edge.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a lakeside town built on a hilly peninsula, with dense traditional houses, narrow streets, and surrounding hills. The water of a lake borders the town on the right. Along the bottom edge there is multilingual printed text identifying the view as a general view of Kastoria, and a small publisher credit. The card has a white border with a slightly scalloped edge.

Black‑and‑white seaside view showing rocky shoreline with a few small rowboats pulled up on the rocks. Behind the beach stand several large institutional buildings with pitched roofs and a tall chimney, likely a sanatorium complex. In the foreground, printed caption text identifies the location, and in the bottom right there is a small oval logo and publisher information typical of early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcards.

Monochrome illustrated postcard showing a coastal fortress or tower on a rocky hill with trees, flying a flag bearing a cross in a small shield. At the bottom are two heraldic panels: one with an ornate coat of arms with a cross and drapery, the other with two towers and wavy lines symbolizing water. Beneath them, on a scroll, is the inscription "RIVA REDENTA 3 NOV. MCMXVIII." The border is decorative, and there is a small artist's signature with the date '18 in the upper right.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large hilltop castle complex above a river. The foreground features a calm river with a sandy bank and a few people near the water. Behind the river stand several townhouses and smaller buildings along the embankment. Rising above them is a massive Gothic‑Revival castle or palace with steep, patterned roofs, multiple towers, turrets, and a tall church-like spire. One part of the main building appears to be under restoration or construction, encased in a prominent scaffolding structure. Dense trees cover much of the slope up to the castle.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm river with forested hills in the background. In the foreground, several people stand on a rocky riverbank beside long wooden boats or canoes. Overhanging tree branches frame the image. In the lower right corner, there is printed caption text in multiple languages and a small number "83" appears in the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a large cargo or tanker ship named "SUROIT" moored in a harbor or industrial port. The ship dominates the left and center of the image, with cranes and port infrastructure visible in the hazy background on the right. Calm water in the foreground reflects the hull and masts. On the lower left margin is a vertical credit line indicating the photographer and city.

Black‑and‑white view of a narrow, cobblestoned street lined with old plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and stepped or crow‑stepped gables. Ornate wall‑mounted streetlamps project from the building on the right. The street curves away between the historic townhouses; a small animal, likely a cat, crosses the roadway. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the front.

Black‑and‑white view of a railway station building taken from track level. The station is a two‑storey structure with a dark mansard roof, dormer windows, and a smaller side wing. A platform canopy with columns runs along the facade, and railway tracks occupy the foreground. Trees and a few houses are visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the lower left edge.

An old monochrome postcard view of a stone railway bridge with multiple arches spanning a river. A train track runs along the top of the bridge. In the background there is a small town with several houses and larger villa-like buildings, set against hilly, vine‑covered slopes and forested hills. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image area and along the lower margin.

A vintage postcard-style image showing a riverside or lakeside scene with tall palm trees in the foreground and more palms and low buildings or vegetation across the water. The image area has a printed caption in French that reads "Village de Memphis". There is also handwritten cursive text along the right margin. The overall style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a baroque-style church on a street corner. The church has a façade with niches containing statues, a central arched doorway, and a bell tower with a clock and onion-shaped dome topped by a cross. Tram or trolley wires run across the sky above the street. At the bottom margin of the image, white printed text identifies the location as the 'Graz – Welische Kirche'.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a distant view of a large hilltop castle with a central tower and multiple wings, surrounded by forested hills. To the right stands a separate church or chapel tower with a spire. In the foreground, out-of-focus tables and a railing suggest a terrace viewpoint framed by tree branches. Red printed German text appears in the sky area at the upper right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural waterfront village with wooden houses, small boats and a pier in the foreground, and a prominent stone church with a tall steeple on a hill in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads "Saltviks kyrka. Åland." indicating the church of Saltvik in the Åland Islands.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European spa town in a narrow valley with tree‑covered hills in the background. Multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades line a riverside promenade; signs on the houses advertise banks, hotels, and restaurants. People walk along the street and by the river. The architecture is Central European with mansard roofs and decorative gables.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal in front of a Gothic brick church complex with steep roofs and a tall spire. The church stands directly on the waterfront, with a low fence along the canal and several small figures walking near the entrance. To the left are smaller houses and an industrial-looking chimney. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as a church in Bruges, and red publisher information appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard photograph of a rural mill complex beside a calm pond with ducks, surrounded by dense forested hills. The buildings have traditional sloped tiled roofs and white plastered walls, enclosed by fences and trees. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner of the image.

Colorized scenic view over a small European town in a river valley, surrounded by green fields and rolling hills. In the center stands a prominent church with a tall spire and adjacent cemetery, encircled by houses with red and gray roofs. The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard. The caption "Leisnig i. Sa." appears in red at the top left.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, ornate late‑19th‑century building with multiple floors, arched windows on the ground level and shuttered windows above. The façade has elaborate classical detailing and corner towers with steep roofs. The street in front appears quiet with only a few pedestrians. Printed text at the top reads "GRAZ. Fürstbischöf. Knabenseminar."

Black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional restaurant or café. Tables are covered with white cloths, set with simple glassware and condiments. The walls are densely decorated with framed pictures, carved wooden objects, saws and farm tools arranged in patterns, clocks, jugs, plates and other rustic ornaments. A doorway in the center reveals a second room with more tables and wall decorations. The overall feel is of an early‑20th‑century Central European inn. Faint handwritten text appears at the top edge but is not fully legible.

A vintage winter street scene showing a broad, snow-covered avenue lined with multi‑storey stone buildings on the left and trees on the right. People in long coats and hats walk along the street, and horse‑drawn vehicles appear in the distance. The image has a tinted, hand‑colored look. Text printed in red identifies the street and city, and there is a museum attribution printed at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph taken from a biplane, showing a fortified peninsula jutting into the sea with massive walls and bastions, likely an old fortress. Behind it lies a dense historic town with long waterfront buildings and a straight seafront promenade. Hills and additional coastline appear in the background. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed near the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town with wooden houses and open fields. In the foreground there is a fenced garden and a large villa‑style house; behind it stands a tall flagpole with a flag. More houses and low buildings spread out in the background with forested hills on the horizon. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image in Swedish.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large group of men, women, and children in early 20th‑century dress standing in a long line outdoors. In the foreground, numerous shallow rectangular drying trays filled with small round objects (likely seeds or fruit) are laid out in a grid on the ground. Several children and youths stand closer to the camera. In the background are wooden houses, sheds, and trees, and a larger industrial-looking building with a sign on its upper facade. The overall scene appears to depict workers or a community at an agricultural or processing facility.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a quiet, cobblestoned town with two‑storey plaster houses with steep tiled roofs. On the right corner stands a shop with a sign reading "Colonialwaaren, Destillation." and large initials "F.M.N." A few adults and children stand near the buildings. Tele­phone or telegraph poles line the street, and there is handwritten numbering on the image border, indicating it was used as a photographic postcard or archival image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooded area with a decorative wooden pavilion or shelter on the left and a tall Marian roadside shrine on the right. The shrine features a niche with an image or statue of the Virgin Mary and Child, set on an ornate pedestal surrounded by potted plants and flowers. A path or clearing runs between the structures, and large trees fill the background. The caption in red letters at the bottom reads "Karlsbad. Marienbild beim Aberg."

A vintage monochrome postcard view over a small town set in a valley with surrounding hills and forests. In the foreground is an open grassy field with rows of young trees or shrubs. Behind it are several houses and villas, some with steep roofs and decorative façades, and further back a wooded hillside and distant ridges. A river or pond is visible to the left. The title "Bad Sachsa a. Harz." is printed in red at the top left, and small red vertical print with a number and publisher appears along the right edge.

A black‑and‑white portrait of a bald man wearing round glasses, a suit, and a tie. The lower part of the image contains his handwritten signature and date across the photo. Beneath the photograph, on a white margin, his printed name "Aleksandrs Čaks" appears, along with a small publisher's logo in the bottom right corner.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural mill or farmstead settlement surrounded by fields, trees, and a densely forested hillside. Several traditional Central European buildings with gabled roofs and half-timbered construction are grouped together in the middle ground. At the top right, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the caption identifying the location.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neoclassical colonnade along a canal or river. Crowds of people stroll under the long arcade and along the waterfront promenade, while early 20th‑century cars and buses line the adjacent street. Behind the colonnade rise tree‑covered slopes and several multi‑storey spa or hotel buildings. The text at the bottom left reads "Karlsbad. Mühlbrunnkolonnade".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad city street lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings and shop awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing cross the street and walk along the sidewalks. At the top center the caption reads "10. - ALEXANDRIA. - Rosette street". On the left corner building a sign reads "LLOYD" above another sign, and at the bottom right there is a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city street lined with late‑19th‑century buildings. In the foreground to the left stands a fenced Gothic‑revival stone monument or column with statues in niches and a crenellated top, set in a small landscaped island. Leafless trees frame the scene, and the street extends into the distance with a few pedestrians and early 20th‑century automobiles. On the roofline of a central building in the background there is a large painted advertisement sign.

Black‑and‑white view of a small alpine village in a wide valley, with scattered houses and chalets along a rural road in the foreground. Steep, forested mountains rise immediately behind the settlement, and in the distance a massive, almost vertical rock plateau typical of the Dolomites dominates the skyline. Coniferous trees fill most of the slopes, and open meadows surround the buildings. There is no visible printed caption or text on the front.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone market square surrounded by two‑ and three‑story townhouses and a church with a tall tower. A few people stand or walk in the open square. The title in red at the top reads "Mutzschen, Marktplatz." Additional small shop and restaurant signs are faintly visible on the facades.

A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographic panels. The upper two show streets with wooden houses and verandas, while the lower larger view shows a substantial multi‑storey wooden building with many windows next to a church with a tall spire and other smaller buildings, with open fields in the foreground. Around and between the images there is cursive handwriting and small labels indicating places. The layout and handwriting suggest an early 20th‑century correspondence postcard.

A vintage multi-view postcard with four colored illustrations of landmarks in and around the Dutch city of Nijmegen. The upper left view shows a park landscape with lawns, trees, a round brick tower and distant church-like buildings, labeled as Kronenburgerpark. The upper right view depicts a green park or estate with tall trees, a villa and a smaller white chapel-like building, labeled Koepel Wester Meerwijk. The lower left image shows a broad town square framed by multi‑story historic buildings and pedestrians, labeled Groote Markt. The lower right image portrays an ornate Renaissance-style brick weighing house with a steep roof and exterior staircase opening onto a busy square, labeled de Waag. Each view is captioned with the word 'Nijmegen.' in red script at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town in a river valley with a large medieval hilltop castle dominating the scene. Steep-roofed houses cluster below the castle walls and towers. In the distance a river and industrial smoke are visible. Red printed captions at the top read the town name on the left and the castle name on the right.

Black‑and‑white view along a straight tree‑lined road in a semi‑rural area. On the left stands a large villa with steep tiled roof, dormers, and decorative timber details, enclosed by a fence. Telegraph or power poles run down the center of the road. On the right is a grassy verge and orchards or vineyards supported by wooden stakes. In the distance, on top of a terraced hillside covered with vines, there is a prominent hilltop pilgrimage complex or monastery with multiple towers and a central dome, dominating the skyline.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a corner view of a large late‑19th/early‑20th‑century residential building used as a pension (guesthouse). The structure has ornate façades, bay windows, and a gabled corner, with bare trees and a fenced garden in the foreground. Printed caption text appears along the bottom white border.

A monochrome postcard image showing an ornate domed mosque complex with richly decorated exterior walls and a prominent, patterned main dome. A smaller dome and additional structures stand nearby, along with a slender minaret in the background. Low buildings and palm trees are visible on the horizon. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as Alexandria and the Nebi Daniel Mosque, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a harbor scene with several sailing boats and small craft in the foreground and a coastal city in the background. Buildings line the waterfront, and farther out a fort-like structure sits on a small promontory. Printed captions in Spanish at the bottom identify the view as from La Coruña and note the publisher's address. There is a handwritten note reading "Souvenir" with a signature and a date, plus part of a green Spanish postage stamp in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the entrance gate and guardhouse of an institutional complex surrounded by tall pine trees. Two men in light uniforms stand in front of a small tiled-roof gate building with an arched doorway. Behind the gate, a long multi-storey building with rows of windows and small domed roof structures is visible along a tree-lined driveway. The caption at the top reads "Coswig i. S. - Wettinstift". Additional small text appears on a vertical margin to the left and on plaques near the entrance.

A colorized historic postcard depicting a large neoclassical municipal building with colonnades and many windows, fronted by palm trees and a public square with people walking. Printed text at the bottom identifies it as the town hall (Hôtel de Ville) of Syra. There is a handwritten signature at the top and a watermark with a website address at the bottom.

A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a large baroque fountain with a statue of Neptune holding a trident on top, surrounded by multiple sculpted figures and basins with flowing water. The fountain stands in the middle of a cobblestoned square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and pigeons are visible in the foreground near some leaves. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location as Trento and specifies the square and fountain.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a calm lakeshore or riverbank with a person standing in the left foreground looking across the water. On the opposite bank there is a small settlement and a prominent church with a steeple on a low hill, surrounded by trees and fields. Handwritten text appears along the lower border, and a printed caption at the bottom left reads "Vargø Fredenmarken" (or similar).

Black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined street or promenade beside a row of multi‑storey residential buildings with steep, gabled roofs and small balconies. The buildings have an early 20th‑century Central European look. On the left, a person pushes a pram along a path bordered by tall leafless trees and low fences, with open fields or parkland and a distant house in the background. The scene feels quiet and suburban. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a packed open-air amphitheater with curved stone seating surrounding a central circular stage. The backdrop is a long neoclassical colonnaded façade with doors and decorations, and many people wearing early-20th‑century style hats fill the stands. Printed caption text appears below the image, and red handwritten numbers are on the bottom left and right margins.

A sepia-toned panoramic view over a dense historic cityscape with many low houses and several tall minarets rising above the roofs. At the top center is printed a brief caption identifying the scene. At the lower right there is a faint website watermark added later for archival purposes.

A monochrome postcard-style illustration of a Baroque church with an octagonal central plan and a tall, tiered tower topped by a dome and lantern. The church is surrounded by trees, a low fence, and a few adjacent buildings. At the bottom of the image, printed captions in German identify the location and the church.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a mid‑size railway station with a long, low main building in a neoclassical/19th‑century style. The station has a covered platform with lamps and a few people standing near the doors. Several railway tracks run in front of the building, with a boxcar visible in the right foreground partly obscured by leafy bushes or trees.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square with a prominent monument at its center. The monument consists of a tall pedestal with a standing figure on top and seated figures at the corners, surrounded by steps. Historic multi‑storey buildings encircle the square; signs on the façades advertise banks, cafés, and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the open plaza. The caption "GRAZ – HAUPTPLATZ" appears at the bottom left, and the publisher credit "ERIKA-VERLAG-GRAZ. 522" is printed at the bottom right. Other building signs include "STEIERM. AGRAR BANK" and "CAFÉ NORDSTER".

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a central monument surrounded by a low balustrade, steps, and ornate streetlamps. Around the square stand several four‑ to five‑story historicist buildings with shops and hotels on the ground floor. A statue of a standing figure is on a tall pedestal in the middle. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled square; horse‑drawn vehicles are visible. On the façade of the right‑hand hotel a large sign reads "DRESDNER HOF" and "HOTEL ZUM DRESDNER HOF," while shop signs in German are visible on the left. In the background, on a hill, are detached houses overlooking the town.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European hillside town. In the foreground there are trees and a fenced meadow; behind them stands a compact town with steep‑roofed buildings and at least one church with a tall spire. A larger, ornate building that looks like a school, town hall, or small palace stands centrally. Scattered houses climb the hillside, which is divided into fields and patches of forest. On the hilltop to the right is a round tower or keep, possibly a small castle or lookout, surrounded by trees. The image has wide margins typical of an old photographic or postcard print. No visible text appears on the front.

A black‑and‑white view of a broad, cobblestoned, tree‑lined street in an old European city. On the left are several ornate multi‑story townhouses with rich stucco decoration; on the right a wide sidewalk shaded by tall trees runs alongside a substantial public building on the corner. A small monument or pedestal stands at the corner in front of the building, and several people in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing—women in long dresses and hats, men in suits—are standing or walking along the street. The overall feel is of a calm, upper‑middle‑class residential or institutional quarter. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a view over a town in a valley, framed by two tall cypress trees and the ruined wall of a stone castle in the foreground. Mountains rise in the distance. The image is mounted on a decorative card border with handwritten Italian text beneath the photo.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an old street scene with historic buildings. The central structure has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, small irregular windows with decorative frames, and an ornate entrance with a religious niche or relief above the doorway. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the entrance. On the left is a tall ornamental column or fountain in a cobbled square. Printed captions in red at the top and bottom identify the location and the publisher.

Vintage multi-view postcard with three monochrome photographic scenes of forested Idaho. The top-left image shows a log cabin in dense woods with a line of horses and riders in front. The bottom-left image shows a tall waterfall in a rocky gorge labeled "ELK CREEK FALLS," with a person standing near the base for scale. The large right-hand image shows a thick stand of tall pine trees labeled "WHITE PINE, IDAHO." Below the main image is printed the caption "Scene in the Pines, East of Moscow, Idaho." There is cursive handwriting in ink across the lower center and right portions of the card.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of an ornate spa building with a mansard roof, towers, and arcaded wings, set in formal gardens with trimmed bushes, paths, benches, and a central lawn. The architecture is richly decorated with arches, columns, and sculptural reliefs. At the bottom left of the image a caption is printed naming the place as the Kurhaus in Bad Elster.

Colorized panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by patchwork agricultural fields and gentle hills. The town has dense clusters of houses with red and gray roofs, a prominent church with a tall spire on the left, and some factory chimneys visible in the distance. The caption "Neustadt i. Sa." appears in red script at the top left.

A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a studio photograph of a woman in a shiny, loose-fitting costume posed in a modern dance position on the floor. She is barefoot, with one leg extended forward and the other bent, one hand resting on the extended leg and the other supporting her body. The background is plain. Centered below the photo is the name 'MARY WIGMAN'. Small printed credits appear in the lower left and right margins.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with a tall church dominating the scene. The church has a high tower with a clock and an onion-shaped spire topped by a cross. Surrounding it are multi‑story townhouses and shops lining a relatively empty street where an early automobile and a few pedestrians are visible. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, ornate stone observation tower rising above surrounding trees. The tower has small windows along its shaft and a decorative upper section with round windows and battlement-like elements. At the base is an arched entrance reached by a short staircase, with detailed masonry and an inscribed plaque above the doorway. Printed title text appears in the upper left corner.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard depicting a broad tree‑lined avenue in a park. The path runs straight into the distance, bordered by evenly spaced trees on both sides, with a few benches along the way. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the central path. At the top of the image is printed text reading "Tampere. Puisto."

Colorized vintage view of an Italian-looking town square dominated by a tall rectangular stone clock tower with arched belfry openings at the top. Around the tower are multi‑story pastel buildings with shutters and arcades. In the foreground, several horse-drawn carts loaded with goods are parked in the open plaza, with low mountains visible in the distant background. The image is framed with a white border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No legible caption or writing appears on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the dramatic rock formations of Meteora with a monastery perched atop one of the cliffs. At the bottom border, printed captions identify the view, and there is cursive handwriting across the lower margin.

Color postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a densely built European city with red-tiled roofs. The tower has a steep shingled roof and prominent wooden gallery around the upper part, with two large clock faces showing Roman numerals. A path and greenery surround the tower, and several small figures stand at the overlook. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Uhrturm."

A colorized postcard view of a steam train traveling along a single-track railway through a tree‑lined rural landscape. On a hill in the background stands a white historic building with a red roof and a round tower, identified as a castle. The scene is bordered by a light frame, and a handwritten-style caption appears at the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing harbor construction works. There is a crane lifting a large block on the left, railway tracks running through the middle, steam machinery, workers scattered across the dock, and smoke rising from equipment or a ship. At the top center is printed the caption 'Loanda. Obras do porto.'

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large group of people, mainly women in traditional folk costumes, standing in a long curved line performing a communal dance outdoors before a crowd of onlookers. Below the photograph there is printed text in French and Greek identifying the scene as a traditional dance in Megara, Greece. There is also a round seal-like emblem and a web address printed near the bottom.

A black‑and‑white aerial or elevated panoramic photograph of a dense historic town with rows of stepped‑gabled houses in the foreground and many church spires and traditional brick buildings stretching into the distance. The lower margin contains printed captions in French and English identifying the view as Bruges and describing it as a bird's‑eye view of the town, along with a small number "177" on the left and a printer's mark on the right.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Scandinavian townscape. In the background stands a large church or cathedral with a tall square tower topped by an ornate dome and spire. In front of it are several older buildings with steep tiled roofs and many windows, set among trees and behind a wooden fence along a dirt road that curves in the foreground. The scene has a serene small‑town atmosphere. Printed text appears at the lower left and lower right edges of the image.

A colorized image of a formal garden dominated by a long rectangular reflecting pool or ornamental pond, bordered by trimmed hedges and conical shrubs. At the far end is a broad staircase and terrace with a balustrade and three arched openings, with manicured plantings and large trees in the background under a blue sky.

A colorized vintage view of a landscaped seaside park. A winding concrete path curves through manicured lawns with flowerbeds and shrubbery, bordered by rocks and low stone formations. Mature trees stand near the shoreline, and beyond them is a calm body of water stretching to the horizon, with a low coastline faintly visible in the distance. The style and coloring suggest an early to mid‑20th‑century printed postcard.

A colorized panoramic view over a town nestled in a hilly landscape. In the foreground is a flowering meadow with a path and a tall tree on the right. Beyond are many houses and villas with red and gray roofs, scattered up the hillside, with forest and fields on the ridge in the background. At the top left, printed in red, is the caption 'Jena — Am Landgrafen'.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard with two main illustration panels. The left panel shows the ornate façade of a multi‑story hotel-restaurant building in a late 19th / early 20th century style, with bay windows, balconies, and decorative stucco. The right panel depicts the interior dining hall with chandeliers, detailed ceiling ornamentation, a bar stocked with bottles and glassware, and rows of neatly set tables and chairs. Between the panels is an Art Nouveau floral motif in brown and red. Around the printed images, the card is filled with handwritten cursive text in German. The bottom right has the printed title of the establishment in red.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small rural railway station with wooden buildings and a gabled roof. Railway tracks run in the foreground, with open space around the station. The text in the upper right corner reads "Jönåkers Järnvägsstation," and a small station sign is visible on the main building.

A colorized early-20th-century scene of a railway station platform with electric trains and wooden carriages. Tall lamps line the platform on the left, while tracks and trains extend into the distance on the right. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower portion of the card. Printed text in red at the bottom left reads "Stockholm" and at the bottom right "Östra station". There is a small imprint credit at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white image showing a long line of young women standing closely together, apparently dancing or processing on an elevated ridge or platform. They wear traditional folk costumes with pleated white skirts, embroidered aprons and blouses, dark sleeveless vests, and headscarves or floral headbands. Above them stretches a diagonal string of small hanging light bulbs, suggesting an outdoor festival or celebration at dusk. No visible text or caption appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a circular fountain with a nude female statue standing on a central pedestal, water flowing from her hands and around the base. The fountain is set in a manicured garden with low hedges, benches, and large leafy trees in the background. Two people sit on a bench to the left, dressed in mid‑20th‑century clothing. Behind the trees there is a rocky, slightly elevated hillside. The image has the look and proportions of a vintage picture postcard.

Colorized postcard view of a historic European town with a large multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a river in the foreground. The bridge carries a road lined with buildings and towers, and behind it rises the old town with red‑tiled roofs, several defensive towers, and prominent church spires. The landscape is lush with trees along the riverbanks. At the top of the postcard, red printed text reads "Bautzen. Kronprinzenbrücke."

Sepia-toned panoramic view over fields toward a small town with clustered houses, a prominent church steeple on the right, and larger institutional buildings on the left. Trees and bushes frame the foreground. In the upper left corner, German text reads "Blick auf Wilsdruff."

A black‑and‑white vintage view of an open city square with trees, paths, and fenced areas in the foreground. Multi‑storey brick and stone buildings frame the square on the left and right, and in the distance a large church or tower rises above the rooftops. The perspective looks across a tram or car road toward the park-like square. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's mark is visible in the lower right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges showing a rural dirt road leading through fields toward a church with a tall steeple partly hidden by trees. A small farmhouse stands in the distance on the left. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "Rūjienas baznīca."

A black‑and‑white postcard image showing a wide landscape with numerous conical teepees arranged in a large encampment, likely an Indigenous North American camp. Horses graze and stand tethered throughout the open field, and people can be seen walking and gathering among the tents. Trees form a dense line behind the camp, with low hills and a cloudy sky in the distance. The photograph has an aged, slightly scratched appearance. Faint, inverted handwriting or numbering appears along the top edge.

Sepia-toned historic image showing a single-storey wooden pavilion or villa with a tiled roof, decorative gables, and shuttered windows, set in a landscaped park. A pond in the foreground reflects the entire building and surrounding trees. Several men, women, and children in early-20th‑century clothing stand or walk along the edge of the pond. Tall palm trees and other lush vegetation surround the structure, giving a subtropical or tropical feel. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Close-up of a yellow and black postage stamp affixed to a postcard. The stamp shows a shield with a stylized castle or city gate in the center, surrounded by a lattice pattern and decorative side panels with leaves and crescents. At the top is the inscription "EESTI POST" and on the right edge a small box with the year "1938". At the bottom is the word "CARITAS" above the denomination "50" appearing in two opposing corners, with a small cross emblem centered below.

Black-and-white postcard showing the ornate Baroque facade of a church with tall columns, niches containing statues of saints, and elaborate sculptural decoration above the main doorway. A solitary person in dark clothing stands in front of the entrance. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "ALT GRAZ. Die Ursulinenkirche".

Tinted early 20th‑century postcard showing a woman in traditional dress standing in a paved courtyard between tall plastered apartment buildings. She is hanging or beating a long, colorful striped rug on a wooden rack. There is handwritten ink text across the lower margin and printed captions at the bottom of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grassy, marshy field with a raised, tree‑covered earthwork or wall on the right side. Trees and low vegetation fill the scene, and a building is faintly visible in the far left background. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location as the castle wall in Kuressaare in three languages.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modest harbor or quay. In the foreground is a grassy and rocky shoreline leading to calm water with stones scattered near the shore. Across the water stands a low pier with wooden warehouses or sheds, small boats and masts visible. Forested land extends along the background horizon. The caption "Lovisa; Tullbron." is printed in small red letters in the upper left corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an old European town square with arcaded buildings and several people walking in the open plaza. The printed caption at the top right identifies the view as Piazza del Duomo and Via S. Maria. At the bottom there is a handwritten Italian message dated 14 settembre 1901, along with the photographer's imprint. The architecture is typical of a historic Northern Italian city, with multi‑story stucco buildings, shuttered windows, and porticoes.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an old tavern or inn dining room densely decorated with hunting trophies and rustic ornaments. Antlers, animal heads, horns and various tools hang from the ceiling and walls. A large ornate tiled stove with jugs and plates stands to the left, while wooden benches and carved chairs surround heavy wooden tables set with bottles, glasses, and small decorative pieces. Framed pictures line the patterned wallpaper, and lace trim decorates a wall panel. The overall style is that of a Central European hunting lodge or beer hall.

A black-and-white postcard view of a broad river or canal lined with large trees on both sides. On the left bank stands a small wooden house or boathouse near the water's edge, and in the distance a low bridge crosses the water. A stone embankment runs along the right side. The sky is lightly clouded, and in the top-left corner the location name 'Uddevalla.' is printed.

The image shows the written/mailed side of an old postcard. There is a green 5‑Heller Austro‑Hungarian stamp with the portrait of Emperor Franz Joseph I in the upper‑right corner and a circular cancellation mark. The card is filled with cursive handwriting in Italian, including an address on the right side and a message on the left. Some lines are crossed out in pencil. A vertical printed line in the center reads "THEODOR EISMAN LEIPZIG." The address includes the city name "Fiume" and the word "Ungheria" (Hungary).

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a grand three‑storey villa with ornate gables and a balcony. The building is labeled on its façade as "König Friedrich August" and is surrounded by trees, a garden with tables and chairs, a wrought‑iron fence, and a streetlamp in front. Printed text at the top right reads "Kurheim 'König Friedrich-August' Bad Elster." The image has the look of an early‑20th‑century spa or guesthouse in a wooded resort town.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large, austere masonry building in rationalist style with simple rectangular windows, arched loggias, and a central entrance with steps and a sculpted emblem above. The border is scalloped like old photo paper, and a handwritten-style caption appears along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a dense European town on a riverbank. In the foreground a stone bridge crosses the river. Behind the riverside houses rise larger late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings, including a prominent school complex labeled 'Realgymnasium'. The town extends toward low hills and industrial chimneys on the horizon. The caption at the top right reads 'Meißen r.'

Vintage illustrated postcard divided into small scenes. One shows the Great Sphinx and pyramids with people and camels in the desert. Another shows a palm grove with water in the foreground and figures or animals by the shore. A third view shows pyramids near a river with people and animals in the water. Decorative French captions appear above two scenes. In the blank area to the right there is a handwritten dedication reading "To Maggie with love."

Color postcard showing a medieval hilltop castle surrounded by dense green forest, set against steep, dramatic, rocky mountains. The fortress has thick stone walls, a prominent square tower with a steep pyramidal roof and small windows, and ivy-covered outer walls. No visible printed title or text appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white panoramic cityscape of a European spa town nestled in a narrow valley with forested hills in the background. The foreground shows richly ornamented late‑19th‑century apartment and hotel buildings, with mansard roofs and elaborate facades. In the mid‑ground stands a small towered structure and dense rows of multi‑storey townhouses stepping up the hillside. At the top of the hill a small lookout pavilion or chapel sits on a rocky outcrop. The overall look suggests a historic resort city built along a river, photographed from an elevated vantage point.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large early‑20th‑century institutional building, likely a school or municipal facility, with steep hipped roofs and dormer windows. The structure is three to four stories tall with a symmetrical façade, arched entrances, and a low stone base. It is flanked by smaller auxiliary buildings of similar style. In the foreground are fenced fields, trees, and a rural landscape; in the background are rows of multi‑story residential houses and a gently rolling hillside. The overall composition looks like the edge of a European town transitioning into the countryside. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall stone tower-like monument in a landscaped park. The massive structure has a wide arched entrance at its base, small windows, and a stepped, crenellated top. Young trees and paths lead toward the monument, with open land and trees visible in the background. At the top of the postcard, printed in red Gothic-style script, is the location and the name of the monument in German.

A vintage multi-view postcard bordered in black, showing numerous small monochrome photographs or drawings of buildings, squares, churches, monuments and fountains around a central blank scroll with the word "Stuttgart" printed in ornate red script. Each vignette has a German caption such as public squares, churches, museums, castles, and monuments in and around Stuttgart.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large lakeside guesthouse and restaurant with steep gabled roofs, set against a forested hillside. In front of the building is a long terrace crowded with people sitting at tables beneath umbrellas. A pleasure boat full of passengers moves along the reservoir in the foreground. Several early- to mid‑20th‑century automobiles are parked near the building. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image identifying the location.

A colorful Christmas-themed illustration showing several cartoon Santas working in a wooden log cabin. One Santa sits at a desk using a computer, highlighted with a yellow glow. Another Santa stands on a ladder hammering or fixing something near the roof, while a third Santa outside the cabin is joyfully blowing into a musical instrument, producing musical notes. Piles of letters or packages lie around the cabin. On the upper right corner there is a blue and red triangular logo resembling a stylized postal or corporate emblem. The style is humorous and modern, and there is an artist's signature with the year '87 in the lower right.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small spa town nestled in a wooded valley. Numerous villas and guesthouses are surrounded by trees, with rolling hills and forests in the background. A prominent church with a tall spire stands on the right side. At the bottom right of the image, the caption 'Bad Elster' is printed.

Colorized panoramic view of a European city set in a valley with surrounding hills and mountains. In the foreground is a calm body of water with several small rowboats carrying people. Along the shore stands an ornate lakeside building with towers and a red roof, with tree-lined paths and other villas behind it. The middle and background show dense urban buildings, churches, and greenery rising up towards a hill with a fortification on top. Printed red text at the top reads in German.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large, fortress‑like barracks building with crenellated walls and several pointed towers on a street corner. To the left stands a massive round medieval tower with a conical roof. People walk along wide, mostly empty streets. The sky is softly tinted blue with scattered clouds, in a typical early 20th‑century postcard style. German text is printed at the top identifying the scene in Bautzen.

An old green Italian postal card with printed postage showing a portrait of an Italian monarch in an ornate frame at the upper left and the coat of arms of the Kingdom of Italy (Savoy shield with crown and crossed flags) in the center. The card bears black ink handwriting addressed to a person in Spain and a circular cancellation mark reading "FIRENZE" with a date. Italian printed text appears at the top and bottom of the card, and the denomination "CENTESIMI DIECI" is indicated.

Black-and-white image showing a quiet cobblestoned street lined with 2–3 story masonry buildings, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The street is mostly empty except for a distant pedestrian and a lamppost in the foreground. In the background, on a small rise, there is a prominent tower with a steep spire and a relatively large, almost square belfry-like structure, suggesting a church or bell tower dominating a small historic town.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large tree trunk in the foreground with a historic, castle‑like garden building with two round corner towers in the background. The scene shows a landscaped lawn and paths, likely part of a botanical garden. The bottom border contains printed captions in German, including the place and photographer.

Faded black‑and‑white postcard showing a Gothic-style stone building with pointed arches and sculpted frieze above the entrance. In front of the arched doorway stand several people in what appear to be historical or folk costumes; one plays a violin, others pose near a barrel and trees in tubs. The ground is cobblestoned, suggesting an old European town setting.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rustic two‑storey rural house with timber posts and a thatched or rough roof, partially open and in some disrepair. A few people stand or sit under the overhang on the ground floor. The surrounding area appears rural. At the bottom is a caption in French identifying the scene and a small serial number.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a European city square with a circular fountain and small pool in the foreground, lined with leafless trees and bordered by grand late‑19th‑century buildings. On the left stands an ornate domed building, while on the right a tall Baroque church tower with an onion‑shaped spire rises above attached structures. The street running through the square contains early motor vehicles and pedestrians. Shopfronts with awnings face the square. No visible caption text is present on the front.

A black-and-white postcard view of a tall round brick tower attached to a church-like building. The tower has many arched windows arranged vertically and is topped with a viewing platform surrounded by a railing and a dome-like structure. A flag with a Nordic cross flies at the top. Below, people, horse-drawn vehicles, and early cars move along a busy street. At the bottom of the image, handwritten-style text reads "København. Runde Tårn."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing four men in early 20th‑century clothing standing on a narrow balcony or walkway with a simple metal railing inside a deep rocky gorge or artificial cascade structure. The scene is dark and dramatic, emphasizing the height and depth of the stone walls around them. Printed caption text appears at the bottom within the white border.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a hilltop castle complex dominating a small European town. Large multi‑storey stone buildings with steep gabled roofs and small towers are enclosed by defensive walls above a slope with trees and terraced gardens. In the foreground are clustered houses with pitched roofs, and to the left stands a church with a tall baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome. The scene looks rural with open fields and low hills in the distance. There is no visible postcard text or caption on the image side.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a heavily war-damaged European town by a river. In the foreground a broken iron footbridge lies collapsed into the water and a temporary timber bridge spans the river. The opposite bank is lined with ruins of houses and industrial buildings, with tall factory chimneys in the distance. Two prominent church towers dominate the skyline: one a large Gothic church with a tall pointed spire, the other a Baroque-style tower with an onion-shaped dome-like top. The image edges are worn and slightly creased. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.

Color postcard showing a small wooden boat with people near a quay on a waterfront at sunset or sunrise. Buildings, piers and masts are visible along the shoreline in the background. At the top left printed bilingual text in Greek and French identifies the view of the quay in Thessaloniki/Salonique. There is a handwritten message in French across the sky area, and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a coastal town with a long wooden pier and waterfront buildings along a bay, backed by low hills. At the top left there is a Greek postage stamp and beside it printed text in Greek and French reading "ΤΟ ΦΑΛΗΡΟΝ / LE PHALÈRE". At the bottom right appears the website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large neo‑Gothic brick complex behind a line of leafy street trees. The central block has pointed arches, tall narrow windows, decorative gables with pinnacles and crosses, and an inner gateway passage through the middle of the building. In front stands a separate arched entrance gate in the same brick style, opening from a city street with iron railings on both sides. People are visible near the gate and at some open windows, and a flag flies from the roof.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing a stout man sitting indoors and knitting a long stocking. The drawing is somewhat cartoonish, with the man seated on a simple chair, a brick wall and a small window behind him. To the right is a cupboard or shelving unit with various items and a teapot. Danish text is printed above and below the illustration, including a title about the 'Adler' man and additional promotional or humorous text.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large, ivy-covered villa with a high hipped roof, chimneys, and many windows, surrounded by trees, a garden, and a stone wall. The text at the bottom left reads "Falkenberg. Villa Terra." and at the bottom right credits the photographer/publisher A/B Almquist & Cöster, Hälsingborg, along with a circular logo marked "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI".

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene with large leafy trees in the foreground, two people standing on a sloping sandy bank, boats and a calm river, and an ornate multi‑storey brick building on the opposite shore. The caption at the bottom reads "Strömsholmen, Norrköping." Typical early 20th‑century chromolithographic style with a wide blank margin at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing a church. The main image on the left depicts the exterior of a Gothic‑revival style church with a tall clock tower, steep slate roof, pointed arch windows, and a stone boundary wall covered with vegetation. The top‑right image shows the church interior facing the altar: a chancel arch with decorative scrollwork, stained‑glass windows, side galleries with painted panels, and a carved altar with crucifixes. The bottom‑right image shows the rear gallery with a large pipe organ framed by Gothic arches. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the card.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an illustration of the ocean liner RMS Mauretania at sea. The large four‑funnel steamship dominates the center, with smoke rising from its funnels and smaller sailing and steam vessels around it. The image is framed by a wide light border, and a cursive caption identifying the ship appears beneath the illustration.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a steep rocky cliff covered with conifer trees and shrubs on a mountainside. The terrain is rugged with large rock formations rising above a sloped, partially forested hillside. Printed red text at the top left reads "Harzburg. Rabenklippe." and publisher information with a number is printed vertically along the right edge.

Sepia panoramic view over the Johanneslund neighborhood with wooden houses and gardens, open fields beyond, and the silhouette of a large Renaissance-style castle with towers on the far right. Caption printed at the top left reads "Johanneslund. Kalmar."

Sepia photograph of a young man in a suit and boater hat standing outdoors on a gravel path, holding an umbrella. Trees and a fence blur in the background. At the top, a printed caption reads "Hilsen fra Holmenkollen."

Black-and-white postcard showing a profile image of the 19th‑century steamship SS Great Eastern with multiple masts and central paddle wheels. Beneath the image is a printed caption describing the ship and credits to the Science Museum, London, with a Crown Copyright notice.

Vintage Swedish postcard back with a green 5 öre stamp (SVERIGE) canceled in Stockholm. Circular postmarks show a date that reads 16.3.17 (forenoon). Addressed in cursive to a recipient on Öland; brief Swedish greeting written on the left.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a shoreline with rocks and shallow water in the foreground, dense trees in the middle ground, and a large rectangular ruin on a hill in the distance. A printed Swedish caption appears at the top left.

Unused Swedish patriotic postcard with a 1940 wartime graphic at left showing silhouetted sentries with rifles on a coastal post at sunset and the slogan "På post för Sverige." A Swedish hymn-like stanza is printed below. The right half is the address side with the heading "Brevkort / Carte postale" and a blue postage-rate box.

Vintage advertising postcard showing a sail-and-steam ocean liner at sea with three black funnels and multiple masts under canvas. A decorative border frames the image, and the heading reads "ANCHOR LINE."

Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand historic hall with a coffered ceiling, chandelier, portraits on the walls, rows of chairs, tables, display cases, and a statue. The caption at the bottom is in Swedish and identifies the room.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a forested lakescape with several small islands and farm buildings in the foreground. A printed Swedish caption appears along the lower edge, and credits at bottom right note an aerial photograph approved by the Swedish defense staff.

Black-and-white interior view of a Lutheran church with wooden pews, chandeliers, a pulpit, an altar with a crucifix and altarpiece, and hymn boards. Caption text at the bottom identifies the church and photo studio.

Colorized postcard of a small coastal steam boat moored to a wooden pier on a calm fjord, with snow‑capped mountains reflected in the water. A Norwegian flag flies from the stern. Two Norwegian stamps are affixed at the top right with a circular postmark.

Black‑and‑white photo postcard of a large outdoor gymnastics display on a grass field. Rows of young women perform synchronized moves on an unusually long wooden beam supported by trestles, while men in white trousers supervise. A crowd lines the field and low, Nordic‑style buildings appear in the distant background under a clear sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a huge crowd gathered in front of a grand Baroque church. A Swedish caption at the right mentions a protest meeting in Kalmar on 13 April 1903 against the abolition of the Kalmar diocese. The church facade matches Kalmar Cathedral. Publisher credit and a handwritten Swedish greeting appear along the right edge.

Black-and-white aerial view of an industrial complex with long factory buildings, a chimney, timber stacks and yards, and a road with trees and tram/rail tracks in the foreground. A printed caption appears along the bottom edge. A modern museum credit is also visible in the corner.

Hand-tinted scenic view across a calm moat or lake framed by birch trees, with a small stone arched bridge at center and, in the distance, a Renaissance castle featuring domed corner towers and a tall central spire.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a Scandinavian town with a prominent striped cylindrical water tower beside a canal, a bridge, parks and a central square with early automobiles. Swedish caption at lower left and publisher credit at lower right indicate it is a printed postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a harbor shipyard. Along the waterfront are workshops and houses; a vessel sits on a slipway in dry dock and a large sailing ship is moored to the right, with smaller boats in front. A caption is printed at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white vintage beach scene with many bathers wading and swimming in calm water; a sandy shore with an overturned rowboat in the foreground and a few wooden cottages along a rocky point. Swedish caption is printed at the bottom center; publisher credit appears at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small wooden railway station with a gabled roof and decorative veranda. Railway tracks run in the foreground, several people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing stand on the platform, and a horse cart is visible near the station building. There are signboards on the façade, but the text is not legible. A small serial number appears at the lower left corner of the image.

Black‑and‑white studio photograph of a finely detailed scale model of a three‑masted clipper/barque on a display stand. The model shows a sharp clipper bow, long bowsprit, square sails on the fore and main masts, a gaff on the mizzen, and small flags at the mastheads. Plain backdrop; an embossed photographer's mark appears faintly at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing a lake or river with haystacks in fields and a wooden house among trees. Caption at lower left reads "VY AV HÖGSBY." At lower right there is an oval mark reading "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI" and a credit line indicating the photographer/publisher in Vimmerby.

Colorized panoramic city view captioned "MARBURG a. d. Drau." showing rooftops, church towers, parks and fields of the city. The reverse has a divided back with handwritten message and postal cancellations from Marburg a. d. Drau.

Tinted view of a tree‑lined street with a large red‑brick church featuring two tall spires and a clock on one tower. The printed words "Maribor" and "Marburg a./Drau" appear on the picture side. The reverse shows a divided back with handwritten message, address lines, and a Maribor postmark.

Sepia panoramic view of a town labeled Marburg a/D., showing the Villenviertel (villa district) with villas, tree‑lined streets and rail tracks in the foreground, hills behind. Reverse side has German handwriting, Austrian 5‑Heller stamp and Marburg postmarks, addressed to Lichtenberg, Schneeberg (Krain). Publisher credit appears along the bottom edge.

Colorized panoramic view of a town with red-tiled roofs, several church towers (including a brick twin‑spired Franciscan church and a tall clock‑tower), and a pale, sloped hill behind the town. The front is captioned "MARBURG a./Dr." The reverse has handwritten message, a 15‑para stamp of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes, and a MARIBOR postmark.

Colorized panoramic view of a town nestled by hills, showing dense roofs, church spires and scattered houses; the caption on the image reads "Maribor." The reverse has a divided back with a green guideline, stamp box, and German-language publisher imprint along the left edge, plus a purple circular stamp.

Colorized panorama of a European town with red-roofed buildings and surrounding hills. The front caption reads "MARBURG a/Drau." The reverse is a divided back with a round library stamp and a thin vertical publisher credit along the left margin.

Colorized panoramic view of a Central European town with red‑roofed buildings in a valley bordered by green hills. The front caption reads "Marburg a./Dr." The reverse is a standard divided-back postcard with a circular library stamp and a brief pencil/pen notation.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a panoramic view of a city and handwritten message across the image. A printed caption at the bottom reads "Marburg, Steierm." The reverse side says "Postkarte," has an Austro‑Hungarian 5 heller Franz Joseph stamp with cancellations, and is addressed in Italian to Trieste.

Colorized panoramic view of a central European town showing dense blocks, churches, and straight tree‑lined streets, bordered by hills in the background. The front carries printed titles in two languages: the German name at upper left and the Slovene name at upper right. The reverse shows a divided back with handwritten message and address.

Colorized panoramic view of a Central European town with many red-roofed buildings and church towers in the foreground and low mountains in the background. The front is captioned "MARBURG a. Drau." The reverse shows handwritten message and address, a circular postmark dated 8.VII., a postage stamp, and a violet library stamp from Ljubljana.

Colorized panoramic view of a central European city with church spires, rooftops, fields, and distant hills. Caption on the image reads "Marburg a. d. Drau." The reverse is a German 'Postkarte' layout with printed fields and a round library stamp.

Color lithographed bird's‑eye panorama of Maribor/Marburg on the Drava River with labeled surrounding mountains and settlements; bilingual captions in German and Slovene. The reverse shows a handwritten message, a Yugoslav stamp (50 denomination), and an address to Ljubljana.

Chromolithographic panoramic postcard showing the town and valley of Marburg an der Drau (today Maribor) with the Drava River winding through fields and a compact historic center. Grapevines and a small coat of arms decorate the margin. The reverse is an undivided back with German printing for address only.

Sepia panoramic view of a Central European city with dense low-rise buildings and several church spires, notably a twin‑towered Franciscan church. The reverse side shows the printed caption 'MARBURG A/DR.' with handwritten message and address, postal cancellations reading 'MARBURG', and a purple oval library stamp.

Hand‑tinted view of a riverside square in Ljubljana with a tram, pedestrians, and a large monument in the foreground, looking toward traditional buildings and a bridge over the Ljubljanica River. The caption on the image reads "Ljubljana. Marija trg". The reverse shows a divided back with an institutional circular stamp and printed publisher line.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing the Prešeren Monument with the bronze figure of poet France Prešeren and a muse holding a laurel above him, set in a city square with late 19th–early 20th century façades; a café sign is visible. The reverse side shows a divided back with handwritten message and postal stamps.

Colored lithographic view of a bustling central square with horse-drawn carriages, an early automobile, and pedestrians. Elegant late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings ring the square; a slender Marian column stands near the center, and a hilltop castle rises in the background. The reverse bears a caption identifying the scene and a bilingual city name.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a statue in a city square with surrounding buildings. The caption identifies it as the Prešeren Monument. The reverse side has handwritten notes, an Austrian 5‑heller stamp, and postal marks.

Colorized view of central Ljubljana with the Ljubljanica River and a stone bridge in the foreground, opening onto the main square with the pink Franciscan Church of the Annunciation and surrounding buildings. People are visible in the square. The front caption reads "Ljubljana Marijin trg." The reverse shows handwritten Italian text, an address, a circular Ljubljana postmark and a green 5-value stamp.

Colorized view over a river and stone bridge leading into a busy square with a large Baroque church dominating the right side and a monument in the center of the square. Caption at top reads "LJUBLJANA — LAIBACH — Marijin trg." The reverse shows handwritten message, address, and an Austro‑Hungarian green postage stamp with Laibach postmark.

Colorized view of a central square labeled "Ljubljana. Marijin trg. — Laibach." showing ornate fin‑de‑siècle buildings around the square, a statue/column in the middle, and the stone bridge over the river in the foreground; the reverse is unused with a library stamp and dividing line for address.

Colorized postcard view of a city square with the Prešeren Monument—an allegorical bronze figure above the poet on a tall pedestal—surrounded by grand Secession-era buildings and pedestrians. The caption at the top is bilingual. The reverse reads "Dopisnica / Postkarte" with a round library stamp and some pencil notations.

Colorized view of a busy city square with a red Baroque church with twin towers (Franciscan Church) facing a circular plaza that has a prominent statue in the center. A tram and many pedestrians are visible. Printed captions at top identify the scene as Ljubljana/Laibach. The reverse shows handwriting, an Austrian stamp and postmark.

Tinted view of a central square labeled "Ljubljana – Marijin trg," showing a statue in the middle of the square, ornate late‑19th‑century buildings around it, and Ljubljana Castle on the hill in the background. The reverse side has handwritten text, an Austro‑Hungarian 5‑Heller stamp, and postal markings.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the Prešeren Monument in a city square with ornate Secessionist façades. The caption is bilingual (Slovene/German). The reverse has a handwritten German message, an Austrian green stamp, Laibach/Ljubljana postmark, and a purple censor mark; it is addressed to Pola.

Tinted vintage view of Ljubljana/Laibach showing Marijin trg (Marienplatz): the Franciscan Church of the Annunciation dominates the right, the Prešeren Monument stands in the center, and the edge of the Triple Bridge and buildings around the square are visible. A short handwritten message appears on the front. The reverse reads "Dopisnica. Korrespondenz-Karte" and bears a green Austrian 5 heller Franz Joseph stamp; publisher credit is printed along the side.

Colorized view of central Ljubljana showing Stritar Street leading over the river toward the old town, with grand Secession-era buildings and Ljubljana Castle on the hill in the background. The reverse has a green Austro‑Hungarian stamp, Laibach/Ljubljana postmark, and a handwritten message and address.

Vintage black‑and‑white city view showing a busy square with an electric tram, pedestrians, and Secessionist-style buildings, with a wooded hill and a castle on top in the background.
