In the background are simple houses and visible stone structures described as Roman ruins. There is a green Greek postage stamp in the upper right corner and a circular postmark. Printed captions in French and English identify the place as a Macedonian village called Turkovitci on the Salonica–Verria road.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a multi‑story mountainside hotel building with shutters on the windows. Large painted letters on the facade read "ALBERGO MIRAVALLE." The hotel stands on a sloping hillside, with rocky Alpine peaks rising in the background and some sparse vegetation and low stone structures in the foreground. The image is framed with a white border typical of vintage postcards.

Colorized panoramic view over a small European town nestled in a valley, with dense red‑roofed buildings in the foreground, church towers in the center, and terraced vineyard-covered hills rising behind. On a hilltop stands a prominent tower-like structure and, further back, a larger hilltop complex that looks like a castle or fortress. In the top left corner, the caption 'Freyburg a. U.' is printed in orange letters.

Black‑and‑white image showing a river or canal with two boats in the foreground and middle distance. In the background is a modernist metal bascule or drawbridge in the closed position, with industrial details such as a smokestack and small control building on the far bank. The lower border contains handwritten Cyrillic text.

A black-and-white panoramic view of a lakeside town surrounded by mountains. The foreground shows a dense historic center with multi‑storey buildings, a prominent clock tower near the waterfront, quays and small piers along the shore, and tree‑lined promenades. In the background, flat valley land extends toward high, rugged mountains. The lower border of the card bears the printed caption "RIVA - Panorama".

A monochrome postcard showing the ornate Glockenspiel (carillon clock) set into a steep tiled roof. Below the clock face are arched niches with figurative sculptures, and above them rises an open, decorative bell tower with a domed roof and balcony. In the background, other historic rooftops and a domed tower are visible. At the top of the postcard, printed text reads "Glockenspiel in Graz."

A sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a wide urban square framed by multi‑story historic buildings with shutters and awnings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather in the square; a small kiosk or monument stands near the center. The caption at the bottom identifies the place as Largo Giosuè Carducci in Trento.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town. In the foreground a river curves past a multi‑arch stone bridge with an additional flat, more modern span alongside it. On the near bank are grassy meadows; on the far bank stand dense rows of traditional gabled houses and small industrial buildings. A large church with a tall spire dominates the right side of the skyline, while a twin‑towered church or abbey rises on the left. Bare tree branches frame the scene, suggesting it was photographed in late autumn or winter. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a small railway station building with tiled roof and chimneys, labeled "Målilla" above the doors. Train tracks run along the foreground. Bicycles stand by the platform and a small baggage cart is in front of the station. To the right, there is a separate multi-storey house with a mansard roof and an old car parked nearby. Trees surround the area, and the sky is cloudy. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.

Vintage sepia-tone postcard showing a curved country road lined with low stone walls and dense trees. A few people walk along the road in the distance. At the bottom, printed red text identifies the location and publisher, with additional handwritten cursive text over the lower margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large grassy clearing bordered by tall conifer trees. In the foreground and mid‑ground, numerous women and children in early 20th‑century clothing are sitting on the grass, on benches, or standing; some wear wide‑brimmed hats and light summer dresses. Simple play equipment such as seesaws is visible. The scene appears to be a leisure or spa park area. Text printed at the top left reads "HJO BAD. Barnängen".

A sepia-toned postcard photograph showing a large Baroque basilica with a tall dome and a bell tower, fronted by a classical portico with columns. Trees and a fenced lawn appear in the foreground. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene.

Black-and-white postcard photograph of a lakeside scene. In the foreground there is an unpaved road with a simple wooden guardrail and some stone posts, bordered by trees and shrubs. Beyond the road lies a calm lake with sunlight reflecting on the water, and forested low hills on the opposite shore under a cloudy sky. Printed captions appear at the bottom, one at the left describing the view and a publisher's imprint at the right.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large baroque lakeside castle with four round corner towers topped by domes and lanterns, and a central church‑like section with a tall spire. The building is reflected clearly in the calm water in the foreground, with trees and a small waterside pavilion on the left. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A monochrome blue-toned postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with many people swimming in the waves and sunbathing on the sand. Behind the beach stands a long, modernist-style waterfront bath complex with terraces and railings, set below a tree-covered hill. The scene is lively and summery. Text in Cyrillic and German appears along the bottom margin, identifying the place as the sea baths of Varna.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, austere Baroque/Neoclassical building complex on a corner, with an attached church featuring a tall tower and spire crowned by a cross. The building has three stories with many identical rectangular windows and a modest cornice. Leafless young trees line the cobblestone street in front. Numerous people, including many children in dark winter clothing, stand along the sidewalk. The overall scene suggests a European town in the late 19th or early 20th century. A small street sign is visible on the corner of the building but is not clearly legible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate baroque church interior with high vaulted ceilings, richly decorated columns, and numerous statues and stucco figures. The lower part contains handwritten German text. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as a cloister and its princely chapel.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an outdoor café terrace filled with well-dressed men and women in late 19th–early 20th century fashion, seated at tables beneath trees. In the background stands an ornate villa-like building with a steep tower roof, decorative half-timbering and balconies. Forested hills rise behind the structure. The lower margin and right edge contain printed German text, including the place name Karlsbad and the caption Café Kaiserpark, along with publisher information.

A tinted vintage postcard showing several loaded camels with handlers standing beside them on a dirt path bordered by greenery. The scene appears rural, with trees and bushes in the background under a blue sky. Printed French text at the top left reads "SMYRNE - CHAMEAUX LUTTEURS." A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom right.

Black and white interior view of a traditional log-house room with wooden plank floor and exposed beams. On the left stands an ornate painted cabinet with a slanted writing surface, beside a couple of wooden chairs. In the center is a small-paned window. On the right side there is a settee and chairs around a round table covered with a white tablecloth, set with cups and saucers. Pictures and a mirror hang on the wooden wall. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree‑shaded open café or pavilion behind a low stone wall. In front of the wall there are several people and a horse‑drawn carriage. Greek text is printed in red at the bottom left, along with the Latin transliteration mentioning Veria and Café Barbouta.

An old monochrome postcard showing a natural landscape with a rocky, eroded cliff or ravine, sparse trees on the slope above, and several people in dark clothing sitting or standing near the rock formations in the foreground. The lower margin contains German text identifying the location and publisher: "Wenden" and "Quelle bei ZihruI" with the publisher line "J. Kamien, Wenden."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with traditional German half-timbered houses on the left, a stone embankment and calm water in the foreground, and the ruins of a medieval tower or castle on a wooded hill in the background. The title text at the top left identifies the location as Weida in Thuringia on the river Weida. A small red-printed publisher credit appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a walled complex with a large domed church featuring a cross on top, arched windows, and an attached bell tower. In the foreground are railway tracks. In the lower right corner there is a dark caption panel with handwritten text in Greek script, and along the bottom center the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small hillside settlement. Wooden houses with steep, gabled roofs are clustered along a winding road that climbs through rocky terrain. Forested slopes and bare rock rise behind the buildings. In the top right corner, red printed text reads "Parti af Salhus". The image has the grainy, slightly faded look of an early 20th‑century photograph.

Vintage postcard showing a narrow, bustling street lined with traditional overhanging wooden mashrabiya balconies and shops. In the distance a mosque minaret rises above the buildings. The caption printed below the image reads "Le Caire Souk ez Zilhat." The lower part of the card contains handwritten French text and a signature, including the words "Le Caire 11/24 Avril 190..." and a stamp mark.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a calm lakeside scene. In the foreground a man stands holding or watching several cows as they drink at the water's edge. Reeds line the shore and wooded hills or trees rise on the opposite bank. At the bottom there is a printed caption in Danish.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a waterfront cityscape with a prominent multi‑storey classical-style building in the foreground (identified as the Banco de España) overlooking a harbor filled with small boats. Hills and more urban buildings line the background around the bay. A circular stamp from a public library is visible at the top, and printed captions run along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white (with red caption) historic view of a street lined with brick and plaster buildings forming the entrance area to a military barracks complex. On the right side stand multi‑storey barracks buildings behind a low brick wall with trees; to the left are more walls, a small guard pavilion, and a tall pole or tower with insulators, likely for telegraph or lighting. Several small figures, possibly soldiers and civilians, are seen near the gate. The red printed caption at the top identifies the location as the entrance to the infantry barracks in Wurzen.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large open square bordered by trees, landscaped gardens, and grand late‑19th‑century buildings. Church towers and spires rise in the background. The square is mostly empty except for a few pedestrians. The captions are printed in red, identifying the location as Nijmegen and specifically Keizer Karel Plein.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a rural valley town surrounded by rolling hills and patchwork fields, framed in the foreground by several birch trees. Small houses, a church or tall industrial chimney, and village buildings are scattered through the valley. Red printed German text appears in the upper right portion of the image.

Colorized view of a cloistered courtyard with a central stone fountain and manicured garden. The courtyard is surrounded by double rows of slender Romanesque-Gothic columns with rounded arches, overlooked by a higher terrace with a balustrade. The stone walls have several large circular windows. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a street scene in front of an inn or guesthouse called "Gasthaus zum gold'nen Faß". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the road; others sit in a vine‑covered terrace. The buildings have steep tiled roofs typical of central Europe. Printed red text at the top identifies the place and proprietor, and red publisher information appears at the bottom.

A multi-view color postcard showing scenic landscapes and lakeside buildings surrounded by coniferous forests and mountains. The top images depict hotels or guesthouses, outdoor terraces with tables and umbrellas, and forested hillsides. The bottom images show a calm lake reflecting autumn-colored trees and mountains, as well as lakeside buildings with arches along the shore. Across the center is a bold printed greeting in Italian mentioning Lago di Cei at 960 meters in Trentino.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a cobblestone road with cyclists and pedestrians in front of late 19th–early 20th century buildings. On the right stands a church with a tall, pointed bell tower; to its left is a long hall-like building, and further left a structure with a crenellated tower. Residential and civic buildings line both sides of the street. The top of the card bears printed German text identifying the location.

Vintage illustrated postcard with two main panels framed by flowers. The left panel shows a river scene at sunset, likely the Nile, with sailboats (feluccas), palm trees on the bank, and a distant cityscape with minarets. A lone figure in traditional dress stands by the water. The right panel shows a photograph or drawing of an ancient statue labeled as a wooden statue of a dignitary. Decorative flowers border the images. Handwritten numbers and a signature appear near the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large outdoor Catholic ceremony with a richly decorated altar under an ornate arcade supported by columns. Numerous clergy in vestments and altar boys stand on the platform, facing a dense crowd of faithful in the foreground. In the background are trees and a substantial multi‑story building with balconies. Along the bottom margin, white capital letters identify the event as a diocesan Eucharistic congress in Trento, with a date in 1926.

A black‑and‑white historic street view of a small town, showing wooden houses with ornate balconies and carved details along an unpaved road. Utility poles line the street, and there are stones bordering the roadside. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Parti fra Brumundalen."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a substantial stone building in Romanesque style with arched entryways and tall rectangular windows. The structure is identified as a Carnegie Library. Trees and a few small plants surround the building, and the foreground shows a simple dirt or paved street. Printed caption text appears at the bottom edge, and there are also handwritten red numbers/initials over the caption area.

A black-and-white image of an old church-like building with a steep tiled roof and characteristic small, eye‑shaped dormer windows. The structure has tall, narrow arched windows along its side and a modest tower with an onion-shaped dome and spire. The exterior walls appear weathered. In front there is a low stone and brick wall with a small gate and steps leading up toward the entrance, and mature trees partly obscure the right side of the building. The photo has worn, slightly damaged edges, typical of an old postcard or historical photograph. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long mounted military column riding through a barracks-like street flanked by multi‑storey buildings. At the front is a cavalry band playing instruments on horseback, followed by more soldiers on horses and horse‑drawn equipment. Civilians and soldiers watch from the side of the street and from windows. The caption in red print at the top left reads "Riesa. 3. K. S. Feldart.-Rgt. Nr. 32."

Monochrome postcard showing a forested lakeside scene. Dense conifer trees rise behind a small wooden hut or pump house on stilts at the water's edge, with a calm dark pond in the foreground and grassy shore with some logs. Caption text in German is printed along the bottom margin in red and black.

A monochrome postcard view of a large castle-like complex with round towers at both ends, high pitched roofs and small spires, set on a tree-covered embankment. In front of the castle is an open square or yard used as a timber market, with long stacks of cut wooden planks and a few workers walking around. Closer to the viewer stand several low wooden buildings, one with ornate decoration, another with a signboard on its facade. The scene has an early‑20th‑century feel.

A sepia-toned portrait of a young man with dark wavy hair and a small mustache, dressed in an elaborate Renaissance-style costume with ruffled fabric, a high lace collar, ornate belt, and a richly patterned cloak draped over one shoulder. He faces the camera with a serious expression, holding the hilt of a sword. The image has a studio backdrop and includes faint printed credits along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a row of two‑storey buildings with mansard roofs and dormer windows. The foreground left building has large painted signs and shuttered windows; the cobblestone street in front has several people standing and children playing, and a horse‑drawn carriage with driver stands on the right. The architecture is Central European, and the scene appears to be from the early 20th century.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with a large industrial complex in the foreground, including a long multi‑storey factory building and a tall smokestack. Behind it lie numerous houses and larger town buildings on gently rolling hills. Dense trees and a rocky, wooded slope occupy the lower part of the image. The caption at the bottom left reads "Rabenau." and the publisher line at the bottom reads "Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1905" with the number 5874.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view across a body of water toward a small town. The shoreline is lined with multi‑storey buildings and several church spires rising above the trees. In the foreground are steps leading down to the water. Handwritten text appears at the bottom left.

A monochrome panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly, rural landscape. Dense clusters of houses with pitched roofs, factory chimneys, church spires, and a few larger institutional buildings fill the valley, while scattered houses and fields extend up the surrounding hills. The image has an old printed-photograph style and a caption in the upper left corner that reads "Sebnitz, Sächs. Schweiz." indicating the town and region.

A monochrome postcard showing a two‑storey colonial-style government building with wide verandas supported by thin columns, a tiled or metal gabled roof, and a spiral staircase on the right leading to an upper terrace. Potted plants line the ground floor veranda and a grassy yard with a low fence is in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image in Portuguese and English, identifying the building as Agriculture Department offices at Umbeluzi.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a cobbled street and small square in an old village. In the foreground several women are washing clothes at a stone fountain or trough. Stone houses with wooden shutters surround the square, and a large tree stands near the fountain. In the background are ruins or castle walls on a hill with cypress trees. Printed text at the bottom gives a caption and publisher information.

A colored postcard showing a large classical stone building with arched windows and ornate cornices, set behind a low wall and lawn. Several people stand on the sidewalk and near the entrance; a street runs in front. The upper left corner of the card is torn. In the sky area at the top left, small printed text identifies the location as being in Chicago, Illinois.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing large multi‑storey institutional brick buildings in a rural setting. The complex stands amid open fields with a few small outbuildings and trees in the foreground. The architecture is early 20th‑century, with simple rectangular blocks, pitched roofs, chimneys, and several balconies. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge of the image.

Colorized historical view of a central town square with several ornate multi‑story buildings surrounding an open plaza. Dominating the scene is a large gabled building with a steep green roof and a clock tower rising from the center of the roof ridge. Pedestrians are scattered around the wide cobbled square under a clear sky. The words "Zwickau." and "Hauptmarkt." are printed at the top of the image.

A vintage, monochrome postcard view of a rural rocky landscape with wooden fences in the foreground and two small wooden church buildings with steeples in the background. The scene appears rustic and sparsely populated, with a few wooden houses scattered around. In the top-left corner, there is red printed text identifying the church.

A sepia-toned postcard view of a cluster of old half-timbered and tiled-roof houses surrounded by trees and gardens on a hillside. Laundry is hanging in one yard, and wooden stairways lead up to some of the homes. At the bottom center is a printed caption in German identifying the location as old houses on the Lichtenberg in Leisnig, Saxony.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal cityscape with a beach and bathing huts in the foreground, small boats along the shore, and low industrial and residential buildings in the background. The caption identifies the view as the Riazor Beach in La Coruña. Printer and photographer credits appear along the margin and below the image.

A Czech postal stationery card with printed stamp and special Olympic-themed cancellation. The left side shows a red line drawing of a historic clock tower building, with a blue emblem of Europe and Olympic rings below. Nearby red text commemorates the 16th seminar of general secretaries and mission chiefs of the E.O.C. The upper right has a printed 3 Kč Czech Republic postage stamp depicting a small village scene with houses, church and trees, and is postmarked with a circular cancellation from Praha dated 21.9.1995. The right half of the card has typical postcard address lines and barcode marks.

Colorized panoramic view of a rural valley town with scattered houses, fields, a river with a bridge, and a large brick industrial building with tall chimneys. Low wooded hills surround the settlement. The caption "Hohenfichte i. S." appears at the top left of the image against a blue sky.

Colorized historic view of a cobblestoned market square bordered by multi‑story townhouses. In the center-left stands an ornate baroque town hall building with a clock and a tall tower topped by an onion-shaped spire. A statue on a pedestal stands before the town hall, and decorative street lamps line the square. Several people and a horse-drawn carriage are visible. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed German captions identify the town and the market with the town hall, and business signs are visible on the façades.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view taken from a wooded path on a hillside, with birch trees framing an open field and a town in the distance. The town shows a prominent church spire, factory chimneys, and clustered buildings against low rolling hills. Two figures in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the left side of the path. At the upper right, there is red printed text identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a riverside town with a large hilltop castle complex, church steeples, dense historic houses, a small weir or dam on the river, and factory chimneys with smoke. The foreground is the river with trees; the title "Gruss aus Colditz." is printed in red script beneath the image, with the publisher credit in small type at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a European city street and square. In the foreground stands a large baroque fountain with multiple statues in a circular basin. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with arcades at street level and shuttered windows above. A broad street extends into the distance, lined with historic buildings; horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians are visible. On the right is a domed church or chapel. In the top‑right corner, red text reads "Trento Via Rodolfo Belenzani."

A black-and-white postcard view of a hilly forest landscape with scattered villas and guesthouses nestled among trees. The settlement lies on a slope, with meadows in the foreground and dense coniferous forest behind. At the bottom right of the image, printed text identifies the location as Bärenfels in the Osterzgebirge at an elevation of about 700 meters above sea level.

Black‑and‑white photographic view of a large brick Gothic church with a massive square tower on the left, steep tiled roofs, tall pointed windows with tracery, and buttresses. The building stands by an open square with a few small trees and several people posing in front, suggesting an early 20th‑century postcard or photographic print. The image has a dark border and slight corner damage typical of old postcards or glass‑plate reproductions. No printed caption or writing is visible on the front.

Sepia-toned postcard view showing a tall medieval brick tower with crenellations, identified as Torre Vanga, standing beside a broad open square. To the left runs a tree-lined canal or river with a path and railway tracks in the foreground, and mountains rising in the distant background. A few figures with umbrellas walk in the square near the tower. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval-style castle complex on a wooded slope. Two main gabled buildings with steep roofs and many small windows rise above dense trees in the foreground. At the top right, printed in a serif font, is the caption identifying the site.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large sanatorium‑style complex set in a hilly, forested landscape. The central multi‑storey building with wings and gabled roofs is surrounded by smaller houses, open fields, and trees, with wooded hills in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ancient semi-circular stone odeon (theatre) with stepped seating in the foreground and the cityscape of Patras with buildings and church towers in the background. People are standing on the tiers. Printed bilingual captions in Greek and French identify the site, along with a catalog number and a website watermark at the bottom right.

Colorized historic street scene showing a bustling cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European townhouses and shops. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing walk, sweep the street, and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. In the distance rises a tall church or town‑hall tower. At the bottom of the image, white caption text reads "Nijmegen. Burchtstraat".

A black-and-white postcard showing a multi‑story villa with rows of shuttered windows and an arcade of arches on the ground floor. The foreground includes a garden with a path, low bushes, and a palm tree, framed by larger trees on the sides. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "VILLA S. IGNAZIO - TRENTO". The overall style suggests an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph depicting a group of wooden school buildings behind a low fence and hedge, seen from a dirt road in the foreground. The buildings have steep gabled roofs and many windows, including a prominent rounded bay of windows on the central structure. Printed text at the top left identifies the place and the type of school in Swedish.

Black-and-white image showing an older woman working at a service counter, possibly at a post or telephone office. She is placing or operating a device on the counter in front of her, with several ink stamps nearby. Behind a glass partition is a sign overhead. Reflections of other people can be seen through the glass, suggesting a public-service interior rather than a scenic outdoor view.

Black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined residential street in a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European suburb. The image shows several ornate bourgeois villas with hipped roofs and stucco facades, some with small towers or elaborate balconies. Front gardens are fenced, and a wide unpaved street with young trees runs through the center. Forested hills are visible in the distant background. One prominent building in the left foreground has decorative wall paintings and a name written high on its facade.

Black‑and‑white street scene in a small town square, showing a vintage bus in the center with several men standing around it, wooden houses with steep roofs in the background, an early automobile on the right, and overhead utility wires. The image has caption text at the lower left and a triangular logo with a number at the lower right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate stone bridge with decorative lampposts crossing a canal in the foreground. On the right stands a large neoclassical theatre building with many arched windows, set in a small park with trees and shrubs. The water reflects parts of the bridge and building. Printed text in the upper right reads "Göteborg, Stora Teatern."

Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a street scene with a prominent inn or guesthouse complex. On the left a curved road with sidewalks leads past several houses. Near the center is a multi‑storey building labeled as an inn, with horse‑drawn carriage and early automobile in front, plus two cyclists and a dog on the street. To the right stands a larger hall‑like building with ornate façade and high windows, and further right a tall factory-style chimney within a fenced compound. The text at the top identifies the inn and its owner in German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside or lakeside landscape with trees, a small monument crowned by a large bird (likely an eagle) statue on a rocky hill, and a truss bridge in the background. Printed captions in red read "Grand-Duché de Finlande" at the top and "Tampere. Tammerfors" at the bottom. There is handwritten cursive text along the right margin and a narrow vertical decorative bar on the left.

Colorized vintage postcard view over a small lake with rowboats and a decorative metal fence with climbing plants in the foreground. Across the water stands a large historic-looking lakeside building with two pointed red roofs/turrets, surrounded by many trees. The setting is park-like. Printed text at the top identifies the scene, and there is a handwritten greeting in German along the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white night photograph showing grand baroque and historicist buildings illuminated along a riverfront. Reflections of the lights shimmer in the calm water in the foreground. On the right stands a tall, ornate church tower with statues along the balustrade. On the left are large civic buildings with a clock and a domed tower. A long, low riverboat or paddle steamer with lit windows is moored along the quay.

Vintage monochrome postcard featuring a formal portrait of a bespectacled man with a mustache and goatee, wearing a dark suit, wing collar and bow tie, with a small medal or pin on his lapel. Below the portrait are several lines of printed Greek text identifying him. There are also postal cancellation marks partially covering the lower right and lower left areas of the card.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a Byzantine-style monastery or convent building with arched colonnades and a domed church. Leafless trees and a cypress tree stand in the courtyard. The caption strip at the bottom includes Greek and French text identifying the place and city.

A vintage illustrated postcard featuring large, detailed strawberry plants with red berries dominating the design. Inset within one of the leaves is a small vignette of an architectural site labeled "Türkenbrunnen," showing a pavilion-like structure with columns and a walkway beside a building on a hillside, with a small figure in front. The word "GRAZ." appears at the top left, and there is small printed publisher information along the left and right margins.

Black‑and‑white image showing an ornate parliamentary or council chamber filled with formally dressed men seated in rows of wooden desks. Large crystal chandeliers hang from the ceiling, the walls are richly paneled with pilasters and sculptures, and a framed portrait of a dignitary is visible on the far wall. The scene appears to depict a formal legislative or governmental session in a grand 19th‑century style hall.

Illustrated postcard showing a formal garden alley bordered by tall, dense green hedges leading toward a classical pavilion or fountain structure in the distance. Small, finely dressed figures stroll or sit on benches along the path. The style is early‑20th‑century graphic art with clean lines and muted colors. Text at the bottom names the location, and a small artist signature appears on the right of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large historic inn or guesthouse with a small tower and ornate roof. The building is in a semi-rural setting with a dirt road in front, trees around it, and hills or low mountains in the background. The façade shows timber-framed gables and several balconies and arched windows. The name of the establishment is painted prominently on the front and also appears on a hanging sign at the entrance garden terrace.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an ornate oak‑leaf border around two separate photographs of bridges over rivers. The upper image shows a long bridge spanning a wide river, viewed from a distance, labeled in German. The lower image shows a wooden bridge with structural damage or collapse over another river, also labeled in German. At the bottom is a greeting line naming the city, written in German Fraktur/antiqua style.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined riverside path. On the left is a dirt walkway bordered by regularly spaced trees; on the right a calm river runs past several multi‑storey buildings. The image has a tranquil, small‑town atmosphere. In the lower left corner the caption identifies the location, and in the lower right corner there is a small printer's or publisher's logo with a year.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small historic European town seen from across open fields and orchards. In the foreground are rows of trees and meadows separated by paths or country roads. On a gentle rise in the background stands a dense cluster of multi‑story masonry houses with steep, tiled roofs. Dominating the skyline is a large church or former monastery with a tall baroque-style tower and onion-shaped dome, plus a smaller cupola nearby. Surrounding hills and farmland frame the settlement. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story stone buildings on the left and a tall wooden fence on the right. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart can be seen further down the street. Mature trees form an alley in the middle distance. In the background rises a tall church tower with a slender spire, dominating the skyline. At the top center of the card, a handwritten number "4528" appears.

Color-tinted vintage harbor scene showing small naval ships or torpedo boats moored along a quay with sailors and civilians on board and on the pier. The calm water reflects the vessels, and additional piers and harbor structures extend into the distance on the right. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and there is cursive handwriting across the lower part of the image.

Reverse side of a vintage postcard with handwritten German text. Across the top is printed 'POSTKAART – CARTE POSTALE'. On the right is the address field written in German script, and in the upper‑right corner there is an orange postage stamp cancelled with a circular postmark reading 'TARTU' and 'ESTI' (Estonia). The left side contains a longer handwritten message dated 4 October 1930.

Black‑and‑white postcard image showing a large crowd gathered in a cobbled town square for a parade or civic celebration. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century dress line up, many with umbrellas and hats, while a band or procession passes through the center. Behind them stand several three‑ and four‑story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level, decorated with wreaths and large vertical flags. German‑language shop signs are visible on the façades.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy urban street lined with multi‑story neoclassical buildings. People walk along the sidewalks and a few early to mid‑20th‑century cars are on the road. The perspective looks down a relatively narrow street with balconies, shop signs, and streetlights. Text along the bottom identifies the location as Gharib Pasha Street in Alexandria, and a small logo with a web address appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist two‑storey building on a wide street with mountains in the background. The right side features a rounded corner section with large windows and a sign on top. A road with few pedestrians and bicycles curves away on the left, lined with lampposts and cypress trees. Handwritten caption appears at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey historic tower surrounded by trees and an outdoor seating area with many wooden chairs and tables in the foreground. The tower has small rectangular windows with shutters on the lower levels, arched windows on the upper level, and an onion‑shaped dome with a lantern on top. Printed text at the top identifies the location as Graz and names the tower.

Black-and-white view of a landscaped park with a curving gravel path bordered by low wooden fencing and iron railings. On the left stands a small rectangular stone tower that looks like a medieval ruin, partly surrounded by lawn and trees. In the center and right are dense shrubs and trees climbing up a slope with a stone retaining wall, while on the far right a grand terrace with balustrade and stairs rises from the garden, framed by large leafy plants. In the distant background, a tall chimney stack is visible above the treeline. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

Black-and-white interior view of an old stone church with vaulted ceilings, wooden pews, an ornate pulpit on the right, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, and an altar with a crucifix at the back. The caption at the bottom left identifies the church as Stenkyrka kyrka and notes that this is the interior. The photographer credit appears at the bottom right.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large sanatorium complex with white multi‑story buildings and red roofs nestled in a forested, hilly landscape. A clock tower rises among the roofs, and there are trees and rocks in the foreground with distant hills in the background. At the top in red Gothic-style script is the printed title "Heilstätte Hohwald b. Neustadt i. Sa." Handwritten pencil and ink annotations appear near the top.

Multiview color postcard titled "KRISTINEHAMN" with illustrations of ducks at the top and three photographic scenes below: a riverside view with a bridge and hotel, a landscaped park with modern fountain and checkerboard paving, and a town square/park with flowerbeds, a seated statue and a building marked as a hotel. Text captions in Swedish describe the views.

A hand-colored vintage postcard showing a view of a small German town with a church on a hill (Kirchberg). The scene includes the stone church with a tall spire and tower, half-timbered houses on the slope, and a larger civic-style building with multiple windows and an exterior stairway in the foreground. The overall style is early-20th-century colorized print.

Colorized vintage view of a railway station building with a red roof and arched doorways on the ground floor. The foreground shows people in early 20th‑century clothing walking and standing in an open square in front of the station. At the top of the image, an Italian caption identifies the location as the railway station of Trento.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town taken from a field outside the built‑up area. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a few detached houses; behind them is a dense cluster of town roofs. On the right stands a large church with a tall spire, and further back in the center are several prominent church towers rising above the townscape. The lower margin is blank except for printed captions identifying the scene and publisher.

Black-and-white photograph of a quaint ivy-covered railway station building labeled "RÖSTÅNGA" on a sign above the entrance. The station sits beside multiple train tracks running into the distance. Several people stand on the platform near the building. Trees line the left and background, and the sky is mostly clear. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner of the image.

Colorized vintage view over a European town with red-tiled roofs, seen from an elevated vantage point. On the right stands a prominent stone building with a clock tower and spire facing an open square with a few trees and pedestrians. The background shows flat countryside and scattered buildings. German text is printed at the top: the town name on the left and a caption on the right.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European residential neighborhood, showing a row of ornate late‑19th / early‑20th‑century townhouses with gabled roofs, stucco façades, and decorative window surrounds. The sidewalk is lined with young trees and wrought‑iron fences. A dirt or lightly paved road runs alongside, with people walking and children with strollers or carts in the foreground, and several horse‑drawn wagons further down the street. Utility poles line the road; there are no automobiles visible.

Colorized view down a tree-lined avenue with tram tracks leading to a twin‑spire Gothic‑Revival church. People and children stand on the street in early 20th‑century attire. The sky is pastel at dusk. The caption "Diekirch." appears at the top.

Black‑and‑white early 20th‑century street scene with cobblestones, telegraph poles and a horse‑drawn cart. A row of three‑ to four‑story townhouses lines the right side; a church or ornate historic building rises on the left. Large signage on the nearest right‑hand building reads "STADT DRESDEN" and "Stadt Dresden Hotel Restaurant"; another sign reads "Willy Heberlein."

Black-and-white postcard view of a rural landscape with cows grazing in the foreground, small wooden sheds, and a broad river valley with distant low hills. A Swedish caption is printed along the bottom left, and a publisher credit with a serial number appears at bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a winter mountain scene with snow‑covered fir trees and a rounded peak. The reverse has Romanian printed headings and publisher marks, handwritten holiday wishes in Romanian, address lines, and Romanian stamps with a circular postmark.

Colorized alpine scene showing a white church with a small belfry and red tiled roof on a grassy hill beside a rural road, with the jagged Pala Group mountains in the distance. A German caption is printed in red at the top.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a river valley with pine trees in the foreground and scattered houses below. A printed Swedish caption appears at bottom left and a photographer credit at bottom right.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a white wooden church with a tall steeple and graveyard in the foreground, wildflowers in the grass, and low hills under a cloudy sky. Caption and publisher credit are printed on the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young woman lying on the floor, propped on one arm, facing the camera. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small coastal village with wooden houses packed on rocky shores around a calm inlet. A church with a tall steeple stands on higher ground to the left. Sepia-toned, aged photograph showing a winter scene of a small European town or village. Leafless trees line paths or roads in the foreground, possibly a park or avenue, with snow on the ground. A vintage postcard-style illustration of an urban Italian street scene focused on an ornate Renaissance-style palace with arcaded windows and a balcony, identified as Palazzo Rohr. A vintage Greek telegraph postcard (ΤΗΛΕΓΡΑΦΗΜΑ) printed in blue and beige. Sepia-toned postcard showing a large formation of uniformed soldiers standing in ranks on an open parade ground lined with trees and barracks-like buildings. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, tree‑lined street with rows of townhouses on both sides. The road is mostly empty except for a distant horse‑drawn vehicle. Printed captions in red at the bottom identify the street and publisher.

Black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a large neoclassical building and an open square with people walking. A vintage black‑and‑white photograph showing a gently rolling landscape with grassy hills and scattered trees. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined street with a large pavilion-style building featuring a veranda and railings. Vintage black‑and‑white view of a European street with a prominent brick post office building on the left, featuring ornate architecture, a clock, and flagpole. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand stairway leading up to a multi‑storey school building with many windows, a steep tiled roof with dormers, and a clock tower-like section with a small cupola. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing two women in traditional German dress and a man standing outside a rustic tavern. A colorized historical military scene showing several cavalry soldiers in light blue uniforms with white trim and tall black boots, wearing yellow pickelhaube-style helmets. Sepia-toned postcard showing a man in light-colored clothing and hat walking on a path through a rocky, wooded area toward a metal observation tower with a spiral staircase and a flag on top. A black‑and‑white studio portrait of a royal family: a bearded man in a decorated military tunic seated at the center, surrounded by a woman and several young women in elegant white dresses and a boy in a sailor suit. Colorized vintage view over a harbor with brick warehouses and railway tracks in the foreground, sailing ships and steamships in the water, and a historic European city with multiple church spires in the background. A vintage winter street scene showing a broad snow-covered avenue lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings on the left and right. Sepia-toned postcard view of a town in a river valley with hills in the background. Colorized historic view of a river or moat with a rowboat in the foreground, grassy banks and trees on both sides, and a fortified hillside with stone walls and buildings to the right. Black-and-white postcard image showing a grand Neo‑Romanesque terrace complex with sweeping staircases, arched colonnades, circular decorative windows and two prominent conical towers. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical building with columns and ornate façade on the right, facing an open square where people are walking. Black-and-white winter scene showing a group of skiers moving uphill on a snowy slope toward a large, wooden boarding house or guesthouse. Black‑and‑white view of a narrow, richly carved half‑timbered Renaissance house with a steep tiled roof and small dormer windows. Monochrome postcard-style image showing a street scene with an ornate Orthodox cathedral featuring multiple onion domes rising above trees and surrounding low buildings. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooden two‑storey railway station building with ornate gables and decorative trims, labeled as Ruda Station. Black‑and‑white view of a late‑19th/early‑20th‑century railway station complex with a central clock‑tower entrance, flanked by two similar two‑story buildings. Colorized view of a stone castle tower and surrounding ruins at sunset. The tall rectangular tower with a red-tiled roof stands to the right, attached to a round tower section. Color-tinted panoramic view of a small European town with red-roofed houses surrounded by dense greenery. Black‑and‑white view over a tree‑lined lake with many rowboats moored at a rustic wooden boathouse and pavilion on the shore. Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a steep hill crowned by a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle‑like complex of tall, steep‑roofed buildings. A black-and-white panoramic view of a town nestled in a valley surrounded by forested hills or low mountains. The photograph is framed by dark silhouettes of pine trees in the foreground. Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a multi‑storey corner building with signs for a restaurant and fish shop, and an interior view of a large decorated dining room with guests and bentwood chairs. A vintage, monochrome illustrated postcard showing a European city square with historic gabled houses, shops, a hotel and café with awnings, and a tall church or town-hall tower in the background. Black‑and‑white photograph of a powerful river or waterfall rushing through a rocky, forested gorge. Tall coniferous trees line both sides of the water, and in the distance a bridge can be seen crossing the river. The style, border, and printed captions suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black-and-white postcard view of an alpine village with scattered houses on a forested slope, overlooked by Monte Bondone. A color-printed vintage postcard showing a river or wide stream curving through a forested landscape with rocky cliffs on the right side. Black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street and sidewalk. An old sepia-toned postcard showing a tree-lined path or road in a garden or park, with several people walking and standing along stone walls and wooden fences. Black‑and‑white street view of a small historic town with wooden houses on both sides and a church tower with a cross in the background. The scene is framed by tree branches at the top. Black‑and‑white image of a large rectangular manor or small palace with a steep tiled roof and central baroque gable, seen from a garden lawn with trees and a curved path in the foreground. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide river curving through a rural valley with wooded hills and scattered houses along the banks. Black‑and‑white image showing a calm river or weir in the foreground, with water cascading over a low dam. Black-and-white landscape view over a rocky coastal settlement with scattered wooden houses and villas surrounded by trees and low hills. Sepia-toned street scene showing a cobblestoned intersection lined with multi‑story stone buildings. A colorized vintage postcard view of a broad gravel path or road descending through a landscaped park with trees and flowerbeds. In the foreground three people in early 20th‑century clothing walk away from the viewer. In the distance is a tall, elegant bridge on white piers spanning a valley, and beyond it a low hill with buildings on top. Printed text at the top left reads in Dutch, identifying the scene as Nijmegen in the Netherlands.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large concrete arch bridge crossing a frozen or snow‑covered river or inlet. Sparse leafless trees stand in the foreground, with snow‑covered houses and dense coniferous forest on the right hillside. The bridge has a prominent central arch carrying a long viaduct of evenly spaced vertical supports. A small circular publisher logo appears in the lower right corner, reinforcing the postcard format.

A black‑and‑white divided postcard with two photographic views. The upper image shows a large historic church with a steep roof and small tower standing on a hill, surrounded by trees and adjacent to a multi‑storey house; the caption "Burkhardswalde" is printed in the sky area. The lower image is an elevated view over a rural village with farm buildings, fields, and a river or canal in the foreground, stretching into open countryside.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a harbor scene with a long stone pier and a wooden jetty extending into the water. Small boats and ships are visible in the background, along with industrial buildings and masts. People stand or sit along the quay. The lower portion contains printed captions and overprinted handwriting, with a circular stamp on the left.

Vintage monochrome view over a tree‑lined avenue bordered by multi‑story historic buildings and a prominent church‑like structure with two domed towers on the right. The image shows a spa town set in hilly terrain, with more villas and a large complex on the hill in the background. Printed captions in German read "Marienbad. Kaiserstraße." in the upper left and "Egerländer." in the upper right.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilly residential area with large villas and greenery. A main street runs through the foreground, lined with walls and trees, while ornate mansions stand on the slopes to the right. On the hilltop in the distance a pavilion-like structure is visible. At the top of the card there is printed German text identifying the location as a street scene.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden school building with many windows, a small tower with a weather vane, and a fenced yard along a dirt street. There are a few smaller buildings and a lone person in the distance. Printed captions identify the location as Hamina/Fredrikshamn and the Swedish coeducational school (Svenska Samskolan). The lower part of the card is filled with handwritten cursive text.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large brick institutional building with two tower-like sections topped by crosses, a central entrance reached by a broad staircase with planters, and long side wings with many windows. The architecture appears early 20th century. Printed captions at the bottom read "St. Annastichting." on the left and "NIJMEGEN." on the right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a busy street scene with people walking along a wide unpaved road lined with low buildings and trees. The photograph is framed in a clover‑shaped vignette. Greek and French captions appear at the top, and there are handwritten notes and a date (15.10.1912) on the front, along with a printed logo and URL at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white image showing a formation of uniformed soldiers with rifles standing in ranks along a cobbled courtyard beside a substantial red‑brick building with striped stone bands and arched windows. Several officers and guards stand on the entrance steps under decorative ironwork and large gas‑style lamps. A high metal fence lines the right side, and flagpoles rise behind the building, suggesting the guarded entrance to an important public or government facility in a European city around the early 20th century.

Colorized vintage street view showing a tree-lined avenue with a sidewalk café or inn on the left, bicycles and a horse-drawn cart, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The buildings have brick façades and an arcade with arches. Red printed captions appear at the bottom, and a smaller caption line runs along the lower left edge.

Sepia-toned street scene in an old Chinese commercial district. Narrow stone-paved lane lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings, with many vertical shop signs bearing Chinese characters hanging over the sidewalk. People in traditional Chinese clothing and straw hats, along with some in early 20th‑century Western-style shirts and trousers, walk or stand along the street. A shirtless man stands in the doorway of a wooden-fronted shop on the right; a child in checkered pants looks toward the camera. The architecture and signage suggest a treaty‑port or colonial-era Chinese city.

An old monochrome postcard view of a historic German town. In the foreground there is a stone path with a low wall, a gate, and a man standing near the entrance to a courtyard shaded by a large tree. Behind this are simple houses with gabled roofs and flower boxes. In the upper left rises a more elaborate building with steep roofs, turrets, and decorative windows, while in the background two tall Gothic church spires dominate the skyline. Printed red text at the top gives the location and viewpoint, and a vertical red imprint along the right edge appears to be the publisher's information. On the façade of one of the upper buildings is signage for a wine tavern.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an old timber and brick courtyard building with a steep gabled roof. The scene shows a cobblestone yard cluttered with ladders, carts, and various farm or workshop items, flanked by adjoining structures. At the bottom, there is a German caption printed in a decorative script.

Sepia-toned historical street view showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings. On the left stands a prominent building with a clock tower and onion-shaped dome, and a shop sign reading "Apotheke". Several pedestrians walk along the street toward a distant square with additional houses. German text is printed at the top of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an old European town square with cobblestone pavement, multi‑story historic buildings with balconies and arcades, and a curved corner building with a distinctive projecting loggia. People are walking in the square and small shop awnings are visible. There is a handwritten signature or note in ink at the top of the image, and a printed caption at the bottom.

Vintage color postcard divided into two main images. On the left is a statue of a man standing on a tall pedestal overlooking the water, with bollards and a quay in the foreground; the caption beneath reads "STATUE DE FERDINAND DE LESSEPS." On the right is a harbor scene with ships, quays, and low waterfront buildings; the caption reads "PORT-SAID. VUE ET PORT DE PORT-SAID." Decorative foliage separates the images. There is handwritten cursive text across the bottom and left margins and a date written at the top left.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a waterfront settlement with small boats docked along wooden piers, low-rise houses and shops facing the water, and a hill with larger buildings or a compound on top in the background. The style is late 19th–early 20th century. French caption text appears at the bottom center, with publisher and photographer credits at the lower edge and a circular seal on the left. A modern website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) overlays part of the image.

The image shows the reverse side of a vintage German postcard. On the left is a printed sender/imprint block for a Berlin bookstore and publishing house, with a small logo of a person standing at a lectern. On the right is the standard postcard layout with the word "Postkarte", faint postal cancellation marks where a stamp would be, and typed address lines to an archaeological/antiquities society in Pernau, Estonia.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex above a small town and river in a wooded valley. The multi-winged castle with towers and steep roofs dominates the ridge, with clustered houses and trees on the slope below. The caption "Schloss Nossen." is printed in the upper left corner.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large lumber mill complex in a river valley. In the foreground are neatly stacked piles of cut boards and lumber on rail tracks. In the middle ground stands an industrial mill building with a tall smokestack emitting smoke. A truss bridge crosses a river to the right, and rolling hills and scattered buildings form the background. Printed red text at the top left reads "Potlatch Mill. Palouse, Wash." Handwritten notes and numbers are visible across the upper portion of the card.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a street lined with low, tile‑roofed houses and a few larger public buildings in the background, set against low hills. At the bottom left, there is a caption block in Bulgarian, Russian‑style Cyrillic, French, and Latin script identifying the location as a street in Varna and giving publisher information.

Black-and-white postcard showing a two‑storey brick customs office building by a road, with a 1940s-era car in front and landscaped grass and bushes in the foreground. In the distance a town with low buildings is visible across a river or open land. Printed Swedish caption text appears at the bottom left, and publisher/photographer information at the bottom right.

A simple cream-colored postcard or card with only printed black Estonian text in an elegant cursive and serif typeface. It appears to be a formal thank‑you note for birthday wishes, signed by Hugo Kasse and dated Tallinn, November 1929.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside town with a row of multi‑story historic buildings along an embankment. Behind them rises a steep wooded hill with rocky outcrops, on top of which stands a fortified complex with walls, bastions, and towers. A funicular or inclined railway runs straight up the hillside toward the fortress. In the lower left corner there is an inset graphic advertisement for a hotel or entertainment establishment, and along the bottom margin is handwritten script identifying the location.

An old monochrome photograph showing a large rural gathering in a hilly landscape. In the foreground, men and women in traditional Eastern European folk costumes stand in a row playing very long wooden horns laid on the ground and pointed slightly upward. Many more people in similar attire fill the background fields, suggesting a festival or folk celebration in a mountainous countryside.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style illustration of a broad cobblestoned square with tram tracks running through it. On the left is a row of ornate multi‑story buildings with arcades; one façade features elaborate stucco decoration and a projecting sign or figure. The square is animated by horse‑drawn carts, pedestrians, and market stalls with umbrellas to the right. In the background stands a large classical building with many windows and a central pediment, and farther back a church tower rises along the street axis. The overall look is of a historic European market square.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a European historic town with steep tiled roofs and narrow streets. In the foreground stands a large gabled building with several stepped Renaissance-style façades facing a small square. In the background on a hill rises a vast castle-like complex with long wings, towers, and a prominent Gothic cathedral with twin spires and another tall tower, dominating the skyline and surrounding town.

A sepia-toned historic postcard view of a town with low, densely packed houses and rolling hills in the background. Dominating the right side is a large Ottoman-style mosque with a central dome and a tall, slender minaret. Greek text is printed along the bottom margin of the image, and a modern watermark with a website URL appears across the lower right.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a rural village landscape with open fields and scattered trees in the foreground. In the left background stands a tall church with a steep spire and clock, surrounded by village houses and greenery. Low hills are visible on the horizon. At the top of the card, there is printed German text.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall Gothic-style stone monument surrounded by an iron fence and dense trees, located beside a pathway in a park-like setting. At the top left, red printed text reads "Freiberg i. S. Schwedendenkmal." and at the bottom center another red imprint reads "6054 Brück & Sohn, Meissen".

Sepia-toned studio photograph showing a young woman in traditional folk dress sitting on a fake stone prop, holding a wicker basket of flowers, while a young man in a dark military or police-style uniform and peaked cap leans toward her in a flirtatious pose. The backdrop is a painted pastoral landscape. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing several men standing on a wooden raft or ferry crossing a canal. The background has a few multi‑storey buildings and a small tower‑like structure along the waterway. Greek text is printed in red at the top, and a website watermark appears across the bottom.

Black-and-white aerial view of a historic European city with dense stone buildings, tiled roofs, and a long crenellated wall bordering an open square or courtyard. The scene shows a mix of older medieval structures and more modern institutional buildings in the background. Handwritten-style white text at the bottom reads the city name and mentions that it is a panorama taken from an airplane.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a costumed female performer posing in a Japanese-style kimono with elaborate embroidery of a crane and floral motifs. She holds a fan in one hand and leans forward smiling, as if mid‑performance. The background is a neutral studio backdrop. At the top is printed text identifying the role and performer.

Sepia-toned interior view of a well-furnished sitting room with multiple wooden armchairs, small round tables with cloths, houseplants and vases of flowers, large windows with curtains, a standing lamp, and decorative plates on a shelf. The caption at the bottom identifies the room as the sitting room of 'de Sonnaville Rusthuis' in Hees, near Nijmegen, and credits the architect Cor. Roffelsen of Helmond.

A black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped park with hedges, trees, and a central fountain in the foreground, and a large, three-story brick and stucco building with a tiled roof and many windows in the background. The text at the bottom left reads "Elverum. Parken" and there is a small publisher credit and number at the bottom right.

A colorized historic postcard showing a square with people in early 20th‑century clothing walking in front of ornate buildings and a city gate. On the left is a large red‑brick hotel with decorative stonework; in the center‑right is a tall brick gate tower; to the far right is a monumental arched gate with sculptural reliefs. German text is printed at the bottom naming the scene, and a vertical caption along the left margin identifies the postcard publisher.

An old monochrome postcard showing a richly decorated Russian Orthodox church with onion domes and ornate brickwork, set in a small landscaped park with paths and trees. Beneath the image there is a caption in Russian and German identifying the place as the Orthodox church in Kemmern.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small park villa or pavilion with a terrace and half‑timbered section. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the wooden balcony and sit at outdoor café tables in the foreground. Trees surround the building. Printed caption in German appears at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small, elegant two-story house with a hipped, tiled roof and dormer windows, seen behind a tall iron fence and stone gateposts. Leafy trees surround the building. There is a printed caption in a Scandinavian-looking language beneath the image.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing a traditional half‑timbered watermill complex. The main left image depicts a large timber‑framed mill building with a steep tiled roof set in a wooded landscape above a mill race or stream. The two images on the right show interior machinery of the mill on multiple levels and a close view of the façade with timber framing, small windows, a wooden entrance door with stone surround and a wheelbarrow with a sack in front. At the bottom, a white band bears the caption "Schulze‑Mühle‑Gauernitz."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with a large historic town hall building featuring a steep tiled roof, central gable with a clock, and a small tower with a cupola on top. Several people stand and walk in the open square, which is lined with young trees. Surrounding the square are smaller residential or commercial buildings, one with a sign visible on the left. The printed title text appears at the top of the card.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia‑toned) street scene showing a broad intersection lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses and shops. A prominent corner building with ornate gable and tall spire stands at the junction, with striped shop awnings at street level. Pedestrians and a few cyclists walk along the cobbled street. In the foreground to the right is a fenced-off garden or small square. The lower-left corner bears a caption indicating the location.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a detailed photograph of a late Gothic carved wooden altarpiece with numerous religious figures and scenes. The towering structure is richly ornamented with spires and tracery. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and subject in German.

Colorized view over red‑tiled rooftops of a historic town toward a central clock tower rising above a narrow, winding street. Hills and forested countryside are visible in the background. The printed title at the top reads in German, identifying Meissen and the view of the town tower and Burgstrasse from Schlossberg.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an ornate Baroque pavilion set on a small terrace among blossoming trees and grass. The octagonal building has tall arched windows, a balustraded terrace, decorative cartouches, and a small domed lantern with an open belfry on top. A stone retaining wall with an inscription and a fountain-like niche is visible at the base. The scene is rural and slightly hilly, with terraced slopes in the background.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a canal lock surrounded by trees. A steamship is in the lock chamber, with several people working around it. The water in the foreground reflects the boat and lock walls. At the top of the image, there is red printed text that reads "Nya Slussarne. Trollhättan." indicating the scene shows the new locks at Trollhättan.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal medieval fortification with a tall, cylindrical stone tower and surrounding walls. Several old cannons are positioned along the ramparts aiming out to sea. There is French caption text printed at the bottom left and a modern Greek website watermark at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate historic theater building in a Central European city. The structure is richly decorated in a neo-baroque style with arches, columns, balconies, sculptures, and elaborate façade ornamentation. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk and stand in front of the theater. At the top of the postcard, printed in orange letters, are the words indicating the place and the building.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large neoclassical villa behind a tree‑lined street and an iron fence with stone pillars. At the top there is French text describing the scene and mentioning Sultan Abdul‑Hamid. In the upper‑right corner there is an inset portrait of a bearded man wearing a fez. The overall style is early 20th‑century commemorative postcard.

Sepia-toned image of a large, ornate seaside-style mansion or palace with mansard roofs, a tall corner tower, stone-and-brick façade, arched windows, balconies, and a pergola-covered terrace. The foreground shows manicured lawns and gardens. On the right side, there is vertical handwritten text in purple ink; the bottom portion of the card is left blank for writing, consistent with an old postcard design.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo steamship under way near an industrial harbor. The ship has several masts and a central funnel, and the name "EDÖ" is painted in large letters on the bow. Low industrial buildings and port structures are faintly visible in the background under an overcast sky.

Black‑and‑white image of a rocky coastline in heavy surf. On the rocks stand a tall lighthouse tower, a triangular daymark structure, a smaller building with a light, and a signal mast or cross‑shaped beacon. Waves crash against the foreground rocks. Small printed captions appear in Swedish at the lower left and right edges.

A printed art postcard showing a colored reproduction of a historical painting of a riverside village with half-timbered houses and a large mill complex. The scene is pastoral: a river or mill pond in the mid‑ground with trees and a small dam or sluice, fields and distant hills in the background, and several traditional German-style buildings in the foreground. At the lower right margin is the artist credit and title, and a small printer's code appears at the lower left.

Colorized vintage view over a calm river with reflections of the bank and buildings. On the right stands a large historic complex with a tall church-like tower and cross-topped roofs on a raised embankment. On the left are townhouses and another prominent tower rising above the old town skyline. Trees line the riverbank and the sky is lightly clouded. Printed titles in German appear at the top.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of bare hills or low mountains. The foreground is filled with dense traditional low-rise houses with tiled roofs and a few taller religious buildings, including a church with a bell tower. The style and print resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard, with printed captions in French and Latin characters along the bottom margin.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a Dutch town scene with a canal, a drawbridge or lock area, a group of people gathered on the street, a windmill to the left, and a church spire in the background. A small white building stands by the water. Printed captions in Dutch identify the view and the town of Weesp.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical public building with two main wings and many arched windows, surrounded by a low fence and trees along a wide street. Overhead trolley or tram wires cross the sky. A person and a dog walk in the foreground. Greek text is printed in the white margin below the photo, along with a web address watermark.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑storey houses, with people walking along the sidewalks. In the background stands a large church with a tall tower. The printed caption at the top identifies the location as streets in Kamenz in Saxony, Germany.

A black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle complex rising above dense forest. The structure has multiple connected stone buildings with steep gabled roofs, several round and square defensive towers, and a tall central keep with a pointed roof. The landscape below is heavily wooded, with distant hills faintly visible on the left. There is no visible text on the image.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from a hillside above a rural valley. In the foreground there is sloping ground with low vegetation leading into a dense conifer forest. Beyond the forest lies a patchwork of cultivated fields, small farmhouses and barns, and a curving country road. Farther back, a string of scattered village houses and larger buildings runs along the valley, framed by forested hills in the background. At the far right a church with a tall steeple is visible, serving as the main landmark of the settlement. The scene has no visible printed caption on the image side.

A color night-time illustration of a European city square with cobblestone pavement and surrounding multi‑story buildings with steep red roofs and glowing windows. In the center stands a dark statue on a pedestal, encircled by a low fountain or steps and several pedestrians. Gas or early electric streetlamps illuminate the scene. In the background, on a hill above the roofs, is a fortress or castle silhouette under a cloudy sky with a bright full moon.

Vintage tinted Easter-themed postcard showing a photographic portrait of a young girl emerging from a large cracked egg shell. Above her is a large bell tied with a ribbon, from which hangs a branch decorated with brightly hand‑colored egg-like ornaments in red, blue, pink, and white. The overall image is sepia with hand-applied colors on the girl's dress, egg shell, and decorations. A small publisher's logo appears in the lower left corner and the number 110/90 is printed in the lower right.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm, narrow lake or pond surrounded by dense deciduous forest. The water reflects the trees and sky, and there are reeds or aquatic plants along the shoreline. In the lower left corner, a caption printed in white identifies the location as Muskau O. L. – Eichsee.

An old monochrome postcard view of a rural village street with a low building bearing shop signs, a fenced roadside cross in the foreground, and hills in the background. Several people in early-20th‑century clothing stand or sit along the dirt road. At the top is printed text in Hungarian identifying the place as Pilisszeutlászló and describing it as a favored excursion spot for tourists.

Black-and-white aerial photograph of a mountainous lake area with scattered cabins, dirt roads, forested hills and open meadows. At the lower edge is a lake shore with small buildings along the water, and further up are a few larger hotel‑like buildings. Printed caption text at the bottom right reads the number of the photo, the place name, and the photographer/company credit.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a large Italian square with historic buildings, an ornate baroque church with a dome, frescoed façades with arcades, and on the right a monumental fountain crowned by Neptune holding a trident. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand in the open piazza. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of an outdoor beer‑garden or guesthouse terrace shaded by large trees. People sit at small tables and chairs; some stand and talk near a low building on the left, with fenced grounds and open landscape in the background. Along the bottom margin there is handwritten‑style printed text in German identifying the location and proprietor.

Black‑and‑white divided postcard with two photographs.
