The upper image shows a rural village landscape with fields in the foreground, dense trees, and a cluster of houses with pitched roofs; a church tower is visible among the buildings. In the center, printed text reads "Naunhof bei Großenhain". The lower image shows a stone village church with a small tower and arched windows, surrounded by a cemetery with numerous gravestones. In the lower left corner of the photo is the word "Kirche", and in the lower right a small serial number.

Black‑and‑white image showing a calm river or canal bordered by leafy trees. In the foreground a narrow wooden boat or canoe carries several people in early 20th‑century clothing, leisurely paddling or reclining near the bank. The opposite bank is a grassy park‑like area with scattered trees and a fence in the background. Along the right border of the image there is a vertical handwritten or printed notation.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large historic school building with a steep roof and decorative gables, seen from within a leafy park. A lawn and trees fill the foreground, with the multi‑storey brick structure rising behind them. Printed caption text appears along the lower edge.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large red‑brick barracks complex with decorative gables and a tiled roof. A long fence and gate with brick pillars run along the street in the foreground. Uniformed soldiers stand guard at the entrance beside a striped sentry box. Trees line the street and courtyard, and a clear blue sky with a few clouds appears above. Printed text at the top identifies the city and the barracks of an infantry regiment.

A sepia-toned photograph of a straight, tree-lined road or path bordered by tall leafless trees forming an archway overhead, likely taken in late autumn or winter. At the bottom margin is a printed caption identifying the location and a photo credit.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, two‑storey classical building with simple neoclassical detailing and a triangular pediment at the near end. The structure fronts a tree‑lined promenade or park with footpaths, benches, small kiosks and dense greenery. Low‑rise buildings extend into the distance under an open sky, giving the impression of a smaller historic town. There is a broad white border around the photograph, typical of early‑ to mid‑20th‑century postcards.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs: on the left, an exterior view of a white church with a tall spire set on a low hill with trees in the foreground; on the right, the interior of the same church, showing wooden pews, a pulpit, and an altar in a Gothic-style chancel. Text at the bottom identifies the church and conveys a Christmas and New Year greeting dated 1903–1904, signed by Elise and John Frogner.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small European riverside town. In the foreground is a calm river with reflections of trees and buildings. An old stone bridge crosses the river; part of it is roofed in wood, connecting to a round or polygonal stone gate tower with a steep tiled roof and arched gateway. Beside the tower is a cobbled street lined with modest two‑ to three‑story houses with shuttered windows and tiled roofs. The scene is quiet with no visible people or vehicles, giving a historic, early‑20th‑century atmosphere.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cobblestone street lined with old gabled townhouses. Dominating the scene is a long two‑storey inn with dormer windows and signs in German Fraktur script reading "Hôtel zum Sächsischen Hof" and advertising a garden restaurant and concert hall. A man stands at the entrance beneath an ornate wrought‑iron canopy, while a horse‑drawn carriage with two horses and two people is stopped in front of the building. Another small street sign is visible on the corner of the hotel façade.

A sepia-toned coastal landscape showing a beach on a rocky shoreline at sunset or sunrise. In the foreground there are plants and shrubs silhouetted against the light, with goats or sheep on a rough path. In the distance a distinctive sharp rock stack rises from the sea, with cliffs on the left framing a calm bay. Handwritten-style text in the lower left names the location, and a printed web address appears along the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene with many children and a few adults standing on a tree‑lined avenue flanked by brick townhouses. At the bottom, printed text labels the location as Nijmegen and Bergendalsche Straat, with publisher information and a large handwritten signature across the front.

Black-and-white image of a small passenger steamer or excursion boat traveling along a calm lake or wide river, surrounded by dense coniferous and mixed forest on both shores under a cloudy sky. The boat is centered, moving toward the camera, with several people visible on deck. The scene evokes a northern European lake or archipelago landscape. No visible caption or border text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town nestled against a steep mountain backdrop. In the center stands a prominent church with a tall bell tower rising above clustered houses. In the foreground, a metal truss bridge crosses a river lined with stone embankments. The caption printed at the top right reads "Pilaonte (Trentino) - Panorama" (the first word slightly unclear but legible as a place name). The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A colored postcard showing an inscribed rock face with numerous carved and painted Swedish texts, dates, royal names and a crown symbol. The stone appears in a rocky outdoor setting, and at the bottom right of the postcard is the printed caption "Trollhättan. Kungsgrottan."

Colorized postcard view of a rural road lined with trees and a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground, with fields to the left. In the distance is a small town featuring a church with a tall spire and several tall, square medieval towers, likely part of a castle complex. The scene is calm and pastoral, with early 20th‑century buildings on the right side of the road. German text is printed at the top.

A black-and-white winter scene showing an old intercity bus stopped on a snow-covered rural road. The bus has roof racks and large side windows, with a sign painted on the side indicating its route. A person in a coat and cap, holding a bag or canister, stands by the roadside near the bus. In the background are snowy fields, scattered wooden fences, and a low building, suggesting a remote northern countryside.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing a gently rising cobblestone street flanked by 3–4 storey masonry houses with shops at ground level. At the far end stands a medieval-looking city gate or tower with a high, steep roof and a large archway through which a horse‑drawn vehicle is passing. Several people and children are visible in the street. German shop signs are painted on the façades along the right and left sides of the street.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a grand three‑story classical building partially framed by large trees. The facade has many rectangular windows, decorative stonework, and a central entrance with stairs and a balcony above. The scene appears to be a town square or street in front of the building. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads "Vänersborg, Enskilda Banken" and a small number "3360" appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a corner block of ornate late‑19th‑century apartment buildings in a European city. The corner building has a mansard roof, dormer windows, and a tower-like roof structure with a weather vane on top. Tree-lined streets, tram tracks, and pedestrians are visible in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the city and the street corner depicted.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic stone fountain in strong contrast, shot from a low angle. In the foreground are curved basin steps with water, and a sculptural figure (likely a mythological creature or putto) from which water sprays upward. In the misty background stands a medieval or Gothic‑style civic building with crenellated roofline and a square tower topped by a small cross, suggesting a historic Italian piazza.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings and shops on both sides. People walk along the sidewalks and in the street. At the far end of the street stands a larger, more ornate building framed by trees. The overall style and clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century European town. In the lower left corner, white printed text identifies the view as 'Uddevalla, Kungsgatan.'

Black‑and‑white view of a European town with a narrow dirt road in the foreground where several children walk carrying buckets. Wooden fences enclose gardens and orchards. On the right is a multi‑story stucco house with dormer windows and patterned roof tiles; laundry hangs on lines in the yards. To the left stands a timber‑framed house. In the background rises a large Gothic‑revival church with a tall, slender spire and multiple smaller towers, surrounded by dense townhouses and ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The scene feels rural‑urban, calm, and domestic. No clear printed caption is visible.

Black‑and‑white view of a grand European boulevard or square lined with ornate late‑19th‑century apartment buildings. The central building is on a street corner with a rounded façade, multiple balconies and a tall tower-like cupola. Similar richly decorated façades with bay windows and wrought-iron balconies continue along both streets. In the foreground are a few pedestrians, a horse‑drawn carriage, small carts, gas‑style streetlamps and young trees planted along the sidewalk, giving the impression of an affluent urban neighborhood from the turn of the 20th century. No visible caption or border text is present on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an electric hill railway or tram with three cars traveling through a wooded, hilly landscape. A woman in a long white dress and hat stands by the track in the foreground. At the top of the image there is printed text in Dutch.

Colorized vintage view of a formal flower garden in a city park. A woman in early 20th‑century clothing stands on a gravel path bordered by colorful flowerbeds. White wooden pergolas and benches line the left side, while manicured lawns and more flowerbeds extend into the distance under a blue sky. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as a flower garden in the city park of Chemnitz.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town in a hilly rural landscape. A cluster of houses, farm buildings, and an industrial chimney sit in a valley bordered by fields and a forested ridge in the background. Trees and a road line the foreground. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the place and the publisher.

Sepia-toned studio photograph of a young woman and a young man posed in front of a painted city backdrop with a river and a large gothic-style church or cathedral. The woman wears a light-colored traditional dress and headscarf and carries a wicker basket with linens. The man wears a dark uniform with a cap and sword, saluting the woman. The background suggests a European cityscape but is clearly a painted set rather than an outdoor scene. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a row of urban buildings with shops and a cinema named "Capitol" at the front, a 'Bahnhotel' (railway hotel) sign on the gabled building, and several pedestrians and cyclists along a fenced sidewalk above a lower roadway or rail cutting. At the right, a larger ornate corner building faces a square with an early motorbus and cars, and in the distant background a wooded hill with a tower or lookout on top. The caption at the bottom left reads "Radebeul‑West."

Colorized vintage postcard showing a lake with people rowing small boats in the foreground, dense green trees behind the shore, and beyond them a panoramic view of a hilly city with red‑roofed buildings and church towers. Printed text at the top reads "GRAZ. Hilmteich mit Blick auf die Stadt." indicating a view of the city of Graz from the Hilmteich pond.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a cylindrical water tower with a conical roof standing on a hill covered with trees and paths. At the top left there is printed German text identifying the location as Niederlößnitz–Kötzschenbroda and mentioning the Friedrich‑August‑Weg and the water tower.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic church with a very tall spire and smaller side spires, surrounded by a landscaped park and low town buildings. The sky is a smooth gradient from light beige at the horizon to blue above. Printed German text at the top identifies the place as Hainichen and the church as the Trinity Church. Publisher and production notes are printed vertically along the left and right margins.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large military drill ground in front of a long barracks‑like building with a central arched entrance topped by a clock. Soldiers in uniform are standing in formation and walking in small groups across the open field. Trees line the edge of the parade ground, and the architecture appears early 20th‑century European. Printed text runs along the bottom edge and a red number is handwritten at the top right.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a rural dirt road lined with wooden fences in front of wooden farm buildings or an inn. Two men stand with a horse on the left side of the road, while two women in long skirts and shawls stand on the right. In the background are additional buildings and a small church or similar structure. Printed captions in Finnish and Swedish describe the scene and its connection to the 1808–1809 war. A handwritten note at the top right reads "v. 1908".

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town at the edge of a hilly landscape with terraced vineyards. In the foreground are orchards and gardens bordered by low wooden fences, and a straight tree‑lined street with a few pedestrians and an early motor vehicle. Along the street stand large, ornate bourgeois villas with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the distant left on a hilltop is a prominent church or monastery complex; further right on another hill is a small tower. Terraces and vineyard strips cover the hillsides. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A colorized panoramic view of a valley town surrounded by high, barren mountains. In the foreground are orchards or cultivated fields and scattered houses with red-tiled roofs. A long multi-arched aqueduct or viaduct curves through the greenery. Beyond it stretches a compact town with low buildings, some with bright facades, set at the base of the mountains. A rail line runs along the lower edge of the scene. The style is that of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex above a river and a small town with traditional houses and trees in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads "Schloss Nossen." and a printer's line "Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

Black‑and‑white photograph of a quiet lakeside or coastal village scene. In the left foreground is a wooden boathouse or shed built on the water's edge, with nets or fish hanging from its exterior. Several wooden rowing and sailing boats are moored near the shore and along the tree‑lined bank. The opposite shore and small rocky islets are visible in the distance. The caption "Hangö by" is printed in the upper right corner.

A black‑and‑white rural landscape showing a gently sloping field in the foreground, a very tall solitary coniferous tree rising above lower trees and bushes near the center-right, and a small wooden house or barn with a pitched roof in the middle distance. The background consists of flat farmland and forest under a lightly clouded sky. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large three‑story neoclassical school building with a central portico featuring arched windows and ornate decoration. In front is a circular garden bed with flowers and pathways in a landscaped square. Two women in long dresses walk on the foreground path. The sky is blue with a few clouds. Red printed text at the top reads the city name on the left and the type of school on the right.

A museum-style postcard with two color photographs mounted on a cream background. The left photo shows the interior of a stone castle room with rough masonry walls, a small arched doorway, modern black floor lamps, and a large stone statue of a standing figure in one corner. The right photo is a close-up of a medieval-style stone statue of an armored knight or nobleman with a cape and shield, standing against the same kind of stone wall. At the top of the card there is printed and handwritten Finnish text indicating the castle and institution.

Sepia-toned military postcard showing a long line of cavalry soldiers on horseback drawn up in formation on an open field. The troopers wear pickelhaube-style spiked helmets and carry lances with pennants. Several officers are in front of the ranks. Printed German text appears along the top, with additional red handwritten German annotations across the upper part of the card.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a bustling street scene beneath a hilltop fort with a lighthouse or signal tower. Market stalls with awnings line the street, people in traditional clothing walk or stand, and a cart is visible in the foreground. On top of the hill stands a fortified structure with walls and a tall lighthouse-like tower with antennas and a flag. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text reads "Alexandria - Fort Napoleon."

Black-and-white view of a forest spa or resort town in a mountainous area. Several ornate late-19th/early-20th‑century villas with steep roofs and decorative facades line a gently curving road bordered by evenly spaced trees. In the foreground is a landscaped park with winding gravel paths, young trees, flowerbeds, and a small hexagonal pavilion or gazebo. Dense conifer forest rises directly behind the houses and covers the surrounding hills, which fade into the mist in the distance. One villa bears a sign with a name on its facade.

Colorized vintage view of a steep hillside with rocky cliffs and dense greenery, showing a funicular railway climbing up to a fortified hilltop complex. At the summit are walls, towers, and buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center‑right stands a prominent clock tower. Handwritten notes run along the top margin, and printed caption text appears in blue near the top center.

Colorized vintage waterfront scene showing colonial buildings, palm trees, crowds of people along a quay and a small bridge over the water. A flag flies above a main building. Printed captions in Portuguese identify the place as Loanda and describe a naval celebration. There is a circular postal cancellation in the upper right corner.

A vintage multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges. It shows several small photographs arranged around a larger central image of a modernist multi‑storey white building set among tall pine trees and landscaped grounds. Other views include swans on a lake, forested park scenes, a ruin or monument, a church tower, and various buildings that look like sanatoriums or resort facilities. In the center bottom, there is a cursive inscription in Latvian.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a coastal city with early‑20th‑century European buildings, a small square or park with trees in the foreground, and a harbor with ships and a hilly headland in the background. On the right are ornate multi‑story facades with rooftop statues. The bottom left text is in Cyrillic, and the bottom right text in French reads "Vue de Varna."

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a rural village surrounded by fields and forest. In the foreground there is a road lined with young trees and a pond or small river with a bridge. Behind it are scattered farmhouses and larger village buildings leading up to a wooded hillside. The printed caption at the bottom left reads "Sommerfrische Grillenburg." The image has the typical white border and composition of an early 20th‑century postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small wooden bridge with diagonal railings in a landscaped park. The path continues beyond the bridge, lined with trees and bushes, and leads uphill towards a large multi‑storey building partly visible among the trees. There is a lamppost on the right side of the path. The lower border bears captions in Bulgarian and French identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an interior religious object, likely inside a church or chapel. At the center stands a tall stone or wooden pedestal supporting a polygonal pulpit or reading desk decorated with relief carvings of saints or biblical figures in niches or window-like frames. The wall behind is tiled stone; to the left hangs a small reliquary or liturgical apparatus and to the right is a lectern or book box mounted on the wall. The lower wall paneling is carved with floral or heraldic motifs. There is faint writing or marks near the top edge of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a fortified stone castle with crenellated walls and a tall rectangular tower, surrounded by trees and grassy fields. At the top left, red text reads "KARLOVAC  Stari grad". On the right side are red postage stamps with a stylized male figure and Cyrillic lettering, overprinted with a circular postmark.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing the ruins of a large brick structure with arched windows and a semi‑circular apse, partly surrounded by trees and greenery. At the bottom, printed captions identify the view as the Valkhof ruins in Nijmegen, and a publisher's credit line appears along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a small market square lined with multi‑storey shop buildings, with large painted advertisements on the façades. On the left, several stores bear the name "Oscar Reich" and other commercial signage. In the middle distance is a tall gabled Gothic-style hall-like building with a stepped façade and many small windows. To the right are older, fortress‑like houses and a small square with cobblestones. At the top in red print is the caption "Meissen. Kleinmarkt."

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, grand hotel complex set on a forested hillside above a town. The central building is multi‑storied with towers at each end and a steep, mansard‑style roof, surrounded by smaller villas and lush trees. At the bottom center of the image, handwritten‑style text reads "Karlsbad. Hotel Imperial". The scene suggests an early–20th‑century spa resort in a mountainous area.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rocky coastal landscape with low vegetation sloping down to the sea. A long, narrow pier or jetty extends out into the water, with small structures at the end. In the distance are low, hilly islands. In the lower-left foreground there is printed text identifying the location, and in the lower-right corner a triangular publisher's logo with a number.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town with multiple medieval stone towers and dense traditional houses with steep roofs. A large round tower with crenellations stands prominently on the left atop rocky ground, a tall square church or city‑gate tower with a pointed spire rises in the center, and another cylindrical tower that resembles a water tower stands on the right. The scene shows tightly packed buildings on a slope, small gardens, and narrow streets, suggesting an old fortified city.

Colorized vintage view of a small railway station with a main station building on the left and several freight or passenger cars on tracks to the right. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, and there are telegraph poles, lamps, and a fenced area near the building. The scene is labeled in German at the top with the location and indicates that this is a train station (Bahnhof).

Vintage sepia postcard showing fishermen at sea: several men stand in the surf pulling or steadying a wooden fishing boat while others remain on board, with waves breaking around them. Printed captions in French and Greek appear at the bottom along with a publisher credit and catalog number.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large château or castle complex perched on a rocky outcrop above a small town with red‑tiled roofs, surrounded by dense trees and rolling farmland and hills in the background. At the top in red German text it reads "Gross-Meseritsch. Schloss des Grafen Franz Harrach."

A colorized vintage postcard showing a mosque complex dominated by a tall, slightly damaged minaret rising beside a low, red‑tiled building and a stone wall. Lush green trees surround the structure under a blue sky. French text at the top mentions Salonique (Thessaloniki) and a minaret destroyed by an earthquake. A website credit (elia.org.gr) appears at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural settlement with large houses and institutional buildings in the foreground, and a church with a tall tower rising above clustered village houses in the background. A field stretches across the front, with a single figure walking along a path. Printed red text identifies the place and publisher at the bottom margin.

Colorized vintage street view of a European town. The scene shows a wide, clean street lined with multi-story brick and stone buildings in late 19th- / early 20th-century style. In the distance stands a church or town hall tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock. People in long dresses, hats, and early 1900s attire walk along the sidewalks. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Döbeln i. Sa." on the left and "Königsstrasse." on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up photograph of a medieval-style stone or wood sculpture of a crowned figure, likely a king or saint. The figure has long wavy hair, a decorated crown with fleur-de-lis-like elements, a jeweled necklace or chest ornament, and holds a scepter or staff visible on the right. The image fills nearly the whole card and appears to be a reproduction of a museum or cathedral statue. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.

Minimalist postcard with a large blank area on the left and a vertical red line drawing on the right. The drawing is geometric and abstract, showing a stylized standing figure holding a book among scattered envelopes, books and starburst motifs, all set on a grid. Text in Estonian appears at the bottom of the illustration, and the year '87' is printed to the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a manor-like building with a hipped roof, dormer windows, and a small tower with a cupola and weather vane. The structure is set on a hillside with terraced vineyards or slopes in the background and a formal balustraded stairway and garden in the foreground. Printed red captions identify the scene and publisher: the main caption at the bottom right reads "Schloss Hoflößnitz," and smaller text at the lower left reads "4264 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

Colorized historical postcard view of a town market square dominated by a large, pale building with a steep greenish roof and a tall clock tower. Stalls with produce and goods are set up in the square, and numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and shop. Surrounding the square are multi‑story townhouses. Printed text at the top identifies the location and subject.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined dirt road leading to a railway station building. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the road, and a cyclist rides on a parallel path. The station building is partly visible on the right. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and a handwritten year is added beneath it. A cursive signature or publisher credit is printed in the lower right.

Vintage sepia postcard with floral and pine-cone decorative borders. The main image shows a forested hilly landscape with a small settlement, including several houses and a church with a bulbous baroque-style tower. To the right, in a circular inset, is a large multi‑story villa-like building labeled as a sanatorium. At the bottom, ornate script reads "Maria Grün b/Graz." Printing along the left edge notes a publisher in Graz.

Color-tinted historic postcard view of a riverside harbor with moored boats, a grassy embankment and industrial buildings with chimneys in the background. In the foreground stands a solitary figure by the water. The lower margin contains printed captions in red identifying the scene as in Nijmegen and describing it as the abattoir and harbor, along with the publisher's credit.

An old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a town with low, tiled-roof houses and narrow streets. In the background, on a hill, stands a fortified citadel and minarets of mosques, indicating an Ottoman-era urban landscape. Printed captions in French and Latin script identify the place as Uskub, with additional Ottoman/Turkish script at the top. The card is worn and spotted with age and bears a website watermark at the bottom.

Color postcard showing a large, multi‑story mountain hotel or lodge with a central tower standing on a rocky cliff. The building sits high above rugged stone formations and grassy slopes under a partly cloudy sky. At the top left there is red German text identifying the location and altitude.

Colorized vintage harbor view showing a busy port with multiple large passenger and cargo ships moored along quays, smaller boats moving in the foreground, and an old-looking tugboat prominently in front. The shoreline behind is built up with brick warehouses and mid‑rise buildings, plus cranes and masts. On a hill to the right stands a tall church‑like stone tower with a steep roof, dominating the skyline. The image has a decorative, slightly scalloped border typical of old postcards.

A vintage, monochrome street scene showing a tree‑lined avenue with several children and adults standing and walking along the sidewalk. On the right are tall, ornate brick townhouses with wrought‑iron fences, likely upper‑class residences. The left side shows the continuation of the avenue receding into the distance. Printed red captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen" and "Waldeck Pyrmontsingel," and there is cursive handwriting over part of the sky and across the lower margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden water wheel structure on a river or stream, surrounded by foliage. The wheel appears to be part of an old mill installation. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin, with additional hand‑written or stamped numbers in red and black at the lower right edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with red printed caption at the top showing a hillside landscape with vineyards and trees in the foreground. In the middle distance stands a large villa‑like building, and behind it on the slope is a tall multi‑storey structure with balconies, towers and a central spire, labeled as the Bilz Naturheilanstalt. Smaller houses dot the hills on both sides.

Mounted on a herbarium sheet with pressed elm branches is a small sepia photographic postcard showing a riverside town with a bridge crossing the river, a compact cluster of houses on the slopes, and on the hilltop a large medieval castle and a prominent church tower. The lower-left corner of the postcard bears a printed caption. Surrounding the specimen are institutional labels from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.

Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with wide gravel paths, trees, flowerbeds, and a central fountain. Several people, including adults and children, stand on the path in the foreground. In the background are elegant buildings with red roofs partly hidden by trees. The printed title text at the top is in German and identifies the location as a park area on the Schillerpromenade in Kamenz in Saxony.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a wide dirt path or road running through a wooded park, bordered by rustic wooden railings on both sides. A man in an old-fashioned suit and cap stands by a utility pole on the left. Trees and greenery line the path, and soft clouds appear in the sky. At the top, red printed text reads the location name.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Neo-Gothic brick building with steep roofs, pointed gables, and a tall spire, partially obscured by trees and shrubs in the foreground. The caption at the bottom left, in Latvian and German, identifies the building as a commercial school in Riga.

A color illustration of an early 20th‑century ocean liner, the S.S. "Mooltan", cutting through rough seas. The ship has two tall black funnels emitting smoke, multiple lifeboats along the deck, and a single prominent mast. In the upper left corner, printed text advertises the P. & O. India‑China‑Australia Mail and Passenger Services, giving the ship's tonnage and horsepower.

A sepia-toned, oval-framed portrait print of a uniformed military figure in elaborate 19th‑century dress with epaulettes, medals, and orders on his chest. The card is aged, creased, and stained, resembling an old postcard or cabinet card. Below the portrait there is faint printed text in Cyrillic, partially abraded.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a monument in a landscaped garden in front of a multi‑story historic building. The monument is a tall rectangular stone pedestal with an eagle sculpture on top and a relief portrait of a man on its side. At the base of the monument is a wreath with a vertically striped ribbon. Conifer trees and shrubs surround the monument, and windows of the building form the background.

Black-and-white postcard showing a long, ornate Maya stone building standing on a rubble-covered platform. The facade is richly decorated with geometric patterns and sculpted elements. At the bottom right, Spanish text is printed identifying the structure and viewpoint.

Black‑and‑white wide‑angle view of a very long neoclassical building with a central portico and dome and two similar end pavilions, each with a pediment and smaller dome. A tall flagpole with a U.S. flag stands to the right of the central section. The foreground is an empty, rough dirt field, and there are only faint structures visible far in the distance, suggesting an isolated new public building. The image is framed like an old photographic postcard; some handwriting or numbering appears faintly along the upper edge.

A colored illustrated view of a busy seaport with many steamships and smaller boats in the harbor, quays, warehouses, palm trees, and multi‑story colonial style buildings along the waterfront. In the left foreground stands a tall statue on a pedestal labeled 'Monument de Lesseps.' Handwritten cursive text covers part of the lower and right sides. Printed captions identify the view as a general view of Port Said.

A colorized historical postcard view of a busy open-air market in front of a large Neo-Renaissance style post and telegraph building. Numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing browse stalls with produce and goods under umbrellas in a town square. The central building has two prominent mansard-roofed corner pavilions, arched ground-floor entrances, tall windows, and a clock above the main entrance. Mountains are faintly visible in the background and surrounding townhouses line the adjacent streets. Italian text at the top identifies the location, and an inscription on the façade reads 'R. POSTA E TELEGRAFO'.

Sepia-toned street view of a historic European town. The image shows a broad cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops on both sides, with pedestrians, horse-drawn carts, and early 20th‑century street life. In the distance stands a prominent church with a tall spire. At the top of the postcard is printed the title indicating the town and street name. Several shop signs are visible on the buildings along the right side.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a Central‑European town edge: a prominent, ornate neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance building with a steep gabled roof and decorative stepped gables stands in a tree‑filled park, accompanied by a smaller villa‑like house in front. Behind them are several multi‑storey buildings with similar steep roofs, and beyond that open fields laid out in long strips and a low rolling landscape. A wide unpaved tree‑lined road runs to the left. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a snowy forest landscape with a stream running in the foreground and two wooden cabins or farm buildings in the background. Deep snow covers the ground and roofs, framed by dense conifer trees. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black-and-white postcard showing a tree-lined country road curving into the distance. On the left side stands a large villa-style building identified as Hotel "Mariënboom" with a conservatory and several windows, partly obscured by tall trees. Printed caption text at the bottom names the hotel and indicates the location as Nijmegen on Groesbeeksche weg.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a town built on the lower slopes of a wooded hill. The foreground and midground are filled with large villas and houses with steep roofs and ornate facades, typical of late 19th–early 20th century Central European spa architecture. At the top edge, red printed text identifies the location as Bad Harzburg and specifies that the image shows villas on the Papenberg hill.

Colorized panoramic view framed by two large trees, showing an expansive complex of multi‑story institutional buildings with towers and clock turrets set amid gardens, fields, and scattered houses. In the background are forested hills and distant mountains. The style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard of a hospital or similar institution. At the top, printed text in German identifies the scene as in Graz, district St. Leonhard, and refers to a new hospital.

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, reeds and several swans on the water, and a small hexagonal pavilion or gazebo on an islet. In the background stand two large brick institutional buildings with ornate facades, gables and arched windows, connected by a curving path lined with a low fence. Mature trees surround the scene, suggesting a peaceful estate or hospital complex from the early 20th century.

Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined alley in a city park. Tall deciduous trees border a wide path where a few people in old-fashioned clothing stroll. In the background stands a white statue on a pedestal, partly framed by foliage. At the bottom edge, red printed text reads "Graz – Stadtpark‑Allee."

A black‑and‑white illustrated multi‑view postcard with decorative floral motifs and frames. At the top center is the caption "Helsning från Carlskrona." Surrounding this are several vignette drawings: a central cityscape with a tall clock tower standing above a rail tunnel or cutting, other civic buildings and a domed structure; a circular view of a straight street lined with ornate multistory buildings labeled "Ronnebygatan"; a triangular view of a star‑shaped fortress compound labeled "Kungsholms Fästning"; and a waterfront view of a low fortification with trees and buildings labeled "Kungsholms…". The images depict landmarks of the city of Karlskrona. There is small printer information along the left edge.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a Neo-Gothic church beside a small lake or pond, viewed from a tree-lined path with a fence and a distant horse-drawn carriage. The church is reflected in the water. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Stuttgart. Johanneskirche." with handwritten cursive notes along the lower and right margins.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside promenade with rustic wooden railing and trees. On the left stands a villa-like building with arched windows and ivy on the facade; further along are carriages or carts. On the right is a steep rocky cliff with coniferous trees rising above a river. Printed caption text appears in red at the bottom margin, along with a publisher line.

Black‑and‑white coastal view showing a wide sandy beach curving along a bay, with scattered seaweed on the shore and two small figures walking near the waterline. A line of simple wooden fences or posts runs roughly parallel to the surf. Behind the beach is a small settlement of wooden houses and buildings, some on low bluffs, backed by treeless rolling hills. The setting appears rural and early-20th‑century. Along the bottom edge, in reverse, is a handwritten or scratched number and word that looks like an archival caption.

A black‑and‑white image of an ornate villa or spa building in a landscaped park. The main structure has decorative wooden trim, a round central window, French doors, balconies with railings, and attached wings extending into the garden. Mature trees, manicured shrubs, and curved walking paths surround the building. Several people in late‑19th‑ to early‑20th‑century clothing sit on benches or walk along the paths; one man sits in a wicker beach or garden chair in the left foreground. The scene has a relaxed, resort‑like atmosphere. A faint handwritten caption or numbering appears at the very bottom of the image.

Sepia-tone panoramic view of a small town set against low hills. In the foreground are agricultural fields, followed by a line of trees and village houses. On the hillside stand several larger buildings that look like villas or institutional structures. At the top left text reads "Zitzschewig", in the upper middle "Genesungsheim" appears near a large building on the slope, and on the upper right the hilltop is labeled "Wettinhöhe".

Color postcard showing a wide river with excursion boats moored along a grassy promenade on the left bank. In the background a stone arched bridge crosses the river, and above the opposite bank rise wooded hills with the large ruins of a castle complex and a town of red-roofed buildings below it. The image has the typical white scalloped border of vintage postcards.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historical pageant or tournament held in a city square. In the foreground, mounted riders in medieval-style costumes circle a central pole with long ribbons, while crowds fill grandstands and line the streets on both sides. A temporary castle-like gate stands at the back of the arena, and multi‑story European townhouses with shops (one sign reads "AU BON MARCHE") form the backdrop. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in French, identifying the scene as an event in Bruges.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a narrow wooden footbridge crossing a small river or stream in the foreground. The bridge leads across open fields toward a low hill topped with trees and a white church with a tall, pointed steeple on the left side of the image. The sky is partly cloudy. Printed text in a cursive style appears at the bottom of the postcard.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European city, showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑storey stone buildings. On the right is an ornate corner building with a steep pointed tower and the sign 'Grand'. A tram is visible in the middle of the street, along with an early automobile and a small kiosk in the foreground. Leafless trees line the sidewalk. Caption text is printed at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned postcard featuring a coastal rocky scene viewed through a natural rock arch or cave opening. On the left, small white buildings and what appears to be a lighthouse stand near the cliff edge, with the sea visible behind them. A palm tree and rugged shoreline are in the middle ground. The image occupies the upper left portion, while the rest of the card is densely covered with handwritten text in Greek. There is also a printed caption near the bottom left and a date written by hand (19-7-1900).

Colorized vintage view of an outdoor fairground with a large circular airship-themed carousel in the center reading "Zeppelin IV" and "Parseval V." Visitors in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along paths and stand near the ride; tents and smaller attractions are visible in the background, with trees surrounding the fair. The caption at the top is printed in red German script.

Colorized panoramic view of a small European town set in a valley with surrounding hills and fields. In the foreground there is a large cultivated field, then rows of houses with red and dark roofs, several larger multi‑story buildings and factory‑like structures, and church spires in the distance. At the top left there is red printed text that reads "Olbernhau i. S. Total." The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century lithographic postcard showing the town in its entirety.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, arched stone structure in ruins, likely part of a church or monastery. The architecture features rounded arches and brickwork, with an upper niche and openings suggesting a bell tower or façade. The card has a white border and printed captions along the bottom in multiple languages.

A black‑and‑white, vertically oriented postcard with two separate interior photographs stacked one above the other. The upper image shows a formal office or study: a large wooden desk covered with papers and a typewriter, a patterned rug, paneled walls with vertical stripes, tall curtains with geometric designs, an ornate standing clock, and a round side table with upholstered chairs. The lower image depicts a classroom or lecture room with large windows featuring decorative glass, paneled walls and a coffered ceiling. Individual wooden desks with curved side sections fill the room, all facing a teacher's desk at the front, with a wall clock above it. There is a blank white strip at the bottom where caption text would normally be printed, but it appears empty in this reproduction.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European alpine village set on a gentle hillside, with a prominent church and tall steeple at its center. Terraced fields and orchards occupy the foreground, while farmhouses and clustered village buildings extend along the slope. In the background rise high, rugged mountains with patches of snow near the summits under a clear sky. There is a thin white border around the image, and no visible printed caption or writing on the front.

Sepia-toned studio photograph showing a humorous scene: a uniformed guard with a spiked helmet (Pickelhaube) stands beside a striped wooden sentry box, pointing toward its entrance. Opposite him is a woman in a striped dress with apron and bonnet, holding a wicker basket as if delivering items. The background is plain and theatrical, giving the impression of an early 20th‑century staged postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a central European town square with a large church featuring a tall clock tower and spire. Trees and a few town buildings surround the square, and in the distant background another large building or castle is visible on a hill. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Frauenstein in the Saxon Ore Mountains and refers to the market square.

A vintage postcard-style image showing a rocky, tree-covered shoreline beside a wide lake. On the right, on top of a metal framework, stands a cylindrical water tower or tank. The scene looks across the lake toward low, forested land on the far side. The card has printed captions in red text: one at the bottom left reading "Lahti" and another at the bottom right reading "Sükkasalmi." Along the left edge, in smaller vertical print, appears a publisher line including the words "Athan Ensti, Lahti." The image has a lightly tinted, hand‑colored appearance.

A monochrome postcard showing a white Gothic-style church with tall pointed windows and a prominent steeple rising above trees in the foreground. The building stands on a lawn with a path leading to the entrance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

An old, colorized postcard showing a riverside view with trees and a fence in the foreground and a townscape with church spires across the water in the background. The printed caption under the image reads "Gezicht van Nijmegen op Lent." The card is heavily speckled with age and has dense handwritten cursive text in Dutch both below the picture and vertically along the left margin.

Black-and-white postcard view of a tranquil waterfront settlement with traditional wooden houses along the shoreline, seen across still water with trees in the background and leafy branches framing the top of the image. The scene is rural and calm, likely in a Nordic archipelago. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small publisher logo is at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a village in a hilly, forested landscape. Timber‑framed houses are scattered on the hillside, and in the foreground stands a large multi‑storey building with decorative gables and a tower-like central section identified as a hotel. Conifer and deciduous trees surround the buildings. The place name and region are printed at the top in red text, and the hotel name appears at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic cliff scene: a person stands and poses on the very edge of a protruding rock ledge high above a deep valley of rugged granite cliffs and distant mountains. The perspective emphasizes the steep drop below the ledge. At the bottom in red text it identifies the location as Overhanging Rock at Glacier Point in Yosemite Valley, California. There are also large printed catalog numbers in the middle of the card.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a wide view of exhibition buildings along a broad, unpaved avenue lined with small trees. On the left is a lower, gabled structure with decorative scrollwork on its façades, while to the right stands a larger, ornate exhibition hall with tall arched windows, domes, and detailed architectural ornamentation. Leafless trees and landscaped beds are visible in the foreground. Red printed text in Hungarian appears at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cultivated rural landscape with fields in the foreground, scattered trees and forest bands in the middle distance, and a large lake or body of water on the horizon. Small text is printed along the bottom edge, including a caption on the left and publisher information on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) postcard showing a small Romanesque-style church with a tall narrow bell tower and a rose window above the main entrance. The church stands at the end of a short path bordered by low walls, with trees and hills in the background and a small adjacent house to the right. Printed captions identify the city and the church; there is also a handwritten signature in ink on the right side.

Sepia-toned historic view of a European city street lined with multi-story townhouses. Horse-drawn carts and a few pedestrians move along a gently curving cobbled street. The buildings have typical late 19th–early 20th century facades with tall windows and some ornamental details. At the top of the card is printed the caption identifying the location as Bahnhofstraße in Borna, near Leipzig.

Sepia-toned reproduction of a medieval/early Renaissance religious fresco or panel painting showing two softly modeled angels in flowing robes, flying diagonally across a cracked, aged painted surface. Their feathered wings and drapery are elaborately detailed, and they appear within a curved architectural or celestial setting. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom typical of art-reproduction postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town with stone houses and tiled roofs at the foot of a rocky hill. On top of the rock stands a large building complex resembling a monastery or church, dominating the landscape. Low vegetation and garden plots appear in the foreground. Greek text is printed in the white margin at the bottom, along with a reference number and a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town with cobblestone streets curving between multi‑storey houses. In the background stands a large Gothic church with tall spires and a clock tower. In the foreground is a corner building with arched shopfronts and German writing on the façade. A few people, including a woman and a child, walk along the street, and a tram or carriage track runs through the scene. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.

An old Russian Empire-era postal card with preprinted Russian text in Cyrillic at the top reading 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (postal card). On the left is the imperial double-headed eagle emblem. The card is filled out in cursive handwriting, also in Cyrillic, with several black circular postal cancellation marks and a purple postage or official stamp on the upper right. The bottom has a printed line of text indicating that only the address is written on this side, along with a line mentioning Kiev.

Black‑and‑white / tinted historic street view labeled in German, showing a tree‑lined promenade with many pedestrians in early 20th‑century fashion. On the right are ornate multi‑story buildings with shopfronts and striped awnings; on the left is a park‑like avenue. Hills with buildings rise in the background. The red printed title at the top reads "Karlsbad. Am Eingang der alten Wiese."

A monochrome postcard showing a large medieval cathedral complex with multiple tall towers. Two slender Gothic spires with pinnacles stand at the western end, while two more massive, rounded Romanesque towers with domed tops rise behind them. In front is a long building with a steep roof and rows of small windows. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style German text identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large round tower and adjoining walls of a castle complex. The tower has small windows and a conical roof, and the wall in front looks aged and partly damaged. An ornate arched gate with large wooden doors stands to the right, guarded by two uniformed soldiers. Several civilians walk along the cobbled street outside the walls. On the tower the words "SCHLOSS HART…FEL…" are visible, and there is a commercial signboard on the wall below.

Vintage sepia postcard divided into two main photographs framed with floral ornamentation. The left photo shows a statue of a standing man on a high pedestal in a landscaped setting. The right photo depicts a river with industrial mill buildings and chimneys along the banks and a bridge in the background. Russian and German captions are printed under the right image identifying the location, and there is handwritten German text and a date at the bottom.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a stone and timber pier or breakwater extending into a calm sea. On the pier stand utility poles and a small skeletal lighthouse or beacon structure. A sailboat is visible on the right side of the image on the open water, and another beacon stands on a distant breakwater. The card has scalloped edges and printed caption text at the bottom left, plus a small number at the bottom center.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a landscaped park with a curving gravel path bordered by a low wooden fence, dense trees and bushes, and a prominent monument or statue set on a pedestal in the middle distance. A person in early 20th‑century clothing walks along the path. Printed red caption text at the bottom identifies the scene and publisher, with the year 1906.

Sepia-toned historical street view labeled "Grimma – Markt" showing the market square of a European town. Multi-story townhouses with gabled roofs line a broad cobblestone street. A few people walk in the middle of the square, and shop signs are visible on the façades, including a larger corner building on the right with a steep roof and a lamppost in the foreground.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town situated in a valley, surrounded by wooded hills and distant mountains. A straight, tree‑lined avenue runs from the foreground deep into the town. There are dense blocks of multi‑storey residential and institutional buildings in the foreground, with scattered houses, fields and some church spires further back. At the bottom edge of the image there is German text printed in white identifying the view, along with a small serial number.

A tinted vintage postcard depicting a quiet street with low houses and small towered buildings on the left, trees and hedges along the road, and additional buildings in the distance. The style is early 20th‑century, with printed captions at the bottom identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a tram running along a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk, stand, and push prams along the sidewalks. Overhead tram wires and shop signs are visible. The lower margin has printed red text identifying the location as Freiberg in Saxony and the specific street as Burgstrasse, along with the publisher credit.

Colorized vintage postcard showing traditional Dutch windmills along a waterside landscape. In the foreground is a large wooden windmill next to low buildings and greenery by a canal or river; another windmill stands in the distance on the opposite bank. The sky is pale yellow and blue, and there is printed caption text in the center bottom, with handwritten signatures or notes in ink.

Black-and-white image showing a quiet residential street lined with early 20th‑century houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the foreground, two children stand on the sidewalk, while another person rides a bicycle down the unpaved or partially paved street. The houses have small front gardens with brick fences. On the right side, the gable wall of a corner house bears a large painted business sign reading "Albert Pusch. Maurermeister". The sky is blank/overexposed and the upper-right corner of the card is slightly torn.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a townscape with a central square in the foreground, a few small houses, a tree with fencing around it, streetlights, and people standing near the base of the tree. In the background rises a large historic complex with a church-like tower and adjoining buildings on a hill. At the top in red script is the word "Dippoldiswalde." On the left margin there is vertically printed publisher information and a year.

A vintage printed postcard showing a large Gothic-style church with tall arched windows and a prominent entrance portal opening onto an empty square. The church has steep slate roofs, a richly ornamented tower rising behind the main body, and a small side structure with its own pointed roof. The colors are softly tinted, suggesting a hand-colored or early color-print postcard. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a church in Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal urban scene dominated by a large round stone tower with crenellations and a flag on top, located on a waterfront promenade beside a landscaped traffic circle with trees, cars, and pedestrians. The sea and a ship are visible in the background. Greek and French captions are printed along the bottom margin, and the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is overprinted on the image.

Color-tinted historic street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings with shops and awnings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. In the distance stands a domed church. Printed titles in Cyrillic and Latin identify the city as Varna and the street as Preslavska (Rue Preslavska). The card shows aging and surface wear.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings. On the left is a large, ornate building facing a small park or square with trees and paths. On the right are commercial buildings with shopfronts and awnings. Pedestrians walk along the street, and the overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European town. Text is printed along the bottom margin identifying the place and photographer.

An old monochrome postcard view of three villas in a rural, forested valley. In the foreground is a road and a low stone wall; behind it stand three separate houses labeled as villas, with dense coniferous forest and low hills in the background. The architectural style suggests late 19th to early 20th century Central Europe. Red printed captions in German identify each villa, and a greeting line is printed at the top.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town in a hilly landscape. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with twin spires and a large nave, surrounded by clustered village houses and a few larger buildings. The foreground shows sloping fields and farmhouses on a hillside. The sky area at the top is blank except for red printed German text on the left and a red handwritten note or date on the right.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a wooden building in a rural setting, with trees lining a dirt path. Several women in white nurse uniforms and one or two men stand outside and on a balcony, suggesting a medical or care facility. Printed caption text appears at the lower right of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing multi‑story masonry buildings along a wide, unpaved or lightly paved street with early 20th‑century horse‑drawn vehicles and a few pedestrians. A tall clock‑tower–like building stands in the mid‑distance on the right, with utility poles lining the street and a large tree canopy at the upper right. The style and layout suggest an early urban view. Printed text at the bottom right identifies the street and city, and there are two large handwritten or stamped numbers near the top center.

A black‑and‑white view of a hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The castle sits on a rocky cliff with steep rock faces in the foreground. The complex includes several large, simple-roofed buildings and towers with stepped gables and one slender spire, typical of Central European castles. Additional manor-style houses are visible along the ridge to the right. The sky is blank and overexposed. No visible caption or border text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cloistered courtyard with a formal garden of low box hedges and flower beds. An arcade with rounded arches and simple columns surrounds the courtyard on two levels. Above the cloister rises a square church bell tower with three stages of arched openings and a small pyramidal roof topped by a cross. The surrounding walls show aged plaster and shuttered windows, suggesting an old monastery or convent complex in a European town.

Sepia-toned postcard depicting a large open square with horse-drawn carriages and people in early 20th‑century dress. In the background stands a long neoclassical palace-like building with an arched central entrance, identified at the bottom as the Abdin Palace in Cairo. Promotional text for a tourist agency in Port Said appears printed over the sky area.

Vintage Christmas-themed postcard with a central illustration of a young child dressed in a white winter coat and hood, depicted as an angel with wings, standing on a small cloud. Below the illustration there is a printed poem in an older Scandinavian orthography, with the title in larger, bold text. The background is plain and light-colored.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neoclassical colonnade with many arches and columns, topped with statues and a balustrade. Crowds of people in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll along the promenade and beside a canal or river in front of the building. Trees rise behind the structure. The caption at the bottom right reads "Weltbad Karlsbad. Mühlbrunnkolonnade".

Black‑and‑white view of a European town scene with a small ornamental pond and fountain in the foreground, tree‑lined paths, and a street bordering the water. On the left stands a large, ornate café or hotel with a steep tiled roof and turret; the façade carries painted signs. On the right is a substantial stone church with Gothic Revival features and a very tall, slender spire rising above a square tower. Low hills are visible in the distant background. The overall composition and framing resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing several women in traditional dress standing at a stone fountain in a rural, rocky landscape. The fountain has an arched niche and spout. Printed text in Greek and French appears at the top, describing the scene as women at a fountain in Yenidje-Vardar, Macedonia.

Color postcard showing a central square with a large bronze statue of a robed man standing on an ornate stone pedestal decorated with allegorical female figures and inscriptions. The monument is surrounded by wreaths and ribbons. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with green shutters and shop awnings, and a clock tower with battlements. At the top of the image is a printed caption indicating the location and subject of the monument.

A black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a stone or terracotta Gothic-style sculpture showing the Virgin Mary kneeling and tenderly holding the Christ Child across her lap. Mary wears flowing drapery and a simple crown or headdress, and the background is a plain dark studio backdrop, suggesting the photograph was taken in a museum or church for art‑historical documentation.

An illustrated scene in a soft, watercolor style shows two small children in old-fashioned European clothing standing in a woodland setting. A young boy in a green jacket, striped trousers, and a tall hat leans against a tree while a young girl in a long coral-pink coatdress and a wide straw bonnet decorated with white flowers pins or adjusts a flower at his chest. They are surrounded by foxgloves, grass, and leafy trees, giving a romantic, storybook atmosphere typical of early 20th‑century children's book illustrations.

A colorized historic postcard view of a European town square lined with multi‑story buildings featuring steep red roofs and ornate façades. In the foreground is a large square with café tables and umbrellas surrounding a monumental fountain or statue ensemble. In the background, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower with large clock faces, part of a fortified structure. The caption printed at the top left reads "GRAZ, Hauptplatz," indicating the main square of Graz.

Vintage monochrome/hand‑colored style postcard showing a grand villa-like building with a tower and adjoining colonnaded structure set in formal gardens, framed by trees. Mountains or wooded hills rise in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the view as towards Café Kaiserpark in Karlsbad.

Colorized historic postcard showing a grand corner building in an urban square. The building has ornate Neo‑Baroque / Secessionist architecture with a domed roof, elaborate window frames, and columns over the main entrance. Pedestrians walk around the square and a small kiosk or monument with a red roof is visible in the foreground. Printed captions at the top identify the subject and location.

A monochrome postcard showing a hilltop lookout-tower building with a tall square tower and attached house-like structure, surrounded by trees and landscaped terraces. A path with a railing leads up through the woods to the building. Printed red text in German appears in the upper left, and the building façade itself carries an inscription with the same name.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a low, wide waterfall with smooth cascading water in a rural landscape. People in old-fashioned clothing stand near the edge of the waterfall and along a path above it, with wooden fences, a small building, and trees in the background. The right side of the card is blank except for the printed place name "Goldingen.", while beneath the image is the caption "Reschewasserfall." and along the left margin is the publisher information printed vertically.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small settlement nestled at the foot of terraced vineyard hills. A road with street lamps runs through the foreground, lined with modest houses and garden plots. On the right stands a larger manor‑like building with a decorative roof, and other farm or estate buildings nearby. The slopes behind are divided into many horizontal terraces, likely for wine cultivation. Red printed German text appears in the lower right, with a printer's line at the very bottom and a handwritten number in red ink at the top.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European village at the edge of a forested hillside. In the foreground is a long, ivy‑covered timber or masonry building with a tiled roof and several windows; in front of it stands a woman in a long dress. To the right are outdoor tables and chairs suggesting an inn or guesthouse garden. Behind the houses rises a church with a steep roof and a square tower topped by a small spire, set against densely wooded, hilly terrain.

A colorized historic postcard view of a hilltop complex overlooking a town with red-roofed houses and a river valley in the background. Dominating the scene is a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and adjacent castle-like buildings, all surrounded by greenery and old fortification walls. At the top left, printed in red script, is a caption identifying the location, and there is a small handwritten red inscription at the top right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small mountain village with an alpine backdrop. Prominently featured are a tall, narrow church bell tower with a clock and adjoining church, as well as the adjacent municipal building. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Pejo's town hall and church at an altitude of 1580 meters. There is some handwritten cursive text on the front. The card has a simple cream border and printed publisher information along the bottom edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing an old European city street lined with brick townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart stands on the right side of the street. In the distance a tall church spire rises above the roofs. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the scene, and small publisher information appears at the lower left.

Colorized aerial view of a historic spa town nestled in a valley, surrounded by forested hills and open fields. The foreground shows dense blocks of ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs, red and gray roof tiles, and a small park. On the left there is a church with a tall spire. The town curves along a river or canal on the right side. At the top left of the image, in red capital letters, is the printed title 'KARLSBAD Westend'.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river, with supporting concrete piers. On the right bank stands a multi‑story tower-like building on a wooded hill, with a flag on top. In the foreground, foliage and the river are visible. At the bottom, there is printed Dutch text identifying the scene as the new Waal bridge with the Belvédère in Nijmegen.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a veiled woman in a full white cloak standing in front of an ornate Moorish-style doorway, with carved floral decorations and heavy studded wooden door panels. A barefoot boy in traditional clothing sits on the step beside her. The architectural style is North African/Maghrebi. French captioning appears at the bottom.

Black-and-white view of a small town scene with a metal road bridge and adjoining pedestrian path crossing a stony riverbank. In the background stands a rectangular two‑storey building and several wooden houses with pitched roofs. A cyclist is crossing the bridge and an early automobile is visible on the road beyond. There are telegraph poles and a simple street lamp. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a forest path winding alongside a small stream or ditch. Tall trees with dense foliage line both sides of the path, some with carvings or signs on their trunks. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Dutch that identifies the scene as a brook path near Hotel "De Plasmolen".

A vintage postcard showing a full‑length portrait of a man in traditional Greek costume (fustanella, embroidered vest, red fez-like cap with a dark blue tassel, white stockings, and pom‑pom shoes). The background is a painted studio backdrop with rocks and a neutral landscape. The lower part contains printed captions and handwritten correspondence.

Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobblestone square in a historic European town, centered on a Baroque/Renaissance-style town building with a small tower and clock. The facade bears the inscription "KOENIGLICHES AMTSGERICHT" (Royal District Court). Large pruned trees stand in front of the building, and a lamppost is visible. Surrounding the square are traditional gabled houses with shops on the ground floor. A few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the square. Church spires rise in the distance on the left.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside or coastal scene with small houses among trees and several boats pulled up on the shore. In the background stands a large triangular-gabled stone ruin of a church or monastery. A person rows a small boat in the foreground water. In the upper left corner there is a circular emblem with text surrounding a stylized drawing of the same ruin. The caption "Pirita" appears below the image.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a wide Alpine valley with steep rocky mountains in the background. The foreground shows terraced hillsides, vineyards, orchards, scattered farmhouses and villas, and winding rural roads descending toward a densely built town in the center of the valley. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a freestanding Orthodox church with multiple onion-like domes topped by crosses. The building is in Neo‑Byzantine style, with arched windows, decorative brickwork, and a large central dome surrounded by smaller domes. A fenced yard and gas‑style street lamps frame the front entrance; low town buildings are visible in the background. There is no printed caption or writing on the image side.

A tinted night‑view postcard showing a river curving through a town. On the left bank stands a skyline with a tall, narrow church spire and other historic buildings; on the right rises a high embankment or fortification wall with large multi‑story houses or a palace‑like structure at the top. Above the scene a bird (likely a dove) flies while carrying a small calendar page reading "Januar 1", suggesting a New Year greeting. The overall color tone is dark with a yellowish sky reflected in the river.

A black‑and‑white image of a steamship breaking through sea ice in a wintry landscape. The ship has a dark hull with a light, ice‑covered bow, a single tall smokestack, masts with rigging, and several crew visible on deck. In the background are low, forested shores under a pale sky. A flag is flying at the stern, but the details are indistinct.

An old black‑and‑white postcard view of an urban street intersection. Cobblestone streets are lined with multi‑story stone buildings with shops on the ground floor and tall windows above. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square, and there are streetlamps and tram tracks or rails visible. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as Jerntorget with Andra Långgatan in Göteborg (Gothenburg), and there is a reference number and museum credit at the bottom.

A vintage-style postcard featuring a black‑ink line drawing portrait of a bearded man in formal 19th‑century attire with a bow tie, facing slightly to the left. Beneath the portrait is the printed caption "Ant. Dvořák." The background is plain, and there is also a small artist signature near the lower right of the portrait.

Colorized postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic castle complex and Gothic cathedral on a hill. A long white paddle steamer named "WETTIN" is in the foreground on the river. The castle with round tower and the twin-spired church dominate the skyline. Red-roofed houses line the riverbank. The words "Meissen" appear at the upper left, and "Kgl. Albrechtsburg u. Dom." at the upper right, with a red handwritten number in the top right corner.

A black-and-white postcard view of a rural church with a tall steeple, bare trees and wooden houses with fenced yards in the foreground. The church is the central subject, with simple Gothic-style windows and a steep roof. Printed text at the bottom identifies the church and publisher in Swedish.

An old beige postal card from Peru with printed heading and a blue printed stamp image of a man's portrait valued at four centavos. The card is addressed in handwritten Spanish script to a recipient in Madrid, Spain. There is a circular black postmark partly covering the stamp area, dated 1900. The design is simple, dominated by text rather than imagery.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a large European square bustling with people, trams, and a military parade of uniformed soldiers marching with rifles. In the center stands an equestrian monument on a high pedestal. Around the square are grand multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs and clock towers, tree‑lined streets, ornate lampposts, and a kiosk covered with period advertisements in German. The clothing and vehicles suggest an early‑20th‑century setting.

A black-and-white panoramic view over a European town with a large landscaped park in the foreground. Curving walking paths wind through open grassy areas planted with many small trees and shrubs, leading toward a pond or small lake with islands, bridges, and pavilions. Beyond the park lies a row of townhouses and larger urban buildings, including several multi‑story brick factories or warehouses with chimneys. A long masonry railway viaduct with a series of arches crosses the middle distance, while a church with a tall spire rises among dense townhouses further back. Low wooded hills form the horizon. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.

A vividly colored postcard-style illustration dominated by a large dark blue eagle standing on a sword and stone against a bright yellow sky. Below the eagle is a golden emblem and a stylized cityscape in red and orange tones. At the bottom, in ornate Gothic script, German text advertises a regional gymnastics festival in Graz in 1929. Printer information appears in small text at the upper left.

Sepia-toned portrait of a person in traditional or theatrical costume holding a zither-like string instrument, standing indoors against a plain wall. The clothing includes a decorated tunic, sash, loose trousers, boots, and a cap. Printed text appears in the lower left corner of the image.
