A monochrome religious postcard featuring an illustration of Jesus Christ standing and preaching from a boat to a crowd gathered on the shore and in another boat. The style resembles a 19th‑century academic painting. At the bottom, there is bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the scene, along with the name Alibros and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing the archaeological ruins of a basilica with rows of stone columns and column bases leading toward the sea. The image is labeled at the top with the location and name of the site, indicating it is a view of the ruins of the Basilica of Saint Cyprian in Carthage.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural village street with plastered houses on both sides, trees and fences, a horse‑drawn wagon in the center, and people standing along the unpaved road. In the background a church or manor tower with a dome and spire rises above the trees. The lower margin has red printed German text including a greeting and a publisher credit.

Black‑and‑white view down a very narrow alley lined with tall, old multi‑story houses. Each building has stacked wrought‑iron balconies overflowing with laundry hanging out to dry and some potted plants. The architecture is dense and irregular, with stucco and stone walls and tiled roofs. In the background are steep, rocky mountains, suggesting a town built in a valley or on a hillside. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a domed church building with classical architectural elements, situated on a landscaped hill beside a road. The structure has a large central dome with a lantern, arched windows, and adjoining wings; in the background are additional hospital-style buildings and a tree-covered hillside. Printed text at the top identifies the location as a church of the regional hospital in Graz.

Vintage black‑and‑white portrait of a young girl with long hair wearing a bow and a pearl necklace. She is shown in profile looking down, dressed in an ornate, high‑necked dress. Greek text identifying her appears at the bottom left, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing the interior of a densely packed folk‑art or handicraft shop. Under a stone arch hang wrought‑iron lanterns and nautical‑style decorative wheels, while shelves and walls are filled with plates, ceramics, metalwork, masks, and ornamental objects. Prominently in the foreground is a carved wooden figure of a crowned person, possibly a Madonna or saint, with another angelic figure above. The scene feels like a tourist‑oriented curio shop in an old town.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing the tall tower and spire of a church rising above a dense cluster of old town roofs. The tower has arched windows and an open belfry with a steep spire. At the top left, in Gothic-style script, is the title "Trinitatiskirche." At the bottom left, framed in a small box, is the word "Mitau." A small artist's signature appears in the upper right border.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a view framed by three large arched columns, looking out over a broad piazza with a central baroque fountain and surrounding historic buildings. A church bell tower and another tower rise above the rooftops, and mountains are visible in the distant background. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the scene as Trento and Piaz(z)a Vittorio Emanuele III, seen from the Duomo.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an elegant multi‑storey historicist corner building with ornate façades and domed corner turrets. In front of it stands a tall obelisk‑style war memorial topped with an eagle. The street scene includes several people walking and a horse‑drawn cart. A shop sign on the ground floor reads "SINGER G. NAHMASCHINEN – ACT. GES." The printed caption at the bottom identifies the view as a new war monument in Graz.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a small European town in a hilly, rural area. In the foreground and middle ground are dense clusters of gabled houses with light façades and dark roofs. At the center stands a church with a tall square tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and cross. Commercial buildings with painted advertisements line the main street; one large building in the right foreground carries legible signage. Behind the town are open fields and meadows leading up to forested hills covered with coniferous trees. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century central European village captured in a scenic panoramic photograph, typical of vintage postcards.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a colonial-style stone church with arched portico, heavy buttresses and two ornate bell towers. To the left stands a separate, simpler bell tower with two large arched openings. There is a stone cross on a pedestal in front of the church and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing walking or standing nearby. In the upper left corner, handwritten text identifies the building as the Church of Santo Domingo in Ayacucho.

Sepia-toned view of a large hilltop castle complex with a tall central tower rising above multiple terraced buildings, surrounded by dense forest. In the foreground a small river flows through a landscaped valley with paths, fences, and gardens along its banks. The scene is rural and tranquil. At the top of the image, printed in red German text, is the title of the view.

Color-printed vintage view of an Italian square showing historic buildings around an open piazza. A tall crenellated clock tower (Torre Grande) dominates the right side, with a domed church structure on the left and a large fountain in front of the central building. There is a printed caption at the bottom and vertical handwritten message on the right margin.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a tree-lined cobblestone avenue leading to a station building with an arched façade and central dome. People and children are standing or walking in the foreground, and carts or carriages line the right side. The caption at the top reads in German, identifying the place as the railway station.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large, multi‑storey wooden building with a central tower and steep roof, surrounded by deep snow and dense coniferous forest. The structure looks like a resort, spa, or sanatorium. At the top center of the image there is printed text that reads "Mesnaliens Kursted." The style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard from a Nordic region.

Vintage black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard showing a street scene with Hartmann's Restaurant in Meissen. Large trees partially hide an outdoor garden restaurant terrace filled with people. Adjacent multi‑storey buildings carry painted advertisements including "Säuberlichs Restaurant." Cobblestone streets with several pedestrians in early 20th‑century attire run alongside the buildings. Printed red caption text at the top identifies the location and restaurant, and red publisher text appears at the bottom left.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a stone belfry tower with machicolations and a steep spire, attached to old tiled-roof buildings on a narrow street. A traditional inn with a balcony and shuttered windows stands beside the tower. The scene is labeled as part of a picturesque view of the Auvergne region and identifies the tower as the southern side of the belfry from the 16th century in Besse.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a busy open-air bazaar with many stalls and people in traditional clothing. In the background, on a small hill, stands a fort-like structure with a flag. The sky is rendered in pastel tones. Text printed at the top left identifies the scene as a bazaar near Fort Napoleon in Alexandria. A modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a calm river bordered by trees and shrubs, with a low metal bridge crossing the water at mid‑distance. In the background are gentle hills and more woodland. At the top left, there is printed German text identifying the place.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over leafy garden terraces and rooftops toward a large hilltop complex with tall Gothic spires and historic buildings. The scene shows the Burgberg in Meissen above the Elbe River, with the prominent twin-towered cathedral rising over the town. Printed white text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large, ornate, three‑story brick commercial building occupying a street corner. The structure has arched windows, decorative stonework, and a prominent central corner tower with a domed roof. Ground-floor storefronts wrap around both visible facades; one corner entrance is marked as a bank, and there are painted signs for various businesses. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians stand along the unpaved street, with utility poles and overhead wires visible, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban setting.

Black‑and‑white view over a calm river or lake with several small rowboats in the foreground. On the opposite bank stand three ornate late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century villas surrounded by dense trees, with forested hills rising behind them. The left villa is light‑colored with a balcony, the middle villa has a decorative tower, and the right villa is a larger brick building with dormer windows. Two of the villas display German‑language names on their façades.

Black‑and‑white street scene in a small coastal town with wooden houses, a steep rock face on the right, and several people walking along a quiet road. Parked 1930s–1940s style cars appear on the right. In the distance a church spire rises above the rooftops. Printed caption text is at the lower left, and a publisher's logo with a number is at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view over a forested river or lake system with a small lock or dam in the foreground. A passenger steamboat or motor vessel is passing through the lock along a narrow pier, surrounded by dense coniferous and mixed woodland on rolling hills. The scene looks like a scenic rural waterway, possibly part of a canal with timber structures and calm water, photographed from an elevated vantage point.

A colorized panoramic view over a waterfront town on a hilly shoreline, with many houses and larger buildings along a curved bay or river. The water is in the foreground, green hills with scattered structures are in the background. There is a red Ottoman-era postage stamp (20 paras) in the upper left corner. At the top center is printed text identifying the view, and there are handwritten notes in pen across the sky area and right side. The card has a printed website watermark at the bottom right.

Colorized panoramic view over a rural village surrounded by fields and vineyards. Red‑roofed houses are scattered among dense greenery, and a small white church tower with a dark dome rises on the right. In the foreground are vineyard rows with wooden stakes. At the top left in red letters appears the word "Baltavár." A small red number "8508" is printed vertically along the left edge.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a long Renaissance-style brick building with ornate statues between tall windows and round medallions along the upper façade. A cobblestone street runs in front of the structure, and a single person stands near the main entrance stairs. Printed at the top is the caption 'Stadhuis — Nijmegen.'

A modern, minimalist postcard featuring a close-up of a human eye in grayscale, except for the iris, which is vividly colored in blue and green tones. The Dutch phrase "Tot ziens in Nijmegen" is printed in large, simple black letters above and below the eye on a light gray background.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a bustling open-air market (zoco/souk). People in traditional North African clothing walk and shop along a cobblestone street lined with stalls covered by fabric awnings. The foreground shows tables piled with fruits and vegetables. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as a detail of the market in Tetuan.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Gothic‑style exterior staircase attached to a historic building. The staircase leads up through arched openings supported by slender columns, with richly carved stonework, tracery, and a large decorative crest above the arch. Adjacent façades have tall mullioned windows and carved details. Text at the bottom identifies the view as the staircase of the library in Bruges.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an outdoor terrace with many empty chairs and tables, surrounded by decorative railings, garden beds, and palm trees in large planters. Round globe lamps stand on posts around the terrace, and behind it is a pavilion building with large arched windows. The caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Black-and-white coastal scene showing a rocky shoreline and sandy beach with scattered people enjoying the water. Low houses stand in the background, and a flagpole with a Scandinavian-style flag is visible to the right. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and lower right corners indicating the location and photographer/publisher information.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside town with a long wooden bridge in the foreground reflected in calm water. Behind the bridge stand low wooden and stone buildings, trees, and a church or clock‑tower rising above the town. The caption at the top reads "Hämeenlinna. — Tavastehus." in plain serif type.

Color postcard showing a row of historic half-timbered and gabled houses with steep red-tiled roofs. The main foreground building is a large, irregular medieval house with exposed timber framing on the upper parts and plastered walls, small rectangular windows, and wooden shutters. Adjacent buildings feature stepped gables typical of late medieval or Renaissance urban architecture. The scene is taken on a sunny day with a blue sky and scattered clouds; no visible modern cars or signage appear in the image.

A sepia-toned photograph of a large formal gathering in a courtyard surrounded by a two‑story arcade with arches and balconies. Dozens of well‑dressed men and women in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing fill the courtyard, many wearing hats and light-colored dresses or suits. Potted plants and small trees line the edges of the space. On the upper floors, additional people watch from windows and balconies. At the far end of the courtyard is a decorative arch or stage with greenery and a central emblem above it, giving the impression of a ceremonial or festive event in a grand civic or hotel building. The overall format and border suggest it is an early photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a hilly rural landscape, photographed from a slope above the settlement. In the foreground are fenced gardens, fields, and a few detached houses. A curving road leads toward the town. The middle ground shows dense clusters of traditional gabled houses and several factory chimneys. Two large church buildings with tall towers and baroque-style spires dominate the skyline. Beyond the town lie gently rolling, mostly treeless fields. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a walled entrance gate in a pine forest, leading along a straight road to a large multi‑storey institutional building with a steep tiled roof and dormers. The gatehouse has a hipped tile roof, arched wooden door with metal bars and small signs, and is attached to a plastered wall with vertical fence slats. Tall, thin conifer trees dominate both sides of the road. The architecture suggests an early‑20th‑century Central European sanatorium, hospital, or similar facility.

Color postcard-style image of a busy harbor in summer. In the foreground is a parking area filled with 1950s–1960s European cars, caravans, and a few small buildings. Many people are gathered near a ferry terminal at the water's edge. A large white passenger ferry is docked, flying blue flags with yellow Nordic-style crosses. Several small islands and sailboats are visible in the background under a clear sky.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic photograph of a coastal city with dense low-rise buildings and numerous minarets visible across the skyline. The view is taken from a hill overlooking the city and the sea in the background. Printed titles appear at the top in Greek and French, and there is a website watermark at the bottom right.

Colorized vintage view of a lakeside scene with a grand building featuring two pointed towers and large arched windows on the far shore. Small rowing boats line the edge of the water. The foreground shows trees and shrubs framing the calm pond. At the top left, printed red text reads "Graz: Hilmteich."

Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a country house or small inn on a hill with trees and a path leading up to it. At the left border there is an ornamental drawing of bell-shaped flowers in an Art Nouveau style. The upper left contains the artist's name, and to the right of the flowers is German text that identifies the place as the Bergschlößchen in Sommerfeld, with the proprietor named A. Brunsch. Much of the lower half is left blank for writing a message.

Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographic views of grand historic buildings, decorated with floral motifs and overlaid with dense handwritten script. The left image shows a large neo‑Renaissance opera house on a busy square with carriages and people (the Vienna State Opera). The right image shows a curved, ornate theater building with columns and statues (the Burgtheater). Printed captions in German identify the city as Wien and the buildings as imperial theaters. There is a handwritten date in the early 1900s on the right side and extensive cursive correspondence across the lower half.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing a busy European town square lined with tall historic buildings featuring gabled roofs and arcades. In the center stands a large fountain or monument surrounded by people and market stalls with umbrellas. In the background, on a hill, there is a clock tower overlooking the city. The scene is rendered in a detailed line drawing. At the bottom right, decorative script text reads "Graz, Hauptplatz," and a small imprint credits an atelier.

Colorized historic postcard view of a European city square labeled "Bismarckplatz" with multi‑story classical buildings, shop awnings, a central fountain and garden in the foreground, and a prominent baroque church tower in the background. The word "Graz" is printed at the top right and there is small handwriting and the number 776 at the lower right.

Vintage monochrome postcard with two inset photographs framed by floral illustrations. The upper, larger image shows a rural inn or guesthouse with the sign "Gasthaus z. m. Fuchswirth des Franz Trieb" on the facade, a few people seated outside, and trees and a fence along a dirt road. The lower, smaller image depicts a long, two‑storey classical building with many windows and a central pediment, likely a school or public building. Decorative script text in German runs across the middle and bottom of the card.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a church with a tall central tower and spire, flanked by several multi‑storey residential buildings. In the foreground there are cultivated fields and small trees, giving the impression of a town edge or new suburb. The image has a simple printed caption in the upper left corner that reads "Coswig i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white view of a grand multi‑storey hotel or villa in a spa town setting. The central building has a corner tower with steep roof and decorative cresting; on the tower façade the words "KAISER WILHELM" are visible. It is surrounded by lush trees, a wrought‑iron riverside or park railing in the foreground, and other ornate 19th‑century buildings. In the background, wooded hills rise behind the town, with another large structure on the slope.

An old monochrome postcard with an ornate illustrated frame around a central photograph of a large, rectangular, three‑storey building on a street corner in winter. People stand near the building on a snowy or bare street. The left side of the frame shows a Swedish-style coat of arms with a castle on a shield, a flag, laurel branches, and a lion resting its paw on a sphere. The top and right borders are decorated with a dragon/serpent motif containing Swedish text. At the bottom, in decorative script, it reads "Svenska Folkförbundets Hem i Kalmar." The card is signed in the lower-right corner "H. Söndberg 1910."

An illustrated postcard view of a waterfront promenade in Port Said, with a quay on the left lined with moored boats and a sailing ship, and a street on the right bordered by multi‑story colonial buildings with balconies and shop awnings. In the foreground stands an ornate fountain or monument with a figure on top, surrounded by pedestrians in late‑19th‑century attire and a horse‑drawn carriage. The sky shows a soft sunset. The caption at the bottom reads "PORT SAID, Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee." and there is also a faint website watermark across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town or resort city built on a hillside. In the foreground and mid‑ground are rows of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings lining a broad tree‑planted boulevard or promenade. On the right stands a prominent synagogue‑like structure with two square towers topped by onion domes and a large rose window over the entrance. Behind the street, villas and grand hotels climb the wooded slope, with a church or chapel and other buildings at the top of the hill. The streets are relatively quiet with only a few pedestrians and early motor vehicles or carriages visible. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a rural village in a river valley, with rows of two‑ and three‑storey houses along a main street in the foreground, surrounded by trees and farmland. In the distance are fields, scattered farm buildings and low hills. Red printed caption text in German appears at the top of the image.

An old, tinted postcard view of a rocky sea shore. A woman in a long dark dress stands on the rocks looking out over the water, with waves breaking around her feet. The sea is calm in the distance and the sky is pale. Printed captions in a serif font identify the scene and location, including a title at the top right and the word "Constanţa" at the bottom.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a large, elegant building with a red-tiled roof, arched windows, and a long veranda covered with ivy and climbing plants. Formal garden paths and manicured flower beds lead up to the structure. The scene is labeled with German text at the bottom margin, indicating it is part of a military training area and specifically an officers' casino.

Black‑and‑white image of a large neo‑Romanesque / neo‑Gothic church with two tall octagonal towers topped by domes and crosses, and a third, more slender spire to the left. The nave has tall pointed‑arch windows with tracery and buttresses. In the foreground is a small landscaped square with trees and a polygonal fountain or monument crowned by a statue. A few pedestrians walk along the cobbled street surrounding the church. The image has the margins and wear typical of an old photographic postcard or plate.

Sepia-toned historical view of a town square with multi-story buildings surrounding a cobblestone piazza. In the center is a decorative fountain where people gather with donkeys and carts. Several adults and children in early 20th-century clothing stand or walk across the square. The architecture is typical of an Italian alpine village, with arched porticos on the central building. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Pieve Tesino in Trentino and names the square Piazza Maggiore.

A black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing a gently curving road lined with 2–3 story wooden buildings with shop awnings on the left and trees and fencing on the right. Several pedestrians, including children and adults, walk along the street while a horse‑drawn cart stands further back. The word "Elverum." is printed at the top center of the image, and there are small numbers at the bottom edge typical of early photographic postcards.

A monochrome (sepia-toned) image showing a massive medieval stone structure, likely a round or polygonal tower attached to a larger fortification. The tower has thick rough stone walls, small narrow window slits, a high arched opening, and a steep conical tiled roof. The surrounding area appears to be an open yard with bare ground in the foreground and trees framing the right and upper edges. There is a narrow printed border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or other printing appears on the front.

Color-printed postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground crossed by iron bridges, lined with grand 19th‑century buildings and red‑roofed houses. Above the city rises a wooded hill with fortification walls and a notable clock tower structure. The caption area at the bottom reads the city and location name.

Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a straight city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. A small group of uniformed soldiers and a drummer walk down the center of the street, with a church tower visible in the distance. On the right side, a hanging sign advertises a guest garden and bowling alley. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street in Graz, named Lazarethgasse.

Sepia-toned military postcard showing two ranks of uniformed soldiers with rifles facing each other in a barracks courtyard, with an officer standing between them. The scene depicts a ceremonial change of the barracks guard. German text is printed in red at the bottom identifying Freiberg and the Jäger Battalion No. 12.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a river cutting through a rocky valley with forested slopes. A long bridge crosses the river mid‑scene, with a town and factory chimneys visible beyond. On the right stands a prominent church with a tall spire above the trees. The lower margin contains printed red text and over it a dense handwritten message in dark ink.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a wooden railway station building surrounded by trees. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit along the platform, including several children in hats and dresses. Railway tracks run in the foreground. A large signboard on the building advertises goods, and printed text at the top of the image reads "Rönninge Järnvägsstation."

Vintage sepia postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two‑story half‑timbered and plaster townhouses covered with climbing vines. People in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand and walk along the street. In the far background a church tower rises above the roofs. The caption in red German script appears at the bottom left, with publishing information in smaller red type at the bottom.

Colorized vintage view of a large European town square with historic multi-story buildings surrounding an open plaza. In the center stands an ornate monument with several statues and a staircase, surrounded by people and market stalls shaded by white umbrellas. A tram is visible on the right. Printed at the top is the caption 'Graz, Hauptplatz', and there is handwritten text with a date at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small town nestled in densely forested hills. In the middle distance stands a prominent church with a tall, slender spire and adjacent buildings, surrounded by clustered houses. Coniferous trees dominate the foreground and hills, suggesting a mountainous or upland region. There is a small code or number printed in white in the lower right corner of the image.

A color lithographic postcard showing a lively scene in front of a grand pavilion-like building labeled as the main wine restaurant. Numerous well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion stroll and gather in an open square or fairground. Several ornate buildings with red roofs and towers stand in the background, decorated with flags. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as Düsseldorf 1902 and mention the Haupt Weinrestaurant, with a publisher line referencing Düsseldorf.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a dramatic sunset scene over a river. In the foreground, a long passenger steamboat moves along the water. In the background, on a hill, there is a dark silhouette of a large complex with multiple spires and towers, strongly suggesting a historic cathedral and castle complex. Thick clouds are illuminated from behind by the setting sun, creating a high-contrast sky. A German caption appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a spa park area with an Evangelical church featuring a massive stone tower and steep pointed spire on the left, a landscaped garden and small pavilion/greenhouse in the center, forested hills with a peak in the distance, and a dark wooden house with flower boxes on the right. Printed caption text runs along the bottom edge.

A black-and-white postcard view of a small village set in a hilly, forested landscape. Several houses with steep roofs stand along a tree‑lined road and open fields in the foreground, while dense coniferous forest covers the hills in the background. At the bottom border of the image there is a caption in German script indicating the place and its elevation.

Colorized vintage street view of a European town. Tall multi‑story buildings with shutters line both sides of a broad street where a few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible. In the distance, on a hillside, a fortified complex or castle rises above the town. The caption at the top reads "ROVERETO – S. Maria," and on the left façade a sign reads "PICCOLO ROVAZZI."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a lodge‑style building on the edge of a forest, surrounded by a meadow. The structure has a hipped roof with dormer windows and a veranda or terrace. Printed titles appear at the top and bottom in Polish and German, indicating a mountain shelter/hostel near Jelenia Góra/Hirschberg.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street with several people standing and walking near a whitewashed fountain structure built into a wall, under a large tree. A lamppost projects from the wall above the fountain. In the background are traditional buildings lining the street. The lower margin contains printed French text identifying the scene, and the name of the publisher in Lyon.

The image appears to be a reproduction of a medieval European painting printed as a postcard. It shows a stylized scene with two human figures in front of castle-like architecture. On the right, a woman in a long green and yellow gown stands under a small tower or gateway, reading or holding an open book, with a small white animal (likely a dog) at her feet. On the left, a man in a red outfit and hat walks out of a fortified gate or castle doorway, holding an object in his arms, while another white animal runs along a path. The background consists of worn, fresco-like walls and towers in muted tones, giving an aged, historical look. There is no visible printed text or caption on the postcard front.

Tinted vintage postcard depicting a landscaped park scene with rocky artificial cliffs, stairways, a small waterfall flowing into a pond, and people standing on the steps. Trees and a lawned hill with statuary appear in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen, Kronenburger Park," and a vertical printer's credit appears along the left edge.

A colorized historic street scene showing an urban square leading into a long straight street lined with multi‑story stone buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the open space, while shopfronts occupy the ground floors. Ornate street lamps and a small fenced planted area appear in the foreground. The caption at the top in German identifies the view as looking from Postplatz into Gaschwitzerstraße in Bautzen.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a row of vintage biplanes parked on a grassy airfield under a partly cloudy sky. The planes are lined up diagonally into the distance, with visible numbers such as 34, 36, and 37 on their fuselages. In the lower left corner is the caption "Varbergs Flygfält." and in the lower right corner there is a photographer's imprint and credits.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small hillside village with clustered houses and two prominent church towers, surrounded by fields and rolling terrain, with mountains faintly visible in the background. The caption at the bottom margin reads "TRES - Val di Non (Trentino)".

Black‑and‑white postal card with printed stamp and official markings. The right side shows a boxed printed indicium with three crowns above the denomination "öre 040 öre" and the word "SVERIGE" beneath, along with several handwritten signatures. There is a round postmark from Malmö dated 12 VI 42 and a rectangular reception stamp dated 15 SEP 1942. The left side is mostly blank except for typewritten and handwritten notations.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a fortified gate and clock tower seen from a tree‑lined road. Pruned trees flank the road leading toward an arched entrance in a stone fortress wall. A tall clock tower with a pointed roof rises behind the wall. Several uniformed soldiers stand and walk along the right side of the road. The handwritten word "Belgrad" appears in the upper right corner.

A vintage colorized postcard showing a tall, narrow brick Gothic-style building on a street corner. The façade has large pointed-arch windows and a decorative clock or sign with a sun emblem near the top. The ground floor houses a shop with red-painted storefront and signage, and a few people stand on the sidewalk in front. Surrounding structures are older European townhouses. A green postage stamp with a circular Bruges postmark is visible in the upper right corner. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a house associated with Charles V in Bruges.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large statue of a man in military uniform standing on a tall stone pedestal in a landscaped area with low plants in the foreground. The figure wears a long coat and a spiked helmet, standing with hands on hips. The pedestal bears the inscription "ALBERT" on its side. In the background to the right is a two‑story building with typical Central European architecture and some faint signage on its facade; trees and a low wall are visible to the left.

A vintage handwritten postcard on aged brown paper, written in Spanish cursive. The text begins with the place and date line at the top: "Constantinopla, el 20 de julio 1910". The rest is a dense, neatly written message discussing a dramatic work titled "Don Isaac" and its reception in Constantinople, including mentions of newspapers and possible publication in Spain. A small printed label in the bottom left corner reads "M.C.D.2020".

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large wooden house or pavilion with a red roof, chimney, and surrounding pine trees on a rocky, sloping hillside. A staircase and wooden railings lead up to the building. At the bottom margin there is printed text identifying the view.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded parliamentary chamber during a formal session. The room is grand, with high walls, balconies filled with spectators, and elaborate lamps. A large bust of a woman, symbolizing the Republic, is visible on the left wall. Dozens of suited men occupy curved benches, while a speaker stands at a central podium. The scene captures the reading of the proclamation of the Republic at the inaugural session of the Constituent Assembly.

Vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town surrounded by fields and forested hills. In the left foreground stands a prominent church-like tower with a clock, while rows of pitched-roof houses and a few industrial chimneys stretch across the middle ground. The sky is blank and lightly aged, and red printed text at the top identifies the place. Additional small red printing appears in the lower right corner.

Colorized historic postcard labeled 'Karisbad. Westend.' showing an elegant urban streetscape with tree-lined green space in the foreground and ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings in the background. On the left is a grand mansion identified as Villa Ritter, next to another large building marked Evangel. Hospiz. On the right stands a prominent Russian Orthodox church with onion domes of blue and gold topped with crosses, labeled Russische Kirche. The lower margin includes the publisher imprint and a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a small octagonal stone chapel with a tower and weather vane, surrounded by tall trees. In the background there is a riverside view with boats and a promenade with white railings. Dutch captions are printed below and along the side, and a handwritten name appears on the right margin.

Colorized illustration of a Gothic cathedral with two tall, ornate towers and pointed spires dominating a small square. The church façade has intricate tracery, large arched windows, and a smaller entrance structure with a red roof in front. Surrounding the cathedral are old town buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the upper left corner appears a printed title in German.

The image shows the reverse side of an old postcard. There is a vertical dividing line separating the address area on the right from the message on the left. On the right, a name and town are written in cursive German script, with space for a stamp in the upper left corner. Along the bottom edge, printed text in German identifies the printer or publisher. The handwriting is in dark ink and appears to be dated in the early 20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large military parade ground flanked by two long, four‑storey barracks buildings with hipped roofs and many windows. On the open square, soldiers are standing in formation, drilling, or marching, with officers observing. Training equipment and simple wooden structures are visible around the edges. A red handwritten number "26731" appears at the top right, and a printed caption along the bottom identifies the location as an infantry regiment barracks in Grimma.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large institutional complex composed of several multi‑storey light-colored buildings with mansard roofs and tall windows, set behind a gently sloping park with scattered trees and a path in the foreground. In the bottom-left corner there is printed text identifying the place, and in the bottom-right corner a small oval logo of the photographer or publisher.

Vintage multi-view postcard with two black‑and‑white photographs. The left image shows a tall round stone tower attached to a building, partly hidden by trees and a wooden fence; it is labeled "Pfarrhaus mit Turm". The right image shows a narrow street lined with traditional half‑timbered or gabled houses with shopfronts and people in the street; it is labeled "Partie an der Friedrichstraße". Beneath the images is the printed caption "Gruß aus Osterburken". The lower part of the card contains handwritten cursive text in blue ink.

Colorized historic view over a European town with red-tiled roofs and a prominent clock‑towered civic building in the foreground. The scene is taken from an elevated vantage point, likely a castle hill, looking across the town and out to low hills in the distance. Printed German text at the top reads "Bilin. Blick vom Schloß."

Colorized historic postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance spa or palace-like building with two domed corner towers and a richly decorated central façade, set in a landscaped park with trees and walking paths. Two elegantly dressed figures stroll in the foreground. A broad road runs along the right side, with wooded hills rising behind the complex. Stylized red captions appear at the bottom, along with printer information.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a street lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. Two tall church spires rise in the background. People walk along the street and sidewalks, and bicycles or carts are visible in the foreground. Decorative script at the bottom reads "Grimma i. Sa. Leipzigerstraße," indicating it depicts Leipzigerstraße in the town of Grimma. Shop signs in German are visible on the left side of the street.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a steel railway bridge crossing a calm, tree‑lined river or lake. The bridge and surrounding forest are reflected clearly in the water, with lily pads in the foreground and a small circular platform or buoy on the right. In the bottom left corner the caption reads "BOFORS Järnvägsbron", and in the bottom right appears the number "3543".

A vintage colorized postcard depicting a ceremonial military scene in a city square. Orthodox clergy bless a regimental flag on a table with candles, while uniformed soldiers, officers, and a small marching band stand in formation. Historic multi‑story buildings frame the background, and a crowd watches the event. The main caption at the top is in Greek with a French translation, and there is a printed web address at the bottom.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large statue of a robed man standing on an ornate pedestal with sculpted figures, placed on wide stone steps in a town square. Surrounding the monument are multi-story buildings with shuttered windows and, in the background, a crenellated tower. The image has a printed caption at the top identifying the monument and its location.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, three‑storey barracks building with a mansard roof, dormer windows and decorative stonework. A tree‑lined street and an iron fence run along the front of the building; a few pedestrians are visible in the distance. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location and the military unit stationed there, and a red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a public square and garden framed by tall mountains. In the foreground is a large circular plaza with a monumental statue at its center, surrounded by paths and trees. In the background are several towers and historic buildings of a town nestled at the base of the mountains. The caption printed at the top identifies the scene as Piazza Dante with its monument and public garden in Trento.

A sepia-toned historical photograph showing a small open-air market scene. Women in long skirts and shawls and men in caps are gathered around large wicker baskets and goods laid on the ground. On the left is a wooden cart with large wheels loaded with sacks or bundles. In the background stand trees and multi-story masonry buildings with sash windows and shopfronts, suggesting a town square or street market.

Black‑and‑white image showing an interior display of many brooms and brushes arranged on a tall wooden rack against a wall. On both sides hang dark patterned carpets. Above and around the rack are several printed signs in Cyrillic script. The floor has a tiled border. The composition and printing style resemble an early‑20th‑century commercial or exhibition postcard.

Sepia-tone postcard showing a panoramic view of a European city area dominated by a large neo‑Gothic church with twin spires on a low hill. The church is surrounded by wooden fences, smaller wooden and stone houses, and some distant urban structures such as a water tower. Decorative corner elements frame the image. Printed caption text appears at the top left and along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a person seated alone on an old single‑chair ski lift, suspended high above a valley. Below lies a small alpine village with scattered houses and meadows, surrounded by dense forest. In the background, dramatic jagged mountains with patches of snow dominate the skyline under a partly cloudy sky. The image has a white border and looks like a vintage tourist postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a harbor with several steamships and smaller boats moored along quays lined with low town buildings and factory chimneys emitting smoke. Calm water fills the foreground, reflecting the ships and skyline. In the distance are more industrial buildings and a domed structure among trees. The caption at the bottom left reads "Hamnen, Uddevalla."

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a row of multi‑story residential and town buildings on the left and a wide street with pedestrians and people pushing handcarts. Trees line the right side of the street. In the distance a large church or civic building with a tall tower and dome rises above the rooftops. Printed caption text at the top right reads "Nossen i. Sa. — Bismarckstraße".

Black-and-white postcard view of a canal or river flanked by promenades with trees, benches, pedestrians and small moored boats. In the distance, low-rise historic buildings and a small bridge are visible. Printed caption text appears in Swedish at the lower left and publisher/photographer information at the lower right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a wooden church with a very tall, slender spire rising above trees and a surrounding churchyard with gravestones. On the left margin a vertical label reads "Karlskoga, Värml." and at the bottom right the handwritten caption identifies the church. The overall style suggests an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street-front building complex with leafless trees and several people standing in an open square in front. The central three‑story building bears large painted advertisements and signage in German, including the beer brand "Feldschlösschen," as well as references to a restaurant, skittle alley, billiard and social rooms. On the right is a longer, more formal building with arched windows and a small tower-like end pavilion. The architecture and clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century Central European town scene.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European village nestled in a valley, surrounded by fields and low hills. The village has densely packed gabled houses with tiled roofs, a central church tower with a clock and spire rising above the rooftops, and farm buildings on the outskirts. Beyond the village lie rectangular agricultural plots, tree-lined roads, and terraced or cultivated hillsides.

Sepia-toned view of a leafy urban park with walking paths, shrubs, and tall trees. A tram with several cars runs along a street bordering the park, and a few pedestrians walk nearby. At the bottom, in cursive, is a caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town dominated by a large Gothic-style church on a hill with a tall square tower and steep roof. Surrounding it are smaller houses, trees, and a winding road with a few poles and a parked car in the foreground. At the bottom left of the image the caption reads "Kamenz i. Sa."

A sepia-toned winter scene showing a snow-covered landscape with bare trees in the foreground and farm buildings on a gentle slope. On the hilltop in the background stand the ruins of a large medieval castle with several tall, broken towers and curtain walls. The composition and toning resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Vintage sepia photograph of a wide street leading to a tall, ornate early‑20th‑century hotel or commercial building with Art Nouveau / eclectic façade. The central building has five or six stories, decorative gables along the roofline, and many windows. Old cars or carriages and a few pedestrians are seen on the cobbled street. On the ground floor, vertical shop signs and a central balcony sign bear Cyrillic text.

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a broad, quiet avenue lined with multi‑story townhouses and small trees. A church with an onion-shaped tower is visible in the distance at the end of the street. On the left, a woman in old-fashioned dress stands by a fence; on the right are bourgeois villas with ornate façades and a small pavilion or gazebo in a garden. The printed captions at the top read the locality and the street name in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large late‑19th‑century military barracks complex along a tree‑lined street. The multi‑story brick buildings have steep tiled roofs, gables, and decorative facades, enclosed by an iron fence and stone wall. The perspective is from across a cobbled street with young trees and a small planted traffic island in the foreground. Printed German text in red appears along the top margin, identifying the location and the military unit housed there.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a tram or streetcar traveling along curving tracks beside a red-brick building, with a tree-lined road and pedestrians in the foreground. The scene is semi-rural with dense greenery on a slope and a pastel evening sky. Printed text at the top identifies the location as the surroundings of Nijmegen, specifically Beek, in Dutch.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a grand, two‑storey late‑19th‑century building with decorative façades, awnings and large windows, likely a restaurant or café. In front stands a statue or monument on a pedestal with surrounding gas-style street lamps. Several children are visible in the open square in front of the building. Dense trees form a park-like backdrop. The caption at the bottom reads ""Burgerlust" — Nijmegen." and faint lettering on the building suggests the word "RESTAURANT".

A monochrome postcard showing a large medieval castle complex on a wooded hillside. The main building has steep gabled roofs punctuated with small dormer windows, thick stone walls, and a central tower with smaller turrets. Additional attached buildings and a half‑timbered structure are visible to the right. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a group of early 20th‑century wooden buildings surrounded by coniferous forest. The central building has large windows, a light-colored roof, and small porches; similar structures stand on the left and right. A dirt path and grassy yard lead up to a gate in the background. Printed captions in Swedish at the top read "Sundsvall" on the left and "Epidemiska Sjukhuset" on the right, indicating an epidemic hospital in Sundsvall.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a rural European valley with scattered houses, fields and forested hills. A prominent multi-arch stone railway viaduct spans a small valley on the right side, with a village clustered near its base and farmhouses in the foreground.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of the Acropolis of Athens taken from Philopappos Hill. The Parthenon dominates the top of the rocky hill, with other classical structures and the Odeon of Herodes Atticus visible on the slopes. At the bottom there is printed multilingual caption text in Greek, English and French, along with a small serial number. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small seaside town with wooden houses clustered along the shoreline. In the foreground is a harbor with two sailing boats and a small rowboat on choppy water. The town's buildings rise just behind the quay, with a flag flying above one structure. The word "Fiskebäckskil." is printed in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white photo of a multi‑arch stone bridge crossing a shallow, rocky river. The bridge has three large arches with masonry piers and a metal or concrete railing with decorative panels. People are walking across the bridge and a few cars are visible beneath and beyond it. On the far bank stand mid‑20th‑century apartment or town buildings with steep, tiled roofs and dormer windows, surrounded by leafy trees. The foreground shows rocks and gentle rapids in the river, framed by overhanging branches. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Colored postcard view of a large military barracks complex with several multi‑story cream-colored buildings topped with steep red roofs arranged around a curved entrance road and fenced grounds. The foreground shows the main gate with striped guard posts, a curved driveway, and a perimeter wall. The background reveals open countryside under a blue sky with scattered clouds. Printed text in German appears at the top of the card indicating the town and the name of the barracks.

A vintage black-and-white studio portrait of a woman standing and smiling at the camera with a cigarette in her mouth. She wears an elaborate period-style outfit with a patterned, quilted skirt and a fitted jacket with decorative buttons. The background is plain and dark, giving it a theatrical or promotional feel. In the upper left corner, white printed text identifies her and a role/title, and a small serial number appears in the lower left.

Black‑and‑white view of a central square in a small European town. A large tree stands in the middle of the square, fenced around its trunk. Surrounding it are two‑ and three‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. One building on the left has a shop sign for a bakery, and another on the right bears the sign "Ballsaal" (ballroom). In the background rises an ornate church or town‑hall tower with a tall spire and clock. Several children and a few adults stand or walk in the open square, dressed in early 20th‑century clothing.

Color photograph looking down a straight city street toward the sea. Mid‑rise apartment blocks line both sides, many with balconies and awnings, and numerous TV antennas on the roofs. A few cars from the mid‑20th century era drive along the street, which has small trees planted on the median or sidewalks. The sky is bright blue and the sea is visible at the far end of the avenue. No visible caption or printed text is present on the image side.

A black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a rural road lined with trees leading toward a town in the distance. On the left side of the road stands a horse‑drawn covered wagon with several people beside it. Fields stretch out on the right, and beyond them lies a townscape with church towers and larger buildings on the horizon. The title in red German script is printed at the lower left.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. On the left corner is a building with the shop sign "A.W. Hofmann" and German advertising for sewing machines and steel goods. The street curves into the distance with tram tracks and a few pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. The upper margin bears the printed red title "Riesa a. d. Elbe. Wettinerstrasse." and the right margin credits the publisher.

Colorized historic street scene showing a grand European square with ornate multi‑story buildings and towers on both sides, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption at the top reads "Budapest. Kígyótér. – Schlangenplatz." indicating a square in Budapest.

Black‑and‑white view of a European cobblestone street lined with multi‑story masonry buildings. The central structure is a large early‑20th‑century commercial or office block with arched windows on the top floor and several shopfronts at street level, above which faint signage is visible. People in period clothing walk along the sidewalk. To the right stands an older, more ornate building with pilasters and tall windows; behind the street a large stone church or monastery complex with steep rooflines is visible. The image has the framing, tone, and paper border typical of historical postcards.

A black-and-white postcard view of a large Renaissance castle complex with an inner courtyard garden laid out in geometric flowerbeds and paths. The multi-story building has rows of shuttered windows, corner towers, and arcaded loggias along one side. A high defensive wall with battlements and a square tower runs along the right. At the bottom right border there is printed caption text identifying the place.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a flat rural landscape with canals, fields, and traditional Dutch windmills. One large windmill stands prominently on the left side near the water, with another windmill visible further in the distance to the right. Small farm buildings and a figure walking along the canal bank are also visible. Printed caption text appears at the top in a serif font.

Colorized postcard-style image showing a Catholic religious procession of priests and altar servers in white vestments walking along a path past a stone gate or archway. A canopy is carried toward the rear of the procession. At the top left, red Dutch text is printed over the sky.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad cobbled avenue lined with young trees and late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century buildings with awnings and balconies. Well‑dressed pedestrians in long dresses and hats walk in the street, and a horse‑drawn cart stands in the foreground on the right. The cart has the inscription "H. Donat KOLBERG" on its back. Shops and cafés with striped awnings face the street, and further back more carriages and people are visible.

A vintage, monochrome postcard view taken from a high terrace with a pergola covered in vines, looking out over a city with a river running through the center. A woman stands at the railing, gazing over the rooftops and bridges. Stone steps lead up on the right. The printed caption at the top reads "Graz, Pergola gegen Süden."

A colorized view of a rural landscape in spring with blooming fruit trees in the foreground, farmhouses with red roofs in the middle ground, and on a hill in the background a large castle complex with a tall round tower and fortified walls. The scene is framed like a vintage postcard, and there is a handwritten-style caption in German at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a grand seafront palace complex situated on top of a high cliff above the sea. The large multi-storey building with a tower and flag stands to the right, with terraced gardens in front and a sparsely built coastline stretching to the left. Below the image there are captions in Cyrillic and French indicating the location and the building.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small railway yard and tracks stretching into the distance through a rural settlement. A steam train is visible on the central track, with houses and trees on either side and a water tower in the background. In the foreground are side tracks, a freight wagon, stacked rails or timber, and a person standing near the fence. Printed caption text appears along the bottom left, and a number is printed at the lower right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilly valley settlement with scattered villas and farmhouses surrounded by forests and fields. On the left stands a prominent church-like complex on a hill, overlooking the village below. The scene is labeled with German text printed in red at the bottom margin, along with a publisher's credit and number.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European industrial town in a river valley, with tree‑lined streets, multi‑story masonry apartment blocks, rail or tram tracks along the foreground, and a prominent neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire on the right. In the mid‑ground are factories with smokestacks, and in the background terraced hills and a fortress or large building on a hilltop. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century postcard photograph.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a decorative river-themed border. The central photograph shows a group of African children and an adult standing on a sandy riverbank beside a very large crocodile lying on the ground and chained. Palm trees and a calm river curve into the distance. At the lower left a drawn vignette continues the river scene, and at the bottom are illustrated water plants. Text is printed in red and black around the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a small European town with traditional multi‑storey houses along a river. In the foreground a metal truss bridge crosses the river, supported by stone abutments. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and many windows, and there are low wooded hills in the background. Printed caption text in the upper left reads "Roßwein. Muldensteg."

A black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing a scattered village or farmsteads on open fields with low rolling hills in the background. Wooden houses and barns with fenced pastures dominate the foreground. A group of people is seated on the grass near the lower right. Handwritten captions appear along the bottom edge of the image.

Black‑and‑white landscape-format image showing a large hilltop castle complex overlooking a small town. The fortress has tall multi‑storey stone buildings with steep gabled roofs and several small towers or spires. Below the castle are clustered half‑timbered or plastered houses with pitched roofs, gardens, and terraced slopes, surrounded by leafless trees and countryside. The overall look is that of a historic European castle dominating a rural town.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow canal bordered by old Venetian buildings with Gothic windows and ornate stone facades. A small boat sits in the still water near the foreground. The perspective looks down the canal between the palazzi, and printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a wooded park scene at Schloss Lockwitz. In the foreground is a large tree encircled by a round bench. To the left stands a wooden gymnastic structure with a tall ladder and hanging rings. The background is filled with trees and foliage, giving the impression of a quiet park area on the castle grounds. Caption text is printed in red at the bottom.

Colorized historical postcard showing an outdoor concert in a park. In the center is a large wooden bandstand or music pavilion with a pitched roof and an orchestra playing inside. In front, many elegantly dressed people in early-20th‑century clothing stroll, stand, or sit on white chairs arranged in rows under tall trees. At the top of the card is German text printed in red.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a lakeside industrial town surrounded by low hills. In the foreground are factories with tall smokestacks, warehouses, rail or industrial yards, and scattered wooden houses. Across the lake and river lies a dense cluster of houses and larger public buildings on a gently rising hillside, with forested areas and mountains in the distance. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and a photographer's credit mark in the lower right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a street corner with a multi‑story building housing a guesthouse or restaurant and, to the right, a broad stone staircase leading up through a baroque archway into a leafy garden or terrace. Tables with umbrellas stand beside the steps. German text is printed both on the building façades and in the lower margin, which identifies the location as Meissen on the Elbe River and mentions the establishment "Gaststätte zum Bräustüberl".

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a hilly rural landscape with fields, forested slopes, and a small settlement of multi‑storey houses and farm buildings in the foreground. On the distant hilltop stands a small tower or pavilion. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century European view card. Handwritten captions appear along the bottom border.

A black-and-white portrait of a woman in profile wearing a large, elaborate hat with plumes and a high-collared garment. The style suggests an early 20th‑century theatrical or studio photograph. Text on the image identifies the photographer/location and the woman's role name in a production.

A black-and-white postcard showing an old wooden farmyard building with horizontal log walls and a simple pitched roof. There is a ladder leaning against the left side, a wooden barrel, and farm tools or a winch-like device near the entrance. Vegetation and trees surround the rustic structure. Printed captions appear in the lower left and right corners in two languages.

Black-and-white postcard showing a rural riverside scene with trees and grassy banks in the foreground and a church with a tall tower and pointed spire rising above a wooded hill in the background. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in German that reads "Technitz über Döbeln/Sa."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neo‑baroque theater building with a large central dome, statues on the roof, and a portico supported by tall columns. The building faces a broad, mostly empty street with a few pedestrians and a cyclist in front. Trees frame the scene on both sides. Printed caption text along the lower margin reads "Graz. Stadttheater".

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm shoreline promenade curving around a bay, with dense forest on a hillside to the left and small buildings by the water, including a house-like structure on a pier or floating platform. The style is early 20th‑century, with printed caption text at the bottom and a purple museum ownership stamp overlaid.

Black‑and‑white image showing six men posed indoors in front of a display of military drums, banners, and standards. The men wear ornate 19th‑century military band or drum-major uniforms with tall bearskin or shako-style headgear; some also wear long white aprons and large false beards as part of ceremonial dress. Several drums are on the floor at their feet. Above and behind them hang regimental flags, crests, and a large crescent-shaped drum banner. A line of text is printed along the upper margin of the image.

Vintage monochrome (slightly hand‑tinted) postcard view of steep rocky cliffs with fortification walls and arches known as the Bock in Luxembourg City. At the top left stands a villa on the cliff edge; in the foreground a woman with an umbrella walks along a path beside a stone wall. On the right is a tall church spire rising above trees and rooftops. Printed red caption text across the top identifies the scene and publisher.

Black-and-white postcard image of a wooded valley with a narrow winding path. In the foreground, a rustic bridge or barrier made of intertwined branches crosses a small ditch. A person in early 20th‑century attire stands further up the path. Dense trees and foliage surround the path, creating a shaded forest scene. In the lower-left corner, caption text reads "Beek. Kastanjedal."

Black-and-white image of a steam cargo ship on calm water, viewed in profile. Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town nestled in a valley, photographed from a nearby field or hillside. In the foreground are tilled soil and a few simple farm buildings. Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley, photographed from a slightly elevated, rural vantage point with fields and vegetation in the foreground. A sepia-toned portrait-style postcard showing a formally dressed man seated at a grand piano, in profile, with his hands on the keyboard. The background is plain and indoor, likely a hall or studio. The subject's name is written in white script at the bottom of the image.

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a seated woman in dark civilian clothing and a standing man in a military-style uniform with a side cap and armbands, posing behind a slatted wooden bench. In the lower right corner there is an embossed photographer's mark.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooded hillside with terraced slopes, several small villas or pavilions, and a prominent round stone lookout tower with crenellations and a flag on top. The scene is rural and hilly, and printed captions in German appear at the bottom.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large two-story school building with many tall windows and a prominent exterior staircase at the right. Mature trees and a fenced sidewalk are in the foreground. Sepia-toned panoramic view over a waterfront city with many low buildings and several mosque minarets in the foreground, sailing ships and steamers on a wide strait, and hills with dense housing in the background. A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Gothic cathedral with multiple tall spires rising from a castle‑like complex on a hill above a river. Black‑and‑white view of a small historic town square with a landscaped park in the foreground, featuring paths, lawns, flowerbeds, trimmed trees and a central lamp post. Sepia-toned postcard view framed by a large archway, looking onto an inner courtyard with the domed structure and minaret of a historic mosque. A solitary figure in traditional clothing stands in the foreground. At the bottom, caption text identifies the scene as a mosque in Cairo.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a narrow coastal road squeezed between a steep rocky cliff on the left and whitewashed houses on the right. Black‑and‑white interior view of an opulent hotel lobby or lounge, featuring high ceilings with ornate plasterwork, large round columns, and wide archways. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small town with a prominent stone church and tower rising above surrounding trees and wooden houses. Black‑and‑white image of a broad, mostly empty town square bordered by 19th‑century multi‑story buildings. Sepia-toned panoramic view over a hilly town with dense trees and numerous houses and multi‑storey buildings on the ridge. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing sailing boats with large lateen sails passing through an open metal drawbridge or swing bridge over a wide river. Color postcard view from a wooded hillside lookout with a rustic wooden fence in the foreground, overlooking a bright blue lake. Black‑and‑white postcard view over a tree‑filled square with paths and people walking, surrounded by ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings. Sepia-toned wartime scene showing a barren, uneven landscape with military personnel and possibly horses or artillery grouped in the middle distance. Low hills or earthworks are visible in the background. Along the bottom edge there is a caption printed in German.

In the background, behind dense trees, stands a large building complex on a hill and a church tower with a baroque-style spire. The caption handwritten along the bottom margin reads "Schloss Wechselburg (Mulde)."

A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a European city square framed by multi‑story historic buildings, tree-lined streets, and mountains in the background. The central focus is a large rectangular building facing an open piazza, with other elegant structures and villas climbing the hillside. At the bottom margin of the image, there is printed caption text indicating the location in Trento and naming Piazza Venezia and Via Grazioli.

Monochrome vintage postcard showing a grand Baroque-style fountain set against the facade of a palace with large Corinthian columns and rich sculptural decoration. The fountain features a central standing male figure in historical dress on a rocky base, surrounded by hunting dogs, game, and several other figures arranged on multiple levels, with water cascading into a circular basin in the foreground. The architecture behind has a domed roof, balustrades, and ornate reliefs.

Colorized vintage aerial view of a riverside town with mountains in the background. In the foreground are orderly streets lined with trees and low multi‑story buildings with red and gray roofs. Near the river stands a distinct white church with a tall, narrow bell tower. A bridge crosses the river to the opposite bank, where more buildings and rail tracks are visible. On the right margin there is a printed caption and handwritten cursive message, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A colorized panoramic view of a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. The town has dense clusters of multi‑story buildings with red and gray roofs, a church tower among them, and an industrial complex with a tall chimney and rail tracks in the foreground. Fields and wooded hills surround the settlement. At the top left, red printed text reads "Olbernhau i. Erzgeb."

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a courtyard with a tall, slender Ottoman-style minaret rising behind surrounding buildings and trees. In the foreground a person stands in an open space between stucco houses. The architecture is European with a distinct Islamic minaret attached to (or immediately behind) a chapel-like building. Printed Hungarian text along the bottom identifies the location.

A black‑and‑white interior view of a richly decorated chapel or small church, looking down the central aisle toward the altar. Wooden pews line both sides, and the apse and ceiling are covered with Christian frescoes and icons, including a central image of the Virgin Mary with angels. There are arched windows along the walls and hanging lamps. In the bottom right corner the caption 'La Cappella' is printed.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a brick railway station building partly obscured by large leafy trees. A clock is mounted above a central entrance, and several people are sitting on benches in front of the building. At the bottom left, the caption reads "KIL Järnvägsstationen," and a number "32486" appears in the lower right corner.

Vintage sepia photograph of a rural European valley. In the foreground, trees frame the view of a small village with a half-timbered house and a winding country road. On a hill in the background stands a church with a tall, slender steeple and adjacent buildings, all surrounded by orchards and gentle slopes.

A black-and-white postcard view over a coastal landscape with a long narrow pier or jetty extending into the water. In the foreground are evergreen trees, a road, and a horse-drawn cart near the entrance to the pier. Across the water lie wooded hills under a cloudy sky. White printed captions appear at the bottom indicating the location and the photographer/publisher.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with three interior photographs of elegant rooms (reception room, dining hall, and breakfast room) of a military officers' casino. At left is a decorative illustration with crossed rifles, a hunting horn, and antlers with a crown. The photos are captioned in German, and a large red title reads "Dresden." The main text names the officers' casino of the Royal Saxon 2nd Jäger Battalion No. 13.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy, narrow European city street lined with multi‑story buildings and shops. A tall church or tower rises in the background. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the cobbled street. On the right side there is a hanging sign reading "APOTHEEK" above other Dutch text, and at the bottom margin the printed caption reads "Nijmegen Broerstraat".

Black‑and‑white postcard showing four adults sitting on a shaded veranda behind a rough wooden fence. The people wear light, early‑20th‑century European clothing. Below the photograph there is printed text in Finnish and Swedish describing the scene and referring to a missionary family named Rautanen at the Olukonda station in Amboland.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a town square with trees, benches, and people walking around. Central in the image is a small church or chapel with a simple façade and arched windows, surrounded by colonial-style buildings. Mountains are visible in the distant background. The caption at the bottom reads "S. Vicente - Cabo Verde Praça do Município."

Tinted historical postcard showing four uniformed military men standing in front of a large early biplane on a muddy airfield. The aircraft appears to be from the early days of aviation. The caption at the top is in French and there is a website watermark at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tennis court complex and surrounding parkland bordered by trees. Benches line the courts and paths, and a dirt road leads into a wooded area in the background. Handwritten white lettering appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad square lined with palm trees and surrounded by low-rise neoclassical buildings. In the middle of the open space stands an obelisk-like monument. A few people are walking across the square and hilly terrain with more houses rises in the background. Greek and English captions are printed along the bottom margin.

Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined canal or narrow river with grassy banks and parallel walking paths. A person in light clothing and a hat stands in the shallow water, while another figure walks along the right path among young trees. The scene is rural and tranquil. At the top, printed text reads "Radeburg" in the center and "Partie a. d. Promnitz" on the right.

Black‑and‑white image showing a ceremonial cavalry parade riding along a cobblestone street between tall, ornate 19th‑century buildings. Crowds line both sides of the street, many in early‑20th‑century clothing, waving small flags. Large flags with a dark Nordic cross on a light background hang from the buildings, creating a festive, national‑celebration atmosphere.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a river steamboat in the foreground and a large hilltop castle complex with massive walls and several wings in the background. Below the castle, small houses and riverside buildings line the bank. To the right, a prominent church with a tall, steep‑roofed nave and spire rises above the town. The image surface shows age‑related scratches and cracks, suggesting an early photographic print.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a one-story wooden building with a central tower-like section and gabled roofs, surrounded by a wooden picket fence. In the foreground is an unpaved road or path with planks laid along it. The scene appears rural. Russian text is printed beneath the image, and a small printer's mark appears in the lower left corner.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, classical public building partly obscured by tall deciduous trees. The two‑story masonry structure has pilasters, rectangular windows with simple pediments, and a prominent central entrance reached by steps. Above the roofline rises a distinctive square clock‑tower or cupola with arched windows and a mansard‑style dome. A low fence runs along the foreground and a person in light clothing and a hat stands near the sidewalk, suggesting an early 20th‑century streetscape.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of an ornate historicist / Art Nouveau building complex bordering a landscaped square with trees and benches. The main facade is richly decorated with balconies, sculptural elements, and towers topped with statues. At the top left of the card, the caption reads "Marienbad. Franz Josephs‑Platz." Additional signage on the buildings includes the word "BANK" and hotel names.

Black‑and‑white view over a European small town nestled in a valley, photographed from an elevated dirt path lined with tall trees and a wooden railing. Two people walk along the path in the foreground. Below, dense rooftops and a prominent church with a tall spire dominate the town center, and terraced fields or vineyards cover the hills in the distance. The edges of the image show damage or wear, suggesting an old photographic postcard or glass-plate reproduction.
