A black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town in a valley, photographed from a country road lined with tall trees. In the middle distance are clustered houses and larger buildings, and on the right stands a church with a tower and spire. The surrounding landscape is hilly and wooded. At the top left there is red printed German text describing the view, and at the upper right a red handwritten number or notation.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand, historic university library reading room. The room is rectangular with two stories of high bookcases lining the walls and an upper gallery with ornate metal railings running all around. Large arched openings and a glazed skylight illuminate the space from above. Long wooden reading tables with lamps are arranged in rows on the floor, and a statue or bust stands prominently at the far end. Printed captions in German are visible in the lower left and lower right corners.

Multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard showing the village of Schmannewitz, a street scene with a decorated building labeled as Café Jacob–Konditorei, and a posed studio photograph of four young women in traditional dresses identified as the Schmannewitzer Heidelerchen and Geschwister Jacob. The surrounding caption text promotes Schmannewitz as a holiday resort (Ferienort) in Saxony (in Sa.).

Black‑and‑white view of a wide unpaved street in a European town, lined with two‑ and three‑storey buildings. On the left is a large inn with a sign reading "Gasthof zur Krone" (Inn at the Crown). People stand in front of the inn and along the street; a few carts are visible on the right. In the background are more houses and a church tower with a baroque spire rising above trees. Wooden fences, telegraph poles, and early‑20th‑century clothing suggest a small town scene from that era.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a tree-lined open square with cobblestone paths and rows of traditional gabled houses enclosing a quiet courtyard. Church towers rise in the distant background. The caption at the bottom identifies the view as the Béguinage (Convent of Beguines) in Bruges.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene with a large ancient triumphal arch spanning a cobbled road. A tram runs on tracks beneath the arch, with several pedestrians around it; a uniformed boy or young man stands in the foreground. Surrounding the arch are early 20th‑century buildings. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, along with a faint round stamp mark.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a massive crowd filling a street or plaza. Most people wear wide‑brimmed hats; some are on horseback and many hold umbrellas. In the center, people carry a large protest banner in Spanish. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century political demonstration or revolutionary rally, possibly reproduced as a historical postcard.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large, ornate school building on a tree‑lined waterfront. In the foreground, a calm body of water with a rowboat carrying two people; behind it, a promenade with trees and the imposing multi‑storey brick or stone structure with a hipped roof, dormers, and a small tower. Surrounding the main building are residential houses. At the top of the postcard there is printed text indicating the location and the name of the school.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene in a European city, showing a wide boulevard lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades and shops at street level. Horse‑drawn carriages, early trams, and many pedestrians fill the cobblestone street. In the far distance, a large arched façade closes the perspective, while on the right stands a tall, narrow building with a spired tower. The top of the image has a V‑shaped missing section, suggesting damage or cropping typical of an old postcard or glass negative reproduction.

Sepia-toned historic view of a cobblestone market square bordered by traditional multi‑story houses with gabled roofs. A few pedestrians, a cart, and a man leading a horse move through the open square. Shop signs in German are visible on the buildings, and on the right edge stands a large statue or monument seen from behind. The printed caption at the top reads "Nossen i. Sa. — Unterer Markt".

Vintage black‑and‑white rural landscape view showing gentle fields, a line of young trees along a road or railway, several villas on a hillside, and a larger, turreted building to the right. A central building bears the sign "Pension Kaiserhof." Printed caption text in red at the bottom identifies the place as Bärenfels in the Saxon Ore Mountains. A red handwritten number "2246" appears at the top right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a fortified medieval gate with two large cylindrical towers topped by crenellations, joined by an arched entrance with classical pediment. A low bridge or causeway crosses a moat or river in the foreground. Behind the gate are dense urban buildings and, further back, the towers of a large cathedral. On one of the background buildings, commercial signage is visible.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a grand villa or small castle with multiple turrets and a tall, slender tower in a landscaped setting. In the foreground, a group of women and children in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand and sit in a grassy field. Additional smaller wooden buildings and outdoor seating are visible to the right, with hills or a river valley in the distant background. Decorative red text is printed at the top and along the right margin.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large hilltop castle above a forested riverside. In the foreground there is a low dam or weir with water cascading over it; behind the trees rises a rectangular multi-storey castle building with a steep roof and many windows. A German caption is printed at the top left of the image area.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical palace-like building covered with ivy, with a colonnaded central entrance and many rectangular windows. Attached on the left is a church-like structure with a steep roof and a tower featuring a clock and an onion-shaped spire. In front is a fenced-off lawn or park; a horse-drawn carriage and a few pedestrians are visible along the street.

The postcard shows an ornate, arched city gate built of stone with intricate geometric and arabesque designs. There are several people in traditional attire walking in front of the gate. The text at the top reads '71 - MEKNES - Porte Bab-Mansour El-Alluj - LL'.

A black and white postcard image showing a coastal scene with numerous birds, mainly terns and gulls, nesting among tall grasses. The background reveals a coastline with water and sandbanks. There is Swedish text labeling the types of birds, the location ('Måkläppen utanför Falsterbo, juni 1920'), and credits to the Gothenburg Natural History Museum and a diorama by Olof Gylling.

The image depicts an old, sepia-toned photograph showing two individuals in traditional attire standing beside a stone wall with two arched openings, possibly natural springs or fountains. There is Greek handwriting at the bottom and a faded stamp on the left. The setting appears rural, with rocky ground and shrubbery in the background.

This postcard features an image of an ancient Greek vase painting. The scene depicts a seated woman playing a lyre, dressed in a yellow top and reddish-brown draped skirt, with hair tied back. There is an intricate Greek key (meander) pattern at the top, and some ancient Greek text inscribed near the figure. A small bird is drawn near the ground by her foot. The style is characteristic of Classical Greek pottery art.

A vintage black and white postcard showing an imposing neoclassical building identified as the Palace of Justice. There are people in period attire standing in front of the building. The top of the postcard reads 'Cluj. Palatul Justiției', while the bottom left contains the word 'Kolozsvár,' and to the right, 'Igazságügyi palota.'

A black-and-white image showing two women in fashionable 1960s attire, sitting at a round outdoor table by the water, writing postcards. The table and chairs are typical lightweight outdoor furniture. Behind them, there is an old stone bridge over a calm river or canal, leafy trees, a few other people sitting, and a historic-looking stone building partially visible on the right.

The postcard features a vintage illustration of a city street labeled 'VIA LARGA' with a prominent fountain in the foreground, adorned by classical statues and surrounded by historic European architecture. There is a wax seal, a clover, a small medallion, and handwritten script across the bottom half. Italian text is visible, along with the printed words 'Un Saluto da TRENTO' suggesting it is a greeting from Trento.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard image depicting a plaza with a monument at its center, surrounded by well-kept gardens, buildings, and mountains in the background. The prominent text in red identifies the location as Piazza Dante, with references to Hotel Trento and the railway station, indicating a central and notable urban area. There is handwriting at the bottom in Italian and a line of small text about reproduction rights.

This is a black-and-white postcard featuring a coastal scene with pine trees next to a beach. There is a walking path, new saplings planted along the beach, and a sign in Greek among the trees. The bottom left of the card has Greek and French text describing the scene, while the bottom right shows a copyright notice.

A vintage postcard featuring a sepia-toned photographic image of a village landscape framed by trees. In the image, a small cluster of buildings and a church spire is visible in the distance. Below the image, printed text provides the name of the location in Greek and French. The card also includes stamps and a postmark dated 1902 from Athens.

A black and white photograph of a large, multi-story institutional building with a steep tiled roof and many windows. The architecture features a modest decorative cornice near the roof and a small tower structure visible in the background, suggesting early 20th-century European influence. There are people, including children, standing and walking along a tree-lined street in front. The building is surrounded by a fence. In white script at the bottom left of the image, text is visible.

A black and white postcard showing a heavily damaged building with large sections collapsed or destroyed. The foreground is filled with rubble and debris. Below the image, there is a printed Dutch caption describing the scene. The architectural style and the state of destruction suggest a post-war context.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph of ancient stone ruins dominated by a large, cylindrical stone tower with partially collapsed walls around it. The overall style and wear of the photograph suggest it's historical, likely from the early 20th century or earlier. There is no visible modern infrastructure, and the landscape appears to be rural.

A black and white postcard image showing a densely built coastal town rising up a hillside, with traditional Mediterranean architecture and tiled roofs. There are several boats anchored along the waterfront. Greek text is visible at the bottom left, and there is a watermark from elia.org.gr.

This black-and-white postcard is divided into four sections, showcasing both the exterior and interior of a historic church. The top-left panel displays an outside view of the church, characterized by its Baroque or late Gothic steeple and an onion-shaped dome, common in Central Europe. The top-right and bottom panels exhibit the ornate interior, featuring classic church pews, a central altar, an elaborately decorated pipe organ, and a pulpit gallery with floral adornments and coats of arms.

A black-and-white postcard showing a large institutional building (likely a school) with an ornate roof, seen from across a body of water framed by tree branches. In the upper right, there is red printed text in German indicating the location and nature of the building.

Museum art postcard reproducing Ștefan Popescu's painting "Prînzul secerătorilor" (The Reapers' Lunch): a group of peasants in traditional clothing resting and eating in golden harvest fields with haystacks and a flat landscape in the distance. The reverse has Romanian address fields, a boxed stamp area marked 144, museum credits, and the printer mark I.P. SIBIU.

Museum-issued Romanian postcard. The front reproduces a 19th‑century lithograph of Hanul lui Manuc (Manuc's Inn) in Bucharest: a large courtyard with arcaded wooden galleries and external stairs, several covered wagons, and people around a fire. The reverse has Romanian address fields, museum credits, a bilingual caption, and a printed price.

Art postcard reproducing a still-life painting of vivid red roses and green leaves in a dark blue vase set on a red surface against a dark background. The reverse side is a Romanian-address template with publisher and printer credits and a printed price in lei.

Color postcard reproducing a painting by Paul Bril showing a mountainous landscape with an inn on the right, rocky hills with paths and small towers, and a distant town with church spires. The reverse reads CARTE POȘTALĂ and identifies the work as belonging to the Brukenthal Museum in Sibiu, with multilingual titles and a printed price.

Museum postcard showing a reproduction of a still-life painting by Vasile Popescu with a teapot, sugar bowl, clock and porcelain on a round dark table. The reverse is laid out as a Romanian postcard and credits the Brukenthal Museum in Sibiu, with Romanian and German titles and a printed price.

A Romanian postcard reproducing a winter village street painting by Ion Andreescu. The reverse reads 'CARTE POSTALĂ' with a printed caption of the artwork and a circular cancellation for a national philatelic exhibition in Bucharest dated 21.VI.1977.

Front shows a reproduction of an oil painting of a rustic country house with arched doors and a balcony, under a bright blue sky; the painter's signature appears at the bottom right. The reverse has Romanian text crediting the artist Gheorghe Petrașcu and the title, publisher details, price in lei, and magenta commemorative stamps from Bucharest dated 20.VII.1973.

A museum postcard reproducing a painting of blossoming orchard trees under a blue sky. The reverse side carries bilingual Romanian–English museum text, a printed price, and the painting's title and artist.

Vintage postcard showing a color reproduction of Anthony van Dyck's painting "Death of Cleopatra." The reverse has a Romanian caption identifying the work as being in the Brukenthal Museum in Sibiu, multilingual titles, a red POSTA ROMANA stamp with cancellations (Sibiu and Suceava), and a blue handwritten message and address to Suceava.

Art postcard reproducing Nicolae Grigorescu's painting of a young woman in traditional Romanian dress and headscarf, wearing layered blue and brown bead necklaces. The reverse carries Romanian publisher and museum credits, a blue 55 bani R.P. ROMINA stamp with CODLEA/DUMBRĂVENI postmarks, and a handwritten Romanian address.

Art museum postcard with a reproduction of Nicolae Grigorescu's painting showing peasants driving ox-drawn carts along a country path at sunset. The left panel is blank; the right panel has the image and a printed caption beneath it.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy harbor with many small boats and tugs moored along a quay and the town on the hillside beyond. Printed caption in Romanian at top left reads "TULCEA — Vedere din port". The reverse has Romanian text, stamps and postal marks from the People's Republic era.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a shallow lake covered with water‑lilies in the Danube Delta. A printed Romanian caption at top left reads "DELTA DUNĂRII — Lacul Tătarului." The reverse has Romanian text, a purple airmail stamp of 40 bani from the Romanian People's Republic, a Bucharest postmark dated 1962, and a handwritten message and address in Romanian.

Multiview color tourist postcard showing scenes from the Danube Delta near Tulcea: a fisherman hoisting a huge fish on a riverside pier, a colony of pelicans flying low over a channel, and a shady village path along the water with boats and willows. The reverse has Romanian printed layout, a 40 bani Poșta Română stamp, and postmarks from Tulcea/București, addressed in blue ink.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded beach and modernist seaside hotels at a resort. The reverse bears Romanian printed text and a Bucharest postmark dated 6.9.65, price Lei 1, publisher Editura Meridiane, and a handwritten Romanian message and address. The printed caption mentions Eforie‑Nord and 'Vile pe malul mării'.

Color postcard showing the hotel-ship "Libertatea" moored at the Danube quay, with several children sitting on the waterside. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 bani Romanian stamp, and Bucharest postal cancellations.

Sepia postcard view of a grand historic spa/casino building with a central dome and twin corner turrets, seen from a park with benches and people sitting and walking. The reverse reads in Romanian and Russian and has standard postcard address lines.

Sepia-toned postcard showing the interior of a vaulted stone structure with a series of arches and pillars receding into the distance. Light enters from above, illuminating the dusty floor. Below the image is printed caption text in French and English describing the site as the old prison of Anfa; there is additional Arabic script handwritten or printed at the bottom.

A monochrome/sepia military scene showing a line of soldiers lying prone on a grassy training field, operating belt‑fed machine guns. The troops wear early 20th‑century uniforms with distinctive spiked helmets (Pickelhaube), suggesting pre‑World War I German or Prussian forces. The background shows an earthen embankment and some simple range markers; there are no buildings or notable monuments visible. No printed text is visible on the image side.

Architectural cross‑section drawing of a multi‑storey residential building labeled with numbered rooms and spaces, accompanied by Finnish text explaining the layout. The title at the top reads "Karjalaisten koti." and below the drawing is the address "Helsinki, Liisank. 17, Oikok. 5" followed by a numbered legend describing various facilities such as dining hall, cellar, sauna, laundry and others. The style resembles an early 20th‑century informative or promotional postcard showing the design of a communal house.

Illustrated postcard showing a sunlit town square with a large baroque fountain at its center, decorated with multiple statues and set on several circular steps. Behind it stand painted façades with arcades and many shuttered windows, a tall tree, and distant mountains. A few birds peck on the ground and a cloaked figure walks near the fountain. A handwritten message in Italian runs vertically along the right margin.

Vintage sepia-toned portrait of a smiling young man in formal attire, photographed from the shoulders up against a light background. The image is framed by a wide cream border. At the bottom left, small printed text credits the photographer and the city, along with the year 1919. Across the lower margin is a bold handwritten signature in dark ink.

A black‑and‑white, slightly elevated view over a small town area with a prominent two‑storey classical building in the center, facing a landscaped park with paths, lawns, benches, and trees. Additional townhouses with metal roofs surround the main building, and forested hills with scattered houses can be seen in the background. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as the railway station in Motala.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi‑storey building with a central tower and steep slate roof, set in front of a forest. The facade has many dormer windows and balconies, and a sign on the central gable reads "Genesungsheim". In the foreground are fields and a fence. At the bottom border of the image is printed text reading "Grünhain i. Erzgeb. Genesungsheim".

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a flock of Merino sheep eating in a farmyard. On the left stands a young man in work clothes beside a stone wall; in the doorway of a building on the right stands an older man with a beard and hat, holding a cane or stick. Printed red German text at the bottom identifies the Merino stud sheep farm in Leutewitz near Meissen, Kingdom of Saxony, and the owner. A red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.

Colorized vintage street scene showing a wide, bustling urban avenue lined with multi‑story buildings, shop awnings, tram tracks, horse‑drawn carriages, and many pedestrians. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Via Medina in Naples (Napoli). Additional small red printing appears vertically along the left margin.

Colorized postcard view of a small historic town nestled among trees. Red-tiled roofs and several multi-story buildings fill a valley-like setting. In the center foreground is a gabled building with signage, and a courtyard with a few small human figures. The image is framed by lush green foliage. At the top of the image, printed in red text, is the caption 'Meißen. Winkelkrug.' indicating the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey hotel building in a landscaped setting. The architecture has a late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century style with gabled roofs, many windows, and a long glazed veranda or winter garden along the ground floor. Beneath the image, centered text reads "Hotel Berg en Dal." The lower half of the card is blank except for a small handwritten note in the bottom left corner.

Sepia-toned studio photograph showing a young woman and a man in a military uniform posed romantically. The woman wears a striped blouse with puffed sleeves, a long white skirt, and a small white headpiece. She is kneeling beside a wicker basket on the floor. The man, also kneeling, wears a double-breasted tunic with stand-up collar, shoulder boards, and a peaked cap, with a sword or sabre at his side. They lean toward each other as if in intimate conversation, against a painted backdrop resembling a soft, leafy garden scene.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard view of a riverside cityscape with grand baroque and historicist buildings along the water. A stone bridge with several arches spans the river, and paddle steamers and boats are visible on the water. Prominent church towers and ornate facades dominate the skyline. The word "Dresden" is printed in red in the upper left corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with many swimmers in the water and sunbathers on the sand. In the background there is a long, low modernist beachfront bathing complex with rows of cabins and terraces, backed by a tree‑covered bluff with a promenade. On the right foreground a woman in an old‑fashioned swimsuit stands looking toward the sea. The bottom margin of the card has captions in Cyrillic and German.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a calm river or canal bordered by grassy banks and pollarded trees. In the foreground a wooden rowboat with three people is moving along the water. The lower margin contains printed red text with the place name 'Ubbergen' and publisher information.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of four photographs of the same small European town. Each view shows slightly different angles of central streets lined with 19th‑ and early‑20th‑century townhouses and shopfronts. Pedestrians walk on the sidewalks and a mix of cars from the 1960s–1970s and a boxy truck are parked or driving along cobbled streets. Shop signs in German advertise paints/varnish and electrical household and cooking appliances. Trees and low wooded hills appear in the background of some views.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small river with a stone embankment and weir in the foreground, a fenced footpath and stairs leading up a wooded slope, and on the hill a rectangular villa-like building and a church with a tall spire and smaller turret. Printed text at the top identifies the place and the church.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand neoclassical colonnade filled with people in early 20th‑century clothing strolling and sitting. The image looks down a long interior walkway lined with tall Corinthian columns and a coffered ceiling with hanging lamps. At the bottom, a caption in German identifies the place as the interior of the Mühlbrunnen colonnade in Karlsbad.

Black-and-white postcard view of a quiet street lined with white picket fences and wooden houses, with leafless birch trees on both sides. A lone woman walks along the left sidewalk. In the distance there is a small townscape with a building bearing the sign "ELVERUM." Printed captions at the bottom include a publisher line and the title "Fra Elverum."

Old monochrome postcard view of a hilly town with large villas and residential buildings surrounded by trees. A road winds up the hillside, with several grand houses on the slope and in the valley below. The title at the top is in red Gothic-style script, and a small publisher credit is printed at the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a formal rose garden with curving gravel paths, flower beds, and rows of young rose trees. In the background stands an ornate open pavilion or music gazebo with a red roof and decorative trim, surrounded by tall leafy trees. A wooden bench is visible on the right side. The scene is tranquil and park-like, with printed red text at the top identifying the place.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over open fields and a river in the foreground, looking toward a compact historic town. The town has dense, mostly low-rise buildings and a prominent church with a tall spire dominating the skyline. Trees dot the meadows between the river and the town. In the upper left corner, red printed text reads "Frankenberg i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a wooded hillside toward a town and flat plain beyond. On the left stands a small castle‑like building with a round tower and a flag flying on top. Below and to the right stretches a settlement of houses, church spires, and fields. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Radebeul-West, Kötzschenbroda, and names the hilltop structure 'Die Friedensburg'.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long waterfront palace complex along the Bosphorus, viewed from the water with a small rowboat in the foreground. The architecture is ornate, with neo-baroque and neo-classical facades directly on the shoreline. French caption text appears in red at the bottom and publisher information in small print along the lower edge.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a detached two‑storey wooden house with a steep metal roof and two chimneys, likely from the early 20th century. Leafless trees stand in the foreground and electrical or telephone wires run across the scene. In the upper left corner there is printed text naming the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing an ornate historic interior, likely a throne or council room. The room has richly carved wooden wall paneling and furniture (a central table and high-backed chairs). Above the paneling are painted or frescoed full-length portraits of four medieval-looking rulers or knights, each framed in its own Gothic arch. The wallpaper or wall decoration features repeating heraldic motifs and small crosses, and the parquet floor is geometrically patterned.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a view of a historic castle courtyard and garden with stone columns in the foreground. Behind them stands a large fortified building with multiple windows and a rounded tower, part of the Castello del Buon Consiglio. In the distance are mountains and additional garden structures. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

Colorized illustrated street scene in a historic European city, viewed from above a tree‑lined boulevard that leads into a narrower street with tram tracks. The street is lined with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with shops and awnings at ground level and elaborate domes, spires, and statues on the roofs. Dominating the right side is a tall Baroque church tower with an onion‑shaped dome and clock. Pedestrians and a tram are visible, suggesting an early‑20th‑century urban atmosphere. No visible text appears on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large neoclassical manor or palace with a central portico supported by columns, an arched entrance, and a broad lawn in the foreground framed by trees. In the upper right corner, German text identifies the building.

A vintage monochrome (blue-toned) postcard showing a panoramic cityscape with a prominent flat-topped hill bearing ancient ruins on the left, likely the Acropolis overlooking the city. Foreground includes urban buildings; on the right edge there is a dark silhouette of a tree. The photo is printed within a light border that contains handwritten cursive text along the vertical right side and left margin. The lower part has a faint circular stamp and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.

A monochrome postcard showing an obelisk‑style war memorial standing on a stepped stone base in a clearing, surrounded by low hedges and trees. A cross is on top of the obelisk, and there appears to be an inscription plaque on its front. The setting looks like a cemetery or memorial park. Printed Estonian text appears below the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobbled alley bordered by tall, overhanging houses with wooden balconies. Light comes from the far end of the lane where more traditional houses are visible. The layout and style suggest an old town street scene. French captions are printed above and below the image.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone village street lined with plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and wooden shutters. A woman and a small child walk in the middle of the street while chickens wander nearby. Trees and garden fences flank the road. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large medieval brick or stone castle complex with a high round tower and multiple gabled roofs, dominating the skyline.

Colorized view of a medieval hilltop castle reflected in a calm river, surrounded by dense forest and rocky cliffs. The sky is light blue with a warm horizon, and printed red text in German appears at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white image showing a quiet residential street lined with large shade trees on the left and a row of detached wooden houses on the right. The houses feature broad front porches with columns, gabled roofs, and decorative trim typical of early 20th‑century American architecture. A neat picket fence with rounded finials encloses a small, well‑kept front garden with shrubs and a palm. A straight concrete sidewalk runs between the fence and a dirt verge beside the road, receding into the distance. There is a wide white border around the photograph, as often seen on old postcard prints.

A sepia-toned postcard showing ancient Egyptian ruins with massive stone columns and seated colossal statues. A person in traditional clothing stands near the base of one statue, emphasizing the scale of the architecture. The scene is framed by a beige border with a handwritten-style caption at the bottom and a small number at the lower left. A modern watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed across the lower right.

Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate Baroque-style garden terrace with stone balustrades, arches, and decorative columns. In the foreground there is a round fountain with a sculptural group on a rock base. In the background, a monumental gate and railings stand above the terrace. On the right, a high pedestal carries a large bird-of-prey statue with spread wings (the Turul). Manicured flowerbeds and paths frame the scene. Printed captions in red at the top identify the place and city.

Sepia-toned portrait postcard showing an elegant woman in early 20th‑century fashion, wearing a patterned coat with fur trim and a decorative headband. The lower part of the front bears printed credits and her name and profession in French.

Colorized postcard view of a large institutional building with red tiled roofs, white/cream walls, and green shutters, surrounded by a white fence along a street. The architecture features a turret-like rounded corner, multiple chimneys, dormer windows, and a garden area. At the top of the image there is printed text in German indicating the place and the building.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal procession of men in long overcoats, tailcoats and top hats walking in rows along a broad paved area in front of a large, ornate neoclassical building with rusticated lower stories and tall columns above. Some men carry canes; onlookers stand farther back. A large vertical flagpole or banner is visible at the right edge. The image has the look of an early‑20th‑century civic or diplomatic ceremony.

Black‑and‑white view of an ornate late‑19th‑century palace‑like building with a central pavilion, arched loggias on both sides, and elaborate mansard roof towers. A formal garden with flower beds and trimmed bushes fills the foreground, while elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along a path. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground there is a railway line with a steam locomotive and carriages beside station buildings and tracks. Behind the tracks, clustered houses, a church with a tower, and other town buildings spread up the slope of a wooded hill. The scene is rural and early‑industrial in character. In the top right corner, printed text reads the town name and region.

Colorized historic postcard showing ancient Doric columns of a ruined Greek temple in the foreground, with a large rocky hill and fortress area (Acrocorinth) rising behind. The top carries bilingual printed captions in French and Greek, and there is a website watermark at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a compact European town with dense rows of gabled houses and tiled roofs in the foreground, and a mix of larger brick buildings, factory chimneys emitting smoke, and a distant water tower in the background. The settlement is surrounded by gentle rolling hills. The architecture appears late‑19th to early‑20th century, with multi‑story townhouses and industrial buildings. No visible caption or written text can be seen on the image itself.

A vintage Russian Empire postal card printed on light brown card stock. At the top center, in red Cyrillic letters, it reads 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (Postal Card). On the left is a red imperial coat of arms. On the right is a red postage stamp with the Russian imperial double-headed eagle, overstruck with several circular black postmarks that read 'ГАФСАЛЬ'. The card is filled with handwritten addressing text in a mix of Cyrillic and Latin script, including a German-style salutation at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rectangular, two‑storey neoclassical building with symmetrical windows and a modest garden with a curving path in the foreground. Trees frame the scene on both sides. At the bottom left, white printed text identifies the location as an officers' casino in Döbeln. A red handwritten number "24952" appears along the upper margin.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a hilltop complex dominated by a large rectangular building with a steep hipped roof and a domed tower. Below it are several long, elegant townhouses or institutional buildings flanking a tree‑lined path that leads toward a small monument or fountain in the foreground. The scene is surrounded by wooded hills. In the upper right corner is printed text reading "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb."

Vintage multi-view postcard with three monochrome photographs from the village of Caoria in a mountainous valley. The top image shows a church with a bell tower labeled "Chiesa" against a backdrop of hills. The lower left image shows a building labeled "Oratorio Curaziale". The lower right image shows a multi‑storey school building labeled "Scuole Elementari". On the right side, large text reads "Saluti da CAORIA".

Color postcard view of a landscaped park with benches, a decorative lamppost, and a large monument topped by a statue of a standing figure (Dante Alighieri). Trees and mountains form the backdrop, and a church or civic tower rises behind the monument. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as the Dante Alighieri monument in Trento.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a metal arch bridge crossing a small river in a town. Behind the bridge stand ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with steep roofs and decorative façades, partly obscured by tall trees. In the far background a church or town‑hall tower rises above the rooftops. The caption in red Gothic-style print at the top left reads "Döbeln i. Sa. Königstraße.", indicating the street and town depicted.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a small printed photograph on the left showing a massive stone convent-church complex on a hill, with a path and trees in the foreground. The right side is blank for writing. Printed captions beneath the image identify the site and location, and a vertical printer's credit appears along the left margin.

An old official postcard form printed in Estonian, filled in by hand in purple and black ink. The left side lists various telephone fees in a tabular format with columns for kroons and senti, while the right side has address lines, a serial number field, and handwritten recipient information. There are multiple postal and administrative stamps, including a circular postmark from Risti, Estonia. The paper is yellowed, indicating age.

Colorized vintage street view showing a European town square with historic two‑ and three‑story buildings, a central church with a tall baroque-style bell tower, people walking and cycling, and trees lining the open square. The caption at the top names Varaždin and the specific square, and a sign on the left-hand building reads "Narodna čitaona" (people's reading room).

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a neoclassical building in the foreground with arcades and large arched windows, and a densely built hillside town rising behind it. At the top of the hill stands a prominent domed church. The image includes printed text along the left margin and at the bottom, and a modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr". The word "Syros" appears in script near the lower left.

A monochrome postcard showing an oval-framed portrait of a woman in profile, facing right, styled like an 18th–19th‑century pastel painting. Below the image there is a French caption crediting the subject as Countess Hanska and stating that the portrait is after a pastel by Jean Gigoux. The background is plain and the overall design is simple and vintage.

An old, hand‑colored multi‑view postcard with three framed scenes and floral Art Nouveau ornament. The left image shows a small town with a church featuring a tall tower and spire above red‑roofed houses. The upper central image shows a large inn or guesthouse with arches at the ground level and the sign "Gasthof Polenz Albin Jeheber" on the facade, with figures and carts in front. The right image depicts a rural landscape with fields and a stand of trees. In the center of the card is the printed greeting "Gruss aus Polenz." The lower margin contains publisher information and a note that it is a hand‑colored artist card.

Old black-and-white postcard showing a long brick Neo-Gothic building along a cobblestone street. The façade features tall arched windows, decorative brickwork, and stepped gables typical of Flemish architecture. Printed caption beneath the image reads "Bruges. — Institut Saint-François-Xavier." The card itself is aged and stained, with a blank margin around the photograph.

Colorized image of an open‑air theatrical performance in front of a small stage built in the form of an ancient Greek temple, with a pediment and Greek key frieze. Red curtains frame the proscenium, and a single performer stands on stage. A large crowd watches from simple chairs and standing room; many men wear military-style caps or fezzes, suggesting an early‑20th‑century Mediterranean setting. At the bottom is a printed web address indicating the image comes from a Greek archive.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a formal stone terrace or steps lined with evenly spaced trees, leading toward a monumental area in the distance. The border has a scalloped edge typical of vintage postcards. At the bottom is a printed caption in Latvian identifying the location.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a long red-brick military complex with a tall central tower and crenellated walls, fronted by a tree‑lined street and iron railings. The structure appears fortress‑like and institutional. At the top left, printed in red, is the caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded exhibition ground with a large rectangular reflecting pool in the foreground and an elaborate mud‑brick style palace or pavilion in the background. The architecture resembles Sahelian/Sudanese style with crenellated walls and towers. Numerous visitors walk along the paths and gather near the building. Printed text at the top and bottom identifies it as a view from the 1931 International Colonial Exhibition in Paris, specifically the palace seen from the Indochina section.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a small procession of men carrying large flags on a cobblestone street beside an iron fence and a park. One prominent flag bears a dark Nordic cross design. In the park stands a bust of a person on a pedestal with wreaths or floral tributes laid at its base. Townhouses and trees are visible in the background. A caption strip at the bottom center reads "2 oktober 1910", and a small archival mark in the lower left reads "Vk:2000:75".

A black‑and‑white view of a two‑storey mansion or small castle in a park-like setting. The building has a symmetrical facade with rectangular windows, decorative cornices, and a small balcony. On the right side stands a short, crenellated tower with Gothic‑revival details. The house is surrounded by lush trees and a garden with low shrubs, while a curved path leads toward the entrance.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village with many traditional gabled houses and farm buildings surrounded by trees and gardens. A prominent church with a tower and spire stands on the left side. At the bottom left, white script text overlays the image, identifying the location as a summer resort in Schmannewitz, Saxony.

Vintage monochrome view of a town nestled at the base of dramatic, sheer rock formations. The scene shows many small houses spread across a valley, with towering vertical cliffs and pinnacles dominating the background. Handwritten-style Greek text appears along the bottom margin, and there is also an overprinted modern website watermark.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm pond or small lake with rowboats and people boating in the foreground. The opposite bank is lined with trees, behind which stands a building with two pointed towers. Benches and a path run along the waterfront. Printed caption text appears at the lower left, and handwritten purple and red ink messages and a date are on the lower part of the card.

Black‑and‑white image of an ornate Baroque Catholic church interior, focused on the main altar. The altar is richly decorated with carved columns, statues of saints, candles, and framed images. Above and around the altar are painted arches and foliage-like decorations. In front of the altar rail a cloth banner bears a German Marian greeting. Wooden pews and decorative metal railings are visible in the foreground.

Colorized historic street scene viewed through a dark archway, showing a row of multi‑story townhouses with gabled roofs along a cobblestone market square. Horse‑drawn carts stand in front of the buildings, and shop signs in German hang on the façades. Printed red text at the top identifies the view as Hirschberg i. Schles., the northern market row looking toward the 'Ganslauben'.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a small wooden bridge over a fast‑flowing river or weir in a forested, rocky gorge. Water cascades beneath the bridge, creating white foam in the foreground. Tall coniferous trees rise behind the rocks. On the rock face to the right, a handwritten word is visible. The overall look is of an early 20th‑century landscape postcard.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over cultivated fields towards a small town nestled at the base of a wooded hill. On top of the hill stands a large castle‑like complex with towers. The buildings in the town feature typical early‑20th‑century Central European architecture. At the top of the image, printed in red Gothic‑style letters, is a German caption.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large street procession watched by dense crowds on both sides of a cobblestone street. Participants wear historical or religious-style robes and carry banners or a long cloth canopy. The buildings along the right side have tall, arched windows with shutters, and many onlookers lean out from upper-floor windows. The scene appears European and early 20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial waterfront complex on a lake or river. In the foreground is choppy water; on the shore stand several long, low factory buildings with gabled roofs, tall windows, and a central chimney. To the left is a large A‑frame crane structure by the water. Behind the factory rises a forested hillside with conifer trees and a few wooden houses scattered among them. The sky is overcast and empty, and there is no visible text or caption on the image side.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a wide seaside promenade with scattered pedestrians, some holding parasols. To the left is a long pier or jetty extending into the sea; in the background a densely built hillside town rises above the waterfront. On the right stands a large multi‑storey neoclassical building. The caption at the bottom is printed in Greek and French and identifies the scene as the promenade at the beach of Neo Faliro.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a leafy garden scene on a hillside. In the foreground there is a large wooden terrace or pavilion raised on supports and covered with dense green vines, surrounded by trees. Behind it stands a light-colored building with a red-tiled roof on an elevated slope. Printed text at the bottom right identifies the location and publisher.

A black-and-white panoramic view over a small alpine town nestled in a valley, with tiled-roof houses, church towers, and surrounding fields and hills. In the foreground there is a rustic wooden fence, and in the distance the landscape opens to farmland and mountains. Along the lower border of the image, printed text identifies the location as Cavalese in the Valle di Fiemme and notes its elevation.

Black‑and‑white image of a broad, tree‑lined avenue in a park or landscaped promenade. Tall deciduous trees on both sides form an arch overhead, with simple metal railings and low posts along the paths. The road forks into two directions in the distance. A child stands on the left beside the railing, while a woman in a long dress and hat walks on the right, suggesting late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century fashion. The background shows faint outlines of large buildings behind the trees.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large brick railway station with striped masonry and several steep towers and gables. In front of the building is a small kiosk with signs, and a crowd of people waiting along the street. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen, Station." The architecture and people's clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century European scene.

Multi-view black-and-white postcard showing a small rural village in a hilly forested area, a guesthouse named "Gasthof zum Thüringer Wald", a church with a clock tower, an interior view of a restaurant dining room, and a wooden-framed orientation map board. The map board includes place names and walking routes in German and references the municipality of Mühlstille / Mittelschmalkalden in the Thuringian Forest region.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo or coastal vessel at sea, viewed from the port side. The ship has two tall masts with ladders, a central deckhouse/bridge, and several crew visible on deck. The sea is relatively calm and a low breakwater or coastline is faintly visible in the distance. On the bow, a name is painted in block letters.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a narrow lane beside old stone fortification walls and a large round tower with a conical roof. Leafless trees line the path; a woman and a child walk along the wall in the foreground. Another tower is visible in the distance. Red printed German text is at the top of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a European city square with a richly decorated octagonal fountain in the foreground. The fountain has a tall, ornate column topped by a standing armed figure and surrounded by small putti figures. The basin is stone and filled with water, with an inscription plaque on its side. Around the square are multi‑story historicist façades covered with large painted advertisements and shop signs in German, including a tobacco and cigars shop and other merchants. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk past, including a man with a bicycle and uniformed men, suggesting a bustling urban setting.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier in front of a large stone wall with a relief of a fallen warrior and inscriptions in Greek. Two ceremonial guards in traditional uniform stand on either side of the monument. The lower border contains captions in Greek and French and a photographer credit, along with a small logo and a website watermark.

Color photograph of a lively, tree-lined pedestrian street with people walking, some pushing strollers and others sitting at outdoor café tables. Traditional European buildings with gabled roofs line the street; awnings and shop signs are visible, as well as bicycles and street furniture like benches. The postcard border is white, and the word "NIJMEGEN" is printed at the bottom.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a street scene in Bruges with Gothic-style buildings behind an iron fence. To the right is an ornate, chapel-like structure with pointed arches and tracery; in the center stands a larger historic mansion with turrets, known as the Gruuthuse, and in the foreground several women in long dresses walk along the street. Printed caption text appears at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide river curving through a rural landscape with low hills. In the foreground a paddle steamboat with passengers is docked at a small landing stage, with several people standing on the shore. On the right bank a rocky hill or quarry rises above scattered houses and trees. Handwritten-style German captions are printed in the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a group of uniformed postal workers and other staff inside a large room, standing and sitting at long tables piled with parcels and boxes. Shelves and stacks of packages line the back of the room. A handwritten caption in a cursive style appears along the top edge of the image.

Hand-colored view down a narrow, sunlit alley in an old European town. Tall buildings with green shutters and small balconies line both sides, with laundry hanging overhead. Several people in early 20th‑century dress walk along the street. On the right, a woman stands behind a counter in a dark shop doorway. The facade on the right shows a faded sign, and another hanging sign reads 'VINS'. At the bottom margin, printed text reads 'Corner of the old Town'.

Black‑and‑white seaside view with dramatic sun rays over the Black Sea, small fishing boats near the surf, and people watching from a promenade railing. The reverse has Romanian text, a Romanian stamp, and postmarks.
Color postcard showing a group of visitors standing by a massive, ancient oak tree in a park-like setting, with a path, low chains, and dense conifer trees around.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close, low‑angle view of the baroque sculptural group atop a monumental stone gate: an equestrian figure with attendants and rich ornamentation. The reverse has Romanian postage and caption identifying it as a detail of the third gate of the citadel in Alba Iulia.

Two-sided postcard. Front: black‑and‑white photograph of a round medieval brick tower with crenellations and Gothic arched openings, surrounded by trees. Back: Romanian printed header naming the site, a 40 BANI brown‑green bear stamp reading "Posta R.P. ROMÎNĂ," circular postmarks, blue handwritten message and address to Bucharest.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a mountain chalet with large windows (Casa Diham) set in a forested valley near Bușteni, with a snow‑dusted peak in the background and a 1940s–50s style car parked in front. The reverse has printed multilingual captions and a handwritten Romanian message and address.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a mountain town surrounded by forests and rolling hills. The back reads "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ – VATRA DORNEI — Vedere generală" and has a Romanian stamp (R.P. Romînă, fish motif), Vatra Dornei and Brăila postmarks, and a handwritten Romanian message and address.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the grand spa building with domed roof and towers in a forested mountain setting. Printed caption on the image reads "VATRA DORNEI – Pavilionul central al băilor." The reverse is a Romanian postcard of the People's Republic era with a triangular 40‑bani airmail butterfly stamp, a Vatra Dornei postmark, printed headings, a handwritten message dated 30.VI.1964, and an address to Brăila, Reg. Galați.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a mountain resort scene with chalets and many visitors walking on a road, dense conifer forest, and a prominent limestone cliff in the Eastern Carpathians. The back reads in Romanian and Cyrillic, identifies the view as Lacul Roșu (Red Lake), and bears typical address lines and the publisher mark.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing the Olt River valley at Căciulata, with forested hills and the river running between them; a few rooftops are visible among the trees. The caption "Oltul la Căciulata" is printed on the image. The reverse side reads "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ," has a 40‑bani Romanian stamp marked "Posta R.P. ROMÎNĂ" and a cancellation dated 22.VII.1964, publisher Editura Meridiane, and a handwritten Romanian message addressed to Brăila.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view tourist postcard showing scenes from the Romanian spa resort Călimănești: panoramic views of a valley town by wooded hills, a grand hotel with steep roofs, a riverside villa with a sailboat, a park pavilion/gazebo, and forested parkland. The title "CĂLIMĂNEȘTI" appears vertically on the picture side. The back has Romanian layout text, a Romanian stamp (40 Bani, Posta Română) depicting a lizard (Ablepharus kitaibelii fitzingeri), and a 1968 cancellation. Addressed in Romanian to an addressee in Brăila on Bulevardul Karl Marx.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing scenes from a large botanical garden: ponds with giant water lilies, greenhouses, paths with visitors, a statue and landscaped areas. The title on the front reads "CLUJ – GRĂDINA BOTANICĂ." The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Bucuresti postmark, and printed publisher and price information.

Color postcard showing a sandy beach lined with many tents, cars and a few camper vans along the Black Sea coast. People are sunbathing and swimming. The back has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 Bani POSTA ROMANA stamp with a Mangalia cancellation, and printed caption identifying the place as 2 Mai beach. Publisher: Editura Meridiane; photo credit Al. Mendrea; price Lei 1,50.

Color postcard showing a busy seaport with docks, cranes, cargo ships, warehouses, rail tracks and a striped breakwater lighthouse. The reverse side has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp, Constanța and București postmarks, and a printed caption identifying the view of the harbour.

A multiview color postcard with a ribbon title reading "Constanta," showing seaside scenes, modernist hotels and promenades, people in swimsuits, a harbor ship, a public square with a mosaic building, and ancient Roman ruins by the Black Sea. The reverse is a Romanian divided back with preprinted stamp, price and postal guidance.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a seaside resort with modernist villas along the Black Sea shoreline. Caption at top reads "EFORIE‑NORD – Vile pe malul mării." The reverse is a Romanian People's Republic postcard with a 40 bani stamp, cancellations from Eforie Nord and București, and a handwritten Romanian message and date (1963).

Black‑and‑white view of a modernist office block with a grid facade and the rooftop sign "PTTR". People stroll on a paved plaza; 1950s–60s cars and motorcycles are parked in front. The reverse bears Romanian text, stamp, and postmarks indicating Eforie Nord.

Multi-view color postcard of the Black Sea resort Eforie Nord, showing crowded beaches, seaside promenades, and a modernist hotel. The front bears the title "EFORIE NORD." The reverse has a Romanian 40 Bani "POSTA ROMANA" stamp, Constanța postmarks, Romanian handwriting and address to București, and the publisher imprint Editura Meridiane with a printed price.

Color postcard showing a very crowded seaside beach with concrete terraces and modernist resort buildings above the shore. People are swimming and sunbathing; a small boat is near the surf. The reverse side has Romanian printed headings and publisher details, a purple circular stamp marked C B1, a handwritten message and an address.

Color postcard showing a seaside scene at the Black Sea: a stone terrace with wrought-iron lamps overlooks a crowded sandy beach with umbrellas and sunbathers. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and postmark, and printed credits indicating the location Eforie Nord.
Color postcard showing a crowded beach and rough waves on the Black Sea with several modernist seaside hotels and resort buildings along the shore, viewed from the water under a clear blue sky.

Color postcard showing a modernist seaside hotel complex: a tall slab tower with repetitive balconies behind a low, terraced building with exterior stairs. People in swimsuits are relaxing on a grassy slope with trees. A round logo reading "Eforie Nord" appears on the front.

Color postcard showing a crowded seaside resort with a rocky pier and a lagoon where people are bathing and a canoe is approaching shore. Three tall modernist hotel towers rise behind a grassy embankment. The reverse has Romanian text and a blue 40 BANI Posta Romana stamp with 1974 cancellations.

Color postcard showing a modernist hotel complex with the sign HOTEL BRAN, lawns and sculptures in front, under a blue sky. The back has Romanian pre-printed address fields, handwritten note, Romanian stamps (including a JUDETUL BUZAU coat-of-arms 55 b stamp and a 40 b POSTA ROMANA stamp) and Bucuresti postmarks. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the view as Eforie Nord: Hotelul «Bran».

Vintage multi-view postcard showing the Romanian seaside resort Eforie Nord on the Black Sea. The front has a collage: beachgoers under an umbrella, a pier into the sea, hotel buildings (including one marked "STEAUA MARE"), and greenery. Large title reads "EFORIE NORD." The reverse has Romanian text fields, handwritten message and address, two Romanian stamps, and a postmark from Eforie Nord.

Color postcard showing a modernist seaside hotel facade with many circular balcony openings and a ground‑floor terrace; sign "RECEPTIE" above the entrance. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, Romanian stamps ("POSTA ROMANA 55 b", "ROMANIA 40 BANI"), Bucharest postmarks, and a printed caption reading "EFORIE NORD – Hotel Cascom".

Color postcard showing a mid‑century, four‑story seaside hotel with balconies and a large rooftop sign that reads "HOTEL DIANA." Two beachgoers in swimsuits walk along a garden path in front of the entrance. The reverse side has Romanian text, address fields, a Mangalia 1970 postmark, and a caption identifying the place as Eforie – Hotel Diana.

Color postcard showing a crowded seaside resort with grassy dunes, a beach and outdoor pools. Modernist high-rise hotels dominate the background; the leftmost tower bears the sign "MEDUZA." Pathways with benches lead down to the sand and swimming areas.

A color postcard showing a crowded sandy beach with sunbathers and umbrellas along the Black Sea. A stone groyne extends into the water. The reverse side has Romanian text, multilingual caption, publisher credit, price, and a Romanian stamp and postmark.

Color postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with swimmers in the surf, a tiered modernist pavilion on the left, terraced seawall and green bluffs, and several tall hotel blocks set among trees in the background. Clear summer sky. Reverse side has Romanian handwriting, postmarks, stamp, and a printed caption identifying Eforie Nord.

Black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges showing several people on a sailboat close to shore. Behind them is a long sloped concrete seawall with modernist buildings along the waterfront. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a BUCURESTI postmark, and a printed caption indicating Eforie-Nord.

Color postcard showing a crowded Black Sea beach with waves crashing against a concrete jetty and three tall modernist hotel towers on a grassy bluff. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a 40 Bani Posta Română stamp (Densuș), and a Bucharest cancellation dated 30.08.1972. Printed caption indicates Eforie Nord; address is to București.

Color postcard showing a crowded seaside resort with a sandy beach, a long pier/groyne into the Black Sea, and a circular modernist pavilion beside a swimming pool. The back has Romanian text, stamps reading POSTA ROMANA, and a cancellation from Eforie Nord.

Color postcard showing a small pedestrian bridge over a mountain stream with a tree‑lined riverside promenade and forested hills in the background. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and postmarks. Printed caption at bottom reads SLĂNIC‑MOLDOVA.

Color postcard showing a sunset over the Black Sea from a wrought‑iron seaside terrace with tables, chairs and two ornate lamp posts; a person stands in silhouette watching the sun. The reverse side is a Romanian postcard form with a POSTA ROMANA 55B stamp and cancellation, published by Editura Sport‑Turism. It is addressed to Udrescu Vasile in București. Printed caption mentions România and Eforie Nord with multilingual translations for "sunset."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide city street lined with multi‑story masonry buildings with ornate facades. The right side features a long, prominent building with arched windows, balconies, and ground‑floor shops with awnings; horse‑drawn vehicles and pedestrians are faintly visible. The left side of the image fades into blank space. Printed text in Russian and Latin script at the top right identifies the view as a street scene in Omsk and specifies the street name.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a Lutheran church with wooden pews, a raised pulpit on the left, an ornate altar and reredos in the center, a large circular stained‑glass window above, chandeliers, hymn number boards, and decorative columns. Caption text is printed along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European hill town. A winding path and fenced gardens lead up a slope covered with many flowering trees. On the hilltop stand dense rows of ornate late‑19th‑century houses and a prominent Gothic‑revival church with a tall spire. To the right, a large fortified complex or castle occupies the edge of a rocky cliff above the town. In the foreground are compact townhouses and a tall factory chimney. The sky is blank and there is no printed caption or writing visible.

An old monochrome postcard image depicting a large fortified complex with towers, crenellated walls, and a mix of medieval and Renaissance architectural elements. In the foreground are a few people, carts, and early motor vehicles on a wide road. Trees frame the scene, with mountains faintly visible in the background. At the top of the postcard is printed the caption: "Trento - Castello del Buon Consiglio."

A monochrome postcard showing three veiled women seen from behind as they stand in a doorway with a large circular arch, looking out toward a river or estuary and a distant flat shoreline. The image is framed by the dark interior around the arch. Printed text below the photograph includes a reference to Rabat and the Oudayas.

A colorized historical postcard view of a cityscape dominated by a large Gothic church with a tall, sharp spire rising above older town walls and towers. In the foreground is a tree‑lined avenue leading toward a round defensive tower and city gate. The scene appears pastoral with scattered houses and greenery around the fortifications. Printed caption text in German is at the top left, and there are smaller printer's marks along the left and right margins plus some handwritten notes at the bottom right.

Colorized panoramic postcard view of a hillside spa town with richly ornamented multi‑story buildings in historicist style. A row of grand townhouses and hotels lines a street in the foreground, while larger villas and mansions are scattered up the green hillside, with a forested hill in the background. A smoking red chimney rises from one of the foreground buildings. Printed captions in German appear at the top, identifying the town and specific streets.

A black‑and‑white view of a landscaped garden with a dramatic war monument in the foreground. The statue shows a standing female figure holding a flag above a fallen soldier with a rifle, all mounted on a large stone pedestal partly covered with foliage. An eagle sculpture is at the base. On the front of the pedestal is an inscription in German script. Behind the monument stands a large neo‑Gothic or historicist brick building with ornate gables, turrets, dormer windows and a prominent rose window, suggesting a town hall or civic building. Tall trees and manicured shrubs frame the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small bridge over a narrow river or stream, with several children standing on the riverbank and in the shallow water. Behind the bridge are two- and three‑story houses with pitched roofs and trees lining the street. In the upper left, red printed text reads "Radeberg. An der Röder." and red vertical text on the right margin gives the publisher information. The scene appears to be a quiet town view along the Röder river.

A sepia-toned image of an early 20th‑century steam locomotive shown in full side profile on tracks, printed on a postcard-style card with a blank background. The engine has tank-locomotive features and visible driving rods and wheels. Small printed captions appear in the lower left and lower right corners.

Color illustration of a European market square with outdoor stalls and white umbrellas around a central fountain topped by statues. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and German-language shop signs. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a prominent clock tower with a steep roof and two large clock faces, connected to fortification walls and greenery.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large medieval castle complex with two tall, pointed-roof towers standing by a calm river, whose surface reflects the entire structure. The castle rises above tree‑covered slopes and a few smaller riverside buildings. In the foreground on the right are grassy banks and dense bushes with a tall tree, framing the view of the castle across the water. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white street view showing a large, ornate brick public building with a clock in the central gable and mansard roof on the left, and a cobblestone street rising uphill between rows of smaller townhouses on the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk; a horse‑drawn carriage stands near a corner building with a sign reading "Restaurant". Overhead electric wires cross the sky. The scene has the formal, documentary style typical of early European city postcards.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a large ornate Renaissance-style brick building with many statues along its facade and tall windows; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand on a cobbled street with a horse‑drawn cart. In the distant background a tall church tower is visible. There is printed text at the bottom naming the city and building and handwritten cursive text across the sky and lower margin.

Multi-view color postcard showing scenes from a traditional rural complex or ethnic restaurant: thatched huts and outdoor seating, people in modern casual clothes walking past whitewashed buildings, diners at rustic tables laden with food, musicians playing accordion, and women performing folk dances in richly decorated red and black traditional costumes. The title in a green panel at the top left is written in Cyrillic script.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a Catholic religious gathering in a forested shrine. A group of women, girls, and a priest stand around an enclosed area with statues of the Virgin Mary and a kneeling figure, surrounded by ornate lamp posts and iron railings. At the bottom, in red lettering, is the caption "MONTAGNAGA DI PINE' - 'La Comparsa,'" indicating a Marian apparition site at Montagnaga di Pinè.

Black-and-white landscape image showing a forested valley with a river curving through it. A railway line and road run along the riverbank, with a small building by the tracks. In the distance are wooded hills and scattered buildings. In the lower left corner, there is a printed caption in German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide street bordered on the left by a long multi‑story brick building with shopfronts and awnings, with horse‑drawn carts and pedestrians in the dirt roadway. On the right side is a tree‑lined fence and sidewalk receding into the distance. Russian text at the top identifies the scene as Omsk and mentions Dvortsovaya Street and the Zaitseva Hotel.

A monochrome postcard showing a forested rocky hill with ruins visible along the ridge. At the base of the hill stands a small church with a tower and steep roof, next to a farmhouse-style building in a rural valley setting. In the blank margin at lower left is printed the caption 'Berg Oybin.' and a red handwritten number.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an Alpine guesthouse or mountain chalet in a wide meadow, surrounded by coniferous forest with high, rugged, snow‑covered peaks in the background. A tall flagpole with a light‑colored flag stands to the right of the house. Several people in traditional early‑20th‑century rural clothing stand by a wooden fence and gate in front of the building. The architecture features wooden balconies, overhanging roof eaves, and decorative timber framing typical of Alpine inns. Faint text appears on the building's facade and along the bottom edge of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large medieval castle with high walls and a round tower flying a flag. The structure stands above a moat or deep ditch, with mountains visible in the hazy background. Trees partially frame the scene, and small figures can be seen near the base of the walls. Printed caption text in Italian appears along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white vintage beach view showing a wide sandy shore crowded with sunbathers, several long wooden piers extending into a calm bay, and a excursion boat on the water. Trees frame the upper edge of the image, and low hills lie across the bay. In the lower right corner, printed text in Cyrillic and Latin characters labels the scene as a beach in the city then named Stalin.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a bustling open-air market square with horse-drawn carts, vendors, and townsfolk in traditional dress. Behind the market activity stand multi‑story 19th‑century style buildings with many windows and pitched roofs. The caption at the top is printed in Russian and identifies the scene and its number in a series.

Sepia panoramic view of a small town nestled in a valley with surrounding hills or low mountains. The settlement consists of clustered traditional buildings and a prominent church with a tall steeple on the right side. In the foreground are fields, orchards, and trees. A white border surrounds the image, and the caption at the bottom reads "CIVEZZANO (Trentino) - Panorama."

Black‑and‑white night view of a long, arcaded building with repeated stone arches and columns running in perspective. A band of bright horizontal lights traces the façade above the arches, giving the structure a modern, illuminated look. Large display windows and glass doors line the ground floor; above one entrance is a round clock and a decorative emblem. The pavement in front is broad and mostly empty. The photo has white, slightly wavy edges consistent with vintage postcard paper.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a decorative ceiling or panel layout divided into triangular and oval sections with ornate borders. Each section contains religious imagery: scenes from the life of Christ (including the Crucifixion) and portraits of saints rendered in a classical Catholic style. Around the circular portraits, Latin names of saints are inscribed.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large group of people—men, women and children—posed in front of a timber and brick inn or guesthouse with a tiled roof. Two people stand on a small balcony above the group. German text is printed on the building's signs and at the top of the postcard, where a greeting from Roßbach and the name of the establishment are mentioned.

Color-tinted image showing a person walking along a curving path beside a long, ivy‑covered stone ruin with two levels of arched openings. The structure looks partly collapsed, with exposed brickwork and vegetation growing over the walls and on the roof. In the background, a high arched gate or portal stands across the path. The trees are bare, suggesting late autumn or winter. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly ornamented Gothic façade of a large cathedral. The view focuses on the central main portal with pointed arches, elaborate stone carvings, statues, and a large rose window above. Printed caption text appears below the image in French.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large group of uniformed young men or cadets posed in rows in front of a wooden building with a metal roof and chimney. Several officers stand at the sides, and some equipment or stands are in the foreground. Along the bottom is red‑printed location text and a long handwritten message in blue ink.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view from a riverbank looking across a broad river toward a European town. In the foreground are a rocky shoreline and a dirt path with grass. On the opposite bank stand industrial buildings with tall smokestacks, small riverside structures, boats moored along the shore, and a dense cluster of townhouses. Above the town rises a large church with a steeply pitched roof and a tall baroque-style tower or spire. To the right, on a hill surrounded by trees, is a castle‑like complex or manor with two towers. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century Central or Eastern European riverside town. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image.

A black‑and‑white interior view of a brick crypt or underground chapel. The vaulted ceiling and thick brick columns form rounded arches. In the background, up a few steps, stands a simple altar with candles. The space is sparsely decorated and lit by a single lamp on the ceiling, giving a solemn, contemplative atmosphere typical of early‑20th‑century ecclesiastical architecture.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a fast‑flowing river with rapids, bordered by dense coniferous forest and a low stone embankment. Two small wooden boats with men using poles navigate the turbulent water, with loose logs in the current. In the lower left corner there is a printed caption in Swedish describing the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide unpaved road lined with young trees (Rue Evangelistria) leading toward a distant cityscape with low buildings and a fortified hill in the background. A solitary figure stands in the middle of the road. At the top there is handwritten text in an Ottoman-style script. At the bottom, printed captions in Greek and French identify the view as Evangelistria Street in Salonique (Thessaloniki). The website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears on the right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an elderly man in formal 19th‑century clothing seated in an armchair in a study or living room. He rests his head on one hand, facing left, beside a table with a patterned cloth and papers. Behind him are bookcases filled with books and walls covered with framed pictures and artworks; small statues stand on top of the bookcase. The scene is indoors and intimate, presented as a historic photograph. Printed text appears along the bottom border.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a multi-story early 20th‑century building with a steep roof, dormer windows, and a small tower-like structure on top. The facade bears the word "Sparkasse" and the building sits behind a low fence with trees in the foreground. At the top left of the card is printed the caption "Altmittweida — Gemeindeamt." The overall style suggests a German small-town municipal/bank building.

A monochrome postcard view of a grand historic villa or small castle with a tall pointed tower, sitting on a wooded hillside above a river or lake. A pontoon-style bridge or walkway crosses the water in the foreground, with reflections of the buildings and trees visible in the calm surface. Another large house stands further to the right atop the hill. At the top of the image, in red Gothic-style type, is the printed caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white image of a large medieval castle complex with two tall, slender towers and long slate roofs, standing on a wooded hill above a calm river or moat. Trees line the water's edge in the foreground, and the castle walls rise directly from the rocky slope. The style suggests a Central European fortress; no printed caption or border is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town's main street or square. Two rows of 2–3‑story houses with steep tiled roofs and shuttered windows line both sides of the street. In the center is a landscaped green with small bushes and trees, enclosed by low fences. A tall commemorative column with an eagle sculpture on top stands prominently in the middle of the green, surrounded by a small iron fence and a pedestal bearing an inscription.
