In the background rises a large medieval church or town‑hall–like building with multiple steep gables and tower spires. A few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks.

A black-and-white postcard showing a wooded hill crowned with fortifications and buildings, including a domed tower in the center. The slope beneath is covered with dense trees and rocky outcrops. At the lower left border, a caption in German identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a tram in the foreground and 3–4‑storey townhouses lining both sides of a broad cobbled street. In the background stands a large church or town‑hall tower with a layered, domed spire topped by a cross. The facades bear painted advertisements in German script. People are walking along the sidewalks and in the open square, which has a central lamppost.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long bathing room with a row of metal bathtubs on each side, set on wooden slatted flooring with exposed pipes and radiators along the walls. A woman in a checked dress and head covering stands by an open wooden door at the far end. In the lower left corner, handwritten text reads "NUMMELA LUONTOLA".

Sepia-toned ethnographic postcard showing a kneeling, bare‑chested person in a striped cloth before two large, heavily adorned ritual figures or statues. The central figure is tall, covered with objects, wearing a mask-like face and feathered headdress; a smaller figure with a sword or staff stands beside it. The lower half of the card is blank except for printed red text. Along the left edge there is a vertical publisher credit, and at the bottom center and right are captions in red.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rocky, tree-covered hill or small cliff beside a shoreline, likely a lake or river. The left half is occupied by the natural landscape, while the right half is left blank for writing, with red printed captions in German at the top right and along the right edge.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large institutional building labeled "Marthastift Bautzen" with several stories, steep roof and dormer windows, flanked by other townhouses. In the foreground is a structured garden or orchard where numerous women and girls in long dresses and aprons are working among the plants. The overall style is late 19th to early 20th century.

A black‑and‑white panoramic cityscape showing the rooftops and buildings of an older European town. In the foreground are dense, low-rise houses and a distinctive round pavilion-like building with a many-sided roof and arched windows. In the distance stand taller masonry buildings and church spires under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, with additional handwritten text over the light foreground.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a small European town with multi-story masonry houses along a road. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk on the sidewalk beside a fenced watercourse or dry riverbed. Trees line the right side, with hills in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Schmiedeberg in the Erzgebirge and the specific street as Altenberger Straße.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard composed of four photographs. The upper left image shows a two‑storey Baroque or Neoclassical manor‑like building with dormer windows, a central entrance with balcony, and a small bell turret on the roof, fronted by a circular flowerbed and a driveway. The upper right image depicts an interior dining room or banquet hall with patterned wallpaper, curtains, simple wooden chairs and rectangular tables set with vases and tablecloths. The lower left image shows a workshop or factory room with several people (likely women) seated at desks, working with small machines or assembly tools under task lamps. The lower right image presents another view of the same manor‑style complex from the courtyard side, featuring a tower-like entrance bay with a small spire and weathervane, surrounded by trees and neighboring buildings. There is no legible printed or handwritten text visible on the front side.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large late‑19th‑century neoclassical / historicist building along a tree‑lined street. The facade has rusticated corners, arched windows in the central risalit, pediments over some windows, and a modest towerlike central section. A wrought‑iron fence with gate separates the sidewalk from a small front garden. The street is broad and shaded by regularly planted trees. No visible text or caption appears on the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a row of massive stone columns and arches in a vaulted interior space, likely an old subterranean or covered structure. The image is bordered by a cream frame, and printed text along the bottom identifies the site as columns of Bab-Reirr in Meknes.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small pond with reeds and ducks in the foreground, and multi‑storey residential and institutional buildings on the far bank. Behind them rises a tall brick tower with a distinctive pointed top. Trees frame the scene. In the bottom right corner, handwritten text identifies the place and photographer.

A black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing small rowing and sailing boats in a harbor, with a coastal city and mountains in the background. A prominent lighthouse stands on a pier to the right. Greek and French captions appear at the bottom of the image, and a web address watermark is visible across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view of a rural Alpine valley with steep forested mountains in the background. A dirt path runs through dense vegetation toward a multi‑story white building on the right side, labeled as a mountain hotel. The caption strip at the bottom identifies the location as Bresimo in Val di Non at 1000 meters above sea level and mentions the Albergo Alpino with baths at La Rotonda, owned by Battista Dalla Torre.

Black‑and‑white panoramic postcard photograph showing a rural riverside landscape with fields, scattered houses, a road lined with trees and telegraph poles in the foreground, and a wide river curving past rocky cliffs and wooded hills in the background. The printed caption in German appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a decorative metal gazebo or kiosk in a lush city park. The structure has an ornate railing and columns, topped with a domed roof and finial. Surrounding it are trees, flowering bushes, benches, lampposts and a paved walkway. At the bottom, red printed text identifies the scene as a kiosk in Parque Seminario in Guayaquil, Ecuador.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a semi‑rural district with fields, trees, and several prominent buildings. On the right stands a church with a tall tower and onion-shaped spire; on the left a large multi‑story building with a clock tower is visible behind a smaller house. The scene looks toward a forested hillside in the background. Decorative red script text identifying the location appears at the bottom center, and a small caption appears at the bottom right; the publisher's imprint is printed along the bottom left edge.

Vintage printed postcard with three black‑and‑white illustrations. On the left is a large brick building labeled "Hotel Keizer Karel" with a central tower and flag. In the upper center-right, framed by floral motifs, is a gabled historic building labeled "De Waag." On the far right is a garden scene with an arched stone structure labeled "De Ruïne." At the top center is a purple stamped word "VOORHEEN" with arrows on both sides. At the bottom right is the greeting text "Groeten uit Nijmegen." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century souvenir postcard from the Dutch city of Nijmegen.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a dramatic nocturnal seascape: calm water with a few rocks in the foreground, a dark headland or cape on the left, and a cloudy sky lit from behind near the horizon. Along the bottom margin there is printed text in Russian and French, including the artist's name and title, and a publisher imprint from St. Petersburg.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm river bordered by dense trees and bushes, with a large ivy‑covered house or estate building on the right bank. Rolling hills are faintly visible in the background. The caption in red at the top left reads "Naumburg a. Saale. Partie an der Henne."

A vintage monochrome New Year greeting card dated 1890. The main text 'Godt nytt år!' is written in ornate script across a decorative banner with floral and grain motifs and a circular ornamental pattern behind it. Below is a cursive message in Swedish or closely related Scandinavian language, and in the lower right corner appears the sender's name 'E. Nylund.' The card has rounded corners and a simple cream background.

Black‑and‑white image of a broad, quiet residential street lined with early‑20th‑century multi‑storey townhouses and villas. On the left side are ornate houses with steep tiled roofs, dormers, and decorated facades behind wooden fences and trees. On the right side are more uniform, stuccoed apartment houses behind solid masonry fences and gates. There are several tall trees along the sidewalk, utility poles, and early overhead telephone/telegraph lines. A few people in dark clothing walk or stand along the street, and a cyclist is visible further down the road. The street surface appears partly unpaved. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeshore. Two men in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the grassy bank of a calm lake, with birch trees, a small boat pulled up on shore, and a stacked pile of branches or logs in the foreground. Across the water, low forested hills with scattered houses are visible. The caption printed at the top right reads "Saugtjernet, Elverum".

A black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) winter street scene showing a wide snow-covered avenue lined with multi‑story stone buildings on the left and right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street and sidewalks. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Vegagatan in Göteborg. Additional printed information and a museum inventory code appear along the edges.

A sepia-toned portrait of a young man in a decorated military-style uniform, facing forward, with short hair and round eyeglasses. The background is plain and fades softly around his shoulders, giving a studio-portrait effect. At the bottom is printed text in both French and Greek, and there is a circular seal or emblem on the lower left.

Sepia-toned vintage street view of a European town. It shows a wide unpaved road lined with multi‑storey residential and commercial buildings on both sides. On the left is a row of houses with a shop sign on the nearer corner building. On the right are larger houses, one with a distinctive corner tower and steep roof. A person with a pram is visible in the distance. Printed captions at the top identify the town and the street.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a canal lined with traditional stepped‑gabled houses. In the foreground, numerous swans rest and stand along a tree‑shaded embankment, while their reflections appear in the calm water. The background shows more historic buildings and a church or civic tower. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

Vintage multi-view postcard with four black-and-white photographs of large institutional buildings and streets. Each image is captioned in German, all referring to the "Landeskrankenhaus" (state hospital). The views show a convalescent home, the main avenue lined with trees and multi‑storey hospital wings, another broader view titled simply "Landeskrankenhaus", and a domed chapel building. At the bottom center the city name "GRAZ" is printed.

A vintage postcard view of a single‑storey colonial-era commercial building with a tin roof, wide veranda, and wooden railing. Several people stand on the veranda and near the entrance. Leafless trees frame the foreground, and the sky has a pastel dusk or dawn gradient. Printed multilingual text at the top identifies the location and the commercial house J. A. Serrinha.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing an empty football (soccer) stadium named Lövåsvallen in Billingsfors. The image captures the pitch from one corner, with a dirt running track and simple metal railings around the field. On the right side is a small wooden grandstand with a sharply angled roof. Beyond the field there is dense forest, and in the far background a lake and low hills under a cloudy sky. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Illustrated color postcard showing a landscaped path between old casemate walls on a hillside, with arched brick structures on both sides and a tall bell tower with a distinctive dome in the background. A well‑dressed man with a cane stands in the foreground feeding birds. The scene is tranquil and park‑like, likely part of historic fortifications.

Vintage monochrome postcard illustration of a coastal promenade or rural shoreline scene. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing walk along a path beside trees and fencing, while others stand near small rowboats at the water's edge. A larger building is visible further along the shore. The lower part of the image contains printed captions including the location and a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white view of a hillside with dense trees, terraced paths, and historic buildings. Dominating the scene is a square clocktower with large clock faces on at least two visible sides and a steep, shingled roof with wooden projections. Other fortification-like buildings stand further along the ridge. A small printed number "368" appears in the lower-left border.

Monochrome winter landscape showing a snowy slope with ski or sled tracks in the foreground, dense snow‑covered trees on the left, and a small village on the right with scattered houses and a church tower. Handwritten red number "22581" appears at the top right, and cursive captions along the bottom border read "Erzgebirge." on the left and "Winter in Schellerhau." on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a crowded cobblestone street scene with tram tracks. A dense crowd of people is running toward the camera while smoke billows in the background, likely from firecrackers or a pyrotechnic display. Tall stone and masonry buildings line the street; on the right are shopfronts and balconies with onlookers. A church or large stone religious building stands on the right side of the street. Printed caption and handwritten notes appear at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Gothic-style church with a tall tower rising above the tightly packed roofs of a historic town on a river. In the background, a stone bridge crosses the river and hills stretch into the distance. German captions at the top read "Pirna a. Elbe" on the left and "Blick vom Sonnenstein" on the right.

Black‑and‑white image of a rural village street centered on a two‑storey building with the sign "Restaurant… König Albert Eiche." The house is covered in vines and fronted by a fenced garden. Several adults and children stand in front, one person with a dog, and a child with a small cart. A horse‑drawn carriage travels up the unpaved road to the right, flanked by trees, hedges, and small houses with gabled roofs. The scene has an early‑20th‑century Central European village atmosphere.

A hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a small river or stream flowing through a woodland park. There is a stone bridge with railings crossing the stream, and wooden fences line the path and park boundary. Leafless or early‑spring trees, including birches, fill the scene, under a pale blue and pink sky. Printed captions in German appear along the bottom margin.

A black-and-white postcard showing a modernist square with porticoed buildings, outdoor café tables with umbrellas, and strong geometric shadows. On the right is a marble-clad colonnade; at center is a multi-storey building with balconies and rooftop decorations. The caption at the bottom right reads "Trento - Piazza Littorio."

Color lithographed postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilly town with a prominent church on a ridge, identified in the caption as Schneeberg in the Ore Mountains. The central landscape is framed by a decorative border with leaves and berries. On the left foreground is a miner or worker leaning against a structure, holding a tool or lamp; on the right is a woman seated and making bobbin lace. The bottom contains printed German text naming the place and viewpoint.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a dramatic rocky pillar topped by a monastery complex. Buildings with light‑colored walls and tiled roofs sit on the flat top of the huge cliff, with steep rock faces dropping to a rough path below. The card has a white border with scalloped edges, and printed captions in Greek and French identifying the scene.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a substantial two‑storey civic-looking building on a dirt street, with tall trees and a simple wooden fence on the left. Several uniformed men stand on the stairs at the main entrance. Large flags hang from poles on the facade, and another flag flies from the roof. The architecture has a Central European late‑19th‑century style with rectangular windows and modest stucco decoration. No text is clearly legible in the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly carved Baroque interior of a wooden church. In the foreground is an ornate pulpit covered with dense floral and figurative woodcarving, standing on a sculpted base. Above hangs an elaborately carved sounding board or canopy, and to the right another highly decorated structure, likely part of the altar or a similar liturgical fitting. The setting has log walls and a simple balustrade around the chancel. Text printed at the bottom identifies the location and photographer.

An illustrated cityscape showing a medieval walled town with red‑tiled roofs, round defensive towers, and several tall church spires rising above the skyline. A particularly high, slender spire dominates the right side, with telegraph or power lines crossing the sky in front. The foreground has green trees and a grassy slope leading up to the stone walls and towers. The image is drawn in a muted, early‑20th‑century illustration style and there is no visible printed text on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of men and women in period clothing standing in a row on a wooden stage. Some wear uniforms, others everyday or rural attire; one man holds a lantern. Oil lamps and interior furnishings are visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom.

A colorized panoramic view of a historic European town built on a hill above a river. In the foreground is a winding river bordered by rocky banks and greenery. Above it stand tightly packed houses with red-tiled roofs. On the hilltop rises a large fortified complex with long stone buildings and towers, alongside church spires and other medieval-looking structures. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. In the upper left corner, the word "Bautzen." is printed in red.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, stately brick mansion with classical columns and a central arched entrance, surrounded by bare trees and shrubs. Printed Dutch text at the top identifies the place as Huize "Villandry", a convalescent home for railway staff on the Groesbeeksche Weg near Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white view of a large decorative fountain in a tree‑lined city park. The fountain has a tall central column with figures and an upper bowl, from which strong jets of water arc outward into a circular basin. Benches and flowerbeds surround the fountain, and a person in the foreground sits on a chair looking toward it. Printed white text at the bottom identifies the scene as a fountain in the city park of Graz and credits a local publisher.

Sepia-toned image showing a stone-vaulted underground or basement space, likely part of an old fortification or castle. The room has rough masonry walls and an arched stone ceiling. In the center is a small stone bridge spanning a lower pit or channel filled with rubble. At the far side are arched doorways with metal bars, suggesting dungeon cells or storage rooms. On the right side stands a simple wooden walkway or railing structure, perhaps added later for visitors. The border and wear of the card suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.

A monochrome historical postcard showing a crowd of people, many in traditional clothing and headscarves, gathered around and reaching up toward what appears to be a damaged or looted bakery shop. The scene is chaotic, with people stretching their arms toward a man or goods at an elevated opening in the building. Printed captions in French and English describe the event, and there is a small imprint indicating the edition/publisher from Salonique.

A black‑and‑white view over a leafy city park with winding paths and a small pond in the foreground. Behind the trees stand several multi‑storey residential or institutional buildings. On the left rises a large Gothic church with a tall central tower and steeply pitched roofs. On the right, atop a hill, is a large, ornate castle‑like complex with multiple wings, domes, and towers, overlooking the town below. The scene suggests a historic European city landscape. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.

A monochrome winter scene showing a historic townscape with a large church or cathedral dominating the left side, featuring a tall tower with a spire. Snow covers the ground and rooftops of surrounding smaller buildings and houses. Leafless trees line the foreground, and the image has a wide expanse of white snow or frozen water at the bottom. Centered below the photograph on the white margin is the caption 'Strengnäs'.

Black‑and‑white streetscape of a European town with cobbled and dirt roads, flanked by late‑19th‑century townhouses. On the left stands a fenced churchyard with large trees and a church whose tower has an onion‑shaped dome and a tall spire with a weather vane. On the right are multi‑storey buildings with shopfronts and balconies decorated with plants. Pedestrians in long dresses and hats and a man with a cart suggest an early‑20th‑century scene. German text is visible on several shop signs.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a traditionally dressed street vendor carrying a large metal beverage container and cup, labeled "Limonadier" (lemonade seller). The card is heavily covered with handwritten French text along the margins. There are two overlapping postage stamps in the upper center bearing Arabic-style script and imagery likely from North Africa or the Ottoman sphere.

Black‑and‑white view of a wide cobbled street in a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings on both sides. On the left corner is a shopfront with large windows and painted signage. Farther down the street stands an ornate multi‑storey town‑hall‑like building with a tall tower topped by an onion dome and cross. A few pedestrians, including children, are scattered along the nearly empty street.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing a quiet European street lined with multi‑story historic buildings with steep red roofs and gables. Trees and a low fence front one prominent building on the left, and a few pedestrians stand near shopfronts on the right. The image is framed decoratively, with captions printed below and along the left edge.

Black-and-white view of a European town square with historic gabled houses and a church tower in the background. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and multiple dormer windows. Large painted shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including a prominent triangular-gabled building on the right with decorative garlands and reliefs, and multi-storey houses on the left with commercial storefronts at street level. A narrow lane runs between the central buildings toward the church tower. A few people and a cart are visible in the open cobbled square.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped park in the foreground with paths, lawns, and shrubs, and a brick railway station building in the background. The station has a small tower-like entrance section on the left with the sign 'VALGA' above the doors, and a taller lattice structure or water tower behind it. People are sitting and walking in the park. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up of the pediment and upper façade of a grand historic theater building. The triangular pediment is filled with a classical relief sculpture depicting a reclining lion and mythological human figures, one raising an arm and holding a bow. Beneath the pediment, large serif lettering on the entablature reads "MAGYAR NEMZETI SZINHÁZ." The stone surface appears weathered, emphasizing the age of the structure.

A color postcard showing a spring scene in a city park with many people relaxing on a green lawn under a large flowering tree. In the background rises a tall circular red-brick medieval tower with crenellations and a small spire on top, next to a water-filled moat and historic houses. The word "NIJMEGEN" is printed in white in the lower left corner.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large multi-storey brick industrial building set in open fields, with tall chimneys indicating a factory complex. Trees and low vegetation are in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Dommitzsch and describes the building as a clay pipe factory operated as a joint-stock company.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large wooden house with a gambrel-style roof set amid trees and curved gravel paths. The building stands on a small rise with stone foundation walls and appears to be part of a school campus or institutional grounds. In the foreground are lawns, young trees, and a large mature tree to the right. Printed caption text runs along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's logo appears in the lower right corner.

Vintage portrait postcard mounted on a large backing sheet, showing an older military officer in full dress uniform with medals, sash, and sword. He has a white beard and stands in a formal studio pose holding a helmet. The caption at the top of the photograph reads "Prins Leopold von Bayern." Small printer/photographer credits and a number are at the bottom of the photo. The surrounding backing sheet contains handwritten catalog notes and a red archival stamp.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a scenic coastal view framed by two large trees in the foreground. Below the trees, several people stand and sit on a grassy slope overlooking a bright blue bay. In the water are a small islet with a white building and another rocky islet further back. Mountains rise in the distance. The lower margin contains the printed caption in French and some handwritten text, along with the URL watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.

Black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left stands a large historic mill or industrial building with a castle‑like roofline and multiple small towers, directly by a weir on a calm river. On the right, a tree‑lined embankment stretches along the waterway. At the top, there is red printed German text indicating the place and viewpoint.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large multi‑storey institutional building with a steep, complex roof, towers, dormers, and many windows. The structure is set behind open fields in the foreground and appears to be part of a larger school or campus complex extending to the left with additional buildings and a church‑like tower visible in the background. Printed captions in red at the top identify the location and the name of the school.

Black‑and‑white street view of a mid‑20th‑century town. In the foreground is a brick corner building with signage for Skandinaviska Banken, pedestrians on the sidewalks, and a car driving toward the camera. The street continues into the distance with shops and older buildings on the right, trees and a small park area further ahead, and a few people walking and cycling. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Vintage monochrome view over a wooded valley with a curving railway line in the foreground and a hilltop town in the background. The town shows several multi‑storey historic buildings and a large church with a tall spire dominating the skyline. Industrial structures, including what appears to be a gas holder, are visible on the slope. At the top left in red print is the caption 'Leisnig i. S.'. The image has the typical framing and print style of early 20th‑century European postcards.

Black-and-white postcard view of a rural inn or guesthouse surrounded by trees and low forested hills. The main building has a steep gabled roof and timbered upper facade with the large inscription "Gasthof Bärenfels" on the side. In the foreground there is a fenced garden area and a small path; behind the house rises a wooded slope. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires and an attached castle-like building above a riverside town. In the foreground a paddle steamer labeled "WETTIN" travels along a broad river, with smaller boats and quays on the near bank. At the foot of the hill are 19th‑century houses and industrial buildings, one with a sign on the roof. The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a village church surrounded by trees and a fenced garden or orchard. The church has a tall, tiered tower with a spire and a steeply pitched roof. Printed titles in German identify the place and subject, and a vertical imprint at the left edge names the publisher from Meissen.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The large left image shows a very tall concrete telecommunications tower rising above trees, with a series of stacked circular observation or technical decks near the top and a long segmented antenna mast. The right side is split into two interior views of a modernist restaurant or café inside the tower, featuring curved mezzanines, sweeping staircases, large panoramic windows, potted plants, and neatly arranged tables and chairs.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a tall, round brick tower with decorative battlements and a conical roof, topped by a statue of a bird with outstretched wings. The tower stands on a circular base with a colonnaded gallery and is accompanied by a smaller domed turret. Bushes, trees, and a stone wall are visible in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the place and monument; small publisher information appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are fields, farm buildings, and industrial facilities with tall brick chimneys. A river and a stone bridge can be seen near textile‑factory‑like buildings. The middle of the image shows a dense cluster of townhouses and a church tower, and on a slight rise stands a castle‑like complex. At the top left of the image, the word "Zschopau" is printed in a cursive font, indicating the town's name.

Colorized vintage view of a large Romanesque cathedral facing an open piazza with a central ornate fountain and a horse-drawn carriage. The scene is surrounded by multi-story buildings with red-tiled roofs, set against a mountainous backdrop. At the top center of the image, red text reads "Trient - Trento." The composition and printing style are typical of early 20th‑century European postcards.

The image shows three old black‑and‑white/sepia cards laid on a surface. The bottom-right card is a printed illustration of a couple walking arm in arm at night in a town with steep‑roofed buildings and a church tower under a moonlit sky; printed text in a foreign language appears below the scene along with a handwritten message along the right margin. The bottom-left card depicts a large sailing ship with multiple masts in harbor, likely a photographic postcard. The top card is a faded photograph of a large group of people, mostly women in light dresses, posing outdoors. All three appear to be early 20th‑century postcards or cabinet photos.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a European city with dense historic buildings and tiled roofs. In the foreground is a busy street with pedestrians, trams, and early 20th‑century automobiles; shop signs are visible on the façades. In the background a steep, tree‑covered hill rises above the city, crowned by a prominent clock tower and fortification structures. At the lower right corner, the printed caption reads "Graz."

Colorized vintage postcard showing a small European village in a green hilly landscape. In the foreground are meadows and blossoming trees, with a path leading toward the village. The settlement has red-roofed houses, some half-timbered, and a prominent church with a tall, slender spire. In the background, wooded hills rise behind the town, and on a distant hilltop stands a square stone tower, likely a castle or fortress ruin. Decorative script text is printed along the bottom border.

Color postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with closely packed, brightly painted half-timbered houses with steep red-tiled roofs. Hanging shop signs project from the façades; one sign shows a clock. In the distance a church tower with a spire rises above the roofs. The image has a white border and slightly deckled edges typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards.

Sepia-toned postcard view framed by a dark arch, showing a cobblestoned courtyard with a central statue and large late‑Gothic/renaissance-style palace buildings. Decorative facades with steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and ivy-covered walls are visible. German captions are printed on the image and below it. A red handwritten number appears in the upper right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a steep, forested mountain rising behind a few wooden lodge-style houses and a small road or rail line in the foreground. Dense coniferous trees cover the slopes, and the scene looks like a Nordic alpine village. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads "Åre. Totthummeln." and there is a small photographer's mark/logo in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a corner building housing a hotel with a steep tiled roof, oriel, and decorative façade, situated on a gently curving narrow street lined with similar multi‑storey houses. A large sign on the ground floor reads "Hôtel & Ball‑Säle Alberthof." A lone pedestrian stands near the entrance; leafy trees frame the right side of the scene.

A monochrome vintage postcard depicting a steamship moored at a dock. The ship has a tall smokestack, masts with rigging, and several crew or passengers standing along the railings on deck. Calm water surrounds the vessel and the background is mostly sky with light clouds. Printed captions appear along the bottom margin in both Cyrillic and Latin scripts, identifying the location and the name of the ship.

Color postcard-style illustration of a rural landscape with pine trees, farmhouses with red-tiled roofs and fenced paths. In the background on a wooded hill stands a large baroque pilgrimage church with two tall towers. In the foreground at right, a woman in traditional dress stands beside a wooden roadside shrine with a small religious image under a shingled roof. The caption at the top reads 'Maria Trost bei Graz.'.

Hand-colored vintage postcard showing a large Renaissance-style hunting palace complex with a high red-tiled roof, ornate gables, and a small dome tower. The building is set behind a stone wall and trees. At the bottom, there is German text printed in red describing the site and publisher.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large, elegant early‑20th‑century residential or institutional complex. On the left is a three‑storey villa-like building with steep, tiled roofs, dormers, and an oculus window; on the right, a much larger multi‑wing block with similar steep roofs, dormers, and many windows with flower boxes. The style combines late‑historicist and early Art Nouveau / Jugendstil elements. There is a landscaped garden and trees between the buildings, a decorative entrance gate with steps at the street, and a quiet road in the foreground where a single pedestrian stands. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Black-and-white vintage street scene showing a long straight city street lined with multi‑story buildings. People walk and stand in the roadway, with early 20th‑century clothing visible. Overhead wires and telegraph poles line the street. On the prominent corner building to the right is a shop sign reading "AGNES BACHMAN". At the top of the image is printed the caption "Uddevalla. Kungsgatan." indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white image of a calm forest lake with small wooden rowboats. Several people are boating, and each boat carries a vertical tricolour flag. In the left foreground, a woman in a long skirt and apron bends over a boat tied to a simple wooden pier. Behind her is a sign on a post. The far shore is densely wooded with tall trees; no buildings are visible. The framing and composition resemble an early 20th‑century scenic leisure postcard.

A tinted historic postcard showing a wooden railway station building with a red roof and several dormer windows. A steam locomotive with carriages stands at the platform on the left, while many people in early 20th‑century clothing wait or walk along the platform. The station name board reads "NYKÖPING". There is printed red text at the top describing the location, and smaller printed text under it, all in Swedish.

A colored illustration of a European townscape viewed from an elevated position. In the foreground are small houses with red or brown tiled roofs, narrow streets, and a few pedestrians. Behind them is a belt of trees, and beyond that a hilltop complex with several towers and domes. Most prominent are two tall, narrow, identical church towers flanking a white façade in the center-left, and additional church or civic towers and a large greenish dome to the right. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a carefully arranged set of fine porcelain tableware on a plain, neutral backdrop. The set includes two lidded tureens (one with a ladle), a tall lidded jug or coffee pot with a handle and spout, a small scalloped plate or saucer, and tiny accessories such as an egg cup and two napkin rings. All pieces are light-colored with dark, likely floral, decorative patterns. There is no visible text or caption on the front.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a calm pond or small lake bordered by dense coniferous forest. A tiny hut-like structure stands on the far shore and a small group of people is visible near the water's edge. The sky is blank and pale, typical of early photographic prints. Printed red text at the top reads "Zeichenteich b. Freiberg i. S." and at the bottom "9676 Brück & Sohn, Meißen."

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard composed of multiple small photographs of waterfalls arranged decoratively around stylized floral graphics. Large ornate script text across the center reads "Jämtländska Vattenfall." Each photograph is captioned with the individual waterfall's name, and there is additional decorative text indicating the year and publisher/photographer. The overall layout is like an illustrated advertising or touristic card promoting the waterfalls of Jämtland.

Colorized interior view of a grand historic hall with a sweeping wooden staircase and gallery balcony. The walls and ceiling are richly decorated with large paintings, ship models, carved figures, plaques, clocks, and other ornaments. Two large model ships hang from the ornately painted ceiling. At floor level there are carved wooden doors, framed displays, and upholstered chairs around a table. The image is bordered by a cream margin with printed captions at the bottom and publisher information along the left edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bird's‑eye northern view over a historic European city with dense low houses in the foreground and a prominent church with a very tall, slender spire rising above the old town in the background. Printed German text appears around the image, including a greeting from Reval and a caption indicating it is a northward bird's‑eye perspective.

A vintage Russian postal card with handwritten cursive text in ink. At the top center is printed text in red and on the left a red imperial double-headed eagle emblem. In the top right corner there is a red postage stamp with the Russian imperial coat of arms, canceled by two black postmarks dated 1904. The card is addressed in Russian and includes the destination city written as St. Petersburg.

An old Russian Empire postal stationery reply postcard with a printed red imperial double-headed eagle crest on the upper left and red pre-printed 3‑kopeck stamp on the upper right. The heading in red Russian text reads "ОТКРЫТОЕ ПИСЬМО ДЛЯ ОТВЕТА". The card is filled with black handwritten script in German, addressed to a Dr. Frank in Pernau. Several black circular postmarks with Cyrillic text and dates are stamped over the card and stamp. Additional small handwritten numbers and notations appear around the edges.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a steamship named VESTERBOTTEN sailing on a body of water, with smoke coming from its funnel and forested shoreline in the background. Another smaller vessel is visible to the left. The photo has printed captions at the bottom identifying the ship and the shipping company in Stockholm.

Sepia-toned coastal view showing a calm bay framed by rugged hills or small mountains. In the foreground there is a narrow road curving along the shoreline, bordered by tall slender cypress trees and other vegetation. An islet or narrow peninsula extends into the water on the right. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. There is faint handwritten text at the bottom and a printed website watermark "www.ella.org.gr" over the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent, elongated ceremonial hall with a richly patterned ceiling, tall arched wall panels covered in mosaics, and large windows on one side. At the far end stands a throne-like arrangement before a huge mosaic wall. The printing along the bottom edge identifies the location as Stockholm and names the hall "Gyllene Salen" (the Golden Hall).

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small town in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground stands a prominent historic building with a tall tower and steep roof, likely a town hall or civic building, surrounded by trees and streets with residential houses. Farmland and wooded hills stretch into the background. At the bottom left, white printed text reads "Eibenstock i. Erzgeb." indicating the location.

A monochrome postcard showing a small harbor scene with a river or canal in the foreground, a low bridge, quayside buildings and a steamboat moored at the right. In the background a church tower with a spire rises above the town. The bottom of the card has printed caption text and a publisher's line, with a large area of handwritten Swedish text covering the lower part.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town set in a river valley. In the foreground a river curves around a grassy area with rocks and trees along its banks. Behind it stands a row of modest, tightly packed houses with gabled roofs. Rising above the town on a hill is a large historic castle complex with multiple wings, towers, and fortified walls, as well as a tall church spire. Industrial chimneys are visible on the right side in the background. The whole scene suggests an old fortified city overlooking a small river, photographed from an elevated vantage point.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with two‑storey townhouses and shops with shutters. Children and adults in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the street; a horse‑drawn cart is visible in the distance. Storefront signs in German script appear on the right‑hand building.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a serene bay with two small islets: in the foreground a low whitewashed chapel complex on a tiny island linked by a narrow causeway, and farther back a tree‑covered islet with a prominent building amid cypress trees. Hills rise in the background. Greek text and the word "CORFOU" appear in the lower right, and a web address watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is printed across the lower part of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street leading to a medieval brick church and adjoining buildings. The central structure has a large pointed gable with an arched entrance and circular window above, flanked by Gothic windows and buttresses. A chapel with a small cross-topped roof and a square tower with belfry openings are visible. On the left is a row of townhouses; in the foreground is a low fence with vegetation. Printed caption text appears at the top in French, and a handwritten signature is on the right margin.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a European spa town square. The scene shows a sloping cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings with shop signs, a decorative fountain or market well in the center, an ornate cast‑iron streetlamp, and to the right a richly carved colonnaded pavilion. Behind it rises a square tower on a hill, with wooded hills forming the background. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the square. At the bottom margin there is a German caption identifying the location.

Sepia-toned image showing a formally dressed aristocratic couple riding in an open horse-drawn carriage. The woman wears an elaborate hat and fur-trimmed coat and holds a large bouquet of flowers; the man is in a decorated military uniform with epaulettes and medals. The polished carriage lamps and wheels are prominent in the foreground. In the blurred background stands a large Baroque/neo-Baroque palace or official residence with mansard roof and many windows, giving a ceremonial, royal impression.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small industrial town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are factory buildings with tall chimneys and densely packed houses. Curving railway tracks with trains and freight cars run through the middle of the scene toward a station complex with several long, low buildings. Scattered villas and institutional-looking buildings stand on the slopes beyond, with forested hills and fields in the background. The caption "Rosswein." is printed in red in the upper left corner, and there is additional German text on the side of a factory building.

Black‑and‑white view of a European spa or resort town street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century apartment and hotel facades. In the foreground is a curved riverside promenade with trees, pavilions and kiosks, horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. At the bottom right is part of a decorative cast‑iron colonnade or pavilion roof. The architecture is richly detailed, with bay windows, balconies and mansard roofs.

A sepia-toned historic street view showing a slightly curving, cobblestone-lined street flanked by multi‑story buildings with ornate facades and bay windows. Pedestrians, including children in early‑20th‑century clothing, walk along the sidewalks. The architecture is typical of a German small town. At the top of the image is printed text identifying the location as Borna near Leipzig and the specific street as Reichsstrasse.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal city park with terraces, balustraded stairways and ornamental gardens. In the foreground are stone railings, planters and gas-style lamps; two well-dressed men stand talking on the path while women in long dresses walk further inside the park. Trees and hedges line the walkways, and a large villa-like building stands in the background. Caption text in German is printed at the bottom margin.

Black-and-white photograph of a large Gothic or Neo‑Gothic building with steep slate roofs, ornate gables, traceried windows, and a tall, slender spire. A richly decorated external stair‑tower or loggia with pointed arches and balconies rises on the right side of the facade. The scene appears to be a quiet courtyard or square in front of a historic civic or castle‑like structure. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.

Colorized vintage postcard showing two young women or girls in traditional Dutch clothing, with white caps and shawls and bright red skirts over darker underdresses. One is seated on a stone bench or balustrade while holding an open book, and the other stands beside her, looking at the book. The background shows a path bordered by trees receding into the distance. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption.

A colorized panoramic view over the city of Graz, showing dense historic buildings with red and brown roofs surrounded by green hills. In the left foreground stands a prominent tower with a steep, reddish roof, rising above trees—this is the famous clock tower on the Schlossberg hill. Below the image, there is printed German text and a handwritten message in purple ink along the lower margin.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a harbor with calm blue water, sailing ships and steam vessels, and a fortified rocky hill crowned with walls and buildings. A waterfront town stretches along the base of the fortifications. Trees and small structures appear in the foreground. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Souvenir de Corfou," with publisher information in smaller print, and there is handwritten cursive text along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small spa or resort town nestled in rolling hills. The foreground shows a complex of substantial masonry buildings with pitched roofs, towers, and pavilion‑like structures surrounded by dense trees and parkland. A broad, tree‑lined avenue leads uphill through the center toward more villas and resort houses. On a hill in the left background stands a church with a tall spire. In the right background is a large, ornate building with an arcade or colonnade that looks like a spa or Kurhaus. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

Vintage black-and-white streetscape showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and a tall church or clock tower with a spire in the background. Several people, including children and a person pushing a cart, walk along the street. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the scene as Ritterstrasse in Torgau and the publisher's imprint.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a narrow canal cut between steep rocky walls. A metal truss bridge spans the canal at the top of the image with several small human figures standing on it. A boat is visible in the canal, and there is a narrow path or quay running along the left side. Handwritten-style captions appear at the bottom of the image, along with a small logo or mark.

Black-and-white postcard view of a small harbor at the foot of rocky hills. Several sailing ships with tall masts lie at anchor near simple whitewashed buildings along the shoreline. The sea is in the foreground with small waves, and the barren hills rise steeply behind the settlement. Printed captions identify the location and the publisher.

Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographs bordered by decorative grapevine illustrations. The left photo shows the exterior of a corner building with the sign "Zum wilden Mann" above the entrance, on a cobblestone street. The right photo shows the interior of a grand dining room with long tables, many chairs, ornate wall decorations, chandeliers, and a large mirror. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Uerdingen on the Rhine and the establishment as Hôtel-Restaurant "Zum wilden Mann".

Vintage postcard with a monochrome photograph of a group of women (and a few men) in traditional folk dress, standing outdoors in front of trees. Greek text is printed around the image vertically and horizontally, and French text appears below the image. The card identifies the location as Verroia–Karaféria in Macedonia and describes the women's costumes.

Vintage illustrated postcard featuring a caricature-style side profile portrait of a bearded man with glasses, labeled as Dr. Ricardo Jorge. The top margin reads "CELEBRIDADES PORTUGUEZAS" (Portuguese celebrities). At the bottom, there is printing information indicating it is from Edição Rocha on Rua do Arsenal. The artwork is signed and dated 1903.

A colorized historical postcard view of a stone bridge crossing a wide river and leading into a grand baroque cityscape. On the right side, a large church with tall spires and ornate towers dominates the scene, while a red-and-yellow electric tram and horse-drawn carriages cross the bridge. The buildings have red and green roofs and detailed façades. The sky is blue with light clouds. Printed captions at the top read the city name and the bridge name, with a handwritten number in red ink.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large historic building with a central tower and smaller corner turret, likely an inn or villa, set along a tree-lined road. The architecture has ornate windows, a veranda on the left side, and steps leading to an arched entrance. In the distant right background a tower-like structure is visible. At the top of the card, printed in red Gothic-style lettering, are the words identifying the location.

Color photograph of a large Orthodox church with multiple green domes topped with crosses, in a historicist / neo‑Byzantine style. The church stands on a busy urban square with several red‑and‑cream buses, an older black car, cyclists, and pedestrians. Trees line the street in front of the church under a clear blue sky. The image has the grain and color palette typical of mid‑20th‑century printed postcards.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square framed by old masonry houses. At the center stands a large, roughly square building with a steep hipped slate roof and a clock tower topped by a lantern and spire. The façade has classical details over the corner doorways. A horse‑drawn cart stands in the street, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing are visible. Trees and a wrought‑iron fence border the right side of the square. The overall look suggests an older European market town or small city hall. No visible caption or border text is present on the image side.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large circular basin with a powerful vertical jet of water in the center, surrounded by a crowd of people in coats and hats watching the geyser-like fountain. At the bottom margin, there is a caption in German script.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a formal city park with circular flowerbeds and walking paths leading to a large neoclassical building with a central dome-like roof and grand portico. Long, tree‑lined boulevards extend to the left and right, bordered by ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs. In the distant background are low hills and another tall church spire. There is a short handwritten message across the top margin.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century corner apartment or hotel building labeled as Haus "Columbus" on Parkstrasse. The multi‑story structure has many windows, decorative facades, and a mansard roof. In the foreground are leafless trees, a small fenced garden or pavilion, and people walking along intersecting streets. Printed captions appear below the image and along the left edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the arched cloister and central garden courtyard of a historic college building. The view is taken from under the covered arcade with stone columns in the foreground, looking across trees and shrubs toward a two‑story façade with arcades and balustrades. Several people stand in the garden. Handwritten notes and a date appear on the left and bottom margins, and printed captions identify the location as the patio of the Colegio de Fonseca in Santiago.

A monochrome postcard photograph showing a tall, cylindrical stone tower in silhouette at sunset, rising above trees and rooftops of a village street in the foreground. The sky is cloudy and bright behind the dark outline of the ruined tower. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a large, multi-story school building with steep gabled roofs and tall chimneys. Trees partly obscure the façade, and several people are visible walking or standing in front of the entrance. In the lower left corner, handwritten-style text identifies the building.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neo‑classical columned colonnade with a coffered ceiling, stretching into the distance. The left side opens to a street lined with ornate multi‑story spa-town buildings, while the right side is framed by a dense row of columns. At the far end of the colonnade a clock and archways are visible. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Close-up of a vintage postage stamp on a postcard. The stamp is maroon and cream, showing a shield with four striped panels surrounded by floral and ornamental motifs. At the top is the text "EESTI POST". At the bottom is the denomination "50+50" inside a decorative frame, and below that the word "CARITAS" with the numbers "19" and "39" on each side, indicating the year 1939. There is a light circular postmark over part of the design.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone Bismarck monument in a small town square. A large rough-hewn rock with an inscription and a wreath is topped by a sculpted eagle. The monument is enclosed by a metal railing with steps in front, with residential buildings and trees in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

A colorized historic cityscape showing a dense town with red-tiled roofs and several prominent Ottoman‑style buildings. A slender minaret of a mosque rises near the left-center, and low, traditional houses fill the foreground. In the distance, the city extends up gentle hills and is surrounded by rolling green mountains under a clear sky. At the bottom right is a printed website watermark: 'www.elia.org.gr'. The overall style resembles an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small pine‑covered islet connected to the mainland by a narrow causeway in a calm bay. Whitewashed houses with tiled roofs are seen in the foreground, looking down toward the harbor. There are a few small boats in the water and low hills or islands in the distance. The card has a decorative border and printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom, along with a website watermark.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a railway station with a steam locomotive pulling freight cars on the right. People stand on the platform in front of a large, ornate station building with steep tiled roofs and multiple gables. To the left, a tall church tower with a spire rises behind trees. The words "Mariestad" and "Järnvägsstationen" are printed at the top of the image, indicating the town and that this is the railway station.

A colorized vintage view of a broad urban square framed by historic multi‑story buildings, trees, and paths, backed by rocky hills and snowy mountains under a pink-and-blue sky. In the left foreground is a large monument in the center of a circular plaza; the right side shows several classical-style buildings facing the open square. At the top left, printed text reads "Trento  Piazza Dante," identifying the scene as Piazza Dante in Trento, with the surrounding Alpine landscape.

A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a woman in period dress. She kneels beside a wooden chair, hands clasped, wearing a dark dress with an ornate white lace shawl. The background is a plain draped cloth. In the lower left corner appears printed text identifying her role and a small reference number.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural European village nestled in a valley with wooded hills in the background. In the right foreground stands a tall, slender church with a steep spire and Gothic‑style windows. Around it are several houses, some with half‑timbered (Fachwerk) construction and steep tiled roofs, typical of central European architecture. A winding path runs through cultivated fields toward the village. On a distant hilltop in the background is a solitary square tower, likely the remains of a medieval castle or fortification. The image appears to be an early 20th‑century photographic postcard; no visible text is present on the front.

Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographs bordered by floral decoration. The left image shows a tree‑lined public park or promenade with a path and people walking. The right image shows an early electric tramcar on rails with a few pedestrians nearby, on a street flanked by trees and fences. Below the images there is printed text in Romanian and a long handwritten message in cursive. The overall style is early 20th‑century.

Colorized vintage view of a harbor with several steamships and smaller boats docked along quays. Warehouses, crates, and small sheds line the waterfront behind a fence, with a wide road and telegraph poles in the foreground. Low, arid hills appear across the water. The caption in the upper left reads "Suez – Le Port," and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed at the bottom right.

A black-and-white panoramic view of a coastal town surrounded by hills or low mountains. The settlement is densely built with light-colored houses, seen from a distance across fields in the foreground. At the bottom margin, there is printed Greek text identifying the place, and a faint circular seal on the left plus the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' on the right.

Sepia-toned postcard reproduction of Sandro Botticelli's painting "Primavera" showing mythological figures in a forested scene. At the bottom border there is printed Italian text identifying the city, gallery, title of the work, and the artist.

Black-and-white photograph showing the richly decorated interior of a historic church. The view is from the back of the nave looking toward the altar, with wooden pews in the foreground, a carved pulpit on the left, painted vaulted ceilings with elaborate floral and ornamental motifs, religious paintings on the walls, and a large crystal chandelier hanging in the center. At the bottom right, printed text in Swedish identifies the subject as the interior of Kungs Lena Church.

A colorized historic postcard view from a stone staircase along a high fortification wall, looking down over a park with curving paths, lawns, trees, and a pond. Beyond the park are railway tracks, industrial buildings with chimneys, and flat countryside stretching to the horizon. A man stands by the railing in the foreground near a gas-style streetlamp. Text is printed in red at the top and right side of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing the ruins of a medieval stone castle surrounded by greenery. The ruined walls feature tall arched windows and a partially standing round tower. Printed text at the top identifies the site in German and Latvian.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard depicting a tree‑lined residential street with ornate townhouses and fenced front gardens on the left, and a wide, nearly empty road stretching into the distance on the right. Two men stand beside a bicycle on the sidewalk. The scene has an old European urban feel. Printed captions read "Nijmegen" at the lower left and "Batavierenweg" at the lower right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque‑Renaissance palace complex bordering a broad paved square. Several ornate corner towers and a tall central spire rise above the roofline. In the foreground stands a large monument with an obelisk and sculptural figures. Small groups of people in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the square. The caption at the top reads in red Gothic script: "Dresden. Königl. Schloss." and a vertical imprint at the left margin shows the publisher information.

Sepia-toned aerial or elevated view of a small industrial town with dense rows of houses, factory buildings with tall chimneys, a river in the foreground, and a metal truss bridge connecting the riverbanks. In the lower right corner, printed text reads "Blick auf Alt-Penig," indicating the scene is an old view of the town of Penig.

Colorized vintage view of a church and adjacent castle complex with round towers, red-tiled roofs, and baroque-style domes, surrounded by trees. The sky is lightly tinted blue and peach. German text at the top left reads the town name, and at the top right identifies the buildings as a castle and cathedral.

Color-tinted photograph of the interior of a large stone cathedral. The view shows a side aisle with high vaulted ceilings, arched openings, stone walls, and an ornate staircase along the wall. Religious furnishings and altars line the aisle, and a solitary robed figure stands in the distance. At the bottom margin, printed red text identifies the location.

Sepia-toned image showing a steep stone path leading up to a heavily fortified stone gate with battlements, towers, and thick defensive walls built into a rocky hillside. The scene depicts an old fortress entrance. At the bottom the image bears a caption indicating it is the gate of the fortress of Acrocorinth.

Sepia-toned vintage street view showing a straight, relatively narrow city street lined with multi-story buildings and shops on both sides. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the sidewalks. Overhead utility poles and wires run down the center. Printed text at the top identifies the location as a street in Glauchau.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm pond surrounded by lush trees and plants. In the distance, on the far shore, there is a small round pavilion or gazebo with a dome roof. The foreground shows reeds and water plants at the pond's edge. The caption "Bad Elster Gondelteich" appears at the bottom left.

Colored illustrated postcard showing a walled religious complex with an ornate arched entrance gate in an Islamic architectural style, a central domed building with surrounding arcades, and a tall slender minaret. Trees and a garden fill the courtyard, and multi‑story houses appear in the background. At the top, multilingual captions label the scene; a faint central word seems to read a city name, and on the right the French text reads "SAINTE SOPHIE". Greek text appears on the left.

Multiview postcard titled "BURG STOLPEN" featuring an illustrated bird's‑eye plan of Stolpen Castle with numbered buildings and a legend in German on the upper part, plus three photographic views along the bottom: the fortress ruins and walls, a heraldic coat of arms set in stone, and striking columnar basalt formations associated with the castle hill.

A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a wide avenue lined with bare trees and multi‑storey stone buildings. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing and uniforms stand or walk along the street. The bottom margin bears captions in both Latin and Greek scripts identifying the location as Panaghis Vaglianos Street in Argostoli.

Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined street or lane leading over a small wooden bridge. Two people stand on the bridge, one holding a bicycle. On the left is a large villa‑like building; on the right, partly hidden by trees, is another multi‑story building with a small tower and clock. The scene is tranquil and semi‑rural. The printed title at the top reads "Graz. Leechgasse."

A colorized pastoral view showing a herd of cows wading through a shallow river in front of a stone multi‑arched bridge. Behind the bridge are farm buildings and trees under a pink-and-blue evening or morning sky with clouds. Red printed captions appear in the upper left and right corners.

Black‑and‑white view over a landscaped park with paths crossing lawns in front of a long three‑storey modernist school building. People are gathered near the entrance; apartment blocks and a tall industrial chimney rise in the background. In the lower right corner, printed text reads "Läroverket, Kiruna."

A color-tinted historic postcard showing a long, two‑storey military barracks complex along an open, sandy expanse. The architecture is European‑style with arched windows and corner pavilions. At the top left in red French text it reads "Alexandrie. Les Casernes Anglaises a Sidi-Gaber." At the bottom right a modern watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible.

Black-and-white multi-view postcard. Left: a bronze modernist statue of two people, one in a long coat, both standing upright and looking upwards. Top-right: a hilly vineyard with posts and vines descending toward a town and a river plain in the background. Bottom-right: a domed observatory building with a ribbed metal dome on a stone drum adjoining a flat-roofed annex; there is a rectangular plaque on the wall but its text is not legible.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large, Victorian-style house set amid lush gardens and trees. A pathway leads through the landscaped grounds toward the multi-story residence, which has gabled roofs, chimneys, and a broad porch. Red printed captions appear along the bottom and left/right margins, and a red number is printed in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white winter landscape showing a wide snowy mountain panorama with sparse trees. In the foreground a group of skiers traverse an open snowfield. A snow‑covered mountain massif dominates the background. At the lower left there is printed text identifying the view, and at the lower right a small oval logo of the photographer/publisher.

A colorized historic postcard showing an industrial complex with tall chimneys, factory halls, and a tower-like building, seen from an elevated viewpoint with a street and rows of trees in the foreground. The image is heavily overlaid with dense handwritten text in dark ink on both the top image area and the lower margin. Printed caption text appears beneath the picture.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the old town of Bautzen, with dense historic buildings, steep tiled roofs, a large church with a tall spire in the center, and several round medieval defensive towers and walls in the foreground, partially obscured by trees. The word "Bautzen" is printed in red in the upper left corner on a blank sky background.

Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing a European village. In the center stands a prominent church on a low hill, with a walled churchyard and trees around it. The church has a tall tower topped with an onion‑shaped dome and spire. Below the hill, a dirt road curves through fields of grass toward several timber or stucco farmhouses and barns. Rolling hills and farmland form the background. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

Colorized view of a church with a tall, ornate tower rising above a red‑roofed nave, surrounded by trees, meadows, and a small stream in the foreground. The sky is bright blue with white clouds. At the top of the image, printed in red type, are the words "Königsbrück." on the left and "Kirche." on the right.

Vintage sepia-toned view of a small town in a mountain valley beside a river. In the foreground is a metal truss bridge crossing the river. Behind it stands a compact cluster of buildings dominated by a tall church tower and a large church-like structure. Rugged mountains rise steeply in the background. The caption in red at the upper right reads "Ala (Trentino); Pilcante", and there is part of a postage stamp visible at the top edge.

Black‑and‑white historic harbor view with multiple steamships and small boats moored along a busy quay. Crates and cargo are stacked on the waterfront and many people are walking or working on the pier. Across the water stands a row of substantial 19th‑century stone buildings; one large, palace‑like block with arcaded ground floor dominates the right side, and a domed church or public building rises in the distant background. A bridge spans the water to the right. Some ship names are visible on the hulls.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a historic two‑story house with a large patterned tile roof and several chimneys. The building façade has rectangular windows framed by pilasters and an arched central doorway. Above the entrance appears the sign of a museum. In the background are parts of neighboring houses and a street scene with a few people. Printed Hungarian text appears in the upper corners identifying the city and the building.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a mid‑20th‑century motor vessel named "HENRIETTE" at sea. The ship has a single mast with rigging, a lifeboat on deck, and a group of people gathered on the aft superstructure. A national flag flies at the stern. At the top right of the card, printed text reads "WATERHUIZEN bij GRONING…". The scene is taken from the water level with open sea in the background.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the interior of a large Gothic cathedral. The view looks down the central nave toward the ornate main altar, with high ribbed vaults, tall clustered columns, side aisles, wooden pews, and a suspended crucifix. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the central aisle. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Trento and describes the scene as the interior of the cathedral (Duomo).

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a European town behind a foreground of fields and dense trees. The town consists of multi‑story buildings with gabled roofs and two prominent church towers rising above the rooftops. One church has a bulbous baroque-style dome. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Marienberg i. Sa." indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white image of a quiet, curved street lined with large, ornate residential or institutional buildings in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European style. The houses have steep tiled roofs, half‑timbered gables, dormer windows, turrets with pointed spires, and decorative woodwork. A small pavilion or veranda stands prominently in the foreground on the left, and the street is otherwise empty except for a few indistinct figures near the buildings.

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a European town square with a central market fountain featuring animal sculptures (notably stags) and a human statue on a pedestal. Surrounding the fountain are multi‑story townhouses with steep tiled roofs and shops at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the cobblestone streets, and a few early automobiles are visible. German signage appears on several buildings.

A colorized historic postcard view over a European town with medieval fortifications and church towers. In the foreground stands a large round stone tower on a square base, surrounded by red-roofed houses and greenery. An arched stone bridge or viaduct crosses a valley to the left, connecting to a fortified complex with multiple towers and walls. In the background, several tall church spires dominate the skyline. At the top center of the image, the caption reads "Blick auf Bautzen." A building in the mid-ground has the word "Restauration" on its facade.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverbank where several wooden rowboats are drawn up on a rocky shore. People in long coats and head coverings are boarding or unloading the boats. Across the calm river a low, forested landscape is visible under a cloudy sky. White caption text is printed along the bottom edge in a Scandinavian language, with a photographer or studio credit at the lower right.

Sepia-toned image showing a rocky, stepped stone platform carved into a hillside, with rough terrain surrounding it. A lone robed figure stands near the rock cut. The card has printed captions at the bottom in French and Greek identifying the site, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right.

Black‑and‑white / sepia military postcard showing German cavalry troops (Uhlans) conducting field exercises or combat in open countryside. Soldiers in spiked pickelhaube helmets and uniforms are aiming rifles while kneeling, lying prone, and advancing through tall grass. At the top, in red German text, is a caption that identifies the location Oschatz and the Saxon 1st Uhlan Regiment No. 17 and mentions the capture and reinforcement of a firing position.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a landscaped cemetery with flowerbeds and trimmed hedges leading toward a monumental stone wall. On the wall is a large relief sculpture depicting an injured soldier being supported by another figure. Wide steps rise on the right toward additional stone structures. Text is printed in two lines below the image, in Latvian and French, along with a small serial number.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural or small‑town landscape with scattered houses, trees, and low hills or mountains in the background. In the foreground there appears to be an open sandy or dirt area, possibly a riverbank or road. The image is framed with a white border. Below the photograph there are captions printed in Greek and French, and at the lower right is the printed URL 'www.elia.org.gr'. A round stamp or logo appears in the lower left corner of the image area.

A black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a waterfront scene with wooden docks in the foreground and several small boats moored along the quay. Behind the water stands a large, ornate brick building with multiple gables, arched windows, and decorative façade details, flanked by other smaller buildings. The caption text appears at the top of the image.

A black-and-white postcard showing a large, classical-style two‑storey stone building behind a metal fence and gate. The facade has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance with a pediment. Conifer trees and other vegetation stand in front, and tree branches frame the image from above. The word "LÄNSRESIDENS" is visible on the building, and a printed caption at the bottom left reads "Umeå. Länsresidenset."

Black‑and‑white interior view of an indoor public bathhouse with a rectangular pool in the foreground, surrounded by classical columns and curtained changing cubicles. The ceiling is high and timbered. Printed caption text appears at the bottom center of the image.

Color image of a mid‑20th‑century city street with four‑ to five‑story apartment blocks featuring simple stucco facades and small balconies. A blue-and-white intercity or city bus is parked by the sidewalk; several pedestrians walk along the storefronts at ground level. Streetlights with curved arms and overhead trolley or tram wires run above the roadway. On the left, a tree‑lined park or boulevard with older cars is visible. The scene suggests an ordinary residential/commercial street in a European city during the socialist era.

A vintage, monochrome portrait of a seated woman in traditional, ornate dress and headgear with tassels. She is shown in profile, resting her head on one hand in a contemplative pose.
