At the bottom of the image appears red printed text in French that reads "Souvenir de Salonique." The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, narrow church with a steep spire in a mountain valley. The church stands behind a rustic wooden fence, surrounded by forested slopes and dramatic rocky peaks in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the image.

Colorized panoramic view of a small Central European village in a valley surrounded by green hills and fields. The settlement consists of farmhouses and village buildings with red and gray roofs, scattered along winding dirt roads and amid trees. The lower margin contains printed German text identifying the location and the publisher, along with a note that it is a hand-colored artist card.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tree-lined street with a rustic pavilion or inn beside the road. The building has large arched windows, latticework details, and a picket fence, with several people standing or sitting in front. The surrounding area appears to be a wooded city park or forest edge. A tram or trolley can be seen in the background on the right. Printed text along the bottom reads the city name and describes the scene as a part of the city forest with a forest tavern.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long, single-storey neoclassical building with many arched windows and a central entrance portico, surrounded by trees and a lawn. The image caption identifies it as the Landes-Turnanstalt on Parkstrasse in Graz. Publisher information is printed along the bottom edge.

A vintage illustrated advertising postcard for an equestrian and saddlery business. The upper left shows a horse pulling a light carriage with two well‑dressed riders. The lower left shows a man saddling a horse. The right half is filled with detailed drawings of saddles, harnesses, bridles, whips, grooming tools, luggage and other horse‑related equipment, with a horse's head mounted on the wall. At the bottom, Dutch text advertises a saddlemaker and carriage upholsterer's shop located in Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling European town square with market stalls and horse‑drawn wagons. On the left stands a neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance town hall with a small belfry and clock. In the center background is a tall corner building marked "HOTEL BAUM." To the right runs a row of ornate late‑19th‑century facades, including a building clearly signed "APOTHEKE" (pharmacy). In the foreground is a large sculptural fountain with figures on rocks and a basin, placed on a stepped plinth. People in early‑20th‑century dress walk and trade in the square, and hills can be seen in the distance.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal town with low buildings along the waterfront and a large rocky hill topped with extensive fortifications above the town. The scene is viewed from across the water. Under the image there is printed text in French and Greek identifying the place, along with a modern website watermark.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are traditional multi‑storey houses, a road junction and a small pavilion or gazebo. More houses, farm buildings and a church with a tall steeple are visible further back, with wooded hills in the distance. Printed German text appears at the bottom, and there is additional handwritten script along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an ornate historic building with richly decorated façades and large arched windows. In front of the building is a terrace café with tables, chairs, umbrellas, and people walking along the promenade. The sign on the awning reads "CAFÉ PUPP," and printed text at the bottom left identifies the scene as 'Weltbad Karlsbad. Café Pupp'. The backdrop consists of wooded hills.

A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of a busy waterfront city. Multi‑story European buildings line a quayside crowded with pedestrians, trams, and horse‑drawn vehicles. Numerous steamships and smaller boats are moored along piers and moving through a wide waterway that is crossed by low bridges further in the distance. On the right, a tree‑covered hill rises with a small domed chapel-like building, while the far background shows a dense cityscape with several towers and domes under a cloudy sky. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard image showing a traditional wooden belfry and an adjacent stone church behind a low stone wall. Leafless and sparsely leaved trees partially obscure the buildings. The architecture is typical of historic Scandinavian rural churches, with a steeply pitched roof and simple arched windows. Printed caption text appears in the upper left, and an additional vertical strip of text is visible along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural church surrounded by many trees and a curving dirt road in the foreground. The church has a square white tower with a dark domed roof topped by a cross. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and a small number at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural wooden building with a tiled roof and decorative trim, likely a village post office or shop, with a fenced yard and two white wooden gates in front. A few people stand in the doorway. Large leafy trees frame the scene, and a simple monument or utility box stands by the unpaved road. The architecture and lettering suggest a Scandinavian countryside setting. Text is printed in white in the lower left and lower right corners.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing an elegant Baroque/Rococo palace wing with ornate columns and statues, set within a landscaped garden. A round fountain stands prominently in the foreground, with curving pathways and trees framing the scene. Printed text at the top identifies the site.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a two‑storey wooden pavilion with a wraparound balcony and a flag on the roof, set within a fenced garden or park. There are scattered trees and low buildings in the background. Printed Russian text appears at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small wooden church surrounded by tall leafless trees and grave markers. The church has shingled walls and roof, a steep central roofline with a small tower and spire, and windows with multiple panes. In the foreground is a graveyard with headstones and monuments. In the lower left corner the caption reads "BRANDSTORPS KYRKA."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view across a harbor toward a city skyline. In the foreground are piers, small boats, and waterfront warehouses; in mid‑harbor a white passenger ship is sailing. On the opposite shore stand rows of multi‑story buildings and several prominent landmarks, including a large domed cathedral on the left and another tall church building on the right. The text at the bottom left names the location in Finnish and Swedish, and a small code appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small town along a river. On the left, steep rocky hills and dense trees descend toward clustered houses with pitched roofs. In the middle distance stand church spires and a tower on a hill. The river curves from the foreground on the right toward a bridge and the town center in the background. The caption printed in the upper right reads "Camburg a. Saale".

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Gothic cathedral with twin ornate towers and a central entrance fronting an open square. Early 20th‑century cars and pedestrians are visible in the foreground. At the bottom margin, handwritten German text reads "Der Dom zu Meißen."

Vintage sepia postcard showing a rural scene on a rocky island landscape. In the foreground a man in traditional clothing stands beside two loaded pack animals (likely donkeys or mules) on a dirt road. In the background, white houses of a hillside town are visible. The card is framed with printed Greek and French text and bears a round stamp-like emblem and a small serial number at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn carriage appear in the distance. Along the right side is a long building with multiple shuttered windows and German signage. At the bottom in red print are the captions identifying the town as Kamenz and the street as Untere Bautznerstrasse, with a small publisher credit beneath.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a circular-framed waterside scene. In the foreground is a harbor with a sailing ship moored at the quay; in the background are multi‑story European stone buildings and a larger institutional building. People are visible along the waterfront. Decorative printed text in red at the top reads "Göteborg." Additional caption text in Swedish appears at the bottom, and there is a handwritten word near the lower right. The left margin has printed series information.

Colorized historic view of a broad cobblestoned market square framed by old townhouses. In the center background stands a two‑story building with a small tower and hipped roof, partly covered by trees and a monument or fountain in front. Few pedestrians are visible, and church spires rise in the distant background. Printed titling at the top left reads "Geithain. Marktplatz." indicating the town and square.

Illustrated view of a mid‑century mountain hotel named "Angelo d'Oro" with a restaurant on the ground floor. The multi‑story building has balconies decorated with red flowers, green shuttered windows, and a large vertical neon sign reading "HOTEL". Outdoor tables with red cloths sit on a terrace in front. In the background are tall, snow‑covered Alps‑like mountains and neighboring town buildings; a classic car is parked on the street and a landscaped path with flowerbeds leads up toward the hotel.

An old monochrome postcard showing a stereoscopic pair of the same landscape scene: a small waterfall and rocky stream running through a narrow valley with bare trees and patches of snow or ice on the ground. At the bottom left of the postcard, there is printed text that appears to label the view and its location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with old houses and stone walls in a historic European town. The street curves gently and leads toward taller multi‑story buildings with steep gabled roofs. On the hill above stands a large medieval complex with a steep roof and tower, and in the background a church or castle tower with a dome and spire is visible. The image has a white border with handwritten-style captions at the bottom.

Vintage sepia postcard depicting a European city street scene with cobblestone pavement, ornate multi‑story buildings, and an iron arch bridge over a river. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. The caption beneath the image reads "Kolozsvár. Szamosi vashíd." and the building on the right bears signage including the word "FONCIERE."

A sepia-toned postcard view of a calm river or pond with an overgrown small island in the foreground and dense trees along the bank. In the background on the right stands a large, simple rectangular building with a gabled roof, resembling a manor house or estate, partly obscured by trees. The sky is cloudy and tree branches frame the upper edges of the image. The word "CESVAINE." is printed in bold capital letters at the top center.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a church square with trees, a fenced-off obelisk-style war memorial in the center, and a large church building in the background. The top of the postcard bears a printed caption in German identifying the place.

Black-and-white historic street scene showing a gently sloping urban street lined with tall, narrow buildings with shutters and striped shop awnings. A tram moves up the street toward the camera, and several pedestrians, a bicycle, and a dog are visible. The caption at the bottom identifies the place as Stikke Hezelstraat in Nijmegen.

Color postcard showing an alpine town with high mountains and forests in the background. In the foreground is a modern light-blue building with wooden roof and green-framed windows; on its wall is the word 'laurebjorum' (uncertain reading). Behind it rises a tall stone church bell tower with a spire and cross. At the lower left corner there is an inset image of a relief or statue of a saint holding a church, with the caption 'SAN LORENZO'. Clear blue sky with a few clouds above.

A monochrome postcard showing a large domed Christian cathedral with two bell towers, bare winter trees in front, and printed captions at the top identifying the view as the main cathedral of Salonique (Thessaloniki).

Black-and-white postcard showing a curved coastal road running along a wooded hillside beside the sea. Small waves break onto the shore; a few scattered buildings appear along the road and on a small headland. At the far left, higher on the hill, is a compact cluster of buildings resembling a fortified town or castle. Greek text captions are printed in the white border beneath the image, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears across the lower right of the image.

Colorized view of medieval castle ruins on a wooded hill, with a tall round stone tower in the foreground and a larger ruined keep or tower behind trees. A stone wall runs along a grassy slope. At the top of the image there is printed German text identifying the place as Frauenstein in the Erzgebirge and mentioning ruins and a lookout tower.

Hand-colored historic postcard showing a wide cobblestone main street lined with multi‑story European townhouses and a grand corner building on the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children and men in suits, stroll or stand along the street. In the background, a solitary conical hill rises beyond the town. The caption at the top reads "Lobositz. Hauptstrasse." and a small red inscription at the bottom reads "Handkolorierte Künstlerkarte."

A monochrome sketch-style postcard showing a hilly riverside landscape with small houses in the foreground and a church-like building on a hill in the background, topped by three large crosses. Trees surround the buildings. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text labels the scene.

Black-and-white photograph with scalloped edges showing a wide view over densely forested hills and meadows. In the foreground there is grassland, a small fence and a tree on the right side; in the background rolling wooded hills stretch to the horizon under a cloudy sky. A caption in German is printed along the bottom margin.

Panoramic, monochrome postcard showing a hilly town with dense low buildings and several minarets, suggesting an Ottoman-era settlement. A main road runs through the center from the foreground into the town. There is printed caption text in French at the top left and right, and extensive handwritten text across the bottom margin. A circular seal or emblem appears on the left, and a modern watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed over the middle of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a stone church with a tall central tower and spire flanked by a smaller spire. The building has a steeply pitched roof and Gothic-style windows, surrounded by trees and a fenced garden. Two people are seated on a bench along a cobblestone street in the foreground. Red printed German text identifies the place and the church, and small vertical text on the right edge indicates the publisher.

A vintage, monochrome postcard showing the ornate neoclassical facade of a theater building on a cobblestone square. The structure has large arched windows, Corinthian columns, and a central pediment with a coat of arms. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the entrance. Printed text at the top left reads "BRUGES – Le Théâtre."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall rectangular lookout tower with a dark top standing above a densely forested hill. The tower rises over coniferous trees, with a rocky slope and a meadow in the foreground. At the bottom of the image there is a handwritten German caption.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a park with curved paths, lawns, and a waterway. Dominating the scene is a round medieval brick tower (part of old city fortifications). In the background are town buildings and an arched railway bridge. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Kronenburgerpark. — NIJMEGEN." The left margin has vertical publisher text, and the upper right has handwritten text with a date.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with the stone ruins of a medieval church or tower. A tall square stone tower and a shorter ruined tower stand among trees and low vegetation; in front of them is a long, low building with a partially collapsed or open roof structure. The lower margin contains printed caption text identifying the place.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large corner hotel building in a European spa town. The four‑story structure has ornate late 19th‑century facades with many windows, balconies, and decorative cornices. Several well‑dressed people stand on the sidewalk in front. The main sign on the building reads "HOTEL STERN." At the top left, printed text says "Marienbad. Hôtel Stern." and along the right margin there is vertical printing giving the publisher information.

A black‑and‑white image of a large wooden building in a park-like setting, photographed from ground level. The structure has a steeply pitched roof with extended, upturned gable ends resembling dragon heads or Viking ship prows, and elaborate wooden detailing along the eaves. It is elevated on a stone terrace or retaining wall, with trees and shrubs partially obscuring the facade. A paved path curves in the foreground and the sky is filled with scattered clouds. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view showing a tree‑lined dirt path on the left overlooking a river valley and a historic hilltop complex with a cathedral-like church and castle buildings dominating the right side. Below the hill lies a small town along the river. Handwritten-style captions are printed in German along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a substantial brick institutional building with classical detailing, likely a hospital, set behind a row of slender leafless trees and a hedge. The layout is landscape, with printed captions beneath the image indicating the place and publisher/photographer information.

A colorized historic postcard showing the ornate façade and terrace of the Grand Hotel Pupp with people in early‑20th‑century fashion strolling and sitting at cafe tables in front of the building. The hotel's name appears on the façade and the caption at the top reads "Karlsbad, Grand Hôtel Pupp." Additional small red text is printed vertically on the right margin and at the lower right corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a European city street lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks and in the roadway, and a tram can be seen further down the street. At the bottom, the captions "Leonhardstrasse" and "Graz" are printed, indicating the street and city depicted.

Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a low stone fortification or earthwork with rifle slits along the walls. A ramped dirt road leads down through a masonry archway in the center. Several people, likely soldiers or travelers, stand on the top of the wall and near the arch, dressed in early-20th‑century style. The landscape around is open and slightly hilly, with no prominent buildings in the background. A small manuscript number appears in the upper-left corner.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small village set among rolling hills and dense forests. Farm fields and meadows occupy the foreground, while scattered houses and larger buildings sit on gently rising slopes. The upper left corner bears printed German text identifying the place as Bärenfels in the Eastern Ore Mountains (Ost-Erzgebirge). The overall style and printing resemble an early- to mid-20th-century photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy outdoor public swimming pool full of children and adults. People are wading, swimming and standing at the pool edge in old-fashioned bathing suits. In the background are trees, a low rectangular building and a wooden tower-like structure beside the pool. The scene appears leisurely and summery. In the lower right corner, printed text labels the place.

Colorized view of a large European town square with a central monument and fountain, market stalls with umbrellas, a tram, and surrounding multi‑story buildings with red roofs and green shutters. In the background a steep hill rises with fortification walls and a prominent clock tower on top. The caption at the top reads "Graz-Hauptplatz," and shop signs in German are visible on the façades.

A sepia-toned panoramic photograph shows a European city nestled in a valley surrounded by hills and low mountains. Dense clusters of historic buildings, churches, and villas spread across the foreground and middle ground, while a wooded hill with a fortification or tower rises on the right. Snow‑capped mountains are faintly visible in the far distance. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed white text indicating the location and viewpoint.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a semi‑rural lakeside settlement with scattered detached houses, tree‑lined plots, cultivated fields, and intersecting narrow roads. In the background is a lake with forested shores and small islands. The houses are simple, steep‑roofed wooden structures typical of northern European countryside in the mid‑20th century.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large rectangular stone building with a tiled roof, simple windows, and a stone retaining wall in the foreground. The image is slightly faded and printed with a wide margin on the right, where a caption identifies the scene as the British consulate in Argostoli. There is also a small publisher's imprint along the left side and a modern website watermark at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene with small boats moored in the foreground and a large, domed building with arched facades and surrounding structures on the opposite bank. The image is labeled at the bottom with text indicating it depicts Port Said and the canal docks.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a half‑timbered house in the foreground and large Gothic stone ruins in the background, surrounded by trees and low hills. Red printed German captions at the top identify the location as Walkenried in the Harz region and note that the view is of a monastery ruin.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a small coastal cargo vessel or tanker sailing in a harbor. The ship dominates the foreground, with visible bridge, funnel, and deck equipment. Along the hull, near the bow, the vessel's name can be read. An urban waterfront with dense mid‑rise buildings, cranes, and port infrastructure fills the background, suggesting an industrial Mediterranean port city.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a landscaped memorial area set in open fields. In the foreground are large stones arranged around a rectangular, monument‑like structure, with paths bordered by low fences leading toward additional stone features and markers in the distance. The printed caption at the top is in German and references a monument connected to battlefield remains. The word "Düppel" appears at the top left.

Sepia-toned street view showing a historic European town. On the right is a prominent oriel bay window with ornate brackets and flower boxes on the corner of a building. The cobblestone street curves into the distance, lined with multi-story townhouses and shops with awnings; a few pedestrians and a cart are visible. German text is printed at the top identifying the location as Pirna on the Elbe River and specifying the corner of Langestraße and Badergasse.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town nestled on a forested hillside. In the foreground are trees and fields; behind them stand scattered houses, villas, and a few larger buildings with steep roofs. A small church or chapel tower is visible among the buildings. Dense coniferous forest covers the large hill rising behind the town. Printed text in German appears at the top of the card.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large, ornate two‑storey corner building in historicist style, with a tiled hip roof, tall arched windows and decorative stucco. The ground‑floor windows have slanted awnings, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the entrance. Printed text in the sky area reads "Pozdrav iz Gjurgjevca".

A sepia-toned historic street scene showing a broad, snowy avenue lined with multi‑story stone buildings in late 19th–early 20th century style. People in winter clothing walk along the street, and shop signs are visible on the ground floors, including a pharmacy. Text in the upper right corner names the city and street in Finnish and Swedish.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, multi‑storey historic building with decorative gables and a balcony, identified on the facade as a restaurant. It stands along a wide road bordered by trees and an old streetlamp; in the distance are more buildings and wooded hills. Two children are visible on the roadside. The printed caption at the top identifies the location as Coswig i. S. – Spitzgrundmühle, and there is German text on the building front.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a wooded, hilly landscape with a curving viaduct carrying a small train or tram (mountain railway) above a road. In the far distance is a large body of water. The caption in cursive script is printed along the bottom border.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a riverside scene with a tram in the foreground on curved tracks beside a cobblestone embankment. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the river. On the hill across the river stands a large Gothic complex with tall cathedral towers and adjoining palace‑like buildings. At the top left of the card, in red print, is the caption 'Meissen.  Kgl. Albrechtsburg.'

A sepia-toned studio portrait of a uniformed soldier framed in an oval vignette on a plain light background. The man, with a short mustache and neatly combed hair, wears a dark military tunic with metal buttons, shoulder straps, and breast pockets. The card edges are worn and slightly creased, resembling an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the front.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large open-air market scene in front of cultivated fields, with many people in traditional North African clothing gathered with donkeys and goods. In the distant background a low city skyline with several minarets is visible. The caption at the bottom reads "37 – MEKNÈS – Le Grand Marché – LL".

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded forest area with tall trees surrounding an open clearing or pond. There are a few people standing on the open ground in the middle distance. The scene is bordered by a light-colored margin, and at the bottom there is a printed caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a hilly European town with dense late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas and apartment houses, steep tiled roofs, and tree‑lined streets. A prominent Gothic‑revival church with a tall spire stands on a hill above the town. Forested hills surround the settlement. No visible border, caption, or other printing appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white view from a hillside lookout over a river bending through a European town. In the foreground three men in early 20th‑century clothing stand by a simple wooden railing, looking at the scenery. Across the river rises a large fortified complex with two tall, conical‑roofed towers and a long main building, resembling a medieval castle or fortress. Nearby are church buildings with steeples and clustered town houses, all surrounded by trees and gentle hills in the distance.

A monochrome postcard showing a Gothic-style church with tall pointed-arch windows and a small tower with a spire on the left side. Leafless trees stand in front of the church within a low walled yard, and surrounding residential buildings are visible. The printed caption at the top is in German and identifies the church as the first and oldest church in Graz.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside promenade and steamboat landing on the Elbe River. On the left, people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along a path lined with trees and buildings. On the right, several paddle steamers and small boats are moored at a landing stage in front of a multi‑arched brick bridge crossing the river. The scene is calm and picturesque, with a lightly clouded sky above.

Colorized historical view of a tree‑lined public square with a tall sculptural monument in the foreground and rows of traditional European buildings behind it. In the background, a steep, green hill rises with fortification walls and towers on top. The top of the image is labeled with red text identifying the location.

A vintage tinted postcard showing a panoramic view over a leafy park or promenade with paths and trees in the foreground and rows of buildings with red roofs and a large complex in the background. The text at the bottom identifies the scene as a view of Nijmegen from the Belvedere. The card has an old printed style with a beige margin for the captions.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic sunset or dusk scene in Trento, with the silhouetted Monument to Dante in the foreground on a high pedestal, the figure pointing outward. In the background, on a hill, a circular colonnaded structure identified as the Monument to Cesare Battisti is visible. Tall trees and mountainous terrain frame the monuments, and handwritten-style text runs along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white waterside view of a small bathhouse or pavilion complex on the shoreline, with a long low building on piles over the water and a central tower-like roof. Behind it, tree‑covered slopes with several villas or houses are visible. The image is framed with a white border and has a printed caption in the lower left corner reading "No. 8. Gustafsberg."

A black-and-white historic postcard showing a large town square with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. Prominent ornate buildings line the square, including a richly decorated city hall and adjacent residences, with a tall church tower rising in the background. At the top is printed text in Swedish, and handwritten upside‑down correspondence covers the upper portion of the card.

Black-and-white postcard view over a coastal fjord landscape with wooded hills on both sides and water extending into the distance. In the foreground there is a small town with houses and larger buildings among trees, and a ship or ferry visible on the water. The caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small oval publisher logo with a number is at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a modernist, multi‑storey white building labeled as being in Uddevalla, situated on a forested hillside. In the foreground are rocky terrain and a small house with a sloped roof; behind it stretches dense coniferous forest. The sky is partly cloudy and the overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century photograph.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad, tree-lined avenue with a central carriageway sloping gently upward into the distance. People and carriages are visible on the street. Elegant multi‑story buildings flank both sides, and there are lampposts and a small open square or intersection in the foreground. Decorative printed text and stamps appear on the front, including red lettering and a circular stamp at the lower left that reads "Souvenir d'Athènes." The caption printed in Greek and French at the bottom right identifies the street.

An old, tinted postcard depicting a massive stone castle complex with thick walls, corner towers, and small windows. The structure has a medieval appearance, with red-tiled roofs atop the towers. The image has a faded, sepia and pastel colorization characteristic of early 20th‑century postcards. At the top of the card, red text in multiple languages labels the view.

Vintage sepia portrait of a uniformed Russian military officer with epaulettes, medals, and ornate braid. The text at the top identifies him as Colonel Chiostak, commander of the Russian troops in Rethymno. A small website watermark appears at the bottom.

A vintage colored postcard showing a large open square with a column topped by a statue in the foreground and several multi‑storey neoclassical buildings in the background. People stand and walk around the square. There are flagpoles with flags flying above the central and right‑hand buildings. The caption text in Greek and French/English at the top identifies the location as Themistocles Square in Piraeus. A website watermark appears at the bottom.

Colorized photograph of a steamship passing through a large canal lock cut into rocky terrain. High stone lock walls rise on both sides, with gates visible at each end of the lock chamber. The surroundings are heavily forested with coniferous trees on rocky hills. On the right bank stands a small red-and-white control building, and several people are seen walking along the lock edge. In the distance, more lock gates and calm canal water extend toward a wooded landscape under a lightly clouded sky.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an ornate iron observation tower rising above dense trees in a park or forest. At the top of the image, red German text identifies the location and the tower. The structure has multiple octagonal levels with intricate latticework, balconies, and windows, standing prominently against a light sky.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing the neoclassical façade of a large museum building with a long colonnade and central portico, set behind a tree‑filled square with pedestrians, carriages and early vehicles. Hills or low mountains rise in the background. Greek and French captions appear below the image, along with a circular Greek seal on the left and a website watermark at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a Byzantine-style brick church with domes and arched windows, surrounded by a simple fence and a few trees, with a townscape in the background. The lower margin contains captions in Greek and French and a small signature/mark of the printer.

Colorized vintage street view showing a broad tree-lined boulevard with people walking and a few horse-drawn vehicles. On the right side stand ornate multi‑storey stone buildings with historicist facades; on the left is a park or garden with dense trees. A tall decorative lamppost rises near the center. Printed text at the top identifies the scene in German and Russian as a boulevard in Riga.

A vintage blue‑toned postcard announcing a festival or celebration. It shows an illustrated cavalry soldier on horseback holding a flag and a rifle, with a stylized background landscape and large curved title text above him. The date 22., 23. ja 24. juunil 1924 is printed prominently at the top, and additional text in Estonian appears at the bottom, commemorating heroes of the War of Independence on the eastern front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a dusty main street corner in a small town, showing a prominent two‑story stone commercial block with an American flag on the roof. The curved corner parapet reads "MIGLIAVACCA 1905 BUILDING." A bank occupies the street‑level corner entrance, with 'BANK' over the door and striped awnings over the windows. Upstairs windows display painted signs for professionals, such as attorneys and doctors. On the left side of the street are older one‑story storefronts, including a drugstore. Pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk in the unpaved street beside a horse‑drawn carriage, while overhead wires and a hanging streetlamp cross the scene.

A colorized postcard view of a rural canal scene with traditional Dutch windmills along the water, trees, a dirt road on the right, and several houses. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the location as Weesp and the specific road as Amsterdamsche weg. Publisher information and a catalog number are also printed in small text.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a tree-lined road and park area descending along a hillside. A decorative bridge or tunnel entrance is visible on the left side where the road passes through, surrounded by dense foliage. In the distant background above the trees, a church spire rises into the sky. Printed text in the upper left corner reads the name of the city and a specific street or area.

Colorized panoramic view over a forested valley town filled with grand spa-era buildings and villas. The town is nestled among wooded hills, with many multi‑story historic structures with red and gray roofs. At the top left in red text is the word "Marienbad." At the top right in red text is the phrase "Blick vom Café Egerländer." The image has the typical printed style and layout of an early 20th‑century postcard.

Vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of an industrial town with factories, chimneys, residential blocks and gardens or fields in the foreground. The landscape stretches towards low hills in the distance. In the upper left corner, red printed text reads "Riesa a. Elbe." indicating the town's name along the Elbe River.

Colorized vintage view over a river toward a European hillside city. In the foreground are riverside promenades, trees, and a bridge. Across the river stand historic buildings with red roofs and a tall white church tower with a green dome. Above the town rises a hill with fortification walls and several buildings on top, including a prominent clock tower. The caption at the top, in red German text, reads: "Graz. Schlossberg und Franziskanerkirche."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a view through a large arched stone gateway toward a historic building complex with steep gabled roofs and a tower. Black‑and‑white photograph of a vast tropical waterfall complex, seen through silhouettes of tall palm trees and other vegetation in the foreground. A black‑and‑white view of a grand spa town set in a forested valley. A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a European city with a river or canal winding through the center, lined by trees and mid‑rise apartment blocks. Colorized historic postcard view of a lawn‑tennis court beside a high stone fortification wall. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on and around the court. Vintage monochrome postcard view of a river scene with a paddle steamer on the Elbe River, low hills and cultivated fields in the background, and a sandy riverbank in the foreground where people, carts, and horses are present. Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European hillside settlement. In the foreground are fields and a row of modest two‑storey houses with steep roofs and simple facades. A color-printed panoramic view of a large hospital complex situated on gently sloping green fields with scattered houses in the foreground and forested hills and snow‑capped mountains in the distance. Color-printed postcard reproducing a historical painting or fresco inside a pointed Gothic arch. Black‑and‑white image of a large statue of a standing man in 18th‑century dress atop a tall pedestal in a landscaped park. A multi-view color postcard showing four photographs of traditional red wooden houses in a rocky, forested landscape with views over water. Black‑and‑white view of a historic European market square. In the center stands a large Baroque/Neoclassical town hall with a steep roof and a central tower bearing a clock and a small cupola. Colorized historic postcard showing a street scene with pedestrians and a tall cypress tree in the foreground. A multi-view color postcard with a yellow border featuring several photographs of a rural mountainous region. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone arched bridge with three main arches spanning a rocky riverbed in a valley. Low mountains or hills rise in the background. Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy public square or main street during a celebration or parade. Sepia-toned panoramic view of a town with many low houses and tiled roofs set at the foot of a barren hill or mountain. A black‑and‑white historic cityscape showing a busy waterfront intersection with bridges, trams, carriages, pedestrians, and a park area in the foreground. Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small rural settlement in a hilly, forested area. Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑story buildings with shops on the ground floor. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical building with a grand colonnaded portico and pediment, surrounded by trees and a landscaped garden in the foreground. Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a tall lattice radio mast or transmission tower rising above a snowy landscape. Conifer trees with snow on their branches frame the foreground. A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a large, multi-storey early‑20th‑century building with a mansard-style roof and many windows, identified as the new post office. Aerial view of a complex centered on a large pinkish‑stone church with a dome and cross-shaped floor plan, surrounded by forested hills. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated Baroque church interior. The view focuses on a high altar with many statues of angels and saints, heavy ornamentation, columns, and a large arched backdrop with painted ceiling. At the bottom left there is a caption printed in German.

Hand-colored historic street view showing a cobblestone intersection with an obelisk-like monument in the center, surrounded by period buildings. Sepia-toned historic street view of a small European town. Timber-framed and masonry houses line a slightly curving main street leading toward low hills in the background. Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a cobblestone main street lined with multi‑story buildings, shops, and pedestrians. Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large three-story school building in historicist style, with arched gables at both ends and in the center, a small tower or cupola on the roof, many tall windows, and a fenced garden in front. Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a group of uniformed military officers standing and conversing in an open camp area. A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard shows an elevated view over a small European town with densely packed tiled‑roof houses in the foreground and a rural, hilly landscape with fields and scattered buildings in the background. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural hillside settlement. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a dirt road leading toward a small church with a Baroque-style spire and rounded windows. In the middle of the square stands an ornate lamppost or fountain. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn carriage move across the largely empty square, and one person in the foreground wears a uniform or traditional dress.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a formal garden courtyard with a long rectangular reflecting pool leading toward a pavilion in neo-Moorish style, flanked by crenellated walls and colonnaded wings with tall cypress trees. The printed caption at the top identifies it as a view from the Exposition Coloniale Internationale in Paris in 1931, and the bottom text specifies that this is the Moroccan Pavilion (Pavillon du Maroc), with architects credited at lower right.

A black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a lakeside rural area with gently rolling fields and forests in the background. In the middle distance on a small peninsula or shore stands a prominent church with a tall steeple and a few surrounding buildings. The foreground shows the opposite shore with bushes and a fence line. At the top of the image there is printed text in a Scandinavian language.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and gentle hills. In the foreground are trees and open countryside; in the middle ground, dense traditional houses with gabled roofs. Dominating the scene is a tall church with a tower and spire rising above the old town. At the bottom left, printed caption text reads "Frankenberg i. Sa."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of people, men and women in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing, standing and sitting among large rock formations and vegetation in a narrow rocky ravine. At the top of the card, there is a printed caption in Russian identifying the location near Krasnoyarsk.

Vintage sepia postcard with three ornate, baroque-style picture frames: on the left a person in traditional dress, in the center a well-dressed person in a long coat and hat holding a cane, and on the right a person in a ballet-style tutu. Under the central portrait is printed text with the name "John Lind" and a German subtitle. There is extensive handwritten cursive text across the lower part and along the right edge. On the left edge appears a vertical printer's imprint mentioning Hamburg.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small mill settlement in a wooded valley. Several traditional European houses and mill buildings stand close together beside a rocky stream, with forested hills rising steeply behind them. The scene is quiet and rural. At the top in red Gothic-style print is a title identifying the location; smaller printer information appears vertically along the right edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Romanesque cathedral and adjacent civic buildings on a square. The image shows the cathedral with its octagonal central tower, rounded apse, side chapels, and arcaded details. Beside it are fortified-looking buildings with battlements and a tall clock tower. In the foreground are a vendor's stand, fencing, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption in red at the top left reads "TRENTO — Duomo".

A colorized postcard showing a young girl in traditional dress standing in a blossoming orchard, with the large medieval clock tower on a hill behind her. The tower has a steep, shingled roof and two big clock faces with Roman numerals. In the upper left corner there is printed German text identifying the location as the clock tower in Graz, Styria.

Vintage sepia postcard featuring a formal portrait of an older man in dark 19th‑century clothing, with sideburns and a serious expression. Below the portrait is printed biographical text in French identifying him, with a list of his works. The layout, border, small reference number, and printer's mark resemble early 20th‑century French art postcards.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a historic Italian square framed by a large arch in the foreground. In the center stands a monumental fountain topped with a statue of Neptune holding a trident, surrounded by sculpted figures and basins. Behind it rises a large Romanesque cathedral with a rose window, arcaded façade, and octagonal dome with a cross on top. To the left are old stone buildings with shuttered windows and a crenellated tower. Small figures of pedestrians and an early automobile appear in the square. Handwritten-style text at the bottom reads the location and square name.

Black‑and‑white historic image of a small wooden railway station with decorative trim and a gabled roof. A sign above the entrance reads "KLOCKRIKE". People in early 20th‑century clothing, including railway staff in uniform, women in long skirts and hats, and children, stand on the platform in front of the station. A railcar or train coach is visible in the left foreground on the tracks, and a horse‑drawn carriage appears to the right.

Colorized landscape view across a wide river toward a small town with a prominent church tower on a hill. In the foreground, a steamboat and a smaller vessel travel along the calm river. The town consists of clustered houses and trees, with fields and low hills in the background under a soft sunset or sunrise sky. The word "Zehren" is printed in cursive at the top left.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a central photograph framed by a wide beige margin. The image shows a column of pack animals and troops crossing a shallow ford in a rocky riverbed, moving toward distant hills with more soldiers visible on the slopes. Beneath the photo is a French caption describing the scene and a printer's credit line.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style view over open fields toward a small town. In the middle distance stands a church with a tall, tiered tower and spire, surrounded by long, low buildings and a mix of houses and industrial chimneys. Bare trees line a road or path in front of the settlement. At the top in red Gothic-style script is printed the caption identifying the place and church.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a small neo‑Gothic chapel in a wooded park. A path curves through the trees, with two men standing near the chapel entrance. The building has a pointed arched doorway, a small rose window above it, and a cross on the roof. Red printed captions identify the scene at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a substantial corner building in a European city. The three‑story stone structure has arched ground‑floor windows and doors, decorative cornices, and many upper‑floor windows with awnings. Swedish text identifying an insurance company is painted along the facade. In the foreground is an iron bridge or railing over water with decorative circles, a lamppost, and a small kiosk-like structure on the right. Printed red text along the bottom identifies the city and company name.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a large parade or demonstration moving down a wide avenue lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings. Crowds watch from sidewalks and balconies. At the front of the procession men in suits carry flags and banners with Cyrillic writing. The clothing and architecture suggest an early–20th‑century urban setting.

A close-up of a purple postage stamp affixed to a postcard. The stamp shows a detailed engraved image of a large neoclassical theatre building with multiple wings and pitched roofs. Decorative floral scrollwork frames the scene. At the top is the wording 'EESTI POST'. At the bottom, the denomination '30' appears in both lower corners with the words 'KOLMKÜMMEND MARKA' in a ribbon. Below the building is the caption 'TEATER-ESTONIA'. There are black postmark cancellation marks across the stamp and onto the surrounding postcard paper.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a frontal view of a large, rectangular neoclassical/art‑deco style building with tall arched windows and circular medallions above them. The building stands at the top of a broad set of steps with flagpoles in the foreground. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge, including the name of the city and the art museum, a printer's mark, and collection information.

Black-and-white postcard view over a forested lake or reservoir bordered by conifer trees in the foreground. Across the water a straight dam structure and a small building or house are visible, with a road leading through the woods and gently rolling fields beyond. The scene looks like a man‑made reservoir in a mountainous, heavily forested area. Handwritten-style caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Colorized vintage view of a small harbor or riverside quay with stone steps descending to the water, several rowboats and a small white steam or motor boat moored in the calm water. On the embankment stands a distinctive wooden and brick building with a turret, mansard-style metal roof, veranda and ornate windows, likely a riverside restaurant or pavilion. A few men in dark suits stand talking near the steps, and a horse-drawn cart and small white kiosks are visible on the cobblestone street. Industrial chimneys and wooden houses appear in the background, suggesting a northern European town in the early 20th century. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of an industrial complex beside a river or lake, surrounded by fields and forest. The site includes long factory halls, several tall silos, a central smokestack emitting smoke, smaller brick buildings, roads and parked vehicles. In the lower left corner there is a small printed logo with the text 'HAMMAR', suggesting the image is a printed postcard of this industrial locality.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a broad cobblestone street lined with 19th‑century buildings and small trees. Horse‑drawn carriages and carts stand along the right side of the street, with pedestrians walking on both sidewalks. A church tower and other civic buildings are visible in the distance. Printed captions appear at the top and bottom of the card in Esperanto and Hungarian, identifying the street and city.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a small village with wooden houses beside a calm river or pond in which the buildings are reflected. On a slight hill behind the houses stands a white church with a tower and spire. Leafless trees and simple wooden fences surround the buildings, suggesting a rural Scandinavian setting. Printed text in Swedish appears at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white view of a waterfront with several sailing boats and small rowboats in the foreground. Along the quay stand wooden seaside buildings and a large bathhouse complex with towers and flagpoles. The scene is labeled at the bottom left with the place name, and a small oval printer's mark appears at the bottom right.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a busy shipyard and dock area with multiple steamships and boats moored and in drydock along a canal. Industrial buildings and workshops line the left side, while smaller houses or offices stand on the right. Numerous flagpoles carry blue and yellow flags. In the distance the canal continues through a wooded landscape. The caption at the top right reads "Motala, Verkstad, Dockan," and a vertical imprint along the right edge credits a local printer in Motala.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large ornate fountain in the foreground, topped by a standing statue and surrounded by sculpted lions and basins. Around the square are market stalls and people in early‑20th‑century dress. Behind them stand multi‑storey historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and shop signs in German, including a prominent wine shop. Tall church towers rise in the background.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a forested mountain valley with scattered houses and villas, likely a resort town. The caption at the top left reads "Kipsdorf i. sächs. Erzgeb." indicating the place shown. Dense coniferous woods cover the hills, with a road and meadows in the foreground and more buildings visible along the valley sides.

Vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a busy urban street lined with multi‑storey European-style buildings. People in early 20th‑century dress walk and stand along the street; some men wear hats and long coats. A large tree dominates the center of the view, partially obscuring a prominent building on the left with classical columns and an ornate fence. Printed captions in Greek and French appear on the image, along with a modern watermark at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large stone hydroelectric power station building beside a fast‑flowing river or rapids. The long façade has repeated tall arched windows and smaller rectangular windows above, with water rushing past the base of the structure. Additional industrial buildings stand on the slope behind. Printed text at the upper right reads "Trollhättan, Kraftstationen."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a narrow irrigation ditch bordered by overhanging trees whose branches form a shaded tunnel over the water. The still water reflects the trees. On the right side, part of a simple wooden fence or small bridge is visible. Beneath the image is a printed caption in red identifying the scene as an irrigation ditch near Hanford, California, with a red number printed in the lower right corner.

An old black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a small town street with unpaved road and wooden houses on both sides. A few people stand or walk along the street. On the left is a two‑storey building with a business sign; more wooden houses extend into the distance. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom, along with printed captions in German indicating greetings from Oberpahlen and the photographer's credit.

Color postcard view of a snowy Alpine town nestled in a wide valley beneath dramatic jagged mountains. In the foreground people are skiing on a gentle slope overlooking the town. The settlement below has pastel-colored houses with sloped roofs and a prominent church with a tall, narrow bell tower at its center. Terraced fields and scattered chalets climb the opposite hillside, and dark conifer forests and high rocky peaks frame the scene under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a mountainous valley landscape with scattered farmhouses, winding roads, forests, and high ridges in the background. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text identifying the location as Feldberg in the Black Forest and the St. Wilhelmer valley.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a cobbled urban street with multi‑story European-style buildings, shopfronts with awnings, and a horse‑drawn carriage moving along the road. Leafless trees line the right side. The street scene is labeled "Strada Domneasca" beneath the image. In the upper right appears the printed word "Galatz." There is a round postal/collector mark at lower left and handwritten text and date at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an urban neighborhood with low houses, trees, and a prominent mosque minaret on the right. In the foreground people walk and gather along a street or small square. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "32. SALONIQUE. Quartier Turc". A web watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a busy seafront quay with moored boats and small ships along the waterfront. A cobbled promenade runs beside the water with pedestrians, horse-drawn carriages, and a tram or wagon. Multi‑storey waterfront buildings line the right side. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the scene as the quay of the Messageries Maritimes in Salonique (Thessaloniki).

Tinted historic postcard view of a large monument in an open square, with a tall statue of a robed figure atop a multi-tiered pedestal adorned with reliefs and sculptural groups. People stroll around the fenced monument, and behind it are trees, buildings, and a bell tower set against a backdrop of mountains. The caption at the top left reads "Trient, Dantedenkmal."

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a grand historic building with a large arched windowed façade and two symmetrical towers. The front of the building is covered with climbing plants and surrounded by a formal garden. In the foreground there is a circular fountain pool with a water jet, pathways, flowerbeds, and benches. The caption at the bottom left reads "Leipzig. Palmengarten".

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a group of soldiers in padded protective armor and face masks practicing bayonet or pole-weapon combat drills outdoors. Several pairs of trainees face each other with long rifles or poles, while officers in uniforms and caps observe. In the background, more soldiers stand in formation in front of low barracks buildings with tall leafy trees behind them.

Vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European town, showing a cobblestone main street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. A tall church tower with a clock and spire dominates the right side in the middle distance. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. German text is printed at the top identifying the location, and business signs are visible on the buildings.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a town with low wooden and stone buildings, tree-lined streets, and a tall chimney and clocktower in the distance. The bottom margin contains printed and handwritten text, with the printed caption reading "Tampere-Tammerfors."

Black‑and‑white image showing a crowd of well‑dressed people in early‑20th‑century fashion strolling in a landscaped park around a small, ornate pavilion or colonnade with Gothic arches and a domed roof. The structure stands in front of grand spa‑style buildings, with wooded hills in the background and tree branches framing the view, giving the impression of a fashionable European spa resort scene.

Black‑and‑white view of an outdoor terrace café or restaurant built along a stone wall on a forested hillside. Long rows of wooden tables and benches follow a path bordered with round globe lamps mounted on posts. Dense coniferous trees fill the background. At the bottom of the image there is printed caption text and a small script signature at the lower right.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town nestled in a forested valley. In the foreground is a curved dirt road bordered by wooden posts and trees, with houses featuring sloped tiled roofs on either side. Further back, more town buildings and a distant church tower or similar structure are visible among dense hills covered with trees. Printed text along the bottom margin identifies the view as being from König Albert-Strasse in Tharandt and credits the publisher Brück & Sohn in Meissen.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing two large, symmetrical multi‑storey barrack buildings facing an open parade ground or courtyard. The architecture is plain and functional with many identical windows and mansard-style roofs with flat roof decks and railings. In the foreground is a grassy area and paved paths; in the background the sky is mostly cloudy. At the lower edge there is German caption text indicating a military barracks for an observation unit in Meissen. A red handwritten number "27057" appears at the top right.

A monochrome illustrated industrial scene showing a large multi‑storey brewery complex with tall chimneys emitting smoke, surrounded by smaller buildings, streets, and a waterfront with sailing ships and steam vessels. The illustration is framed with a wide white border. Below the image, printed text identifies the establishment as D. Carnegie & Co Ltd, brewers in Gothenburg, Sweden.

A vertically oriented old Russian postal card or coupon with printed blue text and handwritten address information in black ink. There are circular black postal stamps and a large diagonal stamp reading "ОПЛАЧЕНО" (Paid). The typography and layout are typical of early 20th‑century Imperial Russian postal stationery.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a modernist, multi‑level restaurant or café with curved balconies, large floor‑to‑ceiling windows, minimalist tables and chairs, and a spiral stair or stepped wall on the left. The space appears to be high above ground level, likely in a tower or high‑rise with panoramic views. No visible printed text or captions are present on the image side.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large baroque hilltop church with twin onion-domed towers rising above a wooded hill. At the foot of the hill are several traditional gabled houses with tiled roofs. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and the publisher, with some faint handwritten notes on the lower margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a modest house surrounded by dense trees and vegetation. The building has a pitched roof with several chimneys and simple rectangular windows. In the foreground there is a small wooden footbridge crossing a ditch or stream. The scene is rural and tranquil. At the bottom of the image, there is printed text identifying the place.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a rural village scene with a large half-timbered inn labeled as Voigt's Gasthof in the foreground, a tree-lined open space with children and adults standing and posing, and a church with a tall, tiered spire and clock tower in the background. The top left contains printed German text identifying the location as Grünlichtenberg near Waldheim and naming the guesthouse.

A color postcard showing a panoramic view of a mountain village nestled in a green valley, with rugged peaks in the background. The town features clusters of multi‑storey stone and plaster buildings, including a church with a bell tower, set among trees and terraced hillsides. The caption "Molina di Ledro." is printed in the upper left corner.

A color postcard-style image of a mountain resort set in a lush alpine valley. Several multi‑story hotels line a road, with 'GRAND HOTEL PEJO' clearly visible on the central building. Surrounding the hotels are green meadows, scattered chalets, tall conifer trees, and high mountains with snow‑capped peaks in the background. Red printed text in Italian appears at the top of the postcard describing the location and its elevation.

A vintage, tinted postcard showing a tall neo‑Gothic church spire rising above a heavily wooded area, with a winding road in the foreground and distant hills under a cloudy sky. The image is framed by a red border on a yellowed background. At the top, there is a caption in a decorative script.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an old European town street with cobblestones, historic houses and trees in the foreground. In the background rise the twin Gothic towers of a large cathedral and another church building on a hill. At the bottom border in cursive German script it reads "Meißen a.d. Elbe" on the left and "Freiheit und Dom" on the right.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers gathered in an open yard in front of a two‑storey railway-station-type building. The text identifies it as related to the First World War "Campagne d'Orient 1914–1917" and mentions the train station of Varria (Veria) in Greece. The layout and printing style are typical of early 20th‑century military postcards.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing four African men standing side by side on a dirt road in a village lined with thatched huts and woven fences. They wear feathered headdresses, patterned cloths wrapped around their waists, and carry rifles and hunting trophies. The scene is ethnographic in character. Printed captions appear at the top: on the left, the word "Loanda" and on the right, "Caçadores de Cabiri - No. 1."

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a wide view of Piazza del Duomo in Trento, Italy. In the center stands a large baroque fountain with multiple statues, surrounded by historic multi-story buildings with arcades and shuttered windows. A domed church or cathedral rises on the right side of the square. Printed captions appear at the top: on the left, a slogan, and on the right, the city and square name.

Colorized historic postcard view of a town square with a large stone fountain in the foreground, topped by a nude classical-style statue. Around the square stand several multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk near the buildings. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed titles at the top read "Grimma." on the left and "Markt mit Brunnen." on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a small town nestled in a valley with many trees, hillside vineyards or fields, and clusters of multi‑storey houses with gabled roofs. The scene looks down from an elevated point toward the Meisa valley, with rolling countryside in the background. Printed German text appears at the top.

Black-and-white postcard showing a cobblestone square in front of a neoclassical church with a columned portico and steps, partially shaded by a large tree. A low fence with stone posts lines the edge of the terrace, beyond which a valley and a small town on rolling hills are visible. Caption text appears at the bottom margin.

A monochrome postcard view of an extensive military barracks complex set on the edge of a town with open fields and low hills in the background. Large multi‑storey brick buildings with pitched roofs and many windows are arranged around internal yards, enclosed by perimeter walls and streets. Printed German text appears at the top, identifying the place as the barracks of the 2nd Royal Saxon Jäger Battalion No. 13 in Meissen.
A black-and-white portrait of an older fisherman wearing a slick, shiny oilskin coat and a sou'wester rain hat, smoking a pipe. At the top of the image there is printed text in Swedish.

Tinted vintage postcard view of a riverside harbor scene. Several sailing boats are moored along the left bank, while a grassy peninsula with a masonry embankment juts into the water. On the peninsula stand a few light‑colored buildings with red roofs and a tall chimney in the background, suggesting industrial or abattoir facilities. A man in a long dark coat and hat stands in the foreground near the water. The image is framed in an oval on a light background, with printed captions in pink and publisher information along the left margin.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing an early motor coach and several people standing on a rough mountain road, with a steep, rugged peak rising in the background. Printed French text at the top describes the scene as an auto-car at Pas de Peyrol in Cantal, part of the Auvergne region. Publisher information appears at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an illustration of two barefoot men in tunics carrying an enormous cluster of grapes on a pole between them, walking through a hilly vineyard landscape with a chapel or small church on a hill in the background. Large grapevines frame the scene on both sides. The Latin phrase "IN VINO VERITAS" appears prominently at the bottom of the image. Beneath this, printed in red Czech text, is a caption describing the subject as a wall painting in the manor wine cellars in Liběchov near Mělník.

A vintage botanical postcard featuring a monochrome illustration of branches, leaves, blossoms, and berries of a pepper tree. The plant fills most of the card, printed in dark ink on a light background. Around the image are printed captions in red: a title at the bottom describing the subject and publisher/printing information along the sides. A handwritten red number is visible along the left edge.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a hillside neighborhood with tightly packed stone and plaster houses with tiled roofs, surrounded by trees. At the lower edge are a stone wall and a couple of standing figures in dark clothing. Greek and French/Latin text is printed at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a European city in a river valley, taken from an elevated hillside path where a person is seated in the lower right corner. A broad river curves through the center, flanked by dense blocks of multi‑story buildings and several church towers, with mountains in the background. A bridge crosses the river at the lower left. Along the right edge, in a small vertical script, is printed a caption.

A black‑and‑white image showing a formal town garden or small park with curving gravel paths, circular flowerbeds, low hedges, and mature trees. In the background stand several late‑19th‑century brick townhouses with decorative window surrounds and high roofs. An ornate iron fence and gate structure is visible at the far right, along with old‑style street lamps. The scene is quiet, with no obvious vehicles, suggesting an early 20th‑century European urban setting.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle surrounded by dense forest. The castle sits on a rocky outcrop above a valley, with multiple gabled roofs and a central tower. In the sky area at the top right, red printed text reads "Schloss Kriebstein bei Waldheim." Along the right vertical margin appears the printer's imprint in small red letters.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, reeds and swans on the water, and a small pavilion on an island. In the background stand several large brick and stone buildings along a curving path lined with trees and fencing. The scene has an old European town atmosphere. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad cobblestone square with a large two‑storey institutional building on the left and an ornate church with onion domes and a tall bell tower with crosses on the right. Trees and a few additional buildings stand behind them. Caption text in Estonian appears at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small town nestled in a heavily forested mountainous area. Many trees and pine-covered hills surround scattered houses and villas; a church-like building with a tower is visible among them. At the bottom edge there is a printed caption in German describing the place and its elevation.

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad square lined with several‑story historic buildings and shops, with awnings over the storefronts and early 20th‑century cars and buses parked in the open space. The perspective looks along a street leading away from the square, with a decorative towered building on the right side. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge in Dutch, identifying the location as the Groote Markt with Burchtstraat in Nijmegen.

Sepia-toned postcard illustration of a serene lakeside or river scene in a landscaped park. On the left stands a villa-like building with a cylindrical tower and conical roof, surrounded by lush gardens and palm-like plants. A wide tree dominates the center, its branches hanging over the water. In the foreground a small rowboat with a man rowing and a woman in a large hat glides on the calm water, while several other boats are moored along the bank and another small boat is visible in the distance. A path with a simple wooden railing runs along the shore, and tall trees line the opposite bank.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a leafy field in the foreground with a row of early 20th‑century detached houses and a few larger brick buildings in the background. The image shows a suburban residential area under an overcast sky. In the lower left corner there is a caption identifying the location, and in the lower right corner a small oval printer's mark.

Black‑and‑white vintage street scene showing an old European town. On the right are several multi‑story buildings with shops at street level; one sign reads "Ph…" suggesting a pharmacy. Trees line the street and there is a tall lamppost in the center foreground. On the left stands a small kiosk or pillar and large leafy trees. Handwritten captions appear in cursive in the bottom left and right corners.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with an octagonal stone fountain in the foreground, ornate streetlamps, and multi‑story 19th‑century buildings lining the square. Shop signs in German are visible on the façades, including a hotel and various merchants. The image has the framing and style of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white rural landscape showing gently rolling meadows with fences, a few telegraph poles, and several large houses on a hillside. In the foreground is a prominent half‑timbered farmhouse with a steep gabled roof, characteristic of Central European (especially German) rural architecture. More multi‑storey villas or pension-style buildings stand further up the slope against a backdrop of dense conifer forest. The sky is blank and bright, and the overall scene feels like an early‑20th‑century countryside resort or village. Along the right edge there is a vertical strip with handwritten or printed numbers and letters, as often seen on vintage negatives or postcard captions, but it is not fully legible.

A monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a rural town in a valley, surrounded by fields and rolling hills. Numerous small houses and farm buildings are visible, along with a larger complex in the middle distance. In the far left, a church with a tower rises above the town. Leafless or sparsely leaved trees frame the right foreground. The caption "Andritz bei Graz." is printed in the upper left corner in a serif typeface.

Black-and-white postcard view of a city square framed by multi-story historic buildings. In the distance, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower. A few pedestrians are visible in the foreground. The caption at the bottom reads in German, identifying the location as Graz's Freiheitsplatz with a view toward Schlossberg.

Sepia-toned historic postcard depicting a large, ornate university building with arched windows and classical architectural details along a tree-lined street. A person is standing on the sidewalk in the foreground. At the bottom center of the card is a caption in two languages.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph mounted on a light border shows a flat rural landscape with a traditional Dutch windmill standing in an open field. A drainage canal runs toward the foreground, with part of an early‑20th‑century automobile visible on the left and some small farm structures on the right. Handwritten text in Dutch appears below the photo and in the upper right margin.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a hillside town with dense old European houses in the foreground and a large castle complex on the hill above. At the center-left a massive scaffolding structure surrounds a building under reconstruction, and a Gothic church tower rises just beside it. Printed red text in German at the top reads 'Meissen. Schlossberg mit dem Dom während des Umbaus.' indicating the castle hill and cathedral during renovation. Along the right edge there is a vertical imprint with the publisher and date.

Black‑and‑white view of an old stone ruin in a forest. Only sections of the outer walls remain, with large arched and rectangular window openings. Several children and a man stand in the openings and at the base of the wall, dressed in early‑20th‑century clothing. The building appears roofless and overgrown, surrounded by tall, leafless or sparsely leafed trees. No caption or printed text is visible on the image side.

Multi-view color postcard with a blue border showing seaside scenes: a busy port promenade with parked 1970s–1980s cars and cranes, a rocky green headland with small piers, crowded sandy beaches on a calm sea, and a large metal water slide structure at a beach resort. In the center is Cyrillic text.

A vintage black‑and‑white (tinted with red title text) postcard view of a calm river with reflections of riverside buildings and wooded hills. On the left foreground is a small rowboat; on the right a covered motorboat moves along the river. On the opposite bank stand several multi‑story houses or hotels built directly by the water, backed by a steep, tree‑covered slope. At the top left of the card there is printed red German text identifying the location as Bad Kösen and describing this riverside section on the Saale near the Loreley.
