Around the image there is printed text in Greek and French describing the scene and indicating it is an official issue of the Hellenic postal service.

A monochrome, printed illustration of a massive neoclassical building complex with multiple domed roofs and long wings arranged around courtyards. The central facade features a grand portico with tall Corinthian columns and wide steps filled with small figures, suggesting visitors entering a major civic or cultural institution. The complex occupies a full city block bordered by streets and sparse trees, with a park‑like area in the distance. No decorative borders or obvious modern elements are visible; the style suggests an early‑20th‑century architectural rendering reproduced as a postcard.

A sepia-toned studio photograph of three young children posed between and on two ornate wooden chairs. The two boys wear sailor suits with dark collars and ties; the girl in the middle wears a light-colored dress and stockings, standing between them. The card has a printed vertical caption in French along the right edge that identifies them as the children of a crown prince. A website watermark, 'www.elia.org.gr', is visible across the lower right portion of the image.

Sepia-toned postcard showing two male actors in theatrical costume posed against a plain studio background. The shorter man on the left, in an ornate military-style uniform with a feathered hat and sash, glares upward at the taller man on the right, who wears a formal tailcoat and monocle while looking down disdainfully. Decorative German text titles the scene at the top, and the actors' names are printed beneath each figure. A photographer/publisher credit and the date 1913 appear at the lower right.

Sepia-toned historic view of a large monument in an open square with mountains in the background. The central feature is a tall pedestal topped by a statue of Dante Alighieri, surrounded by smaller sculptural figures at its base. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk around the monument. Trees and a church or bell tower appear to the right, with dramatic rocky mountains behind. Printed text at the top reads the city name and the name of the monument.

A monochrome panoramic photograph of a small village nestled in a valley with terraced hillsides rising behind it. The foreground shows fields and scattered houses, while the central area is a dense cluster of village buildings with tiled roofs. The mountains or high hills dominate the background. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the view as a panorama of Vattaro in Trentino.

Sepia-toned street scene labeled "Elsterwerda — Markt". It shows the market square of a small European town with cobblestone streets and late 19th–early 20th century townhouses. A corner building with a pointed tower stands prominently; shop signs on the ground floors advertise goods such as textiles and alcoholic beverages. A few pedestrians are visible in the square and along the street.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a central European town hall building on a sloping square. The multi-storey structure has a mansard roof, dormer windows, and a clock tower with a cupola. A crowd of people stands on the steps in front of the entrance. Surrounding are narrow streets lined with multi-storey townhouses, and church spires rise in the distant background. German titles are printed at the top left and bottom right of the card.

A vintage tinted photograph showing a sandy village scene with several thatched-roof huts made from wood and straw. Indigenous people stand among low bushes and drying plants in front of the huts. The colors are sepia and muted, suggesting an early 20th‑century printed postcard. Red printed caption text appears at the top left.

Sepia-toned street scene showing a row of stalls or booths along a wrought-iron fence in an urban setting. Men in traditional Middle Eastern/North African clothing sit and stand at tables, engaged in writing or clerical work—depicting modern scribes. A large tree and a streetlamp stand in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in French, with an imprint and initials on the right.

Black‑and‑white view of a grand European spa town with ornate multi‑story buildings lining both sides of a narrow river or canal. A tree‑lined promenade runs along the water, busy with well‑dressed pedestrians in early 20th‑century fashion. On the right is a long colonnaded building with statues along its roofline, likely a spa colonnade. Hills with villas rise steeply behind the town. Large wall advertisements in German are visible on the left‑side façades.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard view of a European city along a river, with a bridge crossing the water in the foreground and rows of buildings on both banks. In the background a steep hill rises, topped by fortification walls and buildings, with a prominent clock tower on the right side of the hill. A church tower with a bulbous dome stands among the city buildings. Printed text at the top left reads "Graz mit Schloßberg."

Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a river flowing through a narrow valley bordered by steep rocky cliffs on the right and dense conifer forest on both sides. A small path runs along the river at the base of the cliffs, and a few buildings are visible among the trees on the left foreground. The scene is mountainous and heavily wooded. Printed caption text appears in the lower margin.

A philatelic postcard with a minimalist blue-and-red line drawing of an alpine skier in the lower left corner on a white background. In the upper right corner there is a blue postage stamp featuring a stylized skier and Olympic rings with the text "Lillehammer '94" and denomination "1,25s KR". The stamp is cancelled with a circular postmark that includes text around the edge and a small skiing figure.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a river curving through a narrow wooded valley. On the left bank stands a row of early‑20th‑century European buildings, including one with a small steeple or tower, fronted by a riverside promenade lined with trees. Dense forested hills rise steeply behind the town, and a small bridge crosses the river in the mid‑distance. The overall look is of a spa or resort town in a mountainous region. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.

A black-and-white vertical postcard view of a narrow, slightly curving cobblestone street between tall, old masonry buildings. The right side is dominated by a high façade with large sash windows and a small sloping canopy over a doorway, under which several dark‑clad figures stand. Another person walks alone farther down the street. In the distance, over the rooftops with steep gables and tiled roofs, a tall, slender church spire rises. The ground appears wet or lightly snowy, suggesting a cold season. The overall feel is of an early‑20th‑century European old town street.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small coastal settlement at the foot of dark hills. A few large neoclassical-style buildings stand near the shoreline, with scattered smaller houses further back. The sea occupies the foreground. There is printed Greek text at the bottom and extensive handwritten Greek script across the lower and upper parts of the image. A round postal cancellation mark is faintly visible, and a watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appears on the right side.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped urban park with curved flowerbeds full of colorful blooms, trees, and a wide gravel path. In the background stands a substantial stone building and ornamental gates, with lampposts along the path. The place name "Chemnitz." appears at the top left and the caption "Anlagen am Wettinplatz." at the top right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a cemetery path running between rock formations and grave plots. On the left, graves and religious statues are carved into a cliff face with an iron fence and stone balustrade. On the right, numerous gravestones and crosses stand among dense trees. In the background there is a stone wall or ruin with an arched opening. Decorative cursive text is printed in the lower margin.

Illustrated postcard showing a stylized view of the Fisherman's Bastion with its staircase, arched doorway and turreted white stone walls against a blue sky with scattered clouds. The bottom margin contains printed captions in Hungarian and German along with the city name.

A multi-view color postcard showing four photographs of a mountain town nestled in a valley. The images depict tiled-roof houses, a church with a tall bell tower, surrounding green hills and dramatic rocky mountains, plus a town square with a clock tower and commercial buildings. In the center of the card a white strip reads "Saluti da CAVALESE."

Color postcard showing a tall stone monument with stylized socialist‑realist statues of several figures in work clothes standing together against vertical pillars. At the base there are numerous wreaths and flower arrangements decorated with red, yellow and blue ribbons. In the background are low, pale buildings and a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small harbor with wooden piers, several rowing boats in the foreground, sailing boats and a steamship in the background. A man stands on the pier looking toward the water. Buildings and forested shoreline are visible across the bay. Printed captions in Swedish identify the place, and there is cursive handwritten text across the bottom.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a tranquil pond covered with water lilies in the foreground, reflecting a large historic building partially hidden behind dense trees on the far shore. The structure has a castle- or manor-like appearance with a square tower featuring crenellations and other roof elements. Handwritten text appears at the top margin, and a small printed label or watermark is visible in the lower right corner.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small industrial town set in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground are factory buildings with tall chimneys and dense town housing. Toward the center stands a prominent church with a tall tower and Baroque-style dome, surrounded by residential blocks and open plots. Farmland and wooded hills lie in the background. In the lower right corner, white printed text reads "Aue i. Erzgeb." indicating the town and region.

Black‑and‑white image showing a rocky shoreline with many sailboats gathered close to land and others sailing out on the open water. People stand and sit on the rocks near small docking boats. The scene depicts a sailing regatta, with a calm sea and low islands or coastline in the background. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and a small publisher's logo with a number in the lower right.

Colorized panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. The foreground shows a park-like green area with paths and leafless trees. Along intersecting roads stand several multi‑storey townhouses and civic buildings with red or green roofs, as well as an industrial chimney to the right. The scene is printed in an old lithographic style. At the top center appears the caption 'Seifhennersdorf — Mitteldorf.' and at the upper left the word 'Gemeindeamt.'

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of a coastal town with dense low buildings by the sea, taken from a hillside or fortress. In the bay there is a small fortified islet with a structure on it and a couple of boats. Greek and French captions appear below the image, along with a website watermark at the lower right.

A black‑and‑white riverside view showing a large paddle steamer with the word "DRESDEN" visible on its side, moving along a broad river. In the foreground are moored wooden boats. On the opposite bank rises a historic town with dense masonry buildings, church towers, and a large hilltop complex resembling a castle or palace. Smoke from the steamer's funnels drifts across the scene, and there is a bridge just behind the vessel. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century European city postcard.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate restaurant or dining hall with wooden paneled walls, carved columns, chandeliers, and neatly set tables with white tablecloths and folded napkins. Murals or painted scenes decorate the upper walls. In the lower right corner, there is a handwritten studio mark that appears to include the word "PRAGUE".

Black‑and‑white street scene showing the Hauptstrasse (main street) in a small European town. On the left is a corner building with signage for a confectionery and bakery (Cognitorei, Brot‑Weiss & Fein‑Bäckerei, Café). Next to it stands a larger, more ornate building with signs for the restaurant and dance establishment "Zur Börse" and the name Moritz Henker. Further along the cobblestone street are several gabled houses and timber‑frame buildings, with telegraph poles lining the road. A few people, including children, are visible walking or standing along the street. At the top of the image is printed the caption "Coswig i. Sa. – Hauptstrasse" and a red handwritten number on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard view over Budapest's rooftops toward the large riverside palace‑like Gellért complex on Gellért Hill, with the Danube River, a suspension bridge, and the distant dome of the Parliament building. Red printed title text appears at the top.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Renaissance-style weighing house building with ornate gables and dormer windows, situated on a town square. A broad exterior staircase leads up to an entrance on the left side of the facade. Surrounding the building are narrow European townhouses and shops; a horse-drawn cart and pedestrians are visible in the square. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Nijmegen De Waag."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of traditionally dressed men standing in front of a gigantic fallen ancient statue among palm trees. The statue appears to be a large recumbent pharaonic colossus lying on its back. Handwritten ink messages are visible across the bottom. Printed text at the lower left mentions 'Kharkioche F., Alexandrie., Droit réservé.' and at the bottom right 'Photographie ... Co'.

A colorized historic postcard showing a street with cobblestones and a row of multi‑storey Art Nouveau / early 20th‑century buildings. The focus is on a large, monumental corner building with simple geometric façades and small domes on the roofline. Trees line the street in front of a fenced yard. At the top in red letters is the caption in Latvian orthography of the time.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside landscape with a narrow footpath bordered by wildflowers running along a grassy bank. Large trees dominate the left side, overhanging a wide river that curves into the distance with forested banks and low cliffs on the far side. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in a Baltic language, and there is a small publisher's logo on the lower right.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a dense coniferous forest with a straight, sandy road cutting through the trees and power/telephone poles along the roadside. In the distance a lake or wide body of water is visible under a cloudy sky. The word "Pyynikki" is printed in red at the lower right, and there is cursive handwritten ink text along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small European town taken from across a river. In the foreground is a wide, shallow river with a stony bank. On the opposite bank stands a row of elegant late‑19th‑century townhouses and villas with ornate facades and steep roofs, set behind a riverside promenade lined with trees. Behind the houses the terrain rises steeply into a densely forested hillside, with a few villas and terraced vineyards higher up the slope. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

A sepia-toned studio portrait of a woman in an ornate, floor-length gown and crown-like headpiece, posing in profile with one hand behind her head. The style is theatrical, suggesting a costume role. Decorative text is printed in the upper left corner and a small production code appears at the lower right.

Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate Baroque/Neo-Baroque palace complex with grand exterior staircases, colonnades, and sculptural decoration. In the foreground is a formal garden and a large equestrian statue on a decorated pedestal. The caption at the bottom reads "Budapest. Várkert — Burggarten." with a small number "5430" at the lower left.

Black-and-white postcard view of a calm body of water framed by overhanging tree branches. Four swans and a few ducks swim on the rippling surface. In the lower left corner, the caption identifies the scene, and in the lower right corner there is a small logo and credit line for the photographer/publisher.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a busy harbor with several sailing boats and masts in the foreground. In the background are multi‑story waterfront buildings and, farther out along the coastline, a cylindrical tower that appears to be a historic fortification. Greek handwriting-style text runs along the bottom border of the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural townscape in a valley. In the foreground stands a large, multi‑storey residential or guesthouse-style building with many windows and shutters, surrounded by a fence and open fields. Behind it stretches a small town with scattered houses, factory buildings with chimneys, a church tower, and rolling, wooded hills in the background. At the top left, in red print, is a brief title indicating the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a brick tower and building complex partially hidden by large trees on a hillside. To the right, a small arched bridge is visible among the foliage. At the bottom of the image there is a white printed caption in Dutch.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene looking down a broad cobblestone avenue lined with 3–4 story townhouses and shops on both sides. People in early 20th‑century European clothing walk along the street and sidewalks; a few women wear long dresses and hats, some men wear bowler hats. On the left, a large building with mansard-style roof dominates the corner; on the right is a low retaining wall and then more buildings. In the distance the street continues straight ahead, with a line of trees forming a park or promenade on the right. A flag flies atop one of the left-side buildings.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a central‑European spa town set on a wooded hillside. Dense late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings with steep roofs fill the valley and lower slope, while a forested hill rises behind them. On the crest of the hill stands a solitary lookout tower. A German caption is printed in white at the bottom margin.

A sepia-toned historic photograph of a small railway station with several tracks. A freight train with open wagons stands on the left, while a steam locomotive and carriages are visible further down the platform. People are gathered near the station buildings, which are low wooden or plastered structures with gabled roofs. Trees line the right side of the tracks, and a flagpole with a flag stands near the central building. The caption at the top left reads "Axvalls Järnvägsstation."

A black‑and‑white postcard-style image of a large, ornate Victorian Gothic/Second Empire style public building with a tall clock tower and steeply pitched roofs. The structure has many windows, elaborate stone detailing, and a grand stairway leading to arched entrances. Mature trees and a picket fence line the street in the foreground, with smaller houses and other buildings visible in the background. The borders of the image show some damage and handwritten numbers along the right edge.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, rectangular seaside building with several stories, balconies, and many windows, standing directly on a rocky shoreline with hills in the background. Calm water fills the foreground. At the bottom margin, cursive text identifies the view.

Black-and-white photograph of a smiling woman standing beside the window of a rustic wooden house. She is wearing traditional rural attire: a checked headscarf, long-sleeved blouse, laced vest, long skirt, and apron. The building is made of horizontal timber logs with small-paned windows, suggesting a northern European countryside or folk scene.

Colorized street scene showing a mid‑century town center with a prominent red mid‑rise building bearing the SHB (Svenska Handelsbanken) logo and the word "Torget" on its facade. At street level are shops with striped green‑and‑yellow awnings, pedestrians, and a row of parked cars from the 1950s–1960s era. There are zebra crossings, Scandinavian‑style pedestrian signs, and a yellow "POST" sign on a nearby building indicating a post office. The overall style suggests a typical small Scandinavian city center captured in a vintage postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped spa garden with curved paths, flowerbeds, rows of white chairs, and a grand building in the background set against a forested hillside. The central building has a hipped roof with a clock and decorative crown-like feature on top, arched windows, and a balcony. The foreground shows a formal lawn and seating area typical of a European spa town. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone monument in a landscaped city park. The monument is a rectangular structure with two front columns and a small roof featuring a crenellated edge. In the center is a round medallion relief portrait of a person. Low stone walls and metal railings frame the monument, with paths and dense trees in the background and a small palm-like plant in the foreground. Red printed captions in German appear at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white street view of a European town with a large, ornate villa in the foreground on the left, featuring steep tiled roofs, half‑timber and brick details, bay window, balcony with awning, and heavy ivy covering the garden fence. The cobblestone street curves gently to the right, lined with 3–4‑story residential buildings and a taller industrial chimney in the distance. On the right stands a simpler multi‑story building with rows of arched windows. Several people, including children with bicycles, stand or walk along the street. No visible text or caption appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a European riverside town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑storey houses lining a curved street. In the middle distance stands a large factory complex with a very tall smokestack. Beyond are terraced hillsides, fields, and a broad river with steep banks on the opposite shore. People and horse‑drawn vehicles are visible on the main street. A narrow handwritten numeric or catalog notation appears along the right film edge.

A black‑and‑white historic street view showing an elegant, broad, tree‑lined avenue flanked by ornate late‑19th‑century residential buildings. The left side features tall brick townhouses with decorative facades and wrought‑iron balconies; the right side shows similarly elaborate villas and apartment houses with turrets and gables. Children stand and play in the cobbled street, while a woman pushes a large old‑fashioned baby carriage on the right. Gas street lamps line the sidewalks. The scene has a calm, bourgeois urban atmosphere and appears to be taken slightly uphill toward a cluster of turreted buildings in the distance. There is no visible postcard title or caption, only faint signage on a wall that is not clearly legible.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large ornate pavilion in a landscaped park. The building has a prominent glass and metal dome, rich classical decoration on its façade, arched windows, statues and ornamental reliefs. Small trees line the front, and paths with benches and lampposts lead toward the entrance. In the top corners, red printed text identifies the city and the building.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a town square with a prominent round water tower and adjacent school buildings behind a brick wall and trees. Two children stand in the foreground on a cobbled street. On the right edge there is a multi‑story residential building with balconies and shop signage at street level. Handwritten red text appears at the top, and a red number is written in the upper right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a narrow, winding old street lined with traditional two-story houses with overhanging upper floors and wooden balconies. A person stands in the middle of the uneven, possibly cobbled road. The architecture appears Ottoman/Balkan. Printed captions in French and English describe the scene as an old street. Handwritten text on the right margin reads "VODENA".

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small harbor packed with wooden fishing boats and boathouses along the water. Traditional wooden houses climb a rocky hillside in the background, typical of a Scandinavian coastal village. In the lower left the printed caption reads "HUNNEBOSTRAND." and in the lower right there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 5415.

Black-and-white photograph showing a large, formally posed group of mostly women and a few men gathered indoors around a long table. The central table has several tall candles and what appear to be top hats in front of the seated men, who are wearing dark suits and mustaches—possibly part of a humorous or ceremonial event. The women, dressed in 1930s–1940s style dresses and blouses, stand and sit in multiple rows behind and beside the table, smiling toward the camera. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the front.

A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a mid‑20th‑century cargo ship at sea, cutting through choppy waves. The vessel has a single central mast, a superstructure toward the stern, and multiple cargo hatches on deck. The ship's name, "BATAVIER III," is clearly visible on the bow.

Sepia-toned view of a rural landscape with a dirt road running along a meadow toward a long, low monastic-looking building with a steep roof and small tower, set against a wooded hillside beside a calm river or pond. The card has printed captions in German at the top right and bottom right.

Colorized postcard view of a large castle complex with two tall towers and red-tiled roofs on a hill above a river. In the foreground is a steel railway bridge crossing the river and a low weir. Trees and greenery surround the scene. The caption at the top reads "Rochlitz. Schloss und Eisenbahnbrücke." Additional small-print publisher information appears near the bottom edge.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural or small‑town scene with large trees, some low buildings in the background, and stone steps or ruins in the foreground. There is Greek text printed at the top of the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑story building with steep gabled roofs and dormer windows, partly covered in climbing plants. The structure stands in a rural setting with trees, fields, and low hills in the background. A few small human figures appear near the right edge of the scene. Printed German text at the top right identifies the building and its location.

Sepia-toned historic street scene showing a narrow canal or river with a small bridge in a town of stone and plaster buildings. People stand near the bridge and along the street. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, along with a website watermark.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large wooden building in a rural setting, surrounded by trees and a garden or orchard. The structure has a gabled roof with dormers, multiple windows, and open verandas on the right side. In the foreground is a dirt path lined with flowering trees. At the bottom margin is printed text identifying the place, along with a handwritten-looking signature on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural village set in rolling hills and fields. Farmhouses and barns with pitched roofs are scattered across the landscape, leading up to a small church with a tower in the distance. The scene is peaceful and pastoral, with trees and open meadows under a partly cloudy sky. At the bottom left of the postcard, a caption reads "Schellerhau - Osterzgebirge".

Black‑and‑white view of an early‑20th‑century European city street with electric tram #42 in the foreground, pedestrians and a cyclist, and multi‑story historicist buildings with shops and signs. On the left corner is a large ornate building with the rooftop sign "Pickert" and below it a restaurant; on the right are densely packed storefronts with German writing, awnings, and hanging street‑lamp poles along the tram tracks.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship named "Sundmar" moored in a harbor. The vessel has a tall funnel with an emblem, cargo masts and booms, and several crew visible on deck and in a small rowing boat alongside. On the right side of the image stands a large shed or warehouse beside the water, bearing painted commercial signage. Low wooded hills rise in the distant background, and the water in the foreground is calm, with another small rowboat at left.

Black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle with multiple steep‑roofed buildings and a round central tower, standing on a wooded cliff above a river. At the foot of the hill, beside the river, is an industrial complex or mill with a tall chimney and long gabled factory buildings. The foreground shows calm water with reeds along the bank; the sky is clear and bright. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a coastal town with cultivated fields and olive groves in the foreground, low hills to the left, and the sea in the background. A cluster of houses climbs up the hillside, while a larger multi‑storey building stands nearer the shore. Handwritten Greek text appears at the lower left, and additional small Greek captioning is at the lower right. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is printed across the bottom center.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a small, solid stone museum building with a steep tiled roof and decorative shields between large windows. Above the arched entrance is sculpted decoration and the word "JAHNMUSEUM". To the right stands a rough stone tower or wall remnant; to the left are trees and smaller town buildings. Printed captions at the bottom read "Freyburg a. U." on the left and "Jahnmuseum" on the right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside pier or landing stage crowded with people in late‑19th / early‑20th century dress. A steam‑powered vessel is moored at the pier, with its tall smokestack visible. In the background is a tree‑lined riverbank. Printed captions in red at the bottom identify the location as Budapest and specifically the Császár baths landing stage (Haltestelle Kaiserbad). Publisher information appears along the lower edge.

Color-tinted vintage postcard view of a coastal scene with a tall cylindrical lighthouse on a promontory. The shoreline curves away on the left, with low buildings and walls near the lighthouse and the sea in the foreground. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as Ras-El-Tin Lighthouse in Alexandria, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned street scene showing an early 20th‑century urban avenue with tram tracks and two trams, cyclists, and pedestrians. Tall trees line the street and brick townhouses with bay windows and shutters stand on the right. The printed caption at the bottom left reads "NIJMEGEN. Hunerpark" with the word "Hunerpark" struck through, and handwritten text underneath reads "st. Jorisstraat."

A sepia-toned historical photograph showing a large group of people in traditional Balkan-style clothing posing in a narrow courtyard between wooden, overhanging houses. On the right is an ornate arched structure attached to a building, decorated with Orthodox Christian icon paintings in roundels above the arch. The scene has the appearance of a village or small town street in an Ottoman-era Balkan settlement.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph showing a small rural village dominated by a white church with a tall, slender spire and rectangular tower. The church is surrounded by dense trees and a small cemetery or garden, enclosed by low walls. Around it lie farm fields, country roads intersecting at right angles, several barns and farmhouses, and patches of cultivated land. The landscape is gently rolling with forested areas at the edges. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a small town intersection with wooden and plaster buildings, including a gas station in the foreground, bicycles along the sidewalk, and a signpost on a stone pedestal at the crossroads. There are a few pedestrians visible. At the bottom, white caption text identifies the place and publisher.

A black-and-white postcard view of a large steel arch bridge crossing a wide river. In the foreground there is a curved road with landscaped lawns, bushes, and trees, leading towards the bridge. On the bridge, several vehicles can be seen. The landscape beyond the river is flat and open. In the lower left corner, there is printed text naming the location.

A cream-colored Olympic-themed postcard with blue and red printing. On the left is a large blue diamond-shaped graphic resembling a postage stamp, filled with pictograms of various sports surrounding the Olympic rings and the number '88. Under this graphic is Hungarian text. On the upper right is a colorful postage stamp depicting two soccer players in action, labeled 'MAGYAR POSTA' with a value of 4 Ft. The stamp is cancelled with a circular postmark including the Olympic rings, a date, and the word 'BUDAPEST.' The right side has red guide lines for the address.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an equestrian statue on a tall, ornate pedestal in front of a richly decorated Renaissance church façade. The statue depicts a mounted armored figure, seen from the side and slightly from behind, elevated above a fenced square. Architectural details and the overall style suggest an Italian historic city scene.

A monochrome blue-tinted postcard showing a coastal landscape with high cliffs and the sea in the foreground. On the right side stands a large, ornate palace-like building with a tower and flag, set back from the edge of the cliffs. Smaller buildings are visible on the left along the shoreline. At the top there is printed text in Cyrillic, Latin, and French identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone alley framed by old stucco buildings, leading toward an arched passage with windows above it. Beyond the arch rises a church or civic tower with an onion-shaped dome and clock faces. The lower margin of the image contains printed caption text giving the location and title, and the photographer's credit appears in the bottom right margin.

Colorized postcard view of a large historic multi‑story institutional building with ornate gables and a mansard-style roof, partly brick and partly light stone, surrounded by dense green trees under a blue-to-orange gradient sky. Printed German text at the top left identifies the place as the Fürstliches Seminar in Waldenburg i. S.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European town in a valley, dominated by a hill crowned with a large medieval-style castle that has cylindrical towers with conical roofs and small spires. The castle stands on a rocky, wooded outcrop above tightly packed townhouses and industrial buildings with steep gabled roofs. In the foreground there appears to be a lumber yard or construction site with stacked boards. Rolling fields and low hills extend into the distance. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural, hilly landscape with cultivated fields, scattered villas and farmhouses, and forested areas in the foreground and mid‑ground. Low mountains rise in the background under a cloudy sky. At the bottom center margin, printed text identifies the scene as Povo di Trento – Colle di S. Agata.

Black-and-white photographic postcard showing a tree-lined approach to a tunnel-like gate built into a white wall, above which rises a covered gallery and a tall church tower with an onion-shaped dome and a clock. Over the arched tunnel entrance is a small pitched-roof shrine or icon niche with a religious image and an inscription in a Slavic-looking script.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall stone memorial tower on a hilltop surrounded by a few trees. The tower has a square base with four projecting corner pillars and an upper circular section with a viewing platform and parapet. Printed red text at the top left identifies the location and the name of the tower in German.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The castle has thick stone walls, multiple steeply pitched roofs with small dormers, conical corner towers, and a dominant central keep rising above the rest of the buildings. Ivy climbs one side of the main tower. In the foreground are trees and a few smaller houses with sloped roofs, while a winding path or road leads up toward the castle on the right. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large historic building partly obscured by trees. The structure has a long steep tiled roof with many dormer windows and chimneys, and a more austere lower facade with rectangular windows. In front is a wall and fenced garden area, and a grassy field in the foreground. At the top of the card, printed in red Gothic-style script, are the words identifying the scene.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with a mix of low residential buildings and large institutional complexes. In the foreground stands a prominent circular masonry building with a conical roof and small lantern on top, next to several rectangular buildings and tree‑lined streets. Behind it stretches a long block of barracks- or factory‑like structures with an arched central gate and clock tower. Beyond the town are open fields and low hills. A biplane is flying above the town, slightly left of center. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A colored panoramic view of an old city on a strait with many ships. In the foreground are dense low-rise buildings and several Ottoman mosques with domes and tall minarets. The waterway, filled with steamships and boats, is the Bosphorus. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as Constantinople and the Top-Hané (Tophane) district by the Bosphorus. There is also a modern website watermark over the image.

Colored postcard view of a coastal fortress on a rocky hill with buildings at its base, seen across an open green esplanade and seafront. Handwritten notes and printed French caption appear at the bottom, along with a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden lodge‑style building on sandy terrain with scattered trees. Several early biplanes fly overhead. Printed caption text at the top reads "Vliegkamp, Soesterberg". The overall look suggests an early aviation camp or airfield facility near woodland dunes.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a substantial monument in a park or wooded setting. The monument consists of a large rough-hewn stone base with reliefs and inscriptions, surmounted by a seated male figure in 19th‑century dress, holding an object in his hand. Below the image, printed captions identify the sculptor, unveiling date, and the name and location of the monument.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a Byzantine domed church complex set among low hills, with stone walls and a few surrounding buildings. The main structure has a large central dome and arched openings, typical of Byzantine monastic architecture. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge in French.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town surrounded by forested hills and fields. In the middle stands a prominent church with a tall spire, and around it are villas and spa-like buildings nestled among many trees. In the foreground there is a grain or cornfield. The name "Bad Elster" is printed at the lower right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) postcard view of a small town with traditional half‑timbered houses, sloped roofs, a winding road, and a river or stream running through a wooded valley. A solitary person walks along the road in the foreground. At the top left, printed in red, is the title identifying the place, and along the left margin appears the publisher's imprint and number.

A monochrome postcard depicting an inner courtyard framed by richly decorated Gothic and Renaissance buildings. On the right stands a tall, multi‑storey façade with pointed arches, traceried windows, and spires; on the left and center are gabled houses and arched gateways surrounding the open square. Handwritten German text along the bottom margin identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ocean liner at sea, viewed from the side. A large hand from above appears to lower or raise one of the ship's funnels like a magician's trick. There is handwritten cursive text over much of the image, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. Along the bottom margin, partially readable printed text includes the words "…LINE…", "BELFAST", and "DO…" (likely part of a longer caption naming the ship and builder).

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a quiet street scene with a long wooden building on a stone foundation, simple multi-pane windows, a dirt road and decorative metal fence in the foreground. A person stands beside a cow or similar animal near the building. Trees frame the scene. The caption at the top reads "Rauma 1906."

Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town with cobblestone pavement and rows of 2–3 story gabled houses. Shopfronts on the ground floor bear German‑language signs, including a corner building labelled "Rudolph Wöhler" and another business with a sign for "Gertrud Zschaler, Milch‑Tafel‑Margarin". A woman with a parasol stands near the shop entrance with children seated outside, and a man rides a bicycle on the street. Architectural style suggests an older German town center with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings.

Vintage sepia postcard showing two ornate villas in a lush, terraced landscape, with a hill rising behind them. On top of the hill stands a castle‑like building flying a flag. The foreground is a garden or vineyard with plants and a low stone wall and fence. Printed German captions at the bottom identify the view as a scene from Niederlößnitz–Kötzschenbroda and name the hilltop building as Friedensburg. Publisher information appears along the bottom edge.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a multi-story sanatorium building behind a fence-lined street, surrounded by trees and a garden. The structure has a tiled, hipped roof, several chimneys, shuttered windows, and small balconies. Printed red text identifying the sanatorium and its location appears at the upper left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a museum-style display case filled with religious and ceremonial silver objects. At the top center is an ornate crucifix with Christ on the cross; to its left are long tongs or compasses arranged in a star shape around a circular medallion, and to the right are two measuring or carpenter's tools crossed in an X. The middle shelf holds several detailed silver figurines and vessels, including small statues of robed figures and a man in historic dress, plus richly decorated cups. The bottom has a large reflective vessel or ciborium-like object standing upright and, along the lower shelf, several small cups, a teapot, and possibly a rosary or chain. The photograph is framed with a generous white border typical of early 20th‑century postcards; in the lower right corner of the image a small code "H3310Ba" is printed.

Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic‑style church with two tall, slender towers crowned by steep spires and pinnacles. The building features tall pointed-arch windows with tracery and a steeply pitched roof. In the foreground there is a landscaped garden with paths, low stone walls, shrubs, and a rustic wooden fence. The perspective is from slightly below, looking up at the church; no printed text is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad unpaved street lined with leafless trees and wooden fences. On the right are large wooden houses behind a picket fence; on the left are more buildings and a few pedestrians. In the distant background a church spire rises over the town. Handwritten notes in a cursive script appear at the top and bottom margins of the image.

Colorized historic postcard view of a riverside town with dense, multi‑story buildings and a prominent medieval stone tower rising above red‑roofed houses. Trees line the riverbank, and in the foreground a small rowboat with several people glides across the calm water. The caption in red at the top left reads "Elbogen bei Karlsbad."

A sepia-toned interior scene showing a crafts exhibition or shop. A man in a suit stands beside a table covered with a white cloth, displaying numerous inlaid wooden boxes. Around the table are intricately carved and inlaid wooden stools, small tables, and decorative furniture with geometric and arabesque patterns. On the back wall hang woven carpets or kilims with bold geometric motifs. Framed relief panels with horsemen and other scenes line the walls, and a portrait of a uniformed man with epaulettes is displayed above. A card with the number 24 identifies the stand.

Sepia-toned photograph of a street lined with heavily damaged and partially ruined buildings, with people walking along a dusty road. The perspective looks down a long, straight street; the left side shows rubble and burned-out structures, while the right side has standing but scorched buildings. Stylized French text at the top labels the image as showing Rue Venizelos in Salonique (Thessaloniki) after a fire. A circular stamp or logo appears at the lower left, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is visible at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white image of a small two‑storey building in a wooded area. The house has a tiled gable roof, shutters on the windows, and a covered entrance porch. Over the porch a sign with large letters reads "AUSGANG". A decorative streetlamp stands near the entrance, and a path with a simple wooden railing leads toward the building. The scene looks like the exit building of a park, viewpoint, or transport station in a forested hill area.

Sepia-toned military postcard showing a ring of armed soldiers standing outdoors on rough ground, pointing their rifles inward toward a man lying on the ground, with another soldier standing closer to him. The scene looks staged, almost like a demonstration or a grim dance, with distant low buildings on the horizon. There is printed caption text in French at the top right margin and additional text in Greek beneath it, plus a handwritten signature-like note along the side.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a landscaped park scene with dense trees, shrubs, a winding path and a small pond with tall grasses in the foreground. At the top of the card, printed in red German text, it reads: "Bad Elster. Partie in den Anlagen." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century view card from a spa town's park or gardens.

Multi-view sepia postcard showing several street and town scenes from Schafstädt in the Merseburg district. The central caption reads "Schafstädt (Kreis Merseburg)". Around it are five small photographs with German captions: a riverside or canal scene titled "Merseburger Straße", a busy street with people and houses titled "Adler-Apotheke", an open square with buildings and a monument titled "Marktplatz", another waterside view with trees and houses, and a street with larger houses and a gate-like building titled "Bahnhofstraße".

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large group of people gathered around an open‑top Dodge automobile in front of a building. Several men sit in the car while others stand closely behind it, posing for the camera. The car is heavily loaded with the carcasses of large animals from a hunt, strapped over the fenders and running board. The scene appears to be in a town street, and printed caption text in Portuguese appears at the bottom of the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a town square with cobblestone pavement. Along one side stand several 2–3‑storey buildings with shops at street level and a central town hall featuring a small clock tower and cupola. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the open market square. The title text in red at the top identifies the scene as the market square and town hall in Wurzen, Saxony, Germany. Shop signs are visible on the ground floors of the buildings.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a waterfront promenade with a large, elegant, early‑20th‑century building labeled 'Café Esplanade'. The building has multiple balconies, columns, and a red‑tiled roof, with trees lining the esplanade and a few people walking along the stone seawall in the foreground. At the top left, printed text reads 'Crikvenica — Kavana Esplanade'.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a calm lake with reeds in the foreground, dense forest to the left, trees to the right, and a small village with scattered houses on the far shore under a cloudy sky. The word "LATVIJA" appears in the lower left corner and "DZĒRBEŅE" in the lower right, with a small circular publisher's mark nearby.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a street and courtyard leading to an arched gate with the tall bell tower of La Giralda rising behind it. On the left are multi‑story buildings with striped awnings and balconies; a man stands with a donkey on the sidewalk. On the right is a line of trees bordering the open plaza. Handwritten Spanish text is scrawled across the lower half. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Alcázar's Patio de las Banderas in Sevilla.

Vintage stereoscopic postcard showing two nearly identical black‑and‑white images of a row of tall Corinthian columns from an ancient Greek temple ruin. A few people stand near the base of the columns. In the background, on a rocky hill, another monumental complex is visible, resembling the Acropolis. The bottom center contains a printed French caption referring to the temple, partially legible, and there is a circular stamp mark on the left and a website watermark across the lower center.

Illustrated landscape view of a green hilly valley with scattered houses and a prominent baroque church complex with twin towers and a dome on the right side. Snow‑capped mountains appear in the background under a pastel sky at either sunrise or sunset. The scene looks down toward a larger town in the distance. Printed text at the top left reads "MARIATROST bei Graz," and there is cursive handwriting across the upper center of the card.

Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a terraced vineyard looking down over a European river city. In the foreground are orderly rows of vines supported by stakes. Beyond them lies a dense old town on both riverbanks. A multi‑span stone bridge with several arches crosses the wide river. On the hill to the left dominates a large fortified complex with walls, towers, and at least one tall church spire, overlooking the town and river valley.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a row of ornate multi‑story buildings along a street at the edge of a forested hillside. The central building is labeled "Hotel Post" and features a mansard roof and decorative façade. Other commercial buildings with shop awnings line the street, and a bridge and trees appear in the lower right. Red printed captions at the top read place and street names in German.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large Gothic hilltop complex with multiple steep roofs and tall spires rising above a riverside town. In the foreground a side‑wheel steamship with many passengers crosses the wide river. Dense trees cover the slope below the castle‑like buildings, and smaller houses and waterfront structures line the riverbank.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a lakeshore with tall grasses and several large trees in the foreground. Across the water in the background stands a grand Renaissance-style lakeside castle with four prominent round corner towers topped by domes and a central building mass. The image has wide margins typical of an old photographic postcard; no printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the coastal city and harbor of Vigo, with many small boats and ships anchored in the bay. In the foreground are railway tracks and small houses surrounded by vegetation; in the distance, dense urban buildings rise along the hillside and mountains frame the background. Printed caption text appears at the top left and there is a small imprint at the bottom left.

The image shows the reverse side of an old postcard with handwritten text in a cursive script covering the left half, address lines on the right, and multiple overlapping circular postal cancellation marks in the upper center-right. The printed heading reads "POSTKAART – CARTE POSTALE" in red. The address appears to include a street name and number and a recipient's name. There is a faint box at the top right where a stamp would have been placed.

Colorized historical postcard view of a stone multi‑arch bridge over a river with several steam and passenger boats in the foreground. The riverside promenade is visible at the bottom, while the city skyline with historic buildings and church towers stretches along the far bank. Printed titles at the top read "Dresden." on the left and "Friedrich-August-Brücke." on the right. The nearest steamboat bears the name "KOENIG FRIEDRICH AUGUST" and another boat is labeled "BOHEMIA."

A black-and-white postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The castle has steep tiled roofs, multiple wings with many small windows, and a prominent square stone tower rising behind the main buildings. In the lower left corner of the image, a caption in German identifies the site.

Vintage sepia-toned winter scene showing a snow-covered canal or river lined with bare trees on both sides. A lone figure stands on the frozen waterway. In the background there is a tall, square tower with a domed roof rising above the trees, likely part of a historic building. The lower part of the card has printed and stamped text in Swedish, including references to Uddevalla Museum and the date Feb. 1903.

Black-and-white postcard view of a baroque water castle framed by dark tree branches in the foreground, reflected in a calm lake. The building has four large corner towers with domes and a central spire. A caption in German appears at the lower left.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view taken from an elevated rocky viewpoint with a rustic wooden bench in the foreground, looking down into a valley with a small historic town and a prominent castle‑like complex and church tower. Trees frame the scene and a simple railing runs along the cliff edge. Red printed German text appears at the top.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large Protestant church with a tall spire and arched windows, set beside a tree‑lined square or park. People sit on benches in the foreground. The words "GRAZ" and "Evangelische Kirche" are printed in red at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small coastal fishing village with wooden houses and boathouses clustered on rocky shoreline. Several boats float in a calm harbor bordered by bare rock and low vegetation. The houses have steep, tiled roofs typical of Scandinavian seaside architecture. In the bottom-left corner the word "STOCKEN." is printed, and in the bottom-right corner there is a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 6505 inside or below it.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a seaside promenade with stone pavement along a harbor. Men in early 20th‑century clothing walk beside the water, small sailboats are moored along the quay, and multi‑story European-style buildings and a tram line run along the cobbled street. The caption area at the bottom contains Greek and French text identifying the scene as the quays of Salonique (Thessaloniki).

A vintage monochrome postcard view across a river toward a large, ornate multi‑storey administrative building surrounded by trees, with smaller houses in front on the riverbank. The printed German caption at the top identifies the location as Grimma and the royal district administration, and a small printer's credit appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white historic street view showing a straight cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story masonry buildings in European late‑19th/early‑20th‑century style. Shops occupy the ground floors, with large display windows and an awning on the right. People in period clothing, including women with long skirts and hats and children playing, walk along the sidewalks and street. At the top in red script is a caption indicating the town and street name: 'Hartha i. Sa. Albertstrasse.'

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a large, ornate 19th‑century villa or institutional building behind bare winter trees and a low fence. The building has tall rectangular windows, pilasters, and a central entrance with an arched doorway and small staircase. In front is a landscaped garden or park area. At the top, printed in red, is a caption identifying the institute and its location in Nijmegen.

Composite black-and-white naval postcard showing five oval portrait photos of sailors in uniform placed over a background image of a warship at sea with smoke rising behind it. Each sailor wears a cap with Cyrillic writing and their name and hometown are written in Cyrillic script around the oval frames.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a symmetrical, two‑storey manor house with a steep metal roof and dormer windows. A central doorway with a small balcony above is reached by steps and railings. The house stands in a landscaped lawn with a simple garden bed and path leading toward the entrance. Trees frame the building and open countryside is visible in the background.

Black-and-white postcard showing a wooded park with a small pond in the foreground and the gated entrance to a mausoleum complex in the background. A stone wall and iron gate stand among tall trees, with a chapel-like building partially visible behind them. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a broad view over a lake or wide river bend with low, rolling farmland in the background. In the foreground there is a fenced field sloping down toward the water, with scattered trees along the shoreline. Sparse trees and bushes line the banks, and utility poles or similar posts can be seen along a narrow strip of land jutting into the water. At the top of the image, printed text reads a short caption identifying the place.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a hilltop fortress and clock tower above a town with red-roofed houses. The steep, rocky, green-covered hill is crowned by fortifications and buildings, with a long staircase or rampart running up the slope. On the right stands a distinctive tower with a large clock face. Printed text at the top left reads "Graz — Schlossberg."

A multi-view color postcard composed of nine photographs bordered by yellow lines, showcasing picturesque half-timbered houses, canals with flowered bridges, and historic buildings in a European town. At the top center, in large decorative red Gothic-style letters, appears the word "Colmar." The architecture is Alsatian, with steep tiled roofs, wooden beams, and flower boxes on windows. Several images show squares, old civic buildings, arcades, and waterfront scenes, all under clear blue skies.

Old sepia-toned waterfront view of a coastal city with small rowing boats in the foreground, a line of neoclassical-style buildings and a busy quay along the shoreline, and mountains with some snow in the background. On a hill above the town stands a prominent fortress. Greek text is visible along the lower edge of the image, and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears on the right.

A vintage multi‑view postcard composed of six small black‑and‑white photographs arranged decoratively with floral motifs in the corners. The views show: an industrial or institutional brick building with a tall chimney and a group of people in front; a long brick farm or factory building with many people lined up along a fence; a rural road leading to a church with a tower and a group of villagers; a pond or small river with people sitting on the bank and ducks or geese in the water; a tree‑lined estate drive leading to a house; and a large tree with a horse‑drawn carriage nearby. The overall design and clothing style suggest an early 20th‑century European rural community. No visible printed caption or place name can be read on the card.

Colorized panoramic view of a coastal city and harbor with many warships anchored in calm water. The foreground shows a fortified seafront with bastions, trees, and dense historic buildings; in the distance are low mountains across the bay. A circular postal cancellation mark with Greek text and a partial date appears in the sky area, and the bottom right bears the printed website credit "www.elia.org.gr".

Sepia-tone theatrical publicity postcard showing a woman in an elegant dress and a man in a suit, both squatting and playfully pointing at each other. German text at the top references the operetta 'Der Graf von Luxemburg' and the Centraltheater. Their names, Flora Hegner and Oscar Aigner, are printed near their feet. The photographer's mark at the bottom left reads 'HERZFELD DRESDEN 1910.'

Black-and-white view down a broad, tree-lined urban avenue flanked by tall late-19th‑century apartment buildings with ornate façades, turrets, and mansard roofs. Ground floors host shops with large display windows and German signage; few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. The photo has the aesthetic of an early-20th‑century European city postcard.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a rural European town in a valley, with houses along a winding road in the foreground, forested hills to the left, open fields and vineyards on the right, and a church tower plus what appears to be a small castle or fortified building on a hill in the distance. Handwritten captions in German script appear at the bottom border.

The image shows the back side of an old postcard printed in red and beige. On the left is a vertical column filled with dense handwritten text in a cursive script. The center and right side follow the classic divided‑back layout: the top has the printed heading "Carte postale" and multilingual labels for the Universal Postal Union. Below are printed words "SCHWEIZ. SUISSE. SVIZZERA." indicating Switzerland. In the upper‑right corner is a red Swiss postage imprint featuring the word "HELVETIA" and a value of 10, with a circular postmark that reads "CHATEAU D'OEX / GENEVE" and a date. The right side contains the address written in ink, including a line "28 Quai de Bethune" and the city "Paris", with "France" written below.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four towers and a central nave, fronted by a statue in a landscaped square. Surrounding buildings frame the scene. Hungarian and German greetings are printed on the right, and Hungarian captioning and a printer's line appear at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a quiet tree-lined street with a large villa or inn on the left, people standing and walking along the road, and dense trees on the right. Below the photograph there is printed text indicating the location, and the lower half of the card is filled with handwritten correspondence in Dutch, dated 14 October 1900.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a seascape painting showing strong surf and crashing waves under a cloudy sky. The composition is dominated by rough water; a darker shoreline appears on the right side. Printed captions in Russian and French at the bottom credit the artist Ivan Aivazovsky and identify the scene as the beach at Nice.

An illustrated postcard showing a mountainous landscape with forested slopes and a village in the foreground. There are several alpine-style houses with steep roofs and, on a nearby hill, a white church or chapel with a tower and spire. Autumnal trees in red and yellow hues dot the hillsides. In a white box on the right side is printed German text indicating the location, and at the bottom of the artwork is the artist's signature.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a riverside town with a large hilltop complex combining a castle and a cathedral. In the foreground, a long riverboat travels along a wide river, with quays and smaller boats along the bank. Above the town's red‑roofed houses rises a fortified castle-like structure and a Gothic cathedral with tall twin spires. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Red printed captions in German at the top read the town name and identify the castle and cathedral.

A sepia-toned postcard view of a large public square with an imposing central monument consisting of a standing figure and several reclining figures around a massive pedestal. Historic multi‑story baroque and eclectic buildings surround the square. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand near the monument. Printed captions in a Slavic language are located below the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a very crowded seaside beach with men, women, and children in early 20th‑century swimwear. A large wooden beach pavilion or bathhouse stands on the left, with people on its upper deck, while the sandy shore and sea are full of bathers stretching into the distance. Forested hills and cliffs appear in the background. Along the lower border is printed text in Cyrillic and German indicating the location as Varna/Warna and describing the mixed ladies' and gentlemen's beach.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Renaissance-style hunting palace with multiple gabled roof sections, dormer windows, and a central tower topped with a dome. In front of the building is a formal garden with rows of trees and a low wall and entrance gate opening onto a broad unpaved road. At the top left is a short printed title in German identifying the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white view along a riverside promenade with a wooden fence in the foreground, looking across the Mur river toward the historic center of Graz. Large late‑19th‑century buildings line the riverbank, with church towers rising among them. Behind the city is a steep hill crowned with fortification buildings and a prominent clock tower on the slope. Printed caption text at the top left reads "Graz. Mur, Schloßberg".

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a two‑storey inn or guesthouse on a tree‑lined street. The long facade has several windows and a central entrance with a hanging sign. Above the ground floor windows runs a painted signboard with German text giving the name and services of the inn, including a motor‑garage. At the bottom margin of the card is a printed caption identifying the place and building as a guesthouse called "Gasthaus zur Post" in Schmannewitz.

Colorized vintage view of a spa resort building set among dense trees and hills. In the foreground, well‑dressed people stroll and socialize on a landscaped terrace or garden. The multi‑story building in the background has balconies and appears to be part of a spa complex. Red German text is printed along the top margin of the card.

Colorized historic view of a European riverside city with a metal bridge in the foreground, multi‑story townhouses along the embankment, and a steep hill rising behind them. On top of the hill stands a fortified complex with thick walls and buildings, and to the right a prominent clock tower on the hillside and another tall church or civic tower with a clock and baroque dome. The style and printing resemble an early 20th‑century postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street lined with multi‑storey historic houses on the left and a tree‑filled park or promenade on the right. In the park a tall, narrow monument or column (a war memorial) rises above the trees. A few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. Red printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and publisher.

Colorized vintage view of a town with a fortified complex in the foreground, featuring a round brick tower with a steep conical roof and adjoining walls, surrounded by trees and open grassy areas with paths. Behind it rise densely packed houses on a hillside and low mountains. Several people stand on the path in the foreground. The word "Trento" is printed at the top left, with a handwritten date "12 IV 09" above the skyline.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are tightly packed multi‑story townhouses and industrial buildings with tiled roofs and a tall factory chimney. Behind them are clusters of trees and scattered houses leading up to open fields divided into rectangular plots. On the right side stands a prominent neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire and adjoining large buildings that resemble a rectory or school. Rolling wooded hills form the background, with farmsteads and country roads visible across the landscape. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic seaside view of a densely built town climbing up a hillside, with mountains in the background and the sea in the foreground. The buildings form an amphitheatrical harbor town. Handwritten text in purple ink appears at the bottom. Printed captions in French identify the place as Syra (Syros) and there is a date written as 11 Janvier 1903.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a festive street parade. In the foreground, men in traditional folk costumes march while waving their hats. Behind them walks a large group of women dressed in similar traditional attire with pleated skirts and headscarves. One man holds a tall sign and a flagpole. The background shows a crowd of onlookers and modernist buildings with large awnings and balconies. The photo looks like a mid‑20th‑century folk or civic celebration.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a hill densely covered with trees, at the top of which stand a church tower and a large castle‑like complex of buildings. At the bottom of the hill are a few houses and a curving road or railway line. The handwritten caption in German is along the lower margin.

Color-printed historical postcard showing the inner courtyard of a large Renaissance castle complex. The scene includes ornate stone façades, stairways, arched windows, and a tall tower with a spire in the background. In the foreground there is a fountain with a statue resembling Neptune holding a trident. The sky is blue with light clouds. Printed German text appears at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rocky coastal landscape with a small harbor. Several wooden piers and bridges connect low, smooth granite islands. Small sailboats and larger masted vessels are moored along the quays. In the foreground are rocks, shoreline vegetation, and a swimmer or bather near a jetty. A flagpole with a flag stands on the central rock. The scene has printed caption text at the bottom left and a publisher's logo with number at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a broad market square in a European town. Historic multi‑storey buildings line both sides of the square, with a tall clock‑towered town hall dominating the right side. There are shopfronts with awnings, a few parked cars and bicycles, and two people standing near a central lamppost. Trees and additional houses appear in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Ehrenfriedersdorf i. Erzgeb. Markt" and one shop sign reads "OTTO SCHIFFNER Buchbinderei".

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large grand hotel complex with neo-orientalist architecture, including a central dome and ornate arches. The building dominates the background, while in the foreground there is a public square or open area with a tram, early automobiles, and people. The text at the top reads "HELIOPOLIS – Palace Hôtel," and a web address is printed at the bottom right.

Colorized postcard view of a riverside town with red-roofed houses, a steel bridge, an early 20th‑century tram and automobile in the foreground, and a large hilltop complex featuring a castle and a Gothic cathedral with tall spires. The words "Meißen" appear at the top left and "Albrechtsburg u. Dom" at the top right.

A black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a group of young women dressed in long white gowns, each holding a lit candle. One girl in the center wears a crown of candles on her head, while several others have tinsel or wreaths as headpieces. The scene appears posed in a studio and suggests a festive or religious celebration, likely a Saint Lucia procession.

Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped park with tall leafy trees, lawns and flowerbeds. A curved path runs in the foreground where a man in early‑20th‑century clothing and hat sits alone on a bench. In the mid‑ground are ornamental stone steps with a balustrade leading up toward large residential or institutional buildings partly hidden by trees. On the right stands a decorative, vertically layered stone monument or shrine with niches and figurative sculpture, surrounded by rocks and benches.

Sepia-toned image of a large brick ruin with a tall, steeply gabled end wall. The wall has multiple small rectangular and arched window openings arranged symmetrically, with three tall Gothic-style lancet windows at the lower center. On both sides of the central gable stretch long, high brick walls, also in ruin, forming what looks like the nave of a former church or abbey. There are small figures and an umbrella or kiosk visible near the central opening, emphasizing the monument's touristic character. No visible caption or printed text is present on the image side.

A monochrome printed postcard showing a panoramic view of a village in a mountain valley, with terraced fields in the foreground, houses spread across the middle, a prominent church with a tall bell tower on the right, and a castle or fortification on the hillside behind the town. The caption at the bottom reads "Nei paesi redenti: SABBIONARA (Trentino)".

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden building in traditional Scandinavian style with a gabled roof and balcony, set along a dirt road with telegraph poles and surrounded by forested hills. Smaller wooden outbuildings stand nearby. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Trudvang, Rena, and note an establishment run by Marthe Alme. Handwritten cursive text appears across the lower margin and at the upper right corner with a date in July 1905.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a spa or bath complex with tall cylindrical columns, some incorporating a natural rock formation. Large vertical windows line the wall, letting in light. The lower margin contains printed captions in Greek and French. There is a Greek postage stamp depicting a man's portrait with a 2.50 denomination and postal cancellation marks overlapping the image.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a large rectangular four-story building with many windows and a central loggia covered in abundant flowering vines, likely wisteria. In front of the building is a small courtyard or square with young trees and a smaller rounded chapel-like structure attached on the right. The sky is lightly tinted blue and orange, giving a hand-colored look. Italian text at the top identifies the scene as a gymnasium (secondary school) near a bishop's residence in Trento and mentions a gigantic Chinese wisteria.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a tranquil canal lined with large trees on both banks. A boat or barge is moored along the sandy embankment, and telegraph poles run beside a path or road on the right. The printed caption at the top reads "Ismailia Canal of Sweet Water" and there is a faint circular seal plus a website watermark at the bottom right.

A colored postcard view over a coastal city with dense low buildings and red-tiled roofs. In the foreground are domed structures and the tall minaret of a mosque. In the distance, by the sea, stands a round tower near the waterfront. Ships are visible in the harbor under a sunset sky. Multilingual captions at the top identify the scene as a view from the minaret of Acha-Mitcli (Acha-Mitchi) Djami in Salonica, noting the White Tower on the left and the Teke Djami minaret on the right. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom.

A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town nestled in rolling hills and fields. The settlement features a prominent church with a tall steeple in the center, surrounded by clustered houses, farm buildings, and tree-lined streets. Forested areas and agricultural land extend into the distance. In the upper right corner, in red script, is printed the caption identifying the place.

Black‑and‑white view of a small European town with a stone arch road bridge over a shallow river in the foreground. The bridge has simple masonry parapets and metal railings, with a couple of people standing at the near end. On the left stands a two‑story building with a steep tiled roof and several windows; behind it and across the river are closely packed houses with gabled roofs and dormer windows. In the background rise larger institutional‑looking buildings with ornate façades and towers, set against wooded hills and distant fields. Wooden utility poles with multiple ceramic insulators line the riverbank, suggesting early electrification. The scene has the composed, slightly elevated perspective typical of early 20th‑century town‑view postcards.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing an outdoor municipal swimming pool complex. The main left image features a concrete multi‑level diving platform over a large pool with trees and a grassy area in the background. The two images on the right show different perspectives of the same pool, including swimmers, starting blocks numbered 1–4, railings, and low poolside buildings surrounded by tall trees. At the bottom margin, stylized wave symbols flank the printed title "Stadtbad Meißen."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an industrial riverside complex with several multi‑storey factory buildings, tall chimneys and nearby houses, set in a hilly, patchwork agricultural landscape. The text at the top identifies the place as Marienberg in Saxony and specifically the city mill (Stadtmühle).

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town with a railway junction and iron bridge in the foreground. Multiple train tracks curve under the bridge, flanked by fields and fences.
