At the top left of the image the word "Graz" appears, indicating the scene is of the city of Graz and its Schlossberg hill.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a line of World War I soldiers standing at attention outdoors while several high‑ranking officers in greatcoats and kepis inspect or speak with them. The scene appears to be a military review or decoration ceremony in a tree‑lined public space. Handwritten French text is present along the bottom margin with a date from 1916 and a signature.

Colorized panoramic view over a large European river city, showing a suspension bridge crossing the Danube with many steam boats and barges on the water. The viewpoint is from a green hillside with rocky outcrops and buildings below. On both riverbanks there are dense rows of multi‑story historic buildings, boulevards, and promenades. In the distant background another bridge and a large parliament-like building are visible. Red printed caption text appears at the top in Hungarian and German.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story buildings leading toward a tall church tower with a pointed roof and arched windows. A few people and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the street. Handwritten cursive text is present at the bottom and along the left side. Printed red text near the bottom reads the location, and there is a date written in ink.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of powerful rapids and waterfalls with rocky outcrops in the foreground and a small industrial settlement in the background. A narrow footbridge spans part of the falls, and wooden structures or sluices line the riverbank. The title text is printed at the top of the card.

Black-and-white postcard showing a photograph of a medieval bronze grave slab depicting a bishop in full vestments, holding a crozier and a book, framed by Gothic inscriptions and heraldic shields. The lower margin of the postcard bears a German caption identifying the work and its location in Meissen Cathedral.

Black-and-white postcard view of a modest brick railway station building with the large rooftop sign "NYKÖPINGS SÖDRA". Several people, including children, stand or walk in front of the entrance; bicycles are parked nearby. Trees frame the image and open countryside or water is visible in the background. In the lower left corner the caption reads "NYKÖPING. Södra Stationen" and a small publisher's logo with number appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, old house with a tiled roof and shuttered windows, partly hidden by bare trees and shrubs. A fenced garden fronts the building, with a person standing in the doorway and another on the sidewalk. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Neerbosch. – Oude Pastorie." within a white border.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a historic dining or meeting room. A long table with a white cloth and simple wooden chairs stands in the center. On the right, a large, ornate tiled ceramic stove with elaborate relief decoration dominates the room. The walls feature dark wooden paneling, heavy door frames, and a balcony or gallery with carved wooden railing on the upper right. Simple pendant lamps hang from the ceiling, and vases with flowers sit on the table and near the stove. Handwritten white numbers or notes appear at the top right edge of the image, as often seen on early photographic postcards.

Colorized vintage street scene showing a busy outdoor terrace of a building labeled 'Hotel Café Restaurant' on the façade. Numerous people sit at tables under an awning, bicycles are parked in front, and some carts or early carriages are visible on a tree-lined square or road. Red-roofed houses and tall trees line the background. In the sky area on the left is printed text identifying the location as 'Berg en Dal' and 'Hotel Café Restaurant Hamer'.

Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a town square and adjoining main street. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand on a wide, unpaved market area bordered by two‑ and three‑storey houses with gabled roofs and shop signs. The camera looks along a straight street lined with closely packed buildings. Printed captions at the bottom identify the view as the market with Dresdnerstrasse in Ortrand, and the publisher as Friedrich Silbermann of Ortrand.

Sepia-toned portrait postcard showing a bearded man in formal 19th‑century attire, facing slightly to his left. The image has a studio-style, bust-length composition. At the bottom left, small white text reads "C. Miersch BRAHMS," and a small logo and number appear at the bottom right.

Colorized photograph of a sandy beach with sunbathers in swimsuits lying on towels. Behind them is an outdoor café or kiosk with red‑and‑white sun umbrellas and tables. Two tall flagpoles prominently display blue flags with a yellow Nordic cross (the Swedish flag). The scene is surrounded by dense coniferous forest under a clear blue sky, giving a relaxed summer‑holiday atmosphere typical of a lakeside or seaside resort.

Black-and-white view of a broad, sunlit European boulevard lined with tall 19th‑century stone apartment buildings with arcades and awnings at street level. The square is busy with pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages and an early tramway whose tracks curve through the open space. Multi‑story façades with ornate balconies and cornices frame the scene on both sides, and the vista continues into a narrower street in the distance. The image is bordered by a white margin, suggesting a printed postcard or photographic card.

Colorized panoramic postcard view of a spa town set against a forested hillside and distant mountains. The foreground and midground show dense blocks of grand, white and light‑colored historic buildings with ornate facades, mansard roofs, towers and domes, characteristic of a 19th‑century Central European resort. The image has printed captions at the top identifying the place.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a coastal city and harbor. In the foreground there is a low stone wall, a small white house, and several people standing near it. In the background are numerous ships in the bay and the urban waterfront. Large tree branches frame the scene at the top. Italian text is printed along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white view of a rustic, chalet‑style wooden building complex surrounded by lush climbing plants and bushes. The architecture features log‑frame columns, decorative diagonal timber cladding, steep shingled roofs with small towers or spires, and verandas. In the foreground are garden tables and chairs on a gravel terrace, giving the impression of a café or garden restaurant. The photograph is framed like an old postcard, but only a small hanging sign with unreadable writing is visible.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a spa town nestled in forested hills. Grand spa buildings with domes and colonnades line broad promenades and park-like gardens. A tall smokestack emits smoke near the center. In the foreground is a building labeled "HOTEL NEW-YORK" and other town structures. At the top center of the card the caption "Marienbad." is printed in red lettering.

Black-and-white postcard showing a sleek glider aircraft with long wings set up in the courtyard of a historic building with arcaded galleries and stone arches. A group of people stands in the background under an archway. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the glider and its academic flying group.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a steam locomotive with a long freight train traveling along a river at the base of a steep, rocky hillside. Numerous people stand on the trackside near the locomotive. Coniferous trees cover the distant hills. Text in Russian and Latin script appears at the top, identifying the location as Achinsk and describing the rail route near Mount Kemchug.

Vintage beige postcard with handwritten black ink in German script on the address side. It bears a green postage stamp and a circular postmark. The layout shows a printed word 'Postkarte' at the top, a vertical divider line, and the recipient's address written on the right.

A black-and-white view of a small village nestled in a wooded valley. Traditional half-timbered houses and other rural buildings are scattered among trees and gardens. On the right side stands a prominent church with a tall spire and a smaller chapel-like building in front, both surrounded by what appears to be a churchyard or cemetery. Behind the village rises a densely forested hillside. At the bottom margin, there is a caption in German in a decorative script.

A vintage black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) aerial view of a European town with dense, traditional gabled houses and shops around a central street. In the foreground are multi‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; signage on the façades advertises restaurants and shops. Further back stand additional townhouses, a larger institutional building, factory chimneys, and open countryside beyond the town. The lower margin of the image contains printed publisher information at the left and the red caption "Eilenburg." in the center.

Sepia-toned aerial view over a small town surrounded by fields and light woodland. In the foreground are detached houses with gardens; further back stand rows of multi-storey residential buildings and a church-like structure, all set within greenery. The landscape stretches into flat countryside on the horizon. At the bottom left, white printed text reads "GERINGSWALDE. Blick vom Aussichtsturm." indicating the scene is a view of Geringswalde from an observation tower.

Black-and-white image of a railway station area with multiple train tracks in the foreground and platforms with people walking or waiting. On the right is a brick station building with a steep tiled roof, tall arched windows, a round clock on the gable, and an entrance canopy. In the background are mid‑century office and residential buildings, trees, and low hills. Overhead power lines for electric trains cross the scene. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Sundsvall Central Station in Swedish. Additional commercial signage is visible on a large building behind the station.

Colorized postcard view of an ornate historic theater building with a green dome, statues on the roofline, and a grand columned portico, set behind a park with lawns, trees, and pathways. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Graz, Stadttheater."

A colored panoramic view of a small historic town nestled among hills and greenery. In the left background there is a church with a tall spire and adjacent large buildings on a rocky elevation, while in the foreground and middle ground there are many red‑roofed houses and multi‑story town buildings, with a few factory chimneys visible. The landscape stretches into a wide, lightly populated plain under a clear sky. The printed title at the top left reads "Leisnig i. S."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large classical building complex surrounding an open square. The central building has many windows and a tall tower; colonnaded wings with pediments flank each side. Small figures walk across the wide plaza in front. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage street-view postcard showing a busy square with horse-drawn carriages, people walking, and café tables along both sides of the street. Multi‑storey European-style buildings line the square; a sign on the upper-right building partially reads "GRAND …". The caption at the top says "Souvenir de Salonique" and along the bottom "Place de la Liberté" and "Ed. Librairie Italienne". A watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower part of the image.

Colorized vintage view over a bay surrounded by low mountains. In the foreground, by the water, stands a long monastery complex with a tall bell tower and some boats in the sea. The image has a caption in French at the top left and a website watermark along the bottom.

Sepia-toned historical street scene showing a wide, tree-lined avenue with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. Multi‑story buildings line the right side, while on the left there are trees, a fence, and a building with a pointed roof and a tower spire visible in the background. The printed captions at the top read "Bautzen." on the left and "Löbauerstrasse" on the right, indicating the location and street name.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town street dominated by a Baroque church with an onion‑shaped dome and tower. The church is on the left side, with stucco walls, arched windows and a small side building; a balustraded stairway with statues descends toward the street. On the right, a row of 2–3‑storey houses with shops at ground level lines a cobblestone road. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or sit near the church, and a horse‑drawn cart or early vehicle is visible further down the street. The image has wide white margins like a photographic postcard. No clear text is visible.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural town with wooden houses, farm fields and haystacks in the foreground, and a large white church with a tall spire dominating the center. Low, rounded mountains are visible in the background under a bright sky. Printed caption text appears in the lower left and lower right corners.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a powerful waterfall in a rocky river gorge. In the background there is a long truss bridge crossing the river and low mountains or mesas beyond. The foreground has rough rock formations and some wooden or metal structures near the water's edge. Handwritten white text appears along the bottom margin, including a location label on the left and a photographer's credit and date on the right.

A monochrome postcard view of a large wooden villa with a small tower and verandas, mostly hidden among tall coniferous trees. The house sits on a slight rise in a dense forest. At the top of the card is printed the caption identifying the place.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a stone arch bridge over a river with people standing along the railing. Behind the trees on the far bank are large historic buildings and a church-like tower. The caption at the bottom reads "Schloß Wechselburg (Mulde)".

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of Athens with low houses, hills in the background, and an ancient colonnaded temple-like structure in the middle ground. Printed captions in Greek and French label the scene as a panorama of Athens, and there is handwritten cursive text in French across the lower portion of the image.

A sepia-toned postcard reproducing an old engraved certificate framed with ornate Baroque scrollwork. At the top center is a panoramic city view with a large fortress on a high rock above a river and a dense skyline of church spires and towers across the water. Two allegorical figures sit on clouds above the city. The lower half is filled with elaborate German Fraktur text resembling an 18th‑century guild or citizenship document, with signatures and a seal at the bottom. In the right margin, someone has handwritten "Ignaz Missb… (1782)" and there are small printed numbers/marks in the corners.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a busy harborfront with steamships docked along a quay and cobblestone streets filled with horse‑drawn carts and a few early motor vehicles. The masts and funnels of several ships rise above low waterfront warehouses. There are handwritten labels over some ships, and printed caption text at the lower right that reads "Stockholm. Skeppsbron". Large, stately buildings and a domed structure are visible across the water in the background.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an oval photograph showing a town square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings with arcades, a tall clock tower, a large fountain with statues, and people walking in the open plaza. Mountains rise in the background. The upper left corner of the card bears the caption "TRENTO" and the lower right reads "Piazza del Duomo e Torre Grande."

A vintage winter view of a stone castle complex on a hill, dominated by a tall round tower rising above snow-covered slopes with scattered trees. In the background a church dome and cross are visible. The image has a faded, tinted look typical of early 20th‑century postcards. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location and building.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a mountain village nestled in the Alps. In the foreground are tall conifer trees framing several multi‑story alpine buildings with red and brown roofs. A church with a pointed bell tower stands to the right. Behind the settlement rise steep, forested mountains. Printed caption text appears at the bottom, with handwritten cursive text overlaying the lower margin.

A multi-view color postcard showing four scenes of a small alpine village surrounded by forests and green hillsides. The upper-left image shows the village nestled in a valley with scattered houses and a church spire. The upper-right and lower-left images depict chalet-style houses or guesthouses with balconies and outdoor terraces, one with umbrellas and seating. The lower-right image shows a small town square or street corner with a few multi-story buildings, balconies with flowers, and a shop at street level. In the center, in red text on a white panel, is the title 'TRET di Fondo m. 1162'.

Black‑and‑white view of a European riverside city with ornate baroque and historicist buildings to the left, a quay with people walking and horse‑drawn trams or early electric trams on tracks in the center, and numerous steamships moored along the river to the right. In the background a large classical opera‑house‑like building stands near a multi‑arched stone bridge that crosses the river, and a tall clock‑tower rises beyond it. The image has wide white margins and the framing and subject suggest it is an old postcard or photographic print.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a Protestant church, showing rows of wooden pews leading up to a simple altar with candelabras, plants, and a central cross motif. A large multi‑armed chandelier with candles hangs from the ceiling. Hymn boards flank the altar, and doors are set into the walls on either side. At the left is a tall slim clock and a pulpit with drapery. The architectural style is restrained and neoclassical. White printed captions identify the scene and photographer in Swedish.

Illustrated seaside scene showing men, women and children on a sandy beach in early 20th‑century style bathing costumes. A girl in a red‑and‑yellow striped one‑piece swimsuit stands in the center foreground, a boy in a white shirt and green shorts plays with a bundle of clothes near the surf, and other bathers wade in the shallow water. In the background, there is a low pavilion or bathhouse building and more people strolling along the shore. The image has the look of a color lithograph typical of vintage holiday postcards.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing two uniformed soldiers standing in snow beside a simple metal railing, likely on a terrace or overlook. They wear long military greatcoats and caps typical of World War I–era uniforms. The background is largely blank due to snow and overexposure. At the bottom, there is a handwritten inscription in Italian indicating New Year 1918 and a place name.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park or garden path lined with trees and bushes. In the center is a wooden pavilion or gazebo with a pointed roof and open sides. To the right stands a small octagonal or polygonal wooden building with a steep roof and a small finial on top. A simple wooden fence borders the path in the foreground. Printed German captions appear along the top, and a red imprint with the publisher and date is at the bottom.

Color-tinted historic postcard view of a large circular public square/park with curved paths, trees without leaves, low hedges, and a small pond. A horse-drawn carriage moves along the broad road in the foreground, with a few pedestrians walking nearby. Surrounding the square are late-19th/early-20th‑century townhouses and larger buildings, and church spires rise in the background. The captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen" on the left and "Keizer Karel Plein" on the right in red letters.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view over a densely built city with low buildings and a prominent hilltop with classical ruins in the distance, identifiable as the Acropolis. The image is framed by a wide beige border. At the bottom of the photo there is printed caption text in French and Greek.

Black-and-white postcard showing a long, traditional wooden log house with many paned windows and a turf/grass roof, set among tall pine trees. Another wooden building with a tiled roof is partially visible in the background. In the lower left corner there is printed text identifying the building and museum.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an early 20th‑century cargo steamship underway on a calm waterway. The ship has a tall central funnel with a small emblem on it, two masts with rigging, and is loaded with lumber stacked high along the deck. The name "HELFRID" is painted in large letters on the side of the hull near the bow. A small flag is visible at the stern, and the distant shoreline with low buildings and trees appears in the background under an overcast sky.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a city with densely packed low houses in the foreground and a prominent flat‑topped hill with ancient ruins on it in the mid‑distance, recognizable as the Acropolis. A road runs diagonally toward the hill. There is handwriting covering much of the sky area, and printed text along the right edge and bottom margin.

A colorized landscape view of a large riverside or lakeside estate surrounded by dense coniferous forest and open fields. The central building is a sizable multi‑story structure with a tower or belvedere topped by a flagpole flying a tricolor flag. The structure resembles a manor or palace complex with several wings and outbuildings. In the background lie broad waters, gently rolling countryside, and more forest under a lightly clouded sky. There is a wide cream‑colored border typical of early 20th‑century printed postcards, and no visible caption on the front.

Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing three views: a riverside townscape with a multi‑arched stone bridge and church spire; an inset of a church labelled "DIE DEUTSCHE KIRCHE"; and another inset of a large school building labelled "DAS GYMNASIUM". The right half is filled with handwritten German text and floral decoration around the printed greeting "Gruss aus Goldingen".

Sepia-toned studio portrait of a young woman with long wavy hair, seated on a simple wooden bench against a painted backdrop. She wears a folk-style costume with geometric embroidered borders on the skirt and hem, a decorated belt, layered necklaces with a circular central medallion, and a headband of rectangular ornaments. The image has the soft focus and tonal quality typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards. No visible writing or caption appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white image of a 19th‑century railway station building with arched windows on the ground floor and rectangular windows above. A platform canopy extends along the tracks on the right, with several gas‑style street lamps and a few railway staff and passengers standing around. A clock is mounted over the main entrance, and there is a small cart near the left side of the building. The architecture suggests a Central European station of the late 19th to early 20th century.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rocky rural road winding through a barren, hilly landscape with scattered trees. A person in dark clothing walks or stands on the road. The lower margin contains printed captions in Greek and French, and there is a round seal-like mark on the left. The website address 'www.elia.org.gr' is faintly overprinted.

A black‑and‑white historic streetscape showing a corner building with ornate late‑19th‑century architecture on an unpaved intersection. The three‑storey structure has a decorated roofline with finials and a central dome‑like feature. Signs on the façade advertise a bakery and confectionery, a tailor (Herrenschneider), and the name Robert Lankow. A man rides a bicycle on the dirt road, and a woman walks along the fenced sidewalk. Trees and similarly styled townhouses line the street; a church spire is visible in the distant left background.

Vintage sepia postcard showing many schoolgirls in dark uniforms playing in a tree‑lined courtyard. Some are skipping rope while others walk or stand in groups. Buildings line one side of the yard. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the location as a school patio in Figueras.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a dirt road and riders on donkeys or horses in the foreground. Trees line the road, and in the distance there are domed bathhouse-like buildings set against low hills or mountains. The printed caption in French at the bottom identifies the scene as the thermal baths of Bademli near Brousse. The design and typography are typical of early 20th‑century picture postcards.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a cobbled market square bordered by multi-storey townhouses and shops. A church tower with a clock and spire dominates the background. In the foreground stands a fenced statue on a pedestal (the Rietschel monument). German text at the top identifies the scene as the market and Rietschel monument in Pulsnitz, Saxony.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a traditional long wooden house with a grass/sod roof in a pine forest, likely near a river or lake. The building has two covered entrances with simple columns and several windows. Printed white text appears along the bottom edge naming the location and photographer.

Colorized vintage view of a tree-lined avenue in a park. A wide path runs through tall trees on the right, with dense green foliage forming a canopy. On the left is a grassy slope with bushes and a small wooden fence or railing, and a side path curving uphill. The image has the appearance of an early 20th‑century color postcard. At the bottom center, red printed text identifies the location as 'Freiberg i. S. KönigsaIlee.'

Sepia-toned vintage photograph of four men standing outdoors in front of a wooden building with a multi-pane window. They wear early-20th-century uniform-style clothing and caps, each with a rectangular number tag pinned to the chest (e.g., 376, 363). One man rests his hand on the shoulder of another. The card edges are rounded and worn, consistent with an old photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a tree‑lined sidewalk or promenade running into the distance beside a low wooden fence. On the right stands a three‑story residential villa with decorative gable painting, window shutters, and a small bay or winter garden on the ground floor. The setting appears semi‑urban with additional rooftops faintly visible in the far background. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image side.

A black‑and‑white vintage photograph mounted on a postcard border, showing a busy town square or market. Numerous people in early 20th‑century European clothing mingle among horse‑ or ox‑drawn carts. In the background stands a large, rectangular neoclassical building with three stories, arched ground‑floor windows, and a simple hipped roof. Trees line part of the façade, and crowds are gathered along the front of the building. The overall scene suggests a livestock or produce market day in front of a civic or institutional building.

A monochrome postcard view of a long truss bridge on stone piers crossing a wide river, with a small town and forested hills in the background. Early 20th‑century buildings line the riverbank. In the top left corner, text reads "ELVERUM, BROEN".

Black‑and‑white image showing a wooden church with a tall tower and spire, surrounded by a graveyard and trees. A dirt path leads through the churchyard. In the upper right corner there is printed text reading "Ekshärads kyrka," identifying the church in the scene.

A vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a young man in formal attire, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, and patterned tie. The background is plain and softly lit, typical of early 20th‑century studio photography. In the lower left corner the photographer's name "L. FAEGLE." is printed, and there is a small circular studio logo in the lower right.

A monochrome/sepia postcard showing a stately two‑storey manor house at the end of a broad gravel drive, flanked by lower outbuildings and trees. The building has a simple classical façade with evenly spaced windows and a central entrance. In the top left corner of the image there is red printed text that reads "Bornesta."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing the richly decorated Baroque façade and entrance of a large stone cathedral. The upper margin bears printed Spanish text identifying the scene as the Puerta de las Platerías in Santiago de Compostela. Small figures stand in front of the grand doors. A faint imprint at the bottom left reads "Biblioteca de Galicia."

Colorized view of a busy waterfront with low port buildings, small rowing boats and larger ships in a harbor. The scene is labeled in Greek and French and shows a general view of the port area. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom right.

Colorized historical street view showing a bustling European city avenue lined with ornate multi‑story buildings and church towers. A tall baroque-style clocktower dominates the right side, while people walk and horse-drawn or early electric trams move along the central street. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Graz. Herrengasse."

Colorized vintage street view showing a quiet small-town scene with two‑story houses and shops along a curved road. A few pedestrians and a cyclist are visible. Trees line the street, fences border the sidewalks, and the sky is tinted in soft blue and orange. At the top, printed text identifies the location as Großbröhrsdorf and Bischofswerdaer Straße. On the right façade a shop sign reads "E. Emil Bock".

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a narrow city street lined with multi‑story buildings. A church or chapel with a bell tower and dome rises on the right side. People walk along the sidewalks and a horse‑drawn carriage moves down the street. The printed caption at the top reads "87. FIGUERAS – Calle de Cervantes," and there is small printer's text at the bottom.

A black-and-white postcard view of a river spanned by a steel bridge with lattice sides, labeled as the Schönau Bridge. On the left riverbank stands a complex of buildings with steep, tiled roofs, likely part of an industrial or utility facility, and behind them are several power pylons and a tall smokestack. The right side shows a riverside path bordered by a wooden fence and dense vegetation, with a few indistinct figures walking. The image is framed by a white border, with printed caption text at the bottom.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a detailed interior scene beneath a richly ornamented Gothic arch. The image depicts numerous men in period clothing gathered in discussion, some seated and some standing, with portraits and stained-glass windows in the background. Beneath the image is a printed German caption identifying the scene as a consultation about the Leipzig Interim in the presence of Elector Moritz in 1548 at the royal Albrechtsburg in Meissen.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a multi‑storey historicist town building with ornate gables and dormer windows. On the ground floor is a wine tavern with the sign "Wein-Stuben ... Carl Lantzsch." In front of the house runs a cobbled street with an early electric tramcar. At the bottom in red script is a greeting mentioning Meissen and Lantzsch's wine tavern, and printer information runs vertically along the left edge.

Black‑and‑white portrait of a young woman in elaborate, likely theatrical costume with a richly decorated, beaded headdress and lace veil. She looks slightly upward, lit dramatically from one side. At the bottom are printed credits identifying the sitter and photographer, along with a date and city.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with historic gabled townhouses featuring arcaded ground floors. The buildings have stepped and curved gables, with shops or entrances under the arches and several pedestrians in the distance. At the bottom margin there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a flooded riverside or lowland landscape with tall trees standing in water. The scene is calm, likely at evening, with reflections visible on the floodwater. At the top in red print is the word "Groitzsch." followed by a printed caption that has been partly crossed out and corrected by hand in dark ink.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large group of people in traditional folk costumes dancing in a field, likely performing a circular country dance. Low rural buildings and trees appear in the background under a cloudy sky. The caption in French at the bottom mentions Salonique and country dances, and a modern website watermark is visible across the lower right.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the large baroque dome and façade of the Frauenkirche church dominating an open square in Dresden. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk around the square; historic streetlamps and surrounding buildings are visible. Printed captions identify the scene and location along the top and right edges.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small rural town surrounded by forests and fields. Detached wooden houses with light façades and dark roofs are scattered along winding roads. There are open meadows, patches of cultivated land, and dense tree clusters. No prominent monumental building stands out, and there is no visible coastline or mountains; the terrain is gently rolling countryside.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing fishermen standing in shallow water and pulling in nets attached to boats near the shoreline. They wear wide-brimmed hats and traditional work clothes. In the background, across a calm bay, is a coastal town with clustered buildings and some larger institutional structures on a low hill, with trees and walls along the waterfront. Printed French caption and a vertical printer's credit are visible, as well as a logo stamp and a modern website watermark.

Black‑and‑white panoramic postcard view of a forested hill with a walled castle complex. A tall rectangular tower and a long curtain wall stand among dense trees, with rocky outcrops visible to the right. At the bottom of the image, printed captions read "Helfenburg." and "Hradek." in decorative script, with some additional handwritten marks partially visible.

A color illustration of an early 20th‑century ocean liner at sea, seen from the port bow. The ship has a grey hull, white superstructure, tall masts with rigging, and a prominent single red funnel with a dark top. Calm blue water and a light sky form the background. Printed caption text appears along the lower margin.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tall, narrow brick tower with a steep spire attached to a gabled brick building with a tiled roof. In the foreground there is a hedge, leafless pruned trees and a small gate leading into a garden. The bottom margin of the postcard bears the bilingual caption "BRUGES - BRUGGE".

Monochrome postcard-style image showing a large, angular institutional building on a street corner. The architecture is rectilinear with minimal ornament, rounded-arch windows on the upper floor, a prominent external staircase on the side, and an arched main entrance framed by rusticated stone blocks. A shield or coat-of-arms panel is placed above the main doorway. To the right, a slightly lower wing with arcades and rows of arched windows extends along the street. The scene is quiet with empty streets and a small planted area with a tree and lampposts in front of the building.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside or bayfront scene with a long wooden bridge or pier leading to several waterfront buildings. Small rowboats are moored beside a floating structure on the water in the foreground. In the background are numerous tents arranged like a campground and several wooden houses and low buildings set against a forest. On the right margin there is printed location text at the top and large handwritten numbers in black and red ink beneath it.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a central town square with multi‑storey historic buildings and two tall church/clock towers. The foreground shows an open market square with a few people and a streetlamp. Facades bear German signs for a hotel, restaurants, and cellars. Printed titles in red at the top left read "Rosswein. Markt", and at the bottom center the publisher credit "2424 Brück & Sohn, Meissen." is visible.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate neo‑classical / neo‑Romanian style building with arched windows and decorative details, set in a sparse garden or park. The top left bears the printed caption in Romanian, and there is printed information along the left edge as well as handwritten cursive text across the bottom and left margins. A postal cancellation mark is faintly visible in the upper right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, square stone minaret standing alone in a field with some trees in the foreground and low hills in the background. The tower has decorative geometric brickwork panels and a small open lantern structure at the top. At the top of the card is printed the caption identifying the scene as the Minaret d'Aghadir in Tlemcen.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large, ornate military barracks complex with multiple pointed green roofs and towers along a riverside in an urban setting. In the foreground are trees, a quay with boats and barges on the river, sandy riverbank areas with carts, and a street with a red-and-white electric tram. The printed caption at the top reads in German: "Dresden" on the left and "Kaserne des 2. K. S. Jäger-Bataillons No. 13" on the right.

Sepia-toned photograph of a ruined brick building with a steeply pitched tiled roof and substantial buttresses. The walls are partially collapsed and overgrown with vegetation. The structure features bricked-up arched openings and pilaster-like projections along the façade. On the left, an adjoining, more massive masonry section ends in a flat top with a damaged sculptural figure above it. In the background at far left there appears to be a faint spire from another building or church and some low houses across an open field. The image has a clear border typical of early 20th‑century photographic postcards. No visible printed text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white image of a woman in traditional Northern European folk costume standing in a wooden interior. She wears a long striped skirt with an additional striped apron, a fitted vest over a white blouse with full sleeves, stockings and simple black shoes, and a folk-style cap or headscarf. She stands in profile, touching the carved upper frame of a heavy wooden door with ornate panels and decorative friezes; behind her are richly carved wooden walls and plank flooring, suggesting the interior of an old rural house or historic building.

Black‑and‑white view of a busy early‑20th‑century urban street lined with multi‑story commercial buildings. Pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles move along a wide boulevard. Large shop windows and signage appear on the left, including a bold storefront sign reading something like "PAHLAAS." The architecture is typical of central‑European stone or stucco façades with ornamented cornices.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a brick arched bridge with decorative towers and balustrades crossing over a sloping road and embankments. Leafless trees suggest a winter or early spring scene. Two people stand on the bridge parapet. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Nijmegen and the bridge as leading to the Belvédère. Publisher and photographer credits appear in small type and there is a handwritten name at the lower right.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large church with a tall central tower and red-tiled roofs, situated on a slight hill above a green meadow with trees and a path in the foreground. The sky is blue with a few clouds. In the top left and right corners there is printed text in German identifying the location and the building.

A monochrome vintage street scene showing a tree-lined avenue with tram tracks running along a cobbled road. A horse-drawn carriage is visible at the right edge, and a few pedestrians walk in the distance. The right margin is filled with handwritten text in a cursive script, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. The image carries a small printed credit and a watermark from elia.org.gr near the bottom.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a tall circular stone tower with an eagle statue on its spire, smaller turret beside it, and a round colonnaded gallery above a rough stone base surrounded by greenery. German printed caption reads "Millenium‑Denkmal." Another printed caption at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Semlin." There is cursive handwriting in the margins and bottom area in a South Slavic (Serbian/Cyrillic) script.

Multi-view color postcard showing river and town panoramas. The main upper image depicts a broad bend of a river with bridges, a historic town, hills and forests; the caption reads "Tetschen-Bodenbach" and "Elbepanorama." The lower-left image shows a steep rocky hill with a small structure on top above a town street, captioned "Schäferwand." The lower-right image shows another river view with a paddle steamer, bridges, and riverside buildings, captioned "Elbepartie." The style is that of an early 20th‑century chromolithographic postcard.

Colorized historical postcard showing an ornate fenced monument in a park. At the center stands a statue of a seated man on a pedestal inscribed with "K. E. v. BAER". A person in old-fashioned clothing stands in front of the wrought-iron gate. Tall trees form a leafy background. At the top of the card, red printed text reads "Dorpat." on the left and "Das Baerdenkmal." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an extensive industrial brewery complex with multiple brick buildings, tall smoking chimneys, and adjacent railway tracks in a valley surrounded by rocky hills and trees. A smaller inset view at the bottom shows the same brewery and its grounds from another angle. Printed captions in German identify the site as the Felsenkeller brewery near Dresden, and the card has a narrow border with the printer's imprint along the left side.

Black‑and‑white panoramic postcard view of a large Baroque monastery complex surrounded by trees and countryside. Multiple connected buildings with steep roofs and small towers form a quadrangle around an inner courtyard. A church tower with a spire rises near the center. In the foreground are orchards or gardens, while forested hills and an open landscape stretch into the background. At the top left, printed in red Gothic/antiqua script, is a German caption identifying the site.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with a large central statue on a pedestal, formal paths and trees around it, and substantial buildings in the background, framed by mountains. There is printed red text identifying the view as Piazza Dante and Imperial-Hôtel in Trento. The lower part and right side contain handwritten Italian correspondence in ink.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing an ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European apartment or hotel facade with bay windows, decorative stucco and wrought‑iron balconies. A man stands on one balcony. At street level there are shopfronts, including a men's fashion store, and benches along a wide, unpaved or lightly paved roadway. The architectural style is historicist with Art Nouveau elements.

Black-and-white postcard view of a medieval stone castle with high walls and square towers rising behind a smaller whitewashed building with a tiled roof. Trees and foliage frame the foreground. At the bottom of the image there is a caption in white text reading "Kuresaar – Loss – Schloss," indicating the pictured castle.

Black-and-white postcard view of a calm river with reflections of trees and buildings along the opposite bank. On the right side, a row of wooden houses and larger villa-style buildings line a road above the riverbank, with tall, thin trees behind them. To the left, a covered or truss bridge crosses the river. The scene is rural and wooded, and printed caption text appears at the bottom left and right corners.

A sepia-toned landscape view showing grassy hills with the ruins of a stone fortress on the ridge and a white church with a tall steeple on the right. Below the hill is a river crossed by a small bridge, and in the foreground stands a solitary wooden house surrounded by trees and fields. The image has wide margins and the aesthetic of an early 20th‑century postcard photograph. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad, gently curving street lined with multi‑story buildings on both sides. The right side has gabled roofs and shopfronts, while the left side shows long facades with many windows. A horse‑drawn carriage, a few pedestrians, and two children in dresses and hats stand in the foreground. Trees rise behind the buildings on the right. The caption at the top reads 'GRAZ – Wieckenburggasse'.

Vintage monochrome image of a lake or pond with small rowboats, tree‑lined banks, and a promenade. On the right side stands an octagonal pavilion with many windows; in the background are more buildings, including one with a pointed tower. People stroll and sit along the waterfront. The caption at the bottom left reads "Graz, Hilmteich." The image has a yellowish border and aging typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A sepia-toned, vintage photograph showing a steamboat or ferry on calm water, with a forested shoreline and some rocky terrain in the background. There's a small structure on the shore and a tower visible above the treeline. The steamboat has a flag and prominent upper decks, and appears to be carrying passengers.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph featuring several old buildings with steeply pitched tiled roofs, partially obscured by leafy trees. The most prominent structure is a larger stone building with small attic windows and a steep roof, suggesting historical or architectural significance, possibly a castle or manor. No contemporaneous text is visible on the front of the postcard.

The postcard features an illustrated portrait of a woman with soft facial features, wearing a large purple-blue hat with decorative feathers. Beneath the portrait, there is handwritten text in blue ink.

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a small harbor with several docked fishing boats. In the foreground, there are two smaller boats with people in them, one being rowed by a man and child. The background shows more fishing boats docked by wooden piers with some residential houses visible beyond. The overall scene is tranquil and seaside, and the image has a nostalgic, early-to-mid 20th century feel. The lower left corner contains the printed text 'Styrsö, Tången.' and the lower right has a logo with the number 3972.

A black and white vintage postcard showing a large institutional building with a central dome or small tower, flanked by long wings, surrounded by smaller houses and simple farmland with wooden fences. There is handwritten text at the bottom and right side, with a title below the photo and what appears to be a date on the right.

A sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a tram station in front of a large building. In the foreground, vintage trams are lined up on the tracks. In the background, there are notable landmarks: a tall, pointed tower, a round tower, and residences set against a mountainous backdrop. The caption in Italian at the top right reads 'Trento - Stazione del Tram.'

The postcard shows a black-and-white photograph of a large, historic wooden building with a steep, shingled roof and two prominent chimneys. The building has two main entrances, each accessed by a staircase, and simple decorative pediments above the doors. There are two empty flagpoles in front, a few garden chairs, and well-kept gardens with shrubs and flowers. Trees are visible to the left and right, and the photo has a clear sky with some clouds. Text at the bottom left provides location information, while more text at the bottom right gives details about the photograph's copyright.

The postcard depicts a large outdoor gathering or festival, with many people dressed in early 20th-century attire. The field is decorated with numerous lanterns or banners hanging from poles. The postcard has German-language text at the top and along the side, and the image looks sepia-toned, consistent with early postcards.

The postcard is a vintage photograph showing a historic, Gothic-style building complex with pointed arches, large windows, and towers. The setting appears to be a quiet, cobbled yard surrounded by old brick structures. The main focus is on the entrance and chapel of a hospital, characterized by its stone architecture and distinct European medieval influences. The image is black-and-white or sepia toned, typical of early 20th-century postcards.

A black and white postcard showing a large historical building with ornate windows and columns, identified in the printed caption as the Graz Police Directorate (formerly Wildenstein Palace). The building appears to be of Baroque architectural style. The postcard includes overhanging tree branches, shadows, and publisher information in the lower right.

A black-and-white image depicts a modernist-style building complex in a flat, arid landscape. The architecture features clean lines, rectangular forms, and minimal ornamentation, with some arches and a prominent square tower with a smokestack, suggesting industrial or institutional purpose. The foreground is barren, with sparse, young trees staked around. There is no visible signage. The sky is partly cloudy, adding to the dramatic atmosphere of the scene.

The postcard is a monochrome or sepia-toned image showing a historic European market square (Markt) with classic multi-story buildings and a prominent equestrian statue in the center. Behind the square, on a hill, there is a large baroque-style castle (Schloß) with a dome and cupola. The text at the top reads 'Weissenfels a. Saale. Markt und Schloß.' Various numbers are written or crossed out on the image.

A black-and-white postcard depicting a classical-style statue of a woman in flowing robes standing among a rock garden or landscaped park. The statue holds a jug and the background features rolling hills, several trees, and what appears to be a rural or semi-natural landscape. There is an arched trellis and some sparse vegetation around the statue.

The image shows a picturesque medieval European cityscape with old stone buildings featuring stepped gable roofs, red tiles, and latticed windows. There is a stone bridge over a canal, and a small boat with tourists is seen on the water. Leafless tree branches frame the scene, suggesting early spring or late autumn. The setting is quaint and historic, with the sense of being well-preserved for tourism.

The postcard depicts a functionalist-style modernist building, featuring clean lines and rectangular forms, typical of early to mid-20th century architecture. The photo is black and white, suggesting it is from the earlier half of the 20th century. The building has the large letters 'SOK' on the facade. There is clear signage on the image itself with the words 'Kotka' (bottom left) and 'S.O.K' (bottom right). The street appears quiet, and the overall scene exudes an official or business-like atmosphere.

A black-and-white image depicting a two-story building with large windows, likely a public or communal structure surrounded by bare trees and a dirt road. The words 'Sabīle' and 'Atpūtas nams.' are printed in the top corners. There is a numbering '14.' in the lower-right corner, possibly an archival or series number.

A vintage postcard depicting two stone windmills on a hillside by the water. In the background, there is a long bridge crossing the water, with hills and low buildings visible. The text is in both Greek and French, suggesting a historic scene. The postcard is sepia-toned.

The image shows a black-and-white postcard featuring a large, historic stone church with a prominent clock tower and a steeply pitched roof. In the foreground, there is a lush park with benches and a picturesque gazebo. Several people in period clothing, including women in long dresses and hats, are gathered in the park area. The style is distinctly early 20th century. There is handwritten text across the bottom of the postcard, and printed text with place names and what appears to be publisher information.

The image depicts a quaint European village at the base of a wooded hill or small mountain. In the foreground is a country road with a person and a dog. The village has characteristic steep-roofed houses and a church with a tall spire. At the top of the hill stands a round tower, possibly a castle or lookout, flying a flag. Most of the scene is rendered in black and white sketch or engraving style. There is no visible text on the image.

The image shows a fortified stone wall with medieval architectural features, including crenellations and a large tower-like structure with a steep, dark roof. There are three people visible—two girls standing by the wall, and one person walking up a set of steps built into the wall. The scene is in daylight, with clear, blue skies.

A vintage postcard depicting a rural hilly landscape with a large hotel building labeled 'Groot Hôtel' on the left, and a bridge with a tram or train traveling across it to the right. The countryside is lush and green with winding roads and a patchwork of open grass. At the top right, the text reads 'Berg en Dal' and 'Mooi Nederland', suggesting this is a scenic location in the Netherlands.

The image depicts a farmer in traditional attire plowing a field with two oxen. The photograph is black and white, with the man wearing a fez and loose trousers, suggesting a rural, historical setting. At the bottom, there is text in French and additional publication information indicating the photo was taken in Candia, Crete.

This is a vintage black and white postcard featuring a grand building with ornate architectural features and a spire, set on a hill above a river. There is a pontoon bridge over the river in the foreground, with several people walking across it. The postcard contains printed German text, identifying the location and possibly the publisher on the left margin.

The black-and-white image appears to be a vintage photograph of a European town or village nestled within a hilly and forested landscape. Prominent in the upper middle section of the image is a large church with a tall steeple, situated on a hill above the other buildings. The lower area of the image shows several large, ornate buildings—possibly spas or sanatoriums—indicative of late 19th or early 20th-century architecture, along with numerous smaller houses interspersed with trees. There is a peaceful and picturesque charm to the town, and the overall ambiance aligns with historic spa towns of Central Europe.

A vibrant town square scene with a market and various vintage cars parked around an open plaza. People are seen walking, cycling, and shopping at outdoor market stalls. Surrounding the square are two- and three-story mid-century buildings, including a hotel or café on the right with the word 'Kapphandel' visible and a bakery or restaurant at street level. The town is bordered by trees and low hills in the distance, under a clear blue sky.

A vintage black and white postcard depicting a quaint European town with many houses, trees, and a river in the foreground. There are two prominent church spires rising above the rooftops. The postcard has the text 'Grimma i. Sa.' printed at the bottom.

A colorized postcard showing a wide, multi-storey military barracks complex with red-tiled roofs and a central archway, set in a verdant landscape with distant hills and several factory chimneys visible in the background. The postcard text in German identifies the building and its location.

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph showing a park-like area with tall trees and a view of a body of water in the background. There are benches and chairs arranged under a covered structure on the left side, with a wide open space in the middle ground. The setting has a historical, serene ambiance typical of early 20th-century European landscapes. The bottom half of the postcard includes printed text and a large, stamped mark indicating ownership by a museum.

A vintage postcard image depicting a scenic lake surrounded by forested hills, with handwritten notes in ink across the image. The lake is labeled as 'Lake Waha, near Lewiston, Idaho' at the top in red text.

A black-and-white image showing a residential urban neighborhood with three-story apartment buildings lining both sides of a wide, unpaved street. Balconies with railings and street-level shops (with bicycles parked outside) are visible. The sky is partly cloudy. There is a sign on the building in Swedish, and the bottom-left and bottom-right corners of the image contain white text.

A sepia-toned photograph of the main entrance (hoofdeur) to a large brick building decorated with ornate ironwork, flags, drapery, and plant arrangements above the central doorway. The image's style, blocky typography, and formal symmetry suggest an early 20th-century photograph. The building features arched windows and detailed architectural elements consistent with European academic or institutional construction.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a dramatic bluff rising above the bends of a wide river. The landscape is arid with low scrub vegetation, and there are telegraph poles running alongside a dirt road that follows the riverbank. The sky area appears to be either overexposed or cut out. No text or apparent postage marks are visible on the image.

An illustrated postcard depicting a steamship named 'Kalev' sailing on the sea. The ship is decorated with abundant blue flowers and red berries. A white dove is flying over the ship, carrying a sealed envelope. The ship displays a blue, black, and white flag at the top, likely the Estonian flag, and another flag at the stern. The scene is whimsical and colorful.

The postcard features an illustrated scene showing several men in Ottoman military uniforms, one on horseback, with the skyline of old Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul) in the background. Prominently visible are domes and minarets characteristic of the city's famous mosques and historical structures. There is handwritten French text on much of the card, and a printed caption 'SOUVENIR DE CONSTANTINOPLE.'

The image shows an old waterfront scene with many boats and ships docked in a harbor. The view is depicted in vintage, muted colors typical of early colorized postcards. There is busy port activity with carts and people visible along the dock. In the background, there are hills or low mountains across the water. The postcard has inscriptions in both Greek and French at the top and a watermark with a website at the bottom.

The postcard shows an old church with a central dome and byzantine architectural features, viewed from across a courtyard with tiled roofs. There are text labels in Greek and French, along with handwritten notes in Greek and a date. The overall image has a sepia tone, typical of early 20th-century postcards.

A black-and-white postcard featuring a notable building on a hillside with a prominent central tower, battlement-like features, and an extended veranda. The foreground shows terraced gardens and trees. The text at the bottom identifies the building as 'Berggasthaus Friedensburg die Perle der Lößnitz.'

A black-and-white rural landscape photograph depicting rolling fields, birch trees in the foreground, rustic wooden fences, and a prominent church with a tall spire (the Ringsaker Church) in the center background. There are scattered farmhouses and forested hills in the distance. The postcard has Norwegian text at the bottom.

The image is an illustrated postcard featuring an old European town square. The square is surrounded by multi-story historic buildings with arched porticoes and red-tiled roofs. Visible landmarks include a tall bell tower, a church with a dome, and a broad, elegant avenue with pedestrians. In the background, there are lush green mountains. The top of the postcard displays the text: 'Piazza Vittorio Emanuele III e Via Rodolfo Belenzani.'

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a quiet street lined with houses and trees, receding into a gentle hill in the background. There is a single pedestrian walking along the pavement. The setting appears to be a rural or small-town area. The text at the top is in German and provides place and street information.

A sepia-toned postcard image showing a rural or coastal landscape with a prominent white building, some scattered trees, and hilly terrain in the background. Greek text is present, and there is a web address watermark (elia.org.gr) across the bottom.

A black-and-white postcard featuring an aerial or elevated view of a historic European spa town nestled in a valley with forested hills on one side and a sprawling settlement of classical buildings, hotels, and sanatoriums. The text reads 'Karlsbad. Totalansicht', which is German for 'Karlovy Vary. General view'.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a quiet street in a European town, lined with traditional buildings displaying signs in German. The street is empty except for a couple of distant figures. Among the visible shop signs are references to a pharmacy (Apotheke), as well as other businesses. The general style and signage reflect early-to-mid 20th-century Central Europe.

A black-and-white photograph of a broad, European-style street lined with stone buildings that feature arched arcades and ornate facades. Some signs on the buildings are visible, written in what appears to be German. There are pedestrians and a few early 20th-century vehicles, adding to the street scene's bustling atmosphere. The image has a vintage and possibly pre-war look.

A hand-colored vintage postcard image showing a central square flanked by historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. The main feature is a large stone fountain topped by a statue of a kneeling archer (appearing to be Diana, goddess of the hunt), flanked by animal statues (possibly deer or stags). There are several people in early 20th-century dress around the fountain. The name 'Großenhain' is printed on the upper left, and 'Marktbrunnen' (Market Fountain) on the upper right.

A black-and-white historical city street scene featuring pedestrians in period clothing, older multi-story buildings with traditional roofs, storefront awnings, and signage in German. There are lamp posts, telegraph poles, and in the distance, a factory smokestack and church spires. Trees partially obscure some wooden houses in the foreground. Visible street signs on the building read 'Schritt fahren' and 'Mauer Gasse'. There is a large advertisement on a building for 'M. Kaspar' with German text.

A black-and-white postcard showing an interior room that appears to be a museum or exhibition space. Several mannequins dressed in historical military or official uniforms are displayed against one wall, with glass-fronted wooden cabinets and a display case with drawers in the center. Portraits of formally dressed individuals hang on the wall above the uniforms. There is a doorway to another gallery in the background, where a large window and a radiator are visible. Lighting is provided by wall-mounted lamps.

A vintage postcard featuring a romantic, classical-style painting of a young couple. The woman, wrapped in a translucent draped cloth, stands against a stone wall decorated with blooming flowers while a young man leans over the wall, whispering into her ear. The background suggests an outdoor, lush garden or park setting. There is a vertical white section to the right with text in Russian, German, and English, identifying the artist and title.

Colorized historical postcard showing a small Gothic brick chapel with an octagonal base and tall pointed steeple, standing in a grassy area with groups of people gathered in front. Surrounding the chapel are town buildings, and another towered building is visible in the background. Printed titles and publisher information appear at the bottom in German.

A vintage black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a small European town with densely packed traditional houses, a prominent church with a tall spire in the foreground, and farmland and vineyards on gently rolling hills in the background. Printed text at the bottom identifies the place and publisher, including a date.

Black-and-white night photograph of a round, modernist tramway waiting house with illuminated signage on its roof reading "BRAU PUNTIGAM" and a small clock above the entrance. The building is lit from below the eaves and through its windows and doors, reflecting on the wet cobblestone square. Benches curve around the structure. Text at the bottom right identifies the scene as a night view of the tramway waiting house at Jakominiplatz in Graz.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large neoclassical building with a central portico of tall columns, flanked by long wings. A formal garden with paths and low hedges lies in the foreground. At the bottom border, captions in Greek and French identify the scene. The style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century touristic postcard.

Black-and-white portrait of a costumed stage actor holding a large metal tankard and smiling while looking down. He wears a bald cap with side hair, a curled mustache and beard, a ruffled white shirt, and period-style coat with a broad belt, suggesting a theatrical role. Printed at the bottom are the photographer/publisher credit and the actor's name with the title of the play in German.

Reverse side of an exhibition announcement postcard for the Barbara Krakow Gallery. The layout is mostly white with grey vertical text on the left spelling 'BARBARA' and large grey text along the bottom reading 'KRAKOW GALLERY'. The right side contains printed information about an Annual AIDS Benefit Exhibition titled 'EVERYTHING BUT PAPER PRAYERS', including dates in December 2005, opening time, donation details, the gallery website, street address in Boston, Massachusetts, telephone number, and email address.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a frozen sea with snow and ice, on which a group of people in winter coats and hats are standing and posing for the camera. Several more figures are scattered in the distance, and a ship can be seen frozen in the ice near the horizon. At the bottom, there is printed text in Bulgarian and French, including the name Varna.

Black-and-white postcard showing a rural European village landscape taken from an elevated viewpoint. In the foreground are two substantial farm or manor houses with steep gabled tile roofs and multi-pane windows, separated by a road and surrounded by trees and gardens. Beyond them stretch cultivated fields, orchards, and scattered tree lines, with gently rolling hills on the horizon. In the mid-distance a small church with a steeple and other farm buildings are visible, as well as another church-like building on a low rise.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Baroque palace complex with a central three‑storey main building, mansard roof, clock‑tower and cupola, flanked by lower side wings. In the foreground are formal gardens with paths, lawns, trees and statues. Printed title text appears in the upper left corner.

A colorized panoramic view over a green hilly landscape with scattered trees and small farm buildings in the foreground. On the hill in the distance stands a town with a large church or castle-like complex with a tower, adjoining buildings with red roofs, and nearby medieval-looking ruins and walls. Additional village houses and another church-like building with a tower and red roofs appear to the right. At the top left, printed text reads "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb."

An illustrated vintage postcard showing an oriental street scene with a large domed mosque and a tall, ornate minaret. The foreground features people in traditional Middle Eastern clothing walking and trading near stone steps and old buildings. The sky is softly colored, and there is handwritten script and a postal cancellation on the lower part of the card. The printed title at the top left reads "Kaït Bey," and at the bottom appears the place name "Le Caire" along with a handwritten date "17-8-902."

Black-and-white postcard view of a forested mountain landscape. In the foreground there is a grassy meadow with some benches and low shrubs. To the left stands a dense stand of tall conifer trees, while in the background rolling wooded hills stretch into the distance under a partly cloudy sky. Caption text is printed along the lower border.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a small town with wooden buildings on both sides of a wide road. Several adults and children stand or walk along the street, and a few people pose on the steps of a corner building to the right. There is a clock mounted on a pole to the left and telegraph poles receding into the distance. The style suggests an early 20th‑century Scandinavian town. At the top center, printed text reads "Gatuparti, Vivstavarv".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large early‑20th‑century grand hotel on a hill above a wooded slope and landscaped park. The multi‑storey building has corner turrets and a central pavilion roof. In the foreground are paths, lawns, trees, benches, and several people strolling. At the top left of the card is printed text identifying the location and hotel.

Vintage monochrome postcard with an Art Nouveau floral frame around a street-view photograph. The photo shows a busy urban street lined with two- and three‑story European-style buildings, awnings over shopfronts, pedestrians walking, and several horse-drawn carriages. At the top, the city name is printed in Cyrillic and Latin scripts. Above the photo, there is bilingual text identifying the street.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small rural village in a hilly landscape. Traditional half-timbered houses are scattered along winding roads, with fields and tree-covered hills in the background. The printed title in German appears at the top of the card.

Stylized winter cityscape illustration showing a snow‑covered square or street. In the foreground are bushes and trees laden with snow, with several small figures walking or standing in the snow. To the left stands an older, lower building with a steep snow‑covered roof and small towers or spires. Behind it, dominating the center, is a tall rectangular multi‑story block that looks like a mid‑20th‑century apartment or office building. To the right are additional snow‑covered buildings and a red vehicle that resembles a trolleybus or tram. The palette is mainly gray, black, and white with small red accents. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

A vintage illustrated postcard bordered with colorful pansy flowers surrounding an oval vignette of a large white baroque church complex on a hill, with twin towers topped by dark onion-shaped domes and trees in the foreground. Beneath the illustration is decorative text reading "Gruss aus Maria Trost" and a small printer's line at the bottom.

Vintage sepia-toned street view showing a cobblestone street lined with 2–3 story buildings. Signs on the buildings advertise restaurants, including one labeled "Stadt Leipzig" and another "Restauration von Eduard Berge". People are standing and walking along the street. In the distance are larger civic-looking buildings and trees. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Radeburg, Albertstrasse, with the town hall and district court (Stadthaus und Amtsgericht).

Color postcard showing an alpine valley with terraced green slopes, scattered farmhouses, and a village with a church tower on a hillside. High, rocky mountains rise in the background under a clear blue sky. At the top of the image, Italian text labels the place and altitude.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large two‑story building behind leafless trees and a wooden fence. Several people, possibly patients and staff, stand or sit in a small courtyard or terrace in front of the building. The right side margin is blank except for vertically printed red text. The overall style and clothing suggest an early 20th‑century European scene.

An old monochrome postcard showing an industrial complex with long, low factory buildings, several chimneys, and a rural foreground field. Smoke or haze appears over parts of the works. The caption at the bottom identifies the site as a sawmill and hammer works in Brabrand.

Tinted vintage postcard view of a canal in Bruges with several white swans resting on a tree‑lined bank in the foreground. Across the water stands a row of traditional stepped‑gabled houses with red and brown roofs, reflected in the calm canal. The image has a hand‑colored look typical of early 20th‑century postcards. Printed text at the top reads a caption identifying the scene and publisher information.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a valley with steep, barren hills on both sides and a cluster of light-colored industrial or monastic-looking buildings near the bottom of the slope. A chimney or small tower rises from the main rectangular building. Dirt roads and terraced slopes are visible in the landscape. At the top center of the card there is printed text in pre‑reform Cyrillic, and more text appears along the lower edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a naval vessel sailing on a slightly rough sea, viewed from another ship whose railing is visible in the foreground. The ship appears to be a small early‑20th‑century warship. Printed caption text is visible at the bottom in French, including a reference to Salonique (Salonika/Thessaloniki) and to the printer in Limoges‑Lyon, France.

Sepia-toned photograph of a large open market square bordered by whitewashed arcaded buildings. Many people in traditional North African or Middle Eastern robes gather, trade, and sit with goods spread on the ground. Behind the square rises a densely built hill of flat-roofed houses. At the top stands a tall, slender minaret-like tower next to a small religious structure, dominating the skyline. The overall style suggests an old desert town with Islamic architecture.

A black-and-white postcard view of a rural village nestled in rolling hills and fields. Traditional houses with pitched roofs and trees fill the foreground and middle ground, with more homes stretching along a gentle slope in the distance. The landscape is open and pastoral, with low wooded hills on the horizon. At the bottom of the image, there is a white border containing printed script text.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large ornamental fountain in a landscaped park. The fountain has multiple tiers with water jets arching outward, sculpted figures around the basin, and a tall central column topped by additional statuary and a crown-like element. Trees and benches surround the fountain, and a church tower or similar structure is faintly visible on a wooded hill in the background. At the top of the postcard, in red lettering, is a caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white illustrated view of a two‑story house with a small pediment and balcony, likely a café or restaurant with a garden terrace. In the foreground, many people sit at outdoor tables under leafy trees, drinking and talking; a server in an apron stands on the steps leading up to the entrance. The right part of the card is left blank, apparently for writing or printing. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century European café‑garden scene.

Sepia-toned vintage street view of a small European town square. Traditional multi-storey houses with steep tiled roofs line a curved street. In the background rises a baroque-style tower with a cupola and weather vane. Shop signs are visible on the buildings, including one reading "H. Badock". The printed captions on the image say "Pegau" at the top left and "Am Frankeplatz" at the top right, indicating the specific location within the town.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a quiet residential square with several similar two-story brick houses with hipped roofs arranged around an open, circular or oval green space. A wide unpaved or lightly paved street curves around the square. One building with decorative brickwork and a small tree in front is close to the right edge, while more houses extend into the distance on the left. The style suggests planned workers' or middle-class housing from the early 20th century. Handwritten-style printed text at the top left names the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small rural town dominated by a large church with a tall central tower and spire. Surrounding it are several school- and farm‑like buildings, winding unpaved roads, telegraph poles and fields in the background. The image has printed red text at the top reading the town name and indicating that the scene shows the church and school.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large curved masonry dam and reservoir set in a green, wooded valley. People in early 20th‑century dress stand and walk along the dam parapet. In the foreground there is a grassy area and part of a stone building or pavilion with columns on the right. Printed French text appears along the bottom, and a web watermark (elia.org.gr) is visible over the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street scene in a small town. On the left and right are two- to three‑story masonry buildings with tall windows and simple classical detailing. A railing and stone-lined waterway or bridge are visible in the foreground, leading toward a gently rising street with horse-drawn traffic and pedestrians. Leafless trees line the street. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Åmål as seen from Kungsbron (King's Bridge) looking along Kungsgatan (King Street). The publisher's imprint appears on the lower right.

Colorized vintage scene showing several men in Ottoman-era clothing sitting and standing among ancient stone blocks on a grassy slope overlooking a town. In the background are low houses with red roofs and, prominently, a round white building topped with a slender minaret, characteristic of an Ottoman mosque. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. A small website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of people standing and fishing on rocky shoreline outcrops by the sea.
