The figures are dressed in late 19th–early 20th century clothing, including long dresses and hats. The sea stretches into the distance under a cloudy sky. Printed text at the bottom left reads "Fishing Rocks near Seaview," and numerical codes "2823." and "8213." appear in the lower right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic rural landscape with rolling, hedge‑lined fields, a dirt path, and dense tree‑covered hills. A thatched or light‑roofed building is partly visible among the trees on the left, while taller trees crown the hill on the right. The printed caption in Dutch appears in red at the bottom margin, with smaller publisher information beneath.

Colorized landscape view of a small European town on a hill, seen from across a pond and open fields. In the distance are clustered houses, a prominent church spire, and a hilltop castle or fortress. Large trees frame the image in the foreground. At the top right, printed in red text, is the caption 'Stolpen i. Sa.'.

Sepia-toned historic view of a cobblestoned square with people walking and children standing in front of a long, two‑storey building with a tiled mansard roof and dormer windows. Large German words are painted on the facade, including 'Schützenhaus.' and other text advertising halls, concerts and a garden. Additional multi‑storey townhouses line the left side. At the top of the image are printed captions reading 'Torgau a. Elbe.' and 'Paradeplatz.' indicating the location.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a narrow, old European street with tall, closely packed buildings featuring wooden shutters and pitched roofs. Ivy climbs one facade and a wrought‑iron sign hangs above the street. A few pedestrians stand in the roadway. At lower right is a printed caption identifying the scene as a specific house in Bolzano.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a wide market square lined with multi‑storey townhouses and shops. On the left stands a large Baroque-style church with twin towers and a prominent entrance portal. A tall square tower is visible further back on the right. People walk along the street and several early automobiles are parked. The main printed caption at the top reads "Komotau. Markt." with large stamped numbers "65718" and a handwritten year-like annotation in red ink.

Black‑and‑white historical street scene showing a wide cobblestone avenue with horse‑drawn carts loaded with sacks moving along the road and several pedestrians, including children, on the sidewalks. On the left is a fenced garden or park with dense trees; on the right stands a row of ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑story buildings. Wooden poles with early electrical or telegraph wires line the street. People wear late 19th–early 20th century European clothing, including bowler hats and long dresses. The image resembles an old photographic postcard but shows no visible caption or printed text.

Black‑and‑white image that appears staged in a historical or folkloric style: a woman in traditional dress is stepping down from an old horse‑drawn mail coach while a man in a bowler hat and formal clothing assists her and holds a large framed document or poster. Behind them is the coach with large wheels and a flag on top that seems to contain printed text, suggesting a postal or ceremonial setting.

A monochrome postcard showing a naval gun or artillery piece mounted on a stand and shield, displayed indoors as an exhibit. Ropes and stanchions surround the piece, and framed items hang on the walls in the background. Along the right edge, vertically printed French text references the International Exhibition of Athens and its naval section. At the bottom center there is a website watermark.

Black‑and‑white seaside view taken from the water, showing a small Adriatic coastal town with stone waterfront houses, a boat moored at the quay, and a prominent church with a bell tower rising behind the buildings. The right margin has handwritten vertical text, and at the top right of the image area there is a caption "Biograd n.m" indicating the location.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a broad street or square in an old European coastal city. Stone townhouses with shuttered windows line both sides, leading the eye toward a large domed church in the background. The building has a green dome and classical details. People in traditional local clothing and period urban dress stand and walk through the square. Street lamps, potted trees, and stone pillars frame the scene. Printed captions in multiple languages appear at the bottom.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Moorish-style palace surrounded by lush palm trees and a curved driveway, with a flag flying from a tower. At the bottom is French text identifying the scene as the Governor's Summer Palace in Mustapha, Algiers.

Black‑and‑white view of a spa-town street lined with early‑20th‑century villas and guesthouses. The central building has a small tower and balconies, with the name "Haus Mozart" on its facade. Other houses and pensions stand on a sloping street to the right, partly hidden by trees. At the bottom margin, a caption identifies the location as Bad Elster and specifies the street. The overall layout, framing, and printed caption resemble a classic tourist postcard.

Colorized panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly landscape. The foreground shows dense rows of multi‑story buildings with light façades and grey roofs, interspersed with trees. A prominent church with a steep roof and tall spire stands near the center. In the background, houses are scattered up the hillsides under a pastel evening or morning sky. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the town and view direction, along with the publisher information in smaller red text.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a formal spa square with a large rectangular open area framed by low plant beds and benches where many people are sitting and strolling. Mature trees and wooded hills form the backdrop. On the right side is a long, low modernist building with large windows, likely shops or spa facilities. The scene is busy with visitors in period clothing. At the bottom center the caption reads "Bad Elster – Badeplatz."

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene with a church and a weir. On the left stands a tall church with a clock tower and spire, surrounded by trees and adjacent buildings. In the foreground, water cascades smoothly over a wide weir or low dam. The scene is framed by trees along the riverbank, under a partly cloudy sky. Handwritten captions appear along the lower edge.

An illustrated postcard showing a small Baroque-style chapel with a red-tiled roof, bell tower, and cross, located along a street with trees and a picket fence. In the foreground there is a kiosk or poster board covered with colorful posters. The bottom border carries printed captions identifying the location, and a black band at the very bottom right contains a logo and publisher name.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a baroque-style church with a tall tower and onion-shaped dome, fronted by ornate gates with statues and a cobblestone street in the foreground. A residential building stands on the right. The printed caption at the top reads the city name and the church name in German.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a long two‑storey house with a pitched roof, many rectangular windows, and ivy growing up the façade. The house is bordered by a wooden picket fence and trees on either side. In the lower right corner, stylized handwritten text in German appears. A small printed number is visible in the lower left margin.

Vintage sepia postcard view over a small European town in a valley, surrounded by rolling hills and farmland. In the center stands a prominent church with a tall spire, and clustered around it are traditional houses and farm buildings. At the top in red Gothic-style lettering is the title 'Neuhausen i. Sa.'. Along the left margin in red, smaller vertical print appears to be the publisher information and a number.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural landscape with scattered wooden houses, farm fields, a long straight country road lined by stone walls, and low forested hills in the background. The scene is calm and agricultural. At the bottom left the caption 'STORA HÖGA.' is printed, and there is a small triangular publisher logo with the number 836 in the bottom right corner.

Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a slightly downhill street lined with ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses. Several pedestrians, including children, are visible on the street. The caption printed in red at the top right identifies the scene as Friedrichstraße in Hartha, Saxony.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire, pointed arches, and detailed brickwork. At the top in red letters it reads "Hainichen i. S." and "Trinitatiskirche." At the bottom in smaller red print is a publisher's line. The street in front is mostly empty, emphasizing the church building.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large ornate Orthodox church with a tall bell tower and domes, seen from the street behind an iron fence. The architecture is richly decorated with arched windows, pilasters, and a central dome. Printed captions in French and Romanian identify the subject and the location, and a publisher's line appears at the bottom.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing the interior hall of a grand thermal bath establishment. The view looks onto an upper-level gallery with metal railings, arched doorways and windows, and a high glass roof. Several people are seen walking or sitting in the hall. Printed captions along the bottom identify the place as a thermal establishment in Aix-les-Bains, Savoie, France, specifically the hall of the showers in the south annex.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large town square filled with a crowd gathered in a circular formation, surrounded by trees, streetlamps, and neoclassical-style buildings. The town extends up a hillside in the background. Printed text in the top left reads "Argostoli Square" and a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view down a broad urban street lined with richly decorated late‑19th‑century buildings. At the left corner stands a three‑storey hotel with a mansard roof and painted wall sign. Several people with handcarts and a cyclist move along the cobbled street; gas streetlamps and trees line the sidewalks. The architecture features ornate facades and spires typical of historic German cities.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large neoclassical-style building with multiple arches and balconies identified as the Law Courts in Freetown. People in early 20th‑century dress walk in front of the building and along a street lined with a large tree. There is printed caption text in the top right corner and along the right edge, plus a vertical handwritten message in ink.

Black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a carved stone figure, likely medieval, showing a man kneeling on one knee while supporting a broken vertical architectural element (possibly a column or pilaster) on his shoulder. He wears a cap and a tunic with puffed sleeves, has a stern facial expression, and stands on a textured base. The background is plain studio gray, suggesting a museum object photograph. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view of a small European town seen from a hillside across a pond and fields. The town has dense low-rise buildings with red and gray roofs, several larger masonry buildings, a church with a tall steeple, and an industrial chimney emitting smoke. The caption in red text at the top left reads "Rumburg i. B."

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town in a river valley. Ornate 19th‑century and early 20th‑century buildings with mansard roofs line both sides of a narrow river or canal. On the right side, a long colonnaded promenade is crowded with many people walking along the water. Steep wooded hills rise behind the town, topped with large grand hotels or villas. In the foreground at right, a gable of a building carries an advertisement in German mentioning "Wiener Krondorfer Sauerbrunn" and a Trinkhalle (drinking hall).

Black-and-white view of a European town square with a row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings in eclectic and half‑timbered styles. Ground floors host shops and a restaurant; upper floors are residential. A small wooden kiosk or guard hut stands in the open square, along with a tall ornate streetlamp. A few people, including women and children, stand near one of the storefronts. Visible German-language shop signs are on the façades.

Black-and-white image showing a large medieval hilltop complex with two tall, slender towers with steep pointed roofs, part of a fortified structure above a river. Below the fortress are several villas or houses on the riverbank, and the entire scene is reflected clearly in the calm water. Trees frame the right side of the image. The photo has an old, slightly damaged look, and faint handwritten characters appear at the bottom edge of the image.

Colorized historical postcard view of a street corner with a prominent three‑story neoclassical stone building and people walking or with carts on a broad unpaved street. The building has ornate window frames, a small pediment with relief decoration, and signs above the ground floor. Trees and smaller buildings line the side streets. Printed titling in German appears in the upper right corner and on the facade of the building.

Black‑and‑white river view showing a side‑wheel steam tug or paddlesteamer pushing or towing a long barge. In the background, across a wide river, is a small European village with scattered houses and a prominent neo‑Gothic church with a tall pointed spire. The landscape is flat to gently rolling, with fields and a line of trees along the riverbank. No visible caption or border is present on the front.

Colored vintage postcard view of a red-brick belvedere tower and adjoining fortification-like structure surrounded by trees and greenery. In the foreground is an open promenade with people walking, sitting, and a person riding a bicycle, beside a waterfront with a small sailboat. At the top left, printed in red text, it reads "Nijmegen. Belvédère."

The image shows the back side of a mailed postcard. There is a Polish postage stamp depicting a tank and the word "POLSKA," with circular postmarks that read "WARSZAWA." The left margin credits the photographer and mentions Warszawa. The right side has blue handwritten address text to Estonia, USSR. The lower half is filled with blue handwritten message text dated "Warszaw, 18.7.68." The layout is the standard divided back of a mid‑20th‑century postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a long brick military barracks complex lining a tree‑planted street. Several multi‑storey buildings with arched windows and decorative brickwork stretch into the distance behind an iron fence and entrance gate. Small groups of people walk along the unpaved street. At the top left is red printed German text identifying the location as barracks in Chemnitz for the 3rd Royal Saxon Uhlan Regiment No. 21, named after Kaiser Wilhelm, King of Prussia.

Colorized vintage street scene titled "Diekirch – L'Esplanade." It shows a broad tree-lined esplanade or avenue with neatly trimmed trees on both sides, flanked by low-rise European townhouses and shops. A group of children stand in the middle of the road in old-fashioned clothing, while a few adults walk further down the street. On the left is a building with a sign reading "CAFÉ DE L'ESPLANADE." The style and coloration suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Sepia-toned street scene in a European city, showing a relatively narrow, busy street lined with multi-story 19th‑century buildings. Shopfronts and signage in German are visible on both sides. On the left is a large building signed 'HOTEL' with additional German words and a 'SPEISE-SAAL' (dining hall) on the ground floor. Other storefronts display names like 'MARKEL'. Horse-drawn carriages, pedestrians in late 19th or early 20th century clothing, and awnings over shop windows line the street, creating a bustling urban atmosphere. The view looks straight down the street, which recedes into the distance between the tall façades.

A black-and-white postcard view of a waterfront area with several docked passenger boats in the foreground and a large city square with trees and grand stone buildings in the background. One of the prominent buildings looks like a theatre or concert hall. The scene is busy with people walking along the quayside and streets. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Stockholm, Nybroplan, and a publisher imprint appears in the lower-right corner.

A vintage postcard showing a historic field cannon with large wooden wheels mounted on a platform in a landscaped park-like setting. Trees and a low building appear in the background. The card is printed in a sepia tone with red caption text along the bottom and printing/publisher details along the side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a devotional interior scene: a sculptural relief of Christ at the cross with the inscription 'I.N.R.I.' above on a wooden cross. Christ, wearing a crown of thorns and loincloth, leans down from the cross towards a robed figure below, whose draped garments fall in deep folds. The sculpture is mounted on a plain wall; on either side are wall‑mounted candleholders with tall candles and small floral decorations. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom typical of vintage photographic postcards.

Colorized historic view of a European small town street lined with trees and stone posts, leading towards red‑roofed houses and larger buildings in the background. A horse‑drawn cart travels along the unpaved road. In the distance, there is a prominent church or town‑hall tower with a greenish dome and lantern. The word "Königsbrück." is printed in red at the top left.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a planned institutional complex, likely a hospital or barracks, composed of multiple large, symmetric masonry buildings with steep hipped roofs and dormer windows. The complex is arranged around internal courtyards and bordered by fences, with cultivated fields or gardens in the foreground and open countryside in the distance. A broad road runs along the right side, lined with similar buildings. The image has a distinctive trimmed, almost gabled upper border suggesting it was prepared as a postcard or printed view. No visible caption or text appears on the image itself.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a palm-lined public square with a central monument: a tall pedestal topped by a statue, surrounded by trees and greenery. The scene is framed by large palm trunks in the foreground. Greek and English captions are printed at the bottom, along with a website watermark.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a street market scene. In the foreground an Indigenous woman in a dark veil sits on a chair beside a large basket or stall of goods, shaded by an open umbrella. Behind her are market tents, carts, and modest buildings, giving the impression of a busy outdoor bazaar. The edges of the card are scalloped and there is printed French text along the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned group portrait of about fifteen uniformed soldiers standing on the steps in front of a stone building with arched windows. The men wear double‑breasted tunics, kepi-style caps, and carry rifles or swords. At the lower left, a photographer's imprint and town name are visible; more handwritten or printed text and a number appear along the bottom edge.

Black-and-white postcard view of a broad, mostly empty square bordered by late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings. In the center background stands a large, symmetrical three‑storey institutional building with a modestly decorated central entrance and mansard‑style roof, likely a school or municipal facility. Flanking it on both sides are attached townhouses or apartment blocks with shops at street level. A tall, slender pole (possibly for lighting or a flag) rises from the middle of the square. The edges of the image are framed by a white postcard border.

Black-and-white image of a mid‑20th‑century cargo or tanker ship sailing near a coastline. The vessel has a dark hull and white superstructure, with signal flags strung from a mast and smoke faintly visible from the funnel. Low hills and scattered coastal buildings appear hazily in the background across calm water. The ship's name, painted on the bow, reads "JONQUIERES."

Colorized historic street scene showing a wide intersection framed by ornate multi‑story buildings in late 19th–early 20th century style. Pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicles, and shopfronts line the street. At the top is printed text identifying Budapest and the location (Kígyótér with Kossuth Lajos Street) in Hungarian and German. One shop sign reads "LIPP GYULA."

Black‑and‑white view of a large European cobblestone market square with arcaded Baroque and Renaissance townhouses on the left, a hotel on the right, small market stalls with awnings, horse‑drawn carts, and people in early‑20th‑century clothing. In the center of the square stands an ornate Marian or Holy Trinity column with several statues and a fenced base. Tall decorative streetlamps with hanging flower baskets and a wide open sky dominate the scene.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a row of massive round stone defense towers with conical roofs, forming a medieval city wall behind a line of low houses. A road runs along the wall; trees frame the scene in the foreground and on the right hillside. The style resembles an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Vintage sepia multi‑view postcard with decorative floral motifs and a crowned portrait of a woman at the top left. On the right is a view of a wooden bridge or pier leading toward a town skyline with church towers. At the bottom left is a large multi‑storey brick building set among trees and a path, with several people standing in front. Captions identify the scenes as "Nymegen." and "Berg en Dal."

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a bustling town square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with gabled roofs and shop signs. Many people in early 20th‑century clothing gather in the open plaza, with a few carts and streetlamps visible. At the bottom center, the caption reads "Mittweida — Markt".

Sepia-toned postcard showing a wide body of water under a cloudy sky. Long wooden piers or breakwaters extend into the water from the right side, with a few small figures walking along them and a solitary tree near the shore. The scene appears calm and natural, likely an inlet or harbor entrance. In the upper right corner there is printed text in Swedish: "Södra inloppet, Vänersborg."

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a residential street with early 20th‑century multi‑storey tenement houses. In the foreground is a grassy field where several children sit. On the right corner stands a prominent three‑storey building with decorative facade and dormer windows; ground-floor shop signs indicate a bakery and confectionery. A cyclist rides along the unpaved street and two girls walk on the sidewalk. In the distance, industrial buildings and tall chimneys suggest a factory area.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an octagonal Ottoman-style fountain with arches and a domed roof in a courtyard beside a large mosque-like building with arched windows. Several men stand or sit around tables in the foreground, giving a café or public-square atmosphere. French captions are printed at the top left and right, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. In the foreground are ploughed fields leading up to dense clusters of houses with gabled roofs. A prominent church with a baroque-style tower and onion dome rises above the town center. At the top left, in red Gothic-style script, is the printed caption 'Deutsch-Beneschau von Osten' on an otherwise blank sky background.

A vintage colored postcard view of a waterfront scene on the Bosphorus: a small rowboat with a man sits in the foreground on choppy water, while on the opposite shore there is a large building identified as the French Embassy at Therapia, set against a densely wooded hillside. The card has printed caption text in French along the bottom and a publisher credit on the left.

Color postcard-style image showing a peaceful riverside park scene. In the foreground, two women sit on a white bench facing a wide river, with a dog lying beside them and another woman in a yellow headscarf sitting on the grass. Birch trees frame the scene on both sides. Across the river are green fields and a cluster of mid‑20th‑century buildings, including a white multi‑story structure with a central tower and other low-rise residential or institutional buildings, surrounded by trees under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped city garden with lawns, flowerbeds, benches and tall trees. In the background stands a two‑storey classical building with a tiled roof and ornate window frames, approached by a central staircase. A fountain or low circular basin is visible in the middle ground. The edges of the card are deckle‑cut. Along the bottom margin there is printed text in Cyrillic script.

Black‑and‑white panoramic rural landscape showing flat agricultural fields divided by stone fences and hedges, a long straight country road crossing the scene, and scattered farmhouses and buildings in the distance. In the foreground beside the road stands a small, tall utility or signal hut with overhead wires. Low wooded hills rise in the background. In the lower left corner is printed text reading "Parti av Säve." In the lower right corner there is a triangular logo with a number beneath it.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a forest road or trail in a mountainous, coniferous landscape. Tall fir trees line both sides of a dirt path that leads into the distance, with benches and several circular road or hiking signs visible along the roadside. The sky is partly cloudy. A printed caption in German appears in the white margin at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard depicting a town market square with a large open plaza. Surrounding it are multi‑story historic buildings, including a church with a tall pointed spire and clock, and a town hall–like building with a clock tower. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the square. German text is printed at the top left and along the bottom edge.

Color postcard view of a large Gothic-style church with a tall central spire and a red-tiled roof, fronted by a statue on a pedestal in the middle of a landscaped square with flowerbeds and trimmed bushes. Surrounding the square are historic multi-storey buildings with ornate facades and domed roofs. People are walking in the square and cars and a bus are visible on the bordering streets. The scene is taken on a sunny day and looks like a central European city center.

Black‑and‑white aerial view over a lakeside town surrounded by forests and low hills. In the foreground stands a prominent light‑colored church with a tower, set among trees and low wooden buildings. Beyond the town are multiple lakes with islands and peninsulas, and a largely rural landscape. In the lower left corner there is white printed text naming the location.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of large brick barracks‑style buildings on a hill, reflected in a calm body of water in the foreground. Trees and rocky banks surround the water. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a gently curving gravel path or road winding through a dense coniferous forest. Tall trees line both sides of the path, and the scene looks like a quiet woodland walking route in hilly terrain. In the top right area there is red printed text indicating the location and name of the path.

Black-and-white panoramic river scene showing a European town on a hill above a wide, calm river. In the foreground is a rocky, wooded riverbank; on the opposite bank stands an industrial building with a tall smokestack and other riverside structures. A narrow pedestrian or service bridge crosses the river toward a small floating bath-house or pavilion moored midstream. Up on the ridge are dense trees, then a line of 19th‑century townhouses, a large pointed neo‑Gothic church with a tall central spire, and, further right, a compact hilltop castle or fortified complex with towers and curtain walls. The view has the framing, aspect ratio, and wear typical of an early 20th‑century postcard or photographic card.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a rural settlement surrounded by forested hills. In the mid‑ground are several wooden buildings, including a larger two‑storey house and smaller farm or guesthouse structures, beside a calm pond or small river. A wooden fence runs along the foreground with rocks and a dirt road, and there are a few small figures near the water. At the top left, printed text reads "Fagernæs, Ringsaker".

Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside city with a bridge over the river, historic buildings and church towers in the foreground, and a fortified hill crowned by walls and a clock tower in the background. Printed captions at the bottom identify the subject as Graz and the Schlossberg by the Mur River.

Colorized panoramic view of a town at the base of a large, tree‑covered hill or mountain. Low buildings with red and light roofs are scattered among many trees and fields in the foreground. Dirt roads and open countryside occupy the very front of the image. At the top right there is printed text in a serif font that appears to be the caption of the postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal fortress complex on a low shoreline. The fort projects into the sea with high walls and a flagpole, and several long, low buildings and a larger house-like structure with a veranda stand inside or beside the walls. The scene is quiet, with no people visible, and the sea stretches out to the left. Printed captions in Portuguese appear at the top, identifying the location and the fort.

Black-and-white view over a coastal town and harbor taken from above a large stone fortress. The foreground shows thick defensive walls with arched windows and an adjacent long building. Beyond the fort lie clustered houses, boats and small islands in a rugged archipelago landscape. The word "MARSTRAND." is printed in the lower left and a small triangular publisher's mark with the number 2106 appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a snowy alpine landscape. Gently rounded, treeless slopes fill most of the scene, covered in deep snow. In the foreground are several snow‑laden conifer trees casting long shadows. On the left stands a small alpine chalet or hut partly buried in snow. Thin poles or fence posts with wire lines run across the slopes, and faint ski tracks or a simple tow line are visible climbing toward a ridge on the right. The print has a white border with slightly deckled edges, typical of vintage postcards.

Color photograph of a medieval hilltop castle rising from a steep, forested rocky hill in a wide alpine valley. Terraced fields climb partway up the slope, with a green meadow in the foreground and high, blue mountains in the background under a mostly clear sky. No visible caption or writing is present on the image side.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large neo-Renaissance academic building complex with multiple wings and ornate roofs along a wide, empty street. At the top, the word "Budapest." appears, followed by multilingual captions identifying the building as the "New Polytechnic" in Hungarian, German, French, and English.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a railway yard with multiple tracks and overhead electric lines. An electric locomotive with carriages stands to the right. Behind it are wooden houses and buildings, with a snow‑covered hill or mine dump rising in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge in Swedish.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick school building with multiple rows of tall arched windows, a tiled roof, and a small clock tower topped with a weather vane. A wooden fence and bare trees stand in front of the building. At the bottom of the image there is printed text identifying the location as a Mittelschule (middle school) in Neu Petershain, district of Calau.

Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a rainy street scene with German troops marching in formation through a city. A military band leads the procession, followed by soldiers on foot, mounted troops on horseback, and early motor vehicles. Large crowds with umbrellas line both sides of the street, watching the parade. Leafless trees and multi‑story stone buildings frame the street. German caption text is printed at the top.

A black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a crowd gathered on a snowy square in front of a large stone church with steep metal roof and small spires. People in winter clothing stand around market stalls, horse‑drawn carts and sleighs, suggesting a fair or market day. Bare trees surround the church. Handwritten-style white text along the bottom reads "Påsklördagsmarknad, Piteå Gamlestad".

A black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) image showing a crowd gathered in front of a brick building with a central tower decorated with flags and bunting. People in early 20th‑century clothing watch from the ground and from a balcony draped with the Union Jack. The printed red caption in the upper right corner reads "Opening of the Mildura Public Library." The right side of the card is left blank, likely for message or address space.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm pond or small lake bordered by trees and a promenade. Several rowboats are moored along the bank and one person is rowing a small boat in the foreground. On the right stands a round pavilion or kiosk with many windows. People stroll or sit along the waterside path, with buildings visible through the trees in the background. At the bottom left, a caption in cursive identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small wooden church building with a metal roof topped by simple crosses, surrounded by a picket fence. Behind the church stands a separate wooden belfry or bell tower among trees. The upper border carries the handwritten word "Uppland." At the bottom, a label identifies the place as "Björkö-Arholma, Upl." The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century Scandinavian rural church scene.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a small Russian Orthodox-style chapel with a striped facade and a golden onion dome topped by a cross. The chapel sits on a raised platform with steps and an iron fence around it, on a cobblestone square with a few surrounding low buildings. At the top of the card there is printed text identifying the place.

Black-and-white postcard image of an old rural church with multiple tall, pointed wooden spires and a separate wooden bell tower on the right. The church has whitewashed stone walls, steep roofs, and arched windows, surrounded by trees. In the bottom left corner, caption text identifies the church.

Vintage colorized postcard showing a large public square filled with people walking and gathering. In the background stand neoclassical buildings with arcades and balconies, palm trees, and a broad open plaza in front. The left side features a larger civic-style building. The right and lower margins are covered with handwritten correspondence. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the location.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large, multi‑storey building complex with red mansard roofs and light stone façades, enclosed by a wall and gatehouse. In front of the entrance stand numerous uniformed soldiers, some on horseback, suggesting a military facility or barracks. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds, and tall trees flank the gate. Printed German text appears at the top identifying the location and the military function of the building.

Multi-view black‑and‑white postcard showing different scenes of an outdoor municipal swimming pool complex with lawns and trees. One central image features a decorative frog fountain sculpture. Other panels depict children playing in shallow water, people sunbathing on the grass next to the pool, and general views of the pool basins, ladders, and surrounding park-like grounds. The caption at the bottom reads "Stadtbad Meißen."

A monochrome postcard-style image showing a heraldic composition. Two men in historical mining uniforms with feathered hats flank a large coat of arms. The shield bears a beehive surrounded by bees and crossed mining hammers above it, all framed with floral garlands. Above the figures appears the curved inscription "BERGSTADT BRAND." Decorative vines border the upper part, and a low ornamental fence with flowers runs along the bottom.

Vintage monochrome illustrated postcard showing a hilly landscape with a town in a valley and a prominent hilltop castle or fortress. In the foreground are figures on horseback and people walking near trees and rocks. The town has a church with a tall tower and clustered houses. Decorative German text panels frame the image, and stylized script in a cartouche identifies the scene as Badenweiler under the rule of Margrave Georg Friedrich (1595–1638), with additional German captions along the sides and bottom.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large, stately two‑storey building with a central gabled section, classical entrance porch with columns, and a manicured garden in front. The architecture suggests an early 20th‑century institutional or villa‑style building. At the bottom of the image there is printed text identifying the location as "Neupetershain Kr. Calau - Barbarastift."

Vintage tinted photograph of a long two‑storey public building with wooden arcades and decorative railings, seen from the street. Several men stand on the sidewalk and under the arches. Leafless trees line the street. The bottom margin of the card has printed captions indicating the town and the building (a prefecture/administrative office).

Black‑and‑white multi-view postcard divided into four panels showing a small rural European village. The views include an elevated panorama of the village and surrounding fields, a church with a tower and clock, a village square with a pond and ducks bordered by traditional houses, and another wide view over the clustered rooftops. The captions in German read "Zadel", "Kirche", "Dorfplatz", and "Totalansicht".

Colorized vintage view of an organized campground or caravan park. Tents and several 1950s-style cars are parked on grassy plots along a dirt path leading to a small central service building with a covered veranda. Mature trees line both sides of the path, and a few people in casual summer clothing move around the campsite. The sky is bright blue with scattered clouds. No visible printed captions or border text appear on the image side.

An illustrated maritime postcard showing a large three‑masted sailing ship in rough seas. The vessel has cream‑colored sails and a dark hull. At the stern there is a small cluster of flags on a mast, including what appears to be a Swedish flag and several signal flags. The sky is cloudy and stormy, and there is a hint of coastline or a lighthouse in the far right background. At the bottom edge of the image there is a caption identifying the ship and its captain.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a statue of an emperor in a long cloak, standing on a tall pedestal in a city square surrounded by historic buildings. The pedestal bears an inscription in Latin and the foreground has a low fence with chains. Printed captions below the image identify the monument and the city, and a publisher line appears along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, rectangular, three‑storey classical building with a dark roof and many evenly spaced windows, fronted by a broad cobblestone square. Trees partially frame the building on both sides, and small figures walk across the open square. Printed caption text appears along the bottom left, and a small triangular publisher's logo with a number is at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white view over a large cobblestoned town square bordered by 3‑ to 4‑storey historic buildings with gabled roofs. The facades bear large German inscriptions, including a dairy, distillation business, and a hotel named "Hotel zum Goldenen Engel". Horse‑drawn carts and a few pedestrians stand on the square, which has a small group of trees and a lamp post in the center. Behind the town stretches a gently rolling agricultural landscape with scattered farmhouses.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street leading into a fortified military complex with earthen ramparts and long barracks-like buildings. A few people walk along the road and on the bridge over a moat; there is a large tree in the foreground and a vaulted gate on the left. Printed German text appears along the bottom, with additional handwritten notes in red and gray pencil or ink.

Black‑and‑white view over a small European town. In the foreground are gardens, trees, wooden fences and half‑timbered farm buildings with steep tiled roofs. Behind them stands a compact cluster of houses. Dominating the skyline is a large church with a tall, slender spire and Baroque-style tower rising from a broad nave roof. The image has a wide white sky area and looks like an early 20th‑century photographic postcard of a rural townscape.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide boulevard lined with ornate 19th‑century buildings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and some horse-drawn vehicles move along the street. A large building dominates the scene with a rooftop advertisement reading "HUNTER WHISKY." In the foreground is an ornate kiosk or small pavilion. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Andrássy út in Budapest in both Hungarian and German.

A monochrome historical street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑storey residential buildings in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century style. A tram and a horse‑drawn carriage travel along tracks in the center of the street; pedestrians stand on the sidewalks, including adults and children with a pram. Leafless trees line the right side. At the top in red print is the caption "Chemnitz-Kaßberg Weststrasse". Shop signs on the buildings include a prominent corner pharmacy sign reading "APOTHEKE" and "Kassberg-Apotheke".

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone building in a historicist style, with steep tiled roofs, arched windows and an elaborate sculptural program. A prominent corner niche holds a tall standing figure above a seated figure, and a richly decorated arched window with reliefs runs beside it. There is an arcaded loggia on the right, and tram or trolley wires run across the scene above a cobblestone street.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European townscape with a large hill in the foreground. Dominating the right side is a medieval castle complex with two tall, pointed-roof towers and a central building, surrounded by trees. In the background to the left, the town of Rochlitz is visible with church spires and clustered houses. At the top left in orange lettering is the printed caption "Schloß Rochlitz i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an old stone building with thick plastered walls and a steeply pitched tiled roof, likely part of a small castle or fortified manor. The structure has small rectangular windows with bars and an irregular, slightly rounded corner tower. In the foreground is a low arched stone bridge over a narrow stream, with leafless trees and simple wooden railings surrounding the approach to the building. The image has a white border and slight wear along the edges, consistent with early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed captions or handwriting appear on the front.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a park with a waterway in the foreground, trees along the bank, a large round medieval brick tower with crenellations on the left, and an ornate mansion-like building on a hill in the background. Below the image is printed caption text identifying the park and city, and small publisher information at the bottom.

A two-panel color postcard. The upper image shows a modern brick railway-station building with flower pots, benches, a tall black metal clock tower, and mid‑rise apartment blocks in the background. The entrance has shopfront windows and signage above the door. The lower image shows the adjacent rail yard of the same station with multiple tracks, platforms connected by covered pedestrian bridges, freight wagons, and surrounding residential buildings. In the center between the two images the caption reads "Borlänge station".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, straight boulevard lined with uniform multi‑story buildings and pruned trees on both sides. A tram runs along tracks in the center of the street, with pedestrians and a few people standing along the sidewalks. The style suggests an early 20th‑century urban scene. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location as Boulevard Hamidié in Salonique (Thessaloniki).

Black-and-white postcard-style portrait of a middle‑aged man in a suit holding a large accordion. Across the upper-right and lower-right parts of the image there is a handwritten dedication and a signature with a date.

Color postcard showing a light-colored, modernist civic building with a central clock tower and slate roof, set behind a large, manicured lawn and garden. People are walking on paths in the foreground, and several 1950s–1960s style cars are parked along the building. The scene is framed by trees under a bright blue sky.

Rectangular gallery announcement card with minimalist typography. It advertises an exhibition at Barbara Krakow Gallery, listing featured artists Alex Katz, Sarah Morris, and Ed Ruscha, along with additional artists under a 'Print Publisher's Spotlight / Solo Impression' heading. Dates of the exhibition and the gallery's contact information, address in Boston, Massachusetts, phone, fax, email, and website appear. Large vertical and horizontal text spells out 'BARBARA KRAKOW GALLERY.' Background is plain light color, no photograph or illustration.

A vintage black-and-white photographic postcard showing a steep rocky hillside with bare trees and stone retaining walls on the left, and old stone or brick rooftops and chimneys of town buildings on the right. The composition looks up toward the Schlossberg hill above the historic town. Printed German text appears in a decorative serif font beneath the image, with a publisher credit and date.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand villa-like building with towers and timber‑frame details, labeled "Waldschlösschen", situated in a landscaped park with paths, flowerbeds, and trees, backed by a forested hillside. The left half contains the photograph; the right half is blank for writing. German captions are printed in red at the top and bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled among trees and rolling fields. In the foreground are tightly packed gabled houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; some facades carry commercial signs. A tall, slender church with a spire stands on a gentle hill to the right, dominating the skyline. In the distance, an industrial complex with a high smokestack rises among more trees and open countryside. The overall scene suggests a turn‑of‑the‑century Central European town. One clearly visible sign on a building reads something like "Marien‑Apotheke," indicating a pharmacy.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a row of ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villas along an unpaved street. The houses have steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, bay windows, balconies, and decorative facades typical of Central European architecture. At the top of the image there is printed text indicating the location.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing ornate funerary and religious monuments inside a cathedral. Various stone and marble wall monuments with sculptures, inscriptions, and reliefs line the interior wall. At the bottom is printed red text identifying the scene, and there is cursive handwritten text across the lower margin. The style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a small pavilion with Moorish-style arches and slender columns standing in a wooded park. Several people are visible near or inside the structure. Printed captions in Russian, French, and German identify the scene and publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a historic hammer mill or smithy. The scene includes a large stone furnace, many tongs and tools hanging on the wall, anvils, heavy hammer mechanisms and wooden beams under a high pitched roof. The edges of the card are scalloped, typical of vintage postcards. At the bottom is a printed caption in German that identifies the place and its construction date.

Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a small riverside town. In the foreground, a calm river with a rowboat carrying two people and a long barge or boat along the bank. On the far bank, there is a partially ruined brick building on the left and, to the right, a stone church with a tall steeple topped by a cross. A stone arch bridge crosses the river next to the church; pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the bridge. Modest houses and trees stand behind the church. The overall look is early‑20th‑century rural Europe.

Old sepia-toned street view of a quiet town with cobblestone paving and wooden one- to two‑storey buildings lining both sides. Utility poles run along the street, and a low, long wooden building with a mansard-like curved gable stands prominently on the right corner. A few people are visible in the distance. The architecture is northern European and early 20th century in style. Some small shop signs are visible in the windows of the corner building, but they are difficult to read.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a view along a tree-lined dirt road leading up a hill toward a large medieval hilltop castle complex. The castle has a tall square tower and a steeply pitched roof, surrounded by dense trees and foliage. Printed text in German appears in the upper right corner, identifying the location as Schloss Scharfenstein in the Erzgebirge region.

Vintage sepia postcard featuring a black‑and‑white photograph of a sculpted Gorgon/Medusa head with a wide grimacing smile and stylized hair. Beneath the image there is printed bilingual captioning in Greek and French identifying the subject, plus publisher information along the right edge. Postal stamps and a handwritten signature appear at the bottom, reinforcing its use as a mailed postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage street scene showing a gently curving cobblestone road lined with two‑story houses and shops. Several people, including women and children, walk along the street; one woman pushes a pram. Large trees overhang the right side of the road. Printed caption text at the top identifies the town and street. A shop sign on the left reads "Bäckerei Emil Paul."

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural valley landscape with rolling hills and scattered wooden houses or cabins. A tree and grassy slope are in the foreground; in the middle distance a curved dirt road and fenced fields lead to a small settlement of low buildings nestled in the valley. The right side of the card is largely blank, likely reserved for writing. Russian text is printed along the top.

Vintage sepia postcard showing an arched stone cloister with vaulted ceilings and repetitive columns. To the right there is a long printed Spanish text block headed with the title identifying the cloister of the university in Santiago de Compostela.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural scene with a pond in the foreground, a small wooden footbridge leading to a farm-like building on the right, and trees partially hiding a large manor or castle-like building in the background. At the top, red printed text reads "Hasenpoth Altes Schloss."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tall tower with crenellated balconies connected by an arched stone bridge over a sloping road and wooded parkland. Bare trees suggest late autumn or winter. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and publisher.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet town street. The scene shows a gently curving main road lined with two‑ and three‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and decorative facades. On the right is a larger civic-looking building marked as the town hall and post office; on the left are residential houses and fences. A child with a small cart or pram stands in the middle of the street, while a few adults walk along the sidewalks. The printed caption at the top in red German text identifies the location as Grünhainichen, specifically the main street with the town hall and post office.

Sepia-toned photograph of a stone statue of a bearded man in rustic clothes and hat, holding a lantern and standing on a high pedestal beside an arched medieval-style doorway. The doorway has rich Romanesque-style carvings around it and a dark wooden door with small decorative studs. A cobblestone street lies in the foreground, and a shop window with various goods is visible on the right edge. The building façade appears old and worn, with a barred window to the left and a smaller modern window above.

Black-and-white postcard view over a large complex of multi-storey brick buildings with tiled roofs, laid out around internal courtyards. The caption at the bottom identifies the site as the Saxon State Police School in Meissen and its officials' houses (Blocks I and II). The complex is surrounded by trees and fields, with a broad rural landscape and distant town and factory chimneys visible on the horizon. A red handwritten reference number is visible at the top right.

Sepia-toned street-and-canal view labeled at the bottom. On the right are tall brick residential buildings with rounded corners and many windows; one ground-floor business has a sign reading "RIJN-BAR". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk and a cart stands in the street. On the left side runs a quayside along a broad canal with moored boats and distant bridges. The captions "Amsterdam" and "Amstelkade" identify the location.

Black-and-white aerial or elevated view of a formal city park with a circular fountain, radiating paths, lawns, and many trees. In the background stand multi‑story urban buildings and factory chimneys. At the bottom margin there is printed text identifying the scene as Aleksanterin kirkkopuisto in Tampere.

Sepia-toned historic postcard view of a European city square labeled "Aussig. Franz Josefs-Platz." The image shows a large landscaped park with many trees, paths, and a central green area. Surrounding the park are ornate multi-story 19th‑century buildings with elaborate facades and mansard roofs. In the foreground there is a utility pole with multiple insulators and visible tram tracks along the street to the right. Hills or low mountains appear in the distant background.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a calm river landscape with reeds in the foreground and tree‑lined banks stretching into the distance. On the left bank some small buildings or houses are faintly visible. At the bottom center of the image there is a printed caption in German.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a musical ensemble on a stage. Several male musicians in embroidered folk-style jackets sit and stand with instruments, including violins and a drum set. The large bass drum in the center carries Cyrillic writing, and there is a faint caption strip along the bottom margin with additional Cyrillic text.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a well‑dressed woman and man standing beside a river or lake in a rural setting. The woman wears a long dark skirt, blouse, and large hat with feathers; the man is in a suit and tie, holding a long pole as if for boating. A small wooden boat lies at the water's edge near a large tree stump. In the background are trees in bloom and a small house or cottage. The lower margin contains handwritten text in a cursive script.

Black‑and‑white postcard image showing women working in a vineyard in traditional rural clothing, bent over the vines with baskets and jugs beside them. In the distant background, across the vineyard and above a line of townhouses, stands a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and spires on a hill, next to an extensive monastery or palace‑like complex. The sky area above the cathedral is partly overpainted or damaged, leaving a white blotch.

An old black‑and‑white photograph of a large three‑storey building with a central pediment and steep tiled roof, likely a school or civic building. The façade has many tall rectangular windows with external sunshades and a rusticated stone ground floor. In front is an open square or schoolyard with several young boys and girls standing and walking, some in darker city clothing and others in light, possibly regional or folk-style dress. Small trees line the edge of the square.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town nestled in wooded hills. The town has dense historic buildings, a church tower, and prominent villas on the hillside. At the bottom edge there are trees and a small pavilion in a park. Decorative red script text is printed along the lower margin, and a red handwritten number appears in the top‑right corner.

Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) winter view over snow‑covered rooftops of a small European town. Dominating the scene on the right is a large Gothic-style church with a tall clock tower and multiple slender spires. In the background are additional towers and chimneys. The word "Lommatzsch." is printed in the upper left corner in a simple serif font.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a long Renaissance-style brick building with many tall windows and sculpted statues on its façade. People walk and cycle along a cobbled street with tram tracks in the foreground. At the bottom of the image there is a printed caption indicating the location.

Illustrated postcard showing a historic stone castle with a large round tower, crenellated walls, and surrounding buildings, set against a mountainous backdrop at sunset. At the top it is labeled in Italian with the city name and the castle name. Along the left side is a vertical printed caption and on the right the printer/publisher's details. At the bottom is a circular medallion with a portrait of a man in profile and Latin text around it, and beneath that an area filled with handwritten Italian text and a date.

Sepia-toned postcard reproduction of a large Gothic-style mural or altarpiece inside an ornate hall. The upper part shows a dramatic narrative scene framed by pointed arches: on the left, a man restrains a young figure while a kneeling woman pleads; on the right, a cloaked figure climbs a steep wall outside, with tall medieval buildings and a moonlit sky in the background. The lower portion shows a richly patterned frieze and a row of intricately carved high-backed wooden chairs lining the wall, suggesting a ceremonial or council chamber. The overall ambience is medieval and Central European.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Craftsman‑style mansion or institutional building set far back behind an expansive manicured lawn. The scene is framed by mature trees and a palm in the foreground, with a concrete sidewalk running across the bottom of the image. The building has multiple gabled dormers, wide eaves, and many windows, giving it an early 20th‑century American residential or hotel appearance. Along the bottom edge there is faint, reversed handwriting or numbering.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a rustic half‑timbered inn or guesthouse in a wooded setting. Two adjoining buildings with timber framing, brick lower walls, and shuttered windows stand among tall trees. Simple wooden tables and benches are placed outside on a dirt courtyard, suggesting an outdoor beer garden or café. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing—men in work aprons or suits, and women in long skirts and aprons—stand near the entrances and along the building front. Small wall signs and posters are visible on the façade, but the text is mostly too small to read.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a spa town nestled in wooded hills. In the foreground are multi-story houses with steep, gabled roofs and many windows; one rooftop bears the word "LONDON". Behind them stand ornate, classical spa buildings with domes and colonnades, chimneys, and tree-lined promenades. The town rises up the hillside with grand hotels and a church-like building visible against the forested background. The caption "Marienbad." is printed in red at the top center.

Color postcard view of an alpine village in a valley surrounded by forested mountains. In the foreground are winding paths through grassy hills leading toward large chalet-style buildings with red-tiled roofs and dark shutters. To the right stands a stone church with a tall bell tower and spire. The scene is framed like a classic tourist postcard, and the caption at the top identifies the place and elevation.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town street. Children stand in groups along a curved road lined with modest multi‑story houses and fenced yards. Low hills or forested slopes rise in the background. Printed German text at the top labels the location and identifies one of the buildings.

Black‑and‑white waterfront scene of a fishing harbor with small wooden boats moored along a wooden quay. Several men walk along the pier among nets and fishing gear. Traditional wooden houses and boathouses with tiled roofs line the water. The image has printed caption text at the bottom left and a small triangular logo with a number at the bottom right, typical of vintage postcards.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard with an illustration of an armed, bearded landsknecht-style soldier holding a large sword and flag beside a cannon on the left, and a finely drawn panoramic view of a city with a hill crowned by fortifications or a tower on the right. Gothic script text reads a greeting from Graz, Austria, with ornate decorative lettering.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small town surrounded by forests, fields, and low hills, with a lake or wide river in the background. The foreground is filled with coniferous trees, and scattered houses and industrial buildings occupy the valley below. In the lower left the caption reads "Brumunddal" with a small number sequence before it, and in the lower right there is a cursive signature or publisher mark reading "Normann". The overall appearance resembles a mid‑20th‑century landscape postcard.

Black‑and‑white/sepia postcard showing a brick building and several simple barracks‑style wooden houses in the background. In the foreground stands a group of Austro‑Hungarian military officers in uniform, some holding or wearing sabres, one saluting. A man in civilian clothes stands at the steps of the brick building. German text in red print at the upper right refers to Exzellenz Albert von Koller, corps commander and commanding general of the 8th Corps at the k.u.k. military camp Milowitz.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a European spa town with a river or canal running through the middle, crossed by several small bridges. Tree‑lined streets and historic multi‑story buildings with ornate facades flank the waterway. In the foreground there are tram tracks, overhead wires, a tram stop shelter, and a few pedestrians. Hilly, wooded terrain with villas rises in the background. Printed caption text at the bottom reads: "BADEN-BADEN. Blick vom Bayrischen Hof".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a statue on a high pedestal surrounded by historic gabled buildings. The scene is labelled as Place Jean Van Eyck and the canal in Bruges. Printed text appears along the bottom and left side, and there is a handwritten signature on the right.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a residential street lined with small trees and large villas in front of wooded, terraced hills with vineyards and scattered buildings in the background. The caption at the top reads "Radebeul. Roseggerstraße," indicating a view of Roseggerstraße in the town of Radebeul. The overall style and printing suggest an early‑20th‑century European postcard.

A monochrome panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a wooded valley. Steep forested hills fill the background. In the middle distance a church with a tall spire rises above the trees, and scattered houses with steep gabled roofs occupy the lower slopes and valley floor. Dense vegetation and garden plots are visible in the foreground. The edges of the image are slightly darkened and worn, as with an old photographic postcard. No printed caption or writing is visible.

A multi‑view color postcard with three photographs. The large left image shows a park with people sitting and relaxing around a tall monument topped by a winged angel statue, surrounded by lush trees. The upper-right image shows a stone lion sculpture on a pedestal, set against greenery and blue sky. The lower-right image shows a busy city intersection with cyclists and pedestrians in front of a tall stone column monument; modern buildings line the streets around it. The word "NIJMEGEN" is printed in red between the right-hand images.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a corner building labeled as an inn or guesthouse, a two‑storey structure with many windows and a tiled gabled roof. A lone person stands on the street in front. The lower image shows an elegant interior dining room with round and square tables covered with white cloths, wooden chairs, wall paneling, chandeliers, lamps, and a tiled stove. Between the images and below them is German cursive text giving the inn's name, proprietor, and description of the wine bar.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a seated statue on a tall plinth in a landscaped park, surrounded by tall conifer trees. The base of the statue is inscribed with the word 'HAMERLING'. At the bottom border in print are the words 'GRAZ' on the left and 'Hamerling-Denkmal' on the right. There is a handwritten message in cursive German across the lower margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia view down a cobblestone street lined with multi‑storey townhouses on both sides. A few pedestrians, including a child, walk along the right sidewalk. In the distance, towers of a church or town building rise above the roofs. At the top of the image, red printed text identifies the location as Kamenz in Saxony and the specific street as Kirchstraße.

Black‑and‑white postcard view framed by trees, looking down from a wooded hill onto a historic European city with a dominant Gothic cathedral featuring a tall, ornate spire and large nave. Rooftops of the old town spread around the church, with hills visible in the background. Handwritten-style caption appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a long metal truss bridge over a wide, mostly dry riverbed in a barren landscape with low hills in the background. The scene is minimal, focusing on the bridge structure stretching horizontally across the image. There is printed text in Greek at the lower left and in English at the lower right, and a round emblem plus a website watermark near the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white printed postcard showing a panorama of the town of Gersdorf near Chemnitz. In the foreground are timber-framed and smaller houses, behind them a large multi‑storey school building with many windows, and further to the right a tall neo‑Gothic church with a slender spire and clock tower. The landscape in the background is rural fields. The caption in red German text is at the top, and the printer's credit and year appear at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white seaside view showing a large, elegant, Mediterranean-style building with arched loggias along a promenade. In the foreground there are stone terraces and railings leading down to a narrow beach. To the right is a calm bay with small waterfront structures on stilts, and in the background are low, barren hills under a sky with scattered clouds. The word "NOVI" is printed in the top-left corner.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a hillside spa town scene. In the foreground are small townhouses along a street at the bottom of a slope. Above them, on the wooded hillside, stands a large ornate building with turrets, balconies, and half-timbered decorative elements, labeled as a café. A tall chimney rises behind the complex. Printed caption text appears at the top left.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑framed elevated view over the rooftops of a historic European town. In the middle distance stands a white stepped‑gabled house with German signage on its facade, and further back are dense roofs, larger civic buildings and a church tower on the hill. The right side has a blank margin with printed red title text at the top and publisher information at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large group of men and boys standing on snow with skis and sleds. They wear dark uniforms and caps, and there are large ice‑sailing boats with tall masts and sails in the background on a frozen surface, likely a lake. Printed text below the image reads "Sportverein Kaiserwald." The lower margin contains handwritten text in old German script.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of an industrial complex on a wooded shoreline with factories, a tall smokestack, piles of raw material, and several buildings. The site is surrounded by forest and water in a coastal or lakeside landscape. Caption text at the bottom left identifies the place as "Nensjö Cellulosa A. B., Språngsviken." A photographer/publisher credit appears at the bottom right.

Black-and-white postcard view of a traditional wooden house with a steep tiled roof, central entrance porch and dormer windows. The house is surrounded by trees and a lawn, and the image has a white border. Printed captions identify the place and photographer at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a narrow valley. In the foreground are dense clusters of masonry houses and industrial buildings with steep gabled roofs and small rectangular windows, plus a tall brick chimney. A church or chapel with a modest spire stands among the houses. In the middle and background, detached villas and larger houses dot a wooded hillside, with fields and trees covering the slopes. Forested hills rise on both sides of the valley under an empty sky. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town square with a large Renaissance-style town hall on the left and a massive twin‑towered Gothic church on the right. In front of the town hall stands an ornate fountain or monument, and the square is bordered by several narrow merchants' houses with awnings and shop signs. The signs on the facades are in German, advertising gold and silverware, furs and clothing, and a café. The overall scene appears early‑20th‑century, with a mostly empty cobblestoned square and a few small carts and pedestrians.

A sepia-toned panoramic view of a mountain town in a valley with large snow-covered peaks in the background. The top of the image is labeled with the town name and valley, altitude, and the names and elevations of surrounding mountain peaks. The lower half shows dense traditional buildings and a church tower, likely the historic center, with open fields and a rail or road viaduct in the distance.

Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by substantial historic buildings. Dominating the scene is a long, multi‑storey structure with steep tiled roofs, dormer windows, and a prominent clock‑tower with a spire to the left, plus another tall church‑like tower with a spire to the right. At street level are arched entrances with staircases, and several shop signs on the ground floor. A few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the otherwise empty square; a handcart stands on the right edge of the image. The composition and wide foreground suggest it was intended as a postcard view of the main square and town hall of a central‑European town.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a park with a pond and fountain in the foreground, trees and walking paths, and a large round medieval brick tower in the background. Swans are visible on the water and a small bridge crosses the pond. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and publisher, as well as the city name.

A black‑and‑white, slightly damaged postcard-like print showing a wide street or square bordered by large institutional or civic buildings in a European architectural style. On the left is an older, castle‑like structure with a steep roof, small round corner tower, and simpler facades, connected to adjoining multi‑story buildings. Leafless trees and a low wall surround a park-like open area, with a single streetlamp in the foreground. On the right is a more ornate, 19th‑century neoclassical or historicist building with arched windows and a rusticated ground floor, facing an open, largely empty street. The two halves of the image appear to be from a panoramic photograph mounted on a backing card; the top and right edges are torn, revealing blank paper beneath. Handwritten text appears faintly along the bottom margin, possibly a place name and date, but is not fully legible.

Black‑and‑white street scene of a European town with cobblestone road, 2‑ to 3‑storey plastered houses with tiled roofs and dormer windows. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. On the right is a corner building with shuttered windows and a large painted sign reading "Deutsche Schänke", suggesting a German tavern. Further down the street are more ornate late‑19th‑century façades. The image has the framing and proportions typical of an old photographic postcard.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a rural village in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are ploughed fields and a road lined with small trees where a few people and a cart or animals are visible. In the middle distance stand scattered village houses, some half-timbered, along with a tall industrial chimney emitting smoke. Further back, a church tower rises among trees and more buildings, giving the impression of a small German village and its castle and church. Red printed German text appears at the top of the card.

An aerial color view of a small European town in a narrow green valley, surrounded by forested hills. The town has dense clusters of red‑tiled roofs, white houses, a visible church tower, and a railway line with tracks and a station running through the center. The surrounding landscape is composed of patchwork fields and meadows bordered by woods. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view over a river valley with a town stretching along both banks. The foreground shows villas with red roofs, trees, fields and a tall industrial chimney by the river. In the distance are dense town buildings, church towers and larger institutional blocks on the hills. The title text in red at the top left reads "Waldheim im Zschopautale."

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall cylindrical Romanesque bell tower made of brick, attached to a cathedral complex. Surrounding it are older stone buildings with arched windows and tiled roofs, and a domed structure on the right. The word "Ravenna" appears at the top left, and below the image is the caption "Campanile del Duomo." At the bottom are the printer's details and a circular stamp-like mark with the letters "M.C.T."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with a path leading to a tall, multi-storey clock or bell tower with a domed roof and lantern topped by a finial. Trees surround the tower, and there is a pavilion or kiosk on the right with chairs or benches arranged outdoors. A man in a suit and hat stands on the path in the foreground. Handwritten text appears along the bottom margin.

A colored illustrated postcard showing a lively leisure scene by a lake at the edge of a forest. In the foreground is a large pavilion-like building with towers, surrounded by people strolling, a horse-drawn carriage, and a tram. On the lake, several small boats are being rowed. Behind the lake rises a densely forested hill with a tall lookout tower on its summit. The style suggests an early-20th-century Central European resort setting. The caption at the top reads 'Graz. Hilmteich.' and the artist's credit and date appear at the bottom left.

A vintage black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a formally posed couple. The woman stands on the left in a light-colored, high‑waisted dress with layered necklaces and her hand resting on the man's shoulder. The man sits on the right in a dark naval or military-style uniform with epaulettes and decorative braid. Below the image there is printed text in Greek and French identifying them. The style is early‑20th‑century royal portraiture.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a small town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground are fenced gardens and trees; behind them stand several gabled houses and other village buildings. At the right, a steam train with smoke billowing from its locomotive crosses on a slightly elevated track near the houses. The scene opens onto rolling fields and wooded hills in the background. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Geising in the Saxon Ore Mountains and refers to the town park (Stadtpark).

Black‑and‑white view of a European small‑town street and square. On the left stands a grand late‑19th‑century corner hotel or villa with ornate façades and a sign reading "PARZIVAL" on the roofline. Shopfronts occupy the ground floor. On the right is a simpler gabled house with commercial signs painted along the walls, and a metal utility pole in the foreground. Several adults and children in early‑20th‑century clothing stand in the cobbled street. Low hills or forest rise in the background.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a Romanesque side entrance of a cathedral. The portal has an arched roof supported by columns, with sculpted lions at the base and additional animal statues on top of the canopy. The stone façade and cobblestone pavement are visible, and the border of the image has a scalloped edge typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards. At the bottom there is a printed caption in Italian.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Italian square framed by an archway. At the center stands an ornate fountain topped by a statue holding a trident, in front of a Romanesque cathedral with a rose window, arcades, and a tall octagonal dome. To the left are old multi‑story buildings with shutters and a crenellated medieval palace with a tower. Pedestrians walk around the open square. Handwritten-style caption text appears along the bottom border.
