Vintage black‑and‑white panorama of a rural European village set among low rolling hills and trees, with a small pond or river in the foreground and clustered houses, farm buildings, and a church-like structure on the slopes. The lower margin contains printed red text naming the place and publisher information.

Vintage black‑and‑white winter view over a snow‑covered European city nestled in a valley, with hills in the background. In the foreground on the right stands a small chapel or wayside shrine on a slope, beside a winding path with railings and trees dusted with snow. The rooftops of the town and industrial chimneys are visible below. A printed caption in German runs along the bottom border of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a railway station with a wooden two‑storey building and platform in the foreground. Several sets of train tracks run across the image, with a low freight wagon and a railway worker standing near luggage or cargo on the platform. Behind the station are residential buildings with steep roofs. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location.

A vintage sepia-toned street scene showing a bustling market with tented stalls on the left and multi‑story buildings lining a narrow street. Horse-drawn carts and pedestrians move along the street, and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town. Red printed captions appear at the bottom of the image identifying the location and street name.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a mid‑20th‑century European city in a valley, with a river or canal running through the center, several bridges, blocks of modernist apartment buildings along the water, denser older low‑rise buildings and church towers in the historic core, and hills or low mountains in the background. Part of an airplane wing is visible at the top right, reinforcing the bird's‑eye perspective. No visible printed caption or text can be seen on the image side.

Black‑and‑white image showing a group of Native American riders on horseback in traditional dress, including feathered headdresses, blankets, and beadwork. They are posed in a line facing the camera on open ground with trees in the background, with two standing figures at the edges. The photograph is bordered like an old print and has a faint, reversed handwritten identifier along the top edge.

Colorized historic view of a bustling European town square filled with market stalls under white umbrellas around a central monument with statues and steps. Multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs frame the square, and a clock tower stands on a hill in the background. The printed caption at the top reads "Graz - Hauptplatz".

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a cobbled street lined with multi‑story buildings leading toward a large round stone tower with a conical roof. The printed caption in German at the top right reads "Freiberg i. Sa. Donatsgasse mit Donatsturm". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a country road leading toward a white church with a tall, narrow spire and arched windows. Fences line the road, and there are open fields and trees around the church. In the upper left corner, faint printed text identifies the church.

Black‑and‑white image of an indoor post office or parcel counter. A woman behind the counter is processing a parcel for two men in heavy coats and hats standing on the customer side; another man waits behind them. Parcels and letters are visible on the counter, and a large window reveals parked cars and a street outside. The clothing and interior style suggest a mid‑20th‑century European setting.

Sepia-toned interior view of a formal meeting or club room with a long table surrounded by ornately carved high‑back wooden chairs on a carpet. At the far wall there is a large white fireplace or decorative mantel. A samovar or large metal urn sits on a side table to the left. On the right side, tall multi-pane windows with a prominent column or pilaster between them admit light. A simple ceiling lamp hangs in the center. The lower margin of the image carries a caption in German.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a Spanish Mission–style building with multiple arches, bell niches, and a central tower. Numerous women in long dresses pose around the arches, balconies, and courtyard, suggesting a staged group portrait. The architecture features stucco walls, red-tile roofs, and ornamental bells. Printed captions and publisher information appear along the bottom and the left and right margins.

Black-and-white street scene showing a wide cobblestone avenue flanked by ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings with shops on the ground floor. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalks, some bicycles are parked or ridden, and there are store signs on both sides. At the bottom left, a printed caption reads "Sundsvall. Storgatan." indicating the location.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural village landscape with scattered farmhouses and larger houses set amidst trees and fields. A road bordered by trees runs along the right side, and low hills or a forest form the background. In the upper left corner, there is a printed caption in German identifying the place.

Sepia-toned street scene showing a busy urban square with many pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background stands a grand neoclassical theater-like building with ornate façade and statuary on the roof. Other multi‑story buildings line the street, and a horse‑drawn carriage is visible on the right. At the top of the image the caption reads in Cyrillic and Latin characters.

An old monochrome postcard showing a tall stone church with a square clock tower and steep spire topped by a cross. The church is surrounded by trees, a small fence, and nearby village houses. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the caption 'Mohorn. Kirche.'

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large multi‑storey baroque/neo‑classical complex with a courtyard and bare trees in the foreground. The building has dormer windows in the roof and two church-like towers with onion domes rising from the rear, indicating a religious institution combined with another function. At the bottom of the image there is a printed German caption.

A colorized historic postcard showing a tall, ornate brick lookout tower attached to a villa-like base building, surrounded by trees. The structure has crenellations, multiple turrets, and a steep roof. Printed German text at the top left mentions Karlsbad and the Kronprinzessin Stephanie-Warte with its elevation and tower height.

The image shows the reverse side of a mailed postcard. There is a red Lithuanian postage stamp with the word 'LIETUVA' and a postmark. The card is divided into an address section on the right and a message written in cursive on the left and bottom. The address is written in Latin script, and the message appears to be in Estonian. A date is written near the top of the message.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a line of box freight cars in the snow, loaded with supplies. Several uniformed men sit or stand in the open doors of the wagons, with one wagon marked by a Red Cross sign. On the left, a horse-drawn sled or cart is being unloaded, watched by men in long coats. Handwritten text appears across the upper part of the image, including a date of 1917.

Sepia-toned group portrait of about forty men, women, and children posed outdoors in front of a plain plastered stone building with a single multi-pane window. Most men wear suits and ties, women wear modest dresses and headscarves or hats. One man in front reclines on the grass holding a guitar, while some hats lie on the ground. The background shows a low stone wall and rough grass, with no visible printed caption on the image side.

The image shows a reproduction of a medieval wall fresco depicting a line of soldiers with tall, rectangular shields and spears marching to the right. The figures wear conical or rounded helmets and tunics in muted reds, ochres and greens. One shield bears wave-like patterns, another shows a stylized serpent or dragon. At the far left a figure in striped armor appears to confront or command the column. The style is flat and linear, typical of Romanesque Italian fresco painting.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a canal scene in Bruges with tall brick houses and gabled roofs lining the water. In the background the large belfry tower of Bruges (Belfort) rises above the buildings. Leafless trees and reflections in the canal are visible. French captions and publisher information are printed along the bottom margin.

Black-and-white postcard view of a quiet city street lined with mid‑20th‑century apartment buildings. Parked vintage cars stand along the right side of the cobbled road, with a sidewalk and old-style street lamps. In the distance, a church tower with a clock dominates the skyline. Trees frame the right edge. The text "VÄNERSBORG Kyrkogatan" appears in the lower-left corner, and the number "55577" appears in the lower-right corner.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a lakeside hotel with three stories and dormer windows labeled "HOTEL DE PLASMOLEN" on its facade. In the foreground, people are rowing small boats on a calm lake. Along the shore in front of the hotel, numerous people sit at outdoor tables and stroll by the water, with trees framing the scene. At the top in red print is a caption identifying the hotel and its location near Nijmegen.

Black-and-white postcard showing a small Byzantine stone church surrounded by a low metal fence in an urban setting. Behind it rise larger neoclassical and modern buildings. The foreground church has a tiled roof, arched windows, carved stone decorations, and a small dome. Printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom identify the site as a Byzantine church in Athens, dedicated to St. Eleutherios (also called Gorgoepikoos). A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right.

A monochrome postcard showing a brick façade with two large arched windows and, above them, two Gothic pointed arches filled with sculpted high‑relief scenes. A circular window with stone surround sits above the reliefs. The architecture appears medieval. Printed caption text runs along the bottom margin, with small vertical printing along the right edge and a star‑like printer's mark at the lower left.

Colorized historic view of a European city gate and street. Two round medieval stone towers with conical red roofs stand on either side of a main street lined with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings. A tall church or town‑hall spire rises in the background. Horse‑drawn carriages and early trams or carts are visible on the street. Handwritten text is in red and purple ink at the bottom left, and printed captions and publisher information appear along the lower edge.

A black‑and‑white view down a very narrow, old stone alley with steps in the middle. Tall, aged buildings rise on both sides with peeling plaster. Laundry hangs on lines high above the alley, including a large striped cloth that dominates the scene. An old-style street lamp is fixed to the wall near the steps. At the bottom and side of the stairs stand a few children or young people. Handwritten text appears at the lower left and printed website text at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white image of a long, austere four‑ to five‑story institutional building in a neo‑Renaissance / fortress style, with a crenellated roofline and evenly spaced windows. The façade faces a broad, nearly empty street with a sidewalk lined by small trimmed trees and a low fence. A few pedestrians walk along the street and there is a grassy area with simple fencing in the foreground. The image has the framing and composition typical of an early 20th‑century architectural postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a curving coastal road built along a rocky hillside covered with trees. The road follows the shoreline above calm water, with cliffs rising on the left and a bay or inlet on the right. A horse‑drawn carriage is visible on the road in the lower left. Printed text in Swedish appears at the top right.

A vintage postcard showing a large gun labeled "110 TON GUN" mounted on a concrete base on a grassy hilltop. In the foreground, a few people sit on benches behind a small fence, overlooking rolling green countryside with a winding road and a village in the distance. The image is printed in color, with extensive handwritten text covering the sky and margins. Near the top of the image, printed in red, is the title indicating the location near Brighton.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large multi-storey stone building with red-tiled roofs on a cobblestone street. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians stand in front of the structure. The architecture is late 19th–early 20th century European. Text in Russian and German at the top identifies the city as Mitau and indicates that the building houses the city savings bank and police administration.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a canal scene with a small passenger ship or boat sailing toward the viewer under (or just past) a raised bascule bridge. The canal is lined with trees, grassy banks, and rocks, and the water reflects the surrounding landscape. Text is printed along the bottom identifying the scene and the photographer/publisher.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town taken from a slightly elevated vantage point. In the foreground are cultivated fields or gardens with laundry hanging to dry and several people working. Beyond this, dense rows of tiled‑roof houses fill the middle ground. Two prominent church towers rise above the buildings: on the right, a Baroque onion‑dome tower with a weather vane; on the left, a tall Gothic spire from a large church on a hill. The background shows more scattered buildings and flat farmland stretching to the horizon. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a coastal city taken from the sea. Small sailing boats and ships are visible in the foreground, with low buildings and a hilly landscape in the background. Printed captions in French and Greek appear at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy cobblestoned street intersection in an early-20th‑century European city. Multi‑story neoclassical buildings with balconies line both sides of the street, a tram is visible on the left, and many pedestrians, soldiers, and townspeople stand or walk in the square. The image is framed with printed captions in French and English along the bottom, identifying the scene as Venizelos Street in Salonica during the First World War.

A monochrome printed postcard showing a drawn panoramic view of a small town with many low buildings, a church or taller structure, and a smokestack on gently rolling terrain. The image is framed by a light border. Under the image in German text it identifies the scene as a general view of Alt-Auz and gives the publisher's information from Berlin.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a mid‑20th‑century coastal cargo ship named TITAN sailing on relatively calm water under a dramatic cloudy sky. The vessel's profile, with its wheelhouse aft and cargo gear amidships, dominates the frame. Small flags fly from the mast near the stern.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a statue of Otto von Bismarck on a tall pedestal in a landscaped garden or park. The pedestal bears the inscription "FÜRST BISMARCK". Behind the monument stands a large historic gabled building with many small roof windows, identified as the Kornhaus. Trees and neatly arranged hedges and flowerbeds fill the foreground.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a coastal town and harbor taken from the water. Small boats lie in the bay, with wooden piers and low buildings along the waterfront. Behind them rises a rocky hillside densely built with houses, and at the highest point stands a large church with a tall spire dominating the skyline. The foreground is open water. The bottom left contains a printed caption, and the bottom right shows a small triangular publisher's logo with the number 1979 inside.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a tree-lined avenue with a landscaped garden and flowerbeds in the foreground, a tram or streetcar running along the road, and period buildings on the left side. Pedestrians stroll along the paths. At the bottom center of the image there is a caption reading "Nijmegen. Stationsweg."

A black‑and‑white group portrait of uniformed men posed in several rows in front of a building with large windows. Most appear to be soldiers in early–mid 20th‑century style field uniforms and peaked caps; a few in the front row wear darker dress or police‑style uniforms and kepis. They stand on or in front of a wooden bench against a plain exterior wall.

A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with substantial early‑20th‑century houses. In the left foreground is a villa with a rounded balcony supported by columns and a tiled roof. The street curves gently into the distance with sidewalks, fences, and more ornate townhouses and small trees along both sides. At the top in red Gothic-style print appears the place name and street: "Freiberg i. Sa. Weißbachstraße."

A black-and-white postcard showing a close-up of a fantastical stone chimera or gargoyle perched on the balustrade of a Gothic cathedral. The creature has wings and is grasping a wreath or cluster of stone berries while overlooking the cityscape in the hazy background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of cultivated fields in the foreground with a low townscape in the distance. On the right side stands a prominent church building with a tower and spire, identified as Antonius Kerk along the Groesbeekseweg. The layout and typography suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Text captions appear below the image, including the city name Nijmegen.

Colorized panoramic view of a coastal city with dense low-rise buildings topped by orange-tile roofs in the foreground, a busy commercial port with piers and cranes in the mid-ground, and a large sheltered bay surrounded by green hills and a central wooded peninsula or hill projecting into the water. The image has a white border like a vintage postcard. The only visible printed text is a small gray label in the bottom-left margin that reads 'Biblioteca de Galicia.'

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a steamship with two large smokestacks and lifeboats along the side, sailing in a harbor with piers and buildings visible in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a ship named "Isle of Thanet" in the channel at Calais. The layout, border, and printed caption suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a central European town street scene. Tall, narrow townhouses line a curved street leading toward a large building with a prominent clock tower and ornate gables. In the foreground is a small square with bare trees and pedestrians, and part of a church-like building on the right edge. At the top left, printed text reads "Döbeln i. S.", and on a storefront at street level the sign "Max Albrecht" is visible.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town at the foot of a steep, rocky mountain. The settlement has compact 2‑3 storey buildings with pitched roofs, streets and a bridge or road in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom read "Piatra N." on the left and "Muntele Petricia" on the right. The right margin of the card is filled with handwritten text in a cursive script.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a quiet park scene with a small pond, two swans swimming in the foreground, and a rustic wooden footbridge crossing the water. Dense trees and shrubs surround the pond. At the bottom center, printed caption text reads "St-NECTAIRE. – Un Coin du Parc" indicating the location as a corner of a park in Saint-Nectaire.

Black‑and‑white view over a small lake in a landscaped park. In the foreground and mid‑distance, people are rowing small boats on the water. On a tiny island stands a small pavilion or boathouse with a steep roof. On the far shore is a picturesque lakeside building with two domed corner towers and a veranda or terrace over the water, possibly a restaurant or pavilion. Behind it, on higher ground, rises a large rectangular brick building that looks like a theatre or cultural institution. To the far left, partly separated by trees, a tall, ornate clock‑ or bell‑tower dominates the skyline. The scene is framed by dense trees and appears to be an early‑20th‑century urban park. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view across a river and meadows toward a historic hilltop complex dominating a small town. The complex combines a massive Gothic cathedral with several high spires and adjoining castle‑like buildings. In the foreground are fields, a low plastered wall with a wooden door, and a few leafless or sparsely leaved trees. The town with traditional European houses lines the riverbank below the fortress. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing four carved wooden figures of men standing in a row against a plain backdrop. A red Swedish 15 öre stamp with the word "SVERIGE" is printed at the top. At the bottom center there is a small caption panel with Swedish text identifying the wood sculpture, the artist and photographer, and the town Ljungskile.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural railway station and a church with a tall clock tower and steep roof. A railway track curves in the foreground, with telegraph poles and a stone kilometer marker beside it. To the left stands a small station building labeled "SANZENO". On the right is a parish church with a prominent bell tower and a cross monument in front. The caption in Italian is printed in red along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small baroque church on a raised terrace with stairs leading up from the street. Leafless trees and bushes surround the church, and a solitary figure in dark clothing stands at the base of the stairs. The roof is steep with a small tower and onion-shaped spire. Printed caption text in German appears in the upper right.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the façade of a large Renaissance-style stone palazzo on a narrow street. The building has rusticated masonry on the ground floor, arched doorways and windows, and more ornate windows with decorative frames on the upper stories. At the bottom margin of the image there is an Italian caption identifying the place.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing an interior hall with a beamed wooden ceiling, smooth reflective floor, and walls decorated with large mural paintings separated by wooden doors. The image caption at the bottom identifies the location and room in French.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a festive street parade in front of multi‑story town buildings with shop signs in Cyrillic. Men, women, and children in traditional folk costumes march with musical instruments, large flags, and a placard reading "ЗАВЪТЪ". Crowds watch from the sidewalks, balconies, and open windows.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a large church with high vaulted ceilings, arched windows, wooden pews, an elevated pulpit with decorative drapery, and an ornate altar at the far end. Chandeliers hang from long cables. At the bottom right there is a small printed publisher's mark and caption text.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a wooden village store building behind a white picket fence. The central two‑storey house has a steep tiled roof and a sign above the entrance reading "Jømna Handelslag". Bicycles are leaned against the fence, telegraph poles and smaller outbuildings surround the main structure, and forested countryside is visible in the background. In the lower right corner the caption on the postcard reads "Jømna Handelslag" and beneath it a smaller line credits the photographer or printer.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing ruined waterfront buildings along a harbor. Many houses by the sea front appear burnt out, with missing roofs and damaged walls. In the background, numerous small boats and ships are visible on the water. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe the scene as ruined quay houses in Salonique/Salonica. A small website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural village scene with a prominent church featuring a tall, slender steeple and clock tower, surrounded by trees and a few houses. In the foreground is a grassy, slightly eroded riverbank or field where several people in early-20th‑century clothing stand or sit. The lower part of the card is left blank for writing, with red printed caption text and a red publisher's line at the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard depicting a monument of a reclining male figure on a high pedestal with a large dog sculpture in front. The statue stands in an outdoor setting with trees and a decorative fence in the background. The lower margin of the card contains a handwritten-style caption in German.

Sepia-toned postcard showing several large domed mausoleums and a minaret on the edge of a desert-like area. In the foreground, a man sits on the ground beside a saddled donkey. The architecture is Islamic, with ornate domes and arched openings. Printed caption text in French appears at the bottom, and there is a publisher mark on the right.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a stone monument of a man in traditional dress holding a sword above his head, standing on a tall ornate pedestal in a park or garden setting with trees in the background. The image is framed in an oval on a beige background, with printed captions in Greek and French at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph of a large seaside hotel or sanatorium on a hillside above a small harbor and stone pier. Several small boats lie in the water beside the quay, and low buildings sit along the waterfront. The image occupies the upper left portion of the card, while the lower and right margins are filled with dense handwritten correspondence in a cursive script. At the top right, printed in red type, is the word "Crikvenica."

Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a large, elongated farmhouse or inn with a tiled gabled roof and multiple arched windows, set on a gentle hillside with fields and sparse trees. A dirt road runs in front of the house, bordered by simple wooden posts and rails; a man in what looks like an early‑20th‑century uniform and cap walks along the road. A stone-lined ditch or small stream is visible in the foreground, and rolling fields and woodland rise behind the house. There is no obvious caption or decorative postcard frame on the front.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large corner brick apartment building with bay windows and a steep, complex roof at an intersection in an urban street. The street slopes downhill and is lined with similar multi‑story buildings, with a few pedestrians and a cyclist visible. Printed caption text appears below the image, along with some handwritten words.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view taken from a wooded hillside, looking down onto a small European village in a broad agricultural valley. The foreground is framed by tall, dark conifer trunks. Below lie compact houses with steep gabled roofs and farm outbuildings. A prominent church with a tower and onion‑shaped dome rises near the village center. Rolling fields, hedgerows, and scattered farmsteads extend into the distance, where another town with a tall church spire crowns a distant hill.

Monochrome vintage view of a European church with a tall tower and baroque-style cupola, seen from a park or village green with large leafless trees, dirt paths, and wooden benches and tables in the foreground. Traditional multi‑storey houses with steep roofs stand to the right of the church behind fences. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century rural or small‑town scene.

Black-and-white postcard view of a northern riverside town with low buildings in the distance under a sky filled with scattered clouds. In the foreground stands a metal road sign shaped like an arrow, indicating the distance to the Arctic Circle in several languages.

Sepia-toned vintage photograph showing two men in long dark coats and brimmed hats sitting on large mounds of ice along a frozen shoreline or lake. The surface around them is covered with ice and snow extending to the horizon, with no visible buildings or text, giving a stark winter seascape or lakescape appearance.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historicist building with ornate façade signage reading "AUTO HALLE" at the top and "Hotel Goldne Sonne" over the main arched entrance. Ground‑floor signs advertise theater, cinema (Kammer‑Lichtspiele), restaurant, café, and auto‑garage. A cobblestone square lies in front, with hedges and small trees enclosing the terrace. Behind and to the right rises a tall medieval‑looking tower and castle‑like structure on a hill, suggesting an old town setting.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand villa‑like building with ornate roofs and towers, labeled as Café Kaiserpark, set in landscaped gardens with a winding path and trees, backed by a forested hillside. The title "Karlsbad" appears at the top, suggesting a spa-town setting. Small red text at the bottom indicates the publisher.

A black-and-white vintage view of a wooden railway-station style building with ornate trim and a steep tiled roof. Several posters and signs are attached to the walls, and a couple of people stand or sit in front. Bushes and a tall flagpole rise on the right. The caption at the top left reads "Brumunddalen St." and a sign on the building itself reads "Brumunddalen." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century postcard photograph.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the ornate interior of a cathedral, with massive columns, carved stone arches, an elaborate chandelier above a richly decorated altar, and side pulpits and choir stalls. Italian text is printed beneath the image identifying the location as the cathedral interior in Spalato/Split, and the left margin bears the printer's credit.

Vintage black-and-white (sepia-toned) postcard view of a small European town in a valley. A large hilltop castle complex with a tall tower dominates the left side, overlooking clustered houses, narrow streets, and a winding road or rail line through the valley. Forested hills surround the settlement. The word "Weesenstein." is printed in red at the top left, and fine red vertical printer's text appears along the right edge.

An illustrated historical waterfront scene showing a round city gate tower with a red, conical roof and a large crane arm extending over the harbor. Sailing ships are moored beside the structure, and horse-drawn carts and people stand on the quay. To the left are old town buildings with gabled roofs. The image is oval-framed on a light background. Dutch captions printed below the image read "Oud Nijmegen." on the left and "de Kraanpoort" on the right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a statue of a seated man with crossed legs on a high pedestal, with a large dog sculpture lying on the lower step in front. The base of the monument bears an inscription in German. Trees and sky form the background. At the bottom margin, a caption in German identifies the location and monument.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large study hall filled with schoolboys seated at wooden desks, reading and writing under the supervision of a teacher. The room has high ceilings, hanging lamps, large windows and framed pictures on the walls. At the bottom of the image is a caption in Dutch identifying the location as St. Dominicus College and describing the study hall.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large fortified complex with round towers and crenellated walls, identified in the caption as Castello del Buon Consiglio. The castle dominates the left side, with a road and a horse-drawn cart in the foreground and mountains in the background. The design and wear suggest an early 20th-century postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large two‑storey school building with dormer windows and a central entrance. A long line of schoolchildren and a few adults stand in front of the building behind a fence. Leafless trees and a stone wall appear in the foreground, and a timber‑framed house is visible on the right. The caption at the top is printed in red German text, and there is a vertical publisher's line along the left edge.

Colorized historic postcard view of a street corner with a large multi‑story building labeled "Restaurant Hotel u. Ball-Säle Alberthof". The structure has a red-tiled roof, decorative gables, and a small tower with a dome. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk on a cobbled square, and a green electric tramcar passes in the foreground. Surrounding are additional town buildings and a slightly hilly, green background. The printed caption at the top identifies the location as Meißen and describes the hotel, ballrooms, and varieté theater "Alberthof".

Black‑and‑white winter night scene of a snowy street lined with trees heavily covered in frost and a long two‑storey commercial building with brightly lit shop windows. The text at the bottom identifies the location as Hamar and mentions 'Rimfrost'. Scandinavian lettering is visible on signage along the building.

Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate dining room prepared for a banquet. Two very long tables covered with white tablecloths run along both sides of a carpeted central aisle, each lined with wooden chairs with cane backs. Potted palms and flowering plants decorate the tables and corners of the room. The space features elaborate wooden sideboards and door frames, high ceilings with decorative plasterwork, a large central chandelier with floral glass shades, and tall curtained windows letting in bright light.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Renaissance-style town hall building dominating a market square. The façade has ornate gables, a clock, corner turrets, and many windows. In the foreground is a busy open-air market with numerous people, stalls, carts, and a fountain with a statue. The lower left margin has printed red text with the place name and subject, and production details and date are printed along the bottom edge.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a modernist building with a pronounced geometric roof and stone facade. There are large windows with awnings and a series of steps leading up to the entrance, flanked by potted plants and a sculpted reclining lion. A woman in mid-century clothing is descending the steps. A sign near the entrance reads 'OLYMPIA', suggesting the name of the building, possibly a hotel or restaurant.

A sepia-toned photograph of a large, classical-style building set behind a formal square or park, with a monument and flagpole prominently in the foreground. There are people visible in front of the building, and a tram or bus can be seen to the right side. The building appears institutional, likely a school or government facility. The text at the bottom left reads 'Pécs,' and at the bottom right, it says 'Fémipari szakiskola az orceágáseloval.'

The image is a sepia-toned, multi-view postcard featuring several landmarks and buildings. The central image shows three women walking among ancient stone ruins, framed by a large arched opening. The text at the bottom reads 'Üdvözlet Pécsről,' which is Hungarian.

A vintage black-and-white postcard shows a man seated on a bench in front of a stone structure, surrounded by tall trees in a forested area. The top right corner says 'Pécs.' and the area below the image reads 'Szaniszló-pihenő.' There are handwritten notes on the bottom part of the postcard.

A sepia-toned photograph of a grand church interior, featuring a central altar with elaborate steps leading up to a raised baldachin (canopy) structure. The church is richly decorated, with ornate columns, arches, chandeliers, and painted ceilings and walls. The architecture is Romanesque Revival or Neo-Romanesque, indicated by the rounded arches and heavy stonework. The photo is bordered, typical of vintage postcards, and there is a logo or insignia in the lower left corner.

A black and white photograph showing a central European city square with a large domed building in the foreground (right side), likely a former mosque, surrounded by a curved road and small park. To the left, a long, classical-style building with many windows is present. In the background, a cathedral with four distinctive towers rises above the city, with hills visible further back.

A multi-view postcard featuring several landmarks and cityscapes from Pécs. The images include a large cathedral with twin towers, a mosque with a tall minaret, a city square with classical buildings and a domed mosque, modern apartment blocks, and panoramic city views set against green hills. The word 'PÉCS' is prominently displayed in the center.

A vintage black and white postcard featuring five photographs of various landmarks in a European city. The central image shows a large cathedral with two towers. Other images display a public square with a domed building, a decorative fountain, an academic building with a flag, and a landscaped park with an ornate urn. Text in Hungarian is present above each image and at the bottom.

The postcard shows a historical black-and-white photograph of a public square or park area with a statue and a small domed building in the background. There is a large building with many windows and a passageway, with a group of people gathered, possibly for a parade or public event. The text on the postcard is in Hungarian.

The image shows a colorized, vintage view of a town from an elevated, grassy vantage point framed by two large trees. In the center, there is a panoramic view of red-roofed buildings, with a flat landscape in the background. At the top, there is a Hungarian postage stamp (10 Korona) and the printed word 'PÉCS.'

The image features a detailed porcelain or ceramic sculpture resembling a domed birdcage or beehive structure, with branches and small flowers intertwined. Atop the dome sits a realistic figure of an owl. The base is a matching plate with crackle glaze. The background is a plain, dark teal or greenish-blue color, with no visible text or inscriptions.

The image depicts a large, ornate building with distinctive architectural features, including steep, pointed roofs and decorative facades. There is a spired church on the left side of the image, and the foreground shows a busy street corner with people walking and a small kiosk. The overall style is reminiscent of early 20th-century Central European architecture. The photo is sepia-toned, suggesting it is from the early 1900s. The sign on the kiosk reads 'Péhndházi Szövetkezet,' which is Hungarian.

A black and white postcard showing the interior of a classroom or study room with wooden desks arranged in rows, a teacher's desk at the front, and framed portraits on the walls. The room appears old-fashioned, and there is a vase with flowers on a table in the foreground. The caption on the bottom is in Hungarian.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a bustling street scene with a prominent baroque-style church in the center, surrounded by classical buildings. People in early 20th-century attire walk along the street. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location in both Hungarian and German.

The image shows a vintage, sepia-toned photograph of a large classroom or study hall with rows of wooden tables and chairs arranged in an orderly fashion. There are pianos and cabinets along the walls, and the room is decorated with plants and pictures. The architecture and furniture style suggest an early 20th-century European setting. The caption text is printed in a serif typeface beneath the image.

The image shows an old, hand-tinted postcard depicting a corner building with elaborate architectural details, including ornate windows and a domed corner tower. The street is nearly empty and leads towards a church or tower with a red roof in the background. There is printed text on the upper left and right corners.

A sepia-toned image of an ornate historic building, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century, with carts and people on the street in front. The architecture features decorative facades, arched windows, and a prominent dome. Hungarian text is visible in the upper left and above several shopfronts.

A black-and-white image showing a large crowd gathered on a city street, with buildings decorated with flags and bunting. An oversized flag (possibly French or German based on the stripes) is prominently displayed in the center, and people are visible on balconies and at windows. The street is bustling, possibly during a parade or public event. The word 'GERARD' is visible on one of the buildings.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a large Gothic church with a prominent clock tower, situated among the red-tiled rooftops of a European town. In the background, there is a tree-covered hill, and pine branches partially obscure the foreground. The postcard has no visible printed or handwritten text on its front side.

The image is a vintage, monochrome postcard showing a bustling town square with numerous horse-drawn carriages and people in period dress. The background features a large Gothic-style church with prominent buttresses and a spire, surrounded by classic European buildings with gabled roofs and multiple windows. The words 'KRONSTADT.' and 'MARKTPLATZ.' are printed at the bottom edges of the postcard.

The image shows a young man in a military uniform standing outdoors, leaning against a tree. The photo is sepia-toned and appears to be old, likely from the early to mid-20th century. The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of a festive parade. A wagon festooned with foliage is being drawn by oxen through a city street. A sepia-toned postcard showing a historical cityscape dominated by a large Gothic church with a tall clock-tower, surrounded by traditional European buildings and backed by forested hills. The text at the bottom includes 'Kronstadt' and 'Brassó', with a publisher's mark.

The postcard depicts the interior of a restaurant, likely built into or adjacent to a rocky cave wall. A sepia-toned portrait photograph of a young man with neatly combed hair, wearing a suit and tie, looking slightly to his left. The photograph is bordered by a blank margin, typical of vintage postcards or studio portrait cards.

A vintage, hand-colored postcard image depicting a central European old town scene. The foreground features an ornate iron pedestrian bridge. A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a quiet street leading to a church with a prominent tower and spire. Trees line the street and there are a few people visible in the background. The image is a colorized photograph showing a wide street lined with historic European-style buildings. The image depicts an old sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate building with arched windows and classical architectural details. A black-and-white photograph showing a person standing next to a large, irregularly shaped rock formation. The image shows a rocky shoreline with gentle waves lapping at the coast. The sun is setting or rising, casting a golden hue over the scene.
